meaning: art. 一；任一；每一
definition: 1. used before a singular countable noun when referring to one unspecified item or any member of a class
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: "Ha!" It was a cross between a laugh and a bark.
exampleZh: “哈！”那是一种一半是笑一半是厉声喊叫的混杂声。

meaning: v. 抛弃，遗弃；（因危险）离开，舍弃；中止，不再有；放弃（信念、信仰或看法）；陷入，沉湎于（某种情感）；n. 放任，放纵
definition: 1. n. the trait of lacking restraint or control; reckless freedom from inhibition or worry；2. v. forsake, leave behind
example: Many want to abandon the multilateral trade talks in Geneva.
exampleZh: 许多国家想要放弃在日内瓦的多边贸易会谈。

meaning: n. 缩略词，缩写形式；缩略，缩写
definition: 1. a short form of a word or phrase；2. a shortened form esp. of a word or phrase
example: Remember, all you have to do is fill in the one or two-letter abbreviation for the chemical symbol.
exampleZh: 记住，你们只要,用一两个字母的缩写,来代表化学元素就可以了。

meaning: v. 遵守（abide by）；容忍，忍受；居住，逗留；（感情，记忆）始终不渝，持续
definition: 1. If you can't abide someone or something, you dislike them very much；2. to live or stay somewhere
example: And infinite numbers of countries sign and ratify them and say "Yes, we will abide by them".
exampleZh: 无数的国家,签署了公约，批准其生效，表明：,“是的，我们会遵守公约条款“

meaning: adj. 能够，有能力的；聪明能干的，精通（某事）的；【名】 （Able）（英）埃布尔，（伊朗）阿布勒（人名）
definition: 1. adj. (usually followed by `to') having the necessary means or skill or know-how or authority to do something；2. adj. have the skills and qualifications to do things well
example: So with his optic glass, his telescope, Galileo was able to discern spots on the orb of the moon.
exampleZh: 因此通过他的磁光玻璃，望远镜，伽利略能够分辨出月亮轨道上的斑点。

meaning: n. 能力，能够；才能，技能，本领
definition: 1. n. the quality of being able to perform; a quality that permits or facilitates achievement or accomplishment；2. n. possession of the qualities (especially mental qualities) required to do something or get something done
example: and I really liked, you know, the material and I felt like I had the natural ability for it,
exampleZh: 我很喜欢课堂上接触到的那些会计知识，而且我感觉我在这方面有天赋。

meaning: adj. 反常的，异常的，变态的；不规则的
definition: 1. different from what is usual or average, especially in a way that is bad；2. not usual or average
example: The abnormal bleeding is your body's own red flag of danger.
exampleZh: 这反常的流血是你身体本身的危险信号。

meaning: adv. 在（船、飞机、火车等）上；上（船、飞机、火车等）；骑在（马）上，跨上（马）；（棒球）在垒上；加入，加盟；prep. 在（船、飞机、火车等）上；上（船、飞机、火车等）；骑在（马）上
definition: 1. adv. on a ship, train, plane or other vehicle；2. adv. on first or second or third base
example: As the ship berthed in New York, McClintock was with the first immigration officers aboard.
exampleZh: 当那艘轮船停泊在纽约时，麦克林托克正和第一批上船的移民官员们在船上。

meaning: v. 废除，废止，取消
definition: 1. v. do away with
example: An Illinois House committee voted Thursday to abolish the death penalty.
exampleZh: 伊利诺伊州议院的一个委员会在星期四投票废除了死刑。

meaning: n. （法律、制度、习俗等的）废除，废止；（特指）奴隶制的废除
definition: 1. n. the act of abolishing a system or practice or institution (especially abolishing slavery)
example: Islanders have campaigned for the abolition of one of the three tiers of municipal power on the island.
exampleZh: 岛民们已经发起了运动，要废除该岛3级市政权力中的1级。

meaning: v. （使）流产，堕（胎）；（由于问题或故障）中止，使夭折；（胚胎器官，有机体）发育不全，败育；n. （飞行、航天任务或其他事业的）中断，取消；夭折的计划（或事业）
definition: 1. to cause something to stop or fail before it begins or before it is complete；2. to stop the development of a baby that has not been born, usually by having a medical operation
example: "In growth," the Master concluded, "you cannot speed the process up. All you can do is abort it."
exampleZh: “关于成长，”这位大师总结道，“你无法加快这个过程，你能做的只有中止它。”

meaning: n. 流产，堕胎；失败；（生）（器官，尤其是种子或水果的）败育，停止发育；流产的胎儿
definition: 1. the intentional ending of a pregnancy；2. the early, unintentional ending of a pregnancy when a baby or young animal is born too early and dies before it is fully developed
example: And a lot of people think that, you know, that qualifies as murder or abortion and they're opposed to that.
exampleZh: 许多人认为，那样做的性质等于谋杀或者堕胎，所以他们反对。

meaning: adv. 大约；几乎；到处，各处；无所事事；周围，在……附近；无序地，凌乱地；朝相反方向；prep. 关于，对于；目的是；针对（问题）；忙于，从事于；对……表示（情绪或心态）；各处，四下；在……附近；（某人或某事物）具有（某种特性）；围绕；adj. 现成的，能得到的；即将（做……）的，快要（发生……）的 （be about to do sth.）；四处走动的；【名】 （About）（法）艾保特（姓氏）
definition: 1. adj. on the move；2. adv. (of quantities) imprecise but fairly close to correct
example: so it's all about, it's sort of about the struggles and it's about faith and it's about destiny, so
exampleZh: 所以，它全部是关于挣扎、信仰和宿命的。所以

meaning: prep. （数量或度量）在……以上，超过；在（或向）……上面；（级别或地位上）高于； （重要性、质量）超过，胜过；（因善良或诚实正直而）不至于，不屑于（做某事）；（声音）比……更响亮，盖过；不受……影响，免于；（重要性、质量）超过，胜过；adv. （级别或地位上）高于；在（或向）上面，在（或向）较高处；高于，超出（特定数量、比率或标准）；上文，前文；adj. 前文述及的，上述的；n. 上文提及之事，前文所提之事（the above）
definition: 1. n. an earlier section of a written text；2. adj. appearing earlier in the same text
example: He separates the waters above and the waters below and creates this space that will become the inhabited world.
exampleZh: 他将天上的水和地上的水分离开来,开创了这个将被居住的世界。

meaning: adv. 并排，并肩，并列；了解（最新情况），跟上（最新进展）；adj. 并排的，并肩的，并列的；及时了解……的
definition: 1. used to say that two or more people are next to each other and moving in the same direction；2. to make sure you know all the most recent facts about a subject or situation
example: My main reason for subscribing to New Scientist is to keep abreast of advances in science.
exampleZh: 我订阅《新科学家》的主要原因是要跟上科学的进步。

meaning: adv. 在国外，到国外；在室外，到室外； 广为流传，广为人知；行动自由； 未击中目标，出错；n. 外国
definition: 1. adj. in a foreign country；2. adv. to or in a foreign country
example: so being interested in the wider world and what's going on abroad as well as here in the UK.
exampleZh: 以便于让孩子们对更广阔的世界，像国外和英国本土发生的事情感兴趣。

meaning: adj. 突然的，意外的；粗鲁的，唐突的，（言语）生硬的；险峻的，陡峭的；（讲话或写作风格）不流畅的，不连贯的
definition: 1. sudden and unexpected, and often unpleasant；2. using too few words when talking, in a way that seems rude and unfriendly
example: In this worldview, institutions--human institutions evolve only slowly over time and cannot be altered by abrupt human interventions.
exampleZh: 在这个世界观里,制度尤其人文制度,发展得非常缓慢,而且不会被突然的人为干预改变

meaning: adj. 缺勤的，缺席的；不存在的，缺乏的；心不在焉的，出神的；不与子女一起住的；prep. 缺乏，没有；v. 缺席，离开
definition: 1. v. go away or leave；2. adj. not in a specified place physically or mentally
example: I mean, you would expect that the group one, absent hydrogen, would be the ones that would have the least.
exampleZh: 我想，你们可能认为第一主族，没有氢，而氢应该是最小的。

meaning: n. 缺席，缺勤，不在；缺乏，没有；缺席期间，休假期间；不注意
definition: 1. n. the state of being absent；2. n. failure to be present
example: Purity, which is the absence of impurity, is a prerequisite for access to the holy or for holy status.
exampleZh: 纯洁，不纯的反义词，是接近神圣或达到神圣状态的先决条件。

meaning: adj. 完全的，纯粹的；绝对的，无疑的；十足的；不受任何限制的，专制独裁的；（结构）独立的；n. 绝对真理，绝对原则
definition: 1. n. something that is conceived to be absolute; something that does not depends on anything else and is beyond human control；2. adj. perfect or complete or pure
example: C So, that's the breakdown. And, the grade is C level, 50% and it's based upon a performance of 50% absolute.
exampleZh: 这些就是分类，分数是，那就是基于成绩的。

meaning: v. 吸收；使并入，纳入；同化，汲取；消减，缓冲（外力、震动等）；理解，掌握（信息）；使全神贯注，使专心；承受（变革、影响等），承担（费用等）；花掉（大量金钱），耗费
definition: 1. v. become imbued；2. v. take up mentally
example: Black walls absorb a lot of heat during the day.
exampleZh: 黑色墙壁在白天吸收大量的热。

meaning: n. (液体、气体等的)吸收；吸纳，同化；专注，着迷；（液体、气体等的）吸收
definition: 1. n. (chemistry) a process in which one substance permeates another; a fluid permeates or is dissolved by a liquid or solid；2. n. (physics) the process in which incident radiated energy is retained without reflection or transmission on passing through a medium
example: Vitamin D is necessary to aid the absorption of calcium from food.
exampleZh: 从食物中吸取钙需靠维生素D的帮助。

meaning: adj. 抽象的，纯概念的；（艺术）抽象派的；理论上的，不切实际的；n. 摘要，梗概；抽象画，抽象派艺术作品；抽象的概念；v. 抽象化，从理论上（或孤立地）考虑；提取，使分离；写……的摘要；偷走，窃取；退出
definition: 1. n. a concept or idea not associated with any specific instance；2. v. consider a concept without thinking of a specific example; consider abstractly or theoretically
example: It's not a question of some abstract concept of justice.
exampleZh: 这不是一个有关正义的某一抽象概念的问题。

meaning: adj. 愚蠢的，荒谬的；滑稽可笑的；荒诞派的；n. 荒诞，荒诞的事物 （the absurd）
definition: 1. stupid and unreasonable, or silly in a humorous way；2. things that happen that are stupid or unreasonable
example: The accusation is absurd, and Milton knew it was absurd, but he loves the attack nonetheless.
exampleZh: 这个控告是荒谬的，弥尔顿自己也知道，但他喜欢这些抨击。

meaning: n. 荒谬，荒唐；荒谬的言行
definition: 1. the quality of being stupid and unreasonable, or silly in a humorous way；2. something that is stupid or unreasonable
example: It was only later that she could see the absurdity of the situation.
exampleZh: 直到后来她才看出了那种局面的荒唐。

meaning: adj. 大量的，丰富的，充足的
definition: 1. adj. present in great quantity
example: What I want you to remember now is that abundant cell proliferation takes place during development.
exampleZh: 这节课我希望你能记住,发育过程中伴有大量的细胞增殖过程

meaning: n. 大量，丰富；繁荣，富裕；数量，丰度；（纸牌惠斯特用语）独得九墩
definition: 1. n. the property of a more than adequate quantity or supply；2. n. (physics) the ratio of the number of atoms of a specific isotope of an element to the total number of isotopes present
example: This area of Mexico has an abundance of safe beaches and a pleasing climate.
exampleZh: 墨西哥的这个地区有大量的安全沙滩与宜人的气候。

meaning: v. 虐待；滥用，辜负；辱骂；糟蹋（某物）；性侵犯；n. 虐待，凌辱；滥用，妄用；辱骂；舞弊，腐败；糟蹋；性侵犯；恶习，陋习；【名】 （Abuse）（英）阿比斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. cruel or inhumane treatment；2. v. treat badly
example: Will not even philosophers, one might ask, given the possibility of absolute power ? be tempted to abuse their positions?
exampleZh: 难道哲学家，有人可能问到，如果他们拥有绝对的力量时,难道不会想要滥用职权吗？

meaning: adj. 辱骂的，侮辱的；凌辱的，虐待的；受虐待的；舞弊的，不法的；滥用的
definition: 1. adj. expressing offensive reproach；2. adj. characterized by physical or psychological maltreatment
example: That's especially true of children who remain in abusive homes bemuse the law blindly favors biological parents.
exampleZh: 这一点对于那些在虐待家庭中长大的孩子来说尤其如此，法律盲目偏袒他们的亲生父母让他们感到困惑。

meaning: n. 专科院校；研究院，学会；（美国的）私立学校；（苏格兰的）中等学校
definition: 1. n. a secondary school (usually private)；2. n. an institution for the advancement of art or science or literature
example: The academy is far more inclusive now than it used to be.
exampleZh: 该学院如今比过去更为兼收并蓄。

meaning: adj. 学业的，学术的；学校的，学院的；学业（成绩）优秀的，善于学习的；不切实际的，空谈的；n. 大学教师，学者；（学校或学院的）课程；大学生
definition: 1. n. an educator who works at a college or university；2. adj. associated with academia or an academy
example: We are an Ivy League school and we are a really, um, you know, high tier academic institution.
exampleZh: 布朗大学属于常春藤联盟，是顶尖的学术研究机构。

meaning: n. 学会会员，院士；学者，知识分子；大学教师
definition: 1. n. someone elected to honorary membership in an academy；2. n. a scholar who is skilled in academic disputation
example: This kind of resources has also a certain influence on the academic evaluation for the academician candidates.
exampleZh: 这种资源对院士候选人的学术评价也产生了一定的影响。

meaning: v. （使）加快，促进；（车辆或驾驶者）加速
definition: 1. v. move faster；2. v. cause to move faster
example: They take an atom of lead, accelerate it and have it collide with an atom of nickel.
exampleZh: 他们选取一个铅原子，将其加速,让它与镍的原子碰撞。

meaning: n. 加速，加快；（车辆）加速能力，加速幅度；加速度
definition: 1. n. an increase in rate of change；2. n. the act of accelerating; increasing the speed
example: Now, gravity, well force, is equal to mass times acceleration, g and the acceleration due to gravity is g.
exampleZh: 是重力，等于质量乘以加速度，由重力导致的加速度是。

meaning: n. 口音，腔调，土音；着重点，强调；重音；（字母上的）读音符号；点缀，特色；v. 强调，突出；重读；以重音演奏
definition: 1. n. distinctive manner of oral expression；2. v. to stress, single out as important
example: But, obviously, it's the matter of adjusting to the accent. So that'll be my advice, I think.
exampleZh: 但是，显然地，这就是适应重口音的问题。所以，我想那就是我的建议。

meaning: v. 接受，收受；同意，赞成；相信，认为……正确；忍受，容忍；吸纳，招收；接纳；承担（责任等），承认；承兑，认付（单据等）；不排斥；适配
definition: 1. v. consider or hold as true；2. v. receive willingly something given or offered
example: Great. Yup, it's going to be an electron acceptor, it wants to accept electrons, it wants to accept electron density.
exampleZh: 很好，没错，它将是一个电子的受主，它想要接收电子，接收电子密度。

meaning: n. 接受；赞同，认可；容忍；接纳；相信，承认
definition: 1. n. the mental attitude that something is believable and should be accepted as true；2. n. the act of accepting with approval; favorable reception
example: Israel's acceptance of a relationship with God doesn't stem from mystical introspection, or philosophical speculation, Levenson says.
exampleZh: 犹太人接受与上帝的关系并不来自于,神秘的内省，或者是出于投机心理，Levenson说。

meaning: adj. 可接受的，（大多数人）认同的；合意的，令人满意的；尚可的，勉强的；可容忍的，可允许的
definition: 1. adj. worthy of acceptance or satisfactory；2. adj. judged to be in conformity with approved usage
example: The boy might instead kick the dog and think he hates the dog because that's a more acceptable target.
exampleZh: 孩子可能会去踢狗，觉得狗很可恨,因为狗是可以接受的替代性目标。

meaning: n. 入口，通道；获得的机会，使用权；（对计算机存储器的）访问，存取；（情感）爆发，发作；探视权；v. 接近，进入；获取，访问（计算机信息）；adj. （电视节目或时间等）对外公开的
definition: 1. n. the right to enter；2. v. obtain or retrieve from a storage device; as of information on a computer
example: With them she can occupy all these different roles, and in doing so she has access to certain kinds of knowledge.
exampleZh: 通过这些她可以，扮演各种各样的角色，也可以让她，获得某种知识。

meaning: adj. 可到达的，可进入的；易得到的，可使用的；可以理解的，易懂的；平易近人的，随和的；易受影响的
definition: 1. adj. capable of being reached；2. adj. capable of being read with comprehension
example: And so it is very accessible to everyone that wants to sort of experience that aspect of the culture.
exampleZh: 所以人人都有机会去体验那种文化。

meaning: n. 附件，配件；装饰品，配饰；同谋，从犯；adj. 辅助的，副的；附属的；同谋的
definition: 1. something added to a machine or to clothing that has a useful or decorative purpose；2. someone who helps another person to commit a crime but does not take part in it
example: The company serves the national automotive aftermarket with a broad range of accessory and recreational-vehicle products.
exampleZh: 该公司为全国机动车售后市场提供各种配件和休闲车产品。

meaning: n. 交通事故，车祸；（不幸的）意外遭遇，不测事件；意外，偶然的事；运气，机遇；大便（或小便）失禁；（亚里士多德思想中的）非本质属性
definition: 1. n. a mishap; especially one causing injury or death；2. n. anything that happens by chance without an apparent cause
example: In fact, you'll find the probability of this happening 3% is only about 3 percent, of it happening just by accident.
exampleZh: 实际上你会发现,出现这种情况的概率是，所以说他们的实验结果完全是偶然的。

meaning: adj. 意外的，偶然的；非主要的，附带的；（亚里士多德思想中的）非本质属性的；临时记号的；n. 临时记号；次要方面，非主要的特性
definition: 1. n. a musical notation that makes a note sharp or flat or natural although that is not part of the key signature；2. adj. associated by chance and not an integral part
example: At least 10 000 children are involved in accidental poisonings every year.
exampleZh: 每年至少有1万名儿童意外中毒。

meaning: v. 赞扬，称赞，为……喝彩；n. 赞扬，称誉，高度评价
definition: 1. public approval and praise；2. to give public approval and praise
example: Elgar received many honours and much acclaim and yet he often considered himself a failure.
exampleZh: 埃尔加获得了很多荣誉和欢呼，但是他常常把自己看成一个失败者。

meaning: v. 为……提供住宿；容纳，提供空间；考虑到，顾及；顺应，适应；帮助（某人），向……施以援手；迎合，迁就；调解
definition: 1. v. be agreeable or acceptable to；2. v. make fit for, or change to suit a new purpose
example: The school was not big enough to accommodate all the children.
exampleZh: 学校没有足够的地方容纳所有的学生。

meaning: n. 住宿，膳宿；住处，办公处，停留处；（楼房或交通工具内的）空间，座位；和解，调和；（通过改变眼球晶状体形状）自动调焦
definition: 1. n. making or becoming suitable; adjusting to circumstances；2. n. a settlement of differences
example: And they did this through two sorts of mechanisms: assimilation and accommodation.
exampleZh: 而这一过程可以通过两种机制实现,同化和顺应

meaning: v. 陪伴，陪同；伴随，与……一起发生；为……伴奏（或伴唱）；附带，补充
definition: 1. v. be associated with；2. v. go or travel along with
example: Ken agreed to accompany me on a trip to Africa.
exampleZh: 肯同意陪我去非洲旅行。

meaning: v. 完成，实现
definition: 1. v. put in effect；2. v. to gain with effort
example: If we'd all work together, I think we could accomplish our goal.
exampleZh: 如果我们齐心协力，我想我们能实现我们的目标。

meaning: n. 成就，成绩；技能，才艺；完成，实现
definition: 1. n. the action of accomplishing something；2. n. an ability that has been acquired by training
example: Well, we all think accomplishment's important, but it's not as though any old accomplishment is important.
exampleZh: 我们都认为成就是很重要的，但不是所有旧的成就都是重要的。

meaning: n. 协议，条约；符合，一致；v. 使受到，给予（某种待遇）；（与……）一致，符合
definition: 1. n. harmony of people's opinions or actions or characters；2. v. go together
example: He did not quit as France's prime minister of his own accord.
exampleZh: 他不是自愿地辞去法国总理一职的。

meaning: n. 按照，依据，与……一致（in accordance with）
definition: 1. n. concurrence of opinion；2. n. the act of granting rights
example: I live in accordance with certain priorities as I have to confront them.
exampleZh: 我按照某些优先级来生活，因为我必须面对它们。

meaning: 根据：表示根据某人或某事的陈述、说法或信念。；按照：表示按照某个标准、规则或方法。；据……所述：表示根据某人的陈述或说法。
definition: 1. as stated or reported by a person, document, or source
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: According to the latest survey, most students prefer flexible schedules to fixed daily routines.
exampleZh: 最新调查显示，多数学生更喜欢灵活的时间安排，而不是固定的日常作息。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: adv. 相应地，照着；因此，所以
definition: 1. adv. (sentence connectors) because of the reason given；2. adv. in accordance with
example: The cost of materials rose sharply last year. Accordingly, we were forced to increase our prices.
exampleZh: 去年材料成本大幅度提高，因此我们被迫加价。

meaning: n. 账户，户头；客户，老主顾；网络账号；描述，报道；账目；账单；赊购账，赊购；理由，解释；重要性；（定期结付的）交易合同；演奏（音乐）；账期交易期；v. 把……视作，认为；解释，说明（account for）；占（一定数量或比例）（account for）；报账
definition: 1. n. a formal contractual relationship established to provide for regular banking or brokerage or business services；2. v. be the sole or primary factor in the existence, acquisition, supply, or disposal of something
example: It should further be noted that in the first creation account, in any kind of unequal relationship before God.
exampleZh: 我们还应该注意第一个创世故事中的描述，说他们在上帝面前有不平等的关系。

meaning: n. 会计，会计学；会计工作，会计职业（=accountancy）；账单；v. 解释，说明；占（一定数量或比例）（account 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. a convincing explanation that reveals basic causes；2. n. a system that provides quantitative information about finances
example: Most large companies now use computers for accounting and housekeeping operations.
exampleZh: 多数大公司现在用计算机进行会计运算和内务操作。

meaning: n. 会计，会计师
definition: 1. n. someone who maintains and audits business accounts
example: Um, definitely, I think on average an accountant is considered to be, you know, a bean counter,
exampleZh: 当然，我觉得会计师常被认为是精打细算的人，

meaning: n. 会计学，会计工作，会计行业
definition: 1. n. the occupation of maintaining and auditing records and preparing financial reports for a business
example: I might just have to review a few accountancy terms.
exampleZh: 我可能只需要复习一些会计术语。

meaning: adj. 负有责任的，应作解释的；可理解的
definition: 1. adj. liable to account for one's actions
example: Public officials can finally be held accountable for their actions.
exampleZh: 政府官员最终是要对他们的行为负责任的。

meaning: n. 责任，责任心，可说明性
definition: 1. n. responsibility to someone or for some activity
example: That I think is a real virtue but it can come at the price of demanding short term accountability.
exampleZh: 我认为这是个优点，但是可能会,付出短期责任的代价。

meaning: v. 积累，积攒
definition: 1. v. get or gather together；2. v. collect or gather
example: It was his ambition to accumulate a million dollars before he turned thirty.
exampleZh: 他的雄心是在30岁以前积攒100万美元。

meaning: n. 积累，堆积；堆积物，堆积量
definition: 1. n. an increase by natural growth or addition；2. n. several things grouped together or considered as a whole
example: And whether the community's work contributes much to an overall accumulation of knowledge is doubtful.
exampleZh: 社区的工作对知识的全面积累是否有很大的贡献，这一点是值得怀疑的。

meaning: adj. 累积的，逐渐增加的
definition: 1. adj. increasing by successive addition；2. adj. marked by acquiring or amassing
example: This paper is a large part of your accumulative grade, so make sure to follow the instructions.
exampleZh: 这篇论文在你的总成绩中占很大一部分，所以一定要按照说明去做。

meaning: adj. 准确的，精确的；（工具，方法）精密的；正确无误的；（武器、投掷）精准的
definition: 1. adj. conforming exactly or almost exactly to fact or to a standard or performing with total accuracy；2. adj. (of ideas, images, representations, expressions) characterized by perfect conformity to fact or truth ; strictly correct
example: One problem is that they're not always accurate and there's a couple of factors that could lead them away from accuracy.
exampleZh: 其中一个问题就是它们并不总是准确的,有几个因素,能减低它们的准确性。

meaning: n. 准确性，精确性；准确，精确
definition: 1. n. the quality of being near to the true value；2. n. (mathematics) the number of significant figures given in a number
example: Then, once you've done that, once you have secured the integrity and accuracy of the meaning, Hirsch says, "Okay, fine.
exampleZh: 在你完成那个之后，一旦你确定了意思的真实性和准确性，赫施说，好的，不错。

meaning: v. 控告，指控；指责，谴责，归咎于
definition: 1. v. bring an accusation against; level a charge against；2. v. blame for, make a claim of wrongdoing or misbehavior against
example: Politicians accuse the media of talking up the possibility of a riot.
exampleZh: 政客们谴责媒体夸大骚乱的可能性。

meaning: n. 控告，指责，谴责；（尚未证实的被控告的）罪名，罪状
definition: 1. n. a formal charge of wrongdoing brought against a person; the act of imputing blame or guilt；2. n. an assertion that someone is guilty of a fault or offence
example: I don't want to make an accusation until I have some proof.
exampleZh: 我要有一些证据以后才提出控告。

meaning: v. 使习惯于，使适应于
definition: 1. v. make psychologically or physically used (to something)
example: You should run hard enough at the end to accustom your body to the late-race fatigue of the marathon.
exampleZh: 你应该在将近结束时跑得卖力一点，以使你的身体适应马拉松比赛时后期的疲惫感。

meaning: adj. 习惯的，适应的；惯常的，通常的；（眼睛对光线变化）习惯了的，适应了的；v. 使习惯于，使适应（accustom 的过去式和过去分词）
definition: 1. adj. (often followed by `to') in the habit of or adapted to；2. adj. commonly used or practiced; usual
example: She was a person accustomed to having eight hours' sleep a night.
exampleZh: 她是那种习惯每晚睡八个小时的人。

meaning: n. （扑克牌中的）A牌；擅长……的人，一流高手；（网球中的）发球得分，爱司球；（击落多架敌机的）王牌飞行员；（高尔夫）一杆进洞；adj. 一流的；极好的；v. 在……中取得好成绩；（网球或排球）发球得分；胜过；（在高尔夫球比赛中）一杆进穴，一杆得分；【名】 （Ace）（英、美、克）埃斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. the smallest whole number or a numeral representing this number；2. v. succeed at easily
example: He knows something about the boss, which is his ace in the hole.
exampleZh: 他对老板有所了解，这是他的王牌。

meaning: v. （隐隐地、持续地）疼痛；渴望；哀痛，怜悯；n. （身体某部位的）疼痛；（心中的）苦痛，痛苦；渴望； 渴望；【名】 （Ache）（美、法、印尼）阿切（人名）
definition: 1. n. a dull persistent (usually moderately intense) pain；2. v. feel physical pain
example: My head had begun to ache and my stomach felt funny.
exampleZh: 我的头开始疼了，我的胃也感到不对劲。

meaning: v. （经努力）达到，取得，实现；获得成功
definition: 1. v. to gain with effort
example: It must struggle against events which would help to achieve its goal too rapidly--by a kind of short-circuit.
exampleZh: 它会在危险中挣扎,因为危险会太早把它带到终点。

meaning: n. 成绩，成就；完成，实现；（纹章）纹章牌
definition: 1. n. the action of accomplishing something
example: The people who were primed, subconsciously with words related to achievement, did better on tests than control group.
exampleZh: 受到影射的人，用与“成就“有关的词进行潜意识影射的人，测试结果比对照组好。

meaning: n. 酸；迷幻药；尖刻（或尖酸）的言语（或语调）；质子供体，电子对受体；adj. 酸的；酸性的；尖酸的，刻薄的；（颜色）刺目的，鲜亮的；（岩石，尤指熔岩）含相当量硅石的
definition: 1. n. any of various water-soluble compounds having a sour taste and capable of turning litmus red and reacting with a base to form a salt；2. adj. harsh or corrosive in tone
example: So just keep in mind when you do see the chlorine in these drugs, it's very different from the acid chloride.
exampleZh: 因此只要记住当你在这些药物中发现氯的时候，它不会是酰氯就好了。

meaning: n. 酸度；（言辞的）尖酸；酸性；胃酸过多
definition: 1. n. the property of being acidic；2. n. the taste experience when something acidic is taken into the mouth
example: As acidity is characteristic of the unripe mango so is abuse of the immature critic.
exampleZh: 正如酸涩是未熟的芒果的特征一样，谩骂是不成熟的批评家的特点。

meaning: v. 承认；认可； 跟……打招呼，理会；告知收到；（公开）感谢
definition: 1. v. declare to be true or admit the existence or reality or truth of；2. v. report the receipt of
example: I did not acknowledge that he had done anything wrong.
exampleZh: 我没有承认他犯了什么错。

meaning: n. 承认；感谢；（作者的）致谢；回执；（表示注意到了某人或某事的）示意
definition: 1. n. the state or quality of being recognized or acknowledged；2. n. a statement acknowledging something or someone
example: This report is an acknowledgement of the size of the problem.
exampleZh: 这个报告承认了问题的严重性。

meaning: v. 使熟悉，使了解
definition: 1. v. cause to come to know personally；2. v. make familiar or acquainted
example: Have steps been taken to acquaint breeders with their right to apply for licenses?
exampleZh: 已经采取措施让饲养动物者了解他们申请执照的权利了吗？

meaning: n. 相识的人，泛泛之交；认识，相识；所知，了解
definition: 1. n. personal knowledge or information about someone or something；2. n. a relationship less intimate than friendship
example: I made the acquaintance of several musicians around that time.
exampleZh: 大约在那段时间，我结识了几位音乐家。

meaning: v. 获得，得到；学到，习得；患上（疾病）；逐渐具有，开始学会
definition: 1. v. come into the possession of something concrete or abstract；2. v. take on a certain form, attribute, or aspect
example: How do we enable our population to acquire those skills and continue to develop?
exampleZh: 我们如何使国家获得这些能力,并持续发展呢？

meaning: n. 学得，习得；（金钱、财物等的）获取；购买，添置，增添物；收购，购置的产业
definition: 1. n. the act of contracting or assuming or acquiring possession of something；2. n. something acquired
example: It deconvolves that reaction of sodium plus chlorine into elementary steps that are related to electron transfer and acquisition.
exampleZh: 它将钠和氯的反应,分解成基本的步骤,这些步骤是直接与电子的转移和获得有关的。

meaning: n. 英亩；大片，大量
definition: 1. n. a unit of area (4840 square yards) used in English-speaking countries；2. n. a territory of western Brazil bordering on Bolivia and Peru
example: He spent holidays at the 300-acre estate of his aunt and uncle.
exampleZh: 他在叔叔和婶婶的300英亩庄园里度过许多假日。

meaning: adv. 从一边到另一边；在……对面；朝，向；宽；横向字谜答案；prep. 从一边到另一边；横过，穿过；在……对面；遍及；在……上；跨越（政治、宗教、社会隔阂等）
definition: 1. adv. to the opposite side；2. adv. transversely
example: You really had a remarkable success in academics, in the administrative... You've taught at great universities across the country.
exampleZh: 您在学术界，行政管理层，都取得了巨大的成功。,您曾在多所美国名校执教。

meaning: v. 行动；举动，表现；假装；表演，演出；担任；起作用；代理；（心理分析）行为表现；n. 行为，行动；法案；装模作样；（戏剧、歌剧等的）一幕；一段表演；节目；表演者，演出团体；发现某人正在（做某事）；判决书；会议记录，公报
definition: 1. n. a legal document codifying the result of deliberations of a committee or society or legislative body；2. v. perform an action, or work out or perform (an action)
example: It had come to a kind of crescendo with voter registration drives and the Voting Rights Act of 1964.
exampleZh: 随着选民登记的进行，和在1964年通过的投票权法案,这样的事愈演愈烈。

meaning: n. 行动；行为；战斗；诉讼；令人激动的事；动作；情节；惊险刺激的活动（或事件）；作用；开始（电影导演开拍的指令）；赚钱的机会；性交；运转方式；v. 处理；adj. 动作（片）的，动作片中的；【名】 （Action）（英）埃克申（人名）
definition: 1. n. something done (usually as opposed to something said)；2. v. institute legal proceedings against; file a suit against
example: The most outrageous action in Laud's crackdown was his move to ban -his attempt to ban preaching in churches.
exampleZh: 他所做过的最骇人听闻的暴行,是企图在教堂里禁止布道训诫行为。

meaning: adj. 代理的；表演的；n. 表演，演技；v. 行动；举动，表现；假装（act 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. the performance of a part or role in a drama；2. adj. serving temporarily especially as a substitute
example: But I think as you get older, like when you were younger, you might want to do acting
exampleZh: 但是我觉得你胆子大一些的时候，比如小的时候，你可能想当演员，

meaning: v. 激活，使活化；使参战；（尤指透过加热）加速……的反应
definition: 1. to cause something to start；2. to make a chemical reaction happen more quickly, especially by heating
example: An example is production of certain molecules called cytokines by T-cells that activate themselves.
exampleZh: 细胞能分泌这类叫做细胞因子的分子,实现自激活

meaning: adj. 好动的；积极主动的；定期进行的，起作用的；（思想等）活跃的；切实的；（火山）活的；主动语态的；活性的；（疾病）恶化的；服役的；参战的；（动词）表动作的；（电路系统）在运转中的；n. 主动语态
definition: 1. n. chemical agent capable of activity；2. adj. tending to become more severe or wider in scope
example: I'd like to describe what we're doing in both of those aspects, both of technology and active learning aspects.
exampleZh: 我想谈谈我们在这两方面,具体干了什么，在技术和自主学习两方面。

meaning: n. 活跃状况，热闹；活动；（Activity）热力活性，活度
definition: 1. n. any specific behavior；2. n. the state of being active
example: These are primal forms of play, if you like, ; that suggest forms of poetic activity; also, spiritual activity.
exampleZh: 这是玩最原始的形式，如果你愿意，这种形式显示出了诗歌活动的形式;,还有精神活动。

meaning: n. 积极分子，活动家；adj. 积极分子的
definition: 1. n. a militant reformer；2. adj. advocating or engaged in activism
example: They're depicting me as a radical animal rights activist and environmentalist determined to force my beliefs on others.
exampleZh: 他们把我描绘成一个激进的动物权利活动家和环保主义者，决心把我的信仰强加于他人。

meaning: n. 演员；像在演戏的人；（行动或过程）参与者
definition: 1. n. a theatrical performer；2. n. a person who acts and gets things done
example: I felt like, in my hometown of Huston, it was cool, special, and different that I was an actor.
exampleZh: 在我的老家休斯顿，作为一名演员，我觉得很酷、很特别、很与众不同。

meaning: n. 女演员
definition: 1. n. a female actor
example: So somewhere, maybe in pre-incarnational time before Franny became Franny, she wanted to be an actress.
exampleZh: 可能是在神灵化身之前的时代,在弗兰尼变成弗兰尼之前，她想要成为演员。

meaning: adj. 真实的，实际的，现实的；（用于对比主次方面）真正的；现存的，当前的
definition: 1. adj. presently existing in fact and not merely potential or possible；2. adj. taking place in reality; not pretended or imitated
example: Sal in this moment becomes so naive, naive of history, of actual lived history of his own country.
exampleZh: 因为萨尔在这一刻变得非常无知，对自己国家的真实历史非常无知。

meaning: adv. 实际上，事实上；（用于开始新话题）其实；竟然，居然
definition: 1. adv. in actual fact；2. adv. used to imply that one would expect the fact to be the opposite of that stated; surprisingly
example: or actually ask the TFs in section to hand out a meter exercise that you can do for next week.
exampleZh: 或者是叫助教在课间,发下个星期你们要做的关于节拍的作业。

meaning: n. 针灸，针刺疗法；v. 对……施行针刺疗法
definition: 1. a treatment for pain or illness in which thin needles are positioned just under the surface of the skin at special points around the body
example: Acupuncture has a harmonizing and energizing effect on mind and body.
exampleZh: 针灸疗法有协调和激活身心的功效。

meaning: adj. 严重的，危险的；急性的，剧烈的；灵敏的；敏锐的，有洞察力的；锐角的；带尖音符的；（声音）高的，尖的
definition: 1. n. a mark (') placed above a vowel to indicate pronunciation；2. adj. having or experiencing a rapid onset and short but severe course
example: There is an acute shortage of water.
exampleZh: 水严重短缺。

meaning: v. 适应；调整，使适合；改编；改造，改装
definition: 1. v. make fit for, or change to suit a new purpose；2. v. adapt or conform oneself to new or different conditions
example: We have had to adapt quickly to the new system.
exampleZh: 我们不得不迅速适应新制度。

meaning: n. 改编本，改写本；适应，改变；适应（性），适应力；适应性变化
definition: 1. n. a written work (as a novel) that has been recast in a new form；2. n. the process of adapting to something (such as environmental conditions)
example: Branagh won two awards for his screen adaptation of Shakespeare's Henry the Fifth.
exampleZh: 布拉纳因他对莎士比亚的《亨利五世》的荧幕改编而获了两次奖。

meaning: adj. 适应的，有适应能力的
definition: 1. adj. having a capacity for adaptation
example: Societies need to develop highly adaptive behavioural rules for survival.
exampleZh: 社会要生存需要建立有高度适应性的行为准则。

meaning: v. 添加，掺入；（使）相加，加；增加；增添（某种特性）；把……计算在内，包括；补充说，继续说；abbr. 注意力缺陷障碍，多动症（ADD）
definition: 1. n. a condition (mostly in boys) characterized by behavioral and learning disorders；2. v. make an addition (to); join or combine or unite with others; increase the quality, quantity, size or scope of
example: So, step five tells us to add 2 electrons between each atom, so we add two there.
exampleZh: 那么，第五步告诉我们在两个原子之间放上两个电子，因此我们在这放上两个。

meaning: n. 增加物，新增人员；增加；加法；（建筑物的）扩建部分
definition: 1. n. a component that is added to something to improve it；2. n. the act of adding one thing to another
example: In addition to headaches, you may develop stomach ulcers as well.
exampleZh: 除了头痛，你还可能患上胃溃疡。

meaning: adj. 附加的，额外的
definition: 1. adj. further or added
example: I'm not sure there might be additional things that international students have to do like additional tests.
exampleZh: 我不确定留学生录取是不是还有其他要求，比如说还要加试什么的。

meaning: n. （尤指毒品）上瘾者，瘾君子；对……入迷的人；v. 使上瘾，使沉迷
definition: 1. n. someone who is so ardently devoted to something that it resembles an addiction；2. v. to cause (someone or oneself) to become dependent (on something, especially a narcotic drug)
example: She recalled feeling like an addict when she became Instagram's most followed user in 2016.
exampleZh: 她回忆起自己在2016年成为 Instagram 上最受关注用户时那种“瘾君子”般的感觉。

meaning: n. 瘾；入迷，嗜好
definition: 1. n. being abnormally tolerant to and dependent on something that is psychologically or physically habit-forming (especially alcohol or narcotic drugs)；2. n. an abnormally strong craving
example: Addiction to drugs can bring a multitude of other problems.
exampleZh: 毒瘾会带来其他许多问题。

meaning: adj. 使人成瘾的；使欲罢不能的，使人入迷的；（人）容易沉迷的
definition: 1. adj. causing or characterized by addiction
example: This dish can always be toned down by adding less Sichuan pepper, but trust me...mala heat is addictive.
exampleZh: 少放点四川胡椒能使这道菜的味道柔和一些，但是相信我，麻辣的热辣感觉是会使人上瘾的。

meaning: n. 地址，住址；网址；电子邮箱地址；演讲，演说；（电子表格中某个单元格的）位置；（对他人的）谈吐；谦恭（或脉脉含情）的方式；机敏，迅速；位置存储编码；v. 演说，演讲；处理，设法解决；在（信封、包裹等）上写姓名和地址，致函； 向……讲话；称呼；（向某人）提出（陈述、投诉等）；（高尔夫）就位击（球）
definition: 1. n. (computer science) the code that identifies where a piece of information is stored；2. v. speak to
example: Well, it turns out on most computers an address of the location and memory, aka a pointer, is itself 32 bits.
exampleZh: 好的，它是一个计算机内存地址,或者说一个指针，占32位。

meaning: adj. 足够的，适当的，合乎需要的；（品质）足够好的，令人满意的；（质量）达到要求的，勉强过关的
definition: 1. adj. (sometimes followed by `to') meeting the requirements especially of a task；2. adj. enough to meet a purpose
example: Then they test you to make sure that you have adequate protection, and some people need an additional shot after that.
exampleZh: 然后医生会检测以确定你已获得了保护,有些人在测试完后需要再打一针

meaning: n. 足够，胜任；适当，恰当
definition: 1. n. the quality of being able to meet a need satisfactorily:
example: There were also issues about nutritional adequacy and meat turned out to be a better overall food than most plants.
exampleZh: 还有关于营养充分的问题,这样看,肉类较植物来说是更好的食物

meaning: adv. 充分地，足够地；适当地
definition: 1. adv. in an adequate manner；2. adv. in an adequate manner or to an adequate degree
example: It requires the citizens are informed, not just informed, well-informed enough to know whether they are being adequately served.
exampleZh: 公民需要了解，不仅仅是了解，要很好地了解他们是否,得到了政府的良好服务。

meaning: v. 黏附，附着；遵守，遵循（规定或协议）；拥护，持有（观点或信仰）
definition: 1. to stick firmly；2. to stick or be attached firmly to a surface
example: One is that cells form tissues that are mechanically intact, they have mechanical integrity because they can adhere to one another.
exampleZh: 一是具有机械完整性的组织是由细胞构成,组织之所以具有机械完整性,是因为细胞能够互相黏附在一起

meaning: n. （尤指对规则、信念等的）遵守，坚持
definition: 1. the fact of someone behaving exactly according to rules, beliefs, etc.；2. the obeying of a rule or law
example: High adherence scores, good adherence to the Mediterranean Diet across all these studies, was associated with these particular health outcomes.
exampleZh: 高遵循度值,即在研究中高度遵循地中海式饮食的人,被证实与以下这些健康性结果有相关性

meaning: adj. 邻近的，毗连的；（几何）（两个角）相邻的
definition: 1. very near, next to, or touching；2. used in compounds to show that something is not exactly the thing mentioned, but very similar to it
example: It's not something you're going to go back and remember it's an opposite side, it's an adjacent side.
exampleZh: 不应该再去翻以前的课本,还去回忆哪个是对边,哪个是邻边

meaning: n. 形容词；adj. 形容词的；从属的
definition: 1. n. a word that expresses an attribute of something；2. adj. of or relating to or functioning as an adjective
example: In French the adjective must agree with the noun in number and gender.
exampleZh: 法语中形容词必须在数和性上与名词一致。

meaning: v. 调整，调节；整理（衣服）；适应，习惯；（保险理赔时）理算，评估（损失，损害）
definition: 1. v. alter or regulate so as to achieve accuracy or conform to a standard；2. v. place in a line or arrange so as to be parallel or straight
example: You can adjust those grades, let's leave it until next week and we can take it at a leisurely pace.
exampleZh: 你可以更正你的成绩，让我们一直延续到下周,我们可以在一个休闲的地方。

meaning: n. 调整，校正；（行为、思想的）调节，适应；调节器
definition: 1. n. making or becoming suitable; adjusting to circumstances；2. n. the act of making something different (as e.g. the size of a garment)
example: But I started the adjustment when I started working work for Governor Bush in early 1999 as policy director.
exampleZh: 但我一开始为布什工作,就开始调整了,那是在1999年初，我是政策司长。

meaning: v. 管理，治理；执行，实施；给予（药物或治疗）；给予帮助，关心照顾（某人）；主持（仪式等）；踢，打；执行遗产管理人的职责
definition: 1. v. work in an administrative capacity; supervise；2. v. administer ritually; of church sacraments
example: And the more I looked and the older I grew, the more difficult it seemed to me to administer political affairs justly.
exampleZh: 随着我更多的观察和年纪增长，我越能了解到很难,公正地管理政治事务。

meaning: n. 管理，行政；管理部门，行政部门；（某一任期的）政府；执行，监管；（药的）服用，配给；遗产管理，（债务人、其他个人或破产公司的）资产管理
definition: 1. n. a method of tending to (especially business) matters；2. n. the persons (or committees or departments etc.) who make up a body for the purpose of administering something
example: Right as Undersecretary of the Treasury for International Affairs in the administration of Gorge W. Bush How bad is it?
exampleZh: 没错,曾担任国际事务财务部次长,任职于布什政府,时下经济到底有多糟呢？

meaning: adj. 管理的，行政的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to or responsible for administration
example: You really had a remarkable success in academics, in the administrative... You've taught at great universities across the country.
exampleZh: 您在学术界，行政管理层，都取得了巨大的成功。,您曾在多所美国名校执教。

meaning: v. 钦佩，仰慕；欣赏，观赏
definition: 1. v. feel admiration for；2. v. look at with admiration
example: We always admire her as she passes by." Mr. Pim watches Pippa suck the concoction.
exampleZh: 她路过的时候我们都仰慕她“皮姆先生看着皮帕,在啜饮着混喝饮料。

meaning: n. 钦佩，赞美，欣赏；赞美对象
definition: 1. n. a feeling of delighted approval and liking；2. n. the feeling aroused by something strange and surprising
example: His admiration for foreign things and approaches was tempered by, as Hughes argues, his devotion to Russia, which he oversaw.
exampleZh: 正如休斯所说,他虽然歆慕外国文化,但仍被本国传统所抑制,他还是忠于他统治之下的俄国

meaning: adj. 令人钦佩的，极其出色的
definition: 1. adj. deserving of the highest esteem or admiration；2. adj. inspiring admiration or approval
example: I think we can see demonstrative from these charts, that man has done a rather admirable job of imitating the human brain.
exampleZh: 我觉得我们可以从这些图表中看到一些说明，人们做了一个非常令人钦佩的工作,来模仿人类的大脑。

meaning: v. （勉强）承认；招认，招供；准许进入（某处）；接纳，接收（入学）；收治，接收入院；承认……有效；容许，为……留有余地
definition: 1. v. declare to be true or admit the existence or reality or truth of；2. v. allow to enter; grant entry to
example: He lived and died not like most people but better, and even his most vehement critics will admit to that.
exampleZh: 他的人生与死亡不同于众人，而是更好，就算是批评他最猛烈的人,也会如此认同。

meaning: n. 承认，供认；允许进入（加入），进入权；录取，录取人数；入场费；入院治疗（检查）；入场人数；入院病人
definition: 1. n. the act of admitting someone to enter；2. n. an acknowledgment of the truth of something
example: Twenty-four is the canonical age at which young men were received for admission into the priesthood.
exampleZh: 4岁是从事神职工作,最佳的年龄,就好像。

meaning: n. 进入许可，加入许可；（物理）导纳；通道
definition: 1. n. the right to enter；2. n. the act of admitting someone to enter
example: We had not been able to gain admittance to the flat.
exampleZh: 我们还未能获得进入那所公寓的权利。

meaning: adv. 诚然，不可否认地
definition: 1. adv. as acknowledged
example: Admittedly, turning to others for help and suggestion by no means refers to absolute and irresponsible dependence.
exampleZh: 诚然，向别人寻求帮助和建议绝不是完全地和不负责任地依赖于他人。

meaning: n. 青少年；adj. 青春期的；不成熟的
definition: 1. a young person who is developing into an adult；2. being or relating to an adolescent
example: He was showing off, as is the way with adolescent boys.
exampleZh: 他在炫耀，青春期的男孩都是这个样子。

meaning: n. 青春期，青春
definition: 1. the period of time in a person's life when they are developing into an adult
example: The play is set in the dangerous no-man's land between youth and adolescence.
exampleZh: 该剧定位于少年和青春期之间的危险的中间年龄段。

meaning: v. 收养；采取，采纳，接受；正式通过；选定（名字），承袭（风俗）；移居，定居；提名（某人）为候选人；保持（姿势）；（地方当局）承担（道路）维修保养责任
definition: 1. v. choose and follow; as of theories, ideas, policies, strategies or plans；2. v. take up and practice as one's own
example: It's in this period that Milton increasingly begins to adopt, or assume, Saint Peter's confident and denunciatory rhetoric.
exampleZh: 就是在这段时间弥尔顿越来越接受，去采用，圣彼得的有信心的责难似的语言。

meaning: n. 采用，接受；推选；正式通过；选择；收养，领养
definition: 1. n. the act of accepting with approval; favorable reception；2. n. a legal proceeding that creates a parent-child relation between persons not related by blood; the adopted child is entitled to all privileges belonging to a natural child of the adoptive parents (including the right to inherit)
example: In 1783 he secured the adoption of the decimal coinage in Congress.
exampleZh: 1783年他促使国会采纳了十进位币制。

meaning: v. 非常喜欢，热爱；爱慕，疼爱；崇拜，崇敬；【名】 （Adore）（法）阿多尔（人名）
definition: 1. to love someone very much, especially in a way that shows a lot of admiration or respect, or to like something very much；2. to worship
example: Many readers adore the novel for its lyrical prose, but others find its leisurely pace frustrating.
exampleZh: 许多读者因这部小说富有诗意的文笔而喜爱它，但也有人觉得其缓慢的节奏令人不耐烦。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: adj. 可爱的，讨人喜欢的；值得崇拜的
definition: 1. used to describe someone or something that makes you love or like them, usually because they are attractive and often small；2. charming, attractive, and easily loved
example: You were smart and adorable and all this time I assumed you were dumb and adorable.
exampleZh: 你很聪明，而且很可爱,这么久了我竟然一直以为你可爱但只是不会说话呢“

meaning: n. 成年人或动物；adj. 成年的，发育成熟的；成人的，理智的；（电影、杂志等）仅限于成人的；v. 像成年人一样表现；变成熟
definition: 1. n. a fully developed person from maturity onward；2. adj. (of animals) fully developed
example: For the adult learner, the technology has the capability of freeing us in terms of time and space.
exampleZh: 对成年学习者而言，技术能够让我们免受,时间和空间的限制。

meaning: n. 成年，成人时期
definition: 1. n. the period of time in your life after your physical growth has stopped and you are fully developed；2. n. the state (and responsibilities) of a person who has attained maturity
example: Parents want to know the best way to nurture and raise their child to adulthood.
exampleZh: 父母们想了解把他们的孩子养育成人的最好方法。

meaning: v. （使）前进，（使）向前移动；发展，进步；预付；提前，提早；促进，推动；提出（想法或理论）；上涨，增加；提拔，晋升；n. 前进；进步，进展；改善；预付款；勾引，追求；（价格、价值的）上涨；贷款；adj. 预先的，事先的；先行的，先遣的
definition: 1. n. a movement forward；2. v. move forward, also in the metaphorical sense
example: And how far in advance he had even been thinking about some of the stuff that he had done
exampleZh: 他很早前就开始构思他的作品了，

meaning: n. 前进，行进；进步，进展；提升，晋升
definition: 1. n. encouragement of the progress or growth or acceptance of something；2. n. the act of moving forward toward a goal
example: Her work for the advancement of the status of women in India was recognized by the whole nation.
exampleZh: 她为促进印度妇女地位的提升所做的工作得到了全国人民的认可。

meaning: adj. 先进的；高级的，高等的；晚期的，状况不佳的；高龄的；新提出（尚未被广泛接受）的；v. 行进；发展，进步；预付（advance 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. farther along in physical or mental development；2. adj. comparatively late in a course of development
example: Especially because some, some advanced degrees that you get, you pay a lot of money to get them,
exampleZh: 尤其是因为，有些高级学位，为了获得它你花了很多钱。

meaning: n. 有利条件，优势；优点；利益；（局末平分后）占先，优势分；v. 有利于，有助于
definition: 1. n. the quality of having a superior or more favorable position；2. v. give an advantage to
example: So a very popular thing to do on Boxing Day is go shopping and take advantage of the sales.
exampleZh: 所以在节礼日人们通常会趁着促销之际出去购物，这很流行。

meaning: adj. 有利的，有益的
definition: 1. adj. giving an advantage；2. adj. appropriate for achieving a particular end; implies a lack of concern for fairness
example: Meteorite impacts can be advantageous for some species, which thrive, and disastrous for other species, which become extinct.
exampleZh: 陨石的撞击对某些物种是有利的，它们会茁壮成长；而对其他物种则是灾难性的，它们会灭绝。

meaning: n. 出现，到来，问世；基督降临节（Advent）；基督降临，基督复临（Advent）
definition: 1. the fact of an event happening, an invention being made, or a person arriving；2. the period of four weeks before Christmas
example: The advent of the computer has brought this sort of task within the bounds of possibility.
exampleZh: 电脑的出现使这种任务的完成成为可能。

meaning: n. 冒险（经历），奇遇；冒险的刺激，冒险欲；生意；v. 冒险；大胆说出；去（某地）探险
definition: 1. n. a wild and exciting undertaking (not necessarily lawful)；2. v. take a risk in the hope of a favorable outcome
example: I also use it as a connection between family life, family roots and just to make the adventure more real.
exampleZh: 联系家庭生活和,故乡的纽带,并通过它们使这次旅程更真实。

meaning: n. 冒险家；投机分子；（金融）投机者；雇佣兵
definition: 1. n. a person who enjoys taking risks；2. n. someone who travels into little known regions (especially for some scientific purpose)
example: Thor Heyerdahl, the Norwegian ethnographer and adventurer, thought the statues had been created by pre-Inca peoples from Peru.
exampleZh: 挪威民族志学者、冒险家托尔·海尔达尔认为，这些雕像是由来自秘鲁的前印加人创造的。

meaning: adj. 勇于冒险的，敢于创新的；爱冒险的；刺激不断的，充满惊险的；新奇的，令人兴奋的
definition: 1. adj. willing to undertake or seeking out new and daring enterprises
example: He had always wanted an adventurous life in the tropics.
exampleZh: 他一直都想要一种在热带丛林里的冒险生活。

meaning: n. 副词（修饰动词、形容词、其他副词或整个句子的词）
definition: 1. n. the word class that qualifies verbs or clauses；2. n. a word that modifies something other than a noun
example: In 'walk slowly', the adverb 'slowly' modifies the verb 'walk'.
exampleZh: 在walk slowly中，副词slowly修饰动词walk。

meaning: n. 敌手，对手；adj. 对立的，敌对的
definition: 1. an enemy
example: His rivals knew that they could expect no quarter from such a ruthless adversary.
exampleZh: 他的竞争者明白，不能期望如此残忍的对手发善心。

meaning: adj. 不利的，有害的；相反的；敌对的
definition: 1. having a negative or harmful effect on something；2. going against something, or causing harm
example: Lack of money will have an adverse effect on our research programme.
exampleZh: 缺少资金将对我们的研究方案有不利影响。

meaning: n. 逆境，厄运
definition: 1. a difficult or unlucky situation or event
example: See, I set before you this day life and prosperity, death and adversity.
exampleZh: 看呐，我今日将生与福，死与祸，陈明在你面前。

meaning: v. 为……做广告，登广告；公布，征聘；宣扬；使变得显眼；提醒……注意
definition: 1. v. call attention to；2. v. make publicity for; try to sell (a product)
example: So for example, in United States, Super Bowl is a really big time for us to advertise
exampleZh: 例如，在美国，橄榄球超级大赛对我们来说就是做广告的重要时刻，

meaning: n. 广告；（某一类事物的）活广告；广告活动，广告宣传
definition: 1. n. a public promotion of some product or service
example: Some people believe that spending money on an advertisement is more important than making a quality product.
exampleZh: 有的人相信多花钱做广告比生产质量好的产品更重要。

meaning: n. 广告活动，广告业；（总称）广告；v. 登广告；公布，征聘；宣扬（advertise 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. a public promotion of some product or service；2. n. the business of drawing public attention to goods and services
example: Again, there's no advertising affecting this, there's no parents being irresponsible and buying sugary cereals for the poor little animals.
exampleZh: 此外,这个结果并不受广告营销的影响,也不因为有父母不负责任,给这个可怜的小动物买高糖的谷物

meaning: n. 忠告，劝告，建议；（金融交易）正式通知；消息
definition: 1. n. a proposal for an appropriate course of action
example: OK, so now, Romeo: "shall I hear more, or shall I speak at this?" Fellows, a bit of advice, don't interrupt.
exampleZh: 现在，罗密欧，我是继续听下去呢,还是现在就对她说话，同学们，有点建议，别打断。

meaning: v. 通知，告知；劝告，建议
definition: 1. v. give advice to；2. v. inform (somebody) of something
example: Plato undertook three long and dangerous voyages to Sicily in order to advise the King Dionysius.
exampleZh: 柏拉图三度冒险渡海至西西里岛,只为向戴奥尼索斯王献策；

meaning: n. 顾问，劝告者；导师，指导教师
definition: 1. n. an expert who gives advice
example: This is the role of the coach, advisor, or teacher.
exampleZh: 这是教练、顾问或老师的角色。

meaning: adj. 顾问的，咨询的；n. 官方警告；警报
definition: 1. n. an announcement that usually advises or warns the public of some threat；2. adj. giving advice
example: She is the chair of the Defense Advisory Committee on Women in the Military.
exampleZh: 她是军队女兵国防顾问委员会的主席。

meaning: adj. 明智的，可取的
definition: 1. adj. worthy of being recommended or suggested; prudent or wise
example: Because of the popularity of the region, it is advisable to book hotels or camp sites in advance.
exampleZh: 鉴于该地区的受欢迎度，事先预订旅馆或露营地是可取的。

meaning: v. 拥护，提倡；n. 拥护者，提倡者；辩护律师；（为某一类人）谋利益者；（一项事业或个组织的）工作者
definition: 1. n. a person who pleads for a cause or propounds an idea；2. v. push for something
example: I felt that it was irresponsible to advocate the legalization of drugs.
exampleZh: 我觉得主张毒品合法化是不负责任的。

meaning: n. 拥护，提倡；辩护，辩护术；游说（团体或组织）；律师职业（或工作）
definition: 1. n. active support of an idea or cause etc.; especially the act of pleading or arguing for something
example: That does not mean the advocacy of high moral standards should also be separated from material rewards.
exampleZh: 那并不意味着拥护崇高的道德标准就应该与物质奖励相分离。

meaning: n. 天线；（滑雪等运动的）空中腾越；adj. 航空的，从飞机上的；空中的，地表以上的；由飞机实施的；（植物的某部分）气生的；在空中翱翔的；（在）大气（中）的
definition: 1. n. a pass to a receiver downfield from the passer；2. adj. in or belonging to the air or operating (for or by means of aircraft or elevated cables) in the air
example: Patterns that are invisible on the ground can be the most striking part of an aerial photograph.
exampleZh: 在地面上看不见的图案可能是空中照片中最为醒目的部分。

meaning: adj. 审美的，美学的；美的，艺术的；n. 美感，审美观；美学（aesthetics）；美术理论
definition: 1. relating to the enjoyment or study of beauty；2. An aesthetic object or a work of art is one that shows great beauty
example: He responded very strongly to the aesthetic of this particular work.
exampleZh: 他对这部作品的审美特质反应十分强烈。

meaning: n. 美学；美学理论；艺术美
definition: 1. US spelling of aesthetics
example: The debate over aesthetics in urban design often reflects deeper disagreements about public space and civic identity.
exampleZh: 关于城市设计美学的争论，往往反映出人们对公共空间和城市身份的更深层分歧。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）
note: 剑桥以 esthetics 词条解释该派生词。

meaning: n. 公共事务，政治事务；事情，事件；个人的事，私事；私人业务；（尤指已婚男女的）私通，风流韵事；社交活动，喜庆事； 物件，东西；商务和金融交易
definition: 1. n. a vaguely specified concern；2. n. a usually secretive or illicit sexual relationship
example: Meaning is an affair of consciousness and not of words.
exampleZh: 含义关乎意识，而不是字词。

meaning: v. 影响；（疾病）侵袭，感染；（在感情上）深深打动，震撼； 假装，佯装；n. （尤指影响行为或行动的）情感，感情
definition: 1. n. the conscious subjective aspect of feeling or emotion；2. v. have an effect upon
example: I'm going to repeat this a second time, because it's important. These local bindings do not affect any global bindings.
exampleZh: 因为这非常重要，这些本地绑定,并不影响全局绑定。

meaning: n. 喜爱，关爱；爱恋，爱慕之情；精神状况，感情；疾患，病；影响
definition: 1. n. a positive feeling of liking
example: So that when he says that citizens are held together by ties of common affection he means something very specific.
exampleZh: 所以当他们说到公民是由,共同感情的关系所团结在一起,他所指的是非常明确的东西。

meaning: adj. 表达爱意的，深情的
definition: 1. adj. having or displaying warmth or affection
example: It was all owing to his too affectionate nature, which craved for admiration.
exampleZh: 这全是因为他生性过于多情，总渴望得到他人的仰慕。

meaning: v. 使隶属，使紧密联系；加入；（组织）接纳……为成员；n. 附属机构，分支机构
definition: 1. to cause a group to become part of or form a close relationship with another, usually larger, group, or organization；2. an organization that is connected with or controlled by another, usually larger, organization
example: He wanted to affiliate with a U.S. firm because he needed expert advice in legal affairs.
exampleZh: 他想成为一家美国公司的会员，因为他需要法律事务方面的专家意见。

meaning: n. （与政治、宗教等组织的）联系，从属关系；加盟，加入
definition: 1. a connection with a political party or religion, or with a larger organization；2. the relationship between two companies that are officially connected to each other
example: In mid-February 1917 a women's movement independent of political affiliation erupted in New York City, the stronghold of the Socialist party in the United states.
exampleZh: 1917年2月中旬，一场独立于政治派别的妇女运动在纽约市爆发，纽约市是美国社会党的大本营。

meaning: v. 断言，证实； 宣称拥护，支持；认可（判决，协议），批准；不宣誓而提供正式证词；给予（某人）情感支持（或鼓励）
definition: 1. to state something as true；2. to publicly show your support for an opinion or idea
example: In my opinion, in the appraisal of migrant workers, it is one-sided to affirm everything or to negate everything.
exampleZh: 在我看来，对农民工的评价中，肯定一切或否定一切都是片面的。

meaning: n. 肯定，维护；情感上的支持（或鼓励）；（因良心原因不愿宣誓而作的正式）确认
definition: 1. a statement or sign that something is true；2. the act of saying yes or of showing that you mean yes
example: The ruling was a welcome affirmation of the constitutional right to free speech.
exampleZh: 此裁决是对言论自由这一宪法权利的受人欢迎的肯定。

meaning: adj. 肯定的，同意的；（法律提案）须议会投票赞成生效的；积极的；n. 同意，赞成；陈述词，肯定词；赞成的一方；int. 同意的，赞成的
definition: 1. relating to a statement that shows agreement or says "yes"；2. a word or statement that shows agreement or says "yes"
example: He asked me if I was ready. I answered in the affirmative.
exampleZh: 他问我是否准备好了。我肯定地回答了。

meaning: v. 使固定，粘上；可固定；n. 词缀；附加物
definition: 1. to fasten or stick one thing to another；2. to add a letter or a group of letters to the beginning or end of a word to make a new word
example: Make the eyes by using craft glue to affix sequins to buttons.
exampleZh: 把珠片粘在纽扣上作为眼睛。

meaning: 词缀附加；附加法
definition: 1. the process of adding an affix (= a letter or group of letters with a particular meaning added to the beginning or end of a word to make a new word), or a letter or group of letters that are added like this
example: Further, 01-sign method is used to optimize affixation information and the space of affixation information is reduced.
exampleZh: 此外采用01标识法对附加信息进行优化，减少了附加信息存储空间。

meaning: adj. 富裕的，富足的；（水）畅流，滔滔流动；丰富的；n. 富人；支流
definition: 1. n. an affluent person; a person who is financially well off；2. adj. having an abundant supply of money or possessions of value
example: It's a fallacy that the affluent give relatively more to charity than the less prosperous.
exampleZh: 富人比不太有钱的人给慈善机构相对更多捐赠是一种谬见。

meaning: n. 富裕，富足；流入，汇聚
definition: 1. n. abundant wealth
example: Affluence liberates the individual, promising that everyone can choose a unique way to self-fulfillment.
exampleZh: 富裕解放了个人，并承诺每个人都可以选择一种独特的方式来实现自我。

meaning: v. 买得起；有（时间）做某事；承担得起；提供，给予；n. （Afford）（英、美）阿福德（人名）
definition: 1. v. be able to spare or give up；2. v. be the cause or source of
example: Now never mind that our own experience with virgins has failed to afford us such a spectacle of bodily transformation.
exampleZh: 没有关系，如果我们关于贞操的知识,之前未能告诉我们如此壮观的身体转换。

meaning: adj. 便宜的，付得起的
definition: 1. adj. that you have the financial means for
example: Exorbitant housing prices have created an acute shortage of affordable housing for the poor.
exampleZh: 过高的房价使穷人负担得起的房源严重短缺。

meaning: n. 可购性，负担能力
definition: 1. the degree to which something can be paid for without causing financial difficulty
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: Improved travel connections and affordability have made the world more accessible, creating a 'global village'.
exampleZh: 更便捷的交通和更低廉的出行费用使世界变得更加通达，创造了一个“地球村”。

meaning: adj. 经济上周转得开的，不欠债的；漂浮的；在流传中的，当前的；在船（或艇）上的；海上的；浸水的；adv. 不欠债地，周转顺畅地；漂浮着；在流传中，当前；在海上；浸满水
definition: 1. floating on water；2. having enough money to pay what you owe
example: We kept her afloat for a couple of hours by bailing frantically.
exampleZh: 我们拼命往外舀水让船漂浮了几个小时。

meaning: adj. 害怕的；担心的；（害怕后果而）不愿意的，勉强的；遗憾的
definition: 1. adj. filled with fear or apprehension；2. adj. filled with regret or concern; used often to soften an unpleasant statement
example: We're afraid of spiders, snakes, heights, storms, large animals, darkness, blood, strangers, humiliation, deep water, and leaving home alone.
exampleZh: 我们害怕蜘蛛，蛇，高地，暴雨，大型动物，黑暗，血，陌生人，侮辱，深水，独自在家。

meaning: prep. 在……之后；紧接着；一次接着一次，持续不断地；跟随，在……身后；（按顺序、重要性）在……后面，仅次于；与……对照，对比；鉴于，由于；尽管；寻找，追捕；关于；模仿，依照；以……命名；（表示时间）（…点）过（…分）；conj. 在……以后；adv. 后来，以后；adj. 后来的，以后的；靠近船尾的
definition: 1. adj. located farther aft；2. adv. happening at a time subsequent to a reference time
example: If my code is correct, what should the average price be, after say, 100 days, if there's no bias. Pardon?
exampleZh: 如果我的代码没写错的话，如果没有偏向值那平均价格会是多少呢，如果没有偏向值，请说？

meaning: n. （战争、风暴、事故的）后果，余波；再萌草，再生草
definition: 1. the period that follows an unpleasant event or accident, and the effects that it causes；2. the period following an event, such as an accident or war, and the effects caused by the event
example: We only usually bring it up when we're talking about the Mexican War and its aftermath, or something.
exampleZh: 我们通常只会在谈论,类似墨西哥战争及其影响时,才会谈到它

meaning: n. 午后，下午；int. 下午好（问候用语）
definition: 1. n. the part of the day between noon and evening；2. n. a conventional expression of greeting or farewell
example: you saw an adult, you said hello, you said good morning and you said good afternoon, you know.
exampleZh: 每逢遇到一个大人，都会说“你好”，“早上好”，“下午好”，就像这样。

meaning: adv. 以后，后来，其后
definition: 1. adv. happening at a time subsequent to a reference time
example: All of these are available on the courses' website so you can play afterward.
exampleZh: 所有的这些例子都能在课程网站上下载’,你们可以课下去看看这些例子。

meaning: adv. 再一次；复原；请再说一遍；不过，然而（then again）；增加，多；【名】 （Again）（英、保）阿盖恩（人名）
definition: 1. adv. anew
example: That's something that we see again and again and it's remarkable how little common sense is often applied.
exampleZh: 这些技能是我们司空见惯的,当时很奇怪人们一般却没有注意到它们。

meaning: prep. 反对；（行为）违背……；（法律或法规）禁止；与……竞争；对……造成伤害（威胁，不利）；碰；倚着；逆向；以……为背景；与……相比；防备，抵御；讨厌某人，不赞同某人；作为（某物的）应付款项；（赌博用语）预计……的失败
definition: 1. abstract: Against (styled as AgainSThttp://www.myspace.
example: In fact this treatise is often described, or maybe even most commonly described, as the Western tradition's greatest argument against censorship.
exampleZh: 事实上，这本著作常常被描述为，或是可能广泛地被认为，是英国传统上最伟大的与控制相对立的文章。

meaning: n. 年龄，年纪；寿命，（物的）年代；法定年龄；时代，时期；年龄段；很长时间；成长，年老，陈年；（地质）代；v. 变老，老化；（使）显老，（使）苍老；（使）变陈，（使）成熟；推算年龄；【名】 （Age）（西、荷）阿赫，（瑞典）阿格，（日）扬（人名）
definition: 1. n. how long something has existed；2. v. begin to seem older; get older
example: From the point of view of the school age of youngsters' population, there are really, I think, two implicit purposes.
exampleZh: 从青少年的,学龄角度考虑，我想存在两个深层目标。

meaning: adj. ……岁的；年老的，年迈的；老化的；（马，农畜）超过成熟年龄的；n. 老年人（the aged）；v. 变老，老化；（使）显老；（使）变陈（age 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. n. people who are old collectively；2. adj. advanced in years; (`aged' is pronounced as two syllables)
example: or they would help, they would tutor elementary school- to high school- aged students,
exampleZh: 也可以为他们的孩子辅导功课，从小学到高中都可以，

meaning: adj. 变老的，变旧的；n. 老化，变老；v. 变老，老化；（使）显老；（使）变陈（age 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. the organic process of growing older and showing the effects of increasing age；2. adj. growing old
example: Scientists would soon be able to manipulate human genes to control the aging process.
exampleZh: 科学家将很快能够通过操控人类基因来控制衰老的过程。

meaning: n. 待议事项，议事日程；（政治）议题；秘密计划，秘密目标
definition: 1. n. a temporally organized plan for matters to be attended to；2. n. a list of matters to be taken up (as at a meeting)
example: But propaganda intends to disclose who the person is, what their agenda is, what their models are.
exampleZh: 然而，宣传旨在公开人物身份，人物议程，以及人物的典范作用。

meaning: n. （人工智能领域）智能体；代理人，代理商；（艺术界的）经纪人；间谍，特工；原动力，动因；剂；（语法）施动者；（美国某些政府部门的）官员；【名】 （Agent）（罗）阿真特（人名）
definition: 1. n. an active and efficient cause; capable of producing a certain effect；2. n. a substance that exerts some force or effect
example: They're going to release a viral agent that will kill half of this country.
exampleZh: 他们会释放出一种病毒，让这个国家一半的人丧命。

meaning: n. 代理行，经销处；政府专门机构，政府内的局，部，处；（尤指产生某效果的）作用；起作用的事物（或人）;社会行为者独立选择的能力
definition: 1. n. an administrative unit of government；2. n. a business that serves other businesses
example: There are children who by a relatively modest donation to an effective aid agency, you could save their lives.
exampleZh: 要拯救这些儿童的生命,只需要你向比较有效的救助机构,捐赠适量的钱款。

meaning: v. 使加重，使恶化；惹怒，激怒
definition: 1. to make a bad situation worse；2. to make a disease worse
example: If the reports are well-founded, the incident could seriously aggravate relations between the two nations.
exampleZh: 如果这些报道是有根据的，那么该事件将可能导致两国间的关系严重恶化。

meaning: n. 加剧，恶化；烦恼，恼人的事；攻击（或挑衅）行为
definition: 1. trouble or difficulty；2. the act of making something such as a problem or injury worse
example: Such solidarity is necessary if we are to avoid a proliferation and aggravation of tensions relating to water.
exampleZh: 如果我们要避免与水有关的紧张局势扩散和恶化，这种团结是必要的。

meaning: n. 总数，合计；骨料，混凝料；adj. 总计的，合计的；（种群）聚生的；v. 集合，聚集；总计达到；合计
definition: 1. something formed by adding together several amounts or things；2. If one team beats another on aggregate, it wins after adding together the goals in two or more matches
example: The full WGI volume, called "Governance Matters VI," shows how the six aggregate indicators are constructed.
exampleZh: 《全球治理指标》全卷，也称《治理之重第六册》，展示了六项综合指标是如何构造起来的。

meaning: adj. 好斗的，挑衅的；积极进取的；非常严重的；强烈的
definition: 1. adj. having or showing determination and energetic pursuit of your ends；2. adj. tending to spread quickly
example: We decided that in the game we would be physical and aggressive.
exampleZh: 我们决定，在比赛中我们将积极拼抢，大胆进攻。

meaning: n. 好斗性，攻击性；侵略，侵犯，挑衅
definition: 1. n. a disposition to behave aggressively；2. n. a feeling of hostility that arouses thoughts of attack
example: They misattribute that, what might be anger, what might even be aggression and violence, to an expression of love.
exampleZh: 他们错误地把，可能的愤怒，侵犯或暴力，解释为爱。

meaning: v. 煽动，鼓动，抗议；使焦虑；搅动，摇动（液体等）
definition: 1. to make someone feel worried or angry；2. to argue forcefully, especially in public, in order to achieve a particular type of change
example: All you need to do is gently agitate the water with a finger or paintbrush.
exampleZh: 你只需要用手指或刷子轻轻搅动水。

meaning: n. 焦虑不安；煽动，鼓动；（液体的）搅动
definition: 1. worry and anxiety；2. the situation in which people protest or argue, especially in public, in order to achieve a particular type of change
example: "Simply remembering an unpleasant incident can bring back the same terrible sadness and agitation to women that they experienced at the time," adds Dr. Legato.
exampleZh: 莱加托博士补充道：“只要回忆起一件令人不快的事，女性就会重新感受到当时经历过的同样强烈的悲伤与焦躁。”

meaning: adv. 以前，从前；adj. 以前的；【名】 （Ago）（美）阿戈（人名）
definition: 1. adj. gone by; or in the past；2. adv. in the past
example: So Muslims believe that Koran has maintained its original form since it was revealed to the Prophet Mohammad, 14 centuries ago.
exampleZh: 穆斯林认为自从《可兰经》,在14世纪展示给先知穆罕默德起,就保持了最原始的形式。

meaning: n. 剧痛，创痛；痛楚，苦难
definition: 1. extreme physical or mental pain or suffering；2. extreme physical or mental pain or suffering, or a period of such suffering
example: He fell awkwardly and went down in agony clutching his right knee.
exampleZh: 他笨拙地摔倒了，紧抓住右膝盖痛苦地蹲了下去。

meaning: v. 同意，赞成；答应，接受；达成一致意见；商定，约定；相符，吻合；赞同；（语法）呼应；批准，认可（计划、要求等）；适合（某人）
definition: 1. v. be in accord; be in agreement；2. v. consent or assent to a condition, or agree to do something
example: If you compare the explicate purposes for adult education, I think you will agree that they are all the same.
exampleZh: 如果将其与成人教育的,表层目标进行比较，你会承认两者是一样的。

meaning: n. 协议，协定，契约；共识；应允，同意；（在数、性或人称方面的）一致
definition: 1. n. the statement (oral or written) of an exchange of promises；2. n. compatibility of observations
example: We understand irony only, he means, to the extent to which we are in agreement with the other person.
exampleZh: 他的意思是,我们只能在赞同对方观点的程度上,理解讽刺。

meaning: adj. 愉悦的，讨人喜欢的；欣然同意的；可接受的
definition: 1. adj. conforming to your own liking or feelings or nature；2. adj. in keeping
example: They were a nice agreeable pair as they glared at each other.
exampleZh: 他俩明明在怒目相向，却还装出一副和和气气的样子。

meaning: n. 农业，农学，农艺
definition: 1. n. a large-scale farming enterprise；2. n. the practice of cultivating the land or raising stock
example: Agriculture was overwhelmingly the activity, the most important activity of the people of that area, of any area.
exampleZh: 绝大多数经济活动是农业活动,农业对该地区,甚至任何地区的人民来说,都是最重要的活动

meaning: adj. 农业的，与农业有关的；务农的，农用的；笨拙的
definition: 1. adj. relating to or used in or promoting agriculture or farming；2. adj. relating to rural matters
example: I think of nineteenth-century art as being horizontal and stretched out like agricultural life in New England.
exampleZh: 我觉得19世纪的艺术应该是,水平的，就像新英格兰伸展开来的农业。

meaning: adv. 在前面，朝前面；领先，占优势；提前，预先；在将来，今后；（数量或价值上）更多，更高；取得进步，获得成功；超出预期地，超前地；adj. 在前的，提前的
definition: 1. adj. having the leading position or higher score in a contest；2. adv. at or in the front
example: I'm going to begin at the bottom of 73: If you have your book, go ahead and open it up.
exampleZh: 我将从73页最下面开始读：,如果你带了书，那么就打开书翻到那页。

meaning: n. 帮助；援助，救助；辅助物，辅助设施；助手；特别津贴，国库税；v. 帮助，援助；促进，有助于；【名】 （Aid）（英、阿拉伯、印）艾德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a resource；2. v. give help or assistance; be of service
example: So I figured it... I may as well apply to these universities which provide really good financial aid.
exampleZh: 所以，我就想我应该申请这些能给予丰厚补助的学校。

meaning: n. 助理，助手；随从武官；【名】 （Aide）（葡）艾德（人名）
definition: 1. a person whose job is to help someone important, such as a member of a government or a military officer of high rank
example: An aide was already spinning the senator's defeat as 'almost as good as an outright win'.
exampleZh: 一名助手已经开始将那位参议员的失败描述成“几乎是大获全胜”。

meaning: abbr. 获得性免疫缺陷综合征，艾滋病（acquired immune deficiency syndrome）
definition: 1. n. a serious (often fatal) disease of the immune system transmitted through blood products especially by sexual contact or contaminated needles
example: Life has only recently got better for hard of hearing patients with the development of modern hearing aids and cochlear implants.
exampleZh: 直到近年来,随着现代助听以及耳蜗植入设备的开发,听力障碍病人的生活才有了改善,不过，有了新技术。

meaning: v. 困扰，使苦恼；（使）患病，（使）不适；【名】 （Ail）（美、印）艾乐（人名）
definition: 1. to cause difficulty and problems for someone or something；2. to be ill, or to cause to be ill
example: If you want to impress your friends with a little-known but totally epic acronym, it is "AIL", the Artificial Inorganic Leaf.
exampleZh: 如果你想找一个本身意义重大但却又知者寥寥的缩写词好给你的朋友留下深刻印象的话，那就是“AIL”，它代表的是人造无机树叶。

meaning: n. 疾病，小病；不安
definition: 1. an illness；2. an illness or health problem
example: She admitted to fabricating the ailment when she submitted a paper about it to the British Medical Journal in 1974.
exampleZh: 她承认其在1974年向《英国医学杂志》提交的一篇论文中捏造了这一疾病。

meaning: n. 目标，目的；瞄准，对准；枪法，击中目标的能力；v. 瞄准，对准；旨在，致力于；针对，指向
definition: 1. n. an anticipated outcome that is intended or that guides your planned actions；2. v. aim or direct at; as of blows, weapons, or objects such as photographic equipment
example: So the aim of this class is to make common sense more common, especially in the real world application.
exampleZh: 所以本课程的目标是让常识更平常，特别是应用到实际中。

meaning: n. 大气，空气；空中，天空；乘坐飞机，航空；神态，氛围；曲调，旋律；装腔作势，做作；空气媒质；气，风；v. 使公开，宣扬；（使）通风；（使）晾干，（使）烘干；播送，播放；出去透气；炫耀，夸示
definition: 1. n. a mixture of gases (especially oxygen) required for breathing; the stuff that the wind consists of；2. v. expose to fresh air
example: Then he flung outward, feet first, with a swish, Kicking his way down through the air to the ground.
exampleZh: 然后，纵身一跳，他两脚先伸出去，在空中乱踢乱舞，于是飕的一声，降落到地面。

meaning: adj. 在空中的，飞行中的；空降的；空气传播的
definition: 1. in the air, or carried by air or wind or by an aircraft
example: He enlisted in the 82nd Airborne 20 years ago.
exampleZh: 他20年前加入了第82空降师。

meaning: n. 空调系统；空气调节
definition: 1. n. a system that keeps air cool and dry
example: We wanted to reduce the cost of heating and air-conditioning.
exampleZh: 我们想减少供暖与空调的开支。

meaning: n. 空调，空调机（可数名词）
definition: 1. n. a system that keeps air cool and dry
example: They have been cooperating closely on developing a new type of air-conditioner.
exampleZh: 他们一直在密切合作开发一种新型空调。

meaning: n. 飞机，航空器
definition: 1. n. a vehicle that can fly
example: The aircraft was gaining height.
exampleZh: 飞机在爬高。

meaning: n. 航空公司；输气管（air line）；航线；adj. 航线的
definition: 1. n. a hose that carries air under pressure；2. n. a commercial enterprise that provides scheduled flights for passengers
example: and ended up owning record companies and radio stations and airline companies and those kind of thing.
exampleZh: 最后拥有了自己的唱片公司、广播电台和航空公司，诸如此类的东西。

meaning: n. 飞机
definition: 1. n. an aircraft that has a fixed wing and is powered by propellers or jets
example: You go on an airplane and then after the usual delays, the plane begins to accelerate down the runway.
exampleZh: 你坐上飞机,正常晚点之后,飞机就开始沿着跑道加速

meaning: n. 机场，航空站 （港）；空旅通俗读物
definition: 1. n. an airfield equipped with control tower and hangers as well as accommodations for passengers and cargo
example: Everybody and his pet dog is trying to get a seat on a plane out of Logan airport.
exampleZh: 每个人和他们的宠物狗,都想获得罗根机场的飞机上的座位。

meaning: n. 走廊，过道；（教堂）耳堂，侧堂
definition: 1. n. a long narrow passage (as in a cave or woods)；2. n. passageway between seating areas as in an auditorium or passenger vehicle or between areas of shelves of goods as in stores
example: She held me firmly by the elbow and led me to my aisle seat.
exampleZh: 她使劲抓着我的胳膊肘，把我领到靠过道的座位上。

meaning: adj. 相似的，类似的；有血缘关系的；【名】 （Akin）（英）埃金，（土、瑞典、尼日利）阿金，（匈）奥金（人名）
definition: 1. having some of the same qualities；2. having some of the same qualities; similar
example: Shakespeare in the theater seemed to represent a temptation greater even than promiscuous sex or perhaps akin to sex.
exampleZh: 在戏剧中,莎士比亚似乎更代表着一种诱惑,而不是乱性或类似的性关系。

meaning: n. 警报；警报器；闹钟；惊恐，担忧；v. 使不安，使恐慌；给（门等）安装警报器
definition: 1. n. fear resulting from the awareness of danger；2. v. fill with apprehension or alarm; cause to be unpleasantly surprised
example: I hear, perhaps, the sounds of the cars outside my house, my alarm clock ringing, what have you.
exampleZh: 我听到,轿车的声音从室外传来,或是闹钟的铃响,随你想象

meaning: n. 唱片，专辑；相册，影集，集邮册
definition: 1. n. one or more recordings issued together; originally released on 12-inch phonograph records (usually with attractive record covers) and later on cassette audio tape and compact disc；2. n. a book of blank pages with pockets or envelopes; for organizing photographs or stamp collections etc
example: So this first album that is coming out with, it's like my first experiment with it, you know.
exampleZh: 所以这第一张专辑像我的第一次尝试。

meaning: n. 含酒精饮品，酒；酒精，乙醇；醇
definition: 1. n. a liquor or brew containing alcohol as the active agent；2. n. any of a series of volatile hydroxyl compounds that are made from hydrocarbons by distillation
example: So, the active part of the thermometer could be water. It could be alcohol, mercury, it could be a piece of metal.
exampleZh: 那么温度计的工作部分,可以是水可以是酒精，水银，可以是一块金属。

meaning: adj. 酒精的，含酒精的；酒精中毒的，酗酒的；喝酒引起的，由酒精引起的；n. 酗酒者，酒鬼
definition: 1. n. a person who drinks alcohol to excess habitually；2. adj. characteristic of or containing alcohol
example: Novello says college students will spend $4.2 billion yearly on alcoholic beverages.
exampleZh: 诺韦洛说大学生每年会在各种酒精饮料上花费42亿美元。

meaning: n. 麦芽啤酒；一杯（或一瓶、一罐）麦芽啤酒；（泛指）啤酒；【名】 （Ale）（塞、几、葡）阿莱，（伊朗）阿勒（人名）
definition: 1. any of various types of beer, usually one that is dark and bitter
example: So it's true that Ale knows that at least one person in the room has a pink hat on their head.
exampleZh: 所以艾尔确实知道,至少有一个人戴着粉色的帽子

meaning: adj. 警惕的，警觉的；机敏的，敏捷的；意识到，注意到（alert to）；v. 向……报警，使警觉；提示，提醒（某人）；n. 警报，警示；警戒，警惕；（电子设备的）提示信号；警戒期；【名】 （Alert）（美、德、俄、西、印）阿莱尔特（人名）
definition: 1. n. condition of heightened watchfulness or preparation for action；2. v. warn or arouse to a sense of danger or call to a state of preparedness
example: This is more of a spoiler alert, but you've had 41 years to see this movie.
exampleZh: 它不只是一个扰流警报，但是你用了41年来看这个电影。

meaning: n. 代数；代数学
definition: 1. n. the mathematics of generalized arithmetical operations
example: At twenty he translated Euler's standard work on algebra into English.
exampleZh: 20岁时，他把尤勒的权威代数著作译成了英语。

meaning: adj. 陌生的；外国的，异域的；与外星人有关的，与地球外有关的；（植物或动物种类）外来的；不相容的，格格不入的 （alien to）；n. 外国人，侨民；外星人（或生物）；（植物或动物种类）外国引进品种；v. 让渡，转让；【名】 （Alien）（法）阿利安（人名）
definition: 1. relating to creatures from another planet；2. strange and not familiar
example: In a world that had suddenly become alien and dangerous, he was her only security.
exampleZh: 在一个突然变得陌生而危险的世界里，他是她唯一的守护神。

meaning: v. 使疏远，使敌对；使格格不入；转让，让渡（财产或权利）
definition: 1. to cause someone or a group of people to stop supporting and agreeing with you；2. to make someone feel that they are different and not part of a group
example: If you can, turn that kind of sponsor away—it's not worth the money to alienate your audience.
exampleZh: 如果可以的话，把这种赞助商拒之门外——不值得花那么多钱来疏远你的观众。

meaning: n. 疏离感；失去支持，疏远；（财产或权利的）转让，让渡；（马克思主义理论）异化感；情感性精神错乱；间离效果，陌生化效果
definition: 1. the feeling that you have no connection with the people around you or that you are not part of a group；2. the act of making someone stop supporting and agreeing with you
example: Iconoclasts face alienation and failure, but can also be a major asset to any organization.
exampleZh: 反传统者面临着被疏远和失败的处境，但他们也可能成为任何组织的主要资产。

meaning: v. 公开支持，与……结盟；（使）排成一条直线，使平行；调整，使一致；（使）参加，加入
definition: 1. to put two or more things into a straight line, or to form a straight line；2. to be the same or similar, or to agree with each other; to make two things do this
example: The top and bottom line of each column on the page should align.
exampleZh: 版面每栏的头一行和末一行要对齐。

meaning: n. 排成直线，摆放恰当；结盟；协调，一致；（铁路或道路的）路线；石排
definition: 1. an arrangement in which two or more things are positioned in a straight line or parallel to each other；2. an agreement between a group of countries, political parties, or people who want to work together because of shared interests or aims
example: They shunned the belief that there is a link between the alignment of the planets and events on the Earth.
exampleZh: 他们回避了在行星的排列和地球上发生的事件之间有联系的看法。

meaning: adj. 相似的，相像的；adv. 相似地，相同地；两者都，同样地；【名】 （Alike）（美、印）艾立凯（人名）
definition: 1. adj. having the same or similar characteristics；2. adv. equally
example: So maybe you can use this pattern to talk about two people that are alike or two places or two things that are alike.
exampleZh: 所以可能你会用这个句型来谈论相似的两个人、两个地方或者两件事情。

meaning: adj. 活着的；仍然存在的；活跃的，充满活力的；热闹的；尚未失败，仍有成功机会；注意到的
definition: 1. adj. possessing life；2. adj. (often followed by `with') full of life and spirit
example: The good scholars of Milton reveal their typical resistance to anything even remotely interesting or alive in the text.
exampleZh: 研究弥尔顿的优秀学者们透露他们反对,研究文本中那些不太有趣和生动的东西。

meaning: det. 全部；每一个；极度，尽量；无论什么，任何；唯一，仅仅；adj. 全部的；每一个的；任何的；尽可能多的；全然是……的，完全表现出……的；（某一体征）显著突出的；adv. 完全地；各方，各选手；非常，太；pron. 所有，全部；唯一；n. 全部，所有；【名】 （All）（英、美、巴、加）奥尔（人名）
definition: 1. adj. quantifier; used with either mass or count nouns to indicate the whole number or amount of or every one of a class；2. adv. to a complete degree or to the full or entire extent (`whole' is often used informally for `wholly')
example: All the poets we will be talking about today are men; not quite all soldiers, but most of them.
exampleZh: 今天我们要谈论的所有诗人都是男性;,并不全都是士兵，但大多数是。

meaning: v. (未经证实地）宣称，指控
definition: 1. v. report or maintain
example: The claimants allege that manufacturers failed to warn doctors that their drugs should be used only in limited circumstances.
exampleZh: 索赔人声称生产商没有警告医生他们生产的药品只能在特定的条件下使用。

meaning: n. （无证据的）说法，指控
definition: 1. n. (law) a formal accusation against somebody (often in a court of law)；2. n. statements affirming or denying certain matters of fact that you are prepared to prove
example: The inspectors found no evidence which supported any allegation of suppression of official documents.
exampleZh: 这些检察官们找不到证据证明对封锁官方文件的任何指控。

meaning: adj. （未经证实而）声称的，所谓的；（在证据不足的情况下）被指控的；v. (未经证实地）宣称，指控（allege 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. declared but not proved；2. adj. doubtful or suspect
example: And if you believe in justice, well then, you'd better believe in justice for detainees and alleged terrorists.
exampleZh: 如果相信正义，那就最好,相信囚犯也需要正义,对恐怖分子嫌疑人也一样。

meaning: adv. 据说，据宣称
definition: 1. adv. according to what has been alleged
example: The police report stated that he was arrested for allegedly assaulting his wife.
exampleZh: 警方报告称，他因涉嫌殴打妻子而被捕。

meaning: adj. 对……过敏的；过敏引起的，过敏性的；对……极其反感的
definition: 1. having an allergy；2. caused by an allergy
example: Nuts can trigger off a violent allergic reaction.
exampleZh: 坚果可以引起严重的过敏反应。

meaning: n. 过敏反应，过敏症；厌恶，反感
definition: 1. a condition that makes a person become sick or develop skin or breathing problems because they have eaten certain foods or been near certain substances；2. a condition that causes illness when someone eats certain foods or touches or breathes in certain substances
example: This type of allergy can very occasionally be fatal.
exampleZh: 这类过敏症在极个别情况下有可能是致命的。

meaning: v. 减轻，缓和
definition: 1. to make something bad such as pain or problems less severe；2. to make pain or problems less severe
example: In other words, wealthy people, in an effort to alleviate penury, would create a savings bank.
exampleZh: 换句话说,富人们要扶危济困,便建立了储蓄银行

meaning: n. 减轻，缓和；镇痛物
definition: 1. the act of making something bad such as pain or problems less severe
example: You should start your essay with a brief description of the graph and comment on China's achievements in poverty alleviation.
exampleZh: 你应该在文章的开头简要描述这张图表，并评论中国在扶贫方面取得的成就。

meaning: n. 小巷，胡同；（两旁有树木、灌木或石头的）小径；（九柱戏和保龄球等游戏的）球道；双打网球场两边的狭长地带；【名】 （Alley）（英）阿利（人名）
definition: 1. n. a narrow street with walls on both sides；2. n. a lane down which a bowling ball is rolled toward pins
example: He wheeled his bike into the alley at the side of the house.
exampleZh: 他把自行车推进了房屋一侧的胡同里。

meaning: v. 分配，分派，划拨
definition: 1. to give something to someone as their share of a total amount, to use in a particular way；2. to give something as a share of a total amount
example: It helps you allocate proper time for a task and perform the task more efficiently.
exampleZh: 它能帮助你分配合理的任务时间，并助你更高效地执行任务。

meaning: n. 配给量，划拨款，份额；分配，分派
definition: 1. the process of giving someone their part of a total amount of something to use in a particular way；2. the part of a total amount of something that someone is given to use in a particular way
example: A State Department spokeswoman said that the aid allocation for Pakistan was still under review.
exampleZh: 国务院的一位女发言人说对巴基斯坦的援助配置仍在审核之中。

meaning: v. 分配，分派，划拨；【名】 （Allot）（英）阿洛特，（西）阿略特，（法）阿洛（人名）
definition: 1. to give something, especially a share of something available, for a particular purpose；2. to give a share of something for a particular purpose
example: It is suggested that 5,000-6,000 years ago people in the Middle East and North Africa started to allot specific lengths of time to tasks.
exampleZh: 据说，在5000至6000年前，中东和北非的人们开始分配特定时间段来完成任务。

meaning: n. 配额，份额，配给物；分配，指定；（可租用的）小块菜园地；（政府拨给美洲印第安人的）留地
definition: 1. a small piece of ground in or just outside a town that a person rents for growing vegetables, fruits, or flowers；2. the process of sharing something, or the amount that you get
example: The gooseberry bushes in my preserving garden allotment are still in their infancy and I'm not expecting much fruit from them until next year.
exampleZh: 我那块用来制作果酱的园艺分配地里的醋栗树丛还处在幼年期，我要到明年才指望能从它们身上收获不少果实。

meaning: v. 允许，准许；使有可能；任凭；接受，认可；促使；（特地）酌留；承认，同意；让对方得分
definition: 1. v. make it possible through a specific action or lack of action for something to happen；2. v. consent to, give permission
example: No, no. But if you have a UROP, or you have a sports practice or something, we will allow that.
exampleZh: 不行，但是如果你得到本科生研究计划，或者你要进行体育锻炼，我们是能够接受的。

meaning: n. 津贴，补助；限额，定量；折价，折扣；免税额；零花钱；考虑到的事情；体谅，原谅；允许，认可；（赛马）减载量；v. 为（某人）提供津贴；定量供应（物品）
definition: 1. n. an amount allowed or granted (as during a given period)；2. v. put on a fixed allowance, as of food
example: In this case, the total fat, which is twelve grams, constitutes 18% of a day's allowance of fat for the typical 200 calorie diet.
exampleZh: 在此表中,脂肪总量是十二克,占了日脂肪建议摄取量的18%,以两百卡为标准

meaning: n. 合金；（与贵金属混合的）劣等金属；v. 把（金属）铸成合金；损坏，使（价值）降低；【名】 （Alloy）（美、法、英、巴、加）阿洛伊（人名）
definition: 1. a metal that is made by mixing two or more metals, or a metal and another substance；2. to mix a metal with one or more other metals to form a new substance
example: And you have this liquid alloy at 600 degrees centigrade, and it turns into a molten salt.
exampleZh: 你得到了液态合金,在600度的时候，它就转变成熔融盐。

meaning: v. 暗指，影射；略加提及；（艺术家，艺术品）使人想起（从前的作品或风格）
definition: 1. to mention someone or something without talking about him, her, or it directly；2. to mention someone or something in a brief or indirect way
example: This is the song mentioned in Revelation 14 that Milton is continually alluding to and we saw him allude to just this passage in Ad Patrem.
exampleZh: 这时《启示录》第14卷里面提到的4,弥尔顿一直在暗指这一段,他在Ad，Patrem中也暗指了这一段。
note: 剑桥以 allude to someone/something 词条解释该派生词。

meaning: n. 暗指，影射，典故
definition: 1. something that is said or written that is intended to make you think of a particular thing or person；2. a brief or indirect reference
example: You actually see this near the top of the handout, the allusion from the Faerie Queene.
exampleZh: 事实上你们可以在讲义的顶部看到，《仙后》的暗喻。

meaning: n. 吸引力，魅力；v. 吸引，引诱；【名】 （Allure）（美、俄、印）艾罗尔（人名）
definition: 1. the quality of being attractive, interesting, or exciting；2. attraction, charm, or excitement
