example: Already the allure of meals in restaurants had begun to pall.
exampleZh: 餐馆里饭菜的吸引力已经变得平淡了。

meaning: n. 吸引力，魅力；v. 吸引，引诱；【名】 （Allure）（美、俄、印）艾罗尔（人名）
definition: 1. the quality of being attractive, interesting, or exciting；2. attraction, charm, or excitement
example: The allurement of a well-paid overseas posting proved difficult for many young graduates to resist.
exampleZh: 高薪海外职位带来的诱惑令许多年轻毕业生难以抗拒。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）
note: 剑桥以 allure 词条解释该派生词。

meaning: n. 同盟国；盟友，支持者；辅助物，助手；v. 与……结盟，与……联合；【名】 （Ally）（英）艾丽，（法）阿利，（巴基）阿利，（尼日利）阿利（人名）
definition: 1. n. a friendly nation；2. v. become an ally or associate, as by a treaty or marriage
example: What this did is it allowed banks to offer insurance or to ally and join in and merge with insurance companies.
exampleZh: 这个法案允许了银行从事保险业务,或者与保险公司合作,整合,并购

meaning: n. 联盟，结盟；结盟团体，结盟国家；（人们间的）亲密关系，（尤指）联姻
definition: 1. n. the state of being allied or confederated；2. n. a connection based on kinship or marriage or common interest
example: It's exactly what we did with the World Bank and the IMF, with the Mashall Plan, with then the Alliance for Progress later, looking at Latin America.
exampleZh: 就像当初我们和世界银行以及世界货币基金组织，像我们的马歇尔计划，和之后的进步联盟，再看看拉美。

meaning: adj. 全能的；有无限权力的，有强大力量的；巨大的，极度的；（表示惊奇或愤怒）上帝呀；n. 全能者（指上帝）
definition: 1. (of God) having the power to do everything；2. very big, loud, or serious
example: So, on 169, he says to Franny as she's sniveling on the couch: "God almighty, Franny," he said.
exampleZh: 在169页，当弗兰尼躺在沙发上时，他说：,全能的上帝，弗兰尼。

meaning: adv. 几乎，差不多
definition: 1. adv. (of actions or states) slightly short of or not quite accomplished
example: It's a good time you are in college at university and you're almost done. You've finished your last class.
exampleZh: 你在大学度过了一段美好时光，你快要完成学业了。你已经上完了最后一门课。

meaning: adv. 在空中，在高处，在上面；在桅杆（或帆索）高处；prep. 在……之上，在……顶上；adj. 在空中的，在头顶上的；在桅杆（或帆索）高处
definition: 1. in the air or in a higher position
example: The golfer is pictured on many of the front pages, kissing his trophy as he holds it aloft.
exampleZh: 这位高尔夫球手高举奖杯亲吻的照片被刊登在许多报纸的头版上。

meaning: adj. 独自的；单独的；孤独的，无依无靠的；唯一的；adv. 独自，单独；独力，单干（地）；单，只；仅仅……就
definition: 1. adj. isolated from others；2. adv. without any others being included or involved
example: To figure out even what this thing is, let alone how to use it properly. So, you know, I'm sympathetic.
exampleZh: 就连认出这是什么东西（都很困难），更别说正确应用它了，所以我很同情这点。

meaning: prep. 沿着，顺着；靠着……边；在某处；adv. 向前；一起，一道；进行，进展；（前）来，到某处；到相当的程度；传播
definition: 1. adv. with a forward motion；2. adv. in accompaniment or as a companion
example: And many junior faculty who would have been furthur along in their careers, they were just graduate students or junior faculty.
exampleZh: 许多年轻的教员,日后在工作中有很多成就，当时都还只是研究生或是年轻教师。

meaning: prep. 在……旁边；沿着……的边；与……一起，与……并肩（工作）；与……相比；与……同等重要的；同时，共存；adv. 在旁边
definition: 1. adv. side by side
example: It would be, I think, extremely instructive to read it alongside The Return of the Soldier or Mrs. Dalloway for the reasons I've mentioned.
exampleZh: 我觉得如果把这本书和《戴洛维夫人》或,《军士返乡》拿来一起看肯定更受启发。

meaning: adv. 大声地，出声地
definition: 1. adv. using the voice; not silently；2. adv. with relatively high volume
example: If I spoke my thoughts aloud they might be as angry and as wild.
exampleZh: 若能直抒己见,那定当是狂怒野蛮之词。

meaning: n. 字母表；基本要素；初步，入门
definition: 1. n. a character set that includes letters and is used to write a language；2. n. the elementary stages of any subject (usually plural)
example: Q comes between P and R in the English alphabet.
exampleZh: 英语字母表中，Q在P和R之间。

meaning: adj. 字母的；按字母顺序的，照字母次序的
definition: 1. adj. relating to or expressed by a writing system that uses an alphabet；2. adj. arranged in order according to the alphabet
example: The instant access memory of a large computer may hold up to 100,000 "words"—string of alphabetic or numerical characters—ready for instant use.
exampleZh: 一台大型计算机的即时存取存储器可容纳多达100000个“单词”——字母或数字字符的字符串——随时可用。

meaning: adv. 已经，早已；马上，够了（用于表达不耐烦或气恼）
definition: 1. adv. prior to a specified or implied time
example: We have already encountered on some level the importance of the figure of eating to John Milton. Think of Comus.
exampleZh: 我们已经在某种程度上见识到了,对于弥尔顿来说吃的形象的重要性，想想司酒宴之神。

meaning: adv. 此外，而且；也，同样；conj. 另外，又；【名】 （Also）（罗）阿尔索（人名）
definition: 1. adv. in addition
example: It's a piece of language but it also belongs to other sorts of semiotic systems as we'll immediately see.
exampleZh: 它是一种语言,它属于一个特殊的语义系统,下面我来解释一下。

meaning: v. 改变，改动；（使）变化；改（服装）；改建（某建筑）；阉割；【名】 （Alter）（美、德、俄、以色列）阿尔特（人名）
definition: 1. v. cause to change; make different; cause a transformation；2. v. make or become different in some particular way, without permanently losing one's or its former characteristics or essence
example: You're not going to alter how much pleasur you enjoyed previously, how much suffering you've undergone previously.
exampleZh: 你无法改变,从前得到的多少快乐，从前遭受多少痛苦。

meaning: n. 改变，变更；（对衣物的）改动
definition: 1. n. an event that occurs when something passes from one state or phase to another；2. n. the act of making something different (as e.g. the size of a garment)
example: Here the Judicature Act made a definite alteration in the law.
exampleZh: 在此，《司法法》对法律进行了明确的修改。

meaning: adj. 轮流的，交替的；间隔的；供选择的，备用的；（叶，芽）互生的；另类的；v. （使）交替，（使）轮流；n. 替补者，候补者
definition: 1. to happen or exist one after the other repeatedly；2. to make something happen or exist one after the other repeatedly
example: What we don't get here is a sense of whether there really is an alternate secret postal system that serves a sort of underground of private networks.
exampleZh: 在这里我们所不明白的是，是否真的存在一个,提供地下的,私密的通信服务的，秘密邮政系统。

meaning: n. 交替，轮流，间隔（在两个或多个状态、动作或条件之间依次反复出现或更替的过程）；（语言学）语音或形态交替（音位、词缀或语法形式在特定条件下系统性地更替出现的现象）；（生物学）世代交替（某些生物生活史中有性与无性生殖世代交替出现的现象，常作 alternation of generations）；（计算机科学）交替或选择（正则表达式或形式语法中表示“或”关系的匹配结构）。
definition: 1. a situation in which one thing repeatedly happens or exists after another
example: You can think of a set as shorthand for alternation of characters.
exampleZh: 您可以将集合 看作是字符备选项的简写法。

meaning: adv. 交替地；轮流地；none
definition: 1. in a way that involves two things happening or existing one after the other repeatedly；2. in a manner in which two things each replace the other
example: Alternately, you could also seek out hard data that illuminates your real chance of success in whatever endeavor you are contemplating.
exampleZh: 或者，你也可以寻找能够说明你在所考虑的任何事业中获得成功的真实机会的确凿数据。

meaning: n. 可供选择的事物，替代物；adj. 可替代的，备选的；非传统的，另类的；（两者）互不相容的，非此即彼的
definition: 1. n. one of a number of things from which only one can be chosen；2. adj. allowing a choice
example: What's the alternative? The alternative,it seems,for the soul theorist, Shelly Kagan is to say,neither of them is Shelly Kagan.
exampleZh: 还有什么选择，灵魂理论者还有的选择，就是说他们都不是。

meaning: conj. 虽然，尽管；但是，然而
definition: 1. despite the fact that; used to introduce a contrast
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: Yet somehow it was transformed into, what it's turned into, a beautiful thing, although not without pain. -Yes.
exampleZh: 但您的一生却，得以转化成另外一种美，尽管伴随着苦痛，-是的。

meaning: n. 海拔高度；高地；（天体在地平线上的）地平纬度；顶垂线；（等级和地位等的）高级
definition: 1. n. elevation especially above sea level or above the earth's surface；2. n. the perpendicular distance from the base of a geometric figure to opposite vertex (or side if parallel)
example: The plane made a dive to a lower altitude.
exampleZh: 飞机俯冲到较低高度。

meaning: adv. 完全地；总共；总之
definition: 1. n. informal terms for nakedness；2. adv. to a complete degree or to the full or entire extent (`whole' is often used informally for `wholly')
example: It's mortality that gives it that sense of ephemeral value, but it's also mortality that threatens to cancel it out altogether.
exampleZh: 因为逃不过必死的结局所以给了美朝生暮死的价值，但必死性也可能带来全盘出局的威胁。

meaning: n. 铝（化学元素，符号 Al，美国英语拼写，英国英语作 aluminium）
definition: 1. n. a silvery ductile metallic element found primarily in bauxite
example: He says not only does arsenic belong under phosphorus, I predict that there is an element that lies below aluminum and above indium.
exampleZh: 他认为不仅砷属于在磷下面，我预言还有一个元素,是在铝之上和铟的下边的。

meaning: adv. 总是，每次都是；一直，长久以来；永远；老是，一再；总还有（表示有另一种可能）
definition: 1. adv. at all times; all the time and on every occasion；2. adv. seemingly without interruption; often and repeatedly
example: It's a persistent problem partly because it always raises these issues of fictionality versus truthfulness, of honesty versus embellishment.
exampleZh: 这是个持久的问题,原因是它一直在质疑虚构性和真实性的关系，还有诚实与修饰的关系。

meaning: v. 是（be 的第一人称单数现在时）；abbr. 上午（同 a.m.）；abbr. （AM）调幅（Amplitude Modulation）；威尔士国民议会（assembly member）；abbr. （Am.）美国人（American）；n. （AM）（中、英）安（人名）
definition: 1. n. a radioactive transuranic metallic element; discovered by bombarding uranium with helium atoms；2. n. a master's degree in arts and sciences
example: That means that p1 and -- where I am, the point number 1 and point number 2 were completely arbitrary.
exampleZh: 因为1和，两个点是2,陆军上面。

meaning: v. 积累，积聚；（人）聚集
definition: 1. to get a large amount of something, especially money or information, by collecting it over a long period；2. to gather a large amount of something, esp. money, by collecting it over a period of time
example: He is planning to amass a fortune for a rainy day.
exampleZh: 他正打算积蓄财富以备不时之需。

meaning: n. 业余爱好者；生手，外行；adj. 非专业的，业余爱好的；不熟练的
definition: 1. n. someone who pursues a study or sport as a pastime；2. adj. engaged in as a pastime
example: Now, and I don't think this is unimportant, King was also - it would seem he was also a minor poet, an amateur poet.
exampleZh: 我认为这并非不重要，金也是,-尽管不显赫，他也是个诗人，一个业余诗人。

meaning: v. 使惊奇，使惊愕
definition: 1. v. affect with wonder；2. v. be a mystery or bewildering to
example: This one I learned about in my own research about 20 years ago, and it never ceases to amaze me.
exampleZh: 这是在我自己的研究中发现的,大概20年前，它一直让我很吃惊。

meaning: adj. 惊人的，了不起的；令人诧异的，令人惊愕的；令人高兴的；v. 使惊奇，使惊愕（amaze 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. surprising greatly；2. adj. inspiring awe or admiration or wonder
example: So two totally different things but, I think it's, it's a cool, cool concept and obviously amazing program, company.
exampleZh: 虽然这是两个完全不同的行业，但我认为他的概念非常好，是个非常出色的项目、公司。

meaning: n. 惊诧，惊奇
definition: 1. n. the feeling that accompanies something extremely surprising
example: They are just being enjoyed there, and they just evoke our sense of radical amazement.
exampleZh: 他们只是让我们来享受，他们会激发起我们最心底的惊奇。

meaning: n. 大使，使节；（体育项目、行业等的）代表人物
definition: 1. n. a diplomat of the highest rank; accredited as representative from one country to another；2. n. an informal representative
example: Welcome back. Ambassador Finn, It's wonderful to have you back with us. Thank you. It's nice to be here.
exampleZh: 欢迎回来，芬恩大使，很高兴能再次邀请您做客，谢谢，我也很高兴。

meaning: adj. 模棱两可的，有歧义的；不明朗的，不确定的
definition: 1. having or expressing more than one possible meaning, sometimes intentionally
example: It's usually best to respond in a complete sentence rather than saying yes or no which can be ambiguous.
exampleZh: 一般来说，回答最好是完整的句子，而不是简单的模棱两可的“是”或“不是”。

meaning: n. 模棱两可，不明确；含混不清的语句；一语多义；暧昧，难以理解的感情（或想法）
definition: 1. (an example of) the fact of something having more than one possible meaning and therefore possibly causing confusion；2. a situation or statement that is unclear because it can be understood in more than one way
example: It does so by insisting on a complex mode of ambiguity that governs the passage--not atmosphere.
exampleZh: 这篇文章很朦胧，很复杂,算不上是一种气氛。

meaning: n. 追求的目标，抱负；雄心，野心；干劲；v. 追求，有……野心
definition: 1. n. a cherished desire；2. v. have as one's ambition
example: The other way it shares an ambition of modernism is precisely in that effort to communicate experience, consciousness.
exampleZh: 它与现代主义追求的另一个共同点,正体现在经验和意识的交流上。

meaning: adj. 有抱负的，野心勃勃的；费劲的，艰巨的；热望的
definition: 1. adj. having a strong desire for success or achievement；2. adj. requiring full use of your abilities or resources
example: Poets begin their careers with easy pastoral poems, but Virgil's speaker says that he is more ambitious now.
exampleZh: 这些诗人在职业生涯初期创作一些简单的田园诗，但是维吉尔的叙述者称说，他现在更有抱负了。

meaning: n. 急救车，救护车；v. 用救护车送（人）
definition: 1. n. a vehicle that takes people to and from hospitals
example: Then, I could hook up another ambulance and a taxicab, a police car, a fire truck.
exampleZh: 接着我可以联接另一辆救护车和出租车，警车和消防车。

meaning: v. 修改，修订；纠正，改正；改善（土壤）的结构（或肥力）；修复；改过自新；【名】 （Amend）（英、德）阿门德（人名）
definition: 1. to change the words of a text, especially a law or a legal document；2. to change the words of something written, esp. a law or a legal document
example: I think we all vote and amend and have activism of our values, religious or not.
exampleZh: 我们每个人都有投票权，希望实现,我们自己的价值观，不管这是否牵扯到宗教。

meaning: n. 修正，修订之处；美国宪法修正案（Amendment）；（土壤结构或肥力的）改善；（对文件或计划的）修改
definition: 1. a change or changes made to the words of a text；2. a change to a law that is not yet in operation and is still being discussed
example: On the other hand, what most of us rely upon I think is essentially the first amendment tradition.
exampleZh: 另一方面，我们大多数人遵循的,说到底还是美国第一修正案的传统。

meaning: adj. 和蔼可亲的，友好的；令人愉快的；【名】 （Amiable）（英）阿米娅布尔，（法）阿米亚布勒（人名）
definition: 1. pleasant and friendly
example: She had been surprised at how amiable and polite he had been.
exampleZh: 她对他如此和蔼可亲、彬彬有礼感到了惊讶。

meaning: prep. 在……过程中，在……中；四周是，被……所环绕；【名】 （Amid）（美）阿米德（人名）
definition: 1. abstract: Amid is an alternate name of Diyarbakır, a city in Turkey.
example: The hotel was in a beautiful position amid lemon groves.
exampleZh: 旅馆位于柠檬树丛之中，优美宜人。

meaning: n. 弹药，军火；（批评或辩论中攻击他人的）把柄，证据
definition: 1. objects that can be shot from a weapon, such as bullets or bombs；2. facts that can be used to support an argument
example: CIT's plight is meanwhile being used as ammunition in a rancorous debate over how to handle failed financial firms.
exampleZh: 与此同时，CIT 的困境正被当作弹药，用于一场围绕如何处置破产金融机构的激烈争执中。

meaning: prep. 在……当中，周围是；与……在一起；……之一；在……群体中；为……所共有；彼此间；以及
definition: 1. in the middle of or surrounded by a group; included in a group
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: That's why the poem, the lyric poem, is privileged among the forms of literary discourse in the New Criticism.
exampleZh: 这就是为什么诗，一首抒情诗，在新批评派眼里要优于其他各种文学形式。

meaning: n. 数量，量；金额，钱数；（感情、质量的）程度；v. 达到，总计（amount to）；等于，意味着（amount to）；发展成，变成（amount to）
definition: 1. n. how much of something is available；2. v. be tantamount or equivalent to
example: And he had a press conference, spoke about the increased use of cars, and the decreased amount of carpooling.
exampleZh: 他开了一个新闻发布会，说道汽车使用量的增加，和拼车的减少。

meaning: adj. 充足的，充裕的；丰满的；宽敞的，巨大的；【名】 （Ample）（西）安普尔（人名）
definition: 1. adj. more than enough in size or scope or capacity；2. adj. affording an abundant supply
example: The driver had ample time to brake or swerve and avoid the woman.
exampleZh: 该司机有足够的时间刹车或急转来避让那女子。

meaning: v. 放大，扩大（声音）；增强，加强；详述，进一步阐明；扩增（基因，DNA序列）
definition: 1. to make something louder；2. to increase the size or effect of something
example: That way you could deliver a small number of vectors and they could amplify into a large number of vectors.
exampleZh: 这样你只需向细胞中转入少量载体,就能得到大量的拷贝

meaning: n. 扩大，增强；阐述，引申；扩增
definition: 1. Amplification makes music or other sounds louder；2. added detail
example: Until the teens, telephones were very expensive because they didn't have good amplification technology.
exampleZh: 在20年代之前,电话还是奢侈品,因为它们还没有增强讯号技术

meaning: v. 逗乐，逗笑；（提供）消遣，（使）娱乐
definition: 1. v. occupy in an agreeable, entertaining or pleasant fashion；2. v. make (somebody) laugh
example: I need distractions. I need to amuse myself so I won't keep thinking about things.
exampleZh: 我需要娱乐。我需要自我消遣，这样我才不会一直想事情。

meaning: adj. 逗人发笑的，有趣的；v. 逗乐，逗笑；（提供）消遣（amuse 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. providing enjoyment; pleasantly entertaining；2. adj. arousing or provoking laughter
example: The show is very amusing and the cast is very good.
exampleZh: 表演非常有趣，演员都很优秀。

meaning: n. 开心，娱乐；娱乐活动，娱乐设施
definition: 1. n. a feeling of delight at being entertained；2. n. an activity that is diverting and that holds the attention
example: What do you do for amusement round here?
exampleZh: 你在这儿以什么消遣？

meaning: n. 相似物，类似事情；相似化合物；adj. 模拟的；（钟表）指针式的
definition: 1. An analogue recording is one that is made by changing the sound waves into electrical signals of the same type. An analogue signal is a signal of this type；2. Analogue television is broadcast using analogue signals, rather than using digital signals
example: Soldier crab is a symbol and when referred to photography, it delivers a message of analogue.
exampleZh: 寄居蟹是一种象征，而当涉及摄影领域时，它传递出模拟摄影的相关寓意。

meaning: adj. 相似的，类似的；（器官）同功的
definition: 1. having similar features to another thing and therefore able to be compared with it；2. (of colours) next to each other on the colour wheel (= a diagram showing colours in a circle so you can see the relationships between them) and therefore similar
example: The solar system also has two analogous classes of objects, smaller than planets—namely, asteroids and comets.
exampleZh: 太阳系也有两类类似的物体，比行星还小——即小行星和彗星。

meaning: n. 类比，比拟；用类比方法，进行比照；同功
definition: 1. a comparison between things that have similar features, often used to help explain a principle or idea；2. a comparison of the features or qualities of two different things to show their similarities
example: The teacher drew an analogy between the human heart and a pump.
exampleZh: 老师打了个比喻，把人的心脏比作水泵。

meaning: vt. 对……进行分析，剖析，研究（等于 analyse）；对……进行分解，解析（常用于科学、数学、语法、化学等领域）；（心理学）对……进行精神分析
definition: 1. v. consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning；2. v. make a mathematical, chemical, or grammatical analysis of; break down into components or essential features
example: Now we're going to analyze this, no secret here, we're going to analyze this using the idea of best response.
exampleZh: 毫无疑问,接下来,我们要用最佳对策的思想来分析了
family: analyze / analyzyse / analysis / analytic / analytical / analyst

meaning: n. 分析；化验分析；心理分析，精神分析；分析报告
definition: 1. n. an investigation of the component parts of a whole and their relations in making up the whole；2. n. the abstract separation of a whole into its constituent parts in order to study the parts and their relations
example: You can ask for a chemical analysis of your tap water.
exampleZh: 你可以要求给你的自来水做化学分析。
family: analyze / analyzyse / analysis / analytic / analytical / analyst

meaning: adj. 分析的，分析性的（=analytical）；具备分析能力的，善于分析的（=analytical）；逻辑必然的；（语言）分析性的
definition: 1. adj. using or subjected to a methodology using algebra and calculus；2. adj. using or skilled in using analysis (i.e., separating a whole--intellectual or substantial--into its elemental parts or basic principles)
example: He's seen me work on long assignments, short assignments, very analytic assignments, very not so analytic assignments.

meaning: n. 祖先，血统；（动植物的）世系，演化；起源，滥觞

meaning: n. 锚；支柱，靠山；商场；新闻节目主持人；（汽车的）刹车；v. 抛锚，泊（船）；使稳固，使固定；成为支柱；主持（新闻节目）；使扎根，使基于；支持，保护；adj. 末棒的，最后一棒的

meaning: adj. 古代的，远古的；古老的，年代久远的；老的，老掉牙的；n. （尤指埃及、希腊和罗马的）古代人；老头

meaning: conj. （用于并列连接）和，与，及；（表示结果）于是，就；（表示先后）然后，接着；（表示转折）但是，然而；（用于句首引出补充）而且，此外；（连接同一词）表示程度加深或持续，如 more and more（越来越）；（用于数字）加，又（英式英语亦连接百位与后接数字）；（非正式，用于 go/come/try 后接另一动词）去，来，试着；n. 逻辑与（AND）；（And）人名（土耳其、瑞典，常译作安德）

meaning: n. 轶事，趣闻；传闻

exampleZh: 此外还有通过个人访谈和小组访谈收集到的轶事证据，以及通过施测问卷收集到的信息。

meaning: n. 天使；仁慈的人，善人；宝贝，乖乖；（尤指仁慈的）精灵，保护神；仙波，雷达回响；【名】 （Angel）（英、罗）安杰尔，（德、塞、俄、保、瑞典、挪）安格尔，（法、葡）安热尔，（西）人名安赫尔，（土）安盖尔（人名）

meaning: n. 角；倾斜，斜角；角度；视角，立场；不可告人的动机；诡计，狡猾的手段；角铁，角钢；鱼钩；v. 斜移，斜置；向（特定人群）提供资讯，定位于；博取，谋取；垂钓，钓鱼；（使）朝向，（使）转向

meaning: adj. 愤怒的，生气的；狂风暴雨的，波涛汹涌的；红肿的，感染的

meaning: n. 愤怒，怒火；v. 使生气，激怒；【名】 （Anger）（法）安热，（德、捷、瑞典）安格尔，（罗）安杰尔（人名）

meaning: n. 剧痛，极度痛苦；v. 感到痛苦

meaning: n. 动物；兽类；衣冠禽兽，畜牲；某一类人或物；adj. 动物的；肉体的，肉欲的；取自动物的；（胚胎）动物极的

meaning: v. 强占，并吞，兼并；附加（尤指对文件补充）；n. 附属建筑；（文件的）附录，附件；【名】 （Annex）（美、法、加、瑞、尼）艾尼克斯（人名）

meaning: v. 预期，预料；预见（并做准备）；期望，盼望；先于……做，早于……行动；提前使用；在期限内履行（义务），偿还（债务）

example: We're desperately hungry", as Marcus empathizes with, "we're desperately hungry. You're not going to last long anyhow."
exampleZh: 我们实在太饿了，马库斯对此感同身受啊，我们实在太饿了，反正你也活不久了“

meaning: pron. 任何事物 （用于含有否定意义的陈述句中）；某事物（用于疑问句和条件分句中）；任一事物（强调）；任何……的事物（接后置修饰语）；任何（接近、像……的）事物；（某范围的）任何事物；重要东西，重要事物；某一限定范围之内的任何一个数量
definition: 1. n. a thing of any kind
example: Milton shows unusually little interest in the miraculousness of the conception or anything like the domestic details of the manger scene.
exampleZh: 不同寻常的是，弥尔顿没有太对,怀孕这一奇迹或其他的事情感兴趣,像马槽这个内在的细节。

meaning: adv. 不管怎样，无论如何；而且，加之；尽管，即使这样；对了，好吧（用于转换话题或回到前一个话题）；（用于表明某事不重要）反正；至少；总之；（表示有意结束谈话）那么；究竟，到底；噢，啊（用于结束谈话或离开）
definition: 1. adv. used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement；2. adv. in any way whatsoever
example: But let me use the term "event" anyway, employing it with caution and as if in quotation marks.
exampleZh: 但是无论如何我还是使用，“事件“，这个词，小心谨慎地使用它，带引号地使用。

meaning: adv. 在任何地方；无论何处；n. 任何地方
definition: 1. adv. at or in or to any place
example: I mean, coming from New York, anywhere I will be a little bit jaded, but Providence is a nice city.
exampleZh: 因为来自纽约，我会对所有地方感到厌倦，但普罗维登斯确实是个不错的地方。

meaning: adv. （空间或时间）相隔，相距；拆开，成碎片；解体，崩溃；分开，分离；与众不同地，独特地；除了……外；远远地；adj. 意见不一致的，有分歧的；分开的；与众不同的
definition: 1. adj. remote and separate physically or socially；2. adv. separated or at a distance in place or position or time
example: I would guess that's pretty much, you know, apart from, you know, all the usual, well-known things.
exampleZh: 我觉得这些差不多了，加上那些众所周知的地方的话。

meaning: n. 公寓套房；（总统等要人的）房间，套间
definition: 1. n. a suite of rooms usually on one floor of an apartment house
example: There is a cat outside the apartment building that starts to meow and the boys are interested in it.
exampleZh: 男孩儿们对楼外,叫唤的猫很感兴趣。

meaning: n. 猿，类人猿；粗野的人，蠢人；v. 模仿；【名】 （Ape）（意）阿佩（人名）
definition: 1. an animal like a large monkey with no tail, that uses its arms to move through trees；2. to copy something or someone badly and unsuccessfully
example: Kivell and Schmitt think this suggests the independent evolution of knuckle-walking behavior in the two African ape lineages.
exampleZh: 凯威尔和施密特认为这表明了在两个非洲类人猿谱系中关节行走行为的独立进化。

meaning: n. 道歉；（因不能赴会的）道歉信；辩护，辩解；勉强（或不适当的）替代物；糟糕的例子
definition: 1. n. an expression of regret at having caused trouble for someone；2. n. a formal written defense of something you believe in strongly
example: Remember, the Apology viewed the dangers posed to philosophy and the philosopher and the philosophical life from the city.
exampleZh: 谨记，《苏格拉底自辩篇》看穿了,城邦对哲学，哲学家,及哲学生活造成的风险。

meaning: v. 道歉，谢罪
definition: 1. v. acknowledge faults or shortcomings or failing；2. v. defend, explain, clear away, or make excuses for by reasoning
example: And then this country has to work with many other nations and listen to them, not apologize, not gravel.
exampleZh: 然后我们需要,与其他国家合作,听取他们的建议，不用道歉，不用困惑。

meaning: adj. 道歉的，愧疚的；（为理论或宗教教义）辩护的，辩解的
definition: 1. adj. offering or expressing apology
example: Gadamer is a bit apologetic about it, and he goes into the appropriate etymologies.
exampleZh: 伽达默尔对它略有歉意，并且他借助了一下语源学。

meaning: abbr. （计算机）应用程序，应用软件；开胃菜；【名】 （App）（美、德、巴）阿普（人名）；（App）（美、德、巴）阿普（人名）
definition: 1. abstract: App is short for application software but is frequently used to mean mobile app (more specific) or computer program (more general).
example: I think we have an app that's like, "Next Muni" here in the city.
exampleZh: 我们有一个“下一趟有轨电车”的应用程序。

meaning: v. 使恐惧，使憎恶，使大为震惊
definition: 1. to make someone have strong feelings of shock or of disapproval
example: THE scene is enough to appal those teachers steeped in ideas about child-centred education and learning through play.
exampleZh: 这个场景足以让那些整日浸淫于“教育要以孩子为中心”和“寓教于乐”等思想的教师们感到震惊。

meaning: adj. 骇人听闻的，令人震惊的；非常的，极其严重的；极坏的，糟透的；v. 使恐惧，使憎恶，使大为震惊（appal 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. very bad；2. shocking and very bad
example: The investigation revealed appalling safety failures that had been ignored for several years.
exampleZh: 调查揭露了多年来一直被忽视的极其严重的安全疏漏。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 设备，器具；机构，组织；器官；评论性注释
definition: 1. n. equipment designed to serve a specific function；2. n. (anatomy) a group of body parts that work together to perform a given function
example: One of the boys had to be rescued by firemen wearing breathing apparatus.
exampleZh: 其中的一个男孩得由戴着呼吸设备的消防队员们营救。

meaning: adj. 显而易见的，易懂的；貌似的，表面上的
definition: 1. adj. clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment；2. adj. appearing as such but not necessarily so
example: Some abstraction is also apparent in the shift from visual to aural imagery in describing God's self-manifestations or theophanies.
exampleZh: 某些抽离在从纳贡者到听见神的自我宣称,或者神显的想像中也是十分明显的。

meaning: adv. 据说，显然；似乎，好像
definition: 1. adv. from appearances alone；2. adv. unmistakably (`plain' is often used informally for `plainly')
example: Franny again cleared her throat. Apparently, her self-imposed sentence of unadulterated good listenership had been fully served. "Why?" she asked.
exampleZh: 弗兰尼又清了喉咙，他的自欺式的自白得到了倾听,遇到了好听众，为什么，她问。

meaning: n. 呼吁，恳求；上诉，申诉；吸引力，感染力；（为慈善或正义事业的）募捐；启发，打动；v. 呼吁，恳求；上诉，申诉；有吸引力，引起兴趣；启发，打动
definition: 1. n. earnest or urgent request；2. v. take a court case to a higher court for review
example: If you can put it in other words, those other words take the form of an appeal to intention.
exampleZh: 若你能将它换个方式表达出来，那也需要借助于意图。

meaning: adj. 吸引人的，有感染力的；恳求的，可怜的；v. 呼吁，恳求；上诉；引起兴趣（appeal 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. able to attract interest or draw favorable attention；2. adj. (of characters in literature or drama) evoking empathic or sympathetic feelings
example: What is it about Tom Hanks that cinema-goers find so appealing?
exampleZh: 汤姆·汉克斯哪点让电影观众觉得那么有吸引力？

meaning: v. 出现，呈现；首次使用，起源；出庭；演出，出场；出版，发表；记载，提及；看来，似乎；表现得……；到达
definition: 1. v. give a certain impression or have a certain outward aspect；2. v. come into sight or view
example: The line of demarcation therefore between the divine and the natural And human worlds would appear to be clear.
exampleZh: 那么神圣与自然的界限,以及与人类世界的界线就很清楚了。

meaning: n. 露面，演出；出庭，到场；外表，外观；表面现象，假象；出现；起源，问世；表现；出版，广播
definition: 1. n. outward or visible aspect of a person or thing；2. n. the event of coming into sight
example: Alpheus is also the god of erotic pastoral poetry, it turns out, and this god is literally gone underground during the terrifying appearance of Saint Peter.
exampleZh: 阿尔甫斯也是描写爱欲的诗歌之神，从诗句上来看，这位神灵在圣彼得面前,悄无声息的隐匿了踪影。

meaning: vt. 平息，安抚；缓解
definition: 1. to prevent further disagreement or fighting by letting the opposing side have something that they want；2. to get rid of unpleasant feelings or make them less strong
example: Gandhi was accused by some of trying to appease both factions of the electorate.
exampleZh: 甘地被一些人指责试图对两派选民都加以姑息。

meaning: n. 平息，安抚，姑息
definition: 1. the act of giving the opposing side in an argument or war an advantage that they have demanded, in order to prevent further disagreement；2. the action of satisfying the demands an aggressive person, country, or organization
example: "Those who display of shame," Tracy says, "have been associated with an awareness of social norms and appeasement behaviors, which elicits trust in others."
exampleZh: “那些表现出害羞的人，”特雷西说，“与社会规范意识和绥靖行为联系在一起，从而引发对他人的信任。”

meaning: n. 阑尾；附录
definition: 1. a small tube-shaped part that is joined to the intestines on the right side of the body and has no use in humans；2. a separate part at the end of a book or magazine that gives extra information
example: The book also includes an appendix with a listing of all U.S. presidents.
exampleZh: 这本书还包含一个列有所有美国总统的附录。

meaning: n. 食欲，胃口；欲望，爱好
definition: 1. n. a feeling of craving something
example: Anyway, philosophers are not purely thinking machines but they are also human beings composed of reason, spiritedness, and appetite.
exampleZh: 无论如何，哲学家并非只是思考机器,他们也是人类,拥有理性，意志与欲望。

meaning: v. 鼓掌；称赞，赞许
definition: 1. v. clap one's hands or shout after performances to indicate approval；2. v. express approval of
example: The analysts applaud the cuts in marginal businesses, but insist the company must make deeper sacrifices.
exampleZh: 分析家们赞同对边际业务的削减，但坚持认为公司必须作出更大牺牲。

meaning: n. 掌声，喝彩
definition: 1. n. a demonstration of approval by clapping the hands together
example: So they're still managing to coordinate but you... Okay, so thank you for this couple, let's give them a round of applause.
exampleZh: 你们又协调成功了,感谢这对情侣,给他们点掌声吧

meaning: n. 苹果；苹果树；苹果公司（Apple Inc.）
definition: 1. n. fruit with red or yellow or green skin and sweet to tart crisp whitish flesh；2. n. native Eurasian tree widely cultivated in many varieties for its firm rounded edible fruits
example: One of our folks reminded me, Microsoft was started and Apple was started during kind of a recessionary period.
exampleZh: 我们的一位同事提醒过我，微软和苹果都是在,经济衰退期成立的。

meaning: n. 家用电器，装置；应用；消防车
definition: 1. n. a device or control that is very useful for a particular job；2. n. durable goods for home or office use
example: Before you buy a new appliance, talk to someone who owns one.
exampleZh: 购买新电器之前，先和有这个电器的人谈谈。

meaning: v. 申请；涂，敷；施加，实施；应用，运用；踩（刹车）；适用，适合；指称
definition: 1. v. put into service; make work or employ (something) for a particular purpose or for its inherent or natural purpose；2. v. be pertinent or relevant or applicable
example: Second explicate purpose for the education institutions is to allow students to practice and to apply what they've learnt.
exampleZh: 第二个教育体系的,表面目标是,给学生实践的机会,让他们运用所学的知识。

meaning: n. 正式申请，书面申请；申请书，申请表；敷用，涂抹；应用，实施；指称；应用软件；勤奋，努力
definition: 1. n. a verbal or written request for assistance or employment or admission to a school；2. n. the act of bringing something to bear; using it for a particular purpose
example: Now for thinking about the application or that putting the content into practice, we put a great deal of emphasis on that.
exampleZh: 接下来要考虑应用,即将内容运用于实践，我们非常强调这一点。

meaning: n. 申请人
definition: 1. n. a person who requests or seeks something such as assistance or employment or admission
example: Upon a negative decision, the applicant loses the protection offered by Belgian law.
exampleZh: 一旦得到否定裁决，申请人就失去了比利时法律所给予的保护。

meaning: adj. 适用的，适当的
definition: 1. adj. capable of being applied; having relevance；2. adj. readily applicable or practical
example: What is a reasonable standard for one family is not applicable for another.
exampleZh: 对一个家庭合理的标准对于另一个家庭并不适用。

meaning: v. 任命，指派；约定，安排（日期、时间）；装饰，布置（房间或空间）；命令，颁布法令；受权处置（财产）
definition: 1. v. create and charge with a task or function；2. v. assign a duty, responsibility or obligation to
example: After due consideration, we have decided to appoint Mr Davis to the job.
exampleZh: 经过适当考虑，我们决定委任戴维斯先生干这项工作。

meaning: n. 约会，约定；任命，委派；职务，职位；家具，陈设
definition: 1. n. the act of putting a person into a non-elective position；2. n. a meeting arranged in advance
example: For example, if you are running behind schedule and you really must be moving to your next appointment,
exampleZh: 例如，如果你已经比计划的时间晚了，不得不马上赶赴下一场约会的时候，

meaning: v. 评价，估量；估价
definition: 1. to examine someone or something in order to judge their or its qualities, success, or needs；2. to give a judgment about how much money something might be sold for
example: This prompted many employers to appraise their selection and recruitment policies.
exampleZh: 这促使很多雇主评价其人才选聘政策。

meaning: n. 评估，估价；评价；员工工作评估
definition: 1. the act of examining someone or something in order to judge their or its qualities, success, or needs；2. a meeting in which an employee discusses his or her progress, aims, and needs at work with his or her manager or employer
example: It may also be necessary to get a new appraisal of the property.
exampleZh: 可能还需要对该房产做个新的估价。

meaning: v. 欣赏，鉴赏；理解，明白；感谢，感激；升值，增值
definition: 1. v. recognize with gratitude; be grateful for；2. v. be fully aware of; realize fully
example: What I want to do is get you to appreciate the unique perspective that you will get from studying solid-state chemistry.
exampleZh: 我要做的是，让你们,欣赏领会到它独特的远景,在学习固体化学的过程中。

meaning: n. 欣赏，鉴赏；感激，感谢；理解，领会；升值，增值；（赞赏性的）演讲，文字
definition: 1. n. understanding of the nature or meaning or quality or magnitude of something；2. n. delicate discrimination (especially of aesthetic values)
example: The aim is to inculcate businesspeople with an appreciation of different cultures.
exampleZh: 其目的是教导商界人员学会欣赏不同的文化。

meaning: adj. 欣赏的，赞赏的；感激的，感谢的
definition: 1. adj. feeling or expressive of gratitude；2. adj. having or showing appreciation or a favorable critical judgment or opinion
example: I have been appreciative of this job, conscious of how disastrous it would be to lose it.
exampleZh: 我一直很珍视这份工作，清楚失去它的后果会有多严重。

meaning: n. 学徒，徒弟；生手，新手；v. 收……为学徒；当学徒
definition: 1. someone who has agreed to work for a skilled person for a particular period of time and often for low payment, in order to learn that person's skills；2. to make someone an apprentice
example: To his chagrin, the apprentice had disobeyed the sorcerer.
exampleZh: 让他懊恼的是，学徒没有服从巫师的命令。

meaning: v. 靠近，临近；接洽，交谈；对付，处理；近似，接近于；n. 方法，态度；靠近，接近；接洽，要求；通道，路径；进场着陆；近似物
definition: 1. n. ideas or actions intended to deal with a problem or situation；2. v. move towards
example: What Levi-Strauss is saying here is that his approach to myth is itself only a version of the myth.
exampleZh: 列维这里想说的是,研究神话的方法本身只是神话的一个版本。

meaning: adj. 合适的，相称的；v. 拨出（款项）；私占，挪用
definition: 1. v. give or assign a resource to a particular person or cause；2. adj. suitable for a particular person or place or condition etc
example: Speech is the way in which we appropriate, deploy and make use of language, and Saussure calls that "parole."
exampleZh: 话语是我们使用语言，分配部署语言的结果，索绪尔叫它，个人语言“

meaning: adj. 合适的，相称的；v. 拨出（款项）；私占，挪用
definition: 1. suitable or right for a particular situation or occasion；2. to take something for your own use, usually without permission
example: Speech is the way in which we appropriate, deploy and make use of language, and Saussure calls that "parole."
exampleZh: 话语是我们使用语言，分配部署语言的结果，索绪尔叫它，个人语言“

meaning: n. 侵吞，挪用；拨款，拨付；所拨款项，专款
definition: 1. n. money set aside (as by a legislature) for a specific purpose；2. n. incorporation by joining or uniting
example: Calls by scientists for large increases in the appropriation of funds for public spending on agricultural research are more than justified.
exampleZh: 科学家们呼吁大幅增加农业研究的公共开支拨款，是非常合理的。

meaning: v. 同意，赞成；批准，通过；核准；喜欢，赞赏；证明，显示；使（废品或公共土地）升值
definition: 1. v. give sanction to；2. v. judge to be right or commendable; think well of
example: The Secretary of State has the power to approve the proposals.
exampleZh: 国务卿有权批准这些提议。

meaning: n. 称许，赞成；批准，许可
definition: 1. n. the formal act of approving；2. n. a feeling of liking something or someone good
example: And you can't read it but there's a kind of stamp of approval here from the governor Nelson Rockefeller.
exampleZh: 你没法领会这个，但是这里有,作为州长的尼尔森，洛克菲勒对此的承认。

meaning: adj. 大概的，近似的；v. 类似，接近；模仿，模拟；粗略估计
definition: 1. v. be close or similar；2. adj. not quite exact or correct
example: They did not have even an approximate idea what the Germans really wanted.
exampleZh: 他们对于德国人真正想要什么甚至没有一个大致概念。

meaning: adv. 大约，大概
definition: 1. adv. (of quantities) imprecise but fairly close to correct
example: At approximately 11:30 p.m., Pollard finally gave his consent to the search.
exampleZh: 大约晚上11:30的时候，波拉德终于对搜查予以同意。

meaning: n. 粗略估计，近似值；类似事物，相似物；近似法
definition: 1. n. an approximate calculation of quantity or degree or worth；2. n. the quality of coming near to identity (especially close in quantity)
example: That is a fair approximation of the way in which the next boss is being chosen.
exampleZh: 那是一个挑选下任老板的大体近似方式。

meaning: n. 四月
definition: 1. n. the month following March and preceding May
example: If you're seeing this and this before April 26, we will be having an Interfaith Day of Youth Service.
exampleZh: 如果你正在收看节目或在4月26日收看节目，我们将会设立青年服务跨信仰日。

meaning: n. 围裙；舞台前缘，台唇；停机坪；v. 着围裙于；【名】 （Apron）（俄）阿普龙（人名）
definition: 1. a piece of clothing worn over the front of other clothes to keep them clean when doing a dirty or messy job, especially cooking；2. the part of an airport in which aircraft are turned around or goods are put onto them
example: She wiped her floury hands on her apron.
exampleZh: 她在围裙上擦了擦沾满面粉的双手。

meaning: adj. 易于……的，有……倾向的；恰当的，适宜的；善学的，聪明的；【名】 （Apt）（英、法、波）阿普特（人名）
definition: 1. suitable or right for a particular situation；2. to be likely to do something or to often do something
example: The words of this report are as apt today as in 1929.
exampleZh: 这份报告的措词在当今如在1929年一样恰当。

meaning: adv. 恰当地，贴切地
definition: 1. in a way that is suitable or right for a particular situation
example: In fact, he offers descriptions of how restaurants and food makers manipulate ingredients to reach the aptly named bliss point.
exampleZh: 实际上，他描述了餐馆和食品生产商如何调整食材配比，以达到名副其实的愉悦点——食品科学中指味觉的最佳平衡点。

meaning: n. 天资，天赋；自然的倾向，习性；适宜
definition: 1. n. inherent ability
example: Just because our aptitude is hardwired doesn't mean it can't improve with practice and skill.
exampleZh: 仅仅因为我们的天资是天生的并不意味着它不能通过练习和技巧来提高。

meaning: adj. 任意的，随心所欲的；专横的，武断的
definition: 1. adj. based on or subject to individual discretion or preference or sometimes impulse or caprice
example: That means that p1 and -- where I am, the point number 1 and point number 2 were completely arbitrary.
exampleZh: 因为1和，两个点是2,陆军上面。

meaning: adv. 随意地，任意地；武断地，专横地
definition: 1. adv. in a random manner
example: You can take something that's magnetic with a north-south 1 magnetization and just say arbitrarily, this will represent one.
exampleZh: 你只需要一个北南极的磁性物体,任意指定，比方说代表。

meaning: v. 仲裁，公断
definition: 1. to make a judgment in an argument, usually because asked to do so by those involved；2. to make a formal judgment to decide an argument
example: In many cases, I am employed to arbitrate between two clashing parties.
exampleZh: 在许多情况下，我受雇于冲突双方进行仲裁。

meaning: n. 仲裁，公断
definition: 1. the process of solving an argument between people by helping them to agree to an acceptable solution；2. the formal process of having an outside person, chosen by both sides to a disagreement, end the disagreement
example: The judge said that arbitration was a fair and expeditious decision-making process.
exampleZh: 法官说仲裁是一个公正且迅速有效率的决定过程。

meaning: n. 弧形，弧线；弧光，电弧；情节（或主题）的发展；反三角函数；v. 做弧形运动；形成电弧；adj. （三角函数和双曲函数）反的；【名】 （Arc）（法）阿尔克（人名）
definition: 1. the shape of part of a circle, or other curved line；2. a powerful flow of electricity that goes across a space between two points
example: The helicopter made a slow arc, passing over the mound but not stopping.
exampleZh: 这架直升飞机做了一个缓慢的弧线运行，飞过那座小丘，但没停下来。

meaning: n. 拱门；拱顶；足弓；拱形物；v. （使）成弓形，拱起；adj. 淘气的，调皮的；傲慢自大的；主要的；comb. 极度的，为首的；【名】 （Arch）（英）阿奇，（德）阿尔希（人名）
definition: 1. a structure, consisting of a curved top on two supports, that holds the weight of something above it；2. something that has the shape of an arch, often used for decoration
example: The arch once stood alone at the entrance to the castle.
exampleZh: 拱门曾经孤零零地矗立在城堡的入口处。

meaning: n. 建筑师；设计师，缔造者
definition: 1. n. someone who creates plans to be used in making something (such as buildings)
example: The architect is drawing up plans for the new offices.
exampleZh: 建筑师正在绘制新办公楼的设计图。

meaning: n. 建筑设计，建筑风格；建筑学；结构；计算机的体系结构，架构
definition: 1. n. an architectural product or work；2. n. the discipline dealing with the principles of design and construction and ornamentation of fine buildings
example: Any advice I could give if anybody wants to do, study architecture is that you’ve got to really want to...
exampleZh: 至于我能给真正想学的人一些什么建议，学习建筑学的首要精义是你得发自内心的喜爱......

meaning: n. 存档材料，档案；档案室；v. 把……存档，把……归档
definition: 1. a collection of historical records relating to a place, organization, or family；2. a place where historical records are kept
example: A quarter of this vast archive has been indexed and made accessible to researchers.
exampleZh: 这批数量巨大的档案的1/4都已编了索引，可供研究者查阅。

meaning: adj. 热心的，热切的；（爱情）热烈的，炽热的；【名】 （Ardent）（法）阿尔当（人名）
definition: 1. showing strong feelings；2. showing strong feelings; eager
example: Ardent supporters of public higher education know the importance of sustaining private higher education.
exampleZh: 热心支持公立高等教育的人知道维持私立高等教育的重要性。

meaning: n. 地区，区域；场地，地方；领域；面积；部位；罚球区；【名】 （Area）（西）阿雷亚（人名）
definition: 1. n. a particular geographical region of indefinite boundary (usually serving some special purpose or distinguished by its people or culture or geography)；2. n. a particular environment or walk of life
example: all local, which are from the upstate area like Saugerties, Woodstock, Rhinebeck and just all Hudson Valley area artists.
exampleZh: 他们都是当地的艺术家，来自索格蒂斯、伍德斯托克、莱茵贝克。都是来自哈德逊谷地的艺术家。

meaning: n. 竞技场，圆形剧场；斗争场所，活动舞台；【名】 （Arena）（英）阿里纳，（意、西、葡、德）阿雷纳（人名）
definition: 1. a large, flat area surrounded by seats used for sports or entertainment；2. an activity that involves argument and discussion
example: He made it clear he had no intention of withdrawing from the political arena.
exampleZh: 他明确表示他没有退出政治舞台的意图。

meaning: v. 主张，认为；说服；争论，争辩；争吵；提出质疑；提出理由；【名】 （Argue）（英、法）阿格（人名）
definition: 1. v. present reasons and arguments；2. v. have an argument about something
example: You could argue that both Southerners and Northerners shared a certain degree of old-fashioned American localism, attachment to place.
exampleZh: 你可以争辩说南方人和北方人,都有一点,旧式的美国地方主义,依恋着所处的地方

meaning: n. 争论，争吵；论据，理由；辩论，讨论；自变数；主词，受词；书的内容提要
definition: 1. n. a fact or assertion offered as evidence that something is true；2. n. a contentious speech act; a dispute where there is strong disagreement
example: She writes, Woman's being created last will not be a very great argument to debase the dignity of the female sex.
exampleZh: 她写道，女性被后造出来并不能,为压制女性尊严做论证。

meaning: n. 论证，推论；争论，辩论
definition: 1. n. a discussion in which reasons are advanced for and against some proposition or proposal；2. n. the methodical process of logical reasoning
example: I gather there seems to be no lessening of the intensity of argumentation in this country.
exampleZh: 我猜想关于这国家，的论证强度没有减少。

meaning: adj. 好争辩的，好争吵的；系统化推理的，按部就班地论证的；争辩的，辩论的
definition: 1. adj. given to or characterized by argument
example: It was because he was of an argumentative mind that in their cabin at night he permitted himself to carp.
exampleZh: 正是因为他爱争辩，所以晚上在他们的船舱里，他才允许自己吹毛求疵。

meaning: adj. 无把握的，有疑问的；可论证的，有论据的
definition: 1. adj. capable of being supported by argument；2. adj. open to argument or debate
example: It is arguable that giving too much detail may actually be confusing.
exampleZh: 过分详细反而使人糊涂的说法是有道理的。

meaning: v. 产生，出现；起源（于），由……引出；起床，起立；上升；【名】 （Arise）（英、美、德、印）阿里塞
definition: 1. v. come into existence; take on form or shape；2. v. originate or come into being
example: In a good marriage, both husband and wife work hard to solve any problems that arise.
exampleZh: 在一桩美满的婚姻中，夫妻双方共同致力于解决出现的任何问题。

meaning: n. 贵族，贵族成员
definition: 1. a person of high social rank who belongs to the aristocracy
example: His limousine waits in the square below, watched over by pigeons and the bust of a dead aristocrat.
exampleZh: 他的豪华轿车在下面的广场等着，被鸽子和逝去贵族的半身像看着。

meaning: adj. 贵族的，有贵族特征的
definition: 1. belonging to a class of people who hold high social rank
example: That is, this kind of aristocratic outfit, aristocracy of birth, which is legitimized by heroic behavior on the battlefield.
exampleZh: 也就是说,由于他们在战场上的英雄行为,他们的贵族的身份和贵族出身是被认可的

meaning: n. 贵族，贵族阶级；贵族统治
definition: 1. a class of people who hold high social rank
example: They throw heraldry, they throw every kind of vestige of Old World culture and monarchy and aristocracy and civilization.
exampleZh: 他们抛掉了世代相传的家徽,抛掉一切来自旧文明,和旧君主政体的痕迹,抛掉了贵族政治和文明

meaning: n. 算术；演算，计算；数据统计；adj. 算术的
definition: 1. n. the branch of pure mathematics dealing with the theory of numerical calculations；2. adj. relating to or involving arithmetic
example: They will concentrate on teaching the basics of reading, writing and arithmetic.
exampleZh: 他们将重点教授阅读、写作和算术的基本要点。

meaning: n. 手臂，上肢；武器，军备；扶手；袖子；职能部门；臂（状部件）；盾徽，纹章；狭长港湾；臂力；v. 武装，备战；提供，配备；使（炸弹等）随时爆炸，准备发射
definition: 1. n. a human limb; technically the part of the superior limb between the shoulder and the elbow but commonly used to refer to the whole superior limb；2. v. prepare oneself for a military confrontation
example: It is nor hand nor foot nor arm nor face nor any other part belonging to a man.
exampleZh: 它又不是手又不是脚，又不是手臂又不是脸,又不是身体上任何其他的部分。

meaning: n. 军备，武器；武装，战备
definition: 1. n. weaponry used by military or naval force；2. n. the act of equiping with weapons in preparation for war
example: You might think, this is impossible, to imagine humans dismantling armament.
exampleZh: 你可能认为这是不可能的，——去想像人类解散军事力量。

meaning: n. 盔甲；装甲（坦克等装甲车辆的统称，也指装甲部队）；防护装甲（车辆、舰船等的硬质防护层）；动植物体表的保护性硬覆盖物（如龟壳）；护面、铠装（工程中的硬质防护外层）；Armour（人名，英、西、葡：阿穆尔）；v. 给……装上装甲，为……加装防护层
definition: 1. strong covering that protects something, especially the body；2. military vehicles that are covered in strong metal to protect them from attack
example: Monkeys do not have any kind of protective armour and use their brains to solve problems.
exampleZh: 猴子没有任何防身的盔甲，就动脑筋解决问题。

meaning: n. 陆军，军队；大批，大群
definition: 1. n. a permanent organization of the military land forces of a nation or state；2. n. a large number of people united for some specific purpose
example: And I've always wanted to be in the army, but South African army is not as, not that great, you know, so.
exampleZh: 我一直想去部队，但是南非的部队并不是那么好。

meaning: adv. 围绕，环绕；大约；周围，四周；以圆周计算；到处，向各处；转弯，掉头；闲散地，无目的地；循环往复地；出现，可用；活跃；prep. 围绕，环绕；到处，向各处；在那边，到那边；在……周围，在附近；大约，大概；以……为中心；避开，绕过
definition: 1. adv. in the area or vicinity；2. adv. by a circular or circuitous route
example: Now the first law is going to hold in all of these steps, and we're going around in a cycle.
exampleZh: 现在热力学第一定律,就蕴含在这所有的步骤里了，我们沿着这个循环走。

meaning: v. 引起，激起；叫醒，唤醒；激起……的性欲
definition: 1. v. call forth (emotions, feelings, and responses)；2. v. stop sleeping
example: The extension of London's Ulez will arouse strong resistance.
exampleZh: 扩大伦敦的超低排放区会引起强烈反对。

meaning: n. 唤起，（尤指性欲的）激起；（睡后的）清醒，醒来
definition: 1. n. the act of arousing；2. n. a state of heightened physiological activity
example: The more salient we make the source of the arousal, the less likely you can get the effect.
exampleZh: 我们越突现觉醒原因，越不可能获得这个效果。

meaning: v. 安排，筹备；整理，布置，排列；改编；商定
definition: 1. v. put into a proper or systematic order；2. v. make arrangements for
example: So, if you want to go at 1:00, you're welcome to do so, but please arrange it with my assistants.
exampleZh: 如果你想去上1点的课，也可以，但是一定要和我的助教安排一下。

meaning: n. 安排，筹备；商定，约定；整理，排列，布置；改编
definition: 1. n. the thing arranged or agreed to；2. n. an orderly grouping (of things or persons) considered as a unit; the result of arranging
example: Yeats sees the Second Coming as an image, as a myth, an idea, a metaphor, a certain stylistic arrangement of experience.
exampleZh: 叶芝把第二次降临看成一个意向，一个神话，一个意识，一个比喻，一种诗意的安排和感受。

meaning: n. 一系列，大量；数组，阵列；盛装；v. 布置，排列；配置（兵力）；穿戴，打扮
definition: 1. a large group of things or people, especially one that is attractive or causes admiration or has been positioned in a particular way；2. to arrange a group of things in a particular way
example: It is 1.7475. Conclusion: if I start to react sodium with chlorine, the result is a crystal, a three-dimensional array.
exampleZh: 这是1。7475，结论就是：,如果我使钠和氯反应，结果将会是一个晶体，一个三维排列。

meaning: v. 逮捕，拘留；阻止，抑制；吸引；心跳停止；n. 逮捕，拘留；停止，终止；【名】 （Arrest）（法）阿雷斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of apprehending (especially apprehending a criminal)；2. v. take into custody
example: But nobody says, "Arrest that man, he has broken his debt; he's not performing his debt to the community."
exampleZh: 他们不会说,"逮捕他,他违背了他的义务,他没有对他的集体履行义务"

meaning: v. 到达，抵达；送达，寄到；发生，出现，诞生；开始，到来；成功，出名；作出（决定）；【名】 （Arrive）（法）阿里夫（人名）
definition: 1. v. reach a destination; arrive by movement or progress；2. v. succeed in a big way; get to the top
example: By extension we have our attempt as readers to arrive at an understanding of the first two books in general.
exampleZh: 延伸开来，我们作为作者，试图,达成对这两卷书的大体上的理解。

meaning: n. 到达，到来；到达者，加入者；产生，出现
definition: 1. n. accomplishment of an objective；2. n. the act of arriving at a certain place
example: But it really wasn't until, I would say, the arrival of Java that object-oriented C++ programming caught the popular attention.
exampleZh: 但是知道Java的诞生，才吸引了大众的关注,而后Java和。

meaning: adj. 傲慢的，自大的
definition: 1. unpleasantly proud and behaving as if you are more important than, or know more than, other people；2. proud in an unpleasant way and behaving as if you are better or more important than other people
example: Modern poetry is, in all these ways, Promethean, astounding, arrogant, enormous, imprudent, visionary.
exampleZh: 综上可见，现代诗歌是普罗米修斯般令人惊骇又自大的，无穷无尽的，轻率的却又充满了幻觉的。

meaning: n. 傲慢，自大
definition: 1. the quality of being unpleasantly proud and behaving as if you are more important than, or know more than, other people
example: We're struck by the arrogance implicit in Milton's active identification here.
exampleZh: 我们感叹弥尔顿在这里暗示,自己可以与基督相提并论。

meaning: n. 箭，矢；箭头，箭号；【名】 （Arrow）（英）阿罗（人名）
definition: 1. n. a mark to indicate a direction or relation；2. n. a projectile with a straight thin shaft and an arrowhead on one end and stabilizing vanes on the other; intended to be shot from a bow
example: Some people like to use an arrow, and the arrow points in the direction of the more electronegative end.
exampleZh: 也可以用箭头，箭头指向,带负电的一极。

meaning: n. 美术，艺术；艺术品；技术，技巧；人文学科；艺术活动（the arts）；adj. 艺术性的；v. be 的第二人称单数现在式
definition: 1. n. the products of human creativity; works of art collectively；2. n. the creation of beautiful or significant things
example: I like having different art pieces that can interact with the room in a way that are not too intrusive.
exampleZh: 我喜欢拥有不同的艺术作品，它们可以以某种方式和房间交流融合，而不会显得很格格不入。

meaning: n. 艺术家，美术家；表演艺术家；大师，行家
definition: 1. n. a person whose creative work shows sensitivity and imagination
example: Even if they are writer or an artist or whatever you are doing, I think it's a very inspiring place.
exampleZh: 即使他们是作家或艺术家，无论你从事什么行业，我想这都是一个非常启发人心的地方。

meaning: adj. 艺术的，艺术家的；有艺术鉴赏力的，有艺术天赋的；有艺术性的，精美的
definition: 1. adj. relating to or characteristic of art or artists；2. adj. satisfying aesthetic standards and sensibilities
example: So is this something you do in your own artistic practice with when you are sitting down, writing a poem?
exampleZh: 您在静下心来，写诗，进行艺术,创造时，也是实践这种理念么？

meaning: adv. 艺术方面地
definition: 1. adv. in an artistic manner
example: Our species originated around 200,000 years ago, and underwent tremendous diversification, culturally, technologically, linguistically, artistically, for 130,000 years.
exampleZh: 我们的物种起源于大约20万年前，并经历了13万年的惊人的多样化进程，包括文化、技术、语言和艺术等方面。

meaning: n. 动脉；干线，干道，干流
definition: 1. one of the thick tubes that carry blood from the heart to other parts of the body；2. an important road or railway line
example: A muscular spasm in the coronary artery can cause a heart attack.
exampleZh: 冠状动脉内肌肉痉挛会导致心脏病发作。

meaning: n. 文章，论文；物品；条款，条文；冠词；见习契约，见习期；v. 见习，签约做实习生；进行控告；使……受协议条款的约束
definition: 1. n. nonfictional prose forming an independent part of a publication；2. v. bind by a contract; especially for a training period
example: Yeah! I mean, one of the ones that comes up again and again is the use of the article.
exampleZh: 是的，其中一再出现的错误就是对冠词的使用。

meaning: v. 明确表达，清楚说明；口齿清楚地说，清晰地发音；用关节连接，连结；adj. 善于表达的；口齿清楚的，发音清晰的；有关节的
definition: 1. able to express thoughts and feelings easily and clearly, or showing this quality；2. to express in words
example: Now we need to take in other things that are also articulate human rights but make them more central: rights within marriage.
exampleZh: 现在我们需要把一些其他的事物,也归类到人权范围之内,而且要给予更多的关注：,比如说，婚内权利。

meaning: n. （想法、思想等的）语言表达；清楚的咬字（或发音），说话；关节连接，铰接式接头
definition: 1. the way in which you pronounce words or produce sounds；2. the way in which you express your feelings and ideas, etc.
example: This was seen as a way of restricting women's articulation of grievances.
exampleZh: 这曾被认为是一种限制妇女表达不满的方法。

meaning: n. （尤指有文化价值或历史价值的）人工制品，历史文物；非自然存在物体，假象（=artefact）
definition: 1. US spelling of artefact mainly UK；2. an object, such as a tool, that was made in the past
example: Don't worry, it doesn't matter that they're called methods, it's a historical artifact.
exampleZh: 别担心，被称为方法没什么关系,这只是一个历史古董。

meaning: adj. 人造的，人工的；人为的；不真挚的，矫揉造作的
definition: 1. adj. contrived by art rather than nature；2. adj. artificially formal
example: The pastoral elegy is clearly one of the most stylized and most self-consciously artificial of all of the poetic genres.
exampleZh: 田园挽歌明显是所有诗歌类型中,最程式化，最具人工雕琢痕迹的诗种之一。

meaning: n. 火炮，大炮；炮兵，炮兵部队
definition: 1. very large guns that are moved on wheels or metal tracks, or the part of the army that uses these；2. large guns that are moved on wheels or metal tracks, or the part of an army that uses these
example: They were asked to pull back from their artillery positions around the city.
exampleZh: 他们被要求从城市四周的炮兵阵地上撤退。

meaning: prep. 作为；以……身份；当作；像，如同；当……时；adv. （程度或数量上）同样，一样；例如，诸如；conj. 像……一样；（说明某事应完成的时间或发生的频率）；照……方式，和……一样；正如，如同；当……时候，在……时候；虽然，尽管；因为，由于；（关系）就像，相当于；以至于（与so或such连用表结果）
definition: 1. n. a very poisonous metallic element that has three allotropic forms; arsenic and arsenic compounds are used as herbicides and insecticides and various alloys; found in arsenopyrite and orpiment and realgar；2. adv. to the same degree (often followed by `as')
example: She's stuck between competing ideals of bodily purity just as surely and as firmly as she is stuck to her seat.
exampleZh: 她陷入贞洁理念的矛盾迷潭之中,与陷入陷入椅子一样确定而坚定。

meaning: v. 攀登，登上；上升，升高，通往高处；升职，晋升；追溯，溯源
definition: 1. to move up or climb something；2. to rise to a position of higher rank
example: Planes must zigzag from one ground beacon to the next, and ascend and descend in steps at each stage obtaining permission from the ground.
exampleZh: 飞机从一个地面信标到下一个信标曲折飞行，在每一阶段都要经过地面的许可才能上升和下降。

meaning: n. 优势；支配地位（亦作 ascendency、ascendence）
definition: 1. a position of power, strength, or success
example: The party's ascendance in local politics was consolidated by a series of decisive electoral victories.
exampleZh: 该党凭借一系列决定性的选举胜利巩固了其在地方政治中的支配地位。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）
note: 剑桥以 ascendancy 词条解释该派生词。

meaning: v. 查明，确定
definition: 1. to discover something；2. to make certain of something
example: Through doing this, the teacher will be able to ascertain the extent to which the child understands what he is reading.
exampleZh: 通过这样做，老师将能确定这个孩子对他正在读的内容的理解程度。

meaning: v. 把……归因于；认为……是……所说（或所为）；认为……具有
definition: 1. to believe or say that something is caused by something else；2. to believe or claim that something was said, written, or created by a particular person
example: It's pretty clear that there are lots of machines that it doesn't seem natural to ascribe beliefs or desires or goals or reasoning to.
exampleZh: 很显然对于很多种机器来说,讨论它们的信仰,欲望,目标或论证,是一件很不自然的事
note: 剑桥以 ascribe something to something 词条解释该派生词。

meaning: n. （香烟或木头等的）灰；灰烬，废墟；骨灰，遗骸；梣树，白蜡树；（古英语中的一个字母，也为音标）æ；v. 把……化为灰烬；以灰覆盖，撒灰于；掸（烟）灰；【名】 （Ash）（英、美）阿什（人名）
definition: 1. n. the residue that remains when something is burned；2. v. convert into ashes
example: He brushed the cigarette ash from his sleeve.
exampleZh: 他掸掉了袖子上的烟灰。

meaning: adj. 感到羞愧，感到羞耻；羞于（做某事）
definition: 1. adj. feeling shame or guilt or embarrassment or remorse
example: I felt incredibly ashamed of myself for getting so angry.
exampleZh: 我为自己发了这么大的脾气而感到极为惭愧。

meaning: adv. 在岸上；向岸上；adj. 在岸上的，在陆上的
definition: 1. adv. towards the shore from the water
example: During the breeding season the birds come ashore.
exampleZh: 在繁殖期鸟儿们上岸。

meaning: adv. 在旁边，到（或向）一边；积攒，留出；除……以外；n. （戏剧或电影中的）旁白；低语，悄悄话；离题话，题外话
definition: 1. n. a line spoken by an actor to the audience but not intended for others on the stage；2. adv. on or to one side
example: And just as a fun aside, we also realized as computer scientists that sometimes technology is not the answer.
exampleZh: 抛开趣味性不提，我们意识到作一个,计算机科学家来说技术,并不是我们要的最终答案。

meaning: v. 询问，打听；要求，请求；邀请，约请 ；指望，期待；【名】 （Ask）（芬、瑞典）阿斯克（人名）
definition: 1. v. inquire about；2. v. make a request or demand for something to somebody
example: OK. So if we have variables, one of the questions we can ask is, what's the type of the variable.
exampleZh: 好，如果我们有了一个变量，我们要问的问题之一就是，这个变量的类型是什么？

meaning: adj. 睡着的；麻木的，发麻的；不专心的，不活跃的；长眠的，已死的；adv. 处于睡眠状态地，进入睡眠状态地
definition: 1. adj. in a state of sleep；2. adv. into a sleeping state
example: You are not dreaming right now, unless you're asleep but if you're-- and you can't usually be immoral in a dream.
exampleZh: 你们现在不是作梦，除了那些睡着的同学-,我们很少会在梦里做出不道德的事。

meaning: n. 方面，特色；朝向，方位；外表，外观；（动词的）体；v. （行星与另一天体）形成角度关系
definition: 1. n. a distinct feature or element in a problem；2. n. a characteristic to be considered
example: So it's like you don't really feel like the broader aspect of university life in Spain whereas here you do.
exampleZh: 所以你在西班牙没法真正体验更丰富的大学生活，但是你在这里可以

meaning: 渴望；立志；追求
definition: 1. to want something very much or hope to achieve something or be successful
example: Those two words have stayed with me—not as something to disdain, but as something to which to aspire.
exampleZh: 那两个词一直陪伴着我——我没有把它当作鄙夷的对象，而是当作值得追求的目标。

meaning: n. 渴望，抱负，志向；送气音；吸引术，抽吸
definition: 1. something that you hope to achieve；2. the removal of a liquid or gas from a space in the body using suction (= a sucking action)
example: This is the modern city, not as a scene of fragmentation or despair, but rather a place of ascent and aspiration.
exampleZh: 这是一座现代化的城市，并不是破碎或绝望的场景，而是一座在上升的渴望之城。

meaning: n. 傻瓜，笨蛋；屁股，臀部；驴；性感的人；null 【名】（Ass）（俄）阿斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. the fleshy part of the human body that you sit on；2. n. a pompous fool
example: "Pray, my good lady," said the ass, "what's the matter with you?"
exampleZh: “请问，我的好夫人，”驴说，“你怎么了？”

meaning: v. 暗杀，行刺
definition: 1. to kill someone famous or important；2. to murder a famous or important person, esp. for political reasons or in exchange for money
example: Security was tightened after extremists threatened to assassinate the visiting diplomat.
exampleZh: 在极端分子威胁刺杀来访外交官后，安保措施得到了加强。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 暗杀，行刺
definition: 1. the murder of someone famous or important
example: What seemed like harmless banter about the marketing manager's new hairdo can sound like a character assassination.
exampleZh: 一些对市场经理的新发型看上去无伤大雅的调侃也可能被视作人身攻击。

meaning: n. 暗杀者，刺客
definition: 1. someone who kills a famous or important person, usually for political reasons or in exchange for money
example: Detectives suspected that the assassin had entered the country using a forged passport.
exampleZh: 侦探怀疑这名刺客使用伪造护照进入了该国。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. （军事）袭击，攻击；人身攻击，侵犯人身（罪）；抨击；闯关，冲击（难关）；v. 袭击，殴打；使（感官）难受
definition: 1. a violent attack；2. a determined or serious attempt to do something difficult
example: A third brigade is at sea, ready for an amphibious assault.
exampleZh: 第三旅在海上待命，随时准备从海上发起进攻。

meaning: v. （使）集合，（使）聚集；装配，组装
definition: 1. v. create by putting components or members together；2. v. collect in one place
example: They basically make many, many copies of their DNA and they make all of their viral proteins and they assemble into new viral units.
exampleZh: 它们会生成不计其数的病毒基因拷贝,并翻译生成病毒蛋白,组装成新的病毒单位

meaning: n. 议会，代表大会；集会，集会者；装配，组装；（计算机）汇编
definition: 1. n. a group of machine parts that fit together to form a self-contained unit；2. n. the act of constructing something (as a piece of machinery)
example: The only people who could speak in the council or in an assembly were the noblemen, the basileis.
exampleZh: 唯一可以在议会或者集会发言的人,只有贵族和部落酋长

meaning: v. 坚称，断言；维护，坚持（权利或权威）；坚持自己的主张，表现坚定；生效，起作用
definition: 1. to behave in a way that expresses your confidence, importance, or power and earns you respect from others；2. to say that something is certainly true
example: It is merely to assert that so far as any body of references is undistorted it belongs to Science.
exampleZh: 单纯坚持,参考的真实性,就是科学。

meaning: n. 断言，明确肯定；使用，主张
definition: 1. a statement that you strongly believe is true
example: Their work makes a rather startling assertion: the trait we commonly call talent is highly overrated.
exampleZh: 他们的研究提出了一个相当惊人的主张：我们通常称为天赋的特征被严重高估了。

meaning: adj. 坚定自信的，果断的
definition: 1. Someone who is assertive behaves confidently and is not frightened to say what they want or believe；2. behaving confidently and able to say in a direct way what you want or believe
example: Be assertive and spell out exactly how you feel.
exampleZh: 自信点，把你的真实感受详细说出来。

meaning: v. 评价，评定；估价，估计；征税，处以罚金
definition: 1. v. place a value on; judge the worth of something；2. v. charge (a person or a property) with a payment, such as a tax or a fine
example: The risks can be so complex that banks hire mathematicians to assess them.
exampleZh: 这类风险可以是如此复杂以至于银行雇佣数学家们去评估它们。

meaning: n. 评估，评价；估价，估计
definition: 1. n. the classification of someone or something with respect to its worth；2. n. an amount determined as payable
example: The third area is what I might think of is an evaluation or assessment as it sometimes is called.
exampleZh: 第三领域我认为是,评价或评估。

meaning: n. 有利条件，有价值的人或物；资产，财产；【名】（Asset）（法）阿塞（人名）
definition: 1. n. a useful or valuable quality
example: If you accept my estimates and you accept the capital asset pricing model, that would have to be true.
exampleZh: 如果你同意我的估算,而且认同资本资本资产定价模型，那这种投资组合就会带来最大收益。

meaning: v. 分派，布置（工作、任务）；分配（某物）；指派，派遣；确定（价值、功能、时间、地点）；转让（财产、权利）
definition: 1. v. give an assignment to (a person) to a post, or assign a task to (a person)；2. v. give out or allot
example: And then in the next page he's going to take that same rising line and assign it to the basses.
exampleZh: 然后在下一页里,他将把同样的上行曲调线,安排在低音部

meaning: n. 作业，任务；（工作等的）分配，指派；（财产、权利的）转让
definition: 1. n. a duty that you are assigned to perform (especially in the armed forces)；2. n. the instrument by which a claim or right or interest or property is transferred from one person to another
example: Could you tell us about one of your favorite classes and a memorable assignment from that class?
exampleZh: 能给我们讲讲你最喜欢的一堂课，以及那堂课上一次难忘的任务吗？

meaning: v. 融入，（使）同化；吸收，理解；使相似，成为相似
definition: 1. to become part of a group, country, society, etc., or to make someone or something become part of a group, country, society, etc.；2. to understand and remember new information and make it part of your basic knowledge so that you can use it as your own
example: China needs to assimilate a good deal of foreign progressive culture, but she must not swallow anything and everything uncritically.
exampleZh: 中国需要大量吸收外国的进步文化，但决不能无批判地兼收并蓄。

meaning: n. 吸收，吸取；同化；（语音）同化现象
definition: 1. the process of becoming a part, or making someone become a part, of a group, country, society, etc.；2. the process of absorbing food into the tissue of a living organism
example: They show comprehension to consist not just of passive assimilation but of active engagement in inference and problem-solving.
exampleZh: 这表明理解不仅包括被动的同化，还包括主动参与推理和解决问题。

meaning: v. 帮助，协助；参加，出席；n. （球赛中的）助攻；资助，帮助
definition: 1. n. the activity of contributing to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose；2. v. give help or assistance; be of service
example: I was looking for a backer to assist me in the attempted buyout.
exampleZh: 我当时正在寻找一位赞助人来帮助我进行这次全面收购。

meaning: n. 帮助，援助
definition: 1. n. the activity of contributing to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose；2. n. a resource
example: So, I think we are capable of, with the kind of assistance of my staff capable of setting exams of comparable difficulty.
exampleZh: 所以，我们可以，在教学人员的帮助下，我们可以,制定出难度相当的考题。

meaning: n. 助理，助手；店员，售货员；adj. 助理的，副的
definition: 1. n. a person who contributes to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose；2. adj. of or relating to a person who is subordinate to another
example: That's why I hope you'll stay with-- you'll each find a teaching assistant and will stay with that person.
exampleZh: 这就是为什么我希望...,你们每人都找一位助教,和他多交流

meaning: v. 联想，联系；支持，同意；交往，（尤指）混在一起；n. 同事，伙伴；副学士，准学士；副职，副手；准会员；联想；adj. 副的，准的，非正式的；联合的，有关连的
definition: 1. n. a person who joins with others in some activity；2. v. make a logical or causal connection
example: He will remain affiliated with the firm as a special associate director.
exampleZh: 他会作为特别副主管，继续与这家公司保持联系。

meaning: n. 协会，社团，联盟；交往，联合；联系，因果关系；联想
definition: 1. n. a formal organization of people or groups of people；2. n. the act of consorting with or joining with others
example: It is association with death and sexuality that renders one impure and disqualifies one from entering the holy sanctuary.
exampleZh: 不洁的事物和死亡与生殖是有联系的,它们被取消了,进入圣所的资格。

meaning: adj. 各种各样的，混杂的；v. 把……分等级；把……归为一类（assort 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. consisting of various types mixed together
example: The workshop provided assorted tools and materials for students to complete their individual projects.
exampleZh: 工作坊提供了各种工具和材料，供学生完成各自的项目。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 各种各样，混合
definition: 1. a group of different types of something；2. a mixture or combination of different types
example: There followed an assortment of praise for the coffee along the lines of "Hey, this coffee is fantastic!"
exampleZh: 接着是各种各样大概就像“嘿，这咖啡真棒”一样的对咖啡的称赞。

meaning: v. 假定，假设，认为；装出，做出；承担，就职；呈现，具有；夺取，篡夺
definition: 1. v. take to be the case or to be true; accept without verification or proof；2. v. take on titles, offices, duties, responsibilities
example: Everyone, according to the logic ofAreopagitica everyone has the potential to assume the inner authority of conscience and self-discipline.
exampleZh: 按照《论出版自由》的逻辑，每个人都有,用内在良心的统治和自律的潜力。

meaning: n. 假定，假设；取得，承担
definition: 1. n. a statement that is assumed to be true and from which a conclusion can be drawn；2. n. a hypothesis that is taken for granted
example: We are working on the assumption that it was a gas explosion.
exampleZh: 我们正依据它是一起燃气爆炸的假设而行动。

meaning: v. 使确信，向……保证；确保，使确定；给……保险
definition: 1. v. make certain of；2. v. inform positively and with certainty and confidence
example: Well I grew up in Michigan and I can assure you that Michiganders love all those things too and probably even more.
exampleZh: 我在密西根州长大,所以我敢保证密西根人也很喜欢这些东西,甚至比南方人更喜欢

meaning: n. 自信，把握；（人寿）保险；保证，确保
definition: 1. n. freedom from doubt; belief in yourself and your abilities；2. n. a binding commitment to do or give or refrain from something
example: He would like an assurance that other forces will not move into the territory that his forces vacate.
exampleZh: 他想要其他部队不会进入他的部队撤出的那个领地的一个保证。

meaning: v. 使吃惊，使惊讶
definition: 1. v. affect with wonder
example: Thunderstruck shows up in English about 100 years after astonish.
exampleZh: Thunderstruck 这个词在 astonish 之后大约100年才出现在英语当中。

meaning: n. 惊讶，惊愕
definition: 1. n. the feeling that accompanies something extremely surprising
example: I spotted a shooting star which, to my astonishment, was bright green in colour.
exampleZh: 我看见了一颗划过长空的流星，让我惊讶的是，它是鲜绿色的。

meaning: adv. 迷失，迷路；步入歧途，堕落
definition: 1. away from the correct path or correct way of doing something；2. away from the correct path or way of doing something
example: The judge thought he'd been led astray by older children.
exampleZh: 法官认为他是被更大的孩子们引入了歧途。

meaning: n. 宇航员，太空人
definition: 1. n. a person trained to travel in a spacecraft
example: Astronaut Pierre Thuot tried to latch the 15-foot robotic arm onto the satellite.
exampleZh: 宇航员皮埃尔·索特想要把这个长15英尺的机械手安到人造卫星上。

meaning: n. 天文学
definition: 1. n. the branch of physics that studies celestial bodies and the universe as a whole
example: Descartes received his stimulus from the new physics and astronomy of Copernicus, Galileo, and others.
exampleZh: 笛卡儿从哥白尼、伽利略和其他科学家的新物理学和天文学中获得了灵感。

meaning: n. 天文学家
definition: 1. n. a physicist who studies astronomy
example: The rebellious artist Milton and the rebellious astronomer Galileo are continually threatening to lapse into some sort of identity with Satan himself.
exampleZh: 叛逆的艺术家弥尔顿，和同样叛逆的天文学家伽利略,不断的陷入某种对撒旦的确认的,危险之中。

meaning: adj. 天文（学）的，天体的；（数量、价格或收费）天文数字的，极其巨大的
definition: 1. adj. relating or belonging to the science of astronomy；2. adj. inconceivably large
example: This distance is known as the 'astronomical unit' or AU.
exampleZh: 这个距离被称为“天文单位”或 AU。

meaning: n. 政治避难，政治庇护；精神病院
definition: 1. protection or safety, especially that given by a government to people who have been forced to leave their own countries for their safety or because of war；2. a hospital for people with mental illnesses
example: So imagine that there's right now somebody in an insane asylum in Michigan who's got the thought,I am Napoleon.
exampleZh: 因此想像一下，现在有个家伙,在密西根一家精神病院，认为自己就是拿破仑。

meaning: prep. 在（表示存在或出现的地点、场所、位置、空间）；在……岁时；在……远；以（某种价格、速度等）；向，朝；处于……状态；处于最佳（或最差等）状态；达；因为；在……方面；响应；忙于；（武器）瞄准；用，以；（抓）住；从事于；冲（某人……）；n. 阿特（老挝货币基本单位att）；砹（极不稳定放射性元素）；abbr. 密封的（airtight）；大气（atmosphere）；原子的（atomic）；气温（air temperature）
definition: 1. n. a highly unstable radioactive element (the heaviest of the halogen series); a decay product of uranium and thorium；2. n. 100 at equal 1 kip in Laos
example: And, by all means, if you are scheduled to attend class at 11:00, please take the test at 11:00.
exampleZh: 当然，如果你安排到11：00参加考试的话，请在11：00参加考试。

meaning: n. 运动员，体育健将；擅长运动的人
definition: 1. n. a person trained to compete in sports
example: This I must say, this topic ignited my imagination when I was a kid when I thought about it; when I was an athlete.
exampleZh: 我必须承认，这个话题点燃了我的想象,当我是孩子时想到它;,当我还是一名运动员时。

meaning: adj. 运动的，体育的；强壮的，健壮的；运动员用的；（在体育、比赛或身体锻炼等方面）行动敏捷的，活跃的
definition: 1. adj. relating to or befitting athletics or athletes；2. adj. vigorously active
example: We have some students who enter on an athletic team and stay all four years with that team.
exampleZh: 有些学生是因为体育特长,而被录取，而且大学四年,仍然从事那项体育活动。

meaning: n. 地图册；第一颈椎，寰椎；（希腊式建筑中支撑柱楣的）男像柱（复数atlantes）
definition: 1. a book containing maps；2. a book containing maps showing where particular things are made, found, etc.
example: The events took place against the dramatic backdrop of the Atlas mountains.
exampleZh: 活动在雄伟的阿特拉斯山脉举行。

meaning: n. （包围地球或其他行星的）大气，大气层；（房间或其他场所内的）空气；气氛，环境；情调，感染力
definition: 1. n. a particular environment or surrounding influence；2. n. a unit of pressure: the pressure that will support a column of mercury 760 mm high at sea level and 0 degrees centigrade
example: And it's just, I didn't like the general atmosphere, people, like, being mean to each other, which I found.
exampleZh: 我不喜欢他们平时的那种氛围，我发现他们人与人之间也很刻薄。

meaning: adj. 大气（层）的，有关大气的；有神秘（美）感的，富有情调的
definition: 1. adj. relating to or located in the atmosphere
example: Then some astronomers came up with the idea that atmospheric ammonia might have acted as a greenhouse gas.
exampleZh: 后来一些天文学家提出，大气中的氨可能起到温室气体的作用。

meaning: n. 原子；微量，极小量
definition: 1. n. (physics and chemistry) the smallest component of an element having the chemical properties of the element；2. n. (nontechnical usage) a tiny piece of anything
example: Two atoms of hydrogen combine with one atom of oxygen to form a molecule of water.
exampleZh: 两个氢原子和一个氧原子结合组成一个水分子。

meaning: adj. 原子的，与原子有关的；原子能的，核能的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to or comprising atoms；2. adj. (weapons) deriving destructive energy from the release of atomic energy
example: One is a little bit higher and one is a little bit lower than they are in the atomic situation.
exampleZh: 一个有点高,一个有点低,相比他们是原子状态的情景而言。

meaning: prep. 在……顶上，在……上面；adv. 在……顶上
definition: 1. adv. on, to, or at the top
example: Forget the paltry crown of laurel placed atop the heads of great writers in the classical tradition.
exampleZh: 别去在意古典传统里加诸伟大作家头上那顶微不足道的桂冠。

meaning: n. （常伴有暴力伤害的）恶行，暴行
definition: 1. an extremely cruel, violent, or shocking act；2. the fact of something being extremely cruel, violent, or shocking
example: The tribunal documented every atrocity committed during the occupation and heard testimony from survivors.
exampleZh: 法庭记录了占领期间犯下的每一桩暴行，并听取了幸存者的证词。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: adj. 凶恶的，残暴的；恶劣的，糟糕的
definition: 1. of very bad quality；2. violent and shocking
example: The report described the living conditions in the camp as atrocious and demanded immediate action.
exampleZh: 该报告称营地的生活条件极其恶劣，并要求立即采取行动。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: v. 系上，贴上，连接；附上（附件）；赋予，认为……具有； 和……在一起，缠着； 附带（条件)；附属，依附；与……有关联；委派；扣押（债务人或其财产)；使依恋
definition: 1. v. cause to be attached；2. v. be attached; be in contact with
example: And he had to attach something to dogs so that their saliva would pour out so he could study saliva.
exampleZh: 他给狗套上了一些装置,来收集狗的唾液用以研究。

meaning: n. 附加设备，附属物；（邮件）附件；文件附件；喜欢，依恋；（临时的）隶属，委派；信念，拥护；连接，连接物；扣押
definition: 1. n. a feeling of affection for a person or an institution；2. n. a supplementary part or accessory
example: The message contains Unicode characters and has been sent as a binary attachment.
exampleZh: 这条信息含有统一码字符，已经以二进制附件形式发送。

meaning: v. 批评，抨击；侵蚀，侵害；全力应对，奋力处理；袭击，攻击；（体育比赛中）进攻；n. （疾病的）突然发作；（情感的）一阵突发；（体育运动中的）进攻；袭击，攻击；批评，抨击；进攻队员；（病虫等的）损害，伤害；【名】 （Attack）（瑞典）阿塔克（人名）
definition: 1. n. (military) an offensive against an enemy (using weapons)；2. v. launch an attack or assault on; begin hostilities or start warfare with
example: So, if you want to attack urban air quality, this is probably moving in the wrong direction, OK?
exampleZh: 所以如果你想攻击都市的空气质量，这可能是一个错误的方向，对吗？

meaning: v. 获得，实现；达到
definition: 1. v. to gain with effort；2. v. reach a point in time, or a certain state or level
example: As Socrates puts it at one point, "The impure cannot attain the pure."
exampleZh: 正如苏格拉底所总结的,污秽不会拥有纯洁

meaning: n. 达到，获得；成就，造诣
definition: 1. n. the act of achieving an aim；2. n. arrival at a new stage
example: The overall trend is hitting Americans of all different levels of educational attainment, although the percentages vary by category.
exampleZh: 总体趋势正在影响不同教育水平的美国人，尽管各类别的百分比有所不同。

meaning: v. 努力，尝试；n. 试图，努力；企图杀害；（运动员创造记录的）尝试，冲击
definition: 1. n. earnest and conscientious activity intended to do or accomplish something；2. v. make an effort or attempt
example: The most outrageous action in Laud's crackdown was his move to ban -his attempt to ban preaching in churches.
exampleZh: 他所做过的最骇人听闻的暴行,是企图在教堂里禁止布道训诫行为。

meaning: v. 随同，陪同；经常去，定期去(学校、教堂等)；伴随……而至，（作为结果）伴随；出席，参加；注意，专心；处理，照料；致力于
definition: 1. v. be present at (meetings, church services, university), etc.；2. v. take charge of or deal with
example: And, by all means, if you are scheduled to attend class at 11:00, please take the test at 11:00.
exampleZh: 当然，如果你安排到11：00参加考试的话，请在11：00参加考试。

meaning: n. 出席人数；出席，出勤；考勤情况；提供帮助（in attendance）
definition: 1. n. the act of being present (at a meeting or event etc.)；2. n. the frequency with which a person is present
example: The students are engaged in the lecture-station format, 50% you would typically have 50% attendance even with the best lecture.
exampleZh: 在普通的讲座-背诵式课堂,学生的出勤率，通常是,即使是最好的讲座也如此。

meaning: n. 服务人员；侍从，随从；护理者；随员，助手；adj. 伴随的，随之产生的；伺候的；陪伴的；到场的
definition: 1. n. someone who waits on or tends to or attends to the needs of another；2. adj. following as a consequence
example: Now that she's a flight attendant, foreign travel has lost its glamour for her.
exampleZh: 她现在是空中乘务员了，去国外旅行对她已失去吸引力。

meaning: n. 注意；注意力；照料；兴趣；立正；殷勤，关心
definition: 1. n. the process whereby a person concentrates on some features of the environment to the (relative) exclusion of others；2. n. the work of providing treatment for or attending to someone or something
example: and they put a very simple idea forward, it captures my attention and I continue thinking about it.
exampleZh: 他们提出一个很简单的想法，吸引了我的注意力，让我一直思考着它。

meaning: adj. 注意的，专心的；贴心的
definition: 1. adj. (often followed by `to') giving care or attention；2. adj. taking heed; giving close and thoughtful attention
example: He wishes the government would be more attentive to detail in their response.
exampleZh: 他希望政府在回应时能更注意细节。

meaning: n. 阁楼，顶楼；（檐部上方的）矮墙，楼层；鼓室上隐窝；（古希腊）阿提卡方言，雅典方言（Attic）；adj. （古希腊）阿提卡（语）的，雅典（语）的（Attic）；文雅的，简洁典雅的（Attic）
definition: 1. n. floor consisting of open space at the top of a house just below roof; often used for storage；2. adj. of or relating to Attica or its inhabitants or to the dialect spoken in Athens in classical times
example: .. The problem with Sadow's suitcase-- I actually had one and you might have one in your attic.
exampleZh: 沙度发明的行李箱问题出现在-,实际上我也有一个,你们的阁楼里可能也会放着一个。

meaning: n. 态度，看法；姿势；个人风格；敌视的态度；（飞机或宇宙飞船飞行时的）姿态；（芭蕾）鹤立式
definition: 1. n. a complex mental state involving beliefs and feelings and values and dispositions to act in certain ways；2. n. the arrangement of the body and its limbs
example: and it's a really different attitude of the people, but here there's a lot more things to do.
exampleZh: 而且这儿的人生活态度很不一样，但在这里我们有更多的事情可做。

meaning: n. 律师；代理人
definition: 1. n. a professional person authorized to practice law; conducts lawsuits or gives legal advice
example: So, please don't bring in your attorney if I didn't ask a question that's identical to one that you've worked.
exampleZh: 因此请不要带你的律师来,如果我没有考的题目,和你做过的题目相同的话。

meaning: v. 吸引；（物体间）产生引力；引起；有吸引力
definition: 1. v. direct toward itself or oneself by means of some psychological power or physical attributes；2. v. exert a force on (a body) causing it to approach or prevent it from moving away
example: But the second is a desire to attract and maintain the divine presence, the continued presence of God in the sanctuary.
exampleZh: 第二个是一种欲望，想要吸引和保持，上帝长久存在于圣所内的欲望。

meaning: n. 有吸引力的事物；吸引力；（两性间的）吸引；（物体间的）引力；（错误的）形态同化
definition: 1. n. the force by which one object attracts another；2. n. an entertainment that is offered to the public
example: So it's definitely also like a touristic attraction just to check out what the people are doing as well.
exampleZh: 看看那里的人在干什么也其实就是一个景点了。

meaning: adj. 吸引人的，有吸引力的；（人）迷人的，有魅力的；值得考虑的，值得做的；（与）引力（有关）的
definition: 1. adj. pleasing to the eye or mind especially through beauty or charm；2. adj. having power to arouse interest
example: And we put up this hypothesis that our observation is that octet stability seems to be an attractive electron configuration.
exampleZh: 我们把假设置于我们的观察之上,即8电子稳定体系,似乎是一种吸引人的电子图像。

meaning: v. 把……归因于；认为是……所作；认为……具有某种特质；n. 属性，特质；标志，象征；定语
definition: 1. n. a construct whereby objects or individuals can be distinguished；2. v. attribute or credit to
example: And they attribute it to the fact that, for all sorts of reasons, the ugly kid just matters less to the parent.
exampleZh: 他们把这个现象归因为，不知道为什么，父母就是没那么喜欢丑小孩。

meaning: adj. 可归因于……的；可能出自……的
definition: 1. adj. capable of being attributed
example: 10,000 deaths a year from chronic lung disease are attributable to smoking.
exampleZh: 每年1万个慢性肺病患者的死亡可能是由于吸烟导致的。

meaning: adj. 定语的，起修饰作用的；归属的，属性的；n. 定语
definition: 1. adj. of adjectives; placed before the nouns they modify
example: Relative pronouns and adverbs introduce attributive clauses.
exampleZh: 关系代词和关系副词引导定语从句。

meaning: n. 拍卖；（桥牌）叫牌阶段；v. 拍卖
definition: 1. a usually public sale of goods or property, where people make higher and higher bids (= offers of money) for each thing, until the thing is sold to the person who will pay most；2. to sell something in a public auction
example: For about six months Wallace Turnage worked in Hector Davis's slave auction house helping organize the auctions every day.
exampleZh: 华莱士·特内奇在赫克托·戴维斯的,奴隶拍卖行工作了六个月,每天帮助组织拍卖

meaning: n. 拍卖商，拍卖师；v. 拍卖
definition: 1. a person in charge of an auction who calls out the prices that people offer；2. someone whose job is to be in charge of an auction and call out the amounts of money that people offer
example: As the auctioneer called out bids, in New York one of the oldest banks on Wall Street, Lehman Brothers, filed for bankruptcy.
exampleZh: 随着拍卖商的叫价声，纽约华尔街最古老的银行之一雷曼兄弟宣告破产。

meaning: n. 观众，听众；读者；觐见，拜见；拥护者
definition: 1. n. a gathering of spectators or listeners at a (usually public) performance；2. n. the part of the general public interested in a source of information or entertainment
example: and you know, we're all trying to make the... trying to interact with the audience in a positive way,
exampleZh: 而且你知道，我们都试着以一种积极的方式与观众互动，

meaning: adj. 声音的，音频的；n. 声音，音频
definition: 1. n. the audible part of a transmitted signal；2. n. an audible acoustic wave frequency
example: Users can download MP3 music files and record them directly onto a CD audio disc using a PC CD burner.
exampleZh: 使用者可下载MP3音乐文件并用个人电脑光盘刻录机直接将其刻录到音频光盘上。

meaning: n. 审计，查……的账目；审查，审核；审计报告；v. 审计，查账；旁听
definition: 1. to make an official examination of the accounts of a business and produce a report；2. to go to a class or educational course for pleasure or interest, without being tested or receiving a grade at the end
example: Each year they audit our accounts and certify them as being true and fair.
exampleZh: 每年他们都会审核我们的账目，以证明其准确合理。

meaning: 审计；旁听
