definition: 1. to make an official examination of the accounts of a business and produce a report；2. to go to a class or educational course for pleasure or interest, without being tested or receiving a grade at the end
example: Configuration management consists of four separate tasks: identification, control, status accounting, and auditing.
exampleZh: 配置管理包括四个独立的任务：识别、控制、状态会计和审计。

meaning: n. 审计员；听众；旁听生
definition: 1. someone whose job is to carry out an official examination of the accounts of a business and to produce a report；2. someone whose job is to examine the accounts of a business and to produce a report on them
example: Assist board in assessing the independence of the external auditor.
exampleZh: 协助董事会评估外部审计师的独立性。

meaning: n. 观众席；礼堂，会堂
definition: 1. n. the area of a theater or concert hall where the audience sits
example: Where were you? -Sacramento, California, Memorial Auditorium I knew when he was done, this brother is for real.
exampleZh: 你当时在哪里？加利福利亚，萨克拉门托的纪念堂,我只知道，这个人非常认真。

meaning: v. 增加，增大；加强，补充；n. 增（元）音
definition: 1. to increase the size or value of something by adding something to it；2. to make something larger or fuller by adding something to it
example: While searching for a way to augment the family income, she began making dolls.
exampleZh: 为求增加家庭收入，她开始做起了玩具娃娃。

meaning: n. 增大，增多；增加物；（主旋律的）延长；（作为殊荣而对纹章进行的）扩充
definition: 1. the process of increasing the size, value, or quality of something by adding to it
example: If not, then some augmentation of testing practices may be required.
exampleZh: 如果不是，就需要一些增加的测试实践。

meaning: n. 八月；（美、德、英、波）奥古斯特（人名）；adj. （august）威严的，令人敬畏的
definition: 1. n. the month following July and preceding September；2. adj. of or befitting a lord
example: They would announce in December that we issued back in August these options to our executives.
exampleZh: 他们会在十二月的时候通告说,我们已经在八月的时候,向公司经营管理者发行股票期权了

meaning: n. 姑妈，伯母，舅妈等（指父亲或母亲的姐妹，或伯父、叔父、舅父等的妻子；也可放在名字前作称呼）
definition: 1. n. the sister of your father or mother; the wife of your uncle
example: Let's say it's your boyfriend or girlfriend. it's your mom and dad, your aunt or uncle,
exampleZh: 我们假设是你的男友或者女友，你的父母，还有你的姑姑或者姑父。

meaning: n. 伯母，阿姨，姑妈，姨妈，舅妈（同 aunt；亦作 aunty；亦用作亲昵称呼）；（Auntie）“大婶”（对英国广播公司的谑称）；（Auntie）“大婶”（对澳大利亚广播公司的谑称）
definition: 1. n. the sister of your father or mother; the wife of your uncle
example: Dear auntie, thanks very much!
exampleZh: 亲爱的阿姨，我们感谢您！

meaning: adj. 原作的，真迹的；传统的，正宗的；逼真的，仿真的；真实的，可靠的
definition: 1. adj. conforming to fact and therefore worthy of belief；2. adj. not counterfeit or copied
example: Authentic Italian cooking is very healthy—witness the low incidence of heart disease in Italy.
exampleZh: 正宗的意大利烹饪对健康非常有益，在意大利心脏病发病率低就是证据。

meaning: n. 真实性，可靠性
definition: 1. n. undisputed credibility
example: There are factors, however, that have cast doubt on the statue's authenticity.
exampleZh: 然而，有些因素已经让人们对这座雕像的真实性产生了怀疑。

meaning: n. 作者，著者；作家；发起者，创始人；作品；v. 撰写，写作；发起，创造
definition: 1. n. writes (books or stories or articles or the like) professionally (for pay)；2. v. be the author of
example: This is The Wind Among the Reeds, author William Butler Yeats, the year 1899, on the verge of the new century.
exampleZh: 这是威廉巴特勒叶芝的《苇间风》,在新世纪即将到来之际的1899年出版。

meaning: n. 专家，权威人士；行政管理机构；权力，权限；权威，威信；许可，授权；当局，官方
definition: 1. n. the power or right to give orders or make decisions；2. n. (usually plural) persons who exercise (administrative) control over others
example: He's absorbed the touching authority of Phoebus Apollo, the god of the sun. Milton -- why is that important?
exampleZh: 他已经吸收了阿波罗触动他人的权威，那么，弥尔顿，为什么那么重要呢？

meaning: adj. 专断的，命令式的；可靠的，可信的，权威的
definition: 1. adj. having authority or ascendancy or influence；2. adj. of recognized authority or excellence
example: The Torah probably reached a fixed and authoritative status first, then the books of the Prophets and finally the Writings.
exampleZh: 律法》可能是最早固定了权威地位的，然后是《先知书》再是《文集》

meaning: v. 批准，许可；授权
definition: 1. v. grant authorization or clearance for；2. v. give or delegate power or authority to
example: It would certainly be within his power to authorize a police raid like that.
exampleZh: 他肯定有权批准那种警方突袭行动。

meaning: n. 批准书，授权书；批准，授权
definition: 1. n. a document giving an official instruction or command；2. n. the power or right to give orders or make decisions
example: You may not enter the security area without authorization.
exampleZh: 未经批准不得进入警戒地区。

meaning: adj. 汽车的；n. 汽车；comb. 与汽车相关的；自动的；自身的；自发的
definition: 1. n. a motor vehicle with four wheels; usually propelled by an internal combustion engine
example: Over the last decade, auto theft has increased by over 56 percent.
exampleZh: 过去的10年来汽车盗窃案上升了56％以上。

meaning: n. 自传；自传体写作
definition: 1. a book about a person's life, written by that person；2. the area of literature relating to such books
example: So Roth imagines lived life as fictional in the same register as a novel, in the same register as an autobiography.
exampleZh: 所以罗斯想像过的生活就像小说中记录的那样，一如自传所述。

meaning: adj. 自传的，自传体的
definition: 1. based on or involving the writer's own life；2. describing the writer or based on the writer’s life
example: Her autobiographical novel draws on childhood memories while deliberately blurring the boundary between fact and fiction.
exampleZh: 她的自传体小说取材于童年记忆，同时有意模糊了事实与虚构之间的界限。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: v. 使自动化
definition: 1. v. make automatic or control or operate automatically
example: Research in human-vehicle interaction has shown even systems designed to automate driving are far from being error-proof.
exampleZh: 人车交互领域的研究表明，即便是专为自动驾驶而设计的系统，也远未达到万无一失的程度。

meaning: n. 自动化
definition: 1. n. the act of implementing the control of equipment with advanced technology; usually involving electronic hardware；2. n. the condition of being automatically operated or controlled
example: In the last ten years automation has reduced the work force here by half.
exampleZh: 在过去的10年中，自动化已经减少了这里一半的劳动力。

meaning: adj. 自动的；必然的；无意识的，不假思索的；n. 自动换挡汽车；自动武器
definition: 1. n. light machine gun；2. adj. operating with minimal human intervention; independent of external control
example: This is a poet who, with his wife, practiced automatic writing, who believed that the dead spoke through the living.
exampleZh: 他是这样的诗人，和他妻子一起，尝试着，自动写作，他们相信死人通过活人说话。

meaning: adv. 自然地，必然地；不假思索地，无意识地；自动地
definition: 1. adv. in a reflex manner；2. adv. in a mechanical manner; by a mechanism
example: So if you just automatically type your essay, your tutor will ring the American word
exampleZh: 所以如果你自动输入你的论文，你的导师会圈出美式的单词，

meaning: adj. 自治的，有自治权的；自主的，有自主权的；自动的
definition: 1. independent and having the power to make your own decisions；2. an autonomous organization, country, or region is independent and has the freedom to govern itself
example: Five of the six provinces are to become autonomous regions in a new federal system of government.
exampleZh: 在新的联邦政府体制下，6个省中的5个将成为自治区。

meaning: n. 自治，自治权；独立自主，自主权
definition: 1. the right of an organization, country, or region to be independent and govern itself；2. the ability to make your own decisions without being controlled by anyone else
example: Each of the area managers enjoys considerable autonomy in the running of his own area.
exampleZh: 每一位地区经理在各自主管的区域都享有相当大的自主权。

meaning: n. 秋天，秋季；晚年，渐衰期；秋（从秋分到冬至）；adj. 秋天的，秋季的；【名】 （Autumn）奥特姆（人名）
definition: 1. n. the season when the leaves fall from the trees
example: But a raving autumn shears Blossom from the summer's wreath; The older is condemned to death, Pardoned, drags out lonely years Conspiring among the ignorant.
exampleZh: 可是一个肃杀的秋天啊,从夏日的花环上剪下鲜花；,年长者被判处死刑，遇赦后，挨过寂寞的一年年,在愚氓中间从事阴谋。

meaning: adj. 辅助的；备用的，后备的；n. 助手，辅助人员；外国援军士兵，雇佣兵；附属机构；志愿队；辅助舰船；助动词
definition: 1. giving help or support, especially to a more important person or thing；2. a person whose job is to give help or support to other workers
example: Socrates demands for common ownership of property at least among the auxiliary class.
exampleZh: 一致性要求太多,苏格拉底要求共有产权,至少后备阶级应具共有权。

meaning: n. 效用，利益；v. 利用，有益于；有益于
definition: 1. use, purpose, advantage, or profit；2. used for saying that something was not successful
example: The doctors tried everything to keep him alive but to no avail.
exampleZh: 医生千方百计想使他活下来，但无济于事。

meaning: adj. 可用的，可获得的；有空的，有闲暇的；未婚的，单身的
definition: 1. adj. obtainable or accessible and ready for use or service；2. adj. not busy; not otherwise committed
example: or it's a moment where you're both feeling opened and available to speak about what the other person looks like.
exampleZh: 或者是在你们彼此都感觉轻松坦率，因而可以评价对方的样子的时候。

meaning: n. 可用性，可得性；空闲，闲暇；未婚，单身
definition: 1. n. the quality of being at hand when needed
example: Availability of this freeze-dried vaccine made it, then, possible to think about vaccinating people all over the world.
exampleZh: 冻干疫苗的应用能使医护人员,考虑向全世界人民接种疫苗

meaning: v. 报复，替……报仇
definition: 1. to do harm to or punish the person responsible for something bad done to you or your family or friends in order to achieve a fair situation；2. to get satisfaction by harming or punishing the person responsible for something bad done to you or your family or friends
example: Adonis was later killed by a wild boar – an attack that may have been arranged to avenge another of Adonis' romantic intrigues.
exampleZh: Adonis 后来被一头野猪杀死——一次袭击可能被安排来报复 Adonis 的另一个浪漫的阴谋。

meaning: n. 大街；（通向大宅子的）林荫道；途径，渠道
definition: 1. n. a line of approach；2. n. a wide street or thoroughfare
example: You could do a lot of shopping and a lot of damage to your bank account on Fifth Avenue.
exampleZh: 你可以在第五大道买很多东西，刷爆你的卡。

meaning: n. 平均水平，一般标准；平均数，平均值；（海损的）平均分担；（按保单规定应付赔偿额的）降减，均减；adj. 普通的，平常的；不好不坏的；平均（数）的；中等的，适中的；v. 平均为，平均达到；计算平均值；将……平均分配；（行情下跌时）买进更多的证券（或商品）以降低平均进价
definition: 1. n. a statistic describing the location of a distribution；2. v. amount to or come to an average, without loss or gain
example: If my code is correct, what should the average price be, after say, 100 days, if there's no bias. Pardon?
exampleZh: 如果我的代码没写错的话，如果没有偏向值那平均价格会是多少呢，如果没有偏向值，请说？

meaning: v. 防止，避免；转移
definition: 1. to prevent something bad from happening；2. to turn away your eyes or thoughts
example: The aim of the current round of talks is to promote free trade and to avert the threat of increasing protectionism.
exampleZh: 本轮会谈的目的是促进自由贸易，消除日益加剧的贸易保护主义的威胁。

meaning: n. 厌恶，憎恶；讨厌的人（或东西）
definition: 1. (a person or thing that causes) a feeling of strong dislike or of not wishing to do something；2. a feeling of strong dislike or unwillingness to do something
example: A new study found parents' aversion to certain animals would pass on to their children.
exampleZh: 一项新研究发现，父母对某些动物的厌恶会传递给孩子。

meaning: n. 航空，飞行（术）；航空工业，飞机工业
definition: 1. n. the aggregation of a country's military aircraft；2. n. the operation of aircraft to provide transportation
example: The man had genius and had made his mark in the aviation world.
exampleZh: 那位男士拥有天赋，而且在航空界已经成名。

meaning: v. 避免，防止；回避，避开；撤销，使无效
definition: 1. v. stay clear from; keep away from; keep out of the way of someone or something；2. v. prevent the occurrence of; prevent from happening
example: But story, that's what the plot is about, and if that's what the plot is about, how can we avoid calling it content?
exampleZh: 但是情节又都是围绕故事的，所以我们怎么能否认，故事是内容呢？

meaning: n. 避免，避开；废止
definition: 1. n. deliberately avoiding; keeping away from or preventing from happening
example: He is so pinched and straightened in his environment that his leaving is more an avoidance than an embrace.
exampleZh: 在如此艰难的处境下他挣扎求生,离开对他而言与其说是寻求解脱,不如说是逃避。

meaning: v. 等待，期待；将发生在，将降临到……身上
definition: 1. v. look forward to the probable occurrence of
example: In a few moments we will adjourn to the transept where cake happens to await.
exampleZh: 一会儿我们会去教堂休息,那里有免费蛋糕。

meaning: adj. 醒着的；v. （使）醒来，唤醒；唤起，激发起；意识到（awake to）
definition: 1. v. stop sleeping；2. adj. not in a state of sleep; completely conscious
example: Exhaustion would make me drift toward sleep and then I would scream until I was wide awake again.
exampleZh: 体力不济之后，我会入睡,下次又是尖叫着惊起。

meaning: n. 奖，奖品；（收入的）增加；（赔偿）裁定额；（毕业证书等的）授予；奖学金；v. 授予，颁发；判给，裁定；【名】 （Award）（美）艾华尔德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a grant made by a law court；2. v. give, especially as an honor or reward
example: I mean that can include... you know, me... sneaking my way into an award show that I don't belong at
exampleZh: 我的意思是那包括……我……偷偷溜进我本不该进的颁奖典礼，

meaning: adj. 知道的，明白的；察觉到的，意识到的；有……意识的，有……知识的；【名】 （Aware）（阿拉伯、索）阿瓦雷（人名）
definition: 1. adj. (sometimes followed by `of') having or showing knowledge or understanding or realization or perception；2. adj. bearing in mind; attentive to
example: Now as soon as we start talking about things like the dominant, we are also aware of the evanescence of dominance.
exampleZh: 说到支配性，我们就必须认识到支配并不是不变的。

meaning: n. 认识，意识；感悟能力
definition: 1. n. having knowledge of；2. n. state of elementary or undifferentiated consciousness
example: plastic The good prejudice is our prior awareness that plastic meant something different in the eighteenth century than it means now.
exampleZh: 好偏见是我们预先知道,在十八世纪的意思与今天的不同。

meaning: adv. 距离……有多远，距离……有多久；朝另一个方向；不在，离开；（放）在安全的地方；逐渐消失；一直，继续不断地；移走；（比赛）在客场；adj. （球队比赛）客场的；n. 客场比赛，客场获胜
definition: 1. adj. not present; having left；2. adv. from a particular thing or place or position (`forth' is obsolete)
example: I think it takes your breath away to think of the unspeakably high hopes that John Milton had for his career.
exampleZh: 我觉得像弥尔顿这样说出自己对职业如此高的希望,是很让人吃惊的。

meaning: n. 敬畏，惊叹；使人敬畏的力量；v. 使敬畏，使惊叹；【名】 （Awe）（英、美、德、尼日利亚）阿韦（人名）
definition: 1. n. an overwhelming feeling of wonder or admiration；2. v. inspire awe in
example: They looked at him with a mixture of horror, envy, and awe.
exampleZh: 他们带着害怕、羡慕和敬畏的混合表情看着他。

meaning: adj. 让人惊叹的，令人敬畏的；非常棒的，极佳的
definition: 1. adj. inspiring awe or admiration or wonder
example: I mean, they last forever. You can keep them on for... like a month or something. Yeah, it's awesome.So, yeah.
exampleZh: 它们可以维持很久。你可以把他们留在阅读器里，长达一个月。是的，太棒了，嗯。

meaning: adj. 让人讨厌的，糟糕的；骇人听闻的，可怕的；生病的，不舒服的；非常的，很多的；adv. 非常，极其
definition: 1. adj. exceptionally bad or displeasing；2. adv. used as intensifiers
example: But there are an awful lot of computations for which this is the right way to do it.
exampleZh: 对，可能,这要花一会儿功夫。

meaning: adj. 令人尴尬的，使人难堪的；难对付的，难处理的；局促不安的；不方便的；笨拙的，不雅观的；不舒适的
definition: 1. adj. causing inconvenience；2. adj. lacking grace or skill in manner or movement or performance
example: Why this struggle, and why must Milton struggle with such awkward metaphysical categories in order simply to address properly the power of light?
exampleZh: 为什么弥尔顿必须,与这样一个奇怪的抽象的东西斗争,仅仅是为了恰当的描述光明的力量？

meaning: v. 削减，删除；用斧修整；解雇；询问；n. 斧头；爵士乐器（尤指吉他或萨克斯管）；n. （Ax）（德、芬）阿克斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. an edge tool with a heavy bladed head mounted across a handle；2. v. chop or split with an ax
example: He whittled a new handle for his ax.
exampleZh: 他为自己的斧头削了一个新斧柄。

meaning: n. 轴，轴线；对称中心线，对称轴；（国家间的）联盟；斑鹿（=chital，复数axis）
definition: 1. n. a straight line through a body or figure that satisfies certain conditions；2. n. the center around which something rotates
example: Of course, once we get to feminism, feminism will have certain ideas of its own about the vertical axis.
exampleZh: 当然，谈到女性主义时，女性主义会对竖轴有自己的解读。

meaning: n. 婴儿，婴孩；动物幼崽；（家庭或团体中）最小的成员；幼稚的人，软弱的人；差事，责任；宝贝，亲爱的；喜欢的东西，宝贝东西；v. 把……当婴儿般对待，对……娇生惯养；小心翼翼地操作，小心对待；adj. （蔬菜）幼嫩的；（幼）小的，小型的
definition: 1. n. a very young child (birth to 1 year) who has not yet begun to walk or talk；2. v. treat with excessive indulgence
example: So she's going to have to stop working in a couple of months to take care of the baby.
exampleZh: 几个月以后她就不能再工作，要开始照顾孩子了。

meaning: n. 婴儿潮，又称生育高峰期
definition: 1. a period when an unusually large number of babies are born
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: The baby boom following the Second World War placed enormous pressure on housing and education.
exampleZh: 第二次世界大战后的婴儿潮给住房和教育带来了巨大压力。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 婴儿潮时代出生的人（尤指第二次世界大战后生育高峰时期出生的人）
definition: 1. a person born during a baby boom, especially after the Second World War
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: At the same time, the baby boomer generation is aging and requiring health care.
exampleZh: 与此同时，婴儿潮一代正在老去，需要医疗保健。

meaning: n. 未婚男子，单身汉；学士；尚未交配的雄鸟；【名】 （Bachelor）（英）巴彻勒（人名）
definition: 1. n. a man who has never been married；2. v. lead a bachelor's existence
example: Okay. They have The Bachelor and they have The Bachelorette. Right now they are doing The Bachelors.
exampleZh: 好的。有《单身男士》，也有《单身女士》栏目。现在进行的是《单身男士》环节。

meaning: n. 后面，后部；背部；（文件等的）背面；（书等的）末尾；椅背，靠背；后卫；（the Backs）（背向剑河的）剑桥大学后园；adj. 后面的，位于后部的；偏远的，偏僻的；到期未付的，拖欠的；早期出版的，过期的；向后的，相反的；（18穴高尔夫球场的）后9穴的；（音）后位的，舌后的；adv. 回原处，恢复原状；回报，回复；向后；束起 ，收拢；与（某物）有距离，在远处；（将钟表）拨回；在曾去过（或提到过）的地方；回到过去，追溯至；控制住，忍住；归还，取回；再次，又一次；v. （使）后退，倒退；支持，资助；下赌注于；伴奏，伴唱；给……加背衬；在……后面；【名】 （Back）（美）巴克（人名）
definition: 1. n. the posterior part of a human (or animal) body from the neck to the end of the spine；2. v. be behind; approve of
example: So, that's present in all of these moments, but--equally present-- I want to get back to this sense of blankness.
exampleZh: 所以它在这些时候都被呈现了出来，而且是同等地呈现了出来-,让我们回头看看,这种空无一物的感觉。

meaning: n. 出身背景，学历，经历；（事件或情况的）背景；背景声音；（画等的）后景；底色；adj. 背景的，事先的；v. 作……的背景
definition: 1. n. a person's social heritage: previous experience or training；2. v. understate the importance or quality of
example: If you want to find out about their background or about how they feel about a certain thing,
exampleZh: 如果你想了解他们的背景，或者他们对做某一件事有什么样的态度，

meaning: n. 支援，增援；备用品，后备；备份；伴唱，伴奏；堵塞；adj. 候补的，替代的；支持性的
definition: 1. n. an accumulation caused by clogging or a stoppage；2. n. someone who takes the place of another (as when things get dangerous or difficult)
example: You should make a copy of the disk as a backup.
exampleZh: 你应该将磁盘复制一个备份。

meaning: adj. 向后的，朝后的；倒退的；落后的；迟钝的；adv. 向后，朝后（=backwards）；反向地，逆向地（=backwards）；向过去（=backwards）；倒退地，退步地（=backwards）；n. 后面（或过去）的部分；【名】 （Backward）（美、俄）巴克克华尔德（人名）
definition: 1. adj. directed or facing toward the back or rear；2. adv. at or to or toward the back or rear
example: He unlocked the door of apartment two and disappeared inside after a backward glance at Larry.
exampleZh: 他打开2号公寓的门锁，向后瞥了拉里一眼之后走进去就不见了。

meaning: adv. 向后；倒转，相反；（时间上）回溯；倒退，每况愈下
definition: 1. adv. at or to or toward the back or rear；2. adv. in a manner or order or direction the reverse of normal
example: My friend said this was Japanese binding, the way that books open from left to right, backwards.
exampleZh: 我的朋友说这是日式缝书法，书页是从左翻到右的。

meaning: n. 后院；后庭
definition: 1. n. the grounds in back of a house
example: He had an assemblage of old junk cars filling the backyard.
exampleZh: 他曾经在后院堆满了废旧汽车。

meaning: n. 培根，烟熏咸肉片
definition: 1. n. back and sides of a hog salted and dried or smoked; usually sliced thin and fried；2. n. English scientist and Franciscan monk who stressed the importance of experimentation; first showed that air is required for combustion and first used lenses to correct vision (1220-1292)
example: and a good old English breakfast where you have a load of cereal and then bacon, eggs, tomatoes,
exampleZh: 一顿好的老式英国早餐有一条燕麦面包，然后夹培根、鸡蛋、西红柿，

meaning: n. 细菌（bacterium的复数）
definition: 1. n. (microbiology) single-celled or noncellular spherical or spiral or rod-shaped organisms lacking chlorophyll that reproduce by fission; important as pathogens and for biochemical properties; taxonomy is difficult; often considered plants
example: So now, the enzyme is locked up with being built, and the penicillin has effectively killed the bacteria.
exampleZh: 所以这是我第一次感受到,我想在单个原子的层面上思考这些分子,所以这时我的专业转到了化学方向。

meaning: adj. 坏的，不好的，令人不悦的；难以接受的，令人遗憾的；粗鲁的，下流的；抱歉的，难过的；质量差的，不合格的；邪恶的，不道德的；顽皮的，不乖的；有病的，疼痛的；腐烂的，变质的；严重的，剧烈的；不明智的，不合适的；不利的，不幸的；拙于，不擅；无价值的，伪造的； 非常好的（比较级badder，最高级baddest）；n. 坏人，坏事；adv. 很，非常；厉害地；【名】 （Bad）（罗）巴德（人名）
definition: 1. n. that which is below standard or expectations as of ethics or decency；2. adj. having undesirable or negative qualities
example: Look at line 120. Milton writes that this choir had been singing at the moment of creation. Not bad.
exampleZh: 看到120行，弥尔顿写到这个唱诗班是在一个,创作的时刻唱歌的，不是不好的时刻。

meaning: n. 徽章，奖章；标记，象征；v. 给予……徽章（或标记）
definition: 1. n. an emblem (a small piece of plastic or cloth or metal) that signifies your status (rank or membership or affiliation etc.)；2. v. put a badge on
example: to be a celebrity or, you know, stuff like that just to make like the quick money badge.
exampleZh: 做个名人，或者就是那一类的，让钱来得快。

meaning: adv. 严重地；差，拙劣地；很，非常；不友好地，恶劣地；不利地，负面地；（支付薪水）低地
definition: 1. adv. to a severe or serious degree；2. adv. (`ill' is often used as a combining form) in a poor or improper or unsatisfactory manner; not well
example: Even the citizens of our fellow democracies see us as morally bankrupt Question: How did things go so badly wrong?
exampleZh: 即使我们民主联盟国家的公民,都觉得我们已经道德沦丧,问您一个问题，为什么事情会发展成这样？

meaning: n. 羽毛球
definition: 1. n. a game played on a court with light long-handled rackets used to volley a shuttlecock over a net
example: I know that we have, you know, some of the best badminton teams as well as taekwondo and martial arts. So you know,
exampleZh: 我知道我们这儿有一些最好的羽毛球队、跆拳道队和武术队。

meaning: v. 使困惑，难住；抑制，控制；n. 挡板，隔板，反射板
definition: 1. to cause someone to be completely unable to understand or explain something；2. to cause someone to be unable to understand or explain something
example: The swindler tried to baffle him out of his money, but in vain.
exampleZh: 骗子想骗取他的钱，可是没成功。

meaning: n. 袋，包；一袋的量；大量，很多；丑妇；宽松的裤子；眼袋；一批，一套；爱好，品味；垒，垒包；全部猎物；v. 把……装进袋子；抢占，占有；捕获，猎杀；批评，嘲笑；进球，得分；放弃，离开；给（病人）戴上氧气面罩；松垂，变形
definition: 1. n. a flexible container with a single opening；2. v. capture or kill, as in hunting
example: Instead, he paused for a moment and said, "I would marry a donkey " and a big bag of peanuts."
exampleZh: 不过出乎意料的是，他想了一会说，“我想娶一只驴子,和一大包花生“

meaning: n. 行李；思想包袱，成见
definition: 1. n. a case used to carry belongings when traveling；2. n. a worthless or immoral woman
example: There is a great deal of ideological baggage that is involved in the dating of the sources.
exampleZh: 有很多思想包袱,关于这些资料来源的时间考证。

meaning: n. 保释；保释金；（板球）三柱门上的横木；压纸杆；v. 保释；（往外）舀水；从……中摆脱出来；离开；【名】 （Bail）（英）贝尔，（法）巴伊（人名）
definition: 1. n. (criminal law) money that must be forfeited by the bondsman if an accused person fails to appear in court for trial；2. v. release after a security has been paid
example: The National Banks would be required to help bail out any bank that was failing.
exampleZh: 国家银行将保释,那些即将倒闭的银行。

meaning: n. 用作诱饵的人（或物）；饵，诱饵；v. 放诱饵；激怒，故意惹恼；纵犬袭击（动物）；【名】 （Bait）（美、法、意）巴伊特（人名）
definition: 1. n. anything that serves as an enticement；2. v. harass with persistent criticism or carping
example: This type of trap uses no bait or other attractant.
exampleZh: 这种陷阱不用诱饵或其他引诱物。

meaning: v. 炎热，灼热；烤，烘，焙；炙烤，受晒；n. 烤制食品；烤餐会；【名】 （Bake）（德、瑞典）巴克（人名）
definition: 1. v. cook and make edible by putting in a hot oven；2. v. prepare with dry heat in an oven
example: I love to bake so anything with fruits that I can , like pies now because it's getting cooler.
exampleZh: 我喜欢烘烤能带水果的任何食物，比如说现在我做馅饼，因为天气变凉了。

meaning: n. 面包店；烘焙食品（如面包，蛋糕）
definition: 1. n. a workplace where baked goods (breads and cakes and pastries) are produced or sold
example: It was a small shop sandwiched between a coffee shop on one side and a bakery on the other.
exampleZh: 这家小店被一个咖啡店和一个面包房夹在中间。

meaning: n. 平衡，均衡，均势；平衡能力；账户余额，结存；结欠，余款；天平，秤；（乐器）平衡器；v. 保持平衡；权衡，斟酌；使收支平衡；均衡，抵消；【名】 (Balance) （西）巴兰赛（人名）
definition: 1. n. a state of equilibrium；2. v. bring into balance or equilibrium
example: What should be established I think is an artistic, harmonious balance between the reader's mind and the author's mind.
exampleZh: 我觉得需要建立一种能艺术地协调，读者和作者思想之间的平衡,我们要保持些许冷漠。

meaning: n. 露台，阳台；楼座，楼厅
definition: 1. n. an upper floor projecting from the rear over the main floor in an auditorium；2. n. a platform projecting from the wall of a building and surrounded by a balustrade or railing or parapet
example: Speak up in the balcony, you who would yank out the organs. Why?
exampleZh: 楼座上那位，就是支持取出那些器官的，为什么这么做？

meaning: adj. 秃头的；光秃的，磨光的，掉光的；不加修饰的，直截了当的；【名】 （Bald）（英）鲍尔德，（德、法、波）巴尔德（人名）
definition: 1. with little or no hair on the head；2. to lose, or begin to lose, the hair on your head
example: Gender differences, he says, are no more relevant when it comes to positions of political rule being bald and being hairy.
exampleZh: 他表示，当性别差异,放到政治支配的位置时,秃发与多发间的区别无关。

meaning: n. 球，球状物；球类运动；踢出（或击出、投出）的一球；舞会；脚趾球，拇指球；勇气；弹丸；睾丸；v. （使）成球状（或团块）；和（女人）发生性关系；【名】 （Ball）（英、西）鲍尔，（法、德、俄、罗、捷）巴尔，（土）巴勒（人名）

exampleZh: 是的，就叫“带球跑”，带球跑的时候，你通常只从十码的地方开始。

meaning: n. 芭蕾舞剧；芭蕾舞团；芭蕾舞；芭蕾舞曲；【名】 （Ballet）（美、法）巴莱（人名）
definition: 1. n. a theatrical representation of a story that is performed to music by trained dancers；2. n. music written for a ballet

exampleZh: 她想当芭蕾舞演员。

meaning: n. 气球；热气球；气球状对话框；球形大酒杯；蠢人；分期付款中最后一笔数目特大的还款；v. 激增；突然长胖；膨胀，鼓起来；乘热气球旅行；（球）被踢（或打）得腾空飞起；（把球）踢飞，打飞；adj. 像气球般鼓起的；【名】 （Balloon）（美、印、泰、俄、巴）巴隆（人名）

exampleZh: 莱恩微弱的问，什么为什么“,为什么你认为它像一个领头气球“

meaning: n. （无记名）投票选举，投票表决；选票；投票总数（the ballot）；v. 要求（某人）投票；（为……）投票；抽签决定；【名】 （Ballot）（英）巴洛特，（法）巴洛（人名）
definition: 1. n. a document listing the alternatives that is used in voting；2. v. vote by ballot
example: The first ballot is on Tuesday Nov. 20.
exampleZh: 第一轮投票是在11月20日，星期二。

meaning: n. 竹，竹子；（制手杖或家具、器具用的）竹竿，竹筒；adj. 竹制的
definition: 1. n. the hard woody stems of bamboo plants; used in construction and crafts and fishing poles；2. n. woody tropical grass having hollow woody stems; mature canes used for construction and furniture
example: The panda's natural habitat is the bamboo forest.
exampleZh: 大熊猫的天然栖息地是竹林。

meaning: n. 禁止，禁令；逐出令；褫夺公民权的判决；诅咒；巴尼（罗马尼亚货币单位，复数bani）；v. 禁止，取缔；（官方）把（某人）逐出某地；【名】 （Ban）（美、罗马、克罗地亚）班恩（人名）
definition: 1. n. a decree that prohibits something；2. v. prohibit especially by legal means or social pressure
example: The most outrageous action in Laud's crackdown was his move to ban -his attempt to ban preaching in churches.
exampleZh: 他所做过的最骇人听闻的暴行,是企图在教堂里禁止布道训诫行为。

meaning: n. 香蕉；香蕉树；（Banana）巴纳纳（姓氏）；adj. （非正式，通常作 bananas）愚蠢的，发狂的
definition: 1. n. any of several tropical and subtropical treelike herbs of the genus Musa having a terminal crown of large entire leaves and usually bearing hanging clusters of elongated fruits；2. n. elongated crescent-shaped yellow fruit with soft sweet flesh
example: These companies are determined to keep a stranglehold on the banana industry.
exampleZh: 这些公司决定对香蕉业进行压制。

meaning: n. 乐队；一伙，一群；范围，段；带，箍；带状物，条纹；波段，频带；戒指；v. 给……分级，把……分段；用带绑扎；加彩条
definition: 1. n. an unofficial association of people or groups；2. v. bind or tie together, as with a band
example: You get people like Chris Martin from Coldplay, you know, such a, you know, massive band
exampleZh: 比如说，有来自酷玩乐队的克里斯•马丁，那是一个非常大型的乐队，

meaning: n. 绷带；v. 用绷带包扎
definition: 1. n. a piece of soft material that covers and protects an injured part of the body；2. v. wrap around with something so as to cover or enclose
example: We put some ointment and a bandage on his knee.
exampleZh: 我们在他的膝盖上涂了些药膏，还缠了一条绷带。

meaning: n. 突然的巨响；重击，猛撞；刘海（bangs）；v. 猛敲，砰然重击；猛摔；很响地使劲关上；（意外地）撞击；与……性交；砰砰作响；adv. 恰好，正好；完全，彻底；突然，猛然；int. 砰；突然，猛然；【名】 （Bang）（英、乍）班，（芬、德、丹）邦（人名）
definition: 1. n. a vigorous blow；2. v. strike violently
example: So, we wanted to bang that syncopation and then, of course, there's no sound on the downbeat over here to make the syncopation work.
exampleZh: 我们想要强调这个切分,然后,当然,在强拍的位置就不发声了,这才构成切分音

meaning: n. 银行；储蓄罐；库存，库；河岸；斜坡；云团，雾团；一排，一组；庄家的赌本；（泥）滩，沙洲；v. 把（钱）存入银行，把……储存入库；与银行有业务往来；（飞机）倾斜飞行；使反弹；（把某物）堆积起来，聚集起来；（用煤等）封炉火；【名】 （Bank）（英、德、俄）班克，（法、匈）邦克（人名）
definition: 1. n. a financial institution that accepts deposits and channels the money into lending activities；2. v. tip laterally
example: But I was not worried because I still have more than half of the cash in my bank account.
exampleZh: 但我并不担心,因为公司的银行账户上还有60多万美元。

meaning: n. 银行业；银行业务；银行家的职业；筑堤；v. bank 的现在分词：把钱存入银行；做银行家；在……边筑堤；倾斜转弯
definition: 1. n. engaging in the business of keeping money for savings and checking accounts or for exchange or for issuing loans and credit etc.；2. n. transacting business with a bank; depositing or withdrawing funds or requesting a loan etc.
example: On the other hand, historically, most institutions do both If you go around the world, are also involved in investment banking.
exampleZh: 另一方面，从历史上来说,如果你去全球看看，也做银行投资业务。

meaning: n. 银行家，银行要员；庄家；稳赢的赌注；捕鳕渔船；水涨齐岸的河流；辅动机车；【名】 （Banker）（英、塞）班克（人名）
definition: 1. n. someone who owns or is an executive in a bank；2. n. the person in charge of the bank in a gambling game
example: Yvonne guessed that he was a very successful publisher or a banker.
exampleZh: 伊冯娜猜测他是一位非常成功的出版商或银行家。

meaning: n. 钞票，纸币
definition: 1. n. a piece of paper money (especially one issued by a central bank)
example: Since the Han and Tang Dynasties, Chinese copper coins and banknote began to be copied by various neighboring states.
exampleZh: 自汉唐以来，中国的铜钱和纸币开始被周边各国复制。

meaning: adj. 破产的，倒闭的；沦丧的，无价值的；v. 使破产，使极其贫困；n. 破产者
definition: 1. n. someone who has insufficient assets to cover their debts；2. v. reduce to bankruptcy
example: Even the citizens of our fellow democracies see us as morally bankrupt Question: How did things go so badly wrong?
exampleZh: 即使我们民主联盟国家的公民,都觉得我们已经道德沦丧,问您一个问题，为什么事情会发展成这样？

meaning: n. 道德的沦丧；破产，倒闭
definition: 1. n. a state of complete lack of some abstract property；2. n. inability to discharge all your debts as they come due
example: In September 2008, Paulson refuse to offer such sales to Leathermen Brothers, permitting Leman Brothers to declare bankruptcy.
exampleZh: 008年9月，鲍尔森拒绝为,雷曼兄弟安排这样的买卖，导致雷曼,宣布破产。

meaning: n. 横幅标语；（网页上的）横幅广告；信仰，准则；旗帜；adj. 极好的，出色的；v. 在（头版的）通栏大字标题下刊登（新闻报道等）；【名】 （Banner）（英、德、罗）班纳（人名）
definition: 1. n. long strip of cloth or paper used for decoration or advertising；2. adj. unusually good; outstanding
example: I felt the banner rip as we were pushed in opposite directions.
exampleZh: 当我们被挤向相反的方向的时候，我感到横幅撕裂了。

meaning: n. 宴会，盛宴；筵席，宴席；v. 宴请；参加宴会；【名】 （Banquet）（法）邦凯，（西）班克特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a ceremonial dinner party for many people；2. v. provide a feast or banquet for
example: And a big banquet follows and Marduk is praised for all that he's accomplished, and his kingship is confirmed and Enuma Elish ends.
exampleZh: 接着举办了盛宴，Marduk受到了赞美,为他所取得的一切成就，他建立了王权，Enuma，Elish也就结束了。

meaning: n. 酒吧；吧台；小吃店；块，棒；（金属）条，栏杆；球门横梁；障碍；小节；条纹，带；功能条；律师职业；（法庭中的）围栏，被告席；电热棒；沙洲，暗礁；军阶杠；巴（气压单位）；v. 封，堵；阻挡，拦住；阻止，禁止；做条纹标记；prep. 除……外；【名】 （Bar）（德、法、俄、罗、捷、波、葡、以、阿拉伯）巴尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a room or establishment where alcoholic drinks are served over a counter；2. v. prevent from entering; keep out
example: I'm going to write it like this three moles of hydrogen which is a gas one bar 100 degrees Celsius.
exampleZh: 我会写成这样：,三摩尔氢分子，气体,1巴，100摄氏度。

meaning: n. 户外烧烤；（户外烧烤用的）烤肉架；烧烤食物；v. （在烤架上）烧烤
definition: 1. n. meat that has been barbecued or grilled in a highly seasoned sauce；2. v. cook outdoors on a barbecue grill
example: We were going to have a barbecue but the rain put the mockers on that idea.
exampleZh: 我们打算露天烧烤，但因为下雨，计划泡汤了。

meaning: n. 理发师；（男子）理发店 （the barber's）；v. 给（男子）理发；【名】 （Barber）（美）巴伯（人名）
definition: 1. n. United States composer (1910-1981)；2. v. perform the services of a barber: cut the hair and/or beard of
example: My father marched me over to Otto, the local barber, to have my hair cut short.
exampleZh: 爸爸把我拽到当地理发师奥托跟前，让他把我的头发剪短。

meaning: adj. 赤裸的；光秃秃的；无遮盖的，无装饰的；仅最基本的；v. 使暴露，使露出；adv. 非常，许多；【名】 （Bare）（英）贝尔（人名）
definition: 1. v. lay bare；2. adj. completely unclothed
example: So as it were,we might say, it might be that mere survival or bare bones survival doesn't really give me what matters.
exampleZh: 所以我们可以说，仅仅生存下去,肉体的存活并不是我需要的。

meaning: adv. 勉强才能；几乎不，几乎没有；刚刚；仅仅，只有；贫乏地，光秃秃；公开地，不加掩饰地
definition: 1. adv. by a small margin；2. adv. in a sparse or scanty way
example: Your young brother or sister, or my little children, can draw pictures of family members that barely look like family members.
exampleZh: 你的弟弟妹妹或者我的小宝贝们,可以画一些看起来,仅仅有点像家庭成员的画

meaning: n. 便宜货，减价品；协议，交易；v. 讨价还价，谈判
definition: 1. n. an agreement between parties (usually arrived at after discussion) fixing obligations of each；2. v. negotiate the terms of an exchange
example: and when he got out of the army, part of the bargain in the United States is

meaning: n. 驳船，平底载货船；华丽大游艇；（旗舰将官的）专用艇；v. 用驳船运载（货物）；猛闯；（主要用于体育运动，尤指蓄意）冲撞；【名】 （Barge）（美）巴奇（人名）
definition: 1. to hurry somewhere or through a place in a rude and forceful way；2. a long boat with a flat bottom, used for carrying heavy objects
example: She wants to cruise the canals of France in a barge.
exampleZh: 她想坐驳船游览法国的运河。

meaning: v. 大声嚷，吼叫；（狗）吠，叫；擦破（胫部的）皮；剥去（树，木头的）皮；n. 狗叫声，吠声；吼叫声；树皮；小帆船，三桅帆船；【名】 （Bark）（英、西、德、捷、法、芬、瑞典）巴克，（阿拉伯、俄）巴尔克（人名）
definition: 1. n. tough protective covering of the woody stems and roots of trees and other woody plants；2. v. speak in an unfriendly tone
example: I set the log on the ground and shaved off the bark.
exampleZh: 我把原木放在地上，然后刨掉树皮。

meaning: n. 畜棚，谷仓；空荡荡的大建筑；（停放汽车、火车等的）大车库；（尤用于粒子物理学）靶（恩）；v. 把……贮存入仓
definition: 1. a large building on a farm in which animals or hay (= dried grass) and grain are kept
example: In 1979, Liquor Barn thrived as a discount merchandiser.
exampleZh: 1979年，作为折扣酒品专卖店的立可仓生意兴隆。

meaning: n. 气压计，晴雨表；变化的标志，指标
definition: 1. a device that measures air pressure and shows when the weather is likely to change；2. something that can show how a particular situation is developing, or how people's opinions on a particular matter are changing
example: In past presidential elections, Missouri has been a barometer of the rest of the country.
exampleZh: 在过去的总统大选中，密苏里州一直是该国其余各州的晴雨表。

meaning: n. 兵营，营房；（一片）简陋的大房子；v. 喝倒彩，起哄；为（士兵）提供营房（barrack 的第三人称单数形式）
definition: 1. a building or group of buildings where soldiers live
example: The soldiers returned to the barracks after completing their training exercise in the mountains.
exampleZh: 士兵们在完成山地训练演习后返回了营房。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 桶；一桶（的量）；枪管，炮管；（马等四足动物的）躯干；v. 飞奔，高速行驶；把……装入桶内；【名】 （Barrel）（法、意）巴雷尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a tube through which a bullet travels when a gun is fired；2. v. put in barrels
example: "All politics grows out of the barrel of a gun," as a famous twentieth-century Machiavellian once put it.
exampleZh: 所有的政治都是活在枪杆子下“,这是二十世纪一位著名,马奇亚维利派学者的解译。

meaning: adj. 贫瘠的，不毛的；不结果实的；不育的；不出成绩的，无效果的；沉闷无趣的，没有吸引力的；n. 瘠地；【名】 （Barren）（英、西）巴伦（人名）
definition: 1. unable to produce plants or fruit；2. unable to have children or young animals
example: That's probably the most bare, bleak, barren and inhospitable island I've ever seen.
exampleZh: 那可能是我见过的最光秃、最荒凉、最贫瘠和最不适合居住的岛屿。

meaning: n. 障碍，壁垒；障碍物，关卡；分界线，屏障；大关，界限；【名】 （Barrier）（法）巴里耶（人名）
definition: 1. n. a structure or object that impedes free movement；2. n. any condition that makes it difficult to make progress or to achieve an objective
example: Duties and taxes are the most obvious barrier to free trade.
exampleZh: 关税及其他各种税是自由贸易最明显的障碍。

meaning: n. 根基，底部；基础；基地；基础成分；（数字进位制中的）基数；（棒球）垒；碱，盐基；（晶体管的）基极；词根；v. 以……为基础；把基地设在……；adj. 卑鄙的，下流的；低劣的；【名】 （Base）（英、美、爱尔兰）马濑（人名）
definition: 1. n. any of various water-soluble compounds capable of turning litmus blue and reacting with an acid to form a salt and water；2. v. use as a basis for; found on
example: If the base move is 0, then the price doesn't change So that makes sense. Interesting question.
exampleZh: 如果这个基础位移是0，这个价格就不变,这是有道理的吗，很有意思的问题。

meaning: n. 棒球运动；棒球（比赛用的小硬球）
definition: 1. n. a ball game played with a bat and ball between two teams of nine players; teams take turns at bat trying to score runs；2. n. a ball used in playing baseball
example: They have got a lot of baseball fields over there. They have a big trail, like a big biking trail.
exampleZh: 那儿有许多棒球场。那边也有个大跑道，看起来就像是一个大型的自行车道。

meaning: n. 地下室，地库
definition: 1. n. the lowermost portion of a structure partly or wholly below ground level; often used for storage；2. n. the ground floor facade or interior in Renaissance architecture
example: So, the poetry that is part and parcel of the conversation between Dean and Carlo--Carlo's poetry--seeps out of that basement room.
exampleZh: 所以，诗歌是迪恩和卡洛的对话中不可缺少的一部分,-卡洛的诗歌--从那间地下室里渗出。

meaning: adj. 最重要的，基本的；最简单的，初级的；（产品和服务）必需的；（化）碱性的；含碱的；n. 基本要素，基本原则
definition: 1. n. a popular programming language that is relatively easy to learn; an acronym for beginner's all-purpose symbolic instruction code; no longer in general use；2. adj. pertaining to or constituting a base or basis
example: It's this basic antagonism, this difference of opinion, that Eikhenbaum wants to focus on and, indeed, does focus on.
exampleZh: 这就是艾肯鲍姆的反对者的，基本意见，针对这点，艾肯鲍姆将反对付诸行动了。

meaning: adv. 基本上，大体上；从根本上说，总的说来
definition: 1. adv. at bottom or by one's (or its) very nature
example: So basically, what he wants us to do is redesign this and produce something better and then possibly patent that.
exampleZh: 所以，医生希望我们能重新设计这种仪器，发明出更加先进的仪器，有可能的话，还可以申请专利。

meaning: n. 盆；洗涤槽；流域；盆地，海盆；内港，内湾；【名】 （Basin）（俄）巴辛，（法）巴赞（人名）
definition: 1. n. a bowl-shaped vessel; usually used for holding food or liquids；2. n. the quantity that a basin will hold
example: We were given a basin of water to wash our hands in.
exampleZh: 我们得到了一盆水洗手。

meaning: n. 基础，要素；基准，方式；理由，根据；主要成分（或部分）
definition: 1. n. a relation that provides the foundation for something；2. n. the fundamental assumptions from which something is begun or developed or calculated or explained
example: Here, the stopping of the train is like the interruption by memory of normal consciousness that's the basis of the poem.
exampleZh: 这里，火车的停止就像是,被正常知觉的记忆所打断，那是这首诗的基础。

meaning: n. 篮子；一篮的量；（篮球运动的）篮；投篮得分
definition: 1. n. a container that is usually woven and has handles；2. n. the quantity contained in a basket
example: The dollar has fallen 6.5 percent this year against a basket of currencies from its largest trading partners.

meaning: n. 篮球；篮球运动

exampleZh: 我仅仅看过一场篮球赛，当时好像是纽约尼克斯队和某个队的比赛。

meaning: n. 男低音歌手；低音，低音部；低音吉他，低音提琴；鲈鱼；椴树；adj. 低音的，低声调的；【名】 （Bass）（英、法、德、俄、罗、捷、马里、匈）巴斯（人名）

meaning: n. 球棒，球拍；蝙蝠；v. 用球板（棒）击球；挥打，击走；【名】 （Bat）（英、蒙）巴特（人名）

exampleZh: 如果你是棒球队球童，那么你就要为棒球队员拿球棒。

meaning: n. 一批，一批生产量；v. 分批处理；【名】 （Batch）（英）巴奇（人名）

example: Each summer a new batch of students tries to find work.
exampleZh: 每年夏天都有一批新的学生要找工作。

meaning: n. 浴缸，浴盆；洗澡，沐浴；浴室；池，盆；v. 给……洗澡；洗澡，沐浴
definition: 1. n. a vessel containing liquid in which something is immersed (as to process it or to maintain it at a constant temperature or to lubricate it)；2. v. clean one's body by immersion into water
example: I don't know if you've been to Bath. But it's very nice, but a bit boring and small.
exampleZh: 我不知道你去过巴斯没有。那里非常漂亮，只是有一点无聊，而且那里很小。

meaning: v. 洗澡，给（某人）洗澡；游泳，嬉水；用水清洗（尤指身体部位）；（光线）洒满，覆盖；n. 游泳，洗浴；【名】 （Bathe）（英）巴思，（德）巴特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of swimming；2. v. cleanse the entire body
example: The police have warned the city's inhabitants not to bathe in the polluted river.
exampleZh: 警方已经警告本市居民不要在那条被污染的河里游泳。

meaning: n. 浴室，盥洗室；卫生间，厕所；（尤指成套出售的）浴室用具
definition: 1. n. a room (as in a residence) containing a bathtub or shower and usually a washbasin and toilet；2. n. a room or building equipped with one or more toilets
example: For Hebrew, I know one sentence in Hebrew: "Sleecha, eypho ha-sheeruteem" which I think is a request for the bathroom.
exampleZh: 我知道一句希伯来语,"请问,卫生间在哪里",我猜这话的意思是想去卫生间了

meaning: n. 营，军营；（有组织的）队伍
definition: 1. n. an army unit usually consisting of a headquarters and three or more companies；2. n. a large indefinite number
example: Ten hours later Anthony was ordered to return to his battalion.
exampleZh: 10小时之后安东尼被命令回营。

meaning: v. 接连猛打；殴打，毒打；肆虐，严重破坏；抨击，责难；给……裹面糊；（墙等的）向后倾斜；n. 面糊（煎料），面团；击球员；（墙等的）向后倾斜；（活字或铅版的）字面磨损处；【名】 （Batter）（英、美、加）巴特尔（人名）
definition: 1. to hit something with force many times；2. to hit and behave violently towards a person repeatedly over a long period of time
example: Whisk the batter with a wire whisk or hand beater until it is smooth and light.
exampleZh: 用搅拌器搅拌糊状物直到糊状物变得光滑酥松。

meaning: n. 电池，蓄电池；一组，一系列；炮组，排炮；殴打罪；（棒球队的）投手和接球手；adj. 笼养的，层架式养殖的
definition: 1. n. group of guns or missile launchers operated together at one place；2. n. a device that produces electricity; may have several primary or secondary cells arranged in parallel or series
example: The only thing that stands between us and that is a suitable battery.
exampleZh: 而之间唯一的困难则是,合适耐用的电池。

meaning: n. 战役，战争；争论，斗争；竞赛，较量；拼搏，奋斗；v. 与……作战，和……斗争；搏斗，奋斗；争吵，争论；阻止，打败；【名】 （Battle）（英）巴特尔，（法）巴特勒，（西）巴特莱（人名）
definition: 1. n. a hostile meeting of opposing military forces in the course of a war；2. v. battle or contend against in or as if in a battle
example: Well,you're in some battle,or rather, your troop is in some battle, and people are being killed left and right.
exampleZh: 比如你在战场上，或者说你的军队在战场上，周围的人被杀死。

meaning: n. （海或湖的）湾；山脉的低凹处，山间平地；（装窗的）房间突出部分；间隔区，限定区域；月桂树；枣红马，栗色马；（尤指教堂中殿墙壁的）柱间距；（船或飞机上的）货舱；v. （犬）连续吠，（狼）连续嚎叫；（尤指要求惩罚某人时）大声叫嚷；adj. 枣红色的，深棕色的；【名】 （Bay）（英、老）贝，（德、意、罗、捷、土、丹）巴伊，（匈）鲍伊，（瑞典）巴伊，（越）七（人名）
definition: 1. n. an indentation of a shoreline larger than a cove but smaller than a gulf；2. v. utter in deep prolonged tones
example: Like, I think the Bay Area is really awesome. There's a lot of like, things to do.
exampleZh: 我认为旧金山湾区真的很棒。那里有许多事情可做。

meaning: aux. 被（用于被动语态）；正，正在（用于进行时）；v. 是；有，存在；做，成为；发生；n. （Be）（缅）拜；（日）部（姓）；（朝）培；（中非）贝（人名）
definition: 1. n. a light strong brittle grey toxic bivalent metallic element；2. v. have the quality of being; (copula, used with an adjective or a predicate noun)
example: The system can be an open system, or it can be a closed system, or it can be isolated.
exampleZh: 系统可以是开系，可以是闭系，或是孤立系。

meaning: n. 海滩，海滨；v. 把（船）拖上岸；搁浅；（垂钓者）钓（鱼）上岸；让（某人）受损；【名】 （Beach）（英）比奇（人名）
definition: 1. n. an area of sand sloping down to the water of a sea or lake；2. v. land on a beach
example: But for all that, that doesn't mean that within the picture of the beach, I'm in the beach.
exampleZh: 这并不算是说,你就置身于画面之中。

meaning: n. （有孔的）珠子；（液体的）小滴；（枪的）圆形准星；（轮胎的）胎圈，胎边；凸圆线脚；念珠；v. 缀珠状物于；把（珠）串在一起；在（平面上）覆盖小珠
definition: 1. a small, coloured, often round piece of plastic, wood, glass, etc. with a hole through it. It is usually put on a string with a lot of others to make jewellery；2. a very small amount of liquid
example: You can imagine a bead with a wire going through it and the bead can only slide back and forth.
exampleZh: 你可以想象一个有金属丝穿过的珠子而且这个珠子只能前后滑动。

meaning: n. 鸟嘴，喙；鹰鈎鼻，尖鼻；法官，男教师；【名】 （Beak）（英、西）比克（人名）
definition: 1. the hard, pointed part of a bird's mouth；2. a large nose
example: The male bird has a red spot on its beak.
exampleZh: 雄鸟喙上有一个红点。

meaning: n. 梁，横梁；臀围；光线，光柱；喜色，笑容；（体操的）平衡木；v. 定向发出（无线电信号）；（光，光源）照耀；喜笑颜开，面露喜色；【名】 （Beam）（英）比姆，（阿拉伯）贝亚姆（人名）
definition: 1. n. a signal transmitted along a narrow path; guides pilots in darkness or bad weather；2. v. smile radiantly; express joy through one's facial expression
example: Be careful you don't knock your head on this low beam.
exampleZh: 小心，别把头撞在这矮梁上。

meaning: n. 豆，菜豆，豆科植物；籽实，豆形种子；用于强调丝毫，一点；脑袋；（Bean）描述Java的软件组件模型（Enterprise Java Bean）；v. （用某物）击中（某人）头部；【名】 （Bean）（英）比恩（人名）
definition: 1. n. any of various edible seeds of plants of the family Leguminosae used for food；2. v. hit on the head, especially with a pitched baseball
example: The unsaturated fats are the corn, soy bean, safflower, sunflower, cottonseed oils, and fats that you get from seafood.
exampleZh: 不饱和脂肪是从,玉米,大豆,红花,葵花,棉籽油以及海鲜中提取出的脂肪

meaning: v. 手持，携带；（车，船）运输，运送；写有，刻有；以（姓名，头衔）相称；见证，作证；承担，担负（责任）；经得起；承受，容忍；生育（孩子）；（树，植物）结（果实），长出（花）；拐弯；n. 熊；粗暴无礼的人，没教养的人；体格笨重的男人，行动迟缓的男人；（股票）卖空者，做空头者；麻烦事，棘手之事；“北极熊”（俄国的外号）；【名】 （Bear）（美）贝尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. massive plantigrade carnivorous or omnivorous mammals with long shaggy coats and strong claws；2. v. have

exampleZh: 当你得到一个最优子结构,但局部解决方案有重跌时，你就可以引入动态编程,来解决这个问题了。

meaning: n. 胡须，络腮胡子；（动物的）颔毛，须；（植物的）芒，髯毛；替身；名义女伴；v. 对抗（令人畏惧的人），顶撞；抓……的胡须；提供胡须；【名】 （Beard）（英、美、加、法）比尔德（人名）
definition: 1. n. the hair growing on the lower part of a man's face；2. v. go along the rim, like a beard around the chin
example: Yeah, so let's have the guy in the beard, but let the mike get to him. Yell out your name.
exampleZh: 请那位留胡子的同学说一下,把麦克风给他,大声说出你的名字

meaning: n. 举止，仪态；与……有关，对……有影响；（对坏事的）宽容，容忍；轴承，支轴；方位，方向角；（用罗盘）定向，测位；（盾形纹章面上的）图案；v. 写有，刻有；手持，携带；承担（bear 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. relevant relation or interconnection；2. adj. (of a structural member) withstanding a weight or strain
example: It has its own purpose, which is not a purpose that has any bearing necessarily on anything else.
exampleZh: 事物自己存在的目的,与其它无关。

meaning: n. 野兽，猛兽，牲畜；凶暴残忍的人，道德败坏的人；（具有某种特性的）东西，货色
definition: 1. n. a living organism characterized by voluntary movement；2. n. a cruelly rapacious person
example: In fact, he called them "Beast machines" and said animals, nonhuman animals are merely robots, but people are different.
exampleZh: 实际上他将动物称之为"野兽机器",他认为,非人类动物全是机器人,但人类是不同的

meaning: v. （反复地）敲，击，打；狠打，猛抽；搅拌，混合；拍动，扇动（翅膀）；（心脏）跳动，搏动；击败，战胜；抢……之先，赶在……之前；避开，避免；n. 敲，击；（音乐或诗歌的）强音拍；（经常去或经过的）路线，地点；以之字形航线抢风航行；adj. 筋疲力尽，疲惫不堪；垮掉的一代的；【名】 （Beat）贝亚特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a regular route for a sentry or policeman；2. v. come out better in a competition, race, or conflict
example: Your heart starts to beat a little faster, your blood starts flowing quicker, and your breath gets shorter.
exampleZh: 你的心跳加速，血脉贲张，呼吸也急促起来。

meaning: n. 美丽，漂亮；美好的事物，上品；美人，美女；魅力，吸引人之处；优点，妙处；美容品，化妆品；adj. （产品、工作或活动）美容的
definition: 1. n. the qualities that give pleasure to the senses；2. n. a very attractive or seductive looking woman
example: Historically, it has not been pleasure or wit or beauty that has been associated with the experience of reading Milton.
exampleZh: 一直以来，人们阅读米尔顿作品的时候,感受到的都不是愉悦，机智，或者美好。

meaning: adj. 美丽的，漂亮的；令人愉悦的，美妙的；（完成得）出色的，极好的；仁慈的
definition: 1. adj. delighting the senses or exciting intellectual or emotional admiration；2. adj. aesthetically pleasing
example: Like the moon, Satan may look beautiful, but upon a closer scrutiny that beauty begins to yield certain metaphysical flaws.
exampleZh: 像月亮那样，撒旦看起来非常美好，但是近看,就会发现这份美丽开始显露出一些抽象的瑕疵。

meaning: v. 使美丽，美化
definition: 1. v. make more beautiful；2. v. be beautiful to look at
example: You know what to beautify is, I suppose?
exampleZh: 我想你知道怎么美化吧？

meaning: conj. （说明原因）因为，由于；（作出解释）因为
definition: 1. abstract: "Because" is a song by The Dave Clark Five, recorded in 1964. Originally the B-side to "Can't You See That She's Mine" in the United Kingdom, "Because" was released as a single in the United States and reached number three on the Billboard Hot 100 chart.
example: Because most of the people there didn't really need it because they have cars, or they just take taxis.
exampleZh: 因为那里的大多数人并不真正需要它，因为他们自己有车，或者会直接打车。

meaning: v. （招手）示意，召唤；吸引，引诱；可能发生；n. 召唤的表示
definition: 1. to move your hand or head in a way that tells someone to come nearer；2. If something beckons, it attracts people
example: Seen from afar, its towering buildings beckon the visitor in.
exampleZh: 远远望去，它的高耸建筑就像在召唤游客。

meaning: v. 变得，变成，成为；适合，使显得漂亮
definition: 1. v. enter or assume a certain state or condition；2. v. undergo a change or development
example: The martyrs in the Easter Rebellion of 1916 become ancient Irish warriors, and we'll talk about that next time.
exampleZh: 916年复活节起义中的烈士6,化身为古代爱尔兰骑士，这个我们下次课再谈。

meaning: n. 床，床铺，床位；底部，基座；花坛，苗圃；海底，河床；岩层；（车辆的）拖斗；v. 把……固定，嵌入；与（某人）上床
definition: 1. n. a piece of furniture that provides a place to sleep；2. v. furnish with a bed
example: I'm now, have to teach in the school. I can't, I'm not at home to teach them how to make their bed,

meaning: n. 床上用品，寝具；（给动物铺窝的）垫子；花坛植物；底层，基层；（岩石的）层理；adj. 适于花坛种植的；v. 把……固定，嵌入；与（某人）上床（bed 的现在分词形式）

exampleZh: 所有被褥都被铺成两个铺位，在马车后部上下叠放着。

meaning: n. 蜜蜂；聚会，联谊赛；工作忙碌的人（busy bee）；【名】 （Bee）（英）比，（赤几）贝埃（人名）
definition: 1. n. any of numerous hairy-bodied insects including social and solitary species；2. n. a social gathering to carry out some communal task or to hold competitions
example: Her arm was beginning to swell up where the bee had stung her.
exampleZh: 她胳膊给蜜蜂蜇了，肿了起来。

meaning: n. 牛肉；肌肉，力量，力气；抱怨，牢骚；要点，关键；犯罪指控，罪名；v. 抱怨，发牢骚
definition: 1. n. cattle that are reared for their meat；2. v. complain

meaning: n. 啤酒；一杯（或一瓶，一罐）啤酒；根汁啤酒；【名】 （Beer）（法、德、俄、罗、捷、瑞典）贝尔，（英、西、南非）比尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a general name for alcoholic beverages made by fermenting a cereal (or mixture of cereals) flavored with hops
example: everybody was happy, everybody was smiling and laughing, almost everybody had a beer in their hand.
exampleZh: 每个人都很开心，每个人都在笑，几乎每个人都手拿一杯啤酒。

meaning: n. 甲虫；画甲虫，拼甲虫（一种掷骰子游戏）；大槌；捶布机；（大众汽车公司生产的）甲壳虫汽车（Beetle）；v. 匆匆地走；（人的眉毛）突出，悬垂；用大槌捶；用捶布机捶（布）；adj. （人的眉毛）粗浓而突出；【名】 （Beetle）（美）比特尔（人名）
definition: 1. an insect with a hard shell-like back；2. to go somewhere quickly
example: Healthy trees are also better able to fend off bark beetle.
exampleZh: 健康的树木也能更好地抵御树皮甲虫。

meaning: prep. （时间上）在……之前，早于；在（某个钟点）之前；（次序）在……之前；当面，在……面前；由……考虑中；面对（法院，法庭或其他官方机构）并受审；比……更重要；（位置）在……前面；（未来将发生的事）等待着，面临着；（宁可……而）不愿……；在……影响下，在……威慑下；conj. 在……以前；到……为止；以免，不然；（先）……才……；（宁可……而）不愿；adv. 以前，过去；在（某时间或某事）以前；在前面

example: I have to say in her defence that she knew nothing about it beforehand.
exampleZh: 我得为她说句话，她事先并不知道此事。

meaning: v. 乞求，恳求；乞讨，行乞；（狗）作乞求状；【名】 （Beg）（德、塞、巴基）贝格（人名）

example: and literally beg you for whatever they want like, if it's money, something to drink, food.
exampleZh: 求你给他们一些东西，钱、喝的、食物，什么都可以。

meaning: n. 乞丐，叫花子；家伙；v. 使贫穷，使匮乏；难以相信，无法相容

example: One time, I paid a beggar when I was driving in my car and I was stopped to the stoplight,
