meaning: v. 开始，着手；开始说；开始发生，开始进行；以……为起点，起始于；首字母为
definition: 1. n. Israeli statesman (born in Russia) who (as prime minister of Israel) negotiated a peace treaty with Anwar Sadat (then the president of Egypt) (1913-1992)；2. v. take the first step or steps in carrying out an action
example: It's one that is maybe initially counterintuitive but actually, I think, is rather important once you begin to think about it.
exampleZh: 乍一听你会觉得不可思议，但是仔细一想就会悟出其中道理。

meaning: n. 开始，开端；序曲，开始部分；早期，初期；发端，起源；adj. 初级的，基本的；v. 开始，着手（begin 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. the event consisting of the start of something；2. adj. serving to begin
example: It shouldn't be difficult to see a kind of problem that is beginning to arise in Milton's text here.
exampleZh: 这是一个很容易看出的问题,在弥尔顿的作品中也被提了出来。

meaning: n. 代表（on behalf of）；因为，为了……的利益（in/on behalf of）；就……而言，在……一方（on behalf of）
definition: 1. n. as the agent of or on someone's part (usually expressed as；2. n. for someone's benefit (usually expressed as `in behalf' rather than `on behalf' and usually with a possessive)
example: Deuteronomy emphasizes God's gracious and undeserved love of Israel, and that's expressed in his mighty acts on Israel's behalf.
exampleZh: 申命记强调上帝对以色列亲切甚至不相称的爱，这在他对以色列人全能的行为上表现出来。

meaning: v. 行为，表现；起反应，起作用；守规矩，举止得体
definition: 1. v. behave in a certain manner; show a certain behavior; conduct or comport oneself；2. v. behave in a certain manner
example: We need to come up with an experiment in which the electron is going to be forced to behave as a wave.
exampleZh: 我们得想出个实验,在这个实验中电子必须,要表现得像波一样。

meaning: n. 行为，举止，态度；（机器、物质等在特定条件下的）性能，性状，反应；（心理学）有机体对刺激的可观察反应或活动
definition: 1. n. manner of acting or controlling yourself；2. n. the action or reaction of something (as a machine or substance) under specified circumstances
example: We are going to now go into the atom and try to understand the scientific basis for this observed behavior.
exampleZh: 我们现在要讲讲原子,并试着去理解这个观察行为,的科学原理。

meaning: adj. 行为的，与行为有关的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to behavior
example: The same with cognition and we will talk a lot about it when we talk about CBT-- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy.
exampleZh: 认知也是如此，我们会深入讨论认知,当谈到认知行为治疗时。

meaning: prep. 在（或向）……的后面；落后于；是……背后的原因；支持；（……的外表）之下；成为（某人的）过去；低于；在……死后；adv. 在后面；留在原地；落后（于）；拖欠，不按时；n. 屁股；（澳橄）射门得分
definition: 1. n. the fleshy part of the human body that you sit on；2. adj. having the lower score or lagging position in a contest
example: Some scholars assume there's a historical memory behind the elaborate and dramatic story of a miraculous redemption by God.
exampleZh: 一些学者假设潜藏着历史记忆,在上帝神奇兑现许诺的详细的戏剧化故事中。

meaning: n. 生物；存在；本质，本性；v. 因为，由于（用于非限定分句）；v. 存在，生存；位于（be 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. the state or fact of existing；2. n. a living thing that has (or can develop) the ability to act or function independently
example: That, it's actually almost as famous for being a cool building as it is being an art museum.
exampleZh: 它除了作为艺术博物馆的身份被大家所知晓，同时也因很酷的建筑风格而闻名遐迩。

meaning: n. 相信，信心；看法，信念，观点；信仰，信条
definition: 1. n. any cognitive content held as true；2. n. a vague idea in which some confidence is placed
example: The decay of Christian belief and practice is not a loss but rather an opportunity for poetry, in Crane.
exampleZh: 基督教信仰和践行的衰败,在克莱恩看来，并不是损失，反而是诗歌新生的机会。

meaning: v. 相信；认为，猜想；信教
definition: 1. v. accept as true; take to be true；2. v. judge or regard; look upon; judge
example: Now we can't neglect the first question here, which is at least for me: did Milton really believe this?
exampleZh: 现在至少对我来说，我们不能忽略一个问题：,弥尔顿真的信这个吗？

meaning: n. 钟，铃；钟声，铃声（the bell）；钟状物；v. 系铃，装钟；发出响铃（或敲钟）般的声音； 给……打电话；呈钟状，成钟状鼓起（或张开）
definition: 1. n. a hollow device made of metal that makes a ringing sound when struck；2. v. attach a bell to
example: You're--and to put it in a crude way, you're teaching the dog that the bell goes with the food.
exampleZh: 简单地说，你在让狗知道,铃声和食物是一起出现的。

meaning: n. （人或动物的）腹部，肚子；胃，胃口；（物体的）腹状部分；腹部猪肉切；（弦乐器的）面板；v. 鼓起，张满；【名】 （Belly）（法、意、葡）贝利（人名）
definition: 1. n. the region of the body of a vertebrate between the thorax and the pelvis；2. v. swell out or bulge out
example: Tim clasped his hands together and held them loosely in front of his belly.
exampleZh: 蒂姆十指交叉搭在腹前。

meaning: v. 应在……地方，应处于……状况；适应，合得来；归……所有；是……的成员，属于（某团体或组织）；居住
definition: 1. v. be owned by; be in the possession of；2. v. originate (in)
example: Many of those figures who belong to the New Critics did much of their important work before they arrived at Yale.
exampleZh: 很多来自新批评派的名人,在到耶鲁教书前就已经做了很多重要的工作。

meaning: n. 所有物，财物；亲属
definition: 1. n. something owned; any tangible or intangible possession that is owned by someone
example: So we got in our car without caddy, much of our belongings as we can put in there.
exampleZh: 所以我们就这样上了车，东西车上能带多少就到多少。

meaning: adj. 钟爱的，深受爱戴的；n. 心爱的人
definition: 1. n. a beloved person; used as terms of endearment；2. adj. dearly loved
example: Strangely enough, the last thing he thought of was his beloved Tanya.
exampleZh: 真奇怪，他最后想到的是他心爱的坦尼娅。

meaning: prep. （位置）在……下面； （数、量、水平等）在……以下；（职位、官衔等）低于；adv. 在下面；（数字或级别）在……以下；在下文中；在下层甲板；【名】 （Below）（英、德、芬、瑞、丹、加）贝洛（人名）
definition: 1. adv. in or to a place that is lower；2. adv. at a later place
example: He separates the waters above and the waters below and creates this space that will become the inhabited world.
exampleZh: 他将天上的水和地上的水分离开来,开创了这个将被居住的世界。

meaning: n. 腰带，皮带；传送带；地带；v. 用腰带系紧；狠打，猛击；（尤指出于惩罚用皮带）抽打，打击（某人）；飞驰；【名】 （Belt）（英、法、德、西）贝尔特（人名）
definition: 1. n. endless loop of flexible material between two rotating shafts or pulleys；2. v. sing loudly and forcefully
example: He tore off his shirt and unbuckled his belt and ran out of his trousers.
exampleZh: 他脱掉了衬衫，解开了腰带，脱掉了裤子。

meaning: n. 长凳，长椅；长方形工作台；法官席（the bench）； 议员席；替补席；（砖石建筑的）壁架，（斜坡上的）平台；v. 把（场上队员）换下；（在展览会上）展览（狗）；仰卧推举；给……以席位；为……设置条凳；【名】 （Bench）（英）本奇，（德）本希，（丹）本克（人名）
definition: 1. n. a long seat for more than one person；2. v. take out of a game; of players
example: The bench had a rough wooden table in front of it.
exampleZh: 那长椅前有张粗糙的木桌。

meaning: v. 弯曲（身体关节）；（路）转弯；歪曲（事实）；篡改；屈从；系，缚（帆，缆绳）；使弯曲，弄弯；n. （道路或河流的）拐弯，弯道；（身体的）弯曲（动作）；（尤指潜水员的）潜涵病，减压病（the bends）；绑结；（纹章盾形）左上方至右下方的对角斜纹；【名】 （Bend）（美、丹、德）本德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a circular segment of a curve；2. v. form a curve
example: The traditional mode of teaching these materials- The lecture hall, we believe has very low bend with.
exampleZh: 传统的教学模式---大课堂讲座-,我们认为效率很低。

meaning: prep. 在……下方；在……表面之下，隐藏在……之下；（对某人来说）不够好，不相称；低于，次于；adv. 在下面，在底下
definition: 1. adv. in or to a place that is lower
example: This is an underworld, of course, but there seems to be another underworld resting just beneath it.
exampleZh: 当然这是地狱，但是这里它似乎,变成了地狱下方的另一个地狱。

meaning: n. 好处，益处；救济金，补助金；额外奖励，保险金；慈善活动；v. 对（某人）有用，使受益；得益于，得利于
definition: 1. n. financial assistance in time of need；2. v. derive a benefit from
example: I'm giving him the benefit of the doubt that, that hopefully things will turn around a little bit,
exampleZh: 在没有足够证据质疑之前，我还是信任他的。希望事情能有所好转，

meaning: adj. 有益的，有利的；（与）权益（有关）的，有财产使用权的
definition: 1. adj. promoting or enhancing well-being；2. adj. tending to promote physical well-being; beneficial to health
example: It can be beneficial to share your feelings with someone you trust.
exampleZh: 与你信任的人分享你的情感会是有益的。

meaning: n. 受益者，受惠人；遗嘱受益人；封臣；adj. 拥有封地的，受圣俸的
definition: 1. n. the recipient of funds or other benefits；2. adj. having or arising from a benefice
example: Who will be the main beneficiary of the cuts in income tax?
exampleZh: 削减所得税的主要受益者将是谁？

meaning: adj. 仁慈的，乐善好施的；（用于慈善机构名称）慈善的，救济的
definition: 1. kind and helpful；2. giving money or help to people or organizations that need it
example: We have the capacity to think morally, we have the capacity to act morally, and to be altruistic or benevolent.
exampleZh: 我们能够以道德的方式思考，我们也能够做有道德的事，我们可以无私奉献，可以乐善好施。

meaning: n. 慈善，仁慈
definition: 1. the quality of being kind and helpful；2. the act of giving money or help to people or organizations that need it
example: He viewed them with the manner of a fatherly pilot, his countenance radiant with benevolence.
exampleZh: 他像一位慈父般的领航员那样望着他们，脸上泛着慈祥的光彩。

meaning: adj. 和蔼的，慈祥的；（物）无害的，温和的；（肿瘤）良性的；（疾病）无生命危险的；（条件、环境）良好的，宜人的；认为无关紧要的；【名】 （Benign）（俄）贝尼根（人名）
definition: 1. pleasant and kind；2. A benign growth is not cancer and is not likely to be harmful
example: What we think of as a career isn't simply the benign product of the gradual development of a certain potential.
exampleZh: 我们认为的事业不是简简单单的,某种可能性逐渐发展的良性产物。

meaning: n. 浆果，莓；果仁，果核；虾子，鱼子；无核浆果；vi. 采集浆果；【名】 （Berry）（法、英、德、意、葡）贝里，（匈）拜里（人名）
definition: 1. n. any of numerous small and pulpy edible fruits; used as desserts or in making jams and jellies and preserves；2. v. pick or gather berries
example: Mr. Berry said the timing was a coincidence and that his decision was unrelated to Mr. Roman's departure.
exampleZh: 贝里先生说时间的安排是个巧合，而且他的决策与罗曼先生的离去毫无关系。

meaning: v. 困扰，烦扰；adj. 充满……的
definition: 1. having a lot of trouble with something, or having to deal with a lot of something that causes problems；2. to cause someone or something to have a lot of problems or trouble
example: The Europeans, beset by difficulties in the eurozone, are desperate that the job should once again go to one of them.
exampleZh: 受到欧元区困境困扰的欧洲人迫切希望，这一职位应再次由他们中的一个人担任。

meaning: prep. 在……旁边，在……附近；与……相比；除……以外（还），除……以外（不再）；adv. 在附近；况且，此外
definition: 1. next to or at the side of someone or something
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: To get down to it, you have to cut away what is not true, what is inflated, beside the point, excess, ornament.
exampleZh: 更直接点，你们要去掉不真实的，除了这点还有膨胀的，过量的和装饰的。

meaning: prep. 除……之外（还）；adv. 而且，再说；此外，也
definition: 1. adv. making an additional point; anyway；2. adv. in addition
example: because I went to a school that had only maybe five or six other Asian people besides me,
exampleZh: 因为在我以前上的一个学校里，除了我之外，仅有五六个亚洲人，

meaning: v. 包围，围困；打扰，纠缠
definition: 1. to surround a place, especially with an army, to prevent people or supplies getting in or out；2. When someone is besieged, a lot of people surround them
example: They will besiege all the cities throughout the land the LORD your God is giving you.
exampleZh: 他们必将你困在耶和华你神所赐你遍地的各城里。

meaning: adj. 最好的，最出色的；最愉快的，最幸福的；最合适的，最恰当的；adv. 最，最高程度地；最出色地，最高标准地；最适合地，最恰当地；n. 最好的事物（或人）；（人或事物所能达到的）最高标准；最合乎要求的事物；（个人的）最高水平，最高纪录；最好的衣服，盛装；（书信结尾的）良好祝愿；v. 打败，胜过；【名】 （Best）（美、德、爱）贝斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the supreme effort one can make；2. v. get the better of
example: Be the best, or don't do it at all. Fight for first, or don't fight at all.
exampleZh: 要做就做最好，要争就争第一。

meaning: n. 畅销品（尤指畅销书、畅销唱片）
definition: 1. n. a book that has had a large and rapid sale
example: His eighth book came out earlier this year and was an instant best-seller.
exampleZh: 他的第8本书今年早些时候出版了，并很快成为了一本畅销书。

meaning: adj. 畅销的，抢手的；畅销书的
definition: 1. adj. selling in great numbers
example: Many people think the best-selling book of all time is one of the Harry Potter books.
exampleZh: 许多人认为有史以来最畅销的书是《哈利·波特》系列书籍。

meaning: v. 打赌，赌博；敢肯定；n. 下注；赌金；预计，猜想；有可能成功的人选（或备选行动）；abbr. 在……之间（between）；【名】 （Bet）（美）贝特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the money risked on a gamble；2. v. maintain with or as if with a bet
example: I'll bet you never heard of Tellus of Athens, neither had Croesus, neither had anybody else outside of Athens.
exampleZh: 我打赌你们从没听说过雅典的特勒斯,包括克罗伊斯在内的,任何一个非雅典人都不知道

meaning: v. 背叛，出卖；食言，辜负；违背（信仰、原则等）；泄露（机密，信息）；流露，显露出（情感或特性）；暴露（不易发觉的东西）
definition: 1. v. reveal unintentionally；2. v. deliver to an enemy by treachery
example: Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
exampleZh: 我实在告诉你们，你们中有个人要背叛我了。

meaning: n. 背叛，出卖
definition: 1. n. an act of deliberate betrayal；2. n. the quality of aiding an enemy
example: Women do not have a monopoly on feelings of betrayal.
exampleZh: 背叛感并非是女人独有的。

meaning: adj. 较好的，更好的；能力更强的，更熟练的；（健康状况）好转的，康复的；更合适的，更得体的；adv. 较好地，更好地；更，更大程度上；更妥，更恰当；n. 更好的事物，较好者；更好的表现，更好的待遇；上司，比自己能力强的人；打赌者（=bettor）；v. 超过，胜过；改善，改进；pron. 更大成就，更好待遇，更好行为；【名】 （Better）（美、法、俄）贝特尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. someone who bets；2. v. surpass in excellence
example: Well, if this thing is going to vibrate for any length of time it better be a standing wave.
exampleZh: 好的，如果它在任意时间振动,那它就是驻波。

meaning: prep. （空间上）在……中间；（时间上）在……之间；（数量、重量、距离等）介于……之间；分隔着；（表示两方或多方关系）在……之间；合用，共享；通过共同努力，一起；（两人）私下间；往返于；adv. （空间或时间上）介于……之间（in between）
definition: 1. adv. in the interval；2. adv. in between
example: The relation between the speech sounds it's like the relation, as I'm saying, between the boy and the birches.
exampleZh: 语言韵律和,就像这种关系，像我说的，像孩子和桦树的关系一样。

meaning: n. 饮料
definition: 1. n. any liquid suitable for drinking
example: We were obliged, faute de mieux, to drink the local beverage.
exampleZh: 因为没有更好的饮料，我们只好将就着喝当地的。

meaning: v. 当心，提防
definition: 1. used to warn someone to be very careful about something or someone；2. used on signs to warn people of something dangerous
example: I think the moral of the story is let the buyer beware.
exampleZh: 我想这个故事的寓意是提醒购买者当心。

meaning: v. 使迷惑，使糊涂
definition: 1. to confuse someone
example: The conflicting instructions seemed designed to bewilder even the most experienced members of the team.
exampleZh: 这些相互矛盾的指示似乎故意要让团队中最有经验的成员也感到困惑。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 困惑，迷惘
definition: 1. confusion
example: He shook his head in bewilderment at the obduracy of this man.
exampleZh: 这男人顽固不化，令他困惑不解、连连摇头。

meaning: prep. 在（或向）……较远的一边；晚于，迟于；涵盖，包括；除……之外；超出（范围）；非（某人）所能理解；adv. 在另一边，在（或向）更远处；（延续）到……之后；n. 来生，再世（the beyond）；远处的事物（the beyond）
definition: 1. adv. farther along in space or time or degree；2. adv. on the farther side from the observer
example: They're focused on beyond that and all the materials and all of the things that could dramatically change the world.
exampleZh: 而关注于很久以后,所有的材料,以及所有可以极大程度改变世界的事物。

meaning: n. 偏见，成见；偏好，天赋；倾向，趋势；斜纹；（统计）偏差，偏倚；偏重心球形；偏压，偏统；v. 使有偏见，使偏心；加偏压（或偏流）于；adj. 偏斜的；adv. 偏斜地；【名】 （Bias）（英）拜厄斯，（法、德、葡、喀）比亚斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a partiality that prevents objective consideration of an issue or situation；2. v. influence in an unfair way
example: Given data which are free from bias there are further snares to avoid in statistical work.
exampleZh: 就算这些数据不带任何偏见，但是统计工作中还有许多需要避免的陷阱。

meaning: n. 《圣经》，犹太教和基督教的圣典（常作 the Bible）；（可数）《圣经》的版本或册本，一本《圣经》；某领域的权威典籍（常小写为 bible），宝典
definition: 1. n. the sacred writings of the Christian religions；2. n. a book regarded as authoritative in its field
example: The novel draws heavily on stories from the Bible while placing them in a modern setting.
exampleZh: 这部小说大量借用《圣经》中的故事，并把它们置于现代背景中。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: adj. 圣经的；依据圣经的（等于 biblical）
definition: 1. adj. of or pertaining to or contained in or in accordance with the Bible；2. adj. in keeping with the nature of the Bible or its times or people
example: What do we make of these allusions to divine colleagues or subordinates in light of Kaufman's claims regarding biblical monotheism?
exampleZh: 参照考夫曼的一神论主张，我们如何理解这些暗示？,他们的地位等同于，还是次于上帝？

meaning: n. 参考书目，文献目录；目录学，文献学
definition: 1. a list of the books and articles that have been used by someone when writing a particular book or article；2. a list of the books from a particular writer or publisher, or written about a particular subject
example: At the end of this chapter there is a select bibliography of useful books.
exampleZh: 本章末尾附着有用书籍的精选书目。

meaning: n. 单车，自行车；v. 骑自行车
definition: 1. n. a wheeled vehicle that has two wheels and is moved by foot pedals；2. v. ride a bicycle
example: He got on his bicycle and rode off.
exampleZh: 他骑上自行车走了。

meaning: v. 出价；投标，竞标；努力争取；（纸牌戏中的）叫牌；命令，吩咐；打招呼，示意；邀请；n. 出价，喊价；投标；努力，尝试；（纸牌戏中的）叫牌；【名】 （Bid）（美）比德（人名）
definition: 1. n. an authoritative direction or instruction to do something；2. v. propose a payment
example: But, it showed additional information that you won't find on Treasury Direct; it showed bid and ask for dealers.
exampleZh: 但是,那里还有,"国库指南"上没有的内容,对于中间商的买入价和卖出价

meaning: adj. （尺寸、数量、规模或年龄）大的；重大的，严重的；有影响力的；糟糕的；有雄心的；受欢迎的；热衷于……的；程度深的，效果好的；大方的，大度的；生僻的，晦涩的；大写的；adv. 大大，给人印象深地；夸口地；大量地；v. 招摇；【名】 （Big）（土）比格（人名）
definition: 1. adj. above average in size or number or quantity or magnitude or extent；2. adv. extremely well
example: So it was like a big shock to me because after five years, I thought I know the language.
exampleZh: 所以，这对我来说，就是一个很大的打击，因为五年的学习以后，我以为我掌握这门语言了。

meaning: adj. 双方的，双边的；（身体部位）两侧的，（大脑）两半球的
definition: 1. involving two groups or countries
example: The business council is aimed at balancing bilateral trade by expanding trade volume.
exampleZh: 商务委员会旨在通过扩大贸易规模来平衡双边贸易。

meaning: n. （商品、服务或餐馆的）账单；议案，法案；纸币，钞票；演出人员名单；广告，传单；票据，汇票；单子，清单；喙；v. 开账单；把……宣传为；宣布（某人）将参加演出
definition: 1. n. a statute in draft before it becomes law；2. v. demand payment
example: You know Bill, we shaped each other up together and known each other since we are 18, 19 years old.
exampleZh: 你知道比尔，我们对彼此产生影响,我们算是一起成长，从18，9岁开始。

meaning: num. 十亿；万亿；n. 十亿；亿万，大量（billions）；【名】 （Billion）（法）比利翁（人名）
definition: 1. n. the number that is represented as a one followed by 12 zeros; in the United Kingdom the usage followed in the United States is frequently seen；2. adj. denoting a quantity consisting of one thousand million items or units in the United States
example: Or if you want negative numbers, between negative 2 billion and positive 2 billion, but it's a finite range.
exampleZh: 或者你想储存一个负数，就必须位于负20亿到,正20亿之间，是个有限的范围。

meaning: n. 亿万富翁
definition: 1. n. a very rich person whose material wealth is valued at more than a billion dollars
example: If it were not for the fact that he was a billionaire, she would never have married him.
exampleZh: 如果不是因为他是个亿万富翁，她不会嫁给他。

meaning: n. 垃圾桶；储物箱；瓶酒搁架；统计堆栈；v. 把……扔进垃圾箱；摒弃，拒绝；把……放（或贮藏）在箱（或仓）中；把（酒等）放进搁架；把（数据）归入统计堆；【名】 （Bin）（美、意）本（人名）
definition: 1. n. a container; usually has a lid；2. v. store in bins
example: She scrunched up three pages of notes and threw them in the bin.
exampleZh: 她把3页笔记揉成团并把它们扔进了垃圾箱。

meaning: v. 捆绑，系；包扎；使紧密联系；迫使，使负有义务（或责任）；（使）凝结，（使）粘合；装订；给……镶边，给……滚边；（量词）适用于（给定的变量）；（规则，语法条件）决定（共指名词词组）之间的关系；（食物，药品）使便秘；n. 窘境，困境；令人不快的事情；法律约束；连结线；蔓，藤；【名】 （Bind）（德）宾德（人名）
definition: 1. n. something that hinders as if with bonds；2. v. stick to firmly
example: When we started with the entire class, I showed the children how to bind the book by hand.
exampleZh: 这门课最开始的时候，我向孩子们展示了如何把书用绳子缝起来。

meaning: n. 双筒望远镜
definition: 1. a pair of tubes with glass lenses at either end that you look through to see things far away more clearly；2. a device for making objects that are far away appear nearer and larger, and made of two attached tubes that you hold up to your eyes to look through
example: And then they have like, you can bring your binoculars or the telescope thing where you look through.
exampleZh: 你还可以带上你的双筒望远镜，或是使用公园里的单筒望远镜，仔细欣赏风景。

meaning: n. 生物化学；生物化学过程；生物的化学结构和特性
definition: 1. n. the organic chemistry of compounds and processes occuring in organisms; the effort to understand biology within the context of chemistry
example: Some of their biochemistry applications are with another Professor at MIT, Alice Ting, and her lab.
exampleZh: 他们的一些生物化学应用与麻省理工学院的另一位教授 Alice Ting 和她的实验室有关。

meaning: adj. 生物化学的；n. 生物化学物质
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to biochemistry; involving chemical processes in living organisms
example: You need to be able to integrate that information into a response, and that happens through these biochemical reactions.
exampleZh: 体内的细胞要整合信息并作出反应,这个过程就通过这些生化反应来完成

meaning: n. 生物化学家
definition: 1. n. someone with special training in biochemistry
example: He gave up his job as a biochemist to become a historian, writer, publisher and activist.
exampleZh: 他放弃了生物化学家的职业，变成一名历史学家、作家、出版人和活动家。

meaning: n. 传记，传记文学；生平
definition: 1. n. an account of the series of events making up a person's life
example: It probably is at least in part, but mainly it is probably intended to be fiction or fictionalized biography.
exampleZh: 最少一部分是，可是结果大相径庭,大篇都是虚构或文学小说化了的自传。

meaning: adj. 传记的，生平的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to or being biography
example: Deconstructionists view the literary personality, like the writer's biographical personality, as irrelevant.
exampleZh: 解构主义者认为文学人格，就像作家的传记人格一样，是无关紧要的。

meaning: n. 传记作者
definition: 1. n. someone who writes an account of a person's life
example: As the painting's biographer, Donald Sassoon, dryly notes, "In reality the effect can be obtained from any portrait."
exampleZh: 正如这幅画作的传记作者唐纳德·沙逊不动声色地指出，“实际上，这种效果可以从任何一幅肖像画中获得。”

meaning: n. 生物学；生命机理，作用方式；生理习性；（某个地区的）生物
definition: 1. n. the science that studies living organisms；2. n. characteristic life processes and phenomena of living organisms
example: but I'm more in the biology department, so that's about all I can tell you on that front.
exampleZh: 但是我是生物系的，所以我能说的就这么多了，

meaning: adj. 生物的，生物学的，生命的；亲生的；含酶的；生化武器的
definition: 1. adj. pertaining to biology or to life and living things；2. adj. of parents and children; related by blood
example: Biological systems have been doing this for billions of years.
exampleZh: 生物系统亿万年来都在这样做。

meaning: n. 生物学家
definition: 1. n. (biology) a scientist who studies living organisms
example: To prove his point, Cialdini cites an interview with molecular biologist James Watson.
exampleZh: 为了证明他的观点，Cialdini 引用了分子生物学家 James Watson 的采访。

meaning: n. 生物技术，生物工艺（学）
definition: 1. n. the branch of molecular biology that studies the use of microorganisms to perform specific industrial processes；2. n. the branch of engineering science in which biological science is used to study the relation between workers and their environments
example: Now we know so much about these, they've turned out to be so useful in biotechnology.
exampleZh: 现在我们对限制性内切酶了解这么深入,它们在生物技术方面又这么有用

meaning: n. 鸟；年轻女子，姑娘；人，家伙；飞机，飞船，卫星；供捕猎（或食用）的鸟；羽毛球；监狱，服刑期（doing bird）；喝倒彩，起哄（give sb. the bird）；【名】 （Bird）（英、西）伯德（人名）
definition: 1. n. warm-blooded egg-laying vertebrates characterized by feathers and forelimbs modified as wings；2. v. watch and study birds in their natural habitat
example: I mean, it will wake us up in the morning. It will be the color of a beautiful bird.
exampleZh: 我是觉得，那样的颜色会让我们在早上惊醒。它会是一只漂亮的鸟的颜色。

meaning: n. 出生，诞生；出身，血统；开始，起源；v. 生，产
definition: 1. n. the time when something begins (especially life)；2. v. cause to be born
example: There was nature; now there is culture, which is very much like an event or birth in the older sense.
exampleZh: 有了自然，然后就有了文明，这就像从前说的发展或者诞生。

meaning: n. 生日，诞辰；出生日期，诞生的日子
definition: 1. n. an anniversary of the day on which a person was born (or the celebration of it)；2. n. the date on which a person was born
example: You know, I couldn't invite a hundred people and buy them all shoes, you know, to my daughter's birthday party, so
exampleZh: 我不会请一百个人来参加我女儿的生日聚会，还给他们每人买双鞋，所以，

meaning: n. 饼干，薄薄一片的甜饼； 松饼(食用时常佐以肉汁)；陶瓷素烧坯（经烧制但未上釉的陶瓷土坯）；淡褐色，灰黄色；（嵌入两块木板中的沟槽将其连接起来的）小木片，木榫
definition: 1. n. small round bread leavened with baking-powder or soda；2. n. any of various small flat sweet cakes (`biscuit' is the British term)
example: He wolfed down the rest of the biscuit and cheese.
exampleZh: 他狼吞虎咽地吃下了剩余的饼干和奶酪。

meaning: n. （基督教的）主教；（国际象棋中的）象
definition: 1. a priest of high rank who is in charge of the priests of lower rank in a particular area；2. a piece that moves from corner to corner along squares of the same colour
example: Bishop's sandpiper poet, there in your handout, is obsessed with the mere details of experience, those sand grains, quartz grains.
exampleZh: 毕肖普写鹬的那首诗，你们的讲稿上有，被零星的描写经验的细节所累，描写了那些谷物和石英岩。

meaning: n. 小片，小块；小部分，片段；（一组东西中的）一个；喜剧小品，小笑话；比特；辅币，12.5美分；马嚼子；钻头；（与某活动、过程有关的）所有事情；女孩，姑娘；（人的）生殖器；adj. 很小的；v. 制约，限制；给（马）上嚼子；v. 咬，咬伤；叮，蜇（bite 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. n. a small quantity；2. n. a small fragment of something broken off from the whole
example: So now I've got this gamma placed in there, -1 gamma minus 1, so I've ben feeling a little bit better.
exampleZh: 这样我把这里的指数，换成γ,这样看起来舒服一些。

meaning: n. 母狗；泼妇；棘手的事；抱怨，牢骚；v. 发牢骚；诽谤，口出恶言；【名】 （Bitch）（法）比奇（人名）
definition: 1. n. an unpleasant difficulty；2. v. say mean things
example: The only thing you should ever bitch about is how cool your life is.
exampleZh: 你唯一可以抱怨的是你生活有多酷。

meaning: v. 咬，咬伤；叮，蜇；卡紧，咬住；产生不良影响；接受，相信；咬饵，上钩；（酸）腐蚀；使生气，使烦恼；（物体）刺痛，勒痛；使伤心，使痛苦；n. 咬；一口的量；咬伤，叮伤；少量吃的东西，小吃；寒冷，刺骨；浓烈的味道；影响力，感染力；吞饵，上钩；咬合；简短的信息；【名】 （Bite）（匈）比泰（人名）
definition: 1. n. a wound resulting from biting by an animal or a person；2. v. to grip, cut off, or tear with or as if with the teeth or jaws
example: Now the pain of a bite, being bit, and then the pain and fear of that is an unconditioned stimulus, unconditioned response.
exampleZh: 咬伤所带来的疼痛感，和有此所带来的痛苦与恐惧,就是无条件刺激和无条件反应。

meaning: adj. 味苦的；痛苦的，辛酸的；激烈的，充满敌意的；愤愤不平的；严寒的，刺骨的；（巧克力）黑色不加糖的；n. 苦啤酒；adv. 严寒刺骨地；v. 使变苦；【名】 （Bitter）（英、法、德、芬、捷、匈）比特（人名）
definition: 1. n. English term for a dry sharp-tasting ale with strong flavor of hops (usually on draft)；2. v. make bitter
example: Bitter constraint and sad occasion are forcing him to write, even though, of course, he's not yet ready.
exampleZh: 亲友的惨遇，痛苦的重压迫使他下笔，尽管如此，他还是没准备好。

meaning: adj. 奇异的，古怪的
definition: 1. very strange and unusual；2. strange and unusual
example: Fantasies cannot harm you, no matter how bizarre or far out they are.
exampleZh: 无论多么荒诞或怪异的幻想都伤害不到你。

meaning: adj. 黑的，黑色的；黑色人种的；不加牛奶的；脏的，布满污垢的；悲伤的，无望的；愤怒的，仇恨的；罪恶的，邪恶的；（幽默）黑色的；（滑雪道）难度最大的；（军事活动）秘密的；黑桃和梅花组牌的；n. 黑，黑色；黑人；黑色衣服；黑色的东西（尤指斯诺克中的黑球）；执黑子的一方；v. 使变黑，弄黑；抵制，拒绝（货品或公司）；【名】 （Black）（英、西）布莱克，（德、葡、捷）布拉克
definition: 1. n. the quality or state of the achromatic color of least lightness (bearing the least resemblance to white)；2. v. make or become black
example: I mean, there's, like I said, a Polish neighborhood to, like, very like, you know, I guess, black neighborhood,
exampleZh: 我的意思是说，有波兰住宅区，黑人住宅区，

meaning: n. 黑板
definition: 1. n. sheet of slate; for writing with chalk
example: You have to touch each of the 16 elements once as I go across the blackboard to actually merge them together, alright.
exampleZh: 为了将这16个元素,合并到一起,对每个元素都只会用到一次。

meaning: n. 勒索，敲诈；胁迫，威胁；勒索金；v. 敲诈，勒索；要挟，胁迫
definition: 1. the act of getting money from people or forcing them to do something by threatening to tell a secret of theirs or to harm them；2. to get money from someone by blackmail
example: She started off by accusing him of blackmail but he more or less ignored her.
exampleZh: 她以指控他敲诈勒索开始，但他基本上没理会她。

meaning: n. 刀片，刀刃；（草，小麦等的）叶片；（船或飞机螺旋桨的）桨叶；（溜冰鞋的）冰刀；花花公子，时髦男士；剑；肩胛骨，肩胛；舌身；v. 滑旱冰
definition: 1. n. especially a leaf of grass or the broad portion of a leaf as distinct from the petiole；2. n. a dashing young man
example: It doesn't think to itself, "How shall I get that blade of grass that's been eluding me?"
exampleZh: 它并不会对自己发问,我该如何割掉那束一直躲着我的草

meaning: v. 责怪，归咎于；怨，怪；n. 责备，过错，罪责
definition: 1. n. an accusation that you are responsible for some lapse or misdeed；2. v. put or pin the blame on
example: You blame yourself as a victim of trauma for not having the sufficient vigilance in your outer cortex to ward it off.
exampleZh: 你会因为你的脑皮层,不能有效保护你不受创伤危害,而成为创伤受害者。

meaning: adj. 空白的，空的；茫然的，毫无表情的；单调的，无活动的；断然的，彻底的；n. 空白处，空格；（头脑或记忆）一片空白；空弹；（金属或木头的）坯件，坯料；v. 成为空白，不记得；冷落，不理睬；阻止（对方）得分；切割（金属坯件）；封锁；【名】 （Blank）（英、德、西、俄、罗、捷、瑞典、芬）布兰克，（法）布朗克（人名）
definition: 1. n. a blank character used to separate successive words in writing or printing；2. v. keep the opposing (baseball) team from winning
example: Milton wrote his epic in lines of unrhymed iambic pentameter or what we call, and what Milton would have called, blank verse.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿的史诗由不押韵的抑扬格五音步诗句写成,我们，还有弥尔顿都称其为无韵诗。

meaning: n. 毯子，毛毯；厚层，覆盖层；气氛，氛围；障碍，障碍物；（平版印刷的）橡皮布；（平版印刷的）橡皮；v. 覆盖，盖住，笼罩；消除（声音），使（声音）模糊不清；迎风航行抢（他船）的上风；adj. 总括的，全面的，通用的
definition: 1. n. bedding that keeps a person warm in bed；2. v. cover as if with a blanket
example: They might suck their thumb, seek out a blanket or so on.
exampleZh: 吮大拇指，或是去寻找毯子之类的。

meaning: n. 爆炸，爆破；冲击波；爆炸声，爆破声；强劲的（气或水）流，疾风；吹奏声，轰鸣；严厉的批评；狂欢，有趣的事；（球队或选手的）猛烈进攻；枪击；（公司、组织等发出的）群发电子邮件；v. 炸毁，爆破；轰开，炸开（通路）；向……射击，枪击；发出刺耳的高音；严厉批评，痛斥；由爆炸引起；用力踢，猛击；喷射（水流、气流等）；使枯萎；轻易击败；损坏，摧毁；开，炸开（通路）；int. 该死，讨厌；【名】 （Blast）（德）布拉斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a very long fly ball；2. v. make a strident sound
example: You could contrast the roguish and fanciful, clearly done by hand, title of the magazine, with that machine-type Blast.
exampleZh: 你们可以把这些明显手写的，无赖而稀奇的标题，和机械化的“暴风“相对比。

meaning: v. 熊熊燃烧；闪耀，发亮光；怒视，（怒火）燃烧；醒目地刊登在报纸等上，大肆宣扬；（枪炮）连续射击（或开火）； 夺取，摘取；大力击（球）；在树皮上刻路标；带头，开拓；快速移动；n. 大火，烈火；火焰；（光或色彩等的）展现，灿烂；（强烈感情的）迸发；（刻在树上用于指示道路的）标记，记号；（尤指马面部的一条）白斑；【名】 （Blaze）（美）布拉兹（人名）
definition: 1. to burn brightly and strongly；2. to be brightly lit or full of colour
example: It's the guerdon, the reward, the prize of fame that we're continually anticipating will burst out someday in a sudden blaze of glory.
exampleZh: 我们一直期盼的奖赏，回报，名望,某天会突然带着荣光到来。

meaning: v. 漂白，使褪色，晒白；使失去活力，使失去实质内容；用漂白剂给……清洗，消毒；n. 漂白剂，消毒剂
definition: 1. a strong chemical used for cleaning things or removing colour from things；2. to remove the colour from something or make it lighter, with the use of chemicals or by the effect of light from the sun; to become lighter in this way
example: The tree's roots are stripped and hung to season and bleach.
exampleZh: 这些树根被剥去皮并挂起来风干晒白。

meaning: adj. 不乐观的，无望的；无遮掩的，荒凉的；阴冷的，寒冷的；沮丧的，阴郁的；（人或其表情）冷漠的，冷峻的；n. 欧鲌
definition: 1. If a place is bleak, it is empty, and not welcoming or attractive；2. Bleak weather is cold and unpleasant.
example: The weather can be quite bleak on the coast.
exampleZh: 沿海一带的天气可能会十分阴冷。

meaning: v. 流血，出血；给……放血；散开，渗开，渗透；榨取（钱财）；（金钱）不断流失，持续损失；抽掉（气体或液体）；印成出血版；n. 流血，出血；泄出（液体，气体）；（染料，颜料）渗色，渗开；出血版
definition: 1. v. lose blood from one's body；2. v. draw blood
example: where for a regular seat you will be paying 70, 80, just for, you know, like a nose bleed section.
exampleZh: 但通常情况下，买一个很远的座位就得花上70或80美元。

meaning: v. （使）混合，调和；（使）协调，融合；调制，配制；n. 混合物；交融，融合；混合词
definition: 1. n. an occurrence of thorough mixing；2. v. combine into one
example: It's a class move, allowing new and old to blend seamlessly.
exampleZh: 这是一次班级活动，让新老同学亲密无间地融合在一起。

meaning: v. 求上帝保佑，祈神赐福，祝福；祝圣，使圣洁；赞美上帝；（表示惊奇）；将……赐予，使有幸得到；同意，赞成；int. 哎呀，太好啦，太谢谢了；【名】 （Bless）（英、意、德、匈）布莱斯（人名）
definition: 1. v. give a benediction to；2. v. confer prosperity or happiness on
example: Then, as I probed them, one sprang up, and stared With piteous recognition in fixed eyes, Lifting distressful hands, as if to bless.
exampleZh: 我小心翼翼的试探他们，一个涌现,固执的眼里带着哀怨的赞誉，举起绝望的双手好像要赐福与我。

meaning: n. 幸事，福祉；支持，赞同；上帝的恩宠，祝福；祷告，祈祷；v. 求上帝保佑，祝福；祝圣，使圣洁；赞美上帝（bless 的现在分词形式）；【名】 （Blessing）（英、德）布莱辛（人名）
definition: 1. n. the formal act of approving；2. n. a desirable state
example: The Reverend Chris Long led the prayers and pronounced the blessing.
exampleZh: 克里斯·朗牧师带领祷告并宣讲了祈福祷词。

meaning: adj. 失明的，盲的；未察觉的，视而不见的；未加思考的，莫名的（形容感情强烈）；（拐角）看不见的，隐蔽的；无窗的，无门的；（行动）未掌握一定信息的；丝毫的，一丁点儿的；盲飞的；（植物）无芽的，无顶生花的；v. 使变瞎，使失明；使眼花，使目眩；蒙蔽，使无辨别力；n. 窗帘，（尤指）卷帘；（狩猎时的）埋伏处，伏击处；借口，幌子；adv. 看不清地；失去理智地；盲目地，无准备地；【名】 （Blind）（法）布兰，（德、瑞典）布林德（人名）
definition: 1. n. people who have severe visual impairments, considered as a group；2. v. render unable to see
example: But as soon as we hope to find that guerdon, the golden ring, ! comes the blind Fury with the abhorred shears -- ouch!
exampleZh: 但是一旦我们想要找到这奖赏，这金戒指，它会带着剪刀暴怒而至--哎唷！

meaning: v. 眨（眼）；（灯）闪烁；表示惊讶，显出不安；退让，让步；n. 眨眼；片刻的犹豫，举棋不定；（光的）瞬间闪烁；【名】 （Blink）（德）布林克（人名）
definition: 1. When you blink, you close and then open your eyes quickly once or several times, and when an eye blinks, it does this；2. If a light blinks, it flashes on and off.
example: He developed a nervous twitch and began to blink constantly.
exampleZh: 他患上了一种神经痉挛病，开始不停地眨眼睛。

meaning: n. 集团，阵营；【名】 （Bloc）（法、罗）布洛克（人名）
definition: 1. a group of countries or people that have similar political interests；2. a group of countries or people that have similar goals and work together to achieve them
example: The two states will join the 25-nation bloc provided they carry out reforms.
exampleZh: 这两个国家将加入25国集团，前提是他们要进行改革。

meaning: n. 大块，一块（木料、石头等）；（四面临街的）街段，街区；大楼，大厦；栋，座，幢；障碍物，阻碍；（短时间的）思维停滞，思维中断；一组，一批，一叠；（连续的）一段时间；阻挡，拦截；积木；（古代斩首用的）垫头木；一大片土地；（物体的）平面，纯色色块；滑轮，滑轮组；区块；v. 阻塞，堵塞（道路、管道等）；遮住（视线）；封锁，挡住（去路）；阻挠，阻止；阻截，拦截（对方的球）；对……进行块操作；用模具使（帽等）成形；【名】 （Block）（英、法、德、西、葡、芬、罗）布洛克（人名）
definition: 1. n. a solid piece of something (usually having flat rectangular sides)；2. v. render unsuitable for passage
example: Why? Because that block identifies a set of things that I'm going to do if the test is true.
exampleZh: 为什么呢？这是因为这一块指令,指定了一系列的要进行的操作,如果测试为真的话。

meaning: n. 网络日志，博客；v. 写博客
definition: 1. n. a shared on-line journal where people can post diary entries about their personal experiences and hobbies；2. v. read, write, or edit a shared on-line journal
example: When Barbieux started his blog, his aspirations were small; he simply hoped to communicate with a few people.
exampleZh: 当巴布开始他的博客时，他的期望并不大。他只是希望能与几个人交流。

meaning: adj. （多指毛发）亚麻色的，金黄色的；（尤指人种）白肤金发的；浅色的；（多指毛发）亚麻色的，金黄色的，浅茶褐色的；n. 长着金发的人；（毛发）金黄色，浅茶褐色；【名】 （Blond）（英、西）布朗德；（法）布隆；（德）布隆德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person with fair skin and hair；2. adj. being or having light colored skin and hair and usually blue or grey eyes
example: I think that Phillipe Blond is a very wonderful designer because he's extremely avant-garde in what he does.
exampleZh: 我觉得Phillipe Blond是个很不错的设计师，因为他在这个领域特别前卫。

meaning: n. 血，血液；出身，血统；成员，人员；杀戮，流血；气质，脾气；纨绔子弟，花花公子；血样，血检；v. 使取得初次经验；用猎物的血涂（新手的）脸；让（猎狗）第一次尝血；【名】 （Blood）（英、西）布拉德（人名）
definition: 1. n. the fluid (red in vertebrates) that is pumped by the heart；2. v. smear with blood, as in a hunting initiation rite, where the face of a person is smeared with the blood of the kill
example: Your heart starts to beat a little faster, your blood starts flowing quicker, and your breath gets shorter.
exampleZh: 你的心跳加速，血脉贲张，呼吸也急促起来。

meaning: adj. 流血的，沾满血的；血腥的，残酷的；该死的，讨厌的；非常的；含血的，似血的；血红的，血色的；adv. 非常，很（用于强调）；该死地，讨厌地；v. 使受伤，使流血；血染，使沾上鲜血；伤害，损害
definition: 1. v. cover with blood；2. adj. having or covered with or accompanied by blood
example: Now men will go content with what we spoiled, Or, discontent, boil bloody, and be spilled.
exampleZh: 现在人们也许会对我们的破坏得意洋洋或者大发牢骚，也许还会会血液沸腾，飞溅。

meaning: n. 花，花朵；花期；青春焕发，风华正茂；（肤色的）红润；（一些水果和植物的）粉衣，粉霜；（尤指音乐录音中）饱满响亮的声音；方坯；v. 开花，绽放；繁荣，兴旺；精神焕发；给（透镜）敷膜；把（铸块）铸成方坯；【名】 （Bloom）（英）布卢姆，（瑞典、西）布洛姆（人名）
definition: 1. n. the organic process of bearing flowers；2. v. produce or yield flowers
example: Harold Bloom has written, and I think he's absolutely right, that Milton begins Paradise Lost with a powerful defense against lateness.
exampleZh: 哈罗德·布卢姆写道，我认为他说得对极了，他说弥尔顿,在《失乐园》的开头对这些“晚“进行了有力的辩护。

meaning: n. （树木的）花，花簇；开花，花期；v. 开花；成长，繁盛，兴旺；【名】 （Blossom）布洛瑟姆（人名）
definition: 1. n. reproductive organ of angiosperm plants especially one having showy or colorful parts；2. v. produce or yield flowers
example: But a raving autumn shears Blossom from the summer's wreath; The older is condemned to death, Pardoned, drags out lonely years Conspiring among the ignorant.
exampleZh: 可是一个肃杀的秋天啊,从夏日的花环上剪下鲜花；,年长者被判处死刑，遇赦后，挨过寂寞的一年年,在愚氓中间从事阴谋。

meaning: n. （女式）短上衣，衬衫；宽松上衣；v. 使（衣服）松垂
definition: 1. n. a top worn by women
example: That blouse sets off the blue of her eyes.
exampleZh: 那件上衣衬托出了她的蓝眼睛。

meaning: v. （风）刮，吹；（用嘴）吹气；吹响，吹奏；毁掉，炸毁；（轮胎）爆开，爆裂；（保险丝）烧断，熔化；擤（鼻子）；浪费，挥霍（金钱）；出错，错失机会；泄露，暴露；迅速离开（某地）；用力投（球）；讨厌，糟糕；开花；（鲸鱼）喷水；吹制（玻璃）；（苍蝇）产卵于；n. 大风，强风；吹气，擤鼻子；猛击，一击；奋斗，努力；打击，挫折；开花，开花期；爵士乐演奏；大麻；（炼钢用语）吹炼
definition: 1. n. a powerful stroke with the fist or a weapon；2. v. exhale hard
example: Then things suddenly blow up on you, but you'll recover and you'll figure something out and then you'll move from there.
exampleZh: 然后突然间爆掉了，但是你会修复好自己而且解决问题,然后你就能从那个经济低谷走出来。

meaning: adj. 蓝色的；忧郁的，沮丧的； 保守的，守旧的；（笑话、故事等）黄色的，色情的；（由于冷或呼吸困难）发青的，青紫的；n. 天蓝色，蓝色；天空，大海；（剑桥或牛津大学的）校队运动员，蓝色荣誉者；红头发者；错误，纰漏；争论，殴打；近生的牛排；v. （使）变成蓝色；用蓝色漂白剂洗（白色衣服）；挥霍，乱花（钱财）；【名】 （Blue）（英、美、加、澳、新）布卢（人名）
definition: 1. n. blue color or pigment; resembling the color of the clear sky in the daytime；2. v. turn blue
example: At the very end of the poem, the uncouth swain "rose, and twitch't his Mantle blue: tomorrow to fresh Woods and Pastures new."
exampleZh: 在诗歌的最后，这个粗鄙的年轻人吟唱到,“慢慢上升，挥动了他蔚蓝色的丝巾“,向崭新的牧场和森林眺望明天“

meaning: n. （建筑物、机器等的）蓝图，设计图；行动方案，规划；（生物细胞的）模型，（基因的）图谱；v. 起草（计划），设计（模型）
definition: 1. n. something intended as a guide for making something else；2. v. make a blueprint of
example: The report is being heralded as a blueprint for the future of transport.
exampleZh: 这份报告被宣称是未来运输的蓝图。

meaning: v. 虚张声势，唬人；假装做；n. 虚张声势的举动，唬人；峭壁，悬崖；树丛，灌木丛；adj. 直率豪爽的；（悬崖）垂直的，（船头）宽而垂直的
definition: 1. to deceive someone by making them think either that you are going to do something when you really have no intention of doing it, or that you have knowledge that you do not really have, or that you are someone else；2. If you bluff your way into or out of a situation, you get yourself into or out of it by deceiving people
example: He said he would resign if he didn't get more money, but it was only a bluff.
exampleZh: 他说如果不给他加薪他就辞职，但那不过是虚张声势而已。

meaning: v. 跌跌撞撞地走，摸索；犯愚蠢的错误，出漏子；误入，不小心陷入（困境）；n. 愚蠢的错误，疏忽
definition: 1. a serious mistake, usually caused by not taking care or thinking；2. to move in an awkward way
example: She cast a sidelong glance at Eric to see if he had noticed her blunder.
exampleZh: 她偷偷斜扫了埃里克一眼，看他有没有留意到她的错误。

meaning: adj. 钝的，不锋利的；直言不讳的，说话生硬的；v. 减弱；使不锋利，使变钝；【名】 （Blunt）（英）布伦特（人名）
definition: 1. A blunt pencil, knife, etc. is not sharp and therefore not able to write, cut, etc. well.；2. saying what you think without trying to be polite or considering other people's feelings
example: I hate to be blunt, Frankie, but she just didn't strike me as being very ladylike.
exampleZh: 恕我直言，弗朗基，但她给我的感觉不是非常端庄。

meaning: n. 模糊不清的事物；模糊的记忆，记不清的事情；污迹；v. （使）看不清楚，记不清；（使）难以区分；玷污；【名】 （Blur）（英、美、俄、马、新、印）布勒（人名）
definition: 1. n. a hazy or indistinct representation；2. v. become glassy; lose clear vision
example: Everything is a blur when I take my glasses off.
exampleZh: 我摘掉眼镜什么都变得模糊不清。

meaning: v. （因感到难堪或羞愧而）脸红；惭愧，尴尬；使成红色；n. （因感到难堪或羞愧的）脸红；胭红，淡红色； 胭脂；玫瑰红酒；胭脂；【名】 （Blush）（英）布拉什（人名）
definition: 1. to become pink in the face, usually from embarrassment；2. a pink colour in the face, usually from embarrassment
example: "The most important thing is to be honest," she says, without the trace of a blush.
exampleZh: “最重要的是要诚实。”她说道，丝毫不脸红。

meaning: n. 板，木板；黑板，告示牌；董事会，理事会；膳食，伙食，膳食费用；局；舞台；（冰球场周围的）界墙；（美国大学的）入学考试；v. 登上（火车、轮船或飞机）；让乘客登机（或上船等）；寄宿；（在学校）住校；将（宠物）暂时寄养在他处；用木板覆盖；【名】 （Board）（英、西）博德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a committee having supervisory powers；2. v. get on board of (trains, buses, ships, aircraft, etc.)
example: We can break the book of Leviticus down into the units that are listed on that side of the board.
exampleZh: 我们将整本《利未记》分成一个个单元来讲,单元表就在那边的板上。

meaning: v. 有（值得自豪的东西）；吹嘘，夸耀；n. 夸耀，自吹自擂，感到自豪的事；【名】 (Boast)（英）博斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. speaking of yourself in superlatives；2. v. show off
example: In its heyday, the studio's boast was that it had more stars than there are in heaven.
exampleZh: 该制片厂吹嘘，它在鼎盛时期拥有的明星比天上的星星还多。

meaning: adj. 自吹自擂的，自夸的
definition: 1. adj. exhibiting self-importance
example: I tried to emphasize my good points without sounding boastful.
exampleZh: 我在强调自己的优点时尽量不让人觉得是在自我吹嘘。

meaning: n. 小船；轮船；vi. 划船
definition: 1. n. a small vessel for travel on water；2. v. ride in a boat on water
example: You just got to find a good refrigerator on your boat, and then you can still go around the world.
exampleZh: 只需找一个好冰箱放在船上,你仍然可以环游世界。

meaning: n. 身体，躯体；躯干；尸体；（与灵魂或精神相对的）肉体；（尤指某种类型或性格的）人；（建筑物、文件等的）主体，主要部分；车身，机身；衣身；器身，（球拍的）拍身；团体，机构，群体；大量；物体，天体；水域；（酒的）醇度，醇厚；（头发的）稠密度，浓密；（妇女或婴儿的）紧身衣裤；（制陶用语）坯体；v. 赋予（抽象事物）以形体，使具体化；制造（汽车）的车身；【名】 （Body）（英、法、罗）博迪（人名）
definition: 1. n. the entire structure of an organism (especially an animal or human being)；2. v. invest with or as with a body; give body to
example: Yeats counterposes Isaiah's prophetic coal to the blazing body of Section IV, where fire is spontaneous, imminent, something that arises from the body.
exampleZh: 叶芝将比赛亚的预言性的煤,和第五节里燃烧的身体相对照，这里火是自燃的，迫在眉睫的，是从人身体里升出的。

meaning: adj. 人体的，身体的，躯体的；（与精神相对的）物质的，实体的；adv. 整个身体地，全身地；整个地，完全地；亲自地；【名】 （Bodily）（英、美）博迪利（人名）
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to or belonging to the body；2. adv. in bodily form
example: There are laws circumscribing the right of individual citizens to cause bodily harm to others.
exampleZh: 限制公民对他人造成人身伤害的规定是有法可依的。

meaning: v. （使）沸腾，煮沸，烧开；用开水煮；怒火中烧；（海，云）翻腾；n. 煮沸，沸腾；疖，皮下脓肿；激昂，兴奋；突然浮上来食鱼饵；【名】 （Boil）（美）博伊尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a painful sore with a hard core filled with pus；2. v. come to the boiling point and change from a liquid to vapor
example: Now men will go content with what we spoiled, Or, discontent, boil bloody, and be spilled.
exampleZh: 现在人们也许会对我们的破坏得意洋洋或者大发牢骚，也许还会会血液沸腾，飞溅。

meaning: n. 汽锅，锅炉；烧水装置（或容器）
definition: 1. n. sealed vessel where water is converted to steam；2. n. a metal pot for stewing or boiling; usually has a lid
example: With the new boiler you can make big savings on fuel bills.
exampleZh: 用这种新锅炉，能省一大笔燃料开销。

meaning: adj. 大胆自信的，敢于冒险的；冒失的，鲁莽的；明显的，轮廓突出的；粗体的，黑体的；陡峭的；n. 黑体，粗体；【名】 （Bold）（英、德、罗、捷、瑞典）博尔德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a typeface with thick heavy lines；2. adj. fearless and daring
example: No, I'm inclined to think that that other bold claim, on the other side, is probably mistaken as well.
exampleZh: 不，我倾向于认为另一个大胆的观点，在另一方面，可能也是错误的。

meaning: v. 增强，激励；巩固（地位），加强；改善，改进；给（座位）加软垫；n. 长枕，垫枕；承梁（用于支撑或减少摩擦）；托木；（削砖用的）凿刀；【名】 （Bolster）（美、印、荷）博尔斯特（人名）
definition: 1. to support or improve something or make it stronger；2. a long firm cylinder-shaped pillow
example: The country is free to adopt policies to bolster its economy.
exampleZh: 这个国家可自由采取措施来巩固经济。

meaning: n. 闪电，霹雳；（门或窗的）金属插销；螺栓；迅速逃跑，溜走；（布的）一匹；枪栓，枪机；弩箭；（纸等的）卷边；v. 突然快速移动；突然离开，脱离（政党、团体等）；用螺栓固定；闩上（门或窗）；狼吞虎咽；（蔬菜）生长过快，结实过早（而不宜食用）；脱口而出；（马）脱缰，逃跑；筛选；adv. 笔直地
definition: 1. n. a discharge of lightning accompanied by thunder；2. v. move or jump suddenly
example: She leaned on the door and pushed the bolt home.
exampleZh: 她倚在门上，上好了门闩。

meaning: n. 炸弹，爆炸装置；失败的东西；长传，长传球；大笔钱；高压容器，喷雾器；很好的人，很好的事；（形状和威力）像炸弹样的物体；掺大麻的香烟；v. 轰炸，炸毁；疾行，快速前进；失败；重击（球）
definition: 1. n. an explosive device fused to explode under specific conditions；2. v. throw bombs at or attack with bombs
example: The Manhattan Project,when they created the atomic bomb and whether or not you agree with the Manhattan Project normatively.
exampleZh: 曼哈顿计划中，他们创造了原子弹,无论你是否同意,这计划。

meaning: n. 纽带，联系；公债，债券；结合，黏合；承诺，契约；枷锁，桎梏；v. （使）建立亲密关系；与……黏合（或连接）；【名】 （Bond）（英、德、西、瑞典）邦德（人名）
definition: 1. n. an electrical force linking atoms；2. v. stick to firmly
example: So let's figure out the bond order for our two molecules here that we figured out the electron configuration for.
exampleZh: 让我们看看这里,两个分子的键序是多少。

meaning: n. 奴役，束缚；施虐性行为
definition: 1. n. the state of being under the control of a force or influence or abstract power；2. n. the state of being under the control of another person
example: All people, she said, lived their lives in bondage to hunger, pain and lust.
exampleZh: 她说所有人都生活在饥饿、痛苦和欲望的束缚之中。

meaning: n. 骨，骨头；骨质；基本结构，基本（bones）；v. 挑刺，剔骨头；施骨肥于；（与某人）性交；（为应付考试）临时突击；adv. 非常，完全地；【名】 （Bone）（英）博恩，（法、西、罗、塞）博内，（老）奔（人名）
definition: 1. n. rigid connective tissue that makes up the skeleton of vertebrates；2. v. study intensively, as before an exam
example: All these cells come from the bone marrow and biologists have traced the formation of these cells in great detail.
exampleZh: 所有这些细胞都来自骨髓,而生物学家已经很详细地,研究了这些细胞的形成过程

meaning: adj. 骨瘦如柴的；似骨的，骨制的；多骨的，多刺的；【名】 （Bony）（法）博尼（人名）
definition: 1. adj. very thin especially from disease or hunger or cold；2. adj. composed of or containing bone
example: There was a soppy stain on his trousers and through it you could see how bony he was.
exampleZh: 他的裤子上有一块湿漉漉的污渍，透过污渍能看出他瘦得皮包骨头。

meaning: n. 奖金，津贴，红利；意外收获，额外好处；【名】 （Bonus）（西、塞）博努斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. anything that tends to arouse；2. n. an additional payment (or other remuneration) to employees as a means of increasing output
example: Bonus notices were issued each year from head office to local agents.
exampleZh: 红利通告每年由总公司发给各地方代理商。

meaning: n. 书，书籍；本子，簿册；（长篇作品的）篇，卷，部；装订成册之物；赌局，打赌；账册，账簿；v. 预订，预约；（警方）将……记录在案；（裁判）记名警告；【名】 （Book）（英）布克，（瑞典）博克，（朝）北（人名）
definition: 1. n. a written work or composition that has been published (printed on pages bound together)；2. v. record a charge in a police register
example: In "The Horror and the Glory," the second half of the book as originally written, that voice becomes the parenthetical.
exampleZh: 恐惧与荣耀“,在书的第二部分，插叙引出了。

meaning: n. 繁荣；流行，风靡；隆隆声；吊杆；帆桁；水栅；v. 迅速发展，繁荣；轰鸣，轰响；用低沉的声音说；【名】 （Boom）（英、美、荷、俄、比、德）博姆（人名）
definition: 1. n. a deep prolonged loud noise；2. v. make a resonant sound, like artillery
example: And so we need to have this mix of sort of-thank you da-da-da-da-boom. Anyway, moving right along.
exampleZh: 所以我们需要把各种动力,混合在一起，不管怎样，始终往前发展。

meaning: v. 使增长，推动；偷窃；宣扬，推广；n. 推动，促进；广告，宣扬；【名】 （Boost）（英）布斯特，（德）博斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of giving hope or support to someone；2. v. increase
example: But the problems can grow much faster than you can get a performance boost out of the computer.
exampleZh: 对，电脑运行速度是很快,但是问题的规模增长的。

meaning: n. 靴子；猛踢；（汽车的）行李箱，后备箱；车轮固定夹；解雇；再者，除此之外（to boot）；v. 猛踢；锁住（非法停车的轮子）；启动（电脑）；在车轮上装制动装置；解雇；（使）穿靴；【名】 （Boot）（英、美、荷、加、德、意、俄）布特（人名）
definition: 1. n. footwear that covers the whole foot and lower leg；2. v. kick; give a boot to
example: The ski had become disconnected from the boot.
exampleZh: 滑雪板与靴子脱离了。

meaning: n. 电话亭，投票间；售货棚，摊位；岗亭；（隔开的）小间；【名】 （Booth）（英）布思，（德、瑞典）博特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a table (in a restaurant or bar) surrounded by two high-backed benches；2. n. small area set off by walls for special use
example: I called her from a public phone booth near the entrance to the bar.
exampleZh: 我在酒吧入口附近的一个公用电话亭给她打了电话。

meaning: n. 国境，边界；镶边，包边；狭长花坛，花带；v. 接壤，毗邻；环绕，沿……的边缘；近似，相像；【名】 （Border）（英）博德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a line that indicates a boundary；2. v. extend on all sides of simultaneously; encircle
example: Is that how important is it that we get control of that border and seal it, so to speak.
exampleZh: 对于我们来说,控制或者是夺取这个关口，是不是很重要呢。

meaning: v. 使厌烦，使讨厌；钻（孔），挖（洞）；盯着看；n. 令人讨厌的人；使人厌烦的事；内径，口径；探孔，钻孔；涌潮，激潮；【名】 （Bore）（法）博尔，（塞、马里）博雷（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person who evokes boredom；2. v. cause to be bored
example: and that's what basically bore us down to. Just their parents don't do their part.
exampleZh: 主要是这个问题，这让我们很烦恼。只是他们的父母没有做好他们该做的。

meaning: adj. 令人厌烦的；乏味的，无趣的，无聊的；n. 钻孔，扩洞；钻成的孔，扩大的洞；v. 使厌烦；钻；盯着看（bore 的现在分词形式）；【名】 （Boring）（英、瑞典）博林（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of drilling；2. adj. so lacking in interest as to cause mental weariness
example: So with apologies for being a bit more boring for twenty minutes, let's do something we'll call formal stuff.
exampleZh: 抱歉接下来的二十多钟分可能有点枯燥,我们来做点正经事

meaning: adj. 天生的，生来就有的；出生的；产生的，（机构、想法等）问世的；comb. 以……的顺序（或方式、地点等）出生的；v. 忍受；承担；具有（bear 的过去分词形式）；【名】 （Born）（英、美、德、爱、丹）博恩（人名）
definition: 1. n. British nuclear physicist (born in Germany) honored for his contributions to quantum mechanics (1882-1970)；2. adj. brought into existence
example: He's, he's from Guam though, but both of his parents are born in Korea and he speaks fluent Korean.
exampleZh: 他来自关岛，但他的父母都出生于韩国，他的韩语也很流利。

meaning: v. 借，借入；（向……）借贷；采用，借用；（演算减法时）借（位）；【名】 （Borrow）（英）博罗（人名）
definition: 1. v. get temporarily；2. v. take up and practice as one's own
example: Boards of directors have long agonized over how much to borrow and different companies seem to have different cultures.
exampleZh: 董事会一直被该借多少钱的问题所困扰着,不同的国家有着不同的文化

meaning: n. 上司，领导，领班；圆形装饰物，浮雕装饰；牛犊，奶牛；v. 发号施令，对……颐指气使；当首领；adj. 很好的，出色的；【名】 （Boss）（英、法、德、西、瑞典）博斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person who exercises control over workers；2. v. raise in a relief
example: and your boss comes to you with a very large project when you already have much work to do.
exampleZh: 你的老板找到你，希望你参与一个大型项目，而你自己的工作已经快忙不过来了。

meaning: n. 植物学；（特定地区的）植物（生态）
definition: 1. the scientific study of plants
example: As growing up, I have seen the botany garden, the museum, the gallery, and other stuff.
exampleZh: 在成长过程中，我参观过植物园、博物馆、美术馆以及其他各类场馆。

meaning: adj. 植物（学）的；n. 植物制剂
definition: 1. involving or relating to plants or the study of plants；2. a plant used as medicine or to give flavour to a drink
example: Plants are grouped into botanical "families" that have certain characteristics in common.
exampleZh: 具有某些共同特点的植物被归为植物学的科。

meaning: det. 双方，两者；pron. 两者；conj. …和…都；……和……都；adj. 两…，双…
definition: 1. adj. (used with count nouns) two considered together; the two
example: Now this may suggest a certain condescension both toward theory and toward literary text, which is not at all intended.
exampleZh: 选择这篇文章也许意味着,要对理论和文本进行一定的浓缩，这一点不是我想要的。

meaning: v. 费心；（使）烦恼，（使）担心；打扰，烦扰；使不舒服，使疼痛；n. 麻烦，不便；讨厌的人（或事）
definition: 1. n. an angry disturbance；2. v. take the trouble to do something; concern oneself
example: And for time's sake, I'm not going to bother changing the name all of the time, at least for now.
exampleZh: 由于时间的原因，我不会总是,去改变这个文件名字，至少现在不会。

meaning: n. 瓶子；一瓶（的量）；酒；奶瓶，乳饮品；信心，勇气；酒癖，嗜酒；v. 装瓶；用玻璃瓶砸；丧失勇气，泄气
definition: 1. n. a glass or plastic vessel used for storing drinks or other liquids; typically cylindrical without handles and with a narrow neck that can be plugged or capped；2. v. store (liquids or gases) in bottles
example: How do they get that information? What is a star, if not just a giant gas bottle, containerless?
exampleZh: 他们是怎样得到信息的？星星是什么？,如果不只是一个巨大的，空空的气体瓶呢？

meaning: n. 底，底部；尽头，远端；最低水平，底层位置；（套装的）下装；臀部；水底；河边洼地；（一局棒球比赛的）后半局；（汽车变速箱的）最低挡；龙骨，船体；底夸克；（尤指马的）持久力，耐力；船（尤指货船）；adj. 底部的，最后的；最不重要的，最差的；离得最远的；v. （船）到达海底，触到海底；钻探……直到矿物层；发现……范围（或本质）；（成绩，局势）到达最低点后趋于平衡；【名】 （Bottom）（英）博顿（人名）
definition: 1. n. the lower side of anything；2. v. provide with a bottom or a seat
example: Well, my usual style of programming would be to implement the one that's lowest down in the hierarchy near the bottom.
exampleZh: 一般我的编程风格是,先构建等级中最低的东西,也就是靠近地层的东西。

meaning: v. 弹起，反弹；跳动，蹦；（使）上下晃动；（用膝盖）颠动（孩子）；蹦蹦跳跳地去；拒付，退回（支票等）；退回（电子邮件）；驱逐，解雇；（向某人）透露主意（以试探其反应）；反复跳槽，来回往返某地；（光线或声音）反射；撞击，碰撞；n. 弹跳，跳动；弹性，弹力；活力，精力；（头发的）弹性，蓬松；突然的增长
definition: 1. n. the quality of a substance that is able to rebound；2. v. spring back; spring away from an impact
example: and have everyone come up with different ideas, and then you can bounce ideas off each other and
exampleZh: 每个人都能提出不同的想法，你们可以互相讨论各自的观点，

meaning: adj. 必然的，肯定的；受约束的，有义务的；被……所限制的，被……所束缚的；要到……去的，驶往……的；装订好的，有封面的；（与……）紧密相连的，关系密切；准备就绪的；（语法要素）黏附的；v. 跳跃，蹦跳着走；形成……的边界，划界；限制，约束；突然增长，急剧上升；（尤指圆形的物体）弹回，弹开；n. 界限，限制；蹦跳，跳跃；v. 捆绑；使团结；凝结（bind 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. n. a line determining the limits of an area；2. v. move forward by leaps and bounds
example: My ego, I hope, is not bound up with the status of being at Princeton or Yale or Berkeley.
exampleZh: 我所追求的，并非是,在普林斯顿或耶鲁或伯克利大学执教。

meaning: n. 分界线，边界；界限，范围；（板球）击球超过边界线得分
definition: 1. n. the line or plane indicating the limit or extent of something；2. n. a line determining the limits of an area
example: An open system, as the name describes, allows mass and energy to freely flow through the boundary.
exampleZh: 开系，顾名思义，允许质量和能量自由地,流过它的边界。

meaning: n. 花束；（尤指酒的）香味，芬芳；赞扬，恭维；【名】 （Bouquet）（英、法）布凯（人名)
definition: 1. a group of flowers that have been fastened together and attractively arranged so that they can be given as a present or carried on formal occasions；2. the characteristic smell of a wine or liqueur
example: These naturally dried flowers will outlast a bouquet of fresh blooms.
exampleZh: 这些自然风干的花会比一束鲜花更为持久。

meaning: n. 发作，发病期；一阵，一次，一场；拳击赛，摔跤比赛；（小提琴、吉他或其他乐器边缘的）曲线；【名】 （Bout）（法）布特（人名）
definition: 1. a short period of illness or involvement in an activity；2. a boxing or wrestling match
example: And it follows qualitatively from just your ordinary observations a bout the direction in which things go spontaneously, right.
exampleZh: 定性地来说,就是你们日常生活中观察到,自发进行的物理现象,会有方向性。

meaning: v. 鞠躬，点头；低下（头）；停止对抗，屈从于；（使）弯曲；用弓拉奏（乐曲）；（新影片）首映，（新产品）投放市场；n. 鞠躬，点头；船头；蝴蝶结；弓；琴弓；（用琴弓拉的）一段（音乐）；字母的一弯；（钥匙、剪刀等的）金属环状柄，圆形拎环；眼镜架，眼镜框；【名】 （Bow）（英、美、爱尔兰）鲍（人名）
definition: 1. n. a knot with two loops and loose ends; used to tie shoelaces；2. v. bend one's knee or body, or lower one's head
example: All of the sounds are produced by the strings on the instrument and how the bow is pulled across the instrument.
exampleZh: 所有声音都是靠乐器上的弦产生的,琴弓在乐器上来回滑动发声

meaning: n. 肠，肠道；内部，深处
definition: 1. n. the part of the alimentary canal between the stomach and the anus
example: Symptoms such as stomach pains and irritable bowels can be signs of bowel cancer.
exampleZh: 胃痛和肠易激等症状都可能是肠癌的征兆。

meaning: n. 碗，盆；一碗之量；碗状物；草地滚球；（草地滚球中的）木球，圆球 ；椭圆形运动场，环形剧场 ；美式足球季后赛；盆地；v. 滚（球，箍或其他圆形物）；（板球等）投球；击中三柱门使（击球手）出局；迅速移动；打保龄球；（打保龄球）得（分）
definition: 1. n. a round vessel that is open at the top; used for holding fruit or liquids or for serving food；2. v. roll (a ball)
example: And you're listening to interviews with possible contestants from Yale " who are going to be on "College Bowl."
exampleZh: 你们听着采访录音带,被采访者是耶鲁的参赛候选人,代表耶鲁参加“学院杯“

meaning: n. 盒，箱，匣；（戏院的）包厢，（法庭的）专席；小亭，岗亭；方框，方格；邮箱；（运动场上的）区，特定区域；电视（the box）；耳光；黄杨；（运动员的）下体护身；v. 把……装箱；（与……）斗拳，参加拳击比赛；（非同群牲畜）混杂，混群（box sheep up）；【名】 （Box）（英、法、西）博克斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a (usually rectangular) container; may have a lid；2. v. put into a box
example: You can always count on seeing tourist on the train with an American Girl bag or an American Girl box
exampleZh: 你总是可以在火车上看到拿着“美国女孩”的包和盒子的游客，

meaning: n. 拳击（运动）；v. 将……装入盒中（box 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. fighting with the fists；2. n. the enclosure of something in a package or box
example: So a very popular thing to do on Boxing Day is go shopping and take advantage of the sales.
exampleZh: 所以在节礼日人们通常会趁着促销之际出去购物，这很流行。

meaning: n. 男孩；儿子；男青年，小伙子；男性朋友们，一群男伙伴（the boys）；一群从事同一职业的男子（boys）；（从事某一职业的）男子；小家伙（用于称呼雄性的狗或马）；伙计（尤用于亲切谈论某人时）；（尤指在战场上作战的）士兵，战友；指称某地等的人；运动队队员（the boys）；小子（对黑人男性的冒犯语）；int. （尤用于表示羡慕或兴奋）好家伙，好样的；【名】 （Boy）（美、印、法、荷）布瓦（人名）
definition: 1. n. a youthful male person；2. n. a friendly informal reference to a grown man
example: The relation between the speech sounds it's like the relation, as I'm saying, between the boy and the birches.
exampleZh: 语言韵律和,就像这种关系，像我说的，像孩子和桦树的关系一样。

meaning: v. 抵制，拒绝参加；n. 抵制行动；【名】 （Boycott）博伊科特（人名）
definition: 1. to refuse to buy a product or take part in an activity as a way of expressing strong disapproval
example: A spokesman says the president has backed off from his threat to boycott the conference.
exampleZh: 一位发言人说，总统已经撤回了他抵制这次会谈的威胁。

meaning: adj. 轻快的，生气勃勃的；兴隆的，红火的；凉爽的，清新的；精干利落的，麻利的；v. 加快；使……活泼，使……兴旺；【名】 （Brisk）（法、芬）布里斯克（人名）
definition: 1. quick, energetic, and active
example: As they started up again, the horse broke into a brisk trot.
exampleZh: 当他们又出发时，那匹马便轻快地小跑起来。

meaning: adj. 宽广的，宽阔的；……宽；咧开嘴的；广泛的，普遍的；大致的，概括的；明确的，明显的；粗俗滑稽的；口音重的；n. 对女人的粗俗称呼；宽阔部分；adv. 宽阔地；【名】 （Broad）（英、德）布罗德（人名）
definition: 1. n. slang term for a woman；2. adj. having great (or a certain) extent from one side to the other
example: I figured Chemical Engineering would be the best way to get into it because it's a really broad major.
exampleZh: 我发现化学工程应该是接触新能源的最好方式，因为这个专业覆盖面也很广。

meaning: v. 增长（经验、知识等）；变宽，变阔；（使）扩大影响
definition: 1. v. make broader；2. v. extend in scope or range or area
example: I call this the broaden-and-build theory of positive emotions because positive emotions appear to broaden people's momentary thought action repertoire and build the enduring personal resources.
exampleZh: 我称其为积极情绪的扩建理论,因为积极情绪似乎能扩展人们的瞬间想法,和动作指令库并建立持久的个人资源。

meaning: n. 宽度，幅度；广度，广泛性
definition: 1. n. the capacity to understand a broad range of topics；2. n. the extent of something from side to side
example: And that means that I'll have to take a Seven-Course Breadth Requirement,
exampleZh: 这就意味着，我有7门必修课，

meaning: v. 散布，传播（信息等）；播撒（种子等）；广播，播送；n. 电视节目，广播节目；广播，播出；adj. 广播（或电视）节目的；adv. 四散地，撒播地

meaning: n. 小册子，资料（或广告）手册；【名】 （Brochure）（美）布罗许尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a small book usually having a paper cover
example: Correct me if I'm wrong , but isn't this last year's brochure?
exampleZh: 这不是去年的小册子吗？若是我说错了就请指出。

meaning: adj. 身无分文的，一文不名的；v. 弄坏；打碎；违反（break 的过去式形式）；【名】 （Broke）（美、印、俄、德）布罗克（人名）
definition: 1. adj. lacking funds
example: It was a new idea that broke with the ideas of its neighbors, and those people were the Israelites.
exampleZh: 他们的新观点使他们在当时，格格不入，他们是犹太人。

meaning: n. 经纪人，中间人；v. 协调，安排；【名】 （Broker）（英）布罗克，（俄）布罗克尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a businessman who buys or sells for another in exchange for a commission；2. v. act as a broker
example: The selling broker is then required to assign a portion of the commission to the buyer broker.
exampleZh: 卖方经纪人则被要求分给买方经纪人一部分佣金。

meaning: n. 青铜；青铜色，古铜色；青铜艺术品；铜牌；adj. 青铜制的；青铜色的，古铜色的；v. 使被太阳晒黑；镶上青铜面；【名】 （Bronze）（葡）布龙泽（人名）
definition: 1. a brown metal made of copper and tin；2. a dark orange-brown colour, like the metal bronze
example: A very important element, he would have had a breast plate made of bronze, perhaps as much as 40 pounds.

meaning: v. 孵蛋；沉思，担忧；n. 一窝幼雏；一大家孩子；幼蜂；adj. 传种的，为繁殖而饲养的；【名】 （Brood）（美）布罗德（人名）
definition: 1. a group of young birds all born at the same time；2. a person's young children
example: Many bird species will raise a second brood, but kingfishers, averaging six or seven eggs per clutch, often raise a third.
exampleZh: 许多鸟类会孵化两窝小鸟，但是翠鸟经常会生第三窝，而它们的每一窝都平均有六七个蛋。

meaning: n. 扫帚；金雀花；【名】 （Broom）（英）布鲁姆（人名）
definition: 1. n. a cleaning implement for sweeping; bundle of straws or twigs attached to a long handle；2. v. sweep with a broom or as if with a broom
example: Broom meant to make a clean sweep of things, a clean sweep of what had come before.
exampleZh: 扫帚》的寓意是将事情做个彻底的了结，对曾经发生过的事情一扫而空。

meaning: n. 兄弟，哥哥，弟弟；同类人（指同一种族、宗教、国家、职业或志同道合的人，如同事、战友、教友）；修士（宗教团体中男性成员的称呼，常置于名字前）；兄弟（用于公司或商店名称，常作 Brothers）；int. 老兄
definition: 1. n. a male with the same parents as someone else；2. n. a male person who is a fellow member (of a fraternity or religion of other group)
example: Where were you? -Sacramento, California, Memorial Auditorium I knew when he was done, this brother is for real.
exampleZh: 你当时在哪里？加利福利亚，萨克拉门托的纪念堂,我只知道，这个人非常认真。

meaning: n. 额；眉毛；坡顶；（从船到岸上的）跳板；【名】 （Brow）（西）布劳（人名）
definition: 1. n. the part of the face above the eyes；2. n. the arch of hair above each eye
example: The nurse mopped his fevered brow.
exampleZh: 护士擦拭了他发烫的前额。

meaning: adj. 褐色的，棕色的；肤色深的，晒黑的；未去壳的，糙的；n. 褐色，棕色；褐色的东西；眼蝶，褐蝶；v. （使）变成棕色，成褐色；【名】 （Brown）（英、意、芬、捷、德、法、西、葡）布朗（人名）
definition: 1. n. an orange of low brightness and saturation；2. v. fry in a pan until it changes color
example: And, um, I knew that Brown was an Ivy League school, so that meant it was a very good school.
exampleZh: 我知道布朗大学是常春藤联盟中的一员，这表明布朗大学一定是一所非常顶尖的学校。

meaning: v. 随意翻阅；（动物）吃草；（在商店里）随便看看；浏览信息；n. 随意的看，浏览；（动物吃的）植物；【名】 （Browse）（英）布劳斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. reading superficially or at random；2. v. shop around; not necessarily buying
example: Sit at your computer, probably at home or at the office, search and browse, and buy.
exampleZh: 坐在你的电脑前，可能在家里或在办公室，搜索、浏览和购物。

meaning: n. 浏览器；逛商店的人，浏览书报者；吃高处草木的动物
definition: 1. n. a viewer who looks around casually without seeking anything in particular；2. n. a program used to view HTML documents
example: But yeah, there is some code, you know a lot of, sometimes cross browser issues
exampleZh: 但事实上，也有些编码，你知道很多跨浏览器的问题，

meaning: n. 青瘀，伤痕；（水果或蔬菜的）碰伤；v. 打击，挫伤；压碎，碾碎；使青肿，使出现伤痕；碰伤（水果）
definition: 1. an injury or mark where the skin has not been broken but is darker in colour, often as a result of being hit by something；2. to develop a bruise or to cause someone or something to have a bruise
example: And people, they would rip off your shirt to see if you had a bruise from a recoiling rifle.
exampleZh: 人们会扯掉你的衬衣,看你胸口是否有步枪后作力造成的瘀伤

meaning: n. 早午餐
definition: 1. n. combination breakfast and lunch; usually served in late morning；2. v. eat a meal in the late morning
example: Clean my apartment and I usually go out for brunch at least one day of the weekend.
exampleZh: 我会打扫房间，周末至少也会有一天外出吃早午饭。

meaning: n. 刷子，画笔；灌木丛；刷；轻擦，掠过；小冲突；狐狸尾巴；柴枝；（性感的）女人（或女孩）；v. 刷，拂拭；刷掉，拂去；刷上；轻擦，触碰
definition: 1. n. a dense growth of bushes；2. v. rub with a brush, or as if with a brush
example: I got the feeling, when I was talking to some of you guys, that maybe you should brush up on your calculus.
exampleZh: 当我和你们中某些人聊天时,我感觉到,你们应该好好复习微积分

meaning: adj. 野蛮的，凶残的；毫不掩饰的，直截了当的；令人不快的，糟糕的
definition: 1. adj. (of weapons or instruments) causing suffering and pain；2. adj. (of persons or their actions) able or disposed to inflict pain or suffering
example: This juxtaposition of brutal reality and lyrical beauty runs through Park's stories.
exampleZh: 残酷的现实和抒情诗般的美并存贯穿于帕克的故事之中。

meaning: n. 残忍，野蛮
definition: 1. n. the trait of extreme cruelty；2. n. a brutal barbarous savage act
example: On 231, just to add to this catalog--we have murdered, abandoned, neglected children--we also have police brutality.
exampleZh: 在231页，就是为了加些内容到这个目录中，我们看到了谋杀，抛弃，忽视儿童，我们还读到了警察的残忍，让我看一下231页。

meaning: n. 气泡，泡沫；经济泡沫；（欲表达的）一点感情；气泡框；泡状物；安全的地方（或位置）；泡螺；v. 冒泡，沸腾；发出冒泡的声音；忙碌，活跃；兴奋，激动；（情绪、感情等）涌动
definition: 1. n. a hollow globule of gas (e.g., air or carbon dioxide)；2. v. form, produce, or emit bubbles
example: At the time the telecoms bubble was at its height.
exampleZh: 当时电信业的泡沫正处于极度膨胀时期。

meaning: n. （美）元；雄性动物；小伙子；纨绔子弟，花花公子；责任，过失；v. 反对，抵制；鼓舞，使振作；弓背跃起；猛烈颠簸；adj. 龅牙的；【名】 （Buck）（美）巴克（人名）
definition: 1. n. a gymnastic horse without pommels and with one end elongated; used lengthwise for vaulting；2. v. to strive with determination
example: Buck never allowed himself to be bullied into doing anything that went against his principles.
exampleZh: 巴克从来不让自己被迫做任何违背自己原则的事。

meaning: n. 桶；一桶之量；（机器的）挖斗，铲斗；大量；投篮得分；存储桶；v. 快速颠簸着行驶；【名】 （Bucket）（德）布克特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a roughly cylindrical vessel that is open at the top；2. v. put into a bucket
example: I'm a drop in the bucket and, you know, well -- You might lose the vote.
exampleZh: 我那一票只是沧海一粟-,你可能是少数派。

meaning: v. 发软；屈服，让步；（人）精神崩溃；（使）弯曲，（使）变形；扣住，扣紧；n. （皮带等的）搭扣，搭钩；【名】 （Buckle）（英、美、加）巴克尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. fastener that fastens together two ends of a belt or strap; often has loose prong；2. v. fasten with a buckle or buckles
example: In other words, Buckle was the avatar of the notion in the late nineteenth century that everything was going to hell in a handbasket.
exampleZh: 换言之，十九世纪后期有一种观念认为所有事物都在迅速恶化,而巴尔克则是这种观念的化身。

meaning: n. 芽，花蕾；伙计，老兄；芽体；v. 发芽，长出花蕾；为……进行芽接；【名】 （Bud）（英）巴德，（中）布特（蒙语·汉语拼音），（罗、匈）布德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a partially opened flower；2. v. develop buds
example: It is important to recognize jealousy and to nip it in the bud before it gets out of hand.
exampleZh: 意识到嫉妒并在它发展到无法控制之前就把它消灭于萌芽状态，这一点至关重要。

meaning: n. 朋友；老兄，兄弟；伙伴，搭档；v. 与……成为朋友，与……结交；adj. 讲述友情的；【名】 （Buddy）（英）巴迪（人名）
definition: 1. n. a close friend who accompanies his buddies in their activities
example: What Buddy does, in this passage, is set up this opposition between his own reading of his story and Zooey's.
exampleZh: 巴蒂所做的，在这个片段里，就是提出,他对自己故事的理解和左伊的之间的矛盾。

meaning: n. 佛教
definition: 1. a religion that originally comes from South Asia, and teaches that personal spiritual improvement will lead to escape from human suffering
example: It's just a little meditation technique, I know that I heard all music as a part of a larger mantra in Buddhism.
exampleZh: 其实只是一些冥想的技巧，据我所知，佛教认为一切音律,都从属一个范围更广的咒语。

meaning: n. 佛教徒，信仰佛教的人；adj. 佛教的，与佛教有关的
definition: 1. someone who believes in Buddhism；2. having to do with Buddhists or Buddhism
example: And I think what we decide to do in our congregation here whether it's Christian, Muslim or Jewish, Hindu, Buddhist,whatever.
exampleZh: 我认为我们对于在国内的集会中做什么的决定,无论是基督教，穆斯林,犹太教，印度教，佛教，不管哪种。

meaning: n. 预算；政府预算案；v. 制定预算，制定开支计划；计划，安排；adj. 廉价的，经济型的
definition: 1. n. a sum of money allocated for a particular purpose；2. v. make a budget
example: And so if you can cut out all of that advertising budget, then you can sell the product for much cheaper.
exampleZh: 所以如果你把广告预算都去掉，产品就可以卖得便宜很多。

meaning: adj. 预算的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to a budget
example: There are huge budgetary pressures on all governments in Europe to reduce their armed forces.
exampleZh: 欧洲各国政府都面临着巨大的裁军预算压力。

meaning: n. 野牛，犎牛；水牛；牛胭鱼；v. 为难，使困惑；吓唬，威吓；【名】 （Buffalo）（英）布法罗（人名）
definition: 1. a large animal of the cattle family, with long, curved horns；2. a North American bison (= a large wild animal, similar to a cow but having a larger head and shoulders covered in hair)
example: Chobe is also renowned for its large herds of elephant and buffalo.
exampleZh: 乔贝还以其大群的大象和水牛而闻名。

meaning: n. 起缓冲作用的人（物）；老家伙，老头；缓冲存储器，缓存；（铁路机车头尾的）缓冲器，减震器；（用于擦亮表面的）抛光工具；v. 保护（某物）；缓解，缓冲；存储，缓存（数据等）
definition: 1. something or someone that helps protect from harm, risk, or problems；2. something that forms a physical barrier or space around something or between two things, to protect them
example: Many of the crashes resulting from fuzz testing are direct results of memory allocation mistakes and buffer overflows.
exampleZh: 由模糊测试导致的许多故障都是内存分配错误及缓冲器溢出的直接结果。

meaning: n. 自助餐；快餐部，点心柜；餐具架，餐具柜；打击；矮凳，踏脚凳；v. 连续猛击，打击；虐待，不公正地对待；adj. 自助的；自助餐的；【名】 （Buffet）（法）比费（人名）
definition: 1. n. a piece of furniture that stands at the side of a dining room; has shelves and drawers；2. v. strike against forcefully
example: At lunchtime, there's a choice between the buffet or the set menu.
exampleZh: 午饭时，可以选择自助餐或套餐。

meaning: n. 昆虫，虫子；小病，轻微的传染病；（计算机程序中的）漏洞，故障；窃听器；热衷，着迷；v. 烦扰，使恼怒；装窃听器；（由于吃惊或害怕）张大眼睛，瞪大双眼

meaning: v. 建造，修建；发展，建立；逐渐增强；n. 体形，体格；（尤指车辆的）造型，构造；构件
definition: 1. n. constitution of the human body；2. v. make by combining materials and parts
example: That's all legitimate eidence. That is what one uses to build up the structure of the interpretation of the poem.
exampleZh: 这些都是合乎逻辑的证据，都是人们用来,建构解读诗歌框架的工具。

meaning: n. 建筑物，房屋，楼房；建筑，建筑业；v. 建造；发展，建立；逐渐增强（build 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place；2. n. the act of constructing something
example: There is a cat outside the apartment building that starts to meow and the boys are interested in it.
exampleZh: 男孩儿们对楼外,叫唤的猫很感兴趣。

meaning: n. 电灯泡；（植物的）鳞茎，球茎；球状物
definition: 1. n. a modified bud consisting of a thickened globular underground stem serving as a reproductive structure；2. n. electric lamp consisting of a transparent or translucent glass housing containing a wire filament (usually tungsten) that emits light when heated by electricity
example: On the stairway to the basement, he took the light bulb out of the socket.
exampleZh: 在通向地下室的楼梯上，他把灯泡从灯座上拧了下来。

meaning: n. 主体，大部分；庞大的身躯，肥硕的体形；（巨大的）容积，体积；adj. 大批的，大宗的；v. 使（产品）数量显得很大；结合（待售的股票或商品）；【名】 （Bulk）（土）布尔克（人名）
definition: 1. n. the property resulting from being or relating to the greater in number of two parts; the main part；2. v. stick out or up
