meaning: adj. 笨重的，庞大的；大块头的，高大肥胖的
definition: 1. adj. of large size for its weight
example: He struggled out of his bulky jacket and threw it on to the back seat.
exampleZh: 他用力脱下笨重的夹克，顺手把它扔到后座上。

meaning: n. 公牛；雄性大型动物；买空者，多头；教皇诏书，教皇训谕；废话，胡说八道；靶心；v. 用力推，猛推；（母牛）发情；【名】 （Bull）（英、葡、瑞典、芬、挪、德）布尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. uncastrated adult male of domestic cattle；2. v. push or force
example: You've had bull sessions, right, with your high school friends or in your college dorm or what have you.
exampleZh: 你们有过自由讨论，是，和高中朋友们，或在大学宿舍，等等。

meaning: n. 子弹，弹丸；（标示用的）黑圆点；（运动中）高速球；【名】 （Bullet）（法）比莱（人名）
definition: 1. n. a projectile that is fired from a gun；2. n. a high-speed passenger train
example: So, you just say, well, this is like a bullet going through pumpkin.
exampleZh: 你会说，好吧，这就像一颗子弹穿过南瓜一样。

meaning: n. （广播或电视中的）新闻简报；公告，布告；（机构或社团的）通讯，刊物；v. 通过公告公布或告知
definition: 1. n. a brief report (especially an official statement issued for immediate publication or broadcast)；2. v. make public by bulletin
example: At 3:30 p.m. a bulletin was released announcing that the president was out of immediate danger.
exampleZh: 下午3:30发布了公告，宣布总统暂时脱离了危险。

meaning: n. 恃强凌弱者，横行霸道者；腌牛肉；v. 威吓，欺侮；威胁，胁迫；adj. 很棒，一流的；int. 没什么了不起；【名】 （Bully）（法）布利（人名）
definition: 1. n. a cruel and brutal fellow；2. v. be bossy towards
example: He has been variously described as a hero, a genius and a bully.
exampleZh: 他被描述为英雄、天才、恶霸，不一而足。

meaning: v. （使身体部位等）碰上，撞上；（无意地）碰，撞；颠簸行进；拖拽；挤出，挤掉；改变（广播或电视节目的时间）；n. 肿块；隆起，凸块；碰撞，撞击；轻微撞车事故；屁股向前扭动的性感动作；增加；绒布；【名】 （Bump）（英、西）邦普（人名）
definition: 1. n. a lump on the body caused by a blow；2. v. knock against with force or violence
example: It's not as though the number two is something that you see or hear or taste or could bump into.
exampleZh: 数字2不是,你能看到或听到或尝到或遇到的东西

meaning: n. （车辆）保险杠；大满杯敬酒；（为跳栏或障碍赛作准备的）新马平地赛；（板球）反弹球；广告时段；烟头；adj. 丰收的，丰盛的；巨大的，大号的；v. 满杯祝酒；干杯；装满
definition: 1. n. a glass filled to the brim (especially as a toast)；2. adj. extraordinarily abundant
example: When I pulled out of the space, I nicked the rear bumper of the car in front of me.
exampleZh: 我把车从车位开出来时，蹭到了我前面那辆车的后保险杠。

meaning: n. 束，串，扎；一伙，一群；大量；发辫（bunches）；突起；v. 捆，扎，使集中；收紧，起褶；【名】 （Bunch）（英）邦奇（人名）
definition: 1. n. a grouping of a number of similar things；2. v. form into a bunch
example: And they have like a giant Christmas tree and a menorah and a bunch of other things, so.
exampleZh: 到时候会有巨大的圣诞树、蜡烛，等等之类的都有。

meaning: n. 束，捆，包；非常；一套，一系列；大量；婴儿；一大笔钱；软件包；v. 匆匆打发，乱塞；匆忙赶往；捆绑销售；与某人和衣同睡
definition: 1. n. a collection of things wrapped or boxed together；2. v. make into a bundle
example: Why? Bundle of properties: mechanical strength, chemical inertness, ease of fabrication: that's not a unique solution.
exampleZh: 为什么，属性的总和：,机械强度，化学惰性，易于制造，那不是独特的解决方法。

meaning: n. 负担，责任；负重，负荷；船的载重量，吨位；（演讲、书或辩论的）主题，主旨（the burden）；v. 烦扰，使负重担；【名】 （Burden）（英）伯登（人名）
definition: 1. n. an onerous or difficult concern；2. v. weight down with a load
example: The measures will lighten the tax burden on small businesses.
exampleZh: 这些措施将减轻小型企业的纳税负担。

meaning: n. 局，处，科；办事处，办公室；五斗橱，衣柜；书桌；【名】 （Bureau）（法）比罗（人名）
definition: 1. n. an administrative unit of government；2. n. furniture with drawers for keeping clothes
example: The Better Business Bureau holds an enormous amount of information on any business problem.
exampleZh: 商业信用局存储着有关任何商务问题的大量信息。

meaning: n. 官僚，官僚主义者
definition: 1. someone working in a bureaucracy；2. a member of a bureaucracy
example: A bureaucrat, who declined to be named said, "It's like Silicon Valley versus Wall Street."
exampleZh: 一位不愿透露姓名的官员称：“这就好比硅谷对华尔街一般。”

meaning: adj. 官僚的，官僚政治的
definition: 1. relating to a system of controlling or managing a country, company, or organization that is operated by a large number of officials；2. involving complicated rules and processes that make something slow and difficult
example: In fact, he was suspicious of large, bureaucratic organizations, as is evidenced in films like That Darned Cat.
exampleZh: 事实上，他对庞大的官僚主义的组织持怀疑态度，这在《那只可恶的猫》等电影中得到了证明。

meaning: n. 官僚制度，官僚机构，官僚作风；官僚，政府官员
definition: 1. a system for controlling or managing a country, company, or organization that is operated by a large number of officials employed to follow rules carefully；2. the officials, employees, and people who run government departments and offices, or similar officers and employees who manage the details of operating a large business
example: And of course, the kings when we see them in Homer do not have a bureaucracy, do not have scribes.
exampleZh: 当然,从《荷马史诗》中所看到的那些国王,他们没有官僚作风,没有随身抄写员

meaning: n. 入室行窃者，窃贼
definition: 1. a person who illegally enters buildings and steals things
example: The main thing to remember is to switch off the burglar alarm.
exampleZh: 最要紧的是记住关掉防盗报警器的开关。

meaning: n. 入室盗窃，入室盗窃罪
definition: 1. the crime of illegally entering a building and stealing things
example: He was jailed for 33 months to run concurrently with a sentence he is already serving for burglary.
exampleZh: 他被关进监狱33个月，与因入室行窃已经在服的刑期同期执行。

meaning: v. 燃烧，消耗；烧坏，烧毁，烧焦；晒伤，晒黑；火辣辣地发痛，发烫；发光，发亮；激怒；刻录；渴望；迅速移动；n. 灼伤，烧伤，烧痕；肌肉酸痛感；小溪；【名】 （Burn）（英）伯恩（人名）
definition: 1. n. pain that feels hot as if it were on fire；2. v. destroy by fire
example: When they invented fire insurance, in the 1600s, there was a lot of skepticism because anyone can burn down their house.
exampleZh: 十七世纪时，人们发明了火险，当时存在很多质疑,因为任何人都可以烧毁他们的房子。

meaning: v. 爆炸，爆裂，胀开；冲，闯，突然出现；猛然打开；充满，满怀（be bursting with）；决堤；突然活跃起来；突然发生，突然发作；分页，断纸；n. 突发，迸发；爆裂，裂口；一阵短促的射击；【名】 （Burst）（美）布尔斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of exploding or bursting something；2. v. break open or apart suddenly
example: because if you go out in public and you start talking to someone, you'll just burst into tears.
exampleZh: 因为在外面的时候，你一开口跟人说话，眼泪就禁不住留下来。

meaning: v. 埋，埋葬；埋藏，隐藏；掩藏情感；把头/脸埋进……；嵌入，插入；埋头于，专心于（bury oneself in）；证明……是错的；轻松战胜，击败；【名】 （Bury）（英、西）伯里，（法）比里，（德、意、罗、波、捷、匈）布里，（俄）布雷（人名）
definition: 1. v. cover from sight；2. v. place in a grave or tomb
example: The woman's objection, as the poem unfolds, is summed up by his choice, the father's choice, to bury the child himself.
exampleZh: 这首诗里揭示的这个女人的反对，从这个父亲的选择中就可以总结出，亲自埋葬这个孩子。

meaning: n. 埋葬，葬礼；葬地，坟墓；adj. 埋葬的
definition: 1. n. the ritual placing of a corpse in a grave；2. n. concealing something under the ground
example: Let's look at what is, for me, the most gripping example of this kind of poem: "Home Burial," on page 204.
exampleZh: 我们来看看，我认为，这类诗中最引人注意的例子：,“家冢“，在204页。

meaning: n. 公共汽车；（计算机／电子技术）总线；母线；v. 乘公共汽车；用公共汽车运送；收拾（餐桌）
definition: 1. n. a vehicle carrying many passengers; used for public transport；2. v. send or move around by bus
example: so I'm going to begin by showing you a very personal look at my hometown, a bus ride.
exampleZh: 所以我将首先展示一下,关于我家乡的一个个人视角,一次公车旅程。

meaning: n. 灌木，灌木丛；荒野，丛林地带；衬套；绝缘套管；浓密的头发；v. 蓬松；伸展，丛生；以灌木装饰；adj. 如灌木般长得低矮的；粗野的；低劣的，便宜的；【名】 （Bush）布什（人名)
definition: 1. n. a low woody perennial plant usually having several major branches；2. v. provide with a bushing
example: or the tax cuts from the wealthy, for the wealthy that were instituted under the Bush administration.
exampleZh: 或者在布什政府领导下，给于富人减税的政策。

meaning: adj. （毛发或枝叶）浓密的，茂密的
definition: 1. adj. used of hair; thick and poorly groomed；2. adj. resembling a bush in being thickly branched and spreading
example: I have got a long body, a narrow little head, lots of furs and a big, bushy tail.
exampleZh: 我的身子长长的，脑袋又窄又小，皮毛丰厚，尾巴又大又浓密。

meaning: n. 商业，买卖，生意；商务，公事；公司，企业；行业，职业；事务，职责；私事；事情；（顾客对商店的）惠顾；系列事件
definition: 1. n. a commercial or industrial enterprise and the people who constitute it；2. n. the activity of providing goods and services involving financial and commercial and industrial aspects
example: So they bring like... I don't know, business people are like, different companies to like talk with students here
exampleZh: 所以他们把……我不知道，把商人，不同公司的商人找来和学生谈话，

meaning: n. （男性）商人，生意人
definition: 1. n. a person engaged in commercial or industrial business (especially an owner or executive)
example: It's for 3 or 4 days and it's put on by a local businessman who's a blue grass freak,
exampleZh: 它会持续3到4天，是当地的一名商人赞助的，他是个热爱蓝草的怪人，

meaning: n. 半身像；女子胸部，胸围；突击搜查；没价值的事物；经济萧条时期；v. 弄坏，打碎；逮捕；降级；阻止，破坏；突袭，搜查；猛烈打击；打破，炸破；adj. 坏掉的；破产的；【名】 （Bust）（英、美、德）布斯特（人名）
definition: 1. a woman's breasts, or the measurement around a woman's breasts and back；2. a model of the head and shoulders of a person
example: This is one of the most important aspects of this marvelous book the Housing boom and bust.
exampleZh: 这是最重要的部分,在这本神奇的著作中。

meaning: adj. 繁忙的，忙碌的；热闹的；全神贯注的；占线的；繁琐的，杂乱的；v. 使自己忙于；n. 警官，警察；【名】 （Busy）（匈）布希，（法）比西（人名）
definition: 1. v. keep busy with；2. adj. actively or fully engaged or occupied
example: I guess some days at Yale can be very busy. Do you think those busy days happen a lot?
exampleZh: 我想有时候在耶鲁会很忙。你觉得经常很忙吗？

meaning: conj. 而，相反；（用于表示歉意）但是；可是（用来提出异议）；除了；（与重复词连用，表示强调）；prep. 除了，除……外；adv. 仅仅，只是；n. 借口，托词；【名】 （But）（俄、罗）布特，（越）笔（人名）
definition: 1. adv. and nothing more
example: but they're still really good at like teaching, but sometimes a little bit crazy. Like... like very strange personalities.
exampleZh: 但是他们还是很擅长教学，但是有时候有点疯狂，比如性格有点奇怪。

meaning: n. 屠夫；肉店；刽子手；笨蛋，莽夫；（火车或剧院的）小贩；v. 屠宰；弄砸；残杀，杀戮；【名】 （Butcher）（英、美、爱）布彻（人名）
definition: 1. n. a retailer of meat；2. v. kill (animals) usually for food consumption
example: So it's true. Before, it was like a butcher place where they cut the cows and pigs and everything.
exampleZh: 是这样的。以前它像个杀牛、猪等动物的屠宰场。

meaning: n. 烟蒂，烟头；（武器或工具）粗端；笑柄；屁股；（头的）顶撞；大桶；枪靶，靶场；（尤指接近地面部分的）树干；v. 用头（或角）顶，撞；（使）毗连，相邻；【名】 （Butt）（英）巴特，（俄、德、印、巴基）布特（人名）
definition: 1. the part of a finished cigarette that has not been smoked；2. slang for bottom
example: It had a butt made also of bronze, which could be a lethal weapon.
exampleZh: 它的基座也是铜制的，这完全可以当作一件致命武器。

meaning: n. 黄油，牛油；水果酱，干果酱；v. 涂黄油于
definition: 1. n. an edible emulsion of fat globules made by churning milk or cream; for cooking and table use；2. v. spread butter on
example: Here's a list of ingredients from Skippy Peanut Butter and you see that sugar is the second most common ingredient.
exampleZh: 这有一份四季宝花生酱的配料表,你可以看到糖是含量第二多的原料

meaning: n. 蝴蝶；见异思迁的人，轻浮易变的人；蝶泳，蝶泳比赛；紧张，心慌；耳环托；v. （将食物）切成蝴蝶展翅状，使成蝶形；adj. 蝴蝶状
definition: 1. n. diurnal insect typically having a slender body with knobbed antennae and broad colorful wings；2. v. flutter like a butterfly
example: It is a very pretty butterfly, with a 2 inch wing span.
exampleZh: 它是一只非常漂亮的蝴蝶，翅膀张开有2英寸宽。

meaning: n. 纽扣，扣子；按钮；徽章；v. 用纽扣扣住；【名】 （Button）（英）巴顿（人名）
definition: 1. n. a round fastener sewn to shirts and coats etc to fit through buttonholes；2. v. provide with buttons
example: And if you go back to here and click on Archive Notes, it is the fourth button down that will take you to something that looks like this.
exampleZh: 如果你们回到这来，点击存档笔记，是倒数第四个,你们会看到像这样的情况。

meaning: v. 购买，能买；相信，接受；（付出代价）获得，赢得；收买，贿赂；买，购买；n. 合算的东西，便宜货；购买
definition: 1. n. an advantageous purchase；2. v. obtain by purchase; acquire by means of a financial transaction
example: Could I have a show of hands of people who are planning to buy the text but haven't done so yet?
exampleZh: 你们能举下手吗，那些,正打算买书，但还没有买的同学？

meaning: n. 买主，买方，买家；采购员；（法律）买受人；（Buyer）人名（英：拜尔、法：比耶、德：布耶尔）
definition: 1. n. a person who buys
example: Mr. Carl Icahn: Well, yeah. I mean China is a great buyer of all of these commodities.
exampleZh: 卡尔·伊坎先生：嗯，我认为,中国是这些原产品的大买主。

meaning: v. 发嗡嗡声，发蜂鸣声；匆忙走动；充满嘈杂声；充满想法；繁忙，充满活力；给（某人）打电话；（飞机）低空飞过；（用蜂鸣器）呼叫；n. 嗡嗡声，蜂鸣声；叽叽喳喳声，嘈杂声；兴奋，快乐；热闹有趣的气氛，时尚氛围；电话；流言，传闻；adj. （词语、想法或活动）时髦的；【名】 （Buzz）（美、印、俄）巴兹（人名）
definition: 1. to make a continuous, low sound such as the one a bee makes；2. to press a buzzer in order to get someone's attention
example: I'll give you a buzz on Monday, OK?
exampleZh: 我星期一给你打电话行吗？

meaning: prep. 由，被；通过，凭借……；相差；在……旁边；到……之前；抓着（身体或东西某个部位）；按照，依据；以……计；在……期间；在（某处）短暂停留；乘以，除以；以……名义（发誓）；就（本性、职业或出身）而言；adv. 经过
definition: 1. adv. so as to pass a given point；2. adv. in reserve; not for immediate use
example: By and by she met an old man with a beard.
exampleZh: 她不久就碰到了一个大胡子老头。

meaning: v. 绕过，避开；对（动脉等）作分流术，为……作搭桥术；不顾（规章制度），不请示；n. 旁路，旁道；分流术，搭桥手术；旁通管，分流器
definition: 1. n. a road that takes traffic around the edge of a town；2. v. avoid something unpleasant or laborious
example: Traffic in the town has dropped off since the bypass opened.
exampleZh: 这条旁道通车后，城里来往的车辆就减少了。

meaning: n. 旁观者，局外人
definition: 1. n. a nonparticipant spectator
example: A bystander named John Roulstone wrote a poem about the event, then, at some point, Hale herself seems to have helped write it.
exampleZh: 一个名叫约翰·罗尔斯登的旁观者就此事写了首诗，然后在某个时间，赫尔自己似乎也帮助完成该作品的创作。

meaning: n. 驾驶室；出租车，的士；（旧时的）出租马车；（吉他的）扬声器箱；v. 乘出租车旅行
definition: 1. n. a compartment at the front of a motor vehicle or locomotive where driver sits；2. v. ride in a taxicab
example: Yes, there're lots of good restaurants, lots of... I like to walk, so I never take a cab.
exampleZh: 是的，这儿有很多好的饭店，很多很多……我喜欢散步，从来不打车。

meaning: n. 卷心菜，洋白菜；（作蔬菜食用的）卷心菜叶子，洋白菜叶子；（冒犯）（因受伤或疾病而）身心残损的人；生活极乏味的人
definition: 1. n. any of various types of cabbage；2. v. make off with belongings of others
example: For all the talk about eating cabbage and eating with ordinary people, even then Hermitage cost a lot of money.
exampleZh: 尽管他花了大笔金钱在"隐士山"葡萄酒上,但是他爱吃卷心菜以及与普通民众一同进餐

meaning: n. 小木屋；船舱；机舱，客舱；v. 使身居斗室
definition: 1. n. small room on a ship or boat where people sleep；2. v. confine to a small space, such as a cabin
example: We kind of meet together and we say, if anyone's cabin burns down we'll all come over and help.
exampleZh: 我们会聚在一起商定，如果有人的房子烧毁了,我们都会来帮忙。

meaning: n. 内阁；储藏柜，陈列柜；私人小房间，密室；机箱，机壳；adj. 内阁的
definition: 1. n. a piece of furniture resembling a cupboard with doors and shelves and drawers; for storage or display；2. n. persons appointed by a head of state to head executive departments of government and act as official advisers
example: The President was very open and encouraging of his senior staff and cabinet to disagree with the way he was going.
exampleZh: 布什总统非常开明,经常会鼓励他身边的同事和内阁,对他选择的道路提出不同意见。

meaning: n. 电缆；钢缆，缆绳；电报；有线电视；v. 给……安装有线电视；给……发电报
definition: 1. n. a telegram sent abroad；2. v. send cables, wires, or telegrams
example: and this I think only in the USA, New Orleans is the only other city that has cable cars.
exampleZh: 并且在美国的其它城市中，除了新奥尔良市，没有第三个城市还有有线缆车了。

meaning: n. 咖啡馆，小餐馆
definition: 1. n. a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold
example: Here, this is a more modern example with a little hash cafe next to it or something.
exampleZh: 看这个,这个例子就更现代一些了,旁边还有些小咖啡馆杂然而列

meaning: n. 自助食堂，自助餐馆
definition: 1. n. a restaurant where you serve yourself and pay a cashier
example: I went and had an overpriced cup of coffee in the hotel cafeteria.
exampleZh: 我到宾馆的自助餐厅里喝了杯过于昂贵的咖啡。

meaning: n. 笼子；监狱；电梯梯厢；（击球练习的）挡球网；足球（或曲棍球）球门；v. 把……关进笼中，把……囚禁起来；【名】 （Cage）（英）凯奇，（法）卡热（人名）
definition: 1. n. an enclosure made or wire or metal bars in which birds or animals can be kept；2. v. confine in a cage
example: He opened up a cage and lifted out a 6ft python.
exampleZh: 他打开一个笼子，提起了一条6英尺长的蟒蛇。

meaning: n. 饼状食物，饼；块，小块；轻而易举的事；钱或资产总额；蛋糕；v. （用会变干的东西厚厚地）覆盖；（干后）结成硬块；【名】 （Cake）（英）凯克，（塞）察凯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a block of solid substance (such as soap or wax)；2. v. form a coat over
example: If you don't know why you're about to eat cake like that you will soon, but you know this.

meaning: n. 计算，运算；估算，预测；算计，盘算

meaning: n. 强烈愿望，使命感；行业，职业；（动物或人的）喊叫；v. 打电话；叫作；呼唤（call 的现在分词形式）

meaning: adj. 镇静的，沉着的；平静的，稳定的；风平浪静的；n. （精神或情感状态的）镇静，平和；宁静，安静；v. 使平静，使镇静；冷静下来，镇静下来；恢复平静，恢复正常；【名】 （Calm）（法、德）卡尔姆（人名）

meaning: n. 骆驼；驼绒织品；驼色，浅黄褐色；打捞浮筒；adj. 驼色的，暗棕色的；【名】 （Camel）（法）卡梅尔，（阿拉伯）卡迈勒（人名）

meaning: v. 取消（计划好的事情）；终止，废除；盖销，注销；（因素，情况）抵消，对消；n. 取消，撤销；邮票注销章，戳记；经修正的版面；【名】 （Cancel）（法）康塞尔（人名）

meaning: n. 癌症；痼疾，社会恶习；巨蟹宫，巨蟹座（Cancer）；出生于巨蟹宫时段（即6月22日至7月22日）的人（Cancer）
