meaning: v. 俘获，捕获；夺取，占领；吸引，引起；记录，体现；拍摄，录制；吃掉（国际象棋棋子）；使（数据）保存于电脑中；俘获（原子，亚原子粒）；（河流）袭夺；n. 捕获，被捕获；被捕获的人（或物）；占领，攻占；夺取，抢占；（数据）存储
definition: 1. n. the act of forcibly dispossessing an owner of property；2. v. succeed in representing or expressing something intangible
example: And, in fact, if any electron comes in their midst, they'll capture it because the binding energy is so high.
exampleZh: 事实上，如果电子从中间进来，它们会捕获它,因为束缚能是如此之大。

meaning: n. 汽车，轿车；（火车的）车厢；（火车上作特殊用途的）车厢（如餐车、卧铺车厢）；（电梯的）梯厢，（索道或气球的）吊舱；战车；【名】 （Car）（土）贾尔，（法、西）卡尔，（塞）察尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a motor vehicle with four wheels; usually propelled by an internal combustion engine；2. n. a wheeled vehicle adapted to the rails of railroad
example: Who will help Tony the Tow Truck? "I cannot help you," says Neato the Car. "I don't want to get dirty."
exampleZh: 谁能来帮帮拖车托尼？，“我帮不了你“,小轿车尼陀说，“我怕脏“

meaning: n. （活动房式的）拖车；（供居住用的）有篷马车，大篷车；（一起旅行的）车队；v. 以车队形式旅行；乘坐大篷车（或拖车式活动房屋）旅行
definition: 1. a wheeled vehicle for living or travelling in, especially for holidays, that contains beds and cooking equipment and can be pulled by a car；2. a painted wooden vehicle that is pulled by a horse and in which people live
example: Her landlocked country is a desert land that was once a hub for ancient Saharan caravan routes.
exampleZh: 她居住的内陆国家是一片沙漠地，曾是古代撒哈拉商队路线的枢纽。

meaning: n. 碳水化合物，糖类；含碳水化合物的食物，糖类食物；含碳水化合物的食物，糖类食物
definition: 1. one of several substances, such as sugar or starch, that provide the body with energy, or foods containing these substances such as bread, potatoes, pasta, and rice；2. A carbohydrate is also a food that contains a large amount of carbohydrate such as bread, fruits, and vegetables
example: Gram for gram the fat provides a lot more punch in terms of calories than protein or carbohydrate.
exampleZh: 与蛋白质或碳水化合物相比，每克脂肪提供了更多以卡路里来计的热量。

meaning: n. 碳；复写纸；炭精棒；碳纤维；adj. 碳的，碳处理的；【名】 （Carbon）（英）卡本，（西）卡尔翁，（法）卡尔邦（人名）
definition: 1. n. an abundant nonmetallic tetravalent element occurring in three allotropic forms: amorphous carbon and graphite and diamond; occurs in all organic compounds；2. n. a thin paper coated on one side with a dark waxy substance (often containing carbon); used to transfer characters from the original to an under sheet of paper
example: So either a potassium cyanide or sodium cyanide, these are used in synthesis in terms of making carbon-carbon bonds.
exampleZh: 因此无论是氰化钾还是氰化钠，都被用来在合成过程中,制造碳碳键。

meaning: n. 银行卡，身份证；明信片，贺卡；名片；纸牌；纸牌游戏（cards）；活宝，怪人；硬纸板；优势，王牌；存储卡，插件；赛事安排；梳理工具；v. 要求出示身份证；亮牌；（高尔夫比赛中）得分；在卡片上记录；梳理；【名】 （Card）（英）卡德（人名）
definition: 1. n. one of a set of small pieces of stiff paper marked in various ways and used for playing games or for telling fortunes；2. v. separate the fibers of
example: I could actually swipe a card and generate electronic receipt via email and then send it out to a person.
exampleZh: 这下，我真的能刷刷卡，发一封邮件，把电子回执,发给对方。

meaning: n. 硬纸板，纸板箱；adj. 不真实的，做作的；硬纸板制的
definition: 1. n. a stiff moderately thick paper；2. adj. without substance
example: He reached into the cardboard box beside him.
exampleZh: 他把手伸进他旁边的纸板箱。

meaning: n. 红衣主教；基数，纯数；红衣凤头鸟；猩红，鲜红；adj. 最主要的，基本的
definition: 1. a priest of very high rank in the Roman Catholic Church；2. a number that represents amount, such as 1, 2, 3, rather than order, such as 1st, 2nd, 3rd
example: Saint Paul enumerates what we now call the cardinal virtues: ; "And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity."
exampleZh: 圣保罗列举了我们现在所说的基本美德：,信念，希望，仁爱，这三种;,最重要的美德就是仁爱“

meaning: n. 照料，护理；小心，谨慎；忧虑，烦恼；收养，监护；v. 照顾，照料；在意，担忧；喜欢，想要；【名】 （Care）（英）凯尔，（塞）察蕾（人名）
definition: 1. n. the work of providing treatment for or attending to someone or something；2. v. feel concern or interest
example: but it's just like a time when they really took the care to look at how to construct things.
exampleZh: 但它代表了一个时期，那时他们真正关注搞建筑的方法。

meaning: adj. 仔细的，小心的；谨慎的，周密的
definition: 1. adj. exercising caution or showing care or attention；2. adj. cautiously attentive
example: I love chemistry now. Be very careful what you say. Have any of you made that statement about hating a subject?
exampleZh: 我现在很喜欢化学,所以你们说话的时候,可要小心咯？

meaning: adj. 粗心大意的，疏忽的；自然的，随便的；淡漠的，不关心的；【名】 （Careless）（英）凯尔利斯（人名）
definition: 1. adj. marked by lack of attention or consideration or forethought or thoroughness; not careful；2. adj. effortless and unstudied
example: It only takes one careless driver to cause an accident.
exampleZh: 只要有一个粗心大意的驾驶员便会发生车祸。

meaning: n. 职业，事业；职业生涯；速度，行程；adj. 就业的，职业的；终身从事的；v. 猛冲
definition: 1. n. the particular occupation for which you are trained；2. v. move headlong at high speed
example: I think it takes your breath away to think of the unspeakably high hopes that John Milton had for his career.
exampleZh: 我觉得像弥尔顿这样说出自己对职业如此高的希望,是很让人吃惊的。

meaning: n. （船或飞机装载的）货物；【名】 （Cargo）（英、西）卡戈（人名）
definition: 1. n. goods carried by a large vehicle
example: Instead of people you could use terms like "cargo," instead of murder, extermination.
exampleZh: 我不把你称为人，而称为“货物”,我不说谋杀，而说“根除”

meaning: n. 木匠，木工；v. 以木工活制作；做木工；【名】 （Carpenter）（英、葡、法）卡彭特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a woodworker who makes or repairs wooden objects；2. v. work as a carpenter
example: She was in the second year of her apprenticeship as a carpenter.
exampleZh: 她当木工学徒已是第二年了。

meaning: n. 地毯；覆盖地面的一层厚东西；人工球场；地毯衣蛾；v. 给……铺地毯；厚厚地铺上；训斥，斥责；【名】 （Carpet）（美、巴、印、法、比）卡尔佩特（人名）
definition: 1. n. floor covering consisting of a piece of thick heavy fabric (usually with nap or pile)；2. v. form a carpet-like cover (over)
example: where, you know... to see the stars and they have the red carpet.
exampleZh: 在那儿，……能看到明星，地上还铺着红地毯。

meaning: n. （旧时的）马车；（火车）车厢；滑架，托板；炮架，托架；婴儿车；运费，运输；仪态，姿态
definition: 1. n. a railcar where passengers ride；2. n. a vehicle with wheels drawn by one or more horses
example: I fought my way into a carriage just before the doors closed.
exampleZh: 我正好在车门关闭之前挤进了一节车厢。

meaning: n. 搬运人，运输工具；航空公司；军车，运输舰；购物袋；（自行车等的）置物架，载重架；带菌者，病毒携带者，病媒；通讯公司；载体；【名】 （Carrier）（英）卡里尔，（法）卡里耶（人名）
definition: 1. n. someone whose employment involves carrying something；2. n. a self-propelled wheeled vehicle designed specifically to carry something
example: He stooped to pick up the carrier bag of groceries.
exampleZh: 他弯腰提起装满食品杂货的购物袋。

meaning: n. 胡萝卜；（为鼓励某人做某事而作出的）诱人的承诺；红发人（carrots）
definition: 1. n. deep orange edible root of the cultivated carrot plant；2. n. perennial plant widely cultivated as an annual in many varieties for its long conical orange edible roots; temperate and tropical regions
example: I sit in my field. I'm eating my carrot. I hold it up and I say, "This is raw? It's ridiculous. 'Raw' as opposed to what?" Right?
exampleZh: 我坐在我的地上，我吃我的萝卜，我突然拿起它，说，这萝卜是生的吗，这简直荒谬，不是生的是什么，是吧？

meaning: v. 提，扛，背；携带，佩戴；运送，载运；传输（水、电等）；传播（疾病）；能记住，能回想起；支撑，承载；承担（责任）；推动，发展；具有（某种特质）；带有，导致；被判处（某种刑罚）；传得远；扔（或踢）到……距离；以多数同意批准（提议）；赢得……的支持；赢得（州或地区的）选举；标有，贴有；刊登，广播；出售；怀（胎）；保持姿态；（加法）进位；准确地唱；超重，超载；n. 搬运；带球跑；掷（击）球距离，（枪的）射程；随身携带（尤指枪）；（财政）转记，结转；水上运输的地方或路线；进位；【名】 （Carry）（英）卡里（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of carrying something；2. v. move while supporting, either in a vehicle or in one's hands or on one's body
example: I'm also part of a variety of social service organizations which seek federal funding to carry out their programs.
exampleZh: 我还参与了各类社会服务组织,它们寻求获得联邦资金以施行其计划。

meaning: n. （马拉的）大车，马车；小型机动车；购物车，手推车；v. 用车装运；搬运，移动；挟持，带走；【名】 （Cart）（英、芬）卡特，（法）卡尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a heavy open wagon usually having two wheels and drawn by an animal；2. v. draw slowly or heavily
example: if you've got a hill or valley and there's a cart on wheels it's going to go down to the bottom.
exampleZh: 如果我们有一座山或者山谷，并且,有一个有轮子的车，这辆车会自动滑到底部。

meaning: n. 硬纸盒，塑料盒；（内装小盒的）大包装盒，纸板箱；靶心白点；v. 用盒包装；制作纸箱；【名】 （Carton）（英、西）卡顿，（法）卡尔东（人名）
definition: 1. a box made from thick cardboard, for storing goods, or a container made from cardboard or plastic, in which milk or fruit juice, etc. is sold；2. a box made from thick cardboard, used for storing or transporting goods
example: I took a ballpoint pen and punched a hole in the carton.
exampleZh: 我拿了一支圆珠笔在纸板箱上戳了个孔。

meaning: n. 漫画，讽刺画；动画片，卡通片；草图，底图；v. 给……画漫画；画漫画
definition: 1. n. a humorous or satirical drawing published in a newspaper or magazine；2. v. draw cartoons of
example: Mickey Mouse, Donald Duck, and other Disney cartoon characters gave endless delight to millions of children.
exampleZh: 米老鼠、唐老鸭及其他迪斯尼卡通形象给数百万的儿童带来了无尽的欢乐。

meaning: n. 漫画家，动画片画家
definition: 1. n. a person who draws cartoons
example: "There's something about their delicate nature that appeals to me," says New Yorker cartoonist Roz Chast.
exampleZh: 《纽约客》的漫画家罗兹·查斯特说：“它们脆弱的特质吸引了我。”

meaning: v. 雕，刻；切下，割下；开创，赢得（carve out）；铺（路），修（路）；侵蚀，冲刷；减少，削减；【名】 （Carve）（西、瑞典）卡韦（人名）
definition: 1. to make something by cutting into a hard material, especially wood or stone, or to cut into a hard material in order to make something；2. to cut thin pieces from a large piece of cooked meat
example: We will look for a pumpkin, to carve into a jack-o'-lantern.
exampleZh: 我们要找一颗南瓜来雕南瓜灯。

meaning: n. 雕刻，雕刻品；雕刻术；v. 雕，刻；切下；开创，赢得（carve 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. a shape or pattern cut into wood or stone or the skill of doing this
example: The museum's medieval collection includes a wooden carving that once decorated the entrance to a monastery.
exampleZh: 这家博物馆的中世纪藏品中有一件木雕，它曾用来装饰一座修道院的入口。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 具体情况，实例；病例，病案；诉讼，官司；案件，案子；容器，箱子；事实，论据；（特定处境或品性的）人；（语法的）格；v. 围绕，包盖；（盗抢前）探察，踩点儿；装入保护容器内；【名】 （Case）（英）凯斯，（西）卡塞，（法）卡斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a comprehensive term for any proceeding in a court of law whereby an individual seeks a legal remedy；2. v. look over, usually with the intention to rob
example: In any case, Lambert Strether, as he arrives in Paris, has awakened to the sheer wonder of urbane culture.
exampleZh: 无论如何，朗伯，史瑞得到巴黎后完全被那里彬彬有礼的文化震撼了。

meaning: n. 现款，现金；金钱，资金；v. 兑现（支票）；支付现款；【名】 （Cash）（英）卡什（人名）
definition: 1. n. money in the form of bills or coins；2. v. exchange for cash
example: So, SIPC was set up in 1970 and SIPC insures cash accounts up to $100,000 and securities accounts up to $500,000.
exampleZh: 证券投资者保护公司于1970年成立,其对现金账户的保护金额高达10万美元,对证券账户的保护金额高达50万

meaning: n. 收银员，出纳员；v. 开除，革除（军职）
definition: 1. n. an employee of a bank who receives and pays out money；2. v. discard or do away with
example: And the cashier is taking a long time.
exampleZh: 所以结账要等很长时间。

meaning: n. 赌场；【名】 （Casino）（西、法）卡西诺（人名）
definition: 1. a building where games, especially roulette and card games are played for money；2. a building where games are played for money
example: Now he is suing the casino, charging that it should have refused his patronage because it knew he was addicted.
exampleZh: 现在他正在起诉这家赌场，指控它本应该拒绝他的光顾，因为它知道他上瘾了。

meaning: v. 投射（光，影）；将（视线，目光）投向；浇铸，铸造；分配角色；扔，掷，抛；描述，描写；投票；使人怀疑；使（魔咒）生效，施法；抛（钓丝），撒（网）；（生长过程中）蜕（皮），脱（角）；（马）失（蹄铁）；用（星相）占卜；（乡村舞蹈中的）转向；（猎）（狗）四处探寻失踪的嗅迹；放开（猎狗）以探寻嗅迹；用绳子绊倒（动物，尤指母牛）；n. 演员阵容；铸型，模型；（固定断骨用的）石膏； 特性，外貌；（眼睛）斜视；掷，投，抛；浅淡的色调；（猎狗）探寻嗅迹；（蚯蚓钻洞时拱到地面的）小土堆；（鹰或猫头鹰的）颗粒状呕吐物；一群鹰，隼；【名】 （Cast）（法）卡斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the actors in a play；2. v. put or send forth
example: You just can't just cast it away, and say it's no big deal. But because it is a deal.
exampleZh: 总不能置之不理，想着反正天也不会塌下来，那你就错了。

meaning: n. 城堡，堡垒；（国际象棋中的）车；豪宅；v. （国际象棋中）王车易位；置……于城堡中；【名】 （Castle）（英）卡斯尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a large and stately mansion；2. v. move the king two squares toward a rook and in the same move the rook to the square next past the king
example: so you remember the Chateau living``` ? the Chateau in the hallway of the enchanted castle ? you all remember that?
exampleZh: 还记得电影里的庄园`,魔法城堡的走廊里,都还记得吗？

meaning: adj. 休闲的，便装的；随便的，非正式的；漫不经心的，随意的；临时的，短期的；碰巧的，偶然的；不认真的，马虎的；不定期的，偶尔的；感情不深的，疏远的；n. 便服，便装（casuals）；临时工；散漫青年；待命士兵
definition: 1. adj. marked by blithe unconcern；2. adj. without or seeming to be without plan or method; offhand
example: Notice how very casual Yeats is in that second strophe, how self-consciously fantastic and speculative he is.
exampleZh: 注意叶芝在第二节,是多么随意，多么自觉的神奇,多么敏锐。

meaning: n. 伤亡人员；受害者，毁坏物；急诊室，急救室；事故，灾难（主要用于保险中）
definition: 1. a person injured or killed in a serious accident or war；2. a person or thing that suffers as a result of something else happening
example: That's a high casualty rate and many a military unit will break if they have that many casualties.
exampleZh: 这个比率相当高,在如此之高的伤亡率下,许多军事单位会因此而瓦解

meaning: n. 猫，猫科动物
definition: 1. n. feline mammal usually having thick soft fur and no ability to roar: domestic cats; wildcats；2. v. beat with a cat-o'-nine-tails
example: There is a cat outside the apartment building that starts to meow and the boys are interested in it.
exampleZh: 男孩儿们对楼外,叫唤的猫很感兴趣。

meaning: n. 目录，目录册，一览表（如图书馆、商品等的目录）；（计算机）系统目录，数据字典；（音乐、影视、出版等）某艺术家或公司的全部作品，作品全集；vt. 为……编目录，把……编入目录，把……登记入目录；vi. 编目录；按确定价格收入目录（等于 catalogue）
definition: 1. n. a book or pamphlet containing an enumeration of things；2. v. make a catalogue, compile a catalogue
example: We'll do a little catalog of them: "Of Man's First Disobedience and the Fruit" - that was line one, of course.
exampleZh: 我们来数一下：,“关于人类最初违反天神命令偷尝禁树的果子“,-这是第一句，当然。

meaning: n. 灾难，灾祸；麻烦，困境；惨败
definition: 1. a sudden event that causes very great trouble or destruction；2. a bad situation
example: From all points of view, war would be a catastrophe.
exampleZh: 从各个方面来看，战争都会是一场灾难。

meaning: adj. 灾难性的；极糟的，失败的；大规模突变的；（与）地质灾变（有关）的
definition: 1. causing sudden and very great harm or destruction；2. very bad
example: The minister gave a warning that if war broke out, it would be catastrophic.
exampleZh: 大臣警告说战争一旦爆发，将会是灾难性的。

meaning: v. 接住；抓住，握住；逮住，捕获；发现，撞见；钩住，绊住；击中，碰到；得病，染病；引起，吸引（注意或兴趣）；（对某事）感到兴奋；搭乘，赶上；及时做（或谈等）；出席，观看；表现，再现；使措手不及；察觉，瞥见；听清，理解；突然意识到；盛住（液体）；（板球）使被接杀出局；（棒球中）当接球手；受（光）照射；（风或水）裹挟，推动；着火，燃烧；遭遇，陷入（困境）；固定，系牢；被（悬浮物）覆盖；n. 接（球等）；（鱼的）捕获量，捕获物；理想的对象；门闩，吊扣；（声息）哽塞；隐患，隐藏的困难；（乐）轮唱片段；传接球游戏；捉人游戏
definition: 1. n. a drawback or difficulty that is not readily evident；2. v. discover or come upon accidentally, suddenly, or unexpectedly; catch somebody doing something or in a certain state
example: you know, sort of young children education programs in the United States catch up to nice countries, like Korea.
exampleZh: 美国的一些儿童教育项目也在紧跟一些出色的国家的步伐，比如韩国。

meaning: n. 种类，范畴
definition: 1. n. a collection of things sharing a common attribute；2. n. a general concept that marks divisions or coordinations in a conceptual scheme
example: Out of over 400 staff there are just 7 that fall into this category.
exampleZh: 400多个职员中只有7人属于这一类。

meaning: v. 提供餐饮服务，承办酒席；满足，迎合；【名】 （Cater）（英）凯特（人名）
definition: 1. v. provide what is desired or needed, especially support, food or sustenance；2. v. supply food ready to eat; for parties and banquets
example: In the contemporary western world, rapidly changing styles cater to a desire for novelty and individualism.
exampleZh: 在当代西方世界，快速变换着的款式迎合了人们对新奇和独特性的追求。

meaning: n. 大教堂，（主教控制的）教区总教堂
definition: 1. a very large, usually stone, building for Christian worship. It is the largest and most important church of a diocese
example: So there's the cathedral here, the Tower of London and Tate Modern, Globe Theatre, these kind of places,
exampleZh: 这里有大教堂、伦敦塔和泰特现代美术馆，环球剧院，诸如此类的地方，

meaning: adj. 罗马天主教的；广泛的，包罗万象的（catholic）；n. 天主教教徒；【名】 （Catholic）（美、印）凯托立克（人名）
definition: 1. including many different types of thing；2. Roman Catholic
example: I know a lot of kids from my high school went there because I went to a Catholic school.
exampleZh: 我认识好多高中同学上了那所学校，因为我念的是天主教高中。

meaning: n. 牛；家牛（包括牦牛、犎牛及水牛）；【名】 （Cattle）（意）卡特莱（人名）
definition: 1. n. domesticated bovine animals as a group regardless of sex or age
example: And in particular, dairy maids, whose responsibility was to milk cows, and so they had a very intimate relationship with cattle, often didn't get disease.
exampleZh: 特别是挤奶女工,她们的工作就是挤奶,她们与奶牛有紧密的关系,通常不会得天花

meaning: n. 花椰菜，菜花
definition: 1. a large, round vegetable that consists of a white mass of hard, tight, flower buds surrounded by green leaves
example: Stores really like orange cauliflower because it's a novelty, it's something different.
exampleZh: 商店真地喜欢橘黄色花椰菜，因为它是一种新奇的东西，与众不同。

meaning: n. 原因；事业；理由；v. 引起
definition: 1. n. events that provide the generative force that is the origin of something；2. v. give rise to; cause to happen or occur, not always intentionally
example: So inadvertent sins can be purged, the sanctuary defilement that they cause can be purged by bringing a purification sacrifice.
exampleZh: 无意的罪孽可以被净化，给圣所所带来的玷污,可以通过进行净化祭来净化。

meaning: n. 小心，谨慎；提醒，告诫；（警察向犯轻罪的人发出的）警告；v. 警告，提醒
definition: 1. n. the trait of being cautious; being attentive to possible danger；2. v. warn strongly; put on guard
example: But let me use the term "event" anyway, employing it with caution and as if in quotation marks.
exampleZh: 但是无论如何我还是使用，“事件“，这个词，小心谨慎地使用它，带引号地使用。

meaning: adj. 小心的，谨慎的
definition: 1. n. people who are fearful and cautious；2. adj. showing careful forethought
example: I think it's a matter of, as a cyclist, being cautious, but also not being afraid.
exampleZh: 我想作为一个骑自行车的人，这是自己小心的问题，但是也不必害怕。

meaning: n. 洞穴，山洞；地窖；v. 洞穴探险；（在压力下）屈服，屈从；挖洞；塌落；int. 当心！；【名】 （Cave）（美、爱）凯夫（人名）
definition: 1. n. a geological formation consisting of an underground enclosure with access from the surface of the ground or from the sea；2. v. hollow out as if making a cave or opening
example: Edmund Spenser in the Faerie Queene does not bring Sir Guyon with his palmer through the cave of Mammon.
exampleZh: 埃蒙德·斯潘塞在《仙后》中并没有让盖恩,带着朝圣者穿越贪婪之神的洞穴。

meaning: n. 洞，腔；(牙齿的) 龋洞
definition: 1. a hole, or an empty space between two surfaces；2. a hole in a tooth
example: In contrast to cavity QED systems, the researchers can custom tailor the circuitry in many areas.
exampleZh: 与腔 QED 系统相比，研究人员可以在许多领域定制电路。

meaning: v. 终止，结束；n. 停止
definition: 1. n. (`cease' is a noun only in the phrase `without cease') end；2. v. put an end to a state or an activity
example: Dos Santos has demanded that UNITA sign a cease-fire and demobilize its troops.
exampleZh: 多斯·桑托斯强烈要求安哥拉彻底独立全国同盟签订停火协议并遣散它的军队。

meaning: n. 天花板，吊顶；上限，最高限度；最高飞行限度，升限
definition: 1. n. the overhead upper surface of a room；2. n. (meteorology) altitude of the lowest layer of clouds
example: Whenever I tried to sleep I would see huge, wobbly, white bags, like the full udders of cows, suspended from the ceiling above me.
exampleZh: 每次我即将入睡,总会看到白色的大袋子摇晃着，如同母牛涨涨的乳房从房顶垂下来。

meaning: v. 庆祝，庆贺；赞扬，赞美；主持（宗教仪式）
definition: 1. v. celebrate, as of holidays or rites；2. v. have a celebration
example: Celebrate your gifts, enjoy them, but don' t take pride in them, take pride in your decision and hardwork.
exampleZh: 为你的天赋欢呼，享受它们带来的乐趣，但为自己作出的决定和勤奋工作，而感到自豪。

meaning: n. 庆典，庆祝活动；庆祝，颂扬；宗教仪式的举行
definition: 1. n. a joyful occasion for special festivities to mark some happy event；2. n. any joyous diversion
example: The movie is a camp celebration of the fashion industry.
exampleZh: 这部电影夸张地颂扬时装行业。

meaning: n. 名声，名望；名人，明星
definition: 1. someone who is famous, especially in the entertainment business；2. the state of being famous
example: And a lot of these other places that are very famous for their celebrity clientele also are down there,
exampleZh: 而且这里还有很多以名人顾客光临而闻名的地方，

meaning: n. 细胞；小牢房；电解槽，电池；电芯；（政治组织的）小组，基层组织；（修道院中的）单人小室；（巢穴中单个的）巢室；（计算机屏幕上的）单元格；【名】 （Cell）（英）塞尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. any small compartment；2. n. (biology) the basic structural and functional unit of all organisms; they may exist as independent units of life (as in monads) or may form colonies or tissues as in higher plants and animals
example: If we think about the size of a typical cell - excuse me, now I'm getting confused about nuclei.
exampleZh: 它大约是10的,负十四次方米，如果我们考虑。

meaning: n. 地下室，地窖；窖藏酒；v. 将（酒）存于地窖；【名】 （Cellar）（捷）采拉尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. the lowermost portion of a structure partly or wholly below ground level; often used for storage；2. n. an excavation where root vegetables are stored
example: Water had started to leak into the cellar.
exampleZh: 水已开始渗入地下室。

meaning: n. 手机
definition: 1. n. a hand-held mobile radiotelephone for use in an area divided into small sections, each with its own short-range transmitter/receiver；2. v. call up by using a cellular phone
example: The new policy prohibits students from using a cell phone during formal examinations.
exampleZh: 新规定禁止学生在正式考试期间使用手机。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: adj. （温度）摄氏的；n. 摄氏温度；【名】 （瑞、印尼、巴、印）摄尔西乌斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. Swedish astronomer who devised the centigrade thermometer (1701-1744)
example: I'm going to write it like this three moles of hydrogen which is a gas one bar 100 degrees Celsius.
exampleZh: 我会写成这样：,三摩尔氢分子，气体,1巴，100摄氏度。

meaning: n. 水泥；胶合剂，接合剂；（对关系、看法等起巩固作用的）纽带；牙骨质；（黏附颗粒的）沉积岩基质；（填充牙齿龋洞的）黏固粉；v. 用（水泥或胶合剂）黏结，胶合；巩固，加强；决定，确立
definition: 1. n. concrete pavement is sometimes referred to as cement；2. v. make fast as if with cement
example: with the cement and the statue and stuff, so it's a lot different.
exampleZh: 现在这里都是水泥钢筋建筑物、艺术雕塑，所有的这些，都跟之前不一样了。

meaning: n. 公墓，墓地
definition: 1. an area of ground in which dead bodies are buried
example: Go into Grove Street Cemetery some go visit his grave and say, "It's not your fault Eli."
exampleZh: 走进韦街公墓,会有人到他的坟前悼念,说,"这不是你的错,伊莱"

meaning: n. 检查员，审查官；潜意识抑制力；（古罗马）监察官；v. 审查，删改（书、电影、信件等）
definition: 1. a person responsible for examining books, films, works of art, or communications, and deciding whether to prevent parts or the whole of them from being seen or made available to the public because they are considered to be offensive or harmful, or because they contain information that someone wishes to keep secret, often for political reasons；2. a computer tool used to hide parts of a text, image, recording or communication, or to prevent it from being shared
example: The director objected to the cuts ordered by the censor.
exampleZh: 导演反对按审查员的指令作删剪。

meaning: n. 审查，检查，审查制度
definition: 1. the action of preventing part or the whole of a book, film, work of art, document, or other kind of communication from being seen or made available to the public, because it is considered to be offensive or harmful, or because it contains information that someone wishes to keep secret, often for political reasons；2. a system in which an authority limits the ideas that people are allowed to express and prevents books, films, works of art, documents, or other kinds of communication from being seen or made available to the public, because they include or support certain ideas
example: Milton devotes a lot of time in Areopagitica to making a number of attempts to distinguish licensing from censorship.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿在《论出版自由》中花了很大功夫,试图区分出版许可管理和出版控制。

meaning: n. （官方的）统计，人口普查；v. 对……进行人口调查；统计……的数目
definition: 1. a count for official purposes, especially one to count the number of people living in a country and to collect information about them；2. an occasion when people or things are officially counted, especially when the people in a country or particular area are counted and general information about them is recorded. The report listing this information is also called a census
example: The detailed assessment of the latest census will be ready in three months.
exampleZh: 有关最新人口普查的详细评估工作将在3个月内就绪。

meaning: n. 分（美元、欧元等的货币单位）；小钱；分毫（用来强调没钱）；（乐）音分；【名】 （Cent）（法）桑（人名）
definition: 1. n. a fractional monetary unit of several countries；2. n. a coin worth one-hundredth of the value of the basic unit
example: What you'll do is every day for the next 30 days give me one cent, next day two, four, eight and so on.
exampleZh: 你们要做的是在未来30天给我一分钱，第二天二分，然后是四分，八分，以此类推。

meaning: n. （地理位置）中间，中心点；（机构，组织）活动中心；关注点，焦点；中间派，中间立场；中锋；v. 把……放在中央；（使）以……为中心，（使）注意力集中于；（使）主要发生在，（使）集中于；n. （Center）森特（人名）
definition: 1. n. an area that is approximately central within some larger region；2. v. center upon
example: The band's performance that night at the Seattle Center Coliseum was a letdown.
exampleZh: 该乐队当晚在西雅图中心体育馆的表演令人大失所望。

meaning: adj. 中央的，中心的；起支配作用的，有控制力的；最重要的，主要的；n. 活动中心
definition: 1. n. a workplace that serves as a telecommunications facility where lines from telephones can be connected together to permit communication；2. adj. serving as an essential component
example: All of this is Darwinian thinking and, I think, increasingly will be central in importance in the twenty-first century.
exampleZh: 这就是达尔文所思考的，我认为，这在二十一世纪会越来越重要。

meaning: v. 集权控制，使集中；实行中央集权
definition: 1. v. make central
example: In the mass production era, multinational firms tended to centralize their operations.
exampleZh: 在大规模生产时期，跨国公司倾向于集中运营。

meaning: n. 摄氏温度；adj. 摄氏度的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to a temperature scale on which the freezing point of water is 0 degrees and the boiling point of water is 100 degrees
example: And you have this liquid alloy at 600 degrees centigrade, and it turns into a molten salt.
exampleZh: 你得到了液态合金,在600度的时候，它就转变成熔融盐。

meaning: n. （计量）厘米，公分（公制长度单位，等于一米的百分之一）
definition: 1. n. a metric unit of length equal to one hundredth of a meter
example: All the samples were taken from a centimeter-long, extremely thin ribbon of the metallic glass.
exampleZh: 所有的样品都取自一厘米长的极薄的金属玻璃带。

meaning: n. 世纪；一百年；（板球）一百分
definition: 1. n. a period of 100 years；2. n. ten 10s
example: All of this is Darwinian thinking and, I think, increasingly will be central in importance in the twenty-first century.
exampleZh: 这就是达尔文所思考的，我认为，这在二十一世纪会越来越重要。

meaning: n. 陶瓷制品，陶瓷器；制陶艺术；adj. 陶瓷的
definition: 1. made from clay that has been shaped and then baked until hard；2. clay that has been shaped and then baked until hard
example: I had seen her ceramic work and asked if she would be interested in making some tiles for us.
exampleZh: 我看过她的瓷器作品，问她有没有兴趣为我们做一些瓷砖。

meaning: n. 谷类食物；谷类植物，谷物；adj. 谷类的；谷类制成的
definition: 1. n. grass whose starchy grains are used as food: wheat; rice; rye; oats; maize; buckwheat; millet；2. adj. made of grain or relating to grain or the plants that produce it
example: and a good old English breakfast where you have a load of cereal and then bacon, eggs, tomatoes,
exampleZh: 一顿好的老式英国早餐有一条燕麦面包，然后夹培根、鸡蛋、西红柿，

meaning: n. 仪式，典礼；礼节，礼仪，客套
definition: 1. n. a formal event performed on a special occasion；2. n. any activity that is performed in an especially solemn elaborate or formal way
example: In Genesis 15,God's promise to Abraham is formalized in a ritual ceremony.
exampleZh: 创世纪》15中上帝对亚伯拉罕的应许是通过仪式起效的。

meaning: adj. 仪式的，礼节的；（职务）礼仪性的，象征性的；n. 仪式，典礼，礼节
definition: 1. n. a formal event performed on a special occasion；2. adj. marked by pomp or ceremony or formality
example: Up to now the post of president has been largely ceremonial.
exampleZh: 到目前为止，总统职位在很大程度上是礼仪性的。

meaning: adj. 必然的，必定的；确定的，无疑的；某个，特定的；某位，一位叫……的；一定程度上的，有点儿；pron. 某些，某几个；n. （Certain）（美、法）塞尔坦（人名）
definition: 1. adj. definite but not specified or identified；2. adj. having or feeling no doubt or uncertainty; confident and assured
example: All right. With all this said, how can the theorist recuperate honor for certain names like, for example, his own?
exampleZh: 好了，说完这些以后，一个理论家该如何,为一些特定的名字，比如，他自己的，恢复尊严呢？

meaning: adv. 无疑，确定；当然，行（用于回答）
definition: 1. adv. definitely or positively (`sure' is sometimes used informally for `surely')
example: But I certainly won't stop them from seeking plastic surgery if that makes them feel better about themselves.
exampleZh: 但是如果整容可以让他们自我感觉更良好，我当然不会阻止他们接受整容手术。

meaning: n. 确实，确定性；确实的事，必然的事
definition: 1. n. the state of being certain；2. n. something that is certain
example: Such attitudes are valueless unless they reflect inner cognition and certainty.
exampleZh: 这种态度如果不能反映内心的认知和确定性就毫无价值。

meaning: n. 证明，证书；文凭，成绩合格证书；电影放映许可证；v. 发证书给……，用证书证明
definition: 1. n. a document attesting to the truth of certain stated facts；2. v. present someone with a certificate
example: She didn't like the course but she stuck it out to get the certificate.
exampleZh: 她并不喜欢这门课，但为了拿证书还是耐着性子学完了。

meaning: v. 证明，证实；给……颁发合格证书；证明（某人）患有精神病；保证
definition: 1. to say in a formal or official way, usually in the form of an official document, that something is true or correct；2. to say officially that someone is mentally ill
example: Each year they audit our accounts and certify them as being true and fair.
exampleZh: 每年他们都会审核我们的账目，以证明其准确合理。

meaning: n. 证明，资质证书；出具课程结业证书
definition: 1. the process of earning an official document, or the act of providing an official document, as proof that something has happened or been done；2. proof or a document proving that someone is qualified for a particular job, or that something is of good quality
example: An employer can demand written certification that the relative is really ill.
exampleZh: 雇主可要求书面证明以证实这位亲属确实病了。

meaning: n. 链，链条；一连串，一系列；连锁商店；镣铐；测链；连环式（指一群房主先售后购的置屋方式）；约束，束缚；v. 用锁链拴住；拘禁，束缚
definition: 1. n. a series of things depending on each other as if linked together；2. v. connect or arrange into a chain by linking
example: OK, this is only true for an ideal gas, and we went through that mathematically where the, with a chain rule.
exampleZh: 这一关系只对理想气体成立，上节课我们,用链式法则推导出了这一关系。

meaning: n. 椅子；主席，委员长；电椅；大学教授的职位；v. 主席，主持；用椅子把某人高高抬起；使……入座；使就任要职；【名】 （Chair）（法）谢尔 （人名）
definition: 1. n. a seat for one person, with a support for the back；2. v. act or preside as chair, as of an academic department in a university
example: I think even if you're in a chair, and you're sitting up straight with good posture, maybe hands on knees.
exampleZh: 哪怕只是坐在椅子上，坐直并保持良好姿势，也许双手放在两膝上。

meaning: n. （尤指男性）主席，（委员会或组织的）负责人；（公司）总裁，（组织）主席；会议主持人，大会主席；轿夫；（自1949年）中国共产党主席（Chairman）；v. 主持，掌管
definition: 1. abstract: The chairman, also simply known as the chair, is the highest officer of an organized group such as a board committee, or deliberative assembly. The person holding the office is typically elected or appointed by the members of the group.
example: Arthur Burns, chairman of the Fed, There's a big inflation run up to Richard Nixon's reelection in 1972.
exampleZh: 亚瑟·伯恩斯，前美联储主席，当时出现了严重的通货膨胀,一直持续到1972年,理查德·尼克松连任总统。

meaning: n. 白垩；粉笔；白垩地层；用粉笔划的记号；v. 用粉笔写（或画）；用粉笔做记号；用白垩粉擦（桌球杆等）；把（酒钱）记于（某人）账上；获（胜），得（分）；变成白垩状；【名】 （Chalk）（美、英、加）乔克（人名）
definition: 1. n. a soft whitish calcite；2. v. write, draw, or trace with chalk
example: But suppose you are in a train and you're moving past me and you look at this piece of chalk.
exampleZh: 但假如你在火车上,从我面前驶过,你看着这支粉笔

meaning: n. 挑战，难题；挑战书，比赛邀请；质疑，质询；喝停盘查；v. 挑战，向……下战书；质疑，拒绝接受；盘问，查问；考验
definition: 1. n. a demanding or stimulating situation；2. v. take exception to
example: So I think that it's true that the economy is difficult and there is big challenge in front of us.
exampleZh: 所以我觉得，目前的经济形势真的很困难，我们面临着很大的挑战。

meaning: adj. 富于挑战性的，困难而有趣的；挑衅的，不赞同的；v. 挑战，向……下战书；质疑，拒绝接受；考验（challenge 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. requiring full use of your abilities or resources；2. adj. stimulating interest or thought
example: Building a home from scratch can be both exciting and challenging.
exampleZh: 白手起家既激动人心又具有挑战性。

meaning: n. 房间，室；会议厅，会所；议院；腔，膛；洞穴；卧室；法官办公室，律师事务所（chambers）；v. 把子弹送入弹膛；把……关在房间里；adj. 室内的；私人的，秘密的；【名】 （Chamber）（英）钱伯（人名）
definition: 1. a room used for a special or official purpose, or a group of people who form (part of) a parliament；2. a judge's private office. A judge may have legal discussions with lawyers in private in his or her chambers.
example: He thought he saw someone lurking above the chamber during the address.
exampleZh: 他以为他看见有人在演讲时潜藏在了会议室里。

meaning: n. 香槟酒；香槟色；【名】 （Champagne）（法，英）尚帕涅（人名）
definition: 1. n. a white sparkling wine either produced in Champagne or resembling that produced there；2. n. a region of northeastern France
example: There's one professor here who toasts his class with a champagne at the end of a term.
exampleZh: 有一个教授期末在班上用香槟敬酒。

meaning: n. 冠军，第一名；拥护者，斗士；v. 捍卫，拥护，支持；adj. 极好的；冠军的，得一等奖的；【名】 （Champion）（英）钱皮恩，（法）尚皮翁（人名）
definition: 1. n. someone who has won first place in a competition；2. v. protect or fight for as a champion
example: In the current world champion of chess, I think Vladimir Kramnik, was defeated in December by a chess-playing program.
exampleZh: 当前的国际象棋世界冠军,弗拉基米尔?克拉姆尼克,就在今年12月被一个国际象棋程序击败

meaning: n. 锦标赛；冠军称号，冠军地位；捍卫，拥护
definition: 1. n. the status of being a champion；2. n. a competition at which a champion is chosen
example: and we also go to a national championship with all the teams here.
exampleZh: 我们也和其他队伍一同参加国家锦标赛。

meaning: n. 机会，时机；可能性；危险，冒险；运气，偶然；v. 偶然，碰巧；冒险做；adj. 偶然的，碰巧的；【名】 （Chance）（英）钱斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a possibility due to a favorable combination of circumstances；2. v. be the case by chance
example: And I had done well, so I knew that I had a good chance of getting into graduate school,
exampleZh: 我的表现也不错，所以，我知道我有很大的机会被研究生院录取，

meaning: n. （英国）财政大臣；（德国或奥地利）总理；（英国大学）名誉校长，（美国大学）校长；法官；【名】 （Chancellor）（英）钱塞勒（人名）
definition: 1. a person in a position of the highest or high rank, especially in a government or university；2. the Chancellor of the Exchequer (= the person in the UK government in charge of tax and government spending)
example: By the time I was vice chancellor, the Senate had become a much larger and a much more democratic body.
exampleZh: 到我做副校长的那个时候，大学评议会已经成为一个更大、更民主的机构了。

meaning: v. 改变，变化；更换，替换；换乘；兑换，找零；交换，互换；n. 变化，变革；找回的钱，零钱；换乘；替代物，替换衣物；全新体验；转成新月；钟乐敲打的一种套路
definition: 1. n. an event that occurs when something passes from one state or phase to another；2. v. undergo a change; become different in essence; losing one's or its original nature
example: A change in the money supply brings a corresponding change in expenditure.
exampleZh: 货币供应量的改变随即引起支出的相应改变。

meaning: n. 频道，电视频道；管道，通道，航道；渠道，手段；沟渠，沟槽；河床；海峡；信道；电子沟道；输液道；v. 引导，把……用于；输送，传送；通灵；努力赶上，受启发；形成凹槽；【名】 （Channel）（美）沙内乐（人名）
definition: 1. n. a path over which electrical signals can pass；2. v. transmit or serve as the medium for transmission
example: However, when that gate is opened, the sodium channel is now going to be incredibly selective and only let through sodium ions and no other type of ion.
exampleZh: 但是，当闸门打开的时候，钠离子通道,将会有极高的选择性,不允许除钠离子以外的任何其它离子通过。

meaning: v. 反复唱，反复呼喊；唱圣歌，诵经文；n. 反复喊的话，反复唱的调子；圣歌，颂歌；【名】 （Chant）（英）钱特（人名）
definition: 1. to repeat or sing a word or phrase continuously；2. to sing a religious prayer or song to a simple tune
example: Supporters began to chant slogans as the candidates entered the crowded hall.
exampleZh: 候选人进入拥挤的大厅时，支持者们开始高呼口号。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 混乱，无秩序状态；混沌；【名】 （Chaos）（西）查奥斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a state of extreme confusion and disorder；2. n. the formless and disordered state of matter before the creation of the cosmos
example: The storms and torrential rain caused traffic chaos across the country.
exampleZh: 暴风雨和倾盆大雨造成了全国的交通混乱。

meaning: adj. 混乱的，无秩序的；（与）……混沌（有关）的
definition: 1. adj. lacking a visible order or organization；2. adj. completely unordered and unpredictable and confusing
example: The traffic in the city is chaotic in the rush hour.
exampleZh: 在上下班高峰时间，城市的交通混乱不堪。

meaning: n. 小礼拜堂，小教堂；礼拜；印刷（或报业）工会会员，印刷（或报业）工会分部；殡仪馆；停尸房；adj. 非国教的；【名】 （Chapel）（英）查普尔，（法）沙佩尔（人名）
definition: 1. a room that is part of a larger building and is used for Christian worship；2. a building used for Christian worship by Christians who do not belong to the Church of England or the Roman Catholic Church
example: Paul Raushenbush My name is Paul Raushenbush. I'm the Associate Dean of Religious Life and Chapel at Princeton University.
exampleZh: 我是,普林斯顿大学教堂和宗教生活副院长。

meaning: n. 章，回，篇；阶段，时期；分会，分部；议会法案；一系列，一连串（a chapter of）；全体教士；宗教团体理事会；v. 把……分成章节
definition: 1. n. a subdivision of a written work; usually numbered and titled；2. n. any distinct period in history or in a person's life
example: And so, for today, for example, it says Classification Schemes, Mendeleev, Atomic Structure, A Readings Chapter 1, Chapter 2, Appendix A.
exampleZh: 今天，举个例子，讲的是分类法，门捷列夫，原子结构，阅读第1，第2章，和附录。

meaning: n. 性格，品质；特色，特征；人物，角色；勇气，毅力；某种人，古怪有趣的人；（书写或印刷）符号，文字，字体；名誉，名声；v. 刻，写；描述；使具有特征；【名】 （Character）（英）克拉克特（人名）
definition: 1. n. an imaginary person represented in a work of fiction (play or film or story)；2. v. engrave or inscribe characters on
example: You know, when you're out here more for the love of the character than you are for the cash,
exampleZh: 你知道，当你是为了工作本身而不是为了钱过来的时候，

meaning: n. 特征，特点，特色；adj. 独特的，典型的
definition: 1. n. a prominent aspect of something；2. adj. typical or distinctive
example: It's this drive to constant self-definition that becomes the characteristic feature of Milton's work for later generations.
exampleZh: 就是这种对自我界定的欲望,变成了弥尔顿留给后人的,作品的典型特征。

meaning: v. 描述，刻画；成为……的特征，是……的典型
definition: 1. v. describe or portray the character or the qualities or peculiarities of；2. v. be characteristic of
example: It revealed a secret about the manipulative and deceptive strategies used to make junk food more addictive and characterize the products as healthy.
exampleZh: 它揭示了一个关于那些被用来使垃圾食品更容易上瘾、并将产品塑造为健康食品的操纵性和欺骗性策略的秘密。

meaning: v. 充电；使……承担责任，赋予……责任；控告，指控；（公开）指责，责备；进攻，冲锋；把……记在账上；要价，收费（金额）；给（枪炮）装弹；斟满（杯子）；n. 电量，电荷；炸药量；掌管，照管；费用，价钱；控告，指控；（书面或口头的）指责，批评；需要照管的人；命令，指示；（人或动物的）猛攻，冲锋；快感，刺激；感召力，感染力；负载；【名】 （Charge）（英）查奇，（法）沙尔热（人名）
definition: 1. n. (criminal law) a pleading describing some wrong or offense；2. v. to make a rush at or sudden attack upon, as in battle
example: so, essentially, they're establishing or controlling or changing the difference between the charge inside the cell and the charge outside cell.
exampleZh: 因此本质上来说，它们制造或者控制或者改变,细胞内外电荷之间的电位差。

meaning: n. 慈善组织，慈善机构；慈善事业；仁慈，宽厚；赈济，施舍
definition: 1. n. a foundation created to promote the public good (not for assistance to any particular individuals)；2. n. a kindly and lenient attitude toward people
example: or any of the countries that used to be in the empire for exceedingly good charity work
exampleZh: 或者来自曾经是英国殖民地的做出突出慈善事业的人，

meaning: adj. 慈善的；仁慈的，宽容的；慷慨的
definition: 1. adj. relating to or characterized by charity；2. adj. full of love and generosity
example: We are happy to donate to bona fide charitable causes.
exampleZh: 我们很乐意向真正的慈善事业捐赠。

meaning: n. 魅力，魔力；护身符，咒语；小挂件，小饰物；粲，粲数；v. 吸引，迷住；诱使，哄诱；向……施魔法，用魔法控制；有魔力
definition: 1. n. attractiveness that interests or pleases or stimulates；2. v. attract; cause to be enamored
example: Thus isolated, thus removed, the vision acquired an especially keen charm that made me race with all speed toward my lone gratification.
exampleZh: 如此形影相吊，如此销魂，这景色生出,一种勾人心魄的诱惑力，促使我全速跑向,我孤独的尤物。

meaning: adj. 迷人的，富有魅力的；（表示不赞成）讨厌的，真够可以的；v. 吸引，迷住；哄诱；向……施魔法（charm 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. pleasing or delighting；2. adj. possessing or using or characteristic of or appropriate to supernatural powers
example: Most of the children when they travel there, we would probably go to her apartment But they would probably have a charming mill on the floor.
exampleZh: 大多数孩子,去那旅游时，都有可能去她家,她们家的地上可能会有,一台漂亮的磨粉机。

meaning: n. 图表，曲线图；海图，星位图；排行榜；v. 绘制；记录，跟踪；制定（行动计划）；进榜，上榜；【名】 （Chart）（泰）察（人名）
definition: 1. n. a visual display of information；2. v. make a chart of
example: Well, if we look on the chart, the first ionization energy is what is reported in your Periodic Table.
exampleZh: 如果我们查阅图表，一级电离能,已经在元素周期表上标示了。

meaning: n. 宪章，章程；特许状，许可证；不完善，漏洞；包租，租赁；v. 包租，租用；特许成立，给予……特权；adj. （临时）租用的；【名】 （Charter）（英、美）查特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a document incorporating an institution and specifying its rights; includes the articles of incorporation and the certificate of incorporation；2. v. hold under a lease or rental agreement; of goods and services
example: The First Bank of the United States was created in 1791 and they had a twenty-year charter which expired in 1811.
exampleZh: 美国第一银行于1791年,建立并且它们有20年的许可证,到1811年到期。

meaning: v. 追逐，追赶；匆忙赶往，急奔；追求，努力争取；求爱；驱逐，赶走；撤职；催促；镂刻，雕刻；n. 追赶，追逐；争取，努力获得；狩猎，猎捕；越野赛马，障碍赛马；【名】 （Chase）（英）蔡斯，（法）沙斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of pursuing in an effort to overtake or capture；2. v. go after with the intent to catch
example: The chase is always much more exciting than the conquest anyway.
exampleZh: 无论如何，追求总比征服更令人兴奋。

meaning: v. 闲聊，聊天；n. 闲聊，聊天；鸣禽；【名】 （Chat）（英、美、泰）沙（人名）
definition: 1. n. an informal conversation；2. v. talk socially without exchanging too much information
example: you do have the chance to have a bit of a chat and meet amazing people here.
exampleZh: 你就有机会遇到一些了不起的人，和他们聊会儿天。

meaning: adj. 便宜的，廉价的；价低质劣的；小气的，吝啬的；卑劣的，可耻的；无足轻重的；简单的，容易获取的；adv. 低价地，便宜地
definition: 1. adj. relatively low in price or charging low prices；2. adj. tastelessly showy
example: And the tickets are really cheap, at least compared to what you would be paying for them normally.
exampleZh: 那些门票真的很便宜，至少比你平时买的票便宜。

meaning: v. 欺骗，行骗；侥幸逃脱，逃避；作弊；对配偶（或伴侣）不忠；n. 骗子，作弊者；欺骗手段，欺诈行为；秘技，作弊软件
definition: 1. to act dishonestly to gain an advantage; a person who behaves dishonestly
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: Oh, I could cheat and make, OK the upper bound a half, but that wouldn't be very honest.
exampleZh: 噢，我可以像作弊一样,把上界扩大两倍，但这看起来没什么用。

meaning: v. 检查，核对；查看，查询；克制，抑制；存放，寄放；托运；在……上打钩；将（对方的）军；n. 检查，核对；制止（手段），抑制（手段）；结账单；支票（=cheque）；方格图案；衣帽寄存处；寄存凭证；钩号；（国际象棋）将军；【名】 （Check）（英）切克（人名）
definition: 1. n. a written order directing a bank to pay money；2. v. examine so as to determine accuracy, quality, or condition
example: I'm going to just give you two examples of the way Moses and God act as a check upon each other.
exampleZh: 我会给大家举两个例子,就上帝和摩西克制对方脾气的例子。

meaning: n. 脸颊，面颊；厚颜无耻，放肆；半边屁股；v. 对……无礼，对……不懂规矩；【名】 （Cheek）（英）奇克（人名）
definition: 1. n. either side of the face below the eyes；2. v. speak impudently to
example: Here I paused in my fiction to shield my eyes and stanch the arrow-straight tracks clawed down my cheek.
exampleZh: 飞箭在我脸上笔直地犁出了一条伤口，我停止了幻想,遮住眼睛，赶忙去止血。

meaning: n. 欢呼声，喝彩声；加油口号，加油歌；欢快，愉快的情绪；v. 欢呼，喝彩；鼓励，鼓舞；【名】 （Cheer）（英、美、加、澳）舍尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a cry or shout of approval；2. v. give encouragement to
example: I think he misses her terribly. You might cheer him up.
exampleZh: 我觉得他太想念她了。你也许能使他振作起来。

meaning: adj. 欢快的，高兴的；令人高兴的，令人愉快的；乐观的，开朗的
definition: 1. adj. being full of or promoting cheer; having or showing good spirits；2. adj. pleasantly (even unrealistically) optimistic
example: They're all bright, they're all cheerful, they all say "Merry Christmas," etc., etc., etc.
exampleZh: 它们都是明亮，欢乐的代名词，都表示圣诞快乐。

meaning: n. 干酪，奶酪；（拍照时让人微笑的用语）笑一笑；大人物，大亨；截然不同；（表示不同情）抱歉啦，真倒霉；带皮的乳酪块；（黏稠度像乳酪的）膏，酱；原装乳酪样的扁圆物（如九柱戏等游戏中使用的木圆盘）；过分的温情；v. 激怒，使厌烦；停止
definition: 1. n. a solid food prepared from the pressed curd of milk；2. v. used in the imperative (get away, or stop it)
example: or you can get a triple-triple, which is three meat patties and three slices of cheese.
exampleZh: 或者你可以要个“三三”汉堡，里面有三块肉饼和三片奶酪。

meaning: n. 厨师，主厨；v. 当厨师；【名】 （Chef）（法）谢夫（人名）
definition: 1. n. a professional cook
example: I think he's perhaps a bit more sort of respected here as a chef than Jamie Oliver.
exampleZh: 我想，作为厨师，他在这里比杰米•奥利弗更受尊重。

meaning: n. 化学；化学成分，化学反应；（彼此间的）吸引
definition: 1. n. the science of matter; the branch of the natural sciences dealing with the composition of substances and their properties and reactions；2. n. the way two individuals relate to each other
example: What I want to do is get you to appreciate the unique perspective that you will get from studying solid-state chemistry.
exampleZh: 我要做的是，让你们,欣赏领会到它独特的远景,在学习固体化学的过程中。

meaning: adj. 化学的，与化学有关的；n. 化学品，化学制品；成瘾的药物
definition: 1. n. produced by or used in a reaction involving changes in atoms or molecules；2. adj. relating to or used in chemistry
example: I figured Chemical Engineering would be the best way to get into it because it's a really broad major.
exampleZh: 我发现化学工程应该是接触新能源的最好方式，因为这个专业覆盖面也很广。

meaning: n. 化学家；药剂师；药店，药房
definition: 1. n. a scientist who specializes in chemistry；2. n. a health professional trained in the art of preparing and dispensing drugs
example: All right. So hopefully we're pretty comfortable naming any type of wave function using the chemist terminology.
exampleZh: 好了，希望我们都可以,接受这种,用化学术语来命名任何类型的波函数了。

meaning: v. 珍视，珍爱；怀念（过去），抱有（希望）
definition: 1. v. be fond of; be attached to
example: When you have such one friend, cherish your friendship for life long.
exampleZh: 当你有这样一个朋友时，请珍惜你们的友谊。

meaning: n. 国际象棋，西洋棋；【名】 （Chess）（英）切斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. weedy annual native to Europe but widely distributed as a weed especially in wheat；2. n. a board game for two players who move their 16 pieces according to specific rules; the object is to checkmate the opponent's king
example: So, that was more like solving chess puzzles, and I couldn't have seen a career on that.
exampleZh: 所以这一切更像是解一个棋局，我原来从不认为哲学可以成为一种职业。

meaning: n. 胸部，胸膛；箱子，盒子，柜子；金库，钱库；v. 以胸部推（球）
definition: 1. n. the part of the human torso between the neck and the diaphragm or the corresponding part in other vertebrates；2. n. box with a lid; used for storage; usually large and sturdy
example: The only legitimate fighting is man against man, shield against shield, chest against chest, everybody else is a pussy.
exampleZh: 唯一合法的战斗方式是人对人,盾对盾,胸对胸,其他的就是孬种

meaning: v. 咀嚼，嚼碎；（为了品尝或因紧张而）不停地嚼，咬；（人或动物）咬，啃；n. 咀嚼；口香糖；供嚼用的烟草；咀嚼物；【名】 （Chew）（美、新、马、英、加）丘（人名）
definition: 1. n. a wad of something chewable as tobacco；2. v. chew (food)
example: Freud uses it as an explanation for why somebody might eat too much or chew gum or smoke.
exampleZh: 弗洛伊德用口腔期人格,来解释为什么会有人暴饮暴食,嚼口香糖或是抽烟。

meaning: n. 鸡；鸡肉；胆小鬼，懦夫；（儿童玩的）比试胆量的游戏；adj. 没勇气的，胆小的；v. 因害怕而放弃，胆怯（chicken out）
definition: 1. n. the flesh of a chicken used for food；2. adj. easily frightened
example: You can look at her and say, "We don't have any of the ingredients for chicken soup."
exampleZh: 你可以看着她，说“我们都没有做鸡汤的食材。”

meaning: adj. 首要的，主要的；为首的，首席的；n. 领袖，首领；酋长；（纹章）上段（盾徽顶部的宽横带）；adv. 主要地；首要地
definition: 1. n. a person who is in charge；2. adj. most important element
example: The fire chief was asked, CEO well, he wasn't exactly the fire chief. I guess he was the CEO.
exampleZh: 记者问消防队长，准确地说不是消防队长，我估计是。

meaning: n. 儿童，小孩；子女；深受（某时期思想）影响的人；孩子气的人，幼稚的人；缺乏经验的人
definition: 1. n. a young person of either sex；2. n. a human offspring (son or daughter) of any age
example: um, in one language and then go to another language you have to talk on the level of a child.
exampleZh: 再转换到另一门陌生的语言将是十分困难的，他的表达可能变得像儿童一样磕磕巴巴。

meaning: adj. 孩子的，孩子般的；幼稚的，孩子气的
definition: 1. adj. indicating a lack of maturity
example: It's time you put a stop to this childish behaviour.
exampleZh: 这种孩子气的行为你该收敛了。

meaning: n. 寒冷，寒意；着凉，受寒；害怕，担心；冷漠，敌意；冷模，冷模部件；v. （使）冷却，冰镇；使很冷；惊吓，使恐惧；放松；（使）沮丧，（使）扫兴；adj. 冷飕飕的；令人紧张的，令人害怕的
definition: 1. n. coldness due to a cold environment；2. v. depress or discourage
example: His words sent a chill down her spine.
exampleZh: 他的话让她觉得毛骨悚然。

meaning: adj. 阴冷的，寒冷的；有寒意的；不友好的，冷淡的；【名】 （Chilly）（法）希伊（人名）
definition: 1. n. very hot and finely tapering pepper of special pungency；2. adj. uncomfortably cool
example: It was too chilly for swimming.
exampleZh: 游泳太冷了。

meaning: n. 烟囱，烟道；（可容人攀登的）岩石裂缝；玻璃灯罩
definition: 1. n. a vertical flue that provides a path through which smoke from a fire is carried away through the wall or roof of a building；2. n. a glass flue surrounding the wick of an oil lamp
example: And lots of people who were chimney sweeps were executed because they had been cleaning chimneys and they had gun-- the equivalent, they had charcoal on their cheeks.
exampleZh: 许多被处决的人只是烟囱清扫工,原因只是他们清扫烟囱并且他们有枪,类似枪的东西,他们脸上有碳灰

meaning: n. 颏，下巴；v. 击打下巴；引体向上；【名】 （Chin）（泰）真，（柬）金，（越）九，（西）钦（人名）
definition: 1. n. the protruding part of the lower jaw；2. v. raise oneself while hanging from one's hands until one's chin is level with the support bar
example: But most people from what I see, put it on their chin.
exampleZh: 我看到的多数同学都放在了下巴上。

meaning: n. 瓷，瓷料；瓷器，瓷制品；朋友；中国（China）；adj. 瓷制的
definition: 1. n. a communist nation that covers a vast territory in eastern Asia; the most populous country in the world；2. n. high quality porcelain originally made only in China
example: At the same time, there are very large developing economies like China and India and Brazil
exampleZh: 与此同时，很大的发展中经济体，像中国、印度和巴西，

meaning: n. 炸薯条，炸薯片；芯片；碎块，碎屑；缺口，豁口；筹码；撮球，切球；木条；v. 打破，弄缺；（尤指用工具）削下，凿下；切成细条；撮球，挑球
definition: 1. n. a small fragment of something broken off from the whole；2. v. break off (a piece from a whole)
example: The release of prisoners was used as a bargaining chip.
exampleZh: 释放战俘被用作讨价还价的筹码。

meaning: n. 巧克力，朱古力；巧克力糖，夹心巧克力糖；巧克力饮料，一杯巧克力饮料；深褐色，巧克力色；adj. 巧克力的，巧克力味的；【名】 （Chocolate）（葡）绍科拉特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a beverage made from cocoa powder and milk and sugar; usually drunk hot；2. n. a food made from roasted ground cacao beans
example: And I just got a box lunch and there was a strange chocolate bar that I got.
exampleZh: 我得到了一盒午餐，里面有一根很奇特的巧克力棒。

meaning: n. 选择，抉择；选择的机会，选择权；选择范围，选择余地；入选者，被选中的东西；精选品；adj. 上等的，优质的；尖刻的，刻薄的；精选的
definition: 1. n. the person or thing chosen or selected；2. adj. of superior grade
example: I had choice for actions with people I know on the street, with people I met in rides to different places.
exampleZh: 我可以在街上与我认识的人交谈，和我在前往不同地方的路上遇到的人交谈。

meaning: n. 唱诗班，合唱团；唱诗席；（合唱团的）声部；一组同类乐器；v. 合唱
definition: 1. a group of people who sing together；2. the area in a large church or cathedral intended for the choir and clergy to sit
example: Look at line 120. Milton writes that this choir had been singing at the moment of creation. Not bad.
exampleZh: 看到120行，弥尔顿写到这个唱诗班是在一个,创作的时刻唱歌的，不是不好的时刻。

meaning: v. 窒息，噎住，卡住；说不出话，哽咽；掐死，扼死；堵塞，塞满；（管子、渠道等）被阻塞，被塞满；失败；阻止，抑制；闷住，扑灭（火等）；窒息，噎住；n. 窒息，噎住的声音；阻气门
definition: 1. n. a coil of low resistance and high inductance used in electrical circuits to pass direct current and attenuate alternating current；2. v. breathe with great difficulty, as when experiencing a strong emotion
example: The plant will soon choke ponds and waterways if left unchecked.
exampleZh: 如不控制这种植物的生长，池塘和水道很快就要被阻塞。

meaning: n. 胆固醇
definition: 1. n. an animal sterol that is normally synthesized by the liver; the most abundant steroid in animal tissues
example: If you don't know your cholesterol level, it's a good idea to have it checked.
exampleZh: 如果你不知道自己的胆固醇水平，最好去查一下。

meaning: v. 选择，挑选；情愿，决定
definition: 1. v. pick out, select, or choose from a number of alternatives；2. v. select as an alternative; choose instead; prefer as an alternative
example: So first, I choose a volatility randomly, from some distribution of possible volatilities 2 from to, in this case, 0.2.
exampleZh: 来决定的一个值，所以首先我先随机选择一个浮动值，从可能的浮动值中的分布进行选择,在这个例子中就是0。

meaning: adj. 挑剔的，过分讲究的
definition: 1. adj. difficult to please
example: Donor countries are becoming more choosy about which countries they are prepared to help.
exampleZh: 捐赠国对受赠国的选择变得更加慎重了。

meaning: v. 剁，砍，劈；大幅削减；强行废止，取消；削（球）；变化无常（chop and change）；n. （羊或猪）排；剁，砍，劈；掌劈；（人或动物）嘴周围的地方；碎浪；动物饲料；商标；【名】 （Chop）（美、俄）肖普（人名）
definition: 1. n. the irregular motion of waves (usually caused by wind blowing in a direction opposite to the tide)；2. v. cut into pieces
example: Bodies can be destroyed because you can take a sword, sweep sweep sweep, and chop it into pieces.
exampleZh: 身体可以被毁掉,因为你可以拿把剑，刷刷刷几下，身体就会被看成碎片。

meaning: n. 筷子（常用复数形式 chopsticks 指一双筷子；单数指其中一根）
definition: 1. n. one of a pair of slender sticks used as oriental tableware to eat food with
example: So, a chopstick regime will make you slow down, think about your food more, and maybe even lose weight.
exampleZh: 所以，用筷子进食能让你放慢速度，更多关注食物，甚至减肥。

meaning: n. 和弦，和音；弦；（解）腱，带；v. 以和弦演奏（或歌唱、谱曲）；【名】 （Chord）（英）科德（人名）
definition: 1. three or more musical notes played at the same time；2. a straight line that joins the ends of an arc (= a curved line that forms part of a circle)
example: Once we get up there, that's sort of the end of the antecedent phrase and we have a chord change.
exampleZh: 前分句在这个高音部分结束，那是前分钟的结尾和弦发生转变。

meaning: n. 家庭杂务，杂活；累活，苦差事
definition: 1. n. a specific piece of work required to be done as a duty or for a specific fee
example: She starts at the beginning of her day and goes through task after task, chore after chore, project after project
exampleZh: 她从一天的开始说起，从一个任务说到另一个任务，从一件杂活说到另一件杂活，从一个项目说到另一个项目。

meaning: n. 副歌，叠句；合唱团，歌咏队；齐声，异口同声；合唱歌曲；（古希腊戏剧）合唱队，解说演员；(伊丽莎白时期戏剧）旁白；乐器扩音器；（演出中伴舞的）歌舞队；v. 齐声说，齐唱；【名】 （Chorus）（法）肖吕斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. any utterance produced simultaneously by a group；2. v. utter in unison
example: As a matter of style, the chorus would staunchly preach yes, for the sake of readability.
exampleZh: 作为一个格式风格问题，那是非常必要的，那样可读性更好。

meaning: n. 基督，耶稣基督；int. 天哪
definition: 1. n. a teacher and prophet born in Bethlehem and active in Nazareth; his life and sermons form the basis for Christianity (circa 4 BC - AD 29)；2. n. any expected deliverer
example: The birth of Christ was the beginning of a major epoch of world history.
exampleZh: 基督的诞生是世界历史一个重要时代的开始。

meaning: n. 圣诞节；圣诞节期间
definition: 1. n. period extending from Dec. 24 to Jan. 6；2. v. spend Christmas
example: Our first Christmas here, we were really upset that we weren't able to go home and see family during Christmas time.
exampleZh: 我们在这儿过的第一个圣诞节真的很失望，在圣诞节期间我们回不了家，也见不到家人。

meaning: n. 基督徒，信徒；adj. 基督教的，信基督教的；有基督教徒品格（尤指正派、仁慈和公正）的
definition: 1. n. a religious person who believes Jesus is the Christ and who is a member of a Christian denomination；2. adj. relating to or characteristic of Christianity
example: And I was saved, to use a Christian term, by articulations and representations of faith heroes connected with social justice.
exampleZh: 用基督教的说法，我被,信仰的表达和代表拯救了,而英雄们将这种信仰与社会正义相联系。

meaning: n. 基督教；基督教徒的品性
definition: 1. n. a monotheistic system of beliefs and practices based on the Old Testament and the teachings of Jesus as embodied in the New Testament and emphasizing the role of Jesus as savior；2. n. the collective body of Christians throughout the world and history (found predominantly in Europe and the Americas and Australia)
example: The Old Testament prophet had said, "All flesh is grass," an important verse for the new dispensation of Christianity.
exampleZh: 旧约里说，“凡有血气的，尽都如草“,这是基督教教义新体系中的重要一条。

meaning: adj. （疾病）慢性的，长期的；（问题）一直有的，反复出现的；难以根除的，积习难改的；糟透的，拙劣的；【名】 （Chronic）（英）克罗尼克（人名）
definition: 1. (especially of a disease or something bad) continuing for a long time；2. very bad
example: That you put together diseases of the heart, cancer, stroke, and then chronic respiratory diseases, those first top four are accounting for a huge number of deaths.
exampleZh: 心脏病,癌症,中风,和慢性呼吸道疾病,这四大疾病加起来造成了大量死亡

meaning: adv. 慢性地，经常复发地；长期地，习惯性地；严重地
definition: 1. in a way that continues or has continued for a long time
example: It is required by law to shut down banks which it regards as chronically short of capital.
exampleZh: 法律规定要关闭资金长期短缺的银行。

meaning: n. 编年史，大事记；（报纸名称）记事报；记事，叙述；v. 把……载入编年史，按事件顺序记载；翔实记载
definition: 1. a written record of historical events；2. part of the name of a newspaper
example: We talk about the San Francisco Chronicle all the time. It's like the main newspaper in the city.
exampleZh: 我们一直在谈论《旧金山纪事报》。它就像这个城市的主要报纸。

meaning: n. 大块，厚块；大量，大部分；话语组成部分，组块；矮胖的（男）人；v. 将……分成数份；将……组合（或归类）；扔，抛；发出“砰啷”声；切分，切割（数据）
definition: 1. a roughly cut piece；2. a part of something, especially a large part
example: You've got to do it above this chunk of code, you've got to do it inside this chunk of code.
exampleZh: 你不得不在一大段代码之上来实现它，你不得不在一大段代码之内来实现它。

meaning: n. 教堂；礼拜仪式；教派，教会；v. 把（产妇等）带到教堂做感恩礼拜；对……进行教会裁决；adj. 教会的；礼拜的；【名】 （Church）（英）丘奇（人名）
definition: 1. n. one of the groups of Christians who have their own beliefs and forms of worship；2. v. perform a special church rite or service for
example: I think even soul's emotion... People are a little too off for good church, for good church people. -Right.
exampleZh: 这也和“灵魂情感“有关。。。,人们对按时拜谒教会这件事，太冷淡，-是的。

meaning: n. 雪茄烟
definition: 1. n. a roll of tobacco for smoking
example: He had a few puffs at the cigar.
exampleZh: 他吸了几口雪茄。

meaning: n. 香烟，纸烟（cigarette 的拼写变体）
definition: 1. n. finely ground tobacco wrapped in paper; for smoking
example: The judgment of cigaret quality has been noted by tobacco and medico health fields.
exampleZh: 卷烟质量评判一直被国内外烟草界和医疗卫生界关注。

meaning: n. 电影院；电影（the cinema）；电影业，电影艺术；【名】 （Cinema）（意）奇内马（人名）
definition: 1. n. a medium that disseminates moving pictures；2. n. a theater where films are shown
example: or even like, sometimes we go to cinema, you know, or the Schubert Theater,
exampleZh: 有时我们也去电影院，或者舒伯特剧院，

meaning: n. 圆，圆形物；圈子，阶层；弧形楼座；黑眼圈；循环，周期；v. 盘旋，环行；围绕，圈起
definition: 1. n. ellipse in which the two axes are of equal length; a plane curve generated by one point moving at a constant distance from a fixed point；2. v. travel around something
example: Sure. I think that Columbus Circle is probably one of the most fashionable places in the city.
exampleZh: 当然可以。我觉得哥伦布环岛可能是这座城市里最时尚的地方之一。

meaning: adj. 圆形的，环形的；循环的，绕圈的；循环论证的；传阅的；n. （同时送达多人的）印刷品，宣传单
definition: 1. n. an advertisement (usually printed on a page or in a leaflet) intended for wide distribution；2. adj. having a circular shape
example: So some scholars have suggested that maybe the letter to the Ephesians was originally intended as a circular letter.
exampleZh: 所以有些学者认为,也许以弗所书原本是一份通函。

meaning: n. 电路，回路；巡回活动，巡回地；环道，环线；巡回赛；赛车道；（英国）巡回审判区，巡回上诉法院；（一套）体操动作；统一经营的连锁剧院（或影院）；v. （绕……）环行
definition: 1. n. an electrical device that provides a path for electrical current to flow；2. v. make a circuit
example: It must struggle against events which would help to achieve its goal too rapidly--by a kind of short-circuit.
exampleZh: 它会在危险中挣扎,因为危险会太早把它带到终点。

meaning: v. （液体或气体）环流，循环；传播，流传；传阅，传送；来往应酬，周旋
definition: 1. v. become widely known and passed on；2. v. cause to become widely known
example: Rumours were already beginning to circulate that the project might have to be abandoned.
exampleZh: 有关这个项目可能被迫放弃的流言已经开始在四处传播。

meaning: n. 发行量，销售量；血液循环；流传，流通；参加社交活动，交际；环流，循环；（图书的）借出
definition: 1. n. the dissemination of copies of periodicals (as newspapers or magazines)；2. n. movement through a circuit; especially the movement of blood through the heart and blood vessels
example: What is a Little Magazine? Well, very often they were big They were little because their circulation was small.
exampleZh: 那么小杂志是什么？，其实它们大多是比较大型的,之所以说它们“小“是因为发行量。

meaning: n. 条件，情况，环境；境况，经济状况；详情，原委；命运，境遇；v. 处于某种情况
definition: 1. n. a condition that accompanies or influences some event or activity；2. n. the set of facts or circumstances that surround a situation or event
example: The defenses had to do with necessity, their dire circumstance, and, implicitly at least, the idea that numbers matter.
exampleZh: 有人说他们在那样的处境下，不得已而为之，并且暗含了“人数重要“的理念。

meaning: n. 马戏团，马戏演员；马戏表演；乱哄哄的人群，热闹的场面；圆形广场，环形交叉口；（古罗马）露天圆形竞技场
definition: 1. n. a travelling company of entertainers; including trained animals；2. n. performance given by a traveling company of acrobats clowns and trained animals
example: Yeah, so I mean, obviously Piccadilly Circus with the big screens is in so many films. Everybody knows it.
exampleZh: 好的，显然地，大屏幕的皮卡迪利广场出现在很多电影里。所有人都知道它。

meaning: v. 引用，援引；引证，引以为例；传唤，传讯；嘉奖，表彰；n. 引用，引文
definition: 1. n. a short note recognizing a source of information or of a quoted passage；2. v. make reference to
example: That permits people to cite it as a model with a straight face eight decades after it was enacted?
exampleZh: 让人们引以为典范,以严肃的态度认为,即使这个新政已是八十年前的事情了？

meaning: n. 引文，引语；传唤，传票；表彰，嘉奖状；引用，引证
definition: 1. n. an official award (as for bravery or service) usually given as formal public statement；2. n. (law) the act of citing (as of spoken words or written passages or legal precedents etc.)
example: You have to put a citation in there so that people know that you're not trying to plagiarize it,
exampleZh: 你要在文中标明引用，让人们知道你不是想要抄袭，

meaning: n. 市民，城镇居民；公民，国民
definition: 1. n. a native or naturalized member of a state or other political community
example: The Hobbesian citizen is not likely to be a risk taker, like a George Washington or an Andrew Carnegie.
exampleZh: 可以这样说,霍布斯笔下的公民是不可能做冒险家的,就像乔治·华盛顿和安德鲁·卡内基一样。

meaning: n. 公民资格，公民身份；公民义务，公民责任感
definition: 1. n. the status of a citizen with rights and duties；2. n. conduct as a citizen
example: He wants to replace that with a new kind of, I want to call it rational citizenship, philosophical citizenship.
exampleZh: 他想要以一种,新型态取而代之，我称之为理性的公民社会，达观的公民社会。

meaning: n. 城市，都市；市民，全市居民；市政府；充满……的地方；伦敦金融、商业区；（国王或女王授权的）特许市；（由州政府划定市界并授予特权的）特权市
definition: 1. n. a large and densely populated urban area; may include several independent administrative districts；2. n. an incorporated administrative district established by state charter
example: This is the modern city, not as a scene of fragmentation or despair, but rather a place of ascent and aspiration.
exampleZh: 这是一座现代化的城市，并不是破碎或绝望的场景，而是一座在上升的渴望之城。

meaning: adj. 城镇的，市政的；公民的，市民的
definition: 1. of or relating to a town or city, or the people who live in it；2. relating to the behaviour of a good member of society
example: We also found little interest in civic life beyond the tight circles of their family and immediate friends.
exampleZh: 我们也发现，除了他们的家庭和亲密朋友的小圈子之外，他们对公民生活几乎没有什么兴趣。

meaning: adj. 公民的，国民的，国内的；平民的，民用的；文明的，有礼貌的；民法的（非刑法的），民事的；习俗规定的，历法规定的；【名】 （Civil）（土）吉维尔，（法）西维尔（人名）
definition: 1. adj. applying to ordinary citizens；2. adj. not rude; marked by satisfactory (or especially minimal) adherence to social usages and sufficient but not noteworthy consideration for others
example: We can have a civil science, because politics is a matter of human making, of human doing, of human goings on.
exampleZh: 我们能够拥有民间科学，因为政治关系到人类的产生，人类的生存，人类的延续。

meaning: v. 教化，熏陶；改善，改进；使文明，使开化
definition: 1. v. train to be discriminative in taste or judgment；2. v. raise from a barbaric to a civilized state
example: "I think it would civilize people a bit more if they had decent conditions."—"I think you've hit the nail on the head."
exampleZh: “我认为如果人们有好的条件，就会使其更有教养一点。”—“我想你说到点子上了。”

meaning: n. 文明；文明社会，文明国家；人类社会；舒适的生活环境；教化，开化
definition: 1. n. a society in an advanced state of social development (e.g., with complex legal and political and religious organizations)；2. n. the social process whereby societies achieve civilization
example: It's good to be back in civilization after two weeks in a tent!
exampleZh: 在帐篷里住了两个星期后又回到人类文明的生活可真好呀！

meaning: n. 平民，百姓（区别于军、警）；adj. 平民的，民用的
definition: 1. n. a nonmilitary citizen；2. adj. associated with or performed by civilians as contrasted with the military
example: He is in charge of the civilian side of the UN mission.
exampleZh: 他在联合国使团中负责平民方面的事务。

meaning: v. 声称，断言；索取，索要（钱）；要求（拥有），认领；使丧生，致命；赢得，获得；值得，需要（花时间或精力）；n. 声称，断言；索要，索赔；权利，所有权；要求得到的土地使用权；专利新特征申明
definition: 1. n. an assertion of a right (as to money or property)；2. v. assert or affirm strongly; state to be true or existing
example: Milton elaborates on this claim that we should read and prove anything we want, for we are sufficient to judge aright.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿详尽阐明了这个论点，我们应该多读书,去求证自己想知道的所有事，因此我们才能够做正确的判断。

meaning: v. （用夹具）夹紧，夹住；紧紧抓住，牢牢固定住；给（车辆）上夹钳；保持（电信号）电压极限在规定水平；n. 夹具，夹钳；车轮固定夹；钳位电路；（窑内的）砖垛；（保护块根作物越冬的）草皮堆
definition: 1. a device made of wood or metal that is used to hold two things together tightly；2. to fasten two things together, using a clamp
example: Somebody forgot to bring along the U-bolts to clamp the microphones to the pole.
exampleZh: 有人忘记带来把麦克风夹在支杆上的U型螺栓。

meaning: n. 宗族，氏族；大家庭，大家族；集团，帮派；【名】 （Clan）（英）克兰（人名）
definition: 1. a group of families, especially in Scotland, who originally came from the same family and have the same name；2. a large family, or a group of people who share the same interest
example: To deal with the rabbit problem, settlers introduced stoats — a member of the weasel clan and a terrific predator.
exampleZh: 为了应对兔患，定居者引进了白鼬——黄鼠狼科的一员，也是极为厉害的捕食者。

meaning: v. 拍手，鼓掌；快速（或用力）放置；轻拍（背或肩膀）；使……砰然相击；（突然）把……关进监狱；n. 鼓掌，拍手；砰然巨响，霹雳声；（友好的）用手轻拍；淋病；【名】 （Clap）（西、英）克拉普（人名）
definition: 1. n. a sudden very loud noise；2. v. put quickly or forcibly
example: No, don't please don't clap, not for that one.
exampleZh: 别急着鼓掌。

meaning: n. 清晰易懂；思路清晰；（画面或声音的）清晰，清楚；清澈，明净；【名】 （Clarity）（英）克拉里蒂（人名）
definition: 1. n. free from obscurity and easy to understand; the comprehensibility of clear expression；2. n. the quality of clear water
example: You might use a yellow filter to improve the clarity of a hazy horizon.
exampleZh: 你可以用一个黄色滤光器来提高模糊的地平线的清晰度。

meaning: v. 澄清，阐明；（通过加热）使净化，使纯净
definition: 1. v. make clear and (more) comprehensible；2. v. make clear by removing impurities or solids, as by heating
example: Thank you for writing and allowing me to clarify the present position.
exampleZh: 谢谢你来信并允许我澄清目前的状况。

meaning: n. 澄清，阐明；净化
definition: 1. n. an interpretation that removes obstacles to understanding；2. n. the act of removing solid particles from a liquid
example: If you have other criteria that you would like to see included in this table, or need more clarification, e-mail me.
exampleZh: 如果您想在这个表中看到其他的标准，或者想澄清更多的疑问，请给我发电子邮件。

meaning: n. 冲突，交战；争论，争执；交锋，比赛；分歧，差异；（金属的）撞击声；（时间上的）冲突，撞期；（颜色、图案等的）不相配；v. 迥然不同，抵触；冲突，交战；争论，争执；（时间上）相冲突，同时发生；（颜色、图案等）不协调，不相配；（体育）交锋，对阵；（使）撞击发出铿锵声
definition: 1. n. a loud resonant repeating noise；2. v. crash together with violent impact
example: The only victors in a head-on clash between the president and the assembly would be the hardliners on both sides.
exampleZh: 总统与议会间正面冲突的惟一赢家将是双方的强硬派。

meaning: n. 扣子，扣环；紧握，紧抱；v. 扣住，扣紧；握紧，抱紧；紧紧缠绕
definition: 1. to hold someone or something firmly in your hands or arms；2. a tight hold with your hand or arms
example: She had sat there twiddling nervously with the clasp of her handbag.
exampleZh: 她坐在那里紧张地旋弄着手提包的搭扣。

meaning: n. 班级；（一节）课，上课时间；（某一科目的）课程；阶级，阶层；等级划分，等级制度；（货物、服务或人的）等级，类别；（飞机、火车等的）舱位等级，车厢等级；品味；同届毕业生；（英国大学的）学位等级；（生物）（植物或动物分类的）纲；（比赛的）组别；v. 把……归类，把……看作；把……编入某一班级；属于……类（或等级），被列为某类（或某级）；adj. 优秀的，出色的；【名】 （Class）（英、德）克拉斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. people having the same social or economic status；2. v. arrange or order by classes or categories
example: When we started with the entire class, I showed the children how to bind the book by hand.
exampleZh: 这门课最开始的时候，我向孩子们展示了如何把书用绳子缝起来。

meaning: adj. 典型的，有代表性的；一流的，经典的；古朴的，典雅的；糟糕的，讨厌的；n. 经典作品，杰作；杰出的事物，典范；传统活动，传统项目
definition: 1. n. a creation of the highest excellence；2. adj. characteristic of the classical artistic and literary traditions
example: you know, a lot of people like the, just the fact that it's Venice and it's classic and...
exampleZh: 很多人喜欢，就喜欢它是威尼斯海滩，很经典。

meaning: adj. 经典的，传统的；和古希腊与古罗马文化相关的；（音乐）古典的；文科的，人文科学的；典型的，有代表性的；相对论和量子力学理论前的概念、理论的，古典力学的
definition: 1. n. traditional genre of music conforming to an established form and appealing to critical interest and developed musical taste；2. adj. of or characteristic of a form or system felt to be of first significance before modern times
example: You can see on the handout those poems by those classical authors that Milton's Lycidas is most indebted to.
exampleZh: 讲义上有这些经典作者的经典诗作,弥尔顿的《利西达斯》是受这些诗作的启发写成的。

meaning: v. 把……分类，把……分级；把（信息）归入保密级别
definition: 1. v. arrange or order by classes or categories；2. v. declare unavailable, as for security reasons
example: And the major difference seems to be in how they classify their attorneys, their lawyers
exampleZh: 主要的区别似乎是他们怎样对律师进行分类，

meaning: n. 分类，分级；类别，级别；（动植物等的）分类学，分类法；（图书馆的书、磁带、杂志等的）分类系统，编目
definition: 1. n. the act of distributing things into classes or categories of the same type；2. n. a group of people or things arranged by class or category
example: And so, for today, for example, it says Classification Schemes, Mendeleev, Atomic Structure, A Readings Chapter 1, Chapter 2, Appendix A.
exampleZh: 今天，举个例子，讲的是分类法，门捷列夫，原子结构，阅读第1，第2章，和附录。

meaning: adj. 分类的，归类的；机密的，保密的；n. 分类广告；v. 把……分类，把……分级；把（信息）归入保密级别（classify 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. n. a short ad in a newspaper or magazine (usually in small print) and appearing along with other ads of the same type；2. adj. arranged into classes
example: He has a security clearance that allows him access to classified information.
exampleZh: 他有安全许可，这准许他接触机密。

meaning: n. 同班同学，同学
definition: 1. n. an acquaintance that you go to school with
example: She felt like a fifth-grader who had snitched on a classmate.
exampleZh: 她觉得自己就像个打同学小报告的小学五年级学生。

meaning: n. 教室，课堂（教学环境）
definition: 1. n. a room in a school where lessons take place
example: The corner of the classroom was damp where the roof had leaked.
exampleZh: 教室漏雨的一角是湿的。

meaning: n. 从句，分句；（法律文件的）条款；【名】 （Clause）（法）克洛斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. (grammar) an expression including a subject and predicate but not constituting a complete sentence；2. n. a separate section of a legal document (as a statute or contract or will)
example: He has a clause in his contract which entitles him to a percentage of the profits.
exampleZh: 他在他的合同里有一项条款保证他享有一定比例的利润。

meaning: n. （动物的）爪，爪子；（水生有壳动物的）螯，钳；爪形器具，钳形工具；v. （用爪）撕，抓；挠痒；（帆船）迎风而行
definition: 1. n. sharp curved horny process on the toe of a bird or some mammals or reptiles；2. v. move as if by clawing, seizing, or digging
example: It has three pairs of legs, each ending in a large claw.
exampleZh: 它有3对腿，每条腿的末端都有一个大爪子。

meaning: n. 黏土，陶土；（网球场的）硬固泥地，红土网球场；肉体；似黏土的东西；黄棕翼欧洲蛾；v. 用黏土处理；【名】 （Clay）（英、法、西、意、葡）克莱（人名）
definition: 1. n. a very fine-grained soil that is plastic when moist but hard when fired；2. n. water soaked soil; soft wet earth
example: So while he fashions this clay figure, This carcass actually--and then breathes life, his own life into it.
exampleZh: 他便创造了一个黏土人物，这便是身体，然后他吹进了生命之气。

meaning: adj. 洁净的，干净的；讲卫生的，爱干净的；无有害物的，无污染的；清醇的，清新的；无污点的，清白的；公正的，遵守规则的；不私藏违禁品的；没吸毒的，没喝酒的；纯洁的，正派的；文明的，无色情的；平滑的，平整的；迅速彻底的；（行动）干净利落的；空白的，未写过的；（文件）无错误的；（木材）无树节的；v. （使）清洁，清理；变干净；清扫，做清洁工；干洗；（烹饪前）清除（动物）内脏；n. 清洁，清扫，打扫；adv. 彻底地，完全地；干净地，纯洁地；【名】 （Clean）（英）克林（人名）
definition: 1. n. a weightlift in which the barbell is lifted to shoulder height and then jerked overhead；2. v. make clean by removing dirt, filth, or unwanted substances from
example: You know, she's really nice about it. We don't really talk about it, but we're both very clean people,
exampleZh: 她这方面很好。我们真的不需要谈论这个，但我们都是很爱干净的人，

meaning: v. 使清洁，清洗；清理，整顿（坏人或不良的情形等）；免除（某人）的罪过；（圣经译文）治愈（麻风病患者）；n. 对某物（尤指皮肤）的清洁
definition: 1. to make something completely clean；2. to make someone or something morally clean or pure
example: Right after your last cigarette, your body will begin to cleanse itself of tobacco toxins.
exampleZh: 在最后一根香烟后，你的身体将马上开始清除烟草毒素。

meaning: adj. 易懂的，明白的；明显的，明确的；完全了解的，清楚的；透明的，清澈的；易看清的，听得清的；（颜色）明亮的，鲜明的；（皮肤）光洁的；没有问题的，健康的；晴朗的；畅通的，无阻碍的；（时间）空闲的；完整的；问心无愧的，清白的；头脑清醒的，思维敏锐的；（比分）领先的；未碰触的，悬离的；摆脱掉（不愉快事物）的；（钱款）净得的，纯收入的；发音清晰的；v. 清除，清理；恢复畅通，不再受阻；证明……无罪；批准，许可；准许……入境（出境）；（使）不再困惑，（使）变清醒；获利，净赚；清偿（债务）；兑现（支票）；（天气）变晴朗；（液体）变清澈；（视力）变清晰；（烟雾等）开始消失；（皮肤）变光滑，变健康；（表情）放松，舒展；使离开，清场；穿过，越过；解决，成功地处理；做完（所有工作）；踢出解围球；adv. 一直；离开，不靠近；清除了地，理清了地；全地，整地，满地，足地；清楚地，清晰地；n. 清白的，无罪的（in the clear）；不再困难的，已脱险的（in the clear）；清除；空隙；【名】 （Clear）（英）克利尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. the state of being free of suspicion；2. v. rid of obstructions
example: It's the sage and serious doctrine of virginity that concludes the speech. It's clear that something's happened between 1634 and 1637.
exampleZh: 它是总结演说,有关童贞的智慧而严肃的教义,很明显，在1634年到1637年间发生过什么。

meaning: adv. 清楚地，清晰地；毫无疑问，显然；明智地，清醒地
definition: 1. adv. without doubt or question；2. adv. in an intelligible manner
example: You could contrast the roguish and fanciful, clearly done by hand, title of the magazine, with that machine-type Blast.
exampleZh: 你们可以把这些明显手写的，无赖而稀奇的标题，和机械化的“暴风“相对比。

meaning: n. 审核批准；（飞机起降的）许可，准许；间距，间隙；清理，清除；（足球等中使对方不能破门的）解围；（银行支票的）结算，兑现
definition: 1. the process of removing waste or things you do not want from a place；2. an occasion when people are forced to move away from the area where they live permanently
example: They have to wait for clearance from air traffic control.
exampleZh: 他们必须等待空中交通管制队下达的起降许可令。

meaning: n. （树木被砍光的）皆伐区；adj. （某区域）无树木的；明显的，鲜明的；明确的，肯定的；v. 砍尽（某区域）的树木
definition: 1. v. remove all the trees at one time；2. adj. clearly or sharply defined to the mind
example: This was a clear-cut case of the original land owner being in the right.
exampleZh: 这是一起明显的原土地所有者有理的案件。

meaning: n. 清除，清理；林中空地；（英国）大学预科；结算；v. 澄清，放晴（clear 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. an area in a wood or forest from which trees and bushes have been removed；2. in the UK, a process by which places on university courses that have not been filled are offered to students in the last few weeks before term begins
example: He fired an arrow into a clearing in the forest.
exampleZh: 他把箭射进森林中的一片空地。

meaning: v. 攥紧（拳头等），咬紧（牙齿等）；紧握，紧咬；n. （身体部位的）紧缩，紧绷；【名】 （Clench）克伦奇（人名）
definition: 1. to close or hold something very tightly, often in a determined or angry way；2. to hold something tightly, or press together your lips or your hands in anger or determination
example: The next time you're faced with a choice that takes self-control, clench your fist or firm that bicep.
exampleZh: 下次当你面临需要自我控制的选择时，握紧你的拳头或收紧你的二头肌。

meaning: n. （总称）神职人员
definition: 1. religious leaders, especially Christian priests, ministers, etc.
example: At lower levels, the church is run by volunteers, so it has lower running costs than churches with salaried clergy.
exampleZh: 在较低层级，教会是由志愿者经营，因此它的运行成本比那些拥有带薪神职人员的教会更低。

meaning: n. 办事员，职员；售货员，店员；（宾馆）接待员；（法庭、市政会等负责管理文书的）文书，书记员；（英国国教会的）牧师；读书识字的人，学者；v. 当职员（或文书、书记员）；【名】 （Clerk）（英）克拉克（人名）
definition: 1. n. an employee who performs clerical work (e.g., keeps records or accounts)；2. v. work as a clerk, as in the legal business
example: A clerk had slipped the wrong tab on Tony's X-ray.
exampleZh: 一位职员失手把一个错误的标签贴到了托尼的X光片上。

meaning: adj. 文书的，办事员的；牧师的，神职人员的；n. 牧师
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to clerks；2. adj. of or relating to the clergy
example: The standard clerical dress throughout Europe was the long black cope.
exampleZh: 整个欧洲的标准牧师服装是黑色的长披肩。

meaning: adj. 聪明的，机灵的；机敏的，巧妙的；诙谐的；熟练的，灵巧的；耍小聪明的，滑头的；真聪明（用于讽刺某人做的蠢事）；健壮的，健康的
definition: 1. adj. skillful (or showing skill) in adapting means to ends；2. adj. showing self-interest and shrewdness in dealing with others
example: Now if you're clever enough maybe you could parlay it into a sense of the meaning of the text.
exampleZh: 如果你们够聪明,可以试着猜一猜文本的含义。

meaning: n. 陈词滥调，老生常谈，套话；（贬义）平庸（或老套）的人或事物；（印刷）铅版，铅版印刷；电版，电版印刷物；adj. （非正式，常作表语）陈腐的，老套的，缺乏新意的
definition: 1. a phrase, remark, or opinion that has very often been said or expressed before and is therefore not original and not interesting；2. something or someone that is not at all original, surprising, or interesting because it has very often been seen before
example: We've all heard the cliche before, actions speak louder than words, but it has real truth in business.
exampleZh: 我们都听过这句“陈词滥调”——行动胜于言语，但在商业中是有它的道理的。

meaning: v. （用鼠标）点击；发出咔嗒声；一见如故，受欢迎；突然明白，恍然大悟；配合默契，进展顺利；得到关注，引起兴趣；n. 短而尖的声音，咔哒声；点击；（南非语等语言的）倒吸气音
definition: 1. n. a short light metallic sound；2. v. move or strike with a noise
example: They click upon themselves as the breeze rises and turn many-colored as the stir cracks and crazes their enamel.
exampleZh: 一阵风吹起，树枝就咯喇喇响,闪射出五彩缤纷，原来这一颤动,冰块坼裂成瓷瓶上的无数细纹。

meaning: adj. 诊所的，医务室的；临床的，临床诊断的；冷静的，无感情的；简陋的，无装饰的；精确的，娴熟的

meaning: n. （动植物的）无性繁殖，克隆；极为相似的人（或事物），复制品；仿制品，山寨货；复制器，仿制机；外表或着装夸大男性气概的男同性恋者；v. 克隆，使无性繁殖；盗用（他人的手机号码），非法复制

exampleZh: 他们缓缓地把他向下放入驾驶舱，设法把他塞进那狭小的空间，并给系上了安全带。

meaning: n. 鸡尾酒；混合物；杂锦冷盘；adj. 鸡尾酒的；v. 喝鸡尾酒
definition: 1. a drink, usually an alcoholic one, made by mixing two or more drinks together；2. a mixture of different things, often an unexpected, dangerous, or exciting one
example: Celebrating a promotion, I took her to a posh hotel for a cocktail.
exampleZh: 为庆祝晋升，我带她去了一家豪华酒店喝鸡尾酒。

meaning: n. 椰子（果实）；椰子肉
definition: 1. a large fruit like a nut with a thick, hard, brown shell covered in fibre (= a mass of thread-like parts) and containing hard, white flesh that can be eaten and a clear liquid；2. the tall tropical tree on which coconuts grow
example: There's rice, coconut, cabbage soup diets, so you could use that kind of theme.
exampleZh: 比如米,椰子,卷心菜汤减肥法,你也可以写这个主题

meaning: n. 密码，暗码；（邮政）编码，（电话）区号；（计算机）编码；道德准则，行为规范；法典，法规；v. 把……编码（或编号）；把……译成密码；（给计算机）编写指令；【名】 （Code）（英、法、西）科德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a set of rules or principles or laws (especially written ones)；2. v. attach a code to
example: Suppose I want to do little piece of code that's going to do planar geometry, points in the plane.
exampleZh: 好，因此我需要一些,把这些东西收集到，一起的一些方式。

meaning: 共存；同时存在
definition: 1. to live or exist together at the same time or in the same place；2. to live or exist together, esp. in peace, at the same time or in the same place
example: Newspaper Web sites can coexist with the newspapers and still bring in healthy profit margins.
exampleZh: 网络报纸可以与纸质报纸共存，仍能带来不错的利润。

meaning: 共存；共处
definition: 1. the fact of living or existing together at the same time or in the same place
example: We developed an example integration scenario that could be enabled by any of the myriad of coexistence mechanisms.
exampleZh: 我们开发了一个示例集成场景，该场景可以由无数的共存机制所支持。

meaning: n. 咖啡（饮品）；一杯咖啡；咖啡豆或咖啡粉；咖啡色；咖啡树；（Coffee）人名，（英）科菲
definition: 1. n. a beverage consisting of an infusion of ground coffee beans；2. n. any of several small trees and shrubs native to the tropical Old World yielding coffee beans
example: So when you go, for example, in your neighborhood, if there's one coffee shop and you like their coffee,
exampleZh: 所以，举个例子来说，如果你住的小区有个咖啡店，而你又喜欢喝咖啡的话，你可以去，

meaning: adj. 认识的，认知的
definition: 1. connected with thinking or conscious mental processes；2. relating to or involving the processes of thinking and reasoning
example: And our students are probably more cognitive than many young people in our society at this point and they think deeply.
exampleZh: 在这个时代，我们的学生大概,比社会上的许多其他年轻人,更具备认知能力，他们思想深刻。

meaning: n. 认识，认知；认识（或认知）的结果
definition: 1. the use of conscious mental processes
example: Such attitudes are valueless unless they reflect inner cognition and certainty.
exampleZh: 这种态度如果不能反映内心的认知和确定性就毫无价值。

meaning: adj. 有条理的，连贯的；说话条理清晰的，易于理解的；团结一致的，凝聚的；（波）相干的，相参的；黏着的，黏连的
definition: 1. adj. marked by an orderly, logical, and aesthetically consistent relation of parts；2. adj. capable of thinking and expressing yourself in a clear and consistent manner
example: He has failed to work out a coherent strategy for modernizing the service.
exampleZh: 他无法想出一个连贯的策略来使该服务现代化。

meaning: n. 连贯性，条理性；凝聚，凝聚力
definition: 1. n. the state of cohering or sticking together；2. n. logical and orderly and consistent relation of parts
example: The campaign was widely criticized for making tactical mistakes and for a lack of coherence.
exampleZh: 该运动遭到广泛批评，因其有策略错误且缺乏连贯性。

meaning: n. 凝聚力，团结；内聚力；（句子、文章等在语法或含义方面的）连贯，衔接
definition: 1. n. the state of cohering or sticking together；2. n. (botany) the process in some plants of parts growing together that are usually separate (such as petals)
example: By 1990, it was clear that the cohesion of the armed forces was rapidly breaking down.
exampleZh: 到1990年时，武装部队凝聚力明显地迅速瓦解。

meaning: adj. 团结的，有凝聚力的；使团结的，使凝聚的
definition: 1. adj. causing cohesion；2. adj. cohering or tending to cohere; well integrated
example: "Daring Adventures" from '86 is a far more cohesive and successful album.
exampleZh: 1986年出的《勇敢的冒险》是一张极富凝聚力、极成功的唱片集。

meaning: n. （绳或线等的）卷，匝；（电路的）线圈；（汽车发动机的）盘管；子宫节育环；蚊香；成卷邮票；混乱，骚动；v. 卷，盘绕；【名】 （Coil）科伊尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a structure consisting of something wound in a continuous series of loops；2. v. to wind or move in a spiral course
example: Tod shook his head angrily and slung the coil of rope over his shoulder.
exampleZh: 托德生气地摇摇头，把那圈绳索甩过肩头。

meaning: n. 硬币，金属货币；塔罗牌中的一种花色（coins）；v. 创造新词，首次使用；铸币，造币；迅速而轻松地发财；【名】 （Coin）（西、意）科因，（法）库安（人名）
definition: 1. n. a metal piece (usually a disc) used as money；2. v. make up
example: We wanted this to be a twenty shilling coin but now in the market it's trading at twenty-one.
exampleZh: 我们希望它是一个值二十先令的硬币,但现在它在市场上以二十一个先令的价值来交换。

meaning: n. 硬币，金属货币；货币制度；新造的词，新词语的创造；铸币，造币
definition: 1. n. coins collectively；2. n. a newly invented word or phrase
example: In 1783 he secured the adoption of the decimal coinage in Congress.
exampleZh: 1783年他促使国会采纳了十进位币制。

meaning: v. 巧合，同时发生；一致，相符；相交，重叠
definition: 1. to happen at or near the same time；2. to be the same or similar
example: The kids' views on life don't always coincide, but they're not afraid of voicing their opinions.
exampleZh: 孩子们的生活观未必总是一致，但是他们不怕表达自己的观点。

meaning: n. 巧合，同时发生；相符，一致；符合
definition: 1. an occasion when two or more similar things happen at the same time, especially in a way that is unlikely and surprising；2. chance or luck
example: By a happy coincidence , we arrived at exactly the same time.
exampleZh: 碰巧运气好，我们刚好同时到达。

meaning: adj. 冷的，凉的；冷淡的，冷漠的；冷色调的；已变淡的；失去知觉的；真实的，客观的；扫兴的，灰蒙蒙的；远未猜中的；n. 感冒，伤风；寒冷，低温；adv. 突然地，彻底地；毫无准备地
definition: 1. n. a mild viral infection involving the nose and respiratory passages (but not the lungs)；2. adj. used of physical coldness; having a low or inadequate temperature or feeling a sensation of coldness or having been made cold by e.g. ice or refrigeration
example: you are concerned because you have a cold and you need to go work and you want to be seen.
exampleZh: 你有点担心，因为你有点感冒，但还是得上班，而你想尽快让医生检查一下。

meaning: v. 合作，协作；勾结，通敌
