definition: 1. v. work together on a common enterprise of project；2. v. cooperate as a traitor
example: That's the important thing they're engaging students and students work as teams, collaborate and learn from each other.
exampleZh: 最重要的是,它能使学生参与其中,以小组为单位工作，合作并互相学习。

meaning: n. 合作，协作；勾结，通敌；合作成果
definition: 1. n. act of working jointly；2. n. act of cooperating traitorously with an enemy that is occupying your country
example: Much hangs on the success of the collaboration between the Group of Seven governments and Brazil.
exampleZh: 很多事情都取决于七国政府集团与巴西之间合作的成功。

meaning: adj. 合作的，协作的
definition: 1. adj. accomplished by collaboration
example: We have the active learning, the collaborative learning from other students.
exampleZh: 我们有自主学习，从他人身上学的,互助式学习。

meaning: v. 倒塌，塌下；崩溃，瓦解；突然倒下，昏倒；瘫倒；突然贬值，暴跌；萎陷，瘪掉；折叠；n. 倒塌，塌陷；突然失败，崩溃；病倒，垮掉；突然贬值，暴跌
definition: 1. n. an abrupt failure of function or health；2. v. break down, literally or metaphorically
example: It's Huxley that said woe to the slaying of a beautiful theory by an ugly fact, nuclear collapse.
exampleZh: 赫胥黎说过,一个美丽的理论,被丑陋的事实所抹杀，核坍塌，真是科学的悲剧。

meaning: n. 衣领，领口；颈圈；（动物颈部颜色异样的）色圈，颈锁形条纹；箍，套管；（股票交易的）项圈策略；肉卷；猪颈部的熏肉块；（植物的）根颈；v. 抓住，逮捕；拦住（以便与之谈话）；【名】 （Collar）（英）科勒，（法）科拉尔，（西）科利亚尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a band that fits around the neck and is usually folded over；2. v. take into custody
example: For instance, are blue collar workers at the university getting paid a decent wage, are they compensated fairly.
exampleZh: 比如，大学工人们,的报酬是否过低，他们是否获得应有的补偿。

meaning: n. 同事，同僚
definition: 1. n. an associate you work with；2. n. a person who is member of your class or profession
example: The reason we picked these two cities we asked realtors- Karl Case, who's my colleague, he teaches at Wellesley College.
exampleZh: 我们选择这两个城市的原因,我询问了房产经纪人,卡尔·科斯是我的同事,他在韦尔兹利大学教书

meaning: v. 聚集，聚积；收集，采集；收藏；领取，接走；募捐，募集；使镇定，使集中思想；赢得，获得；收，收取；推断，推论；和……互撞，和……发生冲突；n. （某些基督教仪式上的）短祷文；打赢的赌，赢钱的赌注；adj. 对方付通话费的；adv. 对方付通话费地；【名】 （Collect）（英）科莱克特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a short prayer generally preceding the lesson in the Church of Rome or the Church of England；2. v. get or gather together
example: We could just collect a bunch of data. For a material .What's the volume it occupies at some pressure and temperature?
exampleZh: 对一种物质我们可以得到一系列测量数据,在给定的温度和气压下,它的体积是什么？

meaning: n. 收藏品，收集物；募捐；一堆（东西），一群（人）；系列时装；专辑，作品集；领取，收取；收集，采集；收账，收债；（尤指牛津大学的）学院期初（或期末）考试
definition: 1. n. several things grouped together or considered as a whole；2. n. a publication containing a variety of works
example: I was able to do letter writing, I was able to do data collection, and do a product there.
exampleZh: 我以前上书信写作的课，要上数据搜集的课，还要上美工课。

meaning: adj. 集体的，共同的；总的，集合的；n. 集体农庄，集体企业；集合名词
definition: 1. n. members of a cooperative enterprise；2. adj. done by or characteristic of individuals acting together
example: This principle of collective bargaining has been a mainstay in labour relations in this country.
exampleZh: 这种集体谈判原则已成为该国劳动关系的一个重要基础。

meaning: n. 大学，专科学校；学院，分院；公学；学会，社团；学院的全体师生
definition: 1. n. the body of faculty and students of a college；2. n. an institution of higher education created to educate and grant degrees; often a part of a university
example: There are tons of studios, and most of those are college kids. That's where "Yoga to the People" is.
exampleZh: 有数不清的工作室，其中的大多数是针对大学生的。“大众瑜伽”工作室就是在那儿。

meaning: v. 冲突，抵触；（迥异的事物）碰在一起；碰撞，相撞
definition: 1. (especially of moving objects) to hit something violently；2. (esp. of moving objects) to hit something violently
example: They take an atom of lead, accelerate it and have it collide with an atom of nickel.
exampleZh: 他们选取一个铅原子，将其加速,让它与镍的原子碰撞。

meaning: n. 碰撞，相撞；冲突，抵触；争用
definition: 1. an accident that happens when two vehicles hit each other with force；2. a strong disagreement
example: He said it was true that a collision had happened.
exampleZh: 他说碰撞真的发生了一次。

meaning: n. 结肠；冒号；（哥斯达黎加和萨尔瓦多的标准货币单位）科朗
definition: 1. n. the part of the large intestine between the cecum and the rectum; it extracts moisture from food residues before they are excreted；2. n. the basic unit of money in El Salvador; equal to 100 centavos
example: Berle was diagnosed with colon cancer last year and had been under hospice care for the past few weeks.
exampleZh: 去年伯利被诊断患有结肠癌，在过去的几周里他一直受到临终关怀护理。

meaning: 分号
definition: 1. n. a punctuation mark (`;') used to connect independent clauses; indicates a closer relation than does a period
example: But, you could have run them together using the semi-colon (;) separator, as shown in Listing 10.
exampleZh: 但是，也可以使用分号(；)分隔符一起运行它们，见清单10。

meaning: n. （陆军、空军或海军陆战队）上校；【名】 （Colonel）（法、罗）科洛内尔（人名）
definition: 1. an officer of high rank in the army or air force
example: He refers to himself with a variety of names and titles, as captain this, colonel that, general that.
exampleZh: 他用许多称号来称呼自己,例如 某某上尉,某某上校,某某将军

meaning: n. 殖民地；殖民团，移民队；聚集人群，聚居地（区）；群体，群落；（统称）英属殖民地；（美国独立前的）北美十三州
definition: 1. n. a body of people who settle far from home but maintain ties with their homeland; inhabitants remain nationals of their home state but are not literally under the home state's system of government；2. n. a group of animals of the same type living together
example: One of my favorite examples is the colony on the south shore of the Bosporus, which is called Chalcedon.
exampleZh: 其中一个我很常举的例子就是,在博斯普鲁斯南部海岸的殖民地,叫做卡尔西顿

meaning: adj. 殖民地的，殖民主义的；殖民地时期风格的；群体的；n. （尤指来自宗主国的）殖民地居民；殖民地时期式样的房屋
definition: 1. n. a resident of a colony；2. adj. of or relating to or characteristic of or inhabiting a colony
example: And... a lot of, a lot of the role was played by the colonial powers within the conflict.
exampleZh: 然后呢。,有很多事取决于殖民力量,在冲突中起的作用。

meaning: n. 殖民主义，殖民政策
definition: 1. n. exploitation by a stronger country of weaker one; the use of the weaker country's resources to strengthen and enrich the stronger country
example: Before colonialism, gender was more salient in central Kenya than it was in Ghana, although age was still crucial in determining authority.
exampleZh: 在殖民主义之前，性别在肯尼亚中部比在加纳更为突出，尽管年龄仍然是决定权力的关键因素。

meaning: v. 在……开拓殖民地，移民于殖民地；将（场所，产业）据为己用；移植于，大批繁殖于；从他地非法把选民移入
definition: 1. v. settle as a colony; of countries in the developing world；2. v. settle as colonists or establish a colony (in)
example: Science fiction writers have long dreamed that humans might one day quit the earth to colonize other planets.
exampleZh: 科幻小说作家们长期以来一直梦想着人类有一天可以离开地球移居到其它星球上。

meaning: n. 颜色，色彩；肤色；有色人种（常用于 people of color 等短语）；颜料；脸色，气色；生动，趣味，地方色彩；vt. 给……着色，涂颜色；影响，左右；歪曲，粉饰；vi. 变色，呈现颜色；adj. 彩色的，能产生彩色的（用于名词前）
definition: 1. n. a visual attribute of things that results from the light they emit or transmit or reflect；2. v. add color to
example: I mean, it will wake us up in the morning. It will be the color of a beautiful bird.
exampleZh: 我是觉得，那样的颜色会让我们在早上惊醒。它会是一只漂亮的鸟的颜色。

meaning: adj. 富有色彩的，色彩鲜艳的，华美的；有趣的，丰富多彩的，生动有趣的
definition: 1. adj. having striking color；2. adj. striking in variety and interest
example: And Rutherford, who I have already described to you as being a little bit colorful in his language, backed up Bohr on this.
exampleZh: 而卢瑟福，就是以前我跟你们提过的那个,语言丰富生动的人，在这一点上证实了波尔的理论。

meaning: n. 圆柱，纪念柱；柱状物；纵队，纵行（列）；（报纸、杂志上的）栏；（报纸或杂志的）专栏（文章）
definition: 1. n. a line of (usually military) units following one after another；2. n. a vertical glass tube used in column chromatography; a mixture is poured in the top and washed through a stationary substance where components of the mixture are adsorbed selectively to form colored bands
example: take a look at page 917, the left-hand column, where Derrida is talking not about Levi-Strauss but about Saussure.
exampleZh: 看一下第917页，左边，这里德里达不是在说列维而是在说索绪尔。

meaning: n. 专栏作家
definition: 1. n. a journalist who writes editorials
example: With us to talk about the findings in the study is Washington Post columnist Kevin Blackstone.
exampleZh: 《华盛顿邮报》专栏作家凯文·布莱克斯通将与我们一起探讨这项研究的发现。

meaning: n. 梳子；梳理；发卡；梳状物；鸡冠；蜂巢；v. 梳，梳理；认真搜寻，仔细搜查；（浪）涌起
definition: 1. n. a flat device with narrow pointed teeth on one edge; disentangles or arranges hair；2. v. straighten with a comb
example: You don't sound the 'b' in the word 'comb'.
exampleZh: 说comb时字母b不发音。

meaning: n. 战斗，搏斗；争论，反对；v. 与……作斗争；防止，减轻；adj. 战斗的；为……斗争的；【名】 （Comb）（法）孔巴（人名）
definition: 1. n. an engagement fought between two military forces；2. v. battle or contend against in or as if in a battle
example: The famed Socratic method of argumentation is basically all that remains of the older pre-Socratic culture of struggle and combat.
exampleZh: 著名的苏格拉底式辩论法,基本上，仍全盘维持旧时前苏格拉底式的,斗争与战斗文化。

meaning: adj. 好战的，好争论的
definition: 1. adj. inclined or showing an inclination to dispute or disagree, even to engage in law suits；2. adj. striving to overcome in argument
example: Daniels is at his best when he's cool and direct, rather than combative and polemical.
exampleZh: 丹尼尔斯冷静、坦率时表现最好，而好斗、爱辩时则不然。

meaning: v. （使）结合，组合；（使）化合；合并，协力；兼有，兼备；兼做，兼办；n. 联盟，联合体；联合收割机
definition: 1. n. harvester that heads and threshes and cleans grain while moving across the field；2. v. put or add together
example: The combine had cut a swathe around the edge of the field.
exampleZh: 联合收割机把庄稼绕田边割了一长条。

meaning: n. 结合体，联合体；结合，联合；（用于开锁的）数码组合；化合作用；两用（或多用的）物品；衫裤相连的内衣；组合；附边车的摩托车
definition: 1. n. a collection of things that have been combined; an assemblage of separate parts or qualities；2. n. a coordinated sequence of chess moves
example: So most of you know, hopefully, that a mule is a combination of a donkey and a horse.
exampleZh: 希望大部分同学都知道，骡子是驴和马的一种组合。

meaning: v. 来；来到，到达；来做，来取；同行，同去；行进（一定距离）来；赶走（某人）；变成，成为；达到，进入（某种状态或境地）；（事件）发生，（时间）到来；（提及的时间）到来；（如何）发生，出现；备有，可提供；达到（某一点或水准）；（经过时间的流逝）开始认为；想起，想到；谈论，谈到；位于，处于；（信件或消息）被收到；由……继承，归……所有；（案件）提交……审理；总共，共计；出身于；由……引起；（性质）体现出来；int. （用以鼓励或安慰）好了，得啦；n. 精液，精子；【名】 （Come）（英）科姆，（阿尔巴）乔梅（人名）
definition: 1. n. the thick white fluid containing spermatozoa that is ejaculated by the male genital tract；2. v. move toward, travel toward something or somebody or approach something or somebody
example: He's narrating in great detail what happened while he was in the womb. Where does this knowledge come from?
exampleZh: 他花了很大笔墨很详细地描写了,他还在子宫里发生的事，但他是怎么知道的呢？

meaning: n. 喜剧，喜剧片；滑稽的事物，搞笑的东西；滑稽，诙谐
definition: 1. n. light and humorous drama with a happy ending；2. n. a comic incident or series of incidents
example: It's a comedy that you only get once you performed and once you know what's happening, and
exampleZh: 这种喜剧只有你自己明白，只有你自己知道发生了什么，

meaning: n. 彗星；【名】 （Comet）（法）科梅（人名）
definition: 1. an object that moves around the sun, usually at a great distance from it, that is seen on rare occasions from the earth as a bright line in the sky
example: We were not altogether sure that the comet would miss the Earth.
exampleZh: 我们不太确定这颗彗星是否会错过地球。

meaning: n. 舒服，舒适；安慰，慰藉；令人感到安慰的人（或事物）；舒适的设施（或条件）；生活富足；v. 安慰，抚慰
definition: 1. n. a state of being relaxed and feeling no pain；2. v. give moral or emotional strength to
example: So we know that, so he will be there to comfort you and give you whatever help you need.
exampleZh: 我们理解大家,所以他会在那里安慰你,给你提供任何需要的帮助

meaning: adj. 令人舒适的；感到舒服的，安逸的；自信的，自在的；富裕的，宽裕的；满意的；易取胜的，轻松领先的；（病、伤后）疼痛减缓的，状况良好的；足够的；n. 温暖的盖被
definition: 1. adj. providing or experiencing physical well-being or relief (`comfy' is informal)；2. adj. free from stress or conducive to mental ease; having or affording peace of mind
example: to make sure that it's going to be a comfortable pair of shoes that last me a long time.
exampleZh: 来保证这双鞋很舒服而且可以穿很久。

meaning: adj. 滑稽的，好笑的；喜剧的；n. 喜剧演员；连环漫画
definition: 1. funny and making you want to laugh；2. a magazine or book that contains a set of stories told in pictures with a small amount of writing
example: His timing is perfect. He has, in other words, all of the attributes of a great comic writer.
exampleZh: 他也总是很懂得掌握时机，其实，他有当一个漫画作家的能力。

meaning: n. 逗号；间歇，音差；银纹多角蛱蝶
definition: 1. n. a punctuation mark (,) used to indicate the separation of elements within the grammatical structure of a sentence；2. n. anglewing butterfly with a comma-shaped mark on the underside of each hind wing
example: There should be an even number of entries after splitting the value using a comma as the delimiter.
exampleZh: 在使用逗号作为分隔符分隔值之后，应该有偶数个条目。

meaning: v. 命令，下令；统率，指挥；博得，赢得；控制，掌管；居高临下，俯瞰；值（高价）；n. 命令，指示；（计算机的）指令；控制，管辖；指挥权，控制权；兵团，军区；指挥部，司令部；掌握，精通；【名】 （Command）（美）科芒（人名）
definition: 1. n. an authoritative direction or instruction to do something；2. v. be in command of
example: Unalterable shall be what I may bring into being, Neither recalled nor changed shall be the command of my lips."
exampleZh: 我所创造的事物永不得更改，一言既出，永不召回或更改“

meaning: n. 指挥官，长官；海军中校；英国高级警官；高级骑士（或爵士）
definition: 1. n. an officer in command of a military unit；2. n. someone in an official position of authority who can command or control others
example: I am certain we would know that George Washington was the commander of our forces in our battle.
exampleZh: 我十分确信你们都知道,乔治·华盛顿是战时美国军队的指挥官

meaning: v. 纪念，用以纪念
definition: 1. to remember officially and give respect to a great person or event, especially by a public ceremony or by making a statue or special building；2. to show honor to the memory of an important person or event in a special way
example: People built a new theatre to commemorate the birth of Cao Yu.
exampleZh: 人们修建了一座新剧场作为对曹禺诞生的纪念。

meaning: n. 纪念，纪念活动
definition: 1. something that is done to remember officially and give respect to a great person or event
example: On the Internet, you will be impressed by the video show of a girl's special commemoration.
exampleZh: 在网上，一个女孩的特别纪念活动的视频节目会给你留下深刻印象。

meaning: v. 开始，着手
definition: 1. v. take the first step or steps in carrying out an action；2. v. set in motion, cause to start
example: We commence building next week.
exampleZh: 我们下周破土动工。

meaning: n. 开始，开端；毕业典礼
definition: 1. n. the time at which something is supposed to begin；2. n. an academic exercise in which diplomas are conferred
example: All applicants should be at least 16 years of age at the commencement of this course.
exampleZh: 所有申请人在本课程开始时应至少年满16岁。

meaning: v. 赞扬，赞许；推荐，举荐；被接受，得到认可；把……托付给（或委托于）
definition: 1. to formally praise someone or something；2. to formally praise or mention with approval someone or something
example: I can commend it to him as a realistic course of action.
exampleZh: 我可以把它作为一套现实的行动方案推荐给他。

meaning: n. 赞扬，称赞，表扬；正式嘉奖，表彰，奖状；（较少用）推荐
definition: 1. praise, or an official statement that praises someone；2. an honour such as a prize given to someone because they have done something that people admire
example: Clare won a commendation for bravery in 1998 after risking his life at the scene of a gas blast.
exampleZh: 1998年克莱尔因在一次瓦斯爆炸现场甘冒生命危险的勇敢行为而荣获嘉奖。

meaning: n. 评论，意见；批评，指责；说明，写照；解说，注释；（计算机）注解；v. 评论，发表意见；（计算机）注解，把（部分程序）转成注解；【名】 （Comment）（美、瑞、法）科门特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a statement that expresses a personal opinion or belief；2. v. make or write a comment on
example: But why is it acting? Why specifically acting and why this weird comment at the end, "What could be prettier?"
exampleZh: 为什么是表演，为什么是具体的表演，为什么,会有这么奇怪的评论，还能有更漂亮的事情吗“

meaning: n. 现场解说，实况报道；评注性著作，评论文；讨论，评论；说明，写照
definition: 1. n. a written explanation or criticism or illustration that is added to a book or other textual material
example: He kept up a running commentary on everyone who came in or went out.
exampleZh: 他不断地对上下场的每一名队员进行解说。

meaning: n. 现场解说员，实况播音员；评论员
definition: 1. n. an expert who observes and comments on something；2. n. a writer who reports and analyzes events of the day
example: In the eyes of this senior Internet industry commentator,the business is far from mature.
exampleZh: 在这位高级互联网行业评论员的眼中，该业务距离成熟还很远。

meaning: n. 贸易，商业；社交，交往；性交
definition: 1. n. transactions (sales and purchases) having the objective of supplying commodities (goods and services)；2. n. the United States federal department that promotes and administers domestic and foreign trade (including management of the census and the patent office); created in 1913
example: You have merchants and traders who are handling the commerce on the trade routes and enjoying broader cultural contacts.
exampleZh: 这里有商人和交易员，他们负责贸易商业,在通商道路上，并且进行广泛的文化交流。

meaning: adj. 商业的，商务的；商业化的，以获利为目的的；由广告商支付的；（化学制品）大量供应且纯度不高的；n. 电视广告，电台广告
definition: 1. n. a commercially sponsored ad on radio or television；2. adj. connected with or engaged in or sponsored by or used in commerce or commercial enterprises
example: And I've seen other similar things where commercial photography, photo journalism and all that stuff is up there,
exampleZh: 我也见过很多商业摄影师，记者摄影师，等等，都是

meaning: v. 使商业化；使商品化
definition: 1. v. exploit for maximal profit, usually by sacrificing quality；2. v. make commercial
example: They are also cooperating with science and technology parks in different regions so as to commercialize the fruits of their innovation.
exampleZh: 它们还与各地的科技园合作，将创新成果商业化。

meaning: n. 考察团，委员会；佣金，回扣；犯罪；委托，命令；（军队中的）官职，军衔；（尤指艺术品）委托制作；所授之权，代办权；v. 委托撰写，委托制作；委任，任命……为军官；（使军舰）正式使用，服现役
definition: 1. n. a special group delegated to consider some matter；2. v. put into commission; equip for service; of ships
example: If they're paid by commission on each trade they just keep calling you up and coming up with new ideas for new trades.
exampleZh: 如果他们的薪水来自交易中抽取的佣金,他们就会不断拜访你,告诉你一些关于新交易的新点子

meaning: v. 犯（罪、错）；调拨，投入；（使）承诺，承担义务；郑重承诺，忠于；把……关进医院（监狱），监禁；传唤（某人）到法院受审；订婚，决定与（某人）保持长期感情；把……托付给
definition: 1. v. perform an act, usually with a negative connotation；2. v. give entirely to a specific person, activity, or cause
example: Ford kept his suspicions to himself, even to the extent of going to jail for a murder he obviously didn't commit.
exampleZh: 福特把自己的怀疑藏在心里，即使到了要为他显然没有犯的谋杀罪而入狱的地步他也不说。

meaning: n. 忠诚，献身；承诺，保证；奉献，投入；热情，决心；义务，责任；花费，使用（资金、时间、人力）；需要定期支付的款项
definition: 1. n. the trait of sincere and steadfast fixity of purpose；2. n. the act of binding yourself (intellectually or emotionally) to a course of action
example: But I think there are substantial proportion of faculty who really do have a commitment defined in different ways.
exampleZh: 但我认为确实相当一部分教职工,虽然有不同的理解，但能做到尽职尽责。

meaning: n. 委员会；受托人，监护人；精神病者监护人
definition: 1. n. a special group delegated to consider some matter；2. n. a self-constituted organization to promote something
example: And, guess who the most severe members of that committee are? It's the students, your peers who are outraged at that kind of behavior.
exampleZh: 猜猜委员会中谁最为严厉,是学生，你们的同伴对这种行为义愤填膺呀。

meaning: n. 商品，货物；有用的东西，必需品
definition: 1. n. articles of commerce
example: Money was a commodity she never thought about except in the abstract.
exampleZh: 金钱是她从未具体想过的一种商品。

meaning: adj. 共同的，共享的；常见的，普遍的，一般的；普通的，平凡的；出于礼貌的，起码的；粗俗的，庸俗的；n. 公共用地，公地；校园公共食堂；常识；（基督教教会适用于各种场合的）普通礼拜；平民
definition: 1. n. a piece of open land for recreational use in an urban area；2. adj. belonging to or participated in by a community as a whole; public
example: Their observance protects the holy object from profanation, from being profaned, reverting from holy status back to common status.
exampleZh: 它们按照惯例保护着神圣的东西不受亵渎，不受玷污，不让它们重新回归世俗。

meaning: adj. 平凡的，不足为奇的；平庸的，陈腐的；n. 司空见惯的事，常见的东西；老生常谈，陈词滥调
definition: 1. n. a trite or obvious remark；2. adj. completely ordinary and unremarkable
example: Simpson's much vaunted discoveries are in fact commonplace in modern sociology.
exampleZh: 辛普森的那些被过分称赞的发现在现代社会学中实际上是老生常谈。

meaning: n. 国家，独立的政治共同体（尤指民主共和国）；英联邦（the Commonwealth）；界，组织；（自愿加入美国的）自治政区，自治政体（如波多黎各）；（美国的）州（尤指肯塔基、马萨诸塞、宾夕法尼亚和弗吉尼亚）；（澳大利亚）联邦；公益
definition: 1. a group of countries with the same political or economic aims；2. a country or part of a country that is governed by its people or representatives of its people
example: The prime minister of Fiji has said Fiji is in no hurry to rejoin the Commonwealth.
exampleZh: 斐济总理称斐济并不急于重返英联邦。

meaning: v. 传递信息，通讯；传达，传递（想法或感情）；传染（疾病）；（房间或建筑）相通，相连；传输（热，力），传递（运动）；领受圣餐
definition: 1. v. transmit information；2. v. transmit thoughts or feelings
example: The other way it shares an ambition of modernism is precisely in that effort to communicate experience, consciousness.
exampleZh: 它与现代主义追求的另一个共同点,正体现在经验和意识的交流上。

meaning: n. 表达，交流，交际；信息，书信，电话；通讯，交通联系；传播学
definition: 1. n. the activity of communicating; the activity of conveying information；2. n. something that is communicated by or to or between people or groups
example: But the interesting thing I realized along the way is that payment is another form of communication.
exampleZh: 我渐渐意识到一个很有趣的事实：,付款是另一种交流方式。

meaning: adj. 爱说话的，健谈的；交际的，沟通的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to communication；2. adj. able or tending to communicate
example: I find it's a communicative way to study people and you learn how to read people in drama.
exampleZh: 我发现这是一种了解他人的互动方式，你能学会在戏剧中读懂人心。

meaning: n. 社群，群体；（共产主义国家的）公社；（尤指欧洲一些国家的）最小行政区；亲密的谈话，互换想法；v. 交流，谈心；（精神上）与……很亲近（或亲密）
definition: 1. n. the smallest administrative district of several European countries；2. v. communicate intimately with; be in a state of heightened, intimate receptivity
example: That is, if you are one of these commune communities, then you're just a small number of people.
exampleZh: 即使是公社，集结成的也只是个小众团体。

meaning: n. 共产主义者，共产党党员；adj. 共产主义的，共产党党员的；共产党的（Communist）
definition: 1. relating to communism, or a supporter of communist ideas
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: The former communist official later became a prominent critic of the political system.
exampleZh: 这名前共产党官员后来成为该政治制度的著名批评者。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 共产主义，共产主义理论（或制度）
definition: 1. a political and economic system in which property is owned collectively
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: The collapse of communism in Eastern Europe transformed the region's economic and political landscape.
exampleZh: 东欧共产主义的崩溃改变了该地区的经济和政治格局。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 社区，社会；（由同国籍、同宗教等构成的）群体，界；（多个国家的）共同体；归属感；（动植物的）群落
definition: 1. n. a group of people living in a particular local area；2. n. a group of people having ethnic or cultural or religious characteristics in common
example: So, I think it's this balance between working very hard and being involved in the greater community, I would say.
exampleZh: 所以，一方面要努力学习，一方面要参与大型社会活动，我想，他们需要把握好平衡。

meaning: v. 通勤，上下班往返；减轻（刑罚）；代偿；（两个运算，两个量）可交换；n. 通勤，上下班交通路程
definition: 1. n. a regular journey of some distance to and from your place of work；2. v. move from one side of an equation to the other side without a change in value
example: People are prepared to commute long distances if they are desperate for work.
exampleZh: 亟须得到工作的人会愿意长途乘车往返上下班。

meaning: n. 上下班往返的人
definition: 1. n. a passenger train that is ridden primarily by passengers who travel regularly from one place to another；2. n. someone who travels regularly from home in a suburb to work in a city
example: Commuter airlines fly to out-of-the-way places. And business travellers are the ones who go to those locations.
exampleZh: 通勤航空公司飞往偏僻的地方。此外，商务旅客就是去那些地方的人。

meaning: adj. 小型的，袖珍的；紧凑的；紧密的，坚实的；矮小而健壮的；（演讲，作品）简洁的，简练的；n. 带镜小粉盒；合约，协定；小型汽车；袖珍物；坯块；v. 压紧，压实；缩短，精简；订立（或签订）（协定）
definition: 1. n. a small cosmetics case with a mirror; to be carried in a woman's purse；2. v. have the property of being packable or of compacting easily
example: I'm not going to writegiven threemoles of hydrogen at one bar and three degrees, blah,bla I'm going to write it in a compact notation.
exampleZh: 我不会写“给定1巴和多少度下,的三摩尔氢分子之类,我会把它写成一个紧凑的形式。

meaning: n. 同伴，伴侣；（受雇照料老人或病人的）陪护；成对的物品之一；同甘共苦的伙伴；（用于书名）指南，手册；伴星；最低级爵士；v. 陪伴；【名】 （Companion）（英）康帕宁（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person who is frequently in the company of another；2. v. be a companion to somebody
example: It's called Death and Transfiguration, and I hear this as a companion piece, a kind of pendant to the Zarathustra.
exampleZh: 这首曲子名叫死亡与净化,我听说它是查拉图斯特拉的姊妹篇,某种对查拉图斯特拉的补充

meaning: n. 情谊，友谊
definition: 1. n. the state of being with someone
example: I depended on his companionship and on his judgment.
exampleZh: 我依赖他的陪伴和他的判断。

meaning: n. 公司；陪伴，同伴；宾客，来宾；在一起的一群人；连队；剧团，歌舞团；女童军大队；v. 结交，交往；陪伴；【名】 （Company）（美、瑞）孔帕尼（人名）
definition: 1. n. an institution created to conduct business；2. v. be a companion to somebody
example: So two totally different things but, I think it's, it's a cool, cool concept and obviously amazing program, company.
exampleZh: 虽然这是两个完全不同的行业，但我认为他的概念非常好，是个非常出色的项目、公司。

meaning: v. 比较，对比；把……比作；（与……）相比；构成（形容词或副词）的比较级和最高级；n. 比较
definition: 1. n. qualities that are comparable；2. v. examine and note the similarities or differences of
example: Managers analyse their company's data and compare it with data on their competitors.
exampleZh: 经理们分析他们公司的数据并与其竞争者的数据进行比较。

meaning: n. 比较，对照；相提并论，相比；比喻，比拟；（副词或形容词的）比较（变化）
definition: 1. n. examining resemblances or differences；2. n. relation based on similarities and differences
example: It's like a dance, you know. It's kind of, like a ballet, you know. So there's no comparison.
exampleZh: 它像舞蹈一样。现场比赛有点像看芭蕾舞。所以，没什么可比性。

meaning: n. （形容词或副词的）比较级；对手；adj. 比较的，相比的；相对的，比较而言的；（形容词或副词）比较级的
definition: 1. n. the comparative form of an adjective；2. adj. relating to or based on or involving comparison
example: It exists alongside of other areas of political inquiry like American government comparative politics and international relations.
exampleZh: 它和其它政治探询课题并存,例如：美国政府,比较政治和国际关系。

meaning: adj. 可比的，可比较的；类似的，同类的
definition: 1. adj. able to be compared or worthy of comparison；2. adj. conforming in every respect
example: Analysts predict that Digital will price the new line at less than half the cost of comparable IBM mainframes.
exampleZh: 分析家们预测迪吉多公司会将其新线产品的价格定在低于可比的IBM公司大型主机成本的一半的水平。

meaning: n. 隔层，分隔间；（飞机、轮船或火车上的）车厢，舱；区划；v. 分隔，划分
definition: 1. one of the separate areas inside a vehicle, especially a train；2. a separate part of a piece of furniture, equipment, or a container with a particular purpose
example: Water in the engine compartment is sucked away by a hose.
exampleZh: 发动机舱里的水由一条软管吸走。

meaning: n. 指南针，罗盘；圆规，两脚规；界限，范围；v. 绕（某物）而行，围绕；图谋完成
definition: 1. n. navigational instrument for finding directions；2. v. bring about; accomplish
example: We had to rely on a compass and a lot of luck to get here.
exampleZh: 我们只得靠罗盘和很大的运气到达这儿。

meaning: n. 同情，怜悯
definition: 1. a strong feeling of sympathy and sadness for the suffering or bad luck of others and a wish to help them
example: And it speaks to those who are courageous enough to acknowledge that life is rife with pain and conflict, just as it's filled with compassion and joy.
exampleZh: 这是属于坚强的人们的,承认生活充满痛苦与矛盾，而并非总是激情欢乐的。

meaning: adj. 有同情心的，怜悯的；v. 同情，怜悯
definition: 1. feeling or showing sympathy and sadness for the suffering or bad luck of others, and wanting to help them；2. a reason, especially in law, to allow someone to do something out of sympathy for their suffering
example: These charities depend on the compassionate feelings and generosity of the general public.
exampleZh: 这些慈善机构依赖于公众的同情和慷慨。

meaning: adj. 兼容的；可共存的；可和睦相处的；与……一致的；n. 兼容性计算机
definition: 1. adj. able to exist and perform in harmonious or agreeable combination；2. adj. having similar disposition and tastes
example: Fujitsu took over another American firm, Amdal, to help it to make and sell machines compatible with IBM in the United States.
exampleZh: 富士通接管了另一家美国公司安岛，以帮助其在美国生产并销售与IBM兼容的机器。

meaning: n. 共存；和睦相处；（计算机设备的）兼容性
definition: 1. n. a feeling of sympathetic understanding；2. n. capability of existing or performing in harmonious or congenial combination
example: On earlier versions of AIX, you only get P6 compatibility mode performance, which is up to 30% performance penalty.
exampleZh: 在 AIX 的早期版本中，你只能获得 P6 兼容模式的性能，这会带来最高30%的性能损失。

meaning: v. 强迫，迫使；使发生，促使；驱赶；【名】 （Compel）（法）孔佩尔（人名）
definition: 1. v. force or compel somebody to do something；2. v. make someone do something
example: She could compel him to support the child after it was born.
exampleZh: 她可以迫使他在孩子出生后抚养孩子。

meaning: adj. 令人信服的，有说服力的；引人入胜的，扣人心弦的；非常强烈的，不可抗拒的；v. 强迫，迫使；使发生，促使（compel 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. driving or forcing；2. adj. tending to persuade by forcefulness of argument
example: This compelling story begins with the crowning of Queen Victoria in 1837.
exampleZh: 这个吸引人的故事开始于1837年维多利亚女王的加冕。

meaning: v. 赔偿，偿付；弥补，补偿；抵消；酬报（某人）
definition: 1. v. adjust for；2. v. make amends for; pay compensation for
example: A surge in domestic sales helped compensate for a fall-off in export sales.
exampleZh: 国内销售的增长帮助补偿了出口销售的减少。

meaning: n. 赔偿金，补偿金；弥补，抵消；报酬，薪水
definition: 1. n. something (such as money) given or received as payment or reparation (as for a service or loss or injury)；2. n. (psychiatry) a defense mechanism that conceals your undesirable shortcomings by exaggerating desirable behaviors
example: And you consider the crimes that are punished by capital punishment, and the crimes that are punished by monetary compensation, and he feels this is quite revealing.
exampleZh: 想想那些被处以死刑的罪行和，要求金钱赔偿的罪行,他觉得这些就很明显地显示了这一不同点。

meaning: adj. 赔偿的；弥补的，补偿的
definition: 1. intended to reduce the harmful effect of something or to provide payment for a loss
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: The evaporation from the leaf surface causes a constant compensatory suction of water.
exampleZh: 叶片表面的蒸发作用会产生持续的补偿性吸水吸力。

meaning: v. 竞争，对抗；争夺；参加比赛
definition: 1. v. compete for something; engage in a contest; measure oneself against others
example: and then we have the nationals where we compete with the schools on the West Coast as well.
exampleZh: 然后我们有全国赛，我们也跟西海岸的学校比。

meaning: n. 竞争；比赛，竞赛；竞争者，对手
definition: 1. n. a business relation in which two parties compete to gain customers；2. n. an occasion on which a winner is selected from among two or more contestants
example: So the nature of the world, post-cold war world is increasingly one about competition for markets, govern of one nation's markets.
exampleZh: 因此冷战之后，市场的竞争,成为世界的主题，一国市场的管理，如果事实如此。

meaning: adj. 竞争的；好竞争的，好胜的；有竞争力的
definition: 1. adj. involving competition or competitiveness；2. adj. subscribing to capitalistic competition
example: These are highly competitive athletes, at the top of their sport, coming here to Princeton when they were recruited.
exampleZh: 这都是竞争力很强的运动员，属于单项之最，被普林斯顿招来时都是顶尖的。

meaning: n. 竞争者，对手；选手，参赛者
definition: 1. n. the contestant you hope to defeat
example: Why? Because no matter how the other firm, your competitor, prices you might have an incentive to undercut them.
exampleZh: 为什么,因为不管你对手怎么定价,你总有想削弱他们的动机

meaning: adj. 能干的，能胜任的；合格的，过得去的；精神正常的，智力无缺陷的；有决定权的；有法定资格的；活性的，（处于）感受态的
definition: 1. adj. properly or sufficiently qualified or capable or efficient；2. adj. adequate for the purpose
example: And we like people who is competent, who can do the job that we require them to do.
exampleZh: 第二，能够胜任工作，也就是能够完成公司要求的工作的人。

meaning: n. 能力，胜任；权限，管辖权；技能；感受态，反应能力；足以谋生的收入（尤指非劳动所得）
definition: 1. n. the quality of being adequately or well qualified physically and intellectually
example: Because you'll have an appropriate level of confidence and competence in your ability to do computational problem solving.
exampleZh: 因为你们在自己的能力范围内,拥有应对解决计算问题的,正当水平的自信心和竞争力。

meaning: v. 汇编，编纂；编译（电脑程式）；收集，搜集（信息，资料）；累积（得分）
definition: 1. to collect information from different places and arrange it in a book, report, or list；2. to change a computer program into a machine language
example: We are trying to compile a list of suitable people for the job.
exampleZh: 我们在努力编制一份适合做这项工作的人员名单。

meaning: n. 编纂，汇编；汇编物，辑
definition: 1. the act of compiling something；2. a book, CD, etc. that has been made from several separate parts
example: If you're getting these compilation errors, well, -- when you compile, notice there's a number of key help -- the number of helpful tidbits here.
exampleZh: 如果你们得到了这些编译错误，当你编译的时候，注意这里有很多关键帮助-,这里很多帮助信息。

meaning: adj. 自满的，自鸣得意的
definition: 1. feeling so satisfied with your own abilities or situation that you feel you do not need to try any harder
example: Please don't, if you are up here, become complacent because a month from now we will have another test.
exampleZh: 如果你考得不错的话，请不要自满,因为在一个月后我们将还有一次测试。

meaning: n. 自满，自鸣得意
definition: 1. a feeling of calm satisfaction with your own abilities or situation that prevents you from trying harder
example: Despite signs of an improvement in the economy, there is no room for complacency.
exampleZh: 尽管在经济方面有改善的迹象，但仍不容自满。

meaning: v. 诉说 （病痛）；悲叹，悲鸣；（构造，机械装置）（因拉力或压力）呻吟，咯吱作响；抱怨，投诉
definition: 1. v. express complaints, discontent, displeasure, or unhappiness；2. v. make a formal accusation; bring a formal charge
example: Can't complain when the whole North East on the other side of the country is getting piled with snow.
exampleZh: 当美国东北区白雪皑皑时，在这儿我们也不会抱怨寒冷。

meaning: n. 抱怨，投诉；不满的缘由，抱怨的问题；疾病，不适
definition: 1. n. an often persistent bodily disorder or disease; a cause for complaining；2. n. (formerly) a loud cry (or repeated cries) of pain or rage or sorrow
example: Portnoy's Complaint", it's about a young Jewish guy growing up from the 70s.
exampleZh: 波特诺伊的怨诉》讲的是一个生长在七十年代的年轻犹太小伙子。

meaning: v. 补充，补足；n. 补足物，衬托物；足数，足额；补语；余角；补体，防御素
definition: 1. to make something else seem better or more attractive when combining with it；2. a part of a clause that usually follows the verb in English and adds more information about the subject or object
example: There will be a written examination to complement the practical test.
exampleZh: 会有一次书面考试来补充实践测试。

meaning: adj. 相互补充的，相辅相成的；互补色的；（基因序列、核苷酸等）互补的；（与）补充医学（有关）的；余角的，互为余角的
definition: 1. useful or attractive together；2. (of colours) producing black or white when combined, and making a very strong contrast when placed next to each other
example: The school's approach must be complementary to that of the parents.
exampleZh: 学校与家长的教育方法必须相辅相成。

meaning: adj. 完全的，彻底的；全部的，完整的；完成的，结束的；技能全面的，技术娴熟的；向前传球成功的；v. 使完整，使完美；填写（表格）；完成，结束
definition: 1. v. come or bring to a finish or an end；2. adj. having every necessary or normal part or component or step
example: It's usually best to respond in a complete sentence rather than saying yes or no which can be ambiguous.
exampleZh: 一般来说，回答最好是完整的句子，而不是简单的模棱两可的“是”或“不是”。

meaning: n. 完成，结束；成功前传；（房地产等）完成交易，完成交割
definition: 1. n. (American football) a successful forward pass in football；2. n. a concluding action
example: But, the reaction says I need twice as much mag as tickle if this reaction is going to go to completion.
exampleZh: 但是这个反应告诉我们,镁的量应该是四氯化钛的两倍,如果要反应完全的话。

meaning: adj. 复杂的，难懂的；组合的，合成的；（句子）复合的；复数的，复的；配合的，络合的；n. 综合大楼，建筑群；复合体，综合体；情结；强烈（或过度）的关心（或忧虑）；配合物，络合物
definition: 1. n. a conceptual whole made up of complicated and related parts；2. adj. complicated in structure; consisting of interconnected parts
example: So it's a complex issue, and I should leave it having said this much, at least for the moment.
exampleZh: 因此它是一个很复杂的问题，而我就讲到这里，至少暂时这样。

meaning: n. 复杂性，错综复杂；复杂之处，费解之处
definition: 1. n. the quality of being intricate and compounded
example: It's the vocabulary, it's the complexity of the thought, and so on that makes it difficult. Iser acknowledges this.
exampleZh: 是词汇，思想的复杂性等等,使它变得难懂，伊瑟尔承认这一点。

meaning: n. 肤色，气色；概貌，局势
definition: 1. the natural appearance of the skin on a person's face, especially its colour or quality；2. the general character of something
example: Rain water was once considered to be good for the complexion.
exampleZh: 雨水曾一度被认为对肤色有益。

meaning: v. 使复杂化，使难以理解；引起并发症；使卷入，使陷入
definition: 1. v. make more complicated；2. v. make more complex, intricate, or richer
example: The day's events, he said, would only complicate the task of the peacekeeping forces.
exampleZh: 他说那天的事件只会使维和部队的任务复杂化。

meaning: adj. 复杂的，难处理的；v. 使复杂化，使难以理解；引起并发症（complicate 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. difficult to analyze or understand
example: He serves as something like a complicated double for the young, unpublished, and as of yet unproductive poet himself.
exampleZh: 他就像一个复杂的替身，是那些年轻的，还没出版诗歌或是不多产的诗人自己的替身。

meaning: n. 使复杂化的难题（或困难）；并发症
definition: 1. n. the act or process of complicating；2. n. a situation or condition that is complex or confused
example: They do not have the capabilities to treat this complication here.
exampleZh: 在这个地方，医生没有能力治疗这种并发症。

meaning: n. 赞扬，称赞；问候，祝贺；v. 赞美，恭维
definition: 1. a remark that expresses approval, admiration, or respect；2. an action that expresses approval or respect
example: 'You were both wonderful!' 'So were you!' we said, returning the compliment.
exampleZh: “你们俩太棒了！”“你也一样啊！”我们也称赞道。

meaning: adj. 赞美的，表示钦佩的；免费赠送的
definition: 1. praising or expressing admiration for someone；2. If tickets, books, etc. are complimentary, they are given free, especially by a business.
example: They could be pasted back together, and the pasting process takes advantage of this natural process of complimentary hybridization.
exampleZh: 它们可以重新粘合在一起,而这粘合的过程,得益于这种自然的互补杂交

meaning: v. 遵从，服从；（商品）符合特定标准
definition: 1. v. act in accordance with someone's rules, commands, or wishes
example: A lot of people in the financial community are annoyed by them because these regulations are costly to comply with and they take a lot of resources.
exampleZh: 很多金融界人士对其烦不胜烦,因为执行规范条例的成本很高,一旦执行,占用太多资源

meaning: n. 服从，遵守；屈从，迁就；可塑性，柔量
definition: 1. n. acting according to certain accepted standards；2. n. happy friendly agreement
example: The U.N. Security Council has linked any lifting of sanctions to compliance with the ceasefire terms.
exampleZh: 联合国安全理事会将任何制裁的解除与遵守停火条款联系起来。

meaning: n. 组成部分，成分，部件；adj. 组成的，构成的
definition: 1. n. an abstract part of something；2. n. something determined in relation to something that includes it
example: this is now a chart of just a component number five, 787 the lattice energies. Keep this number in mind, 787.
exampleZh: 这是成分5的图表，晶格能，记住这个数。

meaning: v. 组成，构成；作曲；撰写（信、诗或演讲稿）；使镇静，使平静；为（照片、图像）构图；排版，排稿
definition: 1. v. form the substance of；2. v. write music
example: Protein molecules compose all the complex working parts of living cells.
exampleZh: 蛋白质分子构成了活细胞所有复杂的工作部件。

meaning: n. 成分构成，成分；（音乐、艺术、诗歌的）作品；创作，作曲；构图；作文
definition: 1. n. a mixture of ingredients；2. n. the way in which someone or something is composed
example: Television has transformed the size and social composition of the audience at great sporting occasions.
exampleZh: 电视改变了大型体育赛事观众的数量及其社会构成。

meaning: n. 创作者，作曲家
definition: 1. n. someone who composes music as a profession
example: A motive is just a little cell, a germ, out of which the composer will build other musical material.
exampleZh: 动机只是个微小的细胞,一个胚芽,基于它 作曲家会创造新的音乐素材

meaning: adj. 合成的，复合的；（火车车厢）综合的；菊科的；（柱式）混合的；n. 合成物，复合材料；罪犯画像；综合提案；菊科植物；混合柱式；v. 合成（图片）
definition: 1. something that is made of various different parts；2. a material made up of more than one substance that is used for building things
example: Galton devised a method of creating composite pictures in which the features of different faces were superimposed over one another.
exampleZh: 高尔顿发明了一种将不同脸的部位相互叠加而创作合成图片的方法。

meaning: n. 混合物，化合物；复合词；大院，有围墙的场地；adj. 复合的，混合的；以复利计算的；v. 使加重，使恶化；合成，混合；以复利计算支付；和解，私了
definition: 1. n. (chemistry) a substance formed by chemical union of two or more elements or ingredients in definite proportion by weight；2. v. make more intense, stronger, or more marked
example: Honey is basically a compound of water, two types of sugar, vitamins and enzymes.
exampleZh: 蜂蜜主要是水、两种糖、维生素和酶的混合物。

meaning: v. 理解，领悟；包括，包含
definition: 1. v. get the meaning of something；2. v. to become aware of through the senses
example: The concept of infinity is almost impossible for the human mind to comprehend.
exampleZh: 无穷的概念几乎是人类的大脑无法理解的。

meaning: n. 理解力，领悟力；（听力或阅读）理解测试；包括，包含
definition: 1. n. an ability to understand the meaning or importance of something (or the knowledge acquired as a result)；2. n. the relation of comprising something
example: And what this means is that any theory of language use and language comprehension cannot simply appeal to a list.
exampleZh: 这也就意味着,任何语言使用和语言理解的理论,都无法列出一份句子的清单

meaning: adj. 综合性的，全面的；有理解力的；n. 综合中学；专业综合测验
definition: 1. n. an intensive examination testing a student's proficiency in some special field of knowledge；2. adj. including all or everything
example: And what this is going to be is a comprehensive introduction to the study of the human mind.
exampleZh: 本课程旨在让大家,在宏观上对人类心智研究形成基本的认识

meaning: v. （使）压紧，压缩；精简，浓缩；压缩（文件）；缩短（时间）；n. （止血、减痛等的）敷布，压布
definition: 1. to press something into a smaller space；2. to make information, a piece of writing, etc. shorter
example: This system uses powerful microchips to compress huge amounts of data onto a CD-ROM.
exampleZh: 这一系统使用功能强大的微芯片来把大量数据压缩到CD-ROM上。

meaning: n. 压紧，压缩
definition: 1. the act of pressing something into a smaller space or putting pressure on it from different sides until it gets smaller；2. the act of making something smaller or shorter so that it will fit into a particular space or time
example: Adiabatic meaning there's no heat involved, and we're going to see how that differs from the isothermal expansion and compression.
exampleZh: 绝热意味着没有热量的传递，我们将看到它,与等温过程的区别。

meaning: v. 包括，包含；构成，组成
definition: 1. v. be composed of；2. v. include or contain; have as a component
example: Those over 45 comprise over 40% of the long-term unemployed, for example.
exampleZh: 例如，45岁以上的人占长期失业者的40%以上。

meaning: n. 折中，妥协；妥协方案，折中办法；v. 妥协，让步；危及，损害
definition: 1. n. a middle way between two extremes；2. v. make a compromise; arrive at a compromise
example: In the end, the compromise is that he notes several writers Sherwood Anderson including Dreiser and Sherwood Anderson.
exampleZh: 最后，为了缓和矛盾,他举出一些作家为例,包括德莱塞。

meaning: adj. 必须做的，义务的，强制的；n. （花样滑冰、竞技体操等的）规定动作
definition: 1. adj. required by rule
example: and the first year is compulsory classes. Everybody takes the same classes.
exampleZh: 第一年学习必修课。每个人的课程都一样。

meaning: v. 估算，计算；不合情理，讲不通；用计算机计算；n. 计算，估计
definition: 1. v. make a mathematical calculation or computation
example: If its in Cartesian form I'll pass in an x and y and compute what a radius and angle is.
exampleZh: 来得到的这个点,我都可以得到这个点的,全部的这种信息。

meaning: n. 计算机，电脑，电子计算机
definition: 1. n. a machine for performing calculations automatically；2. n. an expert at calculation (or at operating calculating machines)
example: With the computer today, you can, for the most part, not represent every possible number that mankind can think of.
exampleZh: 在当今世界，大多数情况下，并不是要把每个数字,都精确表示出来。

meaning: v. 用计算机做，使计算机化；给（某物）安装计算机，用电脑装备（某物）；把……输入计算机，用电脑储存
definition: 1. v. provide with computers；2. v. store in a computer
example: We want to computerize the current manual system we have.
exampleZh: 我们希望目前的电脑化系统，我们有手册。

meaning: n. 计算，计算过程
definition: 1. n. the procedure of calculating; determining something by mathematical or logical methods；2. n. problem solving that involves numbers or quantities
example: So let me write that down, it's how much memory do I need to complete a computation.
exampleZh: 让我把它写下来,当我计算的时候。

meaning: n. 伙伴，战友；同志（用于社会主义政党的成员之间）；【名】 （Comrade）（尼日利）科姆拉德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person who is frequently in the company of another；2. n. a fellow member of the Communist Party
example: So a lot of these things--I said they call you "comrade."
exampleZh: 还有，我刚才说他们称你为“同志“

meaning: v. 隐匿，隐藏；隐瞒（真实感情或真相）；遮盖，遮住
definition: 1. v. prevent from being seen or discovered；2. v. hold back; keep from being perceived by others
example: He didn't attempt to dissimulate or conceal his true feelings.
exampleZh: 他没有尝试着掩饰或隐瞒自己的感受。

meaning: n. 隐藏，隐瞒；隐匿处
definition: 1. n. the condition of being concealed or hidden；2. n. a covering that serves to conceal or shelter something
example: Rather, his subtlety shows itself in his deliberate concealment of it, in the ways in which he masks himself in obviousness.
exampleZh: 他的狡猾表现在他故意地隐藏这种隐约，而且是以很直白的方式表现的。

meaning: v. （通常指不情愿地）承认；认（输），承认（失败）；授予，让与；让对手得分
definition: 1. to admit, often unwillingly, that something is true；2. to admit that you have lost in a competition
example: After losing this decisive battle, the general was forced to concede.
exampleZh: 输掉了这场决定性的战役后，那位将军不得不承认失败。

meaning: n. 让步，妥协；特许权；优惠价，减价；商铺；小摊卖的东西；认输
definition: 1. something that is allowed or given up, often in order to end a disagreement, or the act of allowing or giving this；2. the act of admitting defeat
example: But despite this enormous concession and this realization, Satan is still justified, I think, in his cynical demystification of God's behavior before the defeat of the rebel angels.
exampleZh: 尽管后来做出了如此重大的妥协和转变，但我认为撒旦在叛乱天使战败前对上帝行为,冷嘲热讽的行为还是有其道理的。

meaning: n. 自负，骄傲自大；艺术效果，幻想，奇想；v. 幻想
definition: 1. the state of being too proud of yourself and your actions；2. a clever or surprising comparison, especially in a poem
example: There was no bombast or conceit in his speech.
exampleZh: 他的发言里没有浮夸或自负。

meaning: adj. 自负的，骄傲自大的
definition: 1. too proud of yourself and your actions and abilities
example: Black snails without a house—but they are so common, and so conceited.
exampleZh: 没有壳的黑蜗牛——不过它们太常见了，而且还特别自负。

meaning: v. 构思，设想；使受孕，怀孕
definition: 1. to imagine something；2. to invent a plan or an idea
example: Women, he says, should give up alcohol before they plan to conceive.
exampleZh: 他说女人在计划怀孕前应该戒酒。

meaning: n. 概念，观念；想出，构想；受孕，怀孕；创始
definition: 1. an idea of what something or someone is like, or a basic understanding of a situation or a principle；2. the process of a male and a female sex cell joining and causing a baby to start to form
example: My conception of a garden was based on gardens I had visited in England.
exampleZh: 我对花园的概念是基于我在英格兰参观过的一些花园的。

meaning: v. 集中注意力，聚精会神；使集中，聚集；浓缩；n. 浓缩物，浓缩液
definition: 1. n. the desired mineral that is left after impurities have been removed from mined ore；2. v. make (the solvent of a solution) dense or denser
example: But by distancing itself from the body, the mind, the soul, is able to better concentrate on the forms.
exampleZh: 但是通过脱离肉体的自身因素,心灵和灵魂就可以更好的专注于那些型相

meaning: n. 专心，专注；关注，重视；集中，聚集；含量，浓度
definition: 1. n. (chemistry) the strength of a solution; number of molecules of a substance in a given volume (expressed as moles/cubic meter)；2. n. the spatial property of being crowded together
example: Tiredness affects your powers of concentration.
exampleZh: 疲劳影响注意力的集中。

meaning: n. 概念，观念；adj. （围绕）某主题的；为表达一种想法而创造的；v. 想象，设想
definition: 1. n. an abstract or general idea inferred or derived from specific instances
example: Now, the concept of ritual impurity was a central and integral feature of most, if not all, ancient religions.
exampleZh: 现在，仪式上的不洁已经是大部分宗教,主要的，整体而言的特点。

meaning: adj. 概念的，观念的
definition: 1. adj. being or characterized by concepts or their formation
example: I approach it the way a few other philosophers do in a way that is characteristic of conceptual analysis.
exampleZh: 我研究电影的方法其他一些哲学家也在使用,这种方法,以概念分析为特点。

meaning: n. 担心，忧虑；使人担忧的事物；关心，关爱；重要的事物，关心的事；（某人）负责的事，涉及的事；公司，企业；复杂的物体；v. 有关，关于；涉及，影响；使忧虑，使担心
definition: 1. n. something that interests you because it is important or affects you；2. v. have to do with or be relevant to
example: Another theme in the Book of Deuteronomy is the theme of providential concern, and that appears in Deuteronomy 8.
exampleZh: 申命记》的另一个主题是,对幸运的忧虑，这出现在《申命记》第8章中。

meaning: adj. 相关的， 关于（某个主题）的；担心的，焦急的；关注的，感兴趣的；关心的，挂念的；v. 有关，关于；涉及，影响；使忧虑，使担心（concern 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. feeling or showing worry or solicitude；2. adj. involved in or affected by or having a claim to or share in
example: you are concerned because you have a cold and you need to go work and you want to be seen.
exampleZh: 你有点担心，因为你有点感冒，但还是得上班，而你想尽快让医生检查一下。

meaning: prep. 关于，涉及；adj. 让人不安的，令人担忧的；v. 有关，关于；影响；使担心（concern 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. something that interests you because it is important or affects you；2. v. have to do with or be relevant to
example: All cases concerning children are dealt with in a special children's court.
exampleZh: 所有涉及儿童的案件均由儿童特别法庭审理。

meaning: n. 音乐会，演奏会；一致，和谐；（尤指犯罪时的）联合行动；v. 共同议定，协调
definition: 1. n. a performance of music by players or singers not involving theatrical staging；2. v. contrive (a plan) by mutual agreement
example: We went out for sushi and then we went to a small concert. You know, it was actually really great.
exampleZh: 我们去吃了寿司，去听了个小型音乐会，真的很棒。

meaning: adj. 共同筹划的，一致的；尽力的，竭力的；（音乐）分声部的；v. 共同议定，协调（concert 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. involving the joint activity of two or more
example: We need to make a concerted effort to finish on time.
exampleZh: 我们需要通力合作才能按时完成。

meaning: adj. 简明的，简洁的
definition: 1. short and clear, expressing what needs to be said without unnecessary words；2. expressing what needs to be said without unnecessary words; short and clear
example: Because we only had to override one simple method, this was a concise way to achieve our goal.
exampleZh: 因为我们只需要重写一个简单的方法，所以这是实现我们目标的简洁方式。

meaning: v. 断定，推断出；结束，终止；达成，做成，完成；决定
definition: 1. v. decide by reasoning; draw or come to a conclusion；2. v. bring to a close
example: Let me conclude by just pointing to another poem, a late poem, "Directive," a poem published in 1947.
exampleZh: 让我们看看另一首诗来作为结尾吧，一首晚期的诗，1947年发表的“指令“

meaning: n. 结论，推论；结局，结尾；缔结，商定；（根据所给前提得出的）命题
definition: 1. n. a position or opinion or judgment reached after consideration；2. n. an intuitive assumption
example: It is 1.7475. Conclusion: if I start to react sodium with chlorine, the result is a crystal, a three-dimensional array.
exampleZh: 这是1。7475，结论就是：,如果我使钠和氯反应，结果将会是一个晶体，一个三维排列。

meaning: adj. 结论性的，毫无疑问的
definition: 1. adj. forming an end or termination; especially putting an end to doubt or question；2. adj. final and deciding
example: Her attorneys claim there is no conclusive evidence that any murders took place.
exampleZh: 她的律师们声称没有任何发生过谋杀的确凿证据。

meaning: adj. 确实的，具体的；实在的，有形的；混凝土的；物质的；n. 混凝土；v. 用混凝土覆盖（或做成）；（使）凝固，（使）凝结；使真实（化），使具体（化）
definition: 1. n. a strong hard building material composed of sand and gravel and cement and water；2. v. cover with cement
example: It refers instead, to the concrete, collective, communal salvation from national suffering and oppression, particularly in the form of foreign rule or enslavement.
exampleZh: 相反，它指的是很具体的，集体的，社会的拯救,把一个国家从苦难和压迫中解救出来，尤其是那些在外族统治者奴役下的。

meaning: adj. 并存的，同时发生的；同意的，一致的；（两个或两个以上徒刑判决）同时执行的；（三条或三条以上线）共点的，会合的；n. 共点；同时发生的事件
definition: 1. happening or existing at the same time；2. happening at the same time
example: Many CS students never get into the fascinating topic of designing and implementing programs that are naturally concurrent.
exampleZh: 许多计算机科学专业的学生从来没有涉猎过设计和实现自然并发程序的有趣话题。

meaning: v. 谴责，严厉指责；宣判，判决；使陷入（不愉快的境地）；宣布……不安全；证明（或表明）有罪
definition: 1. v. express strong disapproval of；2. v. declare or judge unfit
example: And so I would never condemn people for spending time and going and looking at that and developing themselves.
exampleZh: 所以我从不会谴责人们将时间花在上面浏览，查阅并充实自己。

meaning: n. 谴责，严厉指责；非难的理由
definition: 1. n. an expression of strong disapproval; pronouncing as wrong or morally culpable；2. n. (law) the act of condemning (as land forfeited for public use) or judging to be unfit for use (as a food product or an unsafe building)
example: That's a condemnation of the students as a whole, and doesn't explain all campus unhappiness.
exampleZh: 这是对全体学生的指责，也无法解释校园里所有的不满情绪。

meaning: v. 冷凝，凝结；压缩，简缩；浓缩，变浓
definition: 1. v. undergo condensation; change from a gaseous to a liquid state and fall in drops；2. v. make more concise
example: When you summarize, you condense an extended idea or argument into a sentence or more in your own words.
exampleZh: 总结的时候，用自己的话把拓展了的观念或论据简缩成一句或几句话。

meaning: n. 冷凝，凝结；凝结的水珠；（书等的）简缩；凝聚反应，缩合反应；精神凝缩（作用）
definition: 1. n. (psychoanalysis) an unconscious process whereby two ideas or images combine into a single symbol; especially in dreams；2. n. the process of changing from a gaseous to a liquid or solid state
example: It's there that Freud argues that really the central two mechanisms of the dream work are condensation and displacement.
exampleZh: 就是在这本书中，弗洛伊德认为，梦运作的两大艺匠,是梦的“凝缩“和“移置“

meaning: n. 状况，状态；条件，环境；疾病；条款；社会地位；v. 训练，使习惯于；控制，制约；护理，保养；影响；加条件于；使（人，动物）健康；（发酵后，在酵母仍存在时）使（啤酒，黑啤酒）酿熟
definition: 1. n. a state at a particular time；2. v. establish a conditioned response
example: Condition," this thing in the middle between the semicolons, is going to be checked every iteration of the loop.
exampleZh: 条件，“这个在两个分号的中间，它将迭代地检查这个循环的条件。

meaning: adj. 有条件的，有前提的；（从句）条件的；n. 条件从句；条件式
definition: 1. adj. qualified by reservations；2. adj. imposing or depending on or containing a condition
example: He was given a conditional discharge and ordered to pay Miss Smith $500 compensation.
exampleZh: 他被判有条件释放，并被命令向史密斯小姐支付$500的赔偿金。

meaning: n. 护发素；衣物柔顺剂；调节剂，调节器
definition: 1. n. exercise that conditions the body；2. n. a trainer of athletes
example: Regular use of conditioner is supposed to give your hair more body.
exampleZh: 经常使用护发素能使头发更浓密。

meaning: n. 吊唁，哀悼
definition: 1. sympathy and sadness for the family or close friends of a person who has recently died, or an expression of this, especially in written form；2. an expression of sympathy esp. for the family of a person who has recently died, or the sympathy expressed
example: I'm sorry to hear that. Please accept my condolence. Take time off as necessary.
exampleZh: 听到这消息我很难过，请接受我的哀悼，如果需要就请假吧。

meaning: adj. 有助的，有益的
definition: 1. providing the right conditions for something good to happen or exist；2. providing the right conditions for something to happen or exist
example: Allowing your mind to wander freely is conducive to sharpening your focus in the long run.
exampleZh: 放任思绪自由游走从长远来看有助于提高专注力。

meaning: v. 实施，进行；指挥；带领，引导；举止，表现；传导；n. 行为，举止；经营方式，管理方法
definition: 1. n. manner of acting or controlling yourself；2. v. direct the course of; manage or control
example: Beyond this, his youth must be innocent of crime and chaste, his conduct irreproachable and his hands stainless.
exampleZh: 通过这些，他的青春,将是贞洁的而不会充满犯罪，他的行为将是无可非难的，他的手将不会有任何污点。

meaning: n. （乐队等的）指挥；售票员，检票员；导体；传导教育的引导者
definition: 1. n. the person who leads a musical group；2. n. a device designed to transmit electricity, heat, etc.
example: Under its new conductor, the orchestra has established an international reputation.
exampleZh: 在新指挥的领导下，这个乐团建立了国际声誉。

meaning: n. 联盟，同盟；加拿大联邦
definition: 1. an organization consisting of different groups of people working together for business or political reasons；2. a group of countries, organizations, or people who have joined together for economic or political reasons
example: Afghanistan was a founding member of the confederation in the 1950s before entering long periods of war and factional fighting.
exampleZh: 在进入长期战争和派系斗争之前，阿富汗在20世纪50年代是该联盟的创始成员国。

meaning: n. 共犯，同谋；盟友，盟国；南部邦联的居民（或士兵）（Confederate）；adj. 联合的，同盟的，联邦的；（美国内战期间）南部邦联的（Confederate）；v. 联合，结盟
definition: 1. someone you work together with in a secret, sometimes illegal, activity；2. someone who fought for or supported the Confederacy in the American Civil War
example: She was, I don't know, ninety and she married some sixty-year-old Confederate veteran at some point in time.
exampleZh: 她大概有,大概有,九十岁,她在某个时期嫁给了一个,六十岁的南部邦联老兵

meaning: v. 授予，赋予；商讨，交换意见；【名】 （Confer）（英）康弗 （人名）
definition: 1. to exchange ideas on a particular subject, often in order to reach a decision on what action to take；2. to give an official title, honour, or advantage to someone
example: He wanted to confer with his colleagues before reaching a decision.
exampleZh: 他想与他的同事先商议一下再作出决定。

meaning: n. （大型、正式的）会议，研讨会；（小型正式的）商讨，讨论；体育协会（或联合会）
definition: 1. n. a prearranged meeting for consultation or exchange of information or discussion (especially one with a formal agenda)；2. n. an association of sports teams that organizes matches for its members
example: And he had a press conference, spoke about the increased use of cars, and the decreased amount of carpooling.
exampleZh: 他开了一个新闻发布会，说道汽车使用量的增加，和拼车的减少。

meaning: v. 供认，招供；承认，坦白；忏悔，告解；聆听忏悔
definition: 1. v. confess to a punishable or reprehensible deed, usually under pressure；2. v. admit, make a clean breast of
example: Now, at this point I have to just confess, as I've confessed at other times before, the three is a claim about empirical science.
exampleZh: 在这一点上我必须承认,像我之前承认过的那样,前提三是关于实证科学的

meaning: n. 供认，供状；承认，坦白；忏悔，告解；声明，告白
definition: 1. n. an admission of misdeeds or faults；2. n. a written document acknowledging an offense and signed by the guilty party
example: A desperate honesty that throbs through his confession does not absolve him from sins of diabolical cunning. He is abnormal.
exampleZh: 他的忏悔被绝望的虔诚悸动着,但这也不能为他那恶魔的狡诈赎罪，他是变态。

meaning: v. 托付，委托；吐露，倾诉
definition: 1. to tell something secret or personal to someone who you trust not to tell anyone else；2. to tell something secret or personal to someone whom you trust not to tell anyone else
example: Many see friendships as a comfort blanket, a shoulder to cry on, a reliable soul to confide in.
exampleZh: 许多人把友谊看作是一条安慰的毯子，一个哭泣时依靠的肩膀，一个倾诉时信赖的对象。

meaning: n. 自信，信心；信任，信赖；把握，肯定；保密，机密；秘密，知心话
definition: 1. n. freedom from doubt; belief in yourself and your abilities；2. n. a feeling of trust (in someone or something)
example: then I think absolutely plastic surgery can... maybe should be used if it's going to help with your self-confidence.
exampleZh: 那么我觉得整形手术一定能……如果它能帮你增强自信，就应该整形。

meaning: adj. （性格，态度）自信的，充满信心的；坚信的，肯定的；n. 密友，知己
definition: 1. adj. having or marked by confidence or assurance；2. adj. persuaded of; very sure
example: It's in this period that Milton increasingly begins to adopt, or assume, Saint Peter's confident and denunciatory rhetoric.
exampleZh: 就是在这段时间弥尔顿越来越接受，去采用，圣彼得的有信心的责难似的语言。

meaning: adj. 机密的，保密的；（言谈举止）神秘的，隐秘的；受信任的，委以机密的
definition: 1. adj. entrusted with private information and the confidence of another；2. adj. (of information) given in confidence or in secret
example: From time to time he passed on confidential information to him.
exampleZh: 他不时地传送机密情报给他。

meaning: n. 布局，构造；配置
definition: 1. the particular arrangement or pattern of a group of related things；2. the way in which all the equipment that makes up a computer system is set to operate
example: And we put up this hypothesis that our observation is that octet stability seems to be an attractive electron configuration.
exampleZh: 我们把假设置于我们的观察之上,即8电子稳定体系,似乎是一种吸引人的电子图像。

meaning: v. 限制，局限；防止……扩散；关押，监禁；使离不开（或受困于床、轮椅等）；n. 边界，范围；限制，局限
definition: 1. v. restrict or confine,；2. v. place limits on (extent or access)
example: I will confine myself to looking at the period from 1900 to 1916.
exampleZh: 我将把自己考察的范围限定在1900年至1916年这段时间以内。

meaning: n. 监禁，关押；分娩，生产
definition: 1. n. concluding state of pregnancy; from the onset of labor to the birth of a child；2. n. the act of restraining of a person's liberty by confining them
example: Last night he was being held in solitary confinement in Douglas jail.
exampleZh: 昨夜，他在道格拉斯监狱中被单独监禁。

meaning: v. 确定，确认；证实，证明；批准，认可；使坚定，加强；给（某人）施坚信礼
definition: 1. v. establish or strengthen as with new evidence or facts；2. v. strengthen or make more firm
example: A brief dip into history serves to confirm this view.
exampleZh: 随便翻阅一下历史就足以证实这种观点。

meaning: n. 确认，确定；证实，证明；批准，许可；坚信礼，坚振礼
definition: 1. n. additional proof that something that was believed (some fact or hypothesis or theory) is correct；2. n. information that confirms or verifies
example: One is what we talked about before regarding first impressions, which is a confirmation bias.
exampleZh: 其中一个就是我们之间谈第一印象是，讲到的确认偏向。

meaning: n. 争执，争论，分歧；战斗，战争；抵触，矛盾；v. 冲突，抵触
definition: 1. n. an open clash between two opposing groups (or individuals)；2. v. be in conflict
example: And obviously within this long period many many different ideas and perspectives were involved within each side of conflict.
exampleZh: 很明显，很久了,非常多的不同的观点和看法,出现在冲突的双方之中。

meaning: v. 遵守，符合；顺从，随潮流；一致，相吻合
definition: 1. v. be similar, be in line with；2. v. adapt or conform oneself to new or different conditions
example: The lamp has been designed to conform to new safety standards.
exampleZh: 该灯设计得符合新的安全标准。

meaning: n. 遵守，依照；随大流，循规蹈矩；符合，一致；信奉英国国教
definition: 1. n. correspondence in form or appearance；2. n. acting according to certain accepted standards
example: You'll hear maybe later about, or maybe you've already about Milgram and maybe Asch conformity and maybe Robber's Cave.
exampleZh: 可能不久后，你们将会接触到，可能已经知道心理学家米尔格拉姆,阿施“权威服从”实验,盗贼洞穴心理实验。

meaning: v. 面对，面临；正视，处理；对峙，对抗；对质，当面对证
definition: 1. v. oppose, as in hostility or a competition；2. v. deal with (something unpleasant) head on
example: One of the reasons I like it, is it really does confront you with this very clear picture.
exampleZh: 我喜欢这本书的原因之一，是它真的让你置身于,一幅清晰的画面之中。

meaning: n. 对抗，冲突；战斗，战役
definition: 1. n. a bold challenge；2. n. discord resulting from a clash of ideas or opinions
example: They will plead with him to pull back from confrontation.
exampleZh: 他们会恳求他不要再对抗下去。

meaning: adj. （与）孔子（有关）的，（与）儒家、儒学或儒教（有关）的；n. 儒家学者，孔子的门徒
definition: 1. n. a believer in the teachings of Confucius；2. adj. relating to or characteristic of Confucianism
example: The ceremony reproduced procedures of traditional spring Confucius fete as are recorded in the Confucian classics.
exampleZh: 祭孔仪式依据典籍记载，通过诵读祭文等程序再现传统祭祀孔子的场景。

meaning: n. 儒家思想，儒学，孔子学说：源于中国古代哲学家孔子的道德、伦理和政治理念，强调家庭、社会和政治秩序的重要性；儒教：作为传统宗教或礼仪传统看待的儒家学说。
definition: 1. n. the teachings of Confucius emphasizing love for humanity; high value given to learning and to devotion to family (including ancestors); peace; justice; influenced the traditional culture of China
example: Confucianism is the largest Chinese school of thoughts, and the mainstream consciousness of the ancient China.
exampleZh: 儒家思想是中国最大的思想流派，也是中国古代的主流意识。

meaning: v. 使糊涂，使迷惑；混淆，弄错；使复杂化
definition: 1. v. mistake one thing for another；2. v. be confusing or perplexing to; cause to be unable to think clearly
example: So this last version of the red light introduces interesting complications which I don't think should confuse us.
exampleZh: 所以，关于红灯的这最后一个例子,让我们思考了平时不会思考的问题。

meaning: n. 困惑，不明确；混淆，混同；慌乱，窘迫；混乱局面，乱成一团
definition: 1. n. disorder resulting from a failure to behave predictably；2. n. a mental state characterized by a lack of clear and orderly thought and behavior
example: Now, I think there's a deliberate confusion here about these lines because their precise historical significance isn't what's most significant.
exampleZh: 这里有一个刻意而为的困惑,是关于这些句子中严谨的历史意义的,而不是关于什么是最重要的。

meaning: v. 祝贺，向……道贺；感到高兴（或自豪）
definition: 1. v. say something to someone that expresses praise；2. v. express congratulations
example: I would first of all, congratulate you for taking the first step of starting to learn that process.
exampleZh: 我会首先祝贺你踏出了学习语言的第一步，

meaning: n. 恭喜，祝贺；恭贺，贺辞
definition: 1. n. the act of acknowledging that someone has an occasion for celebration；2. n. (usually plural) an expression of pleasure at the success or good fortune of another
example: She flashed him a false smile of congratulation.
exampleZh: 她向他虚情假意地微微一笑表示祝贺。

meaning: adj. 祝贺的，恭贺的
definition: 1. adj. expressive of sympathetic pleasure or joy on account of someone's success or good fortune
example: The waitress brings over some congratulatory glasses of champagne, courtesy of the restaurant.
exampleZh: 蒙饭店的好意，女侍者们送过来几杯表示祝贺的香槟酒。

meaning: v. 集合，聚集；adj. 集合在一起的
definition: 1. to come together in a large group of people or animals；2. to gather together into a large group
example: Young people often congregate in the main square in the evenings.
exampleZh: 年轻人傍晚时经常聚集在大广场上。

meaning: n. 教堂会众；一群，聚集的人（或物）
definition: 1. a group of people who have come together in a religious building for worship and prayer；2. a group of people gathered together for religious worship
example: The congregation listened in silence as the minister addressed the community's recent losses.
exampleZh: 牧师谈及社区近来的损失时，会众静静地聆听着。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 国会，议会；代表大会；美国国会（Congress）
definition: 1. n. the legislature of the United States government；2. n. a meeting of elected or appointed representatives
example: Because he was warning Congress that there was problems down the roads, especially with Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.
exampleZh: 因为他之前就向国会发出警告,说现行做法存在问题，特别是房地美和房利美。

meaning: adj. 立法机构的，代表大会的，（美国）国会的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to congress
example: The Congressional Budget Office says the federal deficit shows every sign of getting larger.
exampleZh: 国会预算办公室称联邦赤字显示出种种增加的迹象。

meaning: n. 结合，同时发生；连词；（占星术中两个天体的）相合
definition: 1. n. the temporal property of two things happening at the same time；2. n. the state of being joined together
example: The system is designed to be used in conjunction with a word processing program.
exampleZh: 本系统是为与文字处理软件配合使用而设计的。

meaning: v. （使）连接；（使）相通；使接通（电源、水源等）；与……有关系；把……联系起来；衔接，联运；（使）换乘（飞机或火车）；给……接通电话；产生共鸣，契合；建立良好关系；击中
definition: 1. v. connect, fasten, or put together two or more pieces；2. v. make a logical or causal connection
example: The canal was built to connect Sheffield with the Humber estuary.
exampleZh: 修建这条运河是为了将设菲尔德和亨伯河河口连接起来。

meaning: n. 关系，联系；连接，接通；连接物，接头；联运，转车，转机；交通线；人际关系，人脉；亲戚，旁系亲属；毒品贩子
definition: 1. n. a relation between things or events (as in the case of one causing the other or sharing features with it)；2. n. the state of being connected
example: If you think about it, every single person in this world has some connection to money, they all hate it.
exampleZh: 不妨想一想，世界上的每个个人都和钱,有关系，他们都讨厌它。

meaning: n. 内涵意义，隐含意义，联想意义
definition: 1. a feeling or idea that is suggested by a particular word although it need not be a part of the word's meaning, or something suggested by an object or situation；2. a feeling or idea that is suggested by a word in addition to its basic meaning, or something suggested by an object or situation
example: In any case, the tension between denotation and connotation is part of the way in which irony works.
exampleZh: 在任何情况下，讽刺的作用,都是表达了符号和涵义之间的张力。

meaning: v. 占领，攻克，征服；击败，战胜；克服（恐惧），解决（问题）；成功攀登；在……很受欢迎，在……取得成功
definition: 1. v. to put down by force or authority；2. v. take possession of by force, as after an invasion
example: The only way to conquer a fear is to face it.
exampleZh: 克服恐惧的唯一方法是正视恐惧。

meaning: n. 征服者，胜利者
definition: 1. n. someone who is victorious by force of arms
example: The conquered had to render tribute to the conqueror.
exampleZh: 被征服者只得向征服者称臣纳贡。

meaning: n. 征服，占领；占领地，征服的土地；克服，攻克；爱情的俘虏；【名】 （Conquest）（英）康奎斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of conquering；2. n. success in mastering something difficult
example: They have found really no evidence of extensive conquest and destruction in thirteenth and twelfth century archaeological layers.
exampleZh: 他们并没有找到大规模占领的证据,十三世纪摧毁和十二世纪考古层的证据。

meaning: n. 良知，良心；内疚，愧疚；【名】 （Conscience）（法）孔西延斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. motivation deriving logically from ethical or moral principles that govern a person's thoughts and actions；2. n. conformity to one's own sense of right conduct
example: I'll just take up the list toward the end: "transcendentality, consciousness, or conscience, God, man, and so forth."
exampleZh: 我来把这张表说完：,“先验性，意识，上帝，人类，等“

meaning: adj. 认真的，勤勤恳恳的；凭良心的，与良心有关的
definition: 1. adj. characterized by extreme care and great effort；2. adj. guided by or in accordance with conscience or sense of right and wrong
example: Brooks emerged from his conscientious objection " to share in the gruesome bounty.
exampleZh: 虽然良心上极力拒绝，但布鲁克斯,最终还是加入了这骇人的“盛宴。

meaning: adj. 意识到的；神志清醒的，有知觉的；关注的；刻意的，慎重的
definition: 1. adj. intentionally conceived；2. adj. knowing and perceiving; having awareness of surroundings and sensations and thoughts
example: I have made a conscious choice that I can't drive to work, I do have a spot in the parking garage.
exampleZh: 我都会故意,不开车上班，我的车,停在车库里。

meaning: n. 知觉，清醒；思想，意识；（群体的）观念体系；感知，察觉
definition: 1. n. an alert cognitive state in which you are aware of yourself and your situation；2. n. having knowledge of
example: For Nietzsche, the underpinnings of consciousness which make the operations of consciousness inauthentic are the nature of language itself.
exampleZh: 尼采认为，意识的支柱中,使得意识非真的是,语言的本质。

meaning: adj. 连续的，不间断的
definition: 1. Consecutive events, numbers, etc. follow one after another without an interruption；2. following one after another without an interruption
example: The Cup was won for the third consecutive year by the Toronto Maple Leafs.
exampleZh: 这个奖杯连续第三年由多伦多枫叶队赢去了。

meaning: n. 一致看法，共识
definition: 1. n. agreement in the judgment or opinion reached by a group as a whole
example: The consensus among the world's scientists is that the world is likely to warm up over the next few decades.
exampleZh: 全世界科学家的共识是地球可能在未来几十年中变暖。

meaning: n. 许可，允许；同意，赞同；正式批准文件，批文；v. 赞同，准许，同意；【名】 （Consent）（美、法、荷）孔桑（人名）
definition: 1. n. permission to do something；2. v. give an affirmative reply to; respond favorably to
example: At no time did I give my consent to the plan.
exampleZh: 我从未同意过这项计划。

meaning: n. 结果，后果；重要性，价值
definition: 1. n. a phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon；2. n. the outcome of an event especially as relative to an individual
example: Humans suffered as a consequence from nutritional deficiencies in almost all parts of the world because there weren't complete diets.
exampleZh: 几乎全世界的人们都饱受营养不良的困扰,因为他们没有平衡的食谱

meaning: adj. 随之发生的，由此引起的；（河流，山谷）顺向的；n. 后件，推断；（音乐）答题，答句
definition: 1. adj. following as an effect or result
example: The warming of the Earth and the consequent climatic changes affect us all.
exampleZh: 全球变暖以及随之而来的气候变化影响我们每个人。

meaning: adv. 因此，结果
definition: 1. adv. (sentence connectors) because of the reason given；2. adv. as a consequence
example: Consequently, even as the blogosphere continues to expand, only a few blogs are likely to emerge as focal points.
exampleZh: 因此，虽然博客空间继续扩大，但只有少数博客有可能脱颖而出成为焦点。

meaning: adj. 保守的；保守派的，保守主义的（认为政府应该实行政治保守主义）；（衣着）守旧的，传统的；低估的；保守党的；不愿冒险的，谨慎的；n. 保守者，因循守旧者；保守党党员，保守党支持者
definition: 1. n. a person who has conservative ideas or opinions；2. adj. resistant to change
example: And not everyone believes that the former Governor of Massachusetts is quite so conservative as he now seems.
exampleZh: 并不是所有人都相信,前马萨诸塞州州长,会像他看上去那样,是个保守派

meaning: v. 保护，保存；节省，节约；使（量，如能量、质量）守恒；将……制成蜜饯；n. 蜜饯，果脯
definition: 1. to keep and protect something from damage, change, or waste；2. a type of jam in which the fruit is whole or in large pieces
example: We should conserve oil and gas by making full use of other energy sources.
exampleZh: 我们应该通过充分利用其他能源节约石油和天然气。

meaning: n. 保护，保存；节约，防止浪费；守恒定律
definition: 1. the protection of plants and animals, natural areas, and interesting and important structures and buildings, especially from the damaging effects of human activity；2. carefully using valuable natural substances that exist in limited amounts in order to make certain that they will be available for as long a time as possible
example: The district is under consideration for designation as a conservation area.
exampleZh: 正在考虑将这个地区指定为保护区。

meaning: v. 考虑，斟酌；认为，视为；体贴，顾及；细看，端详；探讨，讨论
definition: 1. v. deem to be；2. v. give careful consideration to
example: With any innovation, it's important not only to launch it properly but also to consider how to sustain it over time.
exampleZh: 对于任何发明，重要的不仅仅是,正确的使用它，还要考虑,怎样维护它。

meaning: n. 考虑，斟酌；考虑因素；体贴，关心；报酬，酬金；（合同协议中的）对价，约因；重要（性）
definition: 1. n. the process of giving careful thought to something；2. n. information that should be kept in mind when making a decision
example: Now that's precisely the question that Freud asked himself in Beyond the Pleasure Principle, a text which begins with a consideration of trauma victims.
exampleZh: 这就是弗洛伊德,在他的《超越快乐原则》中提到的核心问题，整篇文章以对创伤患者的考虑开始。

meaning: prep. 考虑到，鉴于；conj. 考虑到，鉴于；adv. 从各方面考虑，通盘考虑；v. 考虑，斟酌；认为，视为；体贴，顾及（consider 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. v. deem to be；2. v. give careful consideration to
example: Whatever you're reading, it's always worth thinking about and considering what the motives might be for such extraordinary literary risk taking.
exampleZh: 不管是读什么，想想作者,为什么会不惜冒这么大的险,总是有意义的。

meaning: adj. 相当大的，相当重要的；（人）显要的，值得尊敬的
definition: 1. adj. large or relatively large in number or amount or extent or degree
example: He is personally responsible for the reforms, the opening up of Russia to a considerable extent to western European ideas.
exampleZh: 他负起了改革的责任,即俄国对于西欧思想,如此大程度的开放

meaning: adj. 体贴的，考虑周到的；小心的，谨慎的
definition: 1. adj. showing concern for the rights and feelings of others
example: If we're going to be considerate world citizens what can we do about the area of diet?
exampleZh: 我们作为世界公民的,健康饮食考虑的话,我们能做些什么

meaning: v. 由……组成，由……构成；在于，存在于；n. （铁路）车列
definition: 1. v. originate (in)；2. v. have its essential character; be comprised or contained in; be embodied in
example: It wasn't nearly as big as Rome, which would consist of a million inhabitants fairly quickly around this time.
exampleZh: 而且也没有罗马那么大，罗马当时能快速聚集百万居民。

meaning: adj. 始终如一的，一贯的；持续的，连续的；固守的，坚持的；一致的，吻合的
definition: 1. adj. (sometimes followed by `with') in agreement or consistent or reliable；2. adj. capable of being reproduced
example: They are quite unlikable, and this is consistent pretty much across O'Connor's fiction : short, long, medium, whatever.
exampleZh: 他们一点都不可爱，这些由始至终贯穿于她的作品里：,短篇的，长篇的，中篇的，无论哪种都是。

meaning: n. 一致性，连贯性；黏稠度，平滑度
definition: 1. n. the property of holding together and retaining its shape；2. n. a harmonious uniformity or agreement among things or parts
example: Dilute the paint with water until it is the consistency of milk.
exampleZh: 用水把颜料稀释到牛奶的黏稠度。

meaning: vt. 安慰；慰藉；n. 控制台，仪表盘；电视机（或收音机）柜；风琴的操作部分；（带装饰的）支架，支托；【名】 （Console）（意、罗）孔索莱（人名）
definition: 1. to make someone who is sad or disappointed feel better, usually by giving them comfort or sympathy；2. a surface or device with controls for electronic equipment, a vehicle, etc.
example: I can console myself with the fact that I'm not alone.
exampleZh: 我可以用不只我一个人的这种事实来安慰自己。

meaning: n. 安慰，起安慰作用的人（物）
definition: 1. something that makes someone who is sad or disappointed feel better；2. something that gives comfort to someone who is sad or disappointed
example: The only consolation for the baseball team is that they look likely to get another chance.
exampleZh: 对这支棒球队的惟一安慰是他们看来可能会得到另一次机会。

meaning: v. 使巩固，使加强；合并，统一
definition: 1. v. unite into one；2. v. make firm or secure; strengthen
example: Cooper and her colleagues argue that a "town of culture" award could consolidate the town city ties in Britain.
exampleZh: 库珀和她的同事们认为，“文化之城”奖可以巩固英国城镇与城市间的联系。

meaning: n. 巩固；合并
definition: 1. n. combining into a solid mass；2. n. the act of combining into an integral whole
example: Now, we have a process in late Medieval Europe of the consolidation of territorial monarchies.
exampleZh: 现在,我们来探讨欧洲中世纪末期的,领土兼并以及王权强化

meaning: adj. 出色的，引人注目的；显眼的，明显的
definition: 1. very noticeable or attracting attention, often in a way that is not wanted；2. easily noticed; obvious
example: The code is unusually conspicuous, complex, and enigmatic; it attracts an inordinate amount of attention to itself, and this attention has to acquire the rigor of a method.
exampleZh: 这种代码通常很显著，复杂，神秘;,它把大量的注意力都吸引到自己身上，这种注意力得有一种方法的严肃性。

meaning: v. 密谋，共谋；共同导致
definition: 1. to plan secretly with other people to do something bad, illegal, or against someone's wishes；2. to plan secretly with other people to do something bad, illegal, or against someone’s wishes
example: Now Joseph's brothers are jealous of Jacob's partiality to Joseph, and they conspire to get rid of him.
exampleZh: 现在约瑟夫的兄弟们都妒忌雅各布对他的偏爱，他们密谋要解决掉他。

meaning: n. 阴谋，密谋；阴谋集团
definition: 1. the activity of secretly planning with other people to do something bad or illegal；2. a general agreement to keep silent about a subject for the purpose of keeping it secret
example: When they got them rejected it's because there's a conspiracy against them by jealous editors and reviewers.
exampleZh: 当论文被拒绝时,那是因为有人要背后搞阴谋,那些编辑和评论员嫉妒他。

meaning: adj. 持续不断的，经常发生的；恒定的，不变的；忠诚的，忠实的；n. 常数，恒量；不变的事物；【名】 （Constant） （德）康斯坦特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a quantity that does not vary；2. adj. persistent in occurrence and unvarying in nature
example: Now for this experiment, this is a constant enthalpy experiment for the Joule-Thomson experiment, this is equal to zero.
exampleZh: 对于这个实验，焦耳-汤姆逊实验,是一个焓不变的实验,焓变化等于0，所以我可以。

meaning: n. 选民；成分，构成要素；委托人；adj. 组成的，构成的；选举的，有任命（或选举）权的；立宪的，有宪法制定（或修改）权的
definition: 1. one of the parts that a substance or combination is made of；2. a voter (= person who can vote) in a particular area of the country
example: Over time, the protein in the eggshell breaks down into its constituent amino acids.
exampleZh: 随着时间的推移,蛋壳中的蛋白质分解成其构成成分氨基酸。

meaning: n. 选区，选区的选民；支持者，顾客
definition: 1. one of the official areas of a country that elects someone to represent it in a parliament or legislature；2. the people who live and can vote in a particular area
example: That created a big constituency in favor of a dumb change. There was little warning.
exampleZh: 这造就了一种悄无声息的变化,没有人提出警告。

meaning: v. 组成，构成；是，被视为；成立，设立；任命
definition: 1. v. form or compose；2. v. create and charge with a task or function
example: Testing patients without their consent would constitute a professional and legal offence.
exampleZh: 未得病人同意即对其进行试验会构成职业和法律犯罪。

meaning: n. 宪法，章程；体质，体格；组成，结构
definition: 1. n. law determining the fundamental political principles of a government；2. n. the act of forming something
example: It's subsequently seen as one of the precursors of the First Amendment to the American Constitution.
exampleZh: 后来它被看作是美国宪法,第一修正案的前身。

meaning: adj. 宪法的；宪法规定的，合乎宪法的；体质的，体格的；本性的，天性的；n. 保健散步
definition: 1. n. a regular walk taken as a form of exercise；2. adj. of or relating to a constitution
example: The example, and the ideas it produced, encouraged and informed the French and the American revolutions, and the entire modern constitutional tradition.
exampleZh: 这次革命和它的理念,促成了,法国和美国的大革命,并使现代宪法制度得以发展

meaning: v. 限制，约束；强迫，迫使
definition: 1. to control and limit something；2. to limit someone's freedom, or to limit the way something develops or grows
example: Recommendation engines, which are increasingly prevalent intermediaries in people's consumption of culture, may serve to constrain choice and minimize luck.
exampleZh: 推荐引擎作为人们文化消费中越来越普遍的中介，可能会限制选择并最大限度地减少运气成分。

meaning: n. 限制，束缚；克制，拘束
definition: 1. something that controls what you do by keeping you within particular limits；2. unnatural behaviour that is sometimes the result of forcing yourself to act in a particular way
example: Journalists were given the freedom to visit, investigate, and report without constraint.
exampleZh: 新闻记者被赋予在没有约束下参观、调查和报道的自由。

meaning: v. 建造，修建；组成，创立，构思；绘制，作图；n. 构想，观念；建筑物，创造物；结构体
definition: 1. n. an abstract or general idea inferred or derived from specific instances；2. v. make by combining materials and parts
example: All right. The fourth thing I'm going to do, is I'm going to then construct the block of code.
exampleZh: 好，我要做的第四件事情就是，我会去写这块循环代码。

meaning: n. 建造，建筑；创立，构建；构造，结构；建筑物；语法结构；解释，理解
definition: 1. n. the act of constructing something；2. n. the commercial activity involved in repairing old structures or constructing new ones
example: So, if you look at any engineering system, the performance of that engineering system is a function of its design and its construction.
exampleZh: 如果你们观察过工程系统，工程系统的性能就是,它的设计和构造的功能。

meaning: n. 领事馆；领事职位；〈史〉古罗马执政官任期
definition: 1. the office where a consul works；2. the office of a consul
example: The first Australian consulate officials will travel to the East Timor capital next week.
exampleZh: 第一批澳大利亚领事馆官员将于下周前往东帝汶首都。

meaning: n. 领事；（古罗马的）两执政官之一；【名】 （Consul）（法）孔叙尔（人名）
definition: 1. an official chosen by a government to live in a foreign city, in order to take care of people from the official's own country who travel or live there, and to protect the trade interests of that government；2. a government official who lives in a foreign city and takes care of people from his or her own country who live or are travelling there. Part of a consul's job is also to protect the trade and business interests of his or her own country in the foreign country
example: He'll hold the post of consul general for the United States in Shanghai.
exampleZh: 他将就任美国驻上海总领事。

meaning: v. 咨询，请教；商量，商讨；查询，查阅；当顾问
definition: 1. v. get or ask advice from；2. v. seek information from
example: If your skin becomes red, sore or very scaly, consult your doctor.
exampleZh: 如果你的皮肤变红，疼痛或严重脱皮，请咨询医生。

meaning: n. 商讨，磋商，磋商会议；咨询，就诊；查找，查阅
definition: 1. n. a conference (usually with someone important)；2. n. a conference between two or more people to consider a particular question
example: A personal diet plan is devised after a consultation with a nutritionist.
exampleZh: 经向营养师作咨询后，一份个人饮食方案设计出来了。

meaning: adj. 咨询的，顾问的
definition: 1. adj. giving advice
example: It includes consultative, diagnostic, and treatment services.
exampleZh: 它包括咨询、诊断和治疗的服务。
