meaning: n. 顾问；高级顾问医师，会诊医师；咨询者
definition: 1. n. an expert who gives advice
example: Okay, so I work in the TV industry in London as a gardening consultant.
exampleZh: 好的，我在伦敦的电视行业工作，是一名园艺顾问。

meaning: v. 消耗，消费；吃，喝；吞噬，烧毁；使……着迷，充满
definition: 1. v. eat immoderately；2. v. serve oneself to, or consume regularly
example: Many people are unaware of just how much food and drink they consume.
exampleZh: 许多人不知道自己到底消耗掉多少食物和饮料。

meaning: n. 消费者，顾客，用户；食用者，使用者，消耗者
definition: 1. n. a person who uses goods or services
example: But I was a really good programmer and I wanted to understand the consumer side of the Internet.
exampleZh: 但我是个很好的程序设计师,我想了解互联网关于消费者的一面。

meaning: n. 消费，消耗；食用，引用，吸入；专用；肺痨，肺结核
definition: 1. n. the process of taking food into the body through the mouth (as by eating)；2. n. involving the lungs with progressive wasting of the body
example: They enforced complete sharing and if you belonged to a kibbutz you were completely stuck with the common consumption.
exampleZh: 强迫人们绝对共享,如果你是某个集体农场的一员,就彻底受到共同消费的制约。

meaning: n. 联系，联络；接触，触摸；联络人，熟人，社会关系；会见，往来，接触；传染病接触者；隐形眼镜；接通电，触点，接头；（无线电）通信；v. 联系，联络；接触；adj. 供联络的；接触性的，通过接触而起作用的
definition: 1. n. close interaction；2. v. be in or establish communication with
example: that you can contact directly instead of having to go through the bureaucracy of the big university.
exampleZh: 你可以直接和他们联系，而不用通过耶鲁大学的官僚机构。

meaning: adj. （疾病）接触性传染的；（情感）具有感染力的；患接触传染病的
definition: 1. A contagious disease can be caught by touching someone who has the disease or by touching an infected object, or by an infected person coughing, sneezing, etc. near you；2. A contagious person has a disease that they can pass to other people
example: Laughter could be viewed as a form of involuntary noisemaking and it's contagious.
exampleZh: 我们可以把笑声视为不由自主地发出的声音,然后笑声有感染性。

meaning: v. 包含，容纳；遏制，防止……蔓延；抑制（感情）
definition: 1. v. include or contain; have as a component；2. v. contain or hold; have within
example: This is Barth's effort to enclose the silence into something readable, to contain that impossibility in the structure of the story.
exampleZh: 这是巴斯想把沉默嵌套到某些可阅读的的，在故事的结构中包含一些不可能的努力。

meaning: n. 容器；集装箱，货柜
definition: 1. n. any object that can be used to hold things (especially a large metal boxlike object of standardized dimensions that can be loaded from one form of transport to another)
example: Modest container theories, that is, say there's a value to being alive, but it can in principle be outweighed.
exampleZh: 保守的有价值容器理论认为，活着有一定的价值，但是按道理它可以被超越。

meaning: n. 控制，抑制；（对他国力量的）遏制
definition: 1. n. a policy of creating strategic alliances in order to check the expansion of a hostile power or ideology or to force it to negotiate peacefully；2. n. (physics) a system designed to prevent the accidental release of radioactive material from a reactor
example: Fire crews are hoping they can achieve full containment of the fire before the winds pick up.
exampleZh: 消防队员们希望他们能够在起风前对大火做到完全控制。

meaning: v. 污染，弄脏；毒害，腐蚀（人的思想或品德）
definition: 1. v. make impure；2. v. make radioactive by adding radioactive material
example: This heavy metal, which can contaminate water and soil, can interfere with nearly every aspect of fetal development.
exampleZh: 这种重金属可以污染水和土壤，几乎可以干扰胎儿发育的各个方面。

meaning: n. 污染
definition: 1. n. the state of being contaminated；2. n. a substance that contaminates
example: The contamination of the ocean around Puget Sound may be just the beginning.
exampleZh: 普吉特海湾周围海域的污染可能才开始。

meaning: v. 沉思，深思熟虑；盘算，打算；凝视，注视；考虑接受（发生某事的可能性）
definition: 1. to spend time considering a possible future action, or to consider one particular thing for a long time in a serious and quiet way；2. to spend time considering a possible future action, or to consider one particular thing for a long time in a serious way
example: But if you contemplate your own way of thinking about what you're supposed to be doing with your life.
exampleZh: 如果你以自己的思维方式沉思,为了生活你应该去做什么

meaning: n. 沉思，冥想；打算，意图；凝视，默默注视
definition: 1. serious and quiet thought for a period of time
example: He had read much, if one considers his long life, but his contemplation was much more than his reading.
exampleZh: 人们说他漫长的一生，便一定会说他饱读诗书，但他的思想却比他的阅读丰富得多。

meaning: adj. 沉思的，冥思的；（对宗教问题）冥想的，敛心默祷的；n. 宗教思想家
definition: 1. involving quiet and serious thought for a period of time
example: Martin is a quiet, contemplative sort of child.
exampleZh: 马丁是个安静沉思型孩子。

meaning: adj. 当代的，现代的；同时期的，同时代的；n. 同时代的人；同龄人，同辈
definition: 1. n. a person of nearly the same age as another；2. adj. characteristic of the present
example: Galileo is the only contemporary personage, the only seventeenth-century figure, even so much as mentioned in Paradise Lost.
exampleZh: 伽利略是唯一的一个当代人物，唯一的一个17世纪的人物，甚至在里也提到了这点。

meaning: n. 轻视，蔑视；忽视，不顾；藐视法庭
definition: 1. n. lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike；2. n. a manner that is generally disrespectful and contemptuous
example: There may be other variables at play but, all things being equal, similarity does not breed contempt.
exampleZh: 可能有其他因素发挥作用,但是，如果所有因素都一样，如果两个人相似，就不会轻视对方。

meaning: adj. 可鄙的，卑劣的
definition: 1. adj. deserving of contempt or scorn
example: Despite smiling outwardly, many people who receive sarcastic comments feel put down and often think the sarcastic person is rude, or contemptible.
exampleZh: 许多收到讽刺性评论的人，尽管表面上面带微笑，会觉得自己被贬低了，并常常认为讽刺的人粗鲁或可鄙。

meaning: v. 声称，主张；竞争，争夺；处理，对付
definition: 1. v. maintain or assert；2. v. have an argument about something
example: He well knew the futility of trying to contend against witches, so he gave up discouraged.
exampleZh: 他深知与女巫斗争是徒劳无益的，所以他灰心丧气地放弃了。

meaning: n. 看法，观点；争论，争吵；争夺，竞争
definition: 1. n. a point asserted as part of an argument；2. n. a contentious speech act; a dispute where there is strong disagreement
example: His case has become a source of contention between civil liberties activists and the government.
exampleZh: 他的案子已变成了公民自由活动家们和政府之间的争论缘由。

meaning: adj. 有争议的，引起争论的；爱争论的，好争吵的
definition: 1. adj. inclined or showing an inclination to dispute or disagree, even to engage in law suits；2. adj. involving or likely to cause controversy
example: The question of divorce and remarriage in church remains highly contentious.
exampleZh: 离婚和在教堂里再婚的问题仍极具争议。

meaning: adj. 满足的，满意的，甘愿的；n. 目录；所含物，容纳的东西；（书、文章、演讲、电影等的）内容；含量；满足，满意；投赞成票的贵族院议员；网上信息，电子信息；v. 使满意，使满足；【名】 （Content）（法）孔唐（人名）
definition: 1. n. everything that is included in a collection；2. v. satisfy in a limited way
example: And so I help with their media content and create videos that promote their campaigns.
exampleZh: 我帮助制作媒体内容和做视频，用来支持他们的宣传。

meaning: adj. 满足的，满意的；v. 使满意，使满足（content 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. satisfied or showing satisfaction with things as they are
example: Whenever he returns to this place, he is happy and contented.
exampleZh: 每次回到这里，他都是既高兴又满足。

meaning: n. 比赛，竞赛；争夺，竞争；争论，争执；v. 争辩，提出异议；争取赢得，角逐
definition: 1. n. an occasion on which a winner is selected from among two or more contestants；2. v. to make the subject of dispute, contention, or litigation
example: So, the contest, the prizes are neckties, and ladies' scarves. They're very hot.
exampleZh: 在这个测试中，奖品是领带，女生的话给围巾，它们很时髦。

meaning: n. 参赛者，竞争者；争辩者
definition: 1. n. a person who participates in competitions；2. n. a person who dissents from some established policy
example: If a contestant injures himself while attempting to foul his opponent, the referee will not take any action in his favor.
exampleZh: 如果参赛者在企图对对手犯规时弄伤了自己，裁判将不会采取对他有利的行动。

meaning: n. 背景，环境；上下文，语境
definition: 1. n. discourse that surrounds a language unit and helps to determine its interpretation；2. n. the set of facts or circumstances that surround a situation or event
example: There's a way in which the context of the war, too, shadows the poem and remains present in it.
exampleZh: 在战争的背景下，也投影于诗中同时也保持了它的现实性。

meaning: adj. 上下文的，与语境相关的
definition: 1. adj. relating to or determined by or in context
example: The writer builds up a convincing contextual picture of life during the Civil War.
exampleZh: 该作者在文脉上勾勒出内战期间令人信服的生活画面。

meaning: n. 洲，大陆；adj. 有排便节制力的；节制性欲的
definition: 1. n. one of the large landmasses of the earth；2. adj. having control over urination and defecation
example: That is to say, discover an entirely new continent, a new world, so to speak, the new world of Machiavelli.
exampleZh: 也就是说发现了全新的大陆，全新的世界，属于马奇亚维利的全新世界。

meaning: adj. 大洲的，大陆的；欧洲大陆的；具有欧洲特点的；n. （欧洲）大陆人
definition: 1. adj. of or pertaining to or typical of Europe；2. adj. of or relating to or concerning the American colonies during and immediately after the American Revolutionary War
example: He sees no signs of improvement in the U.K. and continental economy.
exampleZh: 他看不出英国和欧洲大陆的经济好转的迹象。

meaning: n. （军队的）分遣队；代表团；adj. 附带的，依情况而定的；偶然（发生）的，可能的
definition: 1. a group of people representing an organization or country, or a part of a military force；2. depending on something else in the future in order to happen
example: Maybe identity, as philosophers like to put it, maybe identity is contingent.
exampleZh: 也许同一性,就像哲学家喜欢说的,也许同一性是偶然的

meaning: v. （使）继续，（使）延续；继续说，接着说；移动，延伸；留任，维持原状
definition: 1. v. continue a certain state, condition, or activity；2. v. continue talking
example: This is a myth that has and will continue to haunt Milton all the way up through Paradise Lost.
exampleZh: 这个神话曾一度而且会一直萦绕着弥尔顿,并贯穿了《失乐园》全诗。

meaning: n. 连续，持续；延续物，附加物；（停顿后的）继续，再开始
definition: 1. n. the act of continuing an activity without interruption；2. n. a part added to a book or play that continues and extends it
example: He predicts a continuation of healthy profits in the current financial year.
exampleZh: 他预测本财政年度能继续保持可观的利润。

meaning: adj. 多次重复的，频繁的；持续的，不间断的
definition: 1. adj. seemingly without interruption; chiefly restricted to what recurs regularly or frequently in a prolonged and closely spaced series；2. adj. `continual' (meaning seemingly uninterrupted) is often used interchangeably with `continuous' (meaning without interruption)
example: The student needs to realize that learning is a continual process—one that is both enjoyable and necessary.
exampleZh: 学生应该意识到学习是一个持续不断的过程——一个令人愉快而又必要的过程。

meaning: adj. 连续不断的，持续的；（语法）进行式的；（函数）连续的
definition: 1. adj. continuing in time or space without interruption；2. adj. of a function or curve; extending without break or irregularity
example: They're trying to lay out an argument which is consistent and continuous and keep surprise to a minimum.
exampleZh: 他们试图自然地建立起一个论点,使之一致，使我们的诧异最小化。

meaning: n. 连续性，连贯性；（电影、电视的）场景串联，衔接；（逻辑上的）连接，联结
definition: 1. n. uninterrupted connection or union；2. n. a detailed script used in making a film in order to avoid discontinuities from shot to shot
example: This continuity of the two scenes next to each other really does not make a lot sense to me.
exampleZh: 就我个人而言,这两幕的衔接很说不过去。

meaning: n. 合同，契约；暗杀协议；（桥牌）定约墩数；婚约，订婚；v. （使）收缩，缩小；签合同，订立契约；患上，感染；订立婚约（或盟约）；欠负（债）
definition: 1. n. a binding agreement between two or more persons that is enforceable by law；2. v. enter into a contractual arrangement
example: Milton makes a covenant with the reader. It's as if he's signing a contract because he's asking for credit here.
exampleZh: 他与读者签了契约，就好像,因为他要借款所以签了份合同一样。

meaning: n. 承包商，立约人
definition: 1. n. someone (a person or firm) who contracts to build things；2. n. the bridge player in contract bridge who wins the bidding and can declare which suit is to be trumps
example: We told the building contractor that we wanted a garage big enough for two cars.
exampleZh: 我们告诉建筑承包商，我们想要一个可以停放两辆汽车的车库。

meaning: n. 收缩，缩小；痉挛，子宫收缩；缩约词，缩约形式；（疾病、习惯等的）招致，染上
definition: 1. n. (physiology) a shortening or tensing of a part or organ (especially of a muscle or muscle fiber)；2. n. the process or result of becoming smaller or pressed together
example: The "I'll" pattern of course, it means the same thing as the "I will." It's only the contraction.
exampleZh: 当然，“I'll” 与 “I will” 句型都表达同样的意思。前者仅仅只是后者的缩写形式。

meaning: v. 反驳，否认；相抵触，相矛盾；发生矛盾
definition: 1. v. be in contradiction with；2. v. deny the truth of
example: So, in my next lecture, what I'm going to do is pretty much contradict most of what I said today.
exampleZh: 在下一次课，我将淡化神学的位置,这与今天我们的工作。

meaning: n. 矛盾，不一致；反驳，驳斥
definition: 1. n. opposition between two conflicting forces or ideas；2. n. (logic) a statement that is necessarily false
example: When there's a contradiction in our heads we're not happy and will take steps to make the contradiction go away.
exampleZh: 当我们的心理活动出现矛盾时,我们会不安，会采取办法,让这种矛盾消失。

meaning: adj. 相互矛盾的，对立的；好反驳的，爱争辩的；n. 矛盾命题
definition: 1. n. two propositions are contradictories if both cannot be true (or both cannot be false) at the same time；2. adj. of words or propositions so related that both cannot be true and both cannot be false
example: Customs officials have made a series of contradictory statements about the equipment.
exampleZh: 海关官员们对于这种设备做出了一系列相互矛盾的陈述。

meaning: adj. 相反的，相对的；乖戾的，好与人作对的；逆向的，逆行的；n. 相反的事实（或事情、情况）；对立命题，反对命题；adv. 相反地
definition: 1. n. a relation of direct opposition；2. adj. very opposed in nature or character or purpose
example: De Man does not believe this. De Man thinks, on the contrary, that there is such a thing as literariness.
exampleZh: 德曼不相信这个，反之，他认为，有书面性这种东西存在。

meaning: n. 差异，对比；对照物，明显不同的事物；（摄影或绘画中的）颜色反差，明暗对比；（电视屏幕的）图像明暗对比度，反差；v. 对比，对照；显出明显的差异，形成对比
definition: 1. n. the opposition or dissimilarity of things that are compared；2. v. put in opposition to show or emphasize differences
example: You could contrast the roguish and fanciful, clearly done by hand, title of the magazine, with that machine-type Blast.
exampleZh: 你们可以把这些明显手写的，无赖而稀奇的标题，和机械化的“暴风“相对比。

meaning: v. 捐赠，捐助；（为……）做贡献；促成，是……的原因之一；撰稿，投稿；发表意见，提议
definition: 1. v. bestow a quality on；2. v. contribute to some cause
example: I expect you to sit there quietly respect your neighbor I expect you to contribute to the learning environment.
exampleZh: 我期待你们安静地坐在这里，尊重周围的同学,我期待你们都对学习环境有所贡献。

meaning: n. 贡献，促成作用；捐款，捐助；（保险金、养老金等的）定期缴款；稿件，投稿
definition: 1. n. any one of a number of individual efforts in a common endeavor；2. n. a voluntary gift (as of money or service or ideas) made to some worthwhile cause
example: So I will take into account it that there is some contribution of both the nucleus and the electron.
exampleZh: 所以我将考虑,那是原子核与电子,共同作用的结果。

meaning: n. 捐赠者，作出贡献者；促成因素；撰稿人，投稿人
definition: 1. n. someone who contributes (or promises to contribute) a sum of money；2. n. a writer whose work is published in a newspaper or magazine or as part of a book
example: Another contributor-submitted patch didn't include a Contributors License Agreement (CLA), so that certainly can't go in.
exampleZh: 另一个贡献者提交的补丁未包括贡献者许可协议（CLA），因此当然不能被收录。

meaning: v. 谋划，策划；设计，发明；设法做到
definition: 1. to arrange a situation or event, or arrange for something to happen, using clever planning；2. to invent and/or make a device or other object in a clever and possibly unusual way
example: I decided to contrive a meeting between the two of them.
exampleZh: 我决定设法让他们双方见上一面。

meaning: n. （对国家、地区、机构等的）控制权，支配权；控制能力；操纵装置；管理，管制；指挥（或检查、控制）站，指挥（或检查、控制）人员；（键盘上的）控制键；v. 控制，掌管；限制，限定；阻止蔓延（或恶化）；操纵，控制（机器或系统等）；抑制，克制
definition: 1. n. power to direct or determine；2. v. exercise authoritative control or power over
example: But the new Presbyterian Party soon developed its own methods of employing state power to control and regulate the church.
exampleZh: 但新的长老派很快就发展了自己的办法,那就是利用政府权力控制和管理教会。

meaning: n. 争论，争议
definition: 1. n. a contentious speech act; a dispute where there is strong disagreement
example: And the terms of the expression change, the parties to the conflict change, the sights change, but the controversy goes on.
exampleZh: 也许人们对这种冲突的表述有所改变，利益双方有所改变，文化景观有所改变，但这种争议永远存在。

meaning: adj. 有争议的，引发争论的
definition: 1. adj. marked by or capable of arousing controversy
example: .. What the Norwegian Government is doing wrong is-- it's a little bit controversial, my pointing this out to them.
exampleZh: 挪威政府做的不对的地方就在于-,这引起了一些争议，我把他们的处境告诉了他们。

meaning: v. 召集，召开（会议）
definition: 1. to bring together a group of people for a meeting, or to meet for a meeting；2. to meet formally as a group, or to arrange a meeting of people or groups for a serious purpose
example: The UN had the foresight to convene a "world assembly on ageing" back in 1982, but that came and went.
exampleZh: 联合国早在1982年就有远见地召开了“老龄化问题世界大会”，但那次大会开完就过去了。

meaning: adj. 方便的，便利的；附近的，方便到达的；适当的
definition: 1. adj. suited to your comfort or purpose or needs；2. adj. easy to reach
example: So it's convenient if you wanna check and see when the next bus is coming.
exampleZh: 用手机可以查下一趟车什么时候来，非常方便。

meaning: n. 方便，便利；便利的事物，便利设施；公共厕所
definition: 1. n. the state of being suitable or opportune；2. n. the quality of being useful and convenient
example: It gives you a lot of expressive convenience, you can write the programs much more cleanly, but most importantly, it's fast.
exampleZh: 你可以把一些程序写的更清楚，最重要的是，它的效率非常高。

meaning: n. 习俗，惯例；大会，集会；公约，协定；（文学、艺术上的）传统手法，传统风格
definition: 1. n. a large formal assembly；2. n. something regarded as a normative example
example: It's a way of thinking about form that has more to do with individuality than it does with convention.
exampleZh: 思考这种形式的方法，与传统习惯相比,与个性更有关系。

meaning: adj. 依照惯例的，遵循习俗的；老一套的，习惯的；（武器等）常规的，非核的
definition: 1. adj. following accepted customs and proprieties；2. adj. conforming with accepted standards
example: It's taken a long time to break out of my own conventional training.
exampleZh: 摆脱我自己的传统训练花了很长一段时间。

meaning: v. （使）汇聚，集中；（观点、目标）趋同；（数）收敛
definition: 1. If lines, roads, or paths converge, they move towards the same point where they join or meet；2. If ideas and opinions converge, they gradually become similar.
example: So I should be taking Arabic because I think it's a so much better way to converge people.
exampleZh: 我应该用阿拉伯语同他们交谈,因为我觉得那是一种更好的方法使人们聚集。

meaning: n. 趋同；汇集，相交；会聚区；收敛（性）；【名】 （Convergence）（法）孔韦尔让斯（人名）
definition: 1. the fact that two or more things, ideas, etc. become similar or come together
example: Experimental results show that the merits in the respects of interactive speed and consistent convergence can be gained.
exampleZh: 实验结果表明，该算法在交互速度和一致性收敛方面具有一定的优势。

meaning: v. 谈话，交谈；n. 相反的事物，反面说法；谈话，交谈；逆命题；adj. 相反的，颠倒的，逆向的；【名】 （Converse）（美、爱）康弗斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a proposition obtained by conversion；2. v. carry on a conversation
example: The child, feeling free and comfortable, started to converse with Peter, and he had to answer many questions.
exampleZh: 孩子感到自由自在，很舒服，开始和彼得交谈，他不得不回答许多问题。

meaning: n. （非正式的）谈话，交谈；社交，交际
definition: 1. n. the use of speech for informal exchange of views or ideas or information etc.
example: So if you answer the phone, you'll be saving me from a long conversation that will last ten hours.
exampleZh: 如果你去接电话的话，我就可以免于一段又臭又长的谈话的痛苦了。

meaning: v. 谈话，交谈；n. 相反的事物，反面说法；谈话，交谈；逆命题；adj. 相反的，颠倒的，逆向的；【名】 （Converse）（美、爱）康弗斯（人名）
definition: 1. the opposite；2. opposite
example: The child, feeling free and comfortable, started to converse with Peter, and he had to answer many questions.
exampleZh: 孩子感到自由自在，很舒服，开始和彼得交谈，他不得不回答许多问题。

meaning: v. （使）转变，（使）转换；（使）改变信仰，（使）皈依；（达阵后）得附加分；使……迷上，使……热衷于；n. 皈依宗教者，改变信仰者；刚迷上……的人，最近开始热衷于……的人；【名】 （Convert）（法）孔韦尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person who has been converted to another religious or political belief；2. v. change the nature, purpose, or function of something
example: It's magical.It's sorcery to take an ore and convert it to metal. It's magic. It still amazes me today.
exampleZh: 非常神奇，采取矿石并将其转变为,金属非常神奇，我现在仍然很吃惊。

meaning: n. 转变，转换；（宗教或信仰的）改变，归附；侵权行为，非法挪用（或侵吞）；改建的房屋；（达阵后的）附加得分
definition: 1. n. an event that results in a transformation；2. n. a change in the units or form of an expression:
example: Currency-conversion costs remain one of the biggest obstacles to cross-border trade.
exampleZh: 货币兑换成本仍是跨境贸易的最大障碍之一。

meaning: adj. 可转换的，可兑换的；（汽车）有活动折蓬的；（词语）同义的；n. 活动顶篷式汽车；可换证券
definition: 1. n. a car that has top that can be folded or removed；2. adj. capable of being exchanged for or replaced by something of equal value
example: In order to keep the currency convertible they had to keep interest rates high to prevent people from demanding the gold.
exampleZh: 为了保持货币的转换性,他们不得不将利率提高,以防人们向他们索求金子的兑换。

meaning: v. 传送，运输；表达，传递；转让（土地、财产等）
definition: 1. v. make known; pass on, of information；2. v. serve as a means for expressing something
example: I have tried to convey something of the flavour of the argument.
exampleZh: 我试图表达某种类似论据的东西。

meaning: n. 运送，输送；运输工具，交通工具；表达，传达；产权转让证书
definition: 1. n. document effecting a property transfer；2. n. the transmission of information
example: The miners rode a conveyance attached to a cable made of braided steel wire.
exampleZh: 矿工们乘坐连着钢索的缆车。

meaning: v. 定罪，宣判……有罪；n. 已决犯，服刑囚犯
definition: 1. to decide officially in a law court that someone is guilty of a crime；2. someone who is in prison because they are guilty of a crime
example: Who said that all the men in the world should wear dull gray suits and convict haircuts?
exampleZh: 谁说世界上所有的男人都应该穿单调的灰色西装，留着罪犯式的发型？

meaning: n. 定罪，判罪；坚定的信仰，深信的观点；确信，深信
definition: 1. the fact of officially being found to be guilty of a particular crime, or the act of officially finding someone guilty；2. a strong opinion or belief
example: It is our firm conviction that a step forward has been taken.
exampleZh: 我们坚信已经向前迈进了一步。

meaning: v. 使确信，使信服；说服，劝服
definition: 1. v. make (someone) agree, understand, or realize the truth or validity of something
example: It became clear that I hadn't been able to convince Mike.
exampleZh: 显然我没能说服迈克。

meaning: adj. 令人信服的，有说服力的；（胜利）轻松的，确定无疑的；v. 使确信，使信服；说服，劝服（convince 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. causing one to believe the truth of something
example: So what we need to examine now is whether John Stuart Mill had a convincing reply to these objections to utilitarianism.
exampleZh: 我们现在的任务是思考穆勒,是否令人信服地回应了对功利主义的质疑。

meaning: n. （尤指护卫）舰队，车队；v. 护送，为……护航
definition: 1. a group of vehicles or ships that travel together, especially for protection；2. travelling one behind another in a row
example: A United Nations aid convoy loaded with food and medicine finally got through to the besieged town.
exampleZh: 一支联合国援助车队载着食物和药物终于抵达了被围困的市镇。

meaning: n. 厨师，炊事员；v. 煮，烧；烹饪，烹调；发生，计划中；干得起劲，干得好；篡改，伪造；【名】 （Cook）（美）库克（人名）
definition: 1. n. someone who cooks food；2. v. prepare a hot meal
example: The olive itself, you use it to cook with as oil; some people just put oil on their salad.
exampleZh: 你可以用它来烹饪,有些人还往沙拉中加入橄榄油

meaning: n. 炊具，锅，厨灶；适宜煮食而不宜生吃的水果（尤指某种苹果）
definition: 1. n. a utensil for cooking
example: The pressure cooker is very useful for people who go out all day.
exampleZh: 压力锅对整天外出的人非常有用。

meaning: n. 曲奇饼，小甜饼；……样的人；（浏览网页后存储在计算机的）缓存文件；淡面包；漂亮的年轻女子
definition: 1. n. any of various small flat sweet cakes (`biscuit' is the British term)；2. n. the cook on a ranch or at a camp
example: Maybe there is no music, so it's just kind of dancing in the middle of a cookie sheet all by himself.
exampleZh: 可能会没有音乐，也许只是在众多饼干人中间,单纯地跳舞。

meaning: adj. 凉的，凉爽的；（衣服布料）使人凉爽的；冷静的，沉着的；时髦的，酷的；没问题，不介意；冷漠的，冷淡的；冷色调的；（钱）大笔的，不折不扣的；v. （使）冷却，（使）变凉；（感情）冷静下来，冷淡下来；adv. 冷静地，镇定地；n. 凉快，凉爽；平静，镇静；时髦，酷；【名】 （Cool）（英）库尔，（法）科尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. the quality of being at a refreshingly low temperature；2. v. make cool or cooler
example: So when I expand this gas adiabatically and it cools down, why do you think it might cool down?
exampleZh: 现在我们知道了气体绝热膨胀时,温度会下载，为什么会降温？

meaning: v. 合作，协作；配合，协助
definition: 1. v. work together on a common enterprise of project
example: They had to cooperate with other people that they owe a debt to society and that that's expressed in taxation.
exampleZh: 必须与他人合作,所以他们欠社会的,所以要用纳税来还。

meaning: n. 合作，协作；协助，配合
definition: 1. n. joint operation or action；2. n. the practice of cooperating
example: In any private cooperation, there is a final line between what is good for management and what is good for shareholders.
exampleZh: 在任何一个私人企业里，总是有一条底线划分,怎样对管理有利,怎样对股东有利。

meaning: adj. 合作的，协作的；乐于配合的；（企业或其他组织）合作性的；n. 合作性组织
definition: 1. n. a jointly owned commercial enterprise (usually organized by farmers or consumers) that produces and distributes goods and services and is run for the benefit of its owners；2. adj. involving the joint activity of two or more
example: She had been charged with being an accessory to the embezzlement of funds from a cooperative farm.
exampleZh: 她已被指控为挪用一个合作农场资金的一个从犯。

meaning: v. 协调，配合；使身体协调；（使颜色、款式、风格等）搭配，配套；给 （原子或分子）配位，与……形成共价键；n. 坐标；配套服装；同等级（或类别）的人（或事物）；adj. 地位相当的，同等重要的；（语法）并列的；（化学）配位的
definition: 1. n. a number that identifies a position relative to an axis；2. v. bring order and organization to
example: Government officials visited the earthquake zone on Thursday morning to coordinate the relief effort.
exampleZh: 政府官员星期四上午视察了地震灾区以协调救灾工作。

meaning: n. 协调，配合；身体的协调性；配位；同一等级（或类别）
definition: 1. n. the skillful and effective interaction of movements；2. n. the regulation of diverse elements into an integrated and harmonious operation
example: All right, so unlike the other game, the two examples of coordination games we saw so far were really pure coordination problems.
exampleZh: 没错,这和之前的博弈不同,目前为止我们看到的前两个案例,是纯粹的协调博弈

meaning: n. 协调人，统筹者
definition: 1. n. someone whose task is to see that work goes harmoniously
example: The Coordinator creates a context or unique identifier for this transaction and some other information about it.
exampleZh: 协调器为该事务及其相关的一些其他信息创建上下文或唯一标识符。

meaning: n. 警察；管纱，纬管；精明，明智；v. 抓获，逮捕；遭受，蒙受；收到，得到；表明，摆出；偷，盗窃；失败，送命（cop out）；【名】 （Cop）（美、俄、印、比利时）焦普（人名）
definition: 1. n. uncomplimentary terms for a policeman；2. v. take by theft
example: which was, it's very popular in Australia even though it's made in England, which is a cop show.
exampleZh: 它在澳大利亚很热门，尽管这是在英格兰制作的，这是一个警察实录。

meaning: v. 对付，处理；n. 长袍，法衣；【名】 （Cope）（英）科普，（西）科佩（人名）
definition: 1. n. brick that is laid sideways at the top of a wall；2. v. come to terms or deal successfully with
example: Farmers are struggling to cope with an invasion of slugs.
exampleZh: 农民正在努力对付蛞蝓的大肆侵害。

meaning: n. 铜；铜钱，铜币；警察；灰蝶，铜色蝶；adj. 紫铜色的，红棕色的；vt. 用铜包，给……镀铜；【名】 （Copper）科珀（人名）
definition: 1. n. a ductile malleable reddish-brown corrosion-resistant diamagnetic metallic element; occurs in various minerals but is the only metal that occurs abundantly in large masses; used as an electrical and thermal conductor；2. v. coat with a layer of copper
example: So it looks like most of you got that the electron configuration that we're writing here is for copper.
exampleZh: 看来大多数人,都看出了,这是铜原子的电子排布。

meaning: v. 抄写，誊写；模仿，效法；作弊，抄袭；听见（或明白）无线电收发报机中讲话人的话；复制，拷贝；n. 一本，一册，一份；复印件，副本；原稿，素材；广告文字
definition: 1. n. a reproduction of a written record (e.g. of a legal or school record)；2. v. copy down as is
example: So this is a classic error. I've not made a copy of the list. I've got an alias of the list.
exampleZh: 这是个相当经典的错误,在这里我并没有得到数组的。

meaning: n. 版权，著作权；adj. 版权的，受版权保护的；v. 获得……的版权；保护……的版权
definition: 1. n. a document granting exclusive right to publish and sell literary or musical or artistic work；2. v. secure a copyright on a written work
example: My music will be on less than 72 hours after I'm done the record and copyright it.
exampleZh: 我录制完音乐，并且拿到版权之后，72小时之内就传上去了。

meaning: n. 珊瑚；（作珠宝的）珊瑚宝石；珊瑚色，橘红色；珊瑚虫；龙虾卵，扇贝卵；adj. 珊瑚色的，浅橘红色的；珊瑚的，珊瑚制的；【名】 （Coral）（英、法、西、葡）科拉尔（人名）
definition: 1. a substance like rock formed in the sea by groups of particular types of small animal, or the small creature that forms this substance；2. a colour between orange and pink
example: Although the coral looks hard, it is very delicate.
exampleZh: 虽然那珊瑚看起来坚硬，它其实非常易碎。

meaning: n. 粗线，细绳；电线；灯芯绒裤子；索状结构；考得（木材单位）；adj. 灯芯绒的；v. 用绳子连接；【名】 （Cord）（英）科德，（法）科尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a line made of twisted fibers or threads；2. v. stack in cords
example: There's a lot of interest in obtaining stem cells from the blood of the umbilical cord on birth.
exampleZh: 从出生时的脐带血中取得一些干细胞,也很有趣

meaning: adj. 热情友好的；感觉强烈的，由衷的；n. 甜果汁饮料；烈性甜酒；镇定药，不太难吃的药
definition: 1. friendly, but formal and polite；2. (of a feeling, especially dislike) strongly felt
example: He had never known him to be so chatty and cordial.
exampleZh: 他以前从来不知道他是这样一个健谈而友善的人。

meaning: n. 热情，友好
definition: 1. behaviour that is friendly, but formal and polite
example: I was greeted with a show of cordiality.
exampleZh: 我受到了热情友好的接待。

meaning: n. 果核；中心部分；核心，要点；骨干，核心成员；地核，天体的核心；核反应堆堆芯；芯体；v. 给……去核；adj. 核心的，最重要的；基础的，必修的；【名】 （Core）（英）科尔，（西、意）科雷（人名）
definition: 1. n. the center of an object；2. v. remove the core or center from
example: Paul Raushenbush This is Paul Raushenbush, the associate dean of Religious Life at Princeton University, signing off from the Inner Core.
exampleZh: 我是，是普林斯顿大学宗教生活副院长,是普林斯顿大学宗教生活副院长，本期的“人性讲堂“就到这里。

meaning: n. 栓皮，软木（南欧和北非的一种橡树的树皮）；瓶塞，软木塞；软木浮子；v. 用瓶塞塞住；用软木炭涂
definition: 1. the light, soft bark (= outer covering) of a Mediterranean tree；2. a short, cylinder-shaped piece of cork, plastic, or rubber that is put into the top of a bottle, especially a wine bottle, to close it
example: I like the pop you get when you pull out a cork.
exampleZh: 我喜欢你拔出瓶塞时弄出的那“砰”的一声。

meaning: n. 谷物，谷粒；玉米；鸡眼；老一套，煽情的东西；v. 腌（肉类等）；使成粒状；【名】 （Corn）（英、法、瑞典）科恩（人名）
definition: 1. n. tall annual cereal grass bearing kernels on large ears: widely cultivated in America in many varieties; the principal cereal in Mexico and Central and South America since pre-Columbian times；2. v. feed (cattle) with corn
example: The unsaturated fats are the corn, soy bean, safflower, sunflower, cottonseed oils, and fats that you get from seafood.
exampleZh: 不饱和脂肪是从,玉米,大豆,红花,葵花,棉籽油以及海鲜中提取出的脂肪

meaning: n. 角；嘴角，眼角；街角，拐角；角落，偏僻处；困境，窘境；角球；场角，场角的辅助人员；v. 将……逼入死角，使走投无路；硬要与某人说话；垄断；转弯，拐弯；囤积；相交成角；【名】 （Corner）（法）科尔内，（英）科纳（人名）
definition: 1. n. a place off to the side of an area；2. v. gain control over
example: Pret and Starbucks are pretty much on every corner by every tube stop, aren't they? so.
exampleZh: 普雷特和星巴克几乎出现在每一个转角，每一个地铁站，不是吗？所以，

meaning: n. 基石，支柱，基础；隅石，墙角石
definition: 1. n. the fundamental assumptions from which something is begun or developed or calculated or explained；2. n. a stone in the exterior of a large and important building; usually carved with a date and laid with appropriate ceremonies
example: We recognize in ourselves a virtue which is considered to be the cornerstone of many systems of moral understanding.
exampleZh: 我们承认我们拥有那种美德，可以作为,许多道德认知体系的基石。

meaning: n. （陆军、海军陆战队或英国空军的）下士；（舰艇的）纠察长助理；（供放圣餐杯和圣餐盘的）圣餐布；adj. 肉体的，身体的
definition: 1. of or relating to the body；2. a person of low rank in the army or the air force
example: The corporal shouted an order at the men.
exampleZh: 下士对士兵们高声下令。

meaning: n. 社团，公司，法人（团体）；市政当局
definition: 1. n. a business firm whose articles of incorporation have been approved in some state；2. n. slang for a paunch
example: The rule applies where a person owns stock in a corporation.
exampleZh: 该规定对于在公司里拥有股份的人适用。

meaning: adj. 公司的；法人的；共同的，全体的；n. 公司，集团
definition: 1. adj. of or belonging to a corporation；2. adj. possessing or existing in bodily form
example: I don't know how to evaluate everything Icahn has done but some corporate raiders have been unkind to employees.
exampleZh: 我不清楚如何评估伊坎,做过的所有的事情，但是一些公司蓄意收购者,一直以来对雇员都不友善。

meaning: n. 特种部队；（从事某工作或活动的）一群人；（美国）海军陆战队；（由两个或两个以上师组成的）军，兵团；【名】 （Corps）（西、德）科尔普斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. an army unit usually consisting of two or more divisions and their support；2. n. a body of people associated together
example: The special corps of the military began evacuating villagers within three hours of the breach.
exampleZh: 军队的特种部队在溃堤发生的三小时内开始疏散村民。

meaning: n. 尸体；v. 使戏剧演员的演出僵住
definition: 1. a dead body, usually of a person；2. to start laughing in a way you cannot control during a performance, or to make someone else do this; a word used by actors and performers
example: The amorphophallus titanum was known as a corpse flower because it exudes a smell of rotting flesh.
exampleZh: 巨花魔芋因其散发出一种腐肉的气味而被称为尸花。

meaning: adj. 正确的，无误的；恰当的，合适的；（行为）合乎礼节的，得体的；（行为）被人认可的，赞许的；v. 改正，纠正；批改；指出错误；（医疗）矫正
definition: 1. v. make right or correct；2. adj. free from error; especially conforming to fact or truth
example: No, OK and that's correct, because each photon of light actually has more energy than is needed to eject an electron.
exampleZh: 没有，好，对了，因为每一个光子实际上,都有更多的能量去逐出一个电子。

meaning: n. 改正，修正；惩罚，处罚；改正的行动（或过程）；int. （想纠正刚说过的话时用）改正，更正
definition: 1. n. the act of offering an improvement to replace a mistake; setting right；2. n. a quantity that is added or subtracted in order to increase the accuracy of a scientific measure
example: One. And so I put 1 into this box so that's the correction I needed to make from before.
exampleZh: ，因此我把1放在这个盒子里,那么这里我需要做的改动。

meaning: adj. 纠正的，矫正的；n. 起纠正作用的东西，修正
definition: 1. n. a device for treating injury or disease；2. adj. designed to promote discipline
example: From this, it is apparent that drastic steps must be taken immediately to develop corrective measures for the pollution problem.
exampleZh: 从这一点可以看出，必须立即采取严厉措施来制定污染问题的相关纠正措施。

meaning: v. 相互关联；显示紧密联系；n. 相关的事物
definition: 1. If two or more facts, numbers, etc. correlate or are correlated, there is a relationship between them；2. if two things correlate, or are correlated, they are connected
example: When you correlate people's preference when they see products with activation in this area, you'll see a nice correlation.
exampleZh: 这一区域的大脑活动,同人们在见到商品后的表现，完美地联系了起来。

meaning: n. 相互关系，关联；相关量
definition: 1. a connection or relationship between two or more facts, numbers, etc.；2. a connection between two or more things
example: There is a direct correlation between exposure to sun and skin cancer.
exampleZh: 皮肤暴露在太阳下与皮肤癌直接相关。

meaning: 相关的；有关联的
definition: 1. If two or more facts, numbers, etc. are correlative, there is an important relationship between them；2. a fact, number, etc. that has an important relationship to another fact, number, etc.
example: Man has rights only in so far as they are a correlative of duty.
exampleZh: 人只有承担义务才能享受与其相关的权利。

meaning: v. 类似于，相当于；通信；相一致，符合
definition: 1. v. be compatible, similar or consistent; coincide in their characteristics；2. v. be equivalent or parallel, in mathematics
example: Racegoers will be given a number which will correspond to a horse running in a race.
exampleZh: 观看赛马的观众将领到一个与参赛马匹相对应的号码。

meaning: n. 信件，信函；通信；相似，关联；一致
definition: 1. n. communication by the exchange of letters；2. n. compatibility of observations
example: The guiding thread of the book is the correspondence, the parts of the city and the parts of the soul.
exampleZh: 本书的导引线索是,当中的相似之处，城邦一部份与灵魂一部份间的对称性。

meaning: n. （尤指从某一国家发回专题报道的）记者，通讯员；通信者，写信人
definition: 1. n. someone who communicates by means of letters；2. adj. similar or equivalent in some respects though otherwise dissimilar
example: A correspondent for Reuters news agency says he saw a number of demonstrators being beaten.
exampleZh: 路透通讯社的一名记者说他看到一些示威者遭到殴打。

meaning: adj. 相应的，相关的；v. 类似于，相当于；通信；相一致，符合（correspond 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. accompanying；2. adj. similar especially in position or purpose
example: The rise in interest rates was not reflected in a corresponding rise in the dollar.
exampleZh: 利率上调没有反映在相应的美元增值上。

meaning: n. （建筑物或火车内的）通道，过道；（一国领土通过他国境内的）走廊；狭长地带
definition: 1. n. an enclosed passageway; rooms usually open onto it
example: She ran out into the corridor.
exampleZh: 她跑出来，冲进走廊。

meaning: v. 损害，破坏；腐蚀，侵蚀
definition: 1. If metal corrodes, or if something corrodes it, it is slowly damaged by something such as rain or water；2. to destroy or be destroyed, esp. by acid or rust, usually over a long period of time
example: He has devised a process for making gold wires which neither corrode nor oxidize.
exampleZh: 他发明了一种制造程序，使金线既不会腐蚀也不会氧化。

meaning: n. 腐蚀，侵蚀；腐蚀产生的物质
definition: 1. the process of corroding, or metal that has been corroded
example: The surface corrosion was worst where the paint had flaked off.
exampleZh: 油漆已经剥落的地方，表面的腐蚀最严重。

meaning: adj. 腐败的，贪污的；不道德的，堕落的；有缺陷的，有错误的；腐坏的，腐烂的；v. 使腐化，使堕落；腐蚀，污染；损坏，破坏
definition: 1. v. corrupt morally or by intemperance or sensuality；2. adj. lacking in integrity
example: He would gladly have traded dozens -he would have traded dozens of corrupt Anglican ministers for the simple and honest King.
exampleZh: 他可以欣然的,他可以出卖大量的圣公会牧师的头衔，并从中牟利,只是为了一个诚实简单的国王。

meaning: n. 贪污，腐败；堕落，腐蚀；（电脑上资讯的）破坏，损坏；（语言）变体；腐坏，腐烂
definition: 1. n. lack of integrity or honesty (especially susceptibility to bribery); use of a position of trust for dishonest gain；2. n. in a state of progressive putrefaction
example: The great American railroads were built by and large, for decades, by government subsidies, and a tremendous amount of corruption.
exampleZh: 这几十年间,美国伟大铁路建起来了,这当然是是通过政府的支助,以及伴随着数不清的行贿受贿

meaning: adj. 装门面的，表面的；化妆用的，美容的；整容的；不重要的，没意义的；n. 化妆品，美容品
definition: 1. substances that you put on your face or body that are intended to improve your appearance；2. Cosmetic changes, etc. are intended to make you believe that something is better when, really, the problem has not been solved
example: She received a cosmetic makeover at a beauty salon as a birthday gift.
exampleZh: 作为生日礼物，她得到了在一家美容院美容的机会。

meaning: adj. 世界主义的，四海为家的；国际性的，国际化的；见过世面的，见识广的；广布的，遍生的；n. 四海为家的人，周游世界的人
definition: 1. containing or having experience of people and things from many different parts of the world；2. someone who has experience of many different parts of the world
example: Back in Holle's cosmopolitan circles in Lima, however, people have a simple explanation for the time he spends in the Amazon.
exampleZh: 然而，回到赫勒在利马的国际化社交圈后，人们对他在亚马逊地区度过的时光给出了一个简单的解释。

meaning: n. 宇宙；完整和谐的一统体系；秋英属植物；【名】 （Cosmos）（法）科斯莫斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. everything that exists anywhere；2. n. any of various mostly Mexican herbs of the genus Cosmos having radiate heads of variously colored flowers and pinnate leaves; popular fall-blooming annuals
example: The gods are very unhappy because they have now been assigned specific duties in the maintenance of the cosmos.
exampleZh: 众神们因为被指派了任务而闷闷不乐,他们都有具体的工作来维持宇宙的运行。

meaning: adj. 宇宙的，外层空间的；巨大的，极重要的；精神的，神灵的
definition: 1. adj. of or from or pertaining to or characteristic of the cosmos or universe；2. adj. inconceivably extended in space or time
example: The AU is a cosmic measuring rod, and the basis of how we scale the Universe today.
exampleZh: 天文单位是宇宙的标尺，是我们今天测量宇宙的基础。

meaning: n. 价钱，费用；成本，开支；代价，损失；诉讼费用；v. 价钱为，需花费；估算成本，估价；使丧失，使损失；使付出努力，使做不愉快的事；使花许多钱；【名】 （Cost）（英、美、罗、巴、法、荷）科斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the total spent for goods or services including money and time and labor；2. v. be priced at
example: So the cost of the product will be higher for them, for you know, for any product that uses advertising
exampleZh: 所以他们的产品价格就会更高，你知道，任何打广告的产品。

meaning: adj. 昂贵的，值钱的；造成严重损失的，代价大的；【名】 （Costly）（英）科斯特利（人名）
definition: 1. adj. entailing great loss or sacrifice；2. adj. having a high price
example: The best equipment is costly but is well worth the outlay.
exampleZh: 最好的设备花费大，但这种开支很值得。

meaning: n. 服装，装束；戏服，表演服装；泳衣，泳装；v. 给（某人）穿上特定服装；adj. （戏剧）古装的
definition: 1. n. the attire worn in a play or at a fancy dress ball；2. v. dress in a costume
example: Yeats is throwing off his early work as if throwing off a kind of costume.
exampleZh: 叶芝抛弃了他的早期作品,就像抛弃一件外套一样。

meaning: n. 小屋，村舍，乡间别墅
definition: 1. n. a small house with a single story
example: The cottage was cold and damp.
exampleZh: 这小屋又冷又湿。

meaning: n. 棉，棉花；棉布；棉线，棉纱；脱脂棉，药棉；adj. 棉的，棉制的；v. 开始领会，开始明白；喜爱，喜欢；【名】 （Cotton）（英、西、葡）科顿，（法）戈登（人名）
definition: 1. n. soft silky fibers from cotton plants in their raw state；2. v. take a liking to
example: Or was it more the 1830s when you've got this booming cotton production happening finally in Alabama and Mississippi and Louisiana?
exampleZh: 又或者是从18世纪30年代起,当阿拉巴马,密西西比和路易斯安那州,的棉花产量大范围高产时吗

meaning: n. 长沙发，长榻；诊察台；v. 表达，措辞；躺下，躺卧；平端（矛或枪）（准备攻击）；用下压及后压晶状体的方式治疗（白内障）；贴线缝绣；【名】 （Couch）（英）库奇（人名）
definition: 1. n. an upholstered seat for more than one person；2. v. formulate in a particular style or language
example: She slipped out of the jacket and tossed it on the couch.
exampleZh: 她快速脱下了那件上衣，把它丢在沙发上。

meaning: v. 咳嗽；发出咳嗽般的声音；透露情报，供认；厉声说出；n. 咳嗽（病）；咳，咳嗽声；【名】 （Cough）（英、美）考夫（人名）
definition: 1. n. sudden expulsion of air from the lungs that clears the air passages; a common symptom of upper respiratory infection or bronchitis or pneumonia or tuberculosis；2. v. exhale abruptly, as when one has a chest cold or congestion
example: Dirt from the motorway made him cough.
exampleZh: 公路上的灰尘使他咳嗽起来。

meaning: v. （礼貌地请求许可）可以，能；（礼貌地请求别人做事）能，能否；（表示可能）可能，也许；（表示未发生的事情）差点就，本能够；（用于提出建议）可以，能；本该，应该（用于对做过或未做某事表示恼怒）；（强调感觉）真想；好像，仿佛；v. 能（can的过去式）
definition: 1. n. airtight sealed metal container for food or drink or paint etc.；2. v. preserve in a can or tin
example: It could be a virus, or it could be all in the mind.
exampleZh: 这可能是种病毒，或者可能全是凭空想像。

meaning: n. 委员会，理事会；政务委员会，地方议会；会议；（教会的）集会；adj. 地方政府廉租的；【名】 （Council）（英）康斯尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a body serving in an administrative capacity；2. n. (Christianity) an assembly or theologians and bishops and other representative of different churches or dioceses that is convened to regulate matters of discipline or doctrine
example: Now one of the main questions going to face your advisory council is the question of discrimination on hiring.
exampleZh: 现在，一个主要问题将会,摆在你们顾问委员会面前，那就是,雇佣歧视的问题。

meaning: n. 议员，评议员（美国英语 councillor 的拼写变体）；State Councilor（通常大写）：国务委员
definition: 1. an elected member of a local council
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: Amender's mother employs a personal trainer, a bodyguard, a singing coach and a councilor to look after all her fifteen-year-old daughter's needs.
exampleZh: Amender 的母亲雇了一名私人教练、一名保镖、一名歌唱教练和一名顾问来满足她15岁女儿的一切需要。

meaning: n. 忠告，建议；辩护律师；咨询，磋商；v. 建议，劝告（做……）；为……提供咨询，给……提供建议；商讨，提出忠告
definition: 1. n. a lawyer who pleads cases in court；2. v. give advice to
example: The Boyars' counsel, that is the counsel of the nobles, literally met in the throne of the palace.
exampleZh: 波雅尔议会 也就是贵族们的议会,实际上就在宫殿内举行

meaning: n. 顾问，咨询师；律师，法律顾问；（学校或夏令营的）辅导员（counsellor 的美式拼写）；（使馆的）参赞，参事
definition: 1. n. someone who gives advice about problems；2. n. someone who has supervisory duties at a summer camp
example: I realized that I would just cry all of the time and I was not going to be a very good counselor,
exampleZh: 我意识到我会时常哭泣，而且不会成为一名优秀的心理辅导员。

meaning: v. （按顺序）数数；计数，点数目；把……算入，包括；重要；被允许，被接受；看作，认为；n. 计算，总数；数数；量的计数；（被指控的）罪状，事项；论点，观点；伯爵；（纱线的）支数；【名】 （Count）（美）康特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the total number counted；2. v. determine the number or amount of
example: What anyone else promises you doesn't count. Only what you can decide for yourself actually counts.
exampleZh: 任何人答应你的事都不算数，只有自己能做主的才算数。

meaning: n. 倒计时，倒数读秒；临近时期；倒计时显示器
definition: 1. n. counting backward from an arbitrary number to indicate the time remaining before some event (such as launching a space vehicle)
example: The countdown has begun for the launch of the space shuttle.
exampleZh: 航天飞机发射前的倒计时已经开始。

meaning: n. 柜台；对立面；计数器，计算器；（棋盘游戏的）筹码；记分冰壶；v. 反驳，驳斥；抵制，抵消；（拳击）还击；逆向移动；adv. 相反地，对立地；逆向地；adj. 反面的，对立的
definition: 1. n. table consisting of a horizontal surface over which business is transacted；2. v. speak in response
example: Um, definitely, I think on average an accountant is considered to be, you know, a bean counter,
exampleZh: 当然，我觉得会计师常被认为是精打细算的人，

meaning: v. 抵制，抵消，中和
definition: 1. to reduce or remove the effect of something unwanted by producing an opposite effect；2. to reduce or remove the effect of something by producing an opposite effect
example: The power of red wine to counteract high cholesterol has been ballyhooed in the press.
exampleZh: 红酒中和高胆固醇的功效在媒体上被夸大了。

meaning: v. 抵制，抵消，中和
definition: 1. to reduce or remove the effect of something unwanted by producing an opposite effect；2. to reduce or remove the effect of something by producing an opposite effect
example: Effective counteraction of misinformation requires both timely evidence and clear public communication.
exampleZh: 有效反制错误信息既需要及时的证据，也需要清晰的公共沟通。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）
note: 剑桥以 counteract 词条解释该派生词。

meaning: adj. 伪造的，假冒的；假装的，虚假的；v. 伪造，仿造；佯作，假装；酷似；n. 伪造物，赝品
definition: 1. made to look like the original of something, usually for dishonest or illegal purposes；2. something that is made to look like the original of something else, usually for dishonest or illegal purposes
example: Cash box would be would have something called it was called Van Court's Bank Note Reporter and Counterfeit Detector .
exampleZh: 钱柜将会是将有种叫做,凡？科特的银行票据报告,和验钞机的东西。

meaning: n. 对应的人（或事物）；（法律文件的）副本
definition: 1. n. a person or thing having the same function or characteristics as another；2. n. a duplicate copy
example: It sends a mixed message, and your counterpart gets to choose what signals to read.
exampleZh: 它传递了一个模棱两可的信息，而你的对方可以选择解读哪些信号。

meaning: n. 国，国家；全国人民，全体国民（the country）；乡下，乡村；地区，区域；乡村音乐；故乡；adj. 乡下的，农村的；乡村音乐的；祖国的，故乡的；粗鲁的
definition: 1. n. the territory occupied by a nation；2. n. a politically organized body of people under a single government
example: You really had a remarkable success in academics, in the administrative... You've taught at great universities across the country.
exampleZh: 您在学术界，行政管理层，都取得了巨大的成功。,您曾在多所美国名校执教。

meaning: n. 乡村，农村；乡村居民
definition: 1. n. rural regions
example: I want to have a look at some of the countryside down in Surrey and in Sussex.
exampleZh: 我想看看萨里和苏塞克斯的一些小乡村。

meaning: n. （英国、爱尔兰的）郡，（美国的）县；郡运动队，县运动队；adj. 有世家地位（或特点）的
definition: 1. n. a region created by territorial division for the purpose of local government；2. n. the largest administrative district within a state
example: Up to five million people a year visit the county.
exampleZh: 每年多达500万人到这个县游览。

meaning: n. 政变
definition: 1. a sudden, illegal seizure of political power by a small group
example: The government was overthrown in a carefully planned coup d'état that surprised foreign observers.
exampleZh: 政府在一场精心策划的政变中被推翻，这让外国观察人士感到意外。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）
note: 剑桥以 coup 词条解释该派生词。

meaning: n. 两个，几个；一对夫妇，一对情侣；v. 加上，结合；（把设备等）连接；形成一双，配成一对；交配，交媾；（用电磁感应，静电荷或光学通信线路）将（电路元件）耦合；【名】 （Couple）（法）库普勒（人名）
definition: 1. n. a small indefinite number；2. v. bring two objects, ideas, or people together

meaning: n. 赠券，优惠券；（剪自报刊的）参赛表，订货单；（债券的）息票；（尤指战时食品、衣服或其他商品的）配给券，票证；（固定利息证券的）票面利率；（足球博彩或其他比赛的）彩票；脸，面孔
definition: 1. n. a negotiable certificate that can be detached and redeemed as needed；2. n. a test sample of some substance
example: I mean, hypothetically a bond trading at $.60 on the dollar with an 8% coupon, five-year bond that's yielding about 18%.
exampleZh: 我的意思是，假设一种债券以0。60美元进行交易,同时有8%的票息，五年期债券收益率在18%左右。

meaning: n. 勇气，胆量；【名】 （Courage）（英）卡里奇，（法）库拉热（人名）
definition: 1. n. a quality of spirit that enables you to face danger or pain without showing fear
example: So, I could ask any of you who have the courage to come forward and fight in my phalanx? Nobody?
exampleZh: 所以,我斗胆请问,在座哪位有胆量上来,为我的方阵效力,没人吗

meaning: adj. 勇敢的，有胆量的
definition: 1. adj. possessing or displaying courage; able to face and deal with danger or fear without flinching
example: It was a very frightening experience and they were very courageous.
exampleZh: 那是一次非常令人恐惧的经历，但他们非常勇敢。

meaning: n. 课程；过程；道路，航线；进程，进展；方针，总方向；行动方式，处理方法；疗程；一道菜；比赛场地；（砖、石等墙的）层；（常sing.）追踪狩猎（尤指野兔）；横帆；一组同音弦；追踪狩猎（尤指野兔）；v. 奔流，快速流动；（感情、思想）涌动；（用猎犬）追踪（兔子）
definition: 1. n. education imparted in a series of lessons or meetings；2. v. move swiftly through or over
example: So, at any rate, this seemed to me to be, when I started teaching this course, reasons not to teach it.
exampleZh: 因此无论如何对我来说，当我开始教这门课的时候决定不说它的原因。

meaning: n. 法院，法庭；球场；王宫，宫廷；朝臣；全体审判人员；庭院，院子；董事（会），理事（会）；（用于大型宅第和公寓街区的名称中）宅第，公寓大楼；v. 奉承，讨好；设法取得，追求；招致，引起（不愉快的事）；谈恋爱，求爱；【名】 （Court）（英）考特，（法）库尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. an assembly (including one or more judges) to conduct judicial business；2. v. make amorous advances towards
example: Embarrassment tells us we're in the presence of the excess, and that's why Beat writers court it.
exampleZh: 难堪告诉我们自己是处在过度的状态，所以垮掉一代的作者追求难堪。

meaning: n. 礼貌，彬彬有礼；礼貌的行为（言语）；屈膝礼；adj. 免费提供的；礼节性的
definition: 1. polite behaviour, or a polite action or remark；2. by permission of
example: I was treated with the utmost courtesy by the staff.
exampleZh: 我受到了工作人员极有礼貌的接待。

meaning: n. 庭院，院子
definition: 1. n. an area wholly or partly surrounded by walls or buildings
example: and said that the courtyard right over there is the most courtyard, the most beautiful courtyard in America.
exampleZh: 他说那边的那个院子是全美国最漂亮的院子。

meaning: n. 堂（表）兄弟，堂（表）姐妹；远房亲戚；兄弟民族（或国家）的人（来自不同国家但文化近似）；相似的人（物）
definition: 1. n. the child of your aunt or uncle
example: I tried again to get ahold of my cousin Joan.
exampleZh: 我又试着联系了一次我表姐琼。

meaning: v. 覆盖，遮盖；包括，涉及；报道；占（一片面积）；行走（一段路程）；足够支付；给……保险；顶替，代替；找借口，包庇；采取行动（保护自己）；掩护；守住，封锁；翻唱；（桥牌）盖打；n. 覆盖物，遮盖物；封面，封底；被子，床单；遮盖，覆盖；保险；掩护；掩饰，幌子；掩蔽处；代替；转录，翻唱；（板球）外场防守；（生态）盖度；【名】 （Cover）（英）科弗，（意）科韦尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a covering that serves to conceal or shelter something；2. v. provide with a covering or cause to be covered
example: to cover all aspects of a complex system that is the software that goes into the radio.
exampleZh: 学会了处理将软件放进广播的复杂系统的各种情况。

meaning: n. 覆盖范围；新闻报道；保险范围；课程内容；防守，盯守
definition: 1. n. the total amount and type of insurance carried；2. n. the extent to which something is covered
example: Now a special TV network gives live coverage of most races.
exampleZh: 现在一个专门的电视网对大多数比赛进行现场报道。

meaning: n. 母牛，奶牛；雌性动物；讨厌的人（或事物、情况）；v. 恐吓，威胁
definition: 1. n. female of domestic cattle:；2. v. subdue, restrain, or overcome by affecting with a feeling of awe; frighten (as with threats)
example: So, it's awkward to have to wait for a cow to get infected before you can vaccinate a population.
exampleZh: 在给人们预防接种之前,你只有干等着,直到有一头奶牛感染了病毒才行

meaning: n. 胆小鬼，懦夫；adj. 胆小的，怯懦的；（动物形象）夹着尾巴的；【名】 （Coward）（英）科沃德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person who shows fear or timidity；2. n. English dramatist and actor and composer noted for his witty and sophisticated comedies (1899-1973)
example: She accused her husband of being a coward.
exampleZh: 她指责自己的丈夫是个胆小鬼。

meaning: adj. 怯懦的，胆小的；恃强凌弱的；adv. 胆怯地，怯懦地
definition: 1. adj. lacking courage; ignobly timid and faint-hearted
example: between a couple of states in Euboea, that said they would never use missiles of any kind, because that was cowardly.
exampleZh: 有一款条约,其中写道他们永远不使用任何投掷物,因为那样很懦弱

meaning: n. 怯懦，胆小
definition: 1. n. the trait of lacking courage
example: Her cowardice began to trouble her in a way.
exampleZh: 她的怯懦在某种程度上开始困扰她。

meaning: n. 牧牛工，牛仔；（美国西部影片中）牛仔；奸商，不负责任的人；牛仔竞技表演者；有牛仔特质的人，（尤指）冒险莽撞的人；v. 当牛仔
definition: 1. n. a hired hand who tends cattle and performs other duties on horseback；2. n. a performer who gives exhibitions of riding and roping and bulldogging
example: Face it – you'll just have to take those cowboy boots back and ask for a refund.
exampleZh: 面对现实吧–你不过是要把那些牛仔靴拿回去，要求退款。

meaning: adj. 舒适的，温暖的，惬意的；友好的，亲密无间的，温馨的；（贬义）密切的，互相勾结的，串通的；安逸的，轻易得到的（但不一定是恰当的）；不提出（或不接受）挑战的；n. （茶壶的）保温罩，茶壶套（常作 tea cozy）；（旧式）（角落里的）带篷双人座；v. （非正式）使感到舒适，使得意；cozy up to：讨好，奉承，巴结
definition: 1. US spelling of cosy
example: Your friend walks in the door and although you were nice and cozy, you can tell that outside, the situation must be different.
exampleZh: 你的朋友走进门，尽管你觉得温暖舒适，但你明白外面肯定是冰天雪地。

meaning: n. 螃蟹，蟹肉；脾气乖戾的人，易怒的人；阴虱病；起重机，绞车；v. 横行，作蟹行；捕蟹，抓蟹；抱怨，烦扰
definition: 1. n. decapod having eyes on short stalks and a broad flattened carapace with a small abdomen folded under the thorax and pincers；2. v. direct (an aircraft) into a crosswind
example: Divers battled for hours to try to free a whale entangled in crab nets.
exampleZh: 潜水员们奋战了几个小时，试图解救一条被捕蟹网缠住的鲸鱼。

meaning: v. 破裂，裂开；崩溃，垮掉；砸开，砸碎；破译，解决；重击，猛击；（使）发出爆裂声，劈啪作响；（嗓音）变嘶哑；说（笑话），开（玩笑）；阻止，打击；开瓶，（尤指）开瓶饮酒；使（碳氢化合物）裂化；n. 裂缝，裂纹；缝隙，窄缝；瑕疵，缺点；爆裂声，噼啪声；尝试，试图；破解信息，破解码；俏皮话，粗鲁的话；重击，猛击；好时光，友好愉快的交谈；嗓音变哑；强效可卡因；股沟；adj. 优秀的，训练有素的；【名】 （Crack）（英、美、加）克拉克克（人名）
definition: 1. n. a long narrow opening；2. v. become fractured; break or crack on the surface only
example: So, it frees you from some of Apple's tethers and this was the code that circulated on the Internet iPhone with which people could crack their iPhones.
exampleZh: 这样我们就从苹果的约束下解放出来,这些代码是在网站上流通的,使用它们可能损坏你们的。

meaning: n. 打击，镇压
definition: 1. a situation in which someone starts to deal with bad or illegal behaviour in a more severe way；2. an action by an authority to stop something
example: The most outrageous action in Laud's crackdown was his move to ban -his attempt to ban preaching in churches.
exampleZh: 他所做过的最骇人听闻的暴行,是企图在教堂里禁止布道训诫行为。

meaning: n. 薄脆饼干；彩色爆竹；好东西，有趣的事物；黑客；精神崩溃的人，断裂（或裂开）的东西；迷人的女子；车把式
definition: 1. n. a thin crisp wafer made of flour and water with or without leavening and shortening; unsweetened or semisweet；2. n. a poor white person in the southern United States
example: I also sometimes just enjoy eating hummus on toast or a cracker.
exampleZh: 有时候，我也喜欢吃带有鹰嘴豆泥的烤面包或饼干。

meaning: n. 摇篮；吊架，吊篮；发源地；（电话的）听筒架； 摇篮；v. 轻轻抱着
definition: 1. a small bed for a baby, especially one that moves from side to side；2. the object that you put a phone, camera, etc. into in order to recharge (= put power into) its batteries
example: By a cradle to grave and some would've even said a cradle to grave and beyond--human bondage.
exampleZh: 从出生到死亡,有些人甚至可以说不仅是从生到死,奴隶的身份成为了世世代代不可磨灭的印记

meaning: n. 工艺，手艺；船，艇，飞行器；诡计，骗术；行业，职业；手工艺品；v. 精心制作；【名】 （Craft）（英、德、罗）克拉夫特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the skilled practice of a practical occupation；2. v. make by hand and with much skill
example: He has a genuine and abiding love of the craft.
exampleZh: 他对这门手艺有着一种发自内心和持久不变的热爱。

meaning: v. 塞进，挤满；临时死记硬背，填鸭式学习；匆忙戴上；贪婪地吃；n. （应考）突击准备，死记硬背；极度拥挤；【名】 （Cram）（美）克拉姆（人名）
definition: 1. to force a lot of people or things into a small space；2. to do many things in a short period of time
example: that will be a lot more successful than trying to cram a lot of vocabulary words right away.
exampleZh: 那样会比一下子塞给自己很多单词要好得多。

meaning: n. 鹤；起重机，吊车；机动升降台架；v. 伸长（脖子）看，探头看；（用起重机）吊运；（行动前）迟疑，踌躇（crane at）；【名】 （Crane）（英、法、西）克兰，（意、葡）克拉内（人名）
definition: 1. n. United States writer (1871-1900)；2. v. stretch (the neck) so as to see better
example: A crane had to be used to haul the car out of the stream.
exampleZh: 不得不用了一台起重机把轿车从河里拉出来。

meaning: v. 撞车，坠毁；猛撞，发出巨响；破产，倒闭，暴跌；（计算机）瘫痪，死机；（在体育比赛中）惨败；过夜，入睡；心脏停止跳动；不请自来，偷偷混入（派对）；闯红灯；n. 撞车事故，失事；巨响，碰撞声；（计算机）瘫痪，死机；破产，暴跌；（做毛巾、窗帘等用的）粗布；adj. 应急的，速成的；adv. 哗啦一声地
definition: 1. n. a loud resonant repeating noise；2. v. fall or come down violently
example: The crash occurred on a sharp bend.
exampleZh: 碰撞发生在一个急转弯处。

meaning: n. 板条箱，柳条箱（或篮、篓等）；破旧车辆；v. 把……装入货箱
definition: 1. a box made of wood, plastic, or metal, especially one divided into parts to hold bottles；2. a cage with a bed that a dog, especially a puppy, sleeps in and stays in when its owners are away from home
example: The letters urged them to take advantage of a complimentary crate of beer courtesy of a marketing company.
exampleZh: 这些信件提醒他们，可享用一家营销公司免费赠送的一箱啤酒。

meaning: v. 渴望；恳求，请求；【名】 （Crave）（法）克拉夫（人名）
definition: 1. to have a very strong feeling of wanting something；2. to desire something strongly
example: It is only natural for youngsters to crave the excitement of driving a fast car.
exampleZh: 年轻人渴望开快车的刺激相当自然。

meaning: v. 爬行，匍匐前进；缓慢移动，缓慢行进；挤满，爬满；谄媚奉承，卑躬屈膝；n. 缓慢移动，徐行；爬泳，自由泳；（海边浅滩的鱼、龟等）围养池
definition: 1. n. a very slow movement；2. v. move slowly; in the case of people or animals with the body near the ground
example: I began to crawl on my hands and knees toward the door.
exampleZh: 我开始手脚并用向门爬去。

meaning: adj. 愚蠢的，古怪的，不理智的；极度烦恼的，疯狂的；精神失常的；狂热的，迷恋的；（角度）极其歪斜的；n. 疯子
definition: 1. n. someone deranged and possibly dangerous；2. adj. affected with madness or insanity
example: Notice something about all of those figures: Shakespeare is preoccupied with figures who may or may not be crazy.
exampleZh: 看一下这些人物：,莎士比亚专注于疯了或者没疯的人物。

meaning: n. 狂热，风靡一时的事物；v. 发狂；呈现龟裂
definition: 1. n. an interest followed with exaggerated zeal；2. v. cause to go crazy; cause to lose one's mind
example: Bands from London introduced the craze for this kind of music.
exampleZh: 伦敦的乐队引发了对这种音乐的狂热。

meaning: n. 奶油，乳脂；霜，膏；奶油色，淡黄色；含奶油食品；乳皮；adj. 奶油色的，淡黄色的，米黄色的；v. 把……搅成奶油状；轻易彻底打败；狠撞；加奶油；捈乳霜
definition: 1. n. the best people or things in a group；2. v. make creamy by beating
example: And it doesn't carry a notion of sanctions, meaning I don't think anybody should be punished for eating strawberry ice cream.
exampleZh: 而且这个判断也没有惩罚的意味，也就是说没有谁,会因为吃草莓冰淇淋而受罚。

meaning: adj. 含奶油的，含油脂的；似奶油的，柔滑细腻的；奶油色的，淡黄色的
definition: 1. adj. of the color of cream；2. adj. thick like cream
example: Continue whisking until the mixture looks smooth and creamy.
exampleZh: 继续搅拌直至混合物看上去均匀且呈奶油状。

meaning: v. 创造，创建；设计，创作；造成，引起；授予，册封；大惊小怪，抱怨
definition: 1. v. make or cause to be or to become；2. v. bring into existence
example: but what works for me the best is to really step out of this sort of need to create
exampleZh: 但是对我来说最有用的方法，就是要走出一种必需创造的意念

meaning: n. 创造，创建；作品，创作；（上帝）创造天地；宇宙，世界，天地万物；授予，册封
definition: 1. n. the human act of creating；2. n. an artifact that has been brought into existence by someone
example: It should further be noted that in the first creation account, in any kind of unequal relationship before God.
exampleZh: 我们还应该注意第一个创世故事中的描述，说他们在上帝面前有不平等的关系。

meaning: adj. 创造（性）的，创作的；有创造力的，有想象力的；n. 创作者；创意，创作素材
definition: 1. adj. having the ability or power to create；2. adj. promoting construction or creation
example: We need to find more creative ways to discipline our students and to maintain control in the classroom.
exampleZh: 我们需要用更有创意的方法约束学生，维持课堂纪律。

meaning: n. 创作者，发明者；造物主，上帝（the Creator）
definition: 1. n. terms referring to the Judeo-Christian God；2. n. a person who grows or makes or invents things
example: This was the first object placed in the heavens by the Creator.
exampleZh: 这是造物主置于天上的第一个物体。

meaning: n. 生物，动物；（具有某种特征的）人；怪物；受支配的人，产物
definition: 1. n. a living organism characterized by voluntary movement；2. n. a human being; `wight' is an archaic term
example: Maybe everything you're now experiencing is not real, but rather is the product of some other, perhaps malevolent, creature.
exampleZh: 或许你现在所经历的一切都不是真实的,而是某种邪恶生物制造出的幻觉

meaning: n. 资格，证明；文凭，资格证书；（政府为新任大使提供的）国书；v. 给……提供证书
definition: 1. the abilities and experience that make someone suitable for a particular job or activity, or proof of someone's abilities and experience；2. a piece of information that is sent from one computer to another to check that a user is who they claim to be or to allow someone to see information
example: The authentication mechanisms' implementation might have weaknesses and allow, for example, credential interception and replay.
exampleZh: 身份验证机制的实现可能存在弱点，比如准许凭证拦截和重播。

meaning: adj. 可信的，可靠的；足够好的，有明显效果的；（因看似可能成功而）可接受的
definition: 1. able to be believed or trusted
example: You should try to determine if this person has any credible references.
exampleZh: 你应该试着确定这个人是否有可信的证明人。

meaning: n. 可靠性，可信度
definition: 1. the fact that someone or something can be believed or trusted
example: One voter in Brasilia summed up the mood – "Politicians have lost credibility," he complained.
exampleZh: 一位巴西利亚选民简述了人们的心情–“政治家们已丧失信誉，”他抱怨道。

meaning: n. 信用，信贷，赊购；赞扬，信誉，声望；存款金额，余额；补助；退税，抵免；学分；带来荣耀的人（或事）；作品（指影片、电视节目、戏剧等）；信任，相信；v. 把（钱）记入总账，把钱存入（账户）；相信，信任；认为是……的功劳，给予承认；认为……有特定品质（或效果）
definition: 1. n. approval；2. v. give someone credit for something
example: But, I give a lot of credit to the European politics of the late 17th and 18th century.
exampleZh: 但是，我觉得很大程度上得益于欧洲政治,在17世纪末和18世纪，起的作用。

meaning: adj. 值得表扬的，令人钦佩的；合乎道德的，高尚的
definition: 1. adj. worthy of often limited commendation
example: It was a very creditable result for the team.
exampleZh: 对这支队来说，这比赛结果是十分值得称道的。

meaning: v. 爬行，匍匐；蹑手蹑脚地移动；不知不觉地到来，渐渐出现；蔓生，蔓延；谄媚奉承，巴结；（由于恐惧、厌恶等）起鸡皮疙瘩；n. 讨厌的人，献媚者；（树篱或墙壁上供动物通过的）墙洞；给幼畜断奶时吃的固体食物；爬行，缓慢行进；毛骨悚然的感觉，战栗
definition: 1. n. someone unpleasantly strange or eccentric；2. v. move slowly; in the case of people or animals with the body near the ground
example: Some people think that the rating agencies have allowed a kind of moral hazard to creep into their organization.
exampleZh: 有些人认为,信用评级机构,已经让某种程度的道德风险,渗透到他们的机构中

meaning: n. 全体船员，全体机组人员；一组工作人员；一伙人，一帮人；全体划船队员；赛艇运动；（尤指演奏车库音乐的）一群乐师；v. 当船员，当空乘人员；【名】 （Crew）（英、西）克鲁（人名）
definition: 1. n. the men who man a ship or aircraft；2. v. serve as a crew member on
example: Sexy? A little, maybe; those full, slightly parted lips, that windswept hair, the general J. Crew look.
exampleZh: 性感吗？或许有一点;,饱满微开的嘴唇，随风飘散的头发，典型美国派的外表。

meaning: n. 蟋蟀；板球（运动）

meaning: n. 罪，罪行；犯罪，犯罪活动；可耻行为，错误；v. （尤指在军队里）指控……有罪，判……有罪
definition: 1. n. (criminal law) an act punishable by law; usually considered an evil act；2. n. an evil act not necessarily punishable by law

exampleZh: 我不希望读者们用到这种相对低端的想象方式,罪过啊！你们中有多少人为你们！

meaning: n. 罪犯；adj. 犯法的，犯罪的；刑事的；应受责备的，可耻的；罪犯的，犯人的；（行为或情形）令人遗憾的，令人震惊的
definition: 1. n. someone who has committed (or been legally convicted of) a crime；2. adj. bringing or deserving severe rebuke or censure

meaning: n. 瘸子，残疾人；感情残废者，感情有缺陷的人；v. 使残疾，使成为跛子；使（心理上或情感上）出现问题；严重损坏，严重削弱

meaning: n. 危机，紧要关头；决定性时刻，关键时刻；（病情的）转折点，危象；adj. 用于处理危机的

meaning: adj. 爽口的，脆生的；脆的，易碎的；洁净的，挺括的；（图片或声音）清晰的，清脆悦耳的；清新的，凉爽的；（言行）干脆利落的；轻快的，利索的；n. 炸薯片；松脆食品；v. （使）发脆；（使）变卷，（使）变卷曲；【名】 （Crisp）（英）克里斯普（人名）
definition: 1. hard enough to be broken easily；2. used to describe cooked foods, such as pastry and biscuits, that are well cooked so that they are just dry and hard enough

meaning: n. 尺度，标准，准则

example: The most important criterion for entry is that applicants must design and make their own work.
exampleZh: 参加的最重要标准就是申请人必须设计并制作自己的作品。

meaning: v. 批评，指责；评论

example: We were taught how to criticize poems.
exampleZh: 我们学习了怎样评论诗歌。

meaning: n. 批评，批判；意见；评论，评价；（对文学作品和历史文献的）考证
definition: 1. n. disapproval expressed by pointing out faults or shortcomings；2. n. a serious examination and judgment of something

exampleZh: 这就是为什么诗，一首抒情诗，在新批评派眼里要优于其他各种文学形式。

meaning: n. 批评家，评论员；批评者，反对……的人
definition: 1. n. a person who is professionally engaged in the analysis and interpretation of works of art；2. n. anyone who expresses a reasoned judgment of something

exampleZh: 他的书让人欲罢不能，读他的书不仅能,在文学批判方面有所收获。

meaning: adj. 批判的，爱挑剔的；极其重要的，关键的；严重的，危急的；病重的，重伤的；评论性的，评论家的；临界的
definition: 1. adj. marked by a tendency to find and call attention to errors and flaws；2. adj. at or of a point at which a property or phenomenon suffers an abrupt change especially having enough mass to sustain a chain reaction

meaning: n. 鳄鱼；鳄鱼皮（皮革）；（短语 crocodile tears）鳄鱼的眼泪，假慈悲

exampleZh: 一项行动正在展开来拯救一个鳄鱼种类使其免遭灭绝。

meaning: n. 庄稼；（谷物或水果的）收成，产量；（同时涌现的）一批，一帮；平头，短发；（尤指头发）大量，丰富；短马鞭；（鸟的）嗉囊；（农场一年的）牲口总数；鞣制的整张兽皮；v. 剪短；剪裁（照片）；（牲畜）啃吃（草）；种植（庄稼）；收获

meaning: v. 反对；杂交；在（支票）上划线（表示只能转入银行帐户）；超过，超出（极限或范围）；（表情）掠过，闪过；（基督教徒）画十字；横传；（两封来往的信）相互错过，相互交错；做斗鸡眼；穿越，横渡；交叉；n. 十字标记，十字形（或叉形）物；杂交，混合物；十字架；苦难；横传；（拳击中的）钩拳迎击；adj. 恼怒的；脾气坏的，易怒的；（街道）交叉的，十字的
definition: 1. n. a wooden structure consisting of an upright post with a transverse piece；2. v. travel across or pass over
example: At each cross-section, people are either willing to use a certain sign in a certain way or they're not.
exampleZh: 在每一个横街面上，人们可以自由的,以自己的方式使用符号。

meaning: n. 人行横道，渡口；交叉口，十字路口；横渡，横越；（十字形教堂中）中殿和耳堂相交处；v. 穿越，横渡；交叉；反对（cross 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. traveling across；2. n. a shallow area in a stream that can be forded
example: She sighed and squatted down next to the crossing of the two trails.
exampleZh: 她叹了口气，在两条小路的交叉口旁蹲了下来。

meaning: v. 蹲下，蹲伏；俯身接近；（动物）蜷伏；n. 蹲（伏）的姿势；【名】 （Crouch）（美）克劳奇（人名）
definition: 1. to bend your knees and lower yourself so that you are close to the ground and leaning forward slightly；2. a position in which you bend your knees and lower yourself so that you are close to the ground and leaning forward slightly

exampleZh: 他们蹲伏着行走，一个个弯着腰快要贴着地面了。

meaning: n. 乌鸦；（公鸡或像公鸡的）啼叫声；克劳人（分布在美国西部的美洲土著居民）；妇人，丑妇；v. 欢叫，高兴地说；自鸣得意
definition: 1. a large, black bird with a loud, unpleasant cry；2. When a cock (= an adult male chicken) crows, it makes a very long and loud sharp cry

meaning: n. 人群；一伙人；百姓，凡夫俗子；（尤指体育运动赛事的）观众，听众；v. 聚集，群集；靠近，盯着；催促，催逼（因而把人激怒或惹恼）；挤满，塞满

meaning: adj. 拥挤的，塞满的；v. 聚集，群集；挤满，塞满；靠近，盯着（crowd 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. overfilled or compacted or concentrated

meaning: n. 王冠，冕；王位，王权（the crown）；王国政府，王国（the Crown）；冠军宝座，桂冠；头顶，帽顶；顶部；5先令的英国旧币；（受损牙齿的）人造冠；v. 为……加冕，立……为王；形成……顶部，给……加顶；使圆满，使完美；（在牙齿上）镶人造冠；打……的头部；（分娩时胎儿的头）露顶；【名】 （Crown）（英）克朗（人名）
definition: 1. n. the Crown (or the reigning monarch) as the symbol of the power and authority of a monarchy；2. v. invest with regal power; enthrone
example: Between 1987 and 1990, Steffi Graf largely held off Navratilova's challenge for the crown.
exampleZh: 1987到1990年期间，施特菲•格拉芙很大程度上抵挡住了纳芙拉蒂洛娃的夺冠挑战。

meaning: adj. 至关重要的，决定性的；极好的

meaning: adj. 粗略的，大概的；粗糙的，粗制的；冒犯的，粗俗的；天然的，自然的；n. 原油；天然的物质

meaning: adj. 残酷的，残忍的；引起痛苦的；v. 弄糟，使没有成功可能

meaning: n. 残酷，残忍；不公，虐待

meaning: n. 巡游，乘船游览；v. 乘船游览；以平稳的速度行驶；缓慢巡行，兜风；轻而易举赢得，轻取；猎艳；【名】 （Cruise）（英、美、加）克鲁斯（人名）

meaning: n. 舱式游艇；巡洋舰；巡逻警车

meaning: v. 崩裂，坍塌；（使）粉碎，（使）成碎屑；瓦解，崩溃；不再抵抗，无力应付；n. 酥皮水果甜点心； 碎屑；（经烹调用作水果浇头的）脂质面包屑

meaning: v. 嘎吱嘎吱地嚼；（使）发出碎裂声；嘎吱嘎吱地行进；（大量地）处理（数字）；n. 压碎声，碎裂声；危急关头，艰难局面（the crunch）；不足，短缺；仰卧起坐

meaning: v. 压坏，挤压变形；捣碎，碾成粉末；把……挤入，将……塞进（狭小的空间内）；（使）变皱，起皱；制服，镇压；使心烦意乱，使消沉；n. 拥挤的人群；（对某人短暂的）热恋，迷恋；迷恋对象；果汁饮料；（牛，羊的）分群栏
definition: 1. n. leather that has had its grain pattern accentuated；2. v. come down on or keep down by unjust use of one's authority

meaning: n. 面包皮；（馅饼或比萨饼等的）酥皮；硬外皮，硬外壳；地壳；生活，生计；v. 形成（或结成）硬皮（或硬壳）

meaning: v. 哭，哭泣；喊叫，呼喊；（兽或鸟）大叫；n. （表达强烈感情的）叫喊，叫声，哭声；大喊，大叫；抗议，请求；吠，嗥叫；哭，哭泣；急需；口号，公众舆论

meaning: n. 结晶，晶体；水晶；水晶玻璃；（钟表的）石英玻璃保护面，表蒙子；adj. 晶莹的，清澈透明的；【名】 （Crystal）（英）克里斯特尔，克丽丝特尔（人名）

meaning: n. 幼兽；（尤指笨拙或举止粗鲁的）毛头小伙子；幼年童子军；v. 产仔，生幼兽；猎幼狐

meaning: n. 立方体；立方，三次幂；小室，小房间；v. 使成立方；把（食物）切成小方块；【名】 （Cube）（瑞典、德）库贝（人名）

meaning: n. 黄瓜，胡瓜；黄瓜植株（学名 Cucumis sativus）

meaning: n. 暗示，提示；（戏剧或电影中的）尾白，提示；（台球等的）球杆；线索；选听（或选看）键；v. 提示，暗示；用球杆击球；【名】 （Cue）（西）库埃（人名）

meaning: n. 烹饪，风味；饭菜，菜肴；【名】 （Cuisine）（法）屈西纳（人名）

exampleZh: 在伦敦举行的一场精彩的音乐会将为他们的夏季巡回演出画上句号。

meaning: n. 异教，异教组织；狂热崇拜，迷信；（特定群体的）偶像，时尚；崇拜者，信徒；宗教信仰，宗教习俗；adj. 受崇拜的，热门的

meaning: v. 开垦，耕作；栽培，培育；陶冶，培养；建立（友谊），结交
