example: Mill's point is that the higher pleasures do require cultivation and appreciation and education.
exampleZh: 穆勒的观点是，高级快乐的确需要,培养，鉴赏，和教育。

meaning: n. 文化，文明；（团体或组织中共同的）态度，习俗；文化群落，（处于历史上特定时期的）社会；艺术活动；修养；（细胞、细菌等的）培养，培养物；栽培，养殖；v. 培育，养殖
definition: 1. n. a particular society at a particular time and place；2. n. the tastes in art and manners that are favored by a social group
example: In any case, Lambert Strether, as he arrives in Paris, has awakened to the sheer wonder of urbane culture.
exampleZh: 无论如何，朗伯，史瑞得到巴黎后完全被那里彬彬有礼的文化震撼了。

meaning: adj. 文化的，与文化有关的；艺术的，文艺的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to the arts and manners that a group favors；2. adj. denoting or deriving from or distinctive of the ways of living built up by a group of people
example: We then promised to move to an emphasis on psychological matters, and finally social and cultural determinants of literature.
exampleZh: 然后我们把重点转移到了心理学，最后还讨论了社会和文化对文学的决定因素。

meaning: adj. 积累的，渐增的；累计的，累积的
definition: 1. increasing by one addition after another；2. increasing as each new amount is added or as each new fact or condition is considered
example: It's very close, but overall the cumulative effects of cloud are to cool Earth rather than heat it.
exampleZh: 这十分相近，但是总体上来说，云的累积作用是降低地球的温度而不是让地球升温。

meaning: adj. 狡猾的，诡诈的；灵巧的，巧妙的；可爱的，好看的；n. 狡猾，诡诈；灵巧，巧妙
definition: 1. Cunning people are clever at planning something so that they get what they want, especially by tricking other people, or things that are cleverly made for a particular purpose；2. pretty and attractive
example: A desperate honesty that throbs through his confession does not absolve him from sins of diabolical cunning. He is abnormal.
exampleZh: 他的忏悔被绝望的虔诚悸动着,但这也不能为他那恶魔的狡诈赎罪，他是变态。

meaning: n. 杯子；一杯（的量）；杯（烹饪的计量单位），量杯（金属或塑料量器）；优胜杯，奖杯；杯状物；（胸罩的）罩杯；（含酒精的）混合饮料；（高尔夫球的）球洞；（男子运动时穿的）护裆；v. （用手）做成杯状；窝起手掌托住；为……拔火罐（或做吸杯治疗）
definition: 1. n. a United States liquid unit equal to 8 fluid ounces；2. v. form into the shape of a cup
example: Usually the teams that are very good at the Premiership will also be very good at the FA Cup
exampleZh: 通常，英超比赛中踢得好的球队在足总杯里也会表现出色，

meaning: n. 橱柜，衣柜；壁橱；小储藏室
definition: 1. n. a small room (or recess) or cabinet used for storage space
example: The second doll takes the ball out of the cupboard and puts it under the bed.
exampleZh: 第二个洋娃娃将球从橱柜中取出,放在了床下面

meaning: v. 控制，抑制；勒住（马）；n. 控制，抑制；路缘，马路牙子；（马的跗关节后部因扭伤韧带引起的）硬瘤
definition: 1. n. an edge between a sidewalk and a roadway consisting of a line of curbstones (usually forming part of a gutter)；2. v. lessen the intensity of; temper; hold in restraint; hold or keep within limits
example: Jay jumped to his feet and ran outside just as an ambulance skidded to the curb.
exampleZh: 杰跳了起来，跑了出去，这时一辆救护车滑到了路边。

meaning: n. 药物，疗法；对策，措施；治愈，治疗；（对橡胶、塑料或其他材料的）熟化；（基督教牧师的）牧师责任（或责任区）；教区；v. 治愈（病人），治好（疾病）；解决；控制，消除（不良的习惯、情感或态度）；加工贮藏；变干硬；【名】 （Cure）（美、法）楚雷（人名）
definition: 1. n. a medicine or therapy that cures disease or relieve pain；2. v. provide a cure for, make healthy again
example: You wanted to be finding the cure for cancer, but you're not actually finding the cure for cancer.
exampleZh: 你想找到治疗癌症的方法，但你实际上没有在找治疗癌症的方法。

meaning: adj. 能治愈的，可矫正的；（塑料、清漆等）可用（添加剂等）硬化的
definition: 1. adj. curing or healing is possible；2. adj. capable of being hardened by some additive or other agent
example: Most skin cancers are completely curable if detected in the early stages.
exampleZh: 大部分的皮肤癌若在早期发现都能完全治愈。

meaning: n. 宵禁令，宵禁时间；（尤指儿童）晚间必须回家的时间；晚钟；打晚钟时刻
definition: 1. a rule that everyone must stay at home between particular times, usually at night, especially during a war or a period of political trouble；2. a time by which a child must be home in the evening
example: The army is now on patrol in Srinagar and a curfew has been imposed.
exampleZh: 军队现在在斯利那加巡逻，宵禁也已实行。

meaning: adj. 好奇的，求知欲强的；稀奇的，不寻常的；爱挑剔的
definition: 1. adj. beyond or deviating from the usual or expected；2. adj. eager to investigate and learn or learn more (sometimes about others' concerns)
example: It's a curious sport in that... well, it started (when) surfers went to surf on land.
exampleZh: 这是一项很有趣的运动，因为……嗯，它是从冲浪选手上陆地冲浪开始的。

meaning: n. 好奇心，求知欲；珍品，奇事
definition: 1. n. a state in which you want to learn more about something；2. n. something unusual -- perhaps worthy of collecting
example: He had this intellectual curiosity that defied the kind of orthodox religious skepticism about any kind of rational belief.
exampleZh: 他的求知欲使得他藐视,传统宗教对于任何理性观点的怀疑

meaning: v. （使）弯曲，卷曲；（使）盘绕，（使）弯弯曲曲移动；边缘翘起；撇（嘴）；参加冰壶运动；n. 鬈发，卷发；（头发的）卷曲；卷曲物，螺旋状物；（锻炼肌肉的）弯曲运动；【名】 （Curl）（英）柯尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a round shape formed by a series of concentric circles (as formed by leaves or flower petals)；2. v. form a curl, curve, or kink
example: The wave and curl of her blonde hair gave her sensuality and youth.
exampleZh: 波浪式的卷曲金发使她显得性感并富有青春活力。

meaning: n. 通货，货币；通用，流行；现时性
definition: 1. n. the metal or paper medium of exchange that is presently used；2. n. general acceptance or use
example: Why do you think the UK uses its own currency instead of using Euros like in other European countries?
exampleZh: 英国使用自己的货币，而不是像其他欧盟成员一样使用欧元，你怎么看待这个问题？

meaning: adj. 现行的，当前的；通用的，流行的；最近的；n. 水流，气流；电流；思潮，趋势；【名】 （Current）（英）柯伦特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a flow of electricity through a conductor；2. adj. occurring in or belonging to the present time
example: That is we make animation file when you put the current to the coil of the field, getting established magnetic field.
exampleZh: 即通过制作动画效果,当你将电流,输送到线圈上，形成磁场。

meaning: adv. 现时，当前
definition: 1. adv. at this time or period; now
example: And, this is how I'm doing now in relationship to what we're currently discussing or evaluating or experiencing.
exampleZh: 这也可以表达我手头正在做的事情与我们正在讨论、评价或者经历的事情之间的联系。

meaning: n. 课程
definition: 1. n. an integrated course of academic studies
example: We do have, um, a focus on non- Western cultures in one of our core curriculum classes.
exampleZh: 在核心课程中，我们确实有一门课不是讲西方文化的。

meaning: n. 骂人话，咒骂语；咒语，魔咒；祸根，祸因；月经，例假（the curse）；v. 诅咒，咒骂；（在心里）臭骂；念咒语诅咒
definition: 1. n. profane or obscene expression usually of surprise or anger；2. v. utter obscenities or profanities
example: They see their failure to produce an heir as a curse from God.
exampleZh: 他们将自己未能生育一个后嗣看作是来自上帝的一个诅咒。

meaning: v. 减缩，限制；剪短；剥夺……特权等
definition: 1. to stop something before it is finished, or to reduce or limit something；2. to reduce or limit something, or to stop something before it is finished
example: NATO plans to curtail the number of troops being sent to the region.
exampleZh: 北大西洋公约组织计划缩减派往该地的部队数量。

meaning: n. 窗帘，门帘；帘状物，幕状物（如浓烟或大雨等）；纱幔，帷幔；（舞台上的）幕，幕布；开幕，落幕；灾难性结局；v. 给（窗户或房间）装上帘子；（用帘子）隔开，覆盖
definition: 1. n. hanging cloth used as a blind (especially for a window)；2. v. provide with drapery
example: It even has a curtain hiding Zooey from his mother.
exampleZh: 它里面的帘子甚至将左伊挡住，不让他妈妈看到。

meaning: n. 曲线，弧线；转弯，弯道；图表曲线；曲线球；（身体的）曲线；v. （使）弯曲，（使）呈曲线形；adj. 弯曲的，曲线形的
definition: 1. n. the trace of a point whose direction of motion changes；2. v. turn sharply; change direction abruptly
example: the total amount of the work that we can get out is just given by the area inside this curve.
exampleZh: 能够输出的功就是,我们可以得出来,曲线所包围的面积。

meaning: n. 垫子，坐垫；减震垫，缓冲垫；起缓解作用的东西；大比分领先，稳操胜券；（台球桌的）弹性衬边；v. 缓冲；减轻……的影响；给…安上垫子，把……安置在垫子上
definition: 1. n. a mechanical damper; absorbs energy of sudden impulses；2. v. protect from impact
example: A hovercraft rides on a cushion of air.
exampleZh: 气垫船悬浮在气垫上行驶。

meaning: n. 监护，监护权；监禁，拘留；保管，保护
definition: 1. the legal right or duty to care for someone or something, especially a child after its parents have separated or died；2. the state of being kept in prison, especially while waiting to go to court for trial
example: He was released from custody the next day.
exampleZh: 他第二天被从拘留中释放。

meaning: n. 风俗，习俗；习惯；光顾，惠顾；惯例，习惯法；（经常性的）顾客；adj. 定做的，量身设计的
definition: 1. n. accepted or habitual practice；2. adj. made according to the specifications of an individual
example: You can also hear Satan's critique of the tyranny of heaven in this account of the rhyme as well. Like kingship, rhyme is a custom.
exampleZh: 在这关于押韵的一段话中也可隐约听到,撒旦对上帝独裁的批判，押韵同王权一样都是惯例。

meaning: adj. 习俗的，习惯的；特有的，典型的；按习惯法的，依惯例的；与非洲黑人传统（或法律）有关的；n. 习惯法汇编
definition: 1. adj. in accordance with convention or custom；2. adj. commonly used or practiced; usual
example: It is customary to offer a drink or a snack to guests.
exampleZh: 通常用饮料或小吃招待客人。

meaning: n. 顾客；（某一类型的）家伙
definition: 1. n. someone who pays for goods or services
example: A customer can go online and just submit an idea, say, "Dell should do the following."
exampleZh: 客户可以上网，提交一个想法，例如说，戴尔应该这样做“

meaning: n. 海关；关税
definition: 1. n. money collected under a tariff
example: It's always Milton's duty - this is the reason that he was put on this earth: to liberate a people from any such constraining customs.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿的使命是,-他是为此才诞于世上：,将英格兰民族从所有抑制人的传统中解放出来。

meaning: v. 切，割，剪；削减，缩减；删节，删减；停止，切断；抄近路，穿过；切（牌），倒（牌）；灌制（唱片），录制（讲话）；划伤，割伤；剪裁；开始长（新牙）；逃学，逃课；停止做不好的事情；切下；切开，把……切碎；凿，挖，刻；剪短，修剪；（割断束缚物）使脱身，使松开；可用于切割；能被切割；剪切（计算机文档）； 剪辑，剪接；停止拍片（或录音、录像）；切换画面；（从感情上）伤害；（与另一条线）相交；冲淡，稀释；划分（区域）；砍（植物）；开除，除名；快速行进；突然转向；插队；（直截了当地）处理；去除（污垢、油污等）；削（球）；符合要求（cut it）；n. 切下的肉块；份额，一份利润；（开出的）通道；伤口，划口；开口，破口；（数量或尺寸上的）削减；理发，发型；款式，式样；删剪，删节；剪辑；（录制的）乐曲；精简，淘汰（如参赛人员）；切，割，削；不理睬，伤人的话（或举动）；adj. 缩减的；割下的；雕过的；阉割过的
definition: 1. n. the act of reducing the amount or number；2. v. separate with or as if with an instrument
example: And so if you can cut out all of that advertising budget, then you can sell the product for much cheaper.
exampleZh: 所以如果你把广告预算都去掉，产品就可以卖得便宜很多。

meaning: adj. 漂亮的，可爱的；性感迷人的；精明的，机灵的；矫揉造作的
definition: 1. adj. attractive especially by means of smallness or prettiness or quaintness；2. adj. obviously contrived to charm
example: You can find me all over the web. There's lots of funny, cute, weird videos, you know.
exampleZh: 在网上你到处都能看到我。有很多滑稽、可爱、奇异的视频。

meaning: n. 网络空间
definition: 1. n. a computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the TCP/IP network protocols to facilitate data transmission and exchange
example: Young people who are digital natives are indeed becoming more skillful at separating fact from fiction in cyberspace.
exampleZh: 数字原生代的年轻人确实越来越善于在网络空间中区分事实与虚构。

meaning: n. 自行车，摩托车；循环，周期；组诗，组歌；整套，系列；自行车骑行；一段时间；v. 骑自行车；循环
definition: 1. n. an interval during which a recurring sequence of events occurs；2. v. cause to go through a recurring sequence
example: So the first step to doing that is I want to just generalize our results so far for a Carnot cycle.
exampleZh: 第一步,首先来推广一下,卡诺循环的结果。

meaning: n. 骑自行车
definition: 1. n. the sport of traveling on a bicycle or motorcycle
example: We did a study using the Framingham data ourselves several --some years ago where we were interested in the issue of weight cycling.
exampleZh: 几年前我们用弗明汉研究的数据做过研究,我们对体重循环这个问题很感兴趣

meaning: n. 骑自行车的人
definition: 1. n. a person who rides a bicycle
example: You might think that its function is to make you more - a better cyclist but that's not its only function.
exampleZh: 你也许只知道它的作用是--,使你成为一个更好的自行车手,但这并不是它的唯一功能

meaning: n. 圆柱体，圆筒；汽缸；高压钢瓶；印刷机滚筒；（枪的）旋转弹膛；筒形石印；柱面
definition: 1. a solid or hollow tube with long straight sides and two circular ends the same size, or an object shaped like this, often used as a container；2. the tube-shaped device, found especially in an engine, inside which the part of the engine that causes the fuel to produce power moves up and down
example: The steam was condensed rapidly by injecting cold water into the cylinder.
exampleZh: 由于汽缸中注入了冷水，蒸汽迅速凝结了。

meaning: adj. 认为人皆自私的，愤世嫉俗的；悲观的，怀疑的；损人利己的；轻蔑的，嘲笑的
definition: 1. believing that people are only interested in themselves and are not sincere；2. used to say that someone's feelings or emotions are used to your own advantage
example: She may be cynical about the film industry, but ultimately she has no intention of biting the hand that feeds her.
exampleZh: 她也许会对电影业冷嘲热讽，但终究不打算恩将仇报。

meaning: n. 愤世嫉俗；犬儒主义；冷嘲热讽
definition: 1. the belief that people are only interested in themselves and are not sincere；2. the fact of using someone's feelings or emotions to your own advantage
example: The awful cynicism of this made an uncomfortable impression, and most of them began to look rather doubtful.
exampleZh: 这种可怕的冷嘲热讽给人留下了一种不舒服的印象，他们中的大多数人开始露出怀疑的神色。

meaning: n. （非正式）爸爸，爹爹；（Dad）人名：（孟、巴基、阿富）达德；（泰）达
definition: 1. n. an informal term for a father; probably derived from baby talk
example: He was here in the 70s. My dad was also a student here so you know, traditions, so.
exampleZh: 0年代的时候他在这里上学。我父亲当时也是这里的学生。现在我也在这儿上学，看出来了吧，这都成了家族传统。

meaning: adj. 每日的，日常的；一天的，按天计算的；adv. 每日，每天；日常地；n. 日报；日工，女佣；（每天拍摄的）电影样片；【名】 （Daily）（英）戴利（人名）
definition: 1. n. a newspaper that is published every day；2. adj. occurring or done each day
example: And it is moving around and we are sitting on that electron watching it go about its daily affairs.
exampleZh: 它正在运动,我们正置身与电子上面,观察它时刻发生的事件。

meaning: adj. 奶制的，乳品的；乳品业的，生产乳品的；n. 乳品公司，乳品店；乳制品；牛奶场，乳品场；地方小店；乳牛
definition: 1. n. a farm where dairy products are produced
example: They included a pizza chef, an electrical engineer, a bank executive, a dairy wholesaler, a school teacher and four stockbrokers; stockbrokers get the word faster.
exampleZh: 这些人中,包括一位披萨厨师,一位电子工程师,一位银行经理,一位牛奶批发商,一位老师,和四位股票经纪人,股票经纪人散播消息的速度更快

meaning: n. 堤，坝；母兽，母畜；水库；（牙科手术中的）橡皮障；v. （在河上）筑坝；阻止，抑制；【名】 （Dam）（美）丹（人名）
definition: 1. n. a barrier constructed to contain the flow of water or to keep out the sea；2. v. obstruct with, or as if with, a dam
example: As you can see, I work here in the Macombs Dam Park where the track is at.
exampleZh: 正如你所看到的，我在这里的梅可姆公园工作，那条小路就在那儿。

meaning: n. （有形的）损坏，损失；损害，伤害；损害赔偿金；费用，代价；v. 损坏，损害；对……造成坏影响
definition: 1. n. the occurrence of a change for the worse；2. v. inflict damage upon
example: And for better or for worse we've done a lot of damage over the past few years for this stuff.
exampleZh: 过去的几年，无论好坏,我们都已经对这个东西造成很大的损坏了。

meaning: int. 该死，见鬼（表示很生气或失望）；天啊（表示赞叹或惊奇）；adj. 该死的（表示对某人或某物生气）；（用于加强语气）十足的，完全的；；adv. 极其，非常；丝毫不；v. 严厉批评，谴责；（表愤怒或厌烦）该死，讨厌，混账；令（某人）下地狱；（强调对某事毫不在意）不管，无所谓；真没想到，真让我吃惊；决不，绝对不；贬斥，把……说得很糟糕；左右为难，做也不是，不做也不是；注定受难（或失败）；诅咒；n. 一点点，丝毫；（对……）在乎
definition: 1. n. something of little value；2. v. wish harm upon; invoke evil upon
example: In that case the red light would be a beacon which means "forward," "go," "follow me," "damn the torpedoes." Right?
exampleZh: 他就很可能代表,出发，跟我来等等意思，对吧？

meaning: adj. 潮湿的；n. 湿气，潮气；沼气；气馁；v. 使潮湿，弄湿；减弱，抑制；把（火）调小；限止（钢琴或其他乐器琴弦）的音；减幅，阻尼
definition: 1. n. a slight wetness；2. v. deaden (a sound or noise), especially by wrapping
example: The cottage was cold and damp.
exampleZh: 这小屋又冷又湿。

meaning: v. 使潮湿，弄湿；减弱，抑制
definition: 1. v. smother or suppress；2. v. make moist
example: Feeling the glass, he discovered that he could dampen the vibration but couldn't make it stop.

meaning: n. 危险，风险；威胁，危险因素；（不愉快之事发生的）可能性，风险；【名】 （Danger）（法）当热（人名）

meaning: adj. 黑暗的，昏暗的；深色的，暗色的；恐怖的，悲惨的；神秘的，隐秘的；忧郁的，悲观的；邪恶的，阴险的；（头发、眼睛或皮肤）褐色的，黑色的；（剧院）关闭的，停业的；（嗓音）低沉圆润的；（语音）暗的；n. 黑暗，暗处；暗色，阴影；黄昏，夜幕；【名】 （Dark）（英）达克（人名）

definition: 1. n. a position or opinion or judgment reached after consideration；2. n. the act of making up your mind about something
example: So I think the first critical decision I made is don't spend money as you promised it to your investors.
exampleZh: 这就是我所做的第一个决策,不要像承诺的那样去花钱。

meaning: adj. 果断的，决断的；决定性的，关键的；确定的，明确的
definition: 1. adj. determining or having the power to determine an outcome；2. adj. unmistakable
example: A different way of putting it-- and none of this is going to come in with a sharp, decisive theory.
exampleZh: 从另一个角度来看-,注意，我现在讲的内容,目前都没有一个明确的理论。

meaning: adj. 十进位的，小数的；n. 小数；十进制
definition: 1. relating to or expressed in a system of counting based on the number ten；2. a number expressed using a system of counting based on the number ten
example: Well, if we actually want to represent something like the number 7, well in binary, not actually in decimal like this.
exampleZh: 如果你表达,类似于7的数字，在二进制中，它和十进制可不太一样。

meaning: n. 甲板，舱面；（船或公共汽车的）层；一副牌；（屋后供休息的）木制平台；（唱机的）盘装置，（音响系统的）走带机构；v. 装饰，打扮；用力击倒；装甲板；【名】 （Deck）（英、法、德）德克（人名）
definition: 1. n. any of various platforms built into a vessel；2. v. be beautiful to look at
example: I was hurled bodily to the deck.
exampleZh: 我整个人被扔到了甲板上。

meaning: v. 宣布，声明；断言，宣称；申报；放弃击球，宣布结束赛局
definition: 1. v. state emphatically and authoritatively；2. v. announce publicly or officially
example: And when you declare a variable, whether as an argument or as literally a local variable, they only live inside of that function.
exampleZh: 当你声明一个变量，不论是一个参数,还是一个局部变量，它们只存在函数的内部。

meaning: n. 声明，表白；申报（单）；（板球）对一赛局结束的宣布；公告，宣告
definition: 1. n. a statement that is emphatic and explicit (spoken or written)；2. n. (law) unsworn statement that can be admitted in evidence in a legal transaction
example: Some delegates believe the final declaration is likely to be too timorous.
exampleZh: 一些代表认为这份最后的声明可能有些过于畏首畏尾的感觉。

meaning: adj. 公告的，宣言的；陈述的，叙述的
definition: 1. n. a mood (grammatically unmarked) that represents the act or state as an objective fact；2. adj. relating to the use of or having the nature of a declaration
example: Some researchers contend that sleep plays no role in the consolidation of declarative memory (i.e., memory involving factual information).
exampleZh: 一些研究者认为，睡眠对于陈述性记忆（例如：牵扯到事实信息的记忆）的巩固没有影响。

meaning: v. 下降，衰退；拒绝，谢绝；变格，词形变化；n. 减少，衰退
definition: 1. n. change toward something smaller or lower；2. v. grow worse
example: And in the--from 1989 to 2006 there was a pretty significant decline, but even in 1989 the numbers weren't very high.
exampleZh: 我们看到,从1989到,2006年有个很明显的下降,但是即使是在1989年这个数字也不高

meaning: v. 装饰，装点；粉刷，装修；授予（某人）勋章
definition: 1. v. make more attractive by adding ornament, colour, etc.；2. v. be beautiful to look at
example: When they came to decorate the rear bedroom, it was Jemma who had the final say.
exampleZh: 他们开始装修后卧室时，说了算的人是杰马。

meaning: n. 装饰，装饰品；勋章，奖章；装潢，装饰风格
definition: 1. n. something used to beautify；2. n. an award for winning a championship or commemorating some other event
example: The room was austere, nearly barren of furniture or decoration.
exampleZh: 这个房间很简朴，几乎没有什么家具或装饰。

meaning: adj. 装饰性的，用作装饰的
definition: 1. adj. serving an esthetic rather than a useful purpose
example: The curtains are for purely decorative purposes and do not open or close.
exampleZh: 那些窗帘纯粹用于装饰目的，不能开合。

meaning: v. （使）减少，（使）降低；n. 减少，降低
definition: 1. n. a change downward；2. v. decrease in size, extent, or range
example: So would you expect, therefore, as we go across a row for the atomic radius, to increase or to decrease? Good. OK, yes.
exampleZh: 那么大家觉得，原子半径沿着某一行向右走，是会增大还是会减小呢？很好，不错，是的。

meaning: n. 法令，政令；裁定，判决；v. 裁定，判决，颁布
definition: 1. an official statement that something must happen；2. to officially decide or order that something must happen
example: He backed a provision that would allow judges to delay granting a divorce decree in some cases.
exampleZh: 他支持允许法官在有些情况下推迟离婚判决的规定。

meaning: v. 致力于，献身于；把（书、戏剧、音乐作品等）献给；为（建筑物或教堂）举行奉献（或落成）典礼
definition: 1. to give all of your energy, time, etc.；2. If you dedicate a book, play, performance, etc. to someone, you publicly say that it is in that person's honour
example: You know, when I asked them to dedicate this song, I had a slightly different song in mind.
exampleZh: 请他们献歌时，本来想选另一首歌。

meaning: n. 献身，奉献；献辞；落成典礼
definition: 1. the willingness to give a lot of time and energy to something because it is important；2. a statement that says in whose honour something has been written, made, performed, etc.
example: The new model is a testament to the skill and dedication of the workforce.
exampleZh: 这种新型产品显示了全体员工的技术水平和敬业精神。

meaning: v. 推断，演绎；对……追本溯源
definition: 1. to reach an answer or a decision by thinking carefully about the known facts；2. to reach an answer by thinking about a general truth and its relationship to a specific situation
example: Usually it is left to employers to deduce the potential from a list of extracurricular adventures on a graduate's resume.
exampleZh: 通常情况下，由雇主从毕业生简历上的课外活动清单中来推断他们的潜力。

meaning: adj. 可推论的，可推断的
definition: 1. able to be deduced (= answered or decided by thinking carefully about the known facts)
example: This, sir, I say, is plainly deducible from his proposition;
exampleZh: 阁下，我说，这从英格利斯的主张可以清楚地推论出来；

meaning: v. 减去，扣除
definition: 1. to take away an amount or part from a total
example: In special cases, a husband can deduct the travel expenses of his wife who accompanies him on a business trip.
exampleZh: 在特殊情况下，丈夫可以扣除差旅中随行妻子的旅费。

meaning: n. 演绎，推论；扣除，扣除额
definition: 1. the process of reaching a decision or answer by thinking about the known facts, or the decision that is reached；2. the calculation of taking an amount or a part of something away from a total or the amount that is taken away
example: Miss Allan beamed at him. "You are clever to guess. I'm sure I don't know how you did it."—"Deduction," James said.
exampleZh: 阿伦小姐对他笑道：“你很会猜， 我确实不知道你怎么办到的。”——杰姆斯说：“推论。”

meaning: adj. 演绎的，推论的
definition: 1. reaching an answer or a decision by thinking carefully about the known facts
example: You should know that a deductive argument is an either-or thing.
exampleZh: 你应该知道演绎论证是一个非此即彼的东西。

meaning: adj. 可扣除的，可减免的；n. 免赔额
definition: 1. A deductible amount can be taken away from a total；2. an amount of money that is taken away from an employee's pay before they receive it
example: Part of the auto-loan interest is deductible as a business expense.
exampleZh: 作为一项业务支出，汽车消费的部分贷款利息是可以扣除的。

meaning: n. 行为，行动；契约，证书；功绩，英勇事迹；v. 立契转让
definition: 1. n. a notable achievement；2. n. a legal document signed and sealed and delivered to effect a transfer of property and to show the legal right to possess it
example: The man has said his deed was but lamely proved.
exampleZh: 这名男子称，对他行为的证明不过是站不住脚的。

meaning: v. 认为，相信；【名】 （Deem）（英）迪姆 （人名）
definition: 1. v. keep in mind or convey as a conviction or view
example: Mainstream organizations will go for what they deem are safe bets rather than venture into unknown territories.
exampleZh: 主流组织将选择他们认为安全的事情，而不是冒险进入未知领域。

meaning: adj. 深的，厚的；纵深的，宽的；有……深的；成……排的；深呼吸的；（声音）低沉的；深色的；酣睡的；严重的；（感情）深厚的；透彻的，深刻的；深奥的；全神贯注，深陷；（人）深沉的；（目光）锐利的，深邃的；靠近场地边界的；神秘的；大幅下降的；有很多优秀选手的；adv. 深深地，至深处；有……深；成……排地；靠近场地边界地；n. 海洋（the deep）；海洋深处（deeps）；中间部分（the deep）；（板球）外围场地（the deep）；【名】 （Deep）迪普（人名）
definition: 1. n. the central and most intense or profound part；2. adj. relatively deep or strong; affecting one deeply
example: There's this deep religious tradition that came out of Slave Religion, but there is also a deep anger. -Yes. Yes.
exampleZh: 在《奴隶宗教》这本书中,既有深深的宗教传统，又有一种怒火，-的确如此。

meaning: adv. 很，非常；深刻地，深沉地；至深处
definition: 1. adv. to a great depth psychologically；2. adv. to a great depth
example: I've always been the kind of person who cared deeply about what happened at the national and international level.
exampleZh: 我一直十分关心,国内国际发生的时事。

meaning: n. 深度，纵深；深刻，深奥；深厚，深切；（声音的）低沉；浓度，强度；严重性，严峻性；渊博，老练；纵深感，景深；最深处，极限；低迷状态，非常糟糕的状态
definition: 1. n. extent downward or backward or inward；2. n. degree of psychological or intellectual profundity
example: This is a poem written in the depth of the Depression and also at the height of Frost's fame.
exampleZh: 这是一首写在经济危机时候的诗,也是在弗罗斯特最有名的时候。

meaning: n. 鹿；（Deer）人名；迪尔
definition: 1. n. distinguished from Bovidae by the male's having solid deciduous antlers
example: People panicking about that, people look like deer in the headlamps yet?
exampleZh: 大家都谈符号色变,你们像被前照灯照到的小鹿那样乱窜吗

meaning: n. 不履行，违约；默认，系统设定值；缺席，弃权；v. 违约，不履行义务；默认，预设；弃权，未到场；adj. 默认的
definition: 1. to fail to do something, such as pay a debt, that you legally have to do；2. In sport, if a team or player defaults, they allow the other side to win without playing or completing a game
example: ArgC How many words were typed at the prompt, by default, Arg C, should always be at least one.
exampleZh: 提示符那里默认要输入多少单词，至少需要一个单词。

meaning: v. 击败，战胜；困惑，难住；使失败，阻挠；反对（动议或提议）；n. 失败，战败；战胜，击败
definition: 1. n. an unsuccessful ending to a struggle or contest；2. v. win a victory over
example: All Southerners who try to express themselves in art are very much aware that they are party to a defeat."
exampleZh: 所有希望藉由艺术的方式,表达自身的南方人都很清楚,他们是战败的一方"

meaning: n. 缺点，缺陷，毛病；v. 背叛，叛变
definition: 1. n. an imperfection in a bodily system；2. v. desert (a cause, a country or an army), often in order to join the opposing cause, country, or army
example: no surprise] as we refer to the objects they are meant to present - a defect in a literary text."
exampleZh: 当我们讲到它们所想要表现的东西时,但这正是文学作品的一个缺点“

meaning: adj. 有问题的，有缺陷的；（词）不完全变化的；n. 有缺陷的人
definition: 1. adj. having a defect；2. adj. markedly subnormal in structure or function or intelligence or behavior
example: A manufacturer negligently made and marketed a car with defective brakes.
exampleZh: 一家制造商渎职，制造并销售了一款有制动缺陷的汽车。

meaning: n. 脱离，退出，叛逃
definition: 1. n. withdrawing support or help despite allegiance or responsibility；2. n. the state of having rejected your religious beliefs or your political party or a cause (often in favor of opposing beliefs or causes)
example: Do they gamble on cooperation (high payoff) or defection (low, but sure payoff)?
exampleZh: 他们是在赌合作(高回报)还是背叛(低，但是肯定有回报)吗？

meaning: v. 保卫，防御；捍卫，维护；（在比赛中）防守，防卫；参加卫冕赛，蝉联；做……的辩护律师，为……辩解
definition: 1. v. argue or speak in defense of；2. v. be on the defensive; act against an attack
example: The newspaper continues to defend its publication of the photographs.
exampleZh: 这家报纸继续为刊登这些照片辩护。

meaning: n. 防御，保卫；防御物，防御能力；国防机构，国防体系；辩解，辩白；被告，辩护律师；（法庭上的）辩护，答辩； 防守队员，防守；（竞赛中的）卫冕，（选举中的）保住席位；戒备心理，自我防卫；国际象棋的防御（黑棋的某种特定走法）
definition: 1. n. (sports) the team that is trying to prevent the other team from scoring；2. n. military action or resources protecting a country against potential enemies
example: I want to spend a little time suggesting and developing the way in which that defense could be undertaken.
exampleZh: 下面我想花点时间,阐述一下这一观点。

meaning: adj. 防御的，戒备的；生气的，发怒的；（比赛中）防守的，防御的；百般辩解的；n. 防御态势，守势；辩护，辩解
definition: 1. n. an attitude of defensiveness (especially in the phrase `on the defensive')；2. adj. intended or appropriate for defending against or deterring aggression or attack
example: It's the same computation. But this is a nice way of writing it, often called defensive programming.
exampleZh: 这跟原来的计算过程没什么不同,但这是写代码的更优秀的一种方式。

meaning: n. 被告，被告人
definition: 1. n. a person or institution against whom an action is brought in a court of law; the person being sued or accused
example: The defendant drove negligently and hit a lamp post.
exampleZh: 被告不小心驾驶，撞到一根路灯柱上了。

meaning: v. 延期，推迟；听从，遵从（defer to）；【名】 （Defer）（法）德费（人名）
definition: 1. to delay something until a later time；2. to delay something until a later time; to postpone
example: as Joyce would say--stream of consciousness, I understand difference temporally. I defer difference. I unfold.
exampleZh: 乔伊斯会说，意识流，我只是暂时地理解了差异，推迟了差异，将之打开。

meaning: adj. 缺乏的，不足的；有缺点的，有缺陷的
definition: 1. adj. inadequate in amount or degree；2. adj. of a quantity not able to fulfill a need or requirement
example: Lead researcher Masashi Soga with the University of Tokyo says the study stemmed from observations about today's nature-deficient children.
exampleZh: 东京大学的首席研究员曾我昌史表示，这项研究源于对当今缺乏自然接触的儿童的观察。

meaning: n. 缺乏，不足；缺陷，瑕疵；赤字
definition: 1. n. the state of needing something that is absent or unavailable；2. n. lack of an adequate quantity or number
example: The most serious deficiency in NATO's air defence is the lack of an identification system to distinguish friend from foe.
exampleZh: 北约防空的最大缺陷就是缺乏能够辨认敌友的识别系统。

meaning: n. 亏损，赤字，不足额；（体育用语）失分数；缺乏，缺陷
definition: 1. n. the property of being an amount by which something is less than expected or required；2. n. a deficiency or failure in neurological or mental functioning
example: The trade balance has been in deficit for the past five years.
exampleZh: 过去五年来贸易状况一直是逆差。

meaning: v. 给……下定义，解释；阐明，使清楚；标明……界限，明确显出……轮廓；是……的特征，为……的特色；【名】 （Define）（英）德法恩，（葡）德菲内（人名）
definition: 1. v. give a definition for the meaning of a word；2. v. determine the essential quality of
example: So in the end,the canon is a list of the winners in the historical debate to define orthodox Christianity.
exampleZh: 所以最后，正典书目只是赢家的清单,他们在这场定义东正教的历史争论中胜出。

meaning: n. 定义，释义；榜样，典范；清晰，清晰度，鲜明度
definition: 1. n. a concise explanation of the meaning of a word or phrase or symbol；2. n. clarity of outline
example: It's this drive to constant self-definition that becomes the characteristic feature of Milton's work for later generations.
exampleZh: 就是这种对自我界定的欲望,变成了弥尔顿留给后人的,作品的典型特征。

meaning: adj. 清晰的，明晰的；确定的，不会改变的；肯定的，一定的；n. 确定之事
definition: 1. adj. precise; explicit and clearly defined；2. adj. known for certain
example: iterature cannot merely be received as a definite unit of referential meaning that can be decoded without leaving a residue.
exampleZh: 文学不能仅仅以一个确切的参考性意思的单位来理解,这种参考性意思的单位在破解时不会留下任何残余。

meaning: adv. 肯定地，当然；明确地，确定地
definition: 1. adv. without question and beyond doubt
example: But... there're definitely, it's definitely a campus that gives you a lot of opportunities to do unique things.
exampleZh: 但是……我们校园的确给学生提供了充足的机会来获得特别的体验。

meaning: v. 违抗，不服从；挑战，激；无法，难以（描述或理解）；经受住，顶住
definition: 1. v. resist or confront with resistance；2. v. elude, especially in a baffling way
example: Statement shoes sometimes defy logic, such as cage-effect booties or insanely high heels, but they always attract attention.
exampleZh: 正代鞋有时候不符合常理，比如笼罩式的短靴或者高得吓人的鞋跟，但它们总是能吸引注意力。

meaning: n. 违抗，蔑视
definition: 1. n. intentionally contemptuous behavior or attitude；2. n. a hostile challenge
example: They're able to choose their actions in conformity with God's will or in defiance of God's will.
exampleZh: 他们能够选择遵从上帝的意愿,也能违背上帝的意愿。

meaning: adj. 违抗的，反叛的，蔑视的
definition: 1. adj. boldly resisting authority or an opposing force
example: Defiant in their haughty and arrogant inaccessibility, they seem to shout: I dare you!
exampleZh: 他们桀骜不驯，一副傲慢自大、拒人千里的模样，仿佛在高声喊道：我谅你不敢！

meaning: v. 恶化，堕落，退化；adj. 衰退的，堕落的；退化的；n. 堕落的人，颓废的人
definition: 1. to become worse in quality；2. having very low moral standards of behaviour
example: Inactivity can make your joints stiff, and the bones may begin to degenerate.
exampleZh: 不活动会使关节僵硬，骨骼因此可能会开始退化。

meaning: n. 恶化，衰退，堕落；变性
definition: 1. the process by which something gets worse；2. the process of becoming worse
example: Studies have shown, for example, that two drugs are about equally effective in treating macular degeneration, an eye disease.
exampleZh: 例如，有一些研究表明，两种药物治疗黄斑变性这种眼病的效果差不多。

meaning: v. 侮辱，贬低；降低，削弱（尤指质量）；降解，分解；使降级，贬黜；使（岩石）陵削；使（能量）衰变
definition: 1. to cause people to feel that they or other people have no value and do not have the respect or good opinion of others；2. to spoil or destroy the beauty or quality of something
example: You have mechanisms inside your natural mechanisms inside your cell that allow the cells to degrade unwanted RNA sequences.
exampleZh: 人体内细胞的这种自然机制,有助于细胞降解不需要的RNA序列

meaning: n. 丢脸，落魄，侮辱；损害，恶化，衰退；降解；陵夷，剥蚀
definition: 1. the process in which the beauty or quality of something is destroyed or spoiled；2. the situation in which people are made to feel they have no value
example: He's punishing the evil corruption of human beings that he has so lovingly created and whose degradation he can't bear to witness.
exampleZh: 他这是在惩罚人类的堕落,上帝充满爱意地创造了人,而人却堕落得让他不可容忍。

meaning: n. 度，度数（温度单位）；（角的）度，度数；学位课程，学位；程度；音级；次，次数；（形容词或副词的）级；共济会职务；社会地位，官衔
definition: 1. n. a position on a scale of intensity or amount or quality；2. n. a specific identifiable position in a continuum or series or especially in a process
example: I don't really have the opportunities to study math and science, which, to some degree, I think is regrettable
exampleZh: 我没什么机会继续学习数学和科学。我有时觉得有些很遗憾，

meaning: v. 推迟，延期；延误，耽搁；（故意）拖延，磨蹭；n. 延期，推迟；延误，耽搁；延迟器；【名】 （Delay）（美）德莱（人名）
definition: 1. n. time during which some action is awaited；2. v. cause to be slowed down or delayed
example: We can think in terms of repetition, obviously, as the delay that sets in between an origin and an end.
exampleZh: 我们可以想想看这里面的重复，很明显，重复性的情节将起因和结果隔开来。

meaning: n. 代表；委员会成员；v. 授权，把……委托给；选派（某人做某事）
definition: 1. n. a person appointed or elected to represent others；2. v. transfer power to someone
example: Should I delegate this task or just say no all together?
exampleZh: 我应该把这个任务委托给别人，还是一并拒绝？

meaning: n. 代表团；授权，委派
definition: 1. n. a group of representatives or delegates；2. n. authorizing subordinates to make certain decisions
example: A United States delegation is in Japan seeking finance for a major scientific project.
exampleZh: 1个美国代表团正在日本为一个重大科研项目寻求资助。

meaning: v. 删除；n. 删除键
definition: 1. v. remove or make invisible；2. v. wipe out magnetically recorded information
example: One tip about this, try to identify all the dominated strategies of all players before you delete, then delete.
exampleZh: 这里有一个窍门,在剔除之前试着找出,所有参与人的劣势策略,然后再剔除它们

meaning: n. 删除，删去的部分；（核酸分子或染色体的）缺失
definition: 1. n. any process whereby sounds are left out of spoken words or phrases；2. n. (genetics) the loss or absence of one or more nucleotides from a chromosome
example: Information must be stored so that it is secure from accidental deletion.
exampleZh: 必须把资料保存起来，这样才不至于无意中删除。

meaning: adj. 故意的，蓄意的；从容的，小心翼翼的；深思熟虑的；v. 仔细考虑，认真商讨
definition: 1. v. think about carefully; weigh；2. adj. by conscious design or purpose
example: The deliberate cruelty of his words cut her like a knife.
exampleZh: 他故意说的残酷无情的话对她像刀割一样。

meaning: n. 考虑，思考；从容，审慎；审议，商议；考虑，细想
definition: 1. n. (usually plural) discussion of all sides of a question；2. n. careful consideration
example: In this house nothing is there by chance: it is always the result of great deliberation.
exampleZh: 在这房子里，没有什么东西是偶然的——总是非常仔细考虑后的结果。

meaning: n. 美味，佳肴；脆弱，娇嫩；微妙，棘手；审慎，体贴；（结构的）精巧，精致
definition: 1. something especially rare or expensive that is good to eat；2. acting and speaking carefully so that no one is offended, or the possibility of causing offence
example: And this is line 679: Why should you be so cruel to yourself, And to those dainty limbs which nature lent For gentle usage and soft delicacy?
exampleZh: 在第679行：，你为什么要对自己那么残忍，对于大自然赋予我们的四肢,只文雅的使用和温和的对待佳肴？

meaning: adj. 柔和的，清淡的；虚弱的，纤弱的；脆弱的，易碎的；小巧玲珑的，纤细的；微妙的，棘手的；精致的，精巧的；灵巧的，熟练的；（仪器）灵敏的；n. 精美的衣物
definition: 1. adj. exquisitely fine and subtle and pleasing; susceptible to injury；2. adj. marked by great skill especially in meticulous technique
example: They're capable of these extraordinarily delicate feats of dexterity, and that's because the poet has mastered his touch.
exampleZh: 反而能够灵巧地完成精细的动作，这是因为诗人已经完全掌握了自己的触觉。

meaning: adj. 美味的，芬芳的；令人愉快的，宜人的
definition: 1. n. variety of sweet eating apples；2. adj. greatly pleasing or entertaining
example: This is the image of a child, also named Marianne Moore, with delicious, prodigious locks.
exampleZh: 这是一个名为玛丽安穆尔的小孩的图，她脸上的表情甜美而奇妙。

meaning: n. 高兴；令人高兴的人或物，乐事；v. 使高兴；以……为乐；【名】 （Delight）（英）迪莱特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a feeling of extreme pleasure or satisfaction；2. v. give pleasure to or be pleasing to
example: There was the delight I caught in seeing long straight rows of red and green vegetables stretching away in the sun to the bright horizon.
exampleZh: 当我看到一排排红的绿的蔬菜,在阳光下延伸得又直又长,直到闪耀的地平线上。

meaning: adj. 令人愉快的，宜人的
definition: 1. adj. greatly pleasing or entertaining
example: He was a man of few words with a delightful dry sense of humour.
exampleZh: 他话不多，很幽默，却又不形于色，让人很愉快。

meaning: v. 投递，运送；履行，兑现；交付，移交；发表，宣布；接生，分娩；解救，拯救；投掷，击打；（法官或法庭）宣布（判决）；拉（选票）；发行，发布（计算机程序）；处理
definition: 1. v. deliver (a speech, oration, or idea)；2. v. bring to a destination, make a delivery
example: This is an opportunity for us to see if we can electronically packaging deliver the results of the current research.
exampleZh: 借此机会可以看看,我们是否能用电子技术,打包传递新研究的成果。

meaning: n. 递送，投递；递送物；演讲风格，演说方式；分娩，生产；投球方式；adj. 运送的
definition: 1. n. the act of delivering or distributing something (as goods or mail)；2. n. the event of giving birth
example: We'll talk later about other kinds of vehicles when we talk about new methods for delivery of drugs.
exampleZh: 我们还会讲到其它媒介,就在之后在新的药物输送方法的时候

meaning: v. 欺骗，哄骗；迷惑；逃避；使失望
definition: 1. to make someone believe something that is not true；2. to believe something that is not true, especially because you want to believe it
example: Whatever we do, we should never delude ourselves into believing that gifted children or geniuses are different from the rest of humanity.
exampleZh: 无论我们怎样做，都不应自欺欺人地相信有天赋的孩子或天才和其他人不同。

meaning: n. 错觉；妄想
definition: 1. belief in something that is not true；2. something a person believes and wants to be true, when it is actually not true
example: Insinuations about her mental state, about her capacity for delusion, were being made.
exampleZh: 当时有对她的精神状态的影射——说她有妄想症的影射。

meaning: v. 强烈要求；需要，需求；n. 坚决的要求；需求，需求量；（困难的）要求；【名】 （Demand）（德）德曼德（人名）
definition: 1. n. the ability and desire to purchase goods and services；2. v. request urgently and forcefully
example: Now, the interest rate in Irving Fisher's world has to equate supply and demand in the market for debt.
exampleZh: 在费雪的理论里,利率必须与,债券市场的供需关系保持平衡

meaning: adj. 费时费力的；苛刻的，难以满足的；v. 强烈要求；需要，需求（demand 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. requiring more than usually expected or thought due; especially great patience and effort and skill
example: That I think is a real virtue but it can come at the price of demanding short term accountability.
exampleZh: 我认为这是个优点，但是可能会,付出短期责任的代价。

meaning: n. 民主政体；民主国家；民主，民主精神
definition: 1. a system in which political power is exercised by the people, usually through elected representatives
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: A functioning democracy depends on transparent institutions and an informed public.
exampleZh: 一个正常运转的民主制度依赖于透明的机构和知情的公众。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: adj. 平等的，有民主精神的；民主政体的；（美国）民主党的
definition: 1. adj. characterized by or advocating or based upon the principles of democracy or social equality；2. adj. belong to or relating to the Democratic Party
example: Objection number two, it's not really slavery to tax because at least in a democratic society it's not a slave holder.
exampleZh: 第二条反对意见，征税算不上是奴隶制,因为至少在民主社会,不存在奴隶主。

meaning: n. （美国）民主党党员；民主主义者
definition: 1. n. a member of the Democratic Party；2. n. an advocate of democratic principles
example: The election may not be the traditional two-horse race between the preferred Democrat and Republican party candidates.
exampleZh: 这次选举可能并不是支持率最高的民主党与共和党候选人间的传统两方角逐。

meaning: adj. 人口的，人口统计的；n. （具有某种特征的）群体；人口统计数据
definition: 1. relating to demography (= the study of populations and the different groups that make them up)；2. a group of people, for example customers, who are similar in age, social class, etc.
example: By the mid-19th century most of Europe was in the first stage of the demographic transition.
exampleZh: 到19世纪中叶，欧洲的大部分地区处于人口转变的第一阶段。

meaning: v. 证明；示范，演示；表露；游行，示威
definition: 1. v. show or demonstrate something to an interested audience；2. v. establish the validity of something, as by an example, explanation or experiment
example: They are anxious to demonstrate to the voters that they have practical policies.
exampleZh: 他们急于向选民证明他们有切实可行的政策。

meaning: n. 演示，展示；游行，示威；证实；表达，表露
definition: 1. n. a show or display; the act of presenting something to sight or view；2. n. a show of military force or preparedness
example: But just to hammer home this point, if I could, we have time for one awkward demonstration.
exampleZh: 但是这个时候为了再三强调到彻底的了解，如果可以的话，我们还有时间做一个不太好的示范。

meaning: adj. 感情外露的；（证据）结论性的，提供证明的；指示的；n. 指示词
definition: 1. n. a pronoun that points out an intended referent；2. adj. given to or marked by the open expression of emotion
example: We came from the English tradition of not being demonstrative.
exampleZh: 我们的感情不外露来自于英国传统。

meaning: v. 标志，预示；表示，意指
definition: 1. to represent something；2. to represent or mean something
example: So it's very much the name of functions that denote or connote their behavior.
exampleZh: 所以很大程度上函数的名字指明了,或暗示了它们的功能。

meaning: n. 指称意义，本义
definition: 1. the main meaning of a word, not including the feelings or ideas that people may connect with the word；2. the act of referring to something or naming it using a word
example: In any case, the tension between denotation and connotation is part of the way in which irony works.
exampleZh: 在任何情况下，讽刺的作用,都是表达了符号和涵义之间的张力。

meaning: v. 谴责，痛斥；检举，告发
definition: 1. to criticize something or someone strongly and publicly；2. to tell someone in authority about a person's illegal activities, especially illegal political activities
example: They were at the mercy of informers who might at any moment denounce them.
exampleZh: 他们完全受那些随时可能告发他们的告密者的支配。

meaning: n. 告发，检举；公开谴责，斥责
definition: 1. public criticism of something or someone；2. the act of accusing someone in public of something bad
example: On September 24, he wrote a stinging denunciation of his critics.
exampleZh: 9月24号，他写了一篇针对他的批评者的言辞犀利的谴责书。

meaning: adj. 稠密的；浓密的，浓重的；密度大的；（文字）难懂的；愚钝的，笨拙的
definition: 1. adj. permitting little if any light to pass through because of denseness of matter；2. adj. having component parts closely crowded together
example: So, indeed, we are talking about a lot of void and a tiny little bit of extremely dense being.
exampleZh: 事实上，更多的是许多真空,只有极小部分的高密度的物质。

meaning: n. 稠密，密集；密度
definition: 1. n. the amount per unit size；2. n. the spatial property of being crowded together
example: Astronomers know that Pluto and Triton have nearly the same size, mass, and density.
exampleZh: 天文学家们知道冥王星和海王卫一拥有几乎相同的体积、质量和密度。

meaning: v. 使产生凹痕；损害，削弱；n. 凹痕；削减；【名】 （Dent）（英、葡）登特（人名）
definition: 1. n. an appreciable consequence (especially a lessening)；2. v. make a depression into
example: They can beat out the dent in the car's wing.
exampleZh: 他们能把汽车挡泥板上的凹痕敲平。

meaning: adj. 牙齿的，牙科的；齿音的；n. 齿音
definition: 1. n. a consonant articulated with the tip of the tongue near the gum ridge；2. adj. of or relating to the teeth
example: Good oral hygiene and regular dental care are important, whatever your age.
exampleZh: 无论年龄大小，良好的口腔卫生和定期的牙齿保健都非常重要。

meaning: n. 牙科医生；牙医诊所
definition: 1. n. a person qualified to practice dentistry
example: I don't know if I'm repeating this but he was at his dentist I didn't tell you this.
exampleZh: 我不清楚我是否在重复这个,但是他当时是在他牙医的诊所-我没有告诉你吧。

meaning: v. 否认；拒绝承认；拒绝给予
definition: 1. v. declare untrue; contradict；2. v. refuse to accept or believe
example: Deny thy father and refuse they name, or if thou wilt not, be but sworn, my love, and I'll no longer be a Capulet." She's a Capulet.
exampleZh: 否认你的父亲，抛弃你的姓名吧，也许你不愿意这样做，只要你宣誓做我的爱人，我也不愿再姓凯普莱特了，她姓凯普莱特。

meaning: n. 否认；拒绝接受，拒不承认；剥夺，拒绝给予
definition: 1. n. the act of refusing to comply (as with a request)；2. n. the act of asserting that something alleged is not true
example: With major life traumas, like losing a loved one, for instance, the mind's first reaction is denial.
exampleZh: 面对人生的重大创痛，例如失去深爱的人，心理的第一反应就是拒绝接受。

meaning: v. 启程，出发；背离，违背；离职
definition: 1. v. move away from a place into another direction；2. v. be at variance with; be out of line with
example: So justice is higher, individual rights are privileged, but not for reasons that depart from utilitarian assumptions.
exampleZh: 所以公正是更高级的，个体权利是种特权，但并不能出于功利主义假设之外的理由。

meaning: n. 背离；离开，启程
definition: 1. n. act of departing；2. n. a variation that deviates from the standard or norm
example: OK, so do we know anything so far that we can point to that would give us a departure?
exampleZh: 好，到目前为止我们能在我们了解到的,东西中找出一些违背这些规律的例子吗？

meaning: n. （组织或机构中的）部，司，系，处，科；（商场里的）部；专长，专责；（法国等国的）省
definition: 1. n. a specialized division of a large organization；2. n. the territorial and administrative division of some countries (such as France)
example: but I'm more in the biology department, so that's about all I can tell you on that front.
exampleZh: 但是我是生物系的，所以我能说的就这么多了，

meaning: v. 取决于；依赖，依靠；相信，指望；那得看情况；（语法上）从属（depend on/upon）
definition: 1. v. be contingent upon (something that is elided)；2. v. have faith or confidence in
example: In other words, the judgment of beauty does not depend on the existence of the object for its satisfaction.
exampleZh: 换句话说，审美不会依赖于,事物自己的存在形式。

meaning: adj. 依赖的，依靠的；取决于；有瘾的；n. 受供养者
definition: 1. n. a person who relies on another person for support (especially financial support)；2. adj. not independent
example: But when you solve the Schrodingerequation, you don't get just a set of solutions that are dependent upon one number.
exampleZh: 但当你解薛定谔的方程式时，你没得到有一个统一答案的,一系列解决方法。

meaning: n. 依赖，依靠；（对毒品或酒精的）瘾，癖
definition: 1. n. lack of independence or self-sufficiency；2. n. being abnormally tolerant to and dependent on something that is psychologically or physically habit-forming (especially alcohol or narcotic drugs)
example: That for an ideal gas it has to be the case that there's no volume dependence of the energy.
exampleZh: 我们可以直接推导这个结果,即证明对理想气体，内能和气体体积无关。

meaning: adj. 可靠的，可信赖的
definition: 1. adj. worthy of reliance or trust；2. adj. worthy of being depended on
example: He was a good friend, a dependable companion.
exampleZh: 他是个好朋友，一个可以信赖的同伴。

meaning: v. 描述，描绘
definition: 1. to represent or show something in a picture or story；2. to represent or show something in a picture, story, movie, etc.; portray
example: Although we still depict nostalgic snow scenes on Christmas cards, winters are now very much warmer.
exampleZh: 虽然我们还在圣诞卡上描绘引人怀旧的雪景，但现在冬天温暖多了。

meaning: n. 描述，描绘
definition: 1. the way that something is represented or shown, or something that represents or shows something
example: Rodin's depiction insists on the carnality of love, just like Hogarth's two paintings—Before and After.
exampleZh: 罗丹的绘画强调爱之欲，就像荷加斯的两幅画：《之前》和《之后》。

meaning: v. 大量减少，耗尽
definition: 1. to reduce something in size or amount, especially supplies of energy, money, etc.；2. to reduce something in size or amount, esp. supplies, energy, or money
example: Surely it is an economic nonsense to deplete the world of natural resources.
exampleZh: 耗尽世界的自然资源无疑是一件经济上的愚蠢行为。

meaning: n. 损耗，耗尽
definition: 1. a reduction in something；2. a reduction in something, or the act of reducing it
example: What they find could provide clues to what might happen worldwide if ozone depletion continues.
exampleZh: 如果臭氧的损耗继续下去，他们的发现能为全世界可能发生的情况提供线索。

meaning: vt. 强烈反对，谴责；vt. 悲悼，哀叹；对……深感遗憾
definition: 1. to say or think that something is very bad；2. to say or think that something is very bad; condemn
example: I deplore the boy's actions, and he will pay the price for what he has done.
exampleZh: 我谴责这个男孩的所作所为，他将为自己的行为付出代价。

meaning: v. 部署，调度；利用
definition: 1. to use something or someone, especially in an effective way；2. to move soldiers or equipment to a place where they can be used when they are needed
example: Speech is the way in which we appropriate, deploy and make use of language, and Saussure calls that "parole."
exampleZh: 话语是我们使用语言，分配部署语言的结果，索绪尔叫它，个人语言“

meaning: n. 有效运用；部署，调动
definition: 1. the use of something or someone in an effective way；2. the movement of soldiers or equipment to a place where they can be used when they are needed
example: The next phase of the operation will involve the deployment of more than 35,000 troops from a dozen countries.
exampleZh: 下阶段的行动包括部署来自12个国家的三万五千多名士兵。

meaning: v. 驱逐（非本国居民）出境；【名】 （Deport）（捷）德波特，（法）德波尔（人名）
definition: 1. to force someone to leave a country, especially someone who has no legal right to be there or who has broken the law；2. to force a person to leave a country
example: We deport aliens who slip across our borders.
exampleZh: 我们把偷渡入境的外国人驱逐出境。

meaning: n. 驱逐出境
definition: 1. the action of forcing someone to leave a country, especially someone who has no legal right to be there or who has broken the law
example: Immigration officers tried to serve her with a deportation order.
exampleZh: 移民局官员试图向她交送驱逐出境令。

meaning: v. 放下，放置；储蓄；存放，寄存；沉积，沉淀；支付（押金、订金或预缴费用）；n. 沉积物，沉积层；订金；押金；存款；竞选保证金
definition: 1. n. the phenomenon of sediment or gravel accumulating；2. v. fix, force, or implant
example: In an aqueous solution, he passes electric current and causes silver ions to deposit and form metallic silver.
exampleZh: 在水溶液中，他接通电流，这得银离子,沉淀，并形成金属银。

meaning: n. 仓库，库房；公共汽车站，火车站，航空站；车库，修车厂；【名】 （Depot）（刚（布））德波特（人名）
definition: 1. a building where supplies or vehicles, especially buses, are kept；2. a bus station or train station
example: The scene inside the Home Depot on Weyman Avenue here would give the old-time American craftsman pause.
exampleZh: 威曼大道家得宝内的场景会让这位美国老派工匠驻足。

meaning: v. （使）贬值，（使）降价；贬低，轻视
definition: 1. to (cause something to) lose value, especially over time；2. to cause something to lose value, esp. over time
example: New cars start to depreciate as soon as they are on the road.
exampleZh: 新车一上路就开始贬值。

meaning: n. 贬值，跌价；贬低，轻视
definition: 1. the process of losing value；2. the amount by which something, such as a piece of equipment, is reduced in value in a company's financial accounts, over the period of time it has been in use. The loss in value reduces a company's profits, and the amount of tax it must pay
example: Foreign currency depreciation is a result of economic depression in the country concerned.
exampleZh: 外汇贬值是有关国家经济不景气的结果。

meaning: v. 使抑郁，使沮丧；降低，抑制；使萧条，使不景气；按下，压下
definition: 1. v. lower someone's spirits; make downhearted；2. v. lower (prices or markets)
example: The risk that those foreclosures will depress prices further may keep some potential buyers on the sidelines.
exampleZh: 这些止赎品将进一步压低价格的风险可能会让一些潜在买家持观望态度。

meaning: n. 抑郁，沮丧；萧条（期），不景气；低气压；凹陷，浅坑；俯角，俯视角
definition: 1. n. a mental state characterized by a pessimistic sense of inadequacy and a despondent lack of activity；2. n. a long-term economic state characterized by unemployment and low prices and low levels of trade and investment
example: This is a poem written in the depth of the Depression and also at the height of Frost's fame.
exampleZh: 这是一首写在经济危机时候的诗,也是在弗罗斯特最有名的时候。

meaning: v. 剥夺，使丧失；免去……的职务（尤指圣职）
definition: 1. v. take away possessions from someone；2. v. keep from having, keeping, or obtaining
example: To deprive the boy of his education is a violation of state law.
exampleZh: 剥夺这个男孩的受教育权是一种违反州法律的行为。

meaning: n. 贫困，匮乏，剥夺；免职（尤指圣职）
definition: 1. n. a state of extreme poverty；2. n. the disadvantage that results from losing something
example: The guilt-prone ones shared more, even though they hadn't magically become more sympathetic to the other child's deprivation.
exampleZh: 容易内疚的人分享得更多，尽管他们并没有凭空变得更同情另一个孩子的缺失遭遇。

meaning: n. 代理人，副手，副职；代表，议员；（美国协助地方治安官办案的）警官；adj. 副的；代理的
definition: 1. n. someone authorized to exercise the powers of sheriff in emergencies；2. n. an assistant with power to act when his superior is absent
example: I was the Deputy Chief of Staff at that time, but because the president was travelling in Anticard.
exampleZh: 当时我是办公厅副主任,但是当时总统,在外访问。

meaning: v. （使）脱轨，出轨；阻挠，破坏；n. 脱轨器
definition: 1. If a train derails or is derailed, it comes off the railway tracks.；2. to prevent a plan or process from succeeding
example: Policymakers should not allow low energy prices to derail the clean energy transition.
exampleZh: 政策制定者不应让低能源价格破坏清洁能源的转型。

meaning: n. 出轨，脱轨
definition: 1. the fact of a train coming off the railway tracks
example: The derailment, according to Transport of London, was reportedly caused by an obstruction on the tracks.
exampleZh: 据英国交通警方说地铁的脱轨是轨道上的障碍物导致的。

meaning: v. 撤销对……的管制，解除控制
definition: 1. to remove national or local government controls or rules from a business or other activity；2. to remove government controls or rules from a business or other activity
example: This started changing, however, in the mid-1970s, when America began to deregulate its transportation industry.
exampleZh: 然而，这种情况在20世纪70年代中期，美国开始放松对运输业的管制时开始改变。

meaning: n. 撤销管制，解除控制
definition: 1. the action of removing national or local government controls or rules from a business or other activity；2. the process of removing government controls or rules from a business or other activity
example: Asian airlines remain untouched by the deregulation that has swept the U.S.
exampleZh: 亚洲的航空公司没有受到已席卷美国的撤销管制的影响。

meaning: v. 获得，取得；起源于，来自；提取，衍生（化学物质）；【名】 （Derive）（法）德里夫（人名）
definition: 1. v. reason by deduction; establish by deduction；2. v. obtain
example: Mr. Ying is one of those happy people who derive pleasure from helping others.
exampleZh: 英先生是那种助人为乐的快活人。

meaning: n. 派生物，衍生物；派生词；（金融）衍生工具（产品）；导数，微商；adj. 非独创的，模仿他人的；（金融产品）衍生的
definition: 1. n. the result of mathematical differentiation; the instantaneous change of one quantity relative to another; df(x)/dx；2. adj. resulting from or employing derivation
example: We have the current argument over how much of the derivative market will be exempt from regulation.
exampleZh: 当前，我们就衍生品市场有多大比例可免于监管存在争议。

meaning: n. 起源，由来；派生，词源；求导，导数
definition: 1. n. the source or origin from which something derives (i.e. comes or issues)；2. n. (historical linguistics) an explanation of the historical origins of a word or phrase
example: About the derivation of the tree of a mandarin duck, a story comes down at the local place.
exampleZh: 关于鸳鸯树的由来，在当地流传着这样一个故事。

meaning: v. 下来，下降；下倾，下斜；降临，来临；（情绪、气氛等）笼罩；突然到来，突然造访；降低身份，堕落；衰落，陷入；遗传
definition: 1. v. move downward and lower, but not necessarily all the way；2. v. come from; be connected by a relationship of blood, for example
example: It expels gas to descend, and expels water from trim bladders to rise.
exampleZh: 它通过排出气体来下降，并通过把水排出气囊来上升。

meaning: n. 下降，降落；斜坡，斜面；出身，血统；堕落，沦落；突然到访，突袭
definition: 1. n. a movement downward；2. n. properties attributable to your ancestry
example: The authors show how this was triggered by his belief in the common descent of all humans.
exampleZh: 作者们表明了这是由他对所有人类都拥有共同血统的信念引发的。

meaning: n. 后裔，子孙；派生物，衍生物；adj. 下降的；祖传的
definition: 1. n. a person considered as descended from some ancestor or race；2. adj. going or coming down
example: He was an O'Conor and a direct descendant of the last High King of Ireland.
exampleZh: 他属于奥康纳家族，是爱尔兰最后一位君王的嫡系后裔。

meaning: v. 描述，形容；做……运动，形成……形状
definition: 1. v. give a description of；2. v. to give an account or representation of in words
example: So, these on-changing properties that describe the state of the equilibrium state of the system are called state variables.
exampleZh: 这些描述,系统平衡态的,变化的属性,就叫做状态变量。

meaning: n. 描述，形容，说明；类型
definition: 1. n. a statement that represents something in words；2. n. the act of describing something
example: So you're going to be able to take a description of a problem and map it into something computational.
exampleZh: 因此你们能拣出,一个问题的主要描述,并将其编成计算性的东西。

meaning: adj. 描写的，说明的，叙述的；描述性的（学科）
definition: 1. adj. serving to describe or inform or characterized by description；2. adj. concerned with phenomena (especially language) at a particular period without considering historical antecedents
example: Descriptive writing in the humanities, particularly in literature, is often mixed with critical writing.
exampleZh: 人文学科的描述性写作，尤其是文学中的描述性写作，经常与批判性写作混合在一起。

meaning: n. 沙漠，荒漠；荒凉的地方；应得的赏罚；v. 离弃，舍弃（某地）；抛弃，遗弃（某人）；背弃，放弃；擅离，开小差；突然丧失；adj. 无人居住的，荒凉的；像沙漠的
definition: 1. n. arid land with little or no vegetation；2. v. leave someone who needs or counts on you; leave in the lurch
example: That's why hermeneutics gradually moved I should say, it didn't desert religion, but it expanded--to the study of the law.
exampleZh: 因此诠释学从宗教领域转移到了,应该说，它没有离开宗教，而是延伸到了法学领域。

meaning: n. 逃跑，擅离职守，开小差；遗弃
definition: 1. n. withdrawing support or help despite allegiance or responsibility；2. n. the act of giving something up
example: He is as bitter as gall at your desertion and its consequences. Don't expect thanks for this noble devotion.
exampleZh: 他对你的背弃以及由此带来的后果恨之入骨，别指望你这份高尚的付出能换来感谢。

meaning: v. 值得，应受
definition: 1. v. be worthy or deserving
example: And the poor don't deserve, don't deserve the benefits that would flow from taxing Michael Jordan to help them.
exampleZh: 你是说穷人不应得到这些福利,不值得通过向乔丹征税来救济他们。

meaning: n. 设计，布局，安排；设计艺术，构思；设计图，图纸；图案，花纹；计划，意图；v. 设计，制图，构思；筹划，制订；预定，指定；【名】 （Design）（俄、巴、印）迪赛（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of working out the form of something (as by making a sketch or outline or plan)；2. v. make or work out a plan for; devise
example: And then I, I self-publish, so I had to do the design and layout of the book myself as well.
exampleZh: 因为这书是我自己出版的，所以书的设计、排版之类的事情都是我自己亲自做的。

meaning: n. 设计师，设计者；谋划者；adj. 由著名设计师设计的，标有设计师姓名的；时尚的，时髦的
definition: 1. n. a person who specializes in designing architectural interiors and their furnishings；2. n. someone who creates plans to be used in making something (such as buildings)
example: But the first time I got here, I wasn't a graphic designer, just like first day.
exampleZh: 但第一次来这里的时候，就像一开始一样，我并不是一个图像设计师。

meaning: v. 把……定名为，把……描述为；任命，指定；标明，标示；adj. 已当选而尚未上任的
definition: 1. to choose someone officially to do a particular job；2. to say officially that a place or thing has a particular quality or purpose
example: There are efforts under way to designate the bridge a historic landmark.
exampleZh: 在努力把这座桥定为历史地标。

meaning: n. 指定，委任；名称，称号
definition: 1. an official title or name；2. the act of designating a place or thing
example: The district is under consideration for designation as a conservation area.
exampleZh: 正在考虑将这个地区指定为保护区。

meaning: n. 愿望，欲望，渴望；情欲，性欲；v. 渴望，想望；要求，请求；被……吸引，对……产生性欲；【名】 （Desire）（英、刚）德西雷（人名）
definition: 1. n. the feeling that accompanies an unsatisfied state；2. v. feel or have a desire for; want strongly
example: All right. Now quickly, as to the plot: desire emerges or begins as the narratable. What is the unnarratable?
exampleZh: 好的我们赶快再来看情节：,欲望开始的时候是叙述性的，那么什么是不可叙述的呢？

meaning: adj. 令人向往的，值得拥有的；可取的；性感的；n. 称心合意的人（或物），好的品质
definition: 1. adj. worth having or seeking or achieving；2. adj. worthy of being chosen especially as a spouse
example: And also if you have a surplus, and that's a desirable thing to do, you can sell it.
exampleZh: 同时如果你还有剩余,这是很理想的情况,你可以卖掉它们

meaning: n. 欲求，希求；性感
definition: 1. n. the quality of being worthy of desiring；2. n. attractiveness to the opposite sex
example: This focus on beauty and desirability "effectively destroys any awareness and action that might help to change that climate."
exampleZh: 这种对美感与吸引力的关注“实际上消解了所有可能有助于改变这种风气的认知与行动”。

meaning: adj. 想要的，渴望的
definition: 1. adj. having or expressing desire for something
example: At that point Franco was desirous of prolonging the war.
exampleZh: 那时，佛朗哥希望战争能延续下去。

meaning: n. 书桌，办公桌，写字台；服务台，问询台；（办理某项业务的）部门；乐谱架，演奏者席；（报社）编辑部；adj. 书桌的，桌上适合用的
definition: 1. n. a piece of furniture with a writing surface and usually drawers or other compartments
example: He says: I have met them at close of day Coming with vivid faces From counter or desk among grey Eighteenth-century houses.
exampleZh: 他说：,我曾在黄昏时遇见他们,他们离开柜台或写字台,脸上带着生动的表情,从18世纪灰黑的房屋里走出。

meaning: n. （计算机）屏幕上显示图标、窗口等的主工作区（桌面）；台式电脑，台式机；桌子的顶面；adj. 台式的，桌上型的（仅用于名词前）
definition: 1. n. the top of a desk；2. n. (computer science) the area of the screen in graphical user interfaces against which icons and windows appear
example: Users can download their material to a desktop PC back in the office.
exampleZh: 用户们可以将他们的资料下载到办公室的台式计算机上。

meaning: adj. 荒无人烟的，荒凉的；凄凉的，孤独忧伤的；v. 使悲痛欲绝，使孤独凄凉；使荒凉，使成废墟
definition: 1. A desolate place is empty and not attractive, with no people or nothing pleasant in it；2. extremely sad and feeling alone
example: Looking inside the breakwater of the port is very desolate.
exampleZh: 从港口防波堤向内望去，景象十分荒凉。

meaning: n. 绝望；令人绝望的人或事；v. 绝望，丧失信心
definition: 1. n. a state in which everything seems wrong and will turn out badly；2. v. abandon hope; give up hope; lose heart
example: If the surprises are too great, then they induce overstrain and we throw away the book in frustration and despair.
exampleZh: 如果令人惊讶之处过多，则会导致读者过劳,最后因失望或绝望而抛开它。

meaning: adj. 不顾一切的，拼命的；极需要的，渴望的；极严重的，极危险的；绝望的，无望的；绝望的，无望的
definition: 1. n. a person who is frightened and in need of help；2. adj. arising from or marked by despair or loss of hope
example: A desperate honesty that throbs through his confession does not absolve him from sins of diabolical cunning. He is abnormal.
exampleZh: 他的忏悔被绝望的虔诚悸动着,但这也不能为他那恶魔的狡诈赎罪，他是变态。

meaning: v. 派遣，发送；迅速处理；杀死，处死；匆匆吃下，匆匆离开（等于 dispatch）；n. 派遣，发送；急件；报道；迅速，高效；杀死（等于 dispatch）；派送部，发货部
definition: 1. n. an official report (usually sent in haste)；2. v. send away towards a designated goal
example: I will despatch the business right willingly, fair sir.
exampleZh: 我很乐意去办这件事，好先生。

meaning: v. 鄙视，厌恶，看不起
definition: 1. to feel a strong dislike for someone or something because you think that that person or thing is bad or has no value；2. to feel a strong dislike for someone or something that you think is bad or worthless
example: In the second verse paragraph, Milton tells his father: "do not despise divine poetry, creation of the prophetic bard.
exampleZh: 在诗的第二段，弥尔顿对他父亲说：,不要轻视神圣的诗歌，诗人预示性的创作。

meaning: prep. 尽管，即使；不由自主地，忍不住地；n. 亵渎；轻蔑，鄙视；v. 蔑视；激怒
definition: 1. n. lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike；2. n. contemptuous disregard
example: But despite the fact that it's modest, if everyone in the US would give according to that scale, it would yield 500 billion dollars.
exampleZh: 尽管每个人的捐款不多，如果在美国，每个人都根据这个标准表捐款，那将会是5000亿美元。

meaning: n. （正餐后的）甜点；【名】 （Dessert）（法）德塞尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a dish served as the last course of a meal
example: There's a list, but I didn't, I just said I'll bring dessert. It's easy.
exampleZh: 有一个食品清单，但我没看，我只是说了，我会带甜点。比较简单。

meaning: n. 目的地，终点，目标；adj. 作为目的地的
definition: 1. n. the place designated as the end (as of a race or journey)；2. n. the ultimate goal for which something is done
example: He gets you to your destination without turning the trip into a white-knuckle experience.
exampleZh: 他会将你安然无恙地送达你的目的地。

meaning: n. 命运，定数；天意，命运之神；【名】 （Destiny）（英）德斯蒂尼，德斯蒂妮（人名）
definition: 1. the things that will happen in the future；2. the force that some people think controls what happens in the future, and is outside human control
example: To ride, to hunt, to smoke like a Turk in the sunshine, there's the destiny of the white man.
exampleZh: 骑马,打猎,在日光下豪迈地吸烟,他们认为这些才是白人应该干的

meaning: adj. 指定的，预定的；前往的，被送往的；（命中）注定的，肯定的
definition: 1. intended (for a particular purpose)；2. travelling or being sent to somewhere
example: Their cooking is elevated to an art form and some of their dishes are destined to become classics.
exampleZh: 他们的烹饪已升华为一种艺术，其中一些菜肴注定会成为经典。

meaning: v. 破坏，毁灭；杀死，人道毁灭（受伤、生病或危险的动物）；彻底打败，击溃；毁掉……的生活，使垮掉
definition: 1. v. do away with, cause the destruction or undoing of；2. v. destroy completely; damage irreparably
example: The virus can actually destroy those white blood cells, leaving the body wide open to attack from other infections.
exampleZh: 该病毒实际上能破坏那些白血球，使身体极易受到其他感染。

meaning: n. 破坏，摧毁
definition: 1. n. the termination of something by causing so much damage to it that it cannot be repaired or no longer exists；2. n. an event (or the result of an event) that completely destroys something
example: It is vital that we act to stop the destruction of the rainforests.
exampleZh: 至关紧要的是，我们应当采取行动制止破坏雨林。

meaning: adj. 破坏性的，毁灭性的
definition: 1. adj. causing destruction or much damage
example: The war was a paradigm of the destructive side of human nature.
exampleZh: 那场战争尽显人性中具有破坏性的一面。

meaning: v. 拆下，使分离；脱离，摆脱；派遣，分派
definition: 1. to separate or remove something from something else that it is connected to
example: We must detach ourselves from the previous task and expend significant mental energy to move on.
exampleZh: 我们必须从先前的任务中脱离出来，并花费大量的精力继续前进。

meaning: adj. 超然的，不带感情的，客观的；单独的，分离的；v. 拆下，使分离；脱离，摆脱；派遣（detach 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. separated；2. A detached house is not connected to any other building
example: He's a man up in the air you know he's so detached he doesn't have his feet on the ground.
exampleZh: 他是个生活在空中的人,十足超然,从不脚踏实地。

meaning: n. 客观，超然，冷漠；分遣队，独立小分队；拆卸，分离
definition: 1. a group of soldiers who are separated from the main group in order to perform a particular duty；2. a feeling of not being emotionally involved
example: His mask of detachment cracked, and she saw for an instant an angry and violent man.
exampleZh: 他冷静超然的伪装破碎了，她一瞬间看到了一个愤怒而又狂暴的男人。

meaning: n. 细节，细微之处；详情，资料；（军队中的）任务，特遣队；v. 详细说明，详述；彻底清洗（汽车）；（尤指军队中）派遣，选派
definition: 1. n. an isolated fact that is considered separately from the whole；2. v. provide details for
example: He's narrating in great detail what happened while he was in the womb. Where does this knowledge come from?
exampleZh: 他花了很大笔墨很详细地描写了,他还在子宫里发生的事，但他是怎么知道的呢？

meaning: adj. 详尽的，详细的；（装饰）精细的，细致的；v. 详细说明，详述；彻底清洗（汽车）；（尤指军队中）派遣，选派（detail 的过去式和过去分词）
definition: 1. adj. developed or executed with care and in minute detail
example: This textbook is very detailed and it may be-- I've had some reaction by students-- more than you wanted to know.
exampleZh: 这本教材编写得非常详细,也许会,我听到过许多学生的反馈,涵盖面实在是太广了

meaning: v. 拘留，扣押；耽搁，阻留
definition: 1. to force someone officially to stay in a place；2. to delay someone for a short length of time
example: Millson stood up. "Thank you. We won't detain you any further, Mrs. Stebbing."
exampleZh: 米尔森站起来。“谢谢您。我们不再耽搁您了，斯特宾太太。”

meaning: n. 拘留，关押；（作为惩罚的）课后留校
definition: 1. the act of officially detaining someone；2. a form of punishment in which children are made to stay at school for a short time after classes have ended
example: He has clearly not been chastened by his thirteen days in detention.
exampleZh: 他显然没有因十三天的拘留而悔过。

meaning: v. 查明，察觉；测出，检测，识别
definition: 1. v. discover or determine the existence, presence, or fact of
example: Arnold could detect a certain sadness in the old man's face.
exampleZh: 阿诺德能察觉到老人脸上的某种悲伤。

meaning: n. 察觉，发现；侦破（案件）
definition: 1. n. the perception that something has occurred or some state exists；2. n. the act of detecting something; catching sight of something
example: The plane is used for electronic jamming and radar detection.
exampleZh: 这架飞机用于进行电子干扰和雷达探测。

meaning: n. 侦探，警探；私家侦探；adj. 有关调查工作的；刑侦的
definition: 1. n. a police officer who investigates crimes；2. n. an investigator engaged or employed in obtaining information not easily available to the public
example: Who, for instance, would want a detective story without a single dialogue in it?
exampleZh: 比如，谁会喜欢一部没有对话的,侦探小说呢？

meaning: v. 使打消念头，防止；【名】 （Deter）（德）德特尔（人名）
definition: 1. to prevent someone from doing something or to make someone less enthusiastic about doing something by making it difficult for that person to do it or by threatening bad results if they do it；2. to prevent or discourage someone from doing something
example: No amount of foul weather, whether hail, wind, rain or snow, seems to deter them.
exampleZh: 不管天气有多恶劣，哪怕是冰雹、大风、雨还是雪，似乎都阻止不了他们。

meaning: n. 威慑，遏制；威慑武器；adj. 威慑的，遏制的
definition: 1. something that deters people from doing something；2. making someone less likely to do something by making it difficult for them to do it or by making them realize that it will have bad results
example: There is a fear that the freeze on bank accounts could prove a lasting deterrent to investors.
exampleZh: 冻结银行帐户很可能对投资者是一个长期的威慑因素。

meaning: n. 洗涤剂，去污剂；adj. 使清洁的，（与）清洁添加剂（有关）的
definition: 1. a chemical substance in the form of a powder or a liquid for removing dirt from clothes, dishes, etc.
example: The detergent comes in powder or liquid form.
exampleZh: 这种洗涤剂有粉状或液态两种。

meaning: v. 恶化，变坏
definition: 1. v. become worse or disintegrate；2. v. grow worse
example: There are fears that the situation might deteriorate into full-scale war.
exampleZh: 人们担心局势会恶化为全面战争。

meaning: n. 恶化
definition: 1. n. a symptom of reduced quality or strength；2. n. process of changing to an inferior state
example: These poor fundamentals have caused a sharp deterioration in the credit quality of CRE loans on banks' books.
exampleZh: 这些薄弱的基本面导致了银行账面上 CRE 贷款的信用质量急剧恶化。

meaning: v. 决定，控制；查明，确定；下定决心；判决，裁定；求出，解出；限定；终止
definition: 1. v. establish after a calculation, investigation, experiment, survey, or study；2. v. shape or influence; give direction to
example: My critical powers are just sufficient to determine this, and I am gratified to be able to say it.
exampleZh: 我的评论能力可以确认这一点，而且我很高兴我能这么说。

meaning: n. 决心，坚定；决定，裁定；测定，确定；（财产权、利息的）终止
definition: 1. n. the act of determining the properties of something；2. n. the quality of being determined to do or achieve something
example: AmbassadorFinn is now with the Liechtenstein Institute Self-Determination in the Woodrow Wilson School of Public and International Affairs, Princeton University.
exampleZh: 芬恩大使现在就职于普林斯顿大学的列支敦斯登民族自决研究院,威尔逊公共和国际事务学院。

meaning: adj. 下定决心的，坚决的；v. 决定，控制；查明，确定；下定决心（determine 的过去式和过去分词）
definition: 1. adj. characterized by great determination；2. adj. having been learned or found or determined especially by investigation
example: The Little Magazine was written by, addressed to, new young writers and artists, and they were determined to make trouble.
exampleZh: 而小杂志则是由年轻的作者和艺术家所编写，也是为了向这些群体致敬，它的存在就是为了惹火上身。

meaning: n. 损害，伤害；造成损害（或损伤）的事物
definition: 1. harm or damage
example: And in fact, in a TV series emotions are often seen as a detriment.
exampleZh: 事实上，在电视剧中,拥有情感通常是弊端。

meaning: adj. 有害的，不利的；n. 有害的人（或物）
definition: 1. causing harm or damage
example: Many foods are suspected of being detrimental to health because of the chemicals and additives they contain.
exampleZh: 许多食物因所含的化学成分和添加剂被怀疑有害健康。

meaning: v. 毁坏，破坏；使极度震惊，使伤心欲绝
definition: 1. to destroy a place or thing completely or cause great damage；2. to make someone feel very shocked and upset
example: When cyclones devastate a city, when homes collapse in a sudden earthquake, the most urgent need is medical attention.
exampleZh: 当气旋毁灭一座城市时，当房屋在突如其来的地震中倒塌时，人们最迫切需要的是医疗看护。

meaning: adj. 毁灭性的，极具破坏力的；令人极为震惊的；令人印象深刻的，吸引人的；极有效的，强有力的；v. 毁灭，破坏；使极度震惊，使伤心欲绝（devastate 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. causing a lot of damage or destruction；2. making someone very shocked and upset
example: It will be a devastating blow to the local community if the factory closes.
exampleZh: 如果这家工厂倒闭，将给当地居民以毁灭性的打击。

meaning: n. 毁坏，破坏；荒废
definition: 1. damage and destruction；2. feeling very shocked or upset
example: Residents returned to Galveston, on the Texas coast, and saw for themselves the devastation wreaked by Hurricane Ike.
exampleZh: 居民回到位于得克萨斯州海岸的加尔维斯顿，亲眼目睹了飓风艾克造成的破坏。

meaning: v. （使）成长，发育，发展；逐渐形成，逐渐养成；开发，研制；出现，产生；修建，开发土地；提高，加强；患病；阐释，展开；冲洗，使底片显影；（修改旋律、和声或节奏以）展开（音乐主题）；（棋）出子
definition: 1. v. make something new, such as a product or a mental or artistic creation；2. v. work out
example: especially as I am trying to develop my own thoughts and my own research questions for my future career.
exampleZh: 尤其是就我未来职业方面，我正在尝试形成自己的观点，提出我的研究问题。

meaning: n. 发育，成长，发达；发展，进步；动态，进展；开发，研制；研制成果；（土地）开发；新建住宅区，新开发区；开始，出现；显影；出子布局
definition: 1. n. act of improving by expanding or enlarging or refining；2. n. a process in which something passes by degrees to a different stage (especially a more advanced or mature stage)
example: And part of this is happening because of the development of all these wireless networks, miniaturization, things moving online.
exampleZh: 部分原因是,无线网络的发展，微型化的发展。

meaning: adj. 发展的，生长的；促使成长的，起改进作用的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to or constituting development
example: Well, one reason is that there are developmental disorders that seem to involve damage to one system but not to another.
exampleZh: 一个原因是,发展障碍看上去,只会对某一个系统产生损害,而不会损害其他系统

meaning: n. 开发商，开发公司；开发者，研制者；显影剂，显色剂；（在特定时间或以特定速度）成长（或发育成熟）的人
definition: 1. n. someone who develops real estate (especially someone who prepares a site for residential or commercial use)；2. n. photographic equipment consisting of a chemical solution for developing film
example: A developer bought the land and divided it into stands.
exampleZh: 开发商买下这块土地将其分为多块建筑用地。

meaning: v. 偏离，脱离；违背；adj. 离经叛道的；n. 异类，偏离规范的人；偏离
definition: 1. to do something that is different from the usual or common way of behaving；2. to go in a different direction
example: If their actions deviate substantially from what we consider acceptable, we may label them evil.
exampleZh: 如果他们的行为大大偏离我们认为可接受的范围，我们可能会给他们贴上邪恶的标签。

meaning: n. 偏离，违背；离差，偏差
definition: 1. the action of being or doing something that is different from the usual or common way of behaving；2. the amount by which a measurement is different from a fixed number or amount
example: That's got the lowest possible standard deviation of expected return and that's 25% stocks and 75% bonds with this sample period.
exampleZh: 这个组合预期回报的标准差最小,在这一点上，投资组合,由25%的股票和75%的债券构成。

meaning: n. 装置，设备；手段，方法；花招，诡计；炸弹，爆炸装置；图画，设计；（某物的）样式，外表
definition: 1. n. an instrumentality invented for a particular purpose；2. n. something in an artistic work designed to achieve a particular effect
example: Well, in Tennyson sound is the device, "the murmurous haunt"--oh, I have no memory at all today.
exampleZh: 在坦尼森的的作品中声音扮演同样的角色，那沙沙的萦绕之声，哦不，我记混了。

meaning: n. 魔鬼；魔王，撒旦（the Devil）；家伙，人；恶棍；淘气鬼，冒失鬼；棘手的事，麻烦事；（出庭律师或其他专业人士的）助手；切碎机；v. 困扰，使担忧；抹辣味料烤（肉等）；（用扯碎机）扯碎（破布）；做律师（或作家等）的助手
definition: 1. n. (Judeo-Christian and Islamic religions) chief spirit of evil and adversary of God; tempter of mankind; master of Hell；2. v. cause annoyance in; disturb, especially by minor irritations
example: In the Book of Revelation it's the number of the beast; it's the number of the devil.
exampleZh: 在《启示录》中,这是野兽的数量;,是魔鬼的数量。

meaning: v. 设计，发明；（通过遗嘱）遗赠（不动产）；图谋；n. （遗嘱中）遗赠不动产的条款；【名】 （Devise）（美、法）德维兹（人名）
definition: 1. n. a will disposing of real property；2. v. come up with (an idea, plan, explanation, theory, or principle) after a mental effort
example: Experts are trying to devise ways to clean up the huge slick.
exampleZh: 专家们在努力想出清除大面积浮油的办法。

meaning: v. 献身，致力；用于
definition: 1. v. give entirely to a specific person, activity, or cause；2. v. dedicate
example: It can't be denied that we need to devote more resources to this problem.
exampleZh: 无可否认，我们必须投入更多的资源来解决这个问题。

meaning: n. 挚爱，忠诚；奉献；（宗教的）虔诚；祈祷，礼拜
definition: 1. n. feelings of ardent love；2. n. commitment to some purpose
example: Her devotion to the job left her with very little free time.
exampleZh: 她全身心投入工作，几乎没有闲暇。

meaning: v. 狼吞虎咽地吃；如饥似渴地阅读，热切地看；吞噬，毁灭；充满（感情）
definition: 1. to eat something eagerly and in large amounts so that nothing is left；2. to destroy something completely
example: A medium-sized dog will devour at least one can of food plus biscuits per day.
exampleZh: 一只中等大小的狗每天至少要干掉一罐食物外加饼干。

meaning: n. 露水；（似露珠的）小水珠；v. 用水珠弄湿；【名】 （Dew）（英）迪尤，（德）德夫（人名）
definition: 1. n. water that has condensed on a cool surface overnight from water vapor in the air
example: And Dew wrote a forceful defense of slavery in the wake of this, which became kind of a seminal text for all future pro-slavery writers.
exampleZh: 此后后德夫为维护奴隶制写了一份有力的辩护,这份辩护被所有后来的亲奴主义作家,尊为一部文献

meaning: n. 糖尿病，多尿症
definition: 1. n. any of several metabolic disorders marked by excessive urination and persistent thirst
example: A child eight or nine years old with what used to be called Adult Onset Diabetes.
exampleZh: 岁或者9岁的小孩,竟然得了曾称为成年始发性糖尿病的疾病

meaning: v. 诊断（病症）；找出原因
definition: 1. v. determine or distinguish the nature of a problem or an illness through a diagnostic analysis；2. v. subject to a medical analysis
example: The test is used to diagnose a variety of diseases.
exampleZh: 此项化验可用于诊断多种疾病。

meaning: n. 诊断，判断
definition: 1. n. identifying the nature or cause of some phenomenon
example: We didn't have the same methods of diagnosis that we do now, so maybe it was just not diagnosed then.
exampleZh: 那时医生的诊断手段远不及现在,因此,这些病可能只是诊断不出来

meaning: n. 图表，图解；几何图形；v. 以图表示
definition: 1. n. a drawing intended to explain how something works; a drawing showing the relation between the parts；2. v. make a schematic or technical drawing of that shows how things work or how they are constructed
example: A diagram of the new road layout was superimposed on a map of the city.
exampleZh: 新公路的规划示意图被叠映在该城市的地图上。

meaning: v. 拨号；n. 钟面，仪表盘；调节器；（老式电话机的）拨号盘；（人的）脸；【名】 （Dial）（英）戴尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. the face of a timepiece; graduated to show the hours；2. v. operate a dial to select a telephone number
example: I can't get a dial tone on this phone.
exampleZh: 我在这部电话上听不到拨号音。

meaning: n. 方言，土话
definition: 1. n. the usage or vocabulary that is characteristic of a specific group of people
example: It is impossible to say at what point along the continuum a dialect becomes a separate language.
exampleZh: 要说出同一语言的方言差异到什么程度就成为一种别的语言是不可能的。

meaning: n. 对话，会话；对白，台词；（计算机）对话框
definition: 1. n. a conversation between two persons；2. n. the lines spoken by characters in drama or fiction
example: You talked about dialog. Is there anything else about the style that you noticed? Yes.
exampleZh: 你刚提到了对话，你还注意到了,其他关于风格的东西吗，是的。

meaning: n. 直径；放大倍数
definition: 1. n. the length of a straight line passing through the center of a circle and connecting two points on the circumference；2. n. a straight line connecting the center of a circle with two points on its perimeter (or the center of a sphere with two points on its surface)
example: They might be 100 nanometers or so in diameter, whereas, a cell is ten microns or so in diameter.
exampleZh: 直径只有一百纳米左右,而一个细胞的直径是十微米左右

meaning: n. 钻石；菱形；（纸牌的）方块；（棒球场的）内场；菱形铁路道口；【名】 （Diamond）（英、意、葡）戴蒙德，（法）迪亚蒙（人名）
definition: 1. n. a transparent piece of diamond that has been cut and polished and is valued as a precious gem；2. n. very hard native crystalline carbon valued as a gem
example: The cut of a diamond depends on the skill of its craftsman.
exampleZh: 切割钻石的好坏取决于工匠的技艺。

meaning: n. 日记；日程簿；专栏
definition: 1. n. a daily written record of (usually personal) experiences and observations；2. n. a personal journal (as a physical object)
example: As a consequence, the diary measures have their own sets of flaws that we'll talk about in a minute.
exampleZh: 这样的结果是,日记方式有自己的缺陷,我们马上就会谈到

meaning: v. 命令，规定；影响，支配；口述，使听写；n. 命令，规定
definition: 1. n. an authoritative rule；2. v. issue commands or orders for
example: What right do they have to dictate how we live our lives?
exampleZh: 他们有什么权利强行规定我们该怎样生活？

meaning: n. 口述，听写；命令，发号施令
definition: 1. n. an authoritative direction or instruction to do something；2. n. speech intended for reproduction in writing
example: She is transcribing, from his dictation, the diaries of Simon Forman.
exampleZh: 她正在根据他的口述记录西蒙·福曼的日记。

meaning: n. 独裁者；专横的人
definition: 1. a ruler who holds absolute power, often in a cruel or oppressive way
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: Following the fall of the military dictator in March, the country has had a civilian government.
exampleZh: 军事独裁者3月垮台之后，该国已有了一个平民政府。

meaning: n. 字典，词典；专业词典，术语大全；电子词典；双语词典
definition: 1. n. a reference book containing an alphabetical list of words with information about them
example: So it doesn't matter how big the dictionary is, you can instantaneously retrieve the value associated with the key. Extremely powerful.
exampleZh: 因为你可以在线性时间，内得到想要的键对应的值,这太强大了。

meaning: v. 死亡；消失，灭亡；停止运转；渴望；达到性高潮；n. 骰子；金属模具，压模；【名】 （Die）（法、美、德）迭（人名）
definition: 1. n. small cubes with 1 to 6 spots on the faces; used to generate random numbers；2. v. pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life
example: III Yonder a maid and her wight Come whispering by: War's annals will fade into night Ere their story die.
exampleZh: 那边一个女仆和她的同伴,走进来低语：,在故事结束前战争会没入夜色中。

meaning: adj. 临终的，垂死的；消亡的，没落的；最后的，快要结束的；垂死之人（the dying）；v. 死亡；消失；变低，变弱（die 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. the time when something ends；2. adj. in or associated with the process of passing from life or ceasing to be
example: They hung dead, well, not actually, actors pretending to be people that were dying from the trees.
exampleZh: 他们把死尸吊起来，当然不是真的，而是演员假装成吊死在树上的死人。

meaning: n. 柴油；内燃机，柴油车；【名】 (Diesel）（德）狄塞耳（人名）
definition: 1. a type of heavy oil used as fuel；2. any vehicle, especially a train, that has a diesel engine
example: And so people definitely go down there to pick up some items that they can't get at Tom Ford or Diesel.
exampleZh: 所以人们一定是去那儿采购一些在汤姆•福特和狄塞尔买不到的东西。

meaning: n. 规定饮食；大量单调的活动；日常饮食；v. 节食；adj. 低脂的，低糖的；【名】 （Diet）（法）迪耶（人名）
definition: 1. n. a prescribed selection of foods；2. v. follow a regimen or a diet, as for health reasons
example: High adherence scores, good adherence to the Mediterranean Diet across all these studies, was associated with these particular health outcomes.
exampleZh: 高遵循度值,即在研究中高度遵循地中海式饮食的人,被证实与以下这些健康性结果有相关性

meaning: adj. 饮食的；n. 规定（或限制）的饮食
definition: 1. n. a regulated daily food allowance；2. adj. of or relating to the diet
example: Dr. Susan Hankinson has studied the dietary habits of more than 50,000 women.
exampleZh: 苏珊·汉金森博士研究了五万多名妇女的饮食习惯。
