example: Milton pushes this image even further into indistinctness with an instance of his famous deployment of the conjunction or.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿甚至把这幅图像发展为朦胧的意象,添加了一丝他引以著称的对关联的展开。

meaning: adv. 平均地，均等地；平稳地，有规律地；镇定地，平和地；获胜机会相当地，势均力敌地
definition: 1. adv. in equal amounts or shares; in a balanced or impartial way；2. adv. in a level and regular way
example: So it turns out that the very first one, voters are not evenly distributed is certainly true, it's undoubtedly true.
exampleZh: 首相想到的就是,现实中选民是不均匀分布的,这的确是毋庸置疑的

meaning: n. 晚上，傍晚；晚会，晚间活动；暮年，晚年；int. 晚上好（good evening 的简称）；adj. 在晚上的，为晚上的
definition: 1. n. the latter part of the day (the period of decreasing daylight from late afternoon until nightfall)；2. n. a later concluding time period
example: But try to imagine a world in which the Evening Star exists, but the Morning Star does not.
exampleZh: 但是尝试想象在一个世界里昏星存在,而晨星不存在

meaning: n. 事件，大事；社交场合，既定活动；赛事，比赛项目；结果
definition: 1. n. something that happens at a given place and time；2. n. a special set of circumstances
example: But let me use the term "event" anyway, employing it with caution and as if in quotation marks.
exampleZh: 但是无论如何我还是使用，“事件“，这个词，小心谨慎地使用它，带引号地使用。

meaning: adj. 充满大事的，多变故的；重大的，重要的
definition: 1. adj. full of events or incidents；2. adj. having important issues or results
example: This has been an eventful year for Tom, both professionally and personally.
exampleZh: 不论在事业方面还是在个人方面，对汤姆来说这一年都是有着许多重大变化的一年。

meaning: adv. 最终，结果
definition: 1. adv. within an indefinite time or at an unspecified future time；2. adv. after a long period of time or an especially long delay
example: And the Aristotelian view held for a long time, but eventually it started to crumble in the light of more data.
exampleZh: 而亚里士多德的观点在很长时间里得到了认同，但最终还是崩溃了,在越来越多的数据面前。

meaning: adj. 最终的，结局的；有条件的
definition: 1. adj. expected to follow in the indefinite future from causes already operating
example: Do you take an opening position in a negotiation which differs from the eventual goal you are heading for?
exampleZh: 你会在谈判中采取与自身最终目标不同的开局立场吗？

meaning: n. 可能出现的情况，不测事件
definition: 1. n. a possible event or occurrence or result
example: Every eventuality is covered, from running out of gas to needing water.
exampleZh: 从耗尽汽油到缺水，所有可能的后果都考虑到了。

meaning: adv. 曾经，从来，在任何时候；一直，始终；越来越，愈发；究竟，到底；非常，确实；【名】 （Ever）（英）埃弗，（俄）叶韦尔，（西、法）埃韦尔（人名）
definition: 1. adv. at any time；2. adv. at all times; all the time and on every occasion
example: No English poet before Milton ever suggested that he had been chosen by God at birth to be a poet.
exampleZh: 在弥尔顿之前没有英国诗人敢说,自己是被上帝选中去做诗人的。

meaning: det. 每个，每一；每……之中的；每隔，每逢（表频率）；所有可能的，完全可能的；【名】 （Every）（美、荷、瑞典）埃夫里（人名）
definition: 1. adj. each and all of a series of entities or intervals as specified；2. adj. (used of count nouns) each and all of the members of a group considered singly and without exception
example: If you think about it, every single person in this world has some connection to money, they all hate it.
exampleZh: 不妨想一想，世界上的每个个人都和钱,有关系，他们都讨厌它。

meaning: pron. 每个人，人人
definition: 1. abstract: "Everybody" is a dance/house single by Russian DJ Leonid Rudenko. The song features vocals from Kelly Barnes -a singer/songwriter in Los Angeles from the band Ragsy.
example: It was a question of constructing an elaborate formal edifice to which everybody could contribute. Students got excited about it.
exampleZh: 现在的精读已形成了一种精确而正式的体系,每个人都可以做出自己的贡献，学生当然会对此感兴趣。

meaning: adj. 日常的，每天的
definition: 1. adj. found in the ordinary course of events；2. adj. suited for everyday use
example: And everyday when you come home from work your roommate is sitting on the couch eating potato chips.
exampleZh: 每天你下班回家，你的室友总是窝在沙发里吃薯片。

meaning: pron. 每个人，人人，大家
definition: 1. abstract: Everyone is a morality play that was collaboratively written by members of six theatre companies in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada: The Electric Company, Neworld Theatre, November Theatre, Pound of Flesh Theatre, Theatre Melee, and Theatre Replacement. These companies wrote one scene each for the play.
example: but everyone knows, like, which one's, ah... which societies exist and who is in them, just things like that.
exampleZh: 但是每个人都知道这种社团的存在，也知道社团的成员是谁，这些事情都不是秘密。

meaning: pron. 每件事物，（有关的）一切，万事；形势，情况；最重要的东西；n. （Everything）（印、美、澳）艾维辛（人名）
definition: 1. abstract: "Everything" is the second single from the album Elegantly Wasted by INXS. It was released only in Mexico, Europe and Australia.
example: He tells us that everything that we've read up to this point that has been spoken by a third-person narrator.
exampleZh: 他把目前为止我们读到的,所有以第三人称叙述的事情都告诉我们。

meaning: adv. 到处，处处；n. 每个地方，所有地方
definition: 1. adv. to or in any or all places
example: So this unique temperature and unique pressure defines a triple point everywhere, and that's a great reference point.
exampleZh: 这样，无论在何处,三相点都具有相同的温度和压强,十分适合来作参考点。

meaning: adj. 清楚的，显然的
definition: 1. adj. clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment；2. adj. capable of being seen or noticed
example: The threat of inflation is already evident in bond prices.
exampleZh: 通货膨胀的威胁在证券价格上已经是明显可见的。

meaning: n. 根据，证明；（呈上法庭的）证据，证词；迹象，痕迹；v. 证实，证明
definition: 1. n. your basis for belief or disbelief; knowledge on which to base belief；2. v. provide evidence for; stand as proof of; show by one's behavior, attitude, or external attributes
example: And out of that came the recognition that Thompson's plum pudding model is not sustainable in the light of this evidence.
exampleZh: 从中我们得出,汤姆生的枣糕布丁原子模型,是不合理的。

meaning: adj. 恶毒的，邪恶的；有害的，易造成伤害的；讨厌的，令人不舒服的；恶魔的，不祥的；n. 有害（或不受欢迎）的事；邪恶，罪恶；坏事，恶行
definition: 1. n. morally objectionable behavior；2. adj. morally bad or wrong
example: And it requires us to understand history not in moral terms, such as "good" and "evil," but rather in aesthetic terms.
exampleZh: 它需要我们,不是以道德层面去理解历史，去判断好坏“,而是要从审美的角度去看。

meaning: v. 引起，唤起（感情、记忆或形象）；召（魂），唤（神）
definition: 1. to make someone remember something or feel an emotion；2. to cause something to be remembered or expressed
example: Meaning in Frost poems, as in the world that they evoke, has to be interpreted every day.
exampleZh: 他的诗中的意义，就像世界唤起的一样，不得不每天都理解一遍。

meaning: v. 进化，演化；逐步发展，逐渐演变
definition: 1. v. work out；2. v. undergo development or evolution
example: That is the modification of what would and does evolve in and of itself within an understanding of literary historiography.
exampleZh: 这种修正会在文学历史的领域里,进化自己。

meaning: n. 进化（论）；演变，发展；（气体的）释放，（热量的）散发；队形变换，位置变换；开方
definition: 1. n. a process in which something passes by degrees to a different stage (especially a more advanced or mature stage)；2. n. (biology) the sequence of events involved in the evolutionary development of a species or taxonomic group of organisms
example: We're dealing with probably the biggest missing link in what we know about human evolution.
exampleZh: 我们正在解决的可能是我们所知的人类进化过程中缺失最大的一环。

meaning: adj. 进化论的，进化的；演变的，逐步发展的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to or produced by evolution
example: Well, this view, this evolutionary view, or evolutionary model, was challenged by man a named Yehezkel Kaufmann in the 1930's.
exampleZh: 这个改进了的观点，或者说改进了的模型，在20世纪30年代受到了来自考夫曼的质疑。

meaning: adj. 确切的，精确的；严谨的，一丝不苟的；精密的，严密的；v. 强取，勒索；实施（报复）；造成重大苦难（或损失等）
definition: 1. v. claim as due or just；2. adj. marked by strict and particular and complete accordance with fact
example: So what this means is that unlike s orbitals, they don't have the exact same shape at any radius from the nucleus.
exampleZh: 这意味着和ｓ轨道不同，它们在离原子核不同距离处的形状不是完全一样的。

meaning: v. 夸大，言过其实；使扩大
definition: 1. v. to enlarge beyond bounds or the truth；2. v. do something to an excessive degree
example: It's not occured to me that we shouldn't think fondly or even sort of exaggerate our past.
exampleZh: 我也不认为,我们应该喜欢,或者甚至夸张我们的过去。

meaning: n. 夸张，言过其实；（艺术等的）夸张手法
definition: 1. n. extravagant exaggeration；2. n. the act of making something more noticeable than usual
example: It's no exaggeration to say that most students have never read a complete Shakespeare play.
exampleZh: 说大多数同学从未完整读过一部莎士比亚戏剧一点也不夸张。

meaning: v. 检查，调查；考核，测验；（医生）诊察；（尤指在法庭上）审问，查问
definition: 1. v. consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning；2. v. observe, check out, and look over carefully or inspect
example: It is necessary to examine how the proposals can be carried out.
exampleZh: 有必要调查一下怎样才能实施这些方案。

meaning: n. 考试；试卷；医学检查
definition: 1. n. a set of questions or exercises evaluating skill or knowledge
example: It's more of a, exam-based class. So, I actually had my exam yesterday, and I have one more later on.
exampleZh: 这门课主要是以考试为主。事实上，我们昨天刚刚考了一次，不久后还要再考一次。

meaning: n. 考官，主考人；审查人，检查人
definition: 1. n. someone who administers a test to determine your qualifications；2. n. an investigator who observes carefully
example: Check out an article written about him in the San Francisco Examiner by clicking on the link below.
exampleZh: 点击下面的链接，可以在《旧金山观察家报》中查看一篇关于他的文章。

meaning: n. 应试人，参加考试者；受检查（或审查、查询的人）
definition: 1. n. someone who is tested (as by an intelligence test or an academic examination)
example: These questions require the examinee to select two of the answer choices.
exampleZh: 要求考生在其中选出2个答案。

meaning: n. 例子，例证；榜样，楷模；典型，范例；例句，例题；警戒，受罚（以示警告）者；v. 得到说明，可加以举例说明
definition: 1. n. an item of information that is representative of a type；2. n. a representative form or pattern
example: For example, he begins by borrowing the Russian formalist distinction in trying to explain what fiction is between plot and story.
exampleZh: 举个例子，他开篇在解释那种文体介于情节和故事之间时,借用了俄国结构主义的特点。

meaning: adj. 典范的，优异的；惩戒性的，严厉的；（损害赔偿）惩罚性（超额赔偿）的；典范的，值得效仿的
definition: 1. adj. worthy of imitation；2. adj. being or serving as an illustration of a type
example: From the earliest days of the Renaissance, the writing of history meant recounting the exemplary lives of great men.
exampleZh: 从文艺复兴初期开始，历史写作就意味着要重述伟人的模范生活。

meaning: v. 是……的典范；举例说明
definition: 1. v. be characteristic of；2. v. clarify by giving an example of
example: Now another way is through accent, and to exemplify this, let's turn to some classical music, the music of Mozart.
exampleZh: 另一种方法是通过重音，为举例说明，我们来听一些古典音乐，莫扎特的音乐。

meaning: v. 超过，超出；超越（限制）；优于，胜过
definition: 1. v. go beyond；2. v. be or do something to a greater degree
example: So it's very easy for people to exceed dietary recommendations given what the modern food supply is.
exampleZh: 在现代食物供给下,人们很容易就超过了建议饮食标准

meaning: adv. 非常，极其；在很大程度上
definition: 1. adv. to an extreme degree or extent
example: Even in summer this place did not look exactly hospitable: in winter, conditions must have been exceedingly harsh.
exampleZh: 即使在夏天，这个地方看上去也并不太宜人：在冬天，条件一定非常恶劣。

meaning: v. 精通，擅长；超过，胜过
definition: 1. v. distinguish oneself
example: or even to make it through school or to do well or excel at school.
exampleZh: 或者甚至是完成学业或者在学校成绩好。

meaning: adj. 极好的，卓越的；int. 太好了
definition: 1. adj. of the highest quality
example: I'm indebted here to Steven Pinker's excellent book The Language Instinct which provides, I think, a superb discussion of these phenomena.
exampleZh: 非常感谢史蒂芬·平克写了这本精彩的,《语言本能》一书,我认为该书对这些现象进行了极好的讨论

meaning: n. 杰出，卓越；优点，美德
definition: 1. n. the quality of excelling; possessing good qualities in high degree；2. n. an outstanding feature; something in which something or someone excels
example: It became difficult to promote conventional ideas of excellence without being instantly accused of elitism.
exampleZh: 倡议传统优秀价值观，很难不立刻招来精英主义的指责。

meaning: prep. 除……外，不包括；conj. 除了，只是；要不是；v. 不包括，把……排除在外
definition: 1. v. take exception to；2. v. prevent from being included or considered or accepted
example: And now we're almost done, except what we H really want is delta H and not delta U, right.
exampleZh: 我们差不多已经完成了,除了我们实际上想要的是Δ

meaning: n. 例外，除外
definition: 1. n. a deliberate act of omission；2. n. an instance that does not conform to a rule or generalization
example: Nobody had much money at the time and I was no exception.
exampleZh: 那时候谁都没有很多钱，我也不例外。

meaning: adj. 卓越的，杰出的；不寻常的，罕见的；（心理或身体上）有缺陷的；n. （公司账目上的）异常项目
definition: 1. adj. far beyond what is usual in magnitude or degree；2. adj. surpassing what is common or usual or expected
example: This is just one more American saying: "We are unique in the World. We are exceptional."
exampleZh: 只不过是又多了一个美国人说：,我们独一无二，我们和别人不一样“

meaning: n. 摘录，节选；v. 摘录，节选
definition: 1. a short part taken from a speech, book, film, etc.；2. to take a small part from a speech, book, film, etc. in order to publish it separately
example: The first excerpt is from Numbers 14, and it shows Moses' ability to placate the wrath of God.
exampleZh: 第一个是来自《民数记》14的片段，展示了摩西,让盛怒的上帝平静的能力。

meaning: n. 超过，过量；越轨行为，暴行；无节制，无度；（保险中的）免赔额；adj. 过多的，超额的；额外的，附加的
definition: 1. n. a quantity much larger than is needed；2. adj. more than is needed, desired, or required
example: Embarrassment tells us we're in the presence of the excess, and that's why Beat writers court it.
exampleZh: 难堪告诉我们自己是处在过度的状态，所以垮掉一代的作者追求难堪。

meaning: adj. 过度的，过多的
definition: 1. adj. beyond normal limits；2. adj. unrestrained, especially with regard to feelings
example: Now formally I could have had this pointing off to another object containing 4, but that just seemed excessive, right?
exampleZh: 当然我可以正式的把它指向,另外一个含有4的对象，但这有点多余对不对？

meaning: n. 交换，互换；短暂的交谈，争吵；交战，交火；兑换，汇兑；交流，互访；交易所；（商品的）调换；电话局，电话交换台；换子，兑子；v. 调换，更换；交流，交谈；交换，互换；兑换，交易
definition: 1. n. chemical process in which one atom or ion or group changes places with another；2. v. give to, and receive from, one another
example: Me and my friend went to the same university and went to the same exchange program to Canada
exampleZh: 我们上了同一所大学，也参加了同一个到加拿大的交流项目，

meaning: v. 使兴奋，使激动；引起，激起；使（身体或身体系统某部份）活动，刺激……的活动；使产生性欲
definition: 1. v. arouse or elicit a feeling；2. v. act as a stimulant
example: Daniel's early exposure to motor racing did not excite his interest.
exampleZh: 丹尼尔早期对赛车运动的接触并没有激起他的兴趣。

meaning: adj. 令人兴奋的，令人激动的；惊险刺激的（尤指无法预知下一步将发生什么）；v. 使兴奋，使激动；激发，引起（excite 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. creating or arousing excitement；2. adj. stimulating interest and discussion
example: It's also going to be the process of watching an artistic form unfold over a very exciting period of time.
exampleZh: 更是一个观察某种艺术形式在一段,刺激的时间里展现的过程。

meaning: n. 令人激动（或兴奋）的事，刺激因素；激动，兴奋；性兴奋
definition: 1. n. the feeling of lively and cheerful joy；2. n. the state of being emotionally aroused and worked up
example: Whatever excitement they may have entailed in the long run, we feel as we wake up that they go on too long.
exampleZh: 因为任何刺激的情节放在这么长的梦里，我们醒来都会觉得持续得太久了。

meaning: v. 呼喊，惊叫，大声说
definition: 1. v. utter aloud; often with surprise, horror, or joy；2. v. state or announce
example: That's why you exclaim "Ouch" after staying away from the pain signals you encountered before.
exampleZh: 这就是为什么你在避开之前遇到过的疼痛信号后，会惊叫“哎呦”的原因。

meaning: n. 惊叫，感叹；感叹语，感叹词
definition: 1. n. an abrupt excited utterance；2. n. a loud complaint or protest or reproach
example: I, for my part, know very well how I can bring about this movement and this exclamation.
exampleZh: 就我而言，我十分清楚自己该如何掀起这股思潮，引发这声呐喊。

meaning: adj. 惊呼的，感叹的
definition: 1. adj. sudden and strong
example: The study on exclamatory sentences is less than that of the other three types.
exampleZh: 与前三者不同的是，感叹句的研究到目前为止还比较少见。

meaning: vt. （故意）不包括，把……排除在外；认为……不可能，排除……的可能；阻挡；开除（学生）；防止……的发生
definition: 1. v. prevent from being included or considered or accepted；2. v. prevent from entering; shut out
example: I cannot entirely exclude the possibility that some form of pressure was applied to the neck.
exampleZh: 我不能完全排除有些压力作用到了颈部的可能性。

meaning: n. 排斥，排除在外；被排除在外的人（或事物）；认为不可能；（合约中的）除外事项；开除学籍
definition: 1. n. the state of being excluded；2. n. the state of being excommunicated
example: many of these ion channels have this size exclusion pore, it's a very important part of them.
exampleZh: 很多离子通道也都有这样的具有尺寸排斥性的小孔，这是它们非常重要的组成部分。

meaning: adj. 独有的，专用的；高档的，昂贵的；不含……的；排外的；排斥的；全部的；唯一关心的；（新闻或报道）独家的；（条款）除外责任的；高级的，昂贵的；n. 独家新闻，独家报道
definition: 1. n. a news report that is reported first by one news organization；2. adj. not divided or shared with others
example: Our group will have exclusive use of a 60-foot boat.
exampleZh: 我们组将有一条专用的60英尺的船。

meaning: n. 短途旅行，远足；涉猎；移动；游览团，远足队；离题；偏移，偏差
definition: 1. n. a journey taken for pleasure；2. n. wandering from the main path of a journey
example: She felt more than usually hungry after her excursion.
exampleZh: 远足后她感到非同寻常地饥饿。

meaning: n. 借口，托词；正当理由；宽恕，赦免；拙劣样品，蹩脚货；（医生或父母为学生写的）病假条，请假条；v. 原谅，宽恕；辩解，开脱；准许……离开；同意免除
definition: 1. n. a defense of some offensive behavior or some failure to keep a promise etc.；2. v. accept an excuse for
example: You know, so it's nice to kind of have an excuse to go, do all sorts of things.
exampleZh: 所以找个借口就去了，干了很多事儿。

meaning: v. 执行，实施；处决；完成，表演（高难度动作）；制作（艺术作品）；（计算机）执行指令（或程序）
definition: 1. v. kill as a means of socially sanctioned punishment；2. v. murder in a planned fashion
example: The result is a new process that will execute the function as if the function had been called.
exampleZh: 得到的是一个新进程，该进程会执行该函数，就如同该函数此前已被调用过一般。

meaning: n. 执行，实施，完成；处决，死刑；表演，制作；政治谋杀；没收债务人财产，扣押债务人；（法律文书或命令的）执行
definition: 1. n. putting a condemned person to death；2. n. the act of performing; of doing something successfully; using knowledge as distinguished from merely possessing it
example: He was arrested for obstruction of a police officer in the execution of his duty.
exampleZh: 他因妨碍警察执行公务而被逮捕。

meaning: adj. 行政的，有执行权的；高档的，豪华的；供主管人员使用的；（有关）经营管理的，领导的；n. 主管，经理；行政部门，执行委员会
definition: 1. n. a person responsible for the administration of a business；2. adj. having the function of carrying out plans or orders etc.
example: He is the founder and the executive director of the Interfaith Youth Core located in Chicago, Illinois.
exampleZh: 他是跨信仰青年核心组织的创使人,及执行理事长,该组织总部设于伊利诺州芝加哥市。

meaning: adj. 被免除……的，获豁免的；v. 免除，豁免；n. 被免除（义务或责任）的人（尤指被免税者）
definition: 1. to excuse someone or something from a duty, payment, etc.；2. with special permission not to do or pay something
example: The interest on the money is exempt from tax.
exampleZh: 这笔钱的利息免税。

meaning: n. 免除，豁免；免税，免税额
definition: 1. special permission not to do or pay something；2. the fact of not having to obey a rule or do something that other people have to do
example: Seventeen states allow parents to get an exemption, sometimes just by signing a paper saying they personally object to a vaccine.
exampleZh: 17个州允许父母获得豁免，有时他们只需要签署一份文件，以此声明他们反对接种疫苗。

meaning: n. 运动，锻炼；（一套）动作，体操；练习，演练；运用；活动，任务；典礼；宗教仪式，礼拜；v. 运动，锻炼；运用，行使；使担忧，使烦恼；驯，遛
definition: 1. n. the activity of exerting your muscles in various ways to keep fit；2. v. put to use
example: And I think too, a really good exercise if you wanted to do is, if you have a dictionary,
exampleZh: 我也认为，如果你想练习，如果你有字典的话，比较好的练习

meaning: v. 运用，施加（影响）；努力，尽力（exert oneself）
definition: 1. v. put to use；2. v. have and exercise
example: In order to be successful he would have to exert himself.
exampleZh: 他必须努力才能成功。

meaning: n. 费力，努力；运用，行使
definition: 1. n. use of physical or mental energy; hard work
example: Climbing further, with renewed courage, he at last saw his goal before him, but not without long and weary exertion.
exampleZh: 他又重新鼓起勇气，继续往上爬，他终于看到了眼前的目标，但还需要经过漫长而疲惫的努力才能到达。

meaning: v. 使精疲力尽；耗尽；详尽讨论；排放，排出（气体，蒸汽）；n. 废气；排气管，排气装置
definition: 1. n. gases ejected from an engine as waste products；2. v. wear out completely
example: They're concerned with having too many accidents, which might exhaust their reserves.
exampleZh: 保险公司都会担心太多事故同时发生,这样的话保险公司可能就会赔个精光

meaning: n. 筋疲力尽；耗尽，枯竭
definition: 1. n. extreme fatigue；2. n. serious weakening and loss of energy
example: Exhaustion would make me drift toward sleep and then I would scream until I was wide awake again.
exampleZh: 体力不济之后，我会入睡,下次又是尖叫着惊起。

meaning: adj. 详尽的，彻底的；消耗的
definition: 1. adj. very thorough; exhaustively complete
example: This is by no means an exhaustive list but it gives an indication of the many projects taking place.
exampleZh: 这绝不是份详尽无遗的清单，但它显示出很多正在进行的项目。

meaning: v. 表现出；卖弄，炫耀；提出（证据等）；展览，展出；n. 展品；（法庭上出示的）证物；展览，展出
definition: 1. n. an object or statement produced before a court of law and referred to while giving evidence；2. v. show an attribute, property, knowledge, or skill
example: The new exhibit will tour a dozen US cities next year.
exampleZh: 这批新展品明年将在美国十二个城市巡回展出。

meaning: n. 展览，展出；表现，展示；表演赛；奖学金
definition: 1. n. the act of exhibiting；2. n. a collection of things (goods or works of art etc.) for public display
example: you have a big exhibition about the plays and the life and the times of William Shakespeare.
exampleZh: 可以看到一个大型的关于威廉•莎士比亚的戏剧、生活和时代的展览。

meaning: n. 流放；被流放者，流亡者；v. 流放；使离开
definition: 1. n. voluntarily absent from home or country；2. v. expel from a country
example: Hobbes was the tutor to a royal household who followed the King into exile during the English Civil War.
exampleZh: 贺伯斯是一位皇室家庭的家教老师,该户人家于英国内战时,随着英皇流亡；

meaning: v. 存在，实际上有；持续存在，生存
definition: 1. v. have an existence, be extant；2. v. support oneself
example: There will need to be some organizing structures or frameworks or standard bodies that exist to coordinate that.
exampleZh: 需要组织结构,框架或者标准,来协调这些网站。

meaning: n. 存在，实有；生存，生活，生活方式；存在物，实体
definition: 1. n. the state or fact of existing；2. n. everything that exists anywhere
example: In other words, the judgment of beauty does not depend on the existence of the object for its satisfaction.
exampleZh: 换句话说，审美不会依赖于,事物自己的存在形式。

meaning: adj. 现存的，现有的；生存的；n. 存在（或实有）的事物
definition: 1. adj. having existence or being or actuality；2. adj. being or occurring in fact or actuality; having verified existence; not illusory
example: This policy, they say, is at best confused and at worst non-existent.
exampleZh: 他们说这项政策说好听点是混乱不清，说不好听点就是根本不存在。

meaning: adj. 现存的，现行的；v. 存在，实有；生活，生活方式（exist 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. having existence or being or actuality；2. adj. existing in something specified
example: Science is very hostile to innovation when it challenges existing theory, sort of like management, the same thing.
exampleZh: 科学对创新是有敌意的,当创新在挑战已存在的理论，跟管理一样，同样的道理。

meaning: n. 出口，通道，太平门；（车辆驶出公路的）出路；离去；退出；去世，死亡；v. 退出（电脑程序）；退场（剧本里的舞台指示）；去世，死亡；摊牌让分；离去
definition: 1. n. an opening that permits escape or release；2. v. move out of or depart from
example: In other words, I don't not know first that that's a sign that says "exit."
exampleZh: 换句话说，我不事先知道,那是一个存在的标志“

meaning: adj. 奇异的，异国风情的；n. 外来植物，外来动物
definition: 1. unusual and exciting because of coming (or seeming to come) from far away, especially a tropical country；2. strange in an attractive way
example: I was beguiled by the romance and exotic atmosphere of the souks in Marrakech.
exampleZh: 我被马拉喀什剧场浪漫的异国情调迷住了。

meaning: v. 扩大，增加；扩展，发展；细谈，详述；变得更自信（善谈）；（宇宙）膨胀
definition: 1. v. extend in one or more directions；2. v. become larger in size or volume or quantity
example: Let's imagine maybe instead we just immediately dropped the pressure let the system expand against the lower pressure.
exampleZh: 现在假设,我们很快地降低压力,让系统在低的外压力下膨胀。

meaning: n. 扩大，扩张；扩充，展开；扩张物；膨胀
definition: 1. n. the act of increasing (something) in size or volume or quantity or scope；2. n. a discussion that provides additional information
example: Adiabatic meaning there's no heat involved, and we're going to see how that differs from the isothermal expansion and compression.
exampleZh: 绝热意味着没有热量的传递，我们将看到它,与等温过程的区别。

meaning: adj. 广阔的；广泛的；扩张的，发展的；开朗的，健谈的
definition: 1. adj. able or tending to expand or characterized by expansion；2. adj. of behavior that is impressive and ambitious in scale or scope
example: This expansive view of linking is called "the Web of Data" and forms the basis of LOD.
exampleZh: 这种扩展的链接观点称为“数据网络”并构成了 LOD 的基础。

meaning: v. 期待；预计；要求，指望；认为；怀孕
definition: 1. v. regard something as probable or likely；2. v. consider obligatory; request and expect
example: Milton's Lady doesn't proceed as we expect her to, to marshal further arguments for the moderate fulfillment of one's conjugal obligations.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿笔下的女士没有按我们期望的那样进行，整理有关人们适当满足婚姻权利义务,的进一步论点。

meaning: n. 期待，预期；期望，指望
definition: 1. n. belief about (or mental picture of) the future；2. n. wishing with confidence of fulfillment
example: I applied for the post more in hope than expectation.
exampleZh: 我申请这个职位是希望多于期待。

meaning: n. 期待，期望
definition: 1. n. pleasurable expectation；2. n. something expected (as on the basis of a norm)
example: The same nations and the short life expectancy of birth probably the lowest quality of life in other areas.
exampleZh: 这一数字在下降，在上述国家,新生儿预期寿命较短，某些区域生活质量极低。

meaning: n. 远征，考察；探险队，考察队；动作敏捷，迅速
definition: 1. an organized journey for a particular purpose；2. the people, vehicles, animals, etc. taking part in an expedition
example: The head of the expedition to Troy, Agamemnon, the sort of generalissimo of that expedition is called Wanax.
exampleZh: 特洛伊远征队的首脑,阿伽门农,当时这类大统帅被称为瓦纳克斯

meaning: v. 把……开除（或除名）；驱逐；排出（空气、水、气体等）
definition: 1. v. force to leave or move out；2. v. put out or expel from a place
example: And what it does is--one way to reproduce is to occupy other animals and manipulate their bodies so as to expel it.
exampleZh: 它繁衍的方式是,占据其他动物并操纵他们的身体,以驱逐他们。

meaning: v. 花费，消耗，耗尽
definition: 1. v. use up, consume fully；2. v. pay out
example: If you give up exercise, your muscles shrink and fat increases. By the same token, if you expend more energy you will lose fat.
exampleZh: 如果你放弃锻炼，肌肉就会萎缩，脂肪会增多。同样地，如果你消耗较多的体能，你就会减掉脂肪。

meaning: n. 经费，支出额；（时间、金钱、精力等的）消耗，花费
definition: 1. n. money paid out；2. n. the act of spending money for goods or services
example: Now the interesting thing is, the green line here is the expenditure on real estate investment.
exampleZh: 有个有趣的情况,绿线代表房地产投资支出

meaning: n. 代价，费用；业务费用，报销（expenses）；需要花钱的东西，花销的东西；v. 把……记入费用账户；向……收取费用；被花掉
definition: 1. n. amounts paid for goods and services that may be currently tax deductible (as opposed to capital expenditures)；2. n. a detriment or sacrifice
example: They're already paying for public transport, so it's just kind of a financial expense they could do without.
exampleZh: 他们已经向公共交通付钱了，所以，那只是一笔没有必要的财务支出。

meaning: adj. 花钱多的，昂贵的；（错误或决定）代价高的
definition: 1. adj. high in price or charging high prices
example: And that's how it actually gets to be so quiet when you have on, supposedly, these quite expensive headphones.
exampleZh: 所以你戴上它后会觉得,周围非常安静，可想而知,这种耳机非常贵的。

meaning: n. 经历，往事；经验，阅历；传统；v. 经历，遭遇；体会到，感受到
definition: 1. n. the accumulation of knowledge or skill that results from direct participation in events or activities；2. v. go or live through
example: So it really, you know, becoming familiar with the different methods is best done through experience, not through books.
exampleZh: 所以，真的，你知道，熟练掌握不同的方法最好是通过经验，而不是通过书。

meaning: adj. 熟练的，有经验的；v. 经历，遭遇；体会到，感受到（experience 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. having experience; having knowledge or skill from observation or participation
example: You use this pattern whenever you want to express that you have experienced something in the past previously.
exampleZh: 每当你想表达你之前已经经历过某事的时候，你就可以用这个句型。

meaning: n. 实验，试验；尝试，实践；v. 进行实验，做试验；试，尝试
definition: 1. n. the act of conducting a controlled test or investigation；2. v. to conduct a test or investigation
example: Now for this experiment, this is a constant enthalpy experiment for the Joule-Thomson experiment, this is equal to zero.
exampleZh: 对于这个实验，焦耳-汤姆逊实验,是一个焓不变的实验,焓变化等于0，所以我可以。

meaning: adj. 实验性的，试验性的；根据经验的，经验上的
definition: 1. adj. relating to or based on experiment；2. adj. relying on observation or experiment
example: The senator is ready to argue for an experimental lifting of the ban.
exampleZh: 该参议员已准备好争取那条禁令的试验性解除。

meaning: n. 专家，能手，权威；adj. 专业的，熟练的；v. 当专家；【名】 （Expert）（法、印、俄、罗、巴、荷）埃克斯佩（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person with special knowledge or ability who performs skillfully；2. adj. having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
example: As an expert in teaching, could you give us some advice on how best to study a language?
exampleZh: 作为一名教育专家，关于怎样才是学习语言的最佳方式，你能给我们一些建议吗？

meaning: n. 专长，专门技能（知识）；专家的意见
definition: 1. n. skillfulness by virtue of possessing special knowledge
example: We need to tap the expertise of the people we already have.
exampleZh: 我们需要利用我们现有人员的专业知识。

meaning: v. 到期，失效；死亡；呼气，吐气；（任期）届满
definition: 1. If something that lasts for a fixed length of time expires, it comes to an end or stops being in use；2. to die
example: And as for taxes, the Bush tax cuts as John said, are set to expire very substantially by the end of 2010.
exampleZh: 至于在税收方面，约翰刚才也说过，布什的减税政策，会在2010年底，最终期满失效。

meaning: n. 到期，（一段时间的）结束；呼气，吐气
definition: 1. the situation in which something that lasts for a fixed length of time comes to an end or stops being in use；2. the act of breathing out
example: Then he proceeded to recite his card number and expiration date before signing off.
exampleZh: 接着他开始背诵自己的卡号和有效期，之后才挂断通话。

meaning: v. 解释，说明；说明（……的）原因，解释（……的）理由
definition: 1. v. make plain and comprehensible；2. v. define
example: How does all this work? Brooks believes that he can understand it, as we'll try to explain, in psychoanalytic terms.
exampleZh: 这些都是怎么实现的呢？，布鲁克斯确信自己可以，从精神分析的角度理解这些问题，我们马上要解释。

meaning: n. 解释，说明；解释性说法，说明性文字；理由，原因
definition: 1. n. a statement that makes something comprehensible by describing the relevant structure or operation or circumstances etc.；2. n. thought that makes something comprehensible
example: Which is just to say, we need to offer a biological/physical explanation of what goes on in near-death experiences.
exampleZh: 那也只不过是说,关于濒死体验我们需要给出,一个生物学或物理学的解释

meaning: adj. 解释的，说明的
definition: 1. adj. serving or intended to explain or make clear
example: After the furore which greeted our first report I felt pusillanimously that we should excise this explanatory passage.
exampleZh: 在我们的第一份报告引起骚动之后，我有些胆怯地觉得我们应该删去这段解释性的文字。

meaning: adj. 清楚明白的，明确的，详述的；直截了当的，坦率的；赤裸裸表现性爱（或暴力）的，露骨的；n. （手稿、早期印刷品或礼拜仪式上唱诗的）结束语
definition: 1. adj. precisely and clearly expressed or readily observable; leaving nothing to implication；2. adj. in accordance with fact or the primary meaning of a term
example: So, inside of code, or inside of a script, there's no print, unless we make it explicit.
exampleZh: 因此，在代码里面，或者在脚本里面，不会有显示结果的功能，除非我们让它这么做。

meaning: v. （使）爆炸，（使）爆破；急剧扩大，激增；（情感）迸发，爆发；推翻，破除；爆响，发出巨响；迅速移动
definition: 1. v. cause to burst with a violent release of energy；2. v. burst outward, usually with noise
example: At last, a women's magazine to explode the myth that thin equals beautiful.
exampleZh: 终于有一家妇女杂志起来推翻瘦即美的神话。

meaning: n. 爆破，爆炸（声）；激增；爆发，迸发；突发的巨响；某事证实是错误的，推翻
definition: 1. n. a violent release of energy caused by a chemical or nuclear reaction；2. n. the act of exploding or bursting something
example: In other cases, the virus propagates in such high numbers that release is literally an explosion of the cell.
exampleZh: 在另一些时候,病毒的数量相当大,那么释放病毒就会使细胞的爆裂

meaning: adj. 易爆的，可能引起爆炸的；（局势）一触即发的，爆炸性的；暴躁的，易怒的；激增的；强有力的；（声音）轰响的；（浊音）爆发的，破裂的；n. 炸药，爆炸物
definition: 1. n. a chemical substance that undergoes a rapid chemical change (with the production of gas) on being heated or struck；2. adj. serving to explode or characterized by explosion or sudden outburst
example: He appeared to be treating the potentially explosive situation with some sensitivity.
exampleZh: 他似乎正在有些敏感地处理潜在的爆炸性局面。

meaning: v. 剥削，压榨；利用（……为自己谋利）；运用，发挥；开发，开拓；n. 英勇事迹，壮举；大胆的表演，不凡的身手
definition: 1. n. a notable achievement；2. v. use or manipulate to one's advantage
example: As computer systems become even more sophisticated, so too do the methods of those who exploit the technology.
exampleZh: 正如计算机系统变得越来越复杂，开发计算机技术的人所采用的方法也日趋复杂。

meaning: n. 剥削，压榨；开发，开采；（出于私利、不公正的）利用
definition: 1. n. the act of making some area of land or water more profitable or productive or useful；2. n. an act that exploits or victimizes someone (treats them unfairly)
example: Extra payments should be made to protect the interests of the staff and prevent exploitation.
exampleZh: 额外报酬应被支付以维护员工的利益和防止剥削。

meaning: v. 探讨，探究；考察，探索；（用手或身体其他部位）探查，仔细检查
definition: 1. v. inquire into；2. v. travel to or penetrate into
example: I want to explore and get in touch with my inner self.
exampleZh: 我想认真探索，了解我内在的个性。

meaning: n. 勘探，勘察；研究，探究
definition: 1. n. to travel for the purpose of discovery；2. n. a careful systematic search
example: This is your opportunity to begin the exploration of one of the greatest novels of our time.
exampleZh: 这是开始探索当代,最伟大的小说之一的一次机遇。

meaning: n. 拥护者，倡导者；代表人物；指数，幂；大师，行家；成分；说明者，说明物；adj. 说明的
definition: 1. a person who supports an idea or belief or performs an activity；2. a number or sign that shows how many times another number is to be multiplied by itself
example: And, if we do so, we can actually get a handle on that Born exponent by solving the equation.
exampleZh: 如果我们这样做，我们实际上能够得到波恩指数,通过解这个方程得到。

meaning: v. 出口；传播，输出；（在计算机中）导出，输出；n. 出口，输出；出口物，输出品；出口量，出口收入；adj. 出口的
definition: 1. n. commodities (goods or services) sold to a foreign country；2. v. sell or transfer abroad
example: This we did set up a number of vehicles for peered appeal exchange and peered export exchange.
exampleZh: 我们利用多种手段进行,同伴之间信息输入交流,信息输出交流。

meaning: n. 出口，输出
definition: 1. n. commodities (goods or services) sold to a foreign country；2. n. the commercial activity of selling and shipping goods to a foreign country
example: Capers are flower buds of Capparis spinosa, grown in countries bordering the Mediterranean. They are preserved in vinegar, and bottled for exportation.
exampleZh: 刺山柑是山柑属植物的花蕾，生长在地中海边沿国家。在醋中保存，瓶装出口。

meaning: v. 暴露，使显露；使面临，使遭受（危险或不快）；揭露，揭发；接触，体验；露出，显露（感情）；使（胶卷）曝光；弃（婴孩）于户外让其死去；n. 揭露，曝光
definition: 1. n. the exposure of an impostor or a fraud；2. v. expose or make accessible to some action or influence
example: Altman strips away the pretense and mythology to expose the film industry as a business like any other.
exampleZh: 奥尔特曼揭穿伪装和神话，把电影业暴露成像其他任何行业一样。

meaning: n. 暴露，接触；曝光，揭发；报道，宣传；单张胶片；曝光时间，曝光量；受冻；朝向
definition: 1. n. vulnerability to the elements; to the action of heat or cold or wind or rain；2. n. the act of subjecting someone to an influencing experience
example: And,again,to us in the modern world, if you didn't already have some exposure to religious narratives like this,that would sound odd.
exampleZh: 同样的，对现代人来说，如果没接触过这类宗教描述,可能会觉得奇怪。

meaning: n. 解释，阐述；展览会，博览会；（奏鸣曲等的）呈示部；暴露，揭露
definition: 1. a clear and full explanation of an idea or theory；2. a show in which industrial goods, works of art, etc. are shown to the public
example: Aristotle was valued because of his clear exposition of rational thought.
exampleZh: 亚里士多德因其对理性思维的清晰阐述而被重视。

meaning: v. 表达，表露；表现，体现；（用数学方法）表示；压榨，挤压出（空气或液体）；特快发运；n. 快车；快递；初速大的猎枪；专使；捷运公司；adj. 快递的，特快的；明确的；特意的；adv. 用快递寄送
definition: 1. n. rapid transport of goods；2. v. give expression to
example: So maybe what we have here is another polemic,another adaptation of familiar stories and motifs to express something new.
exampleZh: 所以，也许这又是另一场辩论,又是对我们所熟悉故事的颠覆。

meaning: n. 表达，表示；表情，神情；（表演、歌唱或演奏时的）情感表现；词语，措词；式，表达式；挤压
definition: 1. n. the feelings expressed on a person's face；2. n. expression without words
example: And the terms of the expression change, the parties to the conflict change, the sights change, but the controversy goes on.
exampleZh: 也许人们对这种冲突的表述有所改变，利益双方有所改变，文化景观有所改变，但这种争议永远存在。

meaning: adj. 富于表情的，富于表现力的；表现的，表达的
definition: 1. adj. characterized by expression
example: HOL is more expressive than first-order logic and enables a concise description of complex properties.
exampleZh: HOL 比一阶逻辑更有表现力，能够对复杂属性进行简洁的描述。

meaning: n. 高速公路
definition: 1. n. a broad highway designed for high-speed traffic
example: The expressway on-ramp lay just ahead.
exampleZh: 高速公路的入口匝道就在前方。

meaning: adj. 精致的，精美的；剧烈的；细致的，有鉴赏力的；n. 花花公子
definition: 1. very beautiful and delicate；2. used to describe feelings such as pleasure or pain that are extremely strong, or qualities that are extremely good; great
example: The exhibition includes exquisite examples of silverwork produced by local craftspeople in the eighteenth century.
exampleZh: 这场展览展出了当地工匠在18世纪制作的精美银器。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: v. 延伸；扩大，延长；持续；包括，波及；提供，表示；伸出；使竭尽全力；对……估价；继承（面向对象语言中的一种概念）
definition: 1. v. extend in scope or range or area；2. v. stretch out over a distance, space, time, or scope; run or extend between two points or beyond a certain point
example: But the idea is--the clip is to make the point that the fear will extend to a rabbit, a white rabbit.
exampleZh: 但关键是，这段影片试图说明,恐惧是会扩散到小白兔身上去的。

meaning: n. 延伸，扩展；展期，延长期；扩建部分，延伸部分；（电话）分机；扩展名；（为非全日制学生开设的）进修部；牵伸（术）；外延；广延（性）
definition: 1. n. a mutually agreed delay in the date set for the completion of a job or payment of a debt；2. n. act of expanding in scope; making more widely available
example: By extension we have our attempt as readers to arrive at an understanding of the first two books in general.
exampleZh: 延伸开来，我们作为作者，试图,达成对这两卷书的大体上的理解。

meaning: adj. 广阔的；广泛的；巨大的，大量的；（农业）粗放（经营）的
definition: 1. adj. large in spatial extent or range or scope or quantity；2. adj. broad in scope or content
example: We have got an extensive subway system and an extensive bus system that we have had for 60, 70 years.
exampleZh: 我们有大规模的地铁系统和巴士系统，它们已经有差不多六七十年的历史了。

meaning: adj. 延长了的，扩展了的；详尽的；v. 扩大，延长；延伸；持续（extend 的过去分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. relatively long in duration; tediously protracted；2. adj. fully extended or stretched forth
example: The oil well extended several hundreds of feet in depth.
exampleZh: 油井向下延伸了数百英尺。

meaning: n. 程度；范围，长度
definition: 1. n. the point or degree to which something extends；2. n. the distance or area or volume over which something extends
example: I think obviously with the war in Iraq emphasised our, the extent, how close we are.
exampleZh: 我想，伊拉克战争，很明显地突出了我们之间的关系有多么密切。

meaning: adj. 外部的，外面的；外表的，表面的；（电影场景）外部拍摄的；n. 外观，外部；外貌
definition: 1. n. the region that is outside of something；2. adj. situated in or suitable for the outdoors or outside of a building
example: There is a wall around Paris and there are exterior forts, but you've got an enormous number of people besieged by Prussian and other German forces, holding on.
exampleZh: 在巴黎外围高墙林立,堡垒遍地,但仍有大批民众,在普鲁士和其他德国军队的围攻中坚守阵地

meaning: adj. 外部的，外面的；对外的，与外国有关的；外来的，外聘的；（药品等类似物质）外用的；n. 外表，外部特征
definition: 1. n. outward features；2. adj. happening or arising or located outside or beyond some limits or especially surface
example: College lecturers acted as external assessors of the exam results.
exampleZh: 学院讲师是考试成绩的校外考核人。

meaning: adj. 灭绝的；消亡的；（火山）死的；（贵族称号）无合法继承人的；熄灭了的
definition: 1. not now existing；2. An extinct volcano is one that is not now active (= will not explode again).
example: Herbalism had become an all but extinct skill in the Western world.
exampleZh: 草药医术在西方世界几乎已成了一项绝迹的技术。

meaning: n. 灭绝，消亡；（债务的）偿清；消光
definition: 1. a situation in which something no longer exists
example: The loggers say their jobs are faced with extinction because of declining timber sales.
exampleZh: 樵夫们说他们的工作因不断下降的木材销售而面临消亡。

meaning: v. 熄灭；消灭，使破灭；取消（权利，义务），使无效；偿清；压制
definition: 1. v. put an end to; kill；2. v. put out, as of fires, flames, or lights
example: However many generations succeed us in coming centuries, none of them will ever see this species that we extinguish.
exampleZh: 在未来的几个世纪里，无论我们传承了多少代人，他们都不会再看到被我们灭绝掉的物种。

meaning: adj. 额外的；另外收费的；n. 另收费的事物；临时演员；（非击球所得的）附加分；（报纸的）号外；adv. 额外；特别，格外
definition: 1. n. a minor actor in crowd scenes；2. adj. more than is needed, desired, or required
example: There's a second figure here standing ab extra, and that's the moon hovering overhead: "while over-head the Moon / sits Arbitress."
exampleZh: 这里有第二个置身事外的角色，就是高高挂在空中的月亮：,“月亮高挂天心，像个公正的决断人“

meaning: n. 选段，引文；提取物，汁；v. 提取，提炼；取出，拔出；摘录；索取，设法得到；开（方），求（根）
definition: 1. to remove or take out something；2. to make someone give you something when they do not want to
example: We know it has to big anyway, since we can extract heat from it without changing the temperature.
exampleZh: 我们知道它必须很大，因为我们得从中提取热量,但不改变它的温度。

meaning: n. 取出，提炼；血统
definition: 1. the process of removing or obtaining something from somewhere, especially from under a surface or from inside something else；2. the process of removing a tooth
example: This paper studied the extraction of liposoluble pigment from the dry powder of tangerine peel.
exampleZh: 本文研究了在柑橘皮干粉中对油溶性色素的提取。

meaning: adj. 异乎寻常的，令人惊奇的；非凡的，卓越的；特别的，临时的；特大（或多）的；特派的，特命的；n. （公司正常业务活动之外的）非常账目，特支款项
definition: 1. adj. beyond what is ordinary or usual; highly unusual or exceptional or remarkable；2. adj. far more than usual or expected
example: Every conceivable Protestant sect was publishing treatises of theological speculation and publishing treatises of religious propaganda at an extraordinary rate.
exampleZh: 任何能想到的新教徒的宗教派别都在以不同寻常的,速度出版神学思考著作和,宗教宣传著作。

meaning: adj. 奢侈的，挥霍的；不切实际的，放肆的；豪华的，精美的
definition: 1. spending too much money, or using too much of something；2. extreme and unreasonable
example: very extravagant. It's over the top and really different. Very much worth an experience.
exampleZh: 非常华丽。它非常夸张，而且真的与众不同。非常值得一去。

meaning: n. 挥霍，浪费；奢侈品；奢华，富丽堂皇；过分，过度
definition: 1. behaviour in which you spend more money than you need to；2. something expensive that you buy even though you do not need it
example: When the company went under, tales of his extravagance surged through the industry.
exampleZh: 这家公司破产时，有关他的奢靡的传言传遍了整个业界。

meaning: adj. 极大的，极度的；极端的，严重的；过分的，偏激的；尽头的，末端的；极限的，从事极限运动的；n. （观点或行为方式的）极端；（事物的）极度；端顶，端词
definition: 1. n. the furthest or highest degree of something；2. adj. of the greatest possible degree or extent or intensity
example: Or maybe you could be wanting to try some extreme sports like skydiving, jumping out of an airplane.
exampleZh: 又或者你想尝试一些极限运动，比如跳伞，直接从飞机上跳下来。

meaning: n. 手足，四肢；尽头，末端；极端，绝境；残酷的手段，非常手段
definition: 1. n. an external body part that projects from the body；2. n. an extreme condition or state (especially of adversity or disease)
example: I should hate and despise myself if I desert the brave fellow in his present extremity.
exampleZh: 假如我抛弃了这位正处于困境的勇士，我将痛恨和蔑视我自己。

meaning: n. 眼睛；目光，所看之处；眼力，鉴赏力；眼光，视角；观点，态度；（钩）环，扣眼；（马铃薯上的）芽眼，芽；（飓风等风暴的）风眼；拍摄对象，取景器；（电）眼，（红外）眼，眼状探测装置；针眼，针鼻儿；v. 注视，仔细打量；【名】 （Eye）（英）艾，（德）艾厄（人名）
definition: 1. n. the organ of sight；2. v. look at
example: The Magi here are, again, an image, a kind of visionary symbol, an image available "in the mind's eye" at all times.
exampleZh: 这儿，三圣贤又是个意象，一个幻想出的标志，时时存在于大脑中的一个意象。

meaning: n. 眉，眉毛
definition: 1. n. the arch of hair above each eye
example: They we are going to protect them which I raise an eyebrow of it myself.
exampleZh: 我很赞同这些投资,我们也要保护这些。

meaning: n. 目力，视力
definition: 1. n. normal use of the faculty of vision
example: He was not a particularly good shot because of his eyesight.
exampleZh: 他由于视力缘故并不是一个特别好的射手。

meaning: n. 寓言；谎言，无稽之谈；神话，传说；v. 虚构，撒谎；讲寓言，编寓言；煞有介事地讲述；【名】 （Fable）（英）费布尔，（法）法布勒（人名）
definition: 1. n. a deliberately false or improbable account；2. n. a short moral story (often with animal characters)
example: Rosenberg is giving us an anecdote from the trenches, and yet it slips very quickly into a sense of fable.
exampleZh: 罗宾森给我们呈现战壕中的轶事，它很快成为一个无稽之谈。

meaning: n. 布料，织物；构造，结构；（汽车的）车身，（飞机的）机身
definition: 1. n. artifact made by weaving or felting or knitting or crocheting natural or synthetic fibers；2. n. the underlying structure
example: And we have a lot of talk about life in this world People are talking about the fabric of life.
exampleZh: 关于世界上的生命，我们已经谈了很多,人们都在探讨生命的构造。

meaning: v. 制造，生产；捏造，编造；组装，装配
definition: 1. to invent or produce something false in order to deceive someone；2. to produce a product, especially in an industrial process
example: David, on the other hand, had labored to fabricate a curious patent leather trouser suit.
exampleZh: 另一方面，大卫努力制作了一套奇特的、别出心裁的皮革裤套装。

meaning: n. 捏造的故事，虚构的信息；制造，生产；组装，装配
definition: 1. the act of inventing false information in order to deceive someone, or the false information itself；2. the act of producing a product, especially in an industrial process
example: MIM fabrication is ideal where near-full density, high impact toughness, fracture toughness, and fatigue and corrosion resistance are required.
exampleZh: 在要求接近全密度、高冲击韧性、断裂韧性、抗疲劳和耐腐蚀性的地方，MIM 制造是理想的。

meaning: adj. 极好的，绝妙的；非凡的，巨大的，惊人的；虚构的，传说的
definition: 1. very good; excellent；2. extremely large in amount or number
example: I thought that was a just fabulous program and that generated very board bipartizan support.
exampleZh: 我认为这个计划非常成功,而且得到了两党的广泛支持。

meaning: n. 脸，面部；面部表情，脸色；人；初看，初听；尊严，威信；面貌；（物体的）正面，表面；斜坡，山坡；钟面，表盘；采掘面，工作面；（球拍的）拍面；（尤指足球的）球门；v. 面临，遭遇；正视，面对；与……交往，与……交谈；面向，面朝；迎战，对阵；抹盖，覆盖；接受，容忍；【名】 （Face）（法）法斯，（意）法切（人名）
definition: 1. n. the front of the human head from the forehead to the chin and ear to ear；2. v. deal with (something unpleasant) head on
example: Now one of the main questions going to face your advisory council is the question of discrimination on hiring.
exampleZh: 现在，一个主要问题将会,摆在你们顾问委员会面前，那就是,雇佣歧视的问题。

meaning: adj. 面部的，面部用的；n. 面部护理，美容
definition: 1. n. cranial nerve that supplies facial muscles；2. adj. of or concerning the face
example: Where's the best place to get a facial in New York City?
exampleZh: 在纽约做美容最好的地方在哪儿？

meaning: n. 部分，方面；（宝石的）琢面，刻面；（构成昆虫或甲壳动物复眼的）小眼面；v. 在……上琢面
definition: 1. one part of a subject, situation, etc. that has many parts；2. one of the small flat surfaces cut on a precious stone
example: To help you reflect, I'd share some questions you can ask yourself for each facet.
exampleZh: 为了帮你思考复盘，我会分享一些你可以针对每个方面自问的问题。

meaning: n. 设施，设备；卫生间；天赋，才能；（机器等的）特别装置，（服务等的）特色；（用作某种用途的）场所
definition: 1. n. a building or place that provides a particular service or is used for a particular industry；2. n. skillful performance or ability without difficulty
example: Actually I mentioned the Term Securities Loan Facility because it's a new innovation but it hasn't started yet.
exampleZh: 事实上，我提到术语,是因为它是一个,新的革新但还没有开始实施。

meaning: v. 使更容易，使便利；促进，推动
definition: 1. v. make easier；2. v. be of use
example: The other way is that like, they facilitate us in having like little meetings with professors and that kind of things,
exampleZh: 同时，学校还会帮助我们邀请教授和我们一起开小型会议，

meaning: n. 简便化，促进；（神经元对刺激反应的）增强
definition: 1. n. the condition of being made easy (or easier)；2. n. (neurophysiology) phenomenon that occurs when two or more neural impulses that alone are not enough to trigger a response in a neuron combine to trigger an action potential
example: The government encourages this practice, and provides many preferential policies and facilitation measures for college students.
exampleZh: 政府鼓励这种做法，并为大学生提供了许多优惠政策和便利措施。

meaning: n. 事实，真相；现实
definition: 1. n. a piece of information about circumstances that exist or events that have occurred；2. n. a statement or assertion of verified information about something that is the case or has happened
example: What may be most important here is the mere fact that Milton is expressing these political convictions at all.
exampleZh: 这里最重要的不过是,弥尔顿只是在表达他的政治信念。

meaning: adj. 真实的；事实的
definition: 1. adj. existing in act or fact；2. adj. of or relating to or characterized by facts
example: Aristotle's distinction seems to be not only empirical again based on the factual distribution of powers.
exampleZh: 亚里士多德的区别似乎,不只是根据经验的，或说,根据事实的权力分配。

meaning: n. 派系，宗派；派系之争，内讧；纪实与虚构相结合的电影（或书等）
definition: 1. a group within a larger group, especially one with slightly different ideas from the main group；2. a group within a larger group, esp. one with slightly different ideas than the main group
example: A small faction within the party opposed the reform despite widespread public support.
exampleZh: 尽管公众广泛支持这项改革，党内一个小派别仍然表示反对。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 因素，要素；等级，系数；因数，因子；遗传因子，基因；（血液中的）凝血因子；代理公司，代理商；地产管理人，管家；测量水平；v. 把……作为因素计入，把……包括在内（factor in）；把……作为因素排除，不把……包括在内（factor out）；将……分解为因子；代理经营，（代管）产业；做代理商；【名】 （Factor）（英）法克特（人名）
definition: 1. n. anything that contributes causally to a result；2. v. resolve into factors
example: A log algorithm typically is one where you cut the size of the problem down by some multiplicative factor.
exampleZh: 对数级复杂度的算法就是指,通过一系列常量级步数的操作,可以将问题的规模。

meaning: n. 工厂，制造厂；（在外国的）代理店
definition: 1. n. a plant consisting of one or more buildings with facilities for manufacturing
example: The time was in the early 70s, so factory farming was not well-known, was not as dominated as it is today, but it still existed.
exampleZh: 那时是70年代早期，工厂化养殖并不为很多人所知,也不如今天这样占主导地位，但当时已经出现了这种方式。

meaning: n. 机能；天赋，才能；（高等院校的）系，院； 全体教员；（某行业，尤指医学行业的）全体从业人员；（尤指来自教会当权者的）特许证，许可证
definition: 1. n. one of the inherent cognitive or perceptual powers of the mind；2. n. the body of teachers and administrators at a school
example: Well, Mario Molina, who was a faculty member here at MIT, won a Nobel prize for describing this process.
exampleZh: 马里奥，莫丽娜，一个麻州理工学院的教员，凭借描述这一过程获得了诺贝尔物理学奖。

meaning: v. 逐渐消失；（使）褪色，（使）变暗；枯萎，凋谢；变得虚弱；退步；（车辆的刹车因摩擦发热而）暂时失灵；（使）（电影或电视画面）淡入（或淡出）另一画面；变得默默无闻，变得无关紧要；（高尔夫球）偏离直线；接受（掷骰子者）的打赌；n. 淡入，淡出；褪色，变暗；（高尔夫球运动员故意击出的）向右偏离球；adj. 平淡的，乏味的；【名】 （Fade）（法）法德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a golf shot that curves to the right for a right-handed golfer；2. v. become less clearly visible or distinguishable; disappear gradually or seemingly
example: III Yonder a maid and her wight Come whispering by: War's annals will fade into night Ere their story die.
exampleZh: 那边一个女仆和她的同伴,走进来低语：,在故事结束前战争会没入夜色中。

meaning: v. 失败；未能做到，未能做；辜负，使失望；不及格，未能通过；出故障，失灵；衰弱，衰退；破产，倒闭；歉收；不下雨，下雨少；忘记；n. 不及格；过失，失败；【名】 （Fail）（葡、捷）法伊尔，（法）法伊（人名）
definition: 1. v. fail to do something; leave something undone；2. v. be unsuccessful
example: The wonderful line he has in his last prose-fiction "Worstward Ho", Try again, fail again, fail better.
exampleZh: 在他最后一部散文小说《向西去啊》有一句，再尝试，再失败，却更好地失败。

meaning: n. 失败；失败的人（或企业、事物）；未做到；缺乏，不足；故障，衰退；公司倒闭；歉收；突然失去
definition: 1. n. an act that fails；2. n. an event that does not accomplish its intended purpose
example: This is where evaluation comes in. The success or failure of a poem depends on the realization of meaning.
exampleZh: 这时就需要评估介入了，一首诗好与坏,取决于它含义表达是否清晰。

meaning: adj. 模糊的，微弱的；微小的，可能性不大的；虚弱的，头晕目眩的；不热情的；n. 晕倒，昏厥；v. 昏厥；变得微弱，衰落；变得没有气力
definition: 1. n. a spontaneous loss of consciousness caused by insufficient blood to the brain；2. v. pass out from weakness, physical or emotional distress due to a loss of blood supply to the brain
example: The heat made him feel faint.
exampleZh: 炎热使他觉得快要晕倒了。

meaning: adj. 公平的；合理的，公正的；相当好的；（数量、大小）相当大的；浅色的，（肤色）白皙的，（头发）金色的；晴朗的；顺风的；普通的；美丽的；界内的；（手段，方法）温和的，非暴力的；（言语，谈话，许诺）花言巧语的；adv. 公平地，公正地；非常；正面地，直接地；清楚地；n. 集市，展览会；露天游乐场；庙会；义卖会；牲畜市场；美女；职业介绍会；v. 变得晴朗；使（车辆，船舶，飞机）具有流线型；【名】 （Fair）（英、芬）费尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a traveling show; having sideshows and rides and games of skill etc.；2. v. join so that the external surfaces blend smoothly
example: He goes into the freak show at the fair, and he joins the crowd where his father also is.
exampleZh: 他去市集去看畸形秀，挤入了他父亲也身处其中的人群。

meaning: adv. 相当地，颇；公平地，公正地；（用以强调）完全，简直；令人愉快地，让人喜欢地；【名】 （Fairly）（英）费尔利（人名）
definition: 1. adv. to a moderately sufficient extent or degree；2. adv. without favoring one party, in a fair evenhanded manner
example: It's a fairly recent understanding of Maybe you can just give us a little time line of what human rights means.
exampleZh: 这是一个新近的理解,也许你可以先给我们一个时间线索,讲讲人权含义的演变。

meaning: n. 仙子，小精灵；兔子（对男同性恋者的蔑称）；仙蜂鸟；adj. 仙女的
definition: 1. n. a small being, human in form, playful and having magical powers；2. n. offensive terms for an openly homosexual man
example: He occupies in this passage every subject position of the fairy tale: the nurse, the hounds and the king.
exampleZh: 他在这段中加入了童话的要素：,如保护者，猎犬和国王。

meaning: n. 信任，信心，信念；宗教；宗教信仰；忠诚；int. 用以表示惊讶或强调千真万确；【名】 （Faith）（英）费思，费丝，（匈）福伊特，（瑞典）法伊特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a strong belief in a supernatural power or powers that control human destiny；2. n. complete confidence in a person or plan etc
example: The relativity of truth, the profusion of languages, these things that afflict Eliot are a source of faith for Stevens.
exampleZh: 真理的相关性，语言的丰富性，这些折磨着艾略特的事物，对于史蒂文斯而言却是信仰的来源。

meaning: adj. 忠实的，忠诚的；如实的，忠于原事（物）的；忠贞的；可信任的，可信赖的；n. 忠实支持者（the faithful）；【名】 （Faithful）（英）费思富尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. any loyal and steadfast following；2. adj. steadfast in affection or allegiance
example: I have been a faithful reader of your newspaper for many years.
exampleZh: 我是贵报多年来的忠实读者。

meaning: adj. 伪造的，冒充的；（动作或感情）虚假的，做作的；n. 假货，赝品；骗子，冒充者；假动作；（绳索、水龙带等的）一圈（=flake）；v. 伪造，冒充；假装，佯装；（尤指体育运动中）做假动作；不懂装懂，不会装会；盘卷（=flake）；【名】 （Fake）（印）费克（人名）
definition: 1. n. something that is a counterfeit; not what it seems to be；2. v. make a copy of with the intent to deceive
example: So it was all these like, fake movie posters that she made for fake movies that weren't real.
exampleZh: 所以那儿全是这类的东西，她为虚拟电影做的虚拟海报。

meaning: v. 降落，落下；跌倒，倒塌；（水平、数量、价格等）下跌，减少；属于；下垂，低垂；照射（到），（阴影）落在；降临，发生；倒台，失势；被打败，沦陷；阵亡，被击毙；打中，击中；（嗓音或声音）变轻，变小；进入（某状态），开始变成（某事物）；n. 落下，跌倒；（数量、水平、价格等的）下降，降低；秋天，秋季；失败，垮台 ；瀑布；（摔跤或柔道项目中的）摔倒，压倒；（雨、雪等的）降落；堕落；【名】 （Fall）（西）法勒（人名）
definition: 1. n. the season when the leaves fall from the trees；2. v. descend in free fall under the influence of gravity
example: And in fact, under type checking, different languages sometimes fall on a spectrum from weak to strong typing.
exampleZh: 实际上，在类型检查的下面，不同的语言会对应着,从弱到强的一个定型范围。

meaning: adj. 错误的，不真实的；伪造的；人造的；站不住脚的，全无根据的；不真诚的；不忠诚的；外表上与……相似的；非法的；妄动的；adv. 欺诈地
definition: 1. adj. not in accordance with the fact or reality or actuality；2. adv. in a disloyal and faithless manner
example: So if you wanna do something conditionally, you generally needs to ask the question, is the following true or false.
exampleZh: 假如想在一定条件下做一件事情，你需要判断下这个条件，来看看条件是真还是假。

meaning: n. 虚假，不真实；假话，谎言；说谎；谬误
definition: 1. n. a false statement；2. n. the act of rendering something false as by fraudulent changes (of documents or measures etc.) or counterfeiting
example: It is autonomous in the sense that it is a pure, uncluttered and uninfluenced declaration of fact or falsehood.
exampleZh: 科学是自主的，因为,科学就是单纯的,不受外界影响的，关于真伪的论断。

meaning: n. 名誉，名气；v. 使闻名，使有名望
definition: 1. n. the state or quality of being widely honored and acclaimed；2. n. favorable public reputation
example: On the Walk of Fame, you're going to find Drew Barrymore's star in front of the Chinese theatre.
exampleZh: 在星光大道上，你会发现德鲁·巴里摩尔的星星在中国剧院前。

meaning: adj. 著名的，出名的；极好的，了不起的
definition: 1. adj. widely known and esteemed
example: The passage is also famous because in it Milton does something that he almost never does. Milton has made a mistake.
exampleZh: 这篇文章有名也是因为弥尔顿做了一些,他几乎从未做过的事，弥尔顿犯了一个错误。

meaning: adj. 熟悉的；常见的，普通的；非正式的，随和的；过分亲密的，随便的；n. （与女巫共居的）妖精；知交，密友；（在教皇或主教家服务的）仆人；【名】 （Familiar）（西）法米利亚尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person attached to the household of a high official (as a pope or bishop) who renders service in return for support；2. adj. well known or easily recognized
example: So it really, you know, becoming familiar with the different methods is best done through experience, not through books.
exampleZh: 所以，真的，你知道，熟练掌握不同的方法最好是通过经验，而不是通过书。

meaning: n. 精通，通晓；熟悉，亲切感；随便，冒昧
definition: 1. n. personal knowledge or information about someone or something；2. n. usualness by virtue of being familiar or well known
example: The enemy would always have the advantage of familiarity with the rugged terrain.
exampleZh: 敌人会一直在对崎岖地形的熟悉上占有优势。

meaning: v. 使了解，使熟悉
definition: 1. v. make familiar or acquainted
example: The goal of the experiment was to familiarize the people with the new laws.
exampleZh: 该实验的目的是使人们熟悉新的规则。

meaning: n. 家，家庭；家属，亲属；家族；子女，孩子；（动植物的）科；语族；祖先； 一窝（动物）； 有组织的犯罪团伙；（具有明显共同特征的）一类东西；（在某些方面）像家人一样的一群人；（数）族；派别；氏族；adj. 家庭的；一家所有的；老少咸宜的；全家用的
definition: 1. n. a social unit living together；2. n. primary social group; parents and children
example: He's a black man, and he passes for his whole life as Jewish, and in doing so rejects his family.
exampleZh: 他是黑人，并以犹太人的身份度过一生，这样做受到了家人的反对。

meaning: n. 饥荒，饥馑；匮乏，短缺；饥饿
definition: 1. n. an acute insufficiency；2. n. a severe shortage of food (as through crop failure) resulting in violent hunger and starvation and death
example: So yet another threat to the promise is overcome: threat of famine is overcome by the relocation to Egypt.
exampleZh: 因此，另一个对承诺的威胁被克服了：,迁移至埃及克服了饥荒的威胁。

meaning: n. 风扇，扇子；粉丝，狂热爱好者；扇形；（使风车头迎风的）风叶；（山坡脚下的）地带；v. 扇，为……扇风；煽（火）；煽动，激起；（击球手）三击不中出局；（呼吸，微风）吹拂；驱散，扇走；击球不中；【名】 （Fan）（美、法、俄）法恩（人名）
definition: 1. n. a device for creating a current of air by movement of a surface or surfaces；2. v. strike out (a batter), (of a pitcher)
example: And my father is a big Frank Lloyd Wright fan, so we go all over the country to see his buildings.
exampleZh: 我老爸是弗兰克•劳埃德•赖特的忠实粉丝，所以我们跑遍了全国去看他的建筑。

meaning: v. 喜欢，想要； 爱恋，爱慕； 认为……会成功（赢）； 认为，想象；自负，自命不凡（fancy oneself）； （表示惊奇或震惊）真想不到，竟然；爱恋，爱慕（常用于英式口语中）； 喜欢，想要（常用于英式口语中）；爱恋，爱慕（常用于英式口语中）；认为……会成功（赢）；n. 喜欢，想要；想象，想象力，想象的事物； （无根据的）想法，空想；花色小蛋糕；（赛马或其他体育比赛中）最被看好的人（或动物）； 喜爱的人（或事物）；（16和17世纪音乐用语）幻想曲；（无根据的）想法，空想；adj. 时髦的，奢华的；华丽的，花哨的；复杂的，高难度的；（食品）特级的，优质的；娴熟的，巧妙的；（花）杂色的；（动物）供观赏的；（画，雕塑）凭想像创作的，想像出来的；【名】 （Fancy）范茜（人名）
definition: 1. n. something many people believe that is false；2. v. imagine; conceive of; see in one's mind
example: Genre" Is simply a fancy word for "Type" Or "Kind" so what genre of piece is this by Beethoven?
exampleZh: 风格,只是某种比种类或类别,更花哨的说法,那这首贝多芬作品属于什么风格呢

meaning: n. 幻想，想象；想象产物，幻想作品；虚拟比赛（游戏）；幻想曲，集成曲；期望；v. 想象，幻想
definition: 1. n. imagination unrestricted by reality；2. v. indulge in fantasies
example: I mentioned in the last lecture that the famous flower passage here of course is -- this is pure fantasy.
exampleZh: 我在上次上课时说过，这段非常著名的花之段落,是一种纯粹的幻想。

meaning: adj. 极好的，非常棒的；极大的，极高的；不切实际的，异想天开的；奇异的，怪诞的
definition: 1. adj. ludicrously odd；2. adj. extraordinarily good; used especially as intensifiers
example: That happened not too long ago, but it was just a really fantastic display of all his work.
exampleZh: 那是不久前的事情，但它真的极好地展示了他所有的作品。

meaning: adv. 远，遥远地；久远地；非常，很大程度上；发展，进展（到）；过分地；adj. 遥远的，久远的；另一边的，较远的；偏远的，极端的；【名】 （Far）（德、西、塞）法尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a terrorist organization that seeks to overthrow the government dominated by Tutsi and to institute Hutu control again；2. adj. at a great distance in time or space or degree
example: Thus far, for us it's been testing individual functions. Later in the term we'll talk about unit testing of classes.
exampleZh: 至今为止，我们用到单元测试的地方,就是测试每个单独的方法,在后面我们会讲到类的单元测试。

meaning: n. 交通费用；乘客；饭菜；常见的东西；供大众使用的东西（尤指娱乐活动）；v. 进展，表现； 发生，结果；出游，旅行；【名】 （Fare）（美）法勒（人名）
definition: 1. n. an agenda of things to do；2. v. proceed or get along
example: The taxi driver picked up a fare at the station.
exampleZh: 出租车司机在车站接了一名乘客。

meaning: n. 告别；离去；分别时的美好祝愿；adj. 告别的；v. 告别，欢送；int. 再见，一路顺风
definition: 1. n. an acknowledgment or expression of goodwill at parting；2. n. the act of departing politely
example: I bade farewell to all the friends I had made in Paris.
exampleZh: 我告别了我在巴黎结交的所有朋友。

meaning: n. 农场，养殖场；农舍；生产企业；v. 耕种，养殖；（收取一定费用）将（税收）包出；承包，外包
definition: 1. n. workplace consisting of farm buildings and cultivated land as a unit；2. v. be a farmer; work as a farmer
example: You move out to someplace that nobody bothered to farm before, because it wasn't profitable enough, because you need more land.
exampleZh: 你搬到一块以前没人耕作过的土地上,因为它并不是那么有利可图,但是你需要更多的土地

meaning: n. 农夫，农民，农场主；（Farmer，人名）法默（英），法尔梅（法），法梅尔（西）
definition: 1. n. a person who operates a farm；2. n. United States civil rights leader who in 1942 founded the Congress of Racial Equality (born in 1920)
example: At first glance, organic farming looks much more expensive for the farmer.
exampleZh: 乍一看，有机耕作对农民来说似乎昂贵得多。

meaning: n. 农业，农场经营；v. 耕种，养殖；（收取一定费用）将（税收）包出；承包，外包（farm 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. the practice of cultivating the land or raising stock；2. adj. relating to rural matters
example: And yeah, so that's what I'm minoring in, like gardening and farming stuff like that.
exampleZh: 那就是我正在辅修的课程，园艺和农业类的课程。

meaning: adv. 较远地，更远地；更进一步；此外，而且；adj. 较远的，更远的；另外的，更多的；另外的，更多的（far 的比较级形式）
definition: 1. adj. more distant in especially space or time；2. adv. to or at a greater extent or degree or a more advanced stage (`further' is used more often than `farther' in this abstract sense)
example: Today, the drilling is farther and farther away from the seashore.
exampleZh: 今天，钻机离海岸越来越远了。

meaning: v. （尤指蛇）以眼神震慑（人，动物），使无法动弹；深深吸引，迷住
definition: 1. v. cause to be interested or curious；2. v. to render motionless, as with a fixed stare or by arousing terror or awe
example: The private lives of movie stars never fail to fascinate.
exampleZh: 电影明星的私生活总为人所津津乐道。

meaning: adj. 极有吸引力的，迷人的；v. 深深吸引，迷住（fascinate 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. capable of arousing and holding the attention；2. adj. capturing interest as if by a spell
example: The exhibition tells the fascinating story of the steam age.
exampleZh: 展览讲述了蒸汽时代引人入胜的故事。

meaning: n. 入迷，着迷；魅力，令人着迷的事物
definition: 1. n. the state of being intensely interested (as by awe or terror)；2. n. a feeling of great liking for something wonderful and unusual
example: The fascination of the game lies in trying to guess what your opponent is thinking.
exampleZh: 这个游戏的魅力就在于要努力去猜对手在想什么。

meaning: n. 法西斯主义者；极右分子；独断专行的人；adj. 法西斯主义的，法西斯的
definition: 1. based on or supporting fascism；2. someone who supports fascism
example: The League of Nations' sanctions did not protect Abyssinia against fascist Italy.
exampleZh: 当年国联的制裁没能使阿比西尼亚（埃塞俄比亚的旧称）免遭意大利的入侵；

meaning: n. 法西斯主义；极端国家主义
definition: 1. a political system based on a very powerful leader, state control, and being extremely proud of country and race, and in which political opposition is not allowed
example: It is the 70th anniversary of both the world's anti-fascism war and the victory of China's Resistance War against Japanese Aggression this year.
exampleZh: 今年是世界反法西斯战争胜利70周年，也是中国人民抗日战争胜利70周年。

meaning: n. 时髦打扮，流行装扮；时尚，时兴；（做事的）方式；时装领域，时尚界；v. （尤指用手工）制作，使成形；塑造
definition: 1. n. how something is done or how it happens；2. v. make out of components (often in an improvising manner)
example: Bryant Park used to have fashion week there and that was like, a great meeting place for people there.
exampleZh: 布莱恩公园过去有时尚周，那里真的是个很适合与人见面的地方。

meaning: adj. 流行的，时髦的；有钱人光顾的
definition: 1. adj. being or in accordance with current social fashions；2. adj. having elegance or taste or refinement in manners or dress
example: Sure. I think that Columbus Circle is probably one of the most fashionable places in the city.
exampleZh: 当然可以。我觉得哥伦布环岛可能是这座城市里最时尚的地方之一。

meaning: adj. 快的，迅速的；系牢的，紧缚的；寻欢作乐的；不褪色的；忠实的，可靠的；adv. 快速地；坚定地，牢固地；v. 斋戒，禁食；n. 斋戒，斋戒期；【名】 （Fast）（英、德、俄、芬、捷、瑞典）法斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. abstaining from food；2. v. abstain from certain foods, as for religious or medical reasons
example: It gives you a lot of expressive convenience, you can write the programs much more cleanly, but most importantly, it's fast.
exampleZh: 你可以把一些程序写的更清楚，最重要的是，它的效率非常高。

meaning: v. 关紧，锁好（门窗）；（使）牢固，（使）固定；握住，咬住；盯住……不放，集中注意力于……；缠着，纠缠；系牢，扣紧；【名】 （Fasten）（英）法森（人名）
definition: 1. v. cause to be firmly attached；2. v. become fixed or fastened
example: When Ted was six we decided that he needed to know how to fasten and unfasten his seat belt.
exampleZh: 泰德六岁时，我们决定让他知道怎样系和解他的安全带。

meaning: adj. 肥的，肥胖的；厚的，宽的；巨额的；极少的，没有的；好打的，易中的；n. 脂肪，肥肉；食用油，烹调用油；多余的部分；v. （使）长肥；【名】 （Fat）（法、西、塞）法特，（东南亚国家华语）发（人名）
definition: 1. n. a soft greasy substance occurring in organic tissue and consisting of a mixture of lipids (mostly triglycerides)；2. v. make fat or plump
example: This is Virgil: "He should sing thin - spun lays and he should be content feeding his fat sheep."
exampleZh: 这是维吉尔的诗：“他哀唱着纤细的抒情诗“,“喂着肥硕的羊儿，他无比满足“

meaning: adj. 致命的；导致失败的，灾难性的；【名】 （Fatal）（葡、芬）法塔尔（人名）
definition: 1. adj. bringing death；2. adj. having momentous consequences; of decisive importance
example: But the last thing I remember I was going to bed from my fatal illness on the Isle of Elba.
exampleZh: 但我最后的记忆就是在厄尔巴岛的病榻上。

meaning: n. （灾难、事故中的）死亡；致命性；宿命
definition: 1. n. a death resulting from an accident or a disaster；2. n. the quality of being able to cause death or fatal disasters
example: For humans, hearing a sudden loud noise might prove frightening, but it does not induce mass fatality.
exampleZh: 对于人类来说，听到突然的巨响可能会令人恐惧，但它不会导致大规模死亡。

meaning: n. 命运；v. 注定；【名】 （Fate）（英）费特（人名）
definition: 1. n. an event (or a course of events) that will inevitably happen in the future；2. v. decree or designate beforehand
example: But the nymphs in all of their sensuous beauty, with "flow'r-inwov'n tresses," they have to experience the same fate.
exampleZh: 但是年轻女神很美丽，但头发被扯断了“,她们不得不经历同样的命运。

meaning: n. 父亲，爸爸；祖先；发明者，创始人；（Father）天父，上帝；（Father）（尤指天主教和东正教的）神父；父亲般的人；（城邦、市镇等的）元老；（动物的）父代；保护人，庇护人；（Father）（用于拟人化的专有名称）……老人；早期基督教神学家；v. 是……的父亲；创立（新思想），创造，发明（新方法）；如父亲般对待（或抚养、照料）；确定（某人）的生父为……，确定（某事物）的责任应由……来承担
definition: 1. n. a male parent (also used as a term of address to your father)；2. v. make children
example: He goes into the freak show at the fair, and he joins the crowd where his father also is.
exampleZh: 他去市集去看畸形秀，挤入了他父亲也身处其中的人群。

meaning: adj. 父亲般的，慈父般的
definition: 1. adj. like or befitting a father or fatherhood; kind and protective；2. adj. showing the affection of a father
example: Fatherly love is as deep and wide as the sea.
exampleZh: 父爱，如大海般深沉而宽广。

meaning: n. 疲乏，厌倦；（金属部件的）疲劳；（士兵穿的）工作服；士兵杂役（尤指作为惩罚,如做打扫、帮厨）；v. 使疲劳，使劳累；adj. 疲劳的
definition: 1. n. temporary loss of strength and energy resulting from hard physical or mental work；2. v. get tired of something or somebody
example: The wing of the plane showed signs of metal fatigue.
exampleZh: 机翼显示出金属疲劳的迹象。

meaning: n. 错误；责任，过错；缺点，故障；断层；发球失误；v. 挑剔，指责；发球失误；产生断层；犯错误，做错事
definition: 1. n. responsibility for a bad situation or event；2. v. put or pin the blame on
example: The other thing you want to do is find the part of the program that is most likely at fault.
exampleZh: 你们要做的另外一件事就是找出,最可能出错的那一部分代码。

meaning: adj. 有故障的，有缺陷的；（思维方法）有错误的
definition: 1. adj. characterized by errors；2. adj. having a defect
example: Well it happened because we clearly must have a faulty assumption This can't possibly be true.
exampleZh: 是因为做了,一个错误的,这不可能是真的。

meaning: v. 较喜欢，偏爱，偏袒；支持，赞同；有利于，有助于；（非正式）长得像（尤指亲属）；（尤指受伤部位）小心对待，爱护；（正式）赐予，给予；（固定搭配 curry favor (with)）讨好，巴结，拍马屁；n. 帮助，恩惠，善举；赞同，支持，好感（常用于 in favor of）；偏袒，偏爱；有利条件，好处，优势（常用于 in someone's favor）；聚会小礼品，赠品（常作 party favor）；（委婉，常作 favors）性恩惠，性方面的允诺；（旧）表示支持或爱慕的饰带，徽章
definition: 1. n. an act of gracious kindness；2. v. promote over another
example: Student: Wouldn't natural selection favor the people ? who learn all these things and then practically try to apply them?
exampleZh: 学生：自然选择会不会垂青,学习并践行这些知识的人？
family: favor / favour / favorable / favourable / favorite / favourite

meaning: adj. 有利的，顺利的，适宜的；赞成的，赞许的，肯定的；良好的，讨人喜欢的
definition: 1. adj. encouraging or approving or pleasing；2. adj. (of winds or weather) tending to promote or facilitate
example: The political scientist he says must have a grasp of the best regime given the most favorable circumstances.
exampleZh: 首先，政治科学家,必需要抓牢最佳政体,营造出最合意的情势；
family: favor / favour / favorable / favourable / favorite / favourite

meaning: adj. （美国英语）最受喜爱的，最中意的（同 favourite）；n. 受喜爱的人（或事物），最爱；（比赛或竞赛中）最有希望的获胜者，热门；（计算机、互联网）收藏夹；收藏项（如网页书签）；（Favorite）（美）费沃里特（人名）；v. （计算机、互联网）把……添加到收藏夹，收藏（网页等）
definition: 1. n. something regarded with special favor or liking；2. adj. appealing to the general public
example: But in the United States, I would say, most definitely, my favorite city, my favorite place I've ever been.
exampleZh: 但我十分确信，在美国，在我去过的城市和地方中，我最喜欢纽约。
family: favor / favour / favorable / favourable / favorite / favourite

meaning: n. 传真机；传真信件；传真；v. 传真（文档、信件等）；用传真与（某人）联系；【名】 （Fax）（美、瑞、巴、德）法克斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. duplicator that transmits the copy by wire or radio；2. v. send something via a facsimile machine
example: Can you send it to me by fax ?
exampleZh: 你能用传真把它发给我吗？

meaning: v. 害怕，畏惧；担心，忧虑；敬畏；n. 恐惧；担心；（坏事发生的）可能性；敬畏
definition: 1. n. an emotion experienced in anticipation of some specific pain or danger (usually accompanied by a desire to flee or fight)；2. v. be afraid or feel anxious or apprehensive about a possible or probable situation or event
example: And the disunited Canaanites put up little or no resistance: they're paralyzed by a fear that is sent by God.
exampleZh: 而被分解的迦南人几乎完全丧失抵抗力：,他们因为上帝送来的恐惧全面瘫痪。

meaning: adj. 害怕的，担心的；可怕的；极坏的，极端的
definition: 1. adj. causing fear or dread or terror；2. adj. lacking courage; ignobly timid and faint-hearted
example: They are fearful that unemployment will soon break the barrier of three million.
exampleZh: 他们担心失业人数不久将突破300万大关。

meaning: adj. 可行的，办得到的；很可能会发生的
definition: 1. adj. capable of being done with means at hand and circumstances as they are
example: She questioned whether it was feasible to stimulate investment in these regions.
exampleZh: 她质问在这些地区刺激投资是否可行。

meaning: n. 可行性，可能性
definition: 1. n. the quality of being doable
example: The committee will study the feasibility of setting up a national computer network.
exampleZh: 委员会将研究建立一个国家计算机网络的可行性。

meaning: n. 宴会，筵席；盛会，特别的享受；宗教节日；v. 饱餐，尽情享用；宴请，设宴招待（某人）
definition: 1. a special meal with very good food or a large meal for many people；2. something that is very enjoyable to see, hear, experience, etc.
example: They were happy to partake of our feast, but not to share our company.
exampleZh: 他们喜欢享用我们准备的丰盛大餐，但是不喜欢和我们呆在一起。

meaning: n. 功绩，壮举；武艺，技艺；adj. 合适的，灵巧的
definition: 1. something difficult needing a lot of skill, strength, courage, etc. to achieve it；2. an act that shows skill, strength, or bravery
example: The tower is being celebrated as a grand feat on the world stage.
exampleZh: 这座塔被誉为世界舞台上的一项伟大壮举。

meaning: n. 羽毛；v. 用羽毛装饰；长羽毛；使（螺旋桨）顺流交距；使（旋翼）周期变距；（划船）平掠回（桨）；如羽毛般浮动（或移动、飘动）；小心翼翼地把……混合起来（或把……弄平）；（油墨、口红等抹上后）化开，变模糊；【名】 （Feather）（英）费瑟（人名）
definition: 1. n. the light horny waterproof structure forming the external covering of birds；2. v. join tongue and groove, in carpentry
example: You've probably heard the phrase "Birds of a feather flock together" and that's true when it comes to romance.
exampleZh: 你们可能听过一个成语,物以类聚，人以群分“,恋爱还真是这样。

meaning: n. 特点，特征；五官，面貌（特征）；地貌；特写，专题节目；正片； 特点，特征；v. 以……为特色，以……为主要组成；起重要作用，占重要地位；放映，上演；担任主演
definition: 1. n. a prominent aspect of something；2. v. have as a feature
example: Now, the concept of ritual impurity was a central and integral feature of most, if not all, ancient religions.
exampleZh: 现在，仪式上的不洁已经是大部分宗教,主要的，整体而言的特点。

meaning: n. 二月
definition: 1. n. the month following January and preceding March
example: He welshed on his agreement with the team that he would play for them in February.
exampleZh: 他逃避履行他与球队合同中在二月为他们踢球的协议。

meaning: adj. 联邦（制）的；（与）联邦政府（有关）的；中央集权式的；（美国内战时期）北部联邦政府的；n. 联邦探员，联邦政府官员；（美国南北战争时期）北部联邦政府支持者；【名】 （Federal）（英）费德勒尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a member of the Union Army during the American Civil War；2. adj. national; especially in reference to the government of the United States as distinct from that of its member units
example: I'm also part of a variety of social service organizations which seek federal funding to carry out their programs.
exampleZh: 我还参与了各类社会服务组织,它们寻求获得联邦资金以施行其计划。

meaning: n. 联邦政府，联邦；联合会；结成联邦（或联盟）
definition: 1. n. an organization formed by merging several groups or parties；2. n. a union of political organizations
example: The shake-up aims to recast IBM as a federation of flexible and competing subsidiaries.
exampleZh: 此次改组旨在将IBM重组为一个灵活且相互竞争的子公司联盟。

meaning: n. 费用，酬金；会费，入场费；封地，采邑；v. 付给（某人）费用；【名】 （Fee）（英、柬）菲（人名）
definition: 1. n. a fixed charge for a privilege or for professional services；2. v. give a tip or gratuity to in return for a service, beyond the compensation agreed on
example: You can't just start mass producing these drugs without paying a licensing fee."
exampleZh: 你们不能就这样大规模生产,却不付任何专利费“

meaning: adj. 衰弱的，虚弱的；（光线或声音）微弱的；软弱的；无效的，不佳的
definition: 1. weak and without energy, strength, or power；2. not effective or good
example: Don't be so feeble! Tell her you don't want to go.
exampleZh: 别那么软弱了！告诉她你不想去。

meaning: v. 饲养，喂养，为……提供食物；以……为食物，吃食；提供（意见或信息等），灌输；施肥；添加燃料；把……放进机器，将……塞进机器；加深，强化；使（缓慢平稳地）移动，使穿过（有限的空间）；维持，满足（习惯）；传球；流入，进入；n. 哺乳，喂养；动物的饲料，植物的肥料；（机器的）进料装置；（机器、设备的）原料供给；（卫星或网络）转播，（信号）传输；（计算机）订阅源；（给舞台演员的）提词，提白；丰盛的一餐
definition: 1. n. food for domestic livestock；2. v. provide as food
example: You need to take a pragmatic approach, because in the beginning, we saw the portal companies, well, feed us.
exampleZh: 采取切实有效的方法，因为一开始，可以找到门户网站。

meaning: n. 反馈意见；（信号返回电子音响系统所致的）噪声；（返回机器、系统或者程序的）返回信息，返回电流
definition: 1. n. the process in which part of the output of a system is returned to its input in order to regulate its further output；2. n. response to an inquiry or experiment
example: Because I think it's always good to have a lot of feedback from students to see what's working,
exampleZh: 因为我觉得有很多学生的反馈是好的，可以判定什么是可行的，

meaning: v. 感受到，体会到；觉得，相信；使人感觉……；察觉到，意识到；触摸；受到；摸索；有知觉，能感知……；n. 感觉，气氛；触觉，手感；触摸；感知，理解；熟练使用；特性，特质
definition: 1. n. an intuitive awareness；2. v. undergo an emotional sensation
example: We feel as we process the world around us that we know things for and as what they are.
exampleZh: 我们觉得我们认识的事物,都是事物真实的本质。

meaning: n. 感觉，感触；预感；看法，态度；情感，情绪；理解力，领悟力；好感，同情；知觉；氛围；品质，特点；adj. 多愁善感的，多情的；v. 感受到，体会到；觉得，相信；使人感觉……(feel 的现在分词形式)
definition: 1. n. the experiencing of affective and emotional states；2. n. a vague idea in which some confidence is placed
example: So now I've got this gamma placed in there, -1 gamma minus 1, so I've ben feeling a little bit better.
exampleZh: 这样我把这里的指数，换成γ,这样看起来舒服一些。

meaning: n. 小伙子，家伙；同伴，同事，同学；研究员；男朋友；（研究期间领取津贴的）研究生；（大学的）董事；（学术或专业团体）会员；对等者，对手；adj. 同类的，同伴的；【名】 （Fellow）（美、英、印）费洛（人名）
definition: 1. n. a boy or man；2. n. a person who is frequently in the company of another
example: And so, Rutherford had a fellow working in his lab by the name of Geiger. And, Geiger invented a detector.
exampleZh: 卢瑟福的一个实验同事,叫做盖革，他发明了一种探测器。

meaning: n. 交情，友谊；（有相似爱好的）团体，协会，联谊会；（高等院校的）研究员； （研究生）奖学金；董事职位，会员资格；（决定奖学金人选的）奖学金评选组；特邀研究员（职位或项目）
definition: 1. n. an association of people who share common beliefs or activities；2. n. the state of being with someone
example: He managed to get a fellowship, and he came to the UK all the way from New Zealand.
exampleZh: 他设法获得了奖学金，从新西兰远道来到英国。

meaning: adj. 女性的，妇女的；女性特有的；由女性组成的；内孔的；雌性的，母的；雌蕊的；n. 雌性动物，雌性植物；女子
definition: 1. n. an animal that produces gametes (ova) that can be fertilized by male gametes (spermatozoa)；2. adj. being the sex (of plant or animal) that produces fertilizable gametes (ova) from which offspring develop
example: She writes, Woman's being created last will not be a very great argument to debase the dignity of the female sex.
exampleZh: 她写道，女性被后造出来并不能,为压制女性尊严做论证。

meaning: adj. 女性特有的，女子气的；女性的，妇女的；（语法）阴性的；n. （语法）阴性词，阴性形式
definition: 1. having characteristics that are traditionally thought to be typical of or suitable for a woman；2. belonging to the group of nouns that, in some languages, are not masculine or neuter
example: In most languages adjectives have slightly different spellings for masculine and feminine.
exampleZh: 在大多数语言中形容词对于阳性和阴性有略微不同的拼写。

meaning: n. 女权主义，男女平等主义；女权运动
definition: 1. the belief that women should be allowed the same rights, power, and opportunities as men and be treated in the same way, or the set of activities intended to achieve this state
example: Once we get to feminism, feminism will have certain ideas of its own about the vertical axis.
exampleZh: 当我们谈到女性主义时，女性主义都会对竖轴有自己的解读。

meaning: n. 女权主义者，女权运动者；adj. 女权主义的，支持女权运动的
definition: 1. a person who believes in feminism, and tries to achieve change that helps women to get equal opportunities and treatment；2. relating to feminism
example: She produced a feminist tract, "Comments on Birth-Control," in 1930.
exampleZh: 她1930年写了一篇女性主义短文《论计划生育》。

meaning: n. 篱笆，栅栏，围栏；（赛马中的）障碍物；买卖赃物者，销赃犯；剑术；（刨子、锯子或其他工具的）防护装置，导向装置；v. （用栅栏、篱笆或围栏）围住，隔开；击剑；巧妙回答，搪塞；出售（赃物）；防护，保卫
definition: 1. n. a barrier that serves to enclose an area；2. v. enclose with a fence
example: However, I believe that, although I'm kind of on the fence,
exampleZh: 尽管我现在不能做出认不认同的选择，但是

meaning: n. 渡船，摆渡；渡口；v. 摆渡，渡运；空运；【名】 （Ferry） （英、法、德、印尼）费里（人名）
definition: 1. n. a boat that transports people or vehicles across a body of water and operates on a regular schedule；2. v. transport from one place to another
example: The ferry is expected to dock at 6.
exampleZh: 渡船预计在6点停靠码头。

meaning: adj. 肥沃的，富饶的；可繁殖的，能结果的；能产生好结果的，促进的；点子多的，想象力丰富的；（核材料）能产生裂变物质的，增殖性的
definition: 1. adj. capable of reproducing；2. adj. intellectually productive
example: The operation cannot be reversed to make her fertile again.
exampleZh: 手术不可逆转，无法使她重获生育能力。

meaning: n. 肥沃，富饶；可繁殖性，生育能力；（思想的）丰富，多产
definition: 1. n. the ratio of live births in an area to the population of that area; expressed per 1000 population per year；2. n. the state of being fertile; capable of producing offspring
example: One study showed that even as few as ten cigarettes a day can damage fertility.
exampleZh: 一项研究表明，每天哪怕只抽10支烟也会损害生育能力。

meaning: n. 肥料，化肥；受精媒介物
definition: 1. n. any substance such as manure or a mixture of nitrates used to make soil more fertile
example: A top dressing of fertilizer should be added to improve growth as mint impoverishes the soil quickly.
exampleZh: 应施顶肥以促进生长，因为薄荷会使土壤迅速变得贫瘠。

meaning: n. 活动节期，纪念活动；节日，节庆；adj. 节日的，喜庆的
definition: 1. n. a day or period of time set aside for feasting and celebration；2. n. an organized series of acts and performances (usually in one place)
example: It's a free music and art festival, it will be 11 am to 7 pm, all day and night.
exampleZh: 这是一个免费的音乐艺术节，上午11点到晚上7点，一整天。

meaning: v. （去）拿来，（去）找来；售得，卖得；推导出，演绎出；吸引，迷住；抵达，到达；给（某人）以（重重的一击或一巴掌）
definition: 1. n. the action of fetching；2. v. go or come after and bring or take back
example: He went to fetch some books.
exampleZh: 他去取来了一些书。

meaning: n. 发烧，发热；狂热，高度兴奋；热病；v. 使发烧，使激动不已
definition: 1. n. a rise in the temperature of the body; frequently a symptom of infection；2. n. intense nervous anticipation
example: He died in 323, when he was not yet 33-years-old, and he died in Babylon of a fever, that is, of course, modern day Iraq.
exampleZh: 他死于公元前323年，未满33岁，在巴比伦死于疟疾，也就是现代伊拉克。

meaning: adj. 发烧的，发热的；狂热的，极度兴奋的
definition: 1. adj. marked by intense agitation or emotion；2. adj. of or relating to or characterized by fever
example: The war-like Glaucon would preside over what Socrates calls a feverish city, honors, competitions and above all war.
exampleZh: 好战的，Glaucon，将代表着,苏格拉底所谓的狂热之城，将荣誉、竞争与战争制度化的城市。

meaning: det. 一些，几个；很少，不多，几乎没有；pron. 一些人（或物）；很少的人（或物）；adj. 少数的；很少（的），几乎没有（的）；n. （尤指享有某种机遇等的）少数派，少数（the few） ；参加过不列颠之战的少数几个英国皇家空军飞行员（the Few）；【名】 （Few）（英）菲尤（人名）
definition: 1. n. an indefinite but relatively small number；2. adj. a quantifier that can be used with count nouns and is often preceded by `a'; a small but indefinite number
example: The optimates, meaning "the best," tended to support the interests of the wealthy senators and the few wealthiest families.
exampleZh: 贵族派，是指精英“,主张保护元老院议员的利益,以及少数富裕家庭。

meaning: n. 纤维，纤维材料（等于 fibre）；膳食纤维，粗纤维（食物中不能消化的植物性物质）；品质，骨气（常作 moral fiber）；光纤，光导纤维（optical fiber 的简称）；（Fiber）（匈）菲贝尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a slender and greatly elongated solid substance；2. n. the inherent complex of attributes that determine a persons moral and ethical actions and reactions
example: But, he built a scintillation screen, which is essentially a cloth fiber that was covered with zinc sulfide.
exampleZh: 他做的闪烁计数器，本质上是在纤维布上,覆盖硫化锌。

meaning: n. 小说；虚构的事，谎言；杜撰，编造
definition: 1. n. a literary work based on the imagination and not necessarily on fact；2. n. a deliberately false or improbable account
example: It had been my accidental reading of fiction and literary criticism that had invoked in me vague glimpses of life's possibilities.
exampleZh: 我偶尔会读小说和文学评述,这让我隐约地窥探到,生活的可能性，“

meaning: adj. 虚构的，小说（中）的
definition: 1. adj. related to or involving literary fiction；2. adj. formed or conceived by the imagination
example: They have a substantial reality within the fictional context, the mimetic context, of this epic. These are angels.
exampleZh: 他们在这篇史诗虚构的模仿得来的，内容中具有极大的现实意义，他们是天使。

meaning: n. 田地，田野；专业，领域；现场，实地；体育场；全体参赛者；矿场，油田；战场；视野；（物理）场；信息栏，字段；外场员，防守队；盾面，底；v. 组建，派出；担任守方；接（球），守（球）；处理，应付（问题或电话）；adj. 实地的，野外的；（军事装备）轻便机动的，战役用的；（比赛）田赛的；【名】 （Field）（英、法、德、葡）菲尔德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a piece of land cleared of trees and usually enclosed；2. v. catch or pick up (balls) in baseball or cricket
example: And so, when we took a field trip to go see the SF Chronicle, it was really, really sad.
exampleZh: 我们去《旧金山纪事报》的报社看过，发现他们真的很萧条。

meaning: adj. （动作或情感）强烈的，激烈的；（人或动物）凶猛的，狂怒的；（天气等）狂暴的，恶劣的；adv. 很，非常；【名】 （Fierce）（英）菲尔斯（人名）
