definition: 1. n. money that is risked for possible monetary gain；2. v. take a risk in the hope of a favorable outcome
example: Nala couldn't resist the opportunity to gamble, so the evil demon seduced him into gambling aggressively.
exampleZh: 那勒无法抵挡赌博的魅力,所以恶魔就诱使他痴迷赌博

meaning: n. 游戏，比赛；一局，一场；运动会；体育课，体育活动；儿戏；诡计，花招；猎物，野味；行当，行业；玩耍，消遣；比赛技巧；adj. 愿意尝试的，有冒险精神的；（腿）残疾的，瘸的；v. 操纵；玩视频（或电视、电脑）游戏；赌博；【名】 （Game）（英）盖姆，（法）加姆，（西）加梅（人名）
definition: 1. n. a single play of a sport or other contest；2. v. place a bet on
example: Almost any game you play has some kind of randomness or pseudorandomness which means that things change overtime somewhat unpredictably.
exampleZh: 大多数你所玩过的游戏都有某种,随机数或者伪随机数,这就意味着每个事件都存在不可预测性。

meaning: n. （青少年的）帮派，团伙；犯罪团伙；一群（体力劳动者）；一伙（常聚会的朋友）；（安装在一起的）一套开关，插座（或其他电气、机械装置）；v. 成群，结伙；将（电气设备或机器）连接，编组；【名】 （Gang）（英）甘，（法）冈，（罗）甘格（人名）
definition: 1. n. an association of criminals；2. v. act as an organized group
example: But like, seeing like, you know, stupid gang things written on bridges, it's like,
exampleZh: 但是，看到像是这样一些很愚蠢的写在桥上的东西，就像是……

meaning: n. 歹徒，匪徒
definition: 1. n. a criminal who is a member of gang
example: I had a hankering to see 1949's White Heat, the Jimmy Cagney flick where he plays gangster Cody Jarrett.
exampleZh: 我很想看1949年的《白热》，那是一部吉米·卡格尼主演的电影，他在其中饰演黑帮老大科迪·贾勒特。

meaning: n. 监狱；监禁（同 jail）；（Gaol）高娅乐（人名）；v. 把……投入监狱，监禁（同 jail）
definition: 1. n. a correctional institution used to detain persons who are in the lawful custody of the government (either accused persons awaiting trial or convicted persons serving a sentence)；2. v. lock up or confine, in or as in a jail
example: All were detained in the Salem Gaol, a grim edifice of granite blocks, iron-barred windows and brick-walled cells.
exampleZh: 所有人都被拘禁在萨勒姆监狱中，这是一座用花岗岩砌成、装有铁栅栏窗户和砖墙砌成的牢房构成的可怕建筑。

meaning: n. 缝隙，缺口；（时间上的）间隔；空白，缺漏；隔阂，差距
definition: 1. n. a conspicuous disparity or difference as between two figures；2. v. make an opening or gap in
example: The gap between the best and poorest childcare provision has widened.
exampleZh: 儿童保育供给的最佳和最低水准之间加大了差距。

meaning: n. 车库；加油站，汽车修理厂；车库音乐；v. 把……送入车库（或修车厂）；【名】 （Garage）（阿拉伯）贾拉杰（人名）
definition: 1. n. an outbuilding (or part of a building) for housing automobiles；2. v. keep or store in a garage
example: In the second line of Tony the Tow Truck, we learn that "I live in a little yellow garage."
exampleZh: 托运车托尼》第二行，写道“我住在一个黄色的垃圾箱里“

meaning: n. 垃圾，废物；垃圾箱；废话，无聊的东西；无用信息；【名】 （Garbage）（法）加尔巴热（人名）
definition: 1. n. food that is discarded (as from a kitchen)；2. n. a worthless message
example: And it's worthless, it's sheer garbage if it isn't supported by adequate kind of technique.
exampleZh: 如果没有足够的技巧的支持,一切都会变得毫无价值，变成彻头彻尾的垃圾。

meaning: n. 花园，菜园，果园；庭园；公园；（用于街名）街，广场；v. 做园艺工作，种植花木；【名】 (Garden）（英、意、巴基）加登（人名）
definition: 1. n. a plot of ground where plants are cultivated；2. v. work in the garden
example: And he would take me when I was a kid to basketball games at Madison Square Garden.
exampleZh: 他总会带着我这个小朋友去麦迪逊广场花园看比赛。

meaning: n. 园丁，花匠；园艺爱好者；园艺家；（Gardener）英语姓氏，加德纳
definition: 1. n. someone who takes care of a garden；2. n. someone employed to work in a garden
example: She herself was not a keen gardener.
exampleZh: 她本人就不是一个热衷于园艺的人。

meaning: n. 园艺，园艺活（在花园、菜园中栽培和养护花木的活动，不可数名词）
definition: 1. n. the cultivation of plants
example: And yeah, so that's what I'm minoring in, like gardening and farming stuff like that.
exampleZh: 那就是我正在辅修的课程，园艺和农业类的课程。

meaning: n. 大蒜；大蒜头；用于有相似气味的植物名中
definition: 1. a plant of the onion family that has a strong taste and smell and is used in cooking to add flavour
example: the cucumbers, the melons, the leeks, the onions, and the garlic.
exampleZh: 有黄瓜，西瓜，韭菜，葱，蒜。，…

meaning: n. （一件）衣服；【名】 （Garment）（英）加门特（人名）
definition: 1. n. an article of clothing；2. v. provide with clothes or put clothes on
example: The thicker the material, the less susceptible the garment will be to wet conditions.
exampleZh: 布料越厚，衣服通常就越不容易浸湿。

meaning: n. 气体；气体燃料；（手术）麻醉气；毒气，瓦斯；汽油；有趣的人（或事）；胀气，胃气；v. 用毒气杀死；闲聊，空谈；【名】 （Gas）（法、德、西）加斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. the state of matter distinguished from the solid and liquid states by: relatively low density and viscosity; relatively great expansion and contraction with changes in pressure and temperature; the ability to diffuse readily; and the spontaneous tendency to become distributed uniformly throughout any container；2. v. attack with gas; subject to gas fumes
example: I'm going to write it like this three moles of hydrogen which is a gas one bar 100 degrees Celsius.
exampleZh: 我会写成这样：,三摩尔氢分子，气体,1巴，100摄氏度。

meaning: n. 汽油（=gasolene）
definition: 1. n. a volatile flammable mixture of hydrocarbons (hexane and heptane and octane etc.) derived from petroleum; used mainly as a fuel in internal-combustion engines
example: I siphoned the gasoline out of the car into a can.
exampleZh: 我用虹吸管把汽车里的汽油抽到桶里。

meaning: v. （因惊讶或疼痛）喘气；n. 喘息，倒抽气
definition: 1. to take a short, quick breath through the mouth, especially because of surprise, pain, or shock；2. to breathe loudly and with difficulty, trying to get more air
example: At last, I hear a soft thud, a gasp, and silence.
exampleZh: 最后，我听到轻轻的砰的一声，一声喘息，然后是一片寂静。

meaning: n. 大门；登机口；闸门，阀门；（体育比赛的）观众人数；（体育比赛的）门票收入；comb. ……门事件（表示政治丑闻）(-gate)；【名】 （Gate）（英）盖特，（法、瑞典）加特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a movable barrier in a fence or wall；2. v. supply with a gate
example: And it's a really great experience. So that's pretty much what I associate Golden Gate Park with, for me.
exampleZh: 节日办得很不错。特别是对我这种常在金门公园附近溜达的人，是一种很好的体验。

meaning: vt.&vi. 聚集，召集；收集，采集；认为，推断；增加（速度、力量等）；给……打褶；收紧，拉近；【名】 （Gather）（德）加特（人名）
definition: 1. n. sewing consisting of small folds or puckers made by pulling tight a thread in a line of stitching；2. v. assemble or get together
example: Actually, I suppose to get ideally married under the open sky, under a Chuppah, gather people under the open sky.
exampleZh: 实际上，我理想中的婚礼就是,在户外的天空和犹太传统的彩棚下进行，人们聚集在蓝天下。

meaning: n. 聚集，聚会；搜集，采集；v. 聚集，召集；收集，采集；认为，推断（gather 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. a group of persons together in one place；2. n. the social act of assembling
example: In the first example, you could be at a social gathering and you really feel the need for some nicotine.
exampleZh: 在第一个例子中，你可能在一个社交聚会上，你特别想找个地方抽根烟。

meaning: n. 测量仪器；宽度，厚度；（测量或判断的）尺度，标准；（铁道的）轨距；（枪管的）口径；（汽车）胎压计；v. 估计，判断；测量
definition: 1. to calculate an amount, especially by using a measuring device；2. to make a judgment about something, usually people's feelings
example: Tomorrow's game against Arsenal will be a good gauge of their promotion chances.
exampleZh: 明天与阿森纳队的比赛是衡量他们能否升级的很好的依据。

meaning: adj. 同性恋的；艳丽的；快乐的；品质差的，没有意义的；n. 同性恋者（尤指男性）；【名】 （Gay）（英、法、瑞典、毛里塔）盖伊，（西）加伊（人名）
definition: 1. n. someone who practices homosexuality; having a sexual attraction to persons of the same sex；2. adj. bright and pleasant; promoting a feeling of cheer
example: So I think that gay marriage and for gay families, it's actually a very good thing in our society
exampleZh: 所以我认为同性恋婚姻以及同性恋家庭对社会是件好事情，

meaning: v. 凝视，注视；n. 凝视，注视；特定视角，特定角度；【名】 （Gaze）（俄、意）加泽，（德）加策（人名）
definition: 1. n. a long fixed look；2. v. look at with fixed eyes
example: He is startled to see: The moon's full gaze on me.
exampleZh: 他见到这些都十分惊诧：,月亮死死的盯着我。，…

meaning: n. 排挡，齿轮；（用于特定目的的）装备，服装；（做事的）速度，努力；（特定用途的）器械，装置；毒品；所有物，财物；v. 使变速，使调挡；【名】 （Gear）（英）吉尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a toothed wheel that engages another toothed mechanism in order to change the speed or direction of transmitted motion；2. v. set the level or character of
example: So in the summer of 2001, we decided to switch gear from a backend technology provider to a front-end consumer-oriented search service.
exampleZh: 于是在2001年夏，公司决定从后台技术提供者,转变为直接面向消费者的搜索服务提供方。

meaning: n. 性别；（语法中的）性；（总称）男性，女性
definition: 1. n. a grammatical category in inflected languages governing the agreement between nouns and pronouns and adjectives; in some languages it is quite arbitrary but in Indo-European languages it is usually based on sex or animateness；2. n. the properties that distinguish organisms on the basis of their reproductive roles
example: Gender differences, he says, are no more relevant when it comes to positions of political rule being bald and being hairy.
exampleZh: 他表示，当性别差异,放到政治支配的位置时,秃发与多发间的区别无关。

meaning: n. 基因，遗传因子
definition: 1. n. (genetics) a segment of DNA that is involved in producing a polypeptide chain; it can include regions preceding and following the coding DNA as well as introns between the exons; it is considered a unit of heredity
example: And if you could change the gene and make people not gay in the womb should have been done.
exampleZh: 如果人们能够改变这种基因,让同性恋们在母体内就改变性取向,那么这种认定就应该进行。

meaning: adj. 基因的，遗传学的；有共同起源的
definition: 1. adj. tending to occur among members of a family usually by heredity；2. adj. of or relating to or produced by or being a gene
example: Genetic scans for disease predictions, and we talked about one way you might do that using gene chips.
exampleZh: 基因扫描技术可用于预测疾病,我们讨论的基因芯片技术是其中的一种

meaning: adv. 基因地，遗传地
definition: 1. adv. by genetic mechanisms
example: I was born with,genetically speaking, relatively high level of anxiety, inclination toward rumination, we'll talk about that later in the course.
exampleZh: 从遗传学上讲，我天生就，比较容易焦虑，容易得抑郁症，在后面的课程上我们会谈到。

meaning: adj. 总体的，普遍的；一般的，常规的；大致的，大概的；综合的，广泛的；首席的，总管的；n. 上将，将军；半军事化管理的宗教组织（如耶稣会修士、多明我会修士或救世军）的领袖；大众，公众；【名】 （General）（英）杰纳勒尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a general officer of the highest rank；2. v. command as a general
example: It began to infiltrate other disciplines and was in general a high-spirited horse for that certain period of time.
exampleZh: 它逐渐渗入到其它学科,总之是那个时代的一匹黑马。

meaning: adv. 笼统地，大概；通常，普遍地
definition: 1. adv. usually; as a rule；2. adv. without distinction of one from others
example: So things can be dangerous. But generally, if you're smart, I think it's a very safe place to live.
exampleZh: 因此，危险还是存在的。但大多数情况下，只要你精明点，我认为那儿还是一个非常安全的居住地。

meaning: v. 概括，归纳；推广，普及；笼统地表达
definition: 1. v. draw from specific cases for more general cases；2. v. speak or write in generalities
example: Critics love to generalize, to formulate trends into which all new work must be fitted, however contradictory.
exampleZh: 评论家喜欢概括，归纳出所有新作品都必须符合的趋势，不管它们是如何地不符。

meaning: v. 产生，引起
definition: 1. v. bring into existence；2. v. give or supply
example: The paradox of exercise is that while using a lot of energy it seems to generate more.
exampleZh: 锻炼的矛盾之处在于消耗很多能量却似乎又产生更多能量。

meaning: n. 发电机；产生者；电力公司；母点，母线，母面
definition: 1. n. an apparatus that produces a vapor or gas；2. n. engine that converts mechanical energy into electrical energy by electromagnetic induction
example: He brought it down, hooked it up, and we got the generator going.
exampleZh: 他把它放倒，连接好，然后我们让发电机开始运转。

meaning: n. 一代（人）；一代人的时间；（产品发展的）代；产生
definition: 1. n. all the people living at the same time or of approximately the same age；2. n. group of genetically related organisms constituting a single step in the line of descent
example: where all the beats, the b-generation in the 50s gathered and they used to sell banned books.
exampleZh: 那里全是50年代时的反传统一代留下的书，那些书当时是禁书。

meaning: adj. 慷慨的，大方的；大量的，丰富的；宽宏大量的
definition: 1. adj. willing to give and share unstintingly；2. adj. not petty in character and mind
example: The poor should be working. But you can assist them with loans, according to Deuteronomy. And these should be generous.
exampleZh: 根据《申命记》所说，穷人应该工作，但你可以，通过借贷资助他们，这应该也是慷慨的行为。

meaning: n. 慷慨，大方
definition: 1. n. the trait of being willing to give your money or time；2. n. acting generously
example: Altruism" is the biologists' term meaning kindness,generosity, and evolutionary biologists have worked really hard to explain why animals might evolve to be kind.
exampleZh: 利他主义是生物学术语,意思是善良，慷慨，进化生物学家努力去解释,为什么动物进化趋向善良。

meaning: n. 天赋，天资；天才，智商很高的人；（擅长做某事的）高手；精华，精髓；对某人有很大好（或坏）影响的人；（神话中某个人、地方或机构的）守护神；（民族或时代的）普遍特征；adj. 天才的
definition: 1. n. someone who has exceptional intellectual ability and originality；2. n. unusual mental ability
example: The genius of Fish's reading of Milton's similes is to understand the particularly time-bound nature of Milton's verse.
exampleZh: 费什解读弥尔顿的比喻的天赋,能够帮助我们理解弥尔顿的韵诗在特定时代下的本质。

meaning: n. 体裁，类型；风俗画；adj. 属于某类型的，按某种风格创作的；【名】 （Genre）（法）让尔（人名）
definition: 1. a style, especially in the arts, that involves a particular set of characteristics；2. produced according to a particular model or style
example: So we looked last time at the oddity, the peculiarity, of Milton's choice of genre here, the pastoral genre.
exampleZh: 所以我们最后一次来研究弥尔顿选择的，田园诗流派里的古怪和特性。

meaning: adj. 文静的，温柔的；（动作）轻柔的，徐缓的；（坡度）平缓的，不陡的；微热的；出身高贵的，品格高尚的；v. 使（或变）温柔，（使）平静；使驯服；n. 蛆，饵；【名】 （Gentle）（英）金特尔（人名）
definition: 1. v. cause to be more favorably inclined; gain the good will of；2. adj. soft and mild; not harsh or stern or severe
example: Now, we are very gentle in this course with respect to knowing integrals, but this is one you have to know.
exampleZh: 这门课对积分,的要求并不高，但这个积分你们必须会算。

meaning: n. （称呼或指男子，尤其是不认识的）先生；彬彬有礼的人，有教养的人；有身份的人，富绅；（古时用语）出身高贵的男子；（对立法机构男性议员的称呼）先生，阁下
definition: 1. n. a man of refinement；2. n. a manservant who acts as a personal attendant to his employer
example: It wasn't true for the gentleman who's sitting there now, but it was true for a lot of people.
exampleZh: 但坐在那边的先生不是这样,但对很多人就是这样

meaning: adj. 真正的，非伪造的；真诚的，真心的
definition: 1. adj. not fake or counterfeit；2. adj. not pretended; sincerely felt or expressed
example: Reading it, however, with a perfect contempt for it, one discovers in it after all, a place for the genuine.
exampleZh: 然心存轻视读之，则觉真实从然出之。

meaning: n. 地理，地理学；地形，地貌；地理环境
definition: 1. n. study of the earth's surface; includes people's responses to topography and climate and soil and vegetation
example: The title of that book, published in 1914, and the one that more than any other made him famous, locates his subjects in a specific geography.
exampleZh: 这本书的名称，1914年出版，是这本书让他出名的，把他的主题放在一个具体的地理位置上。

meaning: adj. 地理的，地理学的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to the science of geography；2. adj. determined by geography
example: Geographic isolation also can proceed slowly, over great spans of time.
exampleZh: 地理隔离也可能在很长一段时间内进展都非常缓慢。

meaning: adv. 在地理上，地理学上
definition: 1. adv. with respect to geography
example: In order to avoid any conflict, we would need to ensure that both marketing campaigns do not overlap geographically.
exampleZh: 为了避免任何冲突，我们需要确保两个营销活动在地理上不重叠。

meaning: n. 地质学；地质状况
definition: 1. n. a science that deals with the history of the earth as recorded in rocks
example: He was visiting professor of geology at the University of Georgia.
exampleZh: 他曾是佐治亚大学的地质学客座教授。

meaning: adj. 地质的，地质学的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to or based on geology
example: With geological maps, books, and atlases you can find out all the proven sites of precious minerals.
exampleZh: 有了地质地图、书籍和地图册，你就可以找到所有已探明的珍贵矿藏的位置。

meaning: adv. 从地质学角度
definition: 1. adv. with respect to geology
example: Cases in which many species become extinct within a geologically short interval of time are called mass extinctions.
exampleZh: 许多物种在地质上很短的时间间隔内灭绝的情况称为大灭绝。

meaning: n. 几何，几何学；几何形状，几何构造；几何体系
definition: 1. n. the pure mathematics of points and lines and curves and surfaces
example: Suppose I want to do little piece of code that's going to do planar geometry, points in the plane.
exampleZh: 好，因此我需要一些,把这些东西收集到，一起的一些方式。

meaning: adj. 几何图形的；几何的，几何学的；（与）英国早期花格窗饰（有关）的；n. 几何图形，几何模型
definition: 1. adj. characterized by simple geometric forms in design and decoration；2. adj. of or relating to or determined by geometry
example: And he defined the average in terms of not the sum divided by two, but he chose the geometric mean.
exampleZh: 鲍林定义平均并不是,简单相加在除以二，他选择几何平均。

meaning: adv. 在几何学上，用几何学方法；按几何级数地
definition: 1. adv. with respect to geometry；2. adv. in a geometric fashion
example: In early, fat times, their Numbers grow geometrically.
exampleZh: 初期的好日子里，他们的数量以几何级数增加。

meaning: n. 病菌，细菌；起源，萌芽；极少量；胚芽，胚胎
definition: 1. n. anything that provides inspiration for later work；2. n. a small apparently simple structure (as a fertilized egg) from which new tissue can develop into a complete organism
example: A motive is just a little cell, a germ, out of which the composer will build other musical material.
exampleZh: 动机只是个小小的细胞，一个胚芽，作曲家将从中创造出其他的音乐素材。

meaning: n. 手势，姿势；姿态，表示；V. 打手势，用动作示意
definition: 1. n. motion of hands or body to emphasize or help to express a thought or feeling；2. v. show, express or direct through movement
example: So every gesture of the hand is going to be the equivalent of a quarter note.
exampleZh: 那么,每个手部的动作,都相当于一个四分音符

meaning: v. 收到，接到；获得，得到；挣得，赚得；去取，去带来；买；得（病），患（病）；遭受……之苦；变成，变得；形成（想法、感觉）；促使，使得；使开始，使进展；得以做，有机会做；到达；达到（某一点或某一阶段）；移动，去；理解，明白；有，经历；做（饭）；搭乘，乘坐；接（电话），应（门铃）；与……通电话；捕获，抓获；袭击，打伤，杀死；使恼火，使难过；使困惑，难住；接收（电视广播信号）；受到（惩罚）；注意到；n. （说话人）讨厌（或鄙夷）的人；（动物的）后代
definition: 1. n. a return on a shot that seemed impossible to reach and would normally have resulted in a point for the opponent；2. v. come into the possession of something concrete or abstract
example: Especially because some, some advanced degrees that you get, you pay a lot of money to get them,
exampleZh: 尤其是因为，有些高级学位，为了获得它你花了很多钱。

meaning: n. 鬼，幽灵；（尤指对可怕事物的）记忆，回忆；一丝，一点；（电视或计算机屏幕上的）重像，重影；v. 代人写作，为人代笔；（平稳不费力地）滑行；作祟于
definition: 1. n. a mental representation of some haunting experience；2. v. move like a ghost
example: She's the editor of a new collection of ghost stories.
exampleZh: 她编了一部新版鬼故事集。

meaning: n. （传说中的）巨人；高大健壮的人；巨兽，巨型植物；大公司，大国；卓越人物，伟人；（天文）巨星；adj. 巨大的，伟大的
definition: 1. n. any creature of exceptional size；2. adj. of great mass; huge and bulky
example: And they have like a giant Christmas tree and a menorah and a bunch of other things, so.
exampleZh: 到时候会有巨大的圣诞树、蜡烛，等等之类的都有。

meaning: adj. 巨大的，庞大的
definition: 1. adj. so exceedingly large or extensive as to suggest a giant or mammoth
example: In Red Rock Valley the road is bordered by gigantic rocks.
exampleZh: 在红岩谷，道路两边都是巨大的岩石。

meaning: n. 礼物，赠品；恩赐，授予；轻而易举的事，绝对不会错失的机会；才能，天赋；v. 赠送；（无意中）让（对手）获得；【名】 （Gift）（英）吉夫特（人名）
definition: 1. n. something acquired without compensation；2. v. give qualities or abilities to
example: But the Lady is hoarding that natural gift just as that unprofitable servant had buried his talent in the earth.
exampleZh: 但小姐隐藏了大自然的礼物,就好像仆人在世上埋没了他的才华。

meaning: adj. 有天赋的，有才华的；聪慧的，有特长的；v. 赠送；（无意中）让（对手）获得（gift 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. endowed with talent or talents
example: He was a natural politician, a gifted orator who knew how to work a crowd.
exampleZh: 他曾是位天生的政治家，是位有天赋且知道如何凝集民众的演说家。

meaning: v. 咯咯地笑，傻笑；n. 轻笑，傻笑；有趣的人（或事），笑话；止不住的咯咯笑
definition: 1. to laugh repeatedly in a quiet but uncontrolled way, often at something silly or rude or when you are nervous；2. a nervous or silly laugh
example: Several students began to giggle when the professor unexpectedly forgot the name of his own book.
exampleZh: 教授意外忘记自己书名时，几名同学开始咯咯笑起来。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 女孩；姑娘，年轻女子，未婚女子；（常与物主限定词连用）女儿；（非正式）（男人的）女朋友；（旧或用于复合词）女职员，女演员
definition: 1. n. a young woman；2. n. a youthful female person
example: Not with this girl, this girl is perfect. But in the past, I've had lots of problems with roommates.
exampleZh: 和这个女孩没吵过，她太完美了。但在过去，我和室友之间存在很多问题。

meaning: v. 给，交给；赠送，赠与，送给；提供，供给；捐赠；支付，付款；将（时间、精力等）用于；举办，举行；表演，公开进行；允许；使产生（某种感觉）；使拥有（某一特性）；生产，引起；给（某人）打（电话）；告诉，说出，说明；给……评定（等级）；（把药等）注入，服入；看待，承认；做（动作）；传染；使受惩罚，让（某人）做；作出（决定或判决）；预计将持续（时间）；伸长，弯曲，断裂；让步，妥协；表示一种可能的情况或状态；n. 伸展性，弹性；适应（或顺应）能力，灵活性；【名】 （Give）（意）吉韦（人名）
definition: 1. n. the elasticity of something that can be stretched and returns to its original length；2. v. cause to have, in the abstract sense or physical sense
example: It's a fairly recent understanding of Maybe you can just give us a little time line of what human rights means.
exampleZh: 这是一个新近的理解,也许你可以先给我们一个时间线索,讲讲人权含义的演变。

meaning: adj. 规定的，指定的；倾向于；（文件）（已在某日期由某人）签署的；赠送的；假定的，假设的；prep. 考虑到；如果，倘若；n. 假定事实；v. 给予（give 的过去分词形式）；【名】 （Given）（英、土）吉文（人名）
definition: 1. n. an assumption that is taken for granted；2. adj. acknowledged as a supposition
example: And Pauli says no two electrons in a given system can have the entire set of quantum numbers identical.
exampleZh: 而泡利认为在一个给定的系统内,没有两个电子有完全相同的量子数。

meaning: n. 冰河，冰川
definition: 1. a large mass of ice that moves slowly
example: A liquid layer forms at the base of the glacier.
exampleZh: 在冰川的底部形成了一层液体。

meaning: adj. 高兴的；感激的；乐意的，非常愿意的；令人愉快的，充满欢乐的；v. 取悦，使高兴；n. 唐菖蒲属植物，唐菖蒲；【名】 （Glad） （英）格莱德，（塞、瑞典）格拉德，（法、挪）格拉（人名）
definition: 1. n. any of numerous plants of the genus Gladiolus native chiefly to tropical and South Africa having sword-shaped leaves and one-sided spikes of brightly colored funnel-shaped flowers; widely cultivated；2. adj. showing or causing joy and pleasure; especially made happy
example: And your friend is saying, "Oh, I'm so glad to be here." "This is so beautiful, so glorious."
exampleZh: 你的朋友说，“哦，我真高兴能来这儿。”“这里这么漂亮，这么气势恢弘。”

meaning: n. 魅力，迷人的美（等于 glamour）；（文学或历史用法）魔法，魔力；vt. （罕用）迷惑；使有魅力（等于 glamour）
definition: 1. another US spelling of glamour
example: The documentary strips away the glamour of professional sport and reveals the exhausting routines behind public success.
exampleZh: 这部纪录片揭开了职业体育的光鲜外表，展现了公众成功背后令人疲惫的日常。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: adj. 迷人的，富有魅力的
definition: 1. attractive in an exciting and special way；2. exciting and attractive
example: Smoking is still attractive to many young people who see it as glamorous.
exampleZh: 吸烟仍然对很多年轻人有诱惑力，他们将之视为魅力标志。

meaning: v. 一瞥，看一眼；浏览；击中.......后弹开，擦过；反光， 闪烁；（球类运动用语）轻擦，轻抹（球，以调整其方向）；斜击（球）；提到，影射；n. 一瞥，很快的一看；（光的）闪烁，闪耀；（板球）斜击；（铅、铜或其他金属的）辉矿类，硫化矿类；（光的）闪烁，闪耀；【名】 （Glance） （美、俄、澳）格兰斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a quick look；2. v. throw a glance at; take a brief look at
example: So if you haven't already, just glance at the person next to you, or say hello if you don't know them.
exampleZh: 如果你还没有做好，那就看看你旁边的人,如果你不认识他们就跟他们打个招呼。

meaning: n. 腺；密封套
definition: 1. an organ of the body or of a plant that secretes (= produces) liquid chemicals that have various purposes；2. an organ of the body that produces chemicals that influence activities such as growth, and that has an important effect on health
example: For example, hormones from the hypothalamus in the brain stimulate the anterior lobe of the pituitary gland.
exampleZh: 例如，来自大脑下丘脑的激素会刺激垂体前叶。

meaning: v. 怒视，瞪眼；发出刺眼的强光，闪耀；n. 刺眼的强光；怒视；密切关注；耀眼（或炫耀的）外表，俗艳
definition: 1. a long, angry look；2. unpleasantly bright or strong light
example: The glare from the screen made it difficult for drivers to see the road ahead.
exampleZh: 屏幕发出的强光使司机难以看清前方的道路。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 玻璃；玻璃杯；一杯之量；玻璃器皿，玻璃制品；玻璃保护面；眼镜，透镜；镜子；（计时）沙漏；气压表，晴雨表；v. 用玻璃覆盖，给……装玻璃；（尤指在打猎时）用望远镜观察（周围环境）；用啤酒杯打（某人的脸）；反映；成玻璃状；【名】 （Glass） （英、法、德、意）格拉斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a brittle transparent solid with irregular atomic structure；2. v. furnish with glass
example: So we'll take h 2 and we'll run -- or actually we'll have h 2 filled in an evacuated glass tube.
exampleZh: 我们马上就会在氢原子上试一试,我们用氢气-我们把玻璃管充满氢气。

meaning: v. 发微光，闪烁；显得光洁明亮；（眼睛）表露出，流露出；（因兴奋而眼睛）发光，发亮；n. 反光，闪光；微光，一丝光线；少量，一线；（情感等的）闪现；（指暂时还不能实现的）想法，愿望
definition: 1. to produce or reflect a small, bright light；2. When eyes gleam, they shine in a way that expresses a particular emotion
example: There was a gleam of legs, and instantly the lagoon seemed deserted.
exampleZh: 腿部一闪而过，礁湖瞬间就显得空无一人。

meaning: v. 滑行，滑动；滑翔；做事顺利；悄悄地走，流逝；n. 滑动，滑行；（滑翔机或无动力飞机的）飞行，滑翔；滑音，延音；（尤指向腿侧的）斜击
definition: 1. to move easily without stopping and without effort or noise；2. to move or progress without difficulty or effort
example: That is what makes metal so fascinating, because metallic bonding allows the atoms to glide over one another without resulting in catastrophic failure.
exampleZh: 所以这就使得金属具有了特别的性质，因为金属键使得原子可以,在彼此之间流动,而不会千万灾难性的后果。

meaning: n. 滑翔机；滑翔员，滑行物；（长廊处的）摆动式长躺椅
definition: 1. an aircraft that has long fixed wings and no engine and flies by gliding
example: He said that if both engines of the plane had failed, the aircraft would become like a "glider".
exampleZh: 他说，如果飞机的两个引擎都失灵了，飞机就会变成一个“滑翔机”。

meaning: n. 一瞥，一看；短暂的感受，短暂的体验；v. 瞥见；开始理解；闪烁，隐约出现
definition: 1. n. a quick look；2. v. catch a glimpse of or see briefly
example: Some of the fans had waited 24 hours outside the hotel to catch a glimpse of their heroine.
exampleZh: 某些追星族为了一睹女杰的风采已在宾馆外守候了24小时。

meaning: v. 闪光，闪烁；（某种强烈的感情）闪现，流露；n. 闪耀；（某种感情的）闪现，流露；奢华，华丽；（装饰用的）闪亮小物件
definition: 1. to produce a lot of small, bright flashes of reflected light；2. If someone's eyes glitter, they look bright and express strong feeling
example: There was stage smoke and glitter grit on the runway.
exampleZh: 秀场T台上弥漫着舞台烟雾，还散落着亮片碎粒。

meaning: n. 地球，世界；地球仪；球体，球状物；v. （使）成球状
definition: 1. n. the 3rd planet from the sun; the planet we live on；2. n. an object with a spherical shape
example: Dr. Russel is creating an elite herd by cross-breeding goats from around the globe.
exampleZh: 罗素博士正在通过使来自世界各地的山羊杂交而创造一种精品羊群。

meaning: adj. 全球的，全世界的；全面的，整体的；（计算机）全局的；球形的
definition: 1. adj. involving the entire earth; not limited or provincial in scope；2. adj. having the shape of a sphere or ball
example: On a global scale, 77% of energy is created from fossil fuels.
exampleZh: 全球77%的能量产生自化石燃料。

meaning: v. （使）全球化
definition: 1. v. make world-wide in scope or application
example: One way to lower costs will be to forge alliances with foreign companies or to expand internationally through appropriate takeovers – in short, to "globalize."
exampleZh: 降低成本的途径之一将是与外国公司结成联盟或通过适当的兼并进行国际性扩张–简言之，就是“全球化”。

meaning: n. 忧郁，绝望；昏暗，幽暗；v. 外观昏暗；显得萧条（或消沉）
definition: 1. n. a state of partial or total darkness；2. n. a feeling of melancholy apprehension
example: "I wish I did," said Phil Jordan, relapsing into his usual gloom.
exampleZh: “我要是做了就好了，”菲尔•乔丹说着，回到平时的忧郁中。

meaning: adj. 阴暗的，幽暗的；沮丧的，悲伤的；前景黯淡的，悲观的
definition: 1. adj. characterized by hopelessness; filled with gloom；2. adj. causing dejection
example: He just keeps on. Bogdanovich reports him being very gloomy about the time the documentary was made, because how he was treated by the profession.
exampleZh: 他一直在奋斗，博格达诺维奇说,他在纪录片拍出来的时候,情绪很低，这都是因为他在事业上受到的对待。

meaning: n. 光荣，荣誉；（对上帝的）赞颂；壮丽，辉煌；值得称赞的事，引以为豪的成就；欣喜；天堂的荣耀（或福祉）；（尤指耶稣基督或圣人头顶的）光环，光轮；v. （因某事而）欣喜；自豪，得意；【名】 （Glory）（法）格洛里（人名）
definition: 1. n. a state of high honor；2. v. rejoice proudly
example: I do all the work and he gets all the glory.
exampleZh: 活儿都是我干，荣誉都是他得。

meaning: adj. 光荣的，值得称道的；辉煌的，绚丽的；极其愉快的；（天气）阳光灿烂的
definition: 1. adj. having or deserving or conferring glory；2. adj. having or worthy of pride
example: The award of the Nobel Prize has crowned a glorious career in physics.
exampleZh: 荣获诺贝尔奖使其物理学研究的辉煌事业达到了顶点。

meaning: n. 词汇表，术语表；专门词典
definition: 1. an alphabetical list, with meanings, of the words or phrases in a text that are difficult to understand
example: Avoid redundancy: Define an item in the glossary or in the domain model, but not in both.
exampleZh: 避免冗余：在术语表或域模型中定义一个条目，但是不要在两者里面都下定义。

meaning: n. （分手指的）手套；（拳击、棒球等所用的）加垫防护手套；v. 给……戴手套；（比赛中用戴手套的手）接（球）
definition: 1. n. the handwear used by fielders in playing baseball；2. n. handwear: covers the hand and wrist
example: He bit the fingers of his right glove and pulled it off.
exampleZh: 他咬住右手手套的指套，把它扯了下来。

meaning: v. 发出微弱而稳定的光；（脸部或身体）发红，发热；喜形于色，容光焕发；发出艳丽色彩；n. 微弱稳定的光；（脸部或身体发出的）红润光泽；兴高采烈；金色，红色；灼热；【名】 （Glow）（美）格楼（人名）
definition: 1. n. an alert and refreshed state；2. v. emit a steady even light without flames
example: There was no light except for the occasional glow of a cigarette.
exampleZh: 除偶尔有香烟的微弱红光外没有一点亮光。

meaning: n. 胶水；凝聚力；v. 胶合，粘贴；专注于
definition: 1. n. cement consisting of a sticky substance that is used as an adhesive；2. v. join or attach with or as if with glue
example: What better suggestion is there for what we could point to as the metaphysical glue, ? the key to personal identity?
exampleZh: 还有什么更好的东西,我们可以用来,作为形而上粘质，作为人格同一性的关键？

meaning: v. 去，走；（尤指与某人）去（某处或出席某项活动）；可能要，打算做；移动，行走；在移动中做；做某个动作；离开；（为某目的）去（某处）；去做（某事）；被发送，被传递；参加（电视或电台节目）；通向，延伸到；上升；放在（通常的位置上）；放得进，适合；相配，协调；除尽，除；进行，进展；被接受，被允许；开始做（某事），进入（某种状态）；变为，变得（尤指朝坏的方面）；处于（尤指令人不快的状况）；（故事、歌词等）内容是；发出（某种声音）；发出信号（或警告）；说；开始（活动）；走开，滚开；参与（表示对所提到行为不赞成）；运转，工作；停止正常运转；消失，不见；得辞掉，被扔掉；（官能）衰退，下降；死亡；用掉，花掉；卖掉，归于；出价购买；促成，显示；流逝，消逝；继续，持续；上厕所；（某人的话）算数；（决定、判决等）对…...不利；取得（某成绩、比分等）；n. （游戏或活动中）轮到的机会；尝试；精力，活力；某事顺利进行；围棋；adj. 运行正常的
definition: 1. n. a time for working (after which you will be relieved by someone else)；2. v. change location; move, travel, or proceed
example: I like the idea of... after seeing that movie, it makes you afraid to go home and go to sleep,
exampleZh: 看完那部电影后，我就喜欢上了那种创作，它让观众不敢回家上床睡觉，

meaning: n. 球门；进球得分；目标，目的；（旅行）目的地；（赛跑的）终点；v. 射门，射门得分
definition: 1. n. the state of affairs that a plan is intended to achieve and that (when achieved) terminates behavior intended to achieve it；2. n. a successful attempt at scoring
example: Now let's think about designing the experiment itself. The goal here, there are two goals. Or more than two.
exampleZh: 那么现在让我们来想想,怎么设计实验本身吧，这里有两个目标，或者多于两个目标。

meaning: n. 山羊；老色鬼；替罪羊；愚蠢的人；摩羯（星）座（the Goat）
definition: 1. n. any of numerous agile ruminants related to sheep but having a beard and straight horns；2. n. a victim of ridicule or pranks
example: A goat was standing up against a tree on its hind legs, trying to get at the leaves.
exampleZh: 一只山羊后腿趴在一棵树上站起来，试图去够树叶。

meaning: n. 神；上帝，天主， 真主（God）；受崇敬的人，偶像；（某一领域的）要人，权威；至为重要的事物；（剧场中的）顶层楼座（the gods）；v. 膜拜，崇拜；int. （用以表示吃惊、愤怒或悲痛等）天哪（God）；【名】 （God）（索、阿拉伯）古德（人名）
definition: 1. n. the supernatural being conceived as the perfect and omnipotent and omniscient originator and ruler of the universe; the object of worship in monotheistic religions；2. n. any supernatural being worshipped as controlling some part of the world or some aspect of life or who is the personification of a force
example: God creates the world and then sort of, as Milton says himself, "uncircumscrib'd withdraws," right? God is not there.
exampleZh: 上帝创造了这个世界，然后，就像弥尔顿说的，“退出了“，是吗，上帝不在结构之中。

meaning: n. 金；金币，黄金制品；金色，金黄色；金牌；宝贵的东西，难能可贵的人；（箭术中的）靶心；adj. 金色的；金制的；【名】 （Gold）（英、法、德、西、罗、捷、瑞典）戈尔德（人名）
definition: 1. n. coins made of gold；2. adj. made from or covered with gold
example: you know, people dressed in gold and things like that, pretending to be kind of statues
exampleZh: 人们穿上金色的服装和类似的东西，假装是一尊雕像，

meaning: adj. 金制的；金色的；极好的，成功的；美好的，幸福的；很有才干的，很受欢迎的；声音圆润的；处于有利地位的；【名】 （Golden）（英、法、罗、德、瑞典）戈尔登（人名）
definition: 1. adj. having the deep slightly brownish color of gold；2. adj. marked by peace and prosperity
example: And it's a really great experience. So that's pretty much what I associate Golden Gate Park with, for me.
exampleZh: 节日办得很不错。特别是对我这种常在金门公园附近溜达的人，是一种很好的体验。

meaning: n. 高尔夫球运动；（无线通讯中的）字母G的代码；v. 打高尔夫球；【名】 （Golf）（西、挪）戈尔夫（人名）
definition: 1. n. a game played on a large open course with 9 or 18 holes; the object is use as few strokes as possible in playing all the holes；2. v. play golf
example: You can't call up the banker and say that, but if you're playing golf it comes out perfectly naturally.
exampleZh: 他们不可能打电话给银行家说这些的,但如果你们一起打球,就会顺口扯到了

meaning: adj. 优良的；能干的，擅长的；令人愉快的，满意的；合适的，方便的；有益的；乖的；虔诚的；健康的；善良的；正直的；相当大的，相当多的；至少；彻底的；明智的，合理的；划算的，收益可观的；赢得赞许的，令人尊敬的；（用于表示回应）好的；表示惊讶、生气或者加强语气；（用于打招呼）好；有趣的；有效的；能提供……的；（踢、射、投）命中；亲密的；够了；n. 善，正义；好事；商品，所有物；（运载的）货物（goods）；优势，利益；真货，正品（the goods）；好人，有道德的人（the good）；adv. 好地；彻底地，完全地；【名】 （Good）（英）古德，（瑞典）戈德（人名）
definition: 1. n. benefit；2. adj. having desirable or positive qualities especially those suitable for a thing specified
example: I think even soul's emotion... People are a little too off for good church, for good church people. -Right.
exampleZh: 这也和“灵魂情感“有关。。。,人们对按时拜谒教会这件事，太冷淡，-是的。

meaning: int. 再见；告别
definition: 1. n. a farewell remark
example: And then you'll see a film called Au Revoir, Les Enfants, sort of see you children, goodbye children.
exampleZh: 然后还有《再见了孩子们》,意思是再见了孩子们

meaning: n. 善良，美德；（尤指食物中的）营养，精华；int. 天哪，啊呀（用作“上帝”的替代语，表示吃惊或愤怒等）
definition: 1. n. that which is pleasing or valuable or useful；2. n. moral excellence or admirableness
example: The ideas or the forms justice itself, beauty itself, goodness itself the forms are not physical objects. Right?
exampleZh: 理念或者型相,如正义,美丽,美德之类,它们并不是物理实体

meaning: n. 商品；动产，私人财产；（公路、铁路等运输的）货物；本领；正要寻找的人（或物）
definition: 1. n. benefit；2. adj. having desirable or positive qualities especially those suitable for a thing specified
example: But we've expanded the list of goods so it includes external goods and not only experiential or internal goods.
exampleZh: 但是我们扩展了美好事物的定义,所以它包括物质方面的美好事物,而不仅是经验和内心方面的美好感受。

meaning: n. 鹅；鹅肉；雌鹅； 傻瓜；（裁缝用的）熨斗；v. 触摸（或捏）某人的臀部； 推动，激励；开大（汽车等）的油门；作嘘嘘声反对（某人）；【名】 （Goose）（英）古斯，（德）戈泽（人名）
definition: 1. n. web-footed long-necked typically gregarious migratory aquatic birds usually larger and less aquatic than ducks；2. v. pinch in the buttocks
example: because when you're sitting there in person, you get goose bumps. It's fantastic.
exampleZh: 因为一旦你本人坐在那里了，你就会激动得浑身起鸡皮疙瘩，真是太好看了。

meaning: n. 峡，峡谷；厌恶，气愤；（猎鹰）鹰的嗉囊，胃；（堵塞狭道，尤指堵塞河道的）冰块； 喉咙；v. 贪婪地吃，狼吞虎咽；尽情享受，沉醉；使扩张；adj. 非常漂亮的，极其吸引人的；【名】 （Gorge）（西）戈赫，（法）戈尔热（人名）
definition: 1. a deep, narrow valley with steep sides, usually formed by a river or stream cutting through hard rock；2. to make someone feel shocked and angry
example: Ahead was the deep V of a gorge with water pouring down it.
exampleZh: 前面是陡深的V字形峡谷，水流倾泻而下。

meaning: adj. 美丽动人的；令人愉快的；绚丽的，华丽的
definition: 1. adj. dazzlingly beautiful
example: But I choose to walk, and just walking in the seasons whether it's snowing or raining, or gorgeous sunny fall day.
exampleZh: 但是我选择走路，什么季节都是如此,无论是雪天，雨天，亦或是秋高气爽。

meaning: n. 福音书（《圣经》四福音书之一）；福音（耶稣的启示和教义）；教义，信条；绝对真理（=gospel truth）；福音音乐（=gospel music）；adj. 传播福音的；福音赞美诗的
definition: 1. any of the four books of the Bible that contain details of the life of Jesus Christ；2. the teachings of Jesus Christ
example: He wouldn't say this if it weren't the gospel truth.
exampleZh: 如果这不是绝对真理，他就不会这么说。

meaning: n. 流言蜚语，小道消息；爱说三道四的人；闲聊；v. 闲聊，说三道四
definition: 1. n. light informal conversation for social occasions；2. v. wag one's tongue; speak about others and reveal secrets or intimacies
example: He added celebrity gossip too, which The London Times would never do in the past.
exampleZh: 他还史无前例地加入了名人八卦,这是《泰晤士报》过去永远不会做的

meaning: v. 统治，管理；控制，影响；（语法）支配；可用来裁定（某案例）；【名】 （Govern）（英）戈文（人名）
definition: 1. v. bring into conformity with rules or principles or usage; impose regulations；2. v. direct or strongly influence the behavior of
example: So, if we are going to govern or regulate human behavior, we have to begin by regulating opinion.
exampleZh: 所以，如果想更好地管理,或是统治人民的作为,必须从管好公共舆论开始。

meaning: n. 政府，内阁；政体，国家体制；（国家等的）治理，管理；政府掌控经济和社会活动的程度；（语法）支配关系
definition: 1. n. the organization that is the governing authority of a political unit；2. n. (government) the system or form by which a community or other political unit is governed
example: Your first thing is responsibility to fulfill your rights to your people, to your culture, to your family, to your government.
exampleZh: 你的首要任务是履行义务而不是行使权利,对人民，对文化圈，对家庭，对政府都是如此。

meaning: n. 州长，省长，总督；理事，董事；主管，机构负责人；老板；调速器，调节器
definition: 1. n. the head of a state government；2. n. a control that maintains a steady speed in a machine (as by controlling the supply of fuel)
example: And you can't read it but there's a kind of stamp of approval here from the governor Nelson Rockefeller.
exampleZh: 你没法领会这个，但是这里有,作为州长的尼尔森，洛克菲勒对此的承认。

meaning: n. 女裙服，女礼服；（法官、教师、律师及大学成员穿的）长袍，长外衣；（尤指在医院穿的）罩衣，外罩；睡衣；v. 使穿长袍，使穿礼服
definition: 1. n. a woman's dress, usually with a close-fitting bodice and a long flared skirt, often worn on formal occasions；2. v. dress in a gown
example: The priest fumbled in the folds of his gown.
exampleZh: 这位牧师胡乱地整了整长袍上的褶皱。

meaning: v. 攫取，抓住；（尤指匆忙地）取，吃，喝；霸占，强夺；利用，抓住（机会）；引人注意，吸引；n. 攫取，赚取；抓具，抓斗；抓取（或截获、采集）的图像
definition: 1. n. a mechanical device for gripping an object；2. v. take hold of so as to seize or restrain or stop the motion of
example: So, if we take a look at what a single bond is, and let me grab some molecules here.
exampleZh: 如果来我们看一下单键，让我拿个分子。

meaning: n. 优美，优雅；文雅，高雅；风度，体面；恩宠，恩典；饭前感恩祷告；宽限期，延缓期；大人（用于对公爵、公爵夫人或大主教的尊称）；v. 为增色，装饰；使增光，使荣耀；【名】 （Grace）（英）格雷斯，格雷丝 (女名)，（法）格拉斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. (Christian theology) a state of sanctification by God; the state of one who under such divine influence；2. v. make more attractive by adding ornament, colour, etc.
example: Recorded September 9th, 1947, Grace Murray Hopper in case you're interested. This was the lab book of Grace Murray Hopper.
exampleZh: 想知道的话大概是在1947年9月9号，记载于,的实验手册中。

meaning: adj. 优美的，优雅的；得体的，有风度的
definition: 1. adj. characterized by beauty of movement, style, form, or execution；2. adj. suggesting taste, ease, and wealth
example: Through the dynamics of the counter-plot, the similes reassure us of what Hartman calls the "graceful coexistence of free will and divine providence."
exampleZh: 从这个反计的整个催动力来看，这些比喻向我们再次确认了被哈特曼称为,“自由意志和神圣天意华丽的共存“的结合“

meaning: adj. 有礼貌的，和蔼的；豪华舒适的，富足安逸的；（上帝）慈悲的；尊贵的，仁慈的（用于对王室成员的称呼）；inter. 天哪，哎呀
definition: 1. adj. characterized by charm, good taste, and generosity of spirit；2. adj. characterized by kindness and warm courtesy especially of a king to his subjects
example: Deuteronomy emphasizes God's gracious and undeserved love of Israel, and that's expressed in his mighty acts on Israel's behalf.
exampleZh: 申命记强调上帝对以色列亲切甚至不相称的爱，这在他对以色列人全能的行为上表现出来。

meaning: n. 等级，品级；（工作岗位，官衔等的）级别，职别；成绩，分数；（美国学制）年级；斜坡，坡度；（疾病的）程度，阶段；与纯种杂交改良的牛；v. 按照级别安排或分配，分类；给……评分；设定（路面）坡度；（尤指色彩）从一个等级逐渐进入另一个等级；（家畜）与优良品种杂交；【名】 （Grade）（英）格雷德，（法、德、西、葡、塞、瑞典）格拉德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a body of students who are taught together；2. v. assign a rank or rating to
example: Well, it's a long time ago but it was elementary school, you know, maybe 3rd grade, 4th grade,
exampleZh: 那是很久以前的事情了，应该是小学时候吧，那大概是三年级或者四年级，

meaning: adj. 逐渐的，渐进的；平缓的，不陡的；n. 弥撒升阶圣歌集
definition: 1. n. (Roman Catholic Church) an antiphon (usually from the Book of Psalms) immediately after the epistle at Mass；2. adj. proceeding in small stages
example: And they squarely faced the question of a gradual abolition plan for the state of Virginia in 1831 and '32.
exampleZh: 然而在1831和32年间的弗吉尼亚州,他们所面临的问题就是,如何开展废除奴隶制的计划

meaning: adv. 逐渐地，逐步地
definition: 1. adv. in a gradual manner
example: That's why hermeneutics gradually moved I should say, it didn't desert religion, but it expanded--to the study of the law.
exampleZh: 因此诠释学从宗教领域转移到了,应该说，它没有离开宗教，而是延伸到了法学领域。

meaning: n. 大学毕业生，学士学位获得者；毕业生；v. 获得学位（尤指学士），大学毕业；毕业（尤指中学）；授予（某人）学位（或毕业文凭等）；（从……）进步到，升级到；按序列或规模安排；（在仪器或容器上）刻度，做标记；逐渐（或逐步）改变（某物，尤指颜色或色调）；adj. （课程、学业）研究生的
definition: 1. n. a person who has received a degree from a school (high school or college or university)；2. v. receive an academic degree upon completion of one's studies
example: After all his hard work, he now needs only two credit hours to graduate.
exampleZh: 通过努力学习，他现在只需再修两个学分就可以毕业了。

meaning: n. 毕业；毕业典礼；（容器或设备上的）刻度；在刻度尺上按度数（或其他比例分配）的划分
definition: 1. n. the successful completion of a program of study；2. n. an academic exercise in which diplomas are conferred
example: I moved out to California without any clue what I might do after graduation,
exampleZh: 我搬到加州，根本不清楚自己毕业后能干什么。

meaning: n. 谷物，谷粒；颗粒，细粒；少量；纹理；（表面的）质地，触感；格令（旧的重量单位，一格令相当于0.065克）；（照片、底片的）显影颗粒；（用于火箭发动机的）固体推进剂；（皮革或其他类似人工材料的）粗糙面，皱面；（石头和煤等原料的）解理面，劈理面；（人的）性格，天性；胭脂虫，胭脂虫红；v. 使表面（或纹理）粗糙；成粒状；（尤指将家具或内表面）漆成木纹（或大理石纹）；将（生皮）去毛；用谷物喂（马）；【名】 （Grain）（法）格兰（人名）
definition: 1. n. a small hard particle；2. v. thoroughly work in
example: Because the plywood has been sliced into thin pieces that are laminated cross-grain.
exampleZh: 因为胶合板是被分割的,层积的混合谷物的板子。

meaning: n. 克（公制重量单位，1000克等于1公斤）；（用作食物的）鹰嘴豆（或其他豆类植物）；奶奶，外婆（同 gramma）；【名】 （Gram）（英、法、德、丹、挪、瑞典）格拉姆（人名）
definition: 1. n. a metric unit of weight equal to one thousandth of a kilogram；2. n. Danish physician and bacteriologist who developed a method of staining bacteria to distinguish among them (1853-1938)
example: But occasionally there is this one little remnant of the old CGS system, centimeters-gram-second, and this is one.
exampleZh: 但是也有些例外,在原来的厘米克秒制中，还有我们说的这个。

meaning: n. 语法，文法；（人的）语言知识及运用能力；语法书；语法理论，语法学；（某门类知识和技能的）基本原理；中学；（计算机）文法
definition: 1. n. the branch of linguistics that deals with syntax and morphology (and sometimes also deals with semantics or morphology)
example: instead of just picking up a book and trying to learn English vocabulary and English grammar structures.
exampleZh: 而不只是拿起书，努力学习英语单词和语法结构。

meaning: adj. 语法的，和语法有关的；语法正确的，符合语法的；语法词汇的，虚词的
definition: 1. adj. of or pertaining to grammar；2. adj. conforming to the rules of grammar or usage accepted by native speakers
example: Native speakers can distinguish between grammatical and ungrammatical sentences even when they have never heard particular combinations before.
exampleZh: 母语使用者可以分辨符合语法规则和不符合语法规则的句子，即使他们以前从没有听过这些特定的词语组合。

meaning: adj. 壮丽的，堂皇的；宏伟的，宏大的；傲慢的，高高在上的；令人愉快的；出色的，极好的；总括的；（常用于大型建筑物的名称前）大的；（对上层社会的人的称呼）大；（罪行）严重的；壮丽的，富丽堂皇的；n. 一千美元，一千英镑；大钢琴，三角钢琴；【名】 （Grand）（英、瑞典）格兰德，（法）格朗（人名）
definition: 1. n. the cardinal number that is the product of 10 and 100；2. adj. of behavior that is impressive and ambitious in scale or scope
example: I've passed through Grand Central Station when filming was happening. I don't know what they were filming though.
exampleZh: 有一次我从那儿经过，正好有部电影在拍。但我不知道他们在拍什么电影。

meaning: n. 孙辈（孙子、孙女、外孙、外孙女）
definition: 1. n. a child of your son or daughter
example: In many ways, positive psychology is the brainchild, the product and the grandchild of humanistic psychology.
exampleZh: 从很多方面来说，积极心理学是，人本主义心理学的产物和衍生。

meaning: n. 孙辈，即孙子、孙女、外孙、外孙女（grandchild 的复数形式）
definition: 1. n. a child of your son or daughter
example: And they tell you about their grandchildren and how cute they are.
exampleZh: 他们跟你谈论自己的孙儿们，告诉你他们有多么乖巧可爱。

meaning: n. 孙子；外孙
definition: 1. n. a male grandchild
example: My little grandson is no trouble at all, but his 6-year-old sister is a handful.
exampleZh: 我的小孙子一点不用人操心，但他6岁的姐姐却很难管教。

meaning: n. 孙女，外孙女
definition: 1. n. a female grandchild
example: My little granddaughter caught her heel in the spokes of her bicycle – it was a very nasty wound.
exampleZh: 我的小孙女把她的后脚跟卷到她的自行车辐条里了–伤得很严重。

meaning: n. 祖父或祖母；外祖父或外祖母（复数常泛指祖父母、外祖父母）
definition: 1. n. a parent of your father or mother
example: Almost every grandparent wants to be with his or her grandchildren and is willing to make sacrifices.
exampleZh: 几乎每个祖父母都想和孙辈在一起，并愿意为他们做出牺牲。

meaning: n. 祖父，外祖父；始祖，鼻祖；vt. （法律、政策）使（现有人员、企业、安排等）不受新规定限制，对…予以豁免
definition: 1. n. the father of your father or mother
example: This is going to travel, fishing with his grandfather, visiting his grandfather's shoes' shop, things that were just an intriguing part of his life.
exampleZh: 这个故事是关于，他和他祖父钓鱼，拜访他祖父的鞋铺，以及他生活的其它趣事。

meaning: n. （外）祖母，奶奶，外婆；女祖先
definition: 1. n. the mother of your father or mother
example: You know, my grandmother spent some time in Germany in Frankfurt. I think it was
exampleZh: 我祖母在德国的法兰克福呆过一段时间，那时

meaning: v. 授予，给予；承认；n. 补助金，拨款；（政府给予的）土地；给予，授予；合法转让；【名】 （Grant）（美）格朗（人名）
definition: 1. n. any monetary aid；2. v. let have
example: May no fate willfully misunderstand me And half grant what I wish and snatch me away not to return.
exampleZh: 别来个命运之神，故意曲解我,只成全我愿望的一半，把我卷了走。

meaning: adv. 的确，诚然；conj. 因为（granted that）；v. 授予，给予；承认（grant 的过去式和过去分词）
definition: 1. adj. acknowledged as a supposition；2. adj. given as a grant
example: You'll remember that in his search for immortality Utnapishtim Gilgamesh sought out Utnapishtim, the one human who had been granted immortality.
exampleZh: 他对永生的追求,吉尔伽美什找到，唯一可以长生不老的人类。

meaning: n. 葡萄；葡萄酒（the grape）；霰弹，葡萄弹（grapeshot 的简称）；葡萄树；葡萄色；【名】 （Grape）（法）格拉普，（德、瑞典）格拉佩（人名）
definition: 1. n. any of various juicy fruit of the genus Vitis with green or purple skins; grow in clusters；2. n. any of numerous woody vines of genus Vitis bearing clusters of edible berries
example: The colouring pigments from the skins are not allowed to bleed into the grape juice.
exampleZh: 这些果皮的色素不允许掺混进葡萄汁中。

meaning: n. 图表，曲线图；坐标图；代表声音单位（或其他言语特征）的书写符号；v. 用图表表示；【名】 （Graph）（英）格拉夫（人名）
definition: 1. n. a visual representation of the relations between certain quantities plotted with reference to a set of axes；2. v. represent by means of a graph
example: The graph shows how house prices have risen since the 1980s.
exampleZh: 此图表明了自20世纪80年代以来房价上涨的情况。

meaning: adj. 详细的，生动的；绘画的；图形的，图示的；（岩石表面纹理）文象的；（与）可视图像（有关）的；（与）视觉艺术（有关）的；n. 图表，图形；绘画，图形设计
definition: 1. n. an image that is generated by a computer；2. adj. written or drawn or engraved
example: The exhibition traces the history of graphic design in America from the 19th century to the present.
exampleZh: 这个展览会追溯了从19世纪到现在美国平面设计的历史。

meaning: adv. 形象地，生动地；以图表形式
definition: 1. adv. in a diagrammatic manner；2. adv. with respect to graphic aspects
example: I am going to solve it graphically and I am going to solve it analytically.
exampleZh: 我将采用图解法,然后我将用分析法解决它。

meaning: v. 抓牢，握紧；理解，领会；抓住（机会）；n. 紧抓，紧握；理解（力），领会；能力所及，伸手可及的距离；控制，权力
definition: 1. n. understanding of the nature or meaning or quality or magnitude of something；2. v. hold firmly
example: It's easy for us to say that it was Milton's memory that facilitated his grasp of the Christian and the classical traditions.
exampleZh: 我们也可以轻易地说那是弥尔顿的记忆,使他对于基督教和经典传统的理解更为容易了。

meaning: n. 草；草地，草坪；大麻； 告密者；草地网球场；牧场；v. 在……上种草；（向警方）告发；捕（鱼）并带上河岸；将（某人）撞倒；给（牲畜）喂草；【名】 （Grass）（英、法、德、俄、瑞典）格拉斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. narrow-leaved green herbage: grown as lawns; used as pasture for grazing animals; cut and dried as hay；2. v. shoot down, of birds
example: The Old Testament prophet had said, "All flesh is grass," an important verse for the new dispensation of Christianity.
exampleZh: 旧约里说，“凡有血气的，尽都如草“,这是基督教教义新体系中的重要一条。

meaning: adj. 长满草的，被草覆盖的；具有草的特点的，似草的；【名】 （Grassy）格拉西（人名）
definition: 1. adj. abounding in grass
example: They sat and had their lunch on a grassy hillside.
exampleZh: 他们坐在长满草的山坡上吃他们的午饭。

meaning: adj. 感谢的，感激的；（尤用于书信或正式场合提出请求）感激不尽，请；令人获得快意的，受欢迎的
definition: 1. adj. feeling or showing gratitude；2. adj. affording comfort or pleasure
example: And I think that was a heady feeling, and I would always be very grateful to have the chance to do that.
exampleZh: 这是一个很刺激的感觉，同时我也会永远感谢,能够有这样一个机会。

meaning: n. 感激之情，感谢
definition: 1. n. a feeling of thankfulness and appreciation
example: So I talked about some of "the greatest hits": the importance of gratitude, the importance of physical exercise.
exampleZh: 于是我谈到了一些热门话题：,感恩的重要性，体育锻炼的重要性。

meaning: n. 坟墓，墓穴；死亡，终结；（废旧机器等的）堆积处；（法语等语言里的）抑音符号，沉音符；adj. 严峻的，严重的；严肃的，庄重的；认真的，深切的；带钝重音符的；（用作演奏演唱指示）缓慢的，庄严的；adv. （用作演奏演唱指示）缓慢地，庄严地；v. 铭记，铭刻；刻（铭文，图像）；（用烧掉附着物然后涂以沥青的方法）清理（船底），拷铲油漆（船底）；【名】 （Grave）（德、英）格拉维（人名）
definition: 1. n. death of a person；2. v. shape (a material like stone or wood) by whittling away at it
example: Well, "The wonder is I didn't see at once" and that is the grave that he has made for their child.
exampleZh: 奇迹的是我曾经看不见“,是他为他们的孩子准备的坟墓。

meaning: n. 万有引力，重力；移动，吸引
definition: 1. n. (physics) the force of attraction between all masses in the universe; especially the attraction of the earth's mass for bodies near its surface；2. n. movement downward resulting from gravitational attraction
example: This also tells you that the mass of an object has nothing to do with gravitation.
exampleZh: 这也表明,物体的质量与重力无关

meaning: n. 重力，地心引力；严重性；严肃，庄严；重（量）
definition: 1. n. (physics) the force of attraction between all masses in the universe; especially the attraction of the earth's mass for bodies near its surface；2. n. a manner that is serious and solemn
example: Arrows would continue to fly forward forever in a straight line were it not for gravity, which brings them down to earth.
exampleZh: 要不是重力使箭掉落地上，它将会一直沿直线往前飞行。

meaning: adj. 灰色的；苍白的；灰白头发的；阴郁的；昏暗的；n. 灰色；暗淡的光线；戈瑞（吸收电离辐射剂量单位，符号 Gy）；（Gray）人名；（意）格拉伊；（英、法、葡、瑞典）格雷；vi. 成为灰色或灰白；vt. 使成灰色或灰白
definition: 1. n. a neutral achromatic color midway between white and black；2. v. make grey
example: it becomes a gray area but it should be pretty clear if you can treat something is reversible are irreversible.
exampleZh: 这是个灰色区域,但什么可以当作可逆过程处理,而什么要当作不可逆过程,这是相当清楚的。

meaning: v. 吃草；放牧；擦过；擦伤，擦破；经常吃零食而不吃正餐，吃很多零食；随意地尝试（或体验、浏览）；n. 擦伤
definition: 1. to break the surface of the skin by rubbing against something rough；2. If an object grazes something, it touches its surface lightly when it passes it
example: The land is used by local people to graze their animals.
exampleZh: 这块地当地人用来放牧。

meaning: n. 油脂；润滑油；v. 给……加润滑油，为……涂（或抹）油
definition: 1. animal or vegetable fat that is soft after melting, or more generally, any thick oil-like substance；2. to put fat or oil on something
example: He wiped the grease from his hands before examining the damaged engine more closely.
exampleZh: 他擦掉手上的油脂，然后更仔细地检查受损的发动机。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: adj. 沾油脂的，油污的；含脂肪的，油腻的；油性的；滑的；圆滑的，虚情假意的
definition: 1. covered with or full of fat or oil；2. covered with or full of grease
example: Tomorrow I'm going to give the toys a good wipe as some seem a bit greasy.
exampleZh: 明天我会把那些玩具好好擦拭一番，因为有些看上去有点油腻了。

meaning: adj. 伟大的，著名的；大型的，巨大的；（数量或程度）极大的，很大的；美妙的；身心健康的，精力充沛的；重要的，重大的；热心的，热衷的；和蔼的，随和的；（外）曾祖（或曾孙）的；（二人）亲近的，亲密的；擅长……的；adv. 很好地，很棒地；n. 伟人，伟大的事物；金曲
definition: 1. n. a person who has achieved distinction and honor in some field；2. adj. relatively large in size or number or extent; larger than others of its kind
example: He's narrating in great detail what happened while he was in the womb. Where does this knowledge come from?
exampleZh: 他花了很大笔墨很详细地描写了,他还在子宫里发生的事，但他是怎么知道的呢？

meaning: n. 贪婪，贪欲；贪食，贪吃
definition: 1. a very strong wish to continuously get more of something, especially food or money；2. a strong desire to continually get more of something, esp. money
example: The corrupt clergy of today, under the malign influence of the horrible Archbishop Laud, are interested only in satisfying their own greed.
exampleZh: 如今腐败的牧师们，在可憎的大主教劳德的恶意中伤下，只关心满足他们自己贪婪的口腹之欲。

meaning: adj. 贪婪的，贪心的；贪吃的，嘴馋的；渴望的
definition: 1. wanting a lot more food, money, etc. than you need；2. A greedy algorithm (= a set of mathematical instructions or rules given to a computer to help calculate something) or method of solving a problem involves making the best choice at each stage without considering future stages
example: Genesis recorded a song which took a swipe at greedy property developers who bought up and demolished people's homes.
exampleZh: 吉尼西丝录制了一首歌曲，对买下并拆毁他人家园的贪婪房地产开发商进行抨击。

meaning: adj. 绿色的；青春的；n. 绿色；青春；vt. 使……变绿色；vi. 变绿色；n. （Green）人名；（英、意）格林；（瑞典、芬）格伦
definition: 1. n. green color or pigment; resembling the color of growing grass；2. v. turn or become green
example: Yeah, I actually, we have a concert here on Main Green once a year called "Spring Weekend"
exampleZh: 是的，我们每年都会在梅因格林举办一场音乐会，叫做“春日周末”，

meaning: n. 温室，暖房；adj. 温室效应的
definition: 1. n. a building with glass walls and roof; for the cultivation and exhibition of plants under controlled conditions；2. adj. of or relating to or caused by the greenhouse effect
example: You can make your flights carbon neutral by planting trees to make up for the greenhouse gas emissions.
exampleZh: 你可以通过种树抵消温室气体排放，这样你的飞行就可以做到碳中和。

meaning: v. 欢迎，迎接；对……作出反应；映入眼帘，扑鼻而来；痛哭，哭泣；【名】 （Greet）（英）格里特（人名）
definition: 1. v. express greetings upon meeting someone；2. v. send greetings to
example: Milton can join his voice to the angel choir and have the honor of being first to greet the "Infant God."
exampleZh: 弥尔顿能够放开歌喉有幸与天使合唱,第一个迎接主的荣光“

meaning: n. 问候，招呼；贺词，祝福；v. 欢迎，迎接；对……作出反应；映入眼帘，扑鼻而来（greet 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. (usually plural) an acknowledgment or expression of good will (especially on meeting)
example: If it's a true happiness smile, that's actually bodes better for the relationship than a Pan Am, or greeting smile.
exampleZh: 如果是一个真正开心的微笑，对这段感情来说是个好兆头,比问候式微笑好的多。

meaning: n. 网格，方格；栅栏；输电网，电力网；赛车起跑线；美式橄榄球球场，橄榄球赛；（控制）栅极；计算机联网；v. 使……构成网格状，布置成网格结构
definition: 1. a pattern or structure made from horizontal and vertical lines crossing each other to form squares；2. a system of wires through which electricity is connected to different power stations across a region, or the system of connected pipes for water and gas
example: The television screens of the next century will be linked up to an emerging world telecommunications grid.
exampleZh: 下个世纪的电视屏幕将与一种新兴的世界电信网格相连。

meaning: n. （尤指因某人去世引起的）悲伤，悲痛；伤心事，悲痛事；麻烦，烦恼
definition: 1. n. intense sorrow caused by loss of a loved one (especially by death)；2. n. something that causes great unhappiness
example: In a strange way she seemed ennobled by her grief.
exampleZh: 奇怪的是，忧伤使她显得更加高贵。

meaning: v. （尤指因某人亡故而）感到悲痛；使伤心；n. 农庄总管；【名】 （Grieve）（英）格里夫 (人名)
definition: 1. v. feel grief; eat one's heart out；2. v. cause to feel sorrow
example: Relatives need time to grieve over loved ones they have lost.
exampleZh: 亲属需要时间痛悼他们失去的至爱。

meaning: adj. 极其严重的，使人痛苦的
definition: 1. adj. causing fear or anxiety by threatening great harm；2. adj. causing or marked by grief or anguish
example: He responds to this grievous loss privately by taking it on himself, by seeking to master it himself, and specifically as a worker.
exampleZh: 他私下里对失去孩子的痛苦的反应,是自己承受，努力地自己承受，尤其是作为一名工人。

meaning: n. 烤架；带烤架的炊具；电焙盘；一盘烧烤食物（尤指烤肉）；烤肉店；门窗护栏（同 grille）；v. 烧烤，烤制；盘问，追问
definition: 1. the surface in a cooker that can be heated to very high temperatures and under which you put food to be cooked；2. a frame of metal bars over a fire on which food can be put to be cooked
example: Place under a hot grill until the nuts have toasted.
exampleZh: 把这些坚果放在高温烤架下面烤熟。

meaning: adj. 严肃的，坚定的；令人不快的，令人沮丧的；阴森的，凄凉的；生病的；质量低劣，糟糕；（地方）简陋的；【名】 （Grim）（英、德、俄、捷、匈）格里姆（人名）
definition: 1. extremely bad, worrying, or without hope；2. worried and serious or sad
example: Now, he describes in pretty harsh and even grim terms what you can do to people who violate the law of nature.
exampleZh: 他用很强硬甚至可怕的字眼描述,你可以怎样对待违反自然法的人。

meaning: v. 露齿而笑，咧着嘴笑；n. 露齿的笑，咧着嘴笑；【名】 （Grin）（美、俄）格林（人名）
definition: 1. n. a facial expression characterized by turning up the corners of the mouth; usually shows pleasure or amusement；2. v. to draw back the lips and reveal the teeth, in a smile, grimace, or snarl
example: Then they turn around to their friends and give a big grin.
exampleZh: 然后他们转向朋友们，露出了大大的微笑。

meaning: v. 磨碎，碾碎；使锋利；用力挤压；摩擦（发出刺耳声）；（跳舞者）扭摆臀部；摇动（碾磨机等机器的）手柄操作；用绞肉机绞（肉）；（机器或车辆伴有噪音地）缓慢运转，费力移动；n. 苦差事；摩擦（声），碾磨（声）；埋头苦读的学生；磨制级别； 小型教学班；（舞蹈中的）扭臀动作；【名】 （Grind）（法、德）格林德（人名）
definition: 1. n. an insignificant student who is ridiculed as being affected or studying excessively；2. v. press or grind with a crunching noise
example: Store the peppercorns in an airtight container and grind the pepper as you need it.
exampleZh: 将胡椒子储藏在密封容器里，当你需要的时候把它磨成粉。

meaning: n. 紧握；掌握，控制；理解；不打滑，走得稳；手柄；紧握（或抓牢）的方式；（拍摄电影时）摄影机和照明设备管理人员；发夹；旅行袋；v. 握紧，夹住；（尤指通过摩擦力）牢牢地附着，紧贴；使感兴趣，吸引住（某人）的注意；对……产生强有力的影响；【名】 （Grip）（英、瑞典）格里普（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of grasping；2. v. hold fast or firmly
example: I better say something about oil in the ancient world, so that you get a grip on what's going on here.
exampleZh: 我最好说一下油在古代世界的地位,以便你能明白为什么会出售芳香油

meaning: v. 呻吟，叹息；咕哝；抱怨，发牢骚；（树木等）发出嘎吱声；堆满（食物）；受……重压；n. 呻吟声，叹息声；抱怨，牢骚；低沉的声响
definition: 1. a deep, long sound showing great pain or unhappiness；2. a complaining noise or phrase
example: They glanced at the man on the floor, who began to groan.
exampleZh: 他们扫了一眼地板上那个开始呻吟的男子。

meaning: n. 食品杂货商；食品杂货店
definition: 1. n. a retail merchant who sells foodstuffs (and some household supplies)
example: At the other end of the social scale was the grocer.
exampleZh: 处于社会阶层另一端的是杂货商。

meaning: n. 食品杂货店，食品杂货业；食品杂货（groceries）
definition: 1. n. a marketplace where groceries are sold；2. n. (usually plural) consumer goods sold by a grocer
example: The grocery shop is offering customers 5 cents for each shopping bag re-used.
exampleZh: 该杂货店为顾客重复使用每个购物袋给5美分。

meaning: n. 凹槽；（流行音乐的）节奏；驾轻就熟，得心应手；常规，习惯；v. 在……上开出沟（或槽等）；形成沟槽；欣赏音乐，跟着音乐起舞；出色地演奏（尤指节奏持续不变的）流行乐（或爵士乐）；过得快活；投（球）至最易击打的好球部位； 出色地进球得（分）
definition: 1. a long, narrow, hollow space cut into a surface；2. a long, narrow space in the surface of a body part
example: We are all unique, so we have to find our own groove and start listening to ourselves.
exampleZh: 我们都是独一无二的，所以要找到属于自己的步调，开始倾听自己内心的声音。

meaning: v. 摸索；摸索着走；探索，努力寻求；猥亵，乱摸；n. 摸，猥亵；【名】 （Grope）（德）格罗佩（人名）
definition: 1. to feel with your hands, especially in order to find or move towards something when you cannot see easily；2. to touch someone's body in order to get sexual pleasure, usually when the person does not like it
example: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope in the noonday as in the night.
exampleZh: 他们白昼遇见黑暗，午间摸索如在夜间。

meaning: adj. 总的，毛的；严重的，极端的；粗鲁的；肥胖难看的，臃肿的；大范围的，粗略的；（高尔夫球的得分）实际所得的；明显的；让人恶心的；adv. 总共，全部；v. 总共赚得；n. 一罗（144个）；毛收入，总收入；【名】 （Gross）（英、法、德、意、葡、西、俄、芬、罗、捷、匈）格罗斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. twelve dozen；2. v. earn before taxes, expenses, etc.
example: It uses what in the Structural Anthropology essay he calls "mythemes" or "gross constituent units" of thought.
exampleZh: 它用到了在《结构人类学》中,所说的思想的，“神话素“或者，“大构成单位“

meaning: n. 地，地面；土地，土壤；（某种用途的）场地；充分的理由，根据；话题，知识领域；观点，立场；优势，有利条件；地线；庭院，花园；渣滓；（绘画或印刷的）背景，底子；v. 以……为根据；（在某学科上）给……以扎实的基础教育；使停飞；禁足；（使）搁浅；落地，着陆；把……放在地上，以……触地；把（电器）接地；（击球员）击出内场地滚球被杀出局；adj. 切碎的，磨碎的；（航空用语）地面的，地勤的；打磨成的，磨光的；生活于地面、地下或水底的；v. 研磨（grind 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. n. the solid part of the earth's surface；2. v. fix firmly and stably
example: so I don't know, I think it's just really cool to be able to work something from the ground up.
exampleZh: 所以，我不知道，我就是觉得能从头开始做一件事很酷。

meaning: n. 集体，团体；组，群；集团；乐团，乐队；空军大队（通常由两个或两个以上的基地组成）；（元素周期表中的）族；（系统语法中的）词组；原子团；v. （使）成组，聚集；将……分类
definition: 1. n. any number of entities (members) considered as a unit；2. v. arrange into a group or groups
example: OK, important -- if you are part of this group here think about it and make sure you understand that.
exampleZh: 好的，这很重要，如果刚才你选了可逆过程,请好好想想并且保证已经理解了这个问题。

meaning: v. 长大，成长；成活，生长；发展，增加；逐渐变得；产生，形成；栽种，种植；留长，蓄；变长；【名】 （Grow）（英）格罗（人名）
definition: 1. v. pass into a condition gradually, take on a specific property or attribute; become；2. v. become larger, greater, or bigger; expand or gain
example: And in it you really talk about what it is to grow up as a Muslim in suburban America.
exampleZh: 在这本书中，您讲到了,作为一位穆斯林，在美国市郊成长的经历。

meaning: n. 成长，生长；增长，发展；肿瘤，赘生物；生长物，产物；种植，栽培；adj. 发展的，增长的
definition: 1. n. (biology) the process of an individual organism growing organically; a purely biological unfolding of events involved in an organism changing gradually from a simple to a more complex level；2. n. a progression from simpler to more complex forms
example: And so this household structure becomes very important for the growth and structure and even the theology of Christianity eventually.
exampleZh: 所以这种家户结构,对于基督教的发展，结构及神学,有着极其重要的影响。

meaning: v. 确保，保证；担保，为……作保；保修，包换；n. 保证，担保；保修单，质量保证书；担保金，抵押品
definition: 1. n. a written assurance that some product or service will be provided or will meet certain specifications；2. v. give surety or assume responsibility
example: People are willing to lend to these organizations at low interest rates because they think there's an implicit government guarantee.
exampleZh: 人们愿意以低利率,向这些组织提供融资,因为他们认为这里有政府默认的担保

meaning: n. 卫兵，警卫；看守，保卫，警戒；列车长；保护装置；（英国的）禁卫军；（篮球）后卫；（拳击运动员的）防御姿势；v. 守卫，保卫；看守，监视；警惕，防范；保护，维护；【名】 （Guard）（英）格尔德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person who keeps watch over something or someone；2. v. to keep watch over
example: Now, between your waist and your shin guard there's some very delicate territory, and there's no armor.
exampleZh: 在你的腰和护胫之间,这部分身体很容易受伤,因为这部分没有防具

meaning: n. 监护人；守卫者，保护者；（方济各会隐修院的）院长；adj. 守护的；【名】 （Guardian）（西）瓜尔迪安（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person who cares for persons or property；2. adj. providing protective supervision; watching over or safeguarding
example: A delightful guide was my guardian angel for the first week of the tour.
exampleZh: 令人愉快的导游是我第一周旅行的守护神。

meaning: v. 猜测，估计；猜中，猜到；认为，以为；n. 猜测，推测；【名】 （Guess）（英）格斯，（德）居斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a message expressing an opinion based on incomplete evidence；2. v. expect, believe, or suppose
example: The basic idea is, you take a guess and you -- whoops -- and you find the tangent of that guess.
exampleZh: 首先取个猜想数,然后，嗯,去取猜想数那儿的切线。

meaning: n. 客人；特邀嘉宾，客串演员；顾客，房客；寄居昆虫；v. 做特邀嘉宾，客串；【名】 （Guest）（英）格斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a visitor to whom hospitality is extended；2. n. United States journalist (born in England) noted for his syndicated homey verse (1881-1959)
example: One recent, also, last year, an article from the Globe, also part some statistics, they show the reading guest.
exampleZh: 同样，一篇最近刊登在《环球时报》上的文章，报道了一些数据，也表明了一些现实。

meaning: v. 带领，引导（某人至某地）；任向导；指导，影响；解释，阐明；n. 指南，手册；导游，向导；准则，指针；女童子军，女童子军成员；【名】 （Guide）（法、葡）吉德（人名）
definition: 1. n. someone employed to conduct others；2. v. direct the course; determine the direction of travelling
example: I used to be a campus tour guide, and what I'd say is, you know, everyone uses a number.
exampleZh: 我以前是校园的导游，我要说的是，每个人都用数字。

meaning: n. 指导，指引；（火箭等的）制导
definition: 1. n. something that provides direction or advice as to a decision or course of action；2. n. the act of guiding or showing the way
example: And these texts almost defy interpretation by a modern person, unless you have guidance from a historian and expert like moi.
exampleZh: 这些文本几乎无法由现代人翻译，除非由历史学家或专家指导，比如我。

meaning: n. 指导方针，准则；参考
definition: 1. n. a light line that is used in lettering to help align the letters；2. n. a detailed plan or explanation to guide you in setting standards or determining a course of action
example: GAE does have some rules that you might not be accustomed to, like the 30-second request-response guideline.
exampleZh: GAE 确实有一些您可能不习惯的规则，如30秒请求响应准则。

meaning: n. 内疚；罪行；罪责
definition: 1. n. the state of having committed an offense；2. n. remorse caused by feeling responsible for some offence
example: They," the "they who convicted us of guilt," well, that's hard to identify. Who is that?
exampleZh: 她们宣告我们有罪“,她们是谁，这很难说？

meaning: adj. 内疚的，羞愧的；有罪的，有过失的
definition: 1. adj. responsible for or chargeable with a reprehensible act; or marked by guilt；2. adj. showing a sense of guilt
example: One social class does not owe anything to another and we should not feel guilty about pursuing financial interests.
exampleZh: 一个社会阶层对另一个阶层并没有亏欠,而且我们也不必为追求经济利益,感到内疚

meaning: n. 吉他，六弦琴
definition: 1. n. a stringed instrument usually having six strings; played by strumming or plucking
example: I'll see, like, some people, you know, playing guitar on the street corners.
exampleZh: 我总是可以看到很多人在街角弹吉他。

meaning: n. 吉他手，吉他弹奏者
definition: 1. n. a musician who plays the guitar
example: "I'm a mediocre harmonica player and a worse guitarist, but I had my pick of incredible musicians," says Mr. Anderson.
exampleZh: “我是个平庸的口琴演奏者和糟糕的吉他手，但我挑选出了非常棒的音乐家们。”安德森先生说。

meaning: n. 海湾；鸿沟，分歧；波斯湾；（地面的）裂口，深渊
definition: 1. n. an arm of a sea or ocean partly enclosed by land; larger than a bay；2. n. an unbridgeable disparity (as from a failure of understanding)
example: The low, marshy land runs out for miles toward the gulf.
exampleZh: 这片低洼的沼泽地沿海湾方向延伸数英里。

meaning: n. 牙龈，牙床；口香糖；树胶；黏胶；透明果味糖；桉树，树胶树；眼屎；v. 用黏胶粘；（因没有牙齿）用牙龈咀嚼；【名】 （Gum）古姆（人名）
definition: 1. n. a preparation (usually made of sweetened chicle) for chewing；2. v. cover, fill, fix or smear with or as if with gum
example: Freud uses it as an explanation for why somebody might eat too much or chew gum or smoke.
exampleZh: 弗洛伊德用口腔期人格,来解释为什么会有人暴饮暴食,嚼口香糖或是抽烟。

meaning: n. 枪，炮；起跑信号，发令枪声；雇用杀手，持枪歹徒；喷射器；猎人；v. 加大……的油门，使加速； 猛投，猛掷；【名】 （Gun）（英）冈，（瑞典）贡，（俄、意）古恩（人名）
definition: 1. n. a weapon that discharges a missile at high velocity (especially from a metal tube or barrel)；2. v. shoot with a gun
example: There'd be certain activities perhaps, for example putting a gun to your head, that would put an end to your life.
exampleZh: 也许会有某些特定的活动，比如用枪指着你的头，会结束你的生命。

meaning: n. 肠，肠道；内脏；勇气，魄力；（尤指大的）胃，肚子；直觉，本能；核心，实质；肠线；（机器或设备的）内部零件；狭道，狭海峡；v. 取出……的内脏（以便烹饪）；毁坏（建筑物）的内部；adj. 感情的，本能的；【名】 （Gut）（英）格特（人名），（德、俄、意、葡、塞、捷、匈、瑞典）古特
definition: 1. n. the part of the alimentary canal between the stomach and the anus；2. v. empty completely; destroy the inside of
example: Let's have your gut reaction to the facts as we know them.
exampleZh: 请告诉我们你对这些我们了解的事实的直觉反应。

meaning: n. 男人，家伙；伙计们，兄弟（或姐妹）们；盖伊模拟像；（帐篷或杆柱的）固定拉绳，牵索；v. 嘲笑，戏弄；用支索稳定（加固）；【名】 （Guy）（英）盖伊，（西）吉，（法）居伊（人名）
definition: 1. n. an informal term for a youth or man；2. v. subject to laughter or ridicule
example: because you're thinking the guy might be trying to steal your car, put you at gunpoint, hijack you,
exampleZh: 因为你会想这个人可能是想偷你的车或用枪威胁你，劫持你，

meaning: n. 体育馆，健身房；（尤指学校的）体育活动
definition: 1. n. athletic facility equipped for sports or physical training
example: There is a gym up on the third floor and will accommodate a couple hundred people there.
exampleZh: 这是三楼的体育馆,能够供几百人使用。

meaning: n. 习惯；（吸毒、喝酒、抽烟的）瘾；道袍，道服；体质，体型；v. 给……穿衣
definition: 1. n. an established custom；2. v. put a habit on
example: if I could type, in order to just to get into that, in order to get into the habit.
exampleZh: 如果我可以输入，为了不在这里陷入，为了养成这个习惯。

meaning: adj. 习惯性的，惯常的；上瘾的
definition: 1. adj. made a norm or custom or habit；2. adj. commonly used or practiced; usual
example: Conformity is a matter of habitual and unreflected ways of doing things.
exampleZh: 从众是一种习惯性的，未反思的做事方式。

meaning: n. （动植物的）生活环境，栖息地；【名】 （Habitat）（德）哈比塔特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the type of environment in which an organism or group normally lives or occurs
example: Dry stone walls may appear stark and lifeless, but they provide a valuable habitat for plants and animals.
exampleZh: 干燥的石墙看上去荒凉而且没有生命迹象，但是它们却为动植物提供了宝贵的栖居地。

meaning: v. 砍，劈；非法侵入（他人计算机系统）；大幅删改（文章）；对付，处理；劈出，开辟（道路）；大声咳嗽；猛踢；骑马消遣；在饲草架上放（饲草）；开出租车；n. 雇佣文人，写手；二流政客，政治仆从；（对他人计算机）侵入；出租车，出租车司机；砍，劈；可出租的马；老马；（大声的）干咳；（冰壶运动中溜掷冰壶时作为足部支撑点的）冰槽，起蹬器；劈（或砍、击）的工具；伤口；（猎鹰）饲鹰板；（晒乳酪等的）晒架；【名】 （Hack）（美、印、丹等）阿克（人名）
definition: 1. n. one who works hard at boring tasks；2. v. cut with a hacking tool
example: You don't need this hack of just, like, manually adding a decimal point just to fix that problem.
exampleZh: 你不需要这样来操作，比如，手动地加入小数点来修正这个错误。

meaning: n. 黑客，骇客；不擅长某项运动的人；计算机迷；砍（或劈）的人，用于砍（或劈）的东西；【名】 （Hacker）（英）哈克（人名）
definition: 1. n. someone who plays golf poorly；2. n. a programmer who breaks into computer systems in order to steal or change or destroy information as a form of cyber-terrorism
example: Instead, Hacker is pushing for more courses like the one he teaches at Queens College: Numeracy 101.
exampleZh: 相反，Hacker 正在推动更多类似于他在皇后学院教授的课程：计算能力101。

meaning: v. 赞扬，欢呼；呼喊，招呼；下冰雹；（大量物体）像雹子般落下（或击打）；表示问候或欢呼欢迎；n. 冰雹；雹子般的一阵；招呼（某人）；【名】 （Hail）（阿拉伯、捷）海尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. precipitation of ice pellets when there are strong rising air currents；2. v. praise vociferously
example: Hail was hammering down onto the roof.
exampleZh: 冰雹砸得屋顶咚咚响。

meaning: n. 毛发，（尤指）头发；些微；（植物叶茎上的）茸毛；comb. 有……毛发（或头发）的 (-haired)
definition: 1. n. a covering for the body (or parts of it) consisting of a dense growth of threadlike structures (as on the human head); helps to prevent heat loss；2. n. a very small distance or space
example: She had theseyer brown glasses and her hair was so thin it looked like ham gravy trickling over her skull.'" Okay.
exampleZh: 她戴着她那褐色的眼睛，她的头发很少,看起来像火腿肉汁正从她的头颅上流淌而下，好吧。

meaning: adj. 多毛的；惊险的，吓人的；【名】 （Hairy）（法）艾里（人名）
definition: 1. adj. having or covered with hair；2. adj. hazardous and frightening
example: Men still appear to be labouring under the misapprehension that women want hairy, muscular men.
exampleZh: 男人们似乎仍误以为女人喜欢体毛多的肌肉男。

meaning: n. 一半，二分之一；半场，半局；（足球、橄榄球等的）中场队员；半品脱；儿童半票；半学年，一学期；（高尔夫）一穴击球得分与对手相等；pron. 一半；（时间）……点半（=half past）；大量，许多；det. 一半；adj. 一半的；不完整的，部分的；adv. 一半地，接近一半地；部分地，不完全地；极其，非常（强调情况很糟）；一半……血统地；【名】 （Half）（英）哈夫，（德）哈尔夫，（阿拉伯）哈勒夫（人名）
definition: 1. n. one of two equal parts of a divisible whole；2. adj. consisting of one of two equivalent parts in value or quantity
example: Okay so exchange numbers; okay good half of that problem is gone now we have just these two left.
exampleZh: 好，交换数字,好，问题解决一半了,只剩你们两个了。

meaning: adv. 在中间，在中途；还可以，过得去；adj. 在中间的，在中途的；不完全的，不彻底的
definition: 1. adj. equally distant from the extremes；2. adv. at half the distance; at the middle
example: So here's what, a little more than halfway down, the left-hand column, page 917, Derrida has to say about that.
exampleZh: 所以这里，中部偏下，第917页左边，德里达说出了自己关于它的看法。

meaning: n. 礼堂，大厅；门厅；走廊，过道；（大学的）学生宿舍；府邸，庄园；【名】 （Hall）（英）霍尔，（法）阿尔，（土）哈勒，（德、波、丹、芬、瑞典）哈尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. an interior passage or corridor onto which rooms open；2. n. a large entrance or reception room or area
example: And by his smile, I knew that sullen hall,-- By his dead smile I knew we stood in Hell.
exampleZh: 看着他的笑，我想起了阴沉压抑的礼堂-,看着他的笑，我想起了阴沉压抑的礼堂。

meaning: v. （使）停止行进；阻止，中断；（口令）立定；跛行；（尤指逻辑或诗韵）有缺陷；踌躇，犹豫；n. 停止，中止；乡间小火车站（只有站台）；跛，瘸； 跛，瘸；（口令）立定；adj. 跛的，瘸的；【名】 （Halt）（美、德、英）哈尔特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the state of inactivity following an interruption；2. v. cause to stop
example: The Presbyterians needed to halt the endless generation of dangerous religious propaganda and continued what they felt on some level was the continued metastasis of Protestant sects.
exampleZh: 长老派需要停止无穷无尽不断产生的,危险的宗教宣传,继续他们认为的在一定程度上,继续转移的清教徒派系。

meaning: n. 火腿；蹩脚演员；无线通讯爱好者；（人的）大腿后部；v. 过火地表演；【名】 （Ham）（英、瑞典、塞）哈姆，（老）罕，（柬）汉（人名）
definition: 1. n. meat cut from the thigh of a hog (usually smoked)；2. v. exaggerate one's acting
example: Every Saturday dad made a beautiful pea and ham soup.
exampleZh: 每个星期六爸爸都做一道鲜美的豌豆火腿汤。

meaning: n. 汉堡包；碎牛肉；【名】 （Hamburger）（英）汉堡，（瑞典）汉布里耶，（德）汉布格尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a sandwich consisting of a fried cake of minced beef served on a bun, often with other ingredients；2. n. beef that has been ground
example: at a place called "Hamburger Hamlet" which is no longer there.
exampleZh: 在一个叫“汉堡村子”的地方，现在已经不在了。

meaning: n. 锤子，榔头；（拍卖用的）木槌；链球；击铁；音槌；锣锤；v. （用锤子）敲击；用力敲打，猛踢；强行灌输，反复强调；（在体育比赛中）使惨败，大败；使（企业）受到打击；严厉批评，指责；（心脏）剧烈跳动；压低（某股票）的价格；【名】 （Hammer）（美、德、挪、奥、俄、丹、加、巴）阿梅（人名）
definition: 1. n. the part of a gunlock that strikes the percussion cap when the trigger is pulled；2. v. beat with or as if with a hammer
example: We've known since antiquity that you could take gold, and you can hammer to very, very thin foil.
exampleZh: 我们已经知道很久以前，人们就能用锤子把金敲成非常非常薄的箔片。

meaning: v. 阻碍，妨碍；n. （尤指装食物用的）带盖大篮子；（装有各种食品的）礼物篮；脏衣篓；障碍船具
definition: 1. to prevent someone doing something easily；2. a large, rectangular container with a lid
example: An occasional restless night is nothing to worry about, but a continuous lack of sleep can hamper your immune system's ability to function.
exampleZh: 偶尔失眠一晚无需担心，但长期睡眠不足会削弱免疫系统的正常运作能力。

meaning: n. 手；（钟表的）指针；一局牌，一手牌；帮助，援手；工人；船员，水手；支配，掌管；作用，影响；鼓掌，拍手喝彩；字迹；一手之宽（用来测量马匹的高度）；（女方的）允婚；表演艺人，制作工匠；comb. 用……手的；手工；v. 交，递；支持，搀扶；卷（帆）；【名】 （Hand）（英、瑞典）汉德（人名）
definition: 1. n. the (prehensile) extremity of the superior limb；2. v. place into the hands or custody of
example: I saw them making their way, hand in hand, down the path.
exampleZh: 我看到他们手拉手沿着小路朝前走。

meaning: n. 一把；少数，少量； 难以控制的人（或事物）
definition: 1. n. a small number or amount；2. n. the quantity that can be held in the hand
example: Just so I get a show of hands: how many people have heard of Roger Bannister? Ok. A handful.
exampleZh: 举下手：,多少人听说过他？好的，只有少数。

meaning: n. 手册，指南
definition: 1. n. a concise reference book providing specific information about a subject or location
example: Ask your company benefits coordinator for a copy of the benefits handbook.
exampleZh: 向贵公司的福利协调员索取福利手册的副本。

meaning: n. （生理或智力上的）残障，残疾；障碍，不利因素；让步赛；让杆数；v. 妨碍，使不利；预测（可能的获胜者）
definition: 1. n. the condition of being unable to perform as a consequence of physical or mental unfitness；2. v. injure permanently
example: He lost his leg when he was ten, but learned to overcome his handicap.
exampleZh: 他10岁时失去了一条腿，但学会了战胜自己的残疾。

meaning: adj. 残疾的，弱智的；残障人士专用的；n. 残疾人，缺陷者
definition: 1. n. people collectively who are crippled or otherwise physically handicapped；2. adj. markedly unable to function as a consequence of injury or illness
example: I'm going to work two days a week teaching handicapped kids to fish.
exampleZh: 我将每周工作两天教残疾儿童钓鱼。

meaning: n. 手工艺；手工艺品
definition: 1. a skilled activity in which something is made in a traditional way with the hands rather than being produced by machines in a factory, or an object made by such an activity；2. a product that is made by hand rather than by using a machine
example: The market features traditional handicraft produced by artists from surrounding villages.
exampleZh: 这个市场出售周边村庄的艺人制作的传统手工艺品。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: v. 拿；处理，应付；操纵；触（球）；经营，管理；n. 把手，拉手；柄，提手；（理解、解决问题的）方法，途径；（尤指奇怪的）名字，名称；（织物等的）手感；赌注总额；comb. 有……个柄的，有……柄的
definition: 1. n. the appendage to an object that is designed to be held in order to use or move it；2. v. be in charge of, act on, or dispose of
example: And, if we do so, we can actually get a handle on that Born exponent by solving the equation.
exampleZh: 如果我们这样做，我们实际上能够得到波恩指数,通过解这个方程得到。

meaning: adj. （男子）英俊的，帅气的；（女子）端庄健美的；宽敞而美观的，宏伟的；慷慨的，气量大的；（金额）可观的，优厚的；（礼品、奖品）贵重的，值钱的；（胜利）重大的
definition: 1. adj. pleasing in appearance especially by reason of conformity to ideals of form and proportion；2. adj. given or giving freely
example: I know I should be humble, but I'm so handsome that everybody stares.
exampleZh: 我知道我应该谦逊一点，但我真是太英俊了，每个人都盯着我看。

meaning: n. 手写，书写；笔迹，书法；手稿；v. 手写，书写（handwrite 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. something written by hand；2. n. the activity of writing by hand
example: But I often get mails back from students' posts I didn't correctly read their handwriting on the email address.
exampleZh: 我给学生寄的邮件经常被退回来,因为他们的字太差,我总是认错他们写的邮件地址。

meaning: adj. 有用的，方便的，便于使用的；手巧的，有手艺的；手边的，附近的；【名】 （Handy）（美、印、加）汉迪（人名）
definition: 1. n. United States blues musician who transcribed and published traditional blues music (1873-1958)；2. adj. easy to reach
example: It would be good to have a pencil and paper handy.
exampleZh: 把铅笔和纸放在手边会很有好处。

meaning: v. 悬挂，吊；（使）挂在墙上；垂下，垂落；悬浮；绞死；贴，糊（墙纸）；安装（门）；（决定）未做出；逗留，徘徊；投曲线球失败；（尤指驾车时）拐弯；（使）死机；n. 悬挂方式；下垂，低垂；（画展中画作的）陈列，布局；【名】 （Hang）（英）杭，（罗）汉格，（东南亚国家华语）康，（老）汉，（柬）韩（用于名字第一节）（人名）
definition: 1. n. a special way of doing something；2. v. be suspended or hanging
example: My nightlife. I really like to hang out with my friends and go out on the weekends and um,
exampleZh: 我的夜生活。我真的很喜欢和朋友们一起到处闲逛，周末一起出去，

meaning: v. 发生；使遭遇；碰巧；adv. 或许，大概
definition: 1. v. come to pass；2. v. happen, occur, or be the case in the course of events or by chance
example: Just as you are making decisions about your life, where you need to go and what needs to happen next.
exampleZh: 当你正在为自己的人生做决定的时候——你要去哪儿？接下来又会发生什么？

meaning: adj. 快乐的；幸福的，使人高兴的；满意的；乐意的；幸运的；合适的；comb. 滥用……的；【名】 （Happy）（英、瑞典、喀）哈皮（人名）
definition: 1. adj. enjoying or showing or marked by joy or pleasure or good fortune；2. adj. marked by good fortune
example: They are trained and have an interest in modern poetry, and this is a happy collaboration for me with them.
exampleZh: 他们非常有经验，并且对现代诗歌也有所涉猎，对我而言，能和他们一起工作是很令人开心的。

meaning: n. 快乐，幸福
definition: 1. n. state of well-being characterized by emotions ranging from contentment to intense joy；2. n. emotions experienced when in a state of well-being
example: And very interesting for positive psychologists, those concerned with wellbeing and happiness: their wellbeing and happiness levels were incredibly similar.
exampleZh: 让积极心理学学者，和研究幸福和快乐的人，更感兴趣的是：,这些双胞胎的幸福和快乐水平非常相似。

meaning: adv. 快乐地；幸运地；乐意地；合适地
definition: 1. adv. in a joyous manner；2. adv. in an unexpectedly lucky way
example: I was a first year student and happily minding my own business, getting ready to try to pick a summer job.
exampleZh: 我当时是一年级，只关心自己的小生活，想好好准备暑假打个工。

meaning: v. 骚扰；不断攻击（敌人）
definition: 1. to continue to annoy or upset someone over a period of time；2. to annoy or trouble someone repeatedly
example: C: Talk to you later guys, I'm off to harass the cat.
exampleZh: 第三只说：先不跟你们聊了，我要去逮猫了。

meaning: n. 骚扰
definition: 1. behaviour that annoys or upsets someone；2. behavior that annoys or troubles someone
example: The amendment will force senators to show where they stand on the issue of sexual harassment.
exampleZh: 该修正案将迫使参议员们表明他们在性骚扰问题上采取什么立场。

meaning: n. 港，海港，港湾；避难所，避风港；（Harbor）哈伯（人名）；v. 庇护，窝藏；怀有，心怀（想法、情绪）；携带，藏有（病原体、寄生虫等）；入港停泊
definition: 1. n. a sheltered port where ships can take on or discharge cargo；2. v. maintain (a theory, thoughts, or feelings)
example: The Statue of Liberty towers stands above the harbor of New York.
exampleZh: 自由女神像耸立在纽约港的上空。

meaning: adj. 硬的，坚固的；困难的；困苦的，艰苦的；费力的，努力的；坚强的，勇敢的；猛烈的，用力的；冷酷的，严厉的；寒冷的，凛冽的；可证实的，确凿的；刺眼的，（感觉上）难受的；（水）硬的；烈性的，强烈的；（酒）苦涩的；仔细的，认真的；严肃的；强壮的；（政治上）极端的；发硬音的；adv. 努力地，费力地；用力地，猛烈地；仔细地，认真地；沉重地，大量地；变硬；在最大程度上；n. 海滩路；【名】 （Hard）（英、芬、瑞典）哈德（人名）
definition: 1. adj. not easy; requiring great physical or mental effort to accomplish or comprehend or endure；2. adv. with effort or force or vigor
example: He succinctly summed up his manifesto as "Work hard, train hard and play hard."
exampleZh: 他把自己的宣言简明地概括成了“努力工作，努力训练，努力玩耍。”

meaning: v. （使）变硬，坚固；（使）更坚定，更强硬；使变得冷酷无情，使麻木不仁；（使声音，面孔等）更严肃，更严厉；变明确；（价格、经济）变得更稳定；（股票、商品价格等）升水（上涨并保持高价位）；【名】 （Harden）（英、美、加、瑞典）哈登（人名）
definition: 1. v. become hard or harder；2. v. make hard or harder
example: Test to see if the finish is tacky, and if it is, leave it to harden.
exampleZh: 测试一下看看最后一道漆是否还发黏，如果是的话，那就放着让它变硬。

meaning: adv. 几乎不，几乎没有；刚刚，才；几乎无法；差不多，大约；严厉的，苛刻的
definition: 1. adv. by a small margin；2. adv. almost not
example: There's hardly a movie that goes by now that doesn't have products inserted and that's all bought and paid for.
exampleZh: 现在已经很难看到一部,没有品牌植入的电影了,这全都是要花钱的

meaning: n. 困苦，艰难
definition: 1. n. a state of misfortune or affliction；2. n. something hard to endure
example: But it's not a very good thing if my consciousness continues to narrow and constrict beyond the threat, or beyond the hardship.
exampleZh: 但它变得不是很好,如果我的意识继续狭窄,收紧超出威胁，超出困难。

meaning: n. （计算机）硬件；五金制品；装备，设备
definition: 1. n. major items of military weaponry (as tanks or missile)；2. n. instrumentalities (tools or implements) made of metal
example: To be totally secure, you need a piece of hardware that costs about $200.
exampleZh: 为保证绝对安全，你需要一个花费约为两百美元的硬件。

meaning: adj. 坚强的，吃苦耐劳的；（植物）耐寒的；坚定不移的，非常忠诚的；鲁莽的，蛮横的；n. 方柄凿
definition: 1. strong enough to bear extreme conditions or difficult situations；2. Hardy plants can live through the winter without protection from the weather
example: Hardy, arguably the greatest English poet, modern English poet, is a figure we don't study in this course otherwise.
exampleZh: 哈迪，可以说是最伟大的英国诗人，现代英国诗人，然而我们不会在这门课中学习他。

meaning: n. 伤害，损害；v. 危害，损害（某事物）；伤害（人或动物）；【名】 （Harm）（德）哈尔姆（人名）
definition: 1. n. any physical damage to the body caused by violence or accident or fracture etc.；2. v. cause or do harm to
example: It's folly to think that we have about us protective spirits who might actually keep us from harm.
exampleZh: 认为真的有神灵在周围,庇佑我们不受伤害是愚蠢的。

meaning: adj. 有害的，造成伤害的
definition: 1. adj. injurious to physical or mental health；2. adj. able or likely to do harm
example: Water is not an effective shield against the sun's more harmful rays.
exampleZh: 水不能有效阻挡太阳中更有害的射线。

meaning: adj. 无害的，不会导致损伤的；无恶意的，不会引起不快的
definition: 1. adj. not causing or capable of causing harm；2. adj. not injurious to physical or mental health
example: Socrates is not harmless because of his own professed ability to attract followers, a few today, a few more tomorrow.
exampleZh: 苏格拉底并非无害,因为他擅长吸引信徒的能耐,今天几个，明天再几个。

meaning: n. 和声，和弦；融洽，和睦；和谐，协调；（内心的）平静；四福音书的对照统一文本，（内容相似文本的）统一对照本；【名】 （Harmony）（英）哈莫尼（人名）
definition: 1. n. compatibility in opinion and action；2. n. the structure of music with respect to the composition and progression of chords
example: The book contrasts modern civilization with the ideal of the noble savage who lived in harmony with nature.
exampleZh: 这本书将现代文明同与自然界和谐相处的高尚野蛮人的理想进行了对比。

meaning: adj. 和睦的，融洽的；悦耳的；和谐的，协调的
definition: 1. adj. musically pleasing；2. adj. exhibiting equivalence or correspondence among constituents of an entity or between different entities
example: What should be established I think is an artistic, harmonious balance between the reader's mind and the author's mind.
exampleZh: 我觉得需要建立一种能艺术地协调，读者和作者思想之间的平衡,我们要保持些许冷漠。

meaning: v. 控制并利用；（把动物）拴在一起（或拴到某物上）；给（马）套上挽具；连接，串联；n. （马的）挽具，马具；系带，吊带；日常工作
definition: 1. n. a support consisting of an arrangement of straps for holding something to the body (especially one supporting a person suspended from a parachute)；2. v. put a harness
example: Turkey plans to harness the waters of the Tigris and Euphrates rivers for big hydro-electric power projects.
exampleZh: 土耳其计划利用底格里斯河与幼发拉底河的水来建造大型水力发电工程。

meaning: adj. （环境）恶劣的，艰苦的；严厉的，残酷的；刺耳的，难听的；刺眼的，耀眼的；丑陋的；刺激性强的，太强力的；【名】 （Harsh）哈什（人名）
