definition: 1. adj. unpleasantly stern；2. adj. disagreeable to the senses
example: He says, "This book tells a harsh and forbidding story and makes one wonder just exactly what its relation to truth is.
exampleZh: 他这样写道：,“这书讲的是一个既冷血,又令人恐惧的故事,将人置于一个总想知道,它与现实关联的状态“

meaning: n. 收获；收获量，捕获量；成果，收获；v. 收割，收获；采集，搜集；收采（人的器官、细胞等）
definition: 1. n. the yield from plants in a single growing season；2. v. gather, as of natural products
example: Rice farmers here still plant and harvest their crops by hand.
exampleZh: 这里的稻农仍然用手工种植和收割庄稼。

meaning: n. 仓促，急忙；v. 赶紧，匆忙；催促；【名】 （Haste）（英）黑斯特，（法）阿斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. overly eager speed (and possible carelessness)；2. n. the act of moving hurriedly and in a careless manner
example: But it's just this making haste toward publication writing something really great right now --that Milton's resisting here.
exampleZh: 但就是这种想要发表什么的愿望,种想要创作出好文章的愿望，使得弥尔顿在这里坚持。

meaning: adj. 匆忙的，仓促的；草率的，轻率的；易怒的；【名】 （Hasty）（英）黑斯蒂（人名）
definition: 1. adj. excessively quick；2. adj. done with very great haste and without due deliberation
example: I refuse to be stampeded into making any hasty decisions.
exampleZh: 我不愿仓促行事，草率作决定。

meaning: v. 促进，使加快；急忙进行，赶紧说（或做）；赶往（某地）
definition: 1. v. act or move at high speed；2. v. step on it
example: He wanted to tell her how enchanting she had looked the night before and press her to hasten their marriage.
exampleZh: 他想告诉她昨晚她看起来有多么迷人并催促她赶紧和他成婚。

meaning: n. （常指带檐的）帽子；（双重的）职位，角色；v. 给……戴上帽子；供应帽子，制造帽子
definition: 1. n. headdress that protects the head from bad weather; has shaped crown and usually a brim；2. v. put on or wear a hat
example: And that's great if you just want to get a one of like, beautiful hat for a wedding
exampleZh: 如果你想买一个类似于参加婚礼的漂亮的帽子这样的东西，去那儿是很好的，

meaning: v. 孵化，孵出；密谋，策划；n. （船甲板或飞机底部装货物的）舱口；（尤指厨房和餐厅之间供传递食物的）两室之间的小窗口；（飞机或宇宙飞船的）舱门；（地面或天花板的）开口；【名】 （Hatch）（英）哈奇，（西）阿奇（人名）
definition: 1. n. the production of young from an egg；2. v. emerge from the eggs
example: The female must find a warm place to hatch her eggs.
exampleZh: 母的必须找个温暖的地方孵蛋。

meaning: v. 厌恶，不喜欢；仇恨，憎恨；（表示不愿说某事，或客气地请求）不愿，不想；n. 憎恶，憎恨；所憎恶的人（或事物）；【名】 （Hate）（法）阿特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the emotion of hate; a feeling of dislike so strong that it demands action；2. v. dislike intensely; feel antipathy or aversion towards
example: It's a... I'd hate to learn all by, when I was a little kid, when I learned, but...
exampleZh: 我小的时候很讨厌学，我学的时候…

meaning: n. 仇恨，憎恨，敌意
definition: 1. n. the emotion of hate; a feeling of dislike so strong that it demands action
example: Peter was such a small boy that one tends to wonder at the man's hatred of him.
exampleZh: 彼得是这样一个小男孩，人们往往会对这个人对他的憎恨感到奇怪。

meaning: adj. 可恶的，令人讨厌的；心怀仇恨的，充满憎恨的
definition: 1. adj. evoking or deserving hatred；2. adj. characterized by malice
example: To-day she was coming at last, but again in company with this hateful stranger.
exampleZh: 今天她终于来了，但又和这个可恶的陌生人作伴。

meaning: v. （用力）拖，拉；强迫（某人）去某处；费力前进，艰难地走；迫使（某人）出庭受审；（用运载工具）运送，运输；（费力地）升级；（尤指帆船）突然改变航道；n. 拖，拉；大批赃物，大量非法物品；赛季（或赛事）得分总数；旅行的距离；一网的捕鱼量；托运的距离；【名】 （Haul）（威尔士）豪尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of drawing or hauling something；2. v. draw slowly or heavily
example: A crane had to be used to haul the car out of the stream.
exampleZh: 不得不用了一台起重机把轿车从河里拉出来。

meaning: v. （鬼魂）出没；萦绕在……心头；（长期）困扰；常去（某地）；n. 常去的地方；栖息地
definition: 1. n. a frequently visited place；2. v. follow stealthily or recur constantly and spontaneously to
example: Well, in Tennyson sound is the device, "the murmurous haunt"--oh, I have no memory at all today.
exampleZh: 在坦尼森的的作品中声音扮演同样的角色，那沙沙的萦绕之声，哦不，我记混了。

meaning: v. 拥有；有（想法、主意、观点等）；显示出，带有（性质、特征）；做，进行（活动）；吃，喝，抽（烟）；患病，得病；得到，收到；经历，经受；担负（责任）；导致，产生（影响）；生，生育；包括；使保持，使处于；明白，懂得；抓住，紧握；欺骗；让，叫，命令；照看；（在家中）招待，款待；允许，容忍；辩过，胜过；已经，曾经（与过去分词连用构成完成时）；与（某人）性交；n. 有钱人（the haves）；诈骗；【名】 （Have）（德）哈弗，（芬）哈韦（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person who possesses great material wealth；2. v. have or possess, either in a concrete or an abstract sense
example: Have you been able to have any kind of contact?
exampleZh: 你取得任何联系了吗?

meaning: n. 安全地，避难所；港口，港湾；v. 为……提供避难所；【名】 （Haven）（美）黑文（人名）
definition: 1. a safe or peaceful place；2. an area of water next to the coast where ships and boats can shelter, or a small port
example: Some Democrats support granting the Haitians temporary safe haven in the U.S.
exampleZh: 一些民主党人支持为海地人提供在美国的临时避难所。

meaning: n. 灾难，混乱；v. 严重破坏；严重破坏；【名】 （Havoc）（英）哈沃克（人名）
definition: 1. confusion and lack of order, especially causing damage or trouble；2. confusion and lack of order that result in damage or trouble
example: Can the body ingest this particular item and deal with it in a reasonable way and not have internal havoc occur?
exampleZh: 营养能否被身体摄取,能否被适当的消化,不导致机体的紊乱

meaning: n. 鹰，隼；鹰派分子，主战分子；（似鹰般）贪婪的人；灰泥托板；v. 叫卖，兜售；咳痰；（人）带鹰出猎；（鸟，蜻蜓）飞行觅食；【名】 （Hawk）奥克（人名）
definition: 1. a type of large bird that catches small birds and animals for food；2. a person who strongly supports the use of force in political relationships rather than discussion or other more peaceful solutions
example: The hawk says he is a fool who tries to match his strength with the stronger.
exampleZh: 鹰说,我是一个愚蠢的,妄图与强权较量的傻子

meaning: n. （用作饲料的）干草； 少量的钱；v. 割草晒干
definition: 1. n. grass mowed and cured for use as fodder；2. v. convert (plant material) into hay
example: The hay, that is, well, what? The payoff, what the poem is all about, what mowing is all about.
exampleZh: 这堆草又是什么呢，是成果，诗歌的成果，割草的结果。

meaning: n. 危险，危害；（不可避免的）风险；（高尔夫球道）障碍物（如池塘或沙地）；机会，机遇；双骰子游戏；（网球）可得分区域；（台球）使球触他球后落入袋中的一击；v. 冒失地提出，冒险猜测；使遭危险，使处于危险；【名】 （Hazard）哈泽德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a source of danger; a possibility of incurring loss or misfortune；2. v. put forward, of a guess, in spite of possible refutation
example: The recent outbreaks of cholera are a timely reminder that this disease is still a serious health hazard.
exampleZh: 最近几次爆发的霍乱是一个适时的提醒，该疾病依然是个严重的健康危害。

meaning: adj. 危险的，有害的；碰运气的
definition: 1. adj. involving risk or danger
example: The report calls for a ban on the import of hazardous waste.
exampleZh: 这篇报道呼吁禁止危险废弃物的进口。

meaning: n. 霾，烟雾；懵懂，迷糊；v. 变朦胧；戏弄（大学新生，作为入学或入会仪式的一部分）；变糊涂；使劳累，使劳役折磨；【名】 （Haze）（法）阿泽（人名）
definition: 1. n. atmospheric moisture or dust or smoke that causes reduced visibility；2. v. become hazy, dull, or cloudy
example: Mist was rising, and trees and shrubs began to disappear in a milk-white haze.
exampleZh: 薄雾正在升起，树木和灌木丛开始消失在一片乳白色的雾霭之中。

meaning: adj. 雾蒙蒙的，朦胧的；记不清的，模糊的；主意不定的，困惑的；【名】 （Hazy）（瑞典）哈叙（人名）
definition: 1. adj. filled or abounding with fog or mist；2. adj. indistinct or hazy in outline
example: The air was thin and crisp, filled with hazy sunshine and frost.
exampleZh: 空气稀薄而清新，弥漫着朦胧的阳光与霜霭。

meaning: pron. 他；（泛指的）人；上帝；n. 男性，男子；雄性动物；n. （He）（中、美、丹）赫（人名）
definition: 1. n. a very light colorless element that is one of the six inert gasses; the most difficult gas to liquefy; occurs in economically extractable amounts in certain natural gases (as those found in Texas and Kansas)；2. n. the 5th letter of the Hebrew alphabet
example: But it's also interesting that he says he trusted that traditional living voice more than he trusted written documents.
exampleZh: 同样有意思的是，他说自己更相信,口述传统而不是文献。

meaning: n. 头；头脑，智力；顶部；排头；领导人，负责人；校长，院长；人数，（动物的）头数；（植物的）叶球，头状花序；一头长，一头高；钉头，锤头；啤酒沫；（河流）源头；脓头；硬币正面（有人头像）；磁头；（短语的）中心词，主导词；水压，蒸汽压力；紧要关头；桌子的上首座位，床头；头痛；蓄水高度，水头；v. 朝（某方向）行进；领导，主管；居……之首；加标题；用头顶（球）；形成……的头或顶部；砍（植物或树木的）枝；（莴苣，卷心菜）结球，长成球状；发源；adj. 领头的，负责的；头的；在顶端的；从前方来的；adv. （硬币）有头像的一面朝上（heads）；【名】 （Head）（英）黑德（人名）
definition: 1. n. the upper part of the human body or the front part of the body in animals; contains the face and brains；2. v. to go or travel towards
example: If you head up around, like Clement, near like Arguello, like just a couple blocks south of the Presidio,
exampleZh: 要是直走，就是克莱门街，挨着阿圭罗街，距离普雷西迪奥两个街区的距离，

meaning: n. 头痛；使人头痛的事，难题
definition: 1. n. something or someone that causes anxiety; a source of unhappiness；2. n. pain in the head caused by dilation of cerebral arteries or muscle contractions or a reaction to drugs
example: After all, when is a headache bad for me?
exampleZh: 毕竟，什么时候头疼对我来说有坏处？

meaning: n. 标题，题目；类名，条目；方向，航向；（为筑隧道作准备而造的）横向巷道；顶幔；v. 朝（某方向）行进；领导；位于排行之首（动词head 的现在分词形式）；【名】 （Heading）（美）黑丁（人名）
definition: 1. n. a line of text serving to indicate what the passage below it is about；2. n. the direction or path along which something moves or along which it lies
example: What projection does is takes a desire from me and then puts it on somebody else heading outwards.
exampleZh: 投射是指个体否认自己的欲望,并认为他人拥有此欲望。

meaning: n. （报纸的）标题，大字标题；（广播或电视里的）新闻提要，头条新闻；v. 给（报道、文章）加标题；在（演出）中担任主演；大肆宣传
definition: 1. n. the heading or caption of a newspaper article；2. v. publicize widely or highly, as if with a headline
example: Both newspapers carried the same banner headline, "Where are you, Mr. President?"
exampleZh: 两份报纸刊登了相同的头版通栏大标题：“总统先生，你在哪里？”

meaning: n. 校长
definition: 1. n. presiding officer of a school
example: He was headmaster of a public school in the West of England.
exampleZh: 他曾是英格兰西部一所公学的校长。

meaning: n. 女校长（尤指英国私立学校的女性校长）
definition: 1. n. a woman headmaster
example: When I began working at Hillcrest High School three years ago, I was introduced to Sharon Dunn, the school's headmistress.
exampleZh: 三年前，当我开始在希尔克雷斯特高中工作时，我被介绍给了该校的校长沙伦·邓恩。

meaning: n. 总部，总公司；司令部，指挥部
definition: 1. n. (usually plural) the office that serves as the administrative center of an enterprise；2. n. the military installation from which a commander performs the functions of command
example: It was Bear Sterns, whose headquarters is right next to Grand Central Station, if you go into New York.
exampleZh: 贝尔斯登公司,这家公司的总部紧挨着大中央车站,你一到纽约就能看到

meaning: v. 痊愈，康复；（感情创伤）愈合，（情感）恢复常态；（使）（裂痕、创伤）弥合，（使）和好；止息（争斗），调停；修复（对土地的破坏）；减轻（痛苦）
definition: 1. v. heal or recover；2. v. get healthy again
example: It was a hurt that would take a long time to heal.
exampleZh: 那是需要很长时间才能愈合的创伤。

meaning: n. 身体状况；健康；医疗，卫生；（组织或系统的）运行状况，运作状况；发达，兴旺
definition: 1. n. a healthy state of wellbeing free from disease；2. n. the general condition of body and mind
example: High adherence scores, good adherence to the Mediterranean Diet across all these studies, was associated with these particular health outcomes.
exampleZh: 高遵循度值,即在研究中高度遵循地中海式饮食的人,被证实与以下这些健康性结果有相关性

meaning: adj. 健康的，健壮的；有益身心的；明智的，合理的；运作良好的，兴旺发达的；大量的，可观的
definition: 1. adj. having or indicating good health in body or mind; free from infirmity or disease；2. adj. financially secure and functioning well
example: But it's really healthy. It's healthy food and I think it's a way we can learn to prepare food.
exampleZh: 但那其实很健康。食物很健康，我们应该学着那样做。

meaning: adj. 有益于健康的，促进健康的；健全的
definition: 1. adj. conducive to good health of body or mind；2. adj. free from filth and pathogens
example: Does the college cafeteria provide a healthful diet?
exampleZh: 此大学餐厅是否供应有益健康的膳食？

meaning: n. （凌乱的）一堆；许多，大量；破旧的汽车，老爷车；v. 堆积，堆放；对……大加赞扬（或指责等）；【名】 （Heap）（英）希普，（芬）海亚普，（东南亚国家华语）协（人名）
definition: 1. n. a collection of objects laid on top of each other；2. v. bestow in large quantities
example: She piled the papers in a heap on her desk, just anyhow.
exampleZh: 她把文件在桌上随便搁成一堆。

meaning: v. 听到，听见；聆听，倾听；听说，得知；审理，听审；脑际响起；听明白
definition: 1. v. perceive (sound) via the auditory sense；2. v. get to know or become aware of, usually accidentally
example: I mean, as an example, I am a musician, but I go to Borders and Barnes & Noble to hear...
exampleZh: 我的意思是，例如，我是一个音乐家，但我去博德斯书店和巴恩斯诺贝尔书店去听……

meaning: n. 听力，听觉；审讯，听证会；解释机会，申辩机会；听力范围；v. 听到，听见；聆听，倾听；听说，得知（动词hear 的现在分词形式）；【名】 （Hearing）（英）希尔林（人名）
definition: 1. n. (law) a proceeding (usually by a court) where evidence is taken for the purpose of determining an issue of fact and reaching a decision based on that evidence；2. adj. able to perceive sound
example: And I'm going to ask you to think of all of the images here, the figurations of listening and hearing in the mask.
exampleZh: 我叫你们想象下这场景，《面具》里听觉和视觉的轮廓。

meaning: n. 心，心脏；内心，感情；胸前；重点，核心；中心，中央；信心，勇气；（表示爱的）心形物；红桃牌，红心牌；菜心；同情，怜悯；爱情，情爱；（土地的）肥力；v. 喜爱，深爱；【名】 （Heart）（英）哈特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the locus of feelings and intuitions；2. n. the hollow muscular organ located behind the sternum and between the lungs; its rhythmic contractions move the blood through the body
example: I mean, you can go anywhere and everywhere, and USF is located in the heart of San Francisco, so.
exampleZh: 我是说，你去哪儿都行，旧金山大学坐落在旧金山的中心位置。

meaning: adj. 热情友好的；精力充沛的，强健的；丰盛的；真挚的，强烈的；假装热情友好的；n. 开朗活泼之人；好伙计
definition: 1. adj. showing warm and heartfelt friendliness；2. adj. providing abundant nourishment
example: When I have time, I will have a hearty midday meal.
exampleZh: 当我有时间的时候，我就会吃一顿丰盛的午餐。

meaning: adj. 由衷的，诚挚的
definition: 1. adj. earnest
example: Our heartfelt sympathy goes out to the victims of the war.
exampleZh: 我们对战争的受害者表示由衷的同情。

meaning: n. 热能，热量；炎热，高温；（做饭的）热源，热度；辣味；愤怒，激动；压力，逼迫；暖气；预赛；（尤指在熔炉中熔炼金属时的）单次熔炼；v. 激起，使激动；加热，使变暖
definition: 1. n. a form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature；2. v. make hot or hotter
example: You could run the reaction, take solid iron gaseous oxygen, form iron oxide, measure the heat of formation of it, tabulate it.
exampleZh: 你可以进行一个反应,用固态铁和氧气生成氧化铁，测量它的生成热，列成表格。

meaning: adj. 加热的，有供暖系统的；激烈的，愤怒的；v. 加热，使变暖；激起，使激动（heat 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. made warm or hot (`het' is a dialectal variant of `heated')；2. adj. marked by emotional heat; vehement
example: And a guy named--a Republican named John Boehner won this position in quite a heated battle.
exampleZh: 共和党一个叫约翰的家伙,在白热化的争斗中赢得了席位。

meaning: n. （尤指从经济角度考虑的）供暖，暖气供应；供暖系统，暖气设备；v. 加热，使变暖；激起，使激动（heat 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. the process of becoming warmer; a rising temperature；2. n. utility to warm a building
example: so I'm heating up the system in this path here, and then to connect the 2 endpoints here, a constant temperature path.
exampleZh: 需要再用，一个等温过程，这两个状态。

meaning: v. 用力举起，使劲拖；（用力）扔，抛；起伏；发出（叹息）；恶心，呕吐；人头攒动，挤满（人）；用绳将（船）拉动（或往高处拖动）；n. （用力）举，拉；（用力）扔；（剧烈的）起伏；（地质）平错，隆起
definition: 1. to move something heavy using a lot of effort；2. to throw something forcefully, especially something large and heavy
example: With a mighty heave he lifted the sack onto the truck.
exampleZh: 他用劲一举，把大麻袋扔到卡车上。

meaning: n. 天堂，天国；极乐之地，极乐；天空；神，诸神；与上帝同享永福；int. （表示惊讶或强调）天哪
definition: 1. n. any place of complete bliss and delight and peace；2. n. the abode of God and the angels
example: Then she has this revelation where she is actually seeing who is going into heaven and it's all the people.
exampleZh: 后来她突然醒悟,因为她看到了前往天堂的人们,每个人都上了天堂。

meaning: adj. 重的，沉的；大量的，严重的；大而结实的，不精致的；厚实的；充满（某物）（heavy with）；重型的，大型的；繁忙的；辛苦的，费力的；用力的，重重的；难消化的；难懂的，艰涩的；危险的，汹涌的；闷热的，沉闷的；浓郁的；（土壤）黏重的；苛刻的，严厉的；认真的，严肃的；（声音）粗重的；（身体部位）沉重的；（心情）忧伤的；n. 保镖，打手；（电影或戏剧中的）反派；重要人物； 严肃报纸（heavies）；烈性啤酒；adv. 浓浓地，沉重地；使不安，使担忧
definition: 1. n. an actor who plays villainous roles；2. adj. of comparatively great physical weight or density
example: I used to listen to a lot of hip-hop music and heavy metal when I was younger.
exampleZh: 我年轻的时候，我常常听一些嘻哈和重金属音乐。

meaning: n. 公顷（土地丈量单位，等于1万平方米或约2.5英亩）
definition: 1. n. (abbreviated `ha') a unit of surface area equal to 100 ares (or 10,000 square meters)
example: His family had a 40-hectare farm on which they grew wheat, maize and hay and raised pigs and cattle.
exampleZh: 他家有一个40公顷的农场，种植小麦、玉米和干草，还养猪和牛。

meaning: adj. 繁忙的，忙乱的；（脸）潮红的；（与）痨病（有关）的，发痨病热的；n. 潮热，痨病热
definition: 1. full of activity, or very busy and fast；2. busy, fast, and full of activity
example: It seems to ease all the aches and pains of a hectic and tiring day.
exampleZh: 它似乎可以减轻繁忙疲劳的一天带来的所有疼痛。

meaning: n. 树篱；防范措施，防备手段；v. 拐弯抹角，避免正面回答；用树篱围住；包围，限制；采取保值措施以规避风险；【名】 （Hedge）（美、英、加、澳、印、法）赫奇（人名）
definition: 1. n. a fence formed by a row of closely planted shrubs or bushes；2. v. avoid or try to avoid fulfilling, answering, or performing (duties, questions, or issues)
example: Well,if hedge funds first became mainstream maybe fifteen years ago, then what are you looking at in terms of history?
exampleZh: 如果对冲基金,在15年前就变成主流,那么你会在它们的历史记录中看到什么呢

meaning: n. 脚后跟；鞋后跟；高跟鞋；手掌根；坏蛋，无赖；袜子后跟；（船的）倾侧度；（小提琴琴弓的）弓跟；（高尔夫）棒杆弯头；面包硬头，干酪硬皮；（植物的）踵；v. 倾斜；给（鞋等）修理后跟；用棒杆弯头击（球）；并列争球时用脚后跟往回传（球）；跳舞时以后跟触地；（唤狗用语）跟上；（由于风力或装载不平衡而）倾侧；使（船）倾侧；int. 跟着我（让狗紧跟在身后的命令）；【名】 （Heel）（德）黑尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. the bottom of a shoe or boot; the back part of a shoe or boot that touches the ground and provides elevation；2. v. tilt to one side
example: With a snarl, the second dog made a dive for his heel.
exampleZh: 伴着一声嗥叫，第二条狗扑向了他的脚后跟。

meaning: n. 身高；高；高度；高处，高地；极佳状况；极端例子
definition: 1. n. the vertical dimension of extension; distance from the base of something to the top；2. n. the highest level or degree attainable; the highest stage of development
example: This is a poem written in the depth of the Depression and also at the height of Frost's fame.
exampleZh: 这是一首写在经济危机时候的诗,也是在弗罗斯特最有名的时候。

meaning: v. 提高，增强
definition: 1. v. become more extreme；2. v. make more extreme; raise in quantity, degree, or intensity
example: It sets the tone of your moves and it could heighten the excitement of your performance.
exampleZh: 它为你的动作奠定基调，还能提升表演的感染力。

meaning: n. 继承人，子嗣；接班人；v. 继承
definition: 1. n. a person who is entitled by law or by the terms of a will to inherit the estate of another；2. n. a person who inherits some title or office
example: He is the eldest son and thus heir to the title.
exampleZh: 他是长子，因此是这个封号的继承人。

meaning: n. 女继承人
definition: 1. n. a female heir
example: An heiress, she doesn't know what to be when she grows up, either.
exampleZh: 作为家族继承人，在长大之后她也不知道该做什么。

meaning: n. 直升机；v. 用直升机运送；乘直升机飞至（某地）
definition: 1. n. an aircraft without wings that obtains its lift from the rotation of overhead blades
example: The helicopter rose into the air.
exampleZh: 直升机升上了天空。

meaning: n. 地狱；苦难的经历；（有人认为含冒犯意）该死，见鬼；int. 见鬼（用于表示生气或恼怒）；v. 过放荡生活；【名】 （Hell）（柬）海，（西）埃利，（德、匈、捷、罗、芬、瑞典）黑尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. any place of pain and turmoil；2. n. a cause of difficulty and suffering
example: I really thought as an entrepreneur, as a startup, you really cannot spend money like hell without thinking about tomorrow.
exampleZh: 作为一个创业者，在创业初期,不能随意烧钱而至公司未来于不顾。

meaning: int. 喂，你好（用于问候或打招呼）；喂，你好（打电话时的招呼语）；喂，你好（引起别人注意的招呼语）；喂，嘿 (认为别人说了蠢话或分心)；嘿（表示惊讶）；n. 招呼，问候；（Hello）（法、印、美、俄）埃洛（人名）；v. 说（或大声说）“喂”；打招呼
definition: 1. abstract: "Hello" is a song by American pop recording duo Karmin. The song is the second official single from their debut EP of the same name, Hello.
example: But I think the more you meet people, here it's, the more you say hello, the more it's familiar.
exampleZh: 但我想，你见的人越多，你说的“你好”越多，你就会越发熟悉这一切的。

meaning: n. 头盔，安全帽；（尤指唇形科和兰科花朵的）花冠盔瓣，唇瓣；冠螺；【名】 （Helmet）（德）黑尔梅特（人名)
definition: 1. a strong, hard hat that covers and protects the head；2. a hard hat that covers and protects the head
example: He waved back, put down the kickstand, and took off his helmet.
exampleZh: 他向后挥挥手，放下撑脚架，并脱掉他的头盔。

meaning: v. 帮助，援助；改善状况，对……有益；给（自己或某人）食物或饮料；擅自拿走，窃取；搀扶，带领；n. 帮助，协助；有助益的东西（如忠告、钱等）；有用；救助；有帮助的人（或事物）；佣人；（计算机程序提供使用说明的）求助程序；int. 救命（呼救用语）；【名】 （Help）（芬）海尔普 （人名）
definition: 1. n. the activity of contributing to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose；2. v. give help or assistance; be of service
example: then I think absolutely plastic surgery can... maybe should be used if it's going to help with your self-confidence.
exampleZh: 那么我觉得整形手术一定能……如果它能帮你增强自信，就应该整形。

meaning: adj. 有帮助的，有用的；愿意帮忙的
definition: 1. adj. providing assistance or serving a useful function；2. adj. of service or assistance
example: It was very helpful for overcoming shyness and for just having a good time and being a little silly.
exampleZh: 这个课在克服害羞方面很有用，它让人很开心，也让人有点幽默。

meaning: adj. 无助的，无奈的；情不自禁的
definition: 1. adj. lacking in or deprived of strength or power；2. adj. unable to function; without help
example: Parents often feel helpless, knowing that all the hugs in the world won't stop the tears.
exampleZh: 家长们常常感到无能为力，知道世上所有的拥抱也不能止住眼泪。

meaning: adv. 无助地；无法控制地
definition: 1. adv. in a helpless manner
example: "I can't either," cried Pinocchio; and his laughter turned to tears as he stumbled about helplessly.
exampleZh: “我也不能了。”皮诺乔叫道。当他无助地跌跌撞撞时，他的笑声变成了眼泪。

meaning: n. （地球的）半球；脑半球；（球体的）一半
definition: 1. one of two halves of the earth, especially above or below the equator；2. one of the two halves of the brain
example: Those of you who are right-handed, which comprises about nine out of ten people, have language in your left hemisphere.
exampleZh: 大约九成的人,都是右利手,他们的语言功能定位于左半球

meaning: n. 母鸡；雌禽；（小）姑娘；用于其他鸟的名称（尤指秧鸡科水鸟）；雌龙虾（或螃蟹、鲑鱼）；【名】 （Hen）（法）昂，（波、柬）亨，（日）边（人名）
definition: 1. n. adult female chicken；2. n. adult female bird
example: This allows the pair to mate properly and stops the hen from staying in the nest.
exampleZh: 这可以使这一对正常交配同时也阻止雌禽待在窝里。

meaning: adv. 因此；之后
definition: 1. adv. (used to introduce a logical conclusion) from that fact or reason or as a result；2. adv. from this place
example: The trade imbalance is likely to rise again in 2007. Hence a new set of policy actions will be required soon.
exampleZh: 贸易不平衡在2007年可能会再度上扬。因此需要很快采取一系列新的政策行动。

meaning: adv. 从此之后
definition: 1. starting from this time
example: Henceforth all branches of the naval officer corps were equal to one another.
exampleZh: 从此以后海军军官团的各个分支都相互平等。

meaning: pron. 她（she的宾格）；她的（she的所有格）；她（指某个国家；一艘船）；n. （法）埃尔（人名）
definition: 1. abstract: her (healthy.energy.
example: I composed pastiches: : "Fraulein von Kulp may turn her hand upon the door. I will not follow her.
exampleZh: 歪歪扭扭的小品文，我还创作模仿他人的打油诗：,冯·库尔普小姐，或许会转身将手放在门上我，不会跟随她。

meaning: v. 预示……的来临；宣布，宣传；热烈欢迎；公开称赞；n. 预兆；使者，先驱；棘翅夜蛾； 掌礼官，（负责比武大会的）纹章官；（英国）宗谱纹章院或苏格兰纹章院官员（位低于纹章官助理）；【名】 （Herald）（美、英、印度）赫勒尔德（人名）
definition: 1. to be a sign that something important, and often good, is starting to happen, or to make something publicly known, especially by celebrating or praising it；2. a sign that something will happen, change, etc.
example: He picked up extra money as a local stringer for the New York Herald.
exampleZh: 他通过做《纽约先驱报》的本地特约记者赚了些外快。

meaning: n. 药草，香草；草本植物；【名】 （Herb）（德、英、瑞典）赫布（人名）
definition: 1. a type of plant whose leaves are used in cooking to give flavour to particular dishes or in making medicine
example: Technically speaking, a spice is part of an aromatic plant that is not a leaf or herb.
exampleZh: 从技术上讲，香料是芳香植物的一部分，不只是叶子或药草。

meaning: adj. 药草的，香草的；n. 草本植物志，草药志
definition: 1. relating to or made from herbs；2. relating to herbs, or made from herbs
example: Three of the new products are based on traditional herbal medicines.
exampleZh: 新产品中有三种是根据传统草药研制的。

meaning: n. 兽群，畜群；人群，民众；v. 驱赶（兽群），放牧；使（人）成群移动；【名】 （Herd）（英、芬）赫德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a group of cattle or sheep or other domestic mammals all of the same kind that are herded by humans；2. v. cause to herd, drive, or crowd together
example: A herd of goats was nibbling the turf around the base of the tower.
exampleZh: 一群山羊正在啃着塔基周围的草皮。

meaning: adv. 在这里，此处；到这里，朝这里（常与 come、go 等连用）；此时，此刻；在这一点上，在这方面；给，这就是（用于句首或给予时引出）；int. 嘿，喂！（用于引起注意或应答）；n. 这里，此处
definition: 1. n. the present location; this place；2. adj. being here now
example: So let's take a look down here at what I'm doing and notice here that this is perhaps more compelling; right?
exampleZh: 让我们往下看一下我在做什么,请注意这里这个可能是更引人入胜的，对不？

meaning: adv. 以此，特此
definition: 1. adv. (formal) by means of this
example: The yeas are 52 and the nays are 49; the nomination is hereby confirmed.
exampleZh: 52票赞成，49票反对；特此确认提名。

meaning: n. 遗产，传统，世袭财产；（植物种类）纯种的，老品种的；特殊（或个人）的所有物，（该有的）一份；上帝选择的人（以色列人或基督教教会）；【名】 （Heritage）（英）赫里蒂奇（人名）
definition: 1. n. practices that are handed down from the past by tradition；2. n. any attribute or immaterial possession that is inherited from ancestors
example: So it was good. I kind of got to know my own heritage and my own land.
exampleZh: 所以去伦敦上学很好。我可以了解我们的祖先和国家。

meaning: n. 英雄，勇士；男主角，男主人公；偶像，崇拜对象；（夹有冷切肉、乳酪、沙拉等的）长卷三明治；（神话或传说中的）超人
definition: 1. n. a man distinguished by exceptional courage and nobility and strength；2. n. the principal character in a play or movie or novel or poem
example: On your journey, and this is also true of the study of folklore, you need a helper. That's part of fiction. You need another hero.
exampleZh: 在你的旅途中，一些民间传说的研究也能证明，你一定需要一个帮手，当然这里面也有虚构成分，你需要英雄。

meaning: adj. 英雄的，英勇的；矢志不渝的，艰苦卓绝的；巨大的；男主角的；（雕像）大于真人（或实物）但不及其两倍大的；n. 勇敢果断的行为；哗众取宠的愚蠢行为；英雄诗体
definition: 1. n. a verse form suited to the treatment of heroic or elevated themes; dactylic hexameter or iambic pentameter；2. adj. very imposing or impressive; surpassing the ordinary (especially in size or scale)
example: That is, this kind of aristocratic outfit, aristocracy of birth, which is legitimized by heroic behavior on the battlefield.
exampleZh: 也就是说,由于他们在战场上的英雄行为,他们的贵族的身份和贵族出身是被认可的

meaning: n. 英雄气概，英勇行为
definition: 1. n. the qualities of a hero or heroine; exceptional or heroic courage when facing danger (especially in battle)
example: It illustrates Satan's self-destruction even as the main narrative of the simile portrays Satan's heroism.
exampleZh: 这个故事讲述了撒旦的自我毁灭,尽管它也描述了撒旦的英雄主义。

meaning: n. 海洛因
definition: 1. a powerful illegal drug
example: The authorities have placed the drug in Class A, the same category as heroin and cocaine.
exampleZh: 当局已把这种毒品定为A级，与海洛因和可卡因属同一类。

meaning: pron. （上文提过的女性）她的，属于她的；n. （Hers）（法、美、英）埃尔（人名）
definition: 1. abstract: her (healthy.energy.
example: She spoils those kids of hers.
exampleZh: 她那几个孩子给她宠坏了。

meaning: pron. 她自己（she 的反身代词）；她亲自
definition: 1. used by a woman or girl to refer to herself as the object or for emphasis
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: The Lady had claimed for herself a remarkable set of powers, but she wasn't yet ready to use them.
exampleZh: 女士要求给她自己一系列权力，但是她并未做好准备使用这些权力。

meaning: v. 犹豫，不愿意
definition: 1. v. pause or hold back in uncertainty or unwillingness；2. v. interrupt temporarily an activity before continuing
example: This could make your superiors hesitate to trust you with major responsibilities.
exampleZh: 这可能会使你的上司犹豫着不愿把重大职责托付给你。

meaning: n. 犹豫，不情愿
definition: 1. n. indecision in speech or action；2. n. a certain degree of unwillingness
example: Asked if he would go back, Mr. Searle said after some hesitation, "I'll have to think about that."
exampleZh: 当被问及他是否愿意回去时，瑟尔先生迟疑了一下后说：“我得考虑一下。”

meaning: adj. 犹豫的，不愿的
definition: 1. adj. lacking decisiveness of character; unable to act or decide quickly or firmly；2. adj. acting with uncertainty or hesitance or lack of confidence
example: Davis's solo work exhibits all the earmarks of his style: it is hesitant, tentative, spare.
exampleZh: 戴维斯的独奏曲尽展其风格特征：犹豫、迟疑、俭朴。

meaning: int. 嗨！（表示问候或用以唤起注意）；n. （口语）一声“嗨”，问候；（Hi）人名；（柬）希
definition: 1. n. an expression of greeting；2. n. a state in the United States in the central Pacific on the Hawaiian Islands
example: Bob Metcalfe Hi, my name is Bob Metcalfe. I'm here today to talk about the Next Big Thing-the video internet.
exampleZh: 嗨，我的名字叫,今天我要在此谈论下一重大事件--网络视频。

meaning: v. 冬眠；（人）（长期）蛰居，不活动
definition: 1. (of some animals) to spend the winter sleeping
example: My current pet name for her is "bear" because she has to hibernate every night.
exampleZh: 我现在给她的爱称是“熊熊”，因为她每天晚上都要冬眠。

meaning: n. 冬眠；（人）蛰居，不活动
definition: 1. the state of being asleep for the winter
example: Female bears normally give birth to tiny walnut-sized cubs during their winter hibernation and suckle them for months.
exampleZh: 母熊通常在冬眠期间产下胡桃大小的幼仔，哺乳几个月。

meaning: v. 把……藏起来，隐藏；躲藏，躲避；遮住，遮挡；掩盖，隐瞒；n. （可观察鸟兽行动的）隐匿处，埋伏处；兽皮；（困境中的）生命，人身安全
definition: 1. n. the dressed skin of an animal (especially a large animal)；2. v. prevent from being seen or discovered
example: You still have to hide the note from theft, but at least you don't have to hide a whole bunch of gold from theft.
exampleZh: 你仍然需要小心藏好票据防止被偷走,但是至少你不用,再藏一堆金子了

meaning: n. 隐藏，躲藏；体罚，痛打；惨败；v. 把……藏起来，隐藏；躲藏，躲避；掩盖，隐瞒（hide 的现在分词形式）；【名】 （Hiding）（美）希丁（人名）
definition: 1. n. the activity of keeping something secret
example: We've used the fundamental equations that are hiding down here, out of sight but never out of mind.
exampleZh: 我们利用了,写在这里的基本方程，虽然没有注意它但却时时刻刻记者它。

meaning: n. 等级制度；统治集团；等级体系
definition: 1. a system in which people or things are arranged according to their importance；2. the people in the upper levels of an organization who control it
example: Like most other American companies with a rigid hierarchy, workers and managers had strictly defined duties.
exampleZh: 像大多数其他等级制度森严的美国公司一样，工人和管理人员都有严格界定的职责。

meaning: adj. 分等级的，等级制度的
definition: 1. arranged according to people's or things' level of importance, or relating to such a system；2. arranged in a hierarchy
example: This pane shows all the projects you have under the same workspace and their objects in a hierarchical structure.
exampleZh: 该面板以层次结构显示同一个工作区中的所有项目，以及它们的对象。

meaning: adj. 高的；富含……的；重要的；先进的，高级的；崇高的；高音的，声音尖锐的；兴高采烈的；喝醉了的，（吸毒后）极度兴奋的；十分赞同的，非常尊敬的；中间的，全盛的；开始变质的，开始发馊的；（宗教或政治观点）极端的，偏激的；（元音）舌位高的；n. 最高水平，最大数量；兴奋，高兴；高气压区；（毒品引致的）快感；高中，中学；强档；高音，高音符；adv. （成本、价值、音量）高，（数量）大；在高处，向高处；【名】 （High）（英）海伊（人名）
definition: 1. n. a lofty level or position or degree；2. adj. greater than normal in degree or intensity or amount
example: You know, Baidu was founded at the beginning of 2000, and quickly NASDAQ reached its historical high of 5,000.
exampleZh: 百度成立于2000年初，不久，纳斯达克指数创下5000点的新高。

meaning: adv. 极其，非常；高度地，高水平地；钦佩地，赞赏地；在高处，地位高
definition: 1. adv. to a high degree or extent; favorably or with much respect；2. adv. at a high rate or wage
example: They different greatly in style. Genesis 1 is formalized, it's highly structured, it has the seven days and everything's paired up.
exampleZh: 风格迥异，《创世纪》1，很书面化,结构严谨，什么东西都是成双成对的。

meaning: v. 突出，强调；用亮色突出；挑染；n. 最好（或最精彩、最激动人心）的部分；挑染的头发；强光部分
definition: 1. n. the most interesting or memorable part；2. v. move into the foreground to make more visible or prominent
example: And I want to just highlight it for you because we're going to come back and look at it.
exampleZh: 我想强调下这一点因为我们即将,回过头去再去看看这些东西。

meaning: adj. 高科技的；现代风格的，用高新技术材料的；n. 高科技（high technology）
definition: 1. n. highly advanced technological development (especially in electronics)；2. adj. resembling or making use of highly advanced technology or devices
example: For now the only bright spots in the labour market are small businesses and high-tech startups.
exampleZh: 目前劳务市场上仅有的一些亮点是小企业和新创办的高科技公司。

meaning: n. 公路，干道；公用通道
definition: 1. n. a major road for any form of motor transport
example: It is the coastal plain, and that provides, or that is the main highway out of Egypt or down to Egypt.
exampleZh: 这就是海岸平原，它提供了或说它本身就是,离开埃及或者下埃及的主要通道。

meaning: v. 抢劫，劫持；强行控制，操纵；n. 劫持事件（或行为）
definition: 1. n. seizure of a vehicle in transit either to rob it or divert it to an alternate destination；2. v. take arbitrarily or by force
example: Two men tried to hijack a plane on a flight from Riga to Murmansk.
exampleZh: 两名男子试图劫持一架从里加飞往摩尔曼斯克的飞机。

meaning: n. 徒步旅行，远足；（价格、花费等的）大幅度提高，猛增；v. 远足，徒步旅行；突然增加，突然提高；拉起，提起（尤指衣物）；后传（发球）给四分卫；【名】 （Hike）（美、俄）海克（人名）
definition: 1. a long walk, especially in the countryside；2. an increase in the cost of something, especially a large or unwanted increase
example: We don't hike and when we get stuck, we don't want food, we want our table of integrals.
exampleZh: 我们不登山,而一旦我们被困住了,我们并不想要食物,我们只需要一张实用积分表

meaning: n. 山丘，小山；（道路的）斜坡；土堆，小堆；国会山；v. 使成堆；【名】 （Hill）（英、德、匈、捷、罗、芬、瑞典）希尔，（法、西）伊尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a local and well-defined elevation of the land；2. v. form into a hill
example: I live in an area called Cobble Hill, which was an Italian neighborhood at one point, and it changed.
exampleZh: 我住在一个叫科布尔山的地方，那儿曾经是个意大利住宅区，后来它变了。

meaning: adj. 多山丘的，丘陵起伏的；【名】 （Hilly）（阿拉伯）希利（人名）
definition: 1. adj. having hills and crags
example: The areas where the fighting is taking place are hilly and densely wooded.
exampleZh: 战斗发生的地区丘陵起伏，树木茂密。

meaning: pron. 他（宾格）；它（指雄性动物）；（书面英语）用于泛指不限定性别的人
definition: 1. abstract: Him is a 1995 play that debuted in the New York Shakespeare Festival. Revolving around the afterlife of Elvis Presley, it was written by Christopher Walken, who also took the lead role.
example: Somebody rose and asked him if he had considered putting the elements in alphabetical order. They were very cruel.
exampleZh: 有人起来问他,是否考虑过将这些元素,按字母顺序排列，他们非常冷酷。

meaning: pron. 他自己；他亲自，他本人；他自己；by himself（或 all by himself）独自，独力
definition: 1. abstract: Himself is Irish-English singer-songwriter Gilbert O'Sullivan's debut album, originally released in August 1971. Union Square Music re-released it 2011 on Salvo label in part of the Gilbert O'Sullivan - A Singer & His Songs collection.
example: Not Milton himself would cry up liberty to poor female slaves or plead for the lawfulness or resisting a private tyranny.
exampleZh: 即便米尔顿本人也不愿为那些女奴的自由所呼号,辩解，或是反对这种私底下的暴行“

meaning: v. 阻碍，妨碍；adj. （尤指身体部位）后面的；【名】 （Hinder）（芬）欣德（人名）
definition: 1. v. be a hindrance or obstacle to；2. adj. located at or near the back of an animal
example: Unfortunately these drugs are quite toxic and hinder the body's ability to fight off infection.
exampleZh: 不幸的是，这些药毒性很大，妨碍身体抗感染的能力。

meaning: n. 造成妨碍的人（或事物）；阻碍，妨碍
definition: 1. n. something immaterial that interferes with or delays action or progress；2. n. any obstruction that impedes or is burdensome
example: Your thoughts and words can flow freely from present to future and from future to past without hindrance.
exampleZh: 你的思想和语言可以自由地从现在流向未来，从未来流向过去，没有任何阻碍。

meaning: n. 铰链，合叶；枢纽，关键；铰合部；v. 给（某物）装铰链
definition: 1. a piece of metal that fastens the edge of a door, window, lid, etc. to something else and allows it to open or close
example: The "fuselage" of the robotic insect was designed to hold a small GM14 motor, crank, and wing hinge.
exampleZh: 机器昆虫的“机身”被设计成能够搭载一台小型 GM14 马达、曲轴和翼铰链。

meaning: n. 暗示，提示；征兆，迹象；少许，少量；秘诀，窍门；v. 暗示，示意；【名】 （Hint）（英）欣特，（法）安特（人名）
definition: 1. n. an indirect suggestion；2. v. drop a hint; intimate by a hint
example: There was not a hint of badness in him.
exampleZh: 他道德十分高尚。

meaning: n. 臀部，髋；屋脊；野蔷薇果；adj. 时髦的；int. 加油！ 好哇！；【名】 （Hip）（塞）希普，（中）协（广东话·威妥玛）（人名）
definition: 1. n. either side of the body below the waist and above the thigh；2. adj. informed about the latest trends
example: We talked about the artificial hip which is a modern precursor of the splint I talked about before.
exampleZh: 我们之前说到的人造髋关节,就是由固定腿部的夹板衍生而来

meaning: v. 租用，租借；聘用，录用；n. 租借，租金；被雇用的人；【名】 （Hire）（美、印）希尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a newly hired employee；2. v. engage or hire for work
example: And then you have to hire an army of consultants that they will supply you to get it to work.
exampleZh: 之后就得雇一大批顾问,他们帮助顾客运用软件。

meaning: det. 他的，它的（指雄性动物）；pron. 他的
definition: 1. abstract: HIS (Herstellerinitiative Software, German for 'OEM software initiative') is an interest group consisting of the car manufacturers Audi, BMW, Daimler AG, Porsche and Volkswagen.
example: Milton anticipated and lovingly invested all of his energy in his future literary power and his future literary fame.
exampleZh: 米尔顿预测到了他将来在文学领域的力量和声望,并且钟情的将他所有的精力投入到文学中。

meaning: n. 历史；沿革，发展过程；历史课，历史学；史书，历史记载；个人经历，履历
definition: 1. n. the aggregate of past events；2. n. the continuum of events occurring in succession leading from the past to the present and even into the future
example: Sal in this moment becomes so naive, naive of history, of actual lived history of his own country.
exampleZh: 因为萨尔在这一刻变得非常无知，对自己国家的真实历史非常无知。

meaning: adj. 历史上重要的；过去的，与历史（或过去）有关的；（时态）历史的
definition: 1. adj. belonging to the past; of what is important or famous in the past；2. adj. important in history
example: The amount of litter in the streets is unbefitting for a historic city.
exampleZh: 街道上垃圾之多与历史名城不协调。

meaning: adj. （有关）历史的；历史学的；（书籍、电影或图片）描述历史的，基于史实的；按历史顺序排列的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to the study of history；2. adj. having once lived or existed or taken place in the real world as distinct from being legendary
example: Now, I think there's a deliberate confusion here about these lines because their precise historical significance isn't what's most significant.
exampleZh: 这里有一个刻意而为的困惑,是关于这些句子中严谨的历史意义的,而不是关于什么是最重要的。

meaning: n. 历史学家，史学工作者
definition: 1. n. a person who is an authority on history and who studies it and writes about it
example: Although not formally trained as an art historian, he is widely respected for his knowledge of the period.
exampleZh: 虽然他不是科班出身的艺术史学家，但他对这一时期的知识却普遍为人尊重。

meaning: v. 打，击；撞击，碰撞；击中，命中；击（球）；产生不良影响，危害；攻击，袭击；达到（一个特定的水平，阶段，数字）；碰到，遇到（困难、问题等）；使（某人）突然意识到；使（突然）闻到，使看到；按，摁；给（人）一剂毒品（或烈酒）；（产品）面市并产生影响；给（21点纸牌游戏玩家）发另一张纸牌；n. 打击；命中，击中；很受欢迎的人（或事物），成功；（对网站的）访问，点击；毒品的一剂；暴力犯罪，凶杀；很受欢迎的人（或事物）
definition: 1. n. (baseball) a successful stroke in an athletic contest (especially in baseball)；2. v. cause to move by striking
example: and I work with them and you know, they hit their goal. That's when I feel the best about it.
exampleZh: 我跟他们一起练，他们达成目标。那时候我感觉最好。

meaning: adv. 迄今，至今
definition: 1. until now or until a particular time
example: They are claiming that, unless there is some hitherto undetected systematic, neutrinos are traveling faster than light.
exampleZh: 他们声称，除非有迄今为止未被探测到的系统误差，中微子的传播速度比光速还要快。

meaning: n. 忙碌的场所，繁忙的地方；蜂房，蜂箱；蜂群；蜂窝状物体；v. （蜜蜂）入蜂箱
definition: 1. a structure where bees live, either built by people or made by the bees themselves；2. a group of bees living together in a hive
example: Glass hives offer a close-up view of the bees at work, with the queen bee in each hive marked by a white dot.
exampleZh: 玻璃蜂房可以近距离观察工作中的蜜蜂，每个蜂房的蜂王都被打上白点标记。

meaning: n. 业余爱好，嗜好； 小马，马驹；燕隼；【名】 （Hobby）（英）霍比（人名）
definition: 1. n. an auxiliary activity；2. n. a child's plaything consisting of an imitation horse mounted on rockers; the child straddles it and pretends to ride
example: He hasn't got any hobbies—unless you call watching TV a hobby.
exampleZh: 他没有什么爱好—除非你把看电视也称作爱好。

meaning: n. 曲棍球；冰球；【名】 （Hockey）（英）霍基（人名）
definition: 1. a game played on a sports field between two teams of eleven players who each have a curved stick with which they try to put a small, hard ball into the other team's goal；2. → ice hockey mainly UK
example: A bagel, a reasonable sized bagel's serving size is the size of a hockey puck.
exampleZh: 百吉饼,合理的一餐份量应该是冰球大小

meaning: v. 吊起，提升；投篮；n. 吊升机械，起重机；吊起，升起；旗宽（贴近旗杆的部分）；（一串）信号旗；【名】 （Hoist）（英、美、印、加）霍伊斯特（人名）
definition: 1. to lift something heavy, sometimes using ropes or a machine；2. to raise a flag to the top of a pole using a rope
example: By using a hoist the movers were able to sling the piano to the third floor.
exampleZh: 搬运工人用吊车才把钢琴吊到3楼。

meaning: v. 抓住，托住；按住，捂住；拥抱；使保持（在某位置）；支撑……的重量；容纳，包含；监禁，拘留；守卫，控制；（好形势）保持不变；吸引某人的注意/兴趣；（使）保持（价值或水平）；保存，存贮；拥有；担任，任职；获得，赢得；持有，怀有（观点、信念等）；认为，相信；举行，进行；（车辆）抓（地）；（船或飞机）保持航线；持续（一种音符）；别挂断；停下，推迟；有效，适用；（使）具有；大量喝（酒）而不醉；不包括，排除在外；（使）坚持；携有违禁毒品；n. 握，抓；擒拿法；影响，控制；支撑点；底舱，货舱；预定；坚持，继续拥有；理解；【名】 （Hold）（英、德、捷）霍尔德（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of grasping；2. v. organize or be responsible for
example: Now the first law is going to hold in all of these steps, and we're going around in a cycle.
exampleZh: 现在热力学第一定律,就蕴含在这所有的步骤里了，我们沿着这个循环走。

meaning: n. 洞，坑；裂口，开口；（高尔夫球运动中的）球洞；（小动物的）洞穴；令人不舒适的地方；缺点，破绽；困境，窘境；禁闭室，单人牢房；空缺的地方（或位置）；（两个守场员间的）空地，空隙；v. （尤指给船）钻洞，打洞；击球入洞；【名】 （Hole）（瑞典、挪）霍勒，（英）霍尔（人名）；（Hole）（英）霍尔，（瑞典、挪）霍勒（人名）
definition: 1. n. an opening into or through something；2. v. hit the ball into the hole
example: Now, if you dug a hole here until there, and of course it may work until that happens.
exampleZh: 现在,如果你在地上挖个洞,让这个物体下落时间足够长,那还说得通

meaning: n. 假日；度假期；法定节假日，节日；（分期付款、税费等的）暂缓缴付期；v. 度假；【名】 【名】（Fit）（捷、罗）菲特（人名）
definition: 1. n. leisure time away from work devoted to rest or pleasure；2. v. spend or take a vacation
example: You know, I came over on a holiday, the first time. I came on a six-month visa holiday.
exampleZh: 那时我是来度假的，第一次来。凭六个月假期签证过来的。

meaning: adj. 空的，空心的；凹的，凹陷的；虚伪的，不真诚的；无用的，无价值的；（声音）沉闷回荡的；空腹的；沉闷回荡的；v. 使凹陷，使下陷；挖洞（成某物）；形成空洞；n. 凹陷处，坑洼处；坑，洞；山谷；【名】 （Hollow）（英）霍洛（人名）
definition: 1. n. a cavity or space in something；2. v. remove the inner part or the core of
example: His proud boast of leading "the party of low taxation" has a hollow ring.
exampleZh: 他有关领导“主张低税收的政党”的豪言有空洞的感觉。

meaning: adj. 神圣的；圣洁的；（表示惊讶、恐慌等）天啊，上帝啊；用于强调；n. 神圣的东西，圣所；【名】 （Holy）（英、德、匈）霍利（人名）
definition: 1. n. a sacred place of pilgrimage；2. adj. belonging to or derived from or associated with a divine power
example: Purity, which is the absence of impurity, is a prerequisite for access to the holy or for holy status.
exampleZh: 纯洁，不纯的反义词，是接近神圣或达到神圣状态的先决条件。

meaning: n. 神圣，圣洁；陛下，圣座（对教皇的尊称）
definition: 1. n. the quality of being holy
example: This day is separated from all other days by additional rules and observances in keeping with its profound holiness.
exampleZh: 这一天被附加的许多规则与其他日子完全区别开来,目的是保持它深厚的神圣性。

meaning: n. 家，住宅；（可买卖的）房子，寓所；家庭；养育院，收容所；适于存放……的地方；发源地，发祥地；栖息地，生息地；家乡，祖国；（组织、公司等的）本部，基地；（比赛的）主场；adj. 家庭的，家用的；在家里做（或进行）的；本国的，国内的；在主场进行的；总部的；adv. 回家，在家；到正确的位置；朝着球门，进入到球门里；v. 归巢；对准（目标）；把（思想、注意力）集中于；把（动物）养作宠物；【名】 （Home）（德、芬）霍梅，（英、尼）霍姆（人名）
definition: 1. n. where you live at a particular time；2. v. provide with, or send to, a home
example: So as we think about these things as I suggest, we've already introduced what de Man drives home to us.
exampleZh: 所以我们正如我提议的那样思考这些事情，我们已经介绍过了德曼想让我们了解的东西。

meaning: adj. 无家可归的
definition: 1. n. someone with no housing；2. adj. without nationality or citizenship
example: Well, there's a lot of homeless people which makes you feel like a really big clash,
exampleZh: 有很多无家可归的人，看上去好像真的很不协调。

meaning: adj. 普通的，朴实无华的；相貌平平的；像家一样舒适的；（女子）热情亲切的，家庭主妇型的
definition: 1. adj. lacking in physical beauty or proportion；2. adj. having a feeling of home; cozy and comfortable
example: While it only turns into a handsome prince in fairy tales, the homely bullfrog may harbor a valuable anti-ageing substance for humans.
exampleZh: 尽管只有在童话故事里才能变身英俊的王子，但平平无奇的牛蛙体内可能含有一种能用于人类抗衰老的珍贵物质。

meaning: n. 祖国，家乡；（某一特殊群体居住的）大片定居地
definition: 1. n. the country where you were born
example: And with some generals or with whoever else, homeland security, how did you go about settling these fights?
exampleZh: 或者是和其他官员，关于国分歧家安全问题有分歧，你是怎么处理这些分歧呢？

meaning: n. （学生的）家庭作业；准备工作；（尤指低酬劳计件活）在家里做的活计
definition: 1. n. preparatory school work done outside school (especially at home)
example: So I've been able to relax a little bit, get all my homework done early and hang out with friends.
exampleZh: 所以我可以放松一下，放下所有的作业，和朋友去逛街。

meaning: adj. 同种类的，同性质的；齐性的，齐次的；同形态（固态、液态或气态）的
definition: 1. consisting of parts or people that are similar to each other or are of the same type；2. consisting of parts or having qualities that are the same
example: That's a homogeneous system, one phase. You have to know if your system is an equilibrium system or not.
exampleZh: 这是个均相系统，只有一个相，你得知道你的系统是不是个平衡系统。

meaning: n. 同性恋者（通常指男性）；adj. 同性恋的，同性性欲的
definition: 1. n. someone who practices homosexuality; having a sexual attraction to persons of the same sex；2. adj. sexually attracted to members of your own sex
example: is that a lot of the people who I know who are gay or lesbian and have homosexual activity,
exampleZh: 我认识很多男女性同性恋者，

meaning: adj. 诚实的，正直的；坦诚的，直率的；真诚的，显示诚意的；正当获得的；纯正的，不花哨的；无意（伤害别人）的；adv. 真的，确实
definition: 1. adj. not disposed to cheat or defraud; not deceptive or fraudulent；2. adj. without dissimulation; frank
example: I want you to know if there is ever anything you want to say, you can be honest.
exampleZh: 我想让你知道，如果你有任何事想跟我倾诉，你都可以诚实地跟我说。

meaning: n. 诚实，正直；银扇草，金钱花
definition: 1. n. the quality of being honest；2. n. southeastern European plant cultivated for its fragrant purplish flowers and round flat papery silver-white seedpods that are used for indoor decoration
example: It's a persistent problem partly because it always raises these issues of fictionality versus truthfulness, of honesty versus embellishment.
exampleZh: 这是个持久的问题,原因是它一直在质疑虚构性和真实性的关系，还有诚实与修饰的关系。

meaning: n. 蜂蜜；亲爱的，宝贝儿；极好的事物；v. 对……说甜言蜜语；加蜜使甜；奉承，；adj. 甘美的；蜂蜜似的；【名】 （Honey）（英）霍尼（人名）
definition: 1. n. a sweet yellow liquid produced by bees；2. v. sweeten with honey
example: They are so juicy and l love the inside where it looks like honey, it sounds so good.
exampleZh: 它们鲜嫩多汁，看起来像想蜂蜜一样诱人。听起来太棒了。

meaning: n. 蜜月；v. 度蜜月
definition: 1. n. a holiday taken by a newly married couple；2. v. spend a holiday after one's marriage
example: We went to Venice for our honeymoon.
exampleZh: 我们去威尼斯度的蜜月。

meaning: n. 荣誉，光荣；名誉，信用，正直；殊荣，荣幸；荣誉称号，头衔，奖章；vt. 尊敬，尊重；向……致敬；给……以荣誉，表彰；（金融）承兑；履行，遵守
definition: 1. n. a tangible symbol signifying approval or distinction；2. v. bestow honor or rewards upon
example: All right. With all this said, how can the theorist recuperate honor for certain names like, for example, his own?
exampleZh: 好了，说完这些以后，一个理论家该如何,为一些特定的名字，比如，他自己的，恢复尊严呢？
family: honor / honour / honorable / honourable / honorary / honourary

meaning: adj. 光荣的；可敬的；高贵的；正直的，值得尊敬的；尊敬的（用于法官、议员等尊称，常写作 the Honorable）（honourable 的美式写法）
definition: 1. adj. not disposed to cheat or defraud; not deceptive or fraudulent；2. adj. worthy of being honored; entitled to honor and respect
example: And he indicated that there are only a few just men, just, honorable men who can even hear those celestial notes.
exampleZh: 他指出只有少数正直的人，可敬的人可以听到那些天国的音符。
family: honor / honour / honorable / honourable / honorary / honourary

meaning: adj. 荣誉的；（职位）无报酬的，义务的；（成员）名誉的
definition: 1. adj. given as an honor without the normal duties
example: The United States bestowed honorary citizenship upon England's World War II prime minister, Sir Winston Churchill.
exampleZh: 美国授予了二战期间的英国首相温斯顿·丘吉尔爵士荣誉公民的称号。
family: honor / honour / honorable / honourable / honorary / honourary

meaning: n. 钩，挂钩；勾拳；曲线球；吸引人的东西；使（投手）下场；（尤指用于收割、剪羊毛）弧形切割工具；弯曲的笔画；弧形岬（或沙嘴）；v. 钩住，挂住；（用手臂等身体部位）箍住；钓鱼；打曲线球；弯成钩状；吸引；偷窃；卖淫；把……连接到（某设备）；【名】 （Hook）（英）胡克，（德、荷）霍克（人名）
definition: 1. n. a catch for locking a door；2. v. fasten with a hook
example: I don't know what this tells us about David and Nina, but don't let them off the hook quite yet.
exampleZh: 从大卫和妮娜的协调中得不出什么结论,这事儿还没结束呢

meaning: v. 单脚跳行；齐足（或双足）跳行；快速移动，快速前往；登上（飞机、火车等）；（尤指搭乘飞机）短途旅行；换来换去；速递，快运；用啤酒花调味；n. 单脚跳；（鸟、小动物）双脚跳；短途旅行；忽布，啤酒花；舞会；霍普舞；毒品（尤指鸦片）；【名】（Hop）（美）合（人名）
definition: 1. to jump on one foot or to move about in this way；2. If an animal, bird, or insect hops, it moves by jumping on all or two of its feet at the same time
example: I used to listen to a lot of hip-hop music and heavy metal when I was younger.
exampleZh: 我年轻的时候，我常常听一些嘻哈和重金属音乐。

meaning: v. 希望；n. 希望；期盼的东西，盼望的事；（发生好事的）可能性；被寄予希望的人（或物）；信赖感；【名】 （Hope）（美）奥普（人名）
definition: 1. n. a specific instance of feeling hopeful；2. v. expect and wish
example: I mean the best thing you can do is just go in there and hope that they like you.
exampleZh: 我的意思是，你能做的最好的事情就是去那儿，然后希望他们会喜欢你。

meaning: adj. 满怀希望的；有希望的，有前途的；（行动）被寄予希望的；n. 希望成功的人，有前途的人
definition: 1. n. an ambitious and aspiring young person；2. adj. having or manifesting or inspiring hope
example: Things didn't look too hopeful at the start of the year.
exampleZh: 在年初，情况显得并不十分美妙。

meaning: adj. 无望的；（感到）绝望的；极差的，糟糕透顶的；彻头彻尾的；无能的
definition: 1. adj. without hope because there seems to be no possibility of comfort or success；2. adj. of a person unable to do something skillfully
example: She had always regarded Greg as a hopeless innocent where women were concerned.
exampleZh: 她过去一直认为格雷格在关于女人方面是一个不可救药的无知者。

meaning: n. 地平线；眼界；地平圈；地层；层位
definition: 1. n. the line at which the sky and Earth appear to meet；2. n. the range of interest or activity that can be anticipated
example: It's not your horizon; it's not my horizon; it's that effective history which takes place when our horizons merge.
exampleZh: 这不是你的视域，也不是我的视域;,而是我们的视域融合时产生的有效历史。

meaning: adj. 水平的；（公司）同一层次的；统一的，一致的；地平线的，在地平线上的；n. 水平位置；水平线，水平面
definition: 1. n. something that is oriented horizontally；2. adj. parallel to or in the plane of the horizon or a base line
example: The brown vinyl covering all the horizontal surfaces is coming unstuck in several places.
exampleZh: 所有横面上盖的棕色乙烯基塑料有些地方开始脱落了。

meaning: n. 角；角质；号角；喇叭；角状物；v. （动物）用角抵撞（或顶撞）；对（丈夫或妻子）不忠诚；装角于
definition: 1. n. a noisemaker (as at parties or games) that makes a loud noise when you blow through it；2. v. stab or pierce with a horn or tusk
example: He can't hear major elements of the soundscape: the truck horn behind him.
exampleZh: 他对身旁的那些声音充耳不闻：,无论是在他身后鸣笛的卡车。

meaning: n. 震惊，恐惧；惧怕，憎恶；恐怖性；极其不愉快的（或可怕的）经历；恐怖故事（或电影等）；调皮捣蛋的孩子
definition: 1. n. intense and profound fear；2. n. something that inspires dislike; something horrible
example: I said that Yeats looks on the modern with a sense of both horror and a fascination, a compulsion almost.
exampleZh: 我说过叶芝看待现代是,以一种害怕和好奇的感觉，一种难以压抑的冲动。

meaning: adj. 可怕的，令人恐惧的；糟糕的，讨厌的；不友好的
definition: 1. adj. provoking horror
example: In 1989, about a year after we went public, we had a horrible problem related to inventory management.
exampleZh: 989年，也就是我们上市的第二年，我们在库存管理方面,遇见了极大的困难。

meaning: v. 使感到震惊，使产生反感
definition: 1. v. fill with apprehension or alarm; cause to be unpleasantly surprised
example: I think it would horrify you what I can detect by smell alone.
exampleZh: 如果你能知道我仅凭嗅觉就能发现多少东西，我想你会震惊得说不出话来。

meaning: n. 马；赛马；跳马，鞍马；锯木架；马力；主力队员；海洛因；夹块，夹石；骑兵；v. 给（人或车辆）提供马；使骑马
definition: 1. n. solid-hoofed herbivorous quadruped domesticated since prehistoric times；2. v. provide with a horse or horses
example: It began to infiltrate other disciplines and was in general a high-spirited horse for that certain period of time.
exampleZh: 它逐渐渗入到其它学科,总之是那个时代的一匹黑马。

meaning: n. 马力（功率单位）
definition: 1. n. a unit of power equal to 746 watts
example: Our horsepower was less than half that of the winner.
exampleZh: 我们的马力还不到获胜者的一半。

meaning: n. 软管，水龙带；马裤；连裤袜，长筒袜；（旧式的）男式紧身裤；v. 用水管冲洗（或浇灌）；欺骗，愚弄；痛打
definition: 1. a long plastic or rubber pipe, used to direct water onto fires, gardens, etc.；2. a word used especially in shops for tights and stockings
example: Or, another way of saying it is, I'm going to open up the fire hose a little bit today.
exampleZh: 也就是说，今天我会把水龙头,稍微多拧开一点。

meaning: n. 医院；青年教育慈善机构；（尤指僧侣骑士团所办的）慈善招待所；【名】 （Hospital）（英）霍斯皮特尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a health facility where patients receive treatment；2. n. a medical institution where sick or injured people are given medical or surgical care
example: And he poses for this photo as an intake photo as he enters St. Elizabeth's Hospital for the Insane in Washington.
exampleZh: 这是他在入住华盛顿圣伊丽莎白精神病院时,所拍的入住照片。

meaning: v. 送入医院疗养（或治疗）
definition: 1. v. admit into a hospital
example: This is the first time to hospitalize in his remaining years.
exampleZh: 这是他生命中的第一次住院。

meaning: adj. 好客的，热情友好的；环境适宜的；乐于接受的
definition: 1. adj. favorable to life and growth；2. adj. disposed to treat guests and strangers with cordiality and generosity
example: They have abandoned her to pick berries or any such cooling fruit as the kind, hospitable woods provide.
exampleZh: 他们抛弃了她去摘莓果,或我们好客的树林提供的其它类似的水果。

meaning: n. 殷勤款待，好客；（公司或机构提供给顾客的）食宿娱乐招待
definition: 1. n. kindness in welcoming guests or strangers
example: We will always remember his generous hospitality.
exampleZh: 我们将永远记住他的慷慨好客。

meaning: n. 主人；主持人；主办者，东道主；寄主，宿主；接受移植组织（或器官）的受体；主机；（某种特别生物的）生存地；许多人（或物）；军队；（圣餐仪式中的）圣饼，圣体；v. 主办，做……的东道主；做节目主持人；作为主人组织（聚会），做东；（通常收费在与互联网连接的计算机上）存储网站
definition: 1. n. a person who invites guests to a social event (such as a party in his or her own home) and who is responsible for them while they are there；2. v. be the host of or for
example: Host: Flashback 29 years ago, and put yourself in the seat here and pretend you were still in school.
exampleZh: 主持人：回首29年前，假装你还坐在这儿,还在商学院念书。

meaning: n. 女主人，女东道主；女主持人；（餐馆的）女迎宾，女门迎；（夜总会的）女招待；（飞机，火车等上的）女服务员
definition: 1. n. a woman host；2. n. a woman innkeeper
example: And then your hostess walks in with the turkey in a tray, and says, "I killed the last cockroach."
exampleZh: 然后主人用托盘托了一只火鸡进来说,我刚刚把最后一只蟑螂拍死了“

meaning: n. 人质
definition: 1. someone who is taken as a prisoner by an enemy in order to force the other people involved to do what the enemy wants；2. someone who is made a prisoner in order to force other people to do something
example: He must be treated as a hostage of high rank, not as a common prisoner.
exampleZh: 他一定要作为一个高级人质而不是一般囚徒来对待。

meaning: adj. 敌对的，怀敌意的；强烈反对的；敌人的，敌方的；艰苦的，不利的；不受（被购公司）欢迎的；n. 敌对分子
definition: 1. adj. characterized by enmity or ill will；2. adj. not belonging to your own country's forces or those of an ally
example: Science is very hostile to innovation when it challenges existing theory, sort of like management, the same thing.
exampleZh: 科学对创新是有敌意的,当创新在挑战已存在的理论，跟管理一样，同样的道理。

meaning: n. 敌意，对抗；强烈的反对，愤怒反抗；战斗，战争行动
definition: 1. n. a hostile (very unfriendly) disposition；2. n. a state of deep-seated ill-will
example: But there is hostility toward finance that I think is very fundamental to a lot of our thinking.
exampleZh: 但是人们对于金融有敌对情绪,我认为,这种情绪对很多人来说,是深植于心的

meaning: adj. 热的，高温的；（使人）感到热的；辣的；活跃的，激烈的；棘手的，危险的；热门的；有望成功的；性感的；暴躁的；过激的，过火的；（某方面）极好的；重视；（音乐）节奏强的；偷来的，难以销赃的；快找到了，快猜中了；紧跟着的；带电的；明亮的，鲜艳的；v. 使热，变热（hot up）；变得激烈（hot up）；adv. 热；热切地，紧迫地；【名】 （Hot）（塞）霍特，（法）奥特（人名）
definition: 1. adj. used of physical heat; having a high or higher than desirable temperature or giving off heat or feeling or causing a sensation of heat or burning；2. adj. characterized by violent and forceful activity or movement; very intense
example: I mean, the weather is always nice. I mean, it never gets too cold, never gets too hot.
exampleZh: 天气一直很好。不会太冷，也不会太热。

meaning: v. 卖弄技艺，表演特技；n. （滑雪或冲浪的）灵巧动作表演者
definition: 1. n. someone who performs dangerous stunts to attract attention to himself；2. n. a frankfurter served hot on a bun
example: During one lunch period, my friend Denny and I went to the Graben Gore Restaurant to have a hotdog.
exampleZh: 在一次午餐期间，我和我的朋友丹尼去格拉本戈尔餐厅吃热狗。

meaning: n. 旅馆，酒店，饭店；（无线电通讯中）字母H的代码；【名】 （Hotel）（美）奥泰尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a building where travelers can pay for lodging and meals and other services
example: There are also some hotel investments,retail properties, smattering of industrial properties not a lot of exposure to individual houses.
exampleZh: 也有一些酒店和商场物业投资,以及一些零散的工业物业,没有太多地投资于个人住宅

meaning: n. 猎犬；卑鄙的人；v. 纠缠，烦扰；（用猎犬）追猎，追逐；激励
definition: 1. a type of dog used for hunting；2. to chase someone or to refuse to leave someone alone, especially because you want to get something from them
example: The hound found the place where the deer lodged.
exampleZh: 猎狗找到了那头鹿躲藏过的地方。

meaning: n. 小时；一小时的路程；（工作，办公等的）固定时间；某个时间；长时间；整点，正点；（西派教会中）固定时分短礼拜；（天文）黄经（或赤经）15°；【名】 （Hour）（法）乌尔，（柬）胡（人名）
definition: 1. n. a period of time equal to 1/24th of a day；2. n. clock time
example: It's about maybe half an hour, one hour from Barbados and maybe another hour and half from Puerto Rico.
exampleZh: 从巴巴多斯岛到那儿大概要半小时或一小时；从波多黎各到那儿则需要再花上一个半小时。

meaning: adj. 每小时的；按小时计算的；频繁的；adv. 每小时；按小时；频繁地，不断地
definition: 1. adj. occurring every hour or payable by the hour；2. adv. every hour
example: Somebody else figured out, how much does he get paid on an hourly basis?
exampleZh: 还有人算出了，他一个小时能挣多少钱？

meaning: n. 房子，住宅；一家人，同住一幢房子的人们；（有特定用途的）大楼，大厦；公司，商业机构；观众席，观众；演出场次；餐馆，餐厅；豪斯音乐；王室，皇族（House）；（某些英国学校学生为进行比赛而分的）组；动物的笼舍；议院，议会；（占星）黄道十二宫之一，黄道宫；v. 让……居住，给……提供住房；给……提供场地，收藏存放；包裹，覆盖；住；adj. 家养的，常在室内的；公司的，机构的；（乐队，组合）（在俱乐部或别的场所）常驻的，定期表演的；【名】 （House）（英）豪斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a dwelling that serves as living quarters for one or more families；2. v. contain or cover
example: And speaking in turn to the arden secularists to say religion should have no part in the White House.
exampleZh: 再说到艺术世俗主义者,他们说白宫不应该涉及宗教。

meaning: n. 房屋，住宅；住房供给，住房建设；（机器的）外壳，外罩；（木块上的）槽，榫眼；遮盖物，遮蔽物；v. 覆盖；给……房子住；把……储藏在房内（house 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. structures collectively in which people are housed；2. n. a protective cover designed to contain or support a mechanical component
example: There's not like stores or restaurants or any place to go. It's just pretty much like housing areas,
exampleZh: 那里没有商店、旅馆或者其他值得游玩的地方。它就只像是一个住宅区。

meaning: n. 家庭，一家人；家务；王室（the Household）；adj. 家用的，家务的；全家人的；家喻户晓的；皇家的（Household）；【名】 （Household）（美、瑞）豪斯霍尔德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a social unit living together
example: The slaves and the freed persons of a Roman household Familia were legally the ones who were the familia.
exampleZh: 一户罗马家庭的奴隶及被释放的自由民,法律上就称为。

meaning: n. 家庭主妇
definition: 1. n. a wife who manages a household while her husband earns the family income
example: Married at nineteen, she was a traditional housewife and mother of four children.
exampleZh: 她19岁就结婚了，是个传统的家庭主妇和4个孩子的母亲。

meaning: n. 家务劳动，家务事
definition: 1. n. the work of cleaning and running a house
example: He always helps with the housework.
exampleZh: 他总是帮着做家务。

meaning: v. 悬停；徘徊，守候；处于不稳定状态；上下波动，左右摇摆；伏窝孵化；n. 翱翔，徘徊；【名】 （Hover）（英、德）霍弗（人名）
definition: 1. to stay in one place in the air, usually by moving the wings quickly；2. to stand somewhere, especially near another person, eagerly or nervously waiting for their attention
example: With the development of science and technology, a Chinese young man Wang Mengqiu, invented Hover Camera.
exampleZh: 随着科技的发展，中国年轻人王梦秋发明了 Hover Camera 悬浮相机。

meaning: adv. 怎样，如何；（指状况、情况）好否，怎么样；（用于询问数量、程度）多少，怎么；（强调程度）多么，何等；（用于引出想要谈及的事实）；conj. 怎样，如何；以任何方式，无论用什么方法；n. 方式，方法；【名】 （How）（英）豪（人名）
definition: 1. abstract: How is a surname. Notable people with the surname include:
example: That's why many of them are thinking really very hard of how to foster entrepreneurship, how to encourage innovation.
exampleZh: 这就是为什么大家都在思索,如何才能培养企业家精神，如何鼓励创新。

meaning: adv. 然而，可是，不过；无论如何；（用于表示惊讶）究竟怎样；……左右，……上下；conj. 不管怎样，无论如何；然而，可是
definition: 1. adv. despite anything to the contrary (usually following a concession)；2. adv. by contrast; on the other hand
example: However, your friend might think that what you're talking about is more important than the project that you're discussing.
exampleZh: 然而，你的朋友可能觉得你们谈论的内容比项目更为重要。

meaning: v. （狗、狼等）嗥叫，长嚎；（因疼痛、愤怒、开心等）大声叫喊；（风）怒号，呼啸；怒吼，怒声要求；嚎哭；n. （狗、狼等）嗥叫，长嚎；（痛苦、愤怒、快乐的）嚎叫，咆哮；（狂风的）怒号，呼啸；颤噪效应
definition: 1. If a dog or wolf howls, it makes a long, sad sound；2. to make a loud sound, usually to express pain, sadness, or another strong emotion
example: They listened to the howl of the wind through the trees.
exampleZh: 他们听着风在林间呼啸的声音。

meaning: v. 蜷缩，依偎；（私下）开会，（暗中）碰头；（美式足球队员）靠拢（听取指示）；草率做成；n. （尤指杂乱地）挤在一起的人（或物品、建筑）；私下商议，秘密碰头；（美式足球）聚拢听取指示的一群队员；混乱，杂乱；【名】 （Huddle）（美、英、加）赫德尔（人名）
definition: 1. to come close together in a group, for example because it is cold；2. to sit or stand in a bent position with your arms and legs close to your body, especially because of cold or fear
example: We lay there: a huddle of bodies, gasping for air.
exampleZh: 我们躺在那儿：挤作一团，大口地喘着气。

meaning: v. 拥抱；抱住，抱在胸前；紧靠，紧挨；（衣服）缠紧，缚紧；暗自庆幸，沾沾自喜；抱有，持有（信念等）；n. 拥抱，紧抱；（摔跤中的）抓握；【名】 （Hug）（美、墨、西）雨歌（人名）
definition: 1. n. a tight or amorous embrace；2. v. squeeze (someone) tightly in your arms, usually with fondness
example: She leapt out of the back seat, and gave him a hug.
exampleZh: 她从后座上跳了出来，给了他一个拥抱。

meaning: adj. 庞大的，极大的；很受欢迎的，著名的；【名】 （Huge）（英）休奇（人名）
definition: 1. adj. unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope
example: And she told me it was this huge toy store and she like, found a picture in a magazine.
exampleZh: 然后妈妈告诉我那就是个很大的玩具店，还在报纸上找了一张照片。

meaning: v. 哼（曲子）；发嗡嗡声；活跃，繁忙；发出难闻的气味；n. 嗡嗡声，嘈杂声；int. （用于表示犹豫或不同意）嗯，哼；【名】 （Hum）（美、加）胡姆（人名）
definition: 1. to make a continuous low sound；2. to sing without opening your mouth
example: And perhaps the explanation has got to be the ubiquity of death is this kind of background, constant hum.
exampleZh: 也许应该这么解释，死亡的无处不在,是一种背景的，持续的嗡嗡声。

meaning: adj. 人的，人类的；（尤指缺点或弱点）显示人的本性的；有人情味的；n. 人，人类；【名】 （Human）（英）休曼（人名）
definition: 1. n. any living or extinct member of the family Hominidae characterized by superior intelligence, articulate speech, and erect carriage；2. adj. characteristic of humanity
example: So, in the second creation story just as in the first, That distinguishes the human creation from the other creatures.
exampleZh: 就如在第一个创造故事中，第二个创造故事，它当人类与其他动物区别开来。

meaning: n. 人类（总称）；人性，人的属性；人道，仁慈；（历史、哲学、文学等）人文学科
definition: 1. n. the quality of being humane；2. n. the quality of being human
example: What I would say about this one, cause it's most complicated, I would say, in the history of humanity.
exampleZh: 我会说，因为,是非常复杂的，我会说，是整个人类史上最复杂的。

meaning: adj. 人道的，仁慈的；（学科分支）人文的，高尚的
definition: 1. showing kindness, care, and sympathy towards others, especially those who are suffering；2. showing kindness, care, and sympathy toward others, esp. those who are suffering
example: In the mid-nineteenth century, Dorothea Dix began to campaign for humane treatment of the mentally ill.
exampleZh: 在19世纪中叶，多罗西娅·迪克斯发起了为精神病患者争取人道待遇的运动。

meaning: n. 人本主义，人文主义；人文学科研究
definition: 1. a belief system based on the principle that people's spiritual and emotional needs can be satisfied without following a god or religion
example: Renaissance humanism placed renewed emphasis on classical texts and encouraged scholars to question inherited assumptions.
exampleZh: 文艺复兴时期的人文主义重新强调古典文本，并鼓励学者质疑沿袭而来的假设。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 人文主义者，人文学者
definition: 1. a person who believes in humanism (= the idea that people do not need a god or religion to satisfy their spiritual and emotional needs)；2. relating to or believing in humanism (= the idea that people do not need a god or religion to satisfy their spiritual and emotional needs)
example: The key to this lies in the proper understanding of the relationship between scientific education and humanist education.
exampleZh: 这个的关键在于正确认识科学教育和人文教育的关系。

meaning: adj. 人道主义的，博爱的；基督凡人论的；n. 人道主义者，博爱者；慈善家；基督凡人论者
definition: 1. (a person who is) involved in or connected with improving people's lives and reducing suffering；2. involved in or connected with improving people’s lives and reducing suffering
example: So the link of the conflict will play a stronger role in making the humanitarian issues more important.
exampleZh: 因而冲突的纽带将会发挥更大的作用,使得人道主义问题更加重要。

meaning: adj. 谦虚的，谦卑的；（级别或地位）低下的，卑微的；简陋的，没有特别之处的；v. 使谦卑，使感到自惭；（轻易）击败（强敌）
definition: 1. v. cause to be unpretentious；2. adj. low or inferior in station or quality
example: What happened to him, I mean why does he all of a sudden ? become so humble and acquiescent?
exampleZh: 他怎么搞的，为何他突然间,变得如此谦卑和默默顺从？

meaning: adv. 谦恭地，谦虚地
definition: 1. adv. in a humble manner；2. adv. in a miserly manner
example: And then he said at the end: "Do justice, love mercy and walk humbly with our God. " And the last value I talked about is faith.
exampleZh: 最后他说：,坚持正义，学会宽容，谦逊地跟从神“,我要说的最后一种价值观是信仰。

meaning: adj. 潮湿的，湿热的
definition: 1. (of air and weather conditions) containing extremely small drops of water in the air；2. (of air and weather) containing extremely small drops of water in the air
example: because the East Coast is more humid, the weather is just totally different
exampleZh: 因为东海岸更潮湿，天气完全不同

meaning: n. 潮湿，湿气；湿度
definition: 1. the quality of being humid；2. a measurement of how much water there is in the air
example: High humidity made the laboratory uncomfortable and affected the accuracy of some sensitive instruments.
exampleZh: 高湿度使实验室很不舒适，并影响了一些精密仪器的准确性。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: v. 羞辱，使蒙羞
definition: 1. to make someone feel ashamed or lose respect for himself or herself；2. to make you feel ashamed or lose respect for yourself
example: "You see," said Hughes, "there's people who want to humiliate you and grind you down."
exampleZh: “你看，” 休斯说，“有人想羞辱你、折磨你。”

meaning: n. 耻辱，蒙羞；丢脸的事，尴尬的场合
definition: 1. the feeling of being ashamed or losing respect for yourself, or an occasion when you have this feeling
example: Humiliation is the greatest fear; self-exposure and failing to appeal to the audience come a close second.
exampleZh: 羞辱是最大的恐惧；紧随其后的是自我暴露和无法吸引观众。

meaning: n. 幽默，诙谐，幽默感；心情，情绪，心境；（医学）体液；（中世纪医学）认为决定体质与情绪的四种体液之一；vt. 迎合，迁就，顺应
definition: 1. n. a message whose ingenuity or verbal skill or incongruity has the power to evoke laughter；2. v. put into a good mood
example: You'll find in Renoir but Renoir's humor is even subtler than Hitchcock's I mean, it's more subtler than Hitchcock.
exampleZh: 你们可以找到大量的幽默,在雷诺的电影里,但是雷诺的幽默比希区柯克的更微妙。

meaning: adj. 幽默的，诙谐的
definition: 1. adj. full of or characterized by humor
example: Most of what people--what made people laugh wasn't in any sense a joke or humorous.
exampleZh: 大部份让人笑的原因,并不是玩笑或幽默。

meaning: n. 一百；许多，数量大；一百美元（英镑）的纸币；百位数；（表示24小时制的整点）一点、两点、三点等整；（板球）击球手获得的一百（或以上）的得分；adj. 一百的；许多的
definition: 1. n. ten 10s；2. adj. being ten more than ninety
example: But these days you pay for it which is why you get SSDs, you're paying several hundred dollars more.
exampleZh: 但是现在你购买固态硬盘，需要多花费几百美元。

meaning: n. 饥饿感；饥饿，饥荒；渴求，渴望；v. 渴求，渴望；挨饿；【名】 （Hunger）（英）亨格，（德、波）洪格尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a physiological need for food; the consequence of food deprivation；2. v. feel the need to eat
example: So the animal may be eaten to satisfy the human hunger for flesh, but the life essence itself belongs to God.
exampleZh: 因此，人们可以吃动物，来满足对肉的渴望，但是血属于上帝。

meaning: adj. 感到饿的，饥饿的；渴望的，热望的；使人饥饿的，引起食欲的；不毛的，贫瘠的
definition: 1. adj. feeling hunger; feeling a need or desire to eat food；2. adj. (usually followed by `for') extremely desirous
example: and you're very hungry after working on your computer at your hotel room late at night.
exampleZh: 你在酒店房间里，在电脑前工作到很晚，这时你肚子很饿了。

meaning: v. 打猎，猎取；搜寻，搜索；追踪，追捕；（骑马用猎犬）猎（狐）；摆动，振荡；n. 搜索，寻找；打猎，狩猎；（英国）猎狐活动；（英国经常举行猎狐运动的）猎狐队伍；猎区，狩猎场；摆动，振荡；【名】 （Hunt）（美）安（人名）
definition: 1. n. Englishman and Pre-Raphaelite painter (1827-1910)；2. v. pursue for food or sport (as of wild animals)
example: It had huge parks as part of its land, where he first learned to hunt butterflies and mount them.
exampleZh: 在他的土地上有一个很大的湖，他就是在那学会了抓蝴蝶。

meaning: n. 打猎，狩猎；搜寻，寻找；摆动，不规则振荡；adj. 打猎的；v. 打猎，猎取；搜寻，搜索；追踪，追捕（hunt 的现在分词形式）；【名】 （Hunting）（英）亨廷（人名）
definition: 1. n. the pursuit and killing or capture of wild animals regarded as a sport；2. n. the activity of looking thoroughly in order to find something or someone
example: If you zoom in up top, which I can't quite do with a keynote here, it says, "This last minute shopping, bargain hunting."
exampleZh: 如果你想追根究底，我也不能,在这里做一个主题演讲，它说，“这是最后一分钟购物，特价商品大甩卖“

meaning: n. 猎人，捕猎者；搜寻者，寻找者；猎狐马；猎犬；有护盖的手表
definition: 1. n. someone who hunts game；2. n. a person who searches for something
example: Well, the Native Americans, as hunter-gatherers, didn't actually enclose land.
exampleZh: 印第安人，作为采猎者，事实上是没有圈地。

meaning: n. 障碍，难关；（供人或马在赛跑中跨越的）栏架，跨栏；跨栏赛跑，障碍赛跑；（把背叛者送往刑场的）囚笼；v. （奔跑中）跳越（某物）；参加跨栏赛跑；克服（障碍或困难），渡过难关；用临时围栏隔开（或围住）；【名】 （Hurdle）（英）赫德尔（人名）
definition: 1. a frame or fence for jumping over in a race；2. a race in which people or horses jump over hurdles
example: that I think was, for me, the first hurdle that I had to get over is that... you know, you're not special.
exampleZh: 我认为那就是，对我来说，要跨越的第一个障碍就是……你不是特别的。

meaning: v. 猛扔，猛摔；大声说出（辱骂或斥责等）；呕吐；n. 乘车，搭便车；猛投，投掷
definition: 1. to throw something with a lot of force, usually in an angry or violent way；2. to shout insults or rude language at someone angrily
example: I hurl a few more bottles after the first one, then the books after the bottles.
exampleZh: 我先扔出去第一个瓶子，接着又扔了好几个瓶子，最后把书也跟着瓶子一起扔了出去。

meaning: n. 飓风；爆发
definition: 1. a violent wind that has a circular movement, especially in the West Atlantic Ocean
example: The eye of the hurricane hit Florida just south of Miami.
exampleZh: 飓风中心袭击了迈阿密正南面的佛罗里达州。

meaning: v. 匆忙，急忙；催促；（朝某方向）迅速移动；迅速处理；n. 急忙；紧急，赶紧的理由；【名】 （Hurry）（美、英、加、澳、法、丹）赫里（人名）
definition: 1. n. a condition of urgency making it necessary to hurry；2. v. move very fast
example: You know, I would guess probably because, or usually people plagiarize because they're in a hurry.
exampleZh: 你知道，我猜恐怕是因为，或者通常人们因为着急才抄袭。

meaning: adv. 匆忙地，仓促地
definition: 1. adv. in a hurried or hasty manner
example: Mr. Smith hurriedly sought to retract the statement, but it had just been broadcast on national radio.
exampleZh: 史密斯先生急忙试图收回声明，但它刚刚已经在国家电台播出了。

meaning: v. 使受伤，使疼痛；感到受伤，感到疼痛；损害；处于困境，手头拮据；伤心；adj. （身体上）受伤的；（感情上）痛苦的；n. 心灵创伤，委屈；（身体上的）伤，痛；【名】 （Hurt）（英）赫特，（德、匈、捷）胡特 (人名)
definition: 1. n. any physical damage to the body caused by violence or accident or fracture etc.；2. v. be the source of pain
example: Because we've now put in a bias suggesting that it should go up. Oops. It wouldn't have hurt it.
exampleZh: 因为我们现在加入了一个,说明股市会增长的偏向值。

meaning: adj. 伤感情的，伤自尊的
definition: 1. adj. causing hurt；2. adj. harmful to living things
example: Other people in their life benefit even more because they no longer have to hear the emotionally hurtful language of sarcasm.
exampleZh: 他们生活中的其他人更会从中受益，因为他们再也不用听到讽刺这种伤害情感的语言了。

meaning: n. 丈夫；v. 节约使用；【名】 （Husband）（英、美、爱）赫斯本德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a married man; a woman's partner in marriage；2. v. use cautiously and frugally
example: and not worry about, you know, if your husband likes it, or if your mom likes it, or whatever.
exampleZh: 而不去管你丈夫喜不喜欢，或者你妈妈喜不喜欢。

meaning: n. （简陋的）小屋；（花园中的）木屋，（建筑工人等住的）临时工棚；v. 供给……小屋；【名】 （Hut）（阿拉伯、罗、塞）胡特 (人名)
definition: 1. n. temporary military shelter；2. n. small crude shelter used as a dwelling
example: You haven't lived till you've learned how to yodel at a tea dance in a mountain hut!
exampleZh: 你要是还未学会在山间小屋的下午茶舞会上用约德尔调歌唱的话，那你就白活了！

meaning: n. 混合物；杂种；混合动力车，油电混合车；混合词，混种词；adj. 混合的；杂种的，杂交成的
definition: 1. a plant or animal that has been produced from two different types of plant or animal, especially to get better characteristics；2. something that is a mixture of two very different things
example: So you see in the hybrid orbital we actually have a larger lobe on top where they constructively interfered.
exampleZh: 所以你们可以看到在杂化轨道里,我们上面,由很大的一叶相长干涉。

meaning: n. 氢，氢气
definition: 1. n. a nonmetallic univalent element that is normally a colorless and odorless highly flammable diatomic gas; the simplest and lightest and most abundant element in the universe
example: I'm going to write it like this three moles of hydrogen which is a gas one bar 100 degrees Celsius.
exampleZh: 我会写成这样：,三摩尔氢分子，气体,1巴，100摄氏度。

meaning: n. 卫生；卫生学，保健学
definition: 1. the degree to which people keep themselves or their environment clean, especially to prevent disease；2. the practice or principles of keeping yourself and your environment clean in order to maintain health and prevent disease
example: Infection with head lice is no reflection on personal hygiene.
exampleZh: 染上头虱并不会给个人卫生带来不好的影响。

meaning: adj. 卫生的，保健的；与卫生相关的
definition: 1. clean, especially in order to prevent disease
example: I said that if I was really hygienic, and you can now wonder about how often do I shower?
exampleZh: 但是这真的很棒，对不对？,那么为什么我要说这些呢？,我说过如果我真的很讲卫生的话？

meaning: n. 连字符，连字号；v. 用连字号连接
definition: 1. n. a punctuation mark (-) used between parts of a compound word or between the syllables of a word when the word is divided at the end of a line of text；2. v. divide or connect with a hyphen
example: The CLP interprets any text string that is prefixed by a double hyphen as a comment.
exampleZh: CLP 将前缀为两个连字符的任何文本字符串都解释为注释。

meaning: n. 虚伪，伪善
definition: 1. a situation in which someone pretends to believe something that they do not really believe, or that is the opposite of what they do or say at another time；2. pretending to be what you are not, or pretending to believe something that you do not
example: He accused newspapers of hypocrisy in their treatment of the story.
exampleZh: 他指责报纸在处理这篇报道时所表现出的虚伪。

meaning: adj. 虚伪的，伪善的
definition: 1. saying that you have particular moral beliefs but behaving in a way that shows these are not sincere
example: It would be hypocritical of me to have a church wedding when I don't believe in God.
exampleZh: 我不信上帝却到教堂举行婚礼，那就是我的虚伪了。

meaning: n. 伪君子，伪善者
definition: 1. someone who says they have particular moral beliefs but behaves in way that shows these are not sincere
example: The magazine wrongly suggested he was a liar and a hypocrite.
exampleZh: 该杂志错误地暗示他是个骗子和伪君子。

meaning: n. 假说，假设；（凭空的）猜想，猜测；前提
definition: 1. an idea or explanation for something that is based on known facts but has not yet been proved；2. an idea or explanation for something that is based on known facts but has not yet been proven
example: The statistics to prove or disprove his hypothesis will take years to collect.
exampleZh: 要花数年来收集证实或推翻他的假设的数据。

meaning: adj. （基于）假设的，假定的；n. 假设命题，假设陈述
definition: 1. imagined or suggested but not necessarily real or true；2. of or based on a hypothesis
example: I wasn't asking about anybody in particular—it was a purely hypothetical question.
exampleZh: 我并没有问到具体某个人—那不过是个纯粹假设性的问题。

meaning: adj. 歇斯底里的，异常兴奋的；极为有趣的，极滑稽的；患癔病的；（笑声）疯狂失控的，不可抑制的
definition: 1. unable to control your feelings or behaviour because you are extremely frightened, angry, excited, etc.；2. extremely funny
example: Police and bodyguards had to form a human shield around him as the almost hysterical crowds struggled to approach him.
exampleZh: 当近乎歇斯底里的人群奋力接近他时，警察和保镖们不得不在他周围形成一堵人墙。

meaning: n. 歇斯底里；（众人的）狂热情绪的爆发；癔症
definition: 1. extreme fear, excitement, anger, etc. that cannot be controlled；2. excitement or emotion that is uncontrollable
example: The article warned against public hysteria and urged readers to rely on verified information.
exampleZh: 这篇文章提醒公众不要陷入恐慌，并呼吁读者依赖经过核实的信息。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: pron. 我；n. 碘元素；字母I；abbr. 不及物动词 (intransitive verb)
definition: 1. n. a nonmetallic element belonging to the halogens; used especially in medicine and photography and in dyes; occurs naturally only in combination in small quantities (as in sea water or rocks)；2. adj. used of a single unit or thing; not two or more
example: i If I'm going to keep that item, item i, if I'm going to take it, I give it a 1.
exampleZh: 如果我想要保留这个物品,如果我打算带走它。

meaning: n. 冰；冰块；冰冻甜食，刨冰；溜冰场；钻石，珠宝；（态度，表情）冰冷；一份冰淇淋；v. 在（糕饼上）加糖霜；冷却，冰镇；确保（胜利等）；杀死；结冰；长射（冰球）过全场越过对方球门线；adj. 冰的；【名】 （Ice）（英）艾斯，（法）伊斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. water frozen in the solid state；2. v. decorate with frosting
example: I would like to, sometime before we move out of New York. I would like to ice skate there.
exampleZh: 我也想在我们搬出纽约前去一次。我想在那儿溜冰。

meaning: adj. 冰冷的；结冰的；不友好的，冷漠的
definition: 1. adj. devoid of warmth and cordiality; expressive of unfriendliness or disdain；2. adj. extremely cold
example: He had slipped on an icy pavement.
exampleZh: 他在结冰的人行道上滑倒了。

meaning: n. 冰山；微露端倪的事物
definition: 1. a very large mass of ice that floats in the sea；2. a kind of lettuce (= a plant with large, green leaves, usually eaten uncooked) that is very crunchy (= making a loud noise when it is eaten)
example: The above complaints are, I suspect, just the tip of the iceberg.
exampleZh: 上述的这些抱怨，我觉得，不过是冰山的一角。

meaning: n. 冰淇淋，冰激凌；（可数）一客冰淇淋或冰淇淋蛋卷；adj. 冰淇淋的，含冰淇淋的；乳白色的，奶白色的
definition: 1. n. frozen dessert containing cream and sugar and flavoring
example: And that pole was right next to this ice-cream stand in front of the theater in Tulle.
exampleZh: 然后那根柱子就在那个,冰激凌摊旁边,剧院前面

meaning: n. 图标；偶像，代表；画像，雕像；圣像（如基督、圣母玛利亚等）；类象符号
definition: 1. a small picture or symbol on a computer screen that you point to and click on (= press) with a mouse to give the computer an instruction；2. a very famous person or thing considered as representing a set of beliefs or a way of life
example: You double click an icon, the program gets loaded into memory, well, conceptually where does your program end up?
exampleZh: 双击一个图标，程序就被加载到内存中，那么，程序在哪里结束？

meaning: n. 想法，主意；观点，看法；原则，信念；理解，了解；猜想；目标，意图；（柏拉图哲学）理念
definition: 1. n. the content of cognition; the main thing you are thinking about；2. n. a personal view
example: It is a transnational idea, in other words, which nevertheless has, obviously, certain specific applications depending on where it is.
exampleZh: 这是一个跨国的概念，但是很明显，它也有其明确的地区性。

meaning: adj. 理想的，最佳的；想象的，不切实际的；n. 理想；典范，完美典型
definition: 1. n. the idea of something that is perfect; something that one hopes to attain；2. adj. conforming to an ultimate standard of perfection or excellence; embodying an ideal
example: Let's try it with a different equation of state, that isn't quite as simple as the ideal gas case.
exampleZh: 考虑一个不同的状态方程，这状态方程不像理想气体状态方程那么简单。

meaning: adj. 理想主义的，空想的；唯心主义者的，空想家的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to the philosophical doctrine of the reality of ideas；2. adj. of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style
example: They talked about the real world that is outside, that is dirty,impure,profane versus academia, which is lofty,idealistic,sacred.
exampleZh: 他们将外面的世界看成是现实，是肮脏的，不洁，被亵渎的，而学术界，则是崇高的，有理想的，神圣的。

meaning: n. 理想主义；唯心主义，唯心论
definition: 1. n. (philosophy) the philosophical theory that ideas are the only reality；2. n. impracticality by virtue of thinking of things in their ideal form rather than as they really are
example: This view is sometimes known in philosophy as idealism: all that exists, are minds and their ideas.
exampleZh: 这个观点在哲学里被称作唯心主义,所有存在的事物都是心灵和思想

meaning: v. 认出，识别；查明，确认；发现；证明（身份），表明；认同，理解；认为……和……一致；和（某人）打成一片
definition: 1. v. recognize as being; establish the identity of someone or something；2. v. give the name or identifying characteristics of; refer to by name or some other identifying characteristic property
example: The new technique has been used to identify the sex of fetuses.
exampleZh: 这项新技术已被用来鉴定胎儿的性别。

meaning: n. 辨认，识别；确认，确定；身份证明；认同，强烈的同情感；密切关联
definition: 1. n. the act of designating or identifying something；2. n. the attribution to yourself (consciously or unconsciously) of the characteristics of another person (or group of persons)
example: And Nabokov says: The students leaned heavily on emotional identification, action, and the social, economic and historical angle.
exampleZh: 纳博科夫说：学生严重倾向于：,情感上的共鸣、动作、,社会、经济和历史角度。

meaning: n. 身份，本体；个性，特性；同一性，一致；恒等运算，恒等式
definition: 1. n. the distinct personality of an individual regarded as a persisting entity；2. n. the individual characteristics by which a thing or person is recognized or known
example: But most of the people focused on Palestinian identity, which the conflict maybe covered, or in certain cases, there is.
exampleZh: 但大多数人关注的是巴勒斯坦身份，巴以冲突可能包括这个层面，在一些例子中，确实是。

meaning: adj. 完全相同的；同一的；（双胞胎）同卵的；恒等的
definition: 1. adj. exactly alike; incapable of being perceived as different；2. adj. being the exact same one; not any other:
example: And Pauli says no two electrons in a given system can have the entire set of quantum numbers identical.
exampleZh: 而泡利认为在一个给定的系统内,没有两个电子有完全相同的量子数。

meaning: n. 意识形态，思想体系；观念学；空想
definition: 1. a set of beliefs or principles, especially one on which a political system, party, or organization is based；2. a particular set of ideas and beliefs, especially one on which a political system, party, or organization is based
example: He attributed the party's lack of success to an overemphasis on ideology and ideas.
exampleZh: 他将该党的不成功归咎与过分强调意识形态和观点。

meaning: adj. 思想体系的，意识形态的
definition: 1. based on or relating to a particular set of ideas or beliefs
example: There is a great deal of ideological baggage that is involved in the dating of the sources.
exampleZh: 有很多思想包袱,关于这些资料来源的时间考证。

meaning: n. 习语，成语；方言，土话；（个人、艺术形式等的）风格，特色
definition: 1. n. a manner of speaking that is natural to native speakers of a language；2. n. the usage or vocabulary that is characteristic of a specific group of people
example: Let us look at an idiom: kill two birds with double-edged sword.
exampleZh: 我们再看一个成语：一举两得/一箭双雕。

meaning: adj. （语言）自然地道的；与（某时期、人或团体的艺术或音乐风格）相合的，特点一致的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to or conforming to idiom
example: when it comes to looking for examples of people speaking good idiomatic English in a recorded form.
exampleZh: 当说到举一个例子说什么文本或音频材料里有使用地道的英语时，

meaning: n. 白痴，笨蛋；弱智者，低能儿
definition: 1. a stupid person or someone who is behaving in a stupid way
example: My point here is not to say, oh, you idiot, Plato, why didn't you think of radio waves?
exampleZh: 我这里不是想说，柏拉图，你真傻，你为什么没想到无线电波呢？

meaning: adj. 十分愚蠢的，白痴般的
definition: 1. stupid
example: "Ignoring the fact that is idiotic," Jeff replied, "why would we do that?"
exampleZh: “无视这一事实是愚蠢的” Jeff回答道，“我为什么要这样做？”

meaning: adj. 无事可做的；懒惰的；闲置的；空闲的；琐碎无聊的，毫无意义的；虚张声势的，唬人的；（钱）现金保存的，存于无息账户的；v. 闲混，无所事事；使……停止工作，使闲散；（发动机、车辆）空转
definition: 1. n. the state of an engine or other mechanism that is idling；2. v. run disconnected or idle
example: Over ten per cent of the workforce is now idle.
exampleZh: 现在有超过百分之十的劳动力闲置。

meaning: adv. 无目的地，无理由地；无动于衷地，懒散地
definition: 1. adv. in an idle manner
example: She sat in the sun, idly sipping a cool drink.
exampleZh: 她坐在阳光下懒洋洋地抿着冷饮。

meaning: n. 偶像，受到热爱和崇拜的人（或物）；圣像，神像；幻象；谬论；【名】 （Idol）（英）伊多尔（人名）
definition: 1. someone who is admired and respected very much；2. a picture or object that people pray to as part of their religion
example: A great cheer went up from the crowd as they caught sight of their idol.
exampleZh: 一看见他们的偶像，人群爆发出一阵热烈的欢呼声。
