meaning: conj. 如果，假如，要是；每当，无论何时；即使，虽然，尽管；（用于间接问句或礼貌问询）是否；〔if only〕要是…多好；〔as if〕好像，仿佛；〔if not〕如果不；即便不；或许不；（常与 can、could、may、might 等情态动词连用）表示婉转请求；（if it isn't…）这不是……吗；n. 条件，设想；不确定的情况（常用复数 ifs）
definition: 1. abstract: If is a 2013 single by Scottish Indie rock band Glasvegas. It was released on 8 July 2013.
example: If my code is correct, what should the average price be, after say, 100 days, if there's no bias. Pardon?
exampleZh: 如果我的代码没写错的话，如果没有偏向值那平均价格会是多少呢，如果没有偏向值，请说？

meaning: v. 点燃，燃烧；引发，激起
definition: 1. to (cause to) start burning or explode；2. to cause a dangerous, excited, or angry situation to begin
example: It can ignite your spirit and make you feel like you can do anything.
exampleZh: 它能使你燃起精神，感觉自己无所不能。

meaning: n. 着火，点燃；点火装置，点火开关
definition: 1. the electrical system in an engine that causes the fuel to burn or explode in order to start the engine；2. the act or process of something starting to burn
example: "Would your car be easy to steal?"—"Fat chance. I've got a device that shuts down the petrol and ignition."
exampleZh: “你的车容易被偷吗？”—“不可能。我有一个可以关闭油门和点火开关的装置。”

meaning: adj. 无知的，（对某事物）不了解的；无礼的，粗鲁的；暴躁的，易怒的
definition: 1. adj. uneducated in general; lacking knowledge or sophistication；2. adj. uneducated in the fundamentals of a given art or branch of learning; lacking knowledge of a specific field
example: That woman's days were spent In ignorant good will, Her nights in argument Until her voice grew shrill.
exampleZh: 那个女人的白天是在,天真无知的善意中度过，可她的夜晚却是在,声嘶力竭的争论中度过。

meaning: n. 无知，愚昧
definition: 1. n. the lack of knowledge or education
example: And so, I have a film clip here of two very nice studies showing babies' ignorant--sorry, young children's ignorance of other people.
exampleZh: 我给大家放两个优秀实验的电影片段,这个影片表明了幼儿对他人的无知

meaning: v. 佯装未见，不理睬；忽视，对……不予理会；（因证据不足）驳回（诉讼）
definition: 1. v. refuse to acknowledge；2. v. bar from attention or consideration
example: At this point in the story, perhaps the view is that all know of God even if they ignore him.
exampleZh: 从这点来看,即使每个人都忽略上帝，但都知道上帝的存在。

meaning: adj. 有病的，不舒服的；坏的，有害的；不友好的，不友善的；不吉祥的，不利的；adv. 坏，恶劣地；艰难地，几乎不；不友好地，不友善地；不祥地；n. 问题，困难；伤害，厄运；病人，患者；【名】 （Ill）（捷、匈）伊尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. an often persistent bodily disorder or disease; a cause for complaining；2. adj. affected by an impairment of normal physical or mental function
example: But it means that we get ill less often and when we do get sick, we recover more promptly.
exampleZh: 但这意味着我们不会常生病，就算病了，也能恢复得更快。

meaning: n. 疾病；（某种）病，患病期
definition: 1. n. impairment of normal physiological function affecting part or all of an organism
example: They're theories of everything, encompassing just about everything that matters, day-to-day life, child development, mental illness, religion, war, love.
exampleZh: 它们试图对世间的一切做出解释，包括了日常生活，儿童发展，心理疾病，宗教，战争及爱情。

meaning: adj. 非法的，违法的；违规的；n. 非法移民，非法劳工
definition: 1. adj. prohibited by law or by official or accepted rules
example: Yes, but in general, firing somebody simply because of age, is not only strange in America but illegal.
exampleZh: 但是总的来说，只因为年龄就辞退员工在美国不常见也不合法。

meaning: adj. 非法的，社会不容许的
definition: 1. illegal or disapproved of by society；2. illegal or socially disapproved of
example: So, they come to the conclusion that their father is going to castrate them because of their illicit love for their Mom.
exampleZh: 所以他们最终总结出,父亲会因为他们对母亲,抱有非分之想而阉割他们。

meaning: adj. 不识字的，文盲的；行文拙劣的，不通顺的；（对某个学科）无知的，不了解的；n. 文盲
definition: 1. unable to read and write；2. knowing little or nothing about a particular subject
example: At the top of the list is Niger, with 77% of males, 93.6% of females, we see the population, in terms of Gender, 86% of the adult population is illiterate.
exampleZh: 位于最前列的是尼日尔，77%的男性以及93，6%的女性是文盲，而忽略性别看整体人口，86%的成年人是文盲。

meaning: n. 文盲；无知；表达错误
definition: 1. a lack of the ability to read and write；2. a lack of knowledge about a particular subject
example: It would help to end illiteracy and disease, but it would also dislocate a traditional way of life.
exampleZh: 它该会有助于消除文盲和疾病，但也会打乱一种传统的生活方式。

meaning: v. 照射，照亮；阐明，解释；使容光焕发；用彩灯装饰；用金、银等彩色图案装饰（书稿的书页或首词第一个字母）
definition: 1. to light something and make it brighter；2. to explain and show more clearly something that is difficult to understand
example: Instead of formulas and charts, the two instructors use games and drawings to illuminate their subject.
exampleZh: 这两位教师用游戏和图画而不是公式和图表来阐明他们的题旨。

meaning: n. 光亮，照明；启迪，阐明；彩灯，灯饰；（旧时书上通常用手工绘制的）彩饰，彩图
definition: 1. light；2. coloured decorative lights outside that make a town look bright and exciting at night
example: The only illumination came from a small window high in the opposite wall.
exampleZh: 惟一的照明来自对面墙上位于高处的一扇小窗户。

meaning: n. 错觉，幻觉；幻想，错误的观念
definition: 1. n. an erroneous mental representation；2. n. something many people believe that is false
example: Mirrors in a room often give an illusion of space.
exampleZh: 房间里的镜子常给人一种空间增大的错觉。

meaning: adj. 虚假的，幻觉的
definition: 1. adj. based on or having the nature of an illusion
example: The creature had appeared at dusk, an illusory time of day.
exampleZh: 那个生物在黄昏时分现身，这是一天里朦胧虚幻的时刻。

meaning: v. 加插图于；说明，阐明；证明，证实
definition: 1. v. clarify by giving an example of；2. v. depict with an illustration
example: To illustrate my point , let me tell you a little story.
exampleZh: 为了说明我的观点，让我来给你们讲个小故事。

meaning: n. 插图，图解；说明，例释；实例，示例
definition: 1. n. artwork that helps make something clear or attractive；2. n. showing by example
example: Let me, by way of illustration , quote from one of her poems.
exampleZh: 作为说明，让我援引她的一首诗。

meaning: adj. 作例证用的，解释性的；图解的，插图的
definition: 1. adj. clarifying by use of examples；2. adj. serving to demonstrate
example: The charts in this article are for illustrative purposes only.
exampleZh: 该文中的图表只用于说明的目的。

meaning: n. 形象，印象；影像，映像，图像；比喻，意象；画像，塑像，雕像；酷似另一个人的人；（人或事物）外形，外表；像点；硬盘备份；（圣经）偶像；v. 作……的像，描绘……的形象；（以探测器或电磁束）扫描出……的直观图；幻想，想像；【名】 （Image）（法）伊马热（人名）
definition: 1. n. an iconic mental representation；2. v. imagine; conceive of; see in one's mind
example: Milton pushes this image even further into indistinctness with an instance of his famous deployment of the conjunction or.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿甚至把这幅图像发展为朦胧的意象,添加了一丝他引以著称的对关联的展开。

meaning: n. 成像；v. 作……的像，描绘……的形象；（以探测器或电磁束）扫描出……的直观图；幻想，想像（image 的现在分词）
definition: 1. n. the ability to form mental images of things or events；2. n. (medicine) obtaining pictures of the interior of the body
example: Rescue teams are using thermal imaging to locate survivors of the earthquake.
exampleZh: 救援队伍正利用热成像确定地震幸存者的位置。

meaning: v. 想象，设想；料想，认为；误以为，胡乱猜想
definition: 1. v. form a mental image of something that is not present or that is not the case；2. v. expect, believe, or suppose
example: PROFESSOR BAWENDI: The only But it's hard to imagine an irreversible compression the way we can just imagine an irreversible expansion.
exampleZh: ,但是我们很难,像描述不可逆膨胀一样,来描述不可逆压缩。

meaning: n. 想象力，想象；幻觉，空想，幻想物；兴趣；创造力，创作力
definition: 1. n. the formation of a mental image of something that is not perceived as real and is not present to the senses；2. n. the ability to form mental images of things or events
example: This lowly variety is not the kind of imagination I would like readers to use. What a crime!
exampleZh: 我不希望读者们用到这种相对低端的想象方式,罪过啊！你们中有多少人为你们！

meaning: adj. 富于想象力的，创新的；运用想象（力）的，虚构的
definition: 1. adj. (used of persons or artifacts) marked by independence and creativity in thought or action
example: You need to be more flexible and imaginative in your approach.
exampleZh: 你的方法必须更加灵活，更富有想象力。

meaning: adj. 想象的，虚构的；虚数的
definition: 1. n. (mathematics) a number of the form a+bi where a and b are real numbers and i is the square root of -1；2. adj. not based on fact; dubious
example: You remember, when he talks about the state of nature, he is not talking about an imaginary place.
exampleZh: 你们应该记得，他所谈到的自然状态，并不是某个假想的地方。

meaning: v. 模仿，仿效；作滑稽模仿；仿造，伪造
definition: 1. v. reproduce someone's behavior or looks；2. v. appear like, as in behavior or appearance
example: He could imitate in speech or writing most of those he admired.
exampleZh: 他能在口语或书写中模仿大多数他崇拜的人。

meaning: n. 模仿，仿效；滑稽模仿；仿制品，赝品；乐句重复；adj. 人造的，仿制的，伪造的
definition: 1. n. the doctrine that representations of nature or human behavior should be accurate imitations；2. adj. not genuine or real; being an imitation of the genuine article
example: Many corporate methods have been adopted by American managers in imitation of Japanese practice.
exampleZh: 美国的管理人员效仿日本人的做法，采用了很多经营公司的方法。

meaning: adj. 模仿的，仿效的；（单词）拟声的
definition: 1. adj. marked by or given to imitation；2. adj. (of words) formed in imitation of a natural sound
example: Neither the human imitative instinct nor a penchant for fantasy by itself leads to an autonomous theater.
exampleZh: 无论是人类的模仿本能，还是对幻想的嗜好本身，都不会单独成为独立的戏剧形式。

meaning: adj. 立刻的，即时的；目前的，紧迫的；附近的，紧接的；（关系或级别）最接近的，直系的；（两者间）直接的；（感知，反应）直觉的
definition: 1. adj. very close or connected in space or time；2. adj. having no intervening medium
example: Actually, I don't really think that... No? -I don't think that... The cultural wars were an immediate war.
exampleZh: 实际上，我并不这么认为。,不，我不这么认为。,文化论战是十分紧迫的论战。

meaning: adv. 立即，马上；紧接地，紧靠地；直接地；conj. 一……就
definition: 1. adv. without delay or hesitation; with no time intervening；2. adv. near or close by
example: Let's imagine maybe instead we just immediately dropped the pressure let the system expand against the lower pressure.
exampleZh: 现在假设,我们很快地降低压力,让系统在低的外压力下膨胀。

meaning: adj. 极大的，巨大的；非常好，极好；无边无际的
definition: 1. adj. unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope
example: If it had hit the Earth, it would have made a crater 100 miles across and thrown up an immense cloud of dust.
exampleZh: 如果它撞上了地球，就会砸出一个100英里宽的大坑并扬起巨大的尘埃云团。

meaning: adv. 极其，非常
definition: 1. adv. to an exceedingly great extent or degree
example: His only experience of gardening so far proved immensely satisfying.
exampleZh: 他仅有的园艺经历到目前为止非常令人满意。

meaning: n. 巨大，广大
definition: 1. n. unusual largeness in size or extent or number
example: So I think there's a combination of recognizing and the immensity of what is nature and the universe.
exampleZh: 所以我认为应当使,对于自然和宇宙认识,与自然和宇宙的广袤融为一体。

meaning: 使沉浸；使浸没
definition: 1. to become completely involved in something；2. to put something or someone completely under the surface of a liquid
example: Their commitments do not permit them to immerse themselves in current affairs as fully as they might wish.
exampleZh: 他们的职责不允许他们如其所愿地埋头于时事。

meaning: n. （做某事的）专心，投入；浸没，浸泡；沉浸式语言教学法；浸入式热水器；掩始；（基督教的）洗礼，浸礼
definition: 1. the fact of becoming completely involved in something；2. the process of learning a language or skill by using nothing else but that language or skill
example: Leaves, brown with long immersion, rose to the surface and vanished back into the depths.
exampleZh: 长时间浸泡而成褐色的叶子浮上了水面，又消失在了水的深处。

meaning: v. （从外地）移居，移民；使移居入境
definition: 1. v. migrate to a new environment；2. v. introduce or send as immigrants
example: 10,000 people are expected to immigrate in the next two years.
exampleZh: 在今后两年里，一万人有望移民。

meaning: n. 移民（入境）；移民人数；移民局入境检查，移民局入境检查处
definition: 1. n. migration into a place (especially migration to a country of which you are not a native in order to settle there)；2. n. the body of immigrants arriving during a specified interval
example: Scholars have proposed three possible models to explain the formation of Israel. The first is an immigration model.
exampleZh: 学者们提出了三种可能的模型,来解释以色列的形成，第一种是移民模式。

meaning: n. （外来）移民，侨民；adj. 移民的，迁入的
definition: 1. n. a person who comes to a country where they were not born in order to settle there
example: Immigrant support groups are waiting to see if he sticks to his word.
exampleZh: 支持移民的团体正观望他是否遵守诺言。

meaning: adj. 即将发生的，临近的；垂悬的
definition: 1. coming or likely to happen very soon；2. (esp. of something unpleasant) likely to happen very soon
example: Our work was like that of geologists who compile the signs of an imminent earthquake or volcanic eruption.
exampleZh: 我们的工作和地质学家的一样，收集一场即将到来的地震或火山爆发的迹象。

meaning: adj. 免疫的；不受影响的；免除的，豁免的；n. 免疫者，免除者
definition: 1. n. a person who is immune to a particular infection；2. adj. relating to the condition of immunity
example: His immune system completely broke down and he became very ill.
exampleZh: 他的免疫系统彻底崩溃了，他已病入膏肓。

meaning: n. 免疫力；免除，豁免
definition: 1. n. the state of not being susceptible；2. n. (medicine) the condition in which an organism can resist disease
example: Humoral refers to immunity in the blood and it's immunity that's in the blood in the form of antibodies.
exampleZh: 体液免疫代表着血液中的免疫机制,血液中的免疫机制是以抗体的形式存在的

meaning: v. （常指通过注射疫苗）使免疫
definition: 1. v. law: grant immunity from prosecution；2. v. perform vaccinations or produce immunity in by inoculation
example: Ambulances were rushed in and teams of doctors and nurses from other areas helped immunize survivors against disease.
exampleZh: 救护车从外地匆匆开进灾区，外地医疗队的医生和护士们帮助幸存者增强抗病能力。

meaning: n. 撞击，冲击力；巨大影响，强大作用；v. 冲击，撞击；挤入，压紧；（对……）产生影响
definition: 1. n. the striking of one body against another；2. v. press or wedge together; pack together
example: So, Hartman and Fish have forwarded two perfectly ingenious theories of Milton's similes, and they've had a tremendous impact, rightly, on generations now of readers of Milton.
exampleZh: 所以，哈特曼和费什提出了两个相当聪明的理论,给弥尔顿的两代读者，留下了深远的影响。

meaning: v. 损害，削弱
definition: 1. to spoil something or make it weaker so that it is less effective；2. to damage or weaken something so that it is less effective
example: Their inability to scowl seemed to impair their ability to see why pushy telemarketers or a lack of birthday wishes might make one's face fall.
exampleZh: 他们无法动怒似乎削弱了他们的能力，让他们明白为什么咄咄逼人的电话推销员或没得到生日祝愿可能会让一个人沉下脸来。

meaning: v. 传授，告知；赋予，给予
definition: 1. to communicate information to someone；2. to give something a particular feeling, quality, or taste
example: The ability to impart knowledge and command respect is the essential qualification for teachers.
exampleZh: 传授知识并博得尊敬的能力对老师们来说是基本的条件。

meaning: adj. 不耐烦的，没有耐心的；迫不及待的，急切的；（对不愉快的事）不能容忍，不愿接受
definition: 1. adj. restless or short of temper under delay or opposition；2. adj. (usually followed by `to') full of eagerness
example: They were impatient at the delay.
exampleZh: 他们对拖延不耐烦了。

meaning: n. 不耐烦，无耐心；热切，急切
definition: 1. n. a lack of patience; irritation with anything that causes delay；2. n. a restless desire for change and excitement
example: Possibly believing me to be tolerant of her impatience, she rolled her eyes and said, "Yeah."
exampleZh: 她可能认为我能容忍她的不耐烦，于是转了转眼珠，说：“是的。”

meaning: adj. 极重要的，必要的；命令的，强制的；祈使的；n. 重要紧急的事，必要的事；祈使语气，祈使语气动词；命令
definition: 1. extremely important or urgent；2. used for giving an instruction or order
example: It is absolutely imperative that we finish by next week.
exampleZh: 我们的当务之急是必须于下周完成。

meaning: adj. 帝国的，皇帝的；宏伟的，华丽的；专横的，飞扬跋扈的；（度量衡）英制的；（纸张尺寸）（英国）762×559毫米的；n. （在下唇下的）尖胡须；纸张尺寸；特等品；【名】 （Imperial）（西）因佩里亚尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a small tufted beard worn by Emperor Napoleon III；2. adj. relating to or associated with an empire
example: He matriculated in the English Literature Department at the Tokyo Imperial University.
exampleZh: 他被东京帝国大学英语文学系录取了。

meaning: n. 帝国主义；势力扩大，扩张主义；帝制，帝王统治
definition: 1. n. a policy of extending your rule over foreign countries；2. n. a political orientation that advocates imperial interests
example: and at some point I'm sure there was a question of cultural imperialism involve.
exampleZh: 我相信，在某些时候,文化帝国主义确实存在过。

meaning: n. 帝国主义者；adj. 帝国主义的
definition: 1. n. a believer in imperialism；2. adj. of or relating to imperialism
example: The play is being widely read as an allegory of imperialist conquest.
exampleZh: 这出戏正被广泛地诠释为帝国主义征服的寓言。

meaning: n. 动力，促进；动量，冲力
definition: 1. something that encourages a particular activity or makes that activity more energetic or effective；2. a force that encourages a particular action or makes it more energetic or effective
example: By 1982, she was restless and needed a new impetus for her talent.
exampleZh: 到1982年，她焦躁不安，需要一个新的对其才华的推动力。

meaning: v. 执行，贯彻；为……提供工具；n. 工具，器具；履行；手段
definition: 1. n. instrumentation (a piece of equipment or tool) used to effect an end；2. v. apply in a manner consistent with its purpose or design
example: But you'll see that once you get to final projects frankly, you're not gonna want to implement everything from scratch.
exampleZh: 但是一旦你得出了最终方案，你就不会愿意利用框架去,实现任何功能了。

meaning: n. 实施，执行
definition: 1. n. the act of accomplishing some aim or executing some order；2. n. the act of implementing (providing a practical means for accomplishing something); carrying into effect
example: Very little has been achieved in the implementation of the peace agreement signed last January.
exampleZh: 去年1月份签署的和平协议的执行几乎没有什么进展。

meaning: adj. 含蓄的，未言明的；内含的，固有的；无疑问的，无保留的；（函数）隐式的，隐的
definition: 1. adj. implied though not directly expressed; inherent in the nature of something；2. adj. being without doubt or reserve
example: All of this monistic philosophy, I think, is implicit in the image of divinity's impregnation of the vast abyss.
exampleZh: 这所有的一元论观点，我认为，都可从神灵孕育洪荒这一意象中看出来。

meaning: v. 暗示，暗指；意味着；必然包含
definition: 1. v. express or state indirectly；2. v. suggest as a logically necessary consequence; in logic
example: Israel was chosen by Yahweh in an act of spontaneous love it does not imply her perfection an act of spontaneous love for the patriarchs.
exampleZh: 以色列被上帝选择是出于一种无意识的爱,这并不暗示着她是完美的,只是对族长无意识的喜欢。

meaning: n. 可能的影响（或作用、结果）；含意，暗指；牵连，涉及
definition: 1. n. something that is inferred (deduced or entailed or implied)；2. n. a meaning that is not expressly stated but can be inferred
example: Implication in a murder finally brought him to the gallows.
exampleZh: 与一桩谋杀案的牵连最终把他送上了绞刑架。

meaning: n. 进口，进口商品；输入，引进；重要性；意思，含意；v. 进口，输入，引进；导入（计算机）；意味，表明
definition: 1. n. commodities (goods or services) bought from a foreign country；2. v. bring in from abroad
example: The country has to import most of its raw materials.
exampleZh: 这个国家大多数原料均依赖进口。

meaning: n. 进口，引进；输入品
definition: 1. n. the commercial activity of buying and bringing in goods from a foreign country；2. n. commodities (goods or services) bought from a foreign country
example: Taking that view, many European countries are restricting the cultivation and importation of genetically modified agricultural products.
exampleZh: 基于这种观点，许多欧洲国家正在限制转基因农产品的种植和进口。

meaning: adj. 重要的，重大的；（人）影响很大的，权威的；大量的，许多的；自负的，自命不凡的
definition: 1. adj. of great significance or value；2. adj. important in effect or meaning
example: What may be most important here is the mere fact that Milton is expressing these political convictions at all.
exampleZh: 这里最重要的不过是,弥尔顿只是在表达他的政治信念。

meaning: n. 重要，重要性；傲慢；名望
definition: 1. n. the quality of being important and worthy of note；2. n. a prominent status
example: We have already encountered on some level the importance of the figure of eating to John Milton. Think of Comus.
exampleZh: 我们已经在某种程度上见识到了,对于弥尔顿来说吃的形象的重要性，想想司酒宴之神。

meaning: v. 强制推行，强制实行；把（自己的观点、信仰等）强加于；打扰，麻烦；把（活字页）拼版；欺骗
definition: 1. v. compel to behave in a certain way；2. v. impose something unpleasant
example: He has tried to impose solutions to the country's problems by fiat.
exampleZh: 他已经试图采取强制性法令来解决该国的问题。

meaning: n. （规章 、惩罚、税种等的）实施；无理要求；（活字页）拼版
definition: 1. n. the act of imposing something (as a tax or an embargo)；2. n. an uncalled-for burden
example: The frightening experience that Yeats evokes here is the imposition of the divine on the human.
exampleZh: 这里写的这种令人害怕的体验,圣对人的强占。

meaning: adj. 壮观的，仪表堂堂的；v. 强制推行，强制实行；把（自己的观点、信仰等）强加于；打扰，麻烦（impose 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. impressive in appearance；2. adj. used of a person's appearance or behavior; befitting an eminent person
example: Parents should beware of imposing their own tastes on their children.
exampleZh: 父母应该提防把自己的兴趣强加给孩子。

meaning: adj. 不可能的，办不到的；（境况）极其艰难的；（人）难以对付的；n. 不可能的事（the impossible）
definition: 1. n. something that cannot be done；2. adj. not capable of occurring or being accomplished or dealt with
example: These are unquestionably strong words, and I think it's impossible for us to overestimate the weight of these words.
exampleZh: 毫无疑问，这些言辞非常激烈，我觉得,怎么高估它们的分量都不过分。

meaning: n. 不可能的事；不可能性
definition: 1. n. incapability of existing or occurring；2. n. an alternative that is not available
example: It is a physical impossibility to be in two places at once.
exampleZh: 同时身处两地在自然法则上是不可能的。

meaning: v. 使钦佩，使留下深刻印象；使意识到（重要性或严重性等）；使铭记；压，压印；外加（电流，电势）；传送；强征；n. 压印，印记
definition: 1. n. the act of coercing someone into government service；2. v. have an emotional or cognitive impact upon
example: It didn't impress me as a good place to live.
exampleZh: 那地方没有给我留下适合居住的印象。

meaning: n. 印象，感想；影响，作用；印象画；（对名人的）滑稽模仿；（通常有悖事实的）感觉，假象；压印，印记；印次；（网络广告）印象数
definition: 1. n. a vague idea in which some confidence is placed；2. n. an outward appearance
example: A lot of people have the impression that home prices only go up and that they're a wonderful investment.
exampleZh: 大多数人都觉得,房价始终是上涨的,而且房屋是理想的投资项目

meaning: adj. 给人印象深刻的，令人钦佩的
definition: 1. adj. making a strong or vivid impression；2. adj. producing a strong effect
example: So, the thing I took the most credit for is bringing people who actually did the really impressive things.
exampleZh: 我做得最好的就是,引进了这些人,他们做出了了不起的成绩。

meaning: v. 关押，监禁；束缚，限制
definition: 1. to put someone in prison；2. to put someone in prison or in a situation that is like prison
example: Pitcher plants use yet another strategy, growing long tube-shaped leaves to imprison their prey.
exampleZh: 猪笼草使用了另一种策略，它们长出长长的管状叶子来囚禁猎物。

meaning: n. 监禁，关押
definition: 1. the act of putting someone in prison or the condition of being kept in prison
example: It's a kind of imprisonment, understanding, and when Heidegger says, wouldn't it be great not to have to merely understand?
exampleZh: 理解是一种禁锢，海德格尔说，不必去理解不是很好吗？

meaning: adj. 即兴的，即席的；adv. 即兴地，即席地；n. 即兴曲（尤指独奏）；即席演出
definition: 1. done or said without earlier planning or preparation
example: The umbrella holder must be good at singing traditional songs and composing new songs impromptu so that they can meet the demand in different places.
exampleZh: 拿着伞的领舞要善于领唱传统的歌曲以及即兴编唱新曲，以适应不同场合的需要。

meaning: v. 康复，健康好转；超过，胜过；提高……的价值；改善，变得更好
definition: 1. v. to make better；2. v. get better
example: Yeah! Well, I mean, I think for sure, the best way to improve your ability to speak any language
exampleZh: 行！我认为，我觉得也一定是这样，最好的提高语言能力的方法，

meaning: n. 改善；改进之处
definition: 1. n. the act of improving something；2. n. a change for the better; progress in development
example: But this policy of giving greater weight, if you show improvement, is something that most of you will benefit from.
exampleZh: 但整个方针是进步处占更大比重，如果你表现进步的话，你们中的大多数会从中获益。

meaning: n. 冲动；脉冲；推动力；adj. 一时兴起的，随兴的；v. 推动
definition: 1. n. an instinctive motive；2. n. a sudden desire
example: Unable to resist the impulse, he glanced at the sea again.
exampleZh: 他抑制不住冲动，又看了一眼大海。

meaning: adj. 冲动的；脉冲的
definition: 1. adj. proceeding from natural feeling or impulse without external stimulus；2. adj. without forethought
example: He is too impulsive to be a responsible mayor.
exampleZh: 他太容易冲动，无法成为一个可靠的市长。

meaning: prep. 在……内，在……里（面），在（某地）；进……里；在……期间；在……以后；在……之内（表示将来时间）；在……岁时；当……时；穿着，戴着，覆盖着……；带……颜色的；在……状态中；在……方面，关于；用……（语言、媒介、方式），以……方式，按照（表示方式）；以……调；从事……，参加；在（活动）过程中；在（书、电影、图片等）中；包含在……中；占……，每……中有……，在……之中（用于较大和较小数字之间）；以……的数量；具有……特性；（引出具某种品质的人的名字）；adv. 进入，朝里，向中间；在里头，在屋里，在家（或在工作处）；到达，到站，在车站；当选；涨潮；收到；递交，送到；填写；着色；击球；（球）落在界内；adj. 在里面的，内部的；时髦的，流行的；（用球）界内的；n. 执政者；门路，关系，接近……的机会
definition: 1. n. a unit of length equal to one twelfth of a foot；2. adj. holding office
example: Rather, his subtlety shows itself in his deliberate concealment of it, in the ways in which he masks himself in obviousness.
exampleZh: 他的狡猾表现在他故意地隐藏这种隐约，而且是以很直白的方式表现的。

meaning: v. 为……举行就职典礼；为……举行落成仪式；开创，开展
definition: 1. to put someone into an official position with a ceremony；2. to put something into use or action officially
example: Q: the 8th China-ASEAN Expo will inaugurate tomorrow. Please brief us on the attendance of ASEAN leaders.
exampleZh: 问：第八届中国-东盟博览会将于明天开幕，请介绍东盟国家政要出席情况。

meaning: n. 就职典礼；开幕式；开创
definition: 1. the act of officially putting someone into an important position, or the ceremony at which this is done；2. the act of something officially starting to be used
example: In 1585, the newly elected doge had thrown silver coins instead of the traditional gold at his inauguration.
exampleZh: 1585年，新当选的总督在他的就职典礼上扔的不是传统的金子，而是银币。

meaning: adj. 天生的
definition: 1. used to refer to a mental or physical characteristic that someone has from birth；2. possessed as a characteristic from birth
example: Are some of these differences biological and inborn, a result of evolution?
exampleZh: 这些差异有的是生物性的，有的是天生的，是进化的结果吗？

meaning: n. 激励，刺激
definition: 1. n. a positive motivational influence；2. n. an additional payment (or other remuneration) to employees as a means of increasing output
example: Neither side would have a real incentive to start a war. Ergo, peace would reign.
exampleZh: 双方都没有发动战争的真实动机。因此，和平将会到来。

meaning: n. 英寸；（距离或数量）少许；身高，腰围；v. （数量）逐渐增加（或减少）；（使）缓慢移动；【名】 （Inch）（英）英奇（人名）
definition: 1. n. a unit of length equal to one twelfth of a foot；2. v. advance slowly, as if by inches
example: Nick's grown almost an inch in the last month.
exampleZh: 尼克这一个月来长高了差不多一英寸。

meaning: n. 发生率；入射
definition: 1. n. the relative frequency of occurrence of something；2. n. the striking of a light beam on a surface
example: Authentic Italian cooking is very healthy—witness the low incidence of heart disease in Italy.
exampleZh: 正宗的意大利烹饪对健康非常有益，在意大利心脏病发病率低就是证据。

meaning: n. 事件，事故；（两国间的）冲突，严重摩擦；（职务、财产等所有物的）附属特权；adj. 由……产生的；附属的；入射的
definition: 1. n. a single distinct event；2. adj. falling or striking of light rays on something
example: And I am going to let this arrow somehow indicate the value of the incident energy.
exampleZh: 我将用这个箭头,来揭示,入射能量的值。

meaning: adj. 附带的，次要的；伴随而来的，免不了的；偶然发生的；n. 杂费，附带事件
definition: 1. n. (frequently plural) an expense not budgeted or not specified；2. adj. (sometimes followed by `to') minor or casual or subordinate in significance or nature or occurring as a chance concomitant or consequence
example: The winner of our Editors' Choice distinction, utilizes a special system that's capable of separating incidental RF interference from targeted jamming attacks.
exampleZh: 我们的编辑选择的荣誉优胜者，利用了一种特殊的系统，能够将偶然的射频干扰从有针对性的干扰攻击中分离出来。

meaning: adv. 顺便说一句；偶然地；附带地，伴随地
definition: 1. adv. introducing a different topic；2. adv. in an incidental manner
example: "I didn't ask you to come. Incidentally, why have you come?"
exampleZh: “我没有叫你来。顺便问一下，你为什么来呢？”

meaning: v. （使）倾向于；点头；（使）倾斜；赞同（某人，某事）；n. 斜坡，倾斜
definition: 1. n. an elevated geological formation；2. v. have a tendency or disposition to do or be something; be inclined
example: He stopped just as his truck tilted down the steep incline, put on the handbrake, and stepped out.
exampleZh: 就在他的卡车沿陡峭的斜坡向下滑的时候，他停了下来，拉住了手闸，然后下了车。

meaning: adj. 有……意向，倾向于……；对……有兴趣的，有天赋的；倾斜的，有坡度的；v. 点头；（使）倾向于；（使）倾斜（incline 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. (often followed by `to') having a preference, disposition, or tendency；2. adj. at an angle to the horizontal or vertical position
example: And I'm inclined to think, "Yes." In fact, I already suggested as much when I talked about the chess-playing computers.
exampleZh: 我倾向于认为,有,实际上,当我在谈会下象棋计算机时,我已经暗示过很多次了

meaning: n. 倾向，意愿；趋向，趋势；斜坡，斜度；轻微向下的动作；轨道交角
definition: 1. n. an attitude of mind especially one that favors one alternative over others；2. n. (astronomy) the angle between the plane of the orbit and the plane of the ecliptic stated in degrees
example: The natural inclination here is to say, "These computer programs, these robots are feeling emotion."
exampleZh: 这边人们可以自然而然地说,这些计算机程序,这些机器人能感受情感

meaning: v. 包含；把……列为一部分，把……算入
definition: 1. v. have as a part, be made up out of；2. v. consider as part of something
example: Moreover, this earthling that seems to include both male and female, is then said to be in the image of God.
exampleZh: 而且，这地球生物中似乎既有男也有女，他们依照上帝的形象。

meaning: n. 包含，包括；包含物，包括的人；认同感，归属感
definition: 1. n. the state of being included；2. n. the relation of comprising something
example: This will cost money, but if social inclusion is to succeed, it must be spent.
exampleZh: 这将花费金钱，但是要想社会包容取得成功，这笔钱就必须得花。

meaning: adj. 包容广阔的；包括一切费用在内的；包括的，包含的；无性别歧视的；对外开放的
definition: 1. adj. including much or everything; and especially including stated limits
example: The academy is far more inclusive now than it used to be.
exampleZh: 该学院如今比过去更为兼收并蓄。

meaning: prep. 包括，包含；v. 包含；把……列为一部分，把……算入（include 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. v. have as a part, be made up out of；2. v. consider as part of something
example: In the end, the compromise is that he notes several writers Sherwood Anderson including Dreiser and Sherwood Anderson.
exampleZh: 最后，为了缓和矛盾,他举出一些作家为例,包括德莱塞。

meaning: n. 收入，收益
definition: 1. n. the financial gain (earned or unearned) accruing over a given period of time
example: such as taking women out of Thailand who are in prostitution and providing them with sustainable income.
exampleZh: 比如把在泰国卖淫的女性解救出来，向她们提供可持续的收入。

meaning: v. 包含，合并；组成公司；掺和，混合（成分）；使具体化，体现；adj. 合成一体的，合并的；具体化的；组成公司（或社团）的
definition: 1. to include something as part of something larger；2. to legally make a company into a corporation or part of a corporation (= a large company or group of companies that is controlled together as a single organization), or (of a company) to become a corporation
example: The new cars will incorporate a number of major improvements.
exampleZh: 这种新型汽车将包含许多重大的改进。

meaning: n. 合并；公司，团体组织
definition: 1. the act of including something or someone as part of something；2. the process or fact of legally making a company into a corporation or part of a corporation (= a large company or group of companies that is controlled together as a single organization)
example: At the time, it was being made available for consideration as a new specification or for incorporation into an existing standards group.
exampleZh: 当时提供它的目的是为了考虑将其作为新规范，或合并到现有的规范组中。

meaning: v. 增长，增强，增大；n. 增长；增长量；【名】 （Increase）（英、美、印、尼日尼亚）英克里斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a quantity that is added；2. v. become bigger or greater in amount
example: When we have an isolated system, the criterion that determineswhether something happens spontaneously is the entropy has to increase.
exampleZh: 对于孤立系统,决定一个过程是否自发发生的判据为：,熵必须增加。

meaning: adv. 越来越多地，不断增加地
definition: 1. adv. advancing in amount or intensity
example: All of this is Darwinian thinking and, I think, increasingly will be central in importance in the twenty-first century.
exampleZh: 这就是达尔文所思考的，我认为，这在二十一世纪会越来越重要。

meaning: adj. 不可思议的，难以置信的；惊人的，极大的，极多的；了不起的，极好的
definition: 1. adj. beyond belief or understanding
example: What are we to make of the incredible similarity of Israel's deity and cult to those of her neighbors?
exampleZh: 我们怎么样解释以色列的神与,它邻国宗教的相似性？

meaning: adv. 难以置信地；非常地
definition: 1. adv. not easy to believe
example: And so suddenly, you are thrown into a pool of so many other incredibly intelligent, driven people, and
exampleZh: 所以，突然之间，你发现周围人都是绝顶聪明，都是劲头十足的人，

meaning: adj. 在职的，现任的；职责所在的，义不容辞的；（公司）占市场份额大的；n. 在职者，现任官员；教区牧师，领圣俸者
definition: 1. officially having the named position；2. to be necessary for someone because it is their duty
example: She felt it was incumbent on herself to act immediately.
exampleZh: 她感到立即采取行动是她义不容辞的责任。

meaning: v. 带来（成本、花费等）；招致，遭受
definition: 1. to experience something, usually something unpleasant, as a result of actions you have taken；2. to experience something bad as a result of actions you have taken
example: Long-term dependence on the library may incur extended licensing costs and dependence on the vendor for regular updates and support.
exampleZh: 长期依赖该库可能会导致许可费用增加，并且会依赖供应商进行定期更新和支持。

meaning: adj. 感激的，蒙恩的；负债的；v. 使负债；使受恩惠（indebt 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. grateful because of help given；2. owing money
example: You can see on the handout those poems by those classical authors that Milton's Lycidas is most indebted to.
exampleZh: 讲义上有这些经典作者的经典诗作,弥尔顿的《利西达斯》是受这些诗作的启发写成的。

meaning: adv. 确实，的确；实际上；真正地； 真的吗（表示惊讶或觉得某事物荒谬）
definition: 1. adv. in truth (often tends to intensify)；2. adv. (used as an interjection) an expression of surprise or skepticism or irony etc.
example: It's this basic antagonism, this difference of opinion, that Eikhenbaum wants to focus on and, indeed, does focus on.
exampleZh: 这就是艾肯鲍姆的反对者的，基本意见，针对这点，艾肯鲍姆将反对付诸行动了。

meaning: adj. 无限期的，期限不定的；模糊不清的，不明确的；（词，屈折变化，短语）不定的
definition: 1. not exact, not clear, or without clear limits；2. not exact or not clear; without clear limits
example: They seem determined to string the talks out for an indefinite period.
exampleZh: 他们好像一心要把谈判无限期地拖下去。

meaning: adj. 自治的，独立的；自立的，自力更生的；公正的，不受他人影响的；分离的，单独的；私营的；无党派的；有主见的，有独立见解的；n. 独立自主者，独立团体；无党派政治家；公理会教友
definition: 1. n. a neutral or uncommitted person (especially in politics)；2. adj. free from external control and constraint
example: So I feel like people are more independent over there, which is sort of a good thing,
exampleZh: 所以，我觉得那里的人更独立，这也是件好事情，

meaning: n. 独立，自主；（国家的）独立；（国家或地区的）政治独立日期
definition: 1. n. freedom from control or influence of another or others；2. n. the successful ending of the American Revolution
example: It's this kind of wealth that allow them to fight this long, hard war of independence, which they finally win.
exampleZh: 这些所带来的财富,就成了他们为之奋斗的原动力,使得他们在艰苦的独立战争中获得胜利

meaning: n. 索引；（物价和工资等）指数；指标，量度；幂，根指数；指针；v. 为……编索引，将……编入索引；使指数化，将（工资）等与（物价水平等）挂钩；（机器，部件）转位
definition: 1. n. a numerical scale used to compare variables with one another or with some reference number；2. v. list in an index
example: Now we talked before about a diet that would follow the glycemic index, that's another pretty helpful method to follow.
exampleZh: 我们之前还谈论过,基于血糖指数的饮食法,那是另一种健康饮食法之一

meaning: v. 表明，标示；象征，暗示；间接提及，示意；指示，指出；（用灯光或手臂）打行车转向信号；有必要，被建议
definition: 1. v. be a signal for or a symptom of；2. v. indicate a place, direction, person, or thing; either spatially or figuratively
example: The extent of the rise might indicate that it had been overdone.
exampleZh: 上涨的程度可能显示事情做得过头了。

meaning: n. 指示，标示；象征，暗示，迹象
definition: 1. n. something that serves to indicate or suggest；2. n. the act of indicating or pointing out by name
example: There had been no indication of either breathlessness or any loss of mental faculties right until his death.
exampleZh: 直到去世，他既没有出现呼吸困难也没有脑功能丧失的迹象。

meaning: adj. 指示的，表明的，象征的；陈述（语气）的；n. 陈述语气的动词形式，陈述语气
definition: 1. n. a mood (grammatically unmarked) that represents the act or state as an objective fact；2. adj. relating to the mood of verbs that is used simple declarative statements
example: In 'Ben likes school', the verb 'like' is in the indicative.
exampleZh: 在Ben likes school中，动词like是陈述语气。

meaning: n. 标志，迹象；方向灯，转向指示灯；指示器，显示器；指示剂；指示（物）种
definition: 1. n. a number or ratio (a value on a scale of measurement) derived from a series of observed facts; can reveal relative changes as a function of time；2. n. a signal for attracting attention
example: I mean buy could actually be a negative indicator that this is probably not of interest to the user.
exampleZh: 我的意思是购物可能是一个负面暗示,暗示用户对这些不是很有兴趣。

meaning: v. 控告，起诉，告发
definition: 1. If a law court or a grand jury indicts someone, it accuses them officially of a crime；2. to accuse someone officially of a crime
example: In the absence of sufficient proof, the police could not indict him.
exampleZh: 没有足够的证据，警方不能起诉他。

meaning: n. 指控，控告；谴责，不满；（制度、社会等的）衰败迹象，腐败迹象；诉状，公诉书
definition: 1. a statement that criticizes someone or something very strongly for being bad or wrong；2. something that shows a policy, system, society, etc. is very bad or wrong
example: Well,I think that's a pretty clear-eyed view,and a clear indictment, of what Kerouac is doing through the character of Sal.
exampleZh: 这是看这本小说的一个很清晰的视角，对Kerouac为萨尔这个角色赋予的东西而申诉。

meaning: adj. 冷淡的，不关心的；中等的，平庸的；一般的，相当差的；中立的；不分化的
definition: 1. adj. marked by a lack of interest；2. adj. showing no care or concern in attitude or action
example: Now, I doubt if there's anybody here who is indifferent between the choices, indifferent with regard to the choice between these two lives.
exampleZh: 我怀疑这里不会有人,会对这两种选择无动于衷，大家对这两种生命选择都会有所感触。

meaning: n. 不感兴趣，漠不关心；不重要，无价值；平凡，普通
definition: 1. n. unbiased impartial unconcern；2. n. apathy demonstrated by an absence of emotional reactions
example: It's a kind of dare demonstrating not just his indifference to the crowd but in fact his scorn for it.
exampleZh: 叶芝这种胆量,不仅说明他对大众的漠然,其实还是对它的蔑视。

meaning: adj. 本土的，固有的
definition: 1. used to refer to the people who originally lived in a place, rather than people who moved there from somewhere else, or to things that relate to these people；2. used to refer to plants and animals that grow or live naturally in a place, and have not been brought there from somewhere else
example: They're driving out of Mexico, Sal and Dean, and they meet indigenous people along the road.
exampleZh: 萨尔和迪安正开车离开墨西哥，他们在路上,遇见了各种当地人。

meaning: adj. 愤愤不平的，愤慨的
definition: 1. angry because of something that is wrong or not fair
example: Well, I'll have you know my manager is rather indignant that it's taken you this long to come.
exampleZh: 好吧，我得告诉你，我经理对你们这么久才来非常生气。

meaning: n. 愤愤不平，义愤
definition: 1. anger about a situation that you think is wrong or not fair
example: The public's feelings were at a high pitch of indignation.
exampleZh: 公众的愤怒情绪达到了极点。

meaning: adj. 不可或缺的，必需的；不能撇开的，责无旁贷的；n. 不可缺少之物，必不可少的人
definition: 1. adj. not to be dispensed with; essential；2. adj. absolutely necessary; vitally necessary
example: Cars have become an indispensable part of our lives.
exampleZh: 汽车已成了我们生活中必不可少的一部分。

meaning: adj. 单独的，个别的；个人的；独特的，与众不同的；n. 个人，个体；与众不同的人，有个性的人；某种类型的人
definition: 1. n. a human being；2. adj. being or characteristic of a single thing or person
example: Thus far, for us it's been testing individual functions. Later in the term we'll talk about unit testing of classes.
exampleZh: 至今为止，我们用到单元测试的地方,就是测试每个单独的方法,在后面我们会讲到类的单元测试。

meaning: n. 利己主义，个人主义；个性，独特气质；（国家对经济、政治的）不干涉主义，自由放任主义
definition: 1. n. the quality of being individual；2. n. a belief in the importance of the individual and the virtue of self-reliance and personal independence
example: Some coming from East Asian societies have said, this emphasis in the West on individualism.
exampleZh: 有些东亚社会的人说，西方这种强调个人主义的思想。

meaning: adj. 室内的，户内的
definition: 1. adj. located, suited for, or taking place within a building；2. adj. within doors
example: If the weather is wet or cold choose an indoor activity.
exampleZh: 如果下雨或是天气寒冷，就选择室内活动。

meaning: adv. 在室内，进入室内；n. 室内，户内
definition: 1. adv. within a building
example: In view of the weather, the event will now be held indoors.
exampleZh: 由于天气的缘故，这项赛事将在室内进行。

meaning: v. 引诱，诱使；引起，导致；给（孕妇）引产，（用药物）催生；归纳出
definition: 1. v. cause to arise；2. v. cause to do; cause to act in a specified manner
example: Again, how much quantity would Firm 2 have to produce in order to induce Firm 1's best response to be 0?
exampleZh: 重复一遍,公司2的产量是多少时,公司1的最佳对策是产量为0呢

meaning: n. 诱因，刺激
definition: 1. n. a positive motivational influence；2. n. act of bringing about a desired result
example: They offer every inducement to foreign businesses to invest in their states.
exampleZh: 他们提供了种种优惠条件吸引外国公司在他们州投资。

meaning: v. 沉湎，沉溺；纵容，迁就；满足（情感、兴趣、欲望等）；参加，参与（尤指违法活动）
definition: 1. to allow yourself or another person to have something enjoyable, especially more than is good for you；2. to give someone anything they want and not to mind if they behave badly
example: In Algiers, no one says "go for a swim", but rather say "indulge in a swim".
exampleZh: 在阿尔及尔没有人说“去游泳”，而是说“畅游一番”。

meaning: n. 沉溺，沉迷；纵容，放纵；嗜好，享受；宽容，包涵；（中世纪时罗马天主教会授予的）特赦，赦免；付款延期，偿债延期
definition: 1. an occasion when you allow yourself to have something enjoyable, especially something that is not good for you, or something enjoyable that you allow yourself like this；2. an occasion when you allow or do not mind someone's failure or bad behaviour
example: The king's indulgence toward his sons angered the business community.
exampleZh: 国王对孩子们的纵容激怒了商界。

meaning: adj. 纵容的，放纵的；宽容的，过于宽厚的；作为一种享受的
definition: 1. allowing someone to have or do what they want, especially when this is not good for them
example: I told her to stop being lazy, cowardly, self-indulgent and pathetic.
exampleZh: 我告诉她别再懒惰、懦弱、自我放纵又自甘可悲了。

meaning: n. 工业，生产制造；行业，产业；勤奋，勤劳；范围，领域
definition: 1. n. the people or companies engaged in a particular kind of commercial enterprise；2. n. the organized action of making of goods and services for sale
example: And we invite professors from other schools or people in industry to come talk to the students here.
exampleZh: 我们会邀请其他学院的教授，还有行业内的人员来给我们的学生演讲。

meaning: adj. 工业的，产业的；有很多产业的，工业发达的；工业用的，用于工业的；（与）工业摇滚（有关）的；因勤劳而得到的；n. 从事工业的公司；工业股票；工业工人
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to or resulting from industry；2. adj. having highly developed industries
example: There are also some hotel investments,retail properties, smattering of industrial properties not a lot of exposure to individual houses.
exampleZh: 也有一些酒店和商场物业投资,以及一些零散的工业物业,没有太多地投资于个人住宅

meaning: v. （使）工业化
definition: 1. v. organize the production of into an industry；2. v. develop industry; become industrial
example: You need to industrialize the development process, relieving humans from any task that does not truly require creativity and human intelligence.
exampleZh: 你需要将开发流程工业化，把人力从那些真正不需要创造力和人类智能的工作中解放出来。

meaning: adj. 勤劳的，勤奋的
definition: 1. adj. characterized by hard work and perseverance；2. adj. working hard to promote an enterprise
example: He believed success came from industry, so he was very industrious.
exampleZh: 他相信成功来自勤奋，所以他很勤奋。

meaning: n. 缺乏活力，惰性；无变化；惯性
definition: 1. lack of activity or interest, or unwillingness to make an effort to do anything；2. the physical force that keeps something in the same position or moving in the same direction
example: The point of Newton is, two things in the Law of Inertia, which one may think is trivial.
exampleZh: 牛顿的观点是,惯性定律分两部分,可能有人觉得这种分法无关紧要

meaning: adj. 必然发生的，不可避免的；总会发生的，惯常的；n. 必然发生的事，不可避免的事
definition: 1. n. an unavoidable event；2. adj. incapable of being avoided or prevented
example: There were tales, inevitable tales of-- and with French food, as you know, presentation accounts for something very much.
exampleZh: 还有一些不可避免的传说,关于法国菜的传说,菜的品相是很重要的

meaning: n. 婴儿，幼儿；（英国学校里四至七岁的）学童；未成年人；adj. 供婴幼儿用的；初期的，初创期的；四岁至七岁幼儿的；【名】 （Infant）（英）因方特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a very young child (birth to 1 year) who has not yet begun to walk or talk
example: There was an infant squalling in the back of the church.
exampleZh: 教堂的后面有个婴儿大声啼哭的声音。

meaning: v. 传染，浸染；污染，败坏；（某种感情或兴趣）影响；感染（计算机病毒）
definition: 1. v. communicate a disease to；2. v. contaminate with a disease or microorganism
example: Usually viruses have certain kinds of cells they want to infect or that they're capable of infecting.
exampleZh: 通常病毒倾向于或者有能力,感染某些种类的细胞

meaning: n. 传染病；感染；玷污，污染
definition: 1. n. the pathological state resulting from the invasion of the body by pathogenic microorganisms；2. n. (phonetics) the alteration of a speech sound under the influence of a neighboring sound
example: AIDS is a tremendous problem, deaths from HIV infection and AIDS a tremendous problem in Africa and other parts of the world.
exampleZh: 艾滋病是一个巨大的问题,在非洲和世界其他地方,艾滋病毒感染和艾滋病带来的死亡,是一个巨大的问题

meaning: adj. 传染的，传染性的；有感染力的，有影响力的
definition: 1. adj. caused by infection or capable of causing infection；2. adj. easily spread
example: In contrast today, because we have antibiotics and we have vaccines, people don't die of infectious diseases as often.
exampleZh: 相反,在现在,因为我们有了抗生素和疫苗,死于感染性疾病的人就不像以前那么多

meaning: v. 推断，推论；暗示，暗指
definition: 1. v. reason by deduction; establish by deduction；2. v. draw from specific cases for more general cases
example: Right. The unconscious, Freud is saying, is something that we have to infer from the way consciousness operates.
exampleZh: 弗洛伊德说潜意识，是由意识的活动方式中推断出来的。

meaning: n. 推断，推理；推断结果，结论
definition: 1. n. the reasoning involved in drawing a conclusion or making a logical judgment on the basis of circumstantial evidence and prior conclusions rather than on the basis of direct observation
example: Almost everything is inference and judgment, and very little is anything that you want to call proof.
exampleZh: 这段时期几乎所有的历史都是推断和猜想,只有很少资料是你们想找的那种证据

meaning: adj. 次的，较差的；低等的，下级的；自卑的；（法庭，特别法庭）下级的；（商品，服务）需求量在衰退期中较之繁荣期更大的，低档的；（位置）下方的，下位的，靠下的；（字母，数字，符号）下标的；低等的；n. 下级，（地位或成就）低于他人者；下标字母，下标数字，下标符号
definition: 1. n. one of lesser rank or station or quality；2. adj. of or characteristic of low rank or importance
example: Our system, therefore, so far as regards this inferior race, rests upon this great immutable law of nature."
exampleZh: 因此,我们政府在对待这一劣等种族时,必须以这一永恒的自然规律为基础"

meaning: n. 低等，劣等；自卑
definition: 1. n. the state of being inferior；2. n. an inferior quality
example: I found it difficult to shake off a sense of social inferiority.
exampleZh: 我发现很难摆脱社会地位低下的自卑感。

meaning: adj. 无限的，无穷尽的；（数量或程度上）极大的，无穷大的；非限定的；n. （空间或数量的）无穷大（the infinite）；上帝（the infinite）
definition: 1. n. the unlimited expanse in which everything is located；2. adj. having no limits or boundaries in time or space or extent or magnitude
example: We're gonna have a so called a loop, an infinite loop and you actually experience this in the real world.
exampleZh: 我们将会做一个循环，一个无限循环，你会在这个,真实世界里体验它。

meaning: n. （时、空、距离）无限，无穷；大量，大宗
definition: 1. n. time without end
example: And, we're going to look at what happens as the chloride ion moves from infinity in towards the positive ion.
exampleZh: 然后我们要看一下,当氯离子从无限远处逐渐靠近,这个正离子会发生什么。

meaning: n. （动词的）不定式；adj. 不定式的
definition: 1. n. the uninflected form of the verb
example: I mean, they have no idea how hard we work, and look at this gigantic split infinitive, to dramatically help.
exampleZh: 他们不知道我们有多么努力地工作，注意到这之间的巨大鸿沟，会有很大的帮助。

meaning: v. （使）充气，（使）膨胀；使（价格、成本等）上涨；夸大，吹嘘
definition: 1. v. fill with gas or air；2. v. exaggerate or make bigger
example: It can inflate itself with water and air to turn into a ball several times its real size.
exampleZh: 它可以用水和空气让自己膨胀，变成体积是自身实际大小数倍的球。

meaning: n. 通货膨胀，通胀率；充气，膨胀，增大；（宇宙论某些理论）暴涨；夸张，自命不凡
definition: 1. n. a general and progressive increase in prices；2. n. (cosmology) a brief exponential expansion of the universe (faster than the speed of light) postulated to have occurred shortly after the big bang
example: Nationally, home prices in the United States rose 85% between 1997 and 2006 in real terms-- in inflation-corrected terms.
exampleZh: 在通货膨胀已校正的条件下,美国房价,在1997 年到2006年之间,实质上上涨了85%

meaning: v. 使遭受，使承受
definition: 1. to cause harm or damage to someone or something; to force someone to experience something unpleasant；2. to force someone or something to experience something unpleasant
example: In their minds, it's a problem that people inflict upon themselves that could be solved if patients were motivated enough.
exampleZh: 在他们看来，这是人们自己强加给自己的问题，只要病人有足够的积极性，这个问题就可以得到解决。

meaning: n. 强加，施加；讨厌的人（或东西）；施加的事物
definition: 1. the action of forcing someone to experience something very unpleasant
example: The ethical issue is about the unnecessary pain/suffering infliction and the intention.
exampleZh: 这里的道德问题是指造成不必要的痛苦或施加折磨以及施虐的意图。

meaning: n. 影响，作用；势力，影响力；有影响的人（或事物）；v. 影响，对……起作用
definition: 1. n. a power to affect persons or events especially power based on prestige etc；2. v. have and exert influence or effect
example: How do you influence the way people connect the way they think about something and the way they act about something.
exampleZh: 您是怎样影响人们,让人们将其所想与,所为联系起来的呢？

meaning: adj. 有影响力的，有势力的；n. 有影响力的人
definition: 1. adj. having or exercising influence or power
example: The West has gradually relaxed its hostile attitude to this influential state.
exampleZh: 西方对这个有影响力的国家的敌对态度已趋缓和。

meaning: n. 流行性感冒
definition: 1. n. an acute febrile highly contagious viral disease
example: You've got the flu, you've got influenza in your upper respiratory tract, your cells are making more influenza.
exampleZh: 你就此得了流感,你得了上呼吸道流感,你的细胞正在制造更多流感病毒

meaning: v. 通知，告知；告发，检举（inform on）；赋特征于，渗透；了解，熟悉；影响
definition: 1. v. impart knowledge of some fact, state or affairs, or event to；2. v. give character or essence to
example: It was remiss of them not to inform us of these changes sooner.
exampleZh: 他们粗心大意，没有早一些通知我们这些变化。

meaning: n. 消息，资料，情报；（计算机程序储存和使用的）数据，信息；问讯处，信息台；（向治安法院提起的）控告，起诉；知识
definition: 1. n. a message received and understood；2. n. a collection of facts from which conclusions may be drawn
example: They submit their data about their people, their users to us, so Baidu users can easily find information related to that.
exampleZh: 校内网将用户数据提交给我们，这样，百度的用户就能够轻松,搜索到相关信息。

meaning: adj. 提供有用信息的，增长见闻的
definition: 1. adj. tending to increase knowledge or dissipate ignorance；2. adj. serving to instruct of enlighten or inform
example: The text was informative and well written.
exampleZh: 正文信息量大，写得很好。

meaning: n. 信息提供者，告密者；资料提供人，合作者
definition: 1. n. a person who supplies information；2. n. someone who sees an event and reports what happened
example: The police made an early breakthrough, with an informant naming Smalls as the leader of the gang.
exampleZh: 当一名线人指证斯莫就是帮派头目时，警方的调查有了突破。

meaning: n. 下面结构；永久性军事设施；基础设施，基础建设
definition: 1. n. the basic structure or features of a system or organization；2. n. the stock of basic facilities and capital equipment needed for the functioning of a country or area
example: Although South Africa has many of the attributes of the First World – some good infrastructure, millions of rich people – it is still not part of that world.
exampleZh: 尽管南非具有第一世界的很多特征-良好的基础设施，成千上万的富翁-但它还并不属于那个世界。

meaning: v. 违反，违背（法律、规则等）；侵犯，侵害（权益）
definition: 1. to break a rule, law, etc.；2. to act in a way that is against a law or that limits someone’s rights or freedom
example: People fear that security cameras could infringe personal liberties.
exampleZh: 人们担心保安摄像机会侵犯人身自由。

meaning: n. （对他人权益的）侵犯，侵害；（对法律、规则等的）违反，违背
definition: 1. an action that breaks a rule, law, etc.；2. an action that is against a law, an agreement, etc.
example: There're other women in the same religious community who'll say, "this is no human rights infringement at all.
exampleZh: 也有同一个宗教团体中的其他女性,会说“这根本不是侵犯人权。

meaning: adj. 灵巧的，有独创性的；精巧的，巧妙的
definition: 1. (of a person) very intelligent and skilful, or (of a thing) skilfully made or planned and involving new ideas and methods；2. (of a person) skilled at inventing new ways to do something, esp. to solve problems, or (of ideas or things) original, and showing esp. the ability to solve problems
example: His smartness of the morning had seemed to Tom a good joke before, and very ingenious.
exampleZh: 汤姆之前觉得他早上耍的小聪明是个很好的笑话，而且很有独创性。

meaning: n. 心灵手巧，聪明才智，独创力；精巧的装置；灵活的方法
definition: 1. someone's ability to think of clever new ways of doing something；2. the skill of thinking, performing, or using things in new ways, esp. to solve problems
example: Where is the ingenuity there and how can we leverage that in our own problem solving?
exampleZh: 那么其独创性在哪里？,我们在解决实际问题时该怎么去利用它？

meaning: n. （食品的）成分，原料；要素，因素；adj. 构成组成部分的
definition: 1. n. a component of a mixture or compound；2. n. an abstract part of something
example: Again, when you see that partially hydrogenated oils on an ingredient list, that means there's Trans fat.
exampleZh: 当成分表出现"部分氢化油"时,就意味着含有反式脂肪

meaning: v. 居住于，栖居在；存在于，占据
definition: 1. v. inhabit or live in；2. v. be present in; be inside of
example: Maasai goddess Enkai, who signals her wrath with eruptions and drought, is said to inhabit the summit.
exampleZh: 据说传说中的马赛女神 Enkai 栖息在火山的最高峰，她会用火山爆发和旱灾来发泄她的愤怒。

meaning: n. （某地的）居民，栖息动物
definition: 1. n. a person who inhabits a particular place
example: As an inhabitant of the 21st century, I try to live a "green" life.
exampleZh: 作为21世纪的居民，我尝试过一种“绿色”的生活；

meaning: adj. 内在的，固有的；（权利，特权）固定属于（某人）的；（形容词）作定语和表语时意义相同的
definition: 1. existing as a natural or basic part of something；2. existing as a natural and permanent quality of something or someone
example: Individuality is a valued and inherent part of the British character.
exampleZh: 个性是英国人重视并固有的特征。

meaning: v. 继承（遗产）；经遗传获得（品质、身体特征等）；接手，承担；接收（前所有者的事物）；（尤作圣经翻译和典故用语）得到
definition: 1. v. obtain from someone after their death；2. v. receive from a predecessor
example: I know also, given your life story, opportunities that you were not obvious to inherit. -Yes.
exampleZh: 纵观您的一生，我知道,您并非刻意追求这些成就，-是的。

meaning: n. 继承物，遗产；遗传特征
definition: 1. n. hereditary succession to a title or an office or property；2. n. that which is inherited; a title or property or estate that passes by law to the heir on the death of the owner
example: Why does he go against the traditional Ancient Near Eastern practice of primogeniture, inheritance by the first born?
exampleZh: 为什么他要违背传统古代近东的惯例,也就是长子继承制，由第一个儿子继承？

meaning: v. 抑制，约束；使拘束，使尴尬；降低（酶等）的活性；禁止（神职人员）司神职
definition: 1. to prevent someone from doing something by making them feel nervous or embarrassed；2. to slow down a process or the growth of something
example: These--Again, the chemicals could excite the other neuron bring up the chances it will fire, or inhibit the other neuron .
exampleZh: 再强调一遍,这些化学物质可使另一个神经元变得兴奋,提高该神经元产生神经冲动的可能性,也可抑制另一个神经的兴奋性

meaning: n. 拘谨，拘束感；阻止，抑制；（尤指对处理指明土地或财产的）禁令
definition: 1. a feeling of embarrassment or worry that prevents you from saying or doing what you want；2. the act of stopping or slowing down a process, or the fact of this happening
example: This is one respectable theory, but the alternative is they have the right knowledge, but they suffer from problems with inhibition.
exampleZh: 这是一个被广泛接受的理论,但另一种观点则认为,婴儿拥有恰当的知识,只不过是他们无法解决抑制的问题

meaning: adj. 开始的，最初的；（字母）位于词首的；n. （姓名的）首字母；v. 用姓名的首字母作标记（或签名）于
definition: 1. n. the first letter of a word (especially a person's name)；2. v. mark with one's initials
example: They learned a lot from the initial market testing exercise.
exampleZh: 他们从最初的市场测试活动中学到了许多。

meaning: adv. 开始，最初
definition: 1. adv. at the beginning
example: Initially the system was offline for a number of days.
exampleZh: 最初系统有几天没有联网。

meaning: v. 开始实施，发起；使了解，传授；（尤指在秘密仪式上）使加入，接纳；n. 新加入某组织的人，新入会的人
definition: 1. n. someone new to a field or activity；2. v. bring into being
example: Hammerhead can initiate multiple connections from IP aliases and simulate numerous (256 +) users at any given time.
exampleZh: Hammerhead 可以在任意给定的时间初始化多个来自 IP 别名的连接并模拟多个（256个以上）用户。

meaning: n. 入会，入会仪式；开始，创始；（某项活动或技能的）入门，初学
definition: 1. n. a formal entry into an organization or position or office；2. n. the act of starting something for the first time; introducing something new
example: If somebody goes through a terrible initiation to get into a club, they'll like the club more.
exampleZh: 如果人们需要经历一些低劣的入会仪式,才能够进入某个社团的话，那他们会更喜欢这个社团。

meaning: n. 措施，倡议；主动性，积极性；主动权；（美国某些州的）公民立法提案程序
definition: 1. n. readiness to embark on bold new ventures；2. adj. serving to set in motion
example: But they don't I don't know, it's just -there isn't enough initiative in the world, not many people do it.
exampleZh: 但是他们没有这样做,我不知道,也许只是,主动性不够,没什么人这样做

meaning: v. 注射；（给……）添加，增加（某品质）；投入（金钱或资源）；（往物质、装置中）注入或射入（电流、粒子束等）；将（宇宙飞船等）射入轨道（或弹道）
definition: 1. to use a needle and syringe (= small tube) to put a liquid such as a drug into a person's body；2. to introduce something new that is necessary or helpful to a situation or process
example: They switched at once from scalpel to syringe and started to inject money into the economy through "quantitative easing"—buying assets with freshly created central-bank money.
exampleZh: 他们立即从手术刀换到注射器，并开始通过“量化宽松”向经济注入资金——用新创建的中央银行货币购买资产。

meaning: n. 注射；大量资金的投入；（液体）注入，喷入；（宇宙飞船等的）射入轨道，入轨；内射，单射
definition: 1. the act of putting a liquid, especially a drug, into a person's body using a needle and a syringe (= small tube)；2. the introduction of something new that is necessary or helpful to a situation or process
example: An injection of local anaesthetic is usually given first to numb the area.
exampleZh: 通常先局部麻药注射使这一部位失去知觉。

meaning: v. 使受伤，弄伤；损害，伤害（名誉、自尊等）；冤枉（某人）
definition: 1. v. cause injuries or bodily harm to；2. v. hurt the feelings of
example: If you try to make any moves, you will injure yourself and the airplane.
exampleZh: 如果你试图轻举妄动，就会伤到自己还会损坏飞机。

meaning: n. （身体上的）伤，损害；（对感情的）伤害，挫伤
definition: 1. n. any physical damage to the body caused by violence or accident or fracture etc.；2. n. an accident that results in physical damage or hurt
example: We take... Let me think, Tort Law, which is sort of personal injury type law.
exampleZh: 还有……侵权法，这是一种针对人身伤害的法律。

meaning: adj. 有害的，致伤的；中伤的，诽谤的
definition: 1. adj. harmful to living things；2. adj. tending to cause great harm
example: The small brown rice planthopper is an injurious insect on the food crop of Ningxia.
exampleZh: 小褐稻飞虱是宁夏粮食作物上的一大害虫。

meaning: n. 墨水，油墨；文字宣传，纸媒宣传；（章鱼、乌贼等海洋生物分泌出的）墨汁；v. 签订，签署（合同等）；涂墨水于（某物）；【名】 （Ink）（美、俄、拉脱维亚）英克（人名）
definition: 1. n. a liquid used for printing or writing or drawing；2. v. append one's signature to
example: but I mark the whole paper up with a lot of red ink if there are mistakes,
exampleZh: 但我在批论文的时候，也会把语法错误的地方用红笔标出来，

meaning: adv. 在内地，向内陆；adj. 内陆的，内地的；国内的；n. 内陆，内地
definition: 1. adj. situated away from an area's coast or border；2. adv. towards or into the interior of a region
example: So, even 15 minutes into the city, inland, it's about five to ten degrees warmer, so.
exampleZh: 再往城里走15分钟，到了内陆地区，气温会升高大约5到10度。

meaning: n. （监狱或精神病院里的）居住者；（房屋的）同住者
definition: 1. a person who is kept in a prison or a hospital for people who are mentally ill；2. a person who is forced by law to stay in a prison or hospital
example: He learned this song as an inmate at a Texas prison.
exampleZh: 他在德克萨斯监狱服刑时学会了这首歌。

meaning: n. （尤指乡村的）小旅馆，小酒馆；（用于旅馆的名字中）酒店，饭店；【名】 （Inn）（柬）因（人名）
definition: 1. n. a hotel providing overnight lodging for travelers
example: She washed her face at the pump in front of the inn.
exampleZh: 她在客栈前的水泵旁洗了洗脸。

meaning: adj. 内部的，靠近中心的；内心的，未表达出来的；存在于性格中的，骨子里的；隐蔽的，内在的；n. 内部，内里；靶子内圈；命中靶子内圈的一发
definition: 1. adj. located inward；2. adj. located or occurring within or closer to a center
example: Everyone, according to the logic ofAreopagitica everyone has the potential to assume the inner authority of conscience and self-discipline.
exampleZh: 按照《论出版自由》的逻辑，每个人都有,用内在良心的统治和自律的潜力。

meaning: adj. 天真的，幼稚的；清白的，无罪的；无辜受害的；没有恶意的，无冒犯之意的；n. 天真无邪的人，幼稚的人；无辜的受害者（尤指犯罪或战争的受害者）；【名】 （Innocent）（英、西）因诺森特，（法）伊诺桑（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person who lacks knowledge of evil；2. adj. free from evil or guilt
example: Innocent was the same as ignorant because knowledge gets in the way of their innocence and they have solitude,living in paradise.
exampleZh: 或说愚昧无知,因为知识使人不再清白,他们在天堂里感到了孤独

meaning: n. 天真，单纯；清白，无罪
definition: 1. n. the quality of innocent naivete；2. n. the state of being unsullied by sin or moral wrong; lacking a knowledge of evil
example: Self knowledge is like lost innocence, however unsettling you find it; it can never be un-thought or un-known.
exampleZh: 自我认知就像逝去的童真，不管你有多不安;,你已经无法不去想或是充耳不闻了。

meaning: v. 革新，创新
definition: 1. v. bring something new to an environment
example: What sets Rice apart from most engineers is his constant desire to innovate and experiment.
exampleZh: 赖斯与大多数工程师不同之处在于他不断地渴望创新和实验。

meaning: n. 新事物，新方法；革新，创新
definition: 1. n. a creation (a new device or process) resulting from study and experimentation；2. n. the creation of something in the mind
example: That's why many of them are thinking really very hard of how to foster entrepreneurship, how to encourage innovation.
exampleZh: 这就是为什么大家都在思索,如何才能培养企业家精神，如何鼓励创新。

meaning: adj. 革新的，新颖的；富有革新精神的
definition: 1. adj. ahead of the times；2. adj. being or producing something like nothing done or experienced or created before
example: He was one of the most creative and innovative engineers of his generation.
exampleZh: 他是同代人中最富有创造力和革新精神的工程师之一。

meaning: adj. 无数的，数不清的
definition: 1. too many to be counted；2. too many to be counted, or very many
example: It's practically impossible to begin a reading of Milton without the burden of innumerable prejudices and preconceptions.
exampleZh: 想要不带大量的偏见或成见的解读米尔顿,几乎是不可能的。

meaning: n. 投入，输进；输入的信息；（为帮助某人做出决定而提供的）建议，意见；讯息输入端；（输入机器供其使用的）电力；输入框；v. 输入（信息）
definition: 1. n. signal going into an electronic system；2. v. enter (data or a program) into a computer
example: There has been a big input of resources into the project from industry.
exampleZh: 工业界对这个项目投入了大量资源。

meaning: v. 调查，查究；询问，打听
definition: 1. v. inquire about；2. v. have a wish or desire to know something
example: He went to the desk to inquire and make a reservation.
exampleZh: 他到前台去咨询并做了预订。

meaning: n. 询问，疑问；调查，审查； 探查，探询
definition: 1. n. a search for knowledge；2. n. an instance of questioning
example: It exists alongside of other areas of political inquiry like American government comparative politics and international relations.
exampleZh: 它和其它政治探询课题并存,例如：美国政府,比较政治和国际关系。

meaning: adj. 过分好奇的，爱打听的；好学的，兴趣广泛的
definition: 1. adj. showing curiosity；2. adj. inquiring or appearing to inquire
example: The inquisitive were shooed away by five young guards who lolled in the shade of a litchi tree.
exampleZh: 五个年轻的保安懒洋洋地躺在荔枝树的树荫下，把好奇的人们都轰走了。

meaning: adj. 疯癫的，精神失常的；蠢极的，荒唐的
definition: 1. adj. afflicted with or characteristic of mental derangement；2. adj. very foolish
example: So imagine that there's right now somebody in an insane asylum in Michigan who's got the thought,I am Napoleon.
exampleZh: 因此想像一下，现在有个家伙,在密西根一家精神病院，认为自己就是拿破仑。

meaning: n. 精神错乱，精神失常；愚蠢（或不理智）的事
definition: 1. n. relatively permanent disorder of the mind
example: He was charged with murder, but got off on a plea of insanity.
exampleZh: 他被指控犯了谋杀罪，但以精神错乱为由逃过惩罚。

meaning: n. 昆虫；类似昆虫的小动物（如蜘蛛）；卑鄙的人
definition: 1. n. small air-breathing arthropod；2. n. a person who has a nasty or unethical character undeserving of respect
example: The roof timbers were affected by rot and insect attack.
exampleZh: 屋顶的木料已经腐朽并遭虫害。

meaning: v. 插入，嵌入；（在文章中）添加，加插；使参与（活动）；（肌肉或其他器官）附着于（尤指移动部分）；n. 插入物；（尤指）插页，附加页；（电影等的）插入镜头
definition: 1. n. a folded section placed between the leaves of another publication；2. v. put or introduce into something
example: Open any of the layout templates, insert your text, make any other changes, and print.
exampleZh: 打开任何一个设计模板，插入你的文本，做任何其他改动，然后打印。

meaning: n. 插入，嵌入；（书、文章等中）添加的东西；（服装面料的）布饰，绣饰；（报刊的）插登广告；（器官的）附着
definition: 1. n. a message (spoken or written) that is introduced or inserted；2. n. the act of putting one thing into another
example: This reduction in the number of degrees of the pick cycle available for weft insertion is acceptable.
exampleZh: 这种对可用于引纬的选纬周期分度数量的缩减是可接受的。

meaning: n. 内部，内侧；内脏，（尤指）胃；里道，内圈；（靠近路边的）慢车道；adv. 在（或向）里面；在监牢里；prep. 在（或向）……内，在（或向）……里；在……时间之内；（足球、英式橄榄球等体育运动）（比另一队员）更靠近球场中心；adj. 里面的；从内部了解到的，内线干的；（马路车道）靠近路边的，慢（道）的；（曲棍球、足球等体育运动）场地中心附近的
definition: 1. n. the region that is inside of something；2. adj. relating to or being on the side closer to the center or within a defined space
example: the total amount of the work that we can get out is just given by the area inside this curve.
exampleZh: 能够输出的功就是,我们可以得出来,曲线所包围的面积。

meaning: n. 内部的人，知情人
definition: 1. n. an officer of a corporation or others who have access to private information about the corporation's operations
example: An insider said, "Katharine has told friends it is time to end her career."
exampleZh: 一名知情者说，“凯瑟琳告诉朋友们她该结束自己的职业生涯了。”

meaning: n. 洞悉，了解；洞察力；【名】 （Insight）（英）因赛特（人名）
definition: 1. n. clear or deep perception of a situation；2. n. a feeling of understanding
example: He was a man of forceful character, with considerable insight and diplomatic skills.
exampleZh: 他是个性格坚强的人，有着非凡的洞察力和交际手腕。

meaning: adj. 富有洞察力的，有深刻见解的
definition: 1. adj. exhibiting insight or clear and deep perception
example: Smartphones reduce the possibility for new and insightful minds, and steal away our dead time.
exampleZh: 智能手机降低了产生新颖独到见解的可能性，还偷走了我们的空闲时间。

meaning: v. 坚决要求，执意坚持；坚称
definition: 1. v. be emphatic or resolute and refuse to budge；2. v. beg persistently and urgently
example: They will be finding different ways to insist on their inclusion and the results will be different in every state.
exampleZh: 他们通过不同的方式使自己参与其中,结果视情况而有所不同

meaning: n. 坚决要求，坚持主张
definition: 1. n. continual and persistent demands；2. n. the state of demanding notice or attention
example: Add to the above Hobbes' repeated insistence that law serve as an instrument for achieving social equality.
exampleZh: 除此之外,霍布斯坚决主张,法律应当是维护社会公平和平等的工具。

meaning: adj. 坚持的，坚决要求的；再三的，反复的
definition: 1. adj. persistently continual；2. adj. demanding attention
example: They were insistent on having a contract for the work.
exampleZh: 他们坚持要就这项工作立一份合同。

meaning: v. 检查，审视；检阅，视察；进行检查，进行视察
definition: 1. v. look over carefully；2. v. come to see in an official or professional capacity
example: Make sure you inspect the goods before signing for them.
exampleZh: 要确保在签收货物之前进行检验。

meaning: n. 视察；检查，审视
definition: 1. n. a formal or official examination
example: An inspection of his rig showed that three of the brakes were faulty.
exampleZh: 对他的重型卡车的检查显示有3处刹车存在问题。

meaning: n. 检查员，督察员；（警察）巡官；（英国公共汽车或火车上的）查票员
definition: 1. n. a high ranking police officer；2. n. an investigator who observes carefully
example: The inspector dutifully recorded the date in a large red book.
exampleZh: 巡视员尽职地在一本红色的大工作簿上记录下了日期。

meaning: v. 激励，鼓舞；赋予灵感，激发（想法）；使产生（感觉或情感）；引起，导致；吸气，吸入
definition: 1. v. heighten or intensify；2. v. supply the inspiration for
example: He has neither the policies nor the personal charisma to inspire people.
exampleZh: 他既没有谋略也没有个人魅力去鼓舞人。

meaning: n. 灵感；启发灵感的人（或事物）；鼓舞人心的人（或事物）；（突然想到的）好主意，妙计；吸气，吸入
definition: 1. n. arousal of the mind to special unusual activity or creativity；2. n. a product of your creative thinking and work
example: Frost is writing against the Romantic idea that poetry is written in repose, received passively as inspiration.
exampleZh: 弗罗斯特不是浪漫主义这一派,浪漫主义是休闲时写的诗歌，被动地作为灵感接受。

meaning: adj. 启发灵感的，鼓舞人心的；绝妙的
definition: 1. adj. imparting a divine influence on the mind and soul
example: She can speak with an eloquence that is almost inspirational.
exampleZh: 她能用一种近乎激发灵感的口才发言。

meaning: vt. 安装，设置；使就任，正式任命
definition: 1. v. set up for use；2. v. place
example: The new head of the university will be instal led today.
exampleZh: 这所大学的新校长将于今天就职。

meaning: n. 安装；装置；安装的设备；（软件）安装
definition: 1. the act of putting equipment or a system in place so that it can be used
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: The installation of solar panels reduced the building's annual energy costs by nearly thirty percent.
exampleZh: 安装太阳能电池板使这栋建筑的年度能源成本降低了近三成。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. （分期付款的）一期付款；（连载故事的）一节，（电视连续剧的）一集；安装，安置；就任，就职
definition: 1. n. a part of a broadcast serial；2. n. a part of a published serial
example: The final instalment on the loan is due next week.
exampleZh: 贷款的最后一期付款下个星期到期。

meaning: n. 例子，实例；v. 举……为例
definition: 1. n. an occurrence of something；2. v. clarify by giving an example of
example: What would you do, for instance, if you found a member of staff stealing?
exampleZh: 比如说，如果你发现有职员偷东西，你会怎么办？

meaning: adj. 立刻的，马上的；速食的，即食的；紧急的，紧迫的；（商业信函用语）本月的；此刻的，现时的；n. 瞬间，片刻；当时，那一刻；速溶咖啡
definition: 1. n. a very short time (as the time it takes the eye blink or the heart to beat)；2. adj. occurring with no delay
example: But de Broglie has told us that the wavelength is related to the instant velocity through this formula.
exampleZh: 但德布罗意曾说过,波长是和瞬时速度相联系的,通过这个公式。

meaning: adj. 瞬间发生的，瞬间完成的
definition: 1. adj. occurring with no delay
example: Used in this way, intuition is an almost instantaneous cognitive process in which a manager recognizes familiar patterns.
exampleZh: 在这种情况下，直觉是管理者识别熟悉模式的瞬间认知过程。

meaning: adv. 代替，顶替，反而
definition: 1. adv. in place of, or as an alternative to；2. adv. on the contrary
example: Let's imagine maybe instead we just immediately dropped the pressure let the system expand against the lower pressure.
exampleZh: 现在假设,我们很快地降低压力,让系统在低的外压力下膨胀。

meaning: n. 本能，天性；直觉；天分，天赋；adj. 充满（某种品质，尤指好品质）的
definition: 1. n. inborn pattern of behavior often responsive to specific stimuli；2. adj. (followed by `with')deeply filled or permeated
example: And that's the kind of instinct I'd like you to get into thinking about. So the answer here is no.
exampleZh: 所以答案是否定的,好的，那我们能在线性时间内排序么？

meaning: adj. 本能的，直觉的；天生的
definition: 1. adj. unthinking; prompted by (or as if by) instinct
example: It's an instinctive reaction – if a child falls you pick it up.
exampleZh: 这是一种本能的反应–如果小孩摔倒了你会扶他起来。

meaning: n. 研究所，学院，协会；（尤指与法律相关的）注释，论述；v. 制定（制度、规则等）；提出（诉讼）；任命，授予……职位（尤指圣职）
definition: 1. n. an association organized to promote art or science or education；2. v. set up or lay the groundwork for
example: He visited the Institute of Neurology in Havana where they both worked.
exampleZh: 他在哈瓦那参观了他们俩都曾工作过的神经病学研究所。

meaning: n. 机构，团体；社会收容机构；制度，习俗；建立，制定；知名的人（或事物）
definition: 1. n. an organization founded and united for a specific purpose；2. n. an establishment consisting of a building or complex of buildings where an organization for the promotion of some cause is situated
example: and went down to California to go to my undergraduate institution, which was Cal Poly, San Luis Obispo.
exampleZh: 之后我去了加利福尼亚州，在位于圣路易斯-奥比斯波县的加州理工大学读本科。

meaning: adj. 机构的，慈善机构的；制度的，惯例的；根深蒂固的；（广告）营造声誉而非为销售额的
definition: 1. adj. relating to or constituting or involving an institution；2. adj. organized as or forming an institution
example: Outside the protected environment of institutional care he could not survive.
exampleZh: 离开福利机构照顾下的这个受保护的环境，他无法生存。

meaning: v. 指示，吩咐；教授，指导；聘请（律师），托办；通知；（法官向陪审团）建议，作说明
definition: 1. v. impart skills or knowledge to；2. v. give instructions or directions for some task
example: You can instruct your bank to allow a third party to remove money from your account.
exampleZh: 你可以通知银行，允许第三方从你的账户取款。

meaning: n. 用法说明；指示，吩咐；教授，指导；（计算机的）指令，命令；给初级律师（或辩护律师、陪审团）的指示；adj. 说明用法的
definition: 1. n. a message describing how something is to be done；2. n. the activities of educating or instructing; activities that impart knowledge or skill
example: Two lawyers were told not to leave the building but no reason for this instruction was given.
exampleZh: 两位律师被告知不要离开这座建筑，但没被告知这一指示的原因。

meaning: n. 教练，导师；大学讲师
definition: 1. n. a person whose occupation is teaching
example: He worked as a dance instructor in London before setting himself up in Bucharest.
exampleZh: 在布加勒斯特开创事业之前，他在伦敦当过舞蹈教练。

meaning: adj. 有教益的，有启发性的
definition: 1. adj. serving to instruct of enlighten or inform
example: It is instructive to see how other countries are tackling the problem.
exampleZh: 了解别的国家如何处理这个问题是具有启发性的。

meaning: n. 器械；乐器；仪器；促成某事的人（或事物），手段；受利用（或控制）的人，工具；文据，正式法律文件；v. 给……装备测量仪器
definition: 1. n. a device that requires skill for proper use；2. v. equip with instruments for measuring, recording, or controlling
example: Yes,it was a clarinet up there,nice and high, and then another instrument came in with What instrument was that?
exampleZh: 对，嘹亮的高音确实来自单簧管，紧接着另一个乐器加入了演奏,这是什么乐器？

meaning: adj. 有帮助的，起作用的；用乐器演奏的；与乐器有关的；与（事物）的工具效用有关的；与仪器或测量器具有关的；（语法）工具格的；n. 器乐曲（通常指非古典音乐）；工具格名词，工具格
definition: 1. adj. relating to or designed for or performed on musical instruments；2. adj. serving or acting as a means or aid
example: It works its magic, again, through purely instrumental means, so we can't really call those songs, and this puzzled me.
exampleZh: 纯器乐的演奏方式,容我重申,能产生神奇的效果,所以我们其实不能把器乐称为歌曲,这让我很困惑

meaning: v. 使隔热，使隔音，使绝缘；使隔离，使免受（不良影响等）；使（陆地）成岛屿
definition: 1. to cover and surround something with a material or substance in order to stop heat, sound, or electricity from escaping or entering；2. to protect someone or something from harmful experiences or influences
example: Is there any way we can insulate our home from the noise?
exampleZh: 有什么办法能使我们家隔音吗？

meaning: n. 隔热，绝缘，隔音；隔热（或绝缘、隔音）材料；隔绝状态
definition: 1. the act of covering something to stop heat, sound, or electricity from escaping or entering, or the fact that something is covered in this way；2. material that is used to stop heat, sound, or electricity from escaping or entering
example: The plastic resin is used in a wide range of products, including electrical wire insulation.
exampleZh: 塑料合成树脂被广泛应用到各种产品中，包括电线的绝缘层。

meaning: n. （物）绝缘体，不导电或不导热的物质；绝缘子（电气工程中支撑导线或带电部件并使其保持绝缘的器件）；从事绝缘工作的工人
definition: 1. a material or covering that electricity, heat, or sound cannot go through
example: It can change between a superconductor a material that conducts electricity, and an insulator a material that doesn't conduct electricity
exampleZh: 它可以在超导体（一种能导电的材料）和绝缘体（一种不导电的材料）之间转变。

meaning: v. 侮辱，冒犯；损害，危害；n. 侮辱，冒犯；（医）（对组织、器官的）损伤
definition: 1. n. a rude expression intended to offend or hurt；2. v. treat, mention, or speak to rudely
example: Their behaviour was an insult to the people they represent.
exampleZh: 他们的行为是对他们所代表的人们的一种侮辱。

meaning: v. 为……投保；为……提供保险；保证，确保；获得（赔偿数额的）支付
definition: 1. v. be careful or certain to do something; make certain of something；2. v. make certain of
example: That is, the insurance policy doesn't just insure you against death, it also builds value over the years.
exampleZh: 也就是说,保单不仅仅,补偿死亡带来的损失,它们还会逐年增值

meaning: n. 保险；保险费；保险业；保险赔偿金，保险金；保险单；预防措施，安全保障
definition: 1. n. promise of reimbursement in the case of loss; paid to people or companies so concerned about hazards that they have made prepayments to an insurance company；2. n. written contract or certificate of insurance
example: That naturally hits monoline insurance companies more than multiline insurance companies because they are more specialized and more vulnerable.
exampleZh: 它对单线保险公司的冲击,自然要大于多线保险公司,因为它们的业务更单一也更容易受到影响

meaning: adj. 完好无损的
definition: 1. adj. constituting the undiminished entirety; lacking nothing essential especially not damaged；2. adj. not impaired or diminished in any way
