exampleZh: 他们的眼睛并未受到损伤,相反,失认症的症状是,患者失去识别某些事物的能力

meaning: n. （食物、饮料、空气等的）摄取量，吸入量；摄入，吸入；（一定时期内）纳入的人数；入口，进口；（从荒野地或公共地开发出的）垦地
definition: 1. n. the process of taking food into the body through the mouth (as by eating)；2. n. an opening through which fluid is admitted to a tube or container
example: Nutritionists say only 33 percent of our calorie intake should be from fat.
exampleZh: 营养学家说我们所摄入的卡路里中只应有33%来自脂肪。

meaning: adj. 不可捉摸的，难以确定的；（资产，利益）无形的；n. 无形的东西
definition: 1. n. assets that are saleable though not material or physical；2. adj. (of especially business assets) not having physical substance or intrinsic productive value
example: You can use this to express possession or a lack of possession of anything. Tangible or intangible.
exampleZh: 你可以用它来表示你有或没有什么东西。有形与无形的事物都可以通用。

meaning: adj. 必需的，必要的，不可或缺的；作为组成部分的；完整的；整的，积分的；n. 积分；完整
definition: 1. necessary and important as a part of a whole；2. contained within something; not separate
example: Now, the concept of ritual impurity was a central and integral feature of most, if not all, ancient religions.
exampleZh: 现在，仪式上的不洁已经是大部分宗教,主要的，整体而言的特点。

meaning: v. （使）合并，成为一体；（使）加入，融入群体；（使）取消种族隔离；求……的积分；表示（面积、温度等）的总和，表示……的平均值；adj. 整合的
definition: 1. v. make into a whole or make part of a whole；2. v. open (a place) to members of all races and ethnic groups
example: They have not made any effort to integrate with the local community.
exampleZh: 他们完全没有尝试融入本地社区。

meaning: n. 结合，融合；取消种族隔离；（数）积分法，求积分；（心理分析）整合
definition: 1. n. the action of incorporating a racial or religious group into a community；2. n. the act of combining into an integral whole
example: I think that a lot of the countries in Europe want to have a closer political and economic integration.
exampleZh: 我认为，很多欧洲国家想相互之间有一个更紧密的政治、经济上的结合。

meaning: n. 正直，诚实；完整，完全；职业操守；（电子数据的）集成度
definition: 1. n. an undivided or unbroken completeness or totality with nothing wanting；2. n. moral soundness
example: Then, once you've done that, once you have secured the integrity and accuracy of the meaning, Hirsch says, "Okay, fine.
exampleZh: 在你完成那个之后，一旦你确定了意思的真实性和准确性，赫施说，好的，不错。

meaning: n. 智力，思维能力；才智出众者
definition: 1. the ability to understand and to think in an intelligent way；2. a very educated person whose interests are studying and other activities that involve careful thinking
example: Nothing better shows our heavenly origins, our divine seed, our human intellect, those holy traces of Promethean fire."
exampleZh: 没有什么能更好的讲述我们的起源，我们的子孙，我们人类的智力，生命之火神圣的踪迹“

meaning: adj. 智力的，理智的；才智超群的；需智力的；思想的，思维的；n. 知识分子
definition: 1. n. a person who uses the mind creatively；2. adj. of or relating to the intellect
example: And we never do anything intellectual like I did in college. I feel stupid.
exampleZh: 我没有机会像在大学那样做一些脑力活动了。我感觉我的脑子要锈掉了。

meaning: adj. 聪明的；有智力的；智能的
definition: 1. adj. having the capacity for thought and reason especially to a high degree；2. adj. possessing sound knowledge
example: And so suddenly, you are thrown into a pool of so many other incredibly intelligent, driven people, and
exampleZh: 所以，突然之间，你发现周围人都是绝顶聪明，都是劲头十足的人，

meaning: n. 智力，才智；智能；情报，谍报；情报机构
definition: 1. n. the ability to comprehend; to understand and profit from experience；2. n. a unit responsible for gathering and interpreting information about an enemy
example: So, we devoted a lecture early on--of a couple of weeks ago, to individual differences across people in intelligence and personality.
exampleZh: 几周之前我们用了一整节课，来讲人与人之间的智力与个性差异。

meaning: adj. 可理解的，明白易懂的；只能凭智力理解的
definition: 1. (of speech and writing) clear enough to be understood
example: At least the kickback system is intelligible. Ivan once started a venture in America which ran up against local sanitation rules.
exampleZh: 至少这套回扣制度是易懂的，伊万曾在美国创办一家企业，遭遇了当地卫生条例的限制。

meaning: v. 打算，想要；意指，意思是；准备，预留（作某种用途或给某人用）
definition: 1. v. have in mind as a purpose；2. v. design or destine
example: He writes home, "I do not intend to shirk now that there is really something to fight for; I mean freedom.
exampleZh: 他在家书中道,"我不打算逃避,我必须为之一战,为自由而战

meaning: n. 意图，目的，打算；愈合；意念
definition: 1. n. an anticipated outcome that is intended or that guides your planned actions；2. n. (usually plural) the goal with respect to a marriage proposal
example: If you can put it in other words, those other words take the form of an appeal to intention.
exampleZh: 若你能将它换个方式表达出来，那也需要借助于意图。

meaning: adj. 专注的，专心致志的；坚决的；急切的；n. 目的，意图；故意
definition: 1. n. an anticipated outcome that is intended or that guides your planned actions；2. adj. giving or marked by complete attention to
example: I was so intent on my work that I didn't notice the time.
exampleZh: 我专心工作，以致忘了时间。

meaning: adj. 故意的，蓄意的
definition: 1. adj. by conscious design or purpose；2. adj. done or made or performed with purpose and intent
example: Women who are the victims of intentional discrimination will be able to get compensation.
exampleZh: 遭受故意歧视的妇女们将能得到赔偿。

meaning: adj. 很大的，十分强烈的；严肃紧张的，激烈的；热情的，热切的；专注的，认真的
definition: 1. adj. in an extreme degree；2. adj. extremely sharp or intense
example: so I, you know, I enjoy that sort of intense effort, the sort of adrenaline that goes with the crunch
exampleZh: 我就喜欢那种高强度的努力，那种肾上腺素增长的感觉。

meaning: n. 强烈，剧烈；（光、声音等的）强度
definition: 1. n. the amount of energy transmitted (as by acoustic or electromagnetic radiation)；2. n. high level or degree; the property of being intense
example: The intensity of the work left little room for personal grief or anxiety.
exampleZh: 该工作的强度很少给个人留下悲伤或忧虑的机会。

meaning: v. 加剧，增强；增强（底片）的阻光度，增加（底片）的厚度
definition: 1. v. increase in extent or intensity；2. v. make more intense, stronger, or more marked
example: Failure can never defeat me but only intensify my desire to succeed.
exampleZh: 失败永远无法打败我，只会增强我对获得成功的渴望。

meaning: adj. 加强的，集中的，深入细致的；精耕细作的，集约的；加强词意的；以强度测量的；n. 加强语势的形容词（或副词、小品词）
definition: 1. n. a modifier that has little meaning except to intensify the meaning it modifies；2. adj. characterized by a high degree or intensity; often used as a combining form
example: You have extensive properties and intensive properties The extensive properties are the ones that scale with the size of the system.
exampleZh: 广延量,和强度量,广延量的值,随着系统的规模变化。

meaning: v. 相互交流，互动；相互作用，相互影响
definition: 1. v. act together or towards others or with others
example: And we will show you exactly how you can write programs that actually interact with the user in that way.
exampleZh: 我们将给大家示范如何,书写代码以及跟用户交互。

meaning: n. 互动，交流；相互影响，相互作用
definition: 1. n. a mutual or reciprocal action; interacting；2. n. (physics) the transfer of energy between elementary particles or between an elementary particle and a field or between fields; mediated by gauge bosons
example: it's happening. And I think it's happening, I think it's being sped up by humans, by our interaction.
exampleZh: 这是一个正在发生的事实，由于人类的活动，这个进程在加速。

meaning: adj. 交互式的，人机对话的；相互交流的，互动的
definition: 1. adj. used especially of drugs or muscles that work together so the total effect is greater than the sum of the two (or more)；2. adj. capable of acting on or influencing each other
example: There is little evidence that this encouraged flexible, interactive teaching in the classroom.
exampleZh: 几乎没有证据表明这促进灵活互动的课堂教学。

meaning: n. （人们之间的）交际，沟通；性交，交媾
definition: 1. the act of having sex；2. conversation and social activity between people
example: There was social intercourse between the old and the young.
exampleZh: 老年人和年轻人之间有社会交往。

meaning: n. 兴趣，关注；吸引力，趣味；爱好；利息；利益，好处；权益，股权；利害关系，重要影响；利益集团，利益相关者；v. 使感兴趣，引起……的关注；劝说（某人）做（或参与）
definition: 1. n. a sense of concern with and curiosity about someone or something；2. v. excite the curiosity of; engage the interest of
example: They are trained and have an interest in modern poetry, and this is a happy collaboration for me with them.
exampleZh: 他们非常有经验，并且对现代诗歌也有所涉猎，对我而言，能和他们一起工作是很令人开心的。

meaning: adj. 有趣的，有吸引力的；怪异的；v. 使感兴趣，引起……的关注；劝说（某人）做（或参与）（interest 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. arousing or holding the attention
example: F Then I'm going to print a capital F just % 1f C to be aesthetically interesting equals another %.1fc.
exampleZh: 然后我将打印大写字母,使其比较美观的，等于另一个。

meaning: adj. 感兴趣的，关心的；利益相关的，当事的；有私心的，有偏见的；v. 使感兴趣，引起……的关注；劝说（某人）做（或参与）（interest 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. having or showing interest; especially curiosity or fascination or concern；2. adj. involved in or affected by or having a claim to or share in
example: People, but I don't know, at the same time, I think people are really interested in what they're doing.
exampleZh: 那里的人......我不太清楚，不过同时，我觉得那里的人们都抱着浓厚的兴趣在做自己的事。

meaning: v. 干涉，干扰；阻碍，妨害；（未经允许）摆弄，（尤指）弄坏；（光或其他电磁波）相互作用，相互干扰；（指马）碰踝，绊脚
definition: 1. v. come between so as to be hindrance or obstacle；2. v. get involved, so as to alter or hinder an action, or through force or threat of force
example: We take the view that it would be wrong to interfere.
exampleZh: 我们所持的态度是：干涉是错误的。

meaning: n. 干涉，干预；（收音机或电视机受到的）干扰信号；犯规阻挡；抵触，冲突
definition: 1. n. a policy of intervening in the affairs of other countries；2. n. the act of hindering or obstructing or impeding
example: What may seem helpful behaviour to you can be construed as interference by others.
exampleZh: 在你看来似乎有助益的行为会被他人看作干涉。

meaning: adj. 暂时的，过渡期间的，间歇的；决算前的，中间时期的；n. 过渡期，中间期；中期利润，阶段性成果
definition: 1. temporary and intended to be used or accepted until something permanent exists；2. used to describe part of a company's business year, rather than the whole year
example: She was sworn in as head of an interim government in March.
exampleZh: 她3月份宣誓出任临时政府首脑。

meaning: adj. 内部的，里面的；国内的，内政的；内心的，本质的；内陆的，腹地的；n. 内部，里面；内陆，腹地；（本国的）内政，内务；（建筑物或房间内的）内景；内心，本质
definition: 1. n. the region that is inside of something；2. adj. situated within or suitable for inside a building
example: So, last date we were looking at some early taxonomy, and then on to a little bit more about the interior of the atom.
exampleZh: 因此，最近我们了解了一下早期的分类法，以便加深,对原子内部的理解。

meaning: adj. 居中的，中间的；中等程度的，中级的；n. 中级水平者，中级学生；中间事物；（化合物）中间体；v. 充当调解人，斡旋
definition: 1. n. a substance formed during a chemical process before the desired product is obtained；2. v. act between parties with a view to reconciling differences
example: They have to assess your level and steer you to the right class, beginner, intermediate.
exampleZh: 他们必须评估你的水平然后把你分到正确的班级，如初级班，中级班。

meaning: adj. 中间的，过渡的；n. 调解人，中间人；媒介
definition: 1. n. a negotiator who acts as a link between parties
example: An intermediary is a bank, so when they pull out of banks they were disintermediating and going from banks into REITs.
exampleZh: 这里的中介就是指银行,所以人们将资金从银行转向REITs,就是去中介化

meaning: adj. 间歇的，断断续续的
definition: 1. not happening regularly or continuously; stopping and starting repeatedly or with periods in between
example: When the driver accelerated, the vacuum was insufficient to run the intermittent mode and the wipers would default to high speed.
exampleZh: 当司机加速时，真空不足以运行间歇模式，雨刷将默认为高速。

meaning: adj. 内部的，体内的；内政的，国内的；本身的，本质的；内心的；（大学生）本校生的；n. 内部部件，内部特征；内脏
definition: 1. adj. happening or arising or located within some limits or especially surface；2. adj. occurring within an institution or community
example: And do you find that you have internal questions that come up or is there pretty much inter fight approach?
exampleZh: 你有没有发现自己内心里存有疑问,或者是否有很多内部斗争的方法？

meaning: adj. 国际的，国际上的；n. 国际比赛；国际比赛选手；外国人；共产国际（International）；国际组织，跨国公司
definition: 1. n. any of several international socialist organizations；2. adj. concerning or belonging to all or at least two or more nations
example: I've always been the kind of person who cared deeply about what happened at the national and international level.
exampleZh: 我一直十分关心,国内国际发生的时事。

meaning: n. 因特网，互联网
definition: 1. n. a computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the TCP/IP network protocols to facilitate data transmission and exchange
example: but they can set up Internet. It gives them access to the information that is on the World Wide Web, so...
exampleZh: 他们可以架起网络，这样就可以让这些国家的人利用互联网的资源。所以……

meaning: v. 解释，说明；口译；把……理解为；演绎
definition: 1. v. make sense of; assign a meaning to；2. v. give an interpretation or explanation to
example: She couldn't speak much English so her children had to interpret for her.

meaning: n. 解释，理解；表演，演奏，艺术处理；口译
definition: 1. n. a mental representation of the meaning or significance of something；2. n. the act of interpreting something as expressed in an artistic performance
example: That's all legitimate eidence. That is what one uses to build up the structure of the interpretation of the poem.
exampleZh: 这些都是合乎逻辑的证据，都是人们用来,建构解读诗歌框架的工具。

meaning: n. 口译者，译员；演奏者，表演者；解释程序
definition: 1. n. someone who mediates between speakers of different languages；2. n. someone who uses art to represent something
example: Speaking through an interpreter, Aristide said that Haitians had hoped coups were behind them.
exampleZh: 通过口译员，亚里斯蒂德说海地人希望政变再也不发生了。

meaning: v. 审问，讯问，质问；（在计算机或其他机器上）查询
definition: 1. to ask someone a lot of questions for a long time in order to get information, sometimes using threats or violence；2. to get information from a computer
example: The only caveat here is the need to interrogate the returned data to switch on the different data and tracer types.
exampleZh: 这里唯一需要注意的是，要检查返回的数据，以启用不同的数据和跟踪程序类型。

meaning: n. 审问，盘问；查询；疑问句
definition: 1. a process of asking someone a lot of questions for a long time in order to get information, sometimes using threats or violence；2. the process of getting information from a computer or electronic device
example: It was a classic of interrogation: first the bully, then the kind one who offers sympathy.
exampleZh: 这是审问的一种典范：开始是欺负人的人，然后那个和善的人再施予同情。

meaning: v. 打断，打扰；使暂停，使中断；阻断，遮挡
definition: 1. n. a signal that temporarily stops the execution of a program so that another procedure can be carried out；2. v. make a break in
example: OK, so now, Romeo: "shall I hear more, or shall I speak at this?" Fellows, a bit of advice, don't interrupt.
exampleZh: 现在，罗密欧，我是继续听下去呢,还是现在就对她说话，同学们，有点建议，别打断。

meaning: n. 打断，插嘴；暂停；阻断物，中断期
definition: 1. n. an act of delaying or interrupting the continuity；2. n. some abrupt occurrence that interrupts an ongoing activity
example: The birth of her son was a minor interruption to her career.
exampleZh: 她儿子的出生对她的事业造成一个小小的中断。

meaning: n. 间隔，间隙；幕间休息，中场休息；音程
definition: 1. n. a definite length of time marked off by two instants；2. n. a set containing all points (or all real numbers) between two given endpoints
example: We can just play with that particular interval to change entirely the way we feel about particular melodies.
exampleZh: 我们只需关注这一特别的音程,是如何彻底改变我们对某些旋律的感受的

meaning: v. 干预，干涉；插话，打岔；干扰，阻挠；发生于其间，介于中间；调停，斡旋
definition: 1. to intentionally become involved in a difficult situation in order to improve it or prevent it from getting worse；2. to happen between two times or between other events or activities
example: They remain unwilling to intervene militarily in what could be an unending war.
exampleZh: 他们仍然不愿意对一场可能无休止的战争进行军事干预。

meaning: n. 干预，介入；调停，斡旋；（为改善情况尤指病痛采取的）措施，做法
definition: 1. intentional action to change a situation, with the aim of improving it or preventing it from getting worse；2. the action by God or a god of getting involved in a human situation in order to change it
example: Many people felt he would be hostile to the idea of foreign intervention.
exampleZh: 许多人觉得他会反对外来干预。

meaning: v. 面试，面谈；采访，访问；讯问，审问；接见，会见；n. 面试，面谈；采访，访谈；问讯，口头审讯；接见，会见
definition: 1. n. the questioning of a person (or a conversation in which information is elicited); often conducted by journalists；2. v. conduct an interview in television, newspaper, and radio reporting
example: and submitted my resume to him and got an interview at General Motors, went there and interviewed with them.
exampleZh: 我给了他简历，然后得到了面试通知，所以就去面试了。

meaning: n. 采访者，面试官，接见者
definition: 1. n. a person who conducts an interview
example: And the interviewer asked me, " "So what tips, what tools can you give from positive psychology?"
exampleZh: 采访者问我，“能给读者传授些积极心理学建议吗“

meaning: n. 接受面试者，受接见者，被采访者
definition: 1. n. a person who is interviewed
example: The success depends on good rapport between interviewer and interviewee.
exampleZh: 成功取决于采访者和被采访者之间的融洽。

meaning: adj. 亲密的；个人的，隐私的；温馨的，幽静舒适的；详尽的，精通的；密切的，紧密的；有性关系的，暧昧的；v. 透露，暗示；宣布，通告；n. 密友，知己
definition: 1. n. someone to whom private matters are confided；2. v. give to understand
example: He went on to intimate that he was indeed contemplating a shake-up of the company.
exampleZh: 他接着暗示他确实在考虑对公司进行一次改组。

meaning: n. 亲密；性，性关系；亲昵的言语（或行为）；熟知，精通；亲切宜人，幽静；私事
definition: 1. n. close or warm friendship；2. n. a usually secretive or illicit sexual relationship
example: The opening of the scene depicts Akhnaten and his family in a moment of intimacy.
exampleZh: 开头一幕描述阿肯那顿及其家人亲密无间的一个时刻。

meaning: v. 恫吓，威胁
definition: 1. to frighten or threaten someone, usually in order to persuade them to do something that you want them to do；2. to frighten or threaten someone, usually in order to persuade the person to do something he or she does not wish to do
example: If you're too concerned with outcomes to the extent that you manipulate and intimidate others to achieve those outcomes, then you aren't leading at all, you're dictating.
exampleZh: 如果你过于关注结果，为此到了去操纵和恐吓他人的程度，那么你根本不是在领导，而是在发号施令。

meaning: n. 恫吓，威胁
definition: 1. the action of frightening or threatening someone, usually in order to persuade them to do something that you want them to do
example: Despite reports of intimidation, Zimbabweans swarmed to polling stations on the final day of voting in the most competitive parliamentary election in Zimbabwe's history.
exampleZh: 在津巴布韦历史上竞争最激烈的议会选举的最后一天，尽管有恐吓的报道，津巴布韦人还是涌向投票站。

meaning: prep. 到……里面；触及，碰撞；朝，向；转向；关于；转变成；造成（某种结果）；除；对……很有兴趣；从事（某职业等）；被迫做，被说服做；成为……的一部分；持续到，直到；【名】 （Into）（美）因托（人名）
definition: 1. toward the inside of something, or indicating a change or result
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: He goes into the freak show at the fair, and he joins the crowd where his father also is.
exampleZh: 他去市集去看畸形秀，挤入了他父亲也身处其中的人群。

meaning: adj. 错综复杂的；难理解的，难学会的
definition: 1. having a lot of small parts that are arranged in a complicated or delicate way；2. with many complicated details that make something difficult to understand
example: His new play, Arcadia, is as intricate, elaborate and allusive as anything he has yet written.
exampleZh: 他的新剧本《阿卡狄亚》是他迄今为止创作的最错综复杂、煞费苦心和让人琢磨不定的。

meaning: n. 错综复杂的事物（或细节）；盘根错节，复杂精细
definition: 1. complicated details；2. the quality of having a lot of complicated small parts or details
example: Geronimo is one of the more complex projects undertaken by the open source community, comparable to Linux in its intricacy.
exampleZh: 与Linux相比，Geronimo是由开放源码社区开发的比较复杂的项目之一。

meaning: v. 激起……的兴趣，引发……的好奇心；密谋；n. 密谋策划，阴谋；秘密的恋情，秘密关系；神秘力量，神秘气氛
definition: 1. to interest someone a lot, especially by being strange, unusual, or mysterious；2. (the making of) a secret plan to do something, especially something that will harm another person
example: The young heroine steps into a web of intrigue in the academic world.
exampleZh: 年轻的女主人公陷入了学术界钩心斗角的罗网。

meaning: adj. 内在的，固有的
definition: 1. being an extremely important and basic characteristic of a person or thing；2. basic to a thing, being an important part of making it what it is
example: Diamonds have little intrinsic value and their price depends almost entirely on their scarcity.
exampleZh: 钻石没有多少内在价值，它们的价格几乎完全取决于其稀有程度。

meaning: adv. 本质地，内在地，固有地
definition: 1. in a way that is an extremely important and basic characteristic of a person or thing
example: Suppose we conjecture that the only thing intrinsically valuable is pleasure and the only thing intrinsically bad is pain.
exampleZh: 假设我们推测出唯一,拥有固有价值的东西是快乐,唯一一样自身是坏的东西是痛苦。

meaning: v. 介绍，引见；使初次了解，使尝试；为（电视或广播节目）做开场白，主持；实施，推行；首次引入（某物），使传入；使开始，创始；将（法案）提交讨论；将……放进，添入
definition: 1. v. cause to come to know personally；2. v. bring something new to an environment
example: It gives me great pleasure to introduce our guest speaker.
exampleZh: 我很荣幸来介绍我们的特约演讲人。

meaning: n. 初次投入使用，采用；介绍，引见；初次经历，首次体验；序言，引言；导读，入门指导；前奏；介绍信；外来品，新引进的东西
definition: 1. n. the first section of a communication；2. n. the act of beginning something new
example: I see this as a course that's an introduction to the literature of a period, to modern poetry.
exampleZh: 我觉得，这只是一门引导性课程,引导大家关注某一时期的文学创作和现代诗歌。

meaning: adj. 引导的，介绍的；入门的，初步的；（新产品）试销的
definition: 1. adj. serving to open or begin；2. adj. serving as a base or starting point
example: All right. So much for the introductory lectures which touch on aspects of the materials that we'll keep returning to.
exampleZh: 好了，这就是导读课程了,我们讲到了我们接下来要讲的材料的内容。

meaning: v. 闯入；打扰，侵扰；（火成岩）侵入（已生成构造）
definition: 1. v. enter uninvited；2. v. enter unlawfully on someone's property
example: That, too, explains the heavy Washington presence at this year's show, as these new technologies intrude upon heavily regulated areas.
exampleZh: 这也解释了为什么在今年的展会上华盛顿有很多人参加，因为这些新技术侵入了受到严格监管的领域。

meaning: n. 扰乱，侵犯；闯入，侵入；（对周围岩层的）火成岩侵入
definition: 1. n. any entry into an area not previously occupied；2. n. entrance by force or without permission or welcome
example: You know that Snort is an intrusion detection system, but how does it detect intrusion?
exampleZh: 您知道 Snort 是一种入侵检测系统，但它是如何检测入侵的呢？

meaning: n. 闯入者，侵入者；不速之客
definition: 1. n. someone who intrudes on the privacy or property of another without permission
example: A fortress is easier to protect because it's simpler: it has no windows, few doors, no skylights, or vent systems through which an intruder might sneak.
exampleZh: 堡垒更易防守，因为它构造更简单：没有窗户、门很少，也没有天窗或可供入侵者潜入的通风系统。

meaning: n. 直觉力；直觉感知，直觉知识
definition: 1. (knowledge from) an ability to understand or know something immediately based on your feelings rather than facts；2. an ability to understand or know something without needing to think about it or use reason to discover it, or a feeling that shows this ability
example: Students have a lot of trouble with the concepts because there is not much intuition about electromagnetic phenomenon.
exampleZh: 学生们对于理解概念,觉得很困难,因为对于电磁学现象,只有很少能凭直觉理解的。

meaning: adj. 直觉的；有直觉力的；易懂的，使用简便的
definition: 1. based on feelings rather than facts or proof；2. able to know or understand something because of feelings rather than facts or proof
example: And we'll talk about this more, so if this is not completely intuitive, we'll see why in a second.
exampleZh: 关于这个我们将会讨论更多，所以如果这个不是完全凭直觉获知的，我们一会儿再来看看为什么。

meaning: v. 武力入侵，侵略；大量涌入，蜂拥而入；侵扰，干扰；扩散，渗入
definition: 1. v. march aggressively into another's territory by military force for the purposes of conquest and occupation；2. v. to intrude upon, infringe, encroach on, violate
example: Opportunists must constantly invade new areas to compensate for being displaced by more competitive species.
exampleZh: “机会主义者”必须不断入侵新的地区，以弥补被更具竞争力的物种取代的损失。

meaning: n. 侵略，入侵；涌入，大批进入；侵犯，干预；侵袭，扩散
definition: 1. n. the act of invading; the act of an army that invades for conquest or plunder；2. n. any entry into an area not previously occupied
example: He leaned towards her and she stiffened at this invasion of her personal space.
exampleZh: 他向她俯过身去，这种侵犯她个人空间的举动让她绷紧了身子。

meaning: n. 侵略者，侵略军
definition: 1. n. someone who enters by force in order to conquer
example: Among the best animated series it has offered, many stand out, including Sponge Bob Square Pants and Invader Zim.
exampleZh: 在它推出的最佳动画系列中，包括《海绵宝宝》和《外星侵略者吉姆》在内，许多动画都很优秀。

meaning: adj. 扩散性的，侵入的；切入的，开刀的
definition: 1. adj. relating to a technique in which the body is entered by puncture or incision；2. adj. marked by a tendency to spread especially into healthy tissue
example: What is more, non-native species can appear harmless for decades, then turn invasive.
exampleZh: 更重要的是，非本地物种可能会在几十年内看起来无害，然后变得有入侵性。

meaning: adj. （法律上）无效的，作废的；（论据、理由等）站不住脚的，错误的；（计算机）不能识别的；残疾的；n. 病弱者，伤残者；vt. 使（因伤或病）退役；使伤残，使病弱
definition: 1. An invalid document, ticket, law, etc. is not legally or officially acceptable；2. An invalid opinion, argument, etc. is not correct, usually because it is not logical or not based on correct information
example: She had been a delicate child and her parents had treated her as an invalid.
exampleZh: 她小时候很虚弱，父母就把她当个病人照料。

meaning: adj. （法律上）无效的，作废的；（论据、理由等）站不住脚的，错误的；（计算机）不能识别的；残疾的；n. 病弱者，伤残者；vt. 使（因伤或病）退役；使伤残，使病弱
definition: 1. n. someone who is incapacitated by a chronic illness or injury；2. v. force to retire, remove from active duty, as of firemen
example: She had been a delicate child and her parents had treated her as an invalid.
exampleZh: 她小时候很虚弱，父母就把她当个病人照料。

meaning: adj. 极有用的，极宝贵的
definition: 1. adj. having incalculable monetary, intellectual, or spiritual worth
example: I was able to gain invaluable experience over that year.
exampleZh: 在那一年里我获得了十分宝贵的经验。

meaning: adv. 始终如一地，一贯地
definition: 1. adv. in an invariable manner
example: Now I try that on my students, and invariably they say "Well, of course you've got to save the child.
exampleZh: 我曾问过我的学生，他们都不约而同地说,“当然要先救小孩。

meaning: v. 发明，创造；编造，虚构
definition: 1. v. come up with (an idea, plan, explanation, theory, or principle) after a mental effort；2. v. make up something artificial or untrue
example: And so the opportunity and need to invent just like any other startup or entrepreneurial activity remains strong.
exampleZh: 因此发明创造的机遇和需要就像,任何创立活动一样，非常重要。

meaning: n. 发明物；发明，创造；虚构，编造；发明才能，创造力；创意曲（短乐曲的题目）
definition: 1. n. the creation of something in the mind；2. n. a creation (a new device or process) resulting from study and experimentation
example: So a hundred years really before the invention of Game Theory, someone had figured out this answer for this game.
exampleZh: 一百多年前博弈论还没有诞生呢,那时就有人解除了这个博弈的答案

meaning: n. 发明者，发明家
definition: 1. n. someone who is the first to think of or make something
example: So the inventor of the chess game-- he was in India, and went to the local king.
exampleZh: 象棋游戏的发明人-,他在印度，去见当地的国王。

meaning: n. 详细目录，清单；存货，库存；盘货，存货盘点；v. 开列清单
definition: 1. a detailed list of all the things in a place；2. the act of counting of all the goods, materials, etc. kept in a place such as a shop
example: In 1989, about a year after we went public, we had a horrible problem related to inventory management.
exampleZh: 989年，也就是我们上市的第二年，我们在库存管理方面,遇见了极大的困难。

meaning: v. 使倒置，使反转；使（位置、顺序或关系）颠倒，使互换；（通过改变音高变化方向）修改（乐句），转回；转位；求逆，求反；n. 仰拱，倒拱；管道内底；颠倒图案的错印邮票；倒置物，倒悬者；adj. 转化的
definition: 1. to turn something upside down or change the order of two things；2. to turn something so its top is at the bottom or put something in the opposite order or position
example: Somehow, when I told you to invert the transformation, some of you had some difficulty.
exampleZh: 我上次让你们逆推变换公式的时候,有的同学觉得很困难

meaning: n. 相反，倒置；逆温；转位；粒子数布居反转；倒反，反转；求逆，求反；（表达）转换
definition: 1. a situation in which something is changed so that it is the opposite of what it was before, or in which something is turned upside down；2. a situation in which an organ, or part of an organ, is turned inside out
example: The basic idea behind dependency inversion is that objects should be dependent upon abstractions and not upon implementations.
exampleZh: 依赖倒置背后的基本思想是，对象应该依赖于抽象，而不是依赖于实现。

meaning: v. 投资；投入（时间或精力）；赋予，授予；给……穿衣；包围，围攻
definition: 1. v. make an investment；2. v. give qualities or abilities to
example: Natural language, speech, and voice are going to be fundamental to the changing UI, and we have to invest.
exampleZh: 自然语言，演说，声音对于改变用户界面来说是最基本的，必须得到投资和发展。

meaning: n. 投资；值得买的东西；（时间、精力的）投入；包围，封锁
definition: 1. n. the act of investing; laying out money or capital in an enterprise with the expectation of profit；2. n. money that is invested with an expectation of profit
example: But then who would understand better than John Milton, Sr. the importance or the value of a long-term investment strategy?
exampleZh: 但在那时谁又比弥尔顿先生更懂得,长远投资的重要性呢？

meaning: n. 投资者，投资机构
definition: 1. n. someone who commits capital in order to gain financial returns
example: The way a good investor does really well is by engaging in successful futurology.
exampleZh: 对未来成功的预测是一个好的投资人的取胜之道。

meaning: v. 侦察（某事）；调查（某人）；研究
definition: 1. v. investigate scientifically；2. v. conduct an inquiry or investigation of
example: It's all very mysterious and we send off a spaceship to investigate the markings, the radio signals from the other place.
exampleZh: 一切都很神秘,所以我们,派遣一艘飞船去调查星球上的印记,以及那些从其他星球传来的无线电信号

meaning: n. 调查，审查；科学研究，学术研究
definition: 1. n. an inquiry into unfamiliar or questionable activities；2. n. the work of inquiring into something thoroughly and systematically
example: We now know what happened because of the surveillance investigation.
exampleZh: 我们现在知道发生了些什么,经过监督调查后

meaning: n. 调查者，侦察员
definition: 1. n. a scientist who devotes himself to doing research；2. n. someone who investigates
example: The infant may be responding to aspects of the stimulus different than those identified by the investigator.
exampleZh: 婴儿对刺激产生反应的方面可能与研究者发现的那些不同。

meaning: adj. 看不见的，隐形的；无形的，非贸易的；被忽视的，不为人注意的；n. 无形进出口
definition: 1. adj. impossible or nearly impossible to see; imperceptible by the eye；2. adj. not prominent or readily noticeable
example: Patterns that are invisible on the ground can be the most striking part of an aerial photograph.
exampleZh: 在地面上看不见的图案可能是空中照片中最为醒目的部分。

meaning: v. 邀请，约请；征求，请求；引起，招致；n. 请柬，请帖
definition: 1. n. a colloquial expression for invitation；2. v. increase the likelihood of
example: But both today and throughout the entire semester, as I'm lecturing I want to invite you to jump in with questions.
exampleZh: 但是在今天以及整个学期里，在我讲课时,希望你们带着问题投入进来。

meaning: n. 邀请；引起，招致；（尤指正式地）征求，请求；请帖，请柬
definition: 1. n. a request (spoken or written) to participate or be present or take part in something；2. n. a tempting allurement
example: you could leave your response to the invitation slightly open-ended by saying you're not sure.
exampleZh: 你可以表示你不确定，开放性地回复这个邀请。

meaning: adj. 诱人的，吸引人的；v. 邀请，约请；征求，请求；引起，招致（invite 的现在分词）
definition: 1. adj. attractive and tempting
example: He sent a letter inviting Naomi to attend his installation as chief of his tribe.
exampleZh: 他给娜奥米寄了封信，邀请她来参加他就任部落酋长的仪式。

meaning: v. 牵涉，涉及；包含，需要；使陷入，使卷入；（使）参加，加入；使承担，使面对
definition: 1. v. connect closely and often incriminatingly；2. v. engage as a participant
example: All right? The first one is, that test has to involve-- shouldn't have to, the value of some variable.
exampleZh: 好不好？第一件事是，循环开始的测试必须必须-不是一定，一些变量的值。

meaning: n. 参与，介入；投入，沉迷；暧昧关系，恋爱关系
definition: 1. n. the act of sharing in the activities of a group；2. n. a connection of inclusion or containment
example: There was a growing unease about their involvement in the war.
exampleZh: 他们对卷入战争感到日益不安。

meaning: adj. 复杂的；与……关系密切的；专心于……的，忙于……的；卷入的，参与的；v. 牵涉，包含（involve 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. connected by participation or association or use；2. adj. entangled or hindered as if e.g. in mire
example: And obviously within this long period many many different ideas and perspectives were involved within each side of conflict.
exampleZh: 很明显，很久了,非常多的不同的观点和看法,出现在冲突的双方之中。

meaning: adj. 内心的，精神的；向内的，向中心的；adv. 向内 (=inwards)；向自己，向内心 (=inwards)；n. 内部；内脏；【名】 （Inward）（英）英沃德（人名）
definition: 1. adj. relating to or existing in the mind or thoughts；2. adv. toward the center or interior
example: The inward meaning of it leaked out, and the great heart of the public was touched.
exampleZh: 它的深层含义流传开来，广大民众的内心被触动了。

meaning: n. 铁；熨斗；铁器，铁制工具；镣铐；（矫正畸形腿的）夹腿；马蹬；陨铁，铁陨石；（高尔夫球）铁头球杆；刚强，毅力；v. 熨，烫；adj. 铁的，铁制的；刚强的，坚强的；强硬的，严酷的；【名】 （Iron）（英）艾恩（人名）
definition: 1. n. a heavy ductile magnetic metallic element; is silver-white in pure form but readily rusts; used in construction and tools and armament; plays a role in the transport of oxygen by the blood；2. v. press and smooth with a heated iron
example: You could run the reaction, take solid iron gaseous oxygen, form iron oxide, measure the heat of formation of it, tabulate it.
exampleZh: 你可以进行一个反应,用固态铁和氧气生成氧化铁，测量它的生成热，列成表格。

meaning: n. （出乎意料的）奇异可笑之处，具有讽刺意味的情况；反语，讽刺；adj. 铁的；含铁的；似铁的
definition: 1. n. witty language used to convey insults or scorn；2. n. incongruity between what might be expected and what actually occurs
example: We understand irony only, he means, to the extent to which we are in agreement with the other person.
exampleZh: 他的意思是,我们只能在赞同对方观点的程度上,理解讽刺。

meaning: adj. 反语的，讽刺的；（因出乎意料而）奇怪的，好笑的
definition: 1. adj. humorously sarcastic or mocking；2. adj. characterized by often poignant difference or incongruity between what is expected and what actually is
example: It is a bitterly ironic thing to learn on the 20th anniversary of Whiten's classic study.
exampleZh: 在怀滕经典研究发表20周年之际得知此事，极具讽刺意味，令人倍感唏嘘。

meaning: adv. 具有讽刺意味的是；反讽地，讽刺地
definition: 1. adv. contrary to plan or expectation；2. adv. in an ironic manner
example: Ironically, the book she felt was her worst sold more copies than any of her others.
exampleZh: 具有讽刺意味的是，那本书她觉得最糟糕，却比她的其他任何一本书卖得都好。

meaning: adj. 非理性的，不合逻辑的，荒谬的；无理的；n. 无理数
definition: 1. n. a real number that cannot be expressed as a rational number；2. adj. not consistent with or using reason
example: And the bestial is identified in Yeats with the heart and with the irrational and with the uncontrollable.
exampleZh: 存于人身的野兽就是心灵,是无理智的，不可控制的。

meaning: adj. 不平整的，不整齐的；（时间）无规律的，不定期的；（行为）不合常规的，不正常的；（词形）不规则的；非正规军的；便秘的；n. 非正规军军人；次品，处理品
definition: 1. n. a member of an irregular armed force that fights a stronger force by sabotage and harassment；2. adj. contrary to rule or accepted order or general practice
example: If so,how many chords are involved in this chord change and are they changing at a regular or irregular rate?
exampleZh: 是否有和弦的转变，这次和弦转变一共用了多少和弦,他们的变化率是规则还是不规则的？

meaning: adj. 不考虑，不顾
definition: 1. without considering; not needing to allow for
example: The weekly rent is the same irrespective of whether there are three or four occupants.
exampleZh: 无论三个还是四个人住，周租金不变。

meaning: v. 灌溉；冲洗（尤指伤口）；使清新
definition: 1. v. supply with water, as with channels or ditches or streams；2. v. supply with a constant flow or sprinkling of some liquid, for the purpose of cooling, cleansing, or disinfecting
example: None of the water from Lake Powell is used to irrigate the area.
exampleZh: 鲍威尔湖的水没有被用来灌溉这一地区。

meaning: n. 灌溉；冲洗（尤指伤口）
definition: 1. n. supplying dry land with water by means of ditches etc；2. n. (medicine) cleaning a wound or body organ by flushing or washing out with water or a medicated solution
example: If the irrigation plan goes ahead, it could spell disaster for the birds.
exampleZh: 如果该灌溉计划继续的话，这对鸟类可能预示着灾难。

meaning: v. 使不耐烦，激怒；刺激（身体某部位），使疼痛；使（生物体、细胞或器官）兴奋；引起不愉快
definition: 1. to make someone angry or annoyed；2. to make a part of your body sore or painful
example: Wear rubber gloves while chopping chillies as they can irritate the skin.
exampleZh: 剁辣椒时戴上橡皮手套，因为它们会刺激皮肤。

meaning: n. 恼怒，生气；（尤指一段时间的）恼人事，烦恼；（身体某部位的）疼痛；刺激（作用），兴奋
definition: 1. the feeling of being angry or annoyed, or something that makes you feel like this；2. a painful or sore feeling in a part of the body
example: He tried not to let his irritation show as he blinked in the glare of the television lights.
exampleZh: 在对着耀眼的电视光线眨眼时，他竭力不把自己的恼怒表现出来。

meaning: adj. 烦人的，使人恼火的；有刺激性的，引发疼痛的；v. 使不耐烦，激怒；刺激（身体某部位），使疼痛；使（生物体、细胞或器官）兴奋（irritate 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. making you feel annoyed；2. making you feel annoyed or angry
example: The most irritating problem was not the delay itself but the lack of explanation.
exampleZh: 最令人恼火的问题不是延误本身，而是缺乏解释。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: adj. 易怒的，急躁的；（身体部位或器官）过敏的；（生物机体）应激性的
definition: 1. becoming annoyed very easily；2. becoming annoyed or angry very easily
example: He had been waiting for over an hour and was beginning to feel irritable.
exampleZh: 他已经等了一个多小时，开始觉得有些烦躁了。

meaning: n. 岛，岛屿；岛状物，孤立体；脑岛，胰岛；v. 使成岛（状），使孤立；【名】 （Island）（英）艾兰（人名）
definition: 1. n. a land mass (smaller than a continent) that is surrounded by water；2. n. a zone or area resembling an island
example: We know that the first colony that the Greeks established was in the Bay of Naples on the island of Ischia.
exampleZh: 我们知道希腊建立的第一个殖民地,是在那不勒斯湾的伊斯基亚岛

meaning: n. （常用于诗歌和名称中）岛；v. 使成岛（状）；【名】 （Isle）（英）艾尔（人名）
definition: 1. (used especially in place names) an island
example: But the last thing I remember I was going to bed from my fatal illness on the Isle of Elba.
exampleZh: 但我最后的记忆就是在厄尔巴岛的病榻上。

meaning: v. 孤立，分离；隔离；单独考虑，区别看待；使（某物质、细胞等）分离；n. 被隔离的人（或物）；（用于研究的）分离菌，隔离群；adj. 孤独的，孤立的
definition: 1. v. place or set apart；2. v. obtain in pure form
example: This policy could isolate the country from the other permanent members of the United Nations Security Council.
exampleZh: 这项政策可能会将这个国家从联合国安理会的其他常任理事国中孤立出来。

meaning: n. 隔离，孤立；孤独；绝缘；（尤指对混合物或微生物的）离析
definition: 1. n. a state of separation between persons or groups；2. n. the act of isolating something; setting something apart from others
example: To make sense, these figures should not be looked at in isolation.
exampleZh: 这些数据不应孤立起来看，否则就没有意义。

meaning: n. 议题，争论点；（报纸、杂志等的）期，号；发放，分配；（新股票或邮票等的）发行；子女，后嗣；流出，发出；结果，后果；v. 发表，颁布；分发，分配；正式发行；流出，发出；由……产生，由……得出
definition: 1. n. an important question that is in dispute and must be settled；2. v. prepare and issue for public distribution or sale
example: So it's a complex issue, and I should leave it having said this much, at least for the moment.
exampleZh: 因此它是一个很复杂的问题，而我就讲到这里，至少暂时这样。

meaning: pron. 它，这，那（指已提到或将提及的事物、无生命的东西、动物、植物、活动、经验、抽象观念等）；用于指某人，尤指性别不详或情况不详时（如婴儿、小孩、电话中的对方）；作无人称动词的主语，表示天气、时间、日期、距离、光线、温度、状态等；作形式主语或形式宾语，替代通常出现在其后面的名词、短语、从句或不定式；与 be 动词构成强调结构，用于强调其后的句子成分；用作直接宾语，几乎不具有或完全不具有任何含义（如 have it、call it a day）；n. （捉迷藏等儿童游戏中的）捉人者，找人者；意大利苦艾酒，味美思酒；abbr. （IT）信息技术（information technology）
definition: 1. n. the branch of engineering that deals with the use of computers and telecommunications to retrieve and store and transmit information
example: It's magical.It's sorcery to take an ore and convert it to metal. It's magic. It still amazes me today.
exampleZh: 非常神奇，采取矿石并将其转变为,金属非常神奇，我现在仍然很吃惊。

meaning: n. 项目，条款；一件商品（或物品）；一则，一条（新闻）；（关系亲密的）一对；adv. （用于介绍清单上逐个项目之前）又，此外还有；v. 逐条列出，记下
definition: 1. n. a distinct part that can be specified separately in a group of things that could be enumerated on a list；2. adv. (used when listing or enumerating items) also
example: There's the vector, and again you'll see this in your handout, says I only took the first item.
exampleZh: 你们同样可以在讲义上看到这个向量,意思是我只拿了第一种物品。

meaning: pron. 它的，其（it 的所有格形式）
definition: 1. n. the branch of engineering that deals with the use of computers and telecommunications to retrieve and store and transmit information
example: Her speech was memorable for its polemic rather than its substance.
exampleZh: 她的演说之所以令人难忘，不是因其内容而是因其辩论方法。

meaning: pron. 它自己；它本身（表强调）；与抽象品质名词连用，表示“非常……，是……的化身”；adv. in itself：就其本身而言，本质上；by itself：单独地；自动地；of itself：自行，自发地；v. speak for itself：不言而喻，有目共睹
definition: 1. used to refer to a thing as the object or for emphasis
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: What Levi-Strauss is saying here is that his approach to myth is itself only a version of the myth.
exampleZh: 列维这里想说的是,研究神话的方法本身只是神话的一个版本。

meaning: n. 象牙，（其他动物的）长牙；象牙制品；象牙色，乳白色；钢琴键；（人的）牙齿；adj. 象牙色的，乳白色的；象牙制成的；【名】 （Ivory）（英）艾沃里（人名）
definition: 1. the hard yellowish-white substance that forms the tusks of some animals such as elephants, used especially in the past to make decorative objects；2. an object made from ivory
example: They don't really, in their ivory towers, understand how pernicious drug crime is.
exampleZh: 身处象牙塔里，他们并不真正懂得毒品犯罪多么有害。

meaning: n. 千斤顶，起重器；J 牌，杰克；插孔，插座；丝毫，根本；（滚木球戏中的）小白球；抛接子游戏；男人，普通人（Jack）；伐木工人；侦探，警察；高空作业工人；船首旗；钱；烤肉炙叉旋转器；琴键拨子；鲹；雄性动物（尤指公灰背隼或公驴）；v. 用千斤顶托起；提高，增加；浪费时间；停止，放弃；登录，接入；偷窃；adj. 厌倦
definition: 1. a piece of equipment that can be opened slowly under a heavy object such as a car in order to raise it off the ground；2. a playing card with a picture of a man on it. It has a lower value than the cards showing a king or queen
example: This is a famous picture of Lee Harvey Oswald who was being assassinated by Jack Ruby.
exampleZh: 这是李·哈维·奥斯瓦尔德的著名照片,他被杰克谋杀。

meaning: n. 夹克衫，短上衣；书皮，护封； 马铃薯皮；（机器或设备的）绝热罩，隔离罩；碟片套；（海上采油平台的）支架；v. 给……装护套；给……穿短上衣；打
definition: 1. n. a short coat；2. v. provide with a thermally non-conducting cover
example: Student: I like your leather jacket She likes my leather jacket Any questions or thoughts, just like that one?
exampleZh: 我很喜欢你的皮夹克,她喜欢我的皮夹克,还有吗？，像刚才那个就很好？

meaning: n. 监狱；监禁；v. 监禁；【名】 （Jail） （英）杰尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a correctional institution used to detain persons who are in the lawful custody of the government (either accused persons awaiting trial or convicted persons serving a sentence)；2. v. lock up or confine, in or as in a jail
example: He'll be sold again, by the way, a third time, for $2000.00, in Mobile, Alabama, at the Mobile Slave Jail.
exampleZh: 他又将被卖掉,顺便说一下,第三次,他被卖了两千美元,在亚拉巴马州一个流动的奴隶监狱

meaning: n. 果酱；堵塞，拥挤；麻烦，困境；爵士乐（摇滚乐）即兴演奏会；卡住，轧住；v. 塞满，挤满；卡住，发生故障；压进，塞入；干扰（无线电或电子信号）；（电话系统因很多人同时打电话而）瘫痪；挤伤，压伤； 即兴表演；（向击球手）投（内角球）；猛推（身体部位、杠杆等）；【名】 （Jam） （伊朗、巴基）贾姆 （人名）
definition: 1. n. preserve of crushed fruit；2. v. press tightly together or cram
example: and I worked at a record label "Island Def Jam" for a while,
exampleZh: 然后我在一家叫做“艾兰德弗詹姆”的唱片公司干了一阵子，

meaning: n. 一月，即公历年的第一个月份
definition: 1. n. the first month of the year; begins 10 days after the winter solstice
example: So in January, 2005, I joined the positive psychology center as the director of education and senior scholar.
exampleZh: 005年一月，我加入积极心理学中心,任教育主任和高级学者。

meaning: n. 玻璃罐，广口瓶；一瓶，一罐（的量或物）；震动；v. 撞击，震动；刺激，对……产生不好的影响；不和谐，不相配；发出刺耳声；【名】 （Jar） （罗）扎尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a vessel (usually cylindrical) with a wide mouth and without handles；2. v. be incompatible; be or come into conflict
example: Well, in any case the jar is just arbitrarily in the middle of that, organizing everything without participating in the nature of anything.
exampleZh: 好，无论如何坛子只是被随意地放置在了自由游戏之中，组织一切，却不参与任何事物的本质。

meaning: n. 行话，黑话；烟色红皓石，黄皓石
definition: 1. special words and phrases that are used by particular groups of people, especially in their work；2. words and phrases used by particular groups of people, esp. in their work, that are not generally understood
example: So here we have a second definition, a new definition for today, and again we can use our jargon.
exampleZh: 这里我们给出第二个定义,也是今天的一个新定义,我们再一次用到术语

meaning: n. 颌，颚；下巴；（机器的）钳口；危险的局面；口部； 闲聊；饶舌，喋喋不休；闲聊；v. 喋喋不休；【名】 （Jaw） （冈）乔（人名）
definition: 1. n. the part of the skull of a vertebrate that frames the mouth and holds the teeth；2. v. talk socially without exchanging too much information
example: So, your tongue is closer to your jaw than it is to your hip in the body; so too in both the motor cortex and the somatosensory cortex.
exampleZh: 所以相对于屁股,你的下巴在身体上距离你的舌头更近,而在运动皮层与感觉皮层上的位置,也是这样对应着的

meaning: n. 爵士乐；爵士乐舞蹈（jazz ballet/jazz dance）；毫无意义的话；诸如此类的事情；adj. 爵士乐的；v. 演奏爵士乐；跳爵士舞；使活泼；游荡；【名】 （Jazz）（德）雅茨（人名）
definition: 1. n. empty rhetoric or insincere or exaggerated talk；2. v. play something in the style of jazz
example: We're going to go to the realm of Western jazz here and I'm going to pick on Chuck Mangione.
exampleZh: 我们来看看西方的爵士乐领域,我选了查克·曼卓林

meaning: adj. 妒忌的，好嫉妒的；珍惜的；猜疑的，留意提防的；（神祇）要求绝对忠实和崇敬的
definition: 1. adj. showing extreme cupidity; painfully desirous of another's advantages；2. adj. suspicious or unduly suspicious or fearful of being displaced by a rival
example: Now Joseph's brothers are jealous of Jacob's partiality to Joseph, And they conspire to be rid of him.
exampleZh: 现在约瑟夫的兄弟们都妒忌雅各布对他的偏爱，他们密谋要解决掉他。

meaning: n. 嫉妒，羡慕；吃醋，醋意
definition: 1. n. a feeling of jealous envy (especially of a rival)；2. n. zealous vigilance
example: Well part of it is that we get very-- We get a sort of jealousy of these people because why should someone have billions of dollars?
exampleZh: 我们也许会有点...,我们会对这些人有一种仇富的情绪,为什么有人成了亿万富翁

meaning: n. 牛仔裤；工装裤；（Jeans）人名；（英、意）琼斯
definition: 1. n. (usually plural) close-fitting pants of heavy denim for manual work or casual wear；2. n. a coarse durable twill-weave cotton fabric
example: You can find really expensive brand name jeans
exampleZh: 你也可以找到很名贵的牛仔服，

meaning: n. 吉普车；吉普（美国汽车品牌，即 Jeep）
definition: 1. n. a car suitable for traveling over rough terrain
example: A jeep trailing a cloud of dust was speeding in my direction.
exampleZh: 一辆吉普车拖着一股扬尘，朝我疾驰而来。

meaning: n. 果冻；（常涂于面包上的）果酱；肉冻；胶状物；轻便塑料鞋；明胶基软糖；轻松愉快的事；v. 把（食物）做成胶冻（或果冻），把（食物）包上胶冻（或果冻）；【名】 （Jelly） （英）杰利，（俄）叶利（人名）
definition: 1. a sweet, soft food made by cooking fruit with sugar to preserve it. It is smooth, without any pieces of fruit in it. Jelly is eaten on bread；2. a soft, sweet, usually brightly coloured food made from sugar, gelatine, and fruit flavours, that shakes slightly when it is moved
example: You can even get peanut butter and jelly on an English muffin for breakfast.
exampleZh: 早餐时你甚至可以吃到英式松饼，佐以花生酱和果冻。

meaning: v. 危及，损害
definition: 1. to put something such as a plan or system in danger of being harmed or damaged；2. to cause something to be harmed or damaged, or to put something in danger
example: They mean well, but they could still be minimizing the abuse or you could jeopardize their safety by obtaining their help.
exampleZh: 他们本意是好的，但仍有可能在轻描淡写虐待行为，而且你寻求他们帮忙的做法还可能危及他们的安全。

meaning: 危险；危难
definition: 1. in danger of being damaged or destroyed；2. Something in jeopardy is in danger of being damaged or destroyed
example: A series of setbacks have put the whole project in jeopardy.
exampleZh: 一系列的挫折已经使整个项目陷入险境。

meaning: n. 急拉，急推；傻瓜，坏蛋；肌肉抽搐；（举重）挺举；腌制后放在木火上烤的肉；颠簸，震摇；v. 急拉，猛推；（举重）挺举过头；制肉干；（用调料浸泡及用木柴火烤）烹饪（猪肉，鸡肉）；adj. 腌泡过的；【名】 （Jerk） 耶尔克（人名）
definition: 1. to make a short sudden movement, or to cause someone or something to do this；2. in weightlifting, to lift the bar quickly, from your shoulders to a position in which the arms are stretched above the head
example: You're probably going to think, "Oh shit, this" instantly your cynicism kicks in and then "Who's this jerk?"
exampleZh: 你可能会想,"这人真要命",你会讥笑道,"这个怪人是谁"

meaning: n. 喷气式飞机；喷射流；煤玉，黑玉；喷嘴，喷射口；v. 乘喷气式飞机旅行；喷射
definition: 1. n. an airplane powered by one or more jet engines；2. v. issue in a jet; come out in a jet; stream or spring forth
example: Maybe do the JET program in a couple of years when I'm graduated.
exampleZh: 也许我毕业以后会参加日本交流和教学计划项目。

meaning: n. 时差反应，飞行时差反应：长途飞行穿越多个时区后因人体生物钟未能及时适应目的地时间而出现的身体疲劳、困倦和不适。
definition: 1. tiredness caused by travelling quickly across several time zones
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: It's a good idea to spend the first night of your holiday sleeping off the jet lag.
exampleZh: 你假期的第一天晚上睡觉来消除飞行时差反应是个好主意。

meaning: n. 宝石；珠宝首饰；难能可贵的人，珍贵的东西；（手表的）宝石轴承；v. 用宝石装饰；把宝石承轴装进手表
definition: 1. n. a precious or semiprecious stone incorporated into a piece of jewelry；2. v. adorn or decorate with precious stones
example: Exhibits are displayed in chic, modern glass cases and lit as if each handbag or lipstick case was a jewel.
exampleZh: 展览品在别致的现代玻璃橱中展出，好像每一个手提包或口红盒被照亮得像宝石一般。

meaning: n. 珠宝，首饰
definition: 1. objects such as rings, necklaces, and bracelets worn for decoration
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: The museum's collection includes jewellery worn by wealthy families in the eighteenth century.
exampleZh: 这家博物馆的藏品包括18世纪富裕家庭佩戴的珠宝。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 工作，职业；零工，任务；职责，责任；罪行，（尤指）盗窃； 东西，物件；费力的事；幸运的事；刺，捅；东西，物件；v. 刺，捅；（尤指经纪人小规模操作）买卖股票；欺骗，出卖；假公济私，营私舞弊；【名】 （Job）（英）乔布，（法、葡）若布，(?-1605)约伯俄罗斯正教会莫斯科牧首，（德、塞、捷、荷、意）约布（人名)
definition: 1. n. the principal activity in your life that you do to earn money；2. v. profit privately from public office and official business
example: But there's another form of the Peter Principle, which is that the job grows faster than the person.
exampleZh: 但是彼特原理还有另外一种形式，那就是岗位成长的比个人还快。

meaning: n. （尤指职业的）赛马骑师；操作者；v. 谋取，获取（利益或优势）；（通过缓慢小心地移动）改变，调整；熟练操作，熟练使用；欺骗，诱使；移动；当赛马骑师
definition: 1. a person whose job is riding horses in races；2. a person whose job involves the use of a particular device, vehicle, object, etc., or who is very interested in a particular thing
example: The jockey took a nasty tumble at the third fence.
exampleZh: 骑师在第三道栅栏处给重重摔下马来。

meaning: v. 慢跑；轻推，轻撞；（多指缓慢地）颠簸着行进；（上下）颠动；使颠簸；n. 慢跑锻炼；轻推；平稳的慢速；【名】 （Jog）（尼）乔格（人名）
definition: 1. n. a sharp change in direction；2. v. continue talking or writing in a desultory manner
example: I got up early the next morning to jog.
exampleZh: 我次日清晨早起去慢跑了。

meaning: v. 成为……的一员，参加；连接，接合；联合，汇合；上（火车、飞机等）；和……作伴，随同；n. 连接处，接合点
definition: 1. n. the shape or manner in which things come together and a connection is made；2. v. become part of; become a member of a group or organization
example: And John was in his first year of school, and he decided to join the running club, and we met there.
exampleZh: 约翰当时是一年级，他决定参加我们的俱乐部，我们就这样认识了。

meaning: adj. 联合的，共同的，共有的；连带的；n. 关节；（一般带有骨头的）一大块肉；（两个物体或部分的）接合处，接缝；廉价娱乐场所，下等娱乐场所；大麻烟卷；v. 把……切成带骨的大块肉；接合，联合；使有接头；【名】 （Joint）（美）茹安（人名）
definition: 1. n. (anatomy) the point of connection between two bones or elements of a skeleton (especially if it allows motion)；2. v. fit as if by joints
example: It would have to grow by acquisitions or joint ventures to achieve global reach.
exampleZh: 它得通过收购或合资来成长壮大以便触及全球。

meaning: n. 笑话，玩笑；荒唐可笑的人（或事物），笑料；恶作剧，捉弄人的玩笑；v. 说笑话，开玩笑；取笑，开……的玩笑；【名】 （Joke）（英）乔克，（塞）约凯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a humorous anecdote or remark intended to provoke laughter；2. v. tell a joke; speak humorously
example: It reminds me of a joke about the statistician who drowned in a pool with an average height of 10 inches.
exampleZh: 这让我想起一个统计学笑话,在一个平均水深为10英寸的游泳池里，谁会被淹死。

meaning: adj. 愉快的，高兴的；令人愉快的，惬意的；明亮好看的；v. 鼓励（某人），劝（某人）高兴；开玩笑；n. 聚会，庆祝活动；adv. （用于强调）很，非常；【名】 （Jolly）（英、印）乔利，（法）若利，（德）约利（人名）
definition: 1. happy and smiling；2. enjoyable, energetic, and entertaining
example: And at the end of the interview, the interviewer is a very jolly guy.
exampleZh: 采访结束，主持人是个热情开朗的男生。

meaning: n. 杂志，期刊，报纸；日记，日志；（会计）日记账
definition: 1. n. a daily written record of (usually personal) experiences and observations；2. n. a periodical dedicated to a particular subject
example: In the long run, we want The Wall Street Journal and so I guess that-- we just have to accept that.
exampleZh: 但从长远来说,我们需要《华尔街日报》,所以我想,我们必须得接受

meaning: n. 新闻业，新闻工作；报刊杂志，新闻报道
definition: 1. n. newspapers and magazines collectively；2. n. the profession of reporting or photographing or editing news stories for one of the media
example: And I've seen other similar things where commercial photography, photo journalism and all that stuff is up there,
exampleZh: 我也见过很多商业摄影师，记者摄影师，等等，都是

meaning: n. 新闻工作者，新闻记者；报人，报纸撰稿人
definition: 1. n. a writer for newspapers and magazines；2. n. someone who keeps a diary or journal
example: It was probably coined by this journalist named O'Sullivan, although now there's a new theory that it wasn't.
exampleZh: 一般认为记者奥沙利文发明了这个词,尽管现在有新理论认为他们并没有联系

meaning: n. 旅行，旅程；历程，过程；v. 旅行；【名】 （Journey）（英）朱尼，朱妮（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of traveling from one place to another；2. v. undertake a journey or trip
example: On your journey, and this is also true of the study of folklore, you need a helper. That's part of fiction. You need another hero.
exampleZh: 在你的旅途中，一些民间传说的研究也能证明，你一定需要一个帮手，当然这里面也有虚构成分，你需要英雄。

meaning: n. 欢欣，高兴；使人高兴的人（或物），乐趣；成功，满足；v. 感到高兴，感到欣喜
definition: 1. n. the emotion of great happiness；2. v. feel happiness or joy
example: And there is finally, again, an affirmation of this joy and gaiety, here seen as a property of the artwork itself.
exampleZh: 最后在这里又一次，叶芝又一次提到了快乐欢愉，这里应看作是这件艺术品的部分特性。

meaning: adj. 高兴的，令人愉快的
definition: 1. adj. full of or characterized by joy
example: Contrast his images of joyous or demonic assent with the images of catastrophe, of descent, of collapse in Eliot, "London Bridge is falling down."
exampleZh: 对比他关于喜悦或着迷的描写,这些都是和灾难，对衰退的描写，或者艾略特描写的崩塌“伦敦桥在倒塌“，相一致的“

meaning: adj. 高兴的，令人愉快的
definition: 1. adj. full of or producing joy；2. adj. full of high-spirited delight
example: We're a very joyful people; we're very musical people and we love music.
exampleZh: 我们是非常快乐的民族；我们是音乐之族；我们热爱音乐。

meaning: n. 法官，审判官；裁判员，评判员；鉴定人，行家；士师（古犹太人领袖称谓）；v. 判断，认为；裁判，评判；估计，估算（数量、距离、尺寸等）；批评，指责；审判，审理；【名】 （Judge）（英、美、爱）贾奇（人名）
definition: 1. n. a public official authorized to decide questions brought before a court of justice；2. v. determine the result of (a competition)
example: Milton elaborates on this claim that we should read and prove anything we want, for we are sufficient to judge aright.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿详尽阐明了这个论点，我们应该多读书,去求证自己想知道的所有事，因此我们才能够做正确的判断。

meaning: n. 判断，看法；判断力，识别力；判决，裁决；报应，天谴
definition: 1. n. an opinion formed by judging something；2. n. the act of judging or assessing a person or situation or event
example: In other words, the judgment of beauty does not depend on the existence of the object for its satisfaction.
exampleZh: 换句话说，审美不会依赖于,事物自己的存在形式。

meaning: adj. 法庭的，司法的；公正的，明断的
definition: 1. relating to a judge or judges, to a law court, or to the justice system；2. relating to or done by courts or judges or the part of a government responsible for the legal system
example: Bias against women permeates every level of the judicial system.
exampleZh: 对妇女的偏见全面影响司法体系的各个层面。

meaning: n. 司法部，司法系统；法官，审判员；adj. 司法的，法官的，法院的
definition: 1. the part of a country's government that is responsible for its legal system, including all the judges in the country's courts；2. the part of a country's government that is responsible for its legal system and which consists of all the judges in the country's courts of law
example: This is the fifth and probably final day of testimony before the Senate Judiciary Committee.
exampleZh: 这是第5天，也可能是最后一天在参议院司法委员会面前作证。

meaning: n. （水果和蔬菜的）汁，水果（蔬菜）汁饮料；肉汁；电，电能；胃液；精力，活力；权势，影响力；汽油；酒；v. 榨（果汁或蔬菜汁）
definition: 1. n. the liquid part that can be extracted from plant or animal tissue；2. n. energetic vitality
example: we thought about using juice, the kinds of stimuli that you would use in animal experiments.
exampleZh: 我们想过使用果汁，这种刺激物也会在动物试验中使用。

meaning: adj. 多汁的，汁液丰富的；生动有趣的，妙趣横生的；值很多钱的，报酬丰厚的；充满诱惑的，吸引人的
definition: 1. adj. full of juice；2. adj. having strong sexual appeal
example: They are so juicy and l love the inside where it looks like honey, it sounds so good.
exampleZh: 它们鲜嫩多汁，看起来像想蜂蜜一样诱人。听起来太棒了。

meaning: n. 七月
definition: 1. n. the month following June and preceding August
example: Milton graduated with an MA from Cambridge University in July of 1632.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿于1632年7月从剑桥大学毕业，取得了文学硕士学位。

meaning: v. 跳，跃；跨越；快速（突然）移动；猛地一动；激增，暴涨；突然转换；略过；突然袭击（某人）；欢跃，雀跃；逃离，逃避；插（队）；马上照办；跳吃（对方的棋子）；与……性交； 侵占（他人开采权或土地）；（桥牌）跳叫；跨接起动（汽车）；n. 跳，跃；惊跳；障碍物；激增；巨变；心神不安；（桥牌）跳叫；性交；【名】 （Jump）（美）江普（人名）
definition: 1. n. a sudden and decisive increase；2. v. move forward by leaps and bounds
example: And similarly can you click on any sentence in the transcript, jump right to that point in the video.
exampleZh: 里面的任意一个句子,然后跳转到视频对应的位置。

meaning: n. （公路或铁路的）交叉口，岔道口；汇合处，交叉点；（电子）接口；连接，结合；（高速公路的）出入口；（铁路的）枢纽站，联轨站
definition: 1. a place where roads, railways, paths, rivers, etc. come together；2. in an electrical circuit (= a closed system of wires), a point where an electric current splits into different paths
example: It was near the junction of City Road and Old Street.
exampleZh: 那是在城市路与老街的交叉路口附近。

meaning: n. 六月；琼（人名）
definition: 1. n. the month following May and preceding July
example: Because they would have started with the hypothesis, not that there existed a month, but that June was particularly likely.
exampleZh: 因为他们是有了假设然后再开始做实验的，而不是说有一个这样特殊的月份，而是六月是一个特殊的月份。

meaning: n. （热带）丛林；弱肉强食的地方；杂草丛生的地方；杂乱无章的一堆；丛林音乐（一种快速舞蹈音乐）
definition: 1. n. an impenetrable equatorial forest；2. n. a location marked by an intense competition and struggle for survival
example: And we are going to be doing a lot of hiking in the jungle.
exampleZh: 我们会在丛林里做许多徒步旅行。

meaning: adj. 年龄较小的；地位（或级别）低的，资历较浅的；（体育运动）青少年的；（7-11岁的）学童的；（学校或学校的一部分) 为11或13岁以下儿童设立的；（四年制大学或中学）三年级学生的；小（用于与父亲同名者的名字之后）；n. 较年幼者，年少者；地位（或级别）较低者，下属；（高中或大学的）三年级学生；青少年运动员；男孩，（尤指）儿子；（英国的）小学生；【名】 （Junior）（美、巴、葡）尤尼奥尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. term of address for a disrespectful and annoying male；2. adj. younger; lower in rank; shorter in length of tenure or service
example: and then officially, during the spring of my junior year of high school, so my third year of high school.
exampleZh: 但后来正式决定来这里是在高三的那个春天。

meaning: n. 废旧杂物；垃圾，破烂；毫无价值的事物；毒品，（尤指）海洛因；中国式帆船；（含有鲸脑油的）抹香鲸头部纤维组织；v. 抛弃，丢掉（废旧物品）；【名】 （Junk）（德、捷）容克（人名）
definition: 1. n. the remains of something that has been destroyed or broken up；2. v. dispose of (something useless or old)
example: Men and women both said, in pretty high numbers, that they were eating more junk food then they should.
exampleZh: 不论男女,很大一部分人都回答,他们确实摄入了过量的垃圾食品

meaning: n. 司法权，审判权；管辖权；管辖区域，管辖范围
definition: 1. the authority of a court or official organization to make decisions and judgments；2. a place or area within which particular courts or official organizations have authority and where particular laws or rules apply
example: The British police have no jurisdiction over foreign bank accounts.
exampleZh: 英国警方对外国银行的账户没有司法管辖权。

meaning: n. 陪审团；（竞赛的）裁判委员会；adj. （航海时）应急的；v. 鉴定，评审（艺术品、工艺品展览会或展品）；【名】 （Jury）（英、法）朱里，（西）胡里，（德）尤里（人名）
definition: 1. n. a body of citizens sworn to give a true verdict according to the evidence presented in a court of law；2. n. a committee appointed to judge a competition
example: The speech of Socrates before the jury is perhaps the most famous attempt to put democracy itself on trial.
exampleZh: 苏格拉底面对陪审团的演说,也许是最著名的试探,意图将民主本身推向审判台。

meaning: n. 陪审员，陪审团成员；（尤指宣誓效忠的）宣誓人
definition: 1. n. someone who serves (or waits to be called to serve) on a jury
example: Another juror, Debbie Beaty, says that the science helped persuade her that Waldroup was not entirely in control of his actions.
exampleZh: 另一位陪审员，黛比·贝蒂，表示科学说服了她，她相信沃尔德鲁普不能完全控制他的行为。

meaning: adv. 正好，恰好；正当……时；不少于，同样；差一点就不，勉强；刚才，刚刚；正在，正要；只是，仅仅是；确实，完全；请，就；可能，也许；表示赞同；adj. 正义的，公平的；应得的，合理的；正确的，精确的；【名】 （Just）（英）贾斯特，（法）朱斯特，（德、匈、波、捷、挪）尤斯特，（西）胡斯特（人名）
definition: 1. adj. used especially of what is legally or ethically right or proper or fitting；2. adv. and nothing more
example: And he indicated that there are only a few just men, just, honorable men who can even hear those celestial notes.
exampleZh: 他指出只有少数正直的人，可敬的人可以听到那些天国的音符。

meaning: n. 公平，正义；公道，合理；司法，法律制裁；法官；【名】 （Justice）（英）贾斯蒂斯，贾斯蒂丝（人名）
definition: 1. n. the quality of being just or fair；2. n. the administration of law; the act of determining rights and assigning rewards or punishments
example: And I was saved, to use a Christian term, by articulations and representations of faith heroes connected with social justice.
exampleZh: 用基督教的说法，我被,信仰的表达和代表拯救了,而英雄们将这种信仰与社会正义相联系。

meaning: v. 是……的正当理由；对……作出解释，为……辩解；使（文本）对齐；（在上帝的眼中）称义，使有义；证明合法；整理版面
definition: 1. v. show to be reasonable or provide adequate ground for；2. v. show to be right by providing justification or proof
example: He's able to justify the ways of God to men here on the physical - on this intimately bodily earth.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿得以从这具体的物质的人间的角度,证明了上帝待人之法。

meaning: n. 正当理由，合理解释；证明为正当，辩护；齐行，整版；（上帝眼中的）称义
definition: 1. n. something (such as a fact or circumstance) that shows an action to be reasonable or necessary；2. n. a statement in explanation of some action or belief
example: All I can say in justification of her actions is that she was under a lot of pressure at work.
exampleZh: 我唯一能为她的行为辩解的理由是她工作压力很大。

meaning: adj. 青少年的，未成年的；少年犯的；幼稚的，孩子气的；（鸟或动物）幼年的；n. 青少年，未成年人；扮演青少年角色的演员；幼鸟，幼兽
definition: 1. relating to a young person who is not yet old enough to be considered an adult；2. affecting children rather than adults
example: She wasn't sent to the juvenile court; instead she was cautioned.
exampleZh: 她未被送上少年法庭，而是受到了警告。

meaning: adj. 渴望的，热衷的；喜爱的，着迷的；热情的，热心的；（兴趣或感情）浓厚的，强烈的；思维敏捷的，敏锐的；（目光或听觉）灵敏的；（战斗或竞争）激烈的，紧张的；（价格）低廉的，有竞争力的；寒冷刺骨的；锋利的，锐利的；（气味、光或声音）有穿透力的，强烈的，明净的；v. （为死者）恸哭，哀号；n. 痛哭，挽歌；【名】 （Keen）（英）基恩，（德）肯，（肯）金（人名）
definition: 1. n. a funeral lament sung with loud wailing；2. v. express grief verbally
example: Thus isolated, thus removed, the vision acquired an especially keen charm that made me race with all speed toward my lone gratification.
exampleZh: 如此形影相吊，如此销魂，这景色生出,一种勾人心魄的诱惑力，促使我全速跑向,我孤独的尤物。

meaning: v. （使）保持，（使）留在；继续，重复；耽搁，延误；保有，留下；存放，储存；经营，管理；保鲜；保守（秘密）；遵守；记录，记载；饲养；供养；保护；（按规定）纪念，庆祝；守门；尊重（法律或习俗）；n. 生活必需品，生活费用；城堡主楼；【名】 （Keep）（英）基普（人名）
definition: 1. n. the financial means whereby one lives；2. v. keep in a certain state, position, or activity; e.g.,
example: And, if you take all of these ideas, omnidirectional and unsaturated, it means that ions can keep glomming on.
exampleZh: 如果你注意所有的想法，无方向性和不饱和性，意味着离子能够保持攫取状态。

meaning: n. 水壶；锅；【名】 （Kettle）（英）凯特尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a metal pot for stewing or boiling; usually has a lid；2. n. the quantity a kettle will hold
example: Someone went upstairs and brought down a huge kettle.
exampleZh: 有人上楼拿下来一个巨大的水壶。

meaning: n. 钥匙；（电脑、打字机或乐器的）键；关键，要诀；答案；音调，声调；图例，符号说明；低岛，礁；扳手；销子，楔；（文章、形势等）主调，基调；（梣树、枫树或无花果树的）翼果；板条间首层灰泥；（有助于石膏等黏附的）粗糙表面；罚球区；v. 键入；成为（获胜）的关键；用钥匙划坏（汽车）；用别针（或楔子、栓）固定；将……的表面处理好；给（广告）加识别编码；adj. 关键的，主要的；【名】 （Key）（美）基（人名）
definition: 1. n. metal device shaped in such a way that when it is inserted into the appropriate lock the lock's mechanism can be rotated；2. v. identify as in botany or biology, for example
example: But what we're trying to do now is identify the key influencers in those merchant areas and make them distribution points.
exampleZh: 但我们现在努力要做的是,在商界确定,最重要的影响因素,让他们变为非配点。

meaning: n. （打字机或计算机的）键盘；（钢琴或风琴的）琴键；键盘乐器；v. 用键盘输入；用键盘操作
definition: 1. n. device consisting of a set of keys on a piano or organ or typewriter or typesetting machine or computer or the like；2. n. holder consisting of an arrangement of hooks on which keys or locks can be hung
example: You can enter text on the QWERTY keyboard or simply write on the screen.
exampleZh: 你可以用标准键盘输入文本或者直接写在屏幕上。

meaning: v. 踢，踢腿；对（自己）生气；戒除（恶习）；踢球得分；（枪）射击时后坐，朝……反冲；活跃，精力充沛；n. 踢，踢腿；极度兴奋，极大的乐趣；（毒品或酒精的）效力，刺激性；突然的猛烈震动；（枪射击时的）反冲，后坐力；（沙尘造成的）球的不规则运动；（赛跑接近终点时的）冲刺；有特定踢球能力的运动员；（一次）踢球（动作）；（玻璃瓶等的）凹底；【名】 （Kick）（英、美、德）基克（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of delivering a blow with the foot；2. v. drive or propel with the foot
example: The boy might instead kick the dog and think he hates the dog because that's a more acceptable target.
exampleZh: 孩子可能会去踢狗，觉得狗很可恨,因为狗是可以接受的替代性目标。

meaning: n. 小孩，年轻人；小山羊；小山羊皮革；v. 戏弄，开玩笑；欺骗，哄骗；（山羊）分娩；adj. 较年幼的；小山羊皮制的；【名】 （Kid）（英）基德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a young person of either sex；2. v. tell false information to for fun
example: But they were fully formed adults and intellectuals, and that was a heady experience for a kid from Chicago.
exampleZh: 但他们是很成熟的成人和知识分子，而这对一个来自芝加哥的小孩来说很不同。

meaning: v. 绑架，劫持；n. 绑架，诱拐
definition: 1. to take a person away illegally by force, usually in order to demand money in exchange for releasing them；2. the crime of taking someone away by force and demanding money in exchange for releasing them
example: Police warned that criminals might try to kidnap wealthy executives unless security procedures were strengthened.

meaning: v. 杀死；扼杀，终止；使痛苦，折磨；使减轻（疼痛）；消磨（时间），打发（时光）；使笑得前仰后合；（用开关）关闭；从文件（或计算机）中删除（行，段，文件）；（英式足球或其他球类比赛）停（球）；扣（球）；中和，抵消（效果，性质）；喝光（一瓶酒）；使倾倒，使折服；n. 杀死，捕杀；被捕杀的动物，猎物；（敌机、敌潜水艇等的）击落，击沉，撞毁；【名】 （Kill）（德）基尔（人名）

meaning: n. 种类；同类的人；特征，性质；圣餐的圣体（指面包或葡萄酒）；adj. 宽容的，体贴的，亲切友好的；温和的，无害的；关爱的，好心的（尤用于答谢语中）；【名】 （Kind）（德、法、俄、捷）金德，（瑞典）欣德（人名）

meaning: n. 君主，国王；某物之王，首屈一指者；（国际象棋中的）王；极具影响；（纸牌中的）老K；（英国）男性国王在位时使用的国歌；v. 立……为王；【名】 （King）（德、英、葡、捷、西）金，（中）金（普通话·威妥玛），（泰）京，（东南亚国家华语）京（人名）

meaning: n. 王国；自然三界之一；（神统治的）天国；管辖范围，领域；界（生物的五大类别之一）；【名】 （Kingdom）（英）金德姆（人名）

meaning: v. 亲吻，接吻；轻拂，轻触；用唇轻触（以示敬意）；（球）轻轻擦过（另一球）；n. 吻，接吻；（一球与另一球的）轻擦；【名】 （Kiss）（美、匈牙利、罗马尼亚）基什（人名）

meaning: n. 成套工具，成套设备；配套元件；全套衣服及装备；成套资料，成套材料；（尤指盛鱼的）大篮子，箱子；（尤指职业舞蹈教师用的）小型小提琴；（海狸、白鼬、貂等动物的）幼崽；v. 装备；预备；【名】 （英）基特，姬特（女名）（教名 Christopher、Katherine 的昵称），（俄）基特，（东南亚国家华语）吉（人名）

meaning: n. 厨房；一套厨具；管弦乐队中的打击乐器组；（语言）不标准的，俚俗的；【名】 （Kitchen）（英）基钦（人名）

meaning: n. 风筝；鸢（猛禽）；空头支票，非法支票；大三角帆；非法（或秘密）的信件（便条）；风筝形四边形；剥削者，掠夺者；飞机；v. 增加（费用）；飞，飞奔；使用（非法支票）骗钱，涂改（支票）；【名】 （Kit）（英）凯特，（塞）基特（人名）

meaning: n. 膝盖，膝关节；（裤子的）膝部；（坐下时）大腿朝上的面；膝盖的猛击；（木船上的）肘板，肘材；曲线图的弯曲处，拐点；v. 用膝盖顶（撞）；【名】 （Knee）（英）尼（人名）
