exampleZh: 但心理学家还不知道,为什么乌比冈效应会存在，目前有几个假设。

meaning: n. 羔羊，小羊；羊羔肉；宝贝，乖乖；v. 产羊羔；照看（产羔母羊）； 怂恿（某人）大笔花钱（尤指花钱纵酒）；【名】 （Lamb）（英）兰姆，（德）兰布（人名）
definition: 1. n. young sheep；2. v. give birth to a lamb
example: And it's virgins who get to sing the nuptial song at the wedding of the lamb that John also envisions.
exampleZh: 只有处子才可以在约翰想象,的羔羊婚礼上唱这首婚礼之歌。

meaning: adj. 瘸的，跛的，残疾的；（尤指借口或论据）站不住脚的，无说服力的；差劲的，拙劣的；幼稚的，无能的（尤指社交方面）；v. 使（人或动物）跛（瘸），使残废；n. 金银锦缎
definition: 1. n. someone who doesn't understand what is going on；2. v. deprive of the use of a limb, especially a leg
example: Then you either got nothing at all, or you got very lame responses.
exampleZh: 人们要么无言以对,要么就丢给你很没有说服力的答案。

meaning: n. 灯，光源；（用于医疗和科研的）发热灯，照射器；灵感的源泉；v. 照明，照亮；发光；灯下捕猎（尤指捕兔）；【名】 （Lamp）（英、德、匈、瑞典）兰普（人名）
definition: 1. n. an artificial source of visible illumination；2. n. a piece of furniture holding one or more electric light bulbs
example: It's the problem that sometimes people knock over an oil lamp in their home and they burn their own house down.
exampleZh: 有时候会出现这种问题,一个人把自己家里的油灯弄翻了,然后把自己的房子点着了

meaning: n. 陆地，地面；土地（尤指耕地或建筑用地）；地产，地皮；农耕，农村生活；国度，国土；想象（或虚构）的地方；（枪炮）阳膛线；v. 着陆，降落；使（飞机）平稳着陆；登陆，上岸；（从船或飞机上）卸下（货物）；落下，跌落；使陷入（困境）；（令人不快的事）突然出现；（尤指轻而易举或意外地）获得；打中（一拳）；【名】 （Land）（英、德、葡、瑞典）兰德（人名）
definition: 1. n. the land on which real estate is located；2. v. reach or come to rest
example: So, his letters come out of this western land, New Mexico, and a land of criminality, the reform school.
exampleZh: 他的信从新墨西哥这片西部的土地而来，还是寄宿学校这种犯罪滋生地。

meaning: n. 楼梯平台；着陆，降落；（军队的）登陆；码头，卸货处；【名】 （Landing）（冈、瑞典、塞内）兰丁（人名）
definition: 1. n. an intermediate platform in a staircase；2. n. structure providing a place where boats can land people or goods
example: I don't know why they make such a big deal out of the person landing on the moon.
exampleZh: 我不理解人类登月,有什么大不了的。

meaning: n. 房东，地主；（客栈、酒吧或出租公寓的）店主，老板
definition: 1. n. a landowner who leases to others
example: and the landlord or the person who owns the house or apartment wants to kick them out.
exampleZh: 房东或者房子的主人就想赶他们出去。

meaning: n. 陆标，地标；里程碑，转折点；有历史意义的建筑（或遗址）；边界，界碑；v. 赋予地标的地位；【名】 （Landmark）（瑞典、挪）兰德马克（人名）
definition: 1. a building or place that is easily recognized, especially one that you can use to judge where you are；2. an important stage in something's development
example: There are efforts under way to designate the bridge a historic landmark.
exampleZh: 在努力把这座桥定为历史地标。

meaning: n. （陆上，尤指乡村的）风景，景色；形势，情形；（陆上或乡村）风景画；横向打印格式；v. 对……做景观美化，美化……的环境；从事景观美化工作；adj. 横向列印的
definition: 1. n. an expanse of scenery that can be seen in a single view；2. v. embellish with plants
example: The Independents resented the new authoritarianism of the Presbyterians, a relatively new phenomenon on the English cultural landscape.
exampleZh: 无党派对长老派的独裁主义非常憎恨，一个相对新的在英国历史现象。

meaning: n. （乡间）小路；（用于路名）道，路；车道；（比赛的）跑道，泳道；航道，航线；（保龄球）球道；收银通道；（电泳）泳道；（尤指漩涡星系中的）暗条；（篮球的）罚球区；【名】 （Lane）（英、俄）莱恩，（老）兰，（德、法、意、葡、塞、瑞典）拉内（人名）
definition: 1. n. a narrow way or road；2. n. a well-defined track or path; for e.g. swimmers or lines of traffic
example: Lane looked faintly interrupted. "Why what?" " Why did you think it was going to go over like a lead balloon?"
exampleZh: 莱恩微弱的问，什么为什么“,为什么你认为它像一个领头气球“

meaning: n. 语言，语言文字；言语，说话；（某一领域的）全部词汇，术语；计算机语言；语言风格，措辞；粗话，脏话；（使用手势、动作或声音的）表达方式
definition: 1. n. a systematic means of communicating by the use of sounds or conventional symbols；2. n. (language) communication by word of mouth
example: By the way, in what I'm saying, I oversimplify by supposing that the basic unit of language is a word.
exampleZh: 因为我想说的是，我们现在是把语言的基本单位简单化了。

meaning: n. （人坐下时的）大腿面，膝上；（比赛中的）一圈；一段旅程；水流冲刷；重叠部分；折皱；（线绳缠绕）一圈；（研磨机）磨盘；抛光工具；（裙装）下摆；（马鞍）翘边；v. （水）轻拍，轻打；（动物）舔，舐；领先一圈（或数圈）；使部分重叠；用精研机抛光；欣然接受；【名】 （Lap）（越）拉普（人名）
definition: 1. n. the upper side of the thighs of a seated person；2. v. lie partly over or alongside of something or of one another
example: I dreamed myself was pretty Paris, plucked by Aphrodite from the field and dropped into Helen's naked lap.
exampleZh: 我梦见我自己是帅气的帕里斯，被阿弗洛狄特,从地上拽起来，跌落到海伦的裸露的两腿之间。

meaning: n. 膝上型计算机，便携式电脑（=laptop computer）
definition: 1. n. a portable computer small enough to use in your lap
example: It is significantly more compact than any comparable laptop, with no loss in functionality.
exampleZh: 它比其它任何一台同类的笔记本电脑都更便于携带，并且在功能性上无任何差别。

meaning: adj. （尺寸、范围、容量）大的；广泛的，重要的；身材高大的；（公司或组织）大规模的；n. 大号，同类中最大者；v. （尤指跳舞和饮酒）作乐，狂欢；adv. 夸大地；大大地；【名】 （Large）（英）拉奇，（法）拉尔热（人名）
definition: 1. n. a garment size for a large person；2. adj. above average in size or number or quantity or magnitude or extent
example: We're moving into the large on-term across next term where we'll teach 600 students in six sections, of about 100 each.
exampleZh: 我们准备下学期,搬去更大的地方,就能一次教六个班的学生，每个班100人左右。

meaning: adv. 很大程度上，主要地
definition: 1. adv. in large part; mainly or chiefly；2. adv. on a large scale
example: Indeed the major strides in prevention have largely come from a perspective focused " on systematically building competency,not correcting weakness."
exampleZh: 事实上，在预防方面取得的重大进展,基本上来自一个观点,也就是注重培养能力，而非改正错误“

meaning: n. 激光（器）；v. 使用激光器；【名】 （Laser）（德）拉泽（人名）
definition: 1. n. an acronym for light amplification by stimulated emission of radiation; an optical device that produces an intense monochromatic beam of coherent light
example: The print quality of the new laser printer is superb.
exampleZh: 新激光打印机的打印质量好极了。

meaning: v. 猛击，狠打；鞭打，抽打；怒斥，抨击；捆绑，捆扎；煽动，激励；（动物）用力甩动（尾巴）；n. 睫毛；鞭打（尤作为惩罚）；突然（猛烈）的一甩；责骂，讽刺；鞭梢；【名】 （Lash）（英）拉希（人名）
definition: 1. to hit with a lot of force；2. to criticize someone severely
example: She went quiet for a moment while she summoned up the words to lash him.
exampleZh: 她沉默了一会儿，想了些话来怒斥他。

meaning: n. 小女孩，姑娘；女佣；【名】 （Lass）（德、俄、捷）拉斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a girl or young woman who is unmarried
example: Catherine Linton, my bonnie lass, I shall be from home all this week.
exampleZh: 凯瑟琳·林惇，我的好姑娘，这一个礼拜我都不在家。

meaning: adj. 最后的；最近的，上一个的；最后剩下的；最不可能的；最末的；仅存的；最不重要的，最无关紧要的；最后遇见的；v. 持续；持久；维持，够用；坚持，支撑下去；n. 鞋楦；仅剩下的部分（或事项）；最后来的人（或发生的事）（the last）；残余，剩余（the last of）；末尾；结束，最后时刻（尤指死亡）（the last）；最后一次提及，最后一次看见（the last）；pron. 最近发生的事情；最后的人或事物；最后的人；最后一次；最后的动作，最后的话；用于指最新获得的消息；adv. 最近，上次；最后；（用于引出最后的话或信息）最后，最后一点；【名】 （Last）（美、德）拉斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the temporal end; the concluding time；2. v. persist for a specified period of time
example: At last they were agreeing, at last they were getting somewhere.
exampleZh: 最终他们取得了一致，最终他们取得了一些进展。

meaning: adv. 最后（一点）
definition: 1. adv. the item at the end
example: Lastly, I would like to thank my parents for all their support.
exampleZh: 最后，我想感谢父母对我的全力支持。

meaning: adj. 晚期的，末期的；晚的，迟的；近日暮的，近深夜的；已故的；不久前的，最近的；adv. 晚，迟；（时间上）接近终了，在晚年；临近日暮，接近午夜；（时间上）接近终了，临近末了，在晚年
definition: 1. adj. being or occurring at an advanced period of time or after a usual or expected time；2. adv. later than usual or than expected
example: Beginning in the late 1630s at the moment in which Lycidas is being written, Milton is becoming increasingly radical.
exampleZh: 在17世纪30年代的晚期,即的创作时期，弥尔顿正变得愈发的激进和极端。

meaning: adv. 后来，随后；再见，回头见；adj. 较晚的，以后的；较新式的，较现代的；晚期的，末期的；【名】 （Later）（德）拉特（人名）
definition: 1. adj. coming at a subsequent time or stage；2. adv. happening at a time subsequent to a reference time
example: Test 1 will be a week from Wednesday, and I will say something about that later in the week.
exampleZh: 测试1从周三开始，持续一周，我会在之后的一周跟你们说一些东西。

meaning: adv. 近来，最近；新近卸任，最近离任
definition: 1. adv. in the recent past
example: You've been working so hard lately and you finally get a few minutes to yourself. So, you can go to the club.
exampleZh: 最近你工作非常辛苦，现在终于有一点时间留给自己。所以，你可以去夜店放松一下。

meaning: n. 纬度；纬度地区；选择的自由，回旋余地；（感光乳剂，相纸）曝光宽容度
definition: 1. the position north or south of the equator measured from 0° to 90°；2. an area near to a particular latitude
example: Each card has not only a date but the latitude, longitude, salinity, temperatures, and depth of each data point.
exampleZh: 每个卡片不仅记有日期，还有每个数据点的纬度、经度、盐度、温度和深度。

meaning: adj. （两者之中的）后者的；末期的，后期的；n. （两者之间的）后者（the latter）；【名】 （Latter）（英、德、捷）拉特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the second of two or the second mentioned of two；2. adj. referring to the second of two things or persons mentioned (or the last one or ones of several)
example: The exercises can be fun and a good warm-up for the latter part of the programme.
exampleZh: 这些练习很有趣，还可以为后面的课程做热身准备。

meaning: v. 笑，发笑；嘲笑，不以为然；愉悦地说；用嘲笑使（某人）离开；（特别表示因成功而）处于有利地位；n. 笑，笑声；令人开心的时刻；引人发笑的人或事，笑料
definition: 1. n. the sound of laughing；2. v. produce laughter
example: Like, I guess just sitting and watching The Simpsons, it's entertaining because they make jokes and they make us laugh.
exampleZh: 我觉得如果单看《辛普森一家》,确实很有乐趣，因为它很搞笑，令人捧腹。

meaning: n. 笑，笑声
definition: 1. n. the sound of laughing；2. n. the activity of laughing; the manifestation of joy or mirth or scorn
example: I tried to negotiate a laugh track so that if the jokes don't work we can superimpose some laughter.
exampleZh: 罐头笑声,《老友记》等喜剧类美剧中常用的笑声录音

meaning: v. 发动，发起；上市，发行；使（船或舰）下水；发射（武器或宇宙飞船）；启动（计算机程序）；投出，用力扔出；使投身于（事业等）；起飞，出海；n. （航天器的）发射；（产品的）上市；（事件的）发起；汽艇，游艇；（新产品，出版物）发布会，推介会
definition: 1. n. a motorboat with an open deck or a half deck；2. v. set up or found
example: With any innovation, it's important not only to launch it properly but also to consider how to sustain it over time.
exampleZh: 对于任何发明，重要的不仅仅是,正确的使用它，还要考虑,怎样维护它。

meaning: n. 待洗（或正在洗涤、洗完）的衣物；洗衣房，洗衣店；洗衣物，洗衣物的活
definition: 1. n. garments or white goods that can be cleaned by laundering；2. n. workplace where clothes are washed and ironed
example: But now I have to carry all the laundry down the street to another building to do it there,
exampleZh: 但现在我得把所有的衣服拿到街上的另一个楼里去洗。

meaning: n. 盥洗室，厕所；（洗手间内的）洗脸盆，洗手池
definition: 1. n. a room or building equipped with one or more toilets；2. n. a bathroom sink that is permanently installed and connected to a water supply and drainpipe; where you can wash your hands and face
example: There's an alcove with a small sink and mirror, and a door to the tiny, but private lavatory.
exampleZh: 壁龛里有一个小洗脸盆和一面镜子，还有一扇门通往一个微型但私用的盥洗室。

meaning: adj. 奢侈的，盛大的；慷慨的，大方的；v. 慷慨（或过度）给予
definition: 1. large in quantity and expensive or impressive；2. very generous
example: He was lavish in his praise for her paintings.
exampleZh: 他大力赞扬她的绘画。

meaning: n. 法律（体系）；法令，法规；规律，法则，定律；法学，法律学；司法界，律师业；（道德或宗教上的）准则，守则；警方，警察；v. 起诉，控告；【名】 （Law）（英、缅、柬）劳（人名）
definition: 1. n. legal document setting forth rules governing a particular kind of activity；2. n. the collection of rules imposed by authority
example: Now the first law is going to hold in all of these steps, and we're going around in a cycle.
exampleZh: 现在热力学第一定律,就蕴含在这所有的步骤里了，我们沿着这个循环走。

meaning: adj. 合法的，法律许可的；法定的
definition: 1. adj. conformable to or allowed by law；2. adj. according to custom or rule or natural law
example: However, he will not go until he receives the lawful signal.
exampleZh: 然而，在收到合法的信号之前，他是不会走的。

meaning: n. 草坪，草地；上等细棉布，上等细麻布；【名】 （Lawn）（缅）朗（人名）
definition: 1. n. a field of cultivated and mowed grass
example: She ran swiftly over the lawn to the gate.
exampleZh: 她轻快地跑过草坪，来到大门口。

meaning: n. 诉讼，诉讼案
definition: 1. a problem taken to a law court by an ordinary person or an organization rather than the police in order to obtain a legal decision；2. a disagreement between people or organizations that is brought to a court of law for a decision
example: He was perpetually involving himself in this long lawsuit.
exampleZh: 他使自己无休止地卷入这场长时间的诉讼。

meaning: n. 律师；v. 从事法律工作，当律师；（律师）处理法律事务；【名】 (Lawyer)（英）劳耶（人名）
definition: 1. n. a professional person authorized to practice law; conducts lawsuits or gives legal advice
example: Now the point here isn't it's funny, other than of course--it's obvious more, which is the lawyer has more wrongs.
exampleZh: 重点不在于好笑，而是，很明显的，这个律师犯了更多错。

meaning: v. 安放，放置；铺放，铺设；下（蛋），产（卵）；摆放（餐具）；提出，提交；使处于特定状态；制定计划或设圈套；下赌注；安排，决定（戏剧、小说情节）的场景；阻止（某物）从地面扬起；安葬（某人）；使倒伏，击倒；（摆好木、柴或煤）生火；沿（特定航线）航行；修整，编整（树篱）；与（某人）性交；n. 诗，民歌；（某物的）位置，方向；地势，地貌；（捻绳索时每股的）捻向；产卵，产卵期；性伙伴；adj. 外行的，非专业的；平信徒的，在俗的；v. 躺；平放；存在，在于（lie 的过去式）
definition: 1. n. a narrative song with a recurrent refrain；2. v. put into a certain place or abstract location
example: Now, the historical value of the Exodus story has fascinated scholars, but also lay people, for generations.
exampleZh: 现在，《出埃及记》故事的历史价值引起了学者的兴趣，但也挫败了世世代代的人们。

meaning: n. 层；层次，等级；摆放者，铺设者，产卵者；压条；v. 分层放置；把（头发）分层剪短；用压条培育（植物）
definition: 1. n. single thickness of usually some homogeneous substance；2. v. make or form a layer
example: there are many genes that are already expressed and presented in this dimpling and thickening of the outer layer.
exampleZh: 在外胚层的凹陷和增厚过程中,表达了很多基因。

meaning: n. 外行，门外汉；（基督教中的）平信徒；【名】 （Layman）（英）莱曼（人名）
definition: 1. someone who is part of a religious organization but who is not paid or specially trained；2. someone who is not trained in or does not have a detailed knowledge of a particular subject
example: The subject matter was so technical as to be beyond the ken of the average layman.
exampleZh: 该主题专业性太强，一般的外行人很难理解。

meaning: n. 解雇，下岗；休养，停工期
definition: 1. n. the act of laying off an employee or a work force
example: Switching to a new career is difficult and getting reemployed after a layoff is even tougher.
exampleZh: 转换到新职业是困难的，裁员后重新就业更加艰难。

meaning: n. 布局，设计；版面编排，版面设计；布置的东西，陈列品
definition: 1. n. a plan or design of something that is laid out；2. n. the act of laying out (as by making plans for something)
example: A diagram of the new road layout was superimposed on a map of the city.
exampleZh: 新公路的规划示意图被叠映在该城市的地图上。

meaning: adj. 懒惰的，不愿工作的；悠闲的，懒洋洋的；粗心的，马虎的；行进缓慢的，慢吞吞的；（牲口身上的烙印）打在一侧的；vi. 懒散地移动或躺下；【名】 （Lazy）（德）拉齐（人名）
definition: 1. adj. moving slowly and gently；2. adj. disinclined to work or exertion
example: I was being a little lazy on Wednesday in the interest of simplifying the code as much as possible.
exampleZh: 在周三我在那个网站上尽可能地,简化代码的时候，我有点偷懒。

meaning: n. 怠惰，无精打采
definition: 1. n. inactivity resulting from a dislike of work；2. n. relaxed and easy activity
example: It's laziness, pure and simple.
exampleZh: 这全然是懒惰。

meaning: v. 引领，带路；通向，通往；（与……）相连，相通；领导，指挥；导致，造成；促使，使得；过（某种生活）；领先，居于首位；开牌；对（证人）进行诱询；用水砣测深；n. 领先地位；超前量，领先的距离；范例，榜样；线索；主角，扮演主角的演员；铅；铅笔芯；狗绳，牵狗带；（报纸或电台的）要闻，头条；子弹；电线，导线；导语；（投球前跑垒员的）离垒；螺距，牙距；水渠，水道；行间距；【名】 （Lead）（英）利德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a soft heavy toxic malleable metallic element; bluish white when freshly cut but tarnishes readily to dull grey；2. v. take somebody somewhere
example: I think if we force people to vote, it would not lead to a good result.
exampleZh: 如果我们采取强制投票，结果也不会多好。

meaning: n. 领导者，首领；领先者，佼佼者；首席小提琴手；指挥；社论；（报纸的）要闻，头条；（胶卷，磁带的）空白段；（渔线）接钩绳；（植物的）顶枝；（尤指表格中的）指向符；【名】 （Leader）（英）利德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person who rules or guides or inspires others；2. n. a featured article of merchandise sold at a loss in order to draw customers
example: Con Markievicz was the only surviving leader of the Easter Rising, condemned to death, but then her sentence was transmuted.
exampleZh: 马克维其是复活节起义唯一,幸存的领袖，被判了死刑，但后来判决又改变了。

meaning: n. 领导，领导地位；领导才能；领导人员，领导层；领先地位
definition: 1. n. the activity of leading；2. n. the body of people who lead a group
example: Its principal good, its principal goal, was the education of citizens for positions of public leadership and high political responsibilities.
exampleZh: 它的首要优点及目标，就是公民教育,训练公共领袖人员,及高标的政治责任。

meaning: adj. 主要的，最重要的；在（比赛或行列中）首位的，居前的；n. 行距；领导；（用于屋顶的）铅皮，铅板；v. 领导（lead 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. thin strip of metal used to separate lines of type in printing；2. adj. indicating the most important performer or role
example: It was a thorough examination of that problematic leading to the conclusion that that's what the myth was about.
exampleZh: 他的解读是对这个问题的彻底考察,最终得出这个神话是关于什么。

meaning: n. 叶，叶子；纸页，书页；薄金属片，（尤指金或银）箔；活动桌板；（窗，门等）扇；空心墙（或双层窗）的内面（或外面）；v. 长新叶；【名】 （Leaf）（英）利夫（人名）
definition: 1. n. the main organ of photosynthesis and transpiration in higher plants；2. v. look through a book or other written material
example: It looks like a leaf. It is nature in its aesthetic form as imitation of itself, life as an imitation of life.
exampleZh: 它看起来像一片树叶，它是艺术,化的自然，模仿着它自己，用生命模仿生命。

meaning: n. 传单，小册子；小叶，初生叶（统称）；v. 散发传单（或小册子）
definition: 1. a piece of paper that gives you information or advertises something；2. to give out leaflets to people
example: PS Please show your friends this letter and the enclosed leaflet.
exampleZh: 又及：请将这封信和随附的传单拿给你的朋友们看。

meaning: n. 联盟，同盟；（体育项目）联合会，社团；联赛；级别，水平；里格（旧时长度单位，约等于5公里）；v. （与……）组成联盟，加入联盟；【名】 （League）（英）利格（人名）
definition: 1. n. an association of sports teams that organizes matches for its members；2. v. unite to form a league
example: This data comes half from the Italian league, which is pretty good and half from the French league, which sucks.
exampleZh: 这些数据一半来自强队意大利队,一半来自弱队法国队

meaning: v. 渗入，漏出；漏，渗漏；泄露，透露；n. 漏洞，裂缝；泄漏出的液体（或气体）；泄密；撒尿；【名】 （Leak）（美、印尼、新等）利克（人名）
definition: 1. n. an accidental hole that allows something (fluid or light etc.) to enter or escape；2. v. tell anonymously
example: The sky leaked all over all of it, and then it began to leak in to the car.
exampleZh: 天空就像四处在漏水，然后车里开始进水。

meaning: v. （身体）倾斜；倾向于做；倚靠，靠在；adj. 瘦且健康的；（肉）瘦的，脂肪少的；不景气的，贫乏的；精简的，效率高的；（混合汽化燃料）空气所占比例高的，稀化的；n. 倾斜，歪曲；瘦肉；【名】 （Lean）（丹）利恩（人名）
definition: 1. n. the property possessed by a line or surface that departs from the vertical；2. v. to incline or bend from a vertical position
example: What I mean is that this tool doesn't speak loudly; it whispers, and you have to lean forward to hear it.
exampleZh: 我是说那种工具声音不会很大;,它是低语的，你不得不倾身细听。

meaning: v. 猛冲，突然而迅速地移动；剧增，猛涨；赶紧抓住（机会）；（心）猛跳；跳，跳跃；n. 跳跃，跳高；骤变，激增；（对新事物的）认真尝试；【名】 （Leap）（美、法、英）莱亚（人名）
definition: 1. n. a light, self-propelled movement upwards or forwards；2. v. move forward by leaps and bounds
example: She took a flying leap and landed on the other side of the stream.
exampleZh: 她一个飞跃跳到小溪的对面。

meaning: v. 学习，学会；得知，获悉；背熟，熟记；认识到，（从……）吸取教训；教导（某人）
definition: 1. v. gain knowledge or skills；2. v. get to know or become aware of, usually accidentally
example: Learn it and master this and master all of these steps and you will master the English language step by step.
exampleZh: 掌握这一句型以及其他所有句型，你就能一步一步地说一口流利的英语了。

meaning: adj. 博学的；学术性的，学者的；后天的，习得的；v. 学习，学会；得知，获悉；背熟，熟记；认识到，（从……）吸取教训 （learn 的过去式和过去分词）；【名】 （Learned）（美）勒尼德（人名）
definition: 1. adj. having or showing profound knowledge；2. adj. highly educated; having extensive information or understanding
example: The conclusion of this parable seems so violent perhaps because the lesson to be learned from the parable is so uncertain.
exampleZh: 这个故事的结尾看起来太残酷了,可能因为这个寓言想要教给我们的东西太不确定。

meaning: n. 学习；知识，学问；v. 学习，学会；得知，获悉；背熟，熟记；认识到，（从……）吸取教训 （learn 的现在分词）
definition: 1. n. the cognitive process of acquiring skill or knowledge；2. n. profound scholarly knowledge
example: Some of the schools that they rate and say that kids are not learning and the tests are too easy.
exampleZh: 他们评价一些学校的时候，发现孩子们没有学习，并且考试太容易了。

meaning: n. 学习者，初学者；（驾驶）学车者；（Learner）人名（勒纳）
definition: 1. n. someone (especially a child) who learns (as from a teacher) or takes up knowledge or beliefs；2. n. works for an expert to learn a trade
example: For the adult learner, the technology has the capability of freeing us in terms of time and space.
exampleZh: 对成年学习者而言，技术能够让我们免受,时间和空间的限制。

meaning: n. 租约，租契；v. 出租，租用
definition: 1. n. property that is leased or rented out or let；2. v. let for money
example: The lease plainly states that all damage must be paid for.
exampleZh: 租约明确规定，一切损坏必须赔偿。

meaning: adj. 一点儿；最少的（little 的最高级）；最微不足道的（little 的最高级形式）；用于极小动植物的名称，如least shrew（little 的最高级形式）；adv. 最低程度地；最少，至少；n. 最不重要的事物，最微小的事物；至少，起码；pron. 最少量；起码；det. 最少的，最小的
definition: 1. n. something that is of no importance；2. adj. the superlative of `little' that can be used with mass nouns and is usually preceded by `the'; a quantifier meaning smallest in amount or extent or degree
example: Now we can't neglect the first question here, which is at least for me: did Milton really believe this?
exampleZh: 现在至少对我来说，我们不能忽略一个问题：,弥尔顿真的信这个吗？

meaning: n. 皮，皮革；（骑摩托车穿的）皮衣，皮夹克；v. 抽打；【名】 （Leather）（英）莱瑟（人名）
definition: 1. n. an animal skin made smooth and flexible by removing the hair and then tanning；2. v. beat with a lather strap
example: I've been looking for a nice leather jacket for a couple of months in this city,
exampleZh: 我已经在这个城市花好几个月的时间找一件不错的皮夹克了。
exampleSource: I can't help but 实战

meaning: v. 离开（某人或某处）；离开居住地点（或群体、工作单位等）；与……脱离关系， 离开（某人）；不立刻做，不马上处理；使保留，让……处于（某种状态、某地等）；给……留下（不愉快的东西）；留下（信息或答复）；遗留，遗忘；剩下（食物或饮料）；遗下（家人）；（去世时）遗赠，遗留；把……留交，交托；递送，递交；留（空隙或空白）；留给（指有限的机会）；不再谈论；（数学）剩余，余下；n. 假期，休假；准许，许可；（斯努克、槌球等）收盘球势，（球被击后）停留的位置
definition: 1. n. the period of time during which you are absent from work or duty；2. v. go away from a place
example: and that's spreading. This prosperity preaching is going on in Africa. And my question is, where does that leave suffering?
exampleZh: 这种劲头越来越大，这种追求繁荣的论调,甚至在非洲都出现了，我想问的是，在这样的大背景下，受苦还能存在么？

meaning: n. 讲座，讲课，演讲；训斥，告诫；v. （尤指在大学里）开讲座，讲课；训斥，告诫
definition: 1. n. a speech that is open to the public；2. v. deliver a lecture or talk
example: The goal is by 2005, they have all the large lecture courses in MIT physics taught in this format.
exampleZh: 我们的目标是到200年，能使所有的大型讲座课,都能用这种方式讲授。

meaning: n. 讲授者，讲演者；（大学的）讲师
definition: 1. n. a public lecturer at certain universities；2. n. someone who lectures professionally
example: I have to say that Shelly Kagan is probably the best lecturer I had in my four years at Yale."
exampleZh: 我不得不说薛立·卡刚很可能是,我在耶鲁四年所遇到的最好的演讲者“

meaning: adj. 左边的；剩余的；左派的，左翼的；adv. 在左面，向左；n. 左侧，左方（the left）；左边的道路，左侧的通道；（认为应将财产、金钱和权力更平等地分配的）左翼人士，左派组织（the Left）；（尤指拳击中的）左手拳；（在足球或类似运动中面向对手球门的）左半场；（军队的）左翼；v. 离开（某人或某处）；抛弃，丢弃；不立刻做（leave 的过去式和过去分词）
definition: 1. n. location near or direction toward the left side; i.e. the side to the north when a person or object faces east；2. adj. being or located on or directed toward the side of the body to the west when facing north
example: Okay so exchange numbers; okay good half of that problem is gone now we have just these two left.
exampleZh: 好，交换数字,好，问题解决一半了,只剩你们两个了。

meaning: n. 左派人士，左翼分子；adj. 左派的，左翼的
definition: 1. n. a person who belongs to the political left；2. adj. believing in or supporting tenets of the political left
example: The works created when DING stayed in the League of Leftist Writers and Yenan illustrate that she tried to voice on behalf of women in the limited discourse space.
exampleZh: 从丁玲在左联、延安时期创作的一些文本可以看出，丁玲试图从女性的角度在有限的话语空间内表达出自己的声音。

meaning: n. 腿；动物腿，腿肉；裤腿；家具的腿，支撑柱条；（旅程或赛程的）一段，一程；（球，尤指高尔夫球）力度不够；（产品或想法的）持久流行或成功；（板球）腿侧区；叉状物的一分支；屈膝礼；comb. 有……腿的(-legged)；v. （撑船者）用腿蹬洞顶或洞壁使（船）通过运河隧洞
definition: 1. n. a human limb; commonly used to refer to a whole limb but technically only the part of the limb between the knee and ankle；2. n. a structure in animals that is similar to a human leg and used for locomotion
example: So if you have a bad heart, then a scientist can take like, cells from your leg,
exampleZh: 所以，如果你心脏不好，科学家就可以从你的腿上提取干细胞，

meaning: n. 遗产，遗赠物；遗留问题，后遗症；adj. （软件或硬件）已过时但因使用范围广而难以替代的
definition: 1. money or property that you receive from someone after they die；2. something that is a part of your history or that remains from an earlier time
example: The book proved such a success that the authors followed it up with "The Messianic Legacy."
exampleZh: 该书获得了如此大的成功，以至作者随后又出了一本《天主的遗产》。

meaning: adj. 法律允许的，合法的；与法律有关的，法律的；（与衡平法相对）普通法或成文法确认的；神学律法的，与神学律法有关的；（纸张）标准大小的；【名】 （Legal）（法）勒加尔（人名）
definition: 1. adj. established by or founded upon law or official or accepted rules；2. adj. of or relating to jurisprudence
example: I give them legal advice and legal representation, and go to court with them and all sorts of things.
exampleZh: 我会给他们一些法律方面的建议，做他们的法定代理人，陪同他们去法院诉讼等等。

meaning: v. 使合法化，使得到法律认可
definition: 1. v. make legal
example: West Germany, by contrast, will not be able to legalize any form of euthanasia for a long time to come.
exampleZh: 与之相反，西德在未来相当长的时间里都无法使任何形式的安乐死合法化。

meaning: n. 传说，传奇故事；传奇人物；（标志、徽记、硬币等物品上的）刻印文字，铭文；（图片或地图的）文字说明，图例；adj. 十分出名的；【名】 （Legend）（英）莱金德，（西）莱亨德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a story about mythical or supernatural beings or events；2. n. brief description accompanying an illustration
example: Into My Own" . "Legend": "the youth is persuaded that he will be rather more than less himself for having foresworn the world."
exampleZh: 进入自我“，“传奇“,“这个少年被劝诱，如果他放弃世界,他将不再是他自己“

meaning: adj. 非常有名的，大名鼎鼎的；传说（中）的
definition: 1. adj. so celebrated as to having taken on the nature of a legend；2. adj. celebrated in fable or legend
example: The hill is supposed to be the resting place of the legendary King Lud.
exampleZh: 这座山据说是传说中的路德国王休息的地方。

meaning: v. 通过立法实施；制定法律，立法
definition: 1. v. make laws, bills, etc. or bring into effect by legislation
example: They promised to legislate to protect people's right to privacy.
exampleZh: 他们承诺立法保护公民的隐私权。

meaning: n. 法规，法律；立法，制订法律
definition: 1. n. law enacted by a legislative body；2. n. the act of making or enacting laws
example: We take, um, legislation and regulation, which is sort of how our agencies work in Washington D.C.,
exampleZh: 我们还学习立法和规章，学习华盛顿特区的政治部门是如何做这些工作的，

meaning: adj. 立法的；（与）立法机关（有关）的
definition: 1. n. persons who make or amend or repeal laws；2. adj. relating to a legislature or composed of members of a legislature
example: Today's hearing was just the first step in the legislative process.
exampleZh: 今天的听证会仅仅是立法程序的第一步。

meaning: n. 立法者，立法委员
definition: 1. n. someone who makes or enacts laws
example: Last month Austin Badon, another state legislator, dropped out because he was finding it hard to raise money.
exampleZh: 上个月，另一位州议会议员Austin Badon也因筹款困难而退出。

meaning: adj. 正当的，合理的；合法的，依法的；合法婚姻所生的；（君主）有合法王位继承权的；（与音乐喜剧、滑稽剧相对）正剧的；v. 使合法化，使正当化
definition: 1. allowed by law；2. reasonable and acceptable
example: The government said that it has suspended all aid to Haiti until that country's legitimate government is restored.
exampleZh: 政府说它已经暂停对海地的所有援助，直到海地恢复合法政府为止。

meaning: n. 合法性，合理性
definition: 1. the quality of being legal；2. the quality of being reasonable and acceptable
example: Sampras beat Carl-Uwe Steeb by 6-1, 6-2, 6-1 to underline the legitimacy of his challenge for the title.
exampleZh: 桑普拉斯以6比1、6比2和6比1战胜了卡尔-尤韦·斯蒂布，证明了他挑战冠军头衔的合理性。

meaning: n. 闲暇，业余时间；休闲活动；adj. 空闲的，有闲的；业余的；【名】 （Leisure）（英）莱热（人名）
definition: 1. n. time available for ease and relaxation；2. n. freedom to choose a pastime or enjoyable activity
example: What is work and leisure now in a society where you don't have to produce everything for yourself?
exampleZh: 在这个社会你不用为自己生产一切,工作和闲暇又意味着什么呢

meaning: adj. 慢悠悠的，不慌不忙的；adv. 从容地，闲适地
definition: 1. adj. not hurried or forced；2. adv. in an unhurried way or at one's convenience
example: You can adjust those grades, let's leave it until next week and we can take it at a leisurely pace.
exampleZh: 你可以更正你的成绩，让我们一直延续到下周,我们可以在一个休闲的地方。

meaning: n. 柠檬；柠檬汁；柠檬色；柠檬树（=lemon tree）；蹩脚的人（或物）；adj. 柠檬色的；【名】 （Lemon）（美）莱蒙（人名）
definition: 1. n. yellow oval fruit with juicy acidic flesh；2. n. a strong yellow color
example: Grilled trout needs only a squeeze of lemon.
exampleZh: 烤鳟鱼只需要一点柠檬榨汁。

meaning: n. 柠檬味汽水；柠檬汁
definition: 1. n. sweetened beverage of diluted lemon juice
example: I wonder if there's any fizz left in the lemonade.
exampleZh: 我想知道这柠檬汽水中还有没有气泡。

meaning: v. 借给，借出；贷出，贷（款）；给……增加，增添（特色）；给予，提供（帮助、支持等）；使适合，使易遭受；【名】 （Lend）（德）伦德（人名）
definition: 1. v. bestow a quality on；2. v. give temporarily; let have for a limited time
example: Why don't I lend some of it out and I can earn interest on the loan and make money.
exampleZh: 为什么我不贷一部分出去呢,这样我就可以通过贷款赚利息了

meaning: adj. 仁慈的，宽大的；柔和的，平静的；【名】 （Lenient）（法）勒尼安（人名）
definition: 1. not as severe or strong in punishment or judgment as would be expected
example: There is little evidence that harsher punishments deter any better than more lenient ones.
exampleZh: 甚少证据显示严惩比宽大更能遏止犯罪。

meaning: n. 仁慈，宽大；宽大（或温和）的行为
definition: 1. treatment in which someone is punished or judged less strongly or severely than would be expected
example: The judge rejected pleas for leniency and sentenced him to a year in prison.
exampleZh: 法官驳回了宽大处理的请求，判处他一年的监禁。

meaning: n. 透镜，镜片；（相机的）镜头；（眼球的）晶状体；隐形眼镜；v. 给……摄影
definition: 1. n. a transparent optical device used to converge or diverge transmitted light and to form images；2. n. genus of small erect or climbing herbs with pinnate leaves and small inconspicuous white flowers and small flattened pods: lentils
example: Opacity of the eye lens can be induced by deficiency of certain vitamins.
exampleZh: 眼球晶状体的混浊可由缺乏某些维生素引起。

meaning: adj. 女同性恋的；n. 女同性恋者
definition: 1. a woman who is sexually or romantically attracted to other women；2. belonging or relating to women who are sexually or romantically attracted to other women
example: is that a lot of the people who I know who are gay or lesbian and have homosexual activity,
exampleZh: 我认识很多男女性同性恋者，

meaning: adv. 更少地，程度较低地；det. （与不可数名词连用）较少的，更少的；prep. 减去，扣除；pron. 更少，较小；更小（或更无关紧要）的事物；adj. 等级较低的，次要的；【名】 （Less）（美、加拿大）莱斯（人名）
definition: 1. adj. (comparative of `little' usually used with mass nouns) a quantifier meaning not as great in amount or degree；2. adv. used to form the comparative of some adjectives and adverbs
example: Yeats is, in fact, a far less nostalgic thinker than either Eliot or Pound, at least as I understand them.
exampleZh: 其实叶芝不如,艾略特或庞德那么怀旧，至少我是这么理解的。

meaning: n. 一节课，一课时；教学单元，（课本中的）课；经验，教训；（教堂礼拜中的）《圣经》选读；vt. 给……上课；教训，训诫
definition: 1. n. a unit of instruction；2. n. punishment intended as a warning to others

exampleZh: 这个故事的结尾看起来太残酷了,可能因为这个寓言想要教给我们的东西太不确定。

meaning: conj. 以免，避免；唯恐，担心
definition: 1. in order to prevent something; for fear that

example: "That is not Michael," she said quickly, lest a judgment should fall on her.
exampleZh: “那不是迈克尔。”她赶快说，以免判决落在她身上。

meaning: v. 允许，准许，同意；使通过；任由，随；（用于提出建议或表示赞同）让我们；（提出帮助时说）让，由；（用于引出命令）要；但愿；（用于引出要说的话）让我（们）来；（计算时说）假设，设；（表示犹豫或思考）让我想想；（表示认为某人应该做某事）让；出租（房屋或土地）；（将工程）承包给某一竞标者； 妨碍，阻碍；n. 擦网球，触网重发；出租，租借；待租房，可出租房产；障碍；【名】 （Let）（缅）莱，（俄）莱特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the most brutal terrorist group active in Kashmir; fights against India with the goal of restoring Islamic rule of India；2. v. make it possible through a specific action or lack of action for something to happen
example: On the right hand side, the work, let's call this left hand side, let's call this right hand side.
exampleZh: 在右手边，让我们先在这里,标下标表示左手，这里示右手。

meaning: n. 信，信函；字母；（缝制在运动服上的）校运动队首字母标志；（代表学位或职位等资格的）首字母缩略词（letters）；文学；法律文书，正式文书（letters）；字面确切含义；（印刷）一种铅字字体； 学识，渊博的学问；v. 用字母标注；把字母印刷（或缝制等）于；赢得学校运动队的字母标志；【名】 （Letter）（美、英、巴西）莱特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a written message addressed to a person or organization；2. v. win an athletic letter
example: Look now, and this is on the handout, at the letter that Milton had written to his friend, Charles Diodati.
exampleZh: 现在看讲义上,弥尔顿写给朋友查尔斯·迪奥达蒂的信。

meaning: n. 数量，程度；标准，水平；层次，级别；看待（或应对、理解）事物的方式；水平高度，相对高度；楼层；平地；水平仪；adj. 平坦的，水平的；相同价值的，相同地位的；比分相同的；平静的，冷静的；v. 使平整；推倒，夷平；（使）比分相同；（尤指用枪）瞄准；针对……（进行批评等）；稳定下来，达到平衡（level off）；坦诚相见；作水准测量；【名】 （Level）（法）勒韦尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a position on a scale of intensity or amount or quality；2. v. aim at
example: C So, that's the breakdown. And, the grade is C level, 50% and it's based upon a performance of 50% absolute.
exampleZh: 这些就是分类，分数是，那就是基于成绩的。

meaning: n. （车辆或机器的）操纵杆，控制杆；杠杆；（用于达到某一目的的）手段，方法；v. （用杠杆）撬动；挤走（某人）；（均衡地用力）移动；把……作为杠杆；【名】 （Lever）（英）利弗，（法）勒韦，（德）莱韦尔（人名）
definition: 1. a bar or handle that moves around a fixed point, so that one end of it can be pushed or pulled in order to control the operation of a machine or move a heavy or stiff object；2. something you use, often unfairly, to try to persuade someone to do what you want
example: Still, we might say, but the rat lever is not the only kind of pleasures there are.
exampleZh: 但我们仍然可以说，老鼠杠杆不是唯一的快乐。

meaning: n. 影响力，手段；杠杆力，杠杆作用；杠杆比率；v. 举债经营；充分利用（资源、观点等）
definition: 1. the action or advantage of using a lever；2. power to influence people and get the results you want
example: If there is one universal lesson from the recent past, it is that leverage is lethal.
exampleZh: 如果从近期的事件中得到一个普遍的教训，那应该是杠杆是致命的。

meaning: v. 征收（罚款、税款等）；扣押财产（以执行判决）；征兵；发动（战争）；n. 征收额，税款；（为执行判决而进行的）财产扣押；征兵；【名】 （Levy）（英、以）利维，（西、意、葡、芬、法、瑞典）莱维（人名）
definition: 1. an amount of money, such as a tax, that you have to pay to a government or organization；2. (of a government or organization) to demand an amount of money, such as a tax, from a person or organization
example: "While they were showing me the data, I was thinking about Etch A Sketch," Levy says.
exampleZh: “在他们向我展示数据时，我却在想儿童绘画板。”利维回忆道。

meaning: adj. （在法律上）有责任的，有义务的；负有偿付责任的；很可能会发生的；有……倾向的
definition: 1. adj. at risk of or subject to experiencing something usually unpleasant；2. adj. subject to legal action
example: If you take part in a partnership you are individually liable for the debts of the corporation.
exampleZh: 如果你加入了合伙制企业,个人需要为企业的债务承担责任

meaning: n. （法律上应承担的）责任，义务；惹麻烦的人（或事）；负债，债务；倾向；可能性
definition: 1. n. the state of being legally obliged and responsible；2. n. an obligation to pay money to another party
example: He was ordered to pay the company $500,000 on account pending a final assessment of his liability.
exampleZh: 在对他的债务做最后的评估期间，他被命令先付这家公司50万美元。

meaning: adj. 思想开明的；自由主义的，支持变革的；（加拿大、英国等国）自由党的；慷慨的，大量给予的；通识（教育）的，文科的；不确切的，不拘泥字面的；自由主义神学的；n. 思想开明的人；自由主义者，支持变革的人；（加拿大、英国等国的）自由党党员，自由党支持者；【名】 （Liberal）（葡）利贝拉尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person who favors a political philosophy of progress and reform and the protection of civil liberties；2. adj. showing or characterized by broad-mindedness
example: Not building our own ties to India, to Japan, to Australia, to the other liberal democracies in Asia.
exampleZh: 不和印度建立关系，不和日本，澳大利亚建立关系，不和其他亚洲自由民主国家打交道。

meaning: v. 解放，解救；使自由，使摆脱约束；偷窃；释放（气体、能量等）
definition: 1. v. give equal rights to; of women and minorities；2. v. grant freedom to; free from confinement
example: Today the move is to liberate the woman, which may in the end strengthen the marriage union.
exampleZh: 今天的行动是解放妇女，这最终可能会加强婚姻联盟。

meaning: n. 解放，解放运动；解脱；释出，放出；劫掠，偷盗
definition: 1. n. the act of liberating someone or something；2. n. the attempt to achieve equal rights or status
example: As far as manners are concerned, I suppose I have always been a supporter of women's liberation.
exampleZh: 就礼仪而言，我想我一直是妇女解放运动的支持者。

meaning: n. 自由，自由权；（某种）合法权利；冒犯行为（或言语），失礼；意志自由，选择自由； 自以为是的言语，专断的行动；（水手的）上岸休假；【名】 （Liberty）（英）利伯蒂（人名）
definition: 1. n. immunity from arbitrary exercise of authority: political independence；2. n. freedom of choice
example: With a few keystrokes, Rebecca was connected to her computer at Liberty Air Service.
exampleZh: 按了几个键后，丽贝卡连接上了她在自由航空公司的电脑。

meaning: n. 图书馆，藏书楼；（书、激光唱片等的）私人收藏；书房，书斋；文库，系列丛书（激光唱片集，成套录像等）；软件库
definition: 1. n. a room where books are kept；2. n. a collection of literary documents or records kept for reference or borrowing
example: I'll go into the library after we're finished this, but it's just... to give my life a bit of diversities,
exampleZh: 我们谈话结束后我还是会回到图书馆去，但是现在……让我的生活更加多样化一点吧，

meaning: n. 图书馆馆长，图书馆管理员
definition: 1. n. a professional person trained in library science and engaged in library services
example: Somebody might be sort of a disorganized librarian and might want to put this one upside down but over here.
exampleZh: 有些人可能是一个没有条理的图书管理员,想要把这个颠倒过来,放在这边。

meaning: n. （美国英语）执照，许可证，特许证；特许（同 licence）；破格，自由（如 poetic license、artistic license）；vt. 许可，特许，发许可证给
definition: 1. n. a legal document giving official permission to do something；2. v. authorize officially
example: The licensing agent reads the book and determines whether or not to print it at all or license it to appear in print.
exampleZh: 出版管理机构阅读后决定是坚决不许印刷,这本书还是许可它被印刷成册。

meaning: v. 舔，舔吃；成功地处理（难题或困境）；揍，打败；（火焰）燎着，（波浪）轻拍；砍倒，击倒；n. 舔；少量，一点；（狠狠的）一击，一撞；（吉他演奏的歌曲）小过门；【名】 （Lick）（英、匈）利克（人名）
definition: 1. n. a salt deposit that animals regularly lick；2. v. beat thoroughly and conclusively in a competition or fight
example: Well I will lick you, if you fool with me.
exampleZh: 好吧，如果你戏弄我，我就会打你。

meaning: n. （容器的）盖，盖子；眼睑；抑制，隐瞒；（对开支的）控制，封顶；馅饼的硬皮；蒴盖；v. 给……盖盖子；【名】 （Lid）（捷、挪）利德（人名）
definition: 1. n. either of two folds of skin that can be moved to cover or open the eye；2. n. a movable top or cover (hinged or separate) for closing the opening of a container
example: Energy can flow across the glass but I put a lid on top, and so the water can't get out.
exampleZh: 能量可以穿过杯壁流动,但是我在顶上加了盖子，所以水不能跑出来。

meaning: v. 平躺，平卧；位于，坐落在；存在，在于；处于，保持（某种状态）；（尤用于墓碑上的文字中）长眠；（比赛时）名列，排名；撒谎，编造谎言；（物体）平放在……上，平放着；朝……方向；造成假象，不可靠；（尤指不快或困难之事）将发生，在等待；（光、云、雾等）存在，展现；（诉讼，控告，索赔）可受理，可立案；n. 方向，位置；谎言，谎话；（动物的）穴，（鸟的）巢；【名】 （Lie）（罗、挪、瑞典）利，（中）李（普通话·威妥玛）（人名）
definition: 1. n. a statement that deviates from or perverts the truth；2. v. be located or situated somewhere; occupy a certain position
example: This is The Life You Can Save, which essentially gives the lie to the idea that there is nothing I can do.
exampleZh: 你可以拯救的生命》,这本书彻底地推翻了那种,“我什么都帮不上“的想法。

meaning: n. 骗子，说谎者；【名】 （Liar）（美、俄、德）莉娅尔（人名）

exampleZh: 上帝选择了雅各布，他年轻时是个说谎者，骗子，而没选择哥哥以扫。

meaning: n. （陆军、海军、空军）中尉；（美国消防、警察部门的）中尉；副职官员，代理官员
definition: 1. (the title of) an officer of middle rank in the armed forces
example: He was a second lieutenant in the army until he deserted.
exampleZh: 他在开小差之前是个少尉。

meaning: n. 生命；人命，性命；生物，活物；寿命，一生；（某事物的）存在期；生活，人生；生活方式；（某种）生活；生气，活力；（绘画的）模特儿，实物；（游戏中的）一次机会，命；传记；无期徒刑，终身监禁；今生，来世；adj. 生命的；一生的，终身的
definition: 1. n. a characteristic state or mode of living；2. n. the course of existence of an individual; the actions and events that occur in living
