meaning: adv. 离开（某处），（在时间或空间上）距，离；从……移开，从……脱离；不再会发生，被取消；关掉，切断；没有，不再供应；不上课，不工作，休息；削价，减价；入睡；做完，光；获得，拥有；（接在数词后）一次的产量；在剧院舞台的后面（或旁边）；prep. 从……离开，向下；靠近，离……不远；从……去掉，从……移开；低于……水平；远离；不上课，不工作，休息；依靠……（过活）；（表示来源或原因）来自，由于；adj. （食物）不新鲜的；令人不快的，不公平的；不友好的，敌对的；状态不如平常好的；不正确的，不对的；微小的；不连接的，不盖在上面的；萧条的，淡季的；离开家的，不工作的；不运转的，不运作的；（一对之中）右边的，右侧的；（某些体育比赛）越位的；在车辆离人行道边缘最远的一侧的；n. 起跑，开始，出发（the off）；（板球）击球手对面的半场；v. 杀死（某人）；离开
definition: 1. v. kill intentionally and with premeditation；2. adj. not in operation or operational
example: I think even soul's emotion... People are a little too off for good church, for good church people. -Right.
exampleZh: 这也和“灵魂情感“有关。。。,人们对按时拜谒教会这件事，太冷淡，-是的。

meaning: v. 得罪，冒犯；令人不悦，令人不舒服； 犯罪，违法； 违犯，违反
definition: 1. v. cause to feel resentment or indignation；2. v. act in disregard of laws, rules, contracts, or promises
example: in terms of how not to offend people and how to do it as ethically as possible
exampleZh: 比如说怎样保证不侵犯人权，怎样让克隆在道德层面行得通，

meaning: n. 违法，犯罪；冒犯，伤害；过错，不当；讨厌的东西，引起反感的事物； 进攻，攻击行为；进攻队员；（球队的）进攻
definition: 1. n. a lack of politeness; a failure to show regard for others; wounding the feelings or others；2. n. a feeling of anger caused by being offended
example: The new law makes it a criminal offense to drink alcohol in public places.
exampleZh: 新法律将在公共场所饮酒定为刑事犯罪。

meaning: adj. 无礼的，冒犯的；令人不快（讨厌）的；攻击的，进攻性的； （体育比赛中）进攻的，攻势的；n. （军事）进攻，攻势； （引人注意的）系列行动，攻势
definition: 1. n. the action of attacking an enemy；2. adj. violating or tending to violate or offend against
example: He also notes that some of the material in the patriarchal stories would be offensive to later religious sensibilities.
exampleZh: 他还指出族长故事里的一些素材,是冒犯后来的宗教敏感性的。

meaning: n. 犯罪者，违法者；造成问题的人（或事物）
definition: 1. n. a person who transgresses moral or civil law
example: The judge will delay his verdict until he receives medical reports on the offender.
exampleZh: 法官将推迟判决，直到收到有关违法者的医疗报告。

meaning: v. 提供，给予；提议，表示愿意（做某事）；出（价），开（价）；提出，作出；表示（爱、友谊等）；（向上帝或神）奉献（祈祷、赞美），祭献（牺牲）； 试图（使用暴力，进行抵抗）；发动，挑起（战争）；把……摆好（或放到位）（以便检测或评估其外观或状况）；（机会）出现；求婚；n. 主动提议，提供； 出价，报价； （商品的）特价，特惠；求婚
definition: 1. n. the verbal act of offering；2. v. make available or accessible, provide or furnish
example: But at the same time, you receive an offer to work at another company that is also very intriguing.
exampleZh: 但与此同时，你也被另外一家公司录用了，这非常吸引人。

meaning: n. （供娱乐或出售的）产品；新近完成的艺术作品；礼品，礼物；供品，祭品；供奉，奉献；（给教会的）捐助，捐赠物（尤指捐款）；v. 提供，给予；提议，表示愿意（做某事）；出（价），开（价）（offer 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. something offered (as a proposal or bid)；2. n. money contributed to a religious organization
example: God prefers the offering of Abel, and as a result Cain is distressed and jealous to the point of murder.
exampleZh: 上帝经常给亚伯恩典,结果，引发了该隐的嫉妒之心，起了杀意。

meaning: n. 办公室；办公楼，办事处；（提供某项服务的）室，处，局；（尤指政府的）部，局，厅；诊所；（办公室、办公楼、事务所等的）全体办事人员，全体工作人员；重要官职，重要职务；（天主教牧师、教徒等）每日的祈祷 （=Divine Office）
definition: 1. n. place of business where professional or clerical duties are performed；2. n. an administrative unit of government
example: Let's say you are in an office, that's say, the doctor's office, and you're waiting a really long time.
exampleZh: 假设你在一个医生的办公室等了很久。

meaning: n. 军官；（政府或大机构的）官员，高级职员；警察，警官；船长；某一荣誉等级中的一分子（如英帝国勋位中四等勋爵士以下的级别）；v. 配备军官；指挥；【名】 （Officer）（英）奥菲瑟（人名）
definition: 1. n. any person in the armed services who holds a position of authority or command；2. v. direct or command as an officer
example: I was strucked by what I found in the New York Times December 8th, a piece writen by an army officer.
exampleZh: 我感到非常震惊,12月8号，我在纽约时报，看到了一篇军官写的文章。

meaning: adj. 正式的，官方的，官方授权的；公务的，公职的；据官方的，公开宣称的（但可能并非事实）；官方场合的，（常指）正式公开的；被正式选用的；n. 官员，高级职员；（体育比赛中的）执法人，裁判员；（大主教法庭，主教法庭或会吏总法庭的）主持法官
definition: 1. n. a worker who holds or is invested with an office；2. adj. having official authority or sanction
example: There's a lot of Christian churches where you can't get married in the outdoors, that's not an official way to get married.
exampleZh: 有许多的基督教教堂,不允许在户外举行婚礼，在户外的婚礼并不代表正式结婚。

meaning: v. 补偿，抵销，抵消；衬托出；使偏离直线方向，使与……不在一条直线上；（墨水，刚印好的页面）转印下一页；n. 抵消物，补偿；偏离量，偏离距离；（测绘）支距；（电压或电流的）偏离；侧枝，短匐茎；（山的）支脉；（建筑）壁阶；胶印法；adj. 胶印的，平版印刷的；偏离中心的，偏置的
definition: 1. to balance one influence against an opposing influence, so that there is no great difference as a result；2. to pay for things that will reduce carbon dioxide in order to reduce the damage caused by carbon dioxide that you produce
example: A moderation in food prices helped to offset the first increase in energy prices.
exampleZh: 食品价格的降低有助于抵消能源价格的第一次上涨。

meaning: n. （人的）后代，子女；（动物的）幼崽，崽兽；结果，产物
definition: 1. the young of an animal；2. a person's children
example: Eleanor was now less anxious about her offspring than she had once been.
exampleZh: 这时，埃莉诺已不像以前那样为子女担忧了。

meaning: adv. 常常，时常；在许多情况下
definition: 1. adv. many times at short intervals；2. adv. frequently or in great quantities
example: These two oscillate back and forth so the moment of deprivation is often then balanced by a moment of imagination.
exampleZh: 来回交替丧失的时刻,经常和想像的时刻,互相平衡。

meaning: n. 燃油，润滑油；石油，原油；润肤油，护发油；食用油；油性涂料，油画颜料（oils）；油画；信息，事实；v. 加油于……，给……加润滑油；给（皮肤）涂油，抹油
definition: 1. n. a slippery or viscous liquid or liquefiable substance not miscible with water；2. v. cover with oil, as if by rubbing
example: It's the problem that sometimes people knock over an oil lamp in their home and they burn their own house down.
exampleZh: 有时候会出现这种问题,一个人把自己家里的油灯弄翻了,然后把自己的房子点着了

meaning: adj. 含油的，涂油的；（食物）含油多的，富含脂肪的；（头发或皮肤）油质的，油性的；（质地、味道、气味、形态）像油的；（人，行为）油滑的，讨好的
definition: 1. adj. containing an unusual amount of grease or oil；2. adj. unpleasantly and excessively suave or ingratiating in manner or speech
example: There's a lot of evidence that oily fish, as distinct from fatty meat, has a beneficial effect.
exampleZh: 大量证据显示，含油的鱼与肥肉不同，具有益处。

meaning: int. 好，行；adj. 可以，不错的；对；安全的，没事的；adv. 可以，不错；对；很好地；n. 同意，批准；v. 批准，同意，认可
definition: 1. n. an endorsement；2. v. give sanction to
example: Okay so exchange numbers; okay good half of that problem is gone now we have just these two left.
exampleZh: 好，交换数字,好，问题解决一半了,只剩你们两个了。

meaning: adj. （人）……岁的，（事物）存在……久的；年老的，年纪大的；衰老的；古老的，历史悠久的；陈旧的；过去的，从前的；原来（属于自己的）的；结识久的；（表示亲昵）老……；（语言形式）古的，早期的；老派的，守旧的；老一套的，经历多次的；n. 老年人；某个年龄段的人；古时；【名】 （Old）（英）奥尔德（人名）
definition: 1. n. past times (especially in the phrase `in days of old')；2. adj. (used especially of persons) having lived for a relatively long time or attained a specific age
example: The Old Testament prophet had said, "All flesh is grass," an important verse for the new dispensation of Christianity.
exampleZh: 旧约里说，“凡有血气的，尽都如草“,这是基督教教义新体系中的重要一条。

meaning: adj. 过时的，老式的；（观点、习俗、价值观等）守旧的，传统的；（表情）反对的；n. （主要用威士忌、苦味酒、水和糖调成的）威士忌鸡尾酒
definition: 1. n. a cocktail made of whiskey and bitters and sugar with fruit slices；2. adj. out of fashion
example: You could argue that both Southerners and Northerners shared a certain degree of old-fashioned American localism, attachment to place.
exampleZh: 你可以争辩说南方人和北方人,都有一点,旧式的美国地方主义,依恋着所处的地方

meaning: n. 橄榄；橄榄树；橄榄色，黄绿色；炖牛肉卷；橄榄贝；（剖）橄榄体；（垫在螺母下拧紧以形成密封的）橄榄环；adj. 橄榄色的，茶青色的；（皮肤）橄榄色的，浅褐色的；【名】 （Olive）（美）奥利芙（人名）
definition: 1. a small bitter green or black fruit that is eaten or used to produce oil, or a Mediterranean tree on which this fruit grows
example: The olive itself, you use it to cook with as oil; some people just put oil on their salad.
exampleZh: 你可以用它来烹饪,有些人还往沙拉中加入橄榄油

meaning: adj. 奥林匹克运动会的；古奥林匹亚的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to the Olympic Games；2. adj. of the region of Olympia in Greece or its inhabitants
example: Other studies have looked at films of people who have just won Olympic gold medals.
exampleZh: 其他的一些研究,关于刚获得奥林匹克金牌的人。

meaning: n. 奥林匹克运动会，奥运会
definition: 1. n. the modern revival of the ancient games held once every 4 years in a selected country
example: and so our organisation is trying to get as many medals as possible for the Olympics, for UK athletes.
exampleZh: 所以我们的组织努力地为奥运、为英国运动员争取尽可能多的金牌。

meaning: n. 奥林匹克运动会；国际比赛（如国际象棋赛）；四年时间
definition: 1. n. one of the four-year intervals between Olympic Games; used to reckon time in ancient Greece for twelve centuries beginning in 776 BC；2. n. the modern revival of the ancient games held once every 4 years in a selected country
example: The Math Olympiad Summer Training Program is a three-week math camp held by the Mathematical Association of America that leads straight to the international championship and is free for those who make it.
exampleZh: 数学奥林匹克夏季训练计划是一个由美国数学协会举办的为期三周的数学训练营，它直接通向国际锦标赛，而且免除那些成功晋级的人的费用。

meaning: v. 省去，遗漏；不做，未能做
definition: 1. v. prevent from being included or considered or accepted；2. v. leave undone or leave out
example: There are as many textbooks that omit it as a type of movement as include it.
exampleZh: 也有不少课本没有把它包括在冰川移动的一种类型里。

meaning: n. 省略，遗漏；被省略（或排除）的人（或物）；（尤指道德上或法律义务的）疏忽
definition: 1. n. a mistake resulting from neglect；2. n. something that has been omitted
example: There's no change to collective bargaining at the USPS, a major omission considering that personnel accounts for 80 percent of the agency's costs.
exampleZh: 美国邮政的集体谈判没有改变，考虑到人力成本占机构成本的80%，这是个重大遗漏问题。

meaning: prep. 在……上（表示接触、附着、由……支撑或移动到……上）；向，朝，对着；关于；在（某一天、日期或特定时间）；根据，依据，凭；带在……身上；一……就；以……为食（或燃料、收入来源等）；吃，喝；服用（药物）；以……支付；在……上赚（钱）；借助（仪器、器械或方式）；在（广播、电视）上播放；参加或处于（活动、状态）中；忙于；作为……成员；靠近，接近，在……旁边；在……基础上（又）增加；与……相比；adv. 在上面；穿上，穿着；向前；继续，不停；进行中；开着，接通；当班；上演，播出；以后；adj. 开着的；发生着的，正在进行中；计划举行的；覆盖；附着（尤指在正确的位置上）；写着的；正在播出的；n. （On）（中、菲）温（人名）
definition: 1. adj. in operation or operational；2. adv. with a forward motion
example: I'm going to write things on the board, I'm going to post things up on the screen, and so on.
exampleZh: 我会在黑板上写东西，我会在屏幕上显示一些内容等等。

meaning: adv. 一次， 一回；曾经，一度；任何一次，从来；乘以一；conj. 一.....就， 一旦；n. 一次
definition: 1. adv. on one occasion；2. adv. as soon as
example: Then, once you've done that, once you have secured the integrity and accuracy of the meaning, Hirsch says, "Okay, fine.
exampleZh: 在你完成那个之后，一旦你确定了意思的真实性和准确性，赫施说，好的，不错。

meaning: num. 一；一个；一岁；一点钟；pron. 一个人；任何人，人们（表泛指）；那个人；（特指的）那种人；det. 一个（强调某人或某事）；一个（用于比较相似的人或物）；某个（用于不认识的人的名字前）；adj. 唯一的；一的；n. 一；一美元纸币；n. （One）（印、马、美）温（人名）
definition: 1. n. the smallest whole number or a numeral representing this number；2. adj. used of a single unit or thing; not two or more
example: It is association with death and sexuality that renders one impure and disqualifies one from entering the holy sanctuary.
exampleZh: 不洁的事物和死亡与生殖是有联系的,它们被取消了,进入圣所的资格。

meaning: pron. 自己，自身；亲自；（不受他人影响的）自己
definition: 1. abstract: Oneself is an American hip hop artist based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. A former member of the legendary Rusty Ps, began his career in 1995.
example: One has to ask oneself what the purpose of the exercise is.
exampleZh: 大家必须问一问自己，这个锻炼的目的是什么。

meaning: adj. 持续存在的，仍在进行的，不断发展的
definition: 1. adj. currently happening
example: or if it's over a long period of time and it's an ongoing situation that you want to get rid of.
exampleZh: 或者是一件持续了很久的事，你特别想摆脱它。

meaning: n. 洋葱，洋葱头
definition: 1. n. edible bulb of an onion plant；2. n. bulbous plant having hollow leaves cultivated worldwide for its rounded edible bulb
example: It seems like the moment you begin to look at this question, you were just like peeling the onion.
exampleZh: 感觉你们在看待这个,问题时，就像剥洋葱一样。

meaning: adj. （产品、服务或信息）在线的，网上的；（计算机）联机的；adv. 在网上，利用网际网路（购买、获得等）；联机地，在电脑操控下；开始运行，存在着
definition: 1. abstract: The term "online" can refer to a state of connectivity.
example: And part of this is happening because of the development of all these wireless networks, miniaturization, things moving online.
exampleZh: 部分原因是,无线网络的发展，微型化的发展。

meaning: adv. 只，只有；仅在……情况下（或地方等）；只是，不过（表示不重要、不严重等）；（强调数量少或时间段）仅仅，才；不早于，直到……才；（除此之外别无可为）只能；（用于说明事情的恶果）只会；不料，竟然；只能（希望或愿望等）；（强调行动恰当）完全，真正；刚刚（强调某事刚发生）；险些没，差点没；adj. 仅有的，唯一的；最好的，最适合的；独生的；conj. 不过，但是；要不是，若非
definition: 1. adj. being the only one; single and isolated from others；2. adv. and nothing more
example: It's one of the only compounds, there's only I think three, where the density actually goes down when it freezes.
exampleZh: 它是我见过的，唯一一个，在降温时密度下降的化合物。

meaning: n. （尤指某种坏事情的）开始，发作；军事攻击
definition: 1. the moment at which something begins, and especially something uncomfortable or unpleasant；2. the first part of a syllable
example: If you do have it, the disease will always have onset by age 40, 50 or what have you.
exampleZh: 如果你有的话，这个病就会从40岁，50岁之类的年纪0,开始发作。

meaning: prep. 到……之上，向……之上，到，朝；（建筑物、房间、门或窗）面朝，通向；发现（某人做了坏事）；了解，掌握，处于有利地位；与……谈话，询问；到（交通工具）上；（重心移动）到（身体某部位）上；成为（列表、系统等）的一部分；转到（其他话题）；抓住；（数）映射到的；adj. 映射的，映成的，满射的
definition: 1. moving to a position on the surface of something
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: And finally at lines 108 through 131, we have Saint Peter, he of the pearly gates. Peter bursts onto the scene.
exampleZh: 最后108到131行，圣彼得出现了，他掌管珍珠之门，彼得的出现很突兀。

meaning: adv. 向前；从……以后；取得进步，获得成功；adj. 向前的，继续的；发展的，进步的
definition: 1. adj. moving toward a position ahead；2. adv. forward in time or order or degree
example: It's a poem deeply invested in the tradition of pastoral poetry, pastoral poetry from Theocritus and Virgil onward.
exampleZh: 这是一首深深植根于从忒俄克里托斯和维吉尔时代，不断发展而来的田园诗的传统中的诗。

meaning: adj. （玻璃、液体等）不透明的，不透光的；难懂的，隐晦的；迟钝的；n. 不透明体；（用于底片）不透明颜料；v. 使不透明
definition: 1. preventing light from travelling through, and therefore not transparent or translucent；2. Opaque writing or speech is difficult to understand
example: You can always use opaque glass if you need to block a street view.
exampleZh: 如果你需要挡住外面的街景，你随时可以使用不透明玻璃。

meaning: adj. 开放的，营业的；开着的，敞开的；（身体部位）张开的；露天的，无遮盖的；开阔的，未围上的；可通行的，畅通的；伸开的，展开的；坦率的；不保密的，公开的；易受影响的，易受攻击的；人人可以参加的；（对特定群体）开放的 ；可得到的，可使用的；思想开明的；尚未决定的；（文件夹、文档等）正在使用中的；（胜利者）赢得公开赛的；（票子）未注明旅行日期的；（支票）未签注的；（数）（集合）开的；（元音）开的；（乐）开放的 ；（电路）开路的，断路的；（纺织品）松散的；v. 开，打开；开封，开启；睁开（眼睛），张开（嘴巴）；翻开，展开；开通，开放；开门，营业 ；开业，开幕；（股市）开盘，开市；着手，开始；启动（计算机程序或文件）；开立账户；通往，通向；展现，出现；使某人更乐意考虑某事；断开（电路）；畅谈；n. 户外，野外；公开，泄露；公开赛（Open）；断开（电路）
definition: 1. n. a clear or unobstructed space or expanse of land or water；2. v. cause to open or to become open
example: He's, Andy is his first name. He's, as well very likeable, very approachable. He has an open door policy,
exampleZh: 安迪是他的名。他也很讨人喜欢，非常平易近人。他主张办公室的门一直要敞开着，

meaning: n. 开启工具；揭幕赛，开场戏；首粒进球；开场的话；（板球）开局者；（桥牌）开叫人
definition: 1. n. the first event in a series；2. n. a person who unfastens or unwraps or opens
example: Writing these scripts has been quite an eye-opener for me. It proves that you can do anything if the need is urgent.
exampleZh: 写这些脚本对我来讲是大开眼界的事。它证明如果需求紧迫，人能做任何事情。

meaning: n. 洞，缺口；开始，开端；开幕式，落成典礼；国际象棋的开局；首次发生，首演；开案陈述；机会，机遇；空缺的职位；开放，开业；开，打开；（林中）空地；开襟，开口；adj. 开始的，开端的；v. 打开，开启；开放，展开；开业，开门（open 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. an open or empty space in or between things；2. adj. first or beginning
example: It's in relation to all of these forms of lateness that we can best understand the opening invocation of Paradise Lost.
exampleZh: 带着所有这些“晚“,我们才能很好的理解《失乐园》的开头。

meaning: adv. 公开地，公然地，坦率地
definition: 1. adv. in an open way
example: So medieval commentators for example began to speak a little bit more openly about some of these features.
exampleZh: 所以，中世纪的注释者渐渐开始,提及这些特点。

meaning: n. 歌剧演出，歌剧表演；歌剧团，歌剧院；歌剧艺术，歌剧剧本；【名】 （Opera）（意）奥佩拉（人名）
definition: 1. n. a drama set to music; consists of singing with orchestral accompaniment and an orchestral overture and interludes；2. n. a commercial browser
example: It was related to the accident of the Phantom of the Opera. It's been repaired now.
exampleZh: 它跟歌剧院幽灵的事件有关。现在它被修好了。

meaning: v. 操纵，操作（机器或设备）；（机器等）运转，运行 ；管理，经营（企业、部门等）；（组织或公司）运营；（使）运行，（使）工作；起作用，发生影响；（以某种方式）行事；开刀，动手术；（士兵或警察在某地区）行动，执行公务
definition: 1. v. direct or control; projects, businesses, etc.；2. v. perform as expected when applied
example: And even though it's an imitation, in many ways, the machine that we've developed can operate more than we can ourselves.
exampleZh: 虽然只是一个仿制品，在很多年内，这个我们发明的机器能够,比我们做的更多。

meaning: n. 运作，实施；运转，操作；手术；（有组织的）活动，行动；军事行动；企业，公司；业务，经营 ；（数学）运算
definition: 1. n. a business especially one run on a large scale；2. n. a planned activity involving many people performing various actions
example: So I put my head down and focused on operation technology, focused on the user's experience, and I delivered.
exampleZh: 我选择脚踏实地工作，专注于公司的运营，专注于提升用户体验，这一切我都做到了。

meaning: adj. （机器、设备等）正常运转的，可使用的；操作的，运营的，业务的；军事行动的；操作论的，操作主义的
definition: 1. adj. pertaining to a process or series of actions for achieving a result；2. adj. fit or ready for use or service
example: The nuclear industry was required to prove that every operational and safety aspect had been fully researched.
exampleZh: 核工业需要证明每一个操作和安全项目都已全面调查过。

meaning: n. （设备、机器的）操作员；经营者；精明圆滑的人，善于取巧的人；电话员，接线员；运算符号
definition: 1. n. (mathematics) a symbol that represents a function from functions to functions；2. n. an agent that operates some apparatus or machine
example: He dialled the operator and put in a call to Rome.
exampleZh: 他拨通了接线员，往罗马打了一个电话。

meaning: adj. 运转正常的，有效的；手术的；（词）最重要的，关键的；n. 技工，工人；密探，（尤指政府的）特工人员
definition: 1. a worker, especially one who is skilled in working with their hands；2. a person who works secretly for an organization
example: I was in love with her—'was' being the operative word.
exampleZh: 在I was in love with her这句话中，was是关键词。

meaning: n. 意见，看法；（群体的）观点，信仰；专家意见，专业意见；（对某人的）评价，印象；（法官或法院说明判决理由的）判决意见书
definition: 1. n. a personal belief or judgment that is not founded on proof or certainty；2. n. a belief or sentiment shared by most people; the voice of the people
example: It's this basic antagonism, this difference of opinion, that Eikhenbaum wants to focus on and, indeed, does focus on.
exampleZh: 这就是艾肯鲍姆的反对者的，基本意见，针对这点，艾肯鲍姆将反对付诸行动了。

meaning: n. 时机，机会
definition: 1. n. a possibility due to a favorable combination of circumstances
example: The decay of Christian belief and practice is not a loss but rather an opportunity for poetry, in Crane.
exampleZh: 基督教信仰和践行的衰败,在克莱恩看来，并不是损失，反而是诗歌新生的机会。

meaning: v. 反抗，阻碍；与……竞争，与……角逐
definition: 1. v. be against; express opposition to；2. v. fight against or resist strongly
example: This party would bitterly oppose the re-introduction of the death penalty.
exampleZh: 本党会强烈反对恢复死刑。

meaning: n. （强烈的） 反对，反抗；对手，竞争者（the opposition）；反对党，在野党（ the Opposition）；对立，对立的事物；（天文，占星）冲
definition: 1. n. the action of opposing something that you disapprove or disagree with；2. n. the relation between opposed entities
example: Laud took his mission as the head of the Church of England to be the squelching of this Puritan opposition.
exampleZh: 劳德以其身为英国大主教的特权,极力打压着清教徒的反抗。

meaning: n. 对手，竞争者；反对者，阻止者；adj. 对立的，敌对的
definition: 1. n. a contestant that you are matched against；2. adj. characterized by active hostility
example: If my opponent chooses Beta and I choose Alpha, I get 3; Beta, I get 1. Once again Alpha is better.
exampleZh: 如果我对手选β,我选α我得3,选β我得1,也是选α好

meaning: adj. 完全相反的，截然不同的；相反的，另一边的；（在说话者、所指的人或物）对面的；（角）对的；（叶，芽）对生的；n. 对立的人（或物），对立面；反义词；adv. 在对面，在对过；prep. 在……对面，与……相对；与……合演，与……联袂演出
definition: 1. n. a word that expresses a meaning opposed to the meaning of another word, in which case the two words are antonyms of each other；2. adj. being directly across from each other; facing
example: So what I want to point out is that it creates an effect that is exactly opposite of a bond.
exampleZh: 我要指出的是,它造成的效果和成键正好相反。

meaning: v. 压迫，欺压；使压抑，使烦恼；（纹章）使（图记）部分模糊
definition: 1. to govern people in an unfair and cruel way and prevent them from having opportunities and freedom；2. to make a person feel uncomfortable or worried, and sometimes ill
example: Tackling the inequality, racism and other forms of "structural violence" which oppress the poor is as critical as extending the drugs.
exampleZh: 解决压迫穷人的不平等、种族主义和其他形式的“结构性暴力”与推广药物一样重要。

meaning: n. 压迫，压制；压迫手段；郁闷，压抑
definition: 1. a situation in which people are governed in an unfair and cruel way and prevented from having opportunities and freedom；2. a feeling of being very uncomfortable and worried
example: Women are still a minority in big business and the political arena, but not because of male oppression.
exampleZh: 在大企业和政治舞台上，女性仍然是少数，但这并不是因为男性的压迫。

meaning: adj. （社会、法律、习俗等）压迫的，暴虐的，不公的 ；（天气、空气等）闷热的，难以忍受的；使人苦恼的，令人焦虑的
definition: 1. cruel and unfair；2. causing people to feel worried and uncomfortable
example: An excess of house plants in a small apartment can be oppressive.
exampleZh: 在一套狭小公寓里放过多的室内植物会给人压抑感。

meaning: v. 选择，作出抉择
definition: 1. v. select as an alternative; choose instead; prefer as an alternative
example: If the banks opt to pull the rug from under the ill-fated project, it will go into liquidation.
exampleZh: 如果这些银行选择不再支持那项倒霉的工程，它就将破产。

meaning: n. 可选择的事物；选择，选择权；（将来的）买卖选择权利，期权；（计算机程序中的）选项；选修课；（购买新设备，尤其是汽车时提供的）附件，配件；v. 买卖（某物的）期权
definition: 1. n. the right to buy or sell property at an agreed price; the right is purchased and if it is not exercised by a stated date the money is forfeited；2. n. one of a number of things from which only one can be chosen
example: It's on the market, very popular in terms of your choices right now as an option as an anti-depressant.
exampleZh: 它在市场上，作为治疗抑郁症的一种选择,现在非常畅销。

meaning: adj. 可选择的，选修的
definition: 1. adj. possible but not necessary; left to personal choice
example: The course consists of ten core modules and five optional modules.
exampleZh: 这门课程包括十个必修单元和五个选修单元。

meaning: adj. 眼睛的，视觉的；n. （光学仪器的）镜头，光学部件；奥普蒂克量杯（酒吧用以量烈性酒）；眼睛；【名】 （Optic）（英）奥普蒂克（人名）
definition: 1. relating to light or the eyes；2. referring to the eyes
example: So with his optic glass, his telescope, Galileo was able to discern spots on the orb of the moon.
exampleZh: 因此通过他的磁光玻璃，望远镜，伽利略能够分辨出月亮轨道上的斑点。

meaning: adj. 视力的，视觉的；有助于视力的，光学的；光读取的，光存贮的；（装置）光电的；n. （一副）眼镜（opticals）
definition: 1. relating to light or the ability to see；2. used in order to see something better
example: Optical scanners ensure that imperfections in the cloth are located and removed.
exampleZh: 光电扫描器能确保找出并去除布料上的瑕疵。

meaning: n. 乐观；乐观主义
definition: 1. n. the optimistic feeling that all is going to turn out well；2. n. a general disposition to expect the best in all things
example: A lot has happened since the exuberant optimism of the political spirit that we see in a tract like Areopagitica.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿在《论出版自由》中发表了极为乐观的政治思想之后,政治形势发生了很大变化。

meaning: adj. 乐观的，乐观主义的；（估计）过于乐观的，高估的
definition: 1. adj. expecting the best in this best of all possible worlds；2. adj. expecting the best
example: So quickly I realized that we were too optimistic about the future of Internet in China.
exampleZh: 很快我就意识到,对于中国互联网的未来看的太过乐观。

meaning: n. 乐观主义者，乐天派
definition: 1. n. a person disposed to take a favorable view of things
example: That's what the optimist thinks-- not just for themselves individually, but for everybody, the total is always positive.
exampleZh: 那是乐观主义者的想法-,而且不但是对他们自己，而是对所有人，等式结果总是正数。

meaning: adj. 最优的，最适宜的；n. 最佳条件，最佳水平
definition: 1. best; most likely to bring success or advantage；2. being the best or most likely to bring success or advantage
example: The disease model,the optimum level is the zero: let's just be Ok; let's just not hurt.
exampleZh: 对疾病模型而言，最优水平是零：,我们都平平安安，别受伤就好了。

meaning: adj. 最佳的，最适的
definition: 1. best; most likely to bring success or advantage；2. the best or most effective possible in a particular situation
example: The notion here is that you can get a globally optimal solution from locally optimal solutions to sub-problems.
exampleZh: 这里的概念是你可以通过,子问题的局部最优方案,得到全局优化解决方案。

meaning: conj. （用以引出另一种可能性）或，或者，还是；（用于否定动词后）也不；（用于警告或忠告）否则，不然；（用于两个数字之间表示约略数目）大约；（用于引出解释性词语）或者说；（用于说明原因）不然，否则；（用于引出对比的概念）；还是；n. （电子）（逻辑电路的）或（OR）；（纹章）金色，黄色；abbr. 俄勒冈州（Oregon）；手术室（operating room）；运筹学（operational research）；普通士兵（other ranks）；【名】 （Or）（中）柯，（柬）奥，（土、匈、土库、阿塞、瑞典）奥尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a state in northwestern United States on the Pacific；2. n. a room in a hospital equipped for the performance of surgical operations
example: I don't drink whisky or brandy or any other spirits.
exampleZh: 我不喝威士忌和白兰地，也不喝其他烈性酒。

meaning: adj. 口头的，口述的；口的，口腔的；（药物）口服的；（语音）口腔发声的；（社会）没有文字的；（心理分析）口欲的，口唇的；n. （尤指外语）口试；（大学里的）口试；【名】 （Oral）（土）奥拉尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. an examination conducted by word of mouth；2. adj. using speech rather than writing
example: There will be a test of both oral and written French.
exampleZh: 将有一次法语口试和笔试。

meaning: n. 橙，柑橘；橙色，橘黄色；橙汁，橘汁饮料；橙树，橘树；橙黄色蝴蝶；（Orange）（美、法、俄、英）奥林奇（人名）；奥兰治（地名）；adj. 橙红色的，橘黄色的；奥兰治党或社团的
definition: 1. n. round yellow to orange fruit of any of several citrus trees；2. adj. of the color between red and yellow; similar to the color of a ripe orange
example: Well, he goes to the hairdresser and he gets a Mohawk that's huge and it's orange.
exampleZh: 呃，他去理发店理了一个硕大的橙色莫霍克发型，
exampleSource: I can't help but 课堂

meaning: n. （环绕地球、太阳等运行的）轨道；势力范围，影响范围；眼眶，眼窝；v. 沿轨道运行，环绕……运行；使（卫星）进入轨道
definition: 1. n. the (usually elliptical) path described by one celestial body in its revolution about another；2. v. move in an orbit
example: The orbit of this comet intersects the orbit of the Earth.
exampleZh: 这颗彗星的轨道和地球的轨道相交。

meaning: adj. 轨道的；（公路）环城的；眼眶的；n. 外环高速公路；（物理）轨道电子密度
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to an orbit；2. adj. of or relating to the eye socket
example: Newton for years had been curious about the cause of the orbital motion of the moon and planets.
exampleZh: 多年来，牛顿一直对月球和行星绕轨道运行的原因感到好奇。

meaning: n. （大型的）管弦乐队；乐池（=orchestra pit）；（剧院中）靠近舞台的座位；古希腊剧场舞台前部半圆形的表演区（供合唱队表演歌舞）
definition: 1. n. a musical organization consisting of a group of instrumentalists including string players；2. n. seating on the main floor in a theater
example: We have a pretty great orchestra here that you can take for credit, um, as like a class
exampleZh: 我们学校的管弦乐团非常棒，加入其中还可以获得学分，就像上课一样，

meaning: n. 磨难，严峻考验；神明裁判（把被告是否经得起剧痛的考验作为被告是否无辜的神谕）
definition: 1. a very unpleasant and painful or difficult experience；2. in the past, a way of trying to find out if someone is guilty or innocent by making them suffer extreme pain. If they did not die, this was considered proof from God that they were innocent
example: Despite her ordeal, she seems to have suffered no ill effects.
exampleZh: 她尽管备受磨难，但好像并未受到不利影响。

meaning: n. 顺序，次序；条理；秩序，治安；命令，指示；点餐，订购；点的餐，订购的货物；汇票，送货单；（社会的）制度，结构；社会阶级，阶层；种类，水准；（会议的）程序，规程；宗教团体，（尤指）修道会；秘密组织（社团）；圣职，牧师职（orders）；勋位，勋爵士团；（动植物）目；（军）专用装备；勋章；装饰样式；（数）阶；（计算机的）等待队列；v. 命令，指示；订购，订货；点（酒菜等）；排列，整理
definition: 1. n. (often plural) a command given by a superior (e.g., a military or law enforcement officer) that must be obeyed；2. v. give instructions to or direct somebody to do something with authority
example: Somebody rose and asked him if he had considered putting the elements in alphabetical order. They were very cruel.
exampleZh: 有人起来问他,是否考虑过将这些元素,按字母顺序排列，他们非常冷酷。

meaning: adj. 有条理的，整齐的；守秩序的；传达命令的，值班的；n. （医院）护理员，勤杂工；传令兵，勤务兵；adv. 有秩序地
definition: 1. n. a soldier who serves as an attendant to a superior officer；2. adj. devoid of violence or disruption
example: Mitosis is an orderly sequence of events by which one parent cell becomes two daughter cells.
exampleZh: 有丝分裂是指一个亲代细胞,变为两个子细胞的有序的过程

meaning: adj. 普通的，平常的；平淡无奇的，平庸的；（尤指法官、主教）常任的，本身有权的；n. 常见的人（或事物）（the ordinary）；常任法官；管区长，教区长（the Ordinary）；（罗马天主教）常规弥撒（Ordinary）；礼拜式规程书典（Ordinary）；（纹章）普通图记；普通股（ordinary share 的简称）；（前轮大后轮小的）老式自行车
definition: 1. n. a judge of a probate court；2. adj. not exceptional in any way especially in quality or ability or size or degree
example: When you don't have to worry about criteria like that ordinary, mechanical energy rules supreme, and that's dictating where equilibrium lies.
exampleZh: 如果你不担心像这样的要求,通常的机械能就占据主要地位，并且决定平衡位于何处。

meaning: n. 矿石，矿砂；【名】 （Ore）（意、瑞典）奥雷，（英）奥尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a mineral that contains metal that is valuable enough to be mined；2. n. a monetary subunit in Denmark and Norway and Sweden; 100 ore equal 1 krona
example: You bring iron ore from one part of the planet, carbon, limestone, you put it into this reactor and you ship this all over the world.
exampleZh: 你得到钢铁从地球的一个地方，还有碳，石灰岩，将它们放入这个反应器,你将它运送到世界各地。

meaning: n. （人体或动植物的）器官；阴茎，阳物；风琴，管风琴； （官方的）机构，机关；机关报刊，宣传工具；【名】 （Organ）（英）奥根（人名）
definition: 1. n. a fully differentiated structural and functional unit in an animal that is specialized for some particular function；2. n. a government agency or instrument devoted to the performance of some specific function
example: The patient's immune system would reject the transplanted organ as a foreign object.
exampleZh: 该病人的免疫系统会将移植器官作为异物加以排斥。

meaning: adj. 有机的，绿色的；有机物的，生物的；构成有机整体的，不可分割的；（发生、发展过程）自然的，演进的；器官的，器质性的；仿自然形态的；n. 有机物质；有机食品
definition: 1. n. a fertilizer that is derived from animal or vegetable matter；2. adj. relating or belonging to the class of chemical compounds having a carbon basis
example: The cost of not having organic and not having fair trade and not having all the things
exampleZh: 没有通过有机培养的食物加上不平等交易等等，

meaning: n. 生物，有机体，（尤指）微生物；有机组织，有机体系
definition: 1. n. a living thing that has (or can develop) the ability to act or function independently；2. n. a system considered analogous in structure or function to a living body
example: DNA carries the genetic blueprint which tells any organism how to build itself.
exampleZh: 脱氧核糖核酸带有决定有机体形成方式的遗传型板。

meaning: v. 组织，筹备；设法提供；（按某一体系）整理，安排；规划，照料；聚集，召集；（为特定人群）建立组织；形成有机体
definition: 1. v. create (as an entity)；2. v. cause to be structured or ordered or operating according to some principle or idea
example: For about six months Wallace Turnage worked in Hector Davis's slave auction house helping organize the auctions every day.
exampleZh: 华莱士·特内奇在赫克托·戴维斯的,奴隶拍卖行工作了六个月,每天帮助组织拍卖
family: organize / organizise / organization / organizatiosation / organizational / organizationasational

meaning: n. 组织，机构；组织工作，筹备工作；编排，配置，结构；条理，逻辑性；机化（医学术语）
definition: 1. n. a group of people who work together；2. n. an organized structure for arranging or classifying
example: And I think as a organization, we try to make sure that those ideas get heard they get expressed.
exampleZh: 我认为，作为一个组织，我们努力确保每个人的声音都能被别人倾听,能够抒发己见。
family: organize / organizise / organization / organizatiosation / organizational / organizationasational

meaning: adj. 组织的，安排的；有关组织（或机构）的；（组织或机构）结构的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to an organization
example: One of the most important tools for organizational improvement is the performance appraisal.
exampleZh: 组织改进的最重要手段之一是业绩评估。
family: organize / organizise / organization / organizatiosation / organizational / organizationasational

meaning: v. 朝向，面对，使适合；定向放置（某物）；确定方位，认识方向（orient oneself）；引导；使熟悉，帮助适应；n. 东方，东亚诸国（the Orient）；（优质珍珠的）光泽；优质珍珠；adj. 东方的，东方国家的；（尤指宝石）光彩夺目的；（太阳等）冉冉上升的，（白昼的光亮等）渐渐变强的；【名】 （Orient） （美）奥里安（人名）
definition: 1. n. the countries of Asia；2. v. be oriented
example: You will need the time to orient yourself to your new way of eating.
exampleZh: 你需要时间适应新的吃法。

meaning: n. 目标，定位；方向，朝向；（基本的）态度，倾向；（岗前、学前、课前等的）情况介绍，培训；适应，熟悉
definition: 1. n. the act of orienting；2. n. an integrated set of attitudes and beliefs
example: To a society which has lost its orientation he has much to offer.
exampleZh: 对一个迷失了方向的社会，他有许多要做的。

meaning: adj. 东方（尤指中国和日本）的，东方人的；（动物学）（与）东方界（有关）的（Oriental）；（珍珠或其他珠宝）有光泽的；n. 东方人（=Oriental）
definition: 1. n. a member of an Oriental race; the term is regarded as offensive by Asians (especially by Asian Americans)；2. adj. denoting or characteristic of the biogeographic region including southern Asia and the Malay Archipelago as far as the Philippines and Borneo and Java
example: The remains and records of these strongholds make it clear that the political organization was an imitation of oriental monarchy.
exampleZh: 这些堡垒的遗迹和记录表明,这个政治体制效法了东方君主政体

meaning: n. 起源，起因；出身，血统；（原）产地；肌肉起端；神经（或血管）起端；（数）原点
definition: 1. n. the place where something begins, where it springs into being；2. n. properties attributable to your ancestry
example: And it's given here this sort of cliched, noble origin with the Native American, the Plains Indian.
exampleZh: 在这儿讲有些陈词滥调的，美洲原住民草原印第安人的高尚开端。

meaning: adj. 起初的，原先的；原作的，真迹的；新创作的，未发表的；独创的，新颖的；有独到见解的，有独创性的；n. （艺术作品或文件的）原件，原稿；（文学作品中人物或地点的）原型；原版书，原版唱片；（根据服装展特制图样定做的）真品原板服装；（举止、服装等）怪异滑稽的人，独特有趣的人
definition: 1. n. an original creation (i.e., an audio recording) from which copies can be made；2. adj. preceding all others in time or being as first made or performed
example: So it's built only a few metres away from the site of the original Shakespeare Globe of the 1600s.
exampleZh: 它建在离十七世纪修建的莎士比亚环球剧院几米之外的地方。

meaning: n. 独创性，创意；独创能力，创造力
definition: 1. n. the ability to think and act independently；2. n. the quality of being new and original (not derived from something else)
example: Artistic originality turns out to be the murderer, to the fans' disgust.
exampleZh: 独创的艺术成了令读者反感的谋杀者。

meaning: v. 起源，产生；创始，开创
definition: 1. v. come into existence; take on form or shape；2. v. bring into being
example: so we got to originate the parts that we played.
exampleZh: 所以我们要加紧创作我们自己的那部分。

meaning: n. 装饰品，点缀品；装饰，摆设；首饰，饰物； 为……增添光彩的人（或事物）（ornament to sth.）；（乐）装饰音（ornaments） ；（基督教）（圣坛、圣餐杯和圣器等）礼拜用品，典礼用品；v. 装饰，点缀
definition: 1. n. something used to beautify；2. v. make more attractive by adding ornament, colour, etc.
example: This is because their staple food, milkweed, is being used more and more as a garden ornament.
exampleZh: 这是因为它们的主要食物，乳草，被越来越多地用于园林装饰。

meaning: adj. 装饰性的，作点缀的；n. 观赏植物；装饰品
definition: 1. n. any plant grown for its beauty or ornamental value；2. adj. serving an esthetic rather than a useful purpose
example: Among them are petunias, ornamental tobacco plants, some varieties of potatoes and tomatoes.
exampleZh: 其中包括矮牵牛、观赏烟草，以及部分品种的土豆和番茄。

meaning: n. 孤儿；（印刷）孤行；v. 使成为孤儿；adj. 孤儿的，无双亲的
definition: 1. n. a child who has lost both parents；2. v. deprive of parents
example: He was an orphan, he had no family, and he was on his first long voyage at sea.
exampleZh: 他是孤儿，没有家人，这是他首次出海远航。

meaning: n. 孤儿院；孤儿身份，孤儿状态
definition: 1. n. the condition of being a child without living parents；2. n. a public institution for the care of orphans
example: We are the first batch of people especially helping the orphanage.
exampleZh: 我们是第一批专程来帮扶这家孤儿院的人。

meaning: adj. （观念、方法或行为）传统的，正统的；（人）正统派的，循规蹈矩的；东正教的，正教的（Orthodox）；（物）普通的，正常的；n. 正统的人，正统的事物
definition: 1. (of beliefs, ideas, or activities) considered traditional, normal, and acceptable by most people；2. (of religious people) having more traditional beliefs than other people in the same religious group
example: So in the end,the canon is a list of the winners in the historical debate to define orthodox Christianity.
exampleZh: 所以最后，正典书目只是赢家的清单,他们在这场定义东正教的历史争论中胜出。

meaning: adj. （表示与已知的人或事物不同）别的，另外的；（表示在与已知的人或事物同一类中）别的，另外的；（两个中）另一的；（一组人或事物中）其余的；（用于列举之后）其他的；对面的，相反方向的；（泛指）别（人）的，他（人）的；最近的，前不久的；pron. （表示与已知的人或事物不同）另外；（表示在与已知的人或事物同一类中）另外；（两个中）另一个（the other）；其余的人（或事物）（the others）；（用于列举之后）其他；对面，相反方向（the other）；性交（the other）；v. 将……看作异类，以异类对待
definition: 1. adj. not the same one or ones already mentioned or implied；2. adj. recently past
example: So you're saying that we are here right now but any second this other event, this other situation will occur.
exampleZh: 你在谈论我们现在是这样的状态，但是一转眼的功夫，另一种事情，另一种情况就会发生。

meaning: adv. 否则，不然；除此以外，在其他方面；不同地，另外地；以其他方式，用别的方法；adj. 不是那样的，另外情况下的
definition: 1. adj. other than as supposed or expected；2. adv. in other respects or ways
example: Shut the window, otherwise it'll get too cold in here.
exampleZh: 把窗户关好，不然屋子里就太冷了。

meaning: 应该；预计会
definition: 1. used to say what is right, advisable, or expected
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: Companies ought to consider the long-term environmental consequences of their investment decisions.
exampleZh: 企业应当考虑其投资决策带来的长期环境后果。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 盎司（重量单位，1盎司约等于28克）；一点点，少量；雪豹
definition: 1. n. a unit of apothecary weight equal to 480 grains or one twelfth of a pound；2. n. a unit of weight equal to one sixteenth of a pound or 16 drams or 28.349 grams
example: Michelle will also spin a customer's wool fleece to specification at a cost of $2.25 an ounce.
exampleZh: 米歇尔也将以每盎司$2.25的价格按照顾客的要求为其纺羊毛呢。

meaning: det. 我们的，我方的；（泛指）我们（人类、一般人）的
definition: 1. belonging to or relating to the speaker and one or more other people
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: Wilde's suggestion, but I think also Kant's suggestion before him, is important for our recognition of our own value.
exampleZh: 王尔德的提议，也是康德的，对我们自己认识到自我的价值很重要。

meaning: pron. 我们的，属于我们的；n. （Ours）（美）乌尔斯（人名）
definition: 1. abstract: Ours is an American rock band led by singer Jimmy Gnecco.
example: exactly who they were targeting and how, though I got the sense that their approach was similar to ours.
exampleZh: 他们究竟把谁当目标又是怎么发现目标的，尽管我有一种感觉,他们的途径和我们的差不多。

meaning: pron. 用作反身代词，作动词或介词宾语，指包括说话者在内的一组人自身，也可泛指人们；作强调用法时表示“我们亲自”，正式英语中有时代替 us 作宾语；固定搭配 by ourselves 意为“独自地；靠我们自己”，between ourselves 意为“只限于咱们之间；秘密地”。
definition: 1. abstract: Ourselves is a 1988 album by punk band 7 Seconds.
example: We recognize in ourselves a virtue which is considered to be the cornerstone of many systems of moral understanding.
exampleZh: 我们承认我们拥有那种美德，可以作为,许多道德认知体系的基石。

meaning: adv. 出现；向外；在室外；出狱；遥远地；出海；退潮；指离球门线或终点线的距离；在公共娱乐场所；公开；出声地；殆尽；直至完成；完全；熄灭；除去；出局；prep. 从……里面出去，离开；adj. 熄灭的；盛开的；面市的；出局的；不能被接受的；过时的；不准确的；打算做……的；被公开的；v. 击倒，击晕；揭露（某人）是同性恋；熄灭；驱逐；拒绝；解除；n. 出路，脱身办法；（棒球）使球员出局的办法；在野党
definition: 1. n. (baseball) a failure by a batter or runner to reach a base safely in baseball；2. v. to state openly and publicly one's homosexuality
example: If you're going out tonight you'll have to count me out.
exampleZh: 假如你们今晚要出去，就别把我算在内。

meaning: n. （战争、疾病、暴力等的）爆发，突然发生
definition: 1. n. a sudden violent spontaneous occurrence (usually of some undesirable condition)
example: His death set in motion a train of events that led to the outbreak of war.
exampleZh: 他的死引发了一系列的事件，从而导致了战争的爆发。

meaning: n. 结果，效果
definition: 1. n. something that results；2. n. a phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon
example: So I think the outcome should be philanthropy and those of you who are successful really ought to give it away.
exampleZh: 所以我认为有钱人,就应该做慈善,而你们中那些成功人士,真的应该将财富捐献出去

meaning: adj. 过时的，陈旧的；v. 使过时（outdate 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. old; no longer in use or valid or fashionable
example: The car has been criticized for its outdated body styling.
exampleZh: 这种轿车因其过时的车身式样而受到批评。

meaning: adj. 户外的，露天的；喜欢户外活动的
definition: 1. adj. located, suited for, or taking place in the open air；2. adj. pertaining to or concerning the outdoors or outdoor activities
example: And one of those is bringing a previous set of skills that I used to the Outdoor Action program.
exampleZh: 其中一种方式，就是将我原来的野外活动技能,带入到我们的户外活动项目中来。

meaning: adv. 在户外，在野外；n. 野外，旷野（the outdoors）；野外活动，户外休闲 （the outdoors）；adj. 户外的
definition: 1. n. where the air is unconfined；2. adv. outside a building
example: For lovers of the great outdoors, activities range from canoeing to bird watching.
exampleZh: 对于户外活动的爱好者们来说，有从划船到观鸟的各种活动。

meaning: adj. 外面的，外部的；远离中心的，外围的；客观外界的，非主观的；（尤用于地名）更远的；n. 外衣，穿在外面的服饰的一部分；靶子的外圈，外圈命中；货箱，转运箱；跑马场围栏外部
definition: 1. adj. being on the outside or further from a center；2. adj. located outside
example: So the distance of the gap needs to be between the outer limits of boredom and overstrain according to Iser.
exampleZh: 因此，据伊瑟尔说，间隙的大小应该,以无聊与过劳作为外缘界限，处于两者之中。

meaning: n. （尤指在某一场合穿的）全套服装；全套工具，全套设备；（协同工作的）一组人，一队人（尤指乐队、运动队、公司）；v. 配备，向……提供装备（或服装）；得到装备
definition: 1. a set of clothes worn for a particular occasion or activity；2. an organization, company, team, military unit, etc.
example: The revamp includes replacing the old navy uniform with a crisp blue and white cotton outfit.
exampleZh: 改进的内容包括将旧海军制服换成清新的蓝白相间的棉套装。

meaning: adj. 爱交际的，外向的；即将离职的；往外去的，离去的；n. 外出，离开物；日常支出，开销（outgoings）；v. 超过，优于（outgo 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. leaving a place or a position；2. adj. at ease in talking to others
example: Responsibility and reliability are necessary qualifications, as well as a friendly and outgoing personality.
exampleZh: 责任感和可靠性是必需的素质，友善和外向的性格也必不可少。

meaning: n. 短途旅游，远足；出门，外出；（尤指在体育项目或电影中的）出场；对同性恋者（尤指名人）的曝光；v. 击倒，击昏；公开（知名人士）的同性恋身份；熄灭（out 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. a journey taken for pleasure；2. n. a day devoted to an outdoor social gathering
example: On the outing, she was offered a candy bar.
exampleZh: 郊游时，有人给了她一块糖果。

meaning: n. 不法之徒，逃犯；被剥夺法律权益和保护者；v. 使非法，禁止，取缔；（旧时）剥夺（某人的）法律权益；【名】 （Outlaw）（美）奥特洛（人名）
definition: 1. (especially in the past) a person who has broken the law and who lives separately from the other parts of society because they want to escape legal punishment；2. to make something illegal or unacceptable
example: It will outlaw flavoured tobacco which lures children, and tobacco advertisements from appearing near schools.
exampleZh: 该法案将禁止引诱儿童的调味烟草，以及禁止在学校附近投放烟草广告。

meaning: n. （情绪或精力的）发泄方式，发泄途径；排出口；商店，分销点；廉价经销店；从事大众媒体行业的公司；电源插座
definition: 1. n. a place of business for retailing goods；2. n. receptacle providing a place in a wiring system where current can be taken to run electrical devices
example: So, Peter the Great, despite his dramatic expansion of the Russian empire, does not get this outlet on the Black Sea.
exampleZh: 所以,彼得大帝,虽然为俄帝国的扩张立下汗马功劳,仍旧没能夺取黑海的入海口

meaning: n. 轮廓，外形；轮廓图，草图；提纲，大纲；梗概，要点；（词的）速记形式；v. 概述，略述；勾勒，描画……的轮廓
definition: 1. n. the line that appears to bound an object；2. v. describe roughly or briefly or give the main points or summary of
example: So, what I did so far is i've told you what Freud had to say in broad outline.
exampleZh: 前面我对弗洛伊德的理论进行了概述。

meaning: n. 看法，态度；前景，展望；景色，风光；瞭望处
definition: 1. n. a habitual or characteristic mental attitude that determines how you will interpret and respond to situations；2. n. belief about (or mental picture of) the future
example: It goes up and down depending on the outlook for earnings and maybe other factors.
exampleZh: 根据收益前景或者其他因素,这个数字可能会上升或下降

meaning: n. 产量，作品；产生，生产过程；输出功率；（计算机的）输出信息；输出端；v. 输出
definition: 1. n. final product; the things produced；2. v. to create or manufacture a specific amount
example: Often that signal gets amplified so it can be used, same thing happens inside cells and there's some output that's generated.
exampleZh: 通常这些信号要放大后才会产生作用,诱发细胞内发生一些变化,并产生某种输出信号

meaning: n. 愤慨，愤怒；骇人听闻的事，暴行；v. 使愤怒，激怒；践踏（准则、法律等）；凌辱，强奸
definition: 1. a feeling of anger and shock；2. a shocking, morally unacceptable, and usually violent action
example: Halfway through the meal, the power cut out, and I began to feel outrage at such poor service.
exampleZh: 吃到一半的时候，停电了，我开始对这样差的服务感到愤怒。

meaning: adj. 骇人的，无法容忍的；反常的，令人惊讶的；极其夸张的，不可能的
definition: 1. shocking and morally unacceptable；2. used to describe something or someone that is shocking because they are unusual or strange
example: The most outrageous action in Laud's crackdown was his move to ban -his attempt to ban preaching in churches.
exampleZh: 他所做过的最骇人听闻的暴行,是企图在教堂里禁止布道训诫行为。

meaning: n. 开始，开端
definition: 1. n. the time at which something is supposed to begin
example: I never understood why he didn't just accede to our demands at the outset.
exampleZh: 我从不能理解为什么他不一开始就答应我们的请求。

meaning: n. 外表，外部（the outside）；（建筑物、车辆等的）周围，外围（the outside）；（人行道的）外侧；（弯曲路面或轨道的）外道，边缘；一令纸的上下两张（outsides）；局外（人士），外界（人士）；prep. 在……的外面，在户外；超出……的范围（或界限）；（团体或组织）以外的；除了，除……之外（outside of）；adv. 在外面；在户外，在四周；在外侧，表面上；adj. 外边的，表面的；（曲棍球、足球等）边锋的；（建筑物）外围的，四周的；不属于本团体（或机构、国家等）的，不相关的；（可能性）极微小的，不大可能的；（车道）靠近路中间的，快车道的
definition: 1. n. the region that is outside of something；2. adj. relating to or being on or near the outer side or limit
example: Yeah, I think if you live outside of London and you need to commute, you got to get the train.
exampleZh: 如果你住在伦敦市区外面，你需要坐火车上下班往返。

meaning: n. 局外人， 外人；（组织、行业）外部的人，外来者；（比赛中）不大可能获胜的人（或动物）
definition: 1. n. someone who is excluded from or is not a member of a group；2. n. a contestant (human or animal) not considered to have a good chance to win
example: In doing so he made himself sort of an outsider to traditional Russian ways of looking at this thing.
exampleZh: 而这样以来,他就如同是一个局外人一样,来对待俄国传统

meaning: n. 市郊，郊区
definition: 1. n. outlying areas (as of a city or town)
example: He did not take the direct route to his home, but made a detour around the outskirts of the city.
exampleZh: 他没有直接回家，而是在市郊绕了一段路。

meaning: adj. 杰出的，优秀的；显著的，突出的；未解决的，未完成的；（款项）未支付的，未结清的
definition: 1. adj. distinguished from others in excellence；2. adj. having a quality that thrusts itself into attention
example: I'm the CEO of Google and I call the broker and I say, how many shares are outstanding?
exampleZh: 如果我是谷歌的执行总裁,我给经纪人打电话问,一共发行了多少股票

meaning: adj. 外表的，表面的；（特定方面）可见的，外部的；朝外的，向外的；（旅程）往外地的，外出的；adv. 向外，朝外；自身之外；明显地，公然地；n. 外表，外面；外部世界，物质世界
definition: 1. adj. relating to physical reality rather than with thoughts or the mind；2. adv. toward the outside
example: Then he flung outward, feet first, with a swish, Kicking his way down through the air to the ground.
exampleZh: 然后，纵身一跳，他两脚先伸出去，在空中乱踢乱舞，于是飕的一声，降落到地面。

meaning: adv. 向外（地），朝外
definition: 1. adv. toward the outside
example: What projection does is takes a desire from me and then puts it on somebody else heading outwards.
exampleZh: 投射是指个体否认自己的欲望,并认为他人拥有此欲望。

meaning: adj. 椭圆形的，卵形的；n. 椭圆形（物），卵形（物）；椭圆形体育场，椭圆形跑道；澳式橄榄球场；【名】 （Oval）（法）奥瓦尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a closed plane curve resulting from the intersection of a circular cone and a plane cutting completely through it；2. adj. rounded like an egg
example: :45 He would typically get to his desk at about 6:45 every morning in the Oval Office.
exampleZh: 他每天早上大概,到达他的办公室。

meaning: n. 烤炉，烤箱；小熔炉，小窑；（纳粹集中营的）火化室；【名】 （Oven）（荷）奥芬（人名）
definition: 1. n. kitchen appliance used for baking or roasting
example: In the summer her mobile home heats up like an oven.
exampleZh: 在夏天，她的活动住房像个烤箱那样热起来。

meaning: adv. 向下，倒下；翻过，翻转；越过；超过，以上；完全覆盖；在上方；剩下，余下；再，又；改变，掉换；结束，完；去，到（某处）；很，太；仔细地；度过一段时间；prep. 盖在……上面；悬在……上面；从一边到另一边；翻越；在……的对面；从……落下；遍及；超过，多于；控制，支配；在……期间；渡过（难关等）；由于，关于；利用，通过；声音大于；胜过，优于；尽管；漏掉，略过；除以；n. （板球）一轮投球；adj. 结束的；剩下的；v. 越过；【名】 （Over）（美、英、德）奥韦尔（人名）
definition: 1. adj. having come or been brought to a conclusion；2. adv. at or to a point across intervening space etc.
example: So now if I look at my V1 over V2 to the gamma minus 1, that's T2 over T1.
exampleZh: 于是把^=中2,的两个温度。

meaning: adj. 总的，全面的；所有的，包括一切的；adv. 全部，总共； 总的说来，大体上；n. （工作时穿的）罩衣；（上下连身的）工作服，防护服（overalls）；背带工装裤（overalls）；骑马裤，紧身制服裤（overalls）
definition: 1. n. (usually plural) work clothing consisting of denim trousers (usually with a bib and shoulder straps)；2. adj. involving only main features
example: There were also issues about nutritional adequacy and meat turned out to be a better overall food than most plants.
exampleZh: 还有关于营养充分的问题,这样看,肉类较植物来说是更好的食物

meaning: n. 大衣，外套； 外层涂料，保护层
definition: 1. n. a heavy coat worn over clothes in winter；2. n. an additional protective coating (as of paint or varnish)
example: That's the way the story is put together, how the overcoat is made, and so on.
exampleZh: 是故事被组合的方式，就像在，外套，中一样。

meaning: v. 克服，解决；征服，战胜；使受不了，使无法行动（或思考）
definition: 1. v. win a victory over；2. v. get on top of; deal with successfully
example: Read everything you can, Milton insists, because only then can you overcome what he thinks of and characterizes as the temptation of reading.
exampleZh: 尽可能地阅读，弥尔顿坚持到，因为只有这样你才能抵抗他认为以及标榜为的,阅读对人产生的诱惑。

meaning: adj. （到期）未付的，未还的；未能准时的，延误的； 早该发生的，早应完成的
definition: 1. adj. past due; not paid at the scheduled time
example: "Some skepticism about these models is overdue," he added.
exampleZh: “对这些模型抱有一些怀疑早该如此，”他补充道。

meaning: v. 漫出，泛滥 ；充满，挤满；装满，完全盖住；扩展出界，过度延伸；洋溢着（情感）；n. 溢出，溢出的液体；容纳不下的人（或物）；溢流管（=overflow pipe）；（计算机）数据过载
definition: 1. When a liquid overflows, it flows over the edges of a container, etc. because there is too much of it；2. If a container or a place overflows, whatever is inside it starts coming out because it is too full
example: Pour in some of the broth, but not all of it, because it will probably overflow.
exampleZh: 倒入部分肉汤，不要全部，因为很可能会溢出来。

meaning: v. 彻底检修，全面改造；全面改革（制度或方法）；（尤指在体育竞赛中）赶上，超过；n. 大修，彻底检修；（制度或方法的）全面改革
definition: 1. to repair an engine, machine, etc. so that every part of it works as it should；2. to completely change a system so that it works more effectively
example: The second line of attack is to overhaul schemes that help workers retrain and encourage them to search for work.
exampleZh: 第二项应对举措是全面改革帮助工人接受再培训的相关方案，并鼓励他们求职。

meaning: adv. 在头顶上方，在空中；adj. 头顶上的，在空中的，高架的；（驱动装置）顶置式的；经费的，管理费用的；n. 经常开支，营运费用（=overheads）；（用于投影仪显示文字、图片等的）透明幻灯片；（尤指飞机的）顶舱
definition: 1. n. the expense of maintaining property (e.g., paying property taxes and utilities and insurance); it does not include depreciation or the cost of financing or income taxes；2. adj. located or originating from above
example: There's a second figure here standing ab extra, and that's the moon hovering overhead: "while over-head the Moon / sits Arbitress."
exampleZh: 这里有第二个置身事外的角色，就是高高挂在空中的月亮：,“月亮高挂天心，像个公正的决断人“

meaning: v. 无意中听到，偷听到
definition: 1. v. hear, usually without the knowledge of the speakers
example: They were shut away in a little room where nobody could overhear.
exampleZh: 他们躲在一个小屋子里，没有人能偷听得到。

meaning: v. （与……）互搭，（与……）复叠；（在关注的问题、承担的责任等方面）部分地重叠，部分相同；（与……）同时发生；n. （物体的）重叠部分，重叠量；（范围方面的）重叠部分；（两事发生的）重叠时间，交接时期
definition: 1. to cover something partly by going over its edge; to cover part of the same space；2. If two or more activities, subjects, or periods of time overlap, they have some parts that are the same
example: And when you have an optimal substructure and the local solutions overlap, that's when you can bring dynamic programming to bear.
exampleZh: 当你得到一个最优子结构,但局部解决方案有重跌时，你就可以引入动态编程,来解决这个问题了。

meaning: v. 忽视，忽略；（工作、职位、提拔等）不考虑（某人）；（对不良现象等）不予理会，视而不见；眺望，俯瞰；监督；检查；用邪恶的眼睛施魔法于；n. 居高临下的位置，从高处能看到的景色；眺望
definition: 1. n. a high place affording a good view；2. v. look past, fail to notice
example: The interaction effects make things even worse, and we can't overlook those negative interaction effects.
exampleZh: 相互影响让事情变得更坏，我们不能忽视这种负面的相互影响。

meaning: adv. 在夜间，在晚上；突然，一夜之间；adj. 夜间的，只供一夜的；突然的，一夜之间的；v. 过夜；连夜快递（货物）；n. 一夜的逗留
definition: 1. adj. lasting, open, or operating through the whole night；2. adv. happening in a short time or with great speed
example: The Federal Funds Rate is the rate that banks borrow and lend to each other overnight.
exampleZh: 联邦资金利率是,一夜间银行之间借进与借出的比率。

meaning: v. （以权力）否决，推翻；凌驾于，比……更重要；对（自动机器）改用手控，超驰控制；（尤指为改变运作方式而）操控，制服；伸展在……上面，重叠；从……上走过，从……上面驶过；（乘公共交通工具）超程乘车（实际距离超出车票允许的距离）；n. （尤指从自动改为手动的）超控装置；（预算、薪金、费用等的）超量，增加；（对决定等的）否决，撤销
definition: 1. (of a person who has the necessary authority) to decide against or refuse to accept a previous decision, an order, a person, etc.；2. to operate an automatic machine by hand
example: The president vetoed the bill, and the Senate failed by a single vote to override his veto.
exampleZh: 总统否决了议案，而参议院因一票之差未能推翻他的否决。

meaning: adj. 外国的，海外的；adv. 在国外，在海外
definition: 1. adj. in a foreign country；2. adv. beyond or across the sea
example: They do a lot of business in lucrative overseas markets.
exampleZh: 他们在利润丰厚的海外市场上生意很多。

meaning: v. 监管，监督；看到，无意中看到
definition: 1. v. watch and direct
example: I was assigned as depot engineer to oversee the oil and gasoline tanks at the compound.
exampleZh: 我被指派为仓库工程师，监管厂区内的石油和汽油储罐。

meaning: n. 监督；失察，疏忽
definition: 1. n. an unintentional omission resulting from failure to notice something；2. n. management by overseeing the performance or operation of a person or group
example: The bill creates an oversight board with the authority to investigate and punish accounting firms.
exampleZh: 该法案创建了一个有权调查并处罚会计师事务所的监督委员会。

meaning: v. 夸大，对……言过其实
definition: 1. to describe or explain something in a way that makes it seem more important or serious than it really is；2. to state something too strongly, or to state that it is greater than it really is
example: Such managers have an enormous stake in succeeding, so they invariably overstate the potential of their new technologies.
exampleZh: 这些管理者与成功有着巨大的利害关系，因此他们总是夸大新技术的潜力。

meaning: adj. 公开的，不隐瞒的
definition: 1. done or shown publicly or in an obvious way and not secret；2. done or shown obviously or publicly; not hidden or secret
example: Although there is no overt hostility, black and white students do not mix much.
exampleZh: 虽然没有明显的敌意，但黑人学生和白人学生还是交往不多。

meaning: v. 追上， 赶上并超过（汽车或人）；（发展或增长）超越，超过；突然降临于，意外发生在；（情感等）压倒，使难以承受
definition: 1. v. catch up with and possibly overtake；2. v. travel past
example: Coming out of the final bend, the runner stepped up a gear to overtake the rest of the pack.
exampleZh: 赛跑者绕过最后一个弯道后开始加速，以图超越同组的其他选手。

meaning: v. 推翻，打倒；背弃，摒弃（规则、观念或社会制度）；投（球）过猛，投球超过（接手或目标）；n. 推翻，打倒；投球过远，投球过猛；（因对方投球过远而得的）分；（拱门、门廊上方的）铁艺装饰板
definition: 1. n. the termination of a ruler or institution (especially by force)；2. v. cause the downfall of; of rulers
example: Look at the last verse of that chapter: "Do we then overthrow the law by this faith?"
exampleZh: 第三章的最后一段：，“我们因信废了律法吗。”

meaning: n. 加班，加班时间；加班费；加时，加时赛；adj. 超时的，加班的；adv. 超时地；v. 使（曝光等）超过时间
definition: 1. n. work done in addition to regular working hours；2. adv. beyond the regular time
example: Almost any game you play has some kind of randomness or pseudorandomness which means that things change overtime somewhat unpredictably.
exampleZh: 大多数你所玩过的游戏都有某种,随机数或者伪随机数,这就意味着每个事件都存在不可预测性。

meaning: v. （使）翻倒，（使）倾覆；推翻，撤销（判决等）；颠覆，破坏（政府或体系）；在英国大选中因获得多数席位而获胜；n. 颠覆，革命；（尤指水温分层的湖水每年两次的）湖水对流
definition: 1. to (cause to) turn over；2. to change a legal decision
example: Now the theoreticians are going to redo their equations, and more experiments will be done to confirm or overturn it.
exampleZh: 现在的理论家将要重做他们的方程，并要做更多的实验来证实或推翻它。

meaning: v. （感情上）使受不了，使不知所措；使大吃一惊；压垮，使应接不暇；打败，击垮； （水）漫过，淹没；压倒，制服
definition: 1. v. overcome, as with emotions or perceptual stimuli；2. v. charge someone with too many tasks
example: A big or steady serving of sarcasm will overwhelm the emotional flavor of any conversation and can taste very bitter to its recipient.
exampleZh: 大量或持续的讽刺会淹没任何谈话的情感色调，而且会让接受者尝到苦涩的滋味。

meaning: adj. 难以抗拒的，令人不知所措的；巨大的，压倒性的；v. （感情上）使受不了，使不知所措；压垮，使应接不暇；打败，击垮（overwhelm 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. so strong as to be irresistible；2. adj. very intense
example: I just want to emphasize one more time, that the overwhelming normal situation is the first one I described, friendly relations.
exampleZh: 我想再强调一遍,正如我最初所说的,两者之间大多情况下都是友好关系

meaning: adv. 压倒性地，不可抵抗地
definition: 1. adv. incapable of being resisted
example: Agriculture was overwhelmingly the activity, the most important activity of the people of that area, of any area.
exampleZh: 绝大多数经济活动是农业活动,农业对该地区,甚至任何地区的人民来说,都是最重要的活动

meaning: v. 欠（钱），负账；应该做，应给予；欠（人情），应该感激；归因于，归功于；【名】 （Owe）（瑞典、挪）奥弗（人名）
definition: 1. v. be obliged to pay or repay；2. v. be indebted to, in an abstract or intellectual sense
example: You bought the house for $300,000; you sell it for $270,000 that's exactly what you owe, so you have nothing left.
exampleZh: 你以30万的价格买入房子,然后以27万的价格卖出,27万就是你的负债数,所以你什么都没剩下

meaning: prep. 由于，因为（多用于正式或书面语境，后接名词或名词性短语）
definition: 1. because of; as a result of
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: The flight was delayed for several hours owing to severe weather conditions.
exampleZh: 由于恶劣天气，航班延误了数小时。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 鸮，猫头鹰；夜猫子（喜欢熬夜的人）（=night owl）
definition: 1. a bird with a flat face and large eyes that hunts small mammals at night；2. a person who likes to stay up late at night
example: The owl is sacred for many Californian Indian people.
exampleZh: 猫头鹰对于很多加利福利亚的印第安人来说是神圣的。

meaning: v. 有，拥有； 承认；为（某事）承担全责，承认为（某事）负全责； 彻底击败，彻底羞辱；adj. 自己的，属于自己的；自己做的，为自己的；具有自己特点的，特有的；pronoun. 自己的，属于自己的；自己做的，自己生产的；具有自己特点的，特有的；【名】 （Own）（阿拉伯）奥恩（人名）
definition: 1. v. have ownership or possession of；2. adj. belonging to or on behalf of a specified person (especially yourself); preceded by a possessive
example: especially as I am trying to develop my own thoughts and my own research questions for my future career.
exampleZh: 尤其是就我未来职业方面，我正在尝试形成自己的观点，提出我的研究问题。

meaning: n. 所有人，物主
definition: 1. n. (law) someone who owns (is legal possessor of) a business；2. n. a person who owns something
example: Then I want to talk about mortgages, which is the way that we finance both commercial and owner-occupied real estate.
exampleZh: 然后再讲一下抵押贷款,它可以为,商业地产和自住房产提供融资

meaning: n. 所有权，物主身份
definition: 1. n. the relation of an owner to the thing possessed; possession with the right to transfer possession to others；2. n. the act of having and controlling property
example: Ownership is not clear because of expropriations in the Nazi era.
exampleZh: 所有权因纳粹时期的征收而不明。

meaning: n. 去势公牛，阉牛；牛（指大的母牛或公牛）
definition: 1. n. an adult castrated bull of the genus Bos; especially Bos taurus；2. n. any of various wild bovines especially of the genera Bos or closely related Bibos
example: Literal punishment: for example, in the Code of Hammurabi, where someone's ox kills a child, then the ox owner's child is killed.
exampleZh: 例如，在汉穆拉比法典里，如果某人的牛,杀死了一个小孩，那么这头牛的主人的小孩也应处死。

meaning: n. 氧化物
definition: 1. a chemical combination of oxygen and one other element
example: You could run the reaction, take solid iron gaseous oxygen, form iron oxide, measure the heat of formation of it, tabulate it.
exampleZh: 你可以进行一个反应,用固态铁和氧气生成氧化铁，测量它的生成热，列成表格。

meaning: n. 氧，氧气
definition: 1. n. a nonmetallic bivalent element that is normally a colorless odorless tasteless nonflammable diatomic gas; constitutes 21 percent of the atmosphere by volume; the most abundant element in the earth's crust
example: If we take hydrogen peroxide in the liquid state, it can break down to form water and oxygen.
exampleZh: 如果我们有一些液态的过氧化氢，它会分解成水和氧气。

meaning: n. 臭氧；（尤指海边的）清新空气；臭氧层（ozone layer 的简写）；【名】 （Ozone）（日）小曾根（姓）
definition: 1. n. a colorless gas (O3) soluble in alkalis and cold water; a strong oxidizing agent; can be produced by electric discharge in oxygen or by the action of ultraviolet radiation on oxygen in the stratosphere (where it acts as a screen for ultraviolet radiation)
example: It is widely known that CFCs can damage the ozone layer.
exampleZh: 众所周知氯氟烃会破坏臭氧层。

meaning: n. 步速，（移动的）速度；（发生、进展、发展的）速度，节奏；一步，一步之距；（马行走或奔跑的）步法；步态；快节奏；快跑的能力；（板球）（影响球速的）两个三柱门之间的场地状况；v. （因担忧、紧张或不耐烦而）踱步，踱步于；（在赛跑中）为……定速度；为……领跑；为（书、电影等中的故事）设定节奏；调整自己的工作（或活动）节奏；步测；（马）走侧对步（主见于专门饲养或训练的马）；prep. （用于人名前，委婉提出不同意见）请……原谅；【名】 （Pace）（捷）帕采，（英）佩斯，（法）帕斯，（罗）帕切（人名）
definition: 1. n. the rate of moving (especially walking or running)；2. v. walk with slow or fast paces
example: You can adjust those grades, let's leave it until next week and we can take it at a leisurely pace.
exampleZh: 你可以更正你的成绩，让我们一直延续到下周,我们可以在一个休闲的地方。

meaning: v. （把……）打包，收拾（行李）；包装，装箱；（用柔软材料）把……裹（包）起来；在（容器中的食物）上覆盖物质（以防止腐烂）；可折叠运输（或存放）；挤进，塞满；聚集；把……盖上，填封；把……大量放进，装满；（把……）压实，（使）堆积；在（委员会或会议）中安插（支持者、利己的人或事物）；具有，能产生（强大之物或能量）；携带（武器）；（橄榄球）形成对阵争球；n. 包，包裹，捆；（尤指士兵或野外徒步者的）背包；（一般为纸质的）小盒，小包；一副纸牌；（一起生活猎食的）兽群（尤指狼群）；（尤指不受人喜欢的）一帮，一伙；（比赛或竞赛中的）集群，集团；（放在伤口上止血或消肿的）裹布，敷料；（美容用的）面膜，贴膜；一队（男或女幼童军）；（军事交通工具，尤指飞机或潜水艇的）一组，一队；（英橄）全体前锋；（极地海洋中的）流冰群，浮冰群；【名】 （Pack）（英、德）帕克（人名）
definition: 1. n. a large indefinite number；2. v. arrange in a container
example: I can take a heat pack, like the kind you buy at a pharmacy. Break it up. It gets hot.
exampleZh: 买来的热装罐在里面打破,它就变热了。

meaning: n. 包裹；（包装食物等的）盒，包；（建议或提供的想法或服务的）一套，一揽子；包价（旅游）；成套出售的东西，套餐；软件包；v. 把……打包，把……装箱（以便出售）；包装（产品或想法等）；配套销售（商品）；承揽图书（尤指插图多的图书）的约稿和印制并整体打包出售给出版商
definition: 1. n. a collection of things wrapped or boxed together；2. v. put into a box
example: Two quotations, the first the president Bush " "Passing a new growth package is our most pressing economic priority."
exampleZh: 下面是两个引述，第一个来自布什总统,“一个新的一揽子增长计划迫在眉睫“

meaning: n. 包装盒，包装袋；（扁平的）小包裹；（通常内容物仅够用一次的）小袋，小包（=sachet）；文件包；信息包，数据包；一笔巨款；男性的性器官；v. 把..……打包
definition: 1. n. a collection of things wrapped or boxed together；2. n. (computer science) a message or message fragment
example: Look in the packet at this letter near the top of the right-hand side of the page.
exampleZh: 看一下这封信的,右手边最上面。

meaning: n. 条约，协议，公约
definition: 1. a formal agreement between two people or groups of people
example: A nonaggression pact will be signed this week between the two countries.
exampleZh: 这周两国将签署互不侵犯条约。

meaning: n. （吸收液体、保洁或保护用的）软垫，垫状物；（动物的）肉掌，（人的）手指肚；便笺本，拍纸簿；发射台，停机坪；（睡莲的）浮叶；低沉的脚步声；（电子）焊接区，焊接点；住处，寓所；v. （用软物）填塞，垫衬；（添加不必要的信息以）拉长（pad sth. out）；虚报（开支、账单）；沿着（路、路线）走；放轻脚步走；在比赛（尤指板球赛）前穿上防护垫（pad up）；（板球）（击球手）有意用护垫挡球（pad up）；abbr. （PAD）外周动脉疾病（peripheral arterial disease）；【名】 （Pad）（英）帕德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a number of sheets of paper fastened together along one edge；2. v. add details to
example: Have a pad and pencil ready and jot down some of your thoughts.
exampleZh: 准备一本便笺簿和一支铅笔，迅速地记下你的一些想法。

meaning: n. 稻田，水田；稻，稻谷；大怒，狂怒；（Paddy）（侮辱性用语）爱尔兰佬；【名】 （Paddy）帕迪（人名）
definition: 1. n. (slur) a person of Irish descent；2. n. an irrigated or flooded field where rice is grown
example: The musicians burst into a rousing rendition of "Paddy Casey's Reel."
exampleZh: 这些音乐家激情演绎了《帕迪·凯西的里尔舞曲》。

meaning: n. （书、报纸、文件等的）页，面；网页；历史重要事件（或时期），历史篇章；伴童，（新娘的）小男傧相；（旅馆或俱乐部中通常身穿制服的）男侍从，听差；（中世纪作为接受骑士训练服侍某个骑士的）学习骑士；（旧时高层人员的）男侍从；（美国议员的）青年助理（本身为学生）；v. （在公共场所）用扩音器呼叫（某人或发布信息）；用寻呼机呼叫（某人）；随意翻阅，浏览（page through）；（软件、数据的）分页（存储）；为……编页码，为……标注页码；【名】 （Page）（西）帕赫，（英）佩奇，（意）帕杰，（法）帕日（人名）
definition: 1. n. one side of one leaf (of a book or magazine or newspaper or letter etc.) or the written or pictorial matter it contains；2. v. call out somebody's name over a P.A. system
example: Now this on page 2. This is how he talks: All this time Dean was telling Marylou things like this.
exampleZh: 这是在第二页，他这样说：,一直以来安总是对玛丽露说些这样的话。

meaning: n. 疼痛，伤痛；苦恼，悲痛；讨厌的人（或事）（=pain in the neck）；努力，苦心（pains）；v. 使痛苦，使苦恼；使疼痛；（身体某一部分）感到疼痛；【名】 （Pain）（意）帕因，（俄）派因，（法）潘，（英）佩因（人名）
definition: 1. n. a symptom of some physical hurt or disorder；2. v. cause bodily suffering to and make sick or indisposed
example: And a few lines down Mammon tells us that we will "work ease out of pain / through labour and endurance."
exampleZh: 在下面几行贪神告诉我们,我们将会“缓解那痛楚，经由劳动和忍耐“

meaning: adj. 疼痛的；引起疼痛的；令人痛苦（难受）的，困难的；令人难堪的
definition: 1. adj. causing physical or psychological pain；2. adj. causing misery or pain or distress
example: When you lead the meditation, I think kneeling is fine, but for me it's really painful, not everybody can do that.
exampleZh: 当进行冥想时，我觉得跪地可以接受，但确实感到疼痛，不是人人都可以坚持。

meaning: n. 油漆，涂料；绘画颜料（paints）；（已干的）油漆层，涂层；化妆，涂脂抹粉；（计算机）（尤指模拟真画效果的）绘图功能；花马，杂色马；（篮球）三秒区；v. （给……）上油漆，（给……）涂颜料；用油漆（或涂料）覆盖（paint sth. out）；（用颜料）绘画；涂，抹（嘴唇、指甲等）；（以某种方式）描绘，描写；（计算机）用绘图程序作图；（在雷达屏幕上）显示（飞机，车辆）；【名】 （Paint）（美）潘（人名）
definition: 1. n. a substance used as a coating to protect or decorate a surface (especially a mixture of pigment suspended in a liquid); dries to form a hard coating；2. v. make a painting
example: The general structure that we're looking at can be summarized as this, if this helps paint a nice mental picture.
exampleZh: 我们一般看到的这个结构可以这样概括,如果这个帮助我们描绘出一个漂亮的记忆画面。

meaning: n. （一幅）画，绘画作品；绘画创作，绘画；粉刷，上油漆；v. 给……上油漆（或涂料）；（用颜料）绘，画；往（指甲、嘴唇等上）施化妆品（paint 的现在分词形式）；【名】 （Painting）（英）佩因廷（人名）
definition: 1. n. graphic art consisting of an artistic composition made by applying paints to a surface；2. n. creating a picture with paints
example: Dudley Herschbach, a Harvard chemistry professor who has a Nobel prize had this painting hung at one of the halls.
exampleZh: 德利·赫施巴赫，一位哈佛化学教授,他曾获得诺贝尔奖并将这画,挂在了其中的一个大厅里。

meaning: n. 画家；油漆匠；系船索，缆索；美洲豹；【名】 （Painter）（英）佩因特（人名）
definition: 1. n. an artist who paints；2. n. a worker who is employed to cover objects with paint
example: He is also a fine painter and varnisher, and says he can make a fine panel door.
exampleZh: 他也是个很好的画匠和油漆匠,而且他会制作极好的门板

meaning: n. （成双的两物品）一对，一双；（由两个相连的类似部分组成的）一套，一副；两个共事（或有特殊关系）的人；（成对物的）另一只，（搭档的）另一人；（交配的）一对动物；两匹并排驾车的马；对子（指两张同点的纸牌）；（议会中）相约放弃投票权的敌对两党的两名议员（或其中一名）；v. 使成对，配对；（使）结成一对（恋人）（pair off/up）；（动物）交配（=pair up）；使（敌对两党的两名议员）组成不投票的一对；【名】 （Pair）佩尔（姓氏）
definition: 1. n. a set of two similar things considered as a unit；2. v. form a pair or pairs
example: and they bought every single one of these guests a pair of new shoes for a party favor.
exampleZh: 而且他们给每个参加聚会的人买了一双新鞋。

meaning: n. 王宫，（官位极高者的）府邸；住在王宫里的人，王室（the Palace）；大厦，豪宅；adj. 王宫的，（总统）官邸的；与政府人员有关的
definition: 1. n. a large and stately mansion；2. n. the governing group of a kingdom
example: I'm going to go guard the Queen and stand outside the palace in my tunic.
exampleZh: 我要去守卫女王，穿着制服站在宫殿外。

meaning: adj. （脸色）苍白的；（颜色）浅的，淡的；（光线）暗淡的，微弱的；较差的，逊色的；v. （脸色）变苍白；（颜色）变淡，变浅；使褪色；显得逊色，相形见绌；用板条围；n. （做桩篱用的）板条，尖桩；（喻）界限，范围；（纹章）（盾形中部的）垂直宽条；（俄国）犹太人居住区；【名】 （Pale）（塞）帕莱（人名）
definition: 1. n. a wooden strip forming part of a fence；2. v. turn pale, as if in fear
example: But he's just looking really pale and worn out.
exampleZh: 但他看起来脸色苍白，精疲力竭。

meaning: n. 手掌，手心；（手套的）掌部；（制帆工用的）护掌；棕榈树；（作为奖赏或胜利象征的）棕榈叶；鹿角的扁平部分；v. 把……藏在手中（尤指玩戏法）；（篮球）持球犯规；用手挡（球）；【名】 （Palm）（英）帕姆，（瑞典）帕尔姆，（法、德、俄、捷、芬、挪）帕尔姆（人名）
definition: 1. n. the inner surface of the hand from the wrist to the base of the fingers；2. v. touch, lift, or hold with the hands
example: He smacked a fist into the palm of his hand.
exampleZh: 他用拳头啪地猛击一下手掌。

meaning: n. 小册子，活页；v. 向……散发小册子
definition: 1. a thin book with only a few pages that gives information or an opinion about something；2. a few sheets of paper folded together to form a thin magazine that contains information or opinions about something
example: The pamphlet was in my desk, in the top drawer—the most obvious place imaginable!
exampleZh: 小册子就在我书桌里，在最上层的抽屉里——能想到的最显眼的位置！

meaning: n. 平底锅；一锅的量； 烤盘，盘状器皿；（天平的）秤盘；（淘金用的）淘选盘；炼锅； 马桶；钢鼓（主要为演奏者用语）；土磐，磐层；洼地，晒盐池；（旧式枪的）火药池；摇摄动作； 脸；v. 移动拍摄，摇摄；用淘金盘淘洗，淘金； 严厉批评（书、电影、戏剧等）；在浅锅中烹调（食物）
definition: 1. n. cooking utensil consisting of a wide metal vessel；2. v. make a sweeping movement
example: If it's a true happiness smile, that's actually bodes better for the relationship than a Pan Am, or greeting smile.
exampleZh: 如果是一个真正开心的微笑，对这段感情来说是个好兆头,比问候式微笑好的多。

meaning: n. 熊猫，大熊猫，猫熊；小熊猫（red panda），红熊猫；Panda（人名）潘达（印、塞）
definition: 1. abstract: Panda, later stylished as PXNDX, is a Mexican alternative rock band formed in Monterrey, Nuevo León in 1996 as part of the musical movement known as Avanzada Regia. The band caught local attention in 2001 with the album Arroz con leche, and mainstream success on their albums Para ti con desprecio (2005) and Amantes Sunt Amentes (2006).
example: So, pandas for instance, like this panda, are notoriously cute, and I don't have anything to say about it really.
exampleZh: 比如说熊猫,像这只熊猫,就是公认的可爱,关于这我并没有什么可说的

meaning: n. 专家咨询组，专题讨论小组；（门等的）镶板，嵌板；控制板，仪表盘；（车身的）金属板；（衣服上的）镶条，饰片；画板；陪审团；国民保健制度（原国民健康保险）医师名单；被告；v. 用（木板、金属板等）覆盖，镶；【名】 （Panel）帕内尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. sheet that forms a distinct (usually flat) section or component of something；2. v. decorate with panels
example: He is also a fine painter and varnisher, and says he can make a fine panel door.
exampleZh: 他也是个很好的画匠和油漆匠,而且他会制作极好的门板

meaning: n. 恐慌，惊慌；人心惶惶，惶恐不安；忙乱，慌乱；粟，稷，糜子；adj. 恐慌的；v. （使）恐慌，（使）惊慌失措；【名】 （Panic）（罗）帕尼克（人名）
definition: 1. n. an overwhelming feeling of fear and anxiety；2. v. be overcome by a sudden fear
example: What would happen is there would be a panic; " people would say they're not paying on the notes.
exampleZh: 这会导致恐慌的发生；,人们会说：“银行没有兑现纸币。

meaning: n. （陆地或海洋的）全景，全貌；全景画，全景摄影；（某一主题或系列事件的）概论，综述；万花筒，各种人物，多样事物
definition: 1. a view of a wide area；2. a photograph in which the image is shown in a wide view
example: He climbed up the tower to see the panorama of the factory.
exampleZh: 他爬上这座高塔以便看到工厂的全景。

meaning: adj. 全景的，远景的
definition: 1. with a view of a wide area
example: Some suite is equipped with private jacuzzi pool in a panoramic terrace for the highest level of pampering.
exampleZh: 部分套房在全景露台上配有私人按摩浴缸，带来顶级的奢华享受。

meaning: v. 气喘，喘息；气喘吁吁地说；气喘吁吁地跑；渴望（pant for）；（心）剧跳，（胸部）剧烈起伏；n. 气喘，喘息； 心跳，胸部的起伏；喷气声；【名】 （Pant）（印、美、英）潘特（人名）
definition: 1. to breathe quickly and loudly through your mouth, usually because you have been doing something very energetic；2. to breathe quickly and loudly through your mouth, usually because you have been doing something energetic
example: "The shell masks the pilings so that the house doesn't look like it's standing with its pant legs pulled up," said Huff.
exampleZh: “外壳把桩柱遮住，这样房子看起来就不像是挽着裤腿站着似的。”赫夫说。

meaning: n. 裤子； 内裤，短裤； 废物，劣质品；adj. 无价值的，低劣的；裤子的；v. 气喘，喘息；喘着气说；渴望（pant 的第三人称单数形式）
definition: 1. n. underpants worn by women
example: She described him as wearing brown corduroy pants and a white cotton shirt.
exampleZh: 她描述说他穿着棕色的灯芯绒长裤和一件白色的棉衬衫。

meaning: n. 纸；报纸；（工作、学习或个人的）资料，文件（papers）；证明，证件（如护照、身份证等）（papers）；政府报告，官方政策文件；考试，答卷；（研究）论文，（学术）讲话；（学校课程的）学期论文；墙纸，壁纸；有价证券；手纸，卫生纸；（剧院等娱乐场所的）免费入场券；v. 用墙纸裱糊（墙壁）；用墙纸覆盖（洞，污点）（paper sth. over）；掩盖（尴尬问题）（paper sth. over）；发免费入场券使（剧院）满座；adj. 纸做的，纸质的；书面的，印刷的；纸上的，有名无实的；【名】 （Paper）（俄）帕佩尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a material made of cellulose pulp derived mainly from wood or rags or certain grasses；2. v. cover with paper
example: It was interesting that I sent home because we will be doing this paper and we will be doing family tree.
exampleZh: 我让他们在家完成的作业很有意思,因为我们要完成这张纸上的内容,并画一个族谱。

meaning: n. 平装书，简装书；v. 以平装本出版；adj. （书）纸面装订的，平装的
definition: 1. n. a book with paper covers；2. adj. (of books) having a flexible binding
example: She said she would buy the book when it comes out in paperback.
exampleZh: 她说等那本书的平装本面市后她会买一本。

meaning: n. 降落伞；v. 跳伞；伞降，空投；紧急任命，临危受命
definition: 1. a piece of equipment made of a large piece of special cloth that is fastened to a person or thing that is dropped from an aircraft, in order to make him, her, or it fall slowly and safely to the ground；2. to jump from an aircraft using a parachute
example: Every now and then you read in the newspaper about somebody whose parachute failed to open and so they died.
exampleZh: 不时地你会在报纸上看到,某人的降落伞没打开导致他们死了。

meaning: n. 游行；列队表演，展示；检阅，阅兵；阅兵场；一系列（人或事）；夸示，炫耀；（用于街道名称中）商业街，公共广场；（常指远离大街的）一小排店铺；v. 游行；（使）列队行进，接受检阅；招摇过市，大摇大摆；把（囚犯）示众；展示，展览；夸示，炫耀（财产、知识等）；（使）冒充，伪装；【名】 （Parade）（法、德）帕拉德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a ceremonial procession including people marching；2. v. walk ostentatiously
example: And the parade, I mean we're talking two hundred, three hundred thousand people in one day.
exampleZh: 在游行中，我们一天里会见到20万，或者30万人。

meaning: n. 典范，范例；样板，范式；词形变化表；纵聚合关系语言项
definition: 1. a model of something, or a very clear and typical example of something；2. a very clear or typical example used as a model
example: Orpheus had provided Milton with a paradigm of the poet, the poet whose discipline and whose abstinence nourished and strengthened his poetry.
exampleZh: 俄耳甫斯在弥尔顿看来是诗人的模范,他严于律己，节制禁欲，让诗作更加出色。

meaning: n. （某些宗教所指的）天堂，天国；乐土（指美好的环境）；（某类活动或某类人的）乐园，完美去处；至福，极乐；（《圣经》中的）伊甸园（Paradise）
definition: 1. a place or condition of great happiness where everything is exactly as you would like it to be；2. Heaven
example: The ancient Egyptians saw paradise as an idealized version of their own lives.
exampleZh: 古埃及人把天堂视为他们现实生活的理想形式。

meaning: n. 矛盾的人（或事物、情况）；似非而是的隽语，悖论；悖论修辞
definition: 1. n. (logic) a statement that contradicts itself
example: It is a curious paradox that professional comedians often have unhappy personal lives.
exampleZh: 这真是个奇怪的矛盾现象—职业喜剧演员的私人生活往往并不快乐。

meaning: adj. 自相矛盾的；事与愿违的，出乎意料的
definition: 1. adj. seemingly contradictory but nonetheless possibly true
example: Some sedatives produce the paradoxical effect of making the person more anxious.
exampleZh: 一些镇静剂产生出使人更紧张这样自相矛盾的结果。

meaning: n. （文章的）段，段落；段落符号；短评；v. 把（文章）分段
definition: 1. n. one of several distinct subdivisions of a text intended to separate ideas; the beginning is usually marked by a new indented line；2. v. divide into paragraphs, as of text
example: In the second verse paragraph, Milton tells his father: "do not despise divine poetry, creation of the prophetic bard.
exampleZh: 在诗的第二段，弥尔顿对他父亲说：,不要轻视神圣的诗歌，诗人预示性的创作。

meaning: adj. 平行的；相似的，同时发生的；（计算机）并行的；并联的；n. （人或事物的）相似的手法，共同点；相似的人（或物）；（地球的）纬线，纬圈；（印刷）平行符号；v. 与……相似；与……同时发生；与……并行；与……相当，比得上；adv. 与……平行
definition: 1. n. something having the property of being analogous to something else；2. v. be parallel to
example: Very similar, parallel stories, and yet there are significant contrasts between the Mesopotamian story and its Israelite adaptation.
exampleZh: 比较苏美尔版与犹太人版的故事,非常相似，但是同时有很大的对比。

meaning: vt. （医学）使麻痹，使瘫痪；使（组织、系统、活动等）陷于停顿或无法正常运作，或使（人）因恐惧、震惊等而无法行动或思考
definition: 1. US spelling of paralyse；2. to cause a person or animal to lose the ability to move or feel part of the body, or to cause someone or something to be unable to act or operate correctly
example: This word means to paralyze, deaden, stupefy, to stun or deprive of sensation, as by a blow.
exampleZh: 这个词的意思是使人麻痹、使人麻木、使人神志不清、使人眩晕或失去知觉，比如受到击打。

meaning: n. 瘫痪（症），麻痹（症）；（行动、决策、运行等的）瘫痪，停顿
definition: 1. a condition in which you are unable to move all or part of your body because of illness or injury；2. a situation in which you are unable to take action
example: The accident left him with partial paralysis, yet he remained determined to resume his career.
exampleZh: 那场事故使他部分瘫痪，但他仍决心重返自己的职业。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 界限，范围；参数，变量；（统计）人口参数
definition: 1. a set of facts or a fixed limit that establishes or limits how something can or must happen or be done；2. a fixed limit that establishes how something should be done
example: It turns out that this quantity here, which is called eta of J the Joule free expansion parameter, is not quite zero.
exampleZh: 这个量后来被，称作焦耳膨胀系数,其实并不等于零。

meaning: n. 寄生植物（或动物），寄生虫；不劳而获者，依赖他人过活者
definition: 1. an animal or plant that lives on or in another animal or plant of a different type and feeds from it；2. a person who is lazy and lives by other people working, giving them money, etc.
example: One of the ways the parasite spreads is through faecal matter.
exampleZh: 寄生物传播的方式之一就是透过排泄物。

meaning: n. 包裹，邮包；一批，一群；一块土地（尤指地产的一部分）；有馅料的食品（通常指油酥点心）；v. 把……包起来（parcel sth. up）；分配（parcel sth. out）；（航海）用涂油帆布条缠包（绳索）；【名】 （Parcel）（英）帕斯尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a wrapped container；2. v. divide into parts
example: So if you want to invent, if you want to innovate, failure is part and parcel with that.
exampleZh: 所以如果想要发明，想要创造，失败是不可或缺的。

meaning: n. 赦免；宽恕，原谅；（中世纪欧洲出售的）赎罪券，赦罪符；v. 赦免；宽恕，原谅；免除（债务）；请原谅（表示礼貌，用于所问或所说的话有可能被认为无礼时）；int. （用于请求别人重复某事）什么，请再说一遍；对不起，不好意思（发出不雅声音之后的道歉用语）；你说什么？（表示惊讶或者受到冒犯）；【名】 （Pardon）（德、法、捷）帕尔东（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of excusing a mistake or offense；2. v. accept an excuse for
example: If my code is correct, what should the average price be, after say, 100 days, if there's no bias. Pardon?
exampleZh: 如果我的代码没写错的话，如果没有偏向值那平均价格会是多少呢，如果没有偏向值，请说？

meaning: n. 父亲（或母亲）；（动植物的）亲代，亲本；母公司，总公司；母体，本体；v. 做……的父亲（或母亲）；为人父母；【名】 （Parent）（英、西）帕伦特，（法）帕朗（人名）
definition: 1. n. a father or mother; one who begets or one who gives birth to or nurtures and raises a child; a relative who plays the role of guardian；2. v. bring up
example: extending the issue of the two-parent versus one-parent family is, "To what extent are these notions validated " cross-culturally?"
exampleZh: 将双亲和单亲家庭的问题扩展了一下，“这些概念究竟在多大程度上,会因跨文化差异而有所变化“

meaning: adj. 父母的，双亲的；亲代的，亲本的；母公司的，上级的
definition: 1. adj. designating the generation of organisms from which hybrid offspring are produced；2. adj. relating to or characteristic of or befitting a parent
example: This government is committed to extending parental choice in education.
exampleZh: 本届政府承诺扩大父母在教育方面的选择权。

meaning: n. 养育子女，育儿；为人父母；（像父母一样对他人的）照顾；v. 做……的父亲（或母亲）（parent 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. a father or mother; one who begets or one who gives birth to or nurtures and raises a child; a relative who plays the role of guardian；2. v. bring up
example: And then I owned a magazine, a parenting magazine, here in Los Angeles.
exampleZh: 然后我有一家杂志社，出育儿杂志，就在这儿，洛杉矶。

meaning: n. 教区，堂区；教区的居民，（尤指）教区教徒；（农村的）行政堂区；（路易斯安那州）堂区（相当于其他州的县）
definition: 1. in some Christian denominations, an area cared for by one priest with its own church, or (in England) the smallest unit of local government；2. an area that a church provides for
example: He is vicar of a large rural parish.
exampleZh: 他是乡下一个大教区的代牧。

meaning: n. 公园；自然保护区；（乡间大宅的）庭园，园林；足球场，橄榄球场；运动场，（尤指）棒球场；专用区，园区；停车场；（汽车）制动；v. 停车，泊车；存放，寄存； （在某处）坐，站立（park yourself）；把……搁置，推迟；【名】 （Park）（英、芬、瑞典）帕克（人名）
definition: 1. n. a large area of land preserved in its natural state as public property；2. v. place temporarily
example: And it's a really great experience. So that's pretty much what I associate Golden Gate Park with, for me.
exampleZh: 节日办得很不错。特别是对我这种常在金门公园附近溜达的人，是一种很好的体验。

meaning: n. 停车，泊车；停车场，停车位；v. 存放，寄存；停车，泊车；坐下（或站着）（park 的现在分词形式）；【名】 【名】（Parking）（英）帕金（人名）
definition: 1. n. space in which vehicles can be parked；2. n. the act of maneuvering a vehicle into a location where it can be left temporarily
example: I have made a conscious choice that I can't drive to work, I do have a spot in the parking garage.
exampleZh: 我都会故意,不开车上班，我的车,停在车库里。

meaning: n. 议会，国会；英国议会（包括下议院和上议院）（Parliament）；一届议会（会期）
definition: 1. n. a legislative assembly in certain countries；2. n. a card game in which you play your sevens and other cards in sequence in the same suit as the sevens; you win if you are the first to use all your cards
example: It's a freedom that, of course, Parliament had pushed for, but now that they've got it there is some misgiving.
exampleZh: 当然，这是一种议会推崇的自由，但是现在他们得到的只是疑虑。

meaning: adj. 议会的，国会的，设有议会的
definition: 1. adj. relating to or having the nature of a parliament；2. adj. having the supreme legislative power resting with a body of cabinet ministers chosen from and responsible to the legislature or parliament
example: The opposition has demanded a re-run of parliamentary elections held yesterday.
exampleZh: 反对派要求重新举行昨天进行的议会选举。

meaning: n. 假释，有条件的释放；（语言学）言语；（战俘所作不逃跑或获释后按规定回来受监管的）宣誓，诺言；v. 准许假释，使获假释
definition: 1. permission for a prisoner to be released before their period in prison is finished, with the agreement that they will behave well；2. to give someone parole
example: Speech is the way in which we appropriate, deploy and make use of language, and Saussure calls that "parole."
exampleZh: 话语是我们使用语言，分配部署语言的结果，索绪尔叫它，个人语言“

meaning: n. 鹦鹉；学舌者，机械模仿别人的人；v. 机械地模仿，鹦鹉学舌般重复；【名】 （Parrot）（英、俄、葡）帕罗特，（法）帕罗（人名）
definition: 1. a tropical bird with a curved beak, often kept as a pet and trained to copy the human voice；2. to repeat exactly what someone else says, without understanding it or thinking about its meaning
example: Your instructor tells you when you write your exam, "Don't just parrot the words of the authors you're studying.
exampleZh: 你们的老师在你们考试答题时,会教导你们说，不要只模仿作者的用词。

meaning: n. 部分；某物的部分（局部）；（书、戏剧、电视剧等的）部，篇，集；（动植物的）器官，部位；部件，零件；成员，参与人员；（世界、国家或城镇等的）区域，地区；（头发的）分缝；（角色的）台词和动作，角色；（在活动或事件中的）作用；（乐器或声音的）声部，音部；（等）份；能力；v. （使）分开，（使）分离；分别；分手；放弃，移交；给（头发）分缝；adv. 既有……又有……（part sth., part sth.）；不完全地，部分地；adj. 部分的，不完全的；【名】 （Part）(英、瑞典）帕特，（泰）巴，（法）帕尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. something determined in relation to something that includes it；2. v. go one's own way; move apart
example: Part of that is the elimination of small words, "the," "and"; the abbreviation of certain words, "your" to "yr."
exampleZh: 他们语言的一部分是对小词的省略，如“这“，“和“，和一些词的缩写“

meaning: adj. 部分的，不完全的；偏袒的，不公平的；偏爱的；n. （乐）分音，泛音
definition: 1. n. the derivative of a function of two or more variables with respect to a single variable while the other variables are considered to be constant；2. adj. being or affecting only a part; not total
example: This should be particularly bothersome to you because, as you've already experienced in 5.60, There are a lot of partial derivatives.
exampleZh: 对你们来说这可能很让人头疼，就像你们在5。60里体验过的那样，这有很多偏微分和变量。

meaning: adv. 不完全地，部分地；偏袒地
definition: 1. adv. in part; in some degree; not wholly
example: Again, when you see that partially hydrogenated oils on an ingredient list, that means there's Trans fat.
exampleZh: 当成分表出现"部分氢化油"时,就意味着含有反式脂肪

meaning: v. 参加，参与；分担，分享；具有，带有（特殊的性质）
definition: 1. v. share in something；2. v. become a participant; be involved in
example: The bonds are auctioned off on regular dates and you cannot participate in the auction; I assume you can't.
exampleZh: 这些债券在规定期限内拍卖,你们不能参与这些拍卖,我想你们是不行的

meaning: n. 参加，参与
definition: 1. n. the act of sharing in the activities of a group；2. n. the condition of sharing in common with others (as fellows or partners etc.)
example: Only in this way can the critical mass of participation be reached.
exampleZh: 只有这样才能凑足参加人数。

meaning: n. 参加者，参与者；adj. 参与的
definition: 1. n. someone who takes part in an activity；2. n. a person who participates in or is skilled at some game
example: You were a, first a participant, and then an instructor in outward bound, which is not like we staff.
exampleZh: 你最开始是拓展训练的参与者,后来又成为了教练，这很不同于我们的工作。

meaning: n. 微粒；极少量；粒子（原子的极微小成分，如电子、质子或中子）；（数）质点；（语法中的）小品词
definition: 1. n. (nontechnical usage) a tiny piece of anything；2. n. a body having finite mass and internal structure but negligible dimensions
example: A proton is an elementary particle of matter that possesses a positive charge.
exampleZh: 质子是带正电荷的物质的基本粒子。

meaning: adj. 特定的，某一的；格外的，特别的；讲究的，挑剔的；特殊的，独特的；详细的，详尽的；n. 一点，一个细节； 详细资料，详情（particulars）；（哲学）（与普遍性相对的）特殊性
