definition: 1. n. a fact about some part (as opposed to general)；2. adj. unique or specific to a person or thing or category
example: What are some of the particular opportunities and challenges of being a Muslim chaplain in America on a secular university campus?
exampleZh: 美国大学中的穆斯林教士,一般都会遇到一些,什么样的机会和挑战呢？

meaning: adv. 非常，尤其；特别是；清楚地，明确地
definition: 1. adv. to a distinctly greater extent or degree than is common；2. adv. specifically or especially distinguished from others
example: Well, it's on one hand a very large idea to take in, particularly I think if one's working in a university.
exampleZh: 这是一个很大的话题，不容易理解，对于在大学中工作学习的人尤为如此。

meaning: adj. （对个别人、团体或思想）偏袒的，盲目拥护的；游击战的；n. （领袖、团体或事业的）坚定的支持者，信徒；游击队员
definition: 1. strongly supporting a person, principle, or political party, often without considering or judging the matter very carefully；2. (in a country that has been defeated) a member of a secret armed force whose aim is to fight against an enemy that is controlling the country
example: The President's choice was clearly motivated by sound budgetary policy, not partisan politics.
exampleZh: 总统的选择显然是出于合理的预算政策，而不是党派政治。

meaning: n. 隔墙，隔板；（国家的）分裂，分治；（化学）分离层；（计算机）存储分区；（数学）分割；v. 分割，分裂（国家）；（用隔板、隔扇等）隔开，分隔
definition: 1. a vertical structure like a thin wall that separates one part of a room or building from another；2. the dividing of a country into separate countries or areas of government
example: To see the new disks, you can run fdisk -l and optionally use fdisk to create a partition on them.
exampleZh: 要查看新的磁盘，你可以运行 fdisk -l，还可以选择使用 fdisk 在它们上创建分区。

meaning: adv. 部分地，在某种程度上
definition: 1. adv. in part; in some degree; not wholly
example: It's a persistent problem partly because it always raises these issues of fictionality versus truthfulness, of honesty versus embellishment.
exampleZh: 这是个持久的问题,原因是它一直在质疑虚构性和真实性的关系，还有诚实与修饰的关系。

meaning: n. （跳舞、玩游戏等的）搭档，同伴；（合伙企业的）合伙人；（生意、组织或国家的）伙伴；配偶，（同居的）伴侣，情人；v. 成为搭档，合伙；【名】 （Partner）（英、德）帕特纳（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person's partner in marriage；2. v. provide with a partner

meaning: n. 合伙（关系），合股；合伙企业；合伙人；（两个人、组织或国家之间的）合作关系，伙伴关系；合伙契约；（板球）（回合结束前或其中一人被迫退场前）一对击球手的跑动得分数
definition: 1. n. the members of a business venture created by contract；2. n. a cooperative relationship between people or groups who agree to share responsibility for achieving some specific goal

meaning: n. 聚会，派对；政党，党派；（契约或争论的）当事人，一方；队，组，群；参加者；人；v. 尽情欢乐，欢宴；adj. （纹章）分割开的，分成不同颜色部分的

meaning: v. 经过，穿过；传递，传送；传（球）；（所有权）转移，转让；（状态）转变；（数量上）超过，突破；（时间）流逝；度过，消磨；通过（考试、课程等）；批准（法律或议案）；发生，说过；略过（问题）；排泄；使（货币等）流通；结束，停止；拒绝邀请（提议）；宣布，声明；（纸牌等游戏中）不叫，过；n. 出入证，通行证；及格，合格；传球；山道，山口；阶段，步骤；（计算机）一次浏览，一次扫描；越过；变戏法；（击剑中的）戳刺；（不好的）境遇，处境；（桥牌）不叫；【名】 （Pass）（德、英）帕斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. (baseball) an advance to first base by a batter who receives four balls；2. v. go across or through
example: According to the Second Brother, it's virtually impossible for a single, helpless maiden to pass uninjured in this wild, surrounding waste.

meaning: n. 过道，走廊；（人体的）管道；段落，章节；通道，通路；通行权，通行许可；经过，穿过；（时间的）流逝；（法案的）通过；航程，船票；过渡，转变；（候鸟的）迁徙；（微生物的）传代；巴沙基（盛装舞步和古典骑术的高抬腿舞步）；v. 使（微生物）继代移种；【名】 （Passage）（美）帕西奇（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of passing from one state or place to the next；2. n. a section of text; particularly a section of medium length

exampleZh: 这段里有很多看起来很多实体神秘地,结合在两性的一个结合体重。

meaning: n. 乘客，旅客；（团体中）不干活的人，闲散人员；adj. 乘客的，旅客的

exampleZh: 例如，你在一节拥挤的车厢里，有一个乘客老是盯着你，

meaning: 路人；过路人

example: The 23-year-old's screams alerted a passerby who went to her rescue.
exampleZh: 那名23岁女孩的尖叫声引起了一个过路人的警觉，他救了她。

meaning: n. 爱恋，情欲；激情，热情；酷爱，热衷的爱好（或活动等）；盛怒，激愤；耶稣的受难（the Passion）
definition: 1. n. strong feeling or emotion；2. n. the trait of being intensely emotional
example: when a teacher isn't there with their full passion and their full heart, you know, like...
exampleZh: 老师不是全心全意讲课的时候，你知道，就像……

meaning: adj. 热诚的，狂热的；热恋的，情意绵绵的；易怒的
definition: 1. adj. having or expressing strong emotions

exampleZh: 所以一旦赛季取得很差的成绩，就很难保持球队的激情，

meaning: adj. 消极的，被动的；被动语态的；（抵抗）非暴力的；（电路，装置）无源的；（金属）经表面钝化处理的，钝化的；n. （动词的）被动语态形式；被动语态（the passive）

meaning: n. 护照；途径，手段
definition: 1. n. any authorization to pass or go somewhere；2. n. a document issued by a country to a citizen allowing that person to travel abroad and re-enter the home country
example: We took a trip to Japan and show the children how to fill out passport information.
exampleZh: 我们带孩子们去日本旅游,告诉他们如何填写护照表格。

meaning: n. 密码；口令，暗语
definition: 1. n. a secret word or phrase known only to a restricted group
example: You need a password to get access to the computer system.
exampleZh: 使用这个计算机系统需要口令。

meaning: adj. 过去的，昔日的；刚过去的，刚结束的；完成的，结束的；（语法）过去时的；n. 过去，昔日（the past）；往事，经历；（语法）过去时，（动词的）过去式（the past）；prep. 晚于，在…...之后；在…...的更远处；经过，越过；超出，超过；adv. 从一侧到另一侧，经过；（时间）过去，逝去

meaning: n. 意大利面食；面团；n. （Pasta）人名；（英、意）帕斯塔
definition: 1. a food made from flour, water, and sometimes egg, that is cooked and usually served with a sauce. It is made in various shapes that have different names
example: I'm going down the pasta aisle or whatever, and I have the daughter of Ravi Shankar over my shoulder.
exampleZh: 我走过超市的意大利面专柜时,身边都萦绕着拉维·香卡的女儿的歌声

meaning: n. 面糊，糊状物；糨糊； 肉（或鱼等）酱（作涂抹料或烹饪用）；（制作人造宝石用的）铅质玻璃；（制陶、瓷器用的）湿黏土；v. （尤指用浆糊）黏，贴；（在计算机上屏幕上）粘贴（文字、图片等）； 狠狠地打，彻底打败；【名】 （Paste）（印度）帕斯泰（人名）
definition: 1. n. any mixture of a soft and malleable consistency；2. v. join or attach with or as if with glue
example: Did you just Copy and Paste 50 times when you could have just used a loop that cycles 50 times?
exampleZh: 你是不是复制粘贴50次,当你可以用一个循环来循环50次呢？

meaning: n. 娱乐，消遣
definition: 1. n. a diversion that occupies one's time and thoughts (usually pleasantly)
example: Eating out is the national pastime in France.
exampleZh: 在法国，下馆子是全国人普遍的消遣活动。

meaning: n. 油酥面团；酥皮糕点
definition: 1. a food made from a mixture of flour, fat, and water, rolled flat and either wrapped around or put over or under other foods, and then baked；2. a type of sweet cake made from special pastry and usually containing something such as fruit or nuts
example: These doughs can be rolled out while you wait for the pastry to chill.
exampleZh: 当你等待油酥面团冷却时，可以擀平这些生面团。

meaning: n. 牧场，牧草地；生活状况，个人发展的机遇；v. 放牧；（牛、羊等）在草地上吃草；【名】 （Pasture）（英）帕斯彻，（法）帕斯蒂尔（人名）
definition: 1. grass or similar plants suitable for animals such as cows and sheep to eat, or an area of land covered in this；2. land covered with grass or similar plants suitable for animals, such as cows and sheep, to eat
example: It was absolutely essential to separate crops from the areas that animals used as pasture.
exampleZh: 把庄稼与牲畜的放牧区分开至关重要。

meaning: v. 轻拍（以示喜爱、赞同或安慰）；轻拍（以引起注意或检查安放好的物品）；爱抚（狗或马等动物）；轻拍抚平，轻拍成形；拍干；n. （表示友善的）轻拍；小块（黄油等）；adj. （回答或解释）脱口而出的，敷衍的；adv. 记得一清二楚地；及时地，适时地；【名】 （Pat）（美）帕特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the sound made by a gentle blow；2. v. pat or squeeze fondly or playfully, especially under the chin

exampleZh: 当然,更常见的情况下,在你的爱人说爱你的时候,你会很激动,心跳加速

meaning: n. 补丁，补片；（保护受伤眼睛的）眼罩；（衣服上的）徽章，标识；药膏，胶布；（与周围部分不同的）斑，小块；小片，碎片；（尤指园艺用的）一小块地；熟悉的地方，家乡； 属地，管辖地；一段时间；（尤指17、18世纪妇女装饰用的）饰颜片，美人斑；（软件的）补丁程序；（电气或电话的）临时连接（线）；（电子乐器，尤指合成乐器中的）预设配置（或声音）数据文件，配音；vt. 修补，缝补；使出现斑块；临时连接，临时接入（通信系统）；（计算机）（用补丁对程序进行）修正，打补丁；解决；拼凑，匆匆制成；【名】 （Patch）（英）帕奇（人名）
definition: 1. n. a small contrasting part of something；2. v. to join or unite the pieces of

meaning: n. 专利（权），专利证书；专利发明；adj. 受专利保护的，专利的；专利生产的，专利经销的；显而易见的，赤裸裸的；（寄生虫感染）明显的，显著的；（脉管、导管或孔）开放的，不闭合的；v. 获得……的专利权；授予专利

meaning: n. 小径，小道；（开出的）通道；（事物或人移动的）路线，轨迹；（有助于实现某事的）道路，途径；通勤火车时刻表；（计算机）路径
definition: 1. n. a course of conduct；2. n. a way especially designed for a particular use
example: And the path that I'm describing then, let's assume that we're raising the temperature up is this path right here.

meaning: adj. 令人怜悯的，可怜的；无用的，差劲的；感伤的

exampleZh: 我告诉她别再懒惰、懦弱、自我放纵又自甘可悲了。

meaning: adj. 能忍耐的，有耐心的；n. 病人，患者；（语言学）受动者，承受者；【名】 （Patient）帕迪恩特（人名）

exampleZh: 问题，那有没有可能,这个病人在你开始解剖时,还是活着的？

meaning: n. 耐心；耐性；忍耐力；考验某人的耐心；单人纸牌游戏
definition: 1. n. good-natured tolerance of delay or incompetence；2. n. a card game played by one person

exampleZh: 耐心和短期的成果，实际上你,两者都想要，都想做好平衡，我们都在奋斗，都在努力。

meaning: n. 爱国者
definition: 1. a person who loves their country and, if necessary, will fight for it

exampleZh: 彼得是一个狂热的爱国者,他爱民如子

meaning: adj. 爱国的，有爱国心的
definition: 1. showing love for your country and being proud of it

meaning: n. 爱国主义，爱国精神
definition: 1. the feeling of loving your country more than any others and being proud of it

meaning: n. 巡逻，巡查；巡逻队，巡逻车；童子军小队； （儿童穿越马路处的）交通管理员；v. （尤指士兵或员警）巡逻，巡查；（尤指威胁性）逛荡，闲逛
definition: 1. (especially of soldiers or the police) to go around an area or a building to see if there is any trouble or danger；2. the act of checking that there is no trouble or danger in a building or area

meaning: n. （艺术家的）赞助人，资助者；代言人，名义赞助人；（酒吧、旅馆等的）主顾，顾客；（古罗马）有权势的保护人，庇护人；（古罗马）已获得自由的奴隶的原主人和保护人；有圣职授予权的人（或机构）；【名】 （Patron）（英）佩特伦，（法、意、罗）帕特龙（人名）

meaning: v. 表现出高人一等的姿态，以高人一等的态度对待；光顾，惠顾（餐馆、酒店或其他生意）；赞助，资助
definition: 1. to speak to or behave towards someone as if they are stupid or not important；2. to be a regular customer of a shop or restaurant, etc.

meaning: n. 赞助，资助；（对餐馆、酒店或其他生意的）惠顾，光顾；职位授予权，恩惠给予权；庇护，扶植；恩赐态度；（古罗马）庇护人的权力和职责，庇护人的地位
definition: 1. the support given to an organization by someone；2. the power of a person to give someone an important job or position

exampleZh: 过去政府官员,通常都是走后门进来的,他们经常都是不称职的。

meaning: n. 模式，方式；图案，花样；模范，典范；模型，底样；（布或墙纸的）样品；样式；（声音或词汇有规则排列的）模式；v. 用图案装饰，给……加上花样；仿照，模仿；赋予……以固定（或易辨认）的形式；使形成，促成（某行为模式）

meaning: n. 暂停，停顿；暂停键；延长记号；v. 暂停，停顿；（按暂停键）暂停；踌躇
definition: 1. n. a time interval during which there is a temporary cessation of something；2. v. interrupt temporarily an activity before continuing

meaning: v. 用石板（或砖）铺（路）；为……铺平道路，创造条件（pave the way for sth./sb.）；【名】 （法、塞尔维亚、克罗地亚）帕韦（人名）
definition: 1. n. a setting with precious stones so closely set that no metal shows；2. v. cover with a material such as stone or concrete to make suitable for vehicle traffic

meaning: n. 人行道；（公路或街道的）硬路面；铺过的表面（地方）；（水平分布的）裸露岩面，砾石滩

meaning: n. （动物的）爪子；（人的）手；v. 用爪子抓（或挠）；摸弄，猥亵地动手动脚；胡乱地翻找；（用手指）触碰

meaning: v. 支付，付；偿还，缴纳；给予，致以；给……付工资；（投资等）产生……利润，（工作等）有……报酬；划算，有好处；付出代价；盈利；用沥青（或焦油）填塞（甲板或木船接缝）以防止漏水；（政府或机构通过提高价格、税率等使某人）为......买单；储蓄；n. 工资，薪水；付款；回报；adj. （电视节目）付费的，收费的
definition: 1. n. something that remunerates；2. v. give money, usually in exchange for goods or services

meaning: n. 支付款项，支付额；付款，支付；报答，报复

meaning: n. （公司员工的）工资名单；（公司的）发放工资总额；（公司员工的）薪资管理；受聘职员总数；vt. 资助，补贴

example: I thought graduate teaching assistants will automatically put on the payroll at the beginning of the semester.

meaning: n. 豌豆（粒）；豆角；豆荚；【名】 （Pea）（意）佩亚（人名）
definition: 1. n. seed of a pea plant used for food；2. n. the fruit or seed of a pea plant
example: The tumour had shrunk to the size of a pea.
exampleZh: 肿瘤已缩小到豌豆大小。

meaning: n. 和平，太平；平静，安宁；（心情）平静，平和；和约；和平时期；治安；和睦，和谐；平安礼（the peace）；和平运动，裁军运动（尤指核裁军运动）；v. 安静；【名】 （Peace）（英）皮斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. the state prevailing during the absence of war；2. n. harmonious relations; freedom from disputes
example: but it's important to get some peace and quiet sometimes, so I do go to Central Park for that.
exampleZh: 但有时候得到一些平静和安宁也很重要，这种时候我就会去中央公园。

meaning: adj. 宁静的，安静的；和平的，非暴力的；爱好和平的；安详的，平和的
definition: 1. adj. not disturbed by strife or turmoil or war；2. adj. peacefully resistant in response to injustice
example: We're glad you spent this time with us, and we hope you have a blessed and peaceful day. Take care.
exampleZh: 很开心你们能和我们一起度过这段时光,希望你们能度过一个幸福而平和的一天，保重。

meaning: n. 桃子；桃树；桃红色；极好的人（或物）；adj. 桃红色的；用桃子制成的；v. 告密，告发；【名】 （Peach）皮奇（人名）
definition: 1. n. cultivated in temperate regions；2. v. divulge confidential information or secrets
example: The walls were painted white with a hint of peach.
exampleZh: 墙壁粉刷成了略呈桃红的白色。

meaning: n. 巅峰，顶点；山顶；有尖峰的山；尖端，尖顶；帽檐，帽舌；极值，峰值；（艏或艉的）尖舱；斜桁外端，（帆的）后上角；v. 达到高峰，达到最大值；消瘦，衰弱，精神萎靡；adj. 巅峰状态的，最高的；高峰时期的；【名】 （Peak）（英）皮克（人名）
definition: 1. n. the most extreme possible amount or value；2. v. to reach the highest point; attain maximum intensity, activity
example: That percent grew to the peak of the market in 1999; after the peak in 2000 it began to fall.
exampleZh: 在1999年这一赞同的比例接近最高点,在2000年达到顶点后开始下降

meaning: n. 花生，花生米；很少的钱（peanuts）；小片聚苯乙烯泡沫塑料（peanuts）
definition: 1. n. underground pod of the peanut vine；2. adj. of little importance or influence or power; of minor status
example: You can even get peanut butter and jelly on an English muffin for breakfast.
exampleZh: 早餐时你甚至可以吃到英式松饼，佐以花生酱和果冻。

meaning: n. 梨，梨树；【名】 （Pear）（英）皮尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. sweet juicy gritty-textured fruit available in many varieties；2. n. Old World tree having sweet gritty-textured juicy fruit; widely cultivated in many varieties
example: In gardens, cankers are most prominent on apples and pear trees.
exampleZh: 花园树木中患溃疡病最多的是苹果树和梨树。

meaning: n. 珍珠；珍珠母；珠状物；极其优秀的人，珍贵的东西；人造珍珠；珠灰色；珍珠项链，珍珠首饰（pearls）；v. 成珠状滴；使呈珠灰色，使呈蓝灰色；（潜水）采珍珠；用珍珠装饰；adj. 珍珠般的；镶珍珠的
definition: 1. n. a smooth lustrous round structure inside the shell of a clam or oyster; much valued as a jewel；2. v. gather pearls, from oysters in the ocean
example: A local jeweler says the pearl is worth at least $500.
exampleZh: 一位本地珠宝商说这颗珍珠至少值$500。

meaning: n. （旧时或贫穷国家的）农民，佃农；没教养的人，粗人
definition: 1. n. a country person；2. n. one of a (chiefly European) class of agricultural laborers
example: That forced peasant farmers to try to eke a living off steep hillsides.
exampleZh: 那迫使农民要靠在陡峭的山坡上来勉强维持生计。

meaning: v. 啄，啄食；匆匆轻吻；缓慢而费力地用打字机打；（马）向前跌倒；n. 匆匆的轻吻；（鸟的）啄；配克（谷物、水果等的干量单位，等于8夸脱）；啄痕
definition: 1. When a bird pecks, it bites, hits, or picks up something small with its beak；2. to give someone a quick kiss, especially on the side of the face
example: "I'll call th' robin up," he said, "and give him th' rind o' th' bacon to peck at."
exampleZh: “我将把知更鸟叫来，”他说道，“把这熏肉圈给它啄一啄。”

meaning: adj. 奇怪的，不寻常的；特别的，独特的；不舒服的；n. 特殊教区（或教堂）；特权，特有财产
definition: 1. adj. beyond or deviating from the usual or expected；2. adj. unique or specific to a person or thing or category
example: This may seem to be a perfectly reasonable vision for a poet considering himself to be an inspired poet to have, but there's something peculiar here.
exampleZh: 这对诗人是一个非常好的幻景,把自己看做是一位有灵感的诗人，但这儿还有些怪异的事情。

meaning: n. 特点，特性；古怪之处，怪癖；奇特，怪异
definition: 1. n. an odd or unusual characteristic；2. n. a distinguishing trait
example: So we looked last time at the oddity, the peculiarity, of Milton's choice of genre here, the pastoral genre.
exampleZh: 所以我们最后一次来研究弥尔顿选择的，田园诗流派里的古怪和特性。

meaning: n. （自行车、汽车或机器的）脚踏板；(钢琴、风琴等的)踏板；（乐）PEDAL NOTE的简称；v. 骑自行车前进；踩（自行车等的）踏板；（尤指以某种特别方式）踩动钢琴踏板；adj. 踏板的，脚踏的；脚的，关于脚的
definition: 1. a small part of a machine or object that is pushed down with the foot to operate or move the machine or object；2. a part on a piano or organ that you press with your foot
example: She pressed her foot down sharply on the brake pedal.
exampleZh: 她猛踩刹车踏板。

meaning: v. 挨户销售，巡回销售；贩卖（非法毒品，偷窃的赃物）；宣传，散布（思想或消息）；忙于琐事；【名】 （Peddle）（英）佩德尔（人名）
definition: 1. to sell things, especially by taking them to different places；2. If you peddle stories or information, you spread them by telling different people
example: His attempts to peddle his paintings around Laramie's tiny gallery scene proved unsuccessful.
exampleZh: 他在拉勒米的小画廊现场周围兜售其画作的企图证明不成功。

meaning: n. 步行者，行人；adj. 平淡无奇的，乏味的；行人的，行人使用的；徒步的
definition: 1. n. a person who travels by foot；2. adj. lacking wit or imagination
example: A pedestrian bridge now connects the parking garage with the mall.
exampleZh: 现在一座人行桥连通车库和购物中心。

meaning: v. 除去，剥去（水果、蔬菜等的）皮；去掉，剥掉，揭掉；剥落，脱落，脱皮；（水果，蔬菜）有可被除掉的皮；（槌球）把（另一球员的球）传过拱门；n. （水果、蔬菜的）皮，外皮；去角质；（16世纪时建在英格兰和苏格兰交界各郡的）堡塔，堡寨；【名】 （Peel）（英）皮尔
definition: 1. to remove the skin of fruit and vegetables；2. If a layer or covering peels, it slowly comes off, and if you peel a layer or covering, you remove it slowly and carefully
example: So, if a stranger slips on a banana peel and lands on his butt, I might laugh because I'm not overcome by compassion.
exampleZh: 所以，看到陌生人踩蕉皮,摔个屁股着地，我会笑,因为我对他的同情不是很强烈。

meaning: v. 窥视，偷看；隐现，微现；看；（使）发出喇叭声；（使）发出尖细的声音；n. 一瞥；说话，声音；吱吱声，啾啾声；（汽车的）喇叭声；人（杂志用语）
definition: 1. to secretly look at something for a short time, usually through a hole；2. to appear slowly and not be completely seen
example: They crept to the door and took a trembling peep.
exampleZh: 他们蹑手蹑脚地走到门口，哆哆嗦嗦地偷看了一眼。

meaning: n. 同龄人，同等地位的人，相匹敌的人；（英国）贵族；v. 凝视，费力地看；隐现；看见；匹敌；【名】 （Peer）（美、爱、英）皮尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person who is of equal standing with another in a group；2. v. look searchingly
example: And they formed seven undergraduates and we went around to peer institutions of Princeton, and wrote a report.
exampleZh: 他们选了七名本科生,然后我们去参观了一些,普林斯顿大学相似的机构，写了一篇报告。

meaning: n. 挂钩，挂钉；晾衣夹子；（系帐篷用的）桩；（标明某物位置的）界桩；（价格、数量等的）限度，标定点；（进一步讨论某事物的）依据，理由；（桶）孔塞；（摩托车的）脚镫；赛位（分配给参赛者钓鱼或射击的位置）；（人的）腿；少量威士忌（白兰地）；（烈酒的）计量，度量；弦钮，琴栓；全力投球，钉子球；v. 用钉（或桩）固定；使工资、价格等固定于某水平（或与……挂鈎）；用衣夹把（洗的衣服）夹在衣绳上；（钓鱼或射击比赛中）给（比赛者）分派赛位；视为，看作；（棒球）投掷快速低球；（在克里比奇牌戏中）用得分枚计分；疾行，孜孜不倦地做某事；adj. 越往下端越细的；abbr. （PEG）聚乙（烯）二醇（polyethylene glycol）；【名】 （Peg）（美）佩格（人名）
definition: 1. a small stick or hook that sticks out from a surface and from which objects, especially clothes, can hang；2. a reason for doing or having something, or for discussing or developing something further
example: He hung his hat on a peg and flung himself into his seat with business-like alacrity.
exampleZh: 他把帽子挂在钉子上，一本正经地迅速坐到座位上。

meaning: n. 笔，钢笔；（圈养动物用的）围栏，圈；（计算机上使用的）电子笔；监狱；处罚，（尤指足球的）点球；墨水；雌天鹅；（动）（枪乌贼的）羽状壳；（西印度群岛）农庄，大农场；（潜艇等战舰的）隐蔽坞，掩藏坞；国际笔会（国际诗人，剧作家，编辑，散文家和小说家协会）（PEN）；秘鲁新索尔（PEN）；v. 写，撰写；（把……）关起来，圈起来；【名】 （Pen）（法）庞，（俄、塞、英、意）佩恩，（柬）宾（人名）
definition: 1. n. a writing implement with a point from which ink flows；2. v. produce a literary work
example: The only fingers with which he'll be able to hold his pen and write this poem are his forced fingers rude.
exampleZh: 他能用来执笔写诗的手指,是他粗鲁的手指。

meaning: n. （因违反法律、规定或合同而受到的）处罚，刑罚；（行为、环境带来的）不利后果，苦难；（体育运动中对犯规者的）判罚，处罚；（足球、橄榄球及类似运动中的）罚球；（桥牌）（叫牌者未完成定约时的）罚分
definition: 1. n. the act of punishing；2. n. a payment required for not fulfilling a contract
example: So we're going to show how this technique is going to help us shoot penalty shots in soccer.
exampleZh: 我们讲学到博弈理论讲如何,帮助我们在足球比赛罚球

meaning: v. 使处于不利地位，不公正地对待；处罚，惩罚，处以刑罚；（体育运动中）判罚
definition: 1. v. impose a penalty on; inflict punishment on
example: Mr. Gill said the city could penalize the company if it did not complete the work on schedule.
exampleZh: 吉尔先生说，如果该公司没有按时完成工作，市政府将对其进行处罚。

meaning: n. 铅笔；石墨芯，类似石墨芯的东西；化妆笔；笔状物；一束光；v. 用铅笔写（或画、涂色）；adj. 用铅笔写（或画、描、记）的
definition: 1. n. a thin cylindrical pointed writing implement; a rod of marking substance encased in wood；2. v. write, draw, or trace with a pencil
example: It's almost like sitting with the pencil, or the pen, or perhaps the keyboard.
exampleZh: 就好比是，坐着，手中拿着铅笔，或钢笔，或是键盘。

meaning: adj. 待决的，待定的，待处理的；即将发生的，迫近的；prep. 直到……为止，在……之前，在等待……之际；v. 等候判定或决定（pend的现在分词）；【名】 （Pending）（瑞典）彭丁（人名）
definition: 1. about to happen or waiting to happen；2. used to say that one thing must wait until another thing happens
example: A judge has suspended the ban pending a full inquiry.
exampleZh: 一名法官已暂时取消了此项禁令，等待一次全面调查。

meaning: n. 钟摆，摆锤；（局势意见等的）摇摆不定，变化不定
definition: 1. a device consisting of a weight on a stick or thread that moves from one side to the other, especially one that forms a part of some types of clocks；2. a change, especially from one opinion to an opposite one
example: The Focault pendulum is one example where you can see that the Earth is rotating around its own axis.
exampleZh: 傅科摆就是一个例子,通过观察它,你会发现地球在自转

meaning: v. 刺入，穿透；打进（某地区或国家的市场）；渗入，打入（组织、团体等）；洞察，了解；被理解，被领悟；透过……看见，看穿；（以阴茎）插入
definition: 1. v. pass into or through, often by overcoming resistance；2. v. come to understand
example: Many of them are derived from cholesterol and they're hydrophobic, which means they can penetrate through cell membranes.
exampleZh: 多数分子都来自于胆固醇,它们是疏水性的,这意味着它们能够穿过细胞膜

meaning: n. 穿透，渗透，进入；（产品对市场的）渗透度，占有率；（某种信仰在某一社会的）渗透；（为刺探情报对某团体、企业等的）渗入；洞察力；（阴茎的）插入
definition: 1. n. an attack that penetrates into enemy territory；2. n. clear or deep perception of a situation
example: The thick walls prevented penetration by debris from the hurricane.
exampleZh: 一堵堵厚墙阻挡了飓风带来的碎片的穿透。

meaning: n. 企鹅；空军地勤人员；企鹅出版社（Penguin Books，英国出版机构）
definition: 1. a black and white bird, found mainly in the Antarctic, that cannot fly but uses its small wings to help it swim
example: Pierre is a 25-year-old penguin at the California Academy of Sciences.
exampleZh: 这只企鹅名为皮埃尔，25岁，来自加利福尼亚科学院。

meaning: n. 半岛
definition: 1. a long piece of land that sticks out from a larger area of land into the sea or into a lake；2. an area of land mostly surrounded by water but connected to a larger piece of land
example: The "Empty Quarter" is a huge area of sand that covers about a quarter of the Arabian Peninsula.
exampleZh: “空白之地”是一大片沙地，覆盖了四分之一的阿拉伯半岛。

meaning: n. 便士（英国货币单位，100便士等于1英镑）；便士（英国1971年前使用的硬币，12便士等于1先令）；分（美国和加拿大货币单位）；一小笔钱（pennies）；一分一毫（用于强调没钱）（a penny）；迪纳里厄斯（古罗马的金币或银币）
definition: 1. n. a fractional monetary unit of Ireland and the United Kingdom; equal to one hundredth of a pound；2. n. a coin worth one-hundredth of the value of the basic unit
example: The trip was expensive but it was worth every penny.
exampleZh: 这次旅行花费很大，但是花的每一分钱都不冤枉。

meaning: n. 养老金，退休金；（法国和其他一些欧洲国家的）廉价小旅店；（给皇室宠臣、艺术家或学者以便他们能从事公益工作的）津贴，补助金；v. （尤指因年龄或疾病而）向（某人）支付养老金使其退休；（因陈旧或不再有用而）丢弃（某物）
definition: 1. n. a regular payment to a person that is intended to allow them to subsist without working；2. v. grant a pension to
example: In fact, the assets that the Norwegian Government owns is about two-thirds oil and one-third government pension fund assets.
exampleZh: 实际上，挪威政府所持有的资产中,大概有三分之二的石油,和三分之一的政府养老基金。

meaning: n. 领取养老金（或退休金、抚恤金）的人
definition: 1. n. the beneficiary of a pension fund
example: Why, the argument goes, should a car-driving pensioner from Lincolnshire have to subsidise the daily commute of a stockbroker from Surrey?
exampleZh: 有人争论道，为什么一个来自林肯郡的、有车开的、领着养老金的人必须去补贴一个来自萨里郡的股票经纪人的日常通勤呢？

meaning: n. 人，人类；人们，大家（the people）；平民，老百姓（the people）；民族，种族（peoples）；（具有共同品质、兴趣等的）人员，团体；与某人有联系的人们（one's people）；各位，诸位；（审判中的）公诉人（the People）；v. 居住在，定居于；充满，充斥着（某种类型的人）
definition: 1. n. (plural) any group of human beings (men or women or children) collectively；2. v. fill with people or supply with inhabitants
example: I think even soul's emotion... People are a little too off for good church, for good church people. -Right.
exampleZh: 这也和“灵魂情感“有关。。。,人们对按时拜谒教会这件事，太冷淡，-是的。

meaning: n. 胡椒粉；辣椒，甜椒，灯笼椒；胡椒；辣椒粉；（棒球）热身投击球练习；v. （在食物上）撒胡椒粉；连续射击；在……上撒，使布满； （演讲、文章等）充满……；【名】 （Pepper）（英、德、意）佩珀（人名）
definition: 1. n. climber having dark red berries (peppercorns) when fully ripe; southern India and Sri Lanka; naturalized in northern Burma and Assam；2. v. add pepper to
example: Brush the eggplant with oil, add salt and pepper, and bake till soft. Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a heavy pan.
exampleZh: 给茄子刷好油，加盐和胡椒粉，烤到软。同时，加热厚底锅中剩余的油。

meaning: prep. 每，每一；按照，根据；经；（纹章）依……的方向；adv. 每，每个；abbr. 人（person）；时期（period）；【名】 (Per)（挪、瑞、丹）佩尔（人名）
definition: 1. abstract: –present
example: The meat ration was down to one pound per person per week.
exampleZh: 肉类的配给量降到了每人每周一磅。

meaning: vt. 认为，理解；察觉，注意到；意识到
definition: 1. v. to become aware of through the senses；2. v. become conscious of
example: Voters perceive him as a decisive and resolute international leader.
exampleZh: 选民认识到他是一位果断、坚定的国际领袖。

meaning: n. 看法，认识；感觉，感知；洞察力；（租金、农作物等的）收取，占有
definition: 1. n. the representation of what is perceived; basic component in the formation of a concept；2. n. a way of conceiving something
example: It did not require a lot of perception to realize the interview was over.
exampleZh: 不需要很强的洞察力就可以意识到面试结束了。

meaning: adj. 感知力强的，有洞察力的，思维敏捷的；视觉的，听觉的，感觉的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to perception；2. adj. having the ability to perceive or understand; keen in discernment
example: Women are very perceptive and if you really like her, she'll feel it.
exampleZh: 女人是很有感知力的，如果你真心喜欢她，她会感觉到的。

meaning: n. 百分之……；部分；adj. 百分之……的；adv. 以百分之……地，每一百中有……地
definition: 1. n. a proportion multiplied by 100
example: In fact, you'll find the probability of this happening 3% is only about 3 percent, of it happening just by accident.
exampleZh: 实际上你会发现,出现这种情况的概率是，所以说他们的实验结果完全是偶然的。

meaning: n. 百分比，百分率；部分，比例；利润分成，提成；利益，好处
definition: 1. n. a proportion multiplied by 100；2. n. assets belonging to or due to or contributed by an individual person or group
example: On the other hand, there's a higher percentage of companies that don't sort of let me say make it.
exampleZh: 另一方面，没有能够很好利用新想法,来发展自身获得成功的公司的确不在少数。

meaning: v. （鸟）栖息，停留；（尤指人在高处或很窄的地方）稍坐，暂歇；（建筑物）坐落于……的上方（或边缘）；把……平稳置于，使坐落于；n. （鸟的）栖木，栖枝；高处，高位；河鲈，鲈鱼；杆（尤指用来测量土地长度的单位）；【名】 （Perch）（俄）佩尔奇，（丹）佩克（人名）
definition: 1. to sit on or near the edge of something；2. to be in a high position or in a position near the edge of something, or to put something in this position
example: The mother carried each baby up a rainforest tree to a safe perch inside a bromeliad plant.
exampleZh: 这位母亲把每只幼崽带上雨林的树，送到凤梨科植物内部一处安全的栖息处。

meaning: adj. 无瑕的，完好的；完全正确的，极其准确的；完美的，理想的；最佳的，绝配的；十足的，完全的；通常的，大体的；（语法）完成时的，完成式的；（数字）完全的；（花）有雌雄蕊的；（昆虫）性成熟的；（真菌）有性孢子形成阶段的，有性的；完成时的，完成式的；v. 完善，使完美；双面印完（一页纸）；使（礼物、头衔等）合法转移；n. （语法）完成时，完成体；【名】 （Perfect）（美、爱、英）珀费克特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a tense of verbs used in describing action that has been completed (sometimes regarded as perfective aspect)；2. v. make perfect or complete
example: Not with this girl, this girl is perfect. But in the past, I've had lots of problems with roommates.
exampleZh: 和这个女孩没吵过，她太完美了。但在过去，我和室友之间存在很多问题。

meaning: n. 完美；完善；完美的人（或物）
definition: 1. n. the state of being without a flaw or defect；2. n. an ideal instance; a perfect embodiment of a concept
example: They have been working on the perfection of the new model.
exampleZh: 他们一直在努力完善新型号。

meaning: v. 演出，表演；执行，履行（尤指复杂的任务或行动）；运行，表现；起…...作用，有…...功能
definition: 1. v. carry out or perform an action；2. v. perform a function
example: Thousands of people paid good money to watch the band perform.
exampleZh: 成千上万的人花很多钱去观看这支乐队的演出。

meaning: n. 表演，演出；工作情况，表现；（投资的）业绩；执行，履行；麻烦，苦差事（a performance）；艺术上的表现，演技；（汽车的）性能；（语言学）语言表现，言语行为；adj. 性能卓越的，高性能的
definition: 1. n. a dramatic or musical entertainment；2. n. the act of performing; of doing something successfully; using knowledge as distinguished from merely possessing it
example: C So, that's the breakdown. And, the grade is C level, 50% and it's based upon a performance of 50% absolute.
exampleZh: 这些就是分类，分数是，那就是基于成绩的。

meaning: n. 表演者，演出者，演员；表现……的人（或事物），性能……的事物；（业绩好或业绩差的）公司，产品
definition: 1. n. an entertainer who performs a dramatic or musical work for an audience
example: Now, Ken Kesey, some of you probably know, was a sort of performer, writer, not really an activist.
exampleZh: 你们可能知道，他算是一个表演家、作家，不过不是一个积极分子。

meaning: n. 香水；芳香，香味，馨香；香精，香料；v. 使香气弥漫；在……上撒香水，抹香水
definition: 1. a liquid with a pleasant smell, usually made from oils taken from flowers or spices and often used on the skin；2. a pleasant, natural smell
example: It looks like, by the way, that they got much of the perfume from areas outside of Greece.
exampleZh: 随便说一下,事实上,很多香料都来自希腊以外

meaning: adv. 可能；（用以缓和语气或表示礼貌）也许，可能；（委婉地表示不赞同或不接受）也许，大概；（用于提出建议或请求）也许；n. 假定，猜想
definition: 1. adv. by chance
example: Shakespeare in the theater seemed to represent a temptation greater even than promiscuous sex or perhaps akin to sex.
exampleZh: 在戏剧中,莎士比亚似乎更代表着一种诱惑,而不是乱性或类似的性关系。

meaning: n. 巨大的危险，危难；（某活动或行为的）危险，问题；v. 使有危险，使临险境，危及
definition: 1. n. a source of danger; a possibility of incurring loss or misfortune；2. v. pose a threat to; present a danger to
example: And it is at you peril that you ignore any one of these dimensions.
exampleZh: 忽视任何一个方面,都是不好的。

meaning: adj. 危险的，艰险的；濒临灾难（或毁灭）的
definition: 1. adj. fraught with danger
example: In its statement the association, known as BALPA, warns that unless safety improves, travellers face a perilous future.
exampleZh: BALPA 协会在它的声明中警告说，除非安全措施得到改善，否则旅行者的未来将十分危险。

meaning: n. 一段时间，时期；（人生或国家历史的）阶段，时代；（地质年代划分的）纪；课时，节；（练习、训练或学习的）时段；（妇女的）月经，经期；（体育比赛的）局；句号，句点；（物理）（振动或循环的）周期；（天文）自转（或公转）周期；（数学）（周期函数的）周期；（化学）周期元素；（修辞）完整句；（乐）乐段，乐节；adj. 具有某个时代特征的；adv. 到此为止，不再说了
definition: 1. n. an amount of time；2. n. one of three periods of play in hockey games
example: It began to infiltrate other disciplines and was in general a high-spirited horse for that certain period of time.
exampleZh: 它逐渐渗入到其它学科,总之是那个时代的一匹黑马。

meaning: adj. 阶段性的，定期的；（化学）元素周期表的；（修辞）完整句的
definition: 1. adj. happening or recurring at regular intervals；2. adj. recurring at regular intervals
example: If you click on Courseware you will get to this menu, the first of which preferences is Periodic Table.
exampleZh: 如果你点击课件，就会来到这个菜单，第一个选择就是周期表。

meaning: n. （尤指学术）期刊；adj. 间发性的，定期的，周期的；（杂志，报纸）定期出版的
definition: 1. n. a publication that appears at fixed intervals；2. adj. happening or recurring at regular intervals
example: The quarterly magazine is a periodical published every three months.
exampleZh: 季刊是每3个月出版一次的期刊。

meaning: v. （人或动物）惨死，猝死；湮灭，毁灭；（木头、橡胶、食物等）腐烂，腐败； 经受酷寒
definition: 1. to die, especially in an accident or by being killed, or to be destroyed；2. If material such as rubber or leather perishes, it decays and starts to break into pieces
example: Most of the butterflies perish in the first frosts of autumn.
exampleZh: 大多数蝴蝶在秋季初霜来临时死亡。

meaning: adj. 永久的，永恒的；（尤指问题或困难）不断出现的，一直存在的；（员工）终生的，长期的；（家庭住址）固定的；n. 烫发
definition: 1. n. a series of waves in the hair made by applying heat and chemicals；2. adj. continuing or enduring without marked change in status or condition or place
example: What they've done is they've put a load of restaurants into it as well and some permanent shops.
exampleZh: 他们做的就是开很多餐馆，还有一些长期经营的商店。

meaning: n. 永久（性），持久（性）
definition: 1. n. the property of being able to exist for an indefinite duration
example: Much of the world's great architecture has been constructed of stone because of its beauty, permanence, and availability.
exampleZh: 世界上许多伟大的建筑都是用石头建造的，因为它美观、持久且容易找到。

meaning: v. 渗透，弥漫；（观点、信念、感情等）充满，充斥
definition: 1. to spread through something and be present in every part of it
example: One need not look further than MTV or mainstream radio stations where songs filled with "booty and bling" consistently permeate the airwaves.
exampleZh: 人们只需看看 MTV 或主流广播电台，就能发现充斥着“ booty and bling ”的歌曲始终在电波中传播。

meaning: 渗透；弥漫
definition: 1. the act of spreading through something and becoming present in every part of it
example: There is an optimal speed at the lowest permeation ratio.
exampleZh: 渗透率最低点对应的转速为最佳转速。

meaning: v. 批准，许可；（使）成为可能；破例做，放纵；n. 执照，许可证；古氏鲳鲹
definition: 1. n. a legal document giving official permission to do something；2. v. consent to, give permission
example: Freedom does permit isolation from society and an alienation of the individual at a high cost, both to the individual and society.
exampleZh: 自由允许人与社会隔绝,人与人疏远,但是不管是对个人还是社会,代价都是巨大的

meaning: n. 同意，许可；许可证，书面许可
definition: 1. n. approval to do something；2. n. the act of giving a formal (usually written) authorization
example: Like I said, basically it's just asking permission to do something or asking for somebody else to do something.
exampleZh: 就像我说的，这个句型的基本意思是征求做某事的允许或请求他人做某事。

meaning: adj. 允许的，许可的
definition: 1. adj. that may be permitted especially as according to rule；2. adj. that may be accepted or conceded
example: In those situations, you might say, and only in those situations, is it permissible to violate the precepts of ordinary morality.
exampleZh: 在那些情势下，也可以说，仅在那些情势下，才能允许违背,寻常道德的戒律。

meaning: adj. 放任的，纵容的；允许而非强制的，可选择的；（生）允许的，许可的；（道路）公众获准可使用的
definition: 1. adj. not preventive；2. adj. granting or inclined or able to grant permission; not strict in discipline
example: If you build a new project based on this code, do you distribute it under permissive terms as well?
exampleZh: 如果你基于这段代码开发一个新项目，你是否也会以宽松许可条款发布它呢？

meaning: adj. 长期的，永恒的；连续不断的，重复不停的；（职位、工作或战利品）终身的；（投资）永不还本的；（植物）四季开花的，四季结果的
definition: 1. continuing for ever in the same way；2. often repeated
example: That would that would give rise to a perpetual motion machine, breaking of the second law. It can't happen.
exampleZh: 否则就会使,得永动机出现，打破第二定律那是不可能的。

meaning: v. 使持续，使长久（尤指不好的事物）
definition: 1. to cause something to continue
example: In a situation where, let's say, female genital cutting is going on and some people perpetuate on theological grounds.
exampleZh: 比如说，女性割礼,这种仪式仍在进行,有些人一味地强调神学的地位。

meaning: v. 使困惑，使茫然；使复杂化
definition: 1. to confuse and worry someone slightly by being difficult to understand or solve；2. to cause someone to be confused or uncertain over something that is not understood
example: That did not perplex Heidi though, for she saw two glasses standing behind.
exampleZh: 这并没有使难倒海蒂，因为她看到后面摆着两个玻璃杯。

meaning: n. 困惑，茫然；令人困惑的情形，令人费解的事物
definition: 1. a state of confusion or a complicated and difficult situation or thing
example: He began counting them and then, with growing perplexity, counted them a second time.
exampleZh: 他开始数，然后更加困惑地数第二遍。

meaning: v. （尤指因种族、宗教或政治信仰而）迫害，残害；骚扰，纠缠
definition: 1. to treat someone unfairly or cruelly over a long period of time because of their race, religion, or political beliefs, or to annoy someone by refusing to leave them alone；2. to treat people unfairly or cruelly over a period of time because of their race, religion, etc.
example: Many are the foes who persecute me, but I have not turned from your statutes.
exampleZh: 逼迫我的，抵挡我的，很多，我却没有偏离你的法度。

meaning: n. （尤指因种族、宗教或政治信仰而进行的）迫害，残害；烦扰
definition: 1. unfair or cruel treatment over a long period of time because of race, religion, or political beliefs
example: Thousands fled the region after facing religious persecution and widespread discrimination.
exampleZh: 成千上万的人在遭受宗教迫害和广泛歧视后逃离了该地区。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: v. 锲而不舍，坚持不懈；固执己见（在辩论中）
definition: 1. v. be persistent, refuse to stop
example: You have to persevere with difficult students.
exampleZh: 对难教的学生你必须坚持诲人不倦的精神。

meaning: n. 毅力，不屈不挠的精神
definition: 1. n. persistent determination；2. n. the act of persisting or persevering; continuing or repeating behavior
example: For him to win the game like that is a testament to his perseverance.
exampleZh: 他能赢得那样的比赛证明了他的毅力。

meaning: v. 继续存在，持续；坚持，执意；坚持说，反复说
definition: 1. v. continue to exist；2. v. be persistent, refuse to stop
example: He urged the United States to persist with its efforts to bring about peace.
exampleZh: 他敦促美国坚持努力实现和平。

meaning: adj. 执意的，坚持不懈的；持续的，反复出现的；（化学品，放射性）作用持久的，挥发慢的；（动植物某部位，如角、叶等）宿存的，不落的
definition: 1. adj. never-ceasing；2. adj. continually recurring to the mind
example: Despite persistent rain showers, the lawn and pavilion were packed with fans.
exampleZh: 尽管有持续阵雨，草坪上和亭子里还是挤满了仰慕者。

meaning: n. 继续存在，维持；坚持不懈，执意
definition: 1. n. the property of a continuous and connected period of time；2. n. persistent determination
example: None can match your sheer will-power and persistence in wearing down the opposition.
exampleZh: 在消磨反对派的意志方面，没有人能比得上你那惊人的毅力和恒心。

meaning: n. 人；自然人，法人；（用于不知其人是谁时）某人，家伙；（语法）人称；（用于复合词）从事……工作（或担任……职务）的人；人品，为人；身体，人身；喜爱（某事物）的人；（戏剧或故事中的）人物，角色；（基督教神学）（圣父、圣子、圣灵三位一体的）位；容貌，外表；【名】 （Person）（法、俄、德、瑞典）佩尔松，（英）珀森（人名）
definition: 1. n. a human being；2. n. a human body (usually including the clothing)
example: where you kind of get a strict, you know, this person is social, this person is studious.
exampleZh: 高中的时候划分得很严格，比如说，这个人爱社交，那个人爱学习。

meaning: adj. 个人的，私人的；私密的，隐私的；针对个人的，人身攻击的；人身的，身体的；人际的，私交的；供个人使用的；亲自的；有人性的；（语法）人称的；n. （报纸私人广告栏内的）私人信息发布，私人广告；（报纸或杂志上的）个人启事栏，私人广告栏（the personals）
definition: 1. n. a short newspaper article about a particular person or group；2. adj. concerning or affecting a particular person or his or her private life and personality
example: so I'm going to begin by showing you a very personal look at my hometown, a bus ride.
exampleZh: 所以我将首先展示一下,关于我家乡的一个个人视角,一次公车旅程。

meaning: adv. 就个人而言；亲自地，本人地；当面地，直接地；个别地，单个地；私人地，私下里；无礼地，冒犯地
definition: 1. adv. as yourself；2. adv. as a person
example: So I think a really good way to deal with stress is to find a hobby that you enjoy, personally,
exampleZh: 所以我觉得应对压力的一个非常好的办法就是给自己找个让自己乐在其中的爱好，

meaning: n. 个性，性格；魅力，品格（如活力、友好、幽默等）；（地方或事物的）特色；有突出个性的人；名人
definition: 1. n. the complex of all the attributes--behavioral, temperamental, emotional and mental--that characterize a unique individual；2. n. a person of considerable prominence
example: No,according to the personality theory, what personal identity requires isn't item-for-item the same personality, but rather the same evolving personality.
exampleZh: 不，根据人格理论，个人认同感并不需要一个完全相同的人格，而是同样在进化的人格。

meaning: n. （公司、组织或军队中的）全体人员，员工；人事部门；adj. 人员的，有关人事的
definition: 1. n. group of people willing to obey orders；2. n. the department responsible for hiring and training and placing employees and for seting policies for personnel management
example: I, of all the things I did as Chief of Staff, I give myself the best grade on personnel.
exampleZh: 作为白宫办公厅主任做的所有工作，在人事方面我给自己打最高的分。

meaning: n. （观察问题的）视角，观点；透视（画）法；（几何）透视关系，投影比例；洞察力，判断力；景观，远景；角度；（声音）立体效果；adj. 透视的
definition: 1. n. a way of regarding situations or topics etc.；2. n. the appearance of things relative to one another as determined by their distance from the viewer
example: In his art he broke the laws of scientific linear perspective.
exampleZh: 他在自己的绘画艺术中打破了科学的直线透视法规律。

meaning: v. 说服，劝服；使相信，使信服；（情形，事件）驱使，敦促
definition: 1. v. win approval or support for；2. v. cause somebody to adopt a certain position, belief, or course of action; twist somebody's arm
example: Why can't you take to the Hustings, persuade your fellow citizens that taxation is unjust and try to get a majority?
exampleZh: 你何不去参加竞选，劝说你的同胞,收税不公正的，并争取到大多数人的支持呢？

meaning: n. 说服，劝服；说服力；（宗教或政治）信仰；教派；某种人（或物）
definition: 1. n. the act of persuading (or attempting to persuade); communication intended to induce belief or action；2. n. a personal belief or judgment that is not founded on proof or certainty
example: The two are open to persuasion, to consider alternatives, perhaps even radical alternatives, to the society that has nurtured them.
exampleZh: 两人都愿接受劝说，并考虑替代性作法,或甚至是极端的替代方案，以改变哺育他们的社会。

meaning: adj. 有说服力的，能使人信服的
definition: 1. adj. tending or intended or having the power to induce action or belief；2. adj. capable of convincing
example: This is a persuasive way that we can move forward as a world community that is intersecting."
exampleZh: 这个方法很有说服力,可以使整个世界向前迈进“

meaning: n. 悲观，悲观情绪；（哲）悲观主义
definition: 1. n. the feeling that things will turn out badly；2. n. a general disposition to look on the dark side and to expect the worst in all things
example: There is a mood of pessimism in the company about future job prospects.
exampleZh: 公司中有一种对工作前景悲观的情绪。

meaning: adj. 悲观的，悲观主义的
definition: 1. adj. expecting the worst in this worst of all possible worlds
example: Just a couple of months ago London seemed to be soaring and now suddenly there's this pessimistic atmosphere because we don't know what's going to happen in London.
exampleZh: 仅仅数月之前,伦敦房价还一路高歌,忽然之间市场一片愁云惨淡,我们不知道伦敦的未来状况

meaning: n. 悲观主义者
definition: 1. n. a person who expects the worst
example: You don't have to be a pessimist to realize that we're in trouble.
exampleZh: 不是悲观论者也能意识到我们有了麻烦。

meaning: n. 害虫，有害动物；讨厌的人（或物）；【名】 （Pest）（德、捷）佩斯特（人名）
definition: 1. an insect or small animal that is harmful or damages crops；2. an annoying person, especially a child
example: The destiny of the pest in the chestnut is not known before reaching the destination.
exampleZh: 栗子中害虫的命运在到达目的地之前是未知的。

meaning: n. 杀虫剂，农药
definition: 1. a chemical substance used to kill harmful insects, small animals, wild plants, and other unwanted organisms；2. a chemical substance used to kill organisms that are not wanted, such as harmful insects or small animals
example: The study found that pesticide residues remained on the fruit even after it had been washed.
exampleZh: 研究发现，水果即使经过清洗，表面仍残留着农药。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 宠物；宠儿，得宠的人；宝贝，亲爱的；生气；v. 抚摸；（男女间）亲吻，爱抚；宠爱；生气；adj. 很喜欢的，钟爱的；【名】 （Pet）（俄）佩特，（柬）贝（人名）
definition: 1. n. a domesticated animal kept for companionship or amusement；2. v. stroke or caress gently
example: Everybody and his pet dog is trying to get a seat on a plane out of Logan airport.
exampleZh: 每个人和他们的宠物狗,都想获得罗根机场的飞机上的座位。

meaning: n. 请愿书； 申诉书，申请书；请愿，祈求，祈祷；v. （向政府或组织）请愿，请求；起诉，递交诉状；（向上帝或国王等）祈求，祈愿
definition: 1. a document signed by a large number of people demanding or asking for some action from the government or another authority；2. a formal letter to a law court asking for a particular legal action
example: You don't have to petition the government to do something.
exampleZh: 你不必再去请求政府,出面做什么事情。

meaning: n. 请愿人，请求者；原告，上诉人；上诉请求离婚者；恳求者，请求者
definition: 1. a person who organizes or signs a petition；2. a person who is asking for action from a law court
example: The petitioner ask for a variation in her maintenance order .
exampleZh: 上诉人要求对她生活费的命令的条件进行变更。

meaning: n. 石油化学产品；adj. 石油化工的；（与）石油化学（有关）的，（与）岩石化学（有关）的
definition: 1. any chemical substance obtained from petroleum or natural gas；2. one of the chemical substances obtained from oil or natural gas

exampleZh: 这些产品广泛应用于石化、化工、化肥、冶金、电力、建材、轻工及纺织等各类企业。

meaning: n. 汽油；深蓝绿色

example: We drove there and back on one tank of petrol.

meaning: n. 石油，原油
definition: 1. n. a dark oil consisting mainly of hydrocarbons
example: If the organic material decays or is oxidized, it will not form petroleum.
exampleZh: 如果有机物腐烂或氧化，它不会形成石油。

meaning: adj. 不重要的，琐碎的，小的；小气的，小心眼的；次要的，职位低的；（罪行）轻微的；【名】 （Petty）（英、法）佩蒂（人名）
definition: 1. n. larceny of property having a value less than some amount (the amount varies by locale)；2. adj. inferior in rank or status
example: She has way more power than she needs, it would seem, to destroy a petty little mages like Comus.
exampleZh: 她会拥有更多的力量，那看上去足够，摧毁一个像科玛斯这样的英俊的法师。

meaning: n. 药店；（医院的）药房，配药室；药剂学，配药学；一批备用药品

example: If your pharmacy doesn't stock the product you want, have them order it for you.
exampleZh: 如果药房没有你所要的产品，让他们替你订货。

meaning: adj. 制药的；n. 药物；制药公司股票（pharmaceuticals）

meaning: n. （发展或变化的）阶段，时期；做出某种行为的短时期；（动物生活周期或年周期的）阶段，期；（月亮的）位相，盈亏；同步，协调；（化）相；（动）（由遗传或季节引起的）动物颜色变化（期）；（物理）相位，相角；（线圈的）匝，（多相电机或电路的）连接；（语言学）（系统语法用语）相（指链接动词与后续动词的关系）；相结构（含有链接动词和后续动词的结构）；v. 分阶段进行；（物理）使相位同步，使定相
definition: 1. n. (physical chemistry) a distinct state of matter in a system; matter that is identical in chemical composition and physical state and separated from other material by the phase boundary；2. v. arrange in phases or stages
example: And that's where like, in Phase One, you can only sign up for 10 units worth of classes.
exampleZh: 比如说，在第一阶段，你只能报10个学分的课程。

meaning: n. 现象；杰出的人，非凡的人（或事物）；（哲学）现象
definition: 1. n. any state or process known through the senses rather than by intuition or reasoning；2. n. a remarkable development
example: Students have a lot of trouble with the concepts because there is not much intuition about electromagnetic phenomenon.
exampleZh: 学生们对于理解概念,觉得很困难,因为对于电磁学现象,只有很少能凭直觉理解的。

meaning: n. 哲学；哲学体系，思想体系；人生哲学，生活（工作）准则；（某一知识或经验领域的）理论基础研究，基本原理
definition: 1. n. a belief (or system of beliefs) accepted as authoritative by some group or school；2. n. the rational investigation of questions about existence and knowledge and ethics
example: And in that class, we study great works of western philosophy, like going back as far as Plato through Aristotle,
exampleZh: 在这门课上，我们学习西方哲学的伟大作品，比如说通过亚里士多德讲到年代久远的柏拉图，

meaning: adj. 哲学的；达观的，处乱不惊的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to philosophy or philosophers；2. adj. characterized by the attitude of a philosopher; meeting trouble with level-headed detachment
example: He was more accustomed to cocktail party chatter than to political or philosophical discussions.
exampleZh: 比起政治或者哲学讨论，他更习惯于鸡尾酒会上的闲谈。

meaning: n. 哲学家，哲人；思想深刻的人
definition: 1. n. a specialist in philosophy；2. n. a wise person who is calm and rational; someone who lives a life of reason with equanimity
example: The Roman poet philosopher Juvenal said men need not so much be informed as reminded.
exampleZh: 罗马哲学家尤维纳利斯说过,人们更需要记住，而不是被通知。

meaning: n. 照片，相片；v. 拍照；给……拍照
definition: 1. n. a picture of a person or scene in the form of a print or transparent slide; recorded by a camera on light-sensitive material
example: And I've seen other similar things where commercial photography, photo journalism and all that stuff is up there,
exampleZh: 我也见过很多商业摄影师，记者摄影师，等等，都是

meaning: adj. 摄影的，照片的；（记忆）精确的，能详细记录的
definition: 1. adj. relating to photography or obtained by using photography；2. adj. representing people or nature with the exactness and fidelity of a photograph
example: I'd been working as a sales rep for a photographic company.
exampleZh: 我一直在担任一家摄影公司的销售代表。

meaning: n. 拍照者，摄影师
definition: 1. n. someone who takes photographs professionally
example: This is a photo by another American photographer, Walker Evans, a photo of Brooklyn Bridge. You recognize it.
exampleZh: 这是美国摄影家沃克埃文斯拍摄的一张照片，你们可以看出，是拍的布鲁克林大桥。

meaning: n. 摄影，摄影术；摄影影像，摄影图片
definition: 1. n. the act of taking and printing photographs；2. n. the process of producing images of objects on photosensitive surfaces

exampleZh: 我也见过很多商业摄影师，记者摄影师，等等，都是

meaning: n. 短语，词组；惯用语，习语；乐句；（芭蕾）舞句；v. 用……方式表达，以……措辞表达；把（乐曲）分成短句
definition: 1. n. an expression consisting of one or more words forming a grammatical constituent of a sentence；2. v. put into words or an expression
example: So what it might be would be a phrase that has struck one as if for the first time.
exampleZh: 因此这种支点也许是,某人刚刚想到的一个短语。

meaning: adj. 短语的，词组的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to or functioning as a phrase
example: The phrasal verb 'tear up' is separable because you can say 'She tore the letter up' or 'She tore up the letter'.
exampleZh: * tear up 是可以分开的短语动词，因为既可以说 She tore the letter up ，又可以说 She tore up the letter。

meaning: adj. 身体的，肉体的；物质的，有形的；外形的，外在的；物理的，物理学的；根据自然规律的，符合自然法则的；粗暴的，粗野的；性欲的，肉欲的；（人）喜欢动手动脚的；肢体活动的；n. 体格检查；（股票）（与期货相对的）现货股票
definition: 1. adj. involving the body as distinguished from the mind or spirit；2. adj. relating to the sciences dealing with matter and energy; especially physics
example: He's able to justify the ways of God to men here on the physical - on this intimately bodily earth.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿得以从这具体的物质的人间的角度,证明了上帝待人之法。

meaning: n. 医生，（尤指）内科医生；抚慰者
definition: 1. n. a licensed medical practitioner
example: He was a consultant physician, a serious man dedicated to his calling.
exampleZh: 他是一名顾问医生，一个专注于其使命的严肃认真的人。

meaning: n. 物理学；物理特性，物理现象
definition: 1. n. the science of matter and energy and their interactions
example: The goal is by 2005, they have all the large lecture courses in MIT physics taught in this format.
exampleZh: 我们的目标是到200年，能使所有的大型讲座课,都能用这种方式讲授。

meaning: n. 物理学家
definition: 1. n. a scientist trained in physics
example: Both Langer and Stone were my physicist advisors, introduced me to the field of positive psychology into this research.
exampleZh: 两位都是我的物理学导师，带我进入了积极心理学领域的研究。

meaning: adj. 生理的，生理机能的；生理学的
definition: 1. relating to the way in which the bodies of living things work
example: Then we're going to talk about two physiological systems just briefly, where cell communication sort of dominates the behavior of the organ.
exampleZh: 然后我将简要地讲到两个生理系统,主要是讲细胞通讯控制器官活动的方式

meaning: n. 钢琴（pianoforte 的简称）；（Piano）人名，法、意、葡译作皮亚诺；adj. （音乐记谱用语）柔和的（常缩略为 p）；adv. （音乐记谱用语）轻柔地（常缩略为 p）
definition: 1. n. a stringed instrument that is played by depressing keys that cause hammers to strike tuned strings and produce sounds；2. adj. used chiefly as a direction or description in music
example: Are they--Do they have the theme or the motive or does the piano have the theme or the motive?
exampleZh: 它们演奏的部分是主题还是动机呢,或者,钢琴演奏的是主题还是动机

meaning: n. 钢琴家，钢琴演奏者
definition: 1. n. a person who plays the piano
example: He regaled us with tales of his days as a jazz pianist.
exampleZh: 他给我们讲述他当爵士乐钢琴师时的事，逗我们开心。

meaning: v. 采，摘（花、果）；（用手指）弄掉；找茬；捡，抱起；选择；弹，拨（弦）；撬开（锁），扒窃……中的东西；小心走路（~ one's way）；（反复地）拔，拉，撕，扯；没胃口地吃；（高尔夫）拾球（尤指认输的拾球）（~ up）；采，摘（花、果等）；n. 精华（the pick of）；选择，选择权；被选中的人（或事物）；鹤嘴锄；（吉他的）拨子；（尖状的）挖撬工具；（篮球）掩护；【名】 （Pick）（英、法、德、捷、匈、瑞典）皮克（人名）
definition: 1. n. the person or thing chosen or selected；2. v. select carefully from a group
example: I was a first year student and happily minding my own business, getting ready to try to pick a summer job.
exampleZh: 我当时是一年级，只关心自己的小生活，想好好准备暑假打个工。

meaning: adj. 挑剔的，吹毛求疵的，过分讲究的
definition: 1. adj. exacting especially about details
example: Some people are very picky about who they choose to share their lives with.
exampleZh: 有些人对选择跟什么样的人共享生活非常挑剔。

meaning: n. 野餐，野餐活动；野餐食物；愉快事物，轻松事物；v. 参加野餐活动
definition: 1. n. a day devoted to an outdoor social gathering；2. v. eat alfresco, in the open air
example: They picnic and they barbecue, and just sit out on the grass and just relax. You know it's a beautiful park.
exampleZh: 他们在那里野餐，露天烧烤，或者简单地坐在草地上放松。那是一个很美的公园。

meaning: n. 图片，绘画；照片；肖像；（电视或电影的）图像；情况，局面；脑海中的情景，形象；电影院（the pictures）；影片；描述；酷似的人（或物）；典范；v. 想象；绘画，拍摄；描绘；（在报纸、杂志等上）登载……的照片（或图片）
definition: 1. n. a visual representation (of an object or scene or person or abstraction) produced on a surface；2. v. imagine; conceive of; see in one's mind
example: Exactly, so I just help them breath, to picture themselves and feel that, and actually feel what it was like.
exampleZh: 正是如此，我帮他们调整呼吸，想象并感受自己，真切地感受。

meaning: adj. （地方）古雅的，风景如画的；（语言）生动的，独特的；（服饰和外貌）引人注意的，奇特的

example: They may be picturesque, even poetical; or they may be pedestrian, even trivial.
exampleZh: 它们也许如画一般，甚至富有诗意；或者它们可能平庸，甚至微不足道。

meaning: n. 馅饼，果馅饼；肉馅饼，蔬菜馅饼

example: I added a dollop of vanilla ice cream to the pie.
exampleZh: 我在馅饼中加了一块香草冰淇淋。

meaning: n. 块，张，片，段；碎片，零件；（成套物品的）部件，部分；（艺术、音乐、戏剧、文学的）一部作品；（报道、新闻、广播的）一篇；份额，一份股权；桩，项，条，件； 一点；（土地的）一块；一段距离；硬币；枪；女人；（三明治等）小吃；v. 拼合，拼装；慢慢理解

meaning: v. （锋利尖锐物体）刺入，刺穿；（在身体某部位）扎眼，穿孔（以佩戴珠宝）；（声或光）穿过，透入；冲过，突破；让某人心如刀割，深深地打动；【名】 （Pierce）皮尔斯（人名，同Pearce）
definition: 1. n. 14th President of the United States (1804-1869)；2. v. cut or make a way through
example: A tap on the door interrupted him and Sally Pierce came in.
exampleZh: 轻轻的敲门声打断了他，萨莉•皮尔斯进来了。

meaning: n. 猪；令人讨厌的人，猪猡；警官（侮辱性用语）；难办的事，不愉快的事；贪吃的人；生铁块，生铅锭；清管器；v. 狼吞虎咽；像猪一样挤在一起；（母猪）生小猪；（在石油或天然气管道中）操作清管器
definition: 1. n. domestic swine；2. v. live like a pig, in squalor
example: You wait for the pig to do something that's halfway close to dancing, like stumbling, and you reward it.
exampleZh: 你等到猪的动作有点像跳舞，比如它摇摇晃晃的，你就奖励它。

meaning: n. 鸽子；（容易）上当受骗的人；（自己的）责任，分内之事；己方飞机；【名】 （Pigeon）（法）皮容，（英）皮金（人名）
definition: 1. n. wild and domesticated birds having a heavy body and short legs

meaning: n. 一堆，一叠；一大堆，大量；大笔钱财；（地毯的）绒面；地桩；宏伟建筑物；痔疮；（纹章）（尖头朝下的）楔形普通图记；电池组；v. 堆放；堆满；聚集；将（女子头发）高高盘起；蜂拥，拥挤；（车）撞（~ into）；夸大（~ something on）；用桩加固（或支撑）；【名】 （Pile）（西）皮莱，（英）派尔（人名）

meaning: n. 朝圣者，香客；（Pilgrim）前辈清教徒移民；到某重要地点（或人物居所）参观的人；流浪者，旅客；v. 漫游，流浪；去朝圣；【名】 （Pilgrim）（英、德）皮尔格林（人名）
definition: 1. a person who makes a journey, often a long and difficult one, to a special place for religious reasons；2. a person who makes a journey to a famous place that is special to them
example: The father, in his tall Pilgrim hat, was like his own father—stern, someone to be respected.
exampleZh: 这位父亲，戴着他那高高的朝圣者帽子，像他自己的父亲那样——严肃并让人尊重。

meaning: n. 朝拜，朝觐；旅行，拜谒，参观；（被看作旅途的）人生；v. 朝圣，朝觐

exampleZh: 回到劳沙小镇，2010年的圣诞之旅基本上结束了。

meaning: n. 药片，药丸；（女用）口服避孕药 （the pill）；（衣服或布料上的）球粒，纤维绒球； 讨厌的家伙；（某些运动用的）球，弹；v. （衣服或布料）起球粒，结绒；把……制成丸剂；（使）服用药丸；抢劫，掠夺；【名】 （pill）（英）皮尔（人名）

meaning: n. 柱子，支柱；主心骨，栋梁；（组织、制度、信仰等的）核心，基础；柱状物；纪念柱；煤柱，矿柱；v. 用柱支撑；【名】 （Pillar）人名，（英）皮勒

exampleZh: 事实上，那有一个高纯度锌的柱子,存在于整个时期。

meaning: n. 枕头；蕾丝枕头（lace pillow的简称）；坐垫，靠垫；v. 将（头）枕在……上，枕着（某物）；为……当枕头；【名】 （Pillow）（英）皮洛（人名）

meaning: n. 飞行员；领航员；（船只的）领航员；（电视）试播节目；常燃小火；航海手册；职业骑师；向导；（火车头前端的）排障器；adj. 试点的；（电信）控制引导信号；v. 驾驶（飞行器）；领航；试验，试行；使（新法律）顺利通过；带领，指引；【名】（Pilot）皮洛特（人名）

meaning: n. （尤指做衣服时固定布料用的）别针，大头针；胸针，饰针；徽章，像章；钉，楔，销，栓；（接骨用的）钢钉，钢针；（插头的）管脚；（手榴弹的）保险针，保险销；（高尔夫球场地内的）旗杆；（保龄球）瓶柱；（人或动物的）双腿；（棋）牵制；（乐）弦轴，琴轸；加仑啤酒桶；（PIN）个人身份识别号码（用于在自动取款机上取款的私人密码）；v. （用钉子）钉住，别住；按住，使不能动弹；（棋）牵制
