example: A kind of a pin used to hold your cloak together, called a fibula, unknown in the previous period.
exampleZh: 一种别住披风的别针,称之为扣针,这在之前的时期从未出现过

meaning: v. 捏，拧，掐；揑住，夹紧；掐掉；（穿的鞋等）夹痛，挤痛；偷窃；逮捕，拘捕；节约，节省；使经济拮据；捏拉缩放；（由于担心或紧张）抿（嘴唇）；（航海）使（帆船）紧抢风；n. 捏，掐，拧；一撮；偷窃；（棒球）紧要时刻，紧要关头；adj. 替代的，替补的；由替补击球手完成的；【名】 （Pinch）（美、加、英）平奇（人名）
definition: 1. n. a painful or straitened circumstance；2. v. squeeze tightly between the fingers
example: She had to pinch herself to make sure she was not dreaming.
exampleZh: 她不得不掐一下自己，弄清楚自己不是在做梦。

meaning: n. 松树；松木；……松（用于其他科针叶类树木名称中）；……松（用于某方面类似松树而与松树无关的植物名称中）；有松针香味；凤梨；v. （因死亡、离别） 难过，悲伤；苦苦思念；为……悲哀，哀悼；渴望，苦苦盼望（尤指不太可能拥有的东西）；【名】 （Pine）派因（人名）
definition: 1. n. a coniferous tree；2. v. have a desire for something or someone who is not present
example: Satan's spear is to the tallest pine what the tallest pine is to a little, bitty wand.
exampleZh: 撒旦的长矛对于最高的松木而言就如同最高的松木,对比一根小小的棍子一般大。

meaning: adj. 粉红色的；（因窘迫、愤怒或剧烈活动而）脸色发红的；同性恋的；左倾的；石竹科的；兴奋的（tickled pink）；n. 粉红色；粉红色衣服或衣料；粉红色葡萄酒；石竹；尖尾帆船；满面红光，容光焕发（in the pink (of)）；粉红色桌球；微黄颜料；左倾的人；精英，典范；v. （车辆引擎）发响爆声，爆震；变成粉红色；（贴身地）剪（羊毛）；剪成锯齿状；（用武器或投掷物）刺，戳，扎；嘲笑，批评；装饰；【名】 （Pink）（美、英、加、德、菲）平克（人名）
definition: 1. n. a light shade of red；2. v. make light, repeated taps on a surface
example: All right, good. So the pink line is actually going to get steeper, but I know what you mean.
exampleZh: 说得很好,但粉色的线会变陡峭,我理解你说的意思了

meaning: n. 品脱（液量单位，约等于半升）；一品脱啤酒；一品脱牛奶；一品脱大的杯子所能盛下的量（贝类计量单位）；一品脱容器；【名】 （Pint）（德、俄、匈）平特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a British imperial capacity measure (liquid or dry) equal to 4 gills or 568.26 cubic centimeters；2. n. a United States dry unit equal to 0.5 quart or 33.6 cubic inches
example: A pint and a half of beer can produce the effect and in men it may last 24 hours.
exampleZh: 一品脱半的啤酒就可以产生这种效果，对男性来说，这种效果可以持续24小时。

meaning: n. 拓荒者；先锋；（前苏联等共产党国家的）少年先锋队队员；（先头部队的）工兵；（天主教禁欲团体）完全禁欲先锋联盟的成员；先锋号（Pioneer）；adj. 先驱的；拓荒的；v. 做先锋，倡导；开辟（道路）
definition: 1. n. someone who helps to open up a new line of research or technology or art；2. v. open up an area or prepare a way
example: What if I am a pioneer or even a genius?
exampleZh: 要是我是个开拓者，甚至是个天才怎么办？

meaning: n. 管子，管道；烟斗；管乐器；（管风琴的）音管；（苏格兰的）风笛（pipes）；（人或动物的）叫声，歌声；葡萄酒桶；（计算机）管线命令；符号"|"；v. 用管道运输；传送，播送（音乐、录音）；用管乐器吹奏；（吹长口哨）召集，召唤；高声说话，尖声唱；在食品（尤指蛋糕）上裱花；（为衣服或室内陈设品）拷边，滚边；插枝繁殖；【名】 （Pipe）（匈）皮佩，（英）派普（人名）
definition: 1. n. a tube with a small bowl at one end; used for smoking tobacco；2. v. utter a shrill cry
example: This last line that I've read seems itself to have been grated on a scrannel pipe.
exampleZh: 我读到的最后一行,听起来似乎它本身被细弱的气管声所激怒了。

meaning: n. 海盗，海上劫掠者；盗版者，侵犯专利权者；非法制作电视或广播节目的人（或组织）；道德败坏者，违法者；v. 盗印，窃用；劫掠（船只）；劫掠（船只）；adj. 盗版的
definition: 1. n. someone who uses another person's words or ideas as if they were his own；2. v. copy illegally; of published material
example: You can't call--we know Odysseus himself is a basileus-- him a merchant. Pirate, sure, but merchant, no.
exampleZh: 我们都知道奥德修斯是君主,我们不能,叫他商人,海盗没问题,但商人绝对不行

meaning: n. 海上抢劫，海盗行为；盗版，非法复制（或销售）；（电视或广播节目的）非法播出，非法制作电视（或广播）节目；抢劫行为，劫持行为，劫机
definition: 1. n. hijacking on the high seas or in similar contexts; taking a ship or plane away from the control of those who are legally entitled to it；2. n. the act of plagiarizing; taking someone's words or ideas as if they were your own
example: Seven of the fishermen have been formally charged with piracy.
exampleZh: 其中7名渔民已被正式指控犯有海盗罪。

meaning: n. 手枪；精力旺盛的人；vt. 用手枪射击；【名】 （Pistol）（罗）皮斯托尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a firearm that is held and fired with one hand
example: It is a myth that gunslingers in the American west cut notches in the handle of their pistol for each man they shot.
exampleZh: 有种传说，美国西部的枪手们每杀死一个人就在他们的枪柄上刻下一个V形记号。

meaning: n. 坑，洼；（表面上的）疤痕，凹陷；矿井；异常凌乱的地方；乐池，乐队席；糟糕的事物（the pits）；（水果或蔬菜的）核；腋窝，心窝；（赛车道旁的）检修加油站；深渊，绝境；交易场所；斗兽场；（剧场）正厅后座；无底洞，巨库；床；v. 使竞争，使对立；去除……的果核；（使）有疤痕，（使）凹陷；停车加油，停车检修；窖藏；【名】 （Pit）（东南亚国家华语）必（人名）
definition: 1. n. a sizeable hole (usually in the ground)；2. v. set into opposition or rivalry
example: Your stomach sinks, you have that sinking feeling in the pit of your stomach, when you get a bad grade on a test.
exampleZh: 当你考试考砸的时候,你的胃会垂下去,或者说,会有胃部下垂的感觉

meaning: n. 体育场地，球场；程度，强度；音准，音高；推销用语；投球；沥青，柏油；（船或飞机的）颠簸；倾斜度，高度；摊位，（街头艺人的）表演场所；（高尔夫）下旋高球；露营地；（技）螺距，节距；v. 扔，抛，掷；（棒球中）投（球）；击地，（使球）定点落地；重跌，坠落；（船或飞机）颠簸；把……定于某水平；使（产品）针对，面向；推销；为……定音高；向下倾斜；扎，搭建；（高尔夫）击下旋高球；用石头铺（路）；（酿酒用语）给（麦芽汁）加酵母；盖上沥青，涂上沥青
definition: 1. n. the property of sound that varies with variation in the frequency of vibration；2. v. throw or toss with a light motion
example: Music gravitates around a home pitch and in the Beethoven Fifth symphony we still haven't gotten the home pitch.
exampleZh: 音乐的音高一般会围绕着主音高浮动,在贝多芬的第五交响乐中 ,我们还没发现这个主音高

meaning: n. 同情，怜悯；可惜的事，遗憾的事；仁慈，慈悲；v. 同情，怜悯
definition: 1. n. a feeling of sympathy and sorrow for the misfortunes of others；2. v. share the suffering of
example: Pity" and "terror," these become crucial terms, the terms that Aristotle, in his Poetics, used to define tragedy.
exampleZh: 遗憾或恐惧“,这是很关键的词，亚里士多德在《诗学》中用它，定义悲剧。

meaning: n. 比萨饼，披萨（一种意大利烤饼，用扁平的面饼铺上番茄酱、奶酪及其他配料烤制而成）；（Pizza）皮扎（意大利人名）
definition: 1. n. Italian open pie made of thin bread dough spread with a spiced mixture of e.g. tomato sauce and cheese
example: Or in another example, let's pretend that you wake up after you had a pizza the next day.
exampleZh: 又或者，假设你吃完披萨，第二天醒来。

meaning: n. 地点，场所；城镇（或建筑物等）；有某用途的建筑（或土地）；表面的某处；家，住所；（书本或讲话中的）点；座位，位置；地位，资格；机会，名额；适当的地方；境况；排名；第二名；（数学的）位；广场，短街；乡间住宅；一套餐具；v. 放置；使处于某种境地；以某种态度对待（或看待）；认出，想起；下指示，请求；安置；排名，归类；（赛跑）获前三/四名；定位球得分；证明……在场；【名】 （Place）（罗）普拉切，（法）普拉斯，（英）普莱斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a point located with respect to surface features of some region；2. v. put into a certain place or abstract location
example: The metropolis, well, it's a place of ambivalence, a place of promise and of threat, of exultation and also of dread.
exampleZh: 都市是一个自相矛盾的地方，既有希望，又有威胁，喜悦与恐惧相伴而存在。

meaning: n. 布置，摆放；（某人的）安置，安顿；实习工作；收容所，安置所；定位球
definition: 1. n. the spatial property of the way in which something is placed；2. n. contact established between applicants and prospective employees
example: The application in Economics is to do with product placement, something that Jake's working on.
exampleZh: 它在经济学的应用是产品植入,这是杰克正在研究的领域

meaning: n. 瘟疫，传染病；鼠疫（尤指腺鼠疫）；（老鼠或昆虫等肆虐造成的）灾害，祸患； 普遍的祸害；烦恼事；愿上天降灾难于……（a plague on）；v. 困扰，折磨；烦扰，纠缠；使得灾祸
definition: 1. n. a serious (sometimes fatal) infection of rodents caused by Yersinia pestis and accidentally transmitted to humans by the bite of a flea that has bitten an infected animal；2. v. cause to suffer a blight
example: Now the second plague in each set of three is introduced with the divine instruction, "Go to Pharaoh."
exampleZh: 每三组的第二个瘟疫开始于圣谕,“到法老面前去“

meaning: adj. 无装饰的，朴素的；单色的，无花纹的；单纯的，不掺杂的；显而易见的；（书面或口头用法）表达清楚的；直截了当的，坦率的；相貌平平的；普通的；直呼其名的；完全的；（编织）平针的；adv. 完全地，简直；明白地，不含糊地；n. （大）平原；（编织的）平针；朴实无华的东西；【名】 （Plain）（英）普莱恩，（法）普兰（人名）
definition: 1. n. extensive tract of level open land；2. v. express complaints, discontent, displeasure, or unhappiness
example: It is the coastal plain, and that provides, or that is the main highway out of Egypt or down to Egypt.
exampleZh: 这就是海岸平原，它提供了或说它本身就是,离开埃及或者下埃及的主要通道。

meaning: n. 原告，起诉人
definition: 1. someone who makes a legal complaint against someone else in court；2. a person or company that makes a legal complaint about someone else in a court of law
example: The defendant may also file a counterclaim against the plaintiff, a cross-claim against any co-defendant or an impleader.
exampleZh: 被告也可以对原告提出反诉，对共同被告或原告提出交叉诉讼。

meaning: n. （详细）规划；（养老金、储蓄、保险）方案；计划，打算；平面图，详图；分布图，示意图；（卫理公会教堂）巡回传教士名单；（手机流量、话费等）套餐；v. 计划，筹划；打算；设计；期望，预料；【名】 （Plan）（瑞典）普兰，（法）普朗（人名）
definition: 1. n. a series of steps to be carried out or goals to be accomplished；2. v. have the will and intention to carry out some action
example: but you have to plan a funeral, and you have to, like, deal with the flowers then make a program
exampleZh: 但同时你也要去筹划葬礼，准备祭奠的鲜花，确定葬礼的流程，

meaning: n. 计划，规划；城镇规划管理，市政规划；v. 计划，筹划；打算；设计；期望，预料（plan 的现在分词）
definition: 1. n. an act of formulating a program for a definite course of action；2. n. the act or process of drawing up plans or layouts for some project or enterprise
example: and they do a lot of things like community service and planning events, things like that.
exampleZh: 而且他们会做很多事情，比如说，社区服务，活动规划等等。

meaning: n. 计划者，规划师，策划人；记事本，日程本（也指日程管理软件等规划工具）；（Planner）人名（德、捷）普兰纳
definition: 1. n. a person who makes plans；2. n. a notebook for recording appointments and things to be done, etc.
example: Our website has a fantastic planner, so you can see how cycling reduces pollution in your local area.
exampleZh: 我们的网站有一款很棒的规划工具，你可以借此看到骑行如何减少你所在区域的污染。

meaning: n. 飞机；（几何学中的）平面；（物体的）平面；（穿过或连接物体的）虚构平面；（存在、思想或发展）水平；木工刨，刨子；悬铃木；翼面；adj. 平的，平坦的；二维平面的，二维空间的；v. 滑翔；擦着水面疾驶；刨平；刨除；乘飞机旅行；【名】 （Plane）（塞、瑞典、法）普拉内（人名）
definition: 1. n. an aircraft that has a fixed wing and is powered by propellers or jets；2. v. cut or remove with or as if with a plane
example: Suppose I want to do little piece of code that's going to do planar geometry, points in the plane.
exampleZh: 好，因此我需要一些,把这些东西收集到，一起的一些方式。

meaning: n. 行星；地球（the planet）；命运星辰；【名】 （Planet）普拉内特（人名）
definition: 1. n. (astronomy) any of the nine large celestial bodies in the solar system that revolve around the sun and shine by reflected light; Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto in order of their proximity to the sun; viewed from the constellation Hercules, all the planets rotate around the sun in a counterclockwise direction；2. n. a person who follows or serves another
example: The new planet is about ten times the size of the earth.
exampleZh: 这个新发现的行星大约是地球大小的10倍。

meaning: adj. 行星的；（与）地球（有关）的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to or resembling the physical or orbital characteristics of a planet or the planets；2. adj. of or relating to or characteristic of the planet Earth or its inhabitants
example: Within our own galaxy there are probably tens of thousands of planetary systems.
exampleZh: 在我们所在的银河系中，很可能存在数以万计的行星系。

meaning: n. 植物；工厂，发电厂；房屋，设施；重型机械，机械设备；栽赃物品；密探，卧底；（斯诺克）击接触球犯规；v. 栽种，种植；灌输（思想）；栽赃；安放（炸弹），（秘密）放置；安插（眼线、密探等）；把……牢牢插进，稳固地放置……；（通常出于不可告人的目的）发布，散布；移栽，移植（室外）；埋葬（人）；创建，建立（殖民地，城市，社区）；（在河流或湖泊中）放养（鱼苗、鱼卵、牡蛎等）；【名】 （Plant）（英、西、意）普兰特，（法）普朗（人名）
definition: 1. n. buildings for carrying on industrial labor；2. v. put or set (seeds, seedlings, or plants) into the ground
example: OK, and we'll just plant that idea, we're going to come back to later on, as we carry on.
exampleZh: 好，我们现在就只是初步形成这个思想而已，我们会在以后继续上课的时候，回来讨论这一点的。

meaning: n. （尤指热带的）种植地，农园；人工林场，苗木场；殖民地，新开垦地；普兰泰申市（美国佛罗里达州城市名）
definition: 1. n. an estate where cash crops are grown on a large scale (especially in tropical areas)；2. n. a newly established colony (especially in the colonization of North America)
example: One is the plantation owner who may have hundreds of thousands of acres.
exampleZh: 一类是拥有成千上万英亩土地的种植园主。

meaning: n. 塑料；信用卡；塑胶制造业（plastics）；塑料学（plastics）；adj. 塑料制的；人造的，不自然的；可塑的；（艺术用语）造型的，塑造的；（科技用语）范性的，塑性的；适应环境多样性的
definition: 1. n. generic name for certain synthetic or semisynthetic materials that can be molded or extruded into objects or films or filaments or used for making e.g. coatings and adhesives；2. adj. capable of being molded or modeled (especially of earth or clay or other soft material)
example: But I certainly won't stop them from seeking plastic surgery if that makes them feel better about themselves.
exampleZh: 但是如果整容可以让他们自我感觉更良好，我当然不会阻止他们接受整容手术。

meaning: n. 盘，碟；一盘（食物）；一道主菜；奉献盘，捐款盘；金属护板（片）；金属牌；（车辆的）号码牌；镀金（或镀银）金属；金/银餐具；盾片，鳞甲；（地质）板块；（书中的）插图；印版；感光板；假牙托；牙箍；全口假牙；（棒球）本垒板；（银质或金质）奖杯；杯赛；横木；（生物）培养皿；载物片，玻璃片；极板；阳极；v. 给……镀（金属）；给……加上装甲；用鳞片覆盖；摆盘；（棒球）跑垒得分；（生物）制作显微片；【名】 （Plate）（英、德、俄、西、意、瑞典）普拉特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a sheet of metal or wood or glass or plastic；2. v. coat with a layer of metal
example: A very important element, he would have had a breast plate made of bronze, perhaps as much as 40 pounds.
exampleZh: 还有一个非常重要的元素,那就是士兵还配有铜质的胸甲,大概能有四十磅重

meaning: n. 高原；（发展、增长后的）稳定期，停滞期；高原印第安人；托盘；v. （在一段时间的发展之后）趋于平稳，进入停滞期
definition: 1. a large flat area of land that is high above sea level；2. a period during which there are no large changes
example: A broad valley opened up leading to a high, flat plateau of cultivated land.
exampleZh: 一个宽阔的山谷展开，通向一片平坦的高原耕地。

meaning: n. 平台；讲台，舞台；讲台上的人（the platform）；（火车站的）月台；（公共汽车上供乘客上下车的）踏脚台；发言机会，论坛；契机；（政党的）纲领；厚底鞋；计算机平台；（海上）钻井平台；（供人上下小船的）水上平台；（火箭或导弹的）卫星发射平台
definition: 1. n. a raised horizontal surface；2. n. a document stating the aims and principles of a political party
example: And it's just like a platform for that; for artists both well-known and not so well-known.
exampleZh: 它就像是个给有名的或者还不那么有名的艺术家提供的舞台。

meaning: adj. 似乎是真的，貌似有理的；（人）花言巧语的，貌似可信的；可靠的，可重用的
definition: 1. seeming likely to be true, or able to be believed；2. A plausible person appears to be honest and telling the truth, even if they are not
example: The researcher offered a plausible explanation for the discrepancy, but further experiments were needed to confirm it.
exampleZh: 研究人员对这一差异给出了看似合理的解释，但仍需进一步实验加以确认。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: v. 玩，玩耍；捉弄，戏弄；摆弄，玩弄；耍弄，愚弄；不认真地干，闹（play at）；参加（游戏、比赛等）；与……比赛；击，踢（球）；出（牌），走（棋子）；派（某人）上场；（在球队中）打（某位置）；扮演，演出；佯装，假装；假扮……玩；（戏剧或电影）上演，上映；演奏，弹奏；（使）播放；闪烁，浮现；（以某方式）行事，做事；（使）发射（或喷射、照射）；赌，投机；被接受，被认可；（喻）合作，买某人的账；寄于；让（上钩的鱼）挣扎得筋疲力尽；（板球场状况对比赛）产生影响；n. 剧本，戏剧；游戏，玩乐；比赛；比赛中的动作；（运动或游戏中的）打法，走法；活动空间，间隙；影响，作用；闪烁，变幻；玩笑；（音频或图像的）播放次数，播放时长；播放（功能）；（报纸或电视的）关注；（对文字的）巧用，妙用；【名】 （Play）（法、瑞典）普莱（人名）
definition: 1. n. a dramatic work intended for performance by actors on a stage；2. v. participate in games or sport
example: These are primal forms of play, if you like, ; that suggest forms of poetic activity; also, spiritual activity.
exampleZh: 这是玩最原始的形式，如果你愿意，这种形式显示出了诗歌活动的形式;,还有精神活动。

meaning: n. 运动员，选手；（乐器的）演奏者；演员，表演者；参与者，角色；（录音或录像的）播放器；风流浪子；（用于剧团的名称中）剧团
definition: 1. n. a person who participates in or is skilled at some game；2. n. someone who plays a musical instrument (as a profession)
example: Identify the best responses of each player as a function of the others and find out where they intersect.
exampleZh: 把每个人的最佳对策看成别人策略的函数,然后找出函数的交点

meaning: n. （尤指学校或公园中的儿童）操场，游乐场；（某一群体的）游憩胜地，度假场所
definition: 1. n. an area where many people go for recreation；2. n. yard consisting of an outdoor area for children's play
example: The resort is a playground of the rich and famous.
exampleZh: 这个度假胜地是富翁名流的娱乐场所。

meaning: n. （城市中的露天）广场；购物中心，商业区；（城际干道沿线的）服务区；（进入城际干道的）收费站；【名】 （Plaza）（英）普拉扎，（西、葡）普拉萨（人名）
definition: 1. an open area or square in a town, especially in Spanish-speaking countries；2. a group of buildings including shops, designed as a single development within a town
example: Across the busy plaza, vendors sell hot dogs and croissant sandwiches.
exampleZh: 忙碌的露天广场对面，小贩们在卖热狗和新月形面包三明治。

meaning: n. 恳求，请求；（法庭上所作的）有罪（无罪）陈述；借口，托辞
definition: 1. an urgent and emotional request；2. the answer that a person gives in court when they have been accused of committing a crime
example: A plea bargain was offered by the state assuring her that she would not go to prison.
exampleZh: 该州提出了一份认罪辩诉协议，保证她不会入狱。

meaning: v. 恳求，乞求；极力主张，极力为……辩护；（在法庭）申辩，认罪；（向法庭）陈述案情；以……为理由，提出……作借口
definition: 1. to make an urgent, emotional statement or request for something；2. to make a statement of what you believe to be true, especially in support of something or someone or when someone has been accused in a law court
example: They will plead with him to pull back from confrontation.
exampleZh: 他们会恳求他不要再对抗下去。

meaning: int. 好吗，请（用于客气地请求）；请千万，请务必（用于加强请求的语气）；行，谢谢（用于接受别人的好意）；请别，请不要；得了吧；让我说；v. （使）开心，（使）满意；想，选择，喜欢；请便，随你的便
definition: 1. v. give pleasure to or be pleasing to；2. adv. used in polite request
example: And, by all means, if you are scheduled to attend class at 11:00, please take the test at 11:00.
exampleZh: 当然，如果你安排到11：00参加考试的话，请在11：00参加考试。

meaning: n. 快乐，满足，欣慰；乐事，趣事；（尤指工作、职责之外的）娱乐，消遣；adj. 游乐的，非公务的；v. 从……中获得乐趣；（使）高兴
definition: 1. n. a fundamental feeling that is hard to define but that people desire to experience；2. n. something or someone that provides pleasure; a source of happiness
example: Historically, it has not been pleasure or wit or beauty that has been associated with the experience of reading Milton.
exampleZh: 一直以来，人们阅读米尔顿作品的时候,感受到的都不是愉悦，机智，或者美好。

meaning: adj. 令人愉快的，惬意的；礼貌而友善的，和蔼可亲的；【名】 （Pleasant）（英）普莱曾特（人名）
definition: 1. adj. affording pleasure; being in harmony with your taste or likings；2. adj. pleasant in manner or behavior
example: Kind of pleasant, I guess, right? " The desire to return to the quiescence of the organic world."
exampleZh: 听起来还不错，不是吗？,“希望回到静态的无机世界的愿望“

meaning: adj. 令人高兴的，令人满意的；v. 使满意，使愉快；选择，喜欢（please 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. the act of one who pleases；2. adj. giving pleasure and satisfaction
example: Likewise, the gifts--the other foods and pleasing odors attracted and maintained the continued presence of God in the sanctuary.
exampleZh: 同样的，个人准备的,都吸引并维持了上帝在圣所里的逗留。

meaning: n. 誓言，保证，承诺；捐款承诺；戒酒誓言（the pledge）；信物；质押；（美国大学中）宣誓加入男生（女生）联谊会的人；为健康祝酒；v. 保证，发誓；使保证，使许诺；承诺给予，承诺提供；用……抵押，以……典押；宣誓加入（大学男生联谊会或女生联谊会）；为健康祝酒；【名】 （Pledge）（英）普莱奇（人名）
definition: 1. n. a deposit of personal property as security for a debt；2. v. promise solemnly and formally
example: He asked her to pledge the house as security for a loan.
exampleZh: 他要她抵押房子作为贷款担保。

meaning: n. 富裕，充裕；pron. 大量，众多；adv. 大量，很多；非常，十分；足够有余；det. 很多，大量；【名】 （Plenty）普伦蒂（人名）
definition: 1. n. a full supply；2. adv. as much as necessary
example: Please accept my present, which has been brought to you, for God has favored me, and I have plenty.
exampleZh: 求你收下我带来给你的礼物，因为神恩待我，使我充足。

meaning: adj. 丰富的，众多的
definition: 1. adj. existing in great number or quantity；2. adj. affording an abundant supply
example: She survived because of a plentiful supply of fresh water.
exampleZh: 她靠着充足的淡水供应活了下来。

meaning: n. 困境，窘境；誓约；v. 宣誓，保证
definition: 1. an unpleasant condition, especially a serious, sad, or difficult one；2. to (promise to) marry
example: She was touched by the plight of the refugees.
exampleZh: 难民的困境使她受到触动。

meaning: n. 阴谋，密谋；情节；（专用的）小块地；（表现两个变量关系的）图表；图表，地图；底层平面图；v. 密谋，暗中策划；（在地图上）画出，标出；构思（情节）；绘制（曲线）；绘制（图表）；在图表上标记，布置；用图表说明；计划，制订；【名】 （Plot）（捷、法）普洛特，普洛（人名）
definition: 1. n. a secret scheme to do something (especially something underhand or illegal)；2. v. plan secretly, usually something illegal
example: That's not good enough, and so the repetition in the plot reinforces the repetition of the sound in question.
exampleZh: 由于她总是不能正确地发音,这样一来情节的重复，就加强了声音的重复。

meaning: v. 耕，犁；（用或仿佛用犁）划出（沟或线）；（用犁）挖出；（轮船，木船）穿过（水域），破浪前进；奋力前进；（不顾困难或要求停止的警告而）继续坚持；（用扫雪机）从（道路）清除积雪；（尤指车辆）猛撞；n. 犁；犁过的地，耕地；雪犁，扫雪机；北斗七星（the Plough)；北斗七星（the Plough)；【名】 （Plough）（英）普劳（人名）
definition: 1. n. a group of seven bright stars in the constellation Ursa Major；2. v. move in a way resembling that of a plow cutting into or going through the soil
example: They were no longer using mules and horses to plough their fields.
exampleZh: 他们那时已不再用骡子和马来犁地了。

meaning: n. 插头；插座；（洗涤槽或浴缸的）塞子；堵塞物；棉球，药棉；螺钉楔子；（车辆引擎的）火花塞；推销，宣传；（压实的）块，口嚼烟；（婴儿的）橡皮奶头；岩颈；（供移植的）幼苗，草皮；鱼饵；消防栓；疲惫的马；v. 堵，塞；补足；接电源，插插头；推广，宣传；射击，射杀；艰难地走，埋头于
definition: 1. n. blockage consisting of an object designed to fill a hole tightly；2. v. fill or close tightly with or as if with a plug
example: The discount rate that is shown is the number that you plug into a formula to get the price.
exampleZh: 这里显示的折扣率,需要被代入一个公式来获得价格

meaning: n. 水管工人，水电工
definition: 1. a person whose job is to supply and connect or repair water pipes, baths, toilets, etc.
example: At the age of 74, he is still going strong as the oldest plumber in business in Boise, Idaho.
exampleZh: 尽管他已经74岁高龄，但身体依然很健壮，是爱达荷州博伊西市商界中最老的水管工。

meaning: n. （建筑物的）管路系统，管道设备；管道工程，管子工的工作；体内“管道”，排泄系统
definition: 1. the water pipes and similar systems in a building；2. the work of connecting water and other pipes in a building
example: Most of the houses in the capital don't have indoor plumbing.
exampleZh: 首都大多数房屋没有室内管道装置。

meaning: v. （使）突然向前倒下（跌落）；猛推，猛插；投入（液体中以使淹没）；（价值）猛跌；（剧烈）颠簸，震荡；（马）猛地用后腿直立；陡然向下倾斜；骤然陷入；（鲁莽地）开始；（使）投身，（使）突然开始从事；种下（植物）；n. （突然的）坠落；跳水，快速游泳；（价值或数量的）骤然下跌；突然陷入；adj. （女式服装）领口低的（plunging）
definition: 1. n. a brief swim in water；2. v. thrust or throw into
example: The company is planning a deeper plunge into the commercial market.
exampleZh: 这家公司正计划进一步投入商业市场。

meaning: n. 复数（形式）；adj. 复数的，复数形式的；多样的，多元的；多数的，多种的
definition: 1. n. the form of a word that is used to denote more than one；2. adj. composed of more than one member, set, or kind
example: The plural 's' is not a free form, as it must always be attached to a noun.
exampleZh: 表示复数的s不是自由语素，必须附着于名词。

meaning: prep. 加；外加，而且；（温度）零上；adj. （在数字后）多，余；略高于标准的；零上的，正的；有利的；正电的；n. 加号，正号；（数字的）加法；好处；conj. 而且；加上；【名】 （Plus）（印、巴、法）普卢斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a useful or valuable quality；2. adj. on the positive side or higher end of a scale
example: +4 Because this could be three plus four, 3 times five, or it could be three, plus four times five.
exampleZh: 因为这可能是，然后乘以5，也可能是，加上4乘以5。

meaning: n. 衣袋，口袋；钱财，财力；（附在某物上的）小口袋，小容器；（用作贸易计量的）（农产品）袋；（与周围不同的）小群体，小区域；（台球）网袋，球袋；岩石或地层中充满矿石或其他物质的空洞；v. 把……放入口袋；把……装进腰包，将……据为己有；赚取，获得（钱财）；击（球）入袋；收敛，抑制（感情）；包，围；adj. 袖珍的，袋装的
definition: 1. n. a small pouch inside a garment for carrying small articles；2. v. put in one's pocket
example: When they left, Julius Caesar, out of his own pocket, gave every soldier in those legions a year's pay.
exampleZh: 他们离开时，恺撒用自己的钱，给那些士兵发了一年的俸禄。

meaning: n. 播客；v. 将……做成播客
definition: 1. abstract: A podcast is a type of digital media consisting of an episodic series of audio, video, PDF, or ePub files subscribed to and downloaded through web syndication or streamed online to a computer or mobile device. The word is a neologism derived from "broadcast" and "pod" from the success of the iPod, as audio podcasts are often listened to on portable media players.
example: I mean, television, radio, these days podcast and film, there's just an embarrassment of richness.
exampleZh: 我的意思是，电视、广播，如今还有播客和电影，内容丰富得简直让人应接不暇。

meaning: n. 诗，韵文
definition: 1. n. a composition written in metrical feet forming rhythmical lines
example: That's why the poem, the lyric poem, is privileged among the forms of literary discourse in the New Criticism.
exampleZh: 这就是为什么诗，一首抒情诗，在新批评派眼里要优于其他各种文学形式。

meaning: n. 诗歌；诗一般的美丽，诗的意境；（学校或大学里的）诗歌课
definition: 1. n. literature in metrical form；2. n. any communication resembling poetry in beauty or the evocation of feeling
example: Now in these two books we've seen Milton dig up and discard just about the entire tradition of epic poetry.
exampleZh: 现在在我们看到的两册书中弥尔顿,挖出并丢弃了所有史诗的传统。

meaning: n. 诗人
definition: 1. n. a writer of poems (the term is usually reserved for writers of good poetry)
example: The poet fell in love with her and immortalized her in his verse.
exampleZh: 诗人爱上了她，并以诗歌使她名传后世。

meaning: adj. 诗的，诗歌的；充满诗情画意的，富有想象力的；n. 诗学，诗论
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to poetry；2. adj. characterized by romantic imagery
example: In fact, it exists, amazingly, in order to hinder understanding in the kinds of texts that we're inclined to call "poetic."
exampleZh: 事实上，它的存在，阻碍我们理解所有带有,诗性的文本“

meaning: n. 观点，论点；要点，核心问题；目的，意图；具体细节；特点，特征；地点；时刻，阶段；得分；小数点，点；罗盘（方位）点；点（标度）；（电影的）利润百分比；尖端，尖头；岬角；光点，色点；插座；（字号的）磅值；轨尖，道岔（points）；（芭蕾）脚尖（points）；（分电器中的）接点；称赞，认可（points）；（板球）防守；尖兵队；排头位置；（动物的）外部位；（猎）直窜（位置）；束衣带；束帆绳；狗指方向；（乐曲的）重要乐句或主题；v. 指，指向；对准，瞄准；朝向，对着；指路；引导，指引；暗示，表明；强调（话语或行动）；（用水泥）勾缝；绷直（脚趾）；削尖；使（光标）指着；插入点号；（狗）示意有（猎物）；【名】 （Point）（法）普安（人名）
definition: 1. n. a geometric element that has position but no extension；2. v. indicate a place, direction, person, or thing; either spatially or figuratively
example: That means that p1 and -- where I am, the point number 1 and point number 2 were completely arbitrary.
exampleZh: 因为1和，两个点是2,陆军上面。

meaning: adj. 毫无意义的，毫无目标的；浪费时间
definition: 1. adj. not having a point especially a sharp point；2. adj. serving no useful purpose; having no excuse for being
example: He's thought about the universe, thinks life is pointless and he acts depressed.
exampleZh: 对于宇宙万物都有着自己的思考,他认为人生毫无意义,所以行事消极

meaning: n. 沉着，镇定；（优雅的）体态，姿态；平衡；（物理）泊；v. （使）平衡，（使）悬浮；准备做……（be poised）；【名】 （Poise）（法）普瓦斯（人名）
definition: 1. calm confidence in a person's way of behaving, or a quality of grace (= moving in an attractive way) and balance in the way a person holds or moves their body；2. behavior or a way of moving that shows calm confidence
example: What amazed him even more than her appearance was her poise.
exampleZh: 比她的长相更让他惊讶的是她的沉着镇定。

meaning: adj. 镇定的，自信的；摆好姿势的；做好准备的；（暂时）平衡，处于中间；姿态优雅的
definition: 1. If an object or a part of your body is poised, it is completely still but ready to move at any moment；2. ready to do a particular thing at any moment
example: She remained poised under intense questioning and answered every challenge with carefully chosen evidence.
exampleZh: 面对尖锐质询，她始终保持镇定，并用精心挑选的证据回应每一项质疑。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 毒药；有害的思想；恶毒的言辞（或行动）；（化）抑制剂；（物理）中子吸收剂；v. 毒杀；在……下毒；毒化，败坏；污染（环境）；抑制；adj. 有毒的；【名】 （Poison）（美、爱、英）波伊松（人名）
definition: 1. n. any substance that causes injury or illness or death of a living organism；2. v. spoil as if by poison
example: Yeah, if they have a race riot round here, I'm gonna kill all the white folks with my poison."
exampleZh: 当然，假如他们有那样的种族暴动，我会用毒药除掉他们，“

meaning: adj. 有毒的；会产生毒素的；恶毒的，令人很不愉快的；有许多危害的，恶性的
definition: 1. adj. having the qualities or effects of a poison；2. adj. not safe to eat
example: So, yes, they're very poisonous, and in fact, there are areas where you find this toxic compound, cyanide.
exampleZh: 因此，没错，它们毒性非常强，而实际上，你会发现很多地方都有这种有毒成分，氰化物。

meaning: v. （用手指或尖利物品）戳，刺；从……露出（或伸出、探出）；把……戳进，把……插入；戳（洞）；拨（火）；与（某人）性交；吸引（另一用户）的注意；n. 捅，戳；轻微的批评，奚落；张望，寻觅；（汽车的）马力，推进力；（尤指19世纪初的）宽前檐女帽（poke bonnet）；袋，小包；钱包；美国商陆；美国白藜芦（Indian poke）；性交
definition: 1. to push a finger or other pointed object quickly into someone or something；2. to (cause something to) appear or stretch out from behind or through something else
example: He gave me a poke in the ribs to wake me up.
exampleZh: 他捅了一下我的肋部把我叫醒。

meaning: n. 杆，柱；地极；截然相反的两极之一；磁极；滑雪杖（ski pole 的简称）；简易鱼竿；直干幼树；电极；车辕；（几何）（球体的）轴极；（几何）（极坐标的）极点；（细胞、器官、身体部分的）极；杆（尤指用来测量土地长度的单位）；v. 用篙撑（船）；n. （Pole）波兰人；【名】 （Pole）波列（人名）
definition: 1. n. a long (usually round) rod of wood or metal or plastic；2. v. propel with a pole
example: When Scott reached the South Pole he found that Amundsen had anticipated him.
exampleZh: 斯科特到达南极时发现阿蒙森已先到过那里。

meaning: adj. 极地的，来自极地的；截然不同的；磁极的；（天体）极性的，极地的；（细胞，器官，身体部分）极的；（液体，尤指溶剂）由偶极矩分子组成的；（固体）离子的；（几何）（球体）轴极的；n. （几何）极线；极光双子星；【名】 （Polar）（德、西）波拉尔（人名）
definition: 1. adj. having a pair of equal and opposite charges；2. adj. characterized by opposite extremes; completely opposed
example: There was a period of excessive warmth which melted some of the polar ice.
exampleZh: 有段时期温度过高，融化了极地的部分冰层。

meaning: n. 警察部门；警察；v. 巡查，维护治安；监督，管制；执行（法律，协议，条约）
definition: 1. n. the force of policemen and officers；2. v. maintain the security of by carrying out a control
example: On 231, just to add to this catalog--we have murdered, abandoned, neglected children--we also have police brutality.
exampleZh: 在231页，就是为了加些内容到这个目录中，我们看到了谋杀，抛弃，忽视儿童，我们还读到了警察的残忍，让我看一下231页。

meaning: n. 警察，警员；（分化）淀帚（橡皮头玻璃搅棒）
definition: 1. n. a member of a police force
example: And his father was denounced by a policeman, by a policeman.
exampleZh: 他的父亲就是被一个警察告发的,一个警察

meaning: n. 政策，方针；(处事) 原则，策略；保险单
definition: 1. n. a line of argument rationalizing the course of action of a government；2. n. a plan of action adopted by an individual or social group
example: And all these political considerations or policy considerations, in some ways, are coming together in President Obama's council.
exampleZh: 所有这些政治方面考虑,或政策考虑，在某种程度上，都交给了总统奥巴马的委员会解决。

meaning: v. 擦亮，磨光；改进，使完美，给……润色；涂指甲油；n. 上光剂，亮光剂；抛光，擦亮；擦光的面，打磨光亮的面；（表演或作品的）完美，优美；文雅，礼貌；n. （Polish）波兰人；波兰语；adj. （Polish）波兰的
definition: 1. n. the property of being smooth and shiny；2. v. make (a surface) shine
example: Now, the Boyars, in the 1660s and the 1670s, some of them began to learn Latin and Polish.
exampleZh: 在15世纪60和70年代,那些波维尔们,波维尔中的一些人开始学拉丁语和波兰语

meaning: adj. 有礼貌的，客气的；礼节性的，客套的；上流的，有教养的
definition: 1. adj. showing regard for others in manners, speech, behavior, etc.；2. adj. marked by refinement in taste and manners
example: You will say it in a polite way. In a way that doesn't put people off or upset them.
exampleZh: 这样你会以一种更礼貌的方式来提起一个话题。这样的说法不会引起人们的不快或气愤。

meaning: n. 有礼貌；有礼貌的行为；优雅
definition: 1. n. a courteous manner that respects accepted social usage；2. n. the act of showing regard for others
example: Many Eastern Asians prefer to hold their emotions in check and instead express themselves with great politeness.
exampleZh: 许多东亚人更喜欢控制自己的情绪，以非常礼貌的方式表达自己。

meaning: n. 政治，政治活动（事务）；政治事业；政治学；(某团体、组织等内的）争权活动，权术；政治信仰，政治观点；（尤指跟社会权力和地位有关的领域、理论或活动的）主张，观（念）；政治思想体系，政治局势
definition: 1. n. social relations involving authority or power；2. n. the study of government of states and other political units
example: But, I give a lot of credit to the European politics of the late 17th and 18th century.
exampleZh: 但是，我觉得很大程度上得益于欧洲政治,在17世纪末和18世纪，起的作用。

meaning: adj. 政治（上）的，政府的；政党的，党派的；对政治感兴趣的，参与政治的；反政府的；（组织内部人际间）牵涉权力关系的，争权夺利的
definition: 1. adj. involving or characteristic of politics or parties or politicians；2. adj. of or relating to your views about social relationships involving authority or power
example: What may be most important here is the mere fact that Milton is expressing these political convictions at all.
exampleZh: 这里最重要的不过是,弥尔顿只是在表达他的政治信念。

meaning: n. 从政者，政治家；政客，善于玩弄权术者
definition: 1. n. a leader engaged in civil administration；2. n. a person active in party politics
example: The person who best captures the unconstrained view, Benjamin Constant, French philosopher and politician, " "It is for self-perfectioning that destiny calls us."
exampleZh: 最好地阐述了本性受约束观点的人，法国哲学家政治家Benjamin，Constant说，“命运召唤我们进行自我完善“

meaning: n. 民意调查，民意测验；选举投票，计票；投票数；投票点（the polls）；头顶，头皮；无角动物（尤指无角牛）；v. 对……进行民意测验（调查）；获得（票数）；（电信，计算机）轮询，探询；截掉（动物，尤指小牛）的角；修枝；【名】 【名】（Poll）（德、匈、罗、英）波尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. an inquiry into public opinion conducted by interviewing a random sample of people；2. v. get the opinions (of people) by asking specific questions
example: All right, now, let's take the other part of the poll, which is the highest experience or pleasure.
exampleZh: 好，现在我们再投个票，哪个是最高级的体验或者快乐。

meaning: n. 民意调查人，民意测验机构；【名】 （Pollster）（英）波尔斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. someone who conducts surveys of public opinion
example: Mono Research, a pollster, estimates support for Mr Lee and the GNP at just 33%.
exampleZh: MONO研究，某民调机构估计李先生与GNP的支持率只有33%。

meaning: v. 污染，弄脏；玷污，败坏
definition: 1. v. make impure
example: Mining would pollute the lake and denude the forest.
exampleZh: 采矿将会污染湖水并伐光森林。

meaning: n. 污染；污染物；噪音污染，（夜间扰人的）强烈灯光
definition: 1. n. undesirable state of the natural environment being contaminated with harmful substances as a consequence of human activities；2. n. the state of being polluted
example: Other cultures focused more on an ethics of divinity where notions such as purity, sanctity, pollution and sin are relevant.
exampleZh: 还有的文化则重于神性道德,他们的道德则与纯结，神圣，亵渎，罪孽等有关。

meaning: n. 污染物
definition: 1. n. waste matter that contaminates the water or air or soil
example: Sulphur dioxide is a pollutant and a major contributor to acid rain.
exampleZh: 二氧化硫是一种污染物，并且是形成酸雨的主要因素。

meaning: n. （在英国1992年后改为大学的）工艺专科学院，理工专科学院；（旧时美国的）理工学校（或学院、大学）；adj. 工艺（或技术）教学的
definition: 1. (especially in Britain before 1992) a college where students study for degrees, especially in technical subjects, or train for particular types of work
example: I'll be getting the equivalent of about £22,000 a year there, but only £20,000 at the Polytechnic.
exampleZh: 我在那里的年薪大约是2.2万英镑，但在理工学院只有2万英镑。

meaning: n. （人工或自然的）池塘；大西洋（the pond）；v. 拦截（或筑坝堵塞）（流水或其他流动液体）以形成小湖；（流水或其他液体）形成小湖；【名】 （Pond）（美、爱）庞德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a small lake
example: Because the pond is deep enough for an adult to wade into but too deep for a child to stand.
exampleZh: 这个池塘不深，一个成年人足以趟过,然而小孩子却无法站立。

meaning: v. 仔细考虑，琢磨，沉思；【名】 （Ponder）（英）庞德（人名）
definition: 1. to think carefully about something, especially for a noticeable length of time；2. to consider something carefully for a long time
example: I think I should take time every day to think about and ponder about the blessings in my life.
exampleZh: 我想我每天都该花点时间，去思索和回味我生命中的种种福气。

meaning: n. 游泳池；池塘，水坑；一小片（液体或光）；（河的）深水处，深潭；后备人员，备用物品；共用的资源（或资金）；（有相同职业或共同从事某项活动的）人群；赌球（或其他体育比赛），赌注；足球普尔（the pools)；落袋台球；垄断性联营；预赛组；v. 集中（资源、钱财等）以备共用；积水成洼；（血液）在静脉中淤积；【名】 （Pool）（英、西）普尔，（芬、德）波尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. an excavation that is (usually) filled with water；2. v. combine into a common fund
example: So you can see right away the students knew that they will be selected as a very honor to the pool.
exampleZh: 所以，学生们很快,就会知道他们将成为,该组织的荣耀。

meaning: adj. 贫穷的；可怜的，不幸的；（身体）虚弱的，衰弱的；不擅长的，不熟练的；劣质的，差的，次的；贫乏的；（数量、比率等）不理想的，不合理的；【名】 （Poor）（美）普尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. people without possessions or wealth (considered as a group)；2. adj. deserving or inciting pity
example: It used to be a different type of neighborhood at one point, it was very poor.
exampleZh: 在过去的某个时候，这里曾是一个完全不同的社区，感觉很穷。

meaning: n. 贫穷，贫困；贫乏，低劣；个人财产权的放弃（作为宗教誓约的一部分）
definition: 1. n. the state of having little or no money and few or no material possessions
example: so you pay and they'll donate money to poverty or Habitat for Humanity or some organizations like that.
exampleZh: 你交钱而他们会把钱捐给穷人或者仁人家园或者其他类似的慈善机构。

meaning: adj. 流行音乐的；通俗的，大众的；n. 流行音乐；砰的响声； 汽水； 爸爸；鲜艳的一小块；（一系列事情中的）一次，一项；（棒球）小腾空球；打，敲击； 通俗古典乐，流行古典乐（pops）； 尝试，努力； 批评；老人家（用作称呼）（pops）；枪击；v. （使）砰地爆开，砰地脱落；迅速去，短暂逗留；突然出现，短暂出现； 突然放置，迅速放入；（使）发出砰的响声，（使）啪的一声爆裂；（因飞机起飞、降落或上下陡坡等）耳压变化，耳胀；（因惊讶或兴奋而）瞪大眼睛； 过于频繁地服用（药片）；打（某人）；爆（玉米花）；击出小腾空球；射击，开枪；打开瓶子喝（啤酒）； 典当，抵押；adv. 砰的响声（go pop）；abbr. 邮局协议 （post office protocol）；人口 （population）；【名】 （Pop）（罗）波普（人名）
definition: 1. n. an informal term for a father; probably derived from baby talk；2. v. bulge outward
example: So what we will be doing is differentiating pop from classical and also differentiating within styles of classical music.
exampleZh: 那么接下来我们要做的是,区分流行音乐和古典音乐的差异,以及各种古典音乐风格之间的不同

meaning: adj. 受大众喜爱的，受欢迎的；（想法、情绪或态度）普遍的；通俗的，大众化的；民众的，百姓的
definition: 1. adj. regarded with great favor, approval, or affection especially by the general public；2. adj. carried on by or for the people (or citizens) at large
example: So a very popular thing to do on Boxing Day is go shopping and take advantage of the sales.
exampleZh: 所以在节礼日人们通常会趁着促销之际出去购物，这很流行。

meaning: n. 流行，普及，受欢迎
definition: 1. n. the quality of being widely admired or accepted or sought after
example: But for all that, despite the popularity of that view, I'm inclined to think it must be wrong.
exampleZh: 虽然观点受到追捧，我倾向认为它一定是错的。

meaning: n. （地区、国家等的）人口，人口数量；（某领域的）生物，族群，人口；（统计）总体，母体；（天文）星族；（物理）布居数
definition: 1. n. the people who inhabit a territory or state；2. n. a group of organisms of the same species populating a given area
example: From the point of view of the school age of youngsters' population, there are really, I think, two implicit purposes.
exampleZh: 从青少年的,学龄角度考虑，我想存在两个深层目标。

meaning: adj. 人口稠密的
definition: 1. adj. densely populated
example: Nigeria is the most populous African country and an economic powerhouse for the continent.
exampleZh: 尼日利亚是非洲人口最稠密的国家，也是非洲大陆的经济强国。

meaning: v. （大批人或动物）居住于，生活于；充满，出现于（某地方，领域）；迁移，殖民于；（给文件）增添数据，输入数据
definition: 1. v. furnish with people；2. v. fill with people or supply with inhabitants
example: We will examine how we can populate data from files directly into DB2 large object data (LOB) columns.
exampleZh: 我们将考察我们如何能将数据直接从文件里输入到 DB2 的大对象数据列中。

meaning: n. 瓷；瓷器；adj. 瓷制的
definition: 1. a hard but delicate, shiny, white substance made by heating a special type of clay to a high temperature, used to make cups, plates, decorations, etc.；2. cups, plates, and decorations, etc. made of porcelain
example: To this class of substance belong mica, porcelain, quartz, glass, wood, etc.
exampleZh: 属于这类物质的有云母、瓷器、石英、玻璃、木材等等。

meaning: n. 门廊；走廊，游廊
definition: 1. a covered structure in front of the entrance to a building；2. a raised, covered, sometimes partly closed area, often made of wood, on the front or side of a building
example: She huddled inside the porch as she rang the bell.
exampleZh: 她一边按门铃一边蜷缩进门廊里。

meaning: n. 猪肉；政府恩惠；v. 暴食（pork out）；（男人）跟……性交；【名】 （Pork）（俄）波尔克（人名）
definition: 1. n. meat from a domestic hog or pig；2. n. a legislative appropriation designed to ingratiate legislators with their constituents
example: Legs of pork were cured and smoked over the fire.
exampleZh: 猪腿在火上经过了烟熏处理。

meaning: n. 燕麦粥，麦片粥；关押期，监禁期
definition: 1. a thick, soft food made from oats boiled in milk or water, eaten hot for breakfast；2. a period of time spent in prison
example: She prepared a bowl of porridge with fresh fruit before leaving for the morning lecture.
exampleZh: 她在去听上午的课之前，准备了一碗加了新鲜水果的燕麦粥。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 港口，避风港；口岸，港口城市；（计算机）端口，接口；波尔图葡萄酒（产自葡萄牙）（=port wine）；（船、飞机等的）舷门，舷窗；射击孔，枪眼（=gun port）；通道，排气口；城门，城门洞；（计算机）移植（软件）；姿势，姿态；（军）斜持枪位置；旅行箱，旅行包；v. 转移，移植（软件）；使（船，舵）向左转；（军）斜持枪；【名】 （Port）（英）波特，（法）波尔，（德、俄、匈、捷）波尔特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a place (seaport or airport) where people and merchandise can enter or leave a country；2. v. transfer data from one computer to another via a cable that links connecting ports
example: Cities like Gdansk, which we tend to forget about, unfortunately, which is a very important port then and still now.
exampleZh: 像格达斯克这样的城市,也就渐渐淡出了人们的视野,而其实,它在当时和现在都仍是,非常重要的港口

meaning: adj. 便携式的，轻便的；可移植的，可在不同计算机上使用的；（变更工作或情景时）可转移的，可随带的；n. 手提式电器；活动教室
definition: 1. n. a small light typewriter; usually with a case in which it can be carried；2. adj. easily or conveniently transported
example: The latest disks, used for small portable computers, spin 3,600 times a minute.
exampleZh: 用于小型手提电脑的最新磁盘每分钟转动3600次。

meaning: n. （火车站、机场等的）行李搬运工人，脚夫；（市场的）搬运工；（酒店、医院等的）门房，守门人；（火车卧铺车厢的）乘务员；（医院的）护工，勤杂工；（大楼的）杂物工；（登山探险中的）补给搬运员；黑啤酒；【名】 （Porter）（英、西、葡、德）波特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person employed to carry luggage and supplies；2. v. carry luggage or supplies
example: Our taxi pulled up at Old Delhi station and a porter sprinted to the door.
exampleZh: 我们的出租车停在老德里车站，一个搬运工疾步跑向车门。

meaning: n. 公文包，画夹；（成册展示的）作品集，照片集；（个人或机构的）投资组合；（部长或大臣的）职责，职务；（公司或机构提供的）系列产品，成套物品；adj. （职业类型）短期合同制的，兼职的
definition: 1. a large, thin case used for carrying drawings, documents, etc.；2. a collection of drawings, documents, etc. that represent a person's, especially an artist's, work
example: The entire portfolio is worth $160,312. Of this amount, my investment is worth only $7,748.
exampleZh: 整个投资组合价值为$160312。在这当中，我的投资额仅为$7748。

meaning: n. （某物的）一部分；（尤指餐馆中食物的）一份，一客；（责任、过失、职责等的）一份，一部分；（根据法律赠与或遗留给继承人的）一份财产； 命运，天数；v. 分配； 给（新娘）嫁妆
definition: 1. n. something determined in relation to something that includes it；2. v. give out or allot
example: And this one will be particularly germane to a portion of Problem Set 1, at least in Problem Set 1.
exampleZh: 这个程序跟习题集1中的,一部分比较相似，至少在习题1中。

meaning: v. 描绘，描写；（在艺术或文学作品中）描述，刻画；（在电影、戏剧等中）扮演
definition: 1. to represent or describe someone or something in a painting, film, book, or other artistic work；2. If a person in a film, book, etc. is portrayed as a particular type of character, they are represented in that way
example: He has worked hard in recent months to portray New York in a better light.
exampleZh: 最近几个月他一直努力工作要从一个更好的角度描绘纽约。

meaning: n. （角色的）扮演；（画、书等中的）描绘，描写；绘画，照片
definition: 1. the way that someone or something is described or represented in a painting, film, book, or other artistic work
example: We are sitting here, looking at a great visual portrayal of the Myth of the Birth of Venus.
exampleZh: 我们坐在这里，欣赏一幅精彩的《维纳斯的诞生》神话主题的视觉艺术作品。

meaning: n. （尤指只刻画脸、头和肩部的）肖像，照片，雕像；描绘，描述；（文件的）纵向打印格式；adj. （纸张、页面、照片等）竖式的，纵向的；【名】 (Portrait）（法）波特雷（人名）
definition: 1. a painting, photograph, drawing, etc. of a person or, less commonly, of a group of people；2. A film or book that is a portrait of something describes or represents that thing in a detailed way
example: She told Whistler that his portrait of her was finished and to stop fiddling with it.
exampleZh: 她告诉惠斯勒他为她画的肖像已经完成了，不要再改来改去了。

meaning: v. 造成，引起（威胁、危险、问题等）；提出（问题）；（为照相、画像等）摆好姿势；假扮，冒充（pose as）；（举止或穿戴）装腔作势，招摇过市；把……难住，使为难；n. （为拍照、画像等摆的）姿势；故作姿态，装腔作势
definition: 1. n. affected manners intended to impress others；2. v. introduce
example: I'll then pose some of the questions and the challenges we are facing in the area of access in sustainability.
exampleZh: 随后我将提出,在获取稳定这方面,我们所面临的问题和挑战。

meaning: n. （坐或立的）姿势；态度，立场；（鸟或其他动物的）体态；情形；v. 故作（姿态），装腔作势；使处于……态度（或姿态）
definition: 1. n. the arrangement of the body and its limbs；2. v. behave affectedly or unnaturally in order to impress others
example: I think even if you're in a chair, and you're sitting up straight with good posture, maybe hands on knees.
exampleZh: 哪怕只是坐在椅子上，坐直并保持良好姿势，也许双手放在两膝上。

meaning: n. 位置，方位；姿势，安置方式；处境，状况；观点，立场；地位，身份；职务，职位；名次；（队员的）职责，角色；恰当位置；阵地；持有状态；（逻辑）命题，主张；v. 安置，使处于；为（产品）定位
definition: 1. n. the particular portion of space occupied by something；2. v. cause to be in an appropriate place, state, or relation
example: The two passages that I'm about to read juxtapose the viewpoints that I've been trying to evoke in describing Gadamer's position.
exampleZh: 我要读的这两篇文章在某些观点上是并行的,我在讲伽达默尔的看法时想激发的就是这些观点。

meaning: adj. 乐观的，有信心的；积极的，建设性的；良好的，有助益的；赞成的，支持的；确信的，肯定的；完全的，绝对的；证据确凿的，明确的；阳性的；正数的，大于零的；正电的，正极的；（摄影）正片的，正像的；（语法）（形容词，副词）原级的；（主哲）实证的，实在的；（占星）（风宫，火宫）积极的；n. 优势，优点；阳性结果；正片；正极，阳极；正数；（语法）原级形容词，原级副词
definition: 1. n. a film showing a photographic image whose tones correspond to those of the original subject；2. adj. characterized by or displaying affirmation or acceptance or certainty etc.
example: z So what we end up seeing is 34 that the z effective is equal to positive 1 . 3 4.
exampleZh: 看到有效的,等于+1。

meaning: v. 拥有，持有；具有（品质或能力）；（尤指邪恶的鬼魅或精灵）缠住，迷住；受（感情）支配，受（感情）影响；了解，懂得;
definition: 1. v. have as an attribute, knowledge, or skill；2. v. have ownership or possession of
example: Under state law, it is a misdemeanour to possess a firearm on school premises.
exampleZh: 根据该州法律，在校园里拥有枪械是一种轻罪。

meaning: n. 拥有，持有；个人财产，所有物；持有违禁物，私藏毒品（或武器）；（对球的）控制，球权；进攻；领地，殖民地；鬼魂附体，着魔；（观点或情感的）支配，控制
definition: 1. n. the act of having and controlling property；2. n. anything owned or possessed
example: Is Milton powerful for the very straightforward reason that he's in possession of this tremendous literary strength, this unimaginable talent?
exampleZh: 弥尔顿之所以强大是因为他有,无穷的文学力量，不可想象的天赋这显而易见的原因呢？

meaning: adj. 占有欲强的，有控制欲的；不愿与人分享的，自私的；（语法中的）所有格的；n. 所有格形容词（或代词等），属有词；（词的）所有格（the possessive）
definition: 1. n. the case expressing ownership；2. adj. serving to express or indicate possession
example: In a sentence, a possessive adjective is always used before a noun.
exampleZh: 在一个句子里，所有格形容词总在名词之前被使用。

meaning: adj. 可能的，可能做到的；可能发生的，可能存在的；合乎事实的，合理的；尽可能……的；（用于形容词后表示强调）最好的（或最差的等）；可能的（但可能性很小）；（数字或分数）最高的；如果可能的话；n. 可能适合的人（事物）；可能性，能完成的事（the possible）；（尤指射击比赛的）最高分
definition: 1. n. something that can be done；2. adj. capable of happening or existing
example: So that's a big help. And equilibrium happens when there isn't any possible change of state that would satisfy this.
exampleZh: 这个非常方便，当所有的变化,都无法满足这个公式的时候,系统就达到了平衡。

meaning: n. 可能，可能性；可能的选项，可能的途径；发展前景，潜能；可能发生的事；机会，契机
definition: 1. n. a future prospect or potential；2. n. capability of existing or happening or being true
example: But we did by putting it on CD, giving students the possibility to watch it any place any time.
exampleZh: 但将其刻成光盘后,学生就能随时随地观看。

meaning: adv. 可能，或许；（用于强调惊讶或震惊）怎么，究竟；怎么可能，绝不可能（用于否定句，表强调）；能不能，能否（用于礼貌地请求）；尽量，尽可能
definition: 1. adv. by chance；2. adv. with a possibility of becoming actual
example: Now the subject matter that he's chosen for this poem, for this so-called first poem, couldn't possibly be more appropriate.
exampleZh: 现在他选这首诗的主题很重要，这所谓第一首诗可能不太恰当。

meaning: n. 邮政，邮递；邮件，包裹；收集（或投递）邮件，邮班；职位，要职；岗位，哨所；柱，杆，桩；（赛马的）终点；球门柱；邮报（用于某些报纸名称中）；帖子，在线留言板上的信息；篮球场上篮筐附近的区域；策应位置；退伍军人协会地方分会；v. 邮寄；把……放入（或塞入）；派驻，委派；使驻守，设置（岗哨等）；张贴，公布；发布，发帖子；交付（保释金）；（运动员，参赛队）取得（成绩），创造（纪录）；（记账用语）将……入账；prep. 在……之后；【名】 （Post）（英、西、捷、瑞典、荷）波斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the position where someone (as a guard or sentry) stands or is assigned to stand；2. v. affix in a public place or for public notice
example: So the nature of the world, post-cold war world is increasingly one about competition for markets, govern of one nation's markets.
exampleZh: 因此冷战之后，市场的竞争,成为世界的主题，一国市场的管理，如果事实如此。

meaning: n. 邮资，邮费；一定面额的邮票；邮寄，邮递
definition: 1. n. the charge for mailing something；2. n. a token that postal fees have been paid
example: I've seen students photocopy exams down to the size of a postage stamp.
exampleZh: 我曾看到过学生将考试内容复印到,一张邮票大小的纸上。

meaning: n. 邮递员，邮差
definition: 1. n. a man who delivers the mail
example: The educator, Neil Postman once said, " "The kids enter schools as question marks and they leave as periods."
exampleZh: 教育家Neil，Postman曾经说过，“孩子进校时像问号而毕业时像句号“

meaning: n. 明信片
definition: 1. n. a card for sending messages by post without an envelope
example: In the sentence, 'I sent her a postcard', the word 'her' is in the dative.
exampleZh: 在I sent her a postcard一句中，her一词处于与格。

meaning: n. 海报，招贴画；大幅装饰画；发帖人，跟帖人；v. 张贴海报；【名】 （Poster）（英）波斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a sign posted in a public place as an advertisement；2. n. someone who pastes up bills or placards on walls or billboards
example: Using a Magic Marker, he wrote seven digits on the poster-size banner.
exampleZh: 他用白板笔在海报大小的横幅上写了七个数字。

meaning: v. 推迟，延缓；把……放在次要地位；把……放在后面
definition: 1. v. hold back to a later time
example: It is totally out of the question to postpone the midnight deadline.
exampleZh: 延迟午夜的最后期限是根本不可能的。

meaning: n. 推迟，延缓
definition: 1. n. time during which some action is awaited；2. n. act of putting off to a future time
example: The postponement was due to a dispute over where the talks should be held.
exampleZh: 延期是因为在会议地点上有争议。

meaning: n. 锅；（盛食品的）罐，瓶；壶；花盆；陶盆，陶罐，碗；一罐，一壶（的量）；（纸牌游戏的）全部赌注；凑集的资金；大麻；大量；大肚子；（球等的）击球入袋；幼儿用便盆；发动机气缸；（体育运动的）奖品，奖杯；射击；（主要用于橄榄球）射门；v. 把（植物）栽入盆中；将（食物）用密封罐煮（或储存）；射杀（动物）；击（球）入袋；制陶；成功获得，赢得；把（电子元件，电路）密封于绝缘材料中；使（小孩）坐便盆；得（分）；【名】 （Pot）（柬）布特，（捷）波特，（法）波（人名）
definition: 1. n. metal or earthenware cooking vessel that is usually round and deep; often has a handle and lid；2. v. plant in a pot
example: He was stirring a pot of soup.
exampleZh: 他当时在搅一锅汤。

meaning: n. 马铃薯，土豆，洋芋；马铃薯植株；（尤指脚后跟部的）袜子破洞
definition: 1. n. an edible tuber native to South America; a staple food of Ireland；2. n. annual native to South America having underground stolons bearing edible starchy tubers; widely cultivated as a garden vegetable; vines are poisonous
example: When you come home tonight, you see your friend once again sitting on the couch eating potato chips.
exampleZh: 今晚你回家的时候，你又见到她像往常一样吃着薯片，陷在沙发里。

meaning: adj. 强大的，有力的；（毒品、药品或化学品）药效强的，强效的；（男子）有性功能的；由T字形构成的，（尤指十字架）有T形端的；（纹章装饰）有交错T形拼花毛皮的；有说服力的；n. 有交错T形拼花的毛皮
definition: 1. very powerful, forceful, or effective；2. powerful, persuasive, or effective
example: Man is potent and important, yet he is fallible and mortal, capable of the greatest achievements and the worst crimes.
exampleZh: 人是强大而重要的,但人也是会犯错并不免一死的,人既能取得辉煌成就也能犯下滔天大罪

meaning: adj. 潜在的，可能的；n. （事物的）潜力，可能性；（人的）潜能，潜力；电势，电位，电压
definition: 1. n. the inherent capacity for coming into being；2. adj. existing in possibility
example: Everyone, according to the logic ofAreopagitica everyone has the potential to assume the inner authority of conscience and self-discipline.
exampleZh: 按照《论出版自由》的逻辑，每个人都有,用内在良心的统治和自律的潜力。

meaning: n. 潜力，潜能；潜在性，可能性
definition: 1. n. the inherent capacity for coming into being；2. n. an aptitude that may be developed
example: All of these are useful breeds whose potentiality has not been realized.
exampleZh: 所有这些都是有益的品种，其潜力尚未被认识到。

meaning: n. 陶器；陶土，黏土；制陶，陶艺；陶瓷厂；陶瓷之都（斯塔福德郡特伦特河畔斯托克市周边地区，为英国陶瓷工业基地）（the Potteries）
definition: 1. the activity or skill of making clay objects by hand；2. objects that are made out of clay by hand
example: You find Mycenaean elements, tools, other things, pottery particularly of a certain kind, all over the Mediterranean Sea.
exampleZh: 你可以在一些发掘的工具及其他物品,特别是某种陶器上,发现迈锡尼文明的影子遍布地中海区域

meaning: n. 家禽；家禽肉
definition: 1. birds, such as chickens, that are bred for their eggs and meat；2. the meat from birds such as chickens
example: Contaminants found in poultry will also be found in their eggs.
exampleZh: 在家禽里发现的污染物，也将会在它们下的蛋里发现。

meaning: n. 磅（重量单位）；英镑（英国货币单位）；一英镑纸币（或硬币），一镑纸币（或硬币）；英镑与外币的比值（the pound）；（流浪猫狗的）收留所，待领场；（违规停放车辆的）临时扣押场；镑（英国以外某些国家的货币单位）；井号键； 拘留所，监禁所；重击，重击声；v. 连续重击，猛打；（心脏）剧烈地跳动；（头）剧痛；脚步声沉重地走（跑）；连续轰炸，猛烈袭击；捣碎，击碎；长时间苦干； 快速地喝； 彻底打败（对手）；大声播放；监禁，拘留
definition: 1. n. 16 ounces；2. v. hit hard with the hand, fist, or some heavy instrument
example: In English it begins with the late novels of Henry James around 1900, in poetry with Eliot and with Ezra Pound.
exampleZh: 在英国现代主义萌芽于1900年左右，体现在亨利·詹姆斯,的后期小说，艾略特和艾兹拉·庞德的诗歌上。

meaning: v. 倾倒，倒出；（给……）斟，倒（饮料等）；倾泻，涌流；（人，物）接踵而至，纷至沓来；（雨）倾盆而下；大量注入（资金），捐献（pour sth. into）；倾诉，倾吐（pour sth. out）；穿上（紧身衣）（pour oneself into）；n. 灌，注；倾泻；倾盆大雨；【名】 （Pour）（美、捷）保尔（人名）
definition: 1. v. cause to run；2. v. move in large numbers
example: And he had to attach something to dogs so that their saliva would pour out so he could study saliva.
exampleZh: 他给狗套上了一些装置,来收集狗的唾液用以研究。

meaning: n. 粉，粉末；扑面粉，美容粉；细雪，粉状雪；火药，炸药；v. 往（脸或身体）上搽粉；撒粉（状物）于（表面），以粉（状物）覆盖；使（某物）成粉状；变成粉末
definition: 1. n. a solid substance in the form of tiny loose particles; a solid that has been pulverized；2. v. apply powder to
example: What he would do is he'd put food powder in the dog's mouth to generate saliva.
exampleZh: 他的做法是,给狗喂食，让狗分泌唾液。

meaning: n. 控制力，操控力；政权，统治；权力，职权；强国，大国；有影响力的人（或组织）；能力，本领；支配力，实力；（某事物或社会集团的）影响力，势力；力量，体能；能量，电力；动力，功率；幂，乘方，指数；放大率；神灵，神力；（基督教）掌权天使（powers）；（旨在提升某群体地位的）权力运动；v. 驱动，推动（机器或车辆）；（使）迅猛移动，快速前进；猛力踢（或推、顶）（尤指球）；adj. 电力的，电动的；强大的；有重要人士参与的；（服装）礼服的，显示权势的
definition: 1. n. possession of controlling influence；2. v. supply the force or power for the functioning of
example: He's a literary power, a figure who could be called upon to supply the voice of tradition in itself.
exampleZh: 他是一种文化力量，一个,可以随时用来声援传统文化的人物。

meaning: adj. （人，组织，国家）强大的，有影响力的；大功率的，高效能的；（文章、演讲或艺术品）极具感染力的，有震撼力的；（感情）强烈的，（效果）巨大的；强壮的，强健的；猛烈的，有力的；（毒品或化学品）强效的；刺耳的，刺眼的，刺鼻的；adv. 非常，很
definition: 1. adj. having great power or force or potency or effect；2. adv. (Southern regional intensive) very
example: Is Milton powerful for the very straightforward reason that he's in possession of this tremendous literary strength, this unimaginable talent?
exampleZh: 弥尔顿之所以强大是因为他有,无穷的文学力量，不可想象的天赋这显而易见的原因呢？

meaning: v. 练习，实践；（尤指）形成……的习惯（或风俗、传统）；作（恶），施（虐）；从事（尤指医疗和法律）工作；阴谋策划（同 practice）
definition: 1. v. engage in a rehearsal (of)；2. v. carry out or practice; as of jobs and professions
example: He usually wants to practise his English on me.
exampleZh: 他通常想跟我练习英语。

meaning: adj. 可行的，行得通的； 适用的，有用的
definition: 1. adj. usable for a specific purpose；2. adj. capable of being done with means at hand and circumstances as they are
example: Under health and safety law, you must do what is reasonably practicable.
exampleZh: 在健康与安全法律的约束下，你必须做合理、可行的事。

meaning: adj. 真实的，实际的；（计划、方法等）切实有效的，切实可行的；（人）明智的，务实的；合适的，适用的；心灵手巧的，善于制作（或修补）的；几乎完全的，实际上的；n. （科学、烹饪等的）实践课，实用知识考试
definition: 1. adj. concerned with actual use or practice；2. adj. guided by practical experience and observation rather than theory
example: By the way, if we begin by talking about poetic and practical language, we're beginning where the Russian formalists began.
exampleZh: 谈到诗化语言和实用语言，我们就和俄国的形式主义者站到了同一个起点。

meaning: n. 实用性，可行性；务实，实事求是；实例，实际情况（practicalities）
definition: 1. n. concerned with actual use rather than theoretical possibilities
example: But most of the objections to Plato's particular form of the philosophic kingship on the practicality of his idea.
exampleZh: 但对柏拉图,特别形式之,哲学王权的异议,在其实践性。

meaning: n. （医学界或法律界的）从业人员，执业者；从事者，实践者
definition: 1. someone involved in a skilled job or activity；2. someone whose regular work has involved a lot of training
example: Very few of them would see themselves as a psychoanalytic practitioner or as a Freudian psychologist.
exampleZh: 他们中很少有人会把自己,视为精神分析从业者,或是精神分析学派的心理学家。

meaning: v. （尤指公开地）赞美，表扬；（用语言或音乐）赞美（上帝）；n. 表扬，赞美；（对上帝的）感谢，崇拜
definition: 1. n. an expression of approval and commendation；2. v. express approval of
example: What is the meaning of an untrodden way, or of "there are none to praise" her but "very few to love"?
exampleZh: 没有人走过的路是什么意思呢？,还有“没有人赞扬她“但是“几乎没有人爱她“又是什么意思呢？

meaning: v. 祈祷，祷告；渴望，祈望；祈求，恳求；adv. （用于询问或指示）请问，请；【名】 （Pray）（匈） 普劳伊，（英）普雷（人名）
definition: 1. v. address God; say a prayer；2. v. call upon in supplication; entreat
example: There's some religious practices of blessing the moon, and certainly in June, summer camps, you often pray outside.
exampleZh: 有一些宗教仪式,是专门祭拜月亮的，在六月的夏令营，我们也会在户外祈祷。

meaning: n. 祷文，祷词；祈祷，祷告；祈祷仪式，祈祷会（prayers）；愿望，祈望；极小的机会，极小的可能性
definition: 1. n. the act of communicating with a deity (especially as a petition or in adoration or contrition or thanksgiving)；2. n. reverent petition to a deity
example: This temporary alienation from God is ultimately repaired through Moses' intense prayer and intercession.
exampleZh: 暂时对上帝的疏远最终被修复,通过摩西不断的祈祷和求情。

meaning: v. 布道，讲道；宣扬，鼓吹；说教，训诫
definition: 1. v. deliver a sermon；2. v. speak, plead, or argue in favour of
example: He said he was trying to preach peace and tolerance to his people.
exampleZh: 他说他正试图向他的人民宣扬和平与宽容。

meaning: n. 传道士，牧师 ；鼓吹者；【名】 （Preacher）（英）普里彻（人名）
definition: 1. n. someone whose occupation is preaching the gospel
example: This is why he's continually mistaken for a preacher, no matter what he does.
exampleZh: 所以他会一直对传教士有误解，无论他做什么事。

meaning: n. 预防措施，防备；避孕措施（precautions）
definition: 1. n. a precautionary measure warding off impending danger or damage or injury etc.；2. n. the trait of practicing caution in advance
example: Could he not, just as a precaution, move to a place of safety?
exampleZh: 难道他不能就当是一种防范搬到一个安全的地方去吗？

meaning: adj. 预防的，防备的
definition: 1. adj. taken in advance to protect against possible danger or failure
example: On the basis of the precautionary principle, it could be argued that it is advisable to follow the FSA's advice.
exampleZh: 基于预防原则，听从食品标准局的建议是可取的。

meaning: v. 处在……之前，先于；在……之前做（或说）；比……更重要，比……（级别）更高
definition: 1. to be or go before something or someone in time or space；2. to be or go before someone or something in time or space
example: Capitalize all proper nouns but not the articles (a, an) that precede them.
exampleZh: 把所有的专有名词大写，它们之前的冠词(a, an)则不用。

meaning: adj. 先前的，前面的；v. 在……之前发生（或出现）；走在……前面（precede 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. existing or happening before someone or something
example: In the preceding code listings, I'm not tapping into much of that power.
exampleZh: 在前面的代码清单中，我并没有过多利用这种功能。

meaning: n. 先例，前例；判例，实例；常规，惯例；adj. 在先的，前面的
definition: 1. an action, situation, or decision that has already happened and can be used as a reason why a similar action or decision should be performed or made；2. the way that something has been done in the past that therefore shows that it is the correct way
example: The trial could set an important precedent for dealing with similar cases.
exampleZh: 这次审判能为处理类似案件开创一个重要先例。

meaning: adj. 宝贵的，珍贵的；珍视的，重要的；珍稀的，珍奇的；（表示气愤）宝贝似的；（言行）矫揉造作的，过分讲究的；可爱的，讨人喜欢的；n. （用作称呼）宝贝，亲爱的；adv. 非常，极其；【名】 （Precious）（英）普雷舍斯，普雷舍丝（人名）
definition: 1. adj. characterized by feeling or showing fond affection for；2. adv. extremely
example: And so, arguably, the fact that life is precious, that it won't endure, could actually increase its value for us.
exampleZh: 所以，可以说，生命是珍贵的，它将不再这个事实，事实上可能增加了其对我们来说的价值。

meaning: adj. 精确的，准确的；恰好的，确切的；（人）严格的，一丝不苟的
definition: 1. adj. sharply exact or accurate or delimited；2. adj. (of ideas, images, representations, expressions) characterized by perfect conformity to fact or truth ; strictly correct
example: Now, I think there's a deliberate confusion here about these lines because their precise historical significance isn't what's most significant.
exampleZh: 这里有一个刻意而为的困惑,是关于这些句子中严谨的历史意义的,而不是关于什么是最重要的。

meaning: n. 精确（性），准确（性）；严谨，细致；（测量、计算或说明的）精确化（尤以数字表现）；adj. （设计）精密的，精确的；要求技术精确的，（行动）精确的
definition: 1. n. the quality of being reproducible in amount or performance
example: Your working day will need to be organized with military precision.
exampleZh: 你们的工作日需要以军人般的精确性来安排。

meaning: adv. 精确地，准确地；恰好，正是（表示强调）；（用于表示完全同意）的确如此；严谨地，细致地
definition: 1. adv. indicating exactness or preciseness；2. adv. in a precise manner
example: The other way it shares an ambition of modernism is precisely in that effort to communicate experience, consciousness.
exampleZh: 它与现代主义追求的另一个共同点,正体现在经验和意识的交流上。

meaning: n. 捕食性动物； 掠夺者，掠夺成性的人（或组织）
definition: 1. an animal that hunts, kills, and eats other animals；2. someone who follows people in order to harm them or commit a crime against them
example: What would he have done if attacked by a predator or an invading Klingon?
exampleZh: 他会怎样做,如果被掠夺者袭击,或者克林贡人入侵？

meaning: adj. （动物）捕食性的，食肉的；掠夺性的，弱肉强食的
definition: 1. A predatory animal kills and eats other animals；2. A predatory person or organization tries to get something that belongs to someone else
example: Ants keep predatory insects away from where their aphids feed; Gmail keeps the spammers out of our inboxes.
exampleZh: 蚂蚁让食肉昆虫远离蚜虫的觅食处；Gmail 使垃圾邮件发送人远离我们的收件箱。

meaning: n. 前任，前辈；（被取代的）原有事物，前身
definition: 1. someone who had a job or a position before someone else, or something that comes before another thing in time or in a series；2. a person who had a job or position before someone else, or a thing that comes before another in time or in a series
example: He is cast in a different mould from his predecessor.
exampleZh: 他和他的前任性格不一样。

meaning: v. 预言，预计，预卜
definition: 1. v. make a prediction about; tell in advance；2. v. indicate by signs
example: It is impossible to predict what the eventual outcome will be.
exampleZh: 无法预测最终结果。

meaning: n. 预言之事，预报之事；预测（行为）
definition: 1. n. the act of predicting (as by reasoning about the future)；2. n. a statement made about the future
example: One is a sort of short-term type of prediction and that is looking at investing and purchasing products.
exampleZh: 其中一个区域主管短期预测,主要在投资和购买物品时发挥作用。

meaning: adj. 可预测的，可预料的；老套乏味的，墨守成规的
definition: 1. adj. capable of being foretold
example: This was a predictable reaction, given the bitter hostility between the two countries.
exampleZh: 考虑到两国之间的强烈敌意，这种反应是可以预见的。

meaning: v. （数量上）占优势，占大多数；占主导地位，占支配地位； 支配，主宰；adj. 主要的，占支配地位的
definition: 1. to be the largest in number or the most important；2. to be the most important or the greatest in number
example: Some traditional cookery powerhouses predominate, with almost half the list comprising restaurants in France, Italy, Spain, and the US.
exampleZh: 一些传统的烹饪强国占主导，榜单上几乎一半的餐厅在法国、意大利、西班牙和美国。

meaning: n. （数量的）优势，普遍；主导地位，支配地位
definition: 1. a situation in which one person or group of people has more importance or power than others；2. a situation in which one type of person or thing within a set is the largest in number
example: Since the former is most common among those inclined towards indifferent relationships, their predominance can bolster individuals' sense of self-worth.
exampleZh: 由于前者在那些倾向于淡漠关系的人群中最为常见，它们的优势可以增强个体的自我价值感。

meaning: adj. 明显的；占主导地位的，占支配地位的
definition: 1. more noticeable or important, or larger in number, than others；2. being the most noticeable or largest in number, or having the most power or influence
example: The transition in Irish painting from one predominant style to the other was not an abrupt one.
exampleZh: 爱尔兰绘画从一种主流风格向另一种主流风格的转变并非突如其来的。

meaning: n. （书的）前言，（演讲的）开场白；开端，序幕；（基督教）序祷，序诵；v. 为（书）作序；以……为开端，以……作为开场白
definition: 1. n. a short introductory essay preceding the text of a book；2. v. furnish with a preface or introduction
example: Remember I asked you from the preface, John Ray's preface, to figure out who Dolly Schiller is, who dies in childbed.
exampleZh: 还记得我曾让你们找出约翰·雷序言中的，死在产床上的多莉是谁。

meaning: v. 更喜爱，宁可；举报，提出（控告）；提拔（某人），提升
definition: 1. v. like better; value more highly；2. v. select as an alternative; choose instead; prefer as an alternative
example: Some people prefer only taking the courses that they want to take. What do you think of that?
exampleZh: 一些人只愿意学习他们喜欢的课程。你对此怎么看？

meaning: adj. 更好的，更合适的
definition: 1. adj. more desirable than another
example: Prevention of a problem is always preferable to trying to cure it.
exampleZh: 防止出现问题总是比试图解决问题更可取。

meaning: n. 偏爱，偏好；更喜欢的人（或物）；优待，优先（权）；（尤指债务偿付）优先偿还权
definition: 1. n. a strong liking；2. n. a predisposition in favor of something
example: Let's make a list of possible speakers, in order of preference.
exampleZh: 咱们按优先顺序列出一份可能请到的发言者名单。

meaning: adj. 优先的，优待的，优惠的；（投票，选举）表明选择顺序的；（债权人）要求债务人优先偿还的
definition: 1. adj. manifesting partiality
example: The government encourages this practice, and provides many preferential policies and facilitation measures for college students.
exampleZh: 政府鼓励这种做法，并为大学生提供了许多优惠政策和便利措施。

meaning: adj. 怀孕的，妊娠的；意味深长的，意义重大的
definition: 1. adj. carrying developing offspring within the body or being about to produce new life；2. adj. rich in significance or implication
example: It's bad enough to say that a lot of the girls get pregnant at a younger age than opposed to here.
exampleZh: 与这里情况相反，许多女孩在很年轻时就做了妈妈，这太糟糕了。

meaning: n. 怀孕（期），妊娠（期）
definition: 1. n. the state of being pregnant; the period from conception to birth when a woman carries a developing fetus in her uterus
example: Current thinking is that women distribute the fat below the waist because it's a fat storage depot for pregnancy and lactation.
exampleZh: 流行观点认为女性,把更多脂肪储存在腰以下,是为怀孕和哺乳提供脂肪储存

meaning: n. 偏见，成见，歧视；损害，侵害；v. 使有偏见，使有成见； 损害，不利于
definition: 1. n. a partiality that prevents objective consideration of an issue or situation；2. v. disadvantage by prejudice
example: So, we're going to talk about somebody's idea about racial prejudice, but that's not a theory of language acquisition.
exampleZh: 我们会谈到某人所提出的,关于种族偏见的理论，但它却并不是语言获得的理论。

meaning: adj. 初步的，预备的；n. 初步行动，准备工作；预赛，预试
definition: 1. n. a minor match preceding the main event；2. adj. designed to orient or acquaint with a situation before proceeding
example: It was agreed that another round of preliminary talks would be held in Beijing.
exampleZh: 商定了又一轮预备会谈将在北京举行。

meaning: adj. 过早的，提早的；早产的；草率的，仓促的
definition: 1. happening or done too soon, especially before the natural or suitable time；2. happening or done too soon, esp. before the natural or desired time
example: And the problem for Freud is premature weaning of a child.
exampleZh: 在弗洛伊德看来,问题就出在孩子过早断奶上面。

meaning: adj. 首要的，最好的；最早的，最初的；n. 总理，首相；（加拿大的）省总理，地方总理；（澳大利亚州或地区的）省长
definition: 1. n. the person who holds the position of head of the government in England；2. v. be performed for the first time
example: The ministers have at least put their finger on a passion, currently squandered on the English Premier League.
exampleZh: 至少部长们已经联合起来将热情挥霍在了英超联赛上。

meaning: n. 前提，假设；（企业或机构使用的）房屋及土地（premises）；上述各项；v. 以……为基础，以……为前提；预先提出，事先提到；声明，说明
definition: 1. an idea or theory on which a statement or action is based；2. to base a theory, argument, etc. on an idea, thought, or belief
example: His reasoning is based on the premise that all people are equally capable of good and evil.
exampleZh: 他的推理是以人可以为善亦可以为恶为前提的。

meaning: n. 保险费；（正常价格或费用以外的）加付款，加价；很高的价值，额外价值；额外补贴，津贴；奖品，奖金；优质汽油（=premium gas）；adj. 高价的，高品质的
definition: 1. an amount that is more than usual；2. an amount of money paid to get insurance
example: For Jeremy Siegel, in the latest edition of his book, the equity premium is 4% a year since 1802.
exampleZh: 杰里米·西格尔在他最新一版的书中讲到,从1802年开始,股权溢价就是每年4%

meaning: v. 使全神贯注，占据（某人的思想）；提前占据
definition: 1. to be the main thought in someone's mind, causing other things to be forgotten；2. to be the main thought in someone’s mind, causing other things to be forgotten
example: Yet this is the feature of AI that ought to preoccupy us the most.
exampleZh: 然而，他所说的是我们应该最为关注的人工智能的一个特征。

meaning: adj. 全神贯注的，心事重重的；被先占的；v. 使全神贯注，占据（某人的思想）；提前占据（preoccupy 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. thinking or worrying about something too much
example: Notice something about all of those figures: Shakespeare is preoccupied with figures who may or may not be crazy.
exampleZh: 看一下这些人物：,莎士比亚专注于疯了或者没疯的人物。

meaning: v. 使做好准备，把……预备好；（为……）做好准备；预备（饭菜），做（饭）；配制（药品或化学制品）；乐意做（be prepared to do sth.）；（在和弦中）预备（不和谐音）
definition: 1. v. make ready or suitable or equip in advance for a particular purpose or for some use, event, etc；2. v. prepare for eating by applying heat
example: I guess you got a higher score, as you are a Brown student. How did you prepare for the test?
exampleZh: 能被布朗大学录取，我猜你的分数一定很高。你是如何准备考试的呢？

meaning: n. 准备（指动作或过程）；准备工作，筹备工作（preparations）；（食物、医药、化妆品的）制剂，配制品；（为科学实验或医药检验预备的）标本；（乐）准备音
definition: 1. n. the activity of putting or setting in order in advance of some act or purpose；2. n. a substance prepared according to a formula
example: Well, with all that said by preparation, let me show you some more poems, beginning with Thomas Hardy, on page 51.
exampleZh: 我做了很多准备，我来给你们看更多的诗篇，从托马斯·哈迪开始，在51页。

meaning: adj. 预备性的，准备性的；预备的，预料的
definition: 1. adj. preceding and preparing for something
example: We want to exercise the preparatory work we've carried out before we consider other, simpler ways of writing these tests.
exampleZh: 在考虑其他编写这些测试的更简单方法之前，我们希望先进行准备工作。

meaning: n. 介词，前置词
definition: 1. n. a function word that combines with a noun or pronoun or noun phrase to form a prepositional phrase that can have an adverbial or adjectival relation to some other word；2. n. (linguistics) the placing of one linguistic element before another (as placing a modifier before the word it modifies in a sentence or placing an affix before the base to which it is attached)
example: There is nothing in the rules of grammar to suggest that ending a sentence with a preposition is wrong.
exampleZh: 在语法规则中没有哪一条表明以介词结束一个句子是错误的。

meaning: n. 先决条件，前提；预备课程；adj. 先决的，必备的
definition: 1. something that must exist or happen before something else can exist or happen
example: Purity, which is the absence of impurity, is a prerequisite for access to the holy or for holy status.
exampleZh: 纯洁，不纯的反义词，是接近神圣或达到神圣状态的先决条件。

meaning: v. 给……开（药），让……采用（疗法）；开处方；规定，命令；制定规定；推荐，推举
definition: 1. v. issue commands or orders for
example: How many psychologists or psychiatrists prescribe "? "run three times a week and see me in the morning"?
exampleZh: 多少心理学家或精神科医生规定病人,“每周跑步锻炼三次，早上来见我？

meaning: n. 处方，药方；处方药；开处方，开药方；解决方法，诀窍；取得的时效（根据长期或不确定时期持续使用或以长期习惯为基础确立的要求权）（=positive prescription)）；adj. 凭处方方可购买的
definition: 1. n. directions prescribed beforehand; the action of prescribing authoritative rules or directions；2. adj. available only with a doctor's written prescription
example: Because there is no limit and there is less prescription there certainly today than in the disease model.
exampleZh: 因为没有界线，如今它的使用程度,也远比疾病模型少。

meaning: adj. （人）在场的，出席的；（事物）存在的；现在的，目前的；考虑中的，正在讨论的；（语法）现在时（态）的；历历在目的；n. 现在，目前；礼物，赠品；（语法）现在时；（举枪的）瞄准（姿势）；v. 颁发，赠送；出示（护照等供检查）；正式提交（支票，账单）； 正式引见，介绍；正式出席，到场；引起，造成；表达（歉意等）；提出，陈述；上映，播出；展示，表现； 主持（广播或电视节目）；把……对准；（病人）呈现症状
definition: 1. n. the period of time that is happening now; any continuous stretch of time including the moment of speech；2. v. show or demonstrate something to an interested audience
example: So, that's present in all of these moments, but--equally present-- I want to get back to this sense of blankness.
exampleZh: 所以它在这些时候都被呈现了出来，而且是同等地呈现了出来-,让我们回头看看,这种空无一物的感觉。

meaning: n. 出席，存在；（某人的）所在地方；感觉中的存在物（如鬼魂）；驻扎部队，驻扎的警力；风度，气质；（公司在某地的）工人（或产品），势力
definition: 1. n. the state of being present; current existence；2. n. the immediate proximity of someone or something
example: Likewise, the gifts--the other foods and pleasing odors attracted and maintained the continued presence of God in the sanctuary.
exampleZh: 同样的，个人准备的,都吸引并维持了上帝在圣所里的逗留。

meaning: n. （颁奖等）仪式，典礼；授予，颁发；（在仪式上接受的）奖项，赠予物；展示会，介绍会，发布会；陈述，报告，说明；（事物的）呈现方式；（证件等的）出示；（证物的）提交，提供；（戏剧的）演出；（胎儿的）先露位置，产位；（尤指在帝王前）正式引见，引……朝见；（圣职等的）推荐
definition: 1. n. the activity of formally presenting something (as a prize or reward)；2. n. the act of making something publicly available; presenting news or other information by broadcasting or printing it
example: I am making a multimedia presentation for my science project.
exampleZh: 我正在为我的科学项目做多媒体演示。

meaning: adv. 现在，目前；不久，随即；马上，很快
definition: 1. adv. in the near future；2. adv. at this time or period; now
example: She gave up presently as if a cloud had approached the sun or the smog thickened and so broken the religious instant, whatever it might have been.
exampleZh: 现在她放弃了，就像乌云蔽日,烟雾笼罩,这个宗教瞬间也破碎了，不管它之前是这么样子。

meaning: v. 保护，维护；保持，维持；腌制，保存（食物）；禁止他人捕猎；n. 果酱，腌菜；（某人或某个团体的）专属领域，独有活动；动物保护区，外人禁入的猎地
definition: 1. n. a domain that seems to be specially reserved for someone；2. v. keep or maintain in unaltered condition; cause to remain or last
example: We deliberate with an eye to preservation or change to making something better or to preserve it from becoming worse.
exampleZh: 我们商议,以求保守或改变,让事物变好,或保守它不至于变得更坏。

meaning: n. 保护，维护；保留，维持；（食物的）保存，保藏；保存的状况，保养的程度
definition: 1. n. the activity of protecting something from loss or danger；2. n. the condition of being (well or ill) preserved
example: The central issue in the strike was the preservation of jobs.
exampleZh: 罢工的核心问题是工作职位的保留。

meaning: n. 防腐剂，保护剂；adj. 保护的，保存的
definition: 1. n. a chemical compound that is added to protect against decay or decomposition；2. adj. tending or having the power to preserve
example: The preservative used is usually ethylene glycol or propylene glycol, as alcohol will evaporate quickly and the traps will dry out.
exampleZh: 常用防腐剂是乙二醇或丙二醇，因为随着酒精快速挥发，捕集器也随之恢复干燥。

meaning: v. 主持，担任主持；主管某地，掌管（局势）（preside over）；（尤指键盘乐器）领奏，主奏（preside at）
definition: 1. to be in charge of a formal meeting, ceremony, or trial；2. to be in charge of or to control a meeting or event
example: The war-like Glaucon would preside over what Socrates calls a feverish city, honors, competitions and above all war.
exampleZh: 好战的，Glaucon，将代表着,苏格拉底所谓的狂热之城，将荣誉、竞争与战争制度化的城市。

meaning: n. 总统，国家主席；（机构、俱乐部、学院等的）负责人，会长，院长，主席；（公司）董事长，（银行）行长，总裁；（基督教）圣餐主持教士
definition: 1. n. an executive officer of a firm or corporation；2. n. the person who holds the office of head of state of the United States government
example: There are these enormous statues. One of the statues is the President Theodore Roosevelt on a horse, on horseback.
exampleZh: 有很多巨大的雕塑。其中一个雕塑是西奥多•罗斯福总统骑在马背上。

meaning: n. 总统（主席，校长）的职位（任期）；（基督教）（牧师或司铎）圣餐主持；监督，主管
definition: 1. n. the tenure of a president；2. n. the office and function of president
example: Even the presidency was handed to him on a platter.
exampleZh: 甚至连总统的职位也让他轻易到手。

meaning: adj. 与总统有关的；总统似的，像总统的（尤指貌似自信大方、经验老到的）
definition: 1. adj. relating to a president or presidency；2. adj. befitting a president
example: I also served for the two years before that as the policy director of President Bush's presidential campain, working at the Texas.

meaning: n. 新闻工作者，新闻界，报刊（the press）；新闻报道；新闻舆论，媒体评论；印刷机；出版社，印刷厂；印刷；按，压，熨；压平器，熨烫机；人群，拥挤；大壁橱，衣柜，书柜；（篮球）紧逼；（举重）推举；（尤指海军的）强行征兵；商业压力；v. 压，挤，推，贴；按，揿；困扰，严重影响；挤着走；敦促，逼迫；坚持，竭力要求；压平，熨平；压榨，榨汁；CD 制作，压制（唱片）；（深情地）紧握（某人的手或臂）；前进，推进；（敌人，对手）进逼，进攻；（高尔夫）过猛击球；征用，临时使用；（举重）推举；【名】 (Press) （美、英、加、俄、印、澳）普雷斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. newspaper writers and photographers；2. v. exert pressure or force to or upon

exampleZh: 他开了一个新闻发布会，说道汽车使用量的增加，和拼车的减少。

meaning: n. 压力，挤压；（气体或液体形成的）压力，压强；心理压力，紧张；催促，要求；气压；v. 对……施加压力，强迫；使……增压
definition: 1. n. the force applied to a unit area of surface; measured in pascals (SI unit) or in dynes (cgs unit)；2. v. to cause to do through pressure or necessity, by physical, moral or intellectual means :
example: These two relations involving entropy are also useful because they'll let us see how entropy depends on volume and pressure.
exampleZh: 这两个涉及熵的关系也非常有用,因为他们告诉我们,熵和体积，压强的关系。

meaning: adj. （问题，需求，情况）紧迫的，迫切的；难以推却的，不容忽视的；n. 压制品，一批压制品（尤指唱片）；按，压，挤，推；v. 按，压；熨平（衣服）；挤着走（pressing 的现在分词形式）；【名】 （Pressing）（匈、法、美）普雷辛（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of pressing; the exertion of pressure；2. adj. compelling immediate action
example: Two quotations, the first the president Bush " "Passing a new growth package is our most pressing economic priority."
exampleZh: 下面是两个引述，第一个来自布什总统,“一个新的一揽子增长计划迫在眉睫“

meaning: n. 声望，威信；adj. 受尊重的，令人敬仰的；贵重的，气派的；【名】 （Prestige）（英）普雷斯蒂奇（人名）
definition: 1. respect and admiration given to someone or something, usually because of a reputation for high quality, success, or social influence；2. causing admiration because of being connected with being rich or powerful
example: It was his responsibility for foreign affairs that gained him international prestige.
exampleZh: 是他在外交事务中的尽职尽责为他赢得了国际声望。

meaning: adj. 有威望的，有声望的
definition: 1. very much respected and admired, usually because of being important；2. very much respected and admired, usually because of being important or of high quality
example: It's one of the best equipped and most prestigious schools in the country.
exampleZh: 它是该国设备最好、最有声望的学校之一。

meaning: v. 料想，（不肯定地）认为；假设，设想；（法律上或官方）假定，推定；擅自，冒昧；意味着；擅作主张，冒昧
definition: 1. to believe something to be true because it is very likely, although you are not certain；2. to do something although you know that you do not have a right to do it
example: We must presume innocence until we have proof of guilt.
exampleZh: 在证实一个人有罪之前，我们必须假定其无辜。

meaning: n. 推测，设想；（法律上的）假定，推定；放肆，冒昧
definition: 1. the act of believing that something is true without having any proof；2. a belief that something is true because it is likely, although not certain
example: Everyone is entitled to the presumption of innocence until they are proved to be guilty.
exampleZh: 在被证明有罪以前，每一个人都应被假定无辜。

meaning: adv. 大概，可能
definition: 1. used to say what you think is the likely situation
example: And so we adjust our minds to accommodate -because presumably we weren't imagining Satan to be that big -to accommodate this sense of Satan's tremendous physical magnitude.
exampleZh: 我们调整了自己的思维来适应这个,-因为我们之前并未设想他的长矛有那么大,-来适应撒旦如此高大的想法。

meaning: v. 伪装，假装；（玩游戏时）假扮，装扮；自诩，自称（pretend to）；adj. 假装的，假想的（尤为儿童使用）
definition: 1. n. the enactment of a pretense；2. v. make believe with the intent to deceive
example: Host: Flashback 29 years ago, and put yourself in the seat here and pretend you were still in school.
exampleZh: 主持人：回首29年前，假装你还坐在这儿,还在商学院念书。

meaning: n. 假象，伪装；借口，托词；装扮游戏角色；自称，自诩；虚浮炫耀的语言（或行为）
definition: 1. n. the act of giving a false appearance；2. n. pretending with intention to deceive
example: Altman strips away the pretense and mythology to expose the film industry as a business like any other.
exampleZh: 奥尔特曼揭穿伪装和神话，把电影业暴露成像其他任何行业一样。

meaning: n. 借口，托词
definition: 1. a pretended reason for doing something that is used to hide the real reason
example: He left the party early on the pretext of having work to do.
exampleZh: 他借口有事要处理，早早离开了聚会。

meaning: adj. （尤指女孩）漂亮的，标致的；（事物）悦目的，悦耳的；（男子）女子气的，俊俏的；巨大的，令人印象深刻的；好看的，令人愉快的； 非常糟糕的；adv. 相当，颇；非常，很；n. 漂亮东西（尤指悦人但不必要的小饰品）；（以高人一等的口吻）漂亮的人，漂亮的孩子；v. 装饰，使漂亮；【名】 （Pretty）（美、印）普雷蒂（人名）
definition: 1. adj. pleasing by delicacy or grace; not imposing；2. adv. used as an intensifier (`jolly' is used informally in Britain)
example: So the sense that one actually is pretty adept in knowing is one that tends to predominate in the university.
exampleZh: 因此在大学中，认为自己了解很多,这种心态颇为流行。

meaning: v. 流行，盛行；（在比赛、竞赛或争辩中）击败，获胜；占优势，占上风；（继续）使用；说服，劝服（prevail on/upon）
definition: 1. v. be larger in number, quantity, power, status or importance；2. v. be valid, applicable, or true
example: Moses holds out a rod during battle in order that Israel prevail over her enemies, and Joshua will do the same with a javelin.
exampleZh: 摩西在战役中手持权杖以使以色列人击败,敌人，约书亚将用标枪做同样的事情。

meaning: n. 流行，盛行
definition: 1. n. the quality of prevailing generally; being widespread；2. n. (epidemiology) the ratio (for a given time period) of the number of occurrences of a disease or event to the number of units at risk in the population
example: So, this just shows as the vaccine was distributed, given to more people, that prevalence of the disease dropped dramatically.
exampleZh: 因此,这表明随着疫苗的推广,以及接种人数的增加,该疾病的患病率显著降低

meaning: adj. 盛行的，普遍的
definition: 1. adj. encountered generally especially at the present time
example: Despite the fact that the disease is so prevalent, treatment is still far from satisfactory.
exampleZh: 尽管事实上这种疾病非常普遍，治疗却远不尽如人意。

meaning: v. 阻止，阻碍；防止，预防；设置障碍
definition: 1. v. keep from happening or arising; make impossible；2. v. prevent from doing something or being in a certain state
example: It's contracting so the Fed is trying to prevent a serious recession by cutting interest rates; they've been cutting them rapidly.
exampleZh: 它在减小,所以美联储正在试图阻止一个因为利率缩减,而产生的严重的经济衰退；,但是他们最近一直在降低利率。

meaning: n. 预防，防止
definition: 1. n. the act of preventing
example: Indeed the major strides in prevention have largely come from a perspective focused " on systematically building competency,not correcting weakness."
exampleZh: 事实上，在预防方面取得的重大进展,基本上来自一个观点,也就是注重培养能力，而非改正错误“

meaning: adj. 预防（性）的，防备的；n. 预防药，预防疗法
definition: 1. n. remedy that prevents or slows the course of an illness or disease；2. adj. preventing or contributing to the prevention of disease
example: The police were able to take preventive action and avoid a possible riot.
exampleZh: 警方及时采取防范措施，避免了可能发生的骚乱。

meaning: n. 预映，预演，预展；预告片；（预先看电影、戏剧、书等后所作的）预告性述评；预审，预视；预览样品；预兆；预测；（计算机）打印预览；v. 为（电影等）写预评；预先播映（或展示），预告；预看，预听；概述，扼要介绍；预审，预观；预测
definition: 1. n. an advertisement consisting of short scenes from a motion picture that will appear in the near future；2. v. watch (a movie or play) before it is released to the general public
example: He had gone to see the preview of a play.
exampleZh: 他去看过一出戏的预演。

meaning: adj. 以前的，先前的；（时间或顺序上）稍前的；过早的，过急的；n. 前科，犯罪记录
definition: 1. adj. (used especially of persons) of the immediate past；2. adj. too soon or too hasty
example: And one of those is bringing a previous set of skills that I used to the Outdoor Action program.
exampleZh: 其中一种方式，就是将我原来的野外活动技能,带入到我们的户外活动项目中来。

meaning: n. 猎物，捕获物；受害者，受骗者；掠夺品；v. 捕食；欺凌，坑害（尤指弱者）；不断困扰，折磨；【名】 （Prey）（美、德、爱）普赖（人名）
definition: 1. an animal that is hunted and killed for food by another animal；2. a creature that is hunted and killed for food by another animal
example: It suggests that ecstasy is like wine, ; and wine is like an eagle clasping you; it's prey in its claws.
exampleZh: 这里暗示着令人着迷的狂喜如同美酒一般，而酒又像是紧紧抓着你的鹰;,用它的利爪疯狂地掠夺着你所有的。

meaning: n. 价格；代价；开价，价码；投注赔率； 价值；v. 为……定价；给（商店中的产品）标价；比较……的价格；问……的价格；【名】 （Price）（英）普赖斯，（法）普里斯，（葡、瑞典）普里塞（人名）
definition: 1. n. the amount of money needed to purchase something；2. v. determine the price of
example: If my code is correct, what should the average price be, after say, 100 days, if there's no bias. Pardon?
exampleZh: 如果我的代码没写错的话，如果没有偏向值那平均价格会是多少呢，如果没有偏向值，请说？

meaning: adj. 无价的；非常有用的； 十分有趣的，极为可笑的
definition: 1. adj. having incalculable monetary, intellectual, or spiritual worth
example: A number of priceless works of art were stolen from the gallery.
exampleZh: 美术馆中许多价值连城的艺术品被盗。

meaning: n. 自豪（感）；自尊（心）；傲慢，自负；最佳状态，全盛期；狮群；引以为傲的人（或事物）；v. 以……自豪（pride oneself on/upon）；【名】 （Pride）（英）普赖德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a feeling of self-respect and personal worth；2. v. be proud of
example: My friends are gone, but that's a truth Nor grave nor bed denied, -- Learned in bodily lowliness And in the heart's pride.
exampleZh: 美丑唇齿相依,心的高傲和肉的低贱，都证实这条真理,我伙伴们虽死，但否认它。

meaning: adj. 自豪的，得意的；令人自豪的；傲慢的，自负的；自尊的，自重的；秀丽的，壮观的；凸出的，隆起的；（肌肉）愈合伤口四周赘生的；（动物）有力量的，精力充沛的；【名】 （Proud）（英）普劳德（人名）
definition: 1. adj. feeling self-respect or pleasure in something by which you measure your self-worth; or being a reason for pride；2. adj. having or displaying great dignity or nobility
example: Because I am very, very proud to be a Texan. As I think you'll find with most people from Texas.
exampleZh: 因为我为自己是德克萨斯人而感到无比骄傲。我想你会发现许多德克萨斯人有同样的感受。

meaning: n. 牧师，神职人员；木渔槌（垂钓时用以打死已上钩的鱼）；v. 任命……为司铎（或祭司）；【名】 （Priest）（英、德）普里斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a clergyman in Christian churches who has the authority to perform or administer various religious rites; one of the Holy Orders；2. n. a person who performs religious duties and ceremonies in a non-Christian religion
example: My stepfather was a former priest, one of the early black men ordained to the priesthood in the United States.
exampleZh: 我的继父原先是一名牧师，是美国早期参与到,牧师事业中的黑人之一。

meaning: adj. 主要的，首要的；小学教育的，初级教育的；初级的，原发性的；最基本的，最根本的；第一手的，直接的；（有机化合物）连上一个碳原子的；（多指胺）（氨基酸顺序）一级的；n. （选举过程中的党内）初选（=primary election）；原色；初级飞羽；主星；初级线圈，原线圈

meaning: adv. 主要地，首要地，根本地
