example: So it's these two elements that Brooks is interested in in Freud and that he primarily does take from Freud.
exampleZh: 布鲁克斯对弗洛伊德感兴趣的地方正是这两个元素,它们也是布鲁克斯从弗洛伊德那里借鉴的最根本的思想。

meaning: adj. 主要的，首要的；优质的，第一流的；最可能的，最适合的；最理想的，最典型的；最初的，原始的；素（或质）数的（如2，3，5，7，11）；互为素或质数的；v. 事先指点，使（某人）做好准备；把（某事物）准备好，使备用；给（表面）涂上底色；n. 盛年，壮年时期；质数，素数；上标符号（'），（数字后）分钟（或英尺）符号；（八个防御姿势的）第一姿势；（自行车比赛中设特别奖的）特设行程；起始，原初；晨经，晨祷（传统上于白天中的第一个小时即早晨六点所做的祈祷，现罕用）；【名】 （Prime）（英）普赖姆，（德）普里梅（人名）
definition: 1. n. a number that has no factor but itself and 1；2. v. insert a primer into (a gun, mine, or charge) preparatory to detonation or firing
example: This is what Tynjanov says: In formalist historiography, the prime significance of major social factors is not at all discarded.
exampleZh: 提尼亚诺夫这样说：,在形式主义者编写历史时，并没有完全忽略主要社会力量的重要性。

meaning: adj. 原始的，远古的；（器物等）粗糙的，简陋的；（人、动物或植物发展）早期的；（行为，思想，情感）本能的，自然的；（艺术风格）朴实无华的；原来的，原有的；（语言学）根词的，非派生的；（数）（代数或几何表达式）本原的；（生）原生的；n. 原始人，未开化的土人；原始派艺术家（或其作品）；文艺复兴前的艺术家（或作品），模仿文艺复兴前艺术风格的现代画家；早期风格物品；词根，原（词）素；（数）基本式，初基；（计算机）图元，原语
definition: 1. n. a person who belongs to an early stage of civilization；2. adj. belonging to an early stage of technical development; characterized by simplicity and (often) crudeness
example: Primitive humans needed to be able to react like this to escape from dangerous animals.
exampleZh: 原始人们需要能够像这样反应以逃脱危险的动物。

meaning: n. 王子，王孙；（小国的）国君，亲王；佼佼者，名家； （某些欧洲国家的）贵族；【名】 （Prince）（英、葡）普林斯，（法）普兰斯（人名）

exampleZh: 霍布斯还相信,只有比较简单易懂的书,才更容易引起君王的怜悯之心。

meaning: adj. 最重要的，首要的；本金的，母金的；n. （美国公立中小学的）校长；（英国的）大学校长，学院院长；（企业或机构的）负责人；（音乐会、戏剧、芭蕾舞剧、歌剧中的）主角演员；（管弦乐队每一乐器组的）首席演奏者；（有利息的）本金，资金；（法律和商业事务中的）当事人，委托人；关键人物；（某些行业）完全合格的开业者；（负责某一部门的）高级公务员；主犯，首犯；决斗者；（支撑檩的）主椽；（管风琴的）主音栓
definition: 1. n. the original amount of a debt on which interest is calculated；2. adj. most important element
example: that it could be blown out of proportion and misused by the principal or by third parties.

meaning: n. （行为）准则，（道德）原则；道义，正直；基本原则，基本法则；（机器等或自然界的）原理，定律；（宗教或政治的）主义，信条；起源，本原；本质，实质；（化）成分，要素
definition: 1. n. a basic generalization that is accepted as true and that can be used as a basis for reasoning or conduct；2. n. a rule or standard especially of good behavior
example: Cummings actually boldly experimented with this principle and he attracted the attention of the linguists, particularly a linguist named Dell Hymes.
exampleZh: 对此，卡明斯做了一个大胆的试验,吸引了语言学家的注意，特别是德尔海默斯。

meaning: v. 打印；印刷，出版；（在报纸或杂志上）刊登，刊载；用印刷体书写；冲印（照片）；印花样于（尤指织物或衣服上）；印上（印痕）；（用模子）印；铭记，铭刻；n. 印刷；印刷字体；印刷出的文字；印刷行业，出版界；印刷品，出版物；印迹，痕迹；印章；印花布，印花布服装；印花，印制图案；（冲印出的）照片； 版画，(用照相制版法制作的）绘画复制品；电影拷贝
definition: 1. n. the result of the printing process；2. v. put into print
example: F Then I'm going to print a capital F just % 1f C to be aesthetically interesting equals another %.1fc.

meaning: n. 打印机；印刷商，印刷工人，印刷公司

example: Any right-thinking printer or any right-thinking publisher would scoff at the presumption of a poet who demanded such a thing.
exampleZh: 任何一个思想健全的印刷商和出版商,都会嘲笑你去假定诗人需要这样的东西。

meaning: n. 印刷（术）；（书的）一次印刷；印刷字体；v. 打印，印刷；（在报纸、杂志上）刊印，刊登；洗印，冲洗（照片）（print 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. text handwritten in the style of printed matter；2. n. the business of producing printed material for sale or distribution
example: From 1641 to 1643, there had been an unprecedented explosion of printing and publishing in England.
exampleZh: 从1641年到1643年，在英格兰出现了,空前的印刷出版狂潮。

meaning: adj. 先前的，事先的；优先的，更重要的；在前面的（prior to）；n. 犯罪前科；小修道院院长；大修道院副院长；托钵会会长；【名】 （Prior）（美）普廖尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. the head of a religious order; in an abbey the prior is next below the abbot；2. adj. earlier in time
example: I had been living in Japan for two years prior to meeting her. I'd been over there,
exampleZh: 在认识她之前，我在日本住了两年。那段时间我一直呆在日本，

meaning: n. 优先事项，最重要的事；优先，优先权，重点；优先通行权；adj. 优先的
definition: 1. n. status established in order of importance or urgency；2. n. preceding in time
example: Two quotations, the first the president Bush " "Passing a new growth package is our most pressing economic priority."
exampleZh: 下面是两个引述，第一个来自布什总统,“一个新的一揽子增长计划迫在眉睫“

meaning: n. 监狱，牢房；监禁，监狱制度；难以脱身的地方（或处境），牢笼；v. 禁锢，关押；【名】 （Prison）（德）普里松（人名）
definition: 1. n. a correctional institution where persons are confined while on trial or for punishment；2. n. a prisonlike situation; a place of seeming confinement
example: After you got kicked out of the school, already we can see where this is going... Headed towards the prison, industrial complex, absolutely.
exampleZh: 在你退学后，我们都能想象你接着会。。,进监狱，进工厂，没错。

meaning: n. 犯人，囚犯；俘虏，战俘；为……所困的人
definition: 1. a person kept in prison or captured by an enemy
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: The prisoner was released after new evidence raised serious doubts about his conviction.
exampleZh: 新证据使人们对其定罪产生严重怀疑，这名囚犯随后获释。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: adj. 私有的，自用的；（服务，行业）私营的，民营的；没有股票上市的；私下的，秘密的；（交易未涉及商业机构的）私下里的；（想法、感觉）私密的；未担任公职的，无官职的；与官职（或工作）无关的；安静的，不受打扰的；（人）内敛的，不喜欢谈论私事的；（尤指两人）单独的；私下辅导的；（教育，医疗）私立的；只有自己人明白的；n. （美、英陆军或美国海军陆战队）二等兵； 私处，阴部（privates）
definition: 1. n. an enlisted man of the lowest rank；2. adj. confined to particular persons or groups or providing privacy
example: And then use that to sort of decide if I want to go back to private equity
exampleZh: 然后，决定是否要入股，
family: private / privacy / privatize / privatizise / privatization / privatizatiosation

meaning: n. 隐私，秘密；清静，（不受干扰的）独处；隐居处
definition: 1. n. the quality of being secluded from the presence or view of others；2. n. the condition of being concealed or hidden
example: She was longing for some peace and privacy.
exampleZh: 她渴望过清静的私人生活。
family: private / privacy / privatize / privatizise / privatization / privatizatiosation

meaning: v. 使私有化，使私营化
definition: 1. v. change from governmental to private control or ownership
example: Please note we can only privatize domains that are current registered through us.
exampleZh: 请注意，我们只能给已经从我们这里注册号的域名隐私。
family: private / privacy / privatize / privatizise / privatization / privatizatiosation

meaning: n. 私有化，私营化
definition: 1. n. changing something from state to private ownership or control
example: There were fears that privatization would lead to job losses.
exampleZh: 人们担心私有化会导致失业。
family: private / privacy / privatize / privatizise / privatization / privatizatiosation

meaning: n. 特权，特殊待遇；荣幸，光荣；（富人或上层阶级的）权势；（律师、医生及其他专业人士的）保密权；言行免责权（尤指议员的权利）；（授予个人，公司，某地的）特许经营权；（生活）优越；v. 给予特权，特别优待；特免，免除（某人）
definition: 1. n. a special advantage or immunity or benefit not enjoyed by all；2. v. bestow a privilege upon
example: In other words, language, according to Derrida, in the Saussurian tradition seems to privilege sound over script, over what is graphic.
exampleZh: 换句话说，德里达认为，在索绪尔的理论中，音响比文字，更具优势。

meaning: adj. （因非常富有或社会地位高而）享有特权的；荣幸的；（信息）得到特许保密的；v. 特免，免除（某人）；授予……以特权；给予特权，特别优待（privilege 的过去分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. blessed with privileges；2. adj. not subject to usual rules or penalties
example: He had promised that the rich and privileged would no longer get preferential treatment.
exampleZh: 他已承诺富人和特权阶层将不会再得到优待。

meaning: n. 奖品，奖项；非常珍贵的人（或物），十分重要的人（或物）；（海战中）缴获的敌船；adj. 可获奖的，优等的；作为奖品的；获奖的；有奖的；完全的；非常重要的，珍贵的；v. 珍视，高度重视；撬开；竭力打探（消息等）
definition: 1. n. something given for victory or superiority in a contest or competition or for winning a lottery；2. v. hold dear
example: Well, Mario Molina, who was a faculty member here at MIT, won a Nobel prize for describing this process.
exampleZh: 马里奥，莫丽娜，一个麻州理工学院的教员，凭借描述这一过程获得了诺贝尔物理学奖。

meaning: adj. 很可能发生（或存在等）的，大概的；n. 可能获胜的人（或动物），可能入选者
definition: 1. n. an applicant likely to be chosen；2. adj. likely but not certain to be or become true or real
example: Some of the novels and stories you read were, it is probable, laid in your own country of America.
exampleZh: 你读的东西，也许是美国化的。

meaning: n. 可能性，或然性；可能发生的事，可能真实的事；（数）概率，几率
definition: 1. n. a measure of how likely it is that some event will occur; a number expressing the ratio of favorable cases to the whole number of cases possible；2. n. the quality of being probable; a probable event or the most probable event
example: There is a 60% probability that the population will be infected with the disease.
exampleZh: 民众感染这种疾病的概率为60%。

meaning: adv. 大概，或许
definition: 1. adv. with considerable certainty; without much doubt；2. adv. easy to believe on the basis of available evidence
example: The same nations and the short life expectancy of birth probably the lowest quality of life in other areas.
exampleZh: 这一数字在下降，在上述国家,新生儿预期寿命较短，某些区域生活质量极低。

meaning: v. 调查，打探，探究；（用手指、细长工具等）探查，查看；搜寻，探索；侦察，侦探（敌情）；n. 探究，详尽调查；（医生和科学家用的）探针； 航天探测器，太空探测器（=space probe）；探测仪，传感器，取样器；【名】 （Probe）（法）普罗布（人名）
definition: 1. to try to discover information that other people do not want you to know, by asking questions carefully and not directly；2. to examine something with a tool, especially in order to find something that is hidden
example: The surgeon would pick up his instruments, probe, repair, and stitch up again.
exampleZh: 外科医生会拿起器械进行探查、修复，然后再缝合。

meaning: n. 问题，难题，困难；疾病；（通过算数或仔细思考而解决的）题；（感觉上）不喜欢，不情愿；（尤指国际象棋等）棋式，排局；adj. 难对付的，成问题的
definition: 1. n. a state of difficulty that needs to be resolved；2. n. a source of difficulty
example: It shouldn't be difficult to see a kind of problem that is beginning to arise in Milton's text here.
exampleZh: 这是一个很容易看出的问题,在弥尔顿的作品中也被提了出来。

meaning: adj. 成问题的，有困难的；未确定的；n. 成问题之事
definition: 1. adj. open to doubt or debate；2. adj. making great mental demands; hard to comprehend or solve or believe
example: This would be particularly problematic if the gateway were hosted by an ISP or other third party.
exampleZh: 如果网关是由 ISP 或其它第三方提供的，这个问题就会特别突出。

meaning: n. 手续，步骤；（商业、法律或政治上的）程序；外科手术；（电脑的）应用程式
definition: 1. n. a particular course of action intended to achieve a result；2. n. a process or series of acts especially of a practical or mechanical nature involved in a particular form of work
example: you've got to get rid of the ritual impurity, so there'll have to be some ritual procedure that purges the impurity.
exampleZh: 要摆脱不纯洁的仪式，将会有一些手段来净化不纯洁。

meaning: v. 开始行动，开展；继续做（或从事、进行）；（完成其他事后）继续做某事；行进，前往；起诉某人；来自，出自；n. （某个事件或活动的）收入，收益
definition: 1. v. continue talking；2. v. move ahead; travel onward in time or space
example: They had to take the finely balanced decision to let the visit proceed.
exampleZh: 他们不得不做出仔细权衡后的决定，让访问继续下去。

meaning: n. 诉讼，诉讼程序（proceeding 的复数）
definition: 1. n. (law) the institution of a sequence of steps by which legal judgments are invoked；2. n. a written account of what transpired at a meeting
example: You want to avoid costly legal proceedings if you can.
exampleZh: 如果能够的话你希望避免昂贵的法律诉讼。

meaning: n. 步骤，程序；（自然或偶然的）变化过程；（为达到某目标的）过程，进程；制作方法，加工方法；传票；（生，剖）端突，突起；adj. （印刷）三原色的，三色版的； 经过特殊加工的；照相板的；v. （用化学物品或机器）处理，加工；审核，受理（正式文件或请求）；（计算机）处理（数据）；冲洗（照片）；加工（食品）；列队行进；把（头发）弄成直发
definition: 1. n. a particular course of action intended to achieve a result；2. v. deal with in a routine way
example: We feel as we process the world around us that we know things for and as what they are.
exampleZh: 我们觉得我们认识的事物,都是事物真实的本质。

meaning: n. （计算机的）处理器（机）；处理程序；加工机（者）；胶片冲洗公司，显影公司；文件处理者，文件经办人
definition: 1. n. a business engaged in processing agricultural products and preparing them for market；2. n. someone who processes things (foods or photographs or applicants etc.)
example: The computer acts as a word processor where the text of a speech can be input at any time.
exampleZh: 计算机起着文字处理器的作用，一篇讲话的文本可随时输入。

meaning: n. （人或车辆的）行列，队伍；一连串的人（或物）；（神学）圣灵流出
definition: 1. n. (theology) the origination of the Holy Spirit at Pentecost；2. n. the group action of a collection of people or animals or vehicles moving ahead in more or less regular formation
example: This is the poem in which the speaker grieves over a death by imagining a procession of mourners at the funeral.
exampleZh: 在《牧歌》第十首中，讲述者想象葬礼上,的一行送葬者，来哀悼一个死者。

meaning: v. （正式）宣告，（公开）声明；强调，声称；（标志或通知）宣传，告知；清楚表明，显示
definition: 1. v. declare formally; declare someone to be something; of titles；2. v. state or announce
example: Jefferson and his colleagues could confidently proclaim their political rights as being colleague and the gift of a creator.
exampleZh: 杰斐逊和他的同僚宣称,他们的政治权利是不言自明的,是造物主所赐予的

meaning: n. 正式的公告，宣言；宣布，公布
definition: 1. n. a formal public statement；2. n. the formal act of proclaiming; giving public notice
example: President Abraham Lincoln, during the Civil War, issued a proclamation setting aside the last Thursday in November for the holiday.
exampleZh: 内战期间，亚伯拉罕·林肯总统发布了一项公告，将11月的最后一个星期四定为节假日。

meaning: v. 引起，造成；（自然地）生产，产生；（尤指用机器）生产，制造；（运用技巧）制作，造出；（某地、某过程或制度）出产，产出；出示，拿出；监制，制作（电影或戏剧）；生育；使（线段）延长；n. 农产品；（尤指某人工作或努力的）成果，结果
definition: 1. n. fresh fruits and vegetable grown for the market；2. v. bring forth or yield
example: And, even Cavendish, one of the things that he observed was that hydrogen could be combusted to produce water vapor.
exampleZh: 甚至卡文迪许都观察到了,氢气燃烧,会产生水蒸气。

meaning: n. （以销售为目的的）生产，制造；（对自然物的）加工，采集，生产；产量；（自然的）产生；（交通工具的）大量生产；（戏剧、电影、电视节目、唱片等的）制作；（戏剧、电影等的）上映，上演；（尤指从制作与公演等特点来看）影片，戏剧；音响效果，制作方式；出示，提供；非常费力的事，非常复杂的事
definition: 1. n. (economics) manufacturing or mining or growing something (usually in large quantities) for sale；2. n. a presentation for the stage or screen or radio or television
example: My other roommate is named Cooper Lewis, who is actually going to play Hamlet in that production.
exampleZh: 我的另一个室友叫库伯·路易斯，他会在那场戏剧演出中扮演哈姆雷特。

meaning: adj. 多产的，丰饶的；有效益的，富有成效的；生产（成品、庄稼或财富）的，生产性的；产生……的，引起……的（productive of）；有构词能力的；（咳嗽）生痰的，分泌黏液的
definition: 1. adj. producing or capable of producing (especially abundantly)；2. adj. having the ability to produce or originate
example: Too much spending on rearmament would place an insupportable burden on the nation's productive capacity.
exampleZh: 过于庞大的重整军备开支会给国家的生产力带来难以承受的负担。

meaning: n. 生产率，生产力
definition: 1. n. the quality of being productive or having the power to produce；2. n. (economics) the ratio of the quantity and quality of units produced to the labor per unit of time
example: The "parable of the talents" rewards hard work and investment; and it's satisfying because it does that, but it also instills an anxiety about non-productivity.
exampleZh: 才能的寓言“奖励努力工作和投资的人;,这很令人满意，但同时它也会造成关于无生产力的忧虑。

meaning: n. 产品，制品；（自然、化学或工业过程的）生成物；（特定行动、影响或事件的）结局；（受某种环境或经历影响而形成的）产物；积，乘积；总称（商业性）音乐制品
definition: 1. n. commodities offered for sale；2. n. an artifact that has been created by someone or some process
example: and then use the proceeds, use the profits that you make from selling the product to make the product better.
exampleZh: 然后用得到的钱，用销售产品的收入和利润来改进产品。

meaning: n. （尤指需要长期训练和正规资格的）职业；（某）职业界同行，同业；（统称，指需要较高教育水平的）职业（the professions）；（信念、观点或感情的）公开表示，表白；入教誓言，修道誓约；入教仪式，入教
definition: 1. n. the body of people in a learned occupation；2. n. an occupation requiring special education (especially in the liberal arts or sciences)
example: I think people here in all levels of the profession are more educated than in Brazil.
exampleZh: 我觉得这儿各个职业层次的人都比在巴西受到的教育好。

meaning: adj. 职业的，专业的；非常内行的，极为称职的；（人）职业性的，非业余的；由职业人员参加的；（人）坚持某种活动特征（或特点）的；n. 专业人员，专业人士；内行，专家；职业选手；（受雇于高尔夫或网球协会的）职业教练
definition: 1. n. a person engaged in one of the learned professions；2. adj. engaged in a profession or engaging in as a profession or means of livelihood
example: We're trying to teach you some chemistry, but I'm also trying to teach you how to transform into a standalone professional.
exampleZh: 我们会教化学，但是我也会教你们如何成为,一个独立的专业人士。

meaning: n. 教授；（大学的）讲师，教员；信仰表示者，宣称信仰者
definition: 1. n. someone who is a member of the faculty at a college or university
example: Isn't it difficult being a mother and a professor at the same time and keeping a balance between the two?
exampleZh: 同时做母亲和教授是不是很困难呢？两者之间取得平衡不容易吧？

meaning: adj. 熟练的，精通的；n. 专家，能手
definition: 1. adj. having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
example: Until you're a proficient reader of a language, writing in our language is a fool's errand.
exampleZh: 你只有成为一个熟练的读者，才有可能成为一个好的作者。

meaning: n. 熟练，精通
definition: 1. n. the quality of having great facility and competence；2. n. skillfulness in the command of fundamentals deriving from practice and familiarity
example: I am fully fluent in English and Spanish and have a working proficiency in French.
exampleZh: 我精通英语和西班牙语，法语也达到了工作熟练的水平。

meaning: n. （人头部的）侧面（像），侧影；（某物的）外形，轮廓；（人、团体或组织的）简介，概况；（人或组织的）形象，姿态；纵断面，剖面；（地球表面纵断面的）轮廓（如河流走向）；（舞台的）平面布景；（以数量形式记录事物特点的）曲线图，数据图表；（记载个人心理或行为特点、喜好等的）档案；v. 概述，扼要介绍；给……画侧面像，显出……侧面轮廓；显出……的轮廓（be profiled）；（尤指用模板）铣出轮廓，使……成形
definition: 1. a short description of someone's life, work, character, etc.；2. information about a person's life, work, interests, etc. on a social media website
example: So in the textbook, you'll sometimes see the term a strategy profile or a strategy vector, or a strategy list.
exampleZh: 你会看到有的课本中称它为,策略组合,策略向量或者策略列表

meaning: n. 利润，盈利； 利益，好处；v. 获益，得益（于）；赢利，获利；【名】 （Profit）（法）普罗菲（人名）
definition: 1. n. the excess of revenues over outlays in a given period of time (including depreciation and other non-cash expenses)；2. v. derive a benefit from
example: Now incidentally, in a for-profit corporation-- this is how to understand this, this is a concept that is enshrined in law.
exampleZh: 顺便提一下,在一家盈利性公司中,我们需要这样理解,这是个在法律中明文昭示的概念

meaning: adj. 盈利的，有利可图的；有益的，有用的
definition: 1. adj. yielding material gain or profit；2. adj. promoting benefit or gain
example: We made a big bet against Internet stocks in 1999 and 2000 that was very profitable for the University.
exampleZh: 999年和2000年我们大幅做空互联网股票,为学校赚得了很多利润

meaning: adj. （影响）深刻的，极大的；（感情）强烈的，深切的；（思想）深邃的，（见解）深刻的；深的，深处的；完全的；艰深的，玄奥的；（疾病，残疾）严重的
definition: 1. adj. showing intellectual penetration or emotional depths; from the depths of your being；2. adj. of the greatest intensity; complete
example: Recent studies have borne out claims that certain perfumes can bring about profound psychological changes.
exampleZh: 最近的研究已经证实了某些香水能导致深刻的心理变化的说法。

meaning: n. （计算机）程序（=programme）；计划，规划；（音乐会、戏剧等演出的）节目单，（体育运动、比赛等的）项目介绍；（电视或广播）节目；课程，大纲；v. （给计算机）编写程序，设计程序；设置，预设；使……有倾向；为……安排节目
definition: 1. n. a system of projects or services intended to meet a public need；2. v. arrange a program of or for
example: Right, leading trips everywhere from 7 days to 78 days, and so it was an extended wilderness tracking program.
exampleZh: 的确，我需要带领学生们远足，时间由7天到78天不等，这是一个长时间探寻野外的项目。

meaning: n. 进步，进展；前进，行进；（社会的）进步；v. 进步，进展；使（任务，事业）取得持续进展；（时间）推移，流逝；缓慢行进；（占星）计算行星（或星象图各星及坐标）的位置；【名】 （Progress）（赞）普罗格雷斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. gradual improvement or growth or development；2. v. develop in a positive way
example: Of course, the problems are not damning; they're problems that reflect the progress yet needed to be made in insurance.
exampleZh: 当然,这些问题并不是非常糟糕的,这些问题反映了,保险行业中还有待改进之处

meaning: adj. 进步的，先进的；逐步发生的，逐步发展的；向前移动的；（音乐）现代的，新潮的；（税制，税种）累进的；（动词）进行式的；（纸牌游戏，舞蹈）搭档轮换的；n. 进步分子，改革派人士；进行时（或体）；（印刷）分色打样
definition: 1. n. a tense of verbs used in describing action that is on-going；2. adj. favoring or promoting progress
example: Willan was able to point to the progressive changes he had already introduced.
exampleZh: 威兰能够指出他已经带来的有进步意义的变化。

meaning: n. 发展，前进；一系列；（从一音或和弦进至另一音或和弦的）进行；占卜术
definition: 1. n. a series with a definite pattern of advance；2. n. a movement forward
example: This article focuses on the regulation of CAK activity via its three subunits and its regulation on the cell cycle progression.
exampleZh: 本文重点探讨通过CAK的三个亚基实现的CAK活性调控，以及其对细胞周期进程的调控作用。

meaning: v. （通过法律、条例等）禁止；阻止，使不可能
definition: 1. v. command against
example: Surfwatch allows parents to prohibit access to specific web sites, newsgroups, and bulletin boards.
exampleZh: 过滤器软件可以让父母禁止对特定的网站、新闻组和电子布告栏的访问。

meaning: n. 禁令，禁律；禁止；（上级法院禁止下级法院对无权受理案件审理的）诉讼中止令；（1920至1933年美国的）禁酒时期（Prohibition）
definition: 1. n. a law forbidding the sale of alcoholic beverages；2. n. a decree that prohibits something
example: Once during prohibition, I was forced to live for days on nothing but food and water.
exampleZh: 在禁酒令时期，有一次我连续好几天除了食物和水之外什么都没有，只能靠它们维生。

meaning: adj. （费用或价格）高得令人望而却步的；限制性的，禁止的；（情况、局势等）阻止某人做某事的，令人望而却步的；几乎可以肯定的
definition: 1. adj. tending to discourage (especially of prices)
example: While this may be so, it does not, in itself, prove that healthy diets are necessarily more expensive or cost prohibitive.
exampleZh: 虽然这可能是这样，但它本身并不能证明健康饮食必然更昂贵或成本过高。

meaning: n. 项目，计划；（学校的）课题，研究项目；廉租房区，公共房屋区；v. 预计，推算；计划，规划；伸出，突出；投掷，喷射；投射，投影；展现，表现；使（声音，尤指嗓音）扩及远处；传播；想像（自己、场景等）在另一地点或时间；（尤指无意地把情感、愿望）投射转移（给别人）；使（某人）迅速成功，让（某人）获得更好的工作；作（曲线）的射影图；把（地球，天空等）投影在平面上
definition: 1. n. any piece of work that is undertaken or attempted；2. v. communicate vividly
example: Now it's not entirely clear that Milton has been successful in sufficiently vilifying Mammon's project of the excavation of riches.
exampleZh: 现在尚不清楚弥尔顿是否成功地,有力地咒骂贪神挖掘财富的这一行径。

meaning: n. 放映机，投影仪；探照灯；计划者，规划者；【名】 （Projector）（英）普罗杰克特（人名）
definition: 1. n. an optical device for projecting a beam of light；2. n. an optical instrument that projects an enlarged image onto a screen
example: Our host ran a long extension cord out from the house and set up a screen and a projector.
exampleZh: 我们的主人从那所房子里牵出了一条长的延长导线，安置了一块屏幕和一个投影仪。

meaning: n. 估算，预测；投射，投影；（声音的）发送，放开；（思想感情的）体现，形象化；投射（不自觉地把自己的欲念等加诸他人）；凸出物，隆起物；（地球或天体在平面上的）投射；投影图；规划
definition: 1. n. a prediction made by extrapolating from past observations；2. n. the projection of an image from a film onto a screen
example: The idea of God is a projection of humans' need to have something greater than themselves.
exampleZh: 人类需要有强于自身的形象，上帝就是这个想法的投射。

meaning: v. 拉长，拖长（感觉或活动）；延长
definition: 1. to make something last a longer time
example: We know what to do to prevent infections and save or prolong lives.
exampleZh: 我们知道该怎么做来预防感染并且拯救或者延长生命。

meaning: adj. 重要的，著名的；显眼的，突出的；突起的，高耸的；n. 舟蛾（=prominent moth）
definition: 1. adj. having a quality that thrusts itself into attention；2. adj. conspicuous in position or importance
example: But they're, I think, the two most prominent positions and definitely the ones most worth taking seriously for our purposes.
exampleZh: 但我想,它们是,两个最突出的观点,并且绝对是,在我们解答问题上值得严肃对待的观点

meaning: n. 重要，著名；突起，凸出；（尤指地形或身体部位）凸出物；日珥
definition: 1. n. the state of being prominent: widely known or eminent；2. n. relative importance
example: The city rose to prominence under Pakal, a club-footed king who reigned from 615 to 683 AD.
exampleZh: 这座城市在巴加尔的统治下声名鹊起，巴加尔是一位跛足的国王，他在公元615年到683年在位。

meaning: v. 承诺，保证；使很可能，预示；指望，期待（promise oneself）；把（某人，尤指女人）许配给；有指望，有前途；n. 承诺，诺言；前途，指望；迹象，预示
definition: 1. n. a verbal commitment by one person to another agreeing to do (or not to do) something in the future；2. v. make a promise or commitment
example: She represents a power that might enable Milton perhaps someday actually to fulfill, to consummate his much-anticipated poetic promise.
exampleZh: 她象征着一种力量,也许有一天那力量可以，使弥尔顿圆满完成他那备受期待的理想诺言。

meaning: adj. 有希望的，有前途的；v. 承诺，答应；使很可能，预示（promise 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. showing possibility of achievement or excellence；2. adj. full or promise
example: She is among the most promising players in her age group.
exampleZh: 在她那个年龄组中她是最有前途的选手之一。

meaning: v. 促进，提倡；升职，晋升；促销，推广； 将（运动队）晋级；使（学生）升年级；负责筹办，主办（大型活动，如音乐会或体育比赛）；促使（议会私法议案）通过；使（卒）升格为（尤指后等）；（先打大牌）使（小牌）赢得一墩；使（催化剂）更活泼
definition: 1. v. contribute to the progress or growth of；2. v. give a promotion to or assign to a higher position
example: She refused to promote Colin above the low rank of "legal adviser."
exampleZh: 她拒绝提升科林，只让他做低级别的“法律顾问”。

meaning: n. 提拔，晋升；促销，推销； 促进，提倡；（体育运动队的）晋级，升级；（为获利而举办的）体育赛事（尤指系列拳击赛）；（化学）助催化
definition: 1. n. a message issued in behalf of some product or cause or idea or person or institution；2. n. act of raising in rank or position
example: So, electron promotion does not happen in terms of nitrogen, because it would not increased our number of unpaired electrons.
exampleZh: 这里对于氮原子不会有电子激发，因为这不会增加,未配对电子的数目。

meaning: v. 促使，导致；鼓励，提示（说话者）；（计算机上）提示；（给演员）提词，提白；n. （给演员的）提词；（计算机屏幕上显示准备接受指令的）提示； 鼓励，催促；（付款通知单上的）付款期限；adj. 迅速的，立刻的；（人）利索的，敏捷的；及时的，准时的；（商品）即期要送的，即期要付的；adv. 准时地
definition: 1. n. a cue given to a performer (usually the beginning of the next line to be spoken)；2. v. give an incentive for action
example: ArgC How many words were typed at the prompt, by default, Arg C, should always be at least one.
exampleZh: 提示符那里默认要输入多少单词，至少需要一个单词。

meaning: adj. 有做……倾向的，易于……的；俯卧的，趴着的；（前臂姿势）手心向下的；v. （尤指面部向下）使俯卧，趴着；n. （Prone）（意、阿根、法、美、巴西）普罗内（人名）
definition: 1. likely to show a particular characteristic, usually a negative one, or to be affected by something bad, such as damage or an illness；2. lying face down
example: Then there are other people who are pretty careful about what they eat and they're still prone to gaining weight.
exampleZh: 还有一类人非常注意控制饮食,但是仍然容易发胖

meaning: n. 代词
definition: 1. n. a function word that is used in place of a noun or noun phrase
example: In 'the man who came', 'who' is a relative pronoun and 'who came' is a relative clause.
exampleZh: 在the man who came中，who是关系代词，而who came是关系从句。

meaning: v. 发（音），读（音）；正式宣布（或公布、授予等）；发表意见，表态
definition: 1. v. speak, pronounce, or utter in a certain way；2. v. pronounce judgment on
example: Schindler in the Holocaust, and then the other guy, in and I can't pronounce his name Rusesabagina, in Rwanda.
exampleZh: 大屠杀中的辛德勒,以及另外一个人,我不知道他的名字怎么发音,卢斯赛伯吉纳,在卢旺达

meaning: n. 发音方法，读法；（某人的）发音
definition: 1. n. the manner in which someone utters a word；2. n. the way a word or a language is customarily spoken
example: You could read some rules on pronunciation, you can try to practise those on your own.
exampleZh: 你可以先学习一些发音规则，然后尝试着自己进行练习。

meaning: n. 证明，证据；检验，证实；（数学）验算，验证；校样，样张；（酒的）标准酒精度；法官单独听证；adj. 防……的，耐……的；试印的；v. 保护……免受影响（或损害）；印……的校样；校对；加水使（酵母）活化；揉（面团）；（面团）发酵
definition: 1. n. any factual evidence that helps to establish the truth of something；2. v. make or take a proof of, such as a photographic negative, an etching, or typeset
example: because there actually is no proof of any social deviance or destruction of people with it.
exampleZh: 因为没有证据真正表明同性恋者有任何社会异常行为和破坏力。

meaning: v. 校对，校阅
definition: 1. to find and correct mistakes in text before it is printed or put online；2. to read and correct a piece of written work
example: I didn't even have the chance to proofread my own report.
exampleZh: 我甚至没有机会校对自己的报告。

meaning: n. 支柱，支撑物；（戏剧或电影中的）道具； 道具管理员（props）；支持者，后盾； 螺旋桨，推进器；（英式橄榄球运动的）前排边锋；（本身没有具体意义但能使句法完整的）结构词；（马快跑时的）骤停；v. 支撑，倚靠；（尤指马等挺直前腿）骤停；用……撑住（某物）
definition: 1. to support something physically, often by leaning it against something else or putting something under it；2. an object used by the actors performing in a play or film
example: I lie still for a minute until I can breathe normally, then stretch my arms out to prop myself up.
exampleZh: 我静静地躺了一会儿直到我能正常呼吸，然后伸出胳膊把自己支撑起来。

meaning: n. 宣传，鼓吹；（罗马天主教的）传信部（Propaganda）
definition: 1. information, ideas, opinions, or images, often only giving one part of an argument, that are broadcast, published, or in some other way spread with the intention of influencing people's opinions；2. information, ideas, opinions, or images that give one part of an argument, which are broadcast, published, etc. in order to influence people's opinions
example: Every conceivable Protestant sect was publishing treatises of theological speculation and publishing treatises of religious propaganda at an extraordinary rate.
exampleZh: 任何能想到的新教徒的宗教派别都在以不同寻常的,速度出版神学思考著作和,宗教宣传著作。

meaning: v. 散播，宣传（观点、信仰等）；传播（运动、光线、声音等）；（动植物等）繁殖，使繁殖
definition: 1. to produce a new plant using a parent plant；2. (of a plant or animal) to produce young plants or animals
example: The easiest way to propagate a vine is to take hardwood cuttings.
exampleZh: 繁殖葡萄藤最容易的办法就是采取硬木扦插。

meaning: n. （动植物等的）繁殖，增殖，；（观点、理论等的）传播；（运动、光线、声音等的）传送
definition: 1. the act of producing a new plant from a parent plant；2. the producing of young plants or animals
example: One of the great successes of the Republican Party in recent decades is the relentless propagation of a simple formula for economic growth: tax cuts.
exampleZh: 近几十年来，共和党最大的成功之一就是坚持不懈地宣传一个简单的经济增长公式：减税。

meaning: v. 推进，驱动；推搡（某人走向特定方向）； 驱使，促使
definition: 1. to push or move something somewhere, often with a lot of force；2. to cause someone to do an activity or be in a situation
example: The tiny rocket is attached to the spacecraft and is designed to propel it toward Mars.
exampleZh: 微型火箭附在宇宙飞船上，用来推进飞船飞向火星。

meaning: n. （飞机或轮船的）螺旋桨，推进器
definition: 1. a device that causes a ship or aircraft to move, consisting of two or more blades that spin at high speed
example: With a low-pitched rumbling noise, the propeller began to rotate.
exampleZh: 随着低沉的隆隆声，螺旋桨开始旋转起来。

meaning: adj. 真正的，像样的；实际上的，严格意义上的；正确的，合适的；合理的，合乎体统的；非常有礼貌的，循规蹈矩的； 特有的，专有的；完全的，彻底的； 用于强调地道的；（圣诗、教义、祷词等）用于某特定场合的；（纹章）原色的；（数）真的，正常的；adv. 完全地，彻底地； 正确地，恰当地；n. 特定季节（或节日）的礼仪；【名】 （Proper）（英、德）普罗珀（人名）
definition: 1. adj. marked by suitability or rightness or appropriateness；2. adj. limited to the thing specified
example: We'll get into the proper or at least more systematic business of the course when we turn to hermeneutics next week.
exampleZh: 下周我们讲到阐释学的时候,将会真正地或者说更系统地对这门课程进行讲解。

meaning: n. 所有物，财产；地产，房地产；房地产股票（或投资）（properties）； 所有权，处置权；特性，性质
definition: 1. n. any area set aside for a particular purpose；2. n. something owned; any tangible or intangible possession that is owned by someone
example: The word "property" is really important to connect the concept of property with something fundamental in the make-up, in the constitution.
exampleZh: 特性这个词真的很重要,将特性的概念和,组成和构造里主要的部分联系起来。

meaning: n. 部分，份额；比例；正确的比例，均衡；大小，程度（proportions）；（事情的）重要性，严重性；等比关系；v. 使（某物）成比例，使相称；分摊
definition: 1. n. the quotient obtained when the magnitude of a part is divided by the magnitude of the whole；2. v. give pleasant proportions to
example: But I think there are substantial proportion of faculty who really do have a commitment defined in different ways.
exampleZh: 但我认为确实相当一部分教职工,虽然有不同的理解，但能做到尽职尽责。

meaning: adj. 成比例的；相称的，协调的；（数）成常比的；n. （数）比例项
definition: 1. n. one of the quantities in a mathematical proportion；2. adj. properly related in size or degree or other measurable characteristics; usually followed by `to'
example: Their system seems to combine the two ideals of strong government and proportional representation.
exampleZh: 他们的体制似乎同时具有强有力的政府与比例代表制这两种理想状况。

meaning: v. 提议，建议；提出（理论或解释）；提名，推荐；计划，打算；求婚；（向立法机构或委员会）提交（动议）；提议祝（酒）
definition: 1. v. make a proposal, declare a plan for something；2. v. present for consideration
example: And so with this example here, I thought I'd propose that we consider exactly how you'd go about tackling something like this.
exampleZh: 有了这个例子，我想我们可以,考虑一下应该如何下手,解决这样的问题。

meaning: n. 提议，建议；提案；（计划、建议等的）提出；求婚
definition: 1. n. something proposed (such as a plan or assumption)；2. n. an offer of marriage
example: That means that the different regulators should each have their own objective, so they have a three-part proposal.
exampleZh: 也就是说每一环节上的,调控者都要有自己的目标，这个计划将分为三部分。

meaning: n. 主张，观点；（尤指商业或政治上的）提议，建议；（美国的）法律修正案；欲做的事，待处理的问题；（数学或逻辑）命题；（尤指被视作有冒犯性的）性交提议，求欢；v. 向（某人）提议；（尤指冒犯地）提出与……性交，向……求欢
definition: 1. n. (logic) a statement that affirms or denies something and is either true or false；2. v. suggest sex to
example: Sterling reflected on this "put up or shut up" proposition.
exampleZh: 斯特林认真思考了一下这个“要么说话，要么闭嘴”的提议。

meaning: n. 散文，白话文；（尤指待翻译的）一段散文；平淡乏味的文章（或话语，表达法）；v. 冗长乏味地说； 把……写成散文，把……改写成散文；写散文；adj. 散文的，散文式的；平凡的，乏味的
definition: 1. n. ordinary writing as distinguished from verse；2. n. matter of fact, commonplace, or dull expression
example: Most of the play is written in verse, but some of it is in prose.
exampleZh: 这剧本大部分是用韵文写的，不过有一些是用散文。

meaning: v. 起诉，控告，检举；（律师在法庭上）指控，公诉；继续（尤指战争）；继续从事（某职业），追求
definition: 1. to officially accuse someone of committing a crime in a law court, or (of a lawyer) to try to prove that a person accused of committing a crime is guilty of that crime；2. to continue to take part in a planned group of activities, especially a war
example: The police have decided not to prosecute because the evidence is not strong enough.
exampleZh: 警方已决定不起诉，因为证据不够充分。

meaning: n. 起诉，诉讼；原告，控方；从事，进行
definition: 1. the act of prosecuting someone；2. the lawyers in a court case who represent the side that accuses someone of committing a crime
example: Failure to comply with the regulations will result in prosecution.
exampleZh: 不遵守规章制度将被起诉。

meaning: n. 可能性，希望；预期，展望；（尤指事业的）成功机会，前景；有望成功的人，有前途的人；可能的顾客，潜在的主顾；（尤指从高处看到的）景象，景色；潜在矿藏或矿床；v. 勘探，勘察；寻找（商业机会）
definition: 1. n. the possibility of future success；2. v. search for something desirable
example: Different former colleague of mine once talked about the prospect of having a kind of heavenly vision of the divine.
exampleZh: 一位前任同事曾和我谈及,一种天堂似的,上帝的生活。

meaning: adj. 有希望的，潜在的； 可能发生的，预期的
definition: 1. adj. concerned with or related to the future；2. adj. anticipated for the near future
example: A prospective premium of about 30 percent on their initial investment is enticing.
exampleZh: 初始投资30％左右的预期收益是诱人的。

meaning: v. 繁荣，成功；蓬勃发展，健康成长；使成功，使兴旺；【名】 （Prosper）（英、德、罗、法）普罗斯珀（人名）
definition: 1. (of a person or a business) to be or become successful, especially financially；2. to be successful, esp. financially
example: The town of Breckenridge and its namesake ski area could prosper under the plan.
exampleZh: 按照这一方案，布雷肯里奇镇及与其同名的滑雪区将会繁荣起来。

meaning: n. 繁荣，成功
definition: 1. the state of being successful and having a lot of money；2. a situation in which people are successful and have a lot of money
example: and that's spreading. This prosperity preaching is going on in Africa. And my question is, where does that leave suffering?
exampleZh: 这种劲头越来越大，这种追求繁荣的论调,甚至在非洲都出现了，我想问的是，在这样的大背景下，受苦还能存在么？

meaning: adj. 繁荣的，富足的
definition: 1. successful, usually by earning a lot of money；2. rich and successful
example: Barcelona has become one of the most dynamic and prosperous cities in the Mediterranean.
exampleZh: 巴塞罗那已经成为地中海地区最具活力、最为繁荣的城市之一。

meaning: v. 保护，防护；（制订法律）保护；投保，为……买保险；对……实行贸易保护；（计算机）保护（数据或储存库）；防守
definition: 1. v. shield from danger, injury, destruction, or damage；2. v. use tariffs to favor domestic industry
example: How would you recommend that investors protect their wealth during this period to ? take advantage of upcoming investment opportunities?
exampleZh: 那你对投资者在这段时间内,如何保护他们的财产并且,进一步利用这即将到来的投资机会有什么建议呢？

meaning: n. 保护，防护；保护物，护身符；保险；避孕（措施）；保护费；贸易保护，关税保护制；保护条例，保护措施；（登山）安全保护器材数量与质量
definition: 1. n. the activity of protecting someone or something；2. n. a covering that is intend to protect from damage or injury
example: One of my favorite stories is, William Ruckelshaus, William Ruckelshaus who was head of the Environmental Protection Agency in the early 1970s.
exampleZh: 我最喜欢的一个故事，是讲,他是20世纪70年代时候的,环境保护机构的会长。

meaning: adj. 保护的，防护的；呵护的，有保护欲的；有贸易保护倾向的，实行关税保护的；n. 保护物，防护物；避孕套
definition: 1. adj. intended or adapted to afford protection of some kind；2. adj. showing a care
example: It's folly to think that we have about us protective spirits who might actually keep us from harm.
exampleZh: 认为真的有神灵在周围,庇佑我们不受伤害是愚蠢的。

meaning: n. 蛋白质，朊；adj. 蛋白质的
definition: 1. n. any of a large group of nitrogenous organic compounds that are essential constituents of living cells; consist of polymers of amino acids; essential in the diet of animals for growth and for repair of tissues; can be obtained from meat and eggs and milk and legumes
example: It lists the protein but not the percent daily value, so you noted something interesting about the food label.
exampleZh: 这里列出了蛋白质却没写其日摄取百分比,你注意到了食品标签里一个有趣的现象

meaning: n. 抗议，反对；抗议活动；声明，断言；（多指来自公证人的）拒付证书；v. （公开）反对，抗议；坚决表示，严正申明； 声明拒付（账单），拒付
definition: 1. n. a formal and solemn declaration of objection；2. v. utter words of protest
example: And reservations, formal protest against this article are the most numerous from countries, from every region of the world.
exampleZh: 而对这项条款的保留意见和正式抗议,是最多的,并且来自世界各地。

meaning: n. 礼仪，礼节；国际议定书，协议；条约草案，（协议或条约的）附件；（协定，公约）修正案（或增补）；（数据传递的）协议，规约；科学实验计划，医疗方案；（科学实验结果的）官方记录；v. 以协议形式发布；拟定
definition: 1. the system of rules and acceptable behaviour used at official ceremonies and occasions；2. a rule or set of rules for a scientific or medical process
example: But as we saw, you know, a lot of the framework of the Kyoto Protocol
exampleZh: 但是，正如我们所看到的，像京都议定书这样的框架，

meaning: n. （新型汽车、机器等的）原型，雏形；典型，范例；蓝本，最初形态；（电子）原型滤波网络；（生物、天体等的）原始型；（建筑、汽车等的）全真模型；v. 制作（产品的）原型
definition: 1. the first example of something, such as a machine or other industrial product, from which all later forms are developed；2. the first example of a machine or other industrial product, from which all later forms are developed
example: Chris Retzler has built a prototype of a machine called the wave rotor.
exampleZh: 克里斯·雷兹勒做出了一台叫做波转子的样机。

meaning: v. 证实，证明；证明是，结果是；显示（自己的）才干（或勇气）（prove oneself）； 检验，认证（遗嘱）；（用数学或科学原理）证明，验算；试（枪），查验；（面团）发酵
definition: 1. v. be shown or be found to be；2. v. establish the validity of something, as by an example, explanation or experiment
example: Milton elaborates on this claim that we should read and prove anything we want, for we are sufficient to judge aright.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿详尽阐明了这个论点，我们应该多读书,去求证自己想知道的所有事，因此我们才能够做正确的判断。

meaning: n. 谚语，格言；典型，模范；vt. 用谚语表达
definition: 1. n. a condensed but memorable saying embodying some important fact of experience that is taken as true by many people
example: An old Arab proverb says, "The enemy of my enemy is my friend."
exampleZh: 有一句古老的阿拉伯谚语说：“我敌人的敌人是我的朋友。”

meaning: adj. 谚语的，俗话所说的；众所周知的；n. （常用于委婉替代谚语或成语中未出现的词）那东西，那玩意儿
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to or resembling or expressed in a proverb；2. adj. widely known and spoken of
example: Signs of danger abound, but like the proverbial slow-boiling frog, we seem unable to rouse ourselves.
exampleZh: 危险的迹象比比皆是，但就像谚语中说的“温水煮青蛙”，我们似乎无法唤醒自己。

meaning: v. 提供，供给；配备，准备好；（法律或规章）规定；供养，提供生计；为（可能事件）作充分准备；任命（牧师）担任有俸神职
definition: 1. v. provide or furnish with；2. v. provide what is desired or needed, especially support, food or sustenance
example: So I figured it... I may as well apply to these universities which provide really good financial aid.
exampleZh: 所以，我就想我应该申请这些能给予丰厚补助的学校。

meaning: n. 提供，供应；准备，预备；（尤指为旅行准备的）食物，必需品（provisions）；条款，规定；赡养，供养；（机构账户上为已知负债，尤指坏账或资产价值缩减，从利润中留出的）准备金；神职委任（尤指教皇对尚未缺额神职的预先委任）；v. 为……提供所需物品（尤指食物）；（为已知债务）留出准备金
definition: 1. n. a stipulated condition；2. v. supply with provisions
example: One provision of the law was to roll back taxes to the 1975 level.
exampleZh: 该法律的一项条款是把税收削减至1975年的水平。

meaning: conj. 假如，只要，在……条件下；v. 提供；规定；为（可能事件）作充分准备（provide 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. v. provide or furnish with；2. v. provide what is desired or needed, especially support, food or sustenance
example: Orpheus had provided Milton with a paradigm of the poet, the poet whose discipline and whose abstinence nourished and strengthened his poetry.
exampleZh: 俄耳甫斯在弥尔顿看来是诗人的模范,他严于律己，节制禁欲，让诗作更加出色。

meaning: n. （知识、兴趣、责任的）范围，领域；省；（由大主教负责管辖的）教省；外省，外地（the provinces）； 北爱尔兰（the Province）；（古罗马总督统治的意大利境外的）行省
definition: 1. n. the territory occupied by one of the constituent administrative districts of a nation；2. n. the proper sphere or extent of your activities
example: The economy of the province was atypical because it was particularly small.
exampleZh: 该省的经济并不算典型，因为它的规模特别小。

meaning: adj. 省的；外省的，地方的；守旧的，偏狭的；n. 乡下人，外省人（常用作贬义，表示某人兴趣狭隘或偏狭守旧）；（国家、帝国的）省内居民；（相对于全国性报纸而言的）地方报纸（provincials）；（管辖教省的）大主教（或都主教）
definition: 1. n. (Roman Catholic Church) an official in charge of an ecclesiastical province acting under the superior general of a religious order；2. adj. of or associated with a province
example: There is no sign of an end to the standoff between Mohawk Indians and the Quebec provincial police.
exampleZh: 莫霍克印第安人和魁北克省警方之间的僵局没有结束的迹象。

meaning: v. 激起，引起；激励，刺激；挑衅，激怒
definition: 1. v. call forth (emotions, feelings, and responses)；2. v. evoke or provoke to appear or occur
example: They accused both radicals and conservatives of trying to provoke a split in the party.
exampleZh: 他们指责激进人士和保守人士都企图挑起党内分歧。

meaning: n. 激怒，挑衅，挑衅性事件； 挑衅（行为或语言）；（尤指蓄意的）性挑逗；（诱发反应或反射作用的）激发试验
definition: 1. n. unfriendly behavior that causes anger or resentment；2. n. something that incites or provokes; a means of arousing or stirring to action
example: He denies murder on the grounds of provocation.
exampleZh: 他以受到了挑衅为理由而否认谋杀。

meaning: adj. 挑衅的，煽动性的；挑逗的，激发性欲的；引发思考的，启发性的；n. 刺激物，挑拨物
definition: 1. adj. serving or tending to provoke, excite, or stimulate; stimulating discussion or exciting controversy；2. adj. exciting sexual desire
example: He has made a string of outspoken and sometimes provocative speeches in recent years.
exampleZh: 他最近几年做了一系列直言不讳的、有时带有挑衅的演说。

meaning: adj. （原因）直接的；（时间、顺序或亲属关系）最近的，最接近的；接近正确的，大约的；极相似的 ；极相似的
definition: 1. closest in time, place, relationship, etc. to something
example: In nearly every startup that fails, the proximate cause is running out of money.
exampleZh: 几乎每场失败的创业都是直接因为资金断档造成的。

meaning: n. （时间、空间、关系的）靠近，亲近
definition: 1. the state of being near in space or time
example: But there's a lot of evidence that similarity, above and beyond proximity, has an effect on attractiveness and on liking.
exampleZh: 但有很多证据表明，相似性，远不同于邻近性，前者会影响吸引和喜欢。

meaning: n. 精神病学，精神病治疗学
definition: 1. the part of medicine that deals with and treats mental illness
example: Recent advances in psychiatry have improved treatment options for patients whose conditions were once considered untreatable.
exampleZh: 精神病学的最新进展为一些病情曾被认为无法治疗的患者提供了更多治疗选择。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: adj. 精神病学的，精神病治疗的；精神疾病的
definition: 1. of or relating to the treatment or study of mental illness
example: How many people know that three times a week physical exercise,30 minutes each time has the same effect ? as our most powerful psychiatric drugs?
exampleZh: 多少人知道，每周三次,体育锻炼，每次三十分钟，与最强劲的精神药物,有同样的效果？

meaning: n. 精神病学家，精神科医生
definition: 1. a doctor who is also trained in psychiatry
example: One forensic psychiatrist described him as having an incurable antisocial personality disorder.
exampleZh: 一位法庭精神病医生将他描述为患有不可治愈反社会人格障碍。

meaning: n. 心理学；心理特点，心理状态；心理影响；心计，善解人意
definition: 1. n. the science of mental life
example: A psychology that will look at also things that work, that were not just study-- depression, anxiety, schizophrenia and neurosis.
exampleZh: 需要着眼于有用的东西，不仅仅是研究-,抑郁，焦虑，精神分裂，神经症。

meaning: adj. 心理的，精神的；心理学的，关于心理学的；由焦虑（或悲伤）引起的，存在于心理上的
definition: 1. adj. mental or emotional as opposed to physical in nature；2. adj. of or relating to or determined by psychology
example: We then promised to move to an emphasis on psychological matters, and finally social and cultural determinants of literature.
exampleZh: 然后我们把重点转移到了心理学，最后还讨论了社会和文化对文学的决定因素。

meaning: n. 心理学家
definition: 1. n. a scientist trained in psychology
example: Shafir is a young psychologist at Princeton who teamed up with the old psychologist Tversky and wrote this paper.
exampleZh: 年轻的心理学家沙菲尔任职于普林斯顿大学,他与年迈的心理学家特维斯基共同完成了论文

meaning: n. 酒吧，酒馆；酒店，旅馆；路人局（游戏术语）；abbr. 公众的；公开的（public 的缩写）；出版，发行；出版物，发行物；（信息的） 刊登，公布 （publication 的缩写）；（媒体的）关注，报道；宣传业，广告行业；引起公众关注的事物（publicity的缩写）；宣传， 推广；v. 时常出入于酒吧，泡酒吧；【名】 （Pub）（匈）普布（人名）
definition: 1. n. tavern consisting of a building with a bar and public rooms; often provides light meals
example: And then on the way to the hospital they stopped by a pub to have some cider.
exampleZh: 之后在去医院的路上,他们居然还去了一个酒吧喝了点苹果酒

meaning: adj. 公众的，大众的；公共的，公用的；政府的，公众事务的； 大学的，为大学的；（声明、事件等）公开的，公诸于众的；公开场合的，大庭广众的；上市的；众所周知的，广为人知的；n. 公众，大众（the public）；志趣相投（或从事同一类活动、具有共同特征）的群体；（对某个艺术家、作家或表演家感兴趣的）读者，观众（one's public）；（酒馆中的）低价吧台（=public bar），酒吧（=public house）；公共场所；【名】 （Public）（英）帕布利克（人名）
definition: 1. n. people in general considered as a whole；2. adj. not private; open to or concerning the people as a whole
example: And so I live with a, with a friend who's actually in another graduate school who's doing public health.
exampleZh: 我和一个朋友一起住。他和我就读的研究生院不同，他是公共卫生专业的研究生。

meaning: v. 宣传，公布
definition: 1. v. make public；2. v. call attention to
example: Send out a media advisory on your group's letterhead if you have an upcoming event you wish to publicize.
exampleZh: 如果你有一场即将举办的活动想要宣传，请用你所在团体的信头发布一份媒体通稿。

meaning: n. （媒体的）关注，报道；宣传， 推广；宣传业，广告行业；宣传品，广告；引起公众关注的事物
definition: 1. n. a message issued in behalf of some product or cause or idea or person or institution；2. n. the quality of being open to public view
example: And after the terror attacks, particularly the 7/7 bombings, they got a lot of publicity
exampleZh: 在恐怖袭击以后，特别是七月七日的爆炸事件，他们引起了广泛的关注，

meaning: adv. 公开地，公然地；由政府；由公众；公众可以获取（或购买）地
definition: 1. adv. in a manner accessible to or observable by the public; openly；2. adv. by the public or the people generally
example: Moses reads the book of the covenant--it's called the Scroll of the Covenant--publicly: this is said in Exodus 24:7.
exampleZh: 摩西阅读了契约卷,在《出埃及记》24：7中，也叫立约卷。

meaning: v. 出版，发行（书、杂志等）；（作家、 音乐家等）发表（自己的作品），使（作品）出版；（在互联网上）发表；（在报纸或杂志上）刊登，登载；公布，公开；颁布（法令），宣读（法令，结婚预告）；向第三方传布（诽谤）
definition: 1. v. put into print；2. v. prepare and issue for public distribution or sale
example: I don't actually know whether it's deserved or not, because Yale does not publish information about what the grading averages are.
exampleZh: 我不知道这名声是不是我应得的，因为耶鲁并没有对什么是普通的评分标准,发表文章。

meaning: n. 出版，发行；出版物，发行物；（信息的） 刊登，公布
definition: 1. n. a copy of a printed work offered for distribution；2. n. the act of issuing printed materials
example: Book publication can be just as interesting and it can tell us just as much about modern poetry as magazines.
exampleZh: 图书出版是很有意思的，而且也能像杂志本身那样,告诉我们很多关于现代诗歌的事情。

meaning: n. 布丁（用大米、面包等做成的甜食）；（餐后）冷布丁（一种黏稠的乳脂状甜食）；（餐末的）甜食，甜点；肉馅布丁；血香肠，黑香肠；矮胖子，呆头呆脑的人
definition: 1. a sweet and usually hot dish made with pastry, flour, bread, or rice, and often fruit；2. a sweet, soft food made from milk, sugar, eggs, and flavouring, eaten cold
example: We found the apple pie pudding too good to resist. Sure enough, it was delicious.
exampleZh: 我们觉得这块苹果馅饼布丁令人无法抗拒。果然，它很美味。

meaning: v. 拉，拽；拖动，移走；拔出，抽出；挪动，挣脱；拉开，拉上；牵引（车辆）；吃力地运转；（使车辆）打斜；划（船），划动；（迅速地）穿脱衣服；拉伤，扭伤；扳动，拉（开关）；犯下（罪行），使出（诡计）；吸引，影响；吸引异性；鼓励，为……打气；（把车）停在某处；拆开，拆散；从酒桶中取酒；取消，撤销；深吸烟斗（或烟）（pull at/on）；举止像（某人）；逮捕，拘留；控制（马）的速度；把（球）从前方场地打向外场；（把球）击向左侧（右侧）；打印（草样，校样）；（计算机）拉式检索（数据）；（美橄）侧翼迂回阻挡；n. 拉，拽；力，引力；吸引力，影响；（对他人的）影响力；艰难攀登；拉伤，扭伤；深吸，大口喝；拉手，拉绳，拉环；性引诱；向左侧（右侧）的一击；草样，校样；null；【名】 （Pull）（法）皮尔，（德、瑞典）普尔 （人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of pulling; applying force to move something toward or with you；2. v. cause to move by pulling
example: So in the case of boron here, what we're starting with is the ion, and now we're going to pull one more electron out.
exampleZh: 那么在硼的情况下，我们应该从这个离子开始，现在我们要再拿走一个电子。

meaning: n. 脉搏，脉率； 强劲的音乐节拍，律动；（声波、光波或电流的）脉冲；（生化）（供细胞培养的）冲量； 冲动；共有立场，心态；（喻）（活力或组织的）核心；（可食用的）豆子；v. （有节奏地）搏动，跳动；产生节奏；洋溢着，充满（激情等）；用脉冲调制（波，光束）；应用脉冲信号于（装置）；（生化）用同位素脉冲标记（培养中的细胞）（pulse-label 的简称）；有节奏地驱动（食物搅拌机）
definition: 1. n. (electronics) a sharp transient wave in the normal electrical state (or a series of such transients)；2. v. expand and contract rhythmically; beat rhythmically
example: So we have this pulse, and it's just kind of out there streaming, but we don't like undifferentiated, disorganized material in the West.
exampleZh: 我们拥有这种律动,而且就像泉水一样流淌出来,但在西方国家我们不喜欢,没有差别的,杂乱无章的素材

meaning: n. 泵，抽水机；平底鞋，轻软舞鞋；高跟无带女鞋；抽吸，泵送；（生理）泵（指特定离子逆浓度梯度进行的跨膜主动运输机制）；v. 用泵（或泵样器官等）输送；快速上下（或内外）运动；涌出，涌流； 盘问，套问； 让某人使用大量药物； 举重（pump iron）；给......洗胃； 不断制造（pump out）；大量增加（pump up）；接连发射；【名】 （Pump）（美、俄、印、泰、加）蓬普（人名）
definition: 1. n. a mechanical device that moves fluid or gas by pressure or suction；2. v. operate like a pump; move up and down, like a handle or a pedal
example: That example I gave last time with the bicycle pump was not quite the right example.
exampleZh: 上次我举打气筒的例子,是不太恰当的。

meaning: n. 南瓜，倭瓜；南瓜藤；小南瓜（一种称呼所爱的人的方式）
definition: 1. a large, round vegetable with hard, yellow or orange flesh
example: Pumpkin pie is a traditional American dish served on Thanksgiving.
exampleZh: 南瓜馅饼是美国传统的感恩节食物。

meaning: n. 一拳，一击；（出拳打击时所需要的）力量；感染力，活力；打孔器，穿孔机；孔洞；压印器，冲压机；潘趣酒（由果汁和酒制成的甜味饮品）；庞奇（奇形怪状、钩鼻、驼背的小丑，木偶戏《庞奇和朱迪》中的男主角）（Punch）；（矮壮的）萨福克驮马（Suffolk punch） ；（矮壮的）萨福克驮马（Suffolk punch）；v. 用拳猛击（某人或某物）；按（按钮或键）；（用工具或机器）打孔，扎眼；（用刺棒）赶（牲口） ；（用刺棒）赶（牲口）；【名】 （Punch）（马来）蓬芝，（英）庞奇（人名）
definition: 1. n. (boxing) a blow with the fist；2. v. deliver a quick blow to
example: He said, "I'll pray for him but if he can punch it'll help." In a small respect, that's Machiavelli.
exampleZh: 神父说，我将为他祈祷，但是如果他能出拳猛击,那将会很有帮助，小面上说，这就是马基雅维利。

meaning: adj. 准时的，守时的；精确的；（语法）（动作）瞬息性的
definition: 1. adj. acting or arriving or performed exactly at the time appointed
example: He's always very punctual. I'll see if he's here yet.
exampleZh: 他一向很准时。我要看看他是不是已经来了。

meaning: n. 准时性
definition: 1. n. the quality or habit of adhering to an appointed time
example: He's becoming more and more obsessive about punctuality.
exampleZh: 他对守时要求越来越过分了。

meaning: v. 处罚，惩罚（做错事或犯法的人）；惩处（犯罪行为）；（尤指体育运动中）利用（对手的失误）；粗暴地对待；使遭受严重打击；自责； 贪婪地吃喝；施加惩罚
definition: 1. v. impose a penalty on; inflict punishment on
example: The bill creates an oversight board with the authority to investigate and punish accounting firms.
exampleZh: 该法案创建了一个有权调查并处罚会计师事务所的监督委员会。

meaning: n. 惩罚手段，处罚；粗暴对待，糟蹋
definition: 1. n. the act of punishing
example: Literal punishment: for example, in the Code of Hammurabi, where someone's ox kills a child, then the ox owner's child is killed.
exampleZh: 例如，在汉穆拉比法典里，如果某人的牛,杀死了一个小孩，那么这头牛的主人的小孩也应处死。

meaning: n. 学生，（尤指）小学生；弟子，门生；瞳孔；见习律师；未成年人
definition: 1. n. a learner who is enrolled in an educational institution；2. n. contractile aperture in the iris of the eye
example: These complex formulae are beyond the grasp of the average pupil.
exampleZh: 这些复杂的公式是一般小学生不能理解的。

meaning: n. 购买，采购；购买的东西；（非继承性的）财产置得；紧握，牢牢抓住；（移动重物的）滑轮（或类似装置）；v. 购买，采购；（努力或艰难地）获得，得到；（航海）（用滑轮或杠杆）升起，举起（绳，索，锚）
definition: 1. n. the acquisition of something for payment；2. v. obtain by purchase; acquire by means of a financial transaction
example: When her deal is done, the client emerges with her purchase.
exampleZh: 交易完成后，顾客拿着购买的东西出来了。

meaning: adj. 纯的，不掺杂质的；血统纯的，纯种的；纯真的，贞洁的；干净的，不含有害物质的；无杂色的，清晰而优美的；完全的，纯粹的；（科学或研究）纯理论的，抽象的；（元音）单音的，纯音的；【名】 （Pure）（俄）普雷（人名）
definition: 1. adj. free of extraneous elements of any kind；2. adj. without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
example: It is autonomous in the sense that it is a pure, uncluttered and uninfluenced declaration of fact or falsehood.
exampleZh: 科学是自主的，因为,科学就是单纯的,不受外界影响的，关于真伪的论断。

meaning: n. 洁净，纯净；纯洁，清白 ；（声音、文章、音乐等的）清晰；纯度；n. （Purity）（肯）普丽蒂（人名）
definition: 1. n. being undiluted or unmixed with extraneous material；2. n. the state of being unsullied by sin or moral wrong; lacking a knowledge of evil
example: Purity, which is the absence of impurity, is a prerequisite for access to the holy or for holy status.
exampleZh: 纯洁，不纯的反义词，是接近神圣或达到神圣状态的先决条件。

meaning: v. 使（某物）洁净，净化；变纯净；洗涤（思想），净化（心灵）；提纯，精炼
definition: 1. v. remove impurities from, increase the concentration of, and separate through the process of distillation；2. v. make pure or free from sin or guilt
example: One can also purify parts of the protein, that is, parts of the virus, that is, "Do I really need to deliver the whole virus?"
exampleZh: 人们还可以纯化部分蛋白质,也就是病毒的某些部分来制造疫苗,那么还需要接种完整的病毒吗

meaning: adj. 紫色的，紫红色的；（作品）词藻华丽的，华而不实的；帝王的；n. 紫色，紫红色；紫色衣服（或料子）；（古罗马，拜占庭）紫色衣服（the purple）；（从某些软体动物提取的）深红色染料；（古罗马）要职，高位，拥有特权的职位（the purple）；（红衣主教的）大红袍（the purple）；v. （使）成紫色，（使）发紫
definition: 1. n. a purple color or pigment；2. v. become purple
example: There's a function in purple, there's a string in green, and in black I have the assignment statements.
exampleZh: 还有个粉色的方法，绿色的字符串，赋值声明是黑色的。

meaning: n. 目的，意图；目标，计划；（达到生活中目标的）决心，毅力；（情势等的）需要，用意（purposes）；重要意义，有价值的意义；v. 有意，打算
definition: 1. n. an anticipated outcome that is intended or that guides your planned actions；2. v. propose or intend
example: Second explicate purpose for the education institutions is to allow students to practice and to apply what they've learnt.
exampleZh: 第二个教育体系的,表面目标是,给学生实践的机会,让他们运用所学的知识。

meaning: adj. 有明确目标的，坚决的；故意的，蓄意的；有意义的
definition: 1. adj. serving as or indicating the existence of a purpose or goal；2. adj. having meaning through having an aim
example: And the rejection of this motif or this idea in Genesis 1 is pointed and purposeful. It's demythologization.
exampleZh: 但《创世纪》第一章中对此模式或观点的否定,是明显且有目的的，它是一种去传奇化的叙述。

meaning: n. 钱包，皮夹子（尤指女用的）；（女用）手提包，手袋；资金，财源；（体育竞赛中的）奖金；v. 噘嘴，撮起嘴唇（以表示反对等）
definition: 1. n. a container used for carrying money and small personal items or accessories (especially by women)；2. v. contract one's lips into a rounded shape
example: You don't want to be like "Hey, criminals, come and get my purse."
exampleZh: 你不会想发出这样的信号：“喂，罪犯们，过来呀，来抢我的包吧。”

meaning: v. 追求，致力于，执行；继续探讨（或追究、从事）；追逐，跟踪，追赶；沿着……前行；追求（某人）；力劝（某人）接受聘用
definition: 1. v. carry out or participate in an activity; be involved in；2. v. follow in or as if in pursuit
example: The best of them are winnowed out to pursue further study and eventually assume positions of public leadership and responsibility.
exampleZh: 学习能力最佳的人,会被精选出来深造,最后承继,公共领袖的职位与责任。

meaning: n. 追求，寻找；继续；追逐，追捕；实行，贯彻；消遣，业余爱好；（自行车赛和滑冰竞赛中的）追逐赛；（生理学）追视
definition: 1. n. the act of pursuing in an effort to overtake or capture；2. n. a search for an alternative that meets cognitive criteria
example: Relentless in his pursuit of quality, his technical ability was remarkable.
exampleZh: 由于对质量的坚持不懈的追求，他的技术能力非同凡响。

meaning: v. 推，移动；按；挤，推搡；推动，促使；推销，推广；说服，强迫；鼓励，督促；努力争取；坚持地做；（军队）挺进；赶走；贩卖（毒品）；接近（某年龄或数字）；使（栈）准备接收顶层数据；对（底片）作增感处理；n. 推 ；按；努力；鼓励，敦促；挺进，进攻 ；毅力，进取心；棘手的事
definition: 1. n. the act of applying force in order to move something away；2. v. move with force,
example: and push myself a little bit further than I went the day before and try to get in shape.
exampleZh: 并且让自己总比头一天跑得远些，并且努力保持身材。

meaning: adj. 执意强求的，爱出风头的；野心勃勃的，有进取心的
definition: 1. adj. marked by aggressive ambition and energy and initiative
example: He decides to sort out her life for her, while a pushy Greek chorus dispenses advice from the sidelines.
exampleZh: 他决定帮她理顺一下生活，而一位爱管闲事的希腊剧情解说演员则从旁观者的角度发表了建议。

meaning: v. 放，放置；猛推，用力插入；将……送往，安置；使与……连接，安装；写下；使处于（某状态或情况）；使受到……的影响，把……施加给；给予（重视、信任、价值等）；把……视为（或列为）；表述，提出；使工作，使用；投掷（铁饼），推（铅球）；（船）（沿某个方向）行驶；谱曲；n. （铅球或铁饼的）投掷，推；（股票）put option 的简称；adj. 固定不动的；【名】 （Put）（泰、缅）布（人名）
definition: 1. n. the option to sell a given stock (or stock index or commodity future) at a given price before a given date；2. v. put into a certain place or abstract location
example: And, furthermore, to put the background in front, 1s2 2s2 2p3 let's do the electronic structure. It is 1s2, 2s2, 2p3.
exampleZh: 此外，把他的背景知识都翻出来，我们分析一下电子结构，这是。

meaning: v. 使困惑，使迷惑；（因迷惑而）苦思，冥思苦想；（通过苦苦思索）解决（或弄清楚），理出头绪（puzzle sth. out）；n. 测验智力（或知识）的游戏（或玩具，问题）；拼图游戏，拼图玩具；令人费解的人（或事物），难题
definition: 1. n. a particularly baffling problem that is said to have a correct solution；2. v. be a mystery or bewildering to
example: We invited readers who completed the puzzle to send in their solutions.
exampleZh: 我们邀请解完谜的读者交出谜底。

meaning: n. 迷惑，困惑；令人困惑的事物
definition: 1. n. confusion resulting from failure to understand
example: I was left with puzzlement as to the existence or nonexistence of God.
exampleZh: 我对上帝存在与否这个问题依然感到困惑。

meaning: n. 金字塔；金字塔形的物体（或一堆东西）；角锥体，棱锥体；（解剖）锥体；金字塔式组织（体系）；金字塔式台球（pyramids）；金字塔式控股；金字塔式骗局（pyramid scheme）；v. 把……堆成尖塔（或角锥）形；在（小投资）上获得丰厚的收益；渐增，上涨；（使）渐增，（使）上涨
definition: 1. a solid object with a square base and four triangular sides that form a point at the top；2. a pile of things that has the shape of a pyramid
example: Traditionally, the Brahmins, or the priestly class, are set at the top of the social pyramid.
exampleZh: 传统上，婆罗门或僧侣阶层位于社会金字塔的顶层。

meaning: v. （因恐惧、气愤等）发抖，颤抖；（建筑物等）震动，摇晃；n. 地震；颤抖，摇晃
definition: 1. n. shaking and vibration at the surface of the earth resulting from underground movement along a fault plane of from volcanic activity；2. v. shake with fast, tremulous movements
example: The quake destroyed mud buildings in many remote villages.
exampleZh: 地震摧毁了许多偏远村庄的泥土房屋。

meaning: v. （使）有权去做；取得资格，达到标准；获得参赛资格；使合格，胜任；符合，可算作；具体说明，使语气缓和；修饰，限定
definition: 1. v. prove capable or fit; meet requirements；2. v. pronounce fit or able
example: The basic course does not qualify you to practise as a therapist.
exampleZh: 这门基础课程并不能使你有资格当一名治疗师。

meaning: n. （通过考试或学习课程取得的）资格，学历；（胜任某一工作或职位所需的）资历，技能条件；获得资格，达到标准；先决条件，正式要求；限制，限定性条件；（语法）（尤指对名词等的）限定，修饰
definition: 1. n. an attribute that must be met or complied with and that fits a person for something；2. n. the act of modifying or changing the strength of some idea
example: An ear and an appetite for these sounds of sense is the first qualification of a writer, be it of prose or verse.
exampleZh: 这些感性的声音的耳朵和胃口,是作家最基本的素质，不论是写散文还是诗歌。

meaning: n. 质量，品质；优质，上乘；素质，品德；特征，特质；（语音）音质，音色；（供有品位者阅读的）高质量报纸（=quality newspaper）；（占星）黄道宫运动三大特征之一；adj. 优质的，高质量的；（报纸）内容严肃的，高级的；棒极了
definition: 1. n. an essential and distinguishing attribute of something or someone；2. adj. of superior grade
example: unless it has really good quality or I think it's going to last me for a really long time.
exampleZh: 除非它真的质量很好，或者我认为我真的会用很久。

meaning: adj. 质量的，定性的，性质的
definition: 1. adj. involving distinctions based on qualities；2. adj. relating to or involving comparisons based on qualities
example: There are qualitative differences in the way children of different ages and adults think.
exampleZh: 不同年龄的儿童和成人在思维方式上有着质的差异。

meaning: v. 测定……的数量，用数量表示，量化；用量词限定（术语，命题）
definition: 1. v. use as a quantifier；2. v. express as a number or measure or quantity
example: OK, so what we've gone through today is we've introduced covalent bonding, and we've figured out a way to quantify it.
exampleZh: 好的，那么我们已经经历了,是我们已经介绍了共价键，我们已经想出了一种定量的方法来。

meaning: n. 定量，量化
definition: 1. n. a limitation imposed on the variables of a proposition (as by the quantifiers `some' or `all' or `no')；2. n. the act of discovering or expressing the quantity of something
example: It is one of the most difficult fields to contain for the purpose of statistical quantification.
exampleZh: 就统计量化而言，它是最难以涵盖的领域之一。

meaning: n. 量，数目；大量，大批；（尤指和质量相对的）数量；（语音）音量；值，参量；代表数量（或参量）的数（或符号）
definition: 1. n. how much there is of something that you can quantify；2. n. an adequate or large amount
example: If you have a quantity which is constant over any closed path, that quantity is a thermodynamics state function.
exampleZh: 如果有一个物理量,对任何闭合回路积分是常数，这个物理量就是一个热力学态函数。

meaning: adj. 数量的，量化的，定量的；（诗）由长短步组成的
definition: 1. adj. expressible as a quantity or relating to or susceptible of measurement；2. adj. relating to the measurement of quantity
example: There is no difference between the two in quantitative terms.
exampleZh: 两者在数量上毫无差别。

meaning: n. 争吵，拌嘴；抱怨（或不赞成）的理由；（用石弓或劲弩发射的）方镞箭，方头投射物；v. 争吵，吵架；不同意，反对；抱怨
definition: 1. n. an angry dispute；2. v. have a disagreement over something
example: So what is at stake in this quarrel between Socrates and the poetic tradition ? that he alludes to?
exampleZh: 那到底他所暗示,介于苏格拉底与诗学传统间的争论,关键点为何？

meaning: adj. 爱争吵的，好口角的
definition: 1. adj. given to quarreling
example: Benedict had been a wild boy and a quarrelsome young man.
exampleZh: 本尼迪克特曾是个狂野的男孩，一个好争吵的年轻男子。

meaning: n. 夸脱（液体单位，英制中约为1.14升，美制中约为0.95升）；夸脱（干量单位，约等于1.10升）；（皮克牌用语）同花顺（指四张连续的同花牌）；（剑）第四姿势
definition: 1. a unit of measurement for liquids, equal to approximately 1.14 litres in the UK, or 0.95 litres in the US；2. a unit of measurement for liquids, equal to approximately 1.14 litres in Britain, or 0.95 litres in the US
example: Which has a higher boiling point, a quart of water or a gallon of water?
exampleZh: 1夸脱水和1加仑水，哪个有更高的沸点？

meaning: n. 四分之一；一刻钟，十五分钟；季度，三个月；学季，四分之一学年；（城镇中的）区；个人，群体；（士兵、服务人员等的）营房；上弦（或下弦）月；（美式足球的）一节；（美国和加拿大的）二十五分硬币；四分之一磅；（对败者的）宽恕，仁慈；四分之一畜体（或鸟身）；（马的）腰腿，臀部及后腿（quarters）；（罗盘上四个点之一所指的）方向；船侧后部；盾的四分之一；v. 将……四等分；把……降至原先的四分之一；提供食宿；在（某处）来回走动；移动，斜向行进；展示，炫耀（盾的四分之一部位上的不同纹章）；adj. 四分之一的
definition: 1. n. one of four equal parts；2. v. provide housing for (military personnel)
example: It's (a) quarter to four now—I'll meet you at (a) quarter past.
exampleZh: 现在是差一刻四点，我会在四点一刻和你碰面。

meaning: adj. 季度的，每季的；（盾，图记）纵横划成四（或更多）部分的；adv. 一季一次地，按季度；（纹章）在盾的四分之一部分（或对角两部分）上；n. 季刊；【名】 （Quarterly）（英）夸特利（人名）
definition: 1. n. a periodical that is published every quarter (or four issues per year)；2. adj. of or relating to or consisting of a quarter
example: A full listing of the companies will be published quarterly.
exampleZh: 公司名录大全每季度出版一次。

meaning: n. 女王，女首领；王后；（某一活动的）出众的女子，精髓；（节日或活动中）当选要职的女子；（纸牌中的）Q牌，王后；（国际象棋中的）王后；（蜜蜂、蚂蚁等的）王，后；母猫；（举止像女人的）男同性恋者； 爱妻，女朋友；v. （国际象棋）使（兵）变后；（女人）对……摆架子，对……专横跋扈；使……成为女王或王后；做女王；【名】 （Queen）（英）奎因（人名）

meaning: n. 疑问，询问；问号；v. 质疑，对……表示疑问；询问，提问

meaning: n. （长久或辛勤的）寻求，探求；（中世纪传奇故事中骑士的）探险；v. 探寻，寻求；【名】 （Quest）（德）奎斯特（人名）

meaning: n. 问题，疑问；试题，题目；（待讨论或处理的）事情，议题；不确定，怀疑；v. 向……提出问题，盘问；对……提出质疑（异议），怀疑

meaning: n. 问卷，调查表

meaning: n. （人、汽车等的）队，行列；（为得到某机会而等待的）长列，长队；（计算机）队列；呼叫队列；辫子；v. 排队（等候）；竞相，抢着（做某事）；（计算机）排成队列，排队

meaning: adj. 迅速的，快的；持续时间很短的，短暂的；敏捷的，脑子反应快的；马上的，即刻的；性情急躁的，容易发怒的；adv. 以很快的速度；迅速发生地，很快发生地；n. （指甲下的）活肉（the quick）；要害，核心（the quick）；活着的人们（the quick）；（板球）快投手；int. 快，快点；【名】 （Quick）（美、英、加、德、印）奎克（人名）

meaning: adj. 轻声的，安静的；不出声的；沉默寡言的，文静的；寂静的，平静的；不受打扰的，悠然的；（感情）不外露的，不张扬的；秘密的，私下的；（颜色、服饰）素净的，朴素大方的；清淡的；n. 安静，静谧；v. （使）平静，安静；消除，减轻（恐惧），平息（抱怨）

meaning: n. 问答比赛，智力竞赛；小测验；（尤指警方调查或正式调查中的）询问，审问；恶作剧，戏弄；戏弄他人者，恶作剧者；（性格、相貌）古怪的人；v. 询问，审问；测验（学生，班级）；（透过镜片）好奇地（或仔细地）打量；戏弄，取笑

definition: 1. n. a sudden short attack；2. v. search without warning, make a sudden surprise attack on
example: so just kind of raid your grandparents', like their wardrobes,
exampleZh: 就像抢劫了你爷爷奶奶的衣柜，

meaning: n. 铁路系统；铁轨，轨道；栏杆，扶手；（挂物用的）横杆；（赛马或赛狗场的）围栏；（镶板门或上下推拉窗的）横档，冒头；冲浪板（或帆板的）边缘；（电子）定电位导体轨；秧鸡；v. 用栏杆把……围起，把……隔开；谴责，抱怨；由铁路运送（货物）；（风帆冲浪用语）斜板滑行
definition: 1. n. a barrier consisting of a horizontal bar and supports；2. v. complain bitterly
example: Raw materials and labour come by ship , rail or road.
exampleZh: 从水上、铁路和公路运来原料和工人。

meaning: n. 铁路，铁道；铁路系统，铁路公司；（其他交通工具使用的）轨道
definition: 1. n. line that is the commercial organization responsible for operating a system of transportation for trains that pull passengers or freight；2. n. a line of track providing a runway for wheels
example: All those creatures, which are very interesting, in the end, you are told, "There's a horse inside a railway carriage."
exampleZh: 所有有趣的生物,到最后都变成了,"在一节车厢里有一匹马"

meaning: n. 雨，雨水；（热带地区的）雨季（the rains）；（降雨般的）一阵，（大量的）降落物；v. 下雨；（使）大量降落，雨点般落下；（使）如雨般地猛击；【名】 （Rain）（法）兰，（英）雷恩，（罗、捷）赖恩（人名）
definition: 1. n. water falling in drops from vapor condensed in the atmosphere；2. v. precipitate as rain
example: Just this watery mass again. So it's creation undoing itself in some of the descriptions, as opposed to just heavy rain.
exampleZh: 又变成了一个大水球,这里是自我毁灭，而不是毁于倾盆大雨。

meaning: adj. 多雨的；下雨的；【名】 （Rainy）（英）雷尼（人名）
definition: 1. adj. (of weather) wet by periods of rain
example: You know, rainy, generally kind of cooler year round, not as many hills, a lot flatter,
exampleZh: 很湿润，全年比较凉爽，没有很多山，有很多平原，

meaning: n. 彩虹；众多花色品种，五颜六色的组合，五花八门的聚合；五彩缤纷的展示；多种颜色，五彩缤纷；adj. 不同种族（或文化等）人群的；【名】 （Rainbow）（英）雷恩博（人名）
definition: 1. n. an arc of colored light in the sky caused by refraction of the sun's rays by rain；2. n. an illusory hope
example: The second rainbow will be bigger than the first, and directly above it.
exampleZh: 第二道彩虹将比第一道更大，并位于第一道的正上方。

meaning: n. 雨衣
definition: 1. n. a water-resistant coat
example: In fact, he doesn't even think about bringing a raincoat.
exampleZh: 事实上，他甚至都没想带一件雨衣。

meaning: v. 提起，举起；（使）直立，站立；建造，树立（塑像等）；增加，提高；筹募，征集；提出，提起；引起，使出现；饲养，种植；抚养，养育；使自乘……次；比（对手）多下赌注；叫醒；使复活；终止，解除；与……取得联系；（海上人员）驶近能看见（陆地或其他船只）的地方；（免疫）刺激（抗血清、抗体等的）生成；n. 加薪；（扑克牌或勃莱格牌用语）赌注加码；（举重）（持杠铃时的）提，举；【名】 （Raise）（意、法、英、美）雷兹（人名）
definition: 1. n. the amount a salary is increased；2. v. raise the level or amount of something
example: Also trying to raise awareness within the community that there are people on the other side we can approach.
exampleZh: 并且在你所处的群体提高人们的意识,了解另一端世界的人们是可以接触的。

meaning: v. 召集，集合；公开支持（或反对）；重新集合，重整（军队）；恢复，重新振作；动员（全体人员）发愤图强；（价格）回升，升值；参加汽车拉力赛；对……善意打趣，嘲笑；n. 集会，大会；赛车，汽车拉力赛；（网球等比赛中的）相持，拉锯；（球队技艺的）改进，提高；恢复健康，康复；（尤指股价）止跌回升；【名】 (Rally) （美）拉利（人名）
definition: 1. n. a large gathering of people intended to arouse enthusiasm；2. v. gather
example: The rally was intended to be a show of strength by the socialists.
exampleZh: 社会主义者组织这次集会意在显示力量。

meaning: n. （尤指饲养牛、马、羊等的）大农场，大牧场；牧场式住宅（=ranch house）；酸奶油沙拉酱（=ranch dressing）；v. 经营牧场（或农场）；在农场饲养（牲畜）；把（土地）用作牧场（或农场）
definition: 1. a very large farm on which animals are kept, especially in North and South America；2. a type of large farm on which animals are kept
example: In his twenties Roosevelt had sought work as a cowboy on a ranch in the Dakota Territory.
exampleZh: 二十多岁时，罗斯福曾经到达科他地区的一个大牧场去找牧牛工的活儿。

meaning: adj. 任意的，随机的，胡乱的；（砖石建筑）石头大小不一的；奇怪的，不同寻常的；n. 随意，随机；不认识的人，陌生人；adv. 随机地，胡乱地
definition: 1. happening, done, or chosen by chance rather than according to a plan；2. strange or unusual
example: I made a ton of random things when I was at Harvard and most of them no one ever saw.
exampleZh: 我在哈佛写了许多程序,很多都没人见过。

meaning: n. （变动或浮动的）范围，界限；视觉（或听觉）范围；射程，射击距离；一系列；成套产品，系列商品；山脉；牧场，牧区；靶场，射击场，炸弹试验场；（尤指旧时的）炉灶；一排建筑物；方向，走向；（飞机等交通工具的）续航距离；v. （在一定的范围内）变化，变动；（按一定位置或顺序）排列，排序；徘徊，四处移动；（文章或讲话）涉及，包括 ；（枪、炮、射击后校准）测距，（用雷达或激光）测距；支持，反对；自然生长，分布；与……联合起来，加入……行列；adj. （生活方式）有秩序的，安定的
definition: 1. n. an area in which something acts or operates or has power or control:；2. v. change or be different within limits
example: Just had, you know, the local driving range and then started doing a bit more on the national level, playing,
exampleZh: 一开始，你知道，就是在当地的练习场打，然后开始打很多国家级的，

meaning: n. 军衔，军阶；（社会、团体中的）地位，等级；（尤指较高的）地位；（警察、士兵等的）队列，行列；排，列；横排，棋盘横格；组织（或机构等）中的全体人员（ranks）；普通士兵（the ranks）；出租车候车站（=taxi rank）；（数）秩；（统计）次序排列；（系统语法用语）（一个或一组语言单位的）阶，级；v. 把……分等级，属于某等级；级别高于，地位高于；排列，使排成行；adj. （植被）茂密的，芜生蔓长的；难闻的，恶臭的；（强调质量、状况等）极端的，糟糕的；【名】 （Rank）（英、德、芬、捷）兰克（人名）
definition: 1. n. a row or line of people (especially soldiers or police) standing abreast of one another；2. v. take or have a position relative to others
example: And response back is "Well, yes, we had people at the table, but they were Oxford educated and they didn't represent the rank-and-file people in my culture."
exampleZh: 而他们得到的回应是,“是的，的确如此，可是那些人读的可是牛津大学,他们并不能代表,我们的普通民众“

meaning: n. 说唱音乐；说唱歌曲；扣击，快速的敲击； 指控，罪名；（尤指人或事的不良）名声，声誉； 指责，苛评；（尤指冗长或即兴的）谈论，闲聊；一丁点儿，极少；v. 急拍，快敲；表演说唱音乐，说唱；批评，指责；厉声地说（rap out）； 闲聊，交谈
definition: 1. a type of popular music with a strong rhythm in which the words are spoken, not sung；2. a statement accusing someone of a crime, or the punishment that someone is given for a crime
example: I know that you are a judge down here and much respected. So, looks like you've beaten the rap."
exampleZh: 我知道你在下面是个广受尊敬的法官,看来你混得很开啊"

meaning: n. 强奸罪，强奸案；（尤指对土地的）破坏，糟蹋；油菜；（榨汁后供制醋用的）葡萄渣；v. 强奸，强暴；蹂躏，破坏（地方）；掠夺，抢夺
definition: 1. to force someone to have sex when they are unwilling, using violence or threatening behaviour；2. (an example of) the crime of forcefully having sex with someone against their wishes
example: The myth that Yeats takes up is of Zeus's rape of the maiden, Leda, whom he attacks as a swan.
exampleZh: 叶芝此诗的神话原型是,宙斯强暴了一个美女，丽达，宙斯变成天鹅侵犯了她。

meaning: adj. 快的，迅速的；（移动，活动）快速的；n. 急流，湍滩；高速交通工具，高速交通网
definition: 1. n. a part of a river where the current is very fast；2. adj. done or occurring in a brief period of time
example: I have a lot more questions to ask you, so I'm going to give you 3 in 1 rapid flier.
exampleZh: 我还有很多问题要问您，我打算一句话问三个问题。

meaning: n. 迅速，速度
definition: 1. n. a rate that is rapid
example: The disease is spreading with alarming rapidity.
exampleZh: 这种疾病正在以令人吃惊的速度蔓延。

meaning: adj. 少见的，不常发生的；稀罕的，珍贵的；半熟的，半生的；（品质）极好的，杰出的；（空气）稀薄的，缺氧的；非常的，极度的
definition: 1. adj. not widely known; especially valued for its uncommonness；2. adj. recurring only at long intervals
example: It is very rare, for instance, for somebody who has learned English past puberty to speak without an accent.
exampleZh: 比如,在青春期后才学习英语的人,很少有讲英语是没有口音的

meaning: adv. 罕有，很少；异乎寻常地，极度
definition: 1. adv. not often
example: Rarely does the narrator comment on or explain a character's actions or thoughts or motives. There's only the barest minimum of dialogue.
exampleZh: 作者极少评价或解释一个人物的行为,或思想或动机，文章中只有不能再直白的对话。

meaning: n. 罕见的人（或物），珍品；稀有，罕见；稀薄
definition: 1. n. noteworthy scarcity；2. n. a rarified quality
example: It was a real prize due to its rarity and good condition.
exampleZh: 它是一件真正的稀世珍品，因为它不但稀有而且保存完好。

meaning: n. 皮疹，疹子；一连串（不愉快的事）；adj. 轻率的，鲁莽的；【名】 （Rash）（美、俄、英）拉什（人名）
definition: 1. a lot of small red spots on the skin；2. a large number of unpleasant events of the same type
example: You might have that commonly, but even more severe than normal; aches; and a rash.
exampleZh: 你们都有过这种经历,有时也许比平常的更加严重,疼痛,皮疹

meaning: n. 老鼠；卑鄙小人（尤指欺诈或变节者）； 常客，常待在某处的人；（为头发定型做出饱满效果的）女用发垫；v. 捕（捉）老鼠，灭鼠； 告发，告密； 背信弃义，食言；用发垫给（头发）定型；int. （rats） 胡说，去你的（用以表示轻度烦恼，恼怒）；【名】 （Rat）（法、意、印、瑞典）拉特，（泰）叻（人名）
definition: 1. n. any of various long-tailed rodents similar to but larger than a mouse；2. v. desert one's party or group of friends, for example, for one's personal advantage
example: But precisely, the human part of you is going to rebel at the unending parade of simple rat-like pleasures.
exampleZh: 更确切地，你的人性会反抗,一股股永无止尽的单调的老鼠般的快感。

meaning: n. 速度，速率；比率，率；费用，价格；费率；（英国）地方税，房地产税（rates）；等级；v. 评价，评定；被认为，被列为； 看好； 对（影片、视频游戏等）分级；划分等级，分等；值得，应得；给（财产）核定应缴地方税款；（机器、发动机等的）额定功率（极限）为；受器重，受青睐（rate with）；【名】 （Rate）（法、塞）拉特（人名）
definition: 1. n. amount of a charge or payment relative to some basis；2. v. assign a rank or rating to
example: Every conceivable Protestant sect was publishing treatises of theological speculation and publishing treatises of religious propaganda at an extraordinary rate.
exampleZh: 任何能想到的新教徒的宗教派别都在以不同寻常的,速度出版神学思考著作和,宗教宣传著作。

meaning: n. 等级，级别；（电影、视频游戏等的）定级，分级；收视率，收听率（the ratings）；（广播电视节目的）排行榜；水兵，普通海员；（机器、发动机等的）额定功率；（根据尺寸所划定的）赛艇等级；（军队的）军阶；苛责，怒斥；v. 对......作评估，评价；将……看作；对（影片、视频游戏等）分级（rate 的现在分词形式）；【名】 （Rating）（德）拉廷（人名）
definition: 1. n. an appraisal of the value of something；2. n. act of ascertaining or fixing the value or worth of
example: I think that going forward, both the rating agencies and the banks will be very important in our society.
exampleZh: 我认为这会有效果,信用评级机构和银行,都将会在我们的社会中扮演很重要的角色

meaning: adv. 颇，相当；宁愿，最好（would rather）；而不是；更确切地说；（用以使表达的语气婉转）有几分，有点儿；恰恰相反，而是；int. 当然，的确（表同意）；【名】 （Rather）（英）拉瑟（人名）
definition: 1. adv. on the contrary；2. adv. to some (great or small) extent
example: It's usually best to respond in a complete sentence rather than saying yes or no which can be ambiguous.
exampleZh: 一般来说，回答最好是完整的句子，而不是简单的模棱两可的“是”或“不是”。

meaning: v. 批准，正式签署
definition: 1. (especially of governments or organizations) to make an agreement official；2. (esp. of governments or organizations) to agree in writing to a set of rules, or to officially approve a decision or plan
example: And infinite numbers of countries sign and ratify them and say "Yes, we will abide by them".
exampleZh: 无数的国家,签署了公约，批准其生效，表明：,“是的，我们会遵守公约条款“

meaning: n. 批准，认可
definition: 1. the process of making an agreement official；2. the act of voting on a decision or signing a written agreement to make it official
example: We welcome this development and we look forward to early ratification of the treaty by China.
exampleZh: 我们欢迎这一进展并期望中国早日批准本条约。

meaning: n. 比率，比例
definition: 1. n. the relative magnitudes of two quantities (usually expressed as a quotient)
example: What is the ratio of men to women in the department?
exampleZh: 这个部门的男女比例是多少？

meaning: n. 配给量，定量；（尤指发给作战士兵的）口粮配给，口粮定量；合理（正常）的量；粮食供应，食物储备；应得之量；v. 对（供应品）定量供应，实行配给；对（某人）实行定量供给，配给
definition: 1. a limited amount of something that one person is allowed to have, especially when there is not much of it available；2. the total amount of food that is given to someone to be eaten during a particular activity and in a particular period of time, especially an amount given to soldiers when they are fighting
example: The meat ration was down to one pound per person per week.
exampleZh: 肉类的配给量降到了每人每周一磅。

meaning: adj. （想法、决定等）合理的，基于理性的；（人）理性的，理智的；富有理性的；（数）有理的，有理数的；n. 有理数
definition: 1. n. an integer or a fraction；2. adj. consistent with or based on or using reason
example: The alphabet might be more rational if all the vowels came first.
exampleZh: 要是所有的元音都排在前面，字母表也许会更合理些。

meaning: v. （使）咯咯作响；（车辆） 嘎拉嘎拉地响，（移动时）隆隆作响；使慌张，使紧张；呆在......里，占用（大得不必要的房间或建筑）；喋喋不休地讲话（rattle on）；n. 咯咯声，咔嗒声；发连续短促尖利声的器具；拨浪鼓；（在观看足球比赛或举行部落仪式中使用的）急响器，响板；（响尾蛇尾部的）角质环，响环；（人垂死时喉间发出的）呼噜声，临终喉鸣； 喋喋不休的人；【名】 （Rattle）（英）拉特尔（人名）
definition: 1. a sound similar to a series of quickly repeated knocks；2. a toy that makes a noise like a series of knocks
example: They've seen it all, so it takes a lot to rattle them.
exampleZh: 他们已经全都见识过了，所以要费很大的劲儿才能让他们感到紧张。

meaning: adj. 生的，未煮过的；天然的，未经加工的；（信息）未经处理的，原始的；（感情，品质）强烈的，不掩饰的；（皮肤）刺痛的；（人）生疏无知的，未经训练的；（天气）阴冷的；（音乐、艺术、语言等）质朴的，未经琢磨的；（语言）粗俗的；（布料边缘）无褶边的；（文字）不加掩饰的，如实坦陈的；（非洲黑人）源自传统部落（或乡村）文化的；强大的，真实的；（污水）未经处理的；n. 擦伤处；【名】 （Raw）（英）罗（人名）
definition: 1. n. informal terms for nakedness；2. adj. (used especially of commodities) being unprocessed or manufactured using only simple or minimal processes
example: This is what Levi-Strauss says in taken from one of Levi-Strauss' most famous books] The Raw and the Cooked.
exampleZh: 然后德里达说，这是列维自己说的,引自列维斯最著名的著作之一],《生食与熟食》

meaning: n. 光束，光线；（热、电或其他能源的）射线；一丝，一线（希望、慰藉等）；（日光浴用语）阳光（rays）；半直线；长音阶第二音，C大调第二音；鳐，魟；辐射状东西；（菊科植物头状花序的）舌状花，（盘）边花；辐肋，鳍刺；（海星的）放射形口腕，辐腕；v. 放射，射出（光线）；呈辐射状伸出，从中心四下延展；【名】 （Ray）雷（人名）
definition: 1. n. a column of light (as from a beacon)；2. v. emit as rays
example: And what's interesting about this sun is it has a ray of light coming out of the top.
exampleZh: 这幅画的有趣之处在于红日的光线从画面的顶端射了出来。

meaning: v. 到达，抵达；被看见，被听到；达到（特定的水平或数量）；达到（一个特定的时间或阶段）；（经讨论或思考后）达成，实现；伸，伸手；能伸到，能够到；把……递给；（大或长等）足够达到；（用电话等）与……联系；影响，打动；（航海）横风航驶；为……提供帮助（reach out to）；n. （臂的）伸出；伸手可及的距离；可到达的距离；（权力或能力）能及的范围；边远地区；层级，层次；河段，直水道；（特定时期内）观众人数，听众人数；（航海）横风行程；【名】 (Reach)(柬)列（人名）
definition: 1. n. the limits within which something can be effective；2. v. reach a destination, either real or abstract
example: So do reach out ultimately to your assigned teaching fellow, to me, to the help list, to the forums online.
exampleZh: 所以务必联系到你们的研究生助教，到我这，到那个帮助栏，到在线论坛上。

meaning: v. （作出）反应；起化学反应； (对食物等）不良反应，过敏；（股票价格）回跌
definition: 1. v. show a response or a reaction to something；2. v. undergo a chemical reaction; react with another substance under certain conditions
example: It is 1.7475. Conclusion: if I start to react sodium with chlorine, the result is a crystal, a three-dimensional array.
exampleZh: 这是1。7475，结论就是：,如果我使钠和氯反应，结果将会是一个晶体，一个三维排列。

meaning: n. 反应，回应；反应能力（reactions）；（药物或食物引起的）不良反应；化学反应；反作用力；（对旧观念等的）抗拒；反动，守旧
definition: 1. n. a response that reveals a person's feelings or attitude；2. n. a bodily process occurring due to the effect of some foregoing stimulus or agent
example: It deconvolves that reaction of sodium plus chlorine into elementary steps that are related to electron transfer and acquisition.
exampleZh: 它将钠和氯的反应,分解成基本的步骤,这些步骤是直接与电子的转移和获得有关的。

meaning: adj. 反动的，保守的；n. 反动派，保守人士
definition: 1. n. an extreme conservative; an opponent of progress or liberalism；2. adj. extremely conservative
example: Although this approach enables consistency and transcends IDEs, it is also slightly reactionary.
exampleZh: 尽管这种方法使一致性成为可能并超越了IDE，但它也有一点反作用。

meaning: v. 阅读，读懂；朗读；（在书籍、报纸等中）读到，看到；解读，（按某种方式）理解；看透（想法或心思）；读起来（给人以某种印象）；有……的字样，写着；换用，改作（用于订正讹误）；读取（磁盘中的信息）；（通过无线电）收听到，听明白；（测量仪器）指示，显示；看（度量仪器显示的数字）；攻读；将（议案或其他法令）提交立法机构；n. 阅读，阅读时间；读物；解释，阐明；adj. 博学的，有学问的；【名】 （Read）（英）里德（人名）
definition: 1. n. something that is read；2. v. interpret something that is written or printed
example: If you're looking to have an opportunity for a personal reflective... I read this on a retreat last year.
exampleZh: 如果你想进行一下自我反省。。。,我去年在度假时读了这本书。

meaning: n. 阅读，宣读；读物，阅读材料；文学知识；理解，解读；朗诵会，朗诵的作品；（宗教仪式上诵读的）《圣经》章节；（测量仪器的）读数；议案宣读（立法机关审议法案的程序）；v. 阅读，读懂；朗读；理解（read 的现在分词形式）；【名】 （Reading）雷丁（人名），雷丁（英，美）（地名）
definition: 1. n. the cognitive process of understanding a written linguistic message；2. n. a datum about some physical state that is presented to a user by a meter or similar instrument
example: Whereas, 27% of whites are reading at a low level, 22% of Asian-Pacific kids are reading at low level.
exampleZh: 也处于低水平，然而，27%的白人孩子阅读能力很差，而22%亚太地区的孩子阅读能力很差。

meaning: n. 读者， 爱读书的人；（初级）读本，简易读物；（英国大学中仅次于教授的）高级讲师（Reader）；（美国大学的）助教；电子阅读器，电子识读机；缩微软片阅读机；（出版社的）审稿人，审阅人；校对人；抄表员；（基督教堂中）领读经文的信徒；【名】 （Reader）（英）里德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person who enjoys reading；2. n. someone who contracts to receive and pay for a service or a certain number of issues of a publication
example: He began and ended his career as a decadent, I suppose a reader of Walter Pater and Oscar Wilde.
exampleZh: 他以颓废者的形象开始和结束其事业，我想作为佩特和王尔德的读者。

meaning: adj. （某人）准备好（做某事）的；预先备好的，可供使用的；乐意的；方便使用的，现成的；迅速的，敏捷的；即将……的；需要的，想要的；n. 现款（the ready/readies）；预备好的状态；adv. 已做完，已完成；v. 做好……的准备；【名】 （Ready）（英）雷迪（人名）
definition: 1. n. poised for action；2. v. prepare for eating by applying heat
example: Or, if you are at a party and you're ready to leave but you've left your bag with the host,
exampleZh: 又或者，你在一个派对上，你准备要走了，但是你刚才把你的包放在派对主人那里了，

meaning: adv. 轻而易举地，迅速地；乐意地，欣然地
definition: 1. adv. without much difficulty；2. adv. in a punctual manner
example: I asked her if she would allow me to interview her, and she readily agreed.
exampleZh: 我问她是否允许我采访她，她欣然同意了。

meaning: adj. 实际存在的，非想象的；名副其实的；真正的，真实的；真的，非人工的；真诚的；强烈的；确实重大的；十足的，绝对的（用来加强语气）；（数量、数字）真实的，实际的；（光学）（图像）实的；（书或电影中的场景）逼真的，似真的；（哲学）实在的；adv. 很，非常地；n. 雷阿尔（巴西1994年以来的基本货币单位，等于100分）；雷阿尔（多个西班牙语国家以前的硬币和货币单位）；【名】 （Real）（德、西、葡、法）雷亚尔，（英）里尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. any rational or irrational number；2. adj. being or occurring in fact or actuality; having verified existence; not illusory
example: I mean it is still like a real big cultural mecca for African American people in New York City.
exampleZh: 对于身在纽约的美国黑人来说，这里仍然是个真正的文化麦加圣地。

meaning: adv. 真正地，事实上；确实的，的确（用于加强语气）；很，十分；（用于带有隐含的否定回答的疑问句和感叹句）真的，是吗；用于缓和否定语气；int. 真的（用来表示兴趣、惊奇或疑惑）；真是的！（用于表示生气或不赞成）；是啊！（用于表示同意某人的意见）
definition: 1. adv. in accordance with truth or fact or reality；2. adv. in actual fact
example: But I had like, really, really big dreams, so I wanted to pursue in New York, which led me here.
exampleZh: 但我有很伟大的梦想，我想在纽约实现这个梦想，这也是我来这里的原因。

meaning: n. 真实，现实；实际经历，见到的事物；真实感，逼真性；存在；（哲学）实在，实在性；adj. 真人秀节目的
definition: 1. n. all of your experiences that determine how things appear to you；2. n. the state of being actual or real
example: And why is that? Within the perspective of Milton's free-will theology, sin can't exist as an external reality.
exampleZh: 为什么呢？从弥尔顿自由意志的学说的角度来看，原罪是不可能以永久现实的形式存在的。

meaning: adj. 务实的，实事求是的；实际的，现实可行的；写实的，逼真的；实在论的
definition: 1. adj. aware or expressing awareness of things as they really are；2. adj. representing what is real; not abstract or ideal
example: And that will end up winning out at basically any realistic temperature where the stuff really is a gas.
exampleZh: 在体系仍然处于气体状态的温度下,熵战胜了能量。

meaning: n. 务实作风，实事求是；现实性，逼真；（艺术、文学中的）现实主义；（科学或哲学的）实在主义，唯实论；权力实用主义；现实主义法学
definition: 1. n. the attribute of accepting the facts of life and favoring practicality and literal truth；2. n. (philosophy) the philosophical doctrine that physical objects continue to exist when not perceived
example: Greene's stories had an edge of realism that made it easy to forget they were fiction.
exampleZh: 格林的故事带有现实主义的色彩，使人容易忘记它们是虚构的。

meaning: v. 了解，意识到；（所担心的事）发生，产生（be realized）；实现（目标、梦想等）；（充分）发挥出自己的潜力； 把（概念等）具体表现出来；用（语言特征）表达；对（记谱不全的乐曲）做完整兑谱改编；获得（金钱，利润）；变现，变卖（资产）
definition: 1. v. be fully aware or cognizant of；2. v. perceive (an idea or situation) mentally
example: And you want this to continue. And then when you get older and you realize what the museum is about,
exampleZh: 你希望这可以延续。当你长大了，你就意识到博物馆是关于什么的，

meaning: n. 认识，领悟；（目标等的）实现；变现，变卖；兑谱，改编；（语言特征的）体现；货物销售；发声，(戏剧)演出，设计成果
definition: 1. n. coming to understand something clearly and distinctly；2. n. making real or giving the appearance of reality
example: This is where evaluation comes in. The success or failure of a poem depends on the realization of meaning.
exampleZh: 这时就需要评估介入了，一首诗好与坏,取决于它含义表达是否清晰。

meaning: n. （知识、活动、思想的）领域，范围；王国；（动物学）界（对地球表面所作的最主要的生物地理划分）
definition: 1. n. a domain in which something is dominant；2. n. a knowledge domain that you are interested in or are communicating about
example: It simply means that one cannot enter the holy sanctuary, God's realm, when impure through contact with death or sexuality.
exampleZh: 这就意味着如果和死亡或者性有关，人就不能进入圣所，上帝的领域。

meaning: v. 获得，收获；收割（庄稼等）；【名】 （Reap）（英）里普（人名）
definition: 1. v. gather, as of natural products；2. v. get or derive
example: The company is just starting to reap the rewards of long-term investments.
exampleZh: 这家公司正开始收获长期投资的回报。

meaning: n. （尤指建筑物或车辆等的）后部，背部（the rear）；（队列的）后方，后尾部队（或舰队）；臀部，屁股（=rear end）；adj. 后方的，背部的；v. 养育，饲养；栽种，培植；（动物）用后腿直立；（建筑、山等）高耸；（人）发火，暴跳（rear up）；adv. 向后，在后面
