definition: 1. n. the back of a military formation or procession；2. v. stand up on the hind legs, of quadrupeds
example: Her car crashed into the rear of a van.
exampleZh: 她的汽车撞毁了一辆面包车的尾部。

meaning: n. 原因，理由；充分理由，正当理由；道理，情理；判断力，理智；v. 推理，逻辑思考；推论出，推断出（reason sth. out）；对（某人）以理相劝，劝告（reason with）；【名】 （Reason）（英）里森（人名）
definition: 1. n. a rational motive for a belief or action；2. v. decide by reasoning; draw or come to a conclusion
example: Is Milton powerful for the very straightforward reason that he's in possession of this tremendous literary strength, this unimaginable talent?
exampleZh: 弥尔顿之所以强大是因为他有,无穷的文学力量，不可想象的天赋这显而易见的原因呢？

meaning: adj. 有道理的，合情理的；（人）通情达理的，讲道理的；适度的，合适的；（价格）公道的；还算好的，尚可的；相当大的，（数量）不少的
definition: 1. adj. showing reason or sound judgment；2. adj. not excessive or extreme
example: So what we see is, again perfectly reasonable statistical techniques, but not looking at things in the right way.
exampleZh: 所以我们这里可以看到，还是很完美很有逻辑的统计学工具，但是他们没有用正确的方式去看待数据。

meaning: v. 使安心，使消除疑虑
definition: 1. to comfort someone and stop them from worrying；2. to comfort someone and stop that person from worrying
example: His father smiled weakly in a forlorn attempt to reassure him that everything was all right.
exampleZh: 他父亲淡淡地一笑，枉然地试图要他放心，一切都安然无恙。

meaning: n. 安慰，慰藉；能消除疑虑的说话（或行动），保证
definition: 1. words of advice and comfort intended to make someone feel less worried
example: Knowing what you earn and what you spend can give you reassurance that you won't get into debt in the first place.
exampleZh: 弄清自己的收入与支出，就能从一开始就确保不会负债。

meaning: n. 造反者，反抗者；反抗权威者；叛逆者，不守规矩者；v. 反叛，造反；违抗，不服从（权威）；反对，反抗（规定、行为规范等）；（胃、腿、头脑等）不听使唤；adj. 造反的；反抗的；【名】 （Rebel）（美、德、荷、法、俄）勒贝尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. `Johnny' was applied as a nickname for Confederate soldiers by the Federal soldiers in the American Civil War; `greyback' derived from their grey Confederate uniforms；2. v. take part in a rebellion; renounce a former allegiance
example: But precisely, the human part of you is going to rebel at the unending parade of simple rat-like pleasures.
exampleZh: 更确切地，你的人性会反抗,一股股永无止尽的单调的老鼠般的快感。

meaning: n. 叛乱，反抗； （对权威的）反抗，不服从；叛逆，不顺从
definition: 1. n. refusal to accept some authority or code or convention；2. n. organized opposition to authority; a conflict in which one faction tries to wrest control from another
example: The martyrs in the Easter Rebellion of 1916 become ancient Irish warriors, and we'll talk about that next time.
exampleZh: 916年复活节起义中的烈士6,化身为古代爱尔兰骑士，这个我们下次课再谈。

meaning: adj. 叛乱的，造反的；（对权威或常规）反抗的，反叛的；（东西）难处理的，难对付的
definition: 1. adj. resisting control or authority；2. adj. discontented as toward authority
example: The rebellious artist Milton and the rebellious astronomer Galileo are continually threatening to lapse into some sort of identity with Satan himself.
exampleZh: 叛逆的艺术家弥尔顿，和同样叛逆的天文学家伽利略,不断的陷入某种对撒旦的确认的,危险之中。

meaning: v. 记起，回想起；使想起，使想到；召回，叫回（某人）；召回（运动员），使归队； 收回（有问题的产品）；检索，调用（计算机储存的数据）； 罢免；使重新集中注意力； 撤销，废止（行动，决定）；n. 记忆力，记性；召回；（因产品有问题的）收回；（将运动员的）召回归队；（请愿后经投票对政府官员的）罢免；回索率，检索率；撤销
definition: 1. n. a request by the manufacturer of a defective product to return the product (as for replacement or repair)；2. v. recall knowledge from memory; have a recollection
example: You'll recall that at the very end of class we pulled up this little demo that looked like this.
exampleZh: 你们可以回忆一下，我们曾,有个这样的演示。

meaning: v. 逐渐远离，渐渐退去；（质量）下降，（问题或疾病等）逐渐减弱；（前额的头发）脱落；（面部特征）向后倾斜；（常指牙龈因为感染）萎缩
definition: 1. to move further away into the distance, or to become less clear or less bright；2. to move further away into the distance, or to become less clear
example: Just as I started to think that I was never going to get well, the illness began to recede.
exampleZh: 就在我开始认为我将永远不会好起来的时候，我的病开始好转。

meaning: v. 得到，收到；遭受，经受（特定待遇）；对……作出反应；接待，招待；接收（某人为成员）；接收，收听（信号）；（通过无线电）听到；购买，窝藏（赃物）；接（球）；领受（圣餐面包或葡萄酒）；接受（治疗）；形成（看法，印象）；容纳，承接
definition: 1. v. get something; come into possession of；2. v. receive a specified treatment (abstract)
example: But at the same time, you receive an offer to work at another company that is also very intriguing.
exampleZh: 但与此同时，你也被另外一家公司录用了，这非常吸引人。

meaning: n. 发票，收据；收到，接收；(企业、银行、政府等）收到的款项，收入（receipts）；v. 在（账单）上注明收讫字样
definition: 1. n. the act of receiving；2. v. report the receipt of
example: The buyer has to sign a delivery note as proof of receipt.
exampleZh: 购买者必须签收送货单表明货已收到。

meaning: n. 接受者，领受者；接收器，容器；adj. 接受的，容纳的
definition: 1. n. a person who gets something；2. n. the semantic role of the animate entity that is passively involved in the happening denoted by the verb in the clause
example: A big or steady serving of sarcasm will overwhelm the emotional flavor of any conversation and can taste very bitter to its recipient.
exampleZh: 大量或持续的讽刺会淹没任何谈话的情感色调，而且会让接受者尝到苦涩的滋味。

meaning: adj. （对观点、建议等）愿意倾听的，乐于接受的；能容纳的，可以接受的；（对治疗）反应良好的；（雌性动物）处于发情期的
definition: 1. adj. open to arguments, ideas, or change；2. adj. ready or willing to receive favorably
example: You know what I mean?" He was slouched rhetorically forward toward Franny, his receptive audience, a supporting forearm on either side of his martini.
exampleZh: 你们知道我意思吗，他夸张的无精打采地,向弗兰尼走去，弗兰尼是他的忠实观众，他双臂撑在马提尼的两边。

meaning: n. （电话）听筒；（无线电或电视）接收器，接收机；（法庭指定的）破产接管人；收受者，收件人；买卖赃物者，收赃人；接球手，外接手；接受罐，聚集器；（安置枪栓并与枪管等部件相连接的）机闸
definition: 1. n. set that receives radio or tv signals；2. n. (law) a person (usually appointed by a court of law) who liquidates assets or preserves them for the benefit of affected parties
example: he throws the ball and then the receiver or someone else can catch it and then they run with it.
exampleZh: 他扔球，然后接球的或者其他人可以抓住球，带着球跑。

meaning: adj. 最近的，最新的；（地质）全新世的 （Recent）
definition: 1. n. approximately the last 10,000 years；2. adj. being new in a time not long past
example: I'd like to close with a short story of recent interaction that I had with a video over the internet.
exampleZh: 我想用一个小故事来结束,是最近我关于网络视频的互动作用。

meaning: adv. 最近，不久前
definition: 1. adv. in the recent past；2. adv. very recently
example: So recently we also set up a meeting with the new director of undergraduate studies in chemical engineering and
exampleZh: 最近我们还和化学工程本科部的新主任开了一次会，

meaning: n. 接待处，服务台；欢迎会，招待会；欢迎，反响；（收音机或电视信号）接收效果，接收质量；接收，接待；（美橄）接球；（幼儿学校的）小班，学前班
definition: 1. n. the manner in which something is greeted；2. n. a formal party of people; as after a wedding
example: Let me take you back to the seventeenth century, up to the very beginning of the literary reception of John Milton.
exampleZh: 让我把你们带回到17世纪，约翰·弥尔顿刚在文学领域为人所知的时候。

meaning: n. 接待员
definition: 1. n. a secretary whose main duty is to answer the telephone and receive visitors
example: The receptionist is the first point of contact most people have with the clinic.
exampleZh: 多数人与诊所接触的第一个人是接待员。

meaning: n. （经济的）衰退（期）；退后，撤回；（天文）退行；凹处
definition: 1. n. the state of the economy declines; a widespread decline in the GDP and employment and trade lasting from six months to a year；2. n. a small concavity
example: For example, we had a recession that started here -I believe that was '48--and then it ended in '49.
exampleZh: 比如我们来看这一次衰退,大概从48年开始,于49年结束

meaning: n. 烹饪法，食谱；诀窍，秘诀；原因；处方
definition: 1. a set of instructions telling you how to prepare and cook food, including a list of what food is needed for this；2. a set of instructions telling you how to prepare and cook a particular food, including a list of what foods are needed for this
example: Notice the difference. The recipe, the sequence of instructions, is actually getting read in, and it's treated just like data.
exampleZh: 注意其中的差别，方法，也就是指令序列，其实是需要读的，被当做数据来对待。

meaning: adj. 相互的，互惠的，报答的；（路线，方向）反向的；（代词，动词）互相的；（量，函数）倒数的；互逆的，互反的；n. 反身代词，相互动词； 倒数，乘法逆元素；互相起作用的事物
definition: 1. A reciprocal action or arrangement involves two people or groups of people who behave in the same way or agree to help each other and give each other advantages.；2. a number that, when multiplied by another number, results in 1
example: The two colleges have a reciprocal arrangement whereby students from one college can attend classes at the other.
exampleZh: 两所学院有一项互惠协定，允许学生在院际间选课。

meaning: v. 背诵，朗诵；详述，列举
definition: 1. v. recite in elocution；2. v. repeat aloud from memory
example: Each child had to recite a poem to the class.
exampleZh: 每个孩子都得在班上背诵一首诗。

meaning: n. 背诵，朗诵；背诵的诗；讲述，陈述
definition: 1. n. written matter that is recited from memory；2. n. a public instance of reciting or repeating (from memory) something prepared in advance
example: So, I joined the faculty in 1978, 091 and my first teaching assignment was 3.091 recitation. I had two sections.
exampleZh: 我在1978年的时候加入了教职的一员，我第一个教授的课程就是3。,当时我的课程分为2个部分。

meaning: adj. 鲁莽的，不计后果的；粗心大意的；【名】 （Reckless）（英）雷克利斯（人名）
definition: 1. doing something dangerous and not worrying about the risks and the possible results；2. showing a lack of care about risks or danger, and acting without thinking about the results of your actions
example: He showed a reckless disregard for his own safety.
exampleZh: 他对个人安危全然无所顾忌。

meaning: v. 估算，计算；料想，认为；把……看作；期望，指望
definition: 1. v. expect, believe, or suppose；2. v. judge to be probable
example: They reckon (that) their profits are down by at least 20%.
exampleZh: 他们估计利润至少下降了20%。

meaning: v. 认识，辨别出；承认，意识到；（正式或在法律上）认可，承认；赞赏，公认；表扬，表彰；（会议或辩论主席）邀请……发言；（计算机等）自动识别（声音、印刷字体等）
definition: 1. v. accept (someone) to be what is claimed or accept his power and authority；2. v. be fully aware or cognizant of
example: The point is simply to recognize that the apples are occult symbols, which is to say they're not apples.
exampleZh: 关键是要认识,苹果是神秘主义的象征，就是说它们并不是苹果。

meaning: n. 承认，接受；表彰，赞誉；认出，识别；（政府对他国的）外交认可
definition: 1. n. the state or quality of being recognized or acknowledged；2. n. the process of recognizing something or someone by remembering
example: Wilde's suggestion, but I think also Kant's suggestion before him, is important for our recognition of our own value.
exampleZh: 王尔德的提议，也是康德的，对我们自己认识到自我的价值很重要。

meaning: v. 建议，劝告 ；推荐，介绍；使显得吸引人，使受欢迎； 把……交托给，把……托付给
definition: 1. v. push for something；2. v. express a good opinion of
example: So, we don't necessarily recommend that, but what was pretty cool especially that day, okay, so this is okay.
exampleZh: 所以，我们不一定推荐那个，但是尤其是那一天，是相当酷的，好的，现在好了。

meaning: n. 正式建议，提议；推荐，介绍；推荐信
definition: 1. n. something (as a course of action) that is recommended as advisable；2. n. something that recommends (or expresses commendation) of a person or thing as worthy or desirable
example: The best way of finding a lawyer is through personal recommendation.
exampleZh: 找律师的最好方法是通过个人推荐。

meaning: v. 调和，使协调一致；（使）和解，（使）恢复友好关系；调停，调解（争吵）；使顺从于，使接受；核对，查核（账目）
definition: 1. to find a way in which two situations or beliefs that are opposed to each other can agree and exist together；2. When two people are reconciled, they become friendly again after they have argued
example: It was hard to reconcile his career ambitions with the needs of his children.
exampleZh: 他很难兼顾事业上的抱负和孩子们的需要。

meaning: n. 和解，复交；协调，和谐一致；对账
definition: 1. a situation in which two people or groups of people become friendly again after they have argued；2. the process of making two opposite beliefs, ideas, or situations agree
example: Their change of policy brought about a reconciliation with Britain.
exampleZh: 他们的政策改变促成了与英国的和解。

meaning: v. 调和，使协调一致；（使）和解，（使）恢复友好关系；调停，调解（争吵）；使顺从于，使接受；核对，查核（账目）
definition: 1. to find a way in which two situations or beliefs that are opposed to each other can agree and exist together；2. When two people are reconciled, they become friendly again after they have argued
example: The mayor adopted a reconciliatory tone in an effort to ease tensions between the two communities.
exampleZh: 市长采取了和解的语气，试图缓和两个社区之间的紧张关系。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）
note: 剑桥以 reconcile 词条解释该派生词。

meaning: n. 记录，记载；（某人或某物过去的）记录，经历；（尤指体育运动中的）最佳纪录，最好成绩；唱片；前科，犯罪记录；唱片乐曲；（计算机）记录（指作为一个单位处理的一批相关信息）；v. 记录，记载；录制；（仪器）显示，标示；（尤指体育上）获得（好成绩）；发表正式（或法律方面的）声明，申明；演奏音乐供录制；adj. 创纪录的；【名】 （Record）（美）勒科尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. anything (such as a document or a phonograph record or a photograph) providing permanent evidence of or information about past events；2. v. make a record of; set down in permanent form
example: and ended up owning record companies and radio stations and airline companies and those kind of thing.
exampleZh: 最后拥有了自己的唱片公司、广播电台和航空公司，诸如此类的东西。

meaning: n. 录音机，录像机；竖笛，直笛；记录器；记录员，记录人；（某些法院的）法官；被任命为兼职法官的大律师（Recorder）
definition: 1. n. equipment for making records；2. n. someone responsible for keeping records
example: Rodney put the recorder on the desk top and pushed the play button.
exampleZh: 罗德尼把录音机放在桌面上，按下了播放键。

meaning: n. 录音，录像；录制；（正式的）记录，记载；v. 记录，记载；录制；（仪器）显示，标示；（尤指体育上）获得（好成绩）（record 的现在分词）
definition: 1. n. signal encoding something (e.g., picture or sound) that has been recorded；2. n. the act of making a record (especially an audio record)
example: That's on tape, that's you know, you get on the early VHS and recording tapes as well, cassette players.
exampleZh: 会卖磁带，你得用早期的家用录像系统、录音磁带或录音机播放。

meaning: v. 恢复（健康，精神，体力）；康复，复原（be recovered）；（从不愉快的经历中）恢复；（从弱势或困境中）好转，扭转；重新获得，寻回；收回（开支、投资等）；恢复（意识、神志或身体状态）；挽回（地位），弥补（时间损失）；提取（能源或化工品等），回收利用； 给……换上新面；n. （军事操练）枪还原，收枪（the recover）；【名】 （Recover）（西）雷科韦尔（人名）
definition: 1. v. get or find back; recover the use of；2. v. get over an illness or shock
example: Then things suddenly blow up on you, but you'll recover and you'll figure something out and then you'll move from there.
exampleZh: 然后突然间爆掉了，但是你会修复好自己而且解决问题,然后你就能从那个经济低谷走出来。

meaning: n. 康复，痊愈；戒除；恢复，复苏；（供刚做完手术的病人使用的）监护室；（被拿走或失去的东西的）复得，找回；收回的物品（资金）；（破损车辆或坠毁飞机）回收修理；（高尔夫）挽回败局之击，复原之击（击回球道或球穴区）；（美橄）重新获球；（划船，自行车赛，游泳）还原至预备姿势（如回桨等）；回收利用（能源、化工品等）
definition: 1. n. return to an original state；2. n. gradual healing (through rest) after sickness or injury
example: That's shown functionally here but recovery means that this sodium channel becomes closed again.
exampleZh: 在此展示了这项功能,恢复代表着钠离子通道再次关闭

meaning: n. 娱乐（活动），消遣（活动）；重现，重建
definition: 1. n. an activity that diverts or amuses or stimulates；2. n. activity that refreshes and recreates; activity that renews your health and spirits by enjoyment and relaxation
example: I play the flute in a wind band for recreation.
exampleZh: 我在管乐队吹长笛消遣。

meaning: adj. 娱乐的，消遣的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to recreation；2. adj. engaged in as a pastime
example: The town and its environs are inviting, with recreational attractions and art museums.
exampleZh: 这个城镇及其周边地区十分引人入胜，建有休闲胜地和艺术博物馆。

meaning: v. 招聘，招收（新成员）；招募（新兵）；说服，动员；（通过招募）组成，组建； 恢复（数量、力气等）；n. 新兵；新成员
definition: 1. n. a recently enlisted soldier；2. v. register formally as a participant or member
example: He is hoping to recruit a chairman from outside the company.
exampleZh: 他在希望从公司之外招聘一位董事长。

meaning: n. 招募，招聘；（自然种群）增长；（生理）募集（反应、现象）
definition: 1. n. the act of getting recruits; enlisting people for the army (or for a job or a cause etc.)
example: In future, staff recruitment will fall within the remit of the division manager.
exampleZh: 以后招募新员工将属于部门经理的职责。

meaning: v. 纠正，矫正；整流，把（交流电）转变成直流电；蒸馏；求曲线的直线等长
definition: 1. to correct something or make something right；2. to make a substance pure
example: The comprehensive spending review offers an opportunity for the government to help rectify this.
exampleZh: 全面支出审查让政府有机会帮助纠正这一问题。

meaning: n. 修正，矫正；（电）整流
definition: 1. the act of correcting something or making something right
example: To review and verify the reports on the rectification of related financial institutions.
exampleZh: 负责审核有关金融机构整改报告的具体工作。

meaning: v. 再发生，反复出现；（思考或讲话时）重新回到，反复提及（recur to）；（小数）循环
definition: 1. to happen many times or to happen again；2. to happen again or happen many times
example: Once the drugs are stopped, symptoms typically recur.
exampleZh: 一旦停药，症状通常会复发。

meaning: n. 重现，复发
definition: 1. the fact of happening again
example: Police are out in force to prevent a recurrence of the violence.
exampleZh: 警察大规模地行动防止暴力的再次发生。

meaning: v. 回收利用，再利用；（将可回收物品）送入回收加工厂；使再循环；再次应用，重新使用（观念、文章等）；n. 回收利用，循环使用
definition: 1. v. cause to repeat a cycle；2. v. use again after processing
example: The power of the Green movement in Germany has made that country a leader in the drive to recycle more waste materials.
exampleZh: 德国环保运动的力量已经使该国成了循环利用更多废料运动中的领先者。

meaning: adj. 可回收利用的，可再循环的；n. 可回收物品
definition: 1. adj. capable of being used again
example: They were appalled at the waste of recyclable material.
exampleZh: 他们憎恶有人浪费可回收材料。

meaning: adj. 红的，红色的；（毛发）红褐色的；（脸）涨红的；（眼睛）充血的，红肿的；（葡萄酒）红色的；（表示停止）红（灯），红（旗）；被禁止的，危险的；（美国政治）支持共和党的；革命的，激进的，赤色的（尤指冷战期间指前苏联）；（纸牌）红桃的，红方块的；（人）红种的；沾有鲜血的；流血的（古或诗/文）；（物理）（表示夸克三种色荷之一的）红色的；n. 红色，红颜料；红衣；红葡萄酒；赤字，亏空，负债；激进分子；（Red）雷德（人名）；v. 整理（同 redd）
definition: 1. n. red color or pigment; the chromatic color resembling the hue of blood；2. adj. of a color at the end of the color spectrum (next to orange); resembling the color of blood or cherries or tomatoes or rubies
example: So this last version of the red light introduces interesting complications which I don't think should confuse us.
exampleZh: 所以，关于红灯的这最后一个例子,让我们思考了平时不会思考的问题。

meaning: v. 减少，降低；（烹调中）使变浓稠，收汁；节食减肥；使沦为，使陷入（不好的境地）；迫使，使不得不（做）；（通过破裂、燃烧等）使变成，使化为；归纳，简化；将分数约到（最小项）；（使）进行还原反应；减薄（底片或图片）；（语音）弱化；使（脱臼，断骨）复位；攻克，征服（尤指围攻并占领城镇或要塞）
definition: 1. v. cut down on; make a reduction in；2. v. make less complex
example: So, The Norton Anthology, this book, this heavy book, I order it as a way to, well, reduce your expenses.
exampleZh: 叫《一首诗的心路历程》，就在这本诺顿诗集里，我自己订购了一本，这样可以减少你们的花费。

meaning: n. 减小，降低；减价，折扣；（照片、地图、图片等的）缩图，缩版；归纳，简化；（数学）归约，约化；染色体减半；简编曲（管弦乐改编的钢琴曲或小乐队演奏曲）；浓汤，浓汁；脱臼（或断骨）复位；（化学）还原，被还原；（语音）弱化
definition: 1. n. the act of decreasing or reducing something；2. n. any process in which electrons are added to an atom or ion (as by removing oxygen or adding hydrogen); always occurs accompanied by oxidation of the reducing agent
example: In other words, the reduction of excitation is obviously something that the pleasure principle is all about.
exampleZh: 换句话说快乐原则关注的不就是,减少兴奋吗？

meaning: adj. 被解雇的，被裁员的；多余的，累赘的；（为预防机器或系统中主要组件故障而设的）复置装置的，备用的
definition: 1. (especially of a word, phrase, etc.) unnecessary because it is more than is needed；2. having lost your job because your employer no longer needs you
example: And so what I see is that as I run this, I'm doing a lot of redundant computation.
exampleZh: 因此我在这里,看到的是随着我的运行，我将会进行很多冗余的计算。

meaning: n. （因劳动力过剩而造成的）裁员，解雇；多余，累赘；复置装置，冗余（机器、系统等某部件发生故障后的替代装置）
definition: 1. a situation in which someone loses their job because their employer does not need them；2. a situation in which something is unnecessary because it is more than is needed
example: Thousands of bank employees are facing redundancy as their employers cut costs.
exampleZh: 数千名银行职员面临裁员，因为他们的雇主要削减成本。

meaning: n. 卷轴，线轴；（钓竿上的）卷线轮；一卷，一盘；（影片的）一本；里尔舞（一种轻快的苏格兰或爱尔兰舞蹈），里尔舞曲；蹒跚（或摇晃）的动作；v. 震惊，困惑；（尤指被打或震惊而）踉跄着后退；蹒跚，踉跄；（感觉）晕眩，天旋地转；卷，绕（reel sth. in）；跳里尔舞；【名】 （Reel）（美）雷埃尔（人名）
definition: 1. a round, wheel-shaped object on which sewing thread, fishing wire, film, etc. can be rolled, or the amount of thread, etc. stored on one of these；2. a fast Scottish or Irish dance, or the music for this
example: The reel comes complete with a set of spares for all the working parts.
exampleZh: 那个卷轴配有一套所有运行部件的备用件。

meaning: v. 提到，谈及（refer to）；描述，涉及（refer to）；查阅，参考（refer to）；将……送交给（以求获得帮助等）；让（某人）注意；把……归因于；（考试中）淘汰（应试者）
definition: 1. v. make reference to；2. v. have to do with or be relevant to
example: They come from Tuam, a place they refer to on the title track of their album, "All the Way From Tuam."
exampleZh: 他们来自蒂厄姆，一个他们在专辑的标题曲《从蒂厄姆远路而来》中提到的地方。

meaning: n. 提及，谈到；参考，查阅；（引自书或诗歌的）引言，引文；引文的作者，参考书目；（帮助或意见的）征求，征询； (为方便查询所用的）标记，编号；推荐信，介绍信；介绍人，推荐人；adj. 参考的，用于查阅的；文献索引的，参照的；v. 列出……的参考书目；提及，提到；引用，参照（某书或某作者）
definition: 1. n. a remark that calls attention to something or someone；2. v. refer to
example: The problems that Frost's poetry poses for us as readers are not problems of reference. They can't be solved by footnotes.
exampleZh: 他的诗歌给我们的困难,不是参考的问题，它们不能就用脚注解决。

meaning: n. （比赛的）裁判员；仲裁员，调解人；（求职等时的）证明人，介绍人；（刊登前鉴定文章的）审阅人，（拨款前鉴定研究计划的）鉴定专家；v. （给……）当裁判；（给……）做仲裁员，（给……）做调解人；审阅，鉴定（专业性强的文章）
definition: 1. in sports such as American football, association football, basketball, etc., a person who is in charge of making certain that the rules are followed；2. an expert who examines academic work and decides whether or not it is suitable to be published
example: But in my role as the Chief of Staff, that role often is a referee.
exampleZh: 但是作为办公厅主任，会经常扮演仲裁的角色。

meaning: n. 公民投票，全民公决
definition: 1. a vote in which all the people in a country or an area are asked to give their opinion about or decide an important political or social question
example: President Kaunda fulfilled his promise of announcing a date for the referendum.
exampleZh: 卡翁达总统实现了他的关于宣布投票公决日期的诺言。

meaning: v. 精炼，提纯；改进，改善；使……文雅
definition: 1. v. improve or perfect by pruning or polishing；2. v. make more complex, intricate, or richer
example: At the same time, more of this newly discovered oil is of the type that requires a greater investment to refine.
exampleZh: 与此同时，在这些新发现的石油中，更多是需要加大投资才能提炼的类型。

meaning: n. 提炼厂，精炼厂
definition: 1. n. an industrial plant for purifying a crude substance
example: In March Mr. Salinas shut down the city's oil refinery at a cost of $500 million and 5,000 jobs.
exampleZh: 3月时萨利纳斯先生关闭了该市的炼油厂，损失了5亿美元和5000个工作岗位。

meaning: n. 精炼，精制；（精细的）改进，改善；举止文雅；高雅情趣；改良品
definition: 1. n. a highly developed state of perfection; having a flawless or impeccable quality；2. n. the result of improving something
example: Phase III, from March 1991 to March 1993, focused on the refinement and institutionalization of these activities.
exampleZh: 从1991年3月到1993年3月，第三阶段的重点是对这些活动做精细的改进并且使其制度化。

meaning: v. 反射（光、热或声音）；反映，照出（影像）；显示，表明；深思，反省；深思后认为，深思后说；引起（某种）看法，带来影响
definition: 1. v. manifest or bring back；2. v. to throw or bend back or reflect (from a surface)
example: Does such an attitudinal change reflect real experiences in daily life?
exampleZh: 人生观的这种转变是否反映了日常生活中的真实经历？

meaning: n. （光、热或声音的）反射；反射光，反射热，回声；（反射出来的）影像，倒影；深思，反省；（尤指见诸语言的）想法，意见；表现，反映；坏的印象；（数）镜射，反射
definition: 1. n. a calm lengthy intent consideration；2. n. the phenomenon of a propagating wave (light or sound) being thrown back from a surface
example: Everything, every thought, every moment, every reflection, every evaluation, you just on fire to share.
exampleZh: 每一个想法，每一个时刻，每一个思想和评价，你都迫不及待的想要去分享。

meaning: adj. 反射的，反光的 ；沉思的，深思的；体现……的，反映……的
definition: 1. adj. persistently or morbidly thoughtful；2. adj. capable of physically reflecting light or sound
example: Avoid using pans with a shiny, reflective base as the heat will be reflected back.
exampleZh: 避免使用底部闪亮、能反射的锅，因为热量会被反射回去。

meaning: v. 改革，革新；改邪归正，改造；（石油炼制）重整；n. 改革，改良；adj. 犹太教改革（仅保留犹太教部分的传统信条和习俗）（Reform）
definition: 1. n. a change for the better as a result of correcting abuses；2. v. make changes for improvement in order to remove abuse and injustices
example: So, his letters come out of this western land, New Mexico, and a land of criminality, the reform school.
exampleZh: 他的信从新墨西哥这片西部的土地而来，还是寄宿学校这种犯罪滋生地。

meaning: n. 改革，革新；（16世纪促成新教产生的）宗教改革运动（the Reformation）
definition: 1. n. improvement (or an intended improvement) in the existing form or condition of institutions or practices etc.; intended to make a striking change for the better in social or political or religious affairs；2. n. a religious movement of the 16th century that began as an attempt to reform the Roman Catholic Church and resulted in the creation of Protestant churches
example: The second part of Duffy's book is a detailed chronology of the Reformation.
exampleZh: 黛菲书的第二部分是关于改革的一个详细年表。

meaning: adj. 改良主义的，改革派的；n. 改良者，改革者
definition: 1. n. a disputant who advocates reform；2. adj. favoring or promoting reform (often by government action)
example: By no Western standards could the patriarch be described as an enlightened or reformist figure.
exampleZh: 没有西方的标准可以把这位大主教评为开明的或者是改革派的人物。

meaning: v. 克制，避免；n. （诗歌的）叠句，（歌曲的）副歌；叠歌部分的音乐伴奏；经常重复的评价（或抱怨）
definition: 1. n. the part of a song where a soloist is joined by a group of singers；2. v. resist doing something
example: When breaking in an engine, you should refrain from high speeds for the first thousand miles.
exampleZh: 磨合发动机时,你应当避免在最初的1千英里高速行驶。

meaning: v. 使恢复精神，使消除疲劳；使记起，提醒；翻新，使变新；刷新，更新（网页）； 再斟满（饮料）；把（食物）浸入冷水冷却（或保鲜）；恢复精神；喝饮料，吃点心；补充给养；n. （计算机）刷新
definition: 1. v. refresh one's memory；2. v. make (to feel) fresh
example: Just to refresh our memories, we looked at the average valence electron energy as a measure of reactivity.
exampleZh: 重新回顾一下我们记忆，我们看了平均价电子能,能用来测量反应性。

meaning: n. 茶点，点心（refreshments）；食物和饮料；恢复活力，焕发精神
definition: 1. n. snacks and drinks served as a light meal；2. n. activity that refreshes and recreates; activity that renews your health and spirits by enjoyment and relaxation
example: She drank a little milk as temporary refreshment.
exampleZh: 她喝了一点牛奶，暂且垫垫饥恢复一下体力。

meaning: n. 冰箱，冷藏库
definition: 1. n. white goods in which food can be stored at low temperatures
example: You just got to find a good refrigerator on your boat, and then you can still go around the world.
exampleZh: 只需找一个好冰箱放在船上,你仍然可以环游世界。

meaning: n. 冷藏，冷冻
definition: 1. n. the process of cooling or freezing (e.g., food) for preservative purposes；2. n. deliberately lowering the body's temperature for therapeutic purposes
example: Oil or vinegar based salad can be stored for a long period of time without refrigeration.
exampleZh: 含油或醋的沙拉可以储存很长一段时间，而且不需要冷藏。

meaning: n. 庇护，避难；（行为和想法的）逃避，躲避；避难所，庇护处；（街道中央的）避车岛，安全岛；v. 给予庇护，接纳避难；避难，逃避
definition: 1. (a place that gives) protection or shelter from danger, trouble, unhappiness, etc.；2. protection or shelter from danger, trouble, etc., or a place that provides this
example: Four people who sought refuge in the Italian embassy have left voluntarily.
exampleZh: 到意大利大使馆寻求避难的四个人已经自愿离开了。

meaning: n. 难民，避难者
definition: 1. a person who has escaped from their own country for political, religious, or economic reasons or because of a war
example: Refugee workers said such action was a violation of medical ethics.
exampleZh: 难民工作者称这种行为违背了医学道德。

meaning: n. 退款，偿还金额；v. 退还（钱款）；退款给，还钱给（某人）
definition: 1. an amount of money that is given back to you, especially because you are not happy with a product or service that you have bought；2. to give someone a refund
example: Ask for a refund if the goods are faulty.
exampleZh: 商品如有缺陷，可要求退款。

meaning: v. 拒绝，回绝（做某事）；不接受，拒绝（别人给的东西）；拒绝给（所需之物）；（物体）未应要求起作用； 不接受（某人的）求婚；（马）拒绝（跨栏或其他障碍物）；n. 垃圾，废弃物；adj. 废弃的
definition: 1. n. food that is discarded (as from a kitchen)；2. v. show unwillingness towards
example: I have said to you, "Let my son go, that he may worship Me," yet you refuse to let him go.
exampleZh: 我已经告诉过你，“让我的孩子离开，他要崇拜我“,但是你却不让他走。

meaning: n. 拒绝，回绝；拒绝接受，拒绝给予；优先取舍权，优先购买权（first refusal）；选择权；（马）（对障碍物的）拒跳
definition: 1. n. the act of refusing；2. n. a message refusing to accept something that is offered
example: You could see the kind of grim refusal to apologize for "boughten friendship," as a kind of, well, as a kind of apology for his own popular success.
exampleZh: 你可以看到他无情地拒绝了,为“买来的友谊“道歉“,就像为他自己当红的成功,道歉一样。

meaning: v. 驳斥，批驳； 否认，辩驳
definition: 1. to say or prove that a person, statement, opinion, etc. is wrong or false；2. to prove a statement, opinion, or belief to be wrong or false
example: The Yes campaign struggled to refute claims about the cost, complexity, and international rarity of their voting model.
exampleZh: 支持阵营难以驳斥有关其投票模式成本高、复杂度高且在国际上十分罕见的说法。

meaning: n. （对观点、指责或理论的）驳斥，反驳
definition: 1. the act of saying or proving that a person, statement, opinion, etc. is wrong or false
example: He prepared a complete refutation of the Republicans' most serious charges.
exampleZh: 他准备全面反驳共和党人对他最严重的指控。

meaning: v. 认为，把……看作；（尤指以某种方式）注视，凝视；注意，留心；与……有关，涉及；n. 尊重，敬佩； 关心，关注；注视，凝视；（用于信函结尾或转达问候）致意，问候（regards）；【名】 （Regard）（西、意）雷加德，（法）勒加尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. (usually preceded by `in') a detail or point；2. v. deem to be
example: He seemed to regard the whole thing as a joke.
exampleZh: 他似乎是把整件事当成玩笑。

meaning: prep. 关于，至于；v. 看待，认为；（尤指以某种方式）注视，凝视；注意，听从（regard 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. (usually preceded by `in') a detail or point；2. v. deem to be
example: The controversy regarding vitamin C is unlikely to be resolved in the near future.
exampleZh: 关于维生素C的争论近期不大可能被解决。

meaning: adv. 不顾，不加理会；不管怎样，无论如何；adj. 不管的，不注意的
definition: 1. adj. (usually followed by `of') without due thought or consideration；2. adv. in spite of everything; without regard to drawbacks
example: Everyone has the right to good medical care regardless of their ability to pay.
exampleZh: 无论支付能力如何，每个人都有权得到良好的医疗。

meaning: n. （尤指独裁的）政府，政权；（机构、公司、经济等的）管理制度，组织方法；饮食起居制度，养生法
definition: 1. a particular government or a system or method of government；2. a particular way of operating or organizing a business, etc.
example: The Little Ice Age has given way to a new climatic regime, marked by prolonged and steady warming.
exampleZh: 小冰河时代已让位于以持续稳定变暖为特征的新气候体制。

meaning: n. （军队的）团；（尤指有组织的）大批，大群（人或物）；统治，管辖；v. 严格控制，管辖（人及其行为）；把……编成团
definition: 1. a large group of soldiers, or (more generally) any large number of things or people
example: We were part of an entire regiment that had nothing else to do but to keep that motorway open.
exampleZh: 我们是整个团的一部分，这个团无其他任务,只是保证公路畅通。

meaning: adj. （军队中）团的；严格控制的，有组织的；n. 军服（regimentals）
definition: 1. connected with a particular regiment (= a large group of soldiers)
example: The regimental HQ is a tiny office manned by two retired officers.
exampleZh: 该团司令部是个有两个退休军官办公的小办公室。

meaning: n. 地区，区域；行政区；（首都以外的）地方（the regions）；身体部位；领域，界
definition: 1. n. the extended spatial location of something；2. n. a part of an animal that has a special function or is supplied by a given artery or nerve
example: So let me go back up here, and I'm going to comment out that region, and let's uncomment this region.
exampleZh: 那么让我们回到这里，我会为这个区域添加注意，让我们先取消注释。

meaning: adj. 地区的，区域的；（与）首都以外各地（有关）的；n. （邮票、报纸等）地方版；地区性体育竞赛
definition: 1. adj. characteristic of a region；2. adj. related or limited to a particular region
example: And the central and also there are the banks from the regional banks that have a roll.
exampleZh: 而且中央银行和地区银行,都有发挥的空间。

meaning: n. 登记表，注册簿；注册员；（人或乐器的）声区，音区；（适合特定场合使用的）语体风格，语域；（印刷，摄影）套准，叠合；现金出纳机；（电子设备的）寄存器；（供暖或制冷设备的）调风口，节气门；（设计图案组成的）条，局部；v. 登记，注册；（正式地或公开地）发表意见，提出主张；流露出，表达出；注意到，受到注意；（仪器上）显出，显示；把……挂号邮寄；取得（结果），得（分）；（印刷，摄影）套准，叠合；【名】 （Register）（美）雷吉斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. an official written record of names or events or transactions；2. v. record in writing; enter into a book of names or events or transactions
example: But in this case it's a response produced in the negative register similar to the responses produced in the saloon.
exampleZh: 在这次让人讨厌的举动中,理查表现得与在酒吧里一样。

meaning: n. 登记，注册，挂号；登记证，注册证；（汽车）牌照号码（=registration number）； （教师对上课学生的）点名；（管风琴）音栓配合（法）
definition: 1. n. the act of enrolling；2. n. the body of people (such as students) who register or enroll at the same time
example: It had come to a kind of crescendo with voter registration drives and the Voting Rights Act of 1964.
exampleZh: 随着选民登记的进行，和在1964年通过的投票权法案,这样的事愈演愈烈。

meaning: n. （负责登记出生、婚姻和死亡等的）登记员，户籍管理员；（大学的）注册主任，教务主任；高等法院注册官；专科住院医师
definition: 1. n. a person employed to keep a record of the owners of stocks and bonds issued by the company；2. n. the administrator responsible for student records
example: If your request is for information about a child, please contact the registrar to find out how to make such a request.
exampleZh: 如果你寻求的是有关孩子的信息，请与登记员联系以获知如何作这样的请求。

meaning: v. 懊悔，惋惜；（用于正式书面语）对......感到抱歉，对......感到遗憾；对（损失或缺乏）感到痛惜；n. 遗憾，惋惜；（因无法出席会议、聚会等的）致歉语
definition: 1. n. sadness associated with some wrong done or some disappointment；2. v. feel remorse for; feel sorry for; be contrite about
example: Because you will come to regret it if you don't do it. But we're not going to grade it.
exampleZh: 但是我们不会对此计分,因为不计分所以让你们。

meaning: adj. 令人懊悔的，令人遗憾的
definition: 1. adj. deserving regret
example: I don't really have the opportunities to study math and science, which, to some degree, I think is regrettable
exampleZh: 我没什么机会继续学习数学和科学。我有时觉得有些很遗憾，

meaning: adj. 后悔的，遗憾的
definition: 1. adj. feeling or expressing regret or sorrow or a sense of loss over something done or undone
example: Even worse, when people finally do decide, they are generally less satisfied with their decision and feel more regretful over whatever choice they made.
exampleZh: 更糟糕的是，当人们最终做出决定时，他们通常对自己的决定不太满意，并对所做的任何选择感到更加后悔。

meaning: adj. 定期的，规律的；经常的，频繁的；惯常的，通常的；持久的，固定的；标准尺寸的，中号的；普通的，平凡的；常备军的，正规军的；（动词）规则的；（人）正常通便的，月经正常的；完全的，彻底的；均匀的，端正的；正规的，正当的；（冲浪等）左腿在前的；n. 常客，老主顾；主演，主力队员；正规军人，职业军人；普通产品，普通装；（区别于世俗教士的）修道者，教士；【名】 （Regular）（以）雷古拉尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a regular patron；2. adj. in accordance with fixed order or procedure or principle
example: but people came and they, you know, started making a fuss about it. So it's back to the regular time.
exampleZh: 但纽约市民不满意这个决定，纷纷跑来闹事。所以，公园的开放时间又恢复到从前了。

meaning: n. 规律性，经常性；匀称，端正；有规则的东西，有规律的事物
definition: 1. n. a property of polygons: the property of having equal sides and equal angles；2. n. the quality of being characterized by a fixed principle or rate
example: Here, this image of the lines of trees and the metrical regularity of that verse that describes them.
exampleZh: 这里，排列成行的树的画面和,诗里韵律的规律描绘的画面。

meaning: v. （用规则条例）控制，管理；调节，调整；监控，监管；校准，对准（时钟或其他仪器）
definition: 1. v. fix or adjust the time, amount, degree, or rate of；2. v. bring into conformity with rules or principles or usage; impose regulations
example: Under such a plan, the government would regulate competition among insurance companies so that everyone gets care at lower cost.
exampleZh: 根据这样一个计划，政府会控制保险公司之间的竞争，这样每个人都能以较低价格获得保险。

meaning: n. 规章制度，规则；（运用规则条例的）管理，控制；adj. （使用或穿戴）符合规定的，正规的； 公式化的，用俗套话堆砌而成的
definition: 1. n. an authoritative rule；2. adj. prescribed by or according to regulation
example: Some in the market now want government regulation in order to reduce costs.
exampleZh: 市场上现在有人想要政府来管理以降低成本。

meaning: adj. 管理的，控制的，监管的
definition: 1. adj. restricting according to rules or principles
example: That makes sense and it seems like getting rid of some of this division of regulatory agencies is very beneficial.
exampleZh: 这样就变得更合理,也有利于解决两个不同的,监管机构的领域相相争问题。

meaning: n. （某行业的）监管者，监管机构；调节器，校准器
definition: 1. n. any of various controls or devices for regulating or controlling fluid flow, pressure, temperature, etc.；2. n. a official responsible for control and supervision of a particular activity or area of public interest
example: Removal and replacement of the voltage regulator and battery are as easy as changing a light bulb.
exampleZh: 拆除和更换电压调节器和电池像更换一个电灯泡一样容易。

meaning: v. （监禁、戒毒或病后通过培训和治疗）使恢复正常生活；恢复……的权利，恢复……的名誉；使（建筑物或地区）恢复原状，修复
definition: 1. to return someone to a good, healthy, or normal life or condition after they have been in prison, been very ill, etc.；2. to return something to a good condition
example: Considerable efforts have been made to rehabilitate patients who have suffered in this way.
exampleZh: 为使受这种苦的病人康复已经付出了相当大的努力。

meaning: n. 康复，复原；（权利、名誉的）恢复；修复，翻新
definition: 1. the process of returning to a healthy or good way of life, or the process of helping someone to do this after they have been in prison, been very ill, etc.；2. the process of returning something to a good condition
example: A number of other techniques are now being used by psychologists in the rehabilitation of young offenders.
exampleZh: 一些别的技术现正被心理学家们用于年轻罪犯的复原。

meaning: v. 排练，排演；监督（表演者或团体）排演；默诵，默默地练习；详述，重复
definition: 1. to practise a play, a piece of music, etc. in order to prepare it for public performance；2. When someone rehearses a story or an argument, they repeat it with all the details
example: They see the result they want clearly and rehearse it over and over again.
exampleZh: 他们清楚地看到自己想要的结果，然后一遍又一遍地预演。

meaning: n. 排练，排演；预演，演习；复述，重复
definition: 1. a time when all the people involved in a play, dance, etc. practise in order to prepare for a performance
example: Today, I was doing a rehearsal at City of London Boys' School,
exampleZh: 今天，我在伦敦城市中学男校彩排，

meaning: n. （君主）在位时期，统治时期；领导期，任期；支配期，极盛期；（运动员或运动队）持有指明荣誉头衔的时期；v. 为王，统治；支配，盛行；成为最佳，成为最重要的
definition: 1. to be the king or queen of a country；2. to be the main feeling or quality in a situation or person
example: In this lecture I shall concentrate on the early years of Charles's reign.
exampleZh: 这一节课我将着重讲查理王朝的早期统治时期。

meaning: n. 缰绳；（成人牵引幼儿用的）安全绳套；控制，主宰；v. 用缰绳勒（马）使停步或放慢步子，勒（马）；控制住，约束；【名】 （Rein）（西、阿拉伯）雷因，（法）兰，（英、荷、捷、德、芬、瑞典）赖因，（爱沙）雷恩（人名）
definition: 1. a long, thin piece of material, especially leather, that helps you to control and direct a horse；2. a strap that is put around a small child's body or wrist and held at the other end by an adult so that the adult can stop the child running away
example: He promised that between now and the end of the year the government would try to rein back inflation.
exampleZh: 他承诺从现在起到年底政府将努力严格控制通货膨胀。

meaning: v. 加强，强化（观点、思想或感觉）；加固，使更结实；给……加强力量（或装备），增援；寻求（或得到）增援；n. 加固物
definition: 1. v. make stronger；2. v. strengthen and support with rewards
example: Remember you want your visuals to reinforce your message, not detract from what you are saying.
exampleZh: 要记住，你是要用视觉资料来强化你的信息，而不是削弱你所讲述的内容。

meaning: n. 援兵，增援部队（reinforcements）；加强，加固；加固物，强化剂；（尤指通过鼓励或奖赏的）加深，增进，强化；回应
definition: 1. n. a military operation (often involving new supplies of men and materiel) to strengthen a military force or aid in the performance of its mission；2. n. information that makes more forcible or convincing
example: The difference is in positive reinforcement you do something; in negative reinforcement you take away something aversive.
exampleZh: 区别就是，在正强化中你接受某种刺激;,而在负强化中你回避了某种厌恶刺激。

meaning: v. 拒绝，否决（提议、建议或请求）；摈弃，不接受（信仰或政治制度）；不雇用，不录取；（因质量不好而）废弃；冷落，嫌弃；排异，排斥（移植器官）；（投币设备）拒绝接受（硬币）；n. 次品，废品；不合格者，被排斥者
definition: 1. n. the person or thing that is rejected or set aside as inferior in quality；2. v. refuse to accept or acknowledge
example: It lies with you to accept or reject the proposals.
exampleZh: 接受或是拒绝这些建议由你决定。

meaning: n. （对提议、建议或请求的）拒绝接受；（对求职者、求学等者的）拒绝；拒聘函，拒绝录取函；嫌弃，厌弃；（对移植器官的）排斥；被抛弃的东西
definition: 1. n. the act of rejecting something；2. n. the state of being rejected
example: And the rejection of this motif or this idea in Genesis 1 is pointed and purposeful. It's demythologization.
exampleZh: 但《创世纪》第一章中对此模式或观点的否定,是明显且有目的的，它是一种去传奇化的叙述。

meaning: v. 非常高兴，深感欣喜；享有（用于吸引人注意奇特之处，尤指名字）（rejoice in）；使感到高兴，使喜悦
definition: 1. to feel or show great happiness about something；2. to feel or show great happiness
example: When the war ended, people finally had cause to rejoice.
exampleZh: 战争结束，人们终于可以欢欣鼓舞了。

meaning: n. 喜庆，欢庆（=rejoicings）；v. 非常高兴，深感欣喜；享有（用于吸引人注意奇特之处，尤指名字）（rejoice in）；使感到高兴，使喜悦（rejoice 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. the act or feeling of showing great happiness about something
example: There was widespread rejoicing when the missing hikers were found safe and uninjured.
exampleZh: 失踪的徒步者被找到且安然无恙时，人们欢欣鼓舞。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: v. 联系，使有联系；涉及，关于；叙述，讲述；认同，理解；相处，交往（描述人们如何交谈、相处和对待他人）
definition: 1. v. make a logical or causal connection；2. v. have to do with or be relevant to
example: I don't think he understood the dynamics of how the police and the city administration relate.
exampleZh: 我认为他不理解警方与市政部门如何发生联系的动态原理。

meaning: n. （人或物间的）联系；（国家、公司、组织等之间的）（正式）关系； 性关系；亲戚，亲属；讲述，叙述
definition: 1. n. an abstraction belonging to or characteristic of two entities or parts together；2. n. the act of sexual procreation between a man and a woman; the man's penis is inserted into the woman's vagina and excited until orgasm and ejaculation occur
example: Both Guillory and Angus Fletcher are examining the troubled relation of Milton to one of his favorite poets.
exampleZh: 无论是古伊洛还是安格斯弗莱彻,他们都在研究弥尔顿最爱的一首诗中和他相关的问题。

meaning: n. （人、团体、国家等相互间的）关系；（人或事物之间的）关联，关系；恋人关系，性爱关系；血缘关系，姻亲关系
definition: 1. n. a relation between people; (`relationship' is often used where `relation' would serve, as in `the relationship between inflation and unemployment', but the preferred usage of `relationship' is for human relations or states of relatedness)；2. n. a state of connectedness between people (especially an emotional connection)
example: It should further be noted that in the first creation account, in any kind of unequal relationship before God.
exampleZh: 我们还应该注意第一个创世故事中的描述，说他们在上帝面前有不平等的关系。

meaning: n. 亲戚，亲属；同类事物，亲缘动物（或植物）；（语法）关系代词，关系限定词，关系副词；（哲学）关系项；相关物；adj. 相比较而言的，比较的；相对的，相关联的；（语法）（代词、限定词或副词）关系的，（从句）由关系词引导的；（乐）（大小调）调号相同的；（与不同军种的军阶）相应（或对应）的； 关于（或涉及到）......的；相比之下存在（或有）的
definition: 1. n. a person related by blood or marriage；2. adj. not absolute or complete
example: Fitness is relative; one must always ask "Fit for what?"
exampleZh: 适宜是相对的；始终必须问问：“适宜什么？”

meaning: n. （物理）相对论；相对性
definition: 1. n. (physics) the theory that space and time are relative concepts rather than absolute concepts；2. n. the quality of being relative and having significance only in relation to something else
example: According to the theory of relativity, nothing can travel faster than light.
exampleZh: 根据相对论，任何东西都无法超越光速。

meaning: v. 休息，（使）放松；放心，镇定；松开，（使）松弛；放宽（规则或法律等）； 减少（关注），分散（注意力）；烫直（头发）
definition: 1. v. become less tense, rest, or take one's ease；2. v. make less tight
example: They picnic and they barbecue, and just sit out on the grass and just relax. You know it's a beautiful park.
exampleZh: 他们在那里野餐，露天烧烤，或者简单地坐在草地上放松。那是一个很美的公园。

meaning: n. 休息，消遣；休闲活动，娱乐活动；（肌肉等的）松弛，放松；（规则或限制的）放宽；（物理）弛豫，重新平衡
definition: 1. n. (physiology) the gradual lengthening of inactive muscle or muscle fibers；2. n. (physics) the exponential return of a system to equilibrium after a disturbance
example: He doesn't understand by leisure simply relaxation enjoying your private moments enjoying your vacation time.
exampleZh: 他了解的安逸,不仅是放松,享受私人时光,享受假期。

meaning: v. 传递，传达（信息、新闻等）；中继转发，转播（广播或电视信号）；重铺，重新铺设（过去式和过去分词形式 relaid）；n. 接力赛；接班的人（或动物），轮换者；传递，传送；中继设备；继电器；中继转播的信息（或节目）；传输系统，传送系统
definition: 1. n. the act of passing something along from one person or group to another；2. v. pass along
example: Britain's prospects of beating the United States in the relay looked poor.
exampleZh: 英国队在接力赛中战胜美国队的希望看上去不大。

meaning: v. 释放，放走；放开，松开；公布，发布；发行，上映；发泄，宣泄；排放（物质）；免除，解雇；放弃，让予；放松，使松弛；n. 释放，获释；排放，泄漏；释放装置；表达，宣泄；解脱，轻松感；新发行的东西；发表，发布；（责任等的）免除； 放弃，让予； 传球；（设备的）松开
definition: 1. n. merchandise issued for sale or public showing (especially a record or film)；2. v. release, as from one's grip
example: And it's nice way to, you know, not be stressed out and just release some energy.
exampleZh: 这是很好的方式，你知道，让自己不要压力过大，释放一些活力。

meaning: adj. 坚韧的，不屈不挠的；残酷无情的，不留情面的；不停的，不间断的
definition: 1. continuing in a severe or extreme way；2. continuing in a determined way without any interruption
example: Their desires rambled on like unstoppable bores, relentless and whimsical at the same time.
exampleZh: 他们的欲望肆意蔓延，像没完没了的扰人琐事，既无休无止又变幻无常。

meaning: adj. 有关的，切题的；正确的，适宜的；有价值的，有意义的
definition: 1. adj. having a bearing on or connection with the subject at issue
example: But I don't think that it is very relevant if you think that it is better that a baby should die.
exampleZh: 但我认为这与你的想法无关,无论你是否认为一个孩子的死亡是件好事。

meaning: n. 相关性，实用性，意义
definition: 1. n. the relation of something to the matter at hand
example: Where we reside has more and more relevance to the kinds of work available to us.
exampleZh: 我们居住的地点已经越来越多的与我们可获得的工作类型有关。

meaning: n. 遗物，遗迹，遗风；圣物，圣骨；（事物存在或发生的）证据，痕记；残留物，废墟（relics）
definition: 1. an object, tradition, or system from the past that continues to exist；2. a part of the body or something that belonged to a holy person
example: The building stands as the last remaining relic of the town's cotton industry.
exampleZh: 这座建筑物是小镇棉纺业仅存的遗迹。

meaning: v. 缓解（疼痛或不快的感觉）；减轻（问题的严重性）；接替，替下；调剂，排遣； 给（城镇）解围，解救；救济，救援；使某人摆脱（烦人的责任）；免去，解除；上厕所，排便
definition: 1. v. provide physical relief, as from pain；2. v. free someone temporarily from his or her obligations
example: The new secretary will relieve us of some of the paperwork.
exampleZh: 新来的秘书会减轻我们文案工作的一些负担。

meaning: n. （因恐惧、忧虑或痛苦的消除而感到的）宽慰，轻松；（疼痛或不快的）减轻，缓解；救济品（如食品、衣物、金钱等）；换班的人，替换者；浮雕，浮雕品；军事援助，解围；税款减免（权）；（暂时的）缓解（物），（短时间的）调剂；（对困苦、不公正遭遇等的）依法补偿；（高峰时或紧急需要时的）临时加班公交车，机动车；凸现（用线条、颜色或明暗表现的立体效果）；（地形的）凹凸，高低；轮廓分明，对比鲜明；突出的品质，令人注目的特征
definition: 1. n. the feeling that comes when something burdensome is removed or reduced；2. n. the condition of being comfortable or relieved (especially after being relieved of distress)
example: and it's just this massive influx of money for Comic Relief that comes from the general public.
exampleZh: 大量的金钱从大众流向喜剧救助会。

meaning: n. 宗教信仰；宗教，教派；痴迷的活动，极爱好的活动
definition: 1. n. a strong belief in a supernatural power or powers that control human destiny；2. n. an institution to express belief in a divine power
example: There's this deep religious tradition that came out of Slave Religion, but there is also a deep anger. -Yes. Yes.
exampleZh: 在《奴隶宗教》这本书中,既有深深的宗教传统，又有一种怒火，-的确如此。

meaning: adj. 宗教的，与宗教相关的；笃信宗教的，虔诚的；极其严谨的，十分认真的；小心的，谨慎的 ；对……很感兴趣的，热衷……的；n. 修士，修女
definition: 1. n. a member of a religious order who is bound by vows of poverty and chastity and obedience；2. adj. concerned with sacred matters or religion or the church
example: But for Milton's contemporaries in the seventeenth century, Milton's power really wasn't at all aesthetic or even religious in nature.
exampleZh: 但在17世纪弥尔顿同时代的人看来，弥尔顿的力量却是毫无美感的，甚至本质上不是宗教上的。

meaning: n. 享受，乐趣；喜欢，喜爱；开胃小菜，调味品；滋味，风味； 引起食欲的香味；v. 享受，喜欢；憧憬，期盼；品味；味道可口；有……的味道； 使有滋味，加佐料于
definition: 1. to like or enjoy something；2. If you relish the idea or thought of something, you feel pleasure that it is going to happen
example: They relish the time after the committee work is done.
exampleZh: 他们享受委员会工作完成之后的时光。

meaning: adj. 勉强的，不情愿的
definition: 1. adj. unwillingness to do something contrary to your custom；2. adj. unwilling to become involved
example: We were kind of reluctant to take on ideas from Germany, of all places, but we finally did.
exampleZh: 我们美国人有点不愿意接受,德国人的想法，不过我们最后还是接受了。

meaning: n. 不情愿，勉强；（物理）磁阻
definition: 1. n. (physics) opposition to magnetic flux (analogous to electric resistance)；2. n. a certain degree of unwillingness
example: The talks have foundered, largely because of the reluctance of some members of the government to do a deal with criminals.
exampleZh: 会谈已经搁浅了，主要是因为一些政府成员不愿意和罪犯们达成协议。

meaning: v. 相信，信赖；依靠，依赖
definition: 1. v. have confidence or faith in
example: Do we rely on the individual behavior and education, or do we try to do something about the environment?
exampleZh: 我们是要依赖个人行为和教育,还是尝试去改变环境呢

meaning: n. 依靠，信任；被依赖的人（或物）
definition: 1. n. certainty based on past experience；2. n. the state of relying on something
example: About 10% of Japanese teenagers are overweight. Nutritionists say the main culprit is increasing reliance on Western fast food.
exampleZh: 约10%的日本青少年都超重。营养学家们称主要的原因是他们越来越依赖西方快餐。

meaning: adj. 可靠的，可信赖的；真实可信的，确凿的；（汽车、设备、系统等）耐用的，性能稳定的；n. 可靠的人（或物）
definition: 1. adj. worthy of reliance or trust；2. adj. conforming to fact and therefore worthy of belief
example: With some degree of confidence, I'm working with a reliable spring and then I will get the mass of the elephant.
exampleZh: 这时我就对弹簧有信心了,我用的是一个可靠的弹簧,我能测出大象的质量

meaning: v. 逗留，留下；剩余，遗留；保持不变，一直是；仍需去做（或处理）；n. 剩余（物），遗迹；遗体，残骸
definition: 1. v. stay the same; remain in a certain state；2. v. continue in a place, position, or situation
example: So given the elevated status of men, it's all the more important that men should remain pure and chaste.
exampleZh: 考虑到男人崇高的地位，男人要保持纯净与贞操就显得更重要了。

meaning: n. 剩余部分，其余；廉价出售的书，滞销图书；差数，余数；有待继承产权，指定继承产权；v. 削价出售（剩书）；adj. 剩余的，残余的
definition: 1. n. something left after other parts have been taken away；2. v. sell cheaply as remainders
example: His widow became a virtual recluse for the remainder of her life.
exampleZh: 他的遗孀在其余生成了一名实际上的隐居者。

meaning: n. 言论，评述；（正式演讲时的）言论（remarks）； 引人注目，显耀；v. 谈论，说起；注意到
definition: 1. n. a statement that expresses a personal opinion or belief；2. v. make mention of
example: We'll come back to that in a second, but let me make a different remark before we get there.
exampleZh: 我们待会回来讲它,我先讲另一个要点

meaning: adj. 引人注目的，非凡的
definition: 1. adj. unusual or striking；2. adj. worthy of notice
example: That's something that we see again and again and it's remarkable how little common sense is often applied.
exampleZh: 这些技能是我们司空见惯的,当时很奇怪人们一般却没有注意到它们。

meaning: n. 解决方法，纠正方法；法定补偿（办法）；治疗（法），药品；（硬币的）公差；v. 补救，纠正；治疗
definition: 1. n. act of correcting an error or a fault or an evil；2. v. set straight or right
example: I'm going to present you one of the most dramatic examples we've seen of differences in brain activations in these areas, and how these differences can be remedy.
exampleZh: 下面我就来给大家展示一下,我们所见过的最令人吃惊的,有关这两处区域活动不同的例子，同时也会介绍如何治疗这些不同。

meaning: adj. 改进的，补救的；治疗的，帮助康复的；补习的，辅导的
definition: 1. adj. tending or intended to rectify or improve；2. adj. tending to cure or restore to health
example: Efforts should be exerted on pollution prevention instead of on remedial measures.
exampleZh: 应该努力预防污染，而不是采取补救措施。

meaning: v. 回想起，记得；记起，忆起（某事物）；记牢，不忘记；纪念，缅怀；（祈祷时）为......祝福；送钱，送礼（给某人）；代（某人）问候（某人）；（失态后）检点，补救
definition: 1. v. recall knowledge from memory; have a recollection；2. v. keep in mind for attention or consideration
example: Now you also may remember that we have already run into Spenser's Mammon before this point, before Paradise Lost.
exampleZh: 现在你们可能也记得我们已经,在遇到《失乐园》之前就与斯潘塞的贪欲之神相遇了。

meaning: n. 纪念，怀念；记忆，回忆；纪念品，纪念物；记忆力
definition: 1. n. the ability to recall past occurrences；2. n. a recognition of meritorious service
example: A service was held in remembrance of local soldiers killed in the war.
exampleZh: 为当地阵亡的战士举行了纪念仪式。

meaning: v. 提醒，使想起；（因相像）使联想起（remind sb. of）
definition: 1. v. put in the mind of someone；2. v. assist (somebody acting or reciting) by suggesting the next words of something forgotten or imperfectly learned
example: Can you remind me to buy a bottle of wine?
exampleZh: 你能提醒我买一瓶葡萄酒吗？

meaning: n. 提醒物，引起回忆的事物；（提醒做某事的）提示信，通知单
definition: 1. n. a message that helps you remember something；2. n. an experience that causes you to remember something
example: The accident was a salutary reminder of the dangers of climbing.
exampleZh: 这次事故提醒人们注意登山的种种危险，倒也不无益处。

meaning: 使人想起的；令人联想到的
definition: 1. making you remember a particular person, event, or thing
example: We drank from wax-coated paper cups reminiscent of a visit to the dentist.
exampleZh: 我们喝水用的蜡纸杯让我想起了那次去看牙医的事。

meaning: n. 回忆往事的谈话，回忆录；追忆，怀旧；引起联想的相似事物
definition: 1. the act of remembering events and experiences from the past；2. Your reminiscences are the experiences you remember from the past, often written in a book
example: Rather it is part reminiscence, part reflection, part history, and part intuitive exploration.
exampleZh: 确切地讲，它是融回忆、思考、史实和直觉探索于一身。

meaning: n. 残余部分，残迹；布头，零头布料；（基督教神学）余剩民；adj. 残余的，剩余的；【名】 （Remnant）（英）雷姆南特（人名）
definition: 1. a small piece or amount of something that is left from a larger original piece or amount；2. a small piece or amount of something that is left from a larger, original piece or amount
example: But occasionally there is this one little remnant of the old CGS system, centimeters-gram-second, and this is one.
exampleZh: 但是也有些例外,在原来的厘米克秒制中，还有我们说的这个。

meaning: adj. 边远的，偏僻的；（距离或空间上）遥远的；（时间上）久远的；（机会或可能性）渺茫的；差别很大的，很不相同的；不友好的，冷漠的；远亲关系的；（电子设备）遥控的；（计算机）远程的，远程连接的；n. 遥控装置，遥控器
definition: 1. n. a device that can be used to control a machine or apparatus from a distance；2. adj. apart in space
example: Its difficulty lies in Milton's tendency in this poem to seek out what Dr. Johnson wonderfully calls remote allusions.
exampleZh: 诗的难点在于弥尔顿想要在诗中极力追求,被约翰逊绝妙地称为不切实际的幻想的倾向。

meaning: vt. 移开，拿开；除去，废除；把……免职，开除；脱下，摘下； 依法迫迁；远离；不同于，迥异于； 搬家；n. 距离，间距；（一些英国学校中的）年级
definition: 1. n. degree of figurative distance or separation；2. v. remove something concrete, as by lifting, pushing, or taking off, or remove something abstract
example: And so what happens when we remove these stops is that the piston slams up against the next pair of stops.
exampleZh: 把挡板移开后活塞会,向上移动直道第二个挡板处。

meaning: n. 移走，去掉；消除，清除；免职，开除；搬运，搬迁；种族迫迁；（从家里运至教堂举行葬礼的）尸体搬运仪式
definition: 1. n. the act of removing；2. n. dismissal from office
example: What they expected to be the removal of a small lump turned out to be major surgery.
exampleZh: 他们本以为只是切除一个小肿块，结果却成了个大手术。

meaning: n. 复兴，再生；文艺复兴（时期）（the Renaissance）；文艺复兴文化，文艺复兴风格（Renaissance）
definition: 1. a new growth of activity or interest in something, especially art, literature, or music；2. the period of new growth of interest and activity in the areas of art, literature, and ideas in Europe during the 15th and 16th centuries
example: What the Dutch painters painted reflects in the same way that Renaissance art reflected what was important to Renaissance Italy.
exampleZh: 如同意大利的作品反映出文艺复兴的精髓,荷兰画家的作品,同样映射出当时的社会文化特点

meaning: v. 使成为，使处于某种状态；给予，提供；（以某种方式）表达，表现；粉刷，往（墙上）抹灰；将（脂肪）熬成油，使熔化；正式宣布（判决或决定）；（供审查，考虑）提交，呈报；放弃，献出；演奏，演唱；翻译；绘制（指用色彩和明暗使轮廓图像具立体感）；秘密引渡（外国罪犯、恐怖嫌疑犯）；从（动物身体）提取（蛋白质、脂肪及其他可用部分）；n. 底灰，底泥；交纳；【名】 （Render）（美、英、加）伦德尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a substance similar to stucco but exclusively applied to masonry walls；2. v. cause to become
example: About 80% of the cyanide at that point is gone, so it does render the root much more safe.
exampleZh: 这时大约百分之八十的氰化物都跑掉了，因此这确实可以使这些根更加安全。

meaning: n. 表演，演奏；翻译，描述；（涂抹墙壁的）灰泥，水泥；给（墙壁）抹灰（或水泥），粉刷；（计算机）描绘（指用色彩和明暗处理手法使轮廓图像更具立体感）；给予，交出；将动物尸体开膛取出脂肪；v. 使成为，使处于某种状态；给予，提供；（以某种方式）表达，展现（render 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. a performance of a musical composition or a dramatic role etc.；2. n. an explanation of something that is not immediately obvious
example: This phrase may well have been a rendering of a popular Arabic expression.
exampleZh: 这个短语很可能是一个阿拉伯语常用表达的译文。

meaning: v. 重新开始，中止后继续；恢复，重新建立（关系）；使（受到损毁或丢失后）重获新生；更换，更新；重申，重复强调；延长（执照、合同等）的有效期，使续签
definition: 1. v. reestablish on a new, usually improved, basis or make new or like new；2. v. cause to appear in a new form
example: He thinks that following out desire can renew language, and Menelaiad, I think, is his attempt at doing that.
exampleZh: 他认为，贯彻到底的渴望,能够给语言带来活力，而Menelaiad正是他为此所做的一次尝试。

meaning: n. 恢复，重新开始；（有效期的）延长，续订；更新，改建；（有神授超凡能力基督徒的）精神重生
definition: 1. n. the conversion of wasteland into land suitable for use of habitation or cultivation；2. n. the act of renewing
example: His avowed intention was to bring about reform and spiritual renewal for the church.
exampleZh: 他公开宣称他目标是进行教会改革和灵性的复兴。

meaning: adj. （合同、协议等）可延期的，可续期的；（能源）可更新的，可再生的；n. 再生性能源，可再生资源
definition: 1. adj. that can be renewed or extended；2. adj. capable of being renewed; replaceable
example: The success of wind power represents a litmus test for renewable energy.
exampleZh: 风能利用的成功是对可再生能源的一次立见分晓的检验。

meaning: v. 修复，翻新（尤指建筑物）；使恢复活力
definition: 1. v. restore to a previous or better condition；2. v. make brighter and prettier
example: We had to renovate this after the lake overflowed its banks a couple of months ago and flooded the area.
exampleZh: 几个月前，湖水漫过河岸，淹没了这个地区，我们不得不对它进行整修。

meaning: n. 翻新，整修
definition: 1. n. the act of improving by renewing and restoring；2. n. the state of being restored to its former good condition
example: how all the spaces are allocated in the building, the new renovation in terms of the students groups.
exampleZh: 楼里所有空间如何分配和翻修，利于学生团队。

meaning: n. 名誉，声望；v. 使有声望
definition: 1. the state of being famous
example: He was also a loyal company man, never allowing his growing renown to go to his head.
exampleZh: 他也是一位忠诚的团队成员，从不让其不断上升的名望冲昏头脑。

meaning: adj. 有名望的，著名的；v. 使有声誉（renown 的过去式和过去分词）
definition: 1. famous for something
example: Chobe is also renowned for its large herds of elephant and buffalo.
exampleZh: 乔贝还以其大群的大象和水牛而闻名。

meaning: n. 租金，租用费；（布等上面的）破洞，裂口；vt. 租用，租借；出租，将……租给； 可租用，租金为；v. 撕裂，扯碎；（声音）响彻，刺破；使心碎（rend 的过去式和过去分词形式）；【名】 （Rent）（瑞典）伦特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a regular payment by a tenant to a landlord for use of some property；2. v. let for money
example: But Brooklyn, the spaces are twice as large, and the rent is half the price.
exampleZh: 但在布鲁克林，空间是那里的两倍大，而租金却是那里的一半。

meaning: n. 租费，租金；出租，租赁；租用物（尤指房屋或车辆）；adj. （与）租借（有关）的，可供租用的
definition: 1. n. property that is leased or rented out or let；2. adj. available to rent or lease
example: He has a rental car and is zooming to the airport.
exampleZh: 他出租给别人的一辆车正在向机场高速驶去。

meaning: v. 修理，修补；补救，挽救（关系或声誉）；（结伴）去，赴（repair to）；n. 修理，补救；修补过的地方；维修状态，保养情况； 常去；常去的场所
definition: 1. n. the act of putting something in working order again；2. v. restore by replacing a part or putting together what is torn or broken
example: Because of this, they can't repair the various kinds of damage they need, or create the amino acids and proteins they need.
exampleZh: 他们不能修复各种损伤,或者生成所需的氨基酸蛋白质

meaning: adj. 可修理的，可补救的，可挽回的
definition: 1. adj. capable of being repaired or rectified
example: Her mistakes looked easily reparable in the light of her restored self-confidence .
exampleZh: 她恢复了自信心以后，所犯的错误似乎也并非不可补救了。

meaning: v. 付还，偿还；报答，回报；值得付出（时间、努力等）
definition: 1. v. pay back；2. v. make repayment for or return something
example: Third, some people have said don't the successful like Gates owe a debt to society for their success that they repay by paying taxes.
exampleZh: 第三，有人说过，像盖茨这样的成功人士,难道不欠社会,不该通过缴税回报社会吗。

meaning: n. 付还，偿还；（分期）偿还额，付还款项
definition: 1. n. the act of returning money received previously；2. n. payment of a debt or obligation
example: He failed to meet last Friday's deadline for repayment of a $114 million loan.
exampleZh: 他在上周五的最后期限内未能偿还$1.14亿的贷款。

meaning: v. 重复，重说；复述，跟读（尤指为学习）；转述，转告；（强调说过的话）再说一遍；重新做，使再次发生；重播；重读，重修；（选举中违法）重复投票；再次成功，两连冠；（吃下的食物因打嗝或消化不良）在口中留下余味；（钟表按要求）连打；n. （事件的）重演，重现；重播节目；（同类货物的）再次运送；重复装饰图案；（乐谱的）反复符号，重复段
definition: 1. n. an event that repeats；2. v. to say, state, or perform again
example: So I will ask you questions. The only annoying thing I will have to do is to repeat your answers.
exampleZh: 所以我要向你们提问,唯一很讨厌的就是我要你们重复你们的回答。

meaning: n. 重复，重说，重做； 重做的事，重说的话；重复的事物，复制品；（乐）（章节或音节的）反复；教师指定的背诵材料
definition: 1. n. an event that repeats；2. n. the act of doing or performing again
example: He could also have cut out much of the repetition and thus saved many pages.
exampleZh: 他本来也可以删掉很多重复的语句，省去很多页数。

meaning: adj. 重复乏味的；多次重复的
definition: 1. adj. persistently continual；2. adj. characterized by repetition
example: This technique is particularly successful where problems occur as the result of repetitive movements.
exampleZh: 这项技术的成功之处在于能解决重复运动引起的问题。

meaning: adv. 重复地，再三地
definition: 1. adv. several time
example: Is that right? In this game, when we analyzed the game repeatedly, it seemed like our analysis converged towards the equilibrium.
exampleZh: 没错吧,当我们反复分析这个博弈,我们的分析最后会趋近均衡

meaning: v. 击退，驱逐；抵御，驱除；使厌恶，使反感；抵制，不愿接受；排斥，相斥
definition: 1. to force someone or something to stop moving towards you or attacking you；2. (of a material) to not allow a substance to be absorbed into it
example: They have fifty thousand troops along the border ready to repel any attack.
exampleZh: 他们沿边界有5万军队，随时准备击退任何进攻。

meaning: n. （表演者或表演团的）全部剧目，全部曲目，全部节目；全部技能（或才能）
definition: 1. all the music or plays, etc. that you can do or perform or that you know；2. all the things that someone can do, all the methods that someone can use, etc.
example: this kind of unitary repertoire of spirits and memories can be evoked by symbols.
exampleZh: 这种灵魂和记忆的结合,可以被象征激发。

meaning: v. 取代；（用……）替换，（以……）接替；更换， 赔还；把......放回原处
definition: 1. v. substitute a person or thing for (another that is broken or inefficient or lost or no longer working or yielding what is expected)；2. v. take the place or move into the position of
example: He wants to replace that with a new kind of, I want to call it rational citizenship, philosophical citizenship.
exampleZh: 他想要以一种,新型态取而代之，我称之为理性的公民社会，达观的公民社会。

meaning: n. 代替，更换；取代（或代替）的人（或物）；补充兵员
definition: 1. n. an event in which one thing is substituted for another；2. n. the act of furnishing an equivalent person or thing in the place of another
example: She will continue in her present job until a replacement can be found.
exampleZh: 在找到替换人员以前，她将继续做她目前的工作。

meaning: v. 回答，答复；（以行动）作出回应，回击；（在体育比赛中）以得分回应，回敬；n. （口头或书面）回答，答复；回应，作出反应；（比赛）一方得分（进球）但对方未得分（进球）；（原告对被告抗辩的）驳复，答辩
definition: 1. n. a statement (either spoken or written) that is made in reply to a question or request or criticism or accusation；2. v. reply or respond to
example: When we finished last time, we were looking at John Stuart Mill's attempt to reply to the critics of Bentham's Utilitarianism.
exampleZh: 上节课结束时，我们讲到约翰·斯图尔特·穆勒试图回应,对边沁功利主义的批判。

meaning: n. 报告，汇报；新闻报道；官方文件，调查报告；传闻，传说；（学生）成绩报告单；案情报告；下属；爆炸声，枪声；谣言，流传；名誉，名声；v. 报道；据说，传闻；述说，报告；公告，公布；举报（罪案）， 报告（事故）；报到；描述（感情、病情等）；（议会委员会主席）正式宣布委员会已讨论（法案）；（议会委员会）将法案交还给议会表决；对（上级或监督者）负责，由......领导；告发，检举；【名】 （Report）（匈）雷波特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a written document describing the findings of some individual or group；2. v. to give an account or representation of in words
example: and then we're going to use the results of the experiment to write a lab report
exampleZh: 然后我们根据实验结果来撰写实验报告，

meaning: n. 记者，通讯员
definition: 1. n. a person who investigates and reports or edits news stories
example: Cash box would be would have something called it was called Van Court's Bank Note Reporter and Counterfeit Detector .
exampleZh: 钱柜将会是将有种叫做,凡？科特的银行票据报告,和验钞机的东西。

meaning: v. 代表；为……代言（辩护）；代表（选区、政党、群体）任国会议员（或其他立法机构议员）；代表（国家、学校、城镇等参加比赛）；作为某人的代表（尤指在正式场合或仪式中）；等于，相当于；（符号或象征）代表，表示；象征，体现；展示，描绘；（尤指不真实地）描述，描写；扮演；明确讲述，清楚说明；声称；正式提出（意见、抗议等）
definition: 1. v. take the place of or be parallel or equivalent to；2. v. express indirectly by an image, form, or model; be a symbol
example: Shakespeare in the theater seemed to represent a temptation greater even than promiscuous sex or perhaps akin to sex.
exampleZh: 在戏剧中,莎士比亚似乎更代表着一种诱惑,而不是乱性或类似的性关系。

meaning: n. 代理人，代表；描绘，表现；表示，象征；表现物（尤指画或模型）；抗议，陈述；（感知理论用语）表象
definition: 1. n. a presentation to the mind in the form of an idea or image；2. n. a creation that is a visual or tangible rendering of someone or something
example: Puerto Ricans are U.S. citizens but they have no representation in Congress.
exampleZh: 波多黎各人是美国公民，但是他们在国会中没有代表。

meaning: adj. 典型的，有代表性的；代表各类人（或事物）的；由代表组成的，代议制的；表现的，体现的；（艺术）具象派的；（哲） （与）表象（有关）的；n. 代表，代理人；代表他人者；销售代表，销售代理；典型人物，有代表性的事物；（美国）众议院议员；（类或群的）样本，代表物
definition: 1. n. a person who represents others；2. adj. serving to represent or typify
example: The sovereign representative acts, you might say, like a filter for the wills and passions of the people.
exampleZh: 而君主代表的行动，就像人民意志和力量的过滤器。

meaning: v. 压抑（痛苦的情感、回忆等）；抑制，克制（行为）；（尤指用武力）镇压，压制；实施镇压；使（基因）转录受阻遏
definition: 1. to not allow something, especially feelings, to be expressed；2. to control what people do, especially by using force
example: Yet children, also fearing their parents' punishment and the loss of parental love, come to repress most aggressive impulses.
exampleZh: 然而，孩子们也害怕父母的惩罚和失去父母的爱，因此他们会抑制最具攻击性的冲动。

meaning: n. 镇压，压制； 抑制，压抑
definition: 1. the use of force or violence to control a group of people；2. the process and effect of keeping particular thoughts and wishes out of your conscious mind in order to defend or protect it
example: There has brooded very steadily over the female half of the human family an air of repression.
exampleZh: 家庭中的女性成员一直笼罩在压抑气氛之下。

meaning: adj. 镇压的，压制的；压抑的，抑制的
definition: 1. controlling what people do, especially by using force；2. preventing people from expressing their feelings
example: The repressive mark was composed of three methyl groups attached to a lysine on the H4 histone.
exampleZh: 抑制性标记由3个甲基基团组成，结合到组蛋白H4的一个赖氨酸残基上。

meaning: n. 责备，批评；责备的话语，批评的言辞；丢脸，耻辱；（给……）带来羞辱的人（或事）；使缺陷或弱点更显突出的事物（a reproach to）；谴责曲（Reproaches）；v. 谴责，批评
definition: 1. to criticize someone, especially for not being successful or not doing what is expected；2. something that you say or do to criticize someone, especially for not being successful or for not doing what is expected
example: You've no reason to reproach yourself, no reason to feel shame.
exampleZh: 你没有理由责备自己，也没有理由感到羞愧。

meaning: v. 复制，翻印；模拟；再制造，再现；繁殖，生殖
definition: 1. v. make a copy or equivalent of；2. v. have offspring or young
example: We cannot say writing came into being belatedly with respect to speech in order to reproduce, imitate, or transcribe speech.
exampleZh: 我们不能说书写比演讲产生得更晚,是为了复制，模仿，或者是记录下演讲的内容。

meaning: n. 生殖，繁殖；复印，再版；（声音的）复制，录制；复制品，仿制品
definition: 1. n. the process of generating offspring；2. n. recall that is hypothesized to work by storing the original stimulus input and reproducing it during recall
example: The reproduction and growth of the cancerous cells can be suppressed by bombarding them with radiation.
exampleZh: 癌细胞的繁殖和生长可通过放射线辐射加以抑制。

meaning: adj. 生殖的，繁殖的；翻印的，复制的
definition: 1. adj. producing new life or offspring
example: Dad, I need to memorize a unit about the reproductive cycle of plants.
exampleZh: 爸爸，我需要记住一个关于植物繁殖周期的单元。

meaning: n. 共和国，共和政体
definition: 1. n. a political system in which the supreme power lies in a body of citizens who can elect people to represent them；2. n. a form of government whose head of state is not a monarch
example: One of his propagandists said this about him: "The pristine form of the Republic was recalled as of old."
exampleZh: 他的一位传道者这么描述他：,“共和制的纯净形式已经恢复，如同旧时“

meaning: adj. 共和政体的，共和国的；拥护共和政体的，共和主义的；（美国）共和党的，支持共和党的（Republican）；北爱尔兰共和主义者的，支持北爱尔兰共和主义者的（Republican）；n. 共和主义者，拥护共和政体者；（美国）共和党人，共和党支持者（Republican）；（主张北爱尔兰应脱离英国成为爱尔兰共和国一部分的）北爱尔兰共和主义者（Republican）
definition: 1. n. a member of the Republican Party；2. adj. relating to or belonging to the Republican Party
example: They formed the rank and file of the republican armies in England against the rule of the king.
exampleZh: 在反抗国王统治的战争中,正是他们,组成了这支共和军。

meaning: n. 名誉，名声
definition: 1. n. the state of being held in high esteem and honor；2. n. notoriety for some particular characteristic
example: And the most important thing in the Southern code of honor, I think, safe to say, was reputation.
exampleZh: 南方人所谓的荣誉的核心部分,我以为,可以肯定的说,是声誉

meaning: 名声；声望
definition: 1. a bad, good, etc. reputation
example: Under his leadership, the U.N.'s repute has risen immeasurably.
exampleZh: 在他的领导下，联合国的名望得到了极大提升。

meaning: adj. 声誉好的，值得信赖的
definition: 1. having a good reputation and able to be trusted；2. having a good reputation
example: You are well advised to buy your car through a reputable dealer.
exampleZh: 你通过一个声誉好的经销商来买车是明智的。

meaning: n. 要求，请求；要求的事，点播的歌曲；（要求计算机提供信息或执行另一任务的）指令；v. 请求，要求；要求（某人）做……，请求（某人）做……；点播（乐曲）
definition: 1. n. a formal message requesting something that is submitted to an authority；2. v. express the need or desire for; ask for
example: You can find that Box Computing efficiently connects enormous user request with the application providers.
exampleZh: 框计算就会展现出高效的一面,能够将众多用户要求与程序提供者连结起来。

meaning: v. 需要；要求做（某事），规定
definition: 1. v. require as useful, just, or proper；2. v. consider obligatory; request and expect
example: For me, when I'm doing assignments that require a lot of writing or you know,
exampleZh: 对我来说，如果我做的项目需要大量的写作，

meaning: n. 要求，必要条件；需要（要求）的事物
definition: 1. n. required activity；2. n. anything indispensable
example: Evidence of basic proficiency in English is part of the admissions requirement.
exampleZh: 基本英语水平的证明是录取条件的一部分。

meaning: v. 营救，援救；拯救，挽救（生意等）；防止……丢失（或遭丢弃），取回；n. 营救，救援；营救行动
definition: 1. n. recovery or preservation from loss or danger；2. v. free from harm or evil
example: We had given up hope of rescue.
exampleZh: 我们那时已经放弃了获救的希望。

meaning: n. （尤指大学或科研机构进行的）研究，探讨；研究工作，调查工作；v. 研究，探索；为……收集资料，调查
definition: 1. n. systematic investigation to establish facts；2. v. inquire into
example: especially as I am trying to develop my own thoughts and my own research questions for my future career.
exampleZh: 尤其是就我未来职业方面，我正在尝试形成自己的观点，提出我的研究问题。

meaning: n. 研究人员
definition: 1. n. a scientist who devotes himself to doing research
example: Someone who lacks staying power and persistence is unlikely to make a good researcher.
exampleZh: 缺乏耐力和毅力的人不可能成为一个出色的研究人员。

meaning: v. 像，与……相似
definition: 1. v. appear like; be similar or bear a likeness to
example: In this respect it would resemble Spenser's Faerie Queene, or perhaps more importantly, Virgil's Aeneid -- other nationalist epics.
exampleZh: 这样的话它就会与斯宾塞的《仙后》，更重要的，维吉尔的《埃涅阿斯记》等一些民族主义史诗相类似。

meaning: n. 相似，相像；相似点，相似之处；相似物
definition: 1. n. similarity in appearance or external or superficial details
example: And that's not simply because Satan bears such a strong resemblance to Milton, as, of course, he does.
exampleZh: 这不单单是因为撒旦与弥尔顿是如此相像,当然了，他们确实很相似。

meaning: v. 怨恨，憎恶
definition: 1. v. feel bitter or indignant about；2. v. wish ill or allow unwillingly
example: The time had come when Mary had forgotten to resent Martha's familiar talk.
exampleZh: 到了玛丽不再厌恶玛莎唠叨的时候了。

meaning: n. 愤恨，怨恨
definition: 1. n. a feeling of deep and bitter anger and ill-will
example: Often I find that anger and resentment are at the bottom of the problem.
exampleZh: 我经常发现愤怒与不满是问题的实际原因。

meaning: v. 预订；保留，预留；拥有，保留（某种权利）；留作，用于（特定场合）；保留（意见），推迟作出（决定或判断）；贮存，贮藏；（教会用语）弥撒仪式后保留部分圣餐；n. 储备（量），储藏（量）；含蓄，寡言；保留意见，异议；（野生生物）保护区；替补队员，后备队员；后备队，替补队（the reserves）；预备役部队，后备部队；（尤指拍卖时的）底价，最低价；（美洲土著居民的）居留地；（陶瓷装饰或纺织品印染中保留原色的）防染本色区 ；（陶瓷装饰或纺织品印染中保留原色的）防染本色区；【名】 （Reserve）（挪、美、法、俄、墨）勒塞尔夫（人名）
definition: 1. n. formality and propriety of manner；2. v. hold back or set aside, especially for future use or contingency
example: That is the special category that Foucault wants to reserve for those privileged figures whom he calls founders of discursivity.
exampleZh: 这就是福柯想为那些他称之为散漫性创始人的,特权作家们保留的特殊类别。

meaning: n. 保留，保护；（房间，座位等的）预订；（美国印第安人的）居留地，保留地；（野生动物）保护区；（财产转让的）权益保留；圣餐保留（指弥撒完毕后部分圣餐留给病人或作为礼拜之用）；存疑，保留；（罗马天主教高级圣职人员的）赦罪权的保留；（教皇的）任命权保留
definition: 1. n. a district that is reserved for particular purpose；2. n. a statement that limits or restricts some claim
example: But I made the reservation for the 14th. So then we went on Valentine's Day, to go and see the exhibit.
exampleZh: 但我把时间预定到了十四号。所以情人节那天我们可以去看展览。

meaning: adj. 寡言少语的，内敛的；保留的，预订的；v. 预订，预约；保留，贮备；拥有（某种权利等）（reserve 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. set aside for the use of a particular person or party；2. adj. marked by self-restraint and reticence
example: But in Homer the term is reserved for Agamemnon or for gods, but not for any other human being.
exampleZh: 但《荷马史诗》中这个位置给了阿伽门农,或者是上帝,而不是其他人

meaning: n. 水库，蓄水池；储藏，蓄积 ；（机器等的）贮液器，贮液槽；（病原体的）储存宿主
definition: 1. a place for storing liquid, especially a natural or artificial lake providing water for a city or other area；2. a large supply of something
example: What that means is we want to run the hot reservoir as hot as possible and the cold reservoir as cold as possible.
exampleZh: 也就是说我们希望高温热源温度尽可能高,同时低温热源温度尽可能低,从原理上说。

meaning: v. 改组，岗位调整；重新洗牌；重新排序，重新安排；n. （机构或组织内的）人事调整，改组
definition: 1. an occasion when the positions of people or things within a particular group are changed；2. to change the positions of people or things within a particular group
example: The prime minister told reporters this morning that he plans to reshuffle his entire cabinet.
exampleZh: 首相今晨告诉记者们他计划改组全体内阁。

meaning: v. 居住，定居；存在于；（权利、权力等）属于；位（于）
definition: 1. v. make one's home in a particular place or community；2. v. live (in a certain place)
example: And there is a proportionality between that and where we expect the electron to reside.
exampleZh: 概率和我们期望电子所处的位置,存在着一种正比关系。

meaning: n. 住宅，住所；居住，定居；（在某国的）居住权，居留许可；（大学的）学生宿舍楼
definition: 1. n. any address at which you dwell more than temporarily；2. n. the official house or establishment of an important person (as a sovereign or president)
example: There were significant differences among women based on age, place of residence, and educational levels.
exampleZh: 基于年龄、住处和教育水平，妇女们之间存在显著的差异。

meaning: n. 居民，住户；（旅馆的）住宿者；住院医生； 寄宿制学校学生；（英国政府派驻半独立国家的） 特派代表；驻外特工；留鸟，无迁徙习性的蝴蝶（或其他动物）；adj. （在某地）居住的，居留的；常驻的；属于（某个群体）的；（鸟、蝴蝶等）非迁徙性的；（计算机程序、文件等在存储器中）驻留的
definition: 1. n. someone who lives at a particular place for a prolonged period or who was born there；2. adj. living in a particular place
example: Local resident groups have united in opposition to the plan.
exampleZh: 当地居民团体已联合起来反对这项计划。

meaning: adj. 住宅区的，居民区的 ；家庭的，住宅的；（为工作、学习或受人照料而）住宿（在某地）的
definition: 1. adj. used or designed for residence or limited to residences；2. adj. of or relating to or connected with residence
example: L.A.'s not as exciting as New York, I guess. It's more suburban and residential than New York.
exampleZh: 我认为洛杉矶没有纽约精彩，她更属于郊区，更适宜居住。

meaning: v. 辞（职），放弃（工作或职位）；（使）听任，（使）顺从（~ oneself to）；（国际象棋）放弃，投子认输
definition: 1. v. leave (a job, post, or position) voluntarily；2. v. give up or retire from a position
example: But it doesn't mean that I need to resign to my thoughts about that feeling.
exampleZh: 但不代表,我要屈从于对那种感受的想法。

meaning: n. 辞职； 辞职信，辞呈；顺从，听任；（棋）认输
definition: 1. n. acceptance of despair；2. n. the act of giving up (a claim or office or possession etc.)
example: And what I'm not talking about is resignation.
exampleZh: 我说的不是屈从。

meaning: v. 阻挡，抵制；抵抗，回击；耐得住，抵挡；使不受……的伤害，抗（伤害）；n. 保护涂层（防染色、着釉等），防染材料
definition: 1. v. elude, especially in a baffling way；2. v. stand up or offer resistance to somebody or something
example: You apply a force and the material will resist it until you have a force great enough to break the bonds.
exampleZh: 如何你对它施加一个外力，材料能够承受,除非这个外力足够强大去打破键。

meaning: n. 反对，抵制；抵抗，反抗；抵抗力，免疫力；阻力；电阻；（敌占区的）秘密抵抗组织
definition: 1. n. the action of opposing something that you disapprove or disagree with；2. n. any mechanical force that tends to retard or oppose motion
example: The good scholars of Milton reveal their typical resistance to anything even remotely interesting or alive in the text.
exampleZh: 研究弥尔顿的优秀学者们透露他们反对,研究文本中那些不太有趣和生动的东西。

meaning: adj. 抵制的，反抗的；有抵抗力的，不受……损害的；n. 抵抗者
definition: 1. adj. relating to or conferring immunity (to disease or infection)；2. adj. able to tolerate environmental conditions or physiological stress
example: The more pesticides are used, the more resistant the insects become so the more pesticides have to be used. It's a vicious circle.
exampleZh: 杀虫剂使用得越多，那些昆虫的抵抗力越强，因此就要使用更多的杀虫剂。这是一个恶性循环。

meaning: v. 解决（问题或困难）；决定，下定决心；作出决议，表决；分解，转化；（使）（症状、病情）消散，消退；解析，解离；分析；（不协和音）转向协和；（当远处物体看得更清楚时）变成；（光学仪器等）分辨；辨析（图表或光谱峰值）；n. 决心，坚定的信念；正式决定，决议；决定要做的事
definition: 1. n. the trait of being resolute；2. v. bring to an end; settle conclusively
example: We have to resolve this matter once and for all.
exampleZh: 我们必须彻底解决这件事情。

meaning: n. 决议，正式决定；（冲突、问题等的）解决，解决办法；决心，决定；坚决，果断；（电视、照相机、显微镜等的）清晰度，分辨率；（故事中主要矛盾的）冲突解开；（乐）解决（指和声中不协和音向协和音的进行）；（医）（炎症或其他症状的）消散，消退；（化）分解；（物理）（力或其他矢量的）分解
definition: 1. n. a formal expression by a meeting; agreed to by a vote；2. n. the ability of a microscope or telescope to measure the angular separation of images that are close together
example: She made a New Year's resolution to get in shape.
exampleZh: 她立下了新年决议，要改善体形。

meaning: adj. 坚决的，果断的
definition: 1. adj. firm in purpose or belief; characterized by firmness and determination；2. adj. characterized by quickness and firmness
example: Voters perceive him as a decisive and resolute international leader.
exampleZh: 选民认识到他是一位果断、坚定的国际领袖。

meaning: n. 旅游胜地，度假胜地；求助的方法，采用的手段；采用，诉诸，求助；v. 诉诸，求助于；常去，（成群结队地）去
definition: 1. n. a hotel located in a resort area；2. v. have recourse to
example: The resort is a playground of the rich and famous.
exampleZh: 这个度假胜地是富翁名流的娱乐场所。

meaning: n. 自然资源；资源（指钱、物、人等）；有助于实现目标的东西，资料；（对付困境所需的）个人素质（resources）；（逆境中的）出路，应付办法； 谋略，智谋；v. 向……提供资金（或设备）
definition: 1. n. available source of wealth; a new or reserve supply that can be drawn upon when needed；2. n. a source of aid or support that may be drawn upon when needed
example: The Internet is often used as a resource and as a tool for distance learning.
exampleZh: 互联网通常被用作远程学习的资源和工具。

meaning: adj. 足智多谋的，机敏的
definition: 1. adj. having inner resources; adroit or imaginative
example: He was amazingly inventive and resourceful, and played a major role in my career.
exampleZh: 他极具创造力又足智多谋，在我的职业生涯中起了重要的作用。

meaning: n. 尊敬，敬重；重视，尊重；方面，着眼点；问候，敬意（respects）；v. 尊敬，敬佩；慎重对待，尊重；遵守；避免破坏（或干扰）；int. 真了不起（因敬重或赞同而发出的感叹）
definition: 1. n. (usually preceded by `in') a detail or point；2. v. regard highly; think much of
example: or they never give themselves that moment that they need to just sort of respect themselves.
exampleZh: 要不就是从来不给自己一个尊重自己的机会。

meaning: adj. 值得尊敬的，体面的；相当好的，不错的；有一定价值的，相当重要的；n. 可敬的人
definition: 1. adj. characterized by proper behavior or conventional conduct; worthy of respect；2. adj. deserving of esteem and respect
example: The former wild man of rock has reinvented himself as a respectable family man.
exampleZh: 过去的那位摇滚狂人已经改变形象，成了一位体面的爱家的男人。

meaning: adj. 表示敬意的，尊敬的
definition: 1. adj. full of or exhibiting respect；2. adj. feeling or manifesting veneration
example: He was very respectful at home and obedient to his parents.
exampleZh: 他在家里很尊重人而且顺从父母。

meaning: adj. 分别的，各自的
definition: 1. adj. considered individually
example: The happy couple and their respective parents took to the floor.
exampleZh: 那幸福的一对和他们各自的父母开始跳起舞来。

meaning: adv. 分别地，依次地
definition: 1. adv. in the order given
example: So each respectively, this is sorted 1 and 2 respectively 4 and 5, this is sorted but clearly they are not in the right order.
exampleZh: 分别地，1磅和2磅的是有序的，同样4,4磅和5磅的也是有序的,但显然它们的顺序并不正确。

meaning: v. （口头或书面）回答，回应；作出反应，回应；（对某种治疗）有良好反应；（桥牌）（对同伴的叫牌）作应叫；（会众对牧师）应答，唱和；承担责任；n. （教堂用语）应答，唱和；（建筑）壁联（与墙相连支承拱的半柱或半墩，尤指在拱廊两端）
definition: 1. v. show a response or a reaction to something；2. v. reply or respond to
example: You have a very, very changing demographic situation in the American South and its political culture has to respond to that.
exampleZh: 你可以想象,当时的美国南方,人口流动是非常厉害的,所以当时的政治文化必须做出相应的调整

meaning: n. 反应，响应；（口头或书面的）回复，答复；（考试题的）答案；（教堂中人们对牧师所说的话作出的）唱和，应答
definition: 1. n. a result；2. n. a bodily process occurring due to the effect of some foregoing stimulus or agent
example: But in this case it's a response produced in the negative register similar to the responses produced in the saloon.
exampleZh: 在这次让人讨厌的举动中,理查表现得与在酒吧里一样。

meaning: adj. 反应迅速的，积极反应的；反应热烈的，热情的；回应的，回答的；（宗教仪式一部分）用应答（或唱和）的
definition: 1. adj. containing or using responses or antiphons recited or sung in alternation；2. adj. readily reacting to people or events or stimuli; showing emotion
example: In, and above all, in the phase of the world, that is, not responsive to our system of values.
exampleZh: 总的来说，世界现状，并没有回应我们的价值观。

meaning: n. （调查表、问卷调查的）答卷人，调查对象；（尤指上诉案或离婚案的）被告；adj. 处于被告地位的；（尤指对民意调查，问卷调查等）作回答的，应答的；（尤指对特定刺激的条件反射）有反应的，反射的
definition: 1. n. the codefendant (especially in a divorce proceeding) who is accused of adultery with the corespondent；2. adj. replying
example: "Artists help scientists reach a broader audience and make emotional connections that enhance learning," one respondent said.
exampleZh: 一位受访者说：“艺术家帮助科学家开拓观众群体，并建立情感联系，从而改善学习效果。”

meaning: adj. （对某人、某事）负责的；（对事故、错误、罪行等）负有责任的，应承担责任的；（工作或职位）重要的，责任重大的；可靠的，负责任的；作为缘由的，应受归咎的；向......负责的，向......汇报的
definition: 1. adj. worthy of or requiring responsibility or trust; or held accountable；2. adj. being the agent or cause
example: And so even at really young ages, we want them to be responsible for their own social interactions.
exampleZh: 即使是在很小的时候，他们也要学会处理人际关系。

meaning: n. 责任，负责；（对不良事件所负的）责任；（道义上或法律规定的）责任（responsibility to/towards）；职责，任务；重任，职权
definition: 1. n. the social force that binds you to the courses of action demanded by that force；2. n. the proper sphere or extent of your activities
example: They throw a lot of work at us, we have a lot of responsibility, it's all new.
exampleZh: 他们丢给我们一大堆工作，我们责任很大，还都是新的。

meaning: v. 休息，歇息；使（运动员）暂时离队； （问题，事情）被搁置；（被）支撑，（使）倚靠；安息，长眠；在于，存放于；（目光）停留（rest on）；依靠，仰仗（rest on/upon）；寄（希望）于，相信；让（土地）休耕；（原告或被告）完成向法庭提出证据（或辩论）；保持不变；（演员）无戏可演；n. 休息（时间）；剩余部分，余下的人（物）（the rest）；静止，停止；（音乐的）休止，休止符；（演说或诗句的）停顿；撑架，支座；（剖）（器官或组织的）一小碎块；（网球）对打，回合；【名】 （Rest）（美）雷斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. something left after other parts have been taken away；2. v. not move; be in a resting position
example: I think I could maybe afford a front door if I work really hard for the rest of my life.
exampleZh: 我想如果我下半辈子努力工作的话，我可以买得起一个前门。

meaning: n. 餐馆，饭店
definition: 1. n. a building where people go to eat
example: This is where Richard is talking about the waitresses, the white waitresses he works with in the restaurant in Chicago.
exampleZh: 理查那些女招待以及和他一起，在芝加哥餐厅工作的那些白人。

meaning: adj. 坐立不安的，不耐烦的；不满足现状的，求变的；得不到休息的，没有睡眠的
definition: 1. unwilling or unable to stay still or to be quiet and calm, because you are worried or bored；2. moving because you are unable to relax, esp. because you are worried or bored, or (of an activity) having a lot of movement as a characteristic
