example: By 1982, she was restless and needed a new impetus for her talent.
exampleZh: 到1982年，她焦躁不安，需要一个新的对其才华的推动力。

meaning: v. 恢复（某种情况或感受）；使复原，使复位；修复，整修；重新采用，恢复使用；归还
definition: 1. v. return to its original or usable and functioning condition；2. v. return to life; get or give new life or energy
example: We will restore her to health but it may take time.
exampleZh: 我们会让她恢复健康，但这或许需要时间。

meaning: n. （对艺术品、建筑等的）修复；（做法、权利、惯例或情况的）恢复，重新实施；归还，返还；（软件程序的）恢复，还原；（牙科）修补；（模拟已灭绝动物或被毁建筑等原型的）修复物（或图），重建物（或图）；（君主、元首、政权等的）原有地位的恢复，复位；王政复辟时期（1660 年英王查理二世复辟及其后的一段时期）（the Restoration）；法国波旁王朝王政复辟（the Restoration）
definition: 1. n. the reign of Charles II in England; 1660-1685；2. n. the act of restoring something or someone to a satisfactory state
example: I owe the restoration of my hearing to this remarkable new technique.
exampleZh: 我把我听力的复原归功于这项非凡的新技术。

meaning: v. 制止，阻止；克制，抑制；控制（某事物）；剥夺……的行动自由（或人身自由），管押；（安全带）缚住（人或其身体部位）
definition: 1. v. keep under control; keep in check；2. v. place limits on (extent or access)
example: To cope with it, they urged human beings to restrain their overarching ambitions.
exampleZh: 为了解决这一问题,希腊人力劝人们抑制过度膨胀的欲望

meaning: n. 克制，抑制；控制，限制；管制措施，制约因素；（武力）阻止，制止；座椅安全带，安全装置；（尤指艺术表达中的）低调处理
definition: 1. n. the of act controlling by restraining someone or something；2. n. discipline in personal and social activities
example: Hardly. Does it not require those qualities of self-control, discipline, and restraint necessary to achieve success here?
exampleZh: 不！难道不需要那些特质吗,诸如自控，纪律与克制等，以求在此取得成功？

meaning: v. 限制，控制（大小、数量、范围）；限制（活动或行为），妨碍；约束，管束；（以法规）限制；封锁（消息）
definition: 1. v. place restrictions on；2. v. place under restrictions; limit access to
example: It's illegal to sign an agreement, to sign a contract saying you're going to restrict quantities.
exampleZh: 签订这样限制产量的协议,属于违法行为

meaning: n. 限制规定，限制法规；（受）限制（状态），（受）约束（状态）；制约因素
definition: 1. n. a principle that limits the extent of something；2. n. an act of limiting or restricting (as by regulation)
example: Since the costs of science were rising faster than inflation, some restriction on funding was necessary.
exampleZh: 既然科学成本上涨快于通货膨胀，资助上的一些限制是必要的。

meaning: adj. 限制（性）的，约束（性）的；（语法） 限定性的
definition: 1. adj. serving to restrict；2. adj. (of tariff) protective of national interests by restricting imports
example: The other reason why costs are so high is the restrictive guild-like ownership structure of the business.
exampleZh: 成本如此之高的另一个原因是该行业类似行会的限制性所有权结构。

meaning: n. 结果，后果；（比赛或选举的）结果；（通过调查、研究、计算而获得的）结果； 考试成绩；成效，成果（results）；经营业绩（results）；（体育比赛中）胜局，获胜；v. 发生，产生；导致，造成（注明的结局或结果）；int. 成功了！（Result!）
definition: 1. n. a phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon；2. v. issue or terminate (in a specified way, state, etc.); end
example: This is the result, this is the fruit, of the hermeneutic engagement between horizons that results in meaning.
exampleZh: 这是阐释学的结果，它的产物，不同视域会合的阐释学能得到文章的含义。

meaning: adj. 由此引起的，因而发生的；n. 合力，合成速率，合成矢量；结果
definition: 1. n. the final point in a process；2. adj. following as an effect or result
example: All the resultant activities have tended, on balance, to reduce tree cover and increase grassland.
exampleZh: 总的来说，所有由此产生的活动都趋向于减少树木覆盖，增加草地。

meaning: v. 恢复（职位），回到（座位）；继续说，接着说；概述；（中断后）重新开始，继续；n. 梗概，摘要（résumé或resumé）；简历，履历（résumé或resumé）
definition: 1. n. short descriptive summary (of events)；2. v. take up or begin anew
example: It shows how to prepare a resume, and gives tips on applying for jobs.
exampleZh: 它说明了如何准备一份简历，并提了一些有关求职的建议。

meaning: n. 重新开始，恢复；（土地、权利等的）重获
definition: 1. n. beginning again
example: We are hoping for an early resumption of peace talks.
exampleZh: 我们企盼着早日恢复和谈。

meaning: n. 简历，履历（求职用）；摘要，概要
definition: 1. abstract: (the colon] is part of the [[title) is a collection of experimental tracks by John Taylor of Duran Duran and Jonathan Elias. The tracks were recorded in 1985 and 1986, and collected and released through John Taylor's website, TrustTheProcess.
example: Applicants are asked to send in a résumé and a cover letter.
exampleZh: 申请人被要求提交一份简历并附申请信。

meaning: n. 零售；v. 零售；以……价格销售；详说，述说（尤指别人的事情）；adv. 以零售方式；adj. 零售的；【名】 （Retail）（印）勒塔伊（人名）
definition: 1. n. the selling of goods to consumers; usually in small quantities and not for resale；2. v. be sold at the retail level
example: There are also some hotel investments,retail properties, smattering of industrial properties not a lot of exposure to individual houses.
exampleZh: 也有一些酒店和商场物业投资,以及一些零散的工业物业,没有太多地投资于个人住宅

meaning: n. 零售商，零售店；讲述者
definition: 1. n. a merchant who sells goods at retail
example: Each warehouse reports back to the retailer which portion of the customer order it was able to fulfil.
exampleZh: 每个仓库都要向零售商反馈自己能够完成的客户订单部分。

meaning: v. 保持，保留；保存，储存；记住；付定金聘定（尤指律师）；留用（员工）
definition: 1. v. hold within；2. v. allow to remain in a place or position
example: I want to teach you things that you are going to retain you're going to take with you.
exampleZh: 我教你们事情，你们将会记住,并且会一直伴随着你们。

meaning: n. 保持，保留；保存，存放；保持力，持续力；记忆力；（热量的）阻滞，（液体的）潴留；（对物质的）吸收和保持
definition: 1. n. the act of retaining something；2. n. the power of retaining and recalling past experience
example: The Citizens' Forum supported special powers for Quebec but also argued for the retention of a strong central government.
exampleZh: 《市民论坛》支持魁北克的特殊权力，但是也主张保留一个强有力的中央政府。

meaning: v. 报复，反击；就（伤害，侮辱）进行报复
definition: 1. to hurt someone or do something harmful to someone because they have done or said something harmful to you；2. to hurt someone or do something harmful to someone because that person has done or said something harmful to you
example: Even in a worst-case situation the United States would have been able to retaliate.
exampleZh: 即使最坏的情形发生，美国也能反击。

meaning: n. 报复，反击
definition: 1. the act of hurting someone or doing something harmful to someone because they have done or said something harmful to you
example: Police said they believed the attack was in retaliation for the death of the drug trafficker.
exampleZh: 警方说他们认为这起袭击是为那个毒贩的死而实施的报复。

meaning: adj. 智力迟钝的，弱智的；十分愚蠢的；v. 减缓，阻碍（retard 的过去式及过去分词形式）
definition: 1. having a slower mental development than other people of the same age
example: The retarded growth of the coral reef has been linked to rising water temperatures and prolonged ocean heat waves.
exampleZh: 珊瑚礁生长迟缓已被认为与海水升温及持续的海洋热浪有关。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）
note: 该词用于描述智力时已经过时并具冒犯性；本表例句采用“迟缓的”这一中性技术义。

meaning: v. （以不同的方式）复述，重新讲述
definition: 1. v. render verbally,；2. v. make into fiction
example: so why do you have the second chapter of this book retell the same story that the first chapter of the book told?
exampleZh: 为什么一本书的第二章,要重复一遍第一章说过的故事？

meaning: n. 复述，重述；复述法；重述版（对故事等的重新讲述或改写）；v. 复述，再讲（retell 的 ing 形式）
definition: 1. v. render verbally,；2. v. make into fiction
example: In this retelling of the tale, Peter Parker is a pedant with sweaty palms and weak posture.
exampleZh: 在这个故事的重述版本中，彼得·帕克是个学究气十足的人，手掌多汗，体态孱弱。

meaning: v. （令）退职，（使）退休；（专业运动员）退役；（因受伤、生病而）退出比赛；使（击球手）出局； 退出，离开（去安静的地方）； 睡觉，就寝；（陪审团）退庭表决；（军队）撤退；命令（部队）撤退；停止使用，使报废；收回（票据，纸币），使停止流通；清偿，付清（债务）；n. 退休，退隐
definition: 1. v. go into retirement; stop performing one's work or withdraw from one's position；2. v. withdraw from active participation
example: It made me wonder if they were trying to tell that I should retire; it felt like a retirement party.
exampleZh: 这让我怀疑,他们是不是在暗示,我应该退休了,感觉那就像是个退休派对

meaning: n. 退休，退职；退休生活，退休期间；（运动员）停止参赛，退役；（陪审团）退庭表决；退庭表决时间；引退，退隐；退隐处，隐蔽处
definition: 1. n. the state of being retired from one's business or occupation；2. n. withdrawal from your position or occupation
example: He says it's a good idea for people to save for their retirement during their earning years but it's wrong.
exampleZh: 他说，让人们在能挣钱的年头为退休而攒钱,社保的初衷是好的，但这样做不对。

meaning: adj. 退休的，退役的；（生活方式）隐居的，退隐的；（人）沉默寡言的，不好交际的；（地方）僻静的，隐蔽的；v. 退休，退役；（因伤）退赛；撤退（retire 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. no longer active in your work or profession；2. adj. honorably retired from assigned duties and retaining your title along with the additional title `emeritus' as in `professor emeritus'; `retired from assigned duties' need not imply that one is inactive
example: And then, in 1934, it was Ernest Rutherford -by the mid-30s, J. J. Thompson had retired.
exampleZh: 之后在1934年，在30年代中期，是卢瑟福，汤姆逊退休了。

meaning: v. （愤怒或风趣地）反驳，回嘴；对（侮辱，伤害）进行报复；利用（对方的论据）反驳对方；蒸馏，干馏；n. 反驳，回嘴；曲颈瓶，蒸馏器
definition: 1. to answer someone quickly in an angry or funny way；2. a quick answer that is angry or funny
example: The "clever" camp retort that diplomacy is not about instant gratification.
exampleZh: “聪明”阵营反驳说，外交不是为了即刻的满足。

meaning: v. （军队）撤退；后退，离开；（水、雪或土地）范围缩小；隐退，躲避；悔棋；改变意见，改变看法；（股价）下挫，下跌；向后倾；n. 撤军，撤兵；后退，离开；退隐处，静居处；（主意、观点、决定的）改变；（股票）贬值；静修期间（或活动）
definition: 1. n. a place of privacy; a place affording peace and quiet；2. v. pull back or move away or backward
example: If you're looking to have an opportunity for a personal reflective... I read this on a retreat last year.
exampleZh: 如果你想进行一下自我反省。。。,我去年在度假时读了这本书。

meaning: v. 找回，收回；检索（储存于计算机的信息）；（狗等）衔回（物品、猎物）；挽救，挽回；回忆，追忆；收绕钓鱼线；n. （尤指中枪猎物的）找回；收绕钓鱼线； 恢复的可能性；检索
definition: 1. to find and bring back something；2. in tennis and similar sports, to successfully return a ball that is difficult to reach
example: There was absolutely no way that we were going to be able to retrieve it.
exampleZh: 我们绝对不可能把它找回来。

meaning: n. 找回，取回；（计算机系统信息的）检索；恢复，挽回
definition: 1. the process of finding and bringing back something；2. the process of getting stored information from a computer
example: In a sense, forgetting is our brain's way of sorting memories, so the most relevant memories are ready for retrieval.
exampleZh: 从某种意义上说，遗忘是大脑对记忆进行分类的一种方式，这样联系最紧密的记忆随时可以被检索出来。

meaning: 回顾；回想
definition: 1. thinking now about something in the past；2. an act of thinking about the past
example: In retrospect, I wish that I had thought about alternative courses of action.
exampleZh: 回想起来，我真希望自己当初考虑过其他的行动方案。

meaning: adj. 回顾的，回想的；有追溯效力的，溯及既往的；n. （艺术家作品）回顾展
definition: 1. a show of the work an artist has done in their life so far；2. relating to or thinking about the past
example: Let's just do a stand-up and let's just do a retrospective, and let's just try this.
exampleZh: 让我们做一个单口喜剧，让我们做一个回顾，让我们试试这个。

meaning: v. 回来，回去；归还，退还；回报，回应；（感觉或情况）重新出现，恢复；重新开始，继续（某项活动）；带来，产生（利润或损失）；回击，击回； 宣告（裁决）；选举，选出；（建筑）（尤指成直角）转延（墙壁）；（高尔夫）打后九穴；（美橄）截获（对方传、踢或漏球）反攻；（桥牌）（尤指同伴所攻出的同花色牌赢墩后）跟着打出，回出；把（空瓶或空罐头盒）送到回收站；n. 回来，返回；归还，退回；重新开始，恢复；回报，收益； 往返票，来回票；返回键，回车键；（选举）结果；（网球等）回击球；（纳税）申报表，申报单；（建筑）转延，转延侧面；回路导线；被退回（或送回）的东西，退票；（可以回收的）空罐头盒，空瓶子（returns）；adj. （票）双程的，往返的；（旅途）返回的，返程的；（比赛）回访的；再度的，再次的
definition: 1. n. document giving the tax collector information about the taxpayer's tax liability；2. v. come back to place where one has been before, or return to a previous activity
example: They're plainly interrelated in a variety of ways, but it's more to the question of determinism I want to return today.
exampleZh: 在很多方面他们都相互联系，但是今天我要多谈点有关决定论的问题。

meaning: v. （使）团聚，（使）重聚；（使）再结合，（使）重新团结
definition: 1. v. have a reunion; unite again；2. v. unify again, as of a country
example: A few days later, a reporter asked the young men and Griffith to reunite at a local coffee shop.
exampleZh: 几天后，一位记者请这几位年轻人与格里菲斯在当地的一家咖啡馆再次会面。

meaning: n. 重新统一
definition: 1. n. the act of coming together again
example: The wall through Berlin was finally ruptured, prefiguring the reunification of Germany.
exampleZh: 柏林墙终于倒塌了，预示着德国的重新统一。

meaning: n. （有组织的）聚会，团聚；重逢，团圆；再联合，重新统一
definition: 1. n. a party of former associates who have come together again；2. n. the act of coming together again
example: I had the experience of seeing one of my outward bound students years after at a reunion event.
exampleZh: 我曾经在一个重聚的活动上,看到多年前拓展训练时,我的一个学生。

meaning: v. 揭示，透露；表明，证明；展示，显示；（通过神或超自然手段）启示；n. （电视节目最后的）揭示；门侧，窗侧
definition: 1. v. make visible；2. v. make known to the public information that was previously known only to a few people or that was meant to be kept a secret
example: The good scholars of Milton reveal their typical resistance to anything even remotely interesting or alive in the text.
exampleZh: 研究弥尔顿的优秀学者们透露他们反对,研究文本中那些不太有趣和生动的东西。

meaning: n. 被揭示的真相，被揭露的内情；揭露，披露；出乎意料的事物，令人惊喜的发现；（上帝的）启示，默示；《启示录》（《圣经·新约》末卷，讲述上帝对圣约翰有关未来的启示）（Revelation）
definition: 1. n. the speech act of making something evident；2. n. an enlightening or astonishing disclosure
example: Where we need some role modeling is in instinct, and that's where a dog is a roving revelation.
exampleZh: 我们所需要得一些角色模仿在本能中，在那里狗就是一个流动的启示。

meaning: n. 报复，报仇；报复欲望，复仇心；雪耻（指在比赛中战胜曾击败自己的对手）；v. 复仇，报复；替（人）报仇；报（被冤枉，被伤害）之仇，洗雪（侮辱）
definition: 1. harm done to someone as a punishment for harm that they have done to someone else；2. to harm someone as a punishment for harm that they have done to you
example: He might 'a' found out he couldn't get his revenge, and be going right after that money.
exampleZh: 他可能会发现他无法复仇，就马上去找那笔钱。

meaning: adj. 渴望复仇的，一心报复的
definition: 1. wanting revenge
example: Season 24 Starts! New Vengeful Merciless Mighty Awesome Cool Radical Revengeful Gladiator Gear is now available for purchase. Level 145 Required.
exampleZh: 竞技场积分赛第24季开始了！玩家现在可以使用竞技场积分在商人那里购买最新的“神圣无情复仇超酷牛逼角斗士”套装了。

meaning: n. （企业、组织的）收入，收益；（政府的）税收；税务局，税务署（the revenue）
definition: 1. n. the entire amount of income before any deductions are made；2. n. government income due to taxation
example: It comes through investment and taking money from investors, either through swiping their credit cards while they're not looking or through revenue.
exampleZh: 它来自投资和,从投资者那里拿钱，无论是当他们不注意的时候刷信用卡,还是通过业务来盈利。

meaning: v. 逆转，彻底改变（决定、政策、趋势等）；撤销，推翻（法庭判决）；颠倒，反转；交换，互换（位置、功能）；承认错误，放弃（立场）；倒（车）；（发动机）反向运转；打对方付费的电话；使（铅字，图案）印成白或浅色；n. 相对，相反（the reverse）；逆向，逆转；倒车挡；失败，挫折；反面，背面；（翻开的书）左手页，（活页文件的）背面；（硬币或奖牌）反面图案（或刻字）；（美式橄榄球）反向传球，变位传球；adj. 相反的，反向的；背面的，反面的；（半导体结的外加电压）反向的；（地层）逆断的，冲断的；反身的
definition: 1. n. a relation of direct opposition；2. v. change to the contrary
example: So this is trying to reverse them that tradition actually get students in and engaged in the course material.
exampleZh: 因此这也是试图将学生,从这种传统中扭转出来,从而使他们能更专注于课堂内容。

meaning: n. 反转，颠倒；（运气）逆转；挫折，失败；（角色的）交换，互换；（对下级法院或权力机构裁决、宣判或法令的）撤销，废弃；（摄）反转
definition: 1. n. a change from one state to the opposite state；2. n. an unfortunate happening that hinders or impedes; something that is thwarting or frustrating
example: The paper says the move represents a complete reversal of previous U.S. policy.
exampleZh: 报上说这一举动反映了之前美国政策的彻底逆转。

meaning: adj. 可逆的，可恢复原状的，可医治的；可翻转 ，可两面穿的，正反两用的
definition: 1. n. a garment (especially a coat) that can be worn inside out (with either side of the cloth showing)；2. adj. capable of reversing or being reversed
example: Heart disease is reversible in some cases, according to a study published last summer.
exampleZh: 根据去年夏天发表的一项研究，心脏病有时是可逆的。

meaning: n. 审查，检查；评论，评论文章；（时事、艺术等的）评论期刊；述评，回顾；复习，温习；（一门课程的）材料，练习；阅兵，阅兵式；中止快速倒带（或卷带）重放装置；v. 仔细研究，审视；给（书、戏剧、电影等）写评论；回顾，反思；（为考试而）复习，温习；校阅，审核；复查（病人）；检阅（军队）；将（判决、案件等）提交上级法院（或权力机构）复审
definition: 1. n. a new appraisal or evaluation；2. v. look at again; examine again
example: It's also that knowledge that an educated, sort of belletristic reader of The Saturday Review of Literature would be very, very familiar with.
exampleZh: 这也是受过教育，某种研究文学且是,《周六文学评论》的读者所十分熟悉的知识。

meaning: n. 评论者，评论家；点评人；（期刊等的）审稿人，评审人
definition: 1. n. someone who reads manuscripts and judges their suitability for publication；2. n. a writer who reports and analyzes events of the day
example: The reviewer padded out his review with a lengthy biography of the author.
exampleZh: 那位评论家用冗长的作者生平来拉长他的评论。

meaning: v. 改变，修正；修改，修订（书刊、估算等）；温习，复习；n. 修订，校订；（印刷）改样；【名】 （Revise）（法）勒维斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of rewriting something；2. v. make revisions in
example: With time he came to revise his opinion of the profession.
exampleZh: 随着时间的推移，他开始修正自己对这一职业的看法。

meaning: n. 修改，修订；修订本，订正版；复习，温习
definition: 1. n. the act of revising or altering (involving reconsideration and modification)；2. n. the act of rewriting something
example: As I say,that seems to me to be the best revision of the personality theory available to them.
exampleZh: 刚才说了，在我看来这似乎是,人格理论的最好修正。

meaning: v. （使）复原，（使）复苏；重新唤起，重新记起；重新使用，使复兴；重新上演
definition: 1. to come or bring something back to life, health, existence, or use；2. to come back to life, health, existence, or use, or bring something back to such a state
example: In other words, he hoped to revive in some way the spirit of the ancients of antiquity, but to modify it in the lights of his own experience.
exampleZh: 换句话说，他希望能够,复兴远古先贤的精神，但加入,他个人的亲身经历。

meaning: n. 复兴，复苏；再流行；（旧剧的）重新上演；（复兴基督教信仰的）奋兴布道会；（体力或活力的）重振
definition: 1. the process of becoming more active or popular again；2. a performance of a play that has not been seen for a long time
example: This return to realism has produced a revival of interest in a number of artists.
exampleZh: 这次向现实主义的回归引起了对许多艺术家兴趣的复苏。

meaning: n. （对权威、规定、法律的）反抗，违抗；叛乱，造反；v. 叛乱，造反；反抗，拒绝服从（权威、规定或法律）；使反感，使震惊
definition: 1. If a large number of people revolt, they refuse to be controlled or ruled, and take action against authority, often violent action；2. to make someone feel unpleasantly shocked or disgusted
example: In February 1848, the people of Paris rose in revolt against the constitutional monarchy of Louis-Philippe.
exampleZh: 1848年2月，巴黎人民奋起反抗路易-菲利浦君主立宪制。

meaning: n. （思想、工作方式等的）彻底变革；（使用武力、暴力的）革命；旋转；旋转一周；（马克思主义）共产主义革命（The Revolution）；循环
definition: 1. n. a drastic and far-reaching change in ways of thinking and behaving；2. n. the overthrow of a government by those who are governed
example: By the time we get to 1644, this is the year that Areopagitica appears, we're well into the English Revolution.
exampleZh: 到1644年，就是《论出版自由》出版的那一年，我们真正进入了英国革命。

meaning: adj. 革命的；革命性的，突破性的；n. 革命者，革命家
definition: 1. n. a radical supporter of political or social revolution；2. adj. markedly new or introducing radical change
example: His father wrote for revolutionary newspapers, He was assassinated in 1922 in Europe on account of his publishing activities.
exampleZh: 他父亲为一些革命报纸写作，因为他的出版活动,他在1922年于欧洲遇害。

meaning: v. （使）旋转；围绕……旋转（revolve around）；以……为最重要内容，以……为中心（revolve around）；反复思考，反复斟酌；循环出现；n. 旋转舞台
definition: 1. v. turn on or around an axis or a center；2. v. move in an orbit
example: All forms of the golden rule revolve around the same concept.
exampleZh: 所有形式的黄金法则都围绕着同一个概念。

meaning: n. 奖励，回报；赏格，悬赏金；报偿，报应；v. 酬谢，奖赏；奖励（行动，品质）；（理所当然地）获得，赢得（be rewarded）；值得（付出时间或精力）
definition: 1. n. a recompense for worthy acts or retribution for wrongdoing；2. v. bestow honor or rewards upon
example: There is a reward for information leading to the recovery of the missing diamonds.
exampleZh: 凡能为找回丢失的钻石提供线索者可获奖赏。

meaning: adj. 值得的，有意义的；赚钱的，营利的；v. 酬谢，奖赏；奖励（行动，品质）；（理所当然地）获得，赢得（reward 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. providing personal satisfaction
example: Despite its length and convoluted plot, "Asta's Book" is a rich and rewarding read.
exampleZh: 虽然《阿斯塔的书》篇幅冗长、情节复杂，但不失为一本丰富及有益的读物。

meaning: n. 花言巧语，浮夸之词；修辞，修辞学
definition: 1. speech or writing intended to be effective and influence people；2. the study of the ways of using language effectively
example: His fiery campaign rhetoric has kept opposition parties on their toes for months.
exampleZh: 他激烈的竞选言辞使反对党数月保持警觉。

meaning: adj. （与）修辞（有关）的；反问的，反诘的；巧辩的，说话虚夸的
definition: 1. Rhetorical speech or writing is intended to seem important or influence people
example: Archie, of course, can't stand this because for him it's perfectly clear that a rhetorical question is a rhetorical question.
exampleZh: 阿齐当然无法忍受，因为对他来说,很明显修辞问句就是修辞问句。

meaning: n. （声音或运动的）节奏，韵律，节拍；节奏感；规则变化，节律；（艺术作品的）匀称，和谐；（韵文或散文）抑扬节奏
definition: 1. n. the basic rhythmic unit in a piece of music；2. n. recurring at regular intervals
example: A basic sense of rhythm and pitch is essential in a music teacher.
exampleZh: 基本的韵律感和音高感是音乐教师的必备素质。

meaning: adj. 有节奏的，有韵律的；规律性发生的；n. 韵律学（=rhythmics）
definition: 1. adj. recurring with measured regularity
example: What string technique are the violins using at this particular moment and then what rhythmic device does the trumpet insert?
exampleZh: 在这个特殊的瞬间,小提琴用到了什么演奏技术,之后小号又用了什么节奏方法

meaning: n. 肋骨；排骨（肉），肋条（肉）；肋骨状物（构成船、房顶等骨架的金属或木质等）；（编织）罗纹，罗纹花样；叶的脉纹（尤指叶的主脉），（昆虫的）翅脉；（岩石的）脉纹，（田地上的）垄；v. （友善地）开……的玩笑，取笑；形成拢起的条纹（或脊坡）；装肋于
definition: 1. n. support resembling the rib of an animal；2. v. form vertical ribs by knitting
example: We shall see—my first attempt at a standing rib roast!
exampleZh: 我们拭目以待——这是我第一次尝试做美式带骨肋排！

meaning: n. 丝带，绸带；（表示军功的）绶带，勋带；（作为比赛奖品的）绶带；（表明支持某一组织、原则或目标而配带的）饰带；带状物，狭长的东西；（打字机用的）色带；碎片（ribbons）；奖品，荣誉；v. 成带状延伸（或运动）；把…撕成条带；用缎带装饰
definition: 1. n. any long object resembling a thin line；2. n. an award for winning a championship or commemorating some other event
example: She had tied back her hair with a peach satin ribbon.
exampleZh: 她用一条桃红色的缎带把头发扎在了脑后。

meaning: n. 稻，水稻；米，大米，稻米；米饭，白饭；（Rice）人名、姓氏，常译作赖斯（英）、莱斯，亦译里瑟（瑞典）、里采（塞）；vt. 把……捣成米糊状；把（熟马铃薯等）压（或擦）成米粒状
definition: 1. n. grains used as food either unpolished or more often polished；2. v. sieve so that it becomes the consistency of rice
example: But the word white shows up a lot in the high glycemic index foods -white rice, white spaghetti, white bread.
exampleZh: 但是白色这个词会在,许多高血糖指数的食物中出现,白米,白面条,白面包

meaning: adj. 有钱的，富有的；富含……的，丰富的；非常有趣的，丰富多彩的；（食物）油腻的；（色彩、气味）浓郁的，（声音）浑厚的；肥沃的，丰产的；华丽昂贵的；（指某人的评论或批评）荒唐的，可笑的；值钱的，生财的；（内燃机内的混合燃料）可燃性成分高的；【名】 （Rich）（丹）里克，（捷）里赫，（英、西）里奇，（葡、法）里什（人名）
definition: 1. n. people who have possessions and wealth (considered as a group)；2. adj. possessing material wealth
example: And it's sort of all the, you know, the rich and famous people go along and watch the horses,
exampleZh: 所有有钱的、有名的人都会去看赛马，

meaning: v. 使……去掉，使……去除；摆脱，消除；adj. 得到解脱的；【名】 （Rid）（俄、德、英、美）里德（人名）
definition: 1. v. relieve from
example: Now Joseph's brothers are jealous of Jacob's partiality to Joseph, And they conspire to be rid of him.
exampleZh: 现在约瑟夫的兄弟们都妒忌雅各布对他的偏爱，他们密谋要解决掉他。

meaning: n. 谜语；谜一般的人（或事）；（筛分土石的）粗筛；v. 猜（某人）出的（谜），为（某人）解（谜）； 打谜语般地说，出谜；把……打得满是窟窿；（尤指令人不快之事）充斥，布满；用粗筛筛；摇动（炉栅）使灰落下；【名】 （Riddle）（美、英、加）里德尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a difficult problem；2. v. pierce with many holes
example: Scientists claimed yesterday to have solved the riddle of the birth of the universe.
exampleZh: 科学家们昨天宣布已经解开了宇宙诞生之谜。

meaning: v. 骑马，骑车；乘坐；航行，漂浮；穿越，翻越；（车辆）行驶；数落，嘲弄；驾驭，被……所支配；取决于（ride on）；得益于；（骑马或车）参赛；运输（货物）；突伸，重叠；顺势退躲以缓冲（击打）；与……性交；n. 乘骑旅行，搭乘旅行；大型游乐设施，乘坐装置；免费搭车；搭载别人者；行车质量，乘坐感觉；机动车辆；骑马道；骑马表演；性交，交媾；节奏钹；【名】 (Ride) （英、美、法）赖德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a journey in a vehicle (usually an automobile)；2. v. sit and travel on the back of animal, usually while controlling its motions
example: so I'm going to begin by showing you a very personal look at my hometown, a bus ride.
exampleZh: 所以我将首先展示一下,关于我家乡的一个个人视角,一次公车旅程。

meaning: n. 骑手，骑马（或自行车、摩托车）的人；附文，附加条款；三读附加意见，三读议案；（陪审团对裁定的）附加意见；（天平的）游码；【名】 （Rider）（英）赖德，（西）里德尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a traveler who actively rides an animal (as a horse or camel)；2. n. a clause that is appended to a legislative bill
example: The only rider on that being, if they're producing Coca-Cola and you have any kind of concern for your teeth, maybe you shouldn't produce so much anyway.
exampleZh: 如果可口可乐是唯一的生产者,并且你狠关心牙齿健康的话,或许你就不应该生产这么多产品了

meaning: n. 山脊，山脉；屋脊；隆起部分，脊状突起；（大气层的）高压脊，高压带；v. 使隆起，使形成脊状；（表面）成脊状，起皱；【名】 （Ridge）（英）里奇（人名）
definition: 1. a long, narrow raised part of a surface, especially a high edge along a mountain；2. the part of a roof where the sloping sides join at the top
example: Rammick lives high on a ridge in a 400-home subdivision.
exampleZh: 拉米克住在高高的山脊上一块有400户的住宅区。

meaning: n. 嘲笑，奚落；v. 嘲笑，奚落
definition: 1. n. language or behavior intended to mock or humiliate；2. v. subject to laughter or ridicule
example: We tried not to seem critical or judgmental while giving advice that would protect him from ridicule.
exampleZh: 在提出使他免受奚落的建议时，我们尽量不表现得挑剔或妄下结论。

meaning: adj. 可笑的，荒谬的
definition: 1. adj. inspiring scornful pity；2. adj. incongruous;inviting ridicule
example: You see lots of people in ridiculous shoes that you couldn't possibly walk in for very long
exampleZh: 你看到很多人穿着滑稽鞋子，根本不可能走很长的路的鞋子，

meaning: n. 步枪，来复枪；步枪队（rifles）；v. 快速搜寻，匆忙翻找；偷窃，盗取；用力掷，猛踢（球）；为（枪、枪管或内膛）凿制来复线
definition: 1. n. a shoulder firearm with a long barrel and a rifled bore；2. v. steal goods; take as spoils
example: When I'd missed a few times, he suggested I rest the rifle on a rock to steady it.
exampleZh: 由于我几次都没打中，他就建议我把步枪放到石头上来保持稳定。

meaning: v. 操纵（选举、比赛）；（给船只）装帆，提供索具；（秘密地）安装，装配；临时搭建，临时架起；（给某人或某物）装束，打扮；n. 钻井架，钻塔；大型卡车；（成套的）装置，装备；帆桅的装配（方式）；服装，制服；诡计，骗局
definition: 1. to arrange dishonestly for the result of something, for example an election, to be changed；2. to fix a piece of equipment in place
example: We've never had a documented case of an oil rig chasing deer out onto the pack ice.
exampleZh: 我们从未记录到石油钻井平台将鹿群驱赶到浮冰上的案例。

meaning: adj. 符合道德的，正当的；正确的，真实的；（人、物）合适的，般配的；（意见，判断）对的；右边的，右侧的；（状态或情况）健康的，正常的； 十足的，真正的（用于强调某人或某物多么糟糕）；正面的，外面的；时尚的，上流社会的；（人或政党）支持保守观点的，右翼的；v. 纠正，矫正；补救，扭转；把（尤指小船）扶正，使直立；n. 正当，公正；正当的要求，权利；版权，发行权（rights）；右边，右方（the right）；右拐，右转弯；右边的路（或入口）；（足球等运动）右外场；部队的右翼；右翼组织，右派政党（the right/the Right）；右翼人士的立场，右翼立场（the right）；右手拳；adv. （地方、位置或时间）正好，就在；直接地，径直地；一直地，完全地；立即，毫不耽搁；正确地，确切地；顺利，正常；在右面，向右边；（政治上）右倾地；用右手地；彻底地，十足地；int. 好的，对（用于表示明白或同意某人的话）；好（用于引起注意）；对吗（用于确认自己说的话是否正确）；（表示不相信或不同意）是吗，好哇；对不对，懂吗（用于确认对方是否在听并明白你说的话）；【名】 （Right）（英）赖特（人名）
definition: 1. n. an abstract idea of that which is due to a person or governmental body by law or tradition or nature；2. v. make reparations or amends for
example: On the right hand side, the work, let's call this left hand side, let's call this right hand side.
exampleZh: 在右手边，让我们先在这里,标下标表示左手，这里示右手。

meaning: adj. （方法、体制等）严格死板的，僵化的；（人）顽固的，不通融的；刚硬的，不易弯曲的；（因强烈的感情而）僵硬的，僵直的；精确的；n. 未铰接的货车
definition: 1. stiff or fixed; not able to be bent or moved；2. not able to be changed or persuaded
example: He was weaned on a diet of rigid discipline and duty.
exampleZh: 他自幼受到严格纪律和职责的约束。

meaning: n. 硬度，刚性；严格，刻板；僵化
definition: 1. the quality of being stiff, fixed, or impossible to bend；2. the quality of being impossible to change or persuade
example: To unlock the kind of rigidity that happens into the adult brain and help other people like Mike.
exampleZh: 以便解开成年人大脑的僵硬状态,帮助像迈克这样的人。

meaning: 严格；严厉；艰苦
definition: 1. the fact that people are made to follow rules in a very severe way；2. the unpleasant or severe conditions of something
example: In order to capture important communication, larger teams must use more rigor and formality in the way they work.
exampleZh: 为了获取重要的交流信息，大型的团队必须以更加严格和正式的方式工作。

meaning: adj. （测试、系统或程序）严密的，缜密的；（规则，制度等）严格的，苛刻的；一丝不苟的；严酷的，恶劣的
definition: 1. careful to look at or consider every part of something to make certain it is correct or safe；2. controlling behaviour in a severe way
example: It's a pretty state of affairs, in his view, when the most rigorous thinking that's being done about literature is being done in popular journals.
exampleZh: 他认为，关于文学的严肃的思考大多,被发表在流行杂志上很不妥当。

meaning: n. （圆形物体的）边沿；（污垢等）一周，一圈；轮辋，轮圈；眼镜框；（篮球的）篮筐，篮圈 ；界，边界；v. 形成......的边沿，给......镶边；【名】 （Rim）（俄）里姆（人名）
definition: 1. the outer, often curved or circular, edge of something；2. to be round or along the edge of something
example: There is also a new steering wheel with an energy-absorbing rim to cushion the driver's head in the worst impacts.
exampleZh: 还有新式方向盘，其边缘具有减震功能在最严重的冲击中缓冲保护司机的头部。

meaning: n. 戒指，指环；环状物，圈形物；圆圈；圆形表演场（或竞技场）；围成一圈的人（或物）；团伙，帮派；铃声，钟声，按铃，敲钟；（说法、讨论、辩论等的）特性；圆形灶盘，炉头；肛门；（化）环；（数）环；v. 包围；绕……画圆，把……圈起来；（尤指在动物身上）套环；敲钟，按铃；（给……）打电话；嗡嗡作响；回响；充满；非法将（汽车）改头换面；【名】 （Ring） （美、挪、德、爱、英、波、丹）林（人名）
definition: 1. n. a characteristic sound；2. v. sound loudly and sonorously
example: So if you just automatically type your essay, your tutor will ring the American word
exampleZh: 所以如果你自动输入你的论文，你的导师会圈出美式的单词，

meaning: n. 暴乱，骚乱；纷呈，丰富多彩；非常有趣的人（或事物）；纵情欢闹，狂欢；骚动；（感情的）爆发，宣泄；v. （人群）发生骚乱，聚众闹事；放纵，恣意；浪费，挥霍；【名】 （Riot）（法）里奥，（西）里奥特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a public act of violence by an unruly mob；2. v. take part in a riot; disturb the public peace by engaging in a riot
example: And there's a riot in there. People are throwing chairs and food. And it's just crazy in there.
exampleZh: 骚乱开始蔓延。人们把椅子和食物摔在地上。屋子里混乱一片。

meaning: adj. （人群）骚乱的，暴乱的；狂欢的，纵情欢闹的；非常滑稽有趣的；丰富多彩的，繁茂的
definition: 1. adj. produced or growing in extreme abundance；2. adj. characterized by unrest or disorder or insubordination
example: He found congenial officers who knew how to leaven war's rigours with riotous enjoyment.
exampleZh: 他找到了和他志趣相投的懂得用狂欢来冲淡战争的残酷的军官。

meaning: v. （使）撕裂，（使）划破；迅速扯开，猛力去除；（迅速）贯穿，穿过；划出（孔洞），击穿；抢掠，剥夺；严厉批评，训斥；利用程序将（光盘上的音序）复制到硬盘驱动器上；n. 裂口，裂缝；撕，撕破；欺诈，剽窃；（在电脑上制作的光碟）复制本；（由海、河中不同水流相遇造成的）裂流（激浪）水域，离岸流；生活放荡的人（尤指男人），浪子；调皮的人，淘气鬼（尤指小孩）；劣马，无用的马；【名】 （Rip）（塞）里普（人名）
definition: 1. n. a dissolute man in fashionable society；2. v. tear or be torn violently
example: I felt the banner rip as we were pushed in opposite directions.
exampleZh: 当我们被挤向相反的方向的时候，我感到横幅撕裂了。

meaning: adj. （水果、谷物等）成熟的；（奶酪）熟的，（酒）芳醇的；（气味）浓烈的，刺鼻的，（香气）馥郁的；时机成熟的，适宜的；充满……的（ripe with）；高龄的，高寿的；（雌性鱼， 昆虫）快要产卵的； (言语) 下流的，粗俗的；【名】 （Ripe）（意，瑞典）里佩（人名）
definition: 1. adj. fully developed or matured and ready to be eaten or used；2. adj. fully prepared or eager
example: Some of us make it to the ripe old age of 80, 90 a 100 or more.
exampleZh: 有些人活到八九十岁高龄甚至更老。

meaning: v. （使）成熟；时机成熟，条件成熟
definition: 1. v. cause to ripen or develop fully；2. v. grow ripe
example: He's been waiting and waiting for his season due so that he can ripen into a powerful Orphic poet.
exampleZh: 他一直在等待着自己繁茂的年华,那时候他将成长为强大的俄耳甫斯式的诗人。

meaning: v. （数字、 数量、价值）增加；升高，上升；起身，站起；（权力或地位）提高；耸立，隆起；（声音）变响，变大；（太阳、月亮）升起；（感情或情绪） 变得强烈；（面包、蛋糕等）发酵；起床；复活，再生；休会，休庭；（风力）加强，增强；（河流）发源；起义，反抗；脸红，涨红；（毛发）竖起；（胃）感到恶心；接近（某个年龄）；n. （数量或水平的）增加，改善；加薪；（地位的）升高，增强；上升，升起；小山丘，斜坡；（声音或声调的）提高；源头，起源；兴起，高涨
definition: 1. n. a growth in strength or number or importance；2. v. move upward
example: That would that would give rise to a perpetual motion machine, breaking of the second law. It can't happen.
exampleZh: 否则就会使,得永动机出现，打破第二定律那是不可能的。

meaning: n. 危险，风险；危险的人（或事物），隐患；（按风险大小评估的）被保险对象，受贷者；（保险业承保的）险；金融风险；v. 使遭受（失去、毁坏或伤害的）危险；冒......的危险，担......的风险；冒险做，（明知结果而）大胆做；【名】 （Risk）（英、阿拉伯）里斯克（人名）
definition: 1. n. a source of danger; a possibility of incurring loss or misfortune；2. v. expose to a chance of loss or damage
example: But it's not quite true, because typically what they actually do that, is they say it's adjusted for risk.
exampleZh: 但是这是不对的，因为它们实际上就是存在这种情况，它们会根据风险进行调整。

meaning: adj. 有危险的，有风险的；有伤风化的，近乎淫秽的
definition: 1. adj. involving risk or danger；2. adj. not financially safe or secure
example: So it was a little risky but safe in the end because I didn't do anything else with it.
exampleZh: 所以它有点冒险但是最终是安全的,因为我没用它做其它的操作。

meaning: n. （宗教等的）仪式，典礼；习惯，例行公事；（尤指某一宗教或教派特定的）程序，仪式；adj. 仪式上的，庆典上的；（行动）常规的，例行的
definition: 1. a way of doing something in which the same actions are done in the same way every time；2. a fixed set of actions and words, especially as part of a religious ceremony
example: Also, moral impurity is not removed or reducible through rituals, through washings and launderings, ritual ablutions and the like.
exampleZh: 此外，道德不洁不能通过仪式来去除或减少，类似于洗、烫、沐浴仪式等等都不行。

meaning: n. 竞争对手，敌手；可与之匹敌者，可与之相比的人（或物）；v. 与......相匹敌，比得上；adj. 竞争的，对抗的；【名】 （Rival）（俄）里瓦尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. the contestant you hope to defeat；2. v. be equal to in quality or ability
example: But these stories rival, and implicitly polemicize against, the myths or mythologies of Israel's neighbors.
exampleZh: 这些故事相矛盾，且隐含着相反含意，与以色列的杜撰故事和神话传说。

meaning: n. 竞争，较量
definition: 1. n. the act of competing as for profit or a prize
example: It was Allen who fired this rivalry with real passion.
exampleZh: 是艾伦满怀激情地激发了这次对抗。

meaning: n. 河，江；（River）人名；（英）里弗
definition: 1. n. a large natural stream of water (larger than a creek)
example: Because it's right near the river, people will catch the fish from the morning and put it into the restaurant.
exampleZh: 因为它就在河的旁边，人们早上捕鱼，然后把它送到饭店。

meaning: n. 路，公路，马路，街； 途径，方法，路子；（矿）地下巷道；贸易路线；铁路；（列车可通行的）无障碍铁路路轨，特殊情况铁路路轨；近岸锚地，港外锚地；【名】 （Road）（英）罗德（人名）
definition: 1. n. an open way (generally public) for travel or transportation；2. adj. taking place over public roads
example: When he gets back to New York, finally, at the end of this first road trip, he has missed Dean.
exampleZh: 当他终于回到纽约时，在这首次旅途的末期，他弄丢了迪恩。

meaning: v. 吼叫，咆哮；（人群）用欢呼声激励，为......喝彩，为加油；哄笑，大笑；（尤指车辆）轰鸣着疾驶，呼啸而过；果断行事，迅速发生；熊熊燃烧；n. 吼叫声， 咆哮声；（风或海的）呼啸声，（机器的）隆隆声；（狮等的）吼叫声；爆笑声；【名】 （Roar）（挪）罗阿尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a deep prolonged loud noise；2. v. make a loud noise, as of wind, water, or vehicles
example: They drown out Orpheus' music with the hideous roar of their howlings and their screamings and they tear him limb from limb.
exampleZh: 她们用可怕的咆哮和尖叫淹没了,俄耳甫斯的音乐，并将他肢解。

meaning: v. 炙，烘（食物，尤指肉）； 严厉批评，斥责； 和善地戏弄； （尤指通过暴露在太阳下或炉火前）使受热发烫；以火刑折磨；烘干，烘焙（食品原料，金属矿等）；焙，炒（坚果、豆子等）；变热；n. （大块）烤肉，待烤的肉；（讲述主角趣事的）庆祝会；户外烧烤野餐；烤，炙，烘（尤指咖啡）；（某种）烘过的咖啡；adj. 烘烤的，烤制的
definition: 1. n. a piece of meat roasted or for roasting and of a size for slicing into more than one portion；2. v. cook with dry heat, usually in an oven
example: you'd have a sort of roast dinner with beef and potatoes and vegetables and things like that.
exampleZh: 你通常会吃一餐烤牛排和土豆蔬菜一类的食物。

meaning: v. 抢劫，盗取；使丧失，剥夺；（足球）夺（对手）的球； 敲……竹杠
definition: 1. v. take something away by force or without the consent of the owner；2. v. rip off; ask an unreasonable price
example: That Rob was a snob and a social climber could not be denied.
exampleZh: 那个罗布是个势利小人，喜欢攀龙附凤——无可否定。

meaning: n. 盗窃，抢劫
definition: 1. n. larceny by threat of violence；2. n. plundering during riots or in wartime
example: In fact, there was a robbery, I think here in Beverly Hills, a couple years back at Tiffany.
exampleZh: 实际上，这里发生过抢劫，就在比佛利山庄这儿，几年前在第芙尼珠宝店。

meaning: n. 机器人，自动操作装置；机器般的人；自动交通信号机；（计算机）爬虫程序
definition: 1. n. a mechanism that can move automatically
example: Much as you might instruct as a human, a robot, to do something to the extent that's currently possible.
exampleZh: 在某种程度上就像指挥人类，机器人一样，从某种意义来说对电脑也是一样的。

meaning: adj. 机器人的，机械的；像机器人的，机械呆板的；机器人舞的
definition: 1. relating to robots, or behaving in a stiff and mechanical way
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: NASA is developing a series of robotic probes that will get the most bang from a buck.
exampleZh: 美国国家航空航天局正在研发一系列机器人探测器，以实现花最少的钱获得最大效益。

meaning: adj. 强健的，强壮的；（系统或组织）稳固的，健全的；（物体）结实的，坚固的；（观点等）强烈的，坚定的；（食物或饮料）味浓的，醇厚的；特大的；粗野的，粗鲁的
definition: 1. (of a person or animal) strong and healthy；2. (of an object or system) strong and unlikely to break or fail
example: And it is a stereotype but it's a statistically robust one and nobody lines up to protest this.
exampleZh: 这确实是刻板印象，但这是有数据支持的,而且没有人会排队去抗议它。

meaning: n. 岩石；礁石；（尤指凸出地面的）岩块，大石块；碎石，石子；钻石，宝石；摇滚乐；可信赖的人，靠山；棒棒糖；石毒，强效可卡因块；睾丸（rocks）；轻轻摇动，轻轻摇摆；v. （使）轻轻摇晃，缓缓摆动；（使）剧烈摇摆，猛烈晃动；使震惊，使害怕；（尤指自信或惹人注目地）穿（衣）；跳摇滚舞，奏摇滚乐；很好，棒极了；【名】 （Rock）（英、德、匈、意、瑞典）罗克（人名）
definition: 1. n. a lump or mass of hard consolidated mineral matter；2. v. move back and forth or sideways
example: for... like a, music concerts, like rock concerts and some corporate events and things like that.
exampleZh: 他负责……比如，音乐会、摇滚演唱会、一些公司活动等等。

meaning: adj. 岩石构成的，多岩石的；坚如岩石的；晃动的，不稳的；身体摇摇晃晃的，头晕目眩的；（局势、关系）不稳固的，困难重重的；与摇滚乐有关的
definition: 1. adj. abounding in rocks or stones；2. adj. causing or characterized by jolts and irregular movements
example: He began a career in journalism, working for the Rocky Mountain News.
exampleZh: 他开始从事新闻事业，供职于落基山新闻报。

meaning: n. 火箭；火箭发动机（=rocket engine/rocket motor）；火箭武器，火箭弹；火箭式焰火，流星焰火（=skyrocket）；芝麻菜，大蒜芥；严厉的斥责；（像火箭般）快速行动者，飞快行进的物体；v. 快速增长，猛增；迅速移动，飞速行进；用火箭武器攻击；（使）迅速成功，迅速提高地位；用火箭运载
definition: 1. n. any vehicle self-propelled by a rocket engine；2. v. shoot up abruptly, like a rocket
example: Oh. The question of why they chose--the baby-- the kids chose the rocket ship one as opposed to the Rafael one.
exampleZh: 这个问题是,为什么婴儿会选择火箭飞船的贴纸,而不是拉斐尔的贴纸

meaning: n. 棒，杆；钓竿，鱼竿；钓鱼者；权力，权杖；枝条，柳条；（责打人用的）棍棒；杖责，惩罚（the rod）；（左轮）手枪；视网膜杆；【名】 （Rod）（英、法、德、捷、希）罗德，（阿拉伯）鲁德，（老）罗
definition: 1. n. a linear measure of 16.5 feet；2. n. a long thin implement made of metal or wood
example: Her mother was there, trying to put a curtain rod up over the little window.
exampleZh: 她妈妈在那儿，正试着给小窗上安一根挂帘杆。

meaning: n. （演员的）角色；作用，职责；【名】 （Role）（意、塞、赤几）罗莱（人名）
definition: 1. n. the actions and activities assigned to or required or expected of a person or group；2. n. an actor's portrayal of someone in a play
example: And... a lot of, a lot of the role was played by the colonial powers within the conflict.
exampleZh: 然后呢。,有很多事取决于殖民力量,在冲突中起的作用。

meaning: v. （使）翻滚，滚动；（使）翻身，翻转；行驶，开动；（机器）转动，运转；（液体）滚落，滑落；使……成球状（或管状）；使平坦，压平；把（衣服的边）卷起来；（使）摇摆，摇晃；（使）原地转圈，翻白眼；摇（车窗），卷（窗帘等）；发出持续的声音；（时间）流逝；（产品）从（流水线，机器）产出；盗窃；连获成功；n. 卷，卷轴；卷状食品；赘肉，肥肉；名单，花名册；一管；滚动，翻滚；左右摇晃，振荡；隆隆声，轰轰响；掷骰子；压路机，辊轧机；（地形的）延绵起伏；【名】 （Roll）（美、挪、加）罗尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. rotary motion of an object around its own axis；2. v. move by turning over or rotating
example: And the fact of the matter is that rock and roll, which was invented within the lifetime of many of us.
exampleZh: 事实上，我们很多人，见证了摇滚的诞生和发展。

meaning: n. 滚筒，轧辊；卷发筒，发卷；（用于移动无轮重物的）滚棒，滚柱；碾轧机，压路机；卷浪，巨浪；涂料辊；绷带卷（=roller bandage）；（卷帘、地图等的）卷轴；滚地球；劳斯莱斯汽车；佛法僧（一种飞行时打滚的鸟）；翻头鸽；金丝雀，白玉鸟；adj. （与）四轮溜冰鞋（有关）的；【名】 （Roller）（英、德、俄、匈、罗、捷、瑞典）罗勒，（法）罗莱（人名）
definition: 1. n. a grounder that rolls along the infield；2. n. a long heavy sea wave as it advances towards the shore
example: A boy of about ten came up on roller skates.
exampleZh: 一个大约十岁的男孩穿着双排四轮旱冰鞋滑了过来。

meaning: n. （通常指短暂的）浪漫史，爱情关系，风流韵事；爱情，恋爱；传奇色彩，浪漫情调；（对某物的）迷恋，钟情；爱情故事；传奇故事；浪漫曲；v. 向……求爱，追求（某人）；夸张，渲染；讨好，奉承；adj. （语言）罗曼语的；【名】 （Romance）（西）罗曼塞（人名）
definition: 1. n. a relationship between two lovers；2. v. make amorous advances towards
example: There had been a half century that had passed since any great modern epic or romance epic had even been produced.
exampleZh: 在过去的半个世纪中,没有任何伟大的现代史诗或浪漫史诗出现。

meaning: adj. （人）浪漫的，有情调的；（事物）富有浪漫色彩的，充满浪漫气息的；爱情的，情爱的；不切实际的，空想的；（文学、艺术和音乐）浪漫主义的（Romantic）；n. 浪漫的人；爱幻想的人，空想者； 浪漫主义作家（或音乐家、艺术家）（Romantic）
definition: 1. n. a soulful or amorous idealist；2. adj. belonging to or characteristic of romanticism or the Romantic Movement in the arts
example: Frost is writing against the Romantic idea that poetry is written in repose, received passively as inspiration.
exampleZh: 弗罗斯特不是浪漫主义这一派,浪漫主义是休闲时写的诗歌，被动地作为灵感接受。

meaning: n. 屋顶，车顶；（洞穴、矿井等的）顶部；口腔顶部，上腭；住处，栖身之处；（价格或工资的）最高限度，上限；v. 给......盖上屋顶；覆遮，遮蔽；【名】 （Roof）（英）鲁夫（人名）
definition: 1. n. a protective covering that covers or forms the top of a building；2. v. provide a building with a roof; cover a building with a roof
example: A shudder in the loins engenders there The broken wall, the burning roof and tower And Agamemnon dead.
exampleZh: 腰肢的猛一颤动,残破的墙垣，燃烧的屋顶和塔巅,阿伽门农死去。

meaning: n. 房间，室；客房；（租用的）住所，寓所（rooms）；空间，地方；机会， 余地；房间里所有的人；v. 租房，合住； 让……同住；【名】 （Room）（英）鲁姆，（俄）罗姆（人名）
definition: 1. n. an area within a building enclosed by walls and floor and ceiling；2. v. live and take one's meals at or in
example: Each guest has her own single room, or shares, on request, a double room.
exampleZh: 每位客人都有自己的单人房间，经要求也可共用双人间。

meaning: n. 根，根茎；（牙齿、头发等的）根部；底部，基部；根源，起因；起源，背景；根脉，祖籍（roots）；与……的特殊关联（roots in）；词根；（数学）方根；（圣经）根苗，苗裔；翻找，搜寻；（神经的）根；（乐）根音（=root note）；性交；根用作物；根音乐；v. （使）生根；扎根于，在……中根深蒂固；根源在于，由……产生（be rooted in）；翻寻；使（某人）无法移动；（与某人）性交；使精疲力竭，挫败；adj. （蔬菜、作物等）块根的，根茎可食用的；【名】 （Root）（英）鲁特，（德、瑞典）罗特（人名）
definition: 1. n. (botany) the usually underground organ that lacks buds or leaves or nodes; absorbs water and mineral salts; usually it anchors the plant to the ground；2. v. take root and begin to grow
example: So we've seen one example of this, this idea of walking through all the integers looking for the square root.
exampleZh: 现在计算机速度很快了，我可以把这个数字设的更大点,计算机会去很快的做这个事情。

meaning: n. 粗绳，绳索；（球状物的）（一）串，（一）条；（套捕牛、马等的）套索；（拳击台、摔跤台的）围绳（the ropes）；绞刑（the rope）；办事的规矩，诀窍（the ropes）；v. 用绳子捆（或绑、系）；用绳套捕捉（动物）；用绳（或带子）围起（或隔开）（rope sth. off）；借绳爬下/借绳登山（rope down/up）；说服……参加（活动） (rope someone in/into)；拧成绳状；【名】 （Rope）（英）罗普，（芬）罗佩（人名）
definition: 1. n. a strong line；2. v. catch with a lasso
example: Does that forces us to say, "Ah, so it's not ?" the same rope at the end as the beginning."
exampleZh: 那我们是不是就必须说,“啊，这不是一开始那根绳子了“

meaning: n. 玫瑰，蔷薇；玫瑰形物，玫瑰花饰，玫瑰花形纹章（尤指英国国徽）；玫瑰色，玫瑰红；红润的肤色；安乐的境地，有利的环境，轻易成功；（水管或洒水壶的）莲蓬式喷嘴；玫瑰红葡萄酒；罗经花，向位圈，方位刻度图（compass rose的简称）；v. 使成玫瑰色，使变红；v. （数字、数量、价值）增加，（质量）提高；升起，达到较高水平（或位置）；（尤指从坐姿）起身，站起（rise的过去式）
definition: 1. n. any of many shrubs of the genus Rosa that bear roses；2. adj. of something having a dusty purplish pink color
example: Somebody rose and asked him if he had considered putting the elements in alphabetical order. They were very cruel.
exampleZh: 有人起来问他,是否考虑过将这些元素,按字母顺序排列，他们非常冷酷。

meaning: adj. 玫瑰色的，粉红色的；（脸颊）红润的，红扑扑的；乐观的，有希望的；安逸的，愉快的；【名】 （Rosy）（罗、意、瑞、典）罗茜，罗西，（英）罗茜（人名）
definition: 1. adj. reflecting optimism；2. adj. having the pinkish flush of health
example: Ultrafine powder with a rosy tinge gives the skin warmth and luminosity.
exampleZh: 带玫瑰色的超细扑粉让皮肤显得温暖而有光泽。

meaning: v. （使）腐败，（使）腐烂；逐渐衰弱（或憔悴）；取笑，开玩笑；n. 腐烂，腐烂物；腐化，堕落（the rot）；官员腐败（the rot）；（尤指植物的）枯病；羊肝蛭病；蠢话，废话；int. 胡说，废话；【名】 （Rot）（美、俄、荷）罗特（人名）
definition: 1. to (cause something to) decay；2. decay
example: The wood must not get damp as rot can quickly result.
exampleZh: 木头不能受潮，否则很快就会烂掉。

meaning: adj. 腐烂的，发臭的；（道德、社会或政治）腐败的，堕落的；令人不快的，讨厌的；质量差的，水平低的；（人）不友善的，不诚实的；身体不适的，有病的；感到内疚（或惭愧）的； （强调非常生气或沮丧）倒霉的，破烂的；adv. 非常；恶劣地，糟糕地；【名】 （Rotten）（法、德）罗滕（人名）
definition: 1. decayed；2. very bad
example: The smell outside this building is overwhelming – like rotten eggs.
exampleZh: 这栋大楼外的气味势不可挡–像臭鸡蛋。

meaning: v. （使）旋转，（使）转动；（人员）轮换，轮值；轮种，轮作；定期调换地点（或位置）；adj. （植） 辐状的
definition: 1. to turn or cause something to turn in a circle, especially around a fixed point；2. If a job rotates or if a group of people rotate their jobs, the jobs are done at different times by different people.
example: The number that you choose to rotate your letters by is what we call in cryptography, a key.
exampleZh: 你选择的旋转字母的数量,就是所谓的加密学，一个密钥。

meaning: n. 旋转，转动；旋转一周（一圈）；轮流，交替；轮班，换班；值轮班的人；（尤指实习医生的）轮流实习；轮作，轮耕；（林业）轮伐期；（数学）坐标轴的旋转；（数学）旋度，旋量（=curl）
definition: 1. movement in a circle around a fixed point；2. a complete circular movement around a fixed point
example: Because positing them allows you explain things about the rotation of the star or the gravitational fluctuations, what have you.
exampleZh: 因为这样假定能帮助你解释,诸如星体运行,引力波动,等现象

meaning: adj. （表面）粗糙的，不平的；（网球或软式墙网球拍）粗面的；粗暴的，猛烈的；（地方）多暴力的，犯罪盛行的；汹涌的，风浪很大的；粗制的，不完善的；粗俗的，不讲究的；粗略的，大致的； 艰难的，不愉快的； 身体不适的；（声音）粗哑的，不悦耳的；（酒）涩味的；未经加工的；（文具）用以打草稿的；n. （高尔夫球场的）深草区（the rough）；草稿，草图； 粗野的人，暴徒；未加工的宝石；高低不平的地面；粗糙的部分；艰苦，不愉快；v. 粗制，对……粗加工；草拟，画……的轮廓；使不平，把……弄毛糙； 因陋就简地生活；粗暴地对待；（在美式橄榄球、冰球等比赛中对对手）动粗；adv. 粗糙地，粗暴地； 风餐露宿；【名】 （Rough）（英）拉夫（人名）
definition: 1. n. the part of a golf course bordering the fairway where the grass is not cut short；2. v. prepare in preliminary or sketchy form
example: In fact, a rough grasp on traditional English meter to Stevens, say, or to Crane, or to Auden or Bishop.
exampleZh: 事实上，粗略的了解英国节律,比如史蒂文斯，克瑞恩，奥登和主教。

meaning: adv. 粗略地，大约；粗暴地，粗鲁地；粗糙地，不精细地
definition: 1. adv. (of quantities) imprecise but fairly close to correct；2. adv. with roughness or violence (`rough' is an informal variant for `roughly')
example: Well, I'm going to get back, let's just draw a bigger square than usual that's roughly four times the size.
exampleZh: 嗯，返回的是，我画一个更大的方形,大致上是4倍的大小。

meaning: adj. 圆形的，球形的；弧形的；微胖的，丰满的；（声音）圆润的；整数的；（钱）大量的；耿直的；adv. 旋转，环绕；周长；在周围，围绕；到处，四处；朝反方向，转过来；绕弯，向另一侧；逐一，挨个；到某地，在某地；大约；闲着；从头至尾；prep. 环绕，围绕；绕过，在另一侧；解决（问题）；在……周围，包围；在……各处；在……整个期间；适应，以……为中心；n. 轮次；（比赛的）局，场；一系列常规活动；（固定的）递送路线；巡防，巡诊；一巡（饮料）；一阵（掌声）；轮唱曲；一次射击，一发子弹；圆形物； 一片（面包），一个（三明治）；v. 环绕，绕过；（使）成圆形，变圆；取整，四舍五入；圆满结束，圆满完成；【名】 （Round）（美、英、加、澳、印、德）朗德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a charge of ammunition for a single shot；2. v. wind around; move along a circular course
example: Yeah, if they have a race riot round here, I'm gonna kill all the white folks with my poison."
exampleZh: 当然，假如他们有那样的种族暴动，我会用毒药除掉他们，“

meaning: v. 唤醒，（使）醒来；激励，（使）振奋；激起（某种情感）；激怒，使激动；使（某事物）发生，引起；搅动（液体，尤指酿制中的啤酒）；n. 觉醒，奋起；【名】 （Rouse）（英）劳斯（人名）
definition: 1. v. become active；2. v. force or drive out
example: When the two servants arrived, they were hardly able to rouse Heidi enough to show her to her bed-room.
exampleZh: 两个仆人赶到时，费了好大劲才勉强把海蒂唤醒到能领着她去卧室的程度。

meaning: n. 路线，航线；道路，路途；常规路线，固定路线；（尤指作为送货工作的）例行拜访，递送路线；途径，方法；（用于美国城市间干线公路编号前）公路（Route）；v. 按特定路线发送（车辆、货物或乘客）；以......线路发送（电话或其他电子信号）
definition: 1. n. an established line of travel or access；2. v. send documents or materials to appropriate destinations
example: But I realize that a lot of people just want to take the easy route and do that instead.
exampleZh: 但我后来发现，很多人只想走捷径，以手术代替其他方式。

meaning: n. 常规，惯例；生活乏味，无聊；（演出中的）一套动作，一系列笑话（等）；（为达到特定目的的）老一套，俗套；（计算机）例行程序；adj. 常规的，例行的；平常的，毫不特别的；平淡乏味的；v. 按惯例安排
definition: 1. n. an unvarying or habitual method or procedure；2. adj. occurring at fixed times or predictable intervals
example: And your workout routine is getting in the way of your job. You have to make a decision.
exampleZh: 但是你的健身计划开始影响到工作。你不得不做一个选择。

meaning: n. 一排，一行；（剧院、体育场等的）一排座位；街（用于某些道路名称）；（表格的）横线，横栏；（编织中的）针行；划船（时间）； 严重分歧，纠纷； 吵架，争吵； （持续时间长的）喧闹声，吵嚷声； 严厉斥责；v. 划（船）；划船送（某人或某物）；参加划船比赛； 争吵，吵架； 痛斥，责骂；使……成排；【名】 （Row）（英）罗（人名）
definition: 1. n. an arrangement of objects or people side by side in a line；2. v. propel with oars
example: Situation number two is I take the same number, and I make a row. They are all in one row.
exampleZh: 状态二我将采用同样的数字，并且我做了一个箭头，它们全部都在一列上。

meaning: adj. 国王的，女王的，王室的；（用于机构或组织名称）皇家的 ；盛大的，隆重的；（用于强调某人或某物极度糟糕）极其的，极度的；n. 王室成员；（鸣钟术）敲奉十口钟的变换响
definition: 1. n. a sail set next above the topgallant on a royal mast；2. adj. of or relating to or indicative of or issued or performed by a king or queen or other monarch
example: They say that if we didn't have a Royal Family, we would just have a president, but, so what?
exampleZh: 他们说，如果我们没有皇室，我们就会有总统，但是，那又怎样？

meaning: n. 王族，王室；王权，王威；版税；(发明、创意、财产等的）使用费；（矿山、石油或天然气的）开采权使用费；（国王授予个人或公司的）权利（尤指矿山开采权）
definition: 1. n. payment to the holder of a patent or copyright or resource for the right to use their property；2. n. royal persons collectively
example: She has married into royalty and has produced a son who is a future king.
exampleZh: 她已经嫁入皇室，还生下了未来的国王。

meaning: v. 擦，磨擦；揉擦，按摩（尤指疼痛部位）；擦痛，磨损；涂，抹；摹拓，拓印（黄铜碑或墓石的）碑文；（滚木球）（球）受阻，转向；（使）相互摩擦，搓；把（配料）揉擦进（混合物）（rub sth. in/into/through）；n. （用手或物体）擦，揉；按摩膏，面膜；困难，问题（the rub）；（烹饪肉之前涂抹在肉表面的）混合香料；（球）受阻，转向；磨损处；【名】 （Rub）（捷）鲁布（人名）
definition: 1. n. an unforeseen obstacle；2. v. move over something with pressure
example: You may need to give the floor a rub-down with glasspaper.
exampleZh: 你可能得用玻璃砂纸打磨一下地板。

meaning: n. 橡胶，合成橡胶； 橡皮擦； 黑板擦； 避孕套； 橡胶套鞋；（桥牌或板球的）一盘，决胜局；（棒球比赛中投手站的）投手板；多轮决胜负的比赛（如三局两胜）；adj. 橡胶制成的；v. 扭转脖子看，好奇地引颈而望；【名】 （Rubber）（西鲁）韦尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. an elastic material obtained from the latex sap of trees (especially trees of the genera Hevea and Ficus) that can be vulcanized and finished into a variety of products；2. v. coat or impregnate with rubber
example: Remember the rubber band on the back of that mask?
exampleZh: 还记得面具后面的橡皮筋不？

meaning: n. 垃圾，废弃物；毫无价值的东西，劣质产品；废话，瞎说；v. 严厉批评，把……说得一无是处；adj. 很差劲的，无用的
definition: 1. n. worthless material that is to be disposed of；2. v. attack strongly
example: whereas Gordon Ramsay says, "Oh, that's rubbish." Well, actually he usually swears more than that.
exampleZh: 然而戈登•拉姆齐经常说，“哦，真是垃圾。”其实他经常骂得更过火。

meaning: adj. 粗鲁的，无礼的；粗俗的，下流的；突如其来的，猛烈的； 简陋的，粗制的； 有活力的，粗壮的； 未开化的，原始的；【名】 （Rude）（美）鲁德（人名）
definition: 1. adj. socially incorrect in behavior；2. adj. (of persons) lacking in refinement or grace
example: which totally goes against the stereotype of like "New Yorkers are mean, they are all like rude and everything."
exampleZh: 和那种“纽约人很刻薄，都很没礼貌。”的刻板印象截然不同，

meaning: n. 小地毯，垫子； （盖腿的）厚毯子，毛毯；（男子的）遮秃假发；（马的）披毯，裹毯；【名】 （Rug）（塞）鲁格（人名）
definition: 1. n. floor covering consisting of a piece of thick heavy fabric (usually with nap or pile)
example: It is not possible to reposition the rug without damaging it.
exampleZh: 想要挪动地毯又不损坏它是不可能的。

meaning: n. 毁坏，毁灭；破产，身败名裂；祸根； 残垣断壁，废墟；残存部分（ruins）；v. 毁坏，破坏；使（建筑物，地方）破败，使成为废墟；使倾家荡产，使破产； 头朝下跌落，哗啦一声掉下；【名】 （Ruin）（法、俄、意、瑞典）吕安（人名）
definition: 1. n. an irrecoverable state of devastation and destruction；2. v. destroy completely; damage irreparably
example: My shoes cost over 6,000 yuan; they have sheepskin soles and can't get wet—once they do, they're ruined.
exampleZh: 我这个鞋子啊，六千多块，都是羊皮底，不能沾水的，沾水就废掉了。

meaning: adj. 破坏性的，毁灭性的；导致破产的，耗资巨大的；破败不堪的，损毁严重的
definition: 1. adj. extremely harmful; bringing physical or financial ruin；2. adj. causing injury or blight; especially affecting with sudden violence or plague or ruin
example: The buildings were in a ruinous state.
exampleZh: 这些建筑破烂不堪。

meaning: n. 规章，条例；（语言、科学等的）规则，法则；行事准则，指导方针；常规，惯常做法；统治，管辖；尺，直尺；铅线印出的线，破折号； 澳大利亚式橄榄球规则（两队各18人参赛）；v. 统治，管辖；支配，控制；占首要地位；（尤指对法律问题）判定，裁定；（用尺等）划（线）； 好极了，非常棒；（行星）对（黄道十二宫图的宫，房子，生活等）有影响；（价格或贸易商品的价格）普遍处于某一水平（或坚挺趋势）；【名】 （Rule）（西）鲁莱（人名）
definition: 1. n. a principle or condition that customarily governs behavior；2. v. exercise authority over; as of nations
example: OK, this is only true for an ideal gas, and we went through that mathematically where the, with a chain rule.
exampleZh: 这一关系只对理想气体成立，上节课我们,用链式法则推导出了这一关系。

meaning: n. 统治者，管理者；尺子，直尺；（计算机屏幕的）标尺；划线板，划线的人；主导行星（对黄道十二宫图的宫、房子、生活等有特别影响的行星）
definition: 1. n. measuring stick consisting of a strip of wood or metal or plastic with a straight edge that is used for drawing straight lines and measuring lengths；2. n. a person who rules or commands
example: The former military ruler of Lesotho has been placed under house arrest.
exampleZh: 莱索托前军事统治者已被软禁了。

meaning: n. （尤指法庭的）裁决，裁定；统治，支配；adj. 统治的，支配的；（热情或感情）占支配地位的，最强烈的 ；流行的，普遍的；v. 统治，支配；控制，操纵；裁定，判决（rule 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. the reason for a court's judgment (as opposed to the decision itself)；2. adj. exercising power or authority
example: One is simple disbelief or unbelief a kind of rejection of ruling opinion simply because you don't like it.
exampleZh: 其一为，就只是不相信或是无信仰,即拒绝统治主张,理由仅是你不喜欢它。

meaning: n. 谣言，传闻，传言；鲁莫尔（人名，意大利语、葡萄牙语）；vt. 谣传，传说（常用被动语态）
definition: 1. n. gossip (usually a mixture of truth and untruth) passed around by word of mouth；2. v. tell or spread rumors
example: "Look around if you like. There's no evidence against me. It's all just rumor," he told a visitor.
exampleZh: “你想的话可以四处看看。这里绝对没有什么对我不利的证据。那些都只是谣言。”他告诉一位到访者。

meaning: v. 跑，奔跑；参加（赛跑），举行（比赛）；跑垒，持球跑动进攻；奔忙，赶快去；管理，经营，使用（车辆）；（使）运转，操作；刊登，播放；（使）行驶；（使）移动，揉擦；闯红灯；（使）流动，流淌；掉色，渗色；变成，变得；达到（一定数量或比率）；（对……）进行（测试或检验）；参加竞选；（连裤袜、长统袜）抽丝，脱线；（使）延伸；（感觉或想法）掠过，迅速传遍；包含（某种词语、内容等）；持续，延续；偷运，走私；印刷；（特征）共有，世代相传（run in）；（物品，行动）花费（某人）（特定数额的钱）；n. 跑步，赛跑；旅程，航程；一系列（成功或失败）；连续上演（或放映）；尝试，努力；额定产量；抛售（美元、英镑等）；争购，挤兑；滑道，路径；（板球或棒球中的）得分；使用自由，出入自由（the run of）；竞选；普通人，普通事物；饲养场；急奏，走句；顺子；腹泻（the runs）；（长统袜或连裤袜的）抽丝；（油漆或类似物刷得过厚引起的）挂流，小溪；（航海）船尾端部；【名】 （Run）（塞）鲁恩（人名）
definition: 1. n. a score in baseball made by a runner touching all four bases safely；2. v. move fast by using one's feet, with one foot off the ground at any given time
example: So we'll take h 2 and we'll run -- or actually we'll have h 2 filled in an evacuated glass tube.
exampleZh: 我们马上就会在氢原子上试一试,我们用氢气-我们把玻璃管充满氢气。

meaning: n. 跑步者；赛马；走私者；送信人，信差；跑垒员；跑动板球员；滑动装置；长条地毯；纤匐枝；跑鞋，运动鞋；性能良好的车；竞争者；可能被接受的想法；（热带海洋的）青鲹；回转磨石（=runner stone）；【名】 （Runner）（英）朗纳（人名）
definition: 1. n. someone who imports or exports without paying duties；2. n. someone who travels on foot by running
example: There was a suspicion that this runner attempted to avoid the procedures for drug testing.
exampleZh: 存在这名赛跑运动员试图逃避药检的怀疑。

meaning: n. 跑步，赛跑；管理，运作；走私，私运（毒品、枪支等）；adj. 运转着的；（水）流动的，（从水管和水龙头）流出的；（疮或身体部位）流出液体的，流脓的；连续的，反复不断的；现场的，实况的；在跑动中完成的，助跑的；持球跑动进攻的；adv. 连续地；v. 跑；运转；行驶（run的现在分词形式）；【名】 （Running）（英）朗宁（人名）
definition: 1. n. (American football) a play in which a player attempts to carry the ball through or past the opposing team；2. adj. moving quickly on foot
example: >> They only use that when the program that you're running-- the program that you're referring to is going to your computer?
exampleZh: >它只有在你运行程序的时候才用到-,那你刚刚提到的程序,会到你的电脑上运行吗？

meaning: n. （机场的）跑道；（时装模特表演时走的）伸展台，T型台；（尤指小体哺乳动物在草地或雪地下等挖的）过道，通道；（运原木的）滑道，滑运斜面
definition: 1. n. a narrow platform extending from the stage into the audience in a theater or nightclub etc.；2. n. a strip of level paved surface where planes can take off and land
example: and all these nonprofits, they have clothes that will go on the runway for an audience to see,
exampleZh: 这些非营利性组织，他们在T台上展示服装给观众看。

meaning: adj. 农村的，乡村的；有乡村特色的，有乡土气息的
definition: 1. adj. living in or characteristic of farming or country life；2. adj. relating to rural areas
example: She said, if you talk to the farmers in these rural areas what do you think they say when you offer?
exampleZh: 她说,如果跟边远地区农户谈及保险,你觉得他们会有什么反应

meaning: v. 冲，奔；把（某人或某物）迅速送往；赶紧做，仓促做；催促，使赶紧；（水、液体等）快速流动；（因感到尴尬）某人的脸/面颊涨红；向……猛冲，猛攻；（大学生联谊会通过举办聚会等）招纳，招收（新会员）；办理手续加入（大学生联谊会）；（美橄）突袭（对方队员，尤指枢纽前卫）；（美式橄榄中）跑动带（球）；仓促生产并分发，匆匆出售（rush something out）；n. （尤指一群人的）冲，奔；（空气、水等）湍流；匆忙，赶紧；（人流或交通的）高峰时间（the rush）；（很多人）争做，急需；迸发的情绪，情绪迸发；（因吸食毒品或因兴奋事物产生的）一阵激动；工作样片（rushes）；灯心草（常用来编筐）；（美橄）突袭对方队员（尤指枢纽前卫）；（美式橄榄球中的）跑动带球；（大学生联谊会的）招新活动；（美国大学生联谊会的）纳新活动（时间）；【名】 （Rush）（英）拉什（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of moving hurriedly and in a careless manner；2. v. step on it
example: They began with an abstract thought, discussed it, reminded each other of another abstract point forgotten in the rush of events.
exampleZh: 他们从一个抽象的想法开始讨论，相互提醒着在匆忙中,被遗忘的另一个抽象概念。

meaning: n. 锈，铁锈；（植物的）锈病，锈菌；铁锈色，赭色；v. （使）生锈；成铁锈色；（因疏忽或不用而）衰退，变迟钝；（因长时间不用或有害使用而）损害，腐蚀；【名】 （Rust）（英）拉斯特，（德、捷、瑞典）鲁斯特，（法）吕斯特（人名）
definition: 1. a reddish-brown substance that forms on the surface of iron and steel as a result of reacting with air and water；2. a reddish-brown colour that looks like rust
example: Years of exposure to salt water had left the metal frame weakened by rust.
exampleZh: 多年接触海水使金属框架因锈蚀而变得脆弱。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: adj. 生锈的，锈迹斑斑的；铁锈色的，赭色的；（技术、知识等）荒废的，生疏的；（人）不熟练的
definition: 1. covered with rust (= metal decay)；2. If a skill you had is rusty, it is not as good as it was because you have not practised it
example: A thin curl of smoke rose from a rusty stove.
exampleZh: 一缕薄薄的青烟从生锈的炉子里冉冉升起。

meaning: adj. 无情的，冷酷的；（行为等）坚决的，果断的
definition: 1. not thinking or worrying about any pain caused to others; cruel；2. cruel, or determined to succeed without caring about others
example: He's a ruthless businessman, as I know to my cost.
exampleZh: 我吃了苦头后才知道他是个无情的商人。

meaning: n. 麻布（或厚纸、塑料等）大袋；一袋（的量）； 解雇（the sack）； 床（the sack）；（通常指在战争中）洗劫，劫掠；（棒球）垒；（在争球线后对四分卫的）擒杀；宽松直筒连衣裙（=sack dress）；宽松女袍；（流行于18世纪、系于礼服裙裙肩上的）宽褶后拖曳地裙裾；萨克葡萄酒；v. 解雇，开除；（军队或军事集团）劫掠，洗劫；（在美式足球中）擒抱（四分卫）；把……装进袋里；上床睡觉（sack out）；【名】 （Sack）（英、法、葡、瑞典）萨克，（德）扎克（人名）
definition: 1. n. a bag made of paper or plastic for holding customer's purchases；2. v. plunder (a town) after capture
example: Now,it's easy to make fun of Chambord, who was a pauvre type, a sad sack,in many ways.
exampleZh: 取笑尚博尔伯爵很容易,在很多方面,他是一个可怜的家伙,是一个冒失鬼

meaning: adj. 神的，神圣的；宗教的，宗教性的；受尊重的，受崇敬的；不可侵犯的，不容干涉的
definition: 1. considered to be holy and deserving respect, especially because of a connection with a god；2. connected with religion
example: The eagle is the animal most sacred to the Native Americans.
exampleZh: 鹰是印第安人眼中最为神圣的动物。

meaning: n. 牺牲，献出；献祭，供奉；祭牲，供品；基督的献身（指耶稣被钉在十字架上）；（天主教作为献祭圣体和圣血，或新教表示感恩的）圣餐礼；（棋）（为战略或战术原因所作出的）弃子，弃卒；（棒球中）牺牲打（sacrifice bunt/fly）；（桥牌）（指在对方叫到进局定约之后的）牺牲性叫牌（sacrifice bid）；v. 牺牲，献出；献祭，以……为祭品；（棋）（故意）弃子，弃卒；（棒球）做牺牲打；（棒球）以牺牲打使（跑垒者）进垒；（桥牌）作牺牲性叫牌；亏本出售
definition: 1. n. the act of losing or surrendering something as a penalty for a mistake or fault or failure to perform etc.；2. v. endure the loss of
example: He was willing to sacrifice his happiness on the altar of fame.
exampleZh: 为了名声，他心甘情愿牺牲幸福。

meaning: adj. 牺牲的，献祭的
definition: 1. adj. used in or connected with a sacrifice
example: It's the same desire for some kind of sacrificial substitution that, I think, is fueling the poem's ending.
exampleZh: 这和为诗歌最后的结尾火上浇油的，牺牲性的替代是毫无差别的。

meaning: adj. 伤心的，难过的；令人伤心的，让人难过的；糟糕的，不能令人接受的；不幸的，可怜的；（歌曲或音乐）显露悲伤的，伤感的；状况不佳的；（人）可悲的，不受人尊敬的； 老土的，过时的；（面团）发得不好的；n. 季节性情感障碍（SAD）
definition: 1. adj. experiencing or showing sorrow or unhappiness；2. adj. of things that make you feel sad
example: And so, when we took a field trip to go see the SF Chronicle, it was really, really sad.
exampleZh: 我们去《旧金山纪事报》的报社看过，发现他们真的很萧条。

meaning: n. 悲伤，悲痛；使人悲伤的事（或难过）的事
definition: 1. n. emotions experienced when not in a state of well-being；2. n. the state of being sad
example: There was more than a hint of sadness in his voice.
exampleZh: 他的声音中流露出了深切的悲伤。

meaning: v. 使悲伤，使难过； 悲伤，难过
definition: 1. v. make unhappy；2. v. come to feel sad
example: But I would not sadden you by the mortal plaint.
exampleZh: 但是我不会用这致命的诉苦来使你忧伤。

meaning: n. 鞍，马鞍；（自行车或摩托车的）车座；（羊、兔或鹿的）脊肉；（哺乳动物或家禽的）后背部，脊；（电缆、电线或管的）托架；（窑里用于支撑陶瓷器的）耐火黏土托架；（役马的）鞍部；（山的）鞍部；鞍点；v. 给（马）装鞍；（驯马师）使（马）参加比赛；使承担（责任、任务），使负重担；跨上马鞍
definition: 1. a seat on a bicycle, motorcycle, etc.；2. a leather seat on a horse
example: It had a saddle with springs sticking out, which wore away the seat of my trousers.
exampleZh: 马鞍上的弹簧翘了出来，磨坏了我臀部的裤子。

meaning: adj. 安全的，平安的；不损害（或危害）健康的；谨慎的；（地点或局势）安全的；不会丢失，不会被拿走； 不错的；不致引起争议的，有把握的；（棒球）成功上垒的；（选举中席位）十拿九稳的；无风险的，稳妥的；n. 保险箱； 阴茎套，安全套；纱橱；int. 嗨，喂（年轻人打招呼时说）；adv. 安全地，平安地；【名】 （Safe）（几）萨菲（人名）
definition: 1. n. strongbox where valuables can be safely kept；2. adj. free from danger or the risk of harm
example: So things can be dangerous. But generally, if you're smart, I think it's a very safe place to live.
exampleZh: 因此，危险还是存在的。但大多数情况下，只要你精明点，我认为那儿还是一个非常安全的居住地。

meaning: n. 安全；安全性；安全场所，安全的地方；安全方法，安全措施； （枪炮的）保险栓，保险机（=safety catch ）；安全分（持球进攻队员在己方端线后被拦截，防守方得两分）；（位置远离争球线的）安全卫； 安全套；（棒球）安打；安全设备；adj. （特征、措施）保障安全的
definition: 1. n. the state of being certain that adverse effects will not be caused by some agent under defined conditions；2. n. a safe place
example: As independent defenders of the common safety and the common interest, they demanded a role in the most important political decisions.
exampleZh: 作为独立的捍卫者,他们享有共同的,集体安全与共同利益,他们要求参与,关键的政治决策

meaning: n. 保障条款， 保护措施；v. 保护，护卫
definition: 1. to protect something from harm；2. to protect children or adults who could be hurt emotionally or physically
example: They will press for international action to safeguard the ozone layer.
exampleZh: 他们将竭力要求国际行动来保护臭氧层。

meaning: v. （人）航行；（船）航行；启航；驾驶（船只）；飘过，（轻快地）移动；n. 帆；乘船航行；（用作交通工具的）帆船的使用；（潜艇的）瞭望塔；油布，篷帆布；帆状物，功能似帆的物体；（风车的）翼板；（旗鱼或一些史前爬行动物的）脊鳍；（僧帽水母等的）帆器
definition: 1. n. a large piece of fabric (usually canvas fabric) by means of which wind is used to propel a sailing vessel；2. v. traverse or travel by ship on (a body of water)
example: He'd learned to sail when he was young, but on the river.
exampleZh: 他年轻时就学会了航海,但是在河上

meaning: n. 帆船运动，乘帆船航行；水运航班；起航；航海术；adj. 航行的；v. （乘船）航行；启航；驾驶（船只）（sail 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. the work of a sailor；2. n. riding in a sailboat
example: That incident that Socrates tells here represents what one could call " the famous Socratic turn Socrates' second sailing so to speak.
exampleZh: 苏格拉底在这儿,所提的事件代,表著名的“苏格拉底转向,即苏格拉底的第二次启航。

meaning: n. 水手，船员；驾船人，帆船驾驶者；喜好航海的人（尤指富有经验者）；【名】 （Sailor）（英）赛勒（人名）
definition: 1. n. any member of a ship's crew；2. n. a serviceman in the navy
example: A sailor carrying a sawn-off shotgun was arrested in Los Angeles.
exampleZh: 一位携带着锯短的散弹枪的水手在洛杉矶被捕。

meaning: n. （基督教追封的）圣者，圣徒；圣人，道德高尚的人；圣（用于宗教圣徒的头衔中）（Saint，缩写为St或S）；摩门教信徒（Saint）；（《圣经》中使用或典出《圣经》的）基督信徒；v. 把……正式封为圣者（或圣人），封圣；adj. 高尚的，圣贤的
definition: 1. n. a person who has died and has been declared a saint by canonization；2. v. hold sacred
example: He reconnoitred the Gulf of Saint Lawrence, travelling up the magnificent river as far as modern Montreal.
exampleZh: 他侦察了圣劳伦斯海湾，沿着壮丽的河流向上前行直到现代的蒙特利尔。

meaning: n. 利益，好处；目的；为了便于讨论（for the sake of argument）；（强调重要或表示恼火）看在上帝分上，天哪（for God's/goodness'/Christ's/heaven's/Pete's etc. sake）；日本米酒，日本清酒；【名】 （Sake）（罗）萨克，（日）酒（姓）（人名）
definition: 1. n. a reason for wanting something done；2. n. Japanese alcoholic beverage made from fermented rice; usually served hot
example: The structural moment of concentration on the code for its own sake cannot be avoided, and literature necessarily breeds its own formalism.
exampleZh: 集中在代码上的结构瞬间,因为它本身的原因不可避免，文学必要地导致了它自身的形式主义。

meaning: n. 沙拉，色拉，沙律（一种常加调味汁的凉拌食物）；生菜，莴苣（尤指适合拌沙拉的绿叶蔬菜）；（Salad）人名，萨拉德（尤指阿拉伯人名）
definition: 1. n. food mixtures either arranged on a plate or tossed and served with a moist dressing; usually consisting of or including greens
example: The olive itself, you use it to cook with as oil; some people just put oil on their salad.
exampleZh: 你可以用它来烹饪,有些人还往沙拉中加入橄榄油

meaning: n. 薪金，薪水；v. 给……薪金
definition: 1. n. something that remunerates
example: but it's not like Law or working in the financial world where you’re gonna get a good salary, so.
exampleZh: 但它不会像法学或者在金融界工作一样给你带来很高的薪水，

meaning: n. 出售，销售；销售额（sales）；销售活动，（尤指）拍卖；降价出售，大减价；销售部门（sales）；销售业务，销售工作（sales）；【名】 （Sale）（意、塞、瑞典）萨莱，（英、萨摩）塞尔，（法）萨尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. the general activity of selling；2. n. a particular instance of selling
example: My shoes were from the sale, but that's maybe like the only new thing I bought.
exampleZh: 我的鞋子是在促销时候买的，但那可能是我买的唯一一件新的东西了。

meaning: n. 男推销员；男售货员
definition: 1. n. a man salesperson
example: At the risk of being immodest, I was a great salesman.
exampleZh: 虽然冒着大吹大擂的风险，但我的确是一名伟大的推销员。

meaning: n. 鲑鱼，三文鱼，大麻哈鱼；鲑鱼肉，三文鱼肉；鲑肉粉红色，浅橙色；类似鲑的鱼，尤指澳鲑，石首鱼；adj. 浅橙色的
definition: 1. a medium-sized silver-coloured fish that lives in the sea or rivers and swims up rivers to produce its eggs. Its pink flesh is eaten as a food；2. a medium-size fish with pink flesh which lives in the sea
example: He gave them a splendid lunch of smoked salmon.
exampleZh: 他款待了他们一顿极好的熏三文鱼午餐。

meaning: n. 美发厅，美容院；高级服装店，时装店；（大宅中的）客厅，会客室；沙龙（旧时作家、艺术家等在名流家中定期举行的聚会）；沙龙画展（Salon）；【名】 （Salon）（法、西、捷、瑞典）萨隆（人名）
definition: 1. a shop where you can get a particular service, especially connected with beauty or fashion；2. a meeting of writers, painters, etc., at the house of someone famous or important
example: She received a cosmetic makeover at a beauty salon as a birthday gift.
exampleZh: 作为生日礼物，她得到了在一家美容院美容的机会。

meaning: n. 盐，食盐（=common salt）；（化学）盐；盐状物（用于某种特殊目的的物质或药品）（salts）；风趣，刺激性；有经验的水手，老水手（old salt）；v. 给（食物）加盐调味；用盐腌制（食物）（=salt down）；（为融化雪或冰）撒盐于（道路）上；给……增添刺激，使……更有趣；使（矿区、矿山）呈虚假的富矿状；adj. 含盐的，咸的；用盐腌制的；（植物）海生的，生长于盐沼的；猥亵的；abbr. （美俄）限制战略武器谈判（Strategic Arms Limitation Talks）；【名】 （Salt）（美、爱尔兰、马耳他）索尔特（姓氏）
definition: 1. n. a compound formed by replacing hydrogen in an acid by a metal (or a radical that acts like a metal)；2. v. add salt to
example: Let's take salt, solid, and dissolve it in a bunch of liquid water.
exampleZh: 我们把食盐晶体，溶解在一些水中。

meaning: adj. 咸的，含盐的；有趣而略显粗俗的；粗鲁的，爱闹事的
definition: 1. adj. engagingly stimulating or provocative；2. adj. containing or filled with salt
example: She could smell the salty tang of the sea.
exampleZh: 她能闻到海水的咸腥味。

meaning: v. （向……）行军礼，（向……）致敬；（尤指公开地）赞扬，颂扬；（尤指用手或身体动作）向……打招呼，向……致意；n. 敬礼，举手礼；致敬，致意； 鸣礼炮，鸣炮致敬；举剑致敬
definition: 1. (especially of people in the armed forces) to make a formal sign of respect to someone, especially by raising the right hand to the side of the head；2. to honour or express admiration publicly for a person or an achievement
example: I was kicked out of school when I was in third grade for refusing to salute the flag.
exampleZh: 我在三年级的时候,因为拒绝向国旗敬礼而被退学。

meaning: n. 招呼，致意；（信函、演讲开头的）称呼语
definition: 1. a greeting in words or actions, or the words used at the beginning of a letter or speech
example: The old man moved away, raising his hand in salutation.
exampleZh: 这位老者离开，举起他的手致意。

meaning: n. 抢救，救援；抢救出的物品；海难救助费，打捞费；v. 打捞，抢救；挽救，挽回（珍贵或重要的事物）；【名】 （Salvage）（法）萨尔瓦热（人名）
definition: 1. to save goods from damage or destruction, especially from a ship that has sunk or been damaged or a building that has been damaged by fire or a flood；2. to try to make a bad situation better
example: They climbed up on the rock with their salvage.
exampleZh: 他们带着抢救出来的财物爬到了礁石上。

meaning: n. 解救物，救星；解救，拯救；（基督教中）对灵魂的拯救，救赎；【名】 （Salvation）（瑞典）萨尔瓦蒂翁（人名）
definition: 1. (a way of) being saved from danger, loss, or harm；2. In the Christian religion, salvation of a person or their spirit is the state of being saved from evil and its effects by the death of Jesus on a cross
example: The Salvation Army shops depend on regular supplies of saleable items.
exampleZh: 救世军商店靠的是获得容易卖物品的经常性的供应。

meaning: adj. 同一的；一模一样的；没有变化的；独一无二的人（或物）；上述的（this/that same）；pron. 同样的人，同样的事物；（数目、颜色、大小、质量等）相同；（与前述之事）同样的事（the same）；未改变的人（或事物），和从前一样的人（或事物）；adv. 同样；【名】 （Same）（意）萨梅（人名）
definition: 1. n. a member of an indigenous nomadic people living in northern Scandinavia and herding reindeer；2. adj. same in identity
example: So Roth imagines lived life as fictional in the same register as a novel, in the same register as an autobiography.
exampleZh: 所以罗斯想像过的生活就像小说中记录的那样，一如自传所述。

meaning: n. 样本，样品；试用产品，试样；（供科学或医学检测用的）抽样样本；（抽查的）样本，抽选人员；（用于新乐曲中的）选录的歌曲片段；v. 品尝，尝试（食品、饮料）；体验（活动）；对……作抽样调查；节录，选录（歌曲等，用于其他录音）；确定（模拟信号）瞬时值；adj. 样品的，实例的；【名】 （Sample）（美、英、爱尔兰）桑普尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a small part of something intended as representative of the whole；2. v. take a sample of
example: 'I'd like to see a sample of your work,' said the manager.
exampleZh: “拿一件你做的货样给我看看。”经理说。

meaning: n. 制裁；处罚，惩罚；（正式）许可，批准；（尤指基督教会的）法令，法律；（伦理学）约束力；支持，鼓励；v. 认可，准许；对……实施制裁，处罚
definition: 1. an official order, such as the stopping of trade, that is taken against a country in order to make it obey international law；2. a strong action taken in order to make people obey a law or rule, or a punishment given when they do not obey
example: The government refused to sanction a further cut in interest rates.
exampleZh: 政府拒绝批准进一步降低利率。

meaning: n. 避难权，庇护；避难所，庇护所；动物保护区，禁猎区；（某种受伤或遭遗弃动物的）收养所；宗教圣所，圣殿；（教堂内的）圣坛
definition: 1. protection or a safe place, especially for someone or something being chased or hunted；2. a place where birds or animals can live and be protected, especially from being hunted or dangerous conditions
example: His church became a sanctuary for thousands of people who fled the civil war.
exampleZh: 他的教堂成了数千逃避内战的人们的一个避难所。

meaning: n. 沙，沙子；沙堆，沙地；沙滩，沙漠（sands）；沙石层，沙层；（尤指大于0.06毫米的沙粒构成的）沉积沙土；沙土色，浅黄灰色；坚定，刚毅；v. （用砂纸或打磨机）磨光；撒沙于，铺沙于；使撒沙似地布满；给……掺沙子；【名】 （Sand）（英、德、意、芬、罗、捷、挪、瑞典）桑德，（法）桑（人名）
definition: 1. n. a loose material consisting of grains of rock or coral；2. v. rub with sandpaper
example: Bishop's sandpiper poet, there in your handout, is obsessed with the mere details of experience, those sand grains, quartz grains.
exampleZh: 毕肖普写鹬的那首诗，你们的讲稿上有，被零星的描写经验的细节所累，描写了那些谷物和石英岩。

meaning: n. 三明治，夹心面包片；果酱（或奶油）夹心松蛋糕；夹心饼干；三明治状物；教学与实习交替培训课程；v. 插入，夹入；粘合（sandwich sth. together）；把……做成三明治
definition: 1. n. two (or more) slices of bread with a filling between them；2. v. make into a sandwich

exampleZh: 一点是我已经谈论过的,人是一种组合,有点儿像灵魂和肉体三明治

meaning: n. 公共卫生，环境卫生；下水道设施，卫生设备
definition: 1. the systems for taking dirty water and other waste products away from buildings in order to protect people's health；2. the system used to keep healthy standards in a place where people live, esp. by removing waste products and garbage safely
example: The location is exceptionally poor, viewed from the sanitation point.
exampleZh: 从环境卫生角度来看，这个位置非常糟糕。

meaning: adj. 公共卫生的，公共保健的；干净的，卫生的；（用品）月经期间使用的
definition: 1. relating to the systems for taking dirty water and other waste products away from buildings in order to protect people's health；2. clean and not dangerous for your health, or protecting health by removing dirt and waste, especially human waste
example: The new houses were more sanitary than the old ones had been.
exampleZh: 新房子比老房子卫生。

meaning: n. 讽刺，挖苦
definition: 1. the use of remarks that clearly mean the opposite of what they say, made in order to hurt someone's feelings or to criticize something in a humorous way；2. remarks that mean the opposite of what they say, made to criticize someone or something in a way that is amusing to others but annoying to the person criticized
example: Sarcasm and demeaning remarks have no place in parenting.
exampleZh: 挖苦和贬损的言语不应用来教育子女。

meaning: adj. 讽刺的，嘲笑的，挖苦的
definition: 1. using remarks that clearly mean the opposite of what you say, in order to hurt someone's feelings or to humorously criticize something
example: It can have a very sarcastic undertone which could be good, depending on what you need to express.
exampleZh: 它可以表达一种带着挖苦意味的好意，这取决于你表达的需要。

meaning: n. 卫星；人造卫星；卫星国，附属国；卫星城镇，卫星郊区；卫星电视；随体DNA；adj. 卫星传送的，使用卫星技术的
definition: 1. n. man-made equipment that orbits around the earth or the moon；2. v. broadcast or disseminate via satellite
example: The news programme came to us via satellite.
exampleZh: 新闻节目是通过卫星传送到我们这里来的。

meaning: n. 讽刺，讥讽；讽刺作品；讽刺文学；（拉丁文学的）讽刺杂咏（尤指讽刺时弊的诗）
definition: 1. a way of criticizing people or ideas in a humorous way, especially in order to make a political point, or a piece of writing that uses this style；2. a humorous way of criticizing people or ideas to show that they have faults or are wrong, or a piece of writing or a play that uses this style
example: The commercial side of the Christmas season is an easy target for satire.
exampleZh: 圣诞节期间商业化的一面很容易成为讽刺的对象。

meaning: adj. 讽刺的，讥讽的；爱挖苦人的
definition: 1. criticizing people or ideas in a humorous way, especially in order to make a political point
example: Compared to Uncle Tommy, he was an intellectual of the highest order, and indeed his satirical pen belied his mild demeanor.
exampleZh: 与汤米叔叔相比，他是一个最高级别的知识分子，他那讽刺的笔锋确实掩盖了他温和的举止。

meaning: n. 讽刺作家，惯于讽刺的人
definition: 1. a person who writes satire
example: He built a reputation in the 1970s as a social satirist.
exampleZh: 他在20世纪70年代作为社会讽刺作家而出名。

meaning: v. 使满意，使满足；满足（要求、需要等）；符合（规定、条件或标准）；使确信，使信服；清偿，偿付；解，符合（方程式）；令人满意，令人满足
definition: 1. v. fulfil the requirements or expectations of；2. v. make happy or satisfied
example: So that's a big help. And equilibrium happens when there isn't any possible change of state that would satisfy this.
exampleZh: 这个非常方便，当所有的变化,都无法满足这个公式的时候,系统就达到了平衡。

meaning: n. 满意，称心；（对需求或欲望的）满足；（抗议、投诉等的）妥善处理；乐事，快事；（债务等的）清偿，（义务等的）履行；赔偿，补偿；通过决斗维护荣誉的机会；（基督教神学）基督替世人赎罪
definition: 1. n. the contentment you feel when you have done something right；2. n. state of being gratified; great satisfaction
example: In other words, the judgment of beauty does not depend on the existence of the object for its satisfaction.
exampleZh: 换句话说，审美不会依赖于,事物自己的存在形式。

meaning: adj. 令人满意的，合适的；（病人）未恶化的，没有生命危险的；（证据，判决）满足案情需要的；赎罪的
definition: 1. adj. giving satisfaction；2. adj. meeting requirements
example: Let's assume for the sake of argument that we manage to build a satisfactory database.
exampleZh: 让我们为了讨论假定我们设法构建了一个令人满意的数据库。

meaning: v. 使湿透，浸透；使充满，使饱和；充斥（市场），使（市场）供大于求；使（化学溶液）饱和；饱和磁化；饱和充电；饱和轰炸；adj. 湿透的；饱和的；n. 饱和脂肪
definition: 1. to make something or someone completely wet；2. to fill a thing or place completely so that no more can be added
example: Saturate the wood with oil and let it soak in. The oil protects the wood.
exampleZh: 用油浸透木材，使之吸收。油可以保护木材。

meaning: n. 饱和，饱和状态；（化学溶液的）饱和状态，饱和度；（尤指照相的）色饱和度；磁化饱和；浸透，湿透
definition: 1. the act or result of filling a thing or place completely so that no more can be added；2. the act of making something or someone completely wet
example: Japanese car makers have been equally blind to the saturation of their markets at home and abroad.
exampleZh: 日本的汽车制造商对国内外市场的饱和同样视而不见。

meaning: n. 星期六
definition: 1. n. the seventh and last day of the week; observed as the Sabbath by Jews and some Christians
example: Especially like on a Friday or Saturday night, and people are going out, and there's music going,
exampleZh: 尤其是星期五和星期六晚上，人们外出，有音乐，

meaning: n. 酱，调味汁；烈酒（the sauce）； 无礼的话（或举动）；v. 加酱汁于，用酱汁调味；使增加趣味；对……粗暴无礼；【名】 （Sauce）（西）绍塞，（法）索斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. flavorful relish or dressing or topping served as an accompaniment to food；2. v. behave saucy or impudently towards
example: It's good with cream sauce but everything's good with cream sauce.
exampleZh: 和奶油酱搭配还不错,不过,奶油酱不论搭配什么都很好吃

meaning: n. 香肠，腊肠；香肠形状；用作亲密称呼小家伙，小子
definition: 1. n. highly seasoned minced meat stuffed in casings；2. n. a small nonrigid airship used for observation or as a barrage balloon
example: The knife for cutting sausage was sitting in the sink.
exampleZh: 用于切香肠的刀在水槽里。

meaning: adj. 凶猛的，残暴的；猛烈的，恶狠狠的；极严重的，大幅度的；未开化的，野蛮的；（土地）荒凉的，无人烟的；n. 未开化的人，野蛮人； 凶狠残暴的人；（纹章）长须半裸带叶环男人形；v. （动物）凶猛攻击，撕咬； 激烈抨击，猛烈批评；【名】 （Savage）（西）萨瓦赫，（英、德）萨维奇（人名）
definition: 1. extremely violent, wild, or frightening；2. very serious or cruel
example: The book contrasts modern civilization with the ideal of the noble savage who lived in harmony with nature.
exampleZh: 这本书将现代文明同与自然界和谐相处的高尚野蛮人的理想进行了对比。

meaning: v. 救助，搭救；避免，减少；积攒，储蓄；节省（钱、时间或其他资源）；保存，保留；收集；（为某人）保留；（计算机）保存（数据）；使健康长寿，护佑；（足球等）救球，防止对方进球；（棒球）（替补投手） 保持（其他投手取得的领先地位）；（基督教）拯救（某人），使摆脱罪孽；n. （足球等守门员的）救球；（棒球）（替补投手） 保持（其他投手取得的领先地位）；（计算机）存储数据；prep. 除……之外；【名】 （Save）（法）萨夫，（意、保、西、罗、塞、瑞典）萨薇 （女名），萨韦（人名）
definition: 1. n. (sports) the act of preventing the opposition from scoring；2. v. save from ruin, destruction, or harm
example: There are children who by a relatively modest donation to an effective aid agency, you could save their lives.
exampleZh: 要拯救这些儿童的生命,只需要你向比较有效的救助机构,捐赠适量的钱款。

meaning: n. （钱、时间或其他资源的）节约，节省；储蓄金，存款； 保留，例外；存钱；adj. 节约的，节省的；节俭的，省钱的；prep. 除了，除……外；【名】 （Saving）人名，（瑞典）萨温；v. 救援，挽救；节省；保存（save 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. an act of economizing; reduction in cost；2. adj. bringing about salvation or redemption from sin
example: So if you answer the phone, you'll be saving me from a long conversation that will last ten hours.
exampleZh: 如果你去接电话的话，我就可以免于一段又臭又长的谈话的痛苦了。

meaning: vt. 说，讲；宣称，说明；认为，据说；发音，读；确信，确定（事实）；（对某人）意味着；表达，传达；指明，表明；假设，比如说；让某人做（某事）；复述，诵念；念，背诵；替（某人或某事）说好话（坏话）；n. 发言权，决定权；int. （吃惊或吸引注意力）哎呀，喂；【名】 （Say）（土）萨伊，（法、老、柬）赛，（英）塞伊，（匈、罗）绍伊（人名）
definition: 1. n. the chance to speak；2. v. express in words
example: What I would say about this one, cause it's most complicated, I would say, in the history of humanity.
exampleZh: 我会说，因为,是非常复杂的，我会说，是整个人类史上最复杂的。

meaning: n. 谚语，格言，警句；（尤指宗教或政治领袖的）重要讲话，教诲；v. 说，讲；宣称，说明；认为，据说（say 的现在分词）
definition: 1. n. a word or phrase that particular people use in particular situations
example: By the way, in what I'm saying, I oversimplify by supposing that the basic unit of language is a word.
exampleZh: 因为我想说的是，我们现在是把语言的基本单位简单化了。

meaning: n. 规模，范围；等级，级别；刻度，标度；秤；比例，比例尺；音阶；鳞，鳞片；水垢；牙垢；天平盘；天秤（星）座（the Scales）；（加热后金属上形成的）氧化皮；（数）进位制；（摄）影调范围；v. 攀登，翻越；刮鳞；剔除（牙垢）；（按比例）缩小（或放大）；（尤指皮肤）生成鳞屑；（成片状）脱落，剥落；称得重量为；（数量，财产） 按一定比例调节；估算（树木的）产木材量；adj. （模型或复制品）按比例缩小的；【名】 (Scale)（意）斯卡莱（人名）
definition: 1. n. an ordered reference standard；2. v. measure by or as if by a scale
example: Because I think our education system, pre-college is generally not great in sort of the world scale.
exampleZh: 因为我觉得我们的教育系统，大学之前的教育在世界范围内并不是最好的。

meaning: vt. 细看，审视；粗略看，浏览；扫描检查（物体或身体部位等）；（机器或计算机程序）扫描，察看；将（文件、照片等）扫描进计算机；（用声呐或雷达）扫描，扫掠；（诗）符合格律，韵节合拍；用（光束）扫描；电视扫描；n. 快速查阅，浏览；（医疗）扫描检查；扫描图；胎儿扫描检查
definition: 1. n. the act of scanning; systematic examination of a prescribed region；2. v. examine minutely or intensely
example: How do I scan a photo and attach it to an email?
exampleZh: 怎样把照片扫描并放到电子邮件的附件呢？

meaning: n. 扫描器，扫描设备；（信息或图像）扫描仪；（医用）扫描器；信号扫掠天线；（声呐或雷达）扫描器
definition: 1. n. someone who scans verse to determine the number and prosodic value of the syllables；2. n. an electronic device that generates a digital representation of an image for data input to a computer
example: You need multiple lines of code, you need these days to use something called a scanner class.
exampleZh: 你需要写许多代码,你要学会使用扫描仪。

meaning: n. 丑行，丑闻；流言蜚语，谣言；（由丑闻引起的）反感，公愤；令人震惊（或反感）的事情
definition: 1. n. disgraceful gossip about the private lives of other people；2. n. a disgraceful event
example: Redleaf was able to figure out who was going to get hit for the backdating scandal before other people did and then that was an advantage.
exampleZh: 莱德利夫可以在其他人之前,找出谁将在这个倒签丑闻中被调查,他抢先一步发现问题,这是他的优势

meaning: adj. 令人愤慨的，可耻的；丑闻的
definition: 1. adj. giving offense to moral sensibilities and injurious to reputation
example: The scandalous, seditious and libelous books that need to be brought to justice in this remarkable sentence are suddenly revealed to have a soul.
exampleZh: 有诽谤性的煽动性的中伤性的需要被审判的书,在这句话里突然被透露出是有灵魂的。

meaning: n. 伤疤，疤痕；（精神上的）创伤；损伤痕迹，污点；（植物的）叶柄疤；（尤指石灰岩的）峭壁，露出地表的岩层；v. 结疤，留下伤疤；给……留下精神创伤；损害……的外观，破坏……的景致
definition: 1. n. a mark left (usually on the skin) by the healing of injured tissue；2. v. mark with a scar
example: Eventually you develop a scab, as it healed, and then it would--and then the scab would fall off, and you'd be left with a scar.
exampleZh: 愈合之后会变成一个疤,这个疤后来会脱落,你身上会留下疤痕

meaning: adj. 缺乏的，不足的；稀有的，少见的；故意缺席的；adv. 几乎不
definition: 1. adj. not enough; hard to find；2. adv. by a small margin
example: Well, I ran the risk and even now, it's what people look scarce I don't care.
exampleZh: 我冒了那个险,知道现在，研究这些的人还是少之又少,我并不在乎别人的看法。

meaning: n. 不足，缺乏
definition: 1. n. a small and inadequate amount
example: This scarcity is inevitable in less developed countries.
exampleZh: 在欠发达国家这种匮乏是不可避免的。

meaning: adv. 勉强，几乎不；刚……（就……），才；决不，一定不
definition: 1. adv. by a small margin；2. adv. almost not
example: It can scarcely be coincidence.
exampleZh: 这决不可能是巧合。

meaning: v. 使惊恐，吓唬；害怕，恐惧；n. 惊恐，惊吓；（社会上的）大恐慌
definition: 1. n. sudden mass fear and anxiety over anticipated events；2. v. cause fear in
example: But Marcion seems to have really put the scare of bejesus into the Roman church.
exampleZh: 但马吉安似乎真的吓坏了,罗马教会。

meaning: adj. 骇人的，恐怖的；异乎寻常的，令人惊奇的；胆小的，易受惊吓的
definition: 1. adj. so scary as to cause chills and shudders
example: So if what I'm going to do now is scary, come and see us and we'll deal with it.
exampleZh: 如果我接下来的计算对你来说是天书,过来找我吧,我来帮你想办法

meaning: v. 撒，播撒；（使）散开，（使）散布在各处；（物理）散射（电磁辐射或粒子）；（棒球）（被击中但没有得分的）有效投（球）；n. 零星散布的东西；（统计）（对某一变量作反复测量或观察所得数值的）离差；（物理）（光、其他电磁波或粒子的）散射
definition: 1. n. a haphazard distribution in all directions；2. v. to cause to separate and go in different directions
example: The concept of regression goes back to the mathematician Gauss, who talked about fitting a line through a scatter of points.
exampleZh: 回归这个概念要追溯到数学家高斯,讨论的是从若干散点中切合出一条直线

meaning: n. 设想，可能发生的情况 ；（电影、戏剧等的）剧情梗概；（艺术或文学作品中的）场景
definition: 1. a description of possible actions or events in the future；2. a written plan of the characters and events in a play or film
example: The worst-case scenario is an aircraft will crash if a bird destroys an engine.
exampleZh: 如果小鸟毁坏了一部发动机，最坏的情形是飞机坠毁。

meaning: n. 事发地，现场；事件，场面；（戏剧、书、电影等的）片段，情节；（戏剧的）一场；（戏剧）布景；活动领域，圈子；（某地方或图画中的）景色，景象；（当众）发脾气，吵闹；同性恋者常去的社交场所
definition: 1. n. the place where some action occurs；2. n. an incident (real or imaginary)
example: Especially San Francisco, it's very open to the art scene and different cultures and different beliefs.
exampleZh: 特别是在旧金山，艺术氛围浓厚，充斥着各种文化和信仰。

meaning: n. 风景，景色；舞台布景
definition: 1. n. the painted structures of a stage set that are intended to suggest a particular locale；2. n. the appearance of a place
example: He is ponderously capricious. Many of his casual opinions on the people and scenery of this country are ludicrous.
exampleZh: 他十分反复无常，他对这个国家的人和,风景的看法十分滑稽。

meaning: adj. 风景优美的；观光的；舞台布景的；（画）描绘事件的
definition: 1. adj. used of locations; having beautiful natural scenery；2. adj. of or relating to the stage or stage scenery
example: It's a nice campus in that, you know, it's just really scenic in a lot of parts, but
exampleZh: 我们的校园很美，许多地方都风景优美，但是，

meaning: n. 香味，芳香；（动物或人的）气味，臭迹；香水；察觉，预示；线索，踪迹；嗅觉；v. 使……带有某种香味；（动物）嗅出，闻到；预感，觉察；【名】 （Scent）（英）森特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a distinctive odor that is pleasant；2. v. cause to smell or be smelly
example: The scent of climbing roses wafts through the window.
exampleZh: 蔷薇的香味随风从窗户飘进来。

meaning: n. 计划（表），进度表；（公共汽车、火车等的）时间表；（价目、费用等的）清单，一览表；（电视或电台的）节目表；（学校的）课程表； 附件（尤指表格、单据等）；（英国所得税制的）报税单；v. 安排，预定；列入，收进（正式目录、清单等中）； 把（建筑物）列为文物保护单位
definition: 1. n. a temporally organized plan for matters to be attended to；2. v. plan for an activity or event
example: it's very hard for the professors to schedule a lot of individual time for the people who can't make it.
exampleZh: 教授很难为那些没法按时考试的考生另外安排时间。

meaning: n. （政府或其他组织的）计划，方案；（用于组织或整理信息的）系统，体系；组合，布局；阴谋，诡计；社会住宅区；v. 密谋，策划；认为，猜想；按色调布置；【名】 （Scheme）（瑞典）谢默（人名）
definition: 1. n. an elaborate and systematic plan of action；2. v. form intrigues (for) in an underhand manner
