exampleZh: 这种体系里的英文诗每行都有重读,然后将他们按一定模式排列。

meaning: n. 学者；有学问的人；奖学金获得者；聪颖勤奋的学生
definition: 1. n. a learned person (especially in the humanities); someone who by long study has gained mastery in one or more disciplines；2. n. someone (especially a child) who learns (as from a teacher) or takes up knowledge or beliefs
example: Now, in writing in these genres, Milton is, of course, confronted with a dilemma. He's a humanist scholar.
exampleZh: 当然，弥尔顿用这种风格来写，就会面临一种窘境，他是一位人文主义学者。

meaning: adj. 学术的，学术性的；博学的，勤奋好学的
definition: 1. adj. characteristic of scholars or scholarship
example: His revolutionary work in linguistics has aroused intense scholarly interest.
exampleZh: 他在语言学方面的革命性著作引起了强烈的学术兴趣。

meaning: n. 奖学金；学问，学术
definition: 1. n. financial aid provided to a student on the basis of academic merit；2. n. profound scholarly knowledge
example: He got a scholarship to the Pratt Institute of Art.
exampleZh: 他得到了一笔普拉特艺术学院的奖学金。

meaning: adj. （成就或能力）学业的，学术的；（与）中学（有关）的；（有关）中世纪经院哲学的；学究气的，烦琐的；n. 经院哲学家，学究；（罗马天主教，尤指耶稣会的）待授神职者；（尤指神学院的）学生，学者
definition: 1. n. a person who pays more attention to formal rules and book learning than they merit；2. adj. of or relating to schools
example: Some of these gifted people may have done poorly in school because their, gifts were not scholastic.
exampleZh: 有些有天赋的人可能在学校表现不佳，因为他们的天赋不是学术的。

meaning: n. （中、小）学校；全校师生；上学时间；上学期间；专科学校；大学，大学期间；（大学的）系，学院；学派，流派；（鱼、鲸、海豚等的）群；（牛津大学的）期末考试大厅；（牛津大学的）期末考试；一伙赌徒；（轮番到酒吧请客喝酒的）酒友；v. 教育，培养（儿童）；训练，教育；（尤指为竞赛）驯马；（鱼，海兽）成群；强迫自己（做难事）；adj. （科萨人）受过西化教育的；（名字）源自西方的
definition: 1. n. an educational institution；2. v. educate in or as if in a school
example: So, his letters come out of this western land, New Mexico, and a land of criminality, the reform school.
exampleZh: 他的信从新墨西哥这片西部的土地而来，还是寄宿学校这种犯罪滋生地。

meaning: n. 学校教育；学费；（马术）训练马在平地比赛（或跨越障碍）；v. 教育，培养；训练，使学会（school 的现在分词形式）；【名】 （Schooling）（英）斯库林（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of teaching at school；2. n. the process of being formally educated at a school
example: His formal schooling continued erratically until he reached the age of eleven.
exampleZh: 他的正式学校教育断断续续地持续到了他11岁时。

meaning: n. 科学，科学知识；专门科学；（大学学习的）学科；理科；技术，技巧；【名】 （Science）（英）赛恩斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a particular branch of scientific knowledge；2. n. ability to produce solutions in some problem domain
example: If I understand it correctly, science as science insofar as its belike scientific methodology, he needs to be defended.
exampleZh: 如果我没有弄错的话，就论文所用的科学方法本身而言,就论文所用的科学方法本身而言，作者的立场应该受到维护。

meaning: adj. 科学的，与科学有关的；细致严谨的，使用科学方法的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to the practice of science；2. adj. conforming with the principles or methods used in science
example: If I understand it correctly, science as science insofar as its belike scientific methodology, he needs to be defended.
exampleZh: 如果我没有弄错的话，就论文所用的科学方法本身而言,就论文所用的科学方法本身而言，作者的立场应该受到维护。

meaning: n. 科学家
definition: 1. n. a person with advanced knowledge of one or more sciences
example: There they are. And, when they are named, they are named by suggestion by the scientist who have isolated them.
exampleZh: 它们在这，当它们被起名的时候，是由科学家们建议的,那些提取它们的科学家。

meaning: n. 剪刀；（英橄）交叉配合，交叉移动；（跳高）剪式跳法；v. 用剪刀剪；使（腿）作剪式运动（scissor 的第三人称单数形式）
definition: 1. n. and edge tool having two crossed pivoting blades；2. n. a wrestling hold in which you wrap your legs around the opponents body or head and put your feet together and squeeze
example: As long as it was not abrupt, right? I may take my scissors, and cut out a foot in the middle.
exampleZh: 这个过程并不是突然的，对吗？，我拿出一把剪刀，这时减掉中间的一英尺。

meaning: v. 责骂，训斥；n. 爱训斥人的人
definition: 1. to speak angrily to someone because they have done something wrong
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: If he finds out, he'll scold me.
exampleZh: 如果他发现了，他会责骂我。

meaning: n. 范围，领域；（发挥能力的）机会，施展余地；视野，眼界；观测仪器（如望远镜、显微镜等）；（船抛锚时的）缆绳长度；特定论点的数量；v. 评估，调查（scope sth. out）；确定（规划项目）的范围；仔细看，彻底检查
definition: 1. n. an area in which something acts or operates or has power or control:；2. n. the state of the environment in which a situation exists

exampleZh: 我们大多数研究是在高等教育范围，偶尔也会有几个项目,是特例。

meaning: n. （游戏或比赛中的）得分，比分；（测验的）评分，分数；实情，真相（the score）；毒品到手；犯罪所得；二十，约二十个（复数 score）；很多，大量（scores）；（一首乐曲的）总谱；（电影或戏剧的）配乐；刻痕，划痕；宿怨；（尤指酒馆中有对应顾客名字刻痕的）往来账户；v. （在运动、比赛或考试中）得（分）；评分，打分数；（在游戏或比赛中）记分；（棒球）使（队友）得分；（使）成功，赢得； （尤指在辩论等活动中机灵地）驳倒，挫败（score off）；购买，弄到（毒品）；得到（某事物）；（通常指与新认识的人）发生性关系；为……写总谱，为……配乐；（在表面上）刻痕，画线；画掉，删去（score sth. out/through）；检测（实验细胞、菌落等），并记录有某种特征的数量；【名】 （Score）（英）斯科尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a number or letter indicating quality (especially of a student's performance)；2. v. gain points in a game
example: I guess you got a higher score, as you are a Brown student. How did you prepare for the test?
exampleZh: 能被布朗大学录取，我猜你的分数一定很高。你是如何准备考试的呢？

meaning: n. 蔑视，轻视；嗤之以鼻的态度； 被鄙视的人；v. 鄙视，嘲笑；拒绝，不屑于做；批评，抨击
definition: 1. a very strong feeling of no respect for someone or something that you think is stupid or has no value；2. to show scorn for someone or something
example: The head of the navy heaped scorn on both the methods and motives of the conspirators.
exampleZh: 这位海军首领对密谋分子的做法和动机都给予了极大的蔑视。

meaning: adj. 轻蔑的，鄙视的
definition: 1. showing or feeling scorn for someone or something
example: Heidi did not take this for a summons, for the maid's face was scornful and forbidding.
exampleZh: 海蒂并不认为这是一种召唤，因为女仆的脸带着轻蔑，令人生畏。

meaning: n. 侦察兵，侦察机；侦查（尤指勘察地区）；童子军（the Scouts）；（英国大学里清扫学生房间的）校工；（演员、运动员等的）人才发掘者，星探；侦查蜂；童子军队员；v. （在某个地区）寻找，搜寻；物色（尤指体育或娱乐）人才； 轻蔑地拒绝（建议，想法）；探查，侦查；跟踪，监视
definition: 1. n. a person employed to watch for something to happen；2. v. explore, often with the goal of finding something or somebody
example: We went ahead to scout out the lie of the land.
exampleZh: 我们先走一步，去侦察地形。

meaning: v. （迅速而吃力地）爬，攀登；不规则地生长；匆忙地移动；仓促完成（困难的事）；匆忙穿（衣）（scramble into）；争夺，抢夺；变换……的无线电信号，倒换……的频率；扰乱（思维）；炒蛋；命令（飞机）紧急起飞，紧急起飞；（四分卫）持球跑进；打乱；n. 攀爬，爬行；（互相推撞的）争夺，争抢；（因赶任务出现的）忙乱，乱作一团； 摩托车越野赛；（四分卫的）持球跑进；战斗机紧急起飞
definition: 1. to move or climb quickly but with difficulty, often using your hands to help you；2. to compete with other people for something there is very little of
example: She managed to scramble out of the vehicle as it burst into flames.
exampleZh: 她设法从突然起火的车里爬了出来。

meaning: n. （纸、布等的）碎片，小块；丝毫，一丁点；废品，废弃材料（=scrap metal）；吃剩的东西，残羹剩饭（scraps）；小摩擦，小口角；极瘦小的人（常指小孩）；v. （因不切实际而）放弃，抛弃（计划、体系）；把（旧机器、旧汽车等当）作废料处理，报废；打架，吵架；激烈竞争；adj. （金属、纸张）废弃的，报废的；零碎的
definition: 1. to not continue with a system or plan；2. to get rid of something that is no longer useful or wanted, often using its parts in new ways
example: If you have a piece of scrap paper with you, suppose that you've started your program as follows.
exampleZh: 如果你有一张废弃的纸张，假如你已经开始了以下的问题。

meaning: v. （用小刀等）刮除；（使）刮擦；擦伤，刮坏；（使）发出刺耳的刮擦声；勉强维持，艰难地完成；勉强维持生活（scrape by/along）；勉强通过；（艰难地）凑集，积累（scrape sth. together/up）；节俭；挖坑，挖洞； 把头发拢在后面（scrape sth. back）；（幽默）不入调地演奏小提琴；在面包上涂一层薄薄的（黄油，人造黄油）；用程序从网上下载（数据）；n. 擦伤，擦痕；刮擦，刮擦声；困境，窘境；地面空洞处，（尤指鸟求爱、筑巢时）在地面挖的洞；涂在面包上的一层黄油（或麦琪淋）；（医）刮宫
definition: 1. to remove an unwanted covering or a top layer from something, especially using a sharp edge or something rough；2. to (cause to) rub against a surface so that slight damage or an unpleasant noise is produced
example: I might scrape through the exam if I'm lucky.
exampleZh: 要是走运的话，我也许能勉强及格。

meaning: v. （用指甲）挠，轻抓；（用指甲或利器）抓破，划破；划出，刮出（痕迹）；（用爪子）抓，刨；（鸟、哺乳动物，尤指鸡）用嘴（或爪子）扒地找食物；寻觅（难找的人或物）（scratch for）；艰难生活（scratch along）；勾掉，划去（写下的字）； 仓促写下；（用尖利物）刮擦出声音； 取消，撤销（想法或计划）；（使）退出比赛；（用刮擦技法）播放唱片；n. （某人皮肤上的）划痕，划伤；刮痕，划痕；抓，挠；刮擦声 ；唱片的嚓嚓声（指唱片纹道与唱针的摩擦噪声）；刮擦（多用于快板乐中，用手制止唱片转动，使其来回移动发出有节奏的嚓嚓声的技巧）；（高尔夫）零让步（表明选手不弱，能在场上达到规定击球的次数）； 钱；adj. （球队或一群人等）仓促拼凑的，匆匆组成的；（高尔夫球员）无让杆的，无让步优待的；碰巧的；打草稿用的
definition: 1. n. an abraded area where the skin is torn or worn off；2. v. cause friction
example: But you'll see that once you get to final projects frankly, you're not gonna want to implement everything from scratch.
exampleZh: 但是一旦你得出了最终方案，你就不会愿意利用框架去,实现任何功能了。

meaning: v. （因伤痛、害怕、激动等）尖叫；（向某人或为某事）高声喊，大声叫；发出尖锐的响声；呼啸而过；（使）醒目，（使）触目惊心（=scream out）；呼吁，抗议；清晰地表明；颜色不相配；n. （因疼痛、惊恐、兴奋等发出的）尖叫声；（动物的）高声尖叫；尖锐刺耳的声音；极其滑稽可笑的人（或事物、场面）
definition: 1. n. sharp piercing cry；2. v. utter a sudden loud cry
example: Exhaustion would make me drift toward sleep and then I would scream until I was wide awake again.
exampleZh: 体力不济之后，我会入睡,下次又是尖叫着惊起。

meaning: n. 屏幕，荧光屏；银幕；电影（总称）；屏风，隔板；掩蔽物，屏障；纱窗，纱门；（医疗）化验，检查；（机动车的）挡风玻璃；（篮球、冰球等运动的）掩护；掩护部队，护航舰队；大筛子，滤网；（纱门或纱窗的）金属丝，塑料线；（印刷）网屏，网版；屏蔽器；v. 隐藏，遮蔽；庇护，包庇；检查，筛查；审查，甄别；筛选，检查排除；防止（或免受）电磁干扰；放映（影片），播放（电视节目）；分析，评估；加网印刷；【名】 （Screen）斯克林（人名）
definition: 1. n. a white or silvered surface where pictures can be projected for viewing；2. v. test or examine for the presence of disease or infection
example: So allow me to put this up on the screen now, which you're now qualified to understand.
exampleZh: 所以请允许我把这个放到屏幕上，现在你们可以理解了。

meaning: n. 螺丝（钉）；螺杆，螺丝杆；螺旋桨；螺旋体，螺旋状物；螺旋运动，拧紧螺旋；监狱看守人，狱警（尤为囚犯用语）；性行为，性伴侣；旋转球，倒旋；（多指包有盐或烟草的）小纸卷；工资，工钱；卑鄙的人，吝啬鬼；疲马；拇指夹（旧时的一种刑具）（the screws）；v. 用螺丝固定；拧紧，旋紧；（物体）旋上，旋开；把（纸等）揉成一团；扭曲（脸），眯起（眼睛）；（和某人）性交；欺骗，诈骗；敲诈，勒索（钱财等）；毁掉，搞砸；见鬼去；使（球）旋转，使（击球）偏转；打旋转球；猛回头，急转身（screw sth. around/round）
definition: 1. n. someone who guards prisoners；2. v. have sexual intercourse with
example: I'm going to look desperately at my T.A.'s to make sure I didn't screw that up.
exampleZh: 我得问问助教们,检查一下我是否算错了

meaning: n. 剧本，讲稿；笔迹，手写体；连写体，草体；字体；（一种语言的）字母系统，字母表；（考生的）笔试答卷； 脚本（程序）（计算机的一系列指令）；（医生的）处方；期待，计划；v. 写剧本，写讲稿；事先准备，计划
definition: 1. n. a written version of a play or other dramatic composition; used in preparing for a performance；2. v. write a script for
example: So, inside of code, or inside of a script, there's no print, unless we make it explicit.
exampleZh: 因此，在代码里面，或者在脚本里面，不会有显示结果的功能，除非我们让它这么做。

meaning: n. 《圣经》（Scripture或the Scriptures）；（某一宗教的）经文，圣典；《圣经》研究；手稿；【名】 （Scripture）（英）斯克里普丘（人名）
definition: 1. n. the sacred writings of the Christian religions；2. n. any writing that is regarded as sacred by a religious group
example: When we study this text in this class, we're not going to be studying it necessarily as scripture.
exampleZh: 当我们这节课研究这个文本时，我们不必把它当做经文来研究。

meaning: v. （尤指用硬刷子）擦洗，擦净；（医生在做手术前）仔细擦洗手和手臂（scrub up）；取消（计划等）；用水净化（汽油，蒸汽）；（骑手用手臂与腿紧迫地摩擦马的颈部和两侧）催马（快行）；（赛车）（司机）让轮胎滑行（或划擦路面）以减速；n. 矮树丛，灌木丛；灌木丛地带；刷洗，擦洗；磨砂膏；医院工作服（scrubs）；无足轻重的人，可鄙的人；二流球队（或队员）；（在公共场所举行的）儿童非正式团体比赛；adj. （植物）矮小的；（动物）劣等的，发育不良的
definition: 1. to rub something hard in order to clean it, especially using a stiff brush, soap, and water；2. to decide not to do something you had planned to do
example: I'm going to completely scrub clean your brain so that you won't remember that you're Shelly Kagan.
exampleZh: 我会把你的脑子刮得一干二净,这样你就不会记得你是Shelly，Kagan了。

meaning: n. 仔细观察，详细审查
definition: 1. the careful and detailed examination of something in order to get information about it；2. the careful and detailed examination of something
example: Like the moon, Satan may look beautiful, but upon a closer scrutiny that beauty begins to yield certain metaphysical flaws.
exampleZh: 像月亮那样，撒旦看起来非常美好，但是近看,就会发现这份美丽开始显露出一些抽象的瑕疵。

meaning: v. 仔细查看，细致审查
definition: 1. to examine something very carefully in order to discover information；2. to examine someone or something very carefully
example: All campaigns scrutinize public records showing who is registered to vote and whether they have voted in past elections.
exampleZh: 所有的竞选人员都要仔细查阅公众档案，看都有谁注册了要投票以及他们是否在过去的选举中投过票。

meaning: n. 雕像，雕塑作品；雕刻艺术，雕塑艺术；（动，植）（贝壳、花粉粒、角质层或其他生物体表面凸起或凹陷的）雕饰，雕纹；v. 雕刻，雕塑；从事雕刻
definition: 1. the art of forming solid objects that represent a thing, person, idea, etc. out of a material such as wood, clay, metal, or stone, or an object made in this way；2. the art of creating objects out of material such as wood, clay, metal, or stone, or a work of art of this type
example: Well, instead of finding that ideal woman, I will create a sculpture"-- as he was a sculptor, " "I will create a sculpture in her image."
exampleZh: 我不再寻找理想中的女人，我要雕刻一座雕像“因为他是雕刻家，“我会以她的形像雕刻一座雕像“

meaning: n. 海洋；内海；海（指月球或火星表面的一片广阔平原）；海面情况，海浪状况；大量，茫茫一片；（用于海名）海（Sea）；巨浪（seas）
definition: 1. n. a division of an ocean or a large body of salt water partially enclosed by land；2. adj. relating to or characteristic of or occurring on the sea or ships
example: He conjures the indecorous image of the dead Lycidas under the whelming tide visiting the bottom of the monstrous sea.
exampleZh: 他想象死去的利西达斯,在排山倒海的浪潮覆盖下拜访尽是妖怪的海底。

meaning: n. 印章，图章；表示确认的事物；密封装置，密封物；密封，密封状态；水止，水封（根据排污管道深度U形管中防止臭气上升的存水）；封蜡，火漆；封蜡模（印），封铅模（印）；海豹；海豹皮；装饰性的背面涂胶水的邮票（印花）；（美国海军）海豹特种部队士兵（SEAL）；v. 封上（信封）；密封（容器）；确定，使成定局；给……涂上保护层；（给文件）加封，盖印；封锁；（为避免烹调时失去过多水分，将食物放在热油中）快速煎炸；猎捕海豹；【名】 （Seal）西尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. fastener consisting of a resinous composition that is plastic when warm; used for sealing documents and parcels and letters；2. v. close with or as if with a seal
example: We control how we use time, we control the temperature in the environment, and hermetically seal ourselves in things.
exampleZh: 我们控制时间的利用，我们控制周边环境的温度,我们把自己封闭在各种事务中，与世隔绝。

meaning: v. 搜查，搜寻；搜查（地方，车辆），搜……的身；思索，细想（问题答案等）；细察，细查；（用计算机）搜索，检索；n. 搜寻，搜查；探索，寻求；（计算机的）搜索，检索；调查地产负担；【名】 （Search）（印、美）瑟奇（人名）
definition: 1. n. the activity of looking thoroughly in order to find something or someone；2. v. try to locate or discover, or try to establish the existence of
example: You'll remember that in his search for immortality Utnapishtim Gilgamesh sought out Utnapishtim, the one human who had been granted immortality.
exampleZh: 他对永生的追求,吉尔伽美什找到，唯一可以长生不老的人类。

meaning: n. 季节；（某种特殊气候的）季；（某种活动或事件发生的）时期；体育赛季；（水果、蔬菜等的）当令期，上市期；度假旺季，法定假期；（一年中时装、发型等的）流行期；（一系列新的电视剧、戏剧等的）播出期，上映期；发情期；（英国上流社会的）社交活动时节（the season）；适当的时机；某时，一段时间；v. 加调料，给……调味；给……增添趣味；使（木材）风干，晒干（木材）；变干燥
definition: 1. n. a period of the year marked by special events or activities in some field；2. v. lend flavor to
example: He's been waiting and waiting for his season due so that he can ripen into a powerful Orphic poet.
exampleZh: 他一直在等待着自己繁茂的年华,那时候他将成长为强大的俄耳甫斯式的诗人。

meaning: adj. 季节性的，随季节变化的；节令性的，适应节日需要的
definition: 1. n. a worker who finds employment only in certain seasons；2. adj. occurring at or dependent on a particular season
example: Most seasonal hiring is done in early October.
exampleZh: 多数季节性招聘是在10月初进行。

meaning: n. 座位；（椅子等的）座部；（机器的）基座；（议会、委员会、法庭等的）席位，职位； 议会议员选区；（组织或重大活动的）所在地；（大户人家在乡间的）别墅，宅邸；（裙子或裤子的）臀部，后裆；屁股；（骑马的）骑姿；v. 使坐下，使就座；容纳，坐得下；使就职；固定，安装
definition: 1. n. a space reserved for sitting (as in a theater or on a train or airplane)；2. v. show to a seat; assign a seat for
example: She's stuck between competing ideals of bodily purity just as surely and as firmly as she is stuck to her seat.
exampleZh: 她陷入贞洁理念的矛盾迷潭之中,与陷入陷入椅子一样确定而坚定。

meaning: num. 第二（的），第二个（的）；（重要性、规模、质量等）居第二位的；另外的，外加的；n. 秒（时间单位）；片刻，瞬间；秒（角度单位）；次品，二等货；第二次上菜，添菜（seconds）；（车辆的）第二挡；（英国大学本科的）二等成绩学位；（学校或大学的）二年级；（棒球的）二垒；正式支持，附议；（体育俱乐部的）预备队（the seconds）；粗面粉，粗粉面包；（尤指拳击比赛或旧时决斗中的）助手；（乐）二度音程；v. 支持，附议；临时调派，短期调任；adv. 以第二位；第二，其次；【名】 (Second) （美）塞孔（人名）
definition: 1. n. 1/60 of a minute; the basic unit of time adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites；2. v. give support or one's approval to
example: What did we lose in our understanding of it as a literary object when the second half was not published?
exampleZh: 将它置于文学作品之列来理解时,我们失去了什么？,书的后半部分没出版时？

meaning: adj. （教育）中等的，中学的；次要的， 第二位的；（疾病、感染）继发性的，第二期的；间接的；（化学反应）副的；（有机化合物）二代的；（主要指胺）仲的；（电）次级的；（地质）中生代的（Secondary）；n. 副手，下属；第二防线；中学（secondary school 的简称）；（鸟）次级飞羽（secondary feather 的简称）；（变压器中的）次级线圈；（地质）中生代（the Secondary）
definition: 1. n. the defensive football players who line up behind the linemen；2. adj. being of second rank or importance or value; not direct or immediate
example: Examinations are taken after about five years of secondary education.
exampleZh: 经过约五年的中等教育后参加考试。

meaning: adj. 旧的，二手的；间接的，第二手的；adv. 间接地，第二手地；以二手方式（购得）
definition: 1. n. an intermediate person; used in the phrase `at second hand'；2. adj. derived from what is primary or original; not firsthand
example: Do you know anywhere I can buy a second-hand computer?
exampleZh: 你知道我在哪儿可以买到二手计算机吗？

meaning: adj. 秘密的，保密的；（感情、担心、行动）不公开的，暗自的；（某人的行为）诡秘的，神秘的；善于掩饰自己的，严守秘密的；n. 秘密，内情；神秘，奥秘；秘诀，诀窍；（罗马天主教弥撒捐献仪式后牧师的）默祷；【名】 （Secret）（法）塞克雷（人名）
definition: 1. n. something that should remain hidden from others (especially information that is not to be passed on)；2. adj. not open or public; kept private or not revealed
example: I guess, like, there're certain things like in the meetings that are secret, like the ritual or whatever,
exampleZh: 我想有一些事情是秘密的，例如会议程序什么的，

meaning: n. 秘密，保密
definition: 1. n. the trait of keeping things secret；2. n. the condition of being concealed or hidden
example: They were all pledged to secrecy.
exampleZh: 他们都宣誓保密。

meaning: adj. （人，组织）保密的，守口如瓶的；（状态，活动）隐瞒的，秘密的；（人的表情，举止）难解的，诡秘的
definition: 1. adj. inclined to secrecy or reticence about divulging information
example: Billionaires are usually fairly secretive about the exact amount that they're worth.
exampleZh: 亿万富翁们通常对有关他们身价的确切数字讳莫如深。

meaning: n. 秘书；书记员，干事；部长，大臣；（英国大使、大臣的）助理
definition: 1. n. a person who is head of an administrative department of government；2. n. an assistant who handles correspondence and clerical work for a boss or an organization
example: Notably, on Monday, the Treasury Department, under Secretary Henry Paulson, announced a proposal for fundamental change in our financial markets.
exampleZh: 众所周知，在星期一，美国财务部部长，亨利·鲍尔森，宣布美国金融市场,将要改革的计划。

meaning: adj. 秘书的，有关秘书工作的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to a secretary or to a secretary's work
example: Computers increasingly aid mid and upper level managers who prepare their own memorandums without secretarial help.
exampleZh: 电脑越来越多地帮助中层和高层管理人员，让他们在没有秘书帮助的情况下准备他们自己的备忘录。

meaning: n. 部分；散件，部件；（书、报等的）节，栏；一部分人；（乐队的）组；断面图，剖面图；（手术中的）开刀，切开；（供显微镜下观察的）切片；（柑橘类水果的）一瓣；（法律文件的）款，项；地段，区域；部门，科； 建房用地；（生物）组（尤指亚属）； 一平方英里的土地；v. 强制（精神病人）入院；将……制成切片；切开，切断；分开，给……分区
definition: 1. n. a self-contained part of a larger composition (written or musical)；2. v. divide into segments
example: where for a regular seat you will be paying 70, 80, just for, you know, like a nose bleed section.
exampleZh: 但通常情况下，买一个很远的座位就得花上70或80美元。

meaning: n. 区域，部分；（尤指商业、贸易等的）部门，行业；小群体；（尤指军队控制的）分区，防区；（磁盘上的）扇区； 扇形，扇形面；函数尺，象限仪；v. 把……分成扇形
definition: 1. n. a plane figure bounded by two radii and the included arc of a circle；2. n. a body of people who form part of society or economy
example: And believe me, make sure that your government does not cut your public sector in a downturn.
exampleZh: 相信我，千万不要让政府在萧条期削减你们的公共交通。

meaning: adj. 非宗教的，世俗的；现实世界的；（教士）教区的，在俗的；政府的而非教会的，民事的；（天文）缓慢的，长期的；（经济）（波动，趋势）长期性的；（尤指古罗马的庆祝活动）每世纪一次的，约百年一次的；n. 在俗牧师；平信徒，普通信徒
definition: 1. not having any connection with religion
example: Cardinal Daly has said that churches should not be used for profane or secular purposes.
exampleZh: 戴利主教说过，教堂不应该用于非宗教或世俗的目的。

meaning: adj. 稳固的，可靠的；严密把守的，牢固的；安全的，稳妥的；（对自己和自己的能力）有自信的；感到有保障的，没有顾虑的；固定住的，系牢的；秘密的；v. （尤指经过努力而）获得，得到；使安全，保护；缚牢，将（某物）固定；确保，保证；为（债务或贷款）作抵押，作保；（外科）压迫（血管）止血；停止工作；船抛锚
definition: 1. v. get by special effort；2. adj. free from fear or doubt; easy in mind
example: He is appointed or authorized to secure for the people the, in many ways, limited ends of peace and security.
exampleZh: 他是由人民任命并授权,让他行使权力保卫人民的安全，保卫来之不易的和平。

meaning: n. 保护措施，安全工作；保安部门；安检处；保障，保证；安全，安全感；抵押品，保证金；证券，债券
definition: 1. n. the state of being free from danger or injury；2. n. a formal declaration that documents a fact of relevance to finance and investment; the holder has a right to receive interest or dividends
example: So, we have this security and a ten-year bond would have twenty coupons attached, each with a date on them.
exampleZh: 我们持有这样的证券，是十年期的债券,并附有二十张息票，每一个都有日期在上面。

meaning: v. 诱奸，勾引；引诱，吸引
definition: 1. to make someone feel attracted to you and want to have sex with you, often someone younger or less experienced；2. to persuade or cause someone to do something that they would not usually consider doing by being very attractive and difficult to refuse
example: Comus attempts to seduce the Lady, you'll remember, with something like an economic theory of natural beauty.
exampleZh: 你们还记得吧，科玛斯试图色诱那位女士，用一套有利可图的自然美的理论。

meaning: n. 诱奸，勾引；诱惑力，吸引力
definition: 1. the attractive quality of something；2. the act of persuading someone to have sex with you
example: Unlike fashion's embrace of playful dissimulation and seduction, this beauty practice instead insists on correcting precisely measured flaws.
exampleZh: 不像时尚界拥抱好玩的伪装和诱惑，这种美容实践反而坚持纠正精确测量的缺陷。

meaning: adj. 有魅力的，性感的；有吸引力的，令人神往的
definition: 1. intended to seduce someone；2. making you want to do, have, or believe something, because of seeming attractive
example: So that music, the sort of seductive feel that was in this video is how humans feel about fat.
exampleZh: 视频音乐传达出的那种诱惑感,很像人类对脂肪的感觉

meaning: v. 看见，看到；有视力，看得见；看（电影或电视节目）；注意到，看出；了解，发现；设想，预测；考虑，定夺；理解，认识到；参阅，参见；阅读；认为，看待；看望，探访；遇见，碰见；会见，会晤；交往；确保，查明；经历，遭受； （地点或时间）目睹，见证；帮助（或支持）……度过；送，护送；与（对方）下同样赌注；看（用于口语，引导注意力）；看上（see sth. in）；n. 主教教区；【名】 （See）（英）西伊，（柬）塞，（德）泽（人名）
definition: 1. n. the seat within a bishop's diocese where his cathedral is located；2. v. perceive by sight or have the power to perceive by sight
example: and you meet people, you see them, judge them for who they are and what you see in them.
exampleZh: 观察所遇之人，以其自身及言行评价他。

meaning: n. 种子，籽；（苹果或橙子等的）果核，籽； 精液，精子（常为幽默用法）；（古时用语，原用于《圣经》中）子嗣，子孙；（感情、过程的）起源，开端；（网球、羽毛球等体育项目中的）种子选手， 种子队；晶粒，晶种；辐射管，镭管；v. 给（蔬菜，水果）去籽（去核），给......脱籽；选定......为种子选手（或种子队）；在（地里）播种；（植物）结籽，脱籽；（植物）自播；（喻）使萌芽，使发展；用晶粒物质使冷凝（结晶）（尤指促云化雨）；adj. 用作种子的；【名】 （Seed）（英）锡德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a small hard fruit；2. v. go to seed; shed seeds
example: Nothing better shows our heavenly origins, our divine seed, our human intellect, those holy traces of Promethean fire."
exampleZh: 没有什么能更好的讲述我们的起源，我们的子孙，我们人类的智力，生命之火神圣的踪迹“

meaning: n. 秧苗，幼苗
definition: 1. n. young plant or tree grown from a seed
example: Keep the soil moist. That way, the seedling will flourish.
exampleZh: 保持土壤湿润,那样小苗就会茁壮成长。

meaning: v. 寻找；寻求，谋求；请求（帮助），征求（意见）；试图，设法；找出，找到（seek sb./sth. out）；自然地向……移动；去，前往（某地）
definition: 1. n. the movement of a read/write head to a specific data track on a disk；2. v. try to get or reach
example: Its difficulty lies in Milton's tendency in this poem to seek out what Dr. Johnson wonderfully calls remote allusions.
exampleZh: 诗的难点在于弥尔顿想要在诗中极力追求,被约翰逊绝妙地称为不切实际的幻想的倾向。

meaning: v. （涉及推断）似乎，看来；（用于表示谨慎、礼貌或委婉）好像，可能；【名】 （Seem）（英）西姆（人名）
definition: 1. v. give a certain impression or have a certain outward aspect；2. v. seem to be true, probable, or apparent
example: There are so many entities in this passage that seem to be mysteriously conjoined in some kind of hermaphroditic unity.
exampleZh: 这段里有很多看起来很多实体神秘地,结合在两性的一个结合体重。

meaning: adj. 表面上的，貌似的，似是而非的；n. （尤指被认为有欺骗性或不同于现实时的）外表，表象
definition: 1. adj. appearing as such but not necessarily so
example: The worst reason to launch an attack would be a fear of seeming irresolute.
exampleZh: 发起攻击最坏的理由就是因为害怕看起来犹豫不决。

meaning: adv. 貌似，看似（但可能并非如此）；似乎，好像（是事实）
definition: 1. adv. from appearances alone
example: Well, how do you get this hearts to move up and down and seemingly in these random patterns?
exampleZh: 但是，你怎样才能让这些爱心们看起来,像是在某种随机的模式下上上下下地移动呢？

meaning: n. 部分，片段；（市场）细分的部分；（水果或花自然形成的）瓣，（昆虫的）节； 球缺，弓形；（直线或弧线上两点间的）段；（特定广播或电视节目的）时间段；某一时段单独播放的节目；音段；v. 分割，划分；（细胞）分裂
definition: 1. n. one of several parts or pieces that fit with others to constitute a whole object；2. v. divide into segments
example: Let me go back to the overall schedule before you go to the individual segment who gets in to see him.
exampleZh: 我们先回到日程的问题上,然后再讨论你说的个人部分,谁可以见总统。

meaning: adj. 由部分组成的；音段的；（建筑）弓形的
definition: 1. adj. divided or organized into speech segments or isolable speech sounds；2. adj. having the body divided into successive metameres or segments, as in earthworms or lobsters
example: Bacterial, community-acquired pneumonia classically show lung consolidation of one lung segmental lobe, which is known as lobar pneumonia.
exampleZh: 细菌性、社区获得性肺炎的典型表现为肺节段性叶的肺实变，称为大叶性肺炎。

meaning: v. （尤指因种族、性别、宗教不同而）使隔离，使分开；实行种族隔离；（使）分开，分离；（成对的等位基因）分离；n. （遗传）分离子；（植物学）集合物种中的一种
definition: 1. to keep one thing separate from another；2. to keep one group of people apart from another and treat them differently, especially because of race, sex, or religion
example: Is it ever good to segregate on the basis of race, income or age?
exampleZh: 根据种族、收入或年龄来划分是否有益？

meaning: n. （对不同种族、宗教或性别的人所采取的）隔离并区别对待，隔离政策；隔离，分隔；（等位基因的）分离
definition: 1. the policy of keeping one group of people apart from another and treating them differently, especially because of race, sex, or religion；2. the act of keeping one person or thing separate from another person or thing
example: The Supreme Court unanimously ruled that racial segregation in schools was unconstitutional.
exampleZh: 最高法院一致裁定学校实施的种族隔离措施违反宪法。

meaning: v. 抓住，捉住；（用武力）夺取，占领；逮捕，捉拿；没收，扣押；把握（机会等）；（感觉、疼痛）侵袭，控制；吸引（注意力），唤起（想象力）；理解，掌握；意识到，得知（be seized of）；（有活动部件的机器，机器的活动部件）咬住，卡住；依法占有（be seized of）；具有（财产）的终身保有权（be seized of）
definition: 1. v. take hold of; grab；2. v. take or capture by force
example: Moreover, whenever they seize a property and try to sell it, it usually loses value anyway in the process.
exampleZh: 而且当他们没收财产并变卖时,财产在这一过程中总会发生价值减损

meaning: n. 夺取，控制；扣押，没收；（疾病的）突然发作
definition: 1. n. a sudden occurrence (or recurrence) of a disease；2. n. the act of forcibly dispossessing an owner of property
example: In seizure patients, brain surgery is sometimes used to implant electrodes.
exampleZh: 在癫痫患者中，脑外科手术有时被用来植入电极。

meaning: adv. 不常，很少
definition: 1. adv. not often
example: She was a severe woman who seldom smiled.
exampleZh: 她是个严肃的女人，脸上很少出现笑容。

meaning: v. 选择，挑选；（在计算机屏幕上）选定；（进化）决定（特征，生物）是否继续存在；adj. 精选的，优等的；高级的，奢华的；【名】 （Select）（美、印）塞阿克特（人名）
definition: 1. v. pick out, select, or choose from a number of alternatives；2. adj. of superior grade
example: Select the text you want to format by holding down the left button on your mouse.
exampleZh: 按住鼠标左键选取你想要格式化的文本。

meaning: n. 选择，挑选；被挑选的人（或物），精选品；可供选择的事物；（比赛中值得赌的）看好的马；所选数据；（英国的）学校入学选拔；（以优越条件）选购土地
definition: 1. n. the act of choosing or selecting；2. n. an assortment of things from which a choice can be made
example: Let's do selection and let's do merge sort here on the right just to see what actually happens.
exampleZh: 中间进行选择排序，右边进行归并排序,看看会发生什么。

meaning: adj. 认真挑选的，严格筛选的；选择性的，有选择的；（记忆）只记一部分的
definition: 1. adj. tending to select; characterized by careful choice；2. adj. characterized by very careful or fastidious selection
example: We seem to have a selective memory for the best bits of the past.
exampleZh: 我们似乎对过去最美好的时光有选择性的记忆。

meaning: n. 自己，自我；（指一个人）自己，本人；私心，私利；本人（用于商业函件、支票等）；（自己的）通常的行为方式，本来面目；adj. （装饰品，封面）与其他部分同质同色的；v. （主植）使自花授粉，使自体受精；（遗传）（动物、植物）同系繁衍，同系受精；自花受精；pron. 自己（用于自谑的赞美语中）；本人（用于票根、支票等，指称持有人或签署人）；【名】 （Self）（英）塞尔夫（人名）
definition: 1. n. your consciousness of your own identity；2. adj. (used as a combining form) relating to--of or by or to or from or for--the self
example: Everyone, according to the logic ofAreopagitica everyone has the potential to assume the inner authority of conscience and self-discipline.
exampleZh: 按照《论出版自由》的逻辑，每个人都有,用内在良心的统治和自律的潜力。

meaning: adj. 自私的，利己的
definition: 1. adj. concerned chiefly or only with yourself and your advantage to the exclusion of others
example: Do you think I'm being selfish by not letting her go?
exampleZh: 你觉得我不让她走是自私吗？

meaning: adj. 无私的，忘我的
definition: 1. adj. showing unselfish concern for the welfare of others
example: She was a wonderful companion and her generosity to me was entirely selfless.
exampleZh: 她是一位极好的伴侣，她对我的宽容完全是无私的。

meaning: v. 出让，转让；出售，售卖；以……价钱出售；促销，推销；有销路；说服，使接受； 出卖，做交易； 欺骗；用以销售（一定数量）；n. 销售，出售；推销品，销售品； 让人失望的东西；推销术；【名】 （Sell）（德）泽尔，（英、芬、瑞典）塞尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. the activity of persuading someone to buy；2. v. exchange or deliver for money or its equivalent
example: So traditionally, what we've done was we had a very small sales force and we sell some ads.
exampleZh: 销售团队规模很小,只靠广告赚钱。

meaning: n. 学期，半学年
definition: 1. n. one of two divisions of an academic year；2. n. half a year; a period of 6 months
example: Like, because I mean... Like this semester, I was hoping to take 3 sciences with an American Cultures class,
exampleZh: 例如，像这学期，我想选三门科学课，外加一门美国文化课，

meaning: n. 研讨会，培训会；（大学的）专题讨论课，研讨班
definition: 1. n. any meeting for an exchange of ideas；2. n. a course offered for a small group of advanced students
example: and the last quarter is a seminar in which you only go once a week for three hours
exampleZh: 最后一个季度是研讨会，每周只需要参加三个小时，

meaning: n. 参议院；大学理事会，大学评议会；（古罗马的）元老院
definition: 1. n. assembly possessing high legislative powers；2. n. the upper house of the United States Congress
example: She became the first black woman to be elected to the Senate.
exampleZh: 她成为第一个被选进参议院的黑人妇女。

meaning: n. 参议员，（古罗马的）元老院议员，（大学理事会的）理事；庭长；【名】 （Senator）（瑞典、斯威）塞纳托尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a member of a senate
example: In fact, our own Senator Christopher Dodd has a bill in Congress right now to bring back the HOLC, basically.
exampleZh: 事实上,参议员克里斯托弗·多德,已向国会提交了议案,意思就是要求恢复房主贷款公司

meaning: v. 邮寄，发送；传达，告知；派遣，打发，安排去；使快速（或猛然）移动；使作出（某种反应），使表现出（某种行为）；排放，排出（烟或化学反应的产生物等）； 使着迷，使入迷；n. 波浪的推力，波浪引起的水位上升（=scend）；【名】 （Send）（德）森德
definition: 1. v. cause to go somewhere；2. v. to cause or order to be taken, directed, or transmitted to another place
example: You just type a few keys, “Happy birthday,” and you send that, and then you’re okay.
exampleZh: 只需要写“生日快乐”，然后发出去就可以了。

meaning: adj. 年龄大些的；（用在家庭内姓名相同的人名后表示）老，年长的；老年人的；（地位、水平或级别）较高的，高级的；（比赛）成人的，高水平的；大于一定年龄（通常为11岁）的学童的；（高中或大学）毕业年级的；n. 较年长的人；老年人，长者；地位（或级别）较高者，上司；（中学或大学的）毕业班学生；资深成人运动员，高水平运动员；【名】 （Senior）（英）西尼尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. an undergraduate student during the year preceding graduation；2. adj. older; higher in rank; longer in length of tenure or service
example: But this year, it's my senior year, so I'm just trying to take it easy and... take my classes.
exampleZh: 但是今年我已经大四了，所以不想再那么忙了，就……好好地上课吧。

meaning: n. 年长，职位高；资历，年资
definition: 1. n. higher rank than that of others especially by reason of longer service；2. n. the property of being long-lived
example: They offered him a post befitting his seniority and experience.
exampleZh: 他们给他提供了一个适合他的资历与经验的职位。

meaning: n. 感觉，知觉；感觉能力，知觉能力；（某种经历所产生的）整体感觉，总体印象；轰动，引起轰动的人（或事）
definition: 1. the ability to feel something physically, especially by touching, or a physical feeling that results from this ability；2. a general feeling caused by something that happens to you, especially a feeling that you cannot describe exactly
example: We have certain kinds of sensations inside our body, the characteristic sensation of fear or joy or depression.
exampleZh: 我们能感受到特定的内在感觉,典型的如恐惧,愉悦,沮丧,等等

meaning: adj. 轰动的，激动人心的；夸张的，耸人听闻的；非常好的，吸引人的
definition: 1. very good, exciting, or unusual；2. Sensational news reports and articles are intended to be shocking and exciting rather than serious
example: It is only the sensational that sells news magazines.
exampleZh: 只有轰动性的消息才能促进新闻杂志的销售。

meaning: n. 感觉官能（即视、听、嗅、味、触五觉）；（对某物的）感觉；道理，合理性；见识，良好的判断；理智，理性；理解力，判断力；意义，含义；（数，物理）指向，方向；v. 感觉到，觉察到；（机器）检测出；adj. （遗传）有意义的；【名】 (Sense) （美）森斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a general conscious awareness；2. v. perceive by a physical sensation, e.g., coming from the skin or muscles
example: It is autonomous in the sense that it is a pure, uncluttered and uninfluenced declaration of fact or falsehood.
exampleZh: 科学是自主的，因为,科学就是单纯的,不受外界影响的，关于真伪的论断。

meaning: adj. 理智的，合理的； 朴素而实用的；可感觉到的，明显的；n. 可感觉到的东西
definition: 1. adj. showing reason or sound judgment；2. adj. able to feel or perceive
example: So, one of the things that you can do is to become technically literate so you can become part of the discussion and help formulate sensible policy.
exampleZh: 其中你能做的一个就是,成为技术达人,这样的话你就能够参与讨论,并且帮助制定可靠的政策。

meaning: n. （探测光、热、压力等的）传感器，敏感元件，探测设备
definition: 1. n. any device that receives a signal or stimulus (as heat or pressure or light or motion etc.) and responds to it in a distinctive manner
example: The electronic sensor has been adapted to fit on a newborn baby.
exampleZh: 电子传感器已被改装以适应新生儿。

meaning: adj. 过敏的，易受影响的；灵敏的；善解人意的，体恤的；（问题、话题）敏感的，须谨慎对待的；机密的，保密的；理解的，意识到的；（对艺术、音乐、文学等）感受力强的，有悟性的；需保护的；小心谨慎的；（照相材料）感光的；（市场）脆弱的；神经过敏的，敏感的；n. 具有超自然通灵能力的人
definition: 1. n. someone who serves as an intermediary between the living and the dead；2. adj. responsive to physical stimuli
example: Literary analysis that is sensitive to the larger contours of the account will reveal the artistic hand of the final editor.
exampleZh: 通常经过文学分析，会发现,最终版本都经过艺术加工。

meaning: n. （对细节或质量的）感知，觉察；（对新情况的）灵敏度；敏感，易生气；多愁善感；体贴，有分寸；小心谨慎；过敏；敏感性，易惹恼人的倾向；（天生的）悟性，敏锐性；表现力；机密性
definition: 1. n. (physiology) responsiveness to external stimuli; the faculty of sensation；2. n. the ability to respond to physical stimuli or to register small physical amounts or differences
example: A level of humility, and hyper sensitivity to the suffering of poor people, the oppressed people and working people.
exampleZh: 他对穷苦人民，受压迫的人民,以及工人阶级有着极大的谦逊和极高的敏感。

meaning: n. 句子，句；判决，判刑；命题；v. 判决，宣判，判刑
definition: 1. n. a string of words satisfying the grammatical rules of a language；2. v. pronounce a sentence on (somebody) in a court of law
example: It's usually best to respond in a complete sentence rather than saying yes or no which can be ambiguous.
exampleZh: 一般来说，回答最好是完整的句子，而不是简单的模棱两可的“是”或“不是”。

meaning: n. 观点，看法，情绪；多愁善感，伤感情绪
definition: 1. a thought, opinion, or idea based on a feeling about a situation, or a way of thinking about something；2. gentle feelings such as sympathy, love, etc., especially when considered to be silly or not suitable
example: It's a perfectly reasonable sentiment to include in an example of the particular genre that Milton is writing his mask in.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿在他的《面具》,这一特别的流派中包含这个例子,是完全合理的。

meaning: adj. 情感的（而非理性的）；多愁善感的，柔情的；（故事、电影、书等）感伤的，故作伤感的
definition: 1. A sentimental person is strongly influenced by emotional feelings, especially about happy memories of past events or relationships with other people, rather than by careful thought and judgment based on facts；2. giving too much importance to emotions, especially love or sadness
example: Beneath the sentimental psychobabble, there's a likable movie trying to get out.
exampleZh: 在多愁善感的心理呓语背后，有个可爱的电影试图破茧而出。

meaning: adj. 单独的，分开的；不同的，不相关的；v. （使）分离；（把……）分成不同部分；隔开，阻隔；（夫妻）分居，（同居情侣）分手；区分，区别；解雇，辞退；n. 可搭配穿着的单件衣服（separates）；独立音响设备（separates）；（按照颗粒大小、矿物组成等标准的）土壤划分（separates）
definition: 1. n. a separately printed article that originally appeared in a larger publication；2. v. act as a barrier between; stand between
example: Ritual impurity also defiles or renders impure sancta, and so it has to be kept separate from sancta.
exampleZh: 仪式上的不洁也会玷污或弄脏圣所，因此它必须远离圣所。

meaning: n. 分开，分隔；分离，离别；（夫妇的）分居；离析；分色（colour separation 的简称）
definition: 1. n. the act of dividing or disconnecting；2. n. coming apart
example: She wondered if Harry had been unfaithful to her during this long separation.
exampleZh: 她想知道，在分开的漫长岁月里哈里是否已经对她不忠了。

meaning: n. 分裂主义者，独立主义者；adj. 分裂主义的，独立主义的
definition: 1. n. an advocate of secession or separation from a larger group (such as an established church or a national union)；2. adj. having separated or advocating separation from another entity or policy or attitude
example: Spanish police say they have arrested ten people suspected of being members of the Basque separatist movement.
exampleZh: 西班牙警方说，他们已经逮捕了10名巴斯克独立运动的嫌疑分子。

meaning: n. 九月（公历一年中的第九个月份，在八月与十月之间，常缩写为 Sep. 或 Sept.）
definition: 1. n. the month following August and preceding October
example: Recorded September 9th, 1947, Grace Murray Hopper in case you're interested. This was the lab book of Grace Murray Hopper.
exampleZh: 想知道的话大概是在1947年9月9号，记载于,的实验手册中。

meaning: n. 顺序，次序；连续事件（或动作、事物）；（电影中表现同一主题或场面的）一组镜头；（生物学中分子或基因的排列）顺序；模进；（纸牌的）同花顺；序列；（天主教弥撒中圣歌与福音之间的）继续经；v. 按顺序排列；测定（整套基因或分子成分的）序列；用音序器播放（或录制）音乐
definition: 1. n. serial arrangement in which things follow in logical order or a recurrent pattern；2. v. arrange in a sequence
example: Work has to be done on schedule and in a prearranged sequence.
exampleZh: 工作必须按期并以预先安排好的顺序完成。

meaning: adj. 连续的，按顺序的；依次发生的，相继发生的；（主计算机）顺序的
definition: 1. adj. in regular succession without gaps
example: Robots are not sequential systems, but rather they are highly parallel in nature.
exampleZh: 机器人不是连续的系统，它们实质上是高度并行的。

meaning: n. （陆军、海军陆战队或空军的）中士；（英国的）巡佐，（美国的）警佐；【名】 （Sergeant）（英）萨金特，（法）塞尔让（人名）
definition: 1. a soldier of middle rank；2. in the UK and some other countries, a police officer whose rank is above constable and below inspector, or, in the US, a police officer whose rank is below a captain
example: The sergeant ordered the recruits to repeat the exercise until their movements were precise.
exampleZh: 中士命令新兵反复练习，直到他们的动作变得准确无误。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: adj. 顺序排列的，一连串（系列）的；（重罪案犯或重案）连环的，连续的；连续播放的，连载的；串行的，单行的；（语言学）（动词）序列的；（乐）序列的；（计算机）（处理器）单任务的；n. （电视或广播）连续剧，（报纸上的）连载故事；（图书馆的）期刊；【名】 （Serial）（阿、美、俄、意、英、法）塞力娅乐（人名）
definition: 1. used to describe a person who repeatedly commits a similar crime or carries out a similar bad act, or the crime or act itself；2. broadcast or published in several separate parts, one after another
example: Gary Gilmore The serial killer Gary Gilmore basically said the pain of others gratified him and caused him no unhappiness at all.
exampleZh: 连环杀手,基本上就说过别人的痛苦,让他很高兴，他一点都不讨厌。

meaning: n. 连续，一系列（事件）；（电视、广播等的）系列片，系列节目；丛书，系列出版物；（两队之间的）系列比赛；（电路的）串联；（同时发行的）一套邮票（或货币、硬币）；（由某一公司推出的）系列产品，（尤指）汽车系列；（年代地层学用语）统；（元素的）系；级数，序列项的总和；有共同特征的一组语音，系列（音）；音列
definition: 1. n. similar things placed in order or happening one after another；2. n. a serialized set of programs
example: You know, he had a series of drawings he did that were just different characters he came up within his mind
exampleZh: 他有一系列展示他脑海中所构想的各种角色的绘画作品。

meaning: adj. 严重的，危急的；认真的，严肃的；重要的，须重视的；（音乐、文学等艺术）严肃的；（人）庄重的，严肃的；大量的，极多的；（恋爱中）态度认真的；极感兴趣的，热衷的；很好的，质优价高的
definition: 1. adj. concerned with work or important matters rather than play or trivialities；2. adj. of great consequence
example: I think that if we don't address it, it has the potential to have very, very serious effects
exampleZh: 我觉得如果我们不解决的话，可能有非常非常严重的后果

meaning: n. 仆人，佣人；（公司或机构的）雇员，职员；献身……的人，受……指引的人；【名】 （Servant）（西）塞尔万特，（法）塞尔旺（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person working in the service of another (especially in the household)；2. n. in a subordinate position
example: His work as a civil servant was a cover for his activities as a spy.
exampleZh: 他以公务员的工作作为搞间谍活动的掩护。

meaning: v. 为……工作，服役；端上，给……提供（餐饮）；够……吃； 接待，服务；对……有用，满足；（向某地或某群体）供应，提供；服刑，服劳役； 送达（传票、令状等）；（网球、排球等）发球；开（某人）（玩笑）；产生……的效果；（军）操作（枪炮）；（航海）卷缠（绳索）；（雄性种畜）与（雌性）交配；（基督教）在弥撒中担任助祭；n. （网球、排球等的）发球； 申斥；【名】 （Serve）（法）塞尔夫（人名）；（Serve）（法）塞尔夫（人名）
definition: 1. n. (sports) a stroke that puts the ball in play；2. v. serve a purpose, role, or function
example: Choose this day which ones you are going to serve, but I in my household will serve Yahweh," serve the Lord.
exampleZh: 今日就可以选择所要事奉的，至于我和我家，我们必定侍奉耶和华“，侍奉上帝。

meaning: n. 公共服务系统，公共事业；（服务性行业或机构所提供的）服务；（对顾客的）接待，招待；工作，效劳；服务费；政府机构，公务部门；兵役，军队；（机器的）使用；仆人，佣人； 服务站；宗教仪式；检修，保养；整套餐具；发球，发球方式；班车，车次；（法律文件的）送达；v. 维修，检修；支付（债务）利息；为……提供服务；（雄性动物）与（雌性动物）交配；adj. 员工专用的； 部队的；提供服务的；【名】 （Service）（英）瑟维斯（人名）

meaning: n. （食物或饮料的）一人份；adj. 上菜用的，分菜肴用的；目前任职的，（尤指）现役的；v. 为……服务；供应，上（饮料、食物）；服役，供职于（serve 的现在分词形式）；【名】 （Serving）（美、瑞）塞尔温（人名）

meaning: v. 放，置；使开始；把故事情节安排在；设置；摆放餐具；镶嵌；安排；树立；布置；凝固；使现出坚定的表情；固定发型；把（断骨）复位；排版；为……谱曲；落（下）；布置（戏剧、电影或电视节目的布景）；（断骨）愈合；n. 一组（类似的东西）；一组（配套使用的东西）；一伙（或一帮、一群）人；电视机；布景 ；舞台；（网球、排球比赛等的）盘；集；一组歌曲（或乐曲）；（在某学科上能力相当的）一批学生 ；（尤指坚定的）姿势；头发的定型；凝固；兽穴；（供移植的）秧苗；adj. 位于（或处于）……的；安排好的；固定的；套（餐）；有可能的；不自然的；【名】 （Set）（瑞、以）塞特（人名）

meaning: n. 挫折，阻碍；（建筑）壁阶；（建筑物的）缩进距离

meaning: v. 解决，结束（争端等）；确定，决定；定居，安家；殖民，移居于；安置，安顿；（使）平静，（使）安定；降落，停留；（使）沉降，下陷；付清，结算；处理，分配（财产）；笼罩，稳定下来；把......放好，安放；（无可奈何地）接受（或答应）；n. 高背扶手木长椅；【名】 （Settle）（英）塞特尔（人名）

meaning: num. 七，七个；n. 七；七个人；七点钟；七岁；（Seven）（土、法、俄）谢文（人名）；adj. 七的，七个的

meaning: v. 摇动，抖动；削弱，动摇；发抖，哆嗦；握手；使震惊，使烦乱；使改变（态度、信念）；摆脱，克服；舞动（拳头、棍子等）；抖掉，抖出；使劲甩动，急剧晃动；摇头（以示否定）；（声音）颤抖；n. 摇动，摇晃；奶昔；（摇动容器后的）撒出物；哆嗦，颤抖（the shakes）；木制墙面板；地震；（乐）颤音

example: The shark described a circle around the shoal of fish.
exampleZh: 这条鲨鱼围绕着鱼群游动。

meaning: adj. 锋利的，尖的；急转弯的；（变化）急剧的；清晰的，鲜明的；剧烈的，强烈的；（语言）尖锐的；刺耳的；聪明的，敏锐的；（味道）浓烈的，辛辣的；时髦的；（风或霜）刺骨的；狡诈的；（音）偏高（的），升半音（的）；瘦削的，不丰满的；adv. 正点，准时；突然地，急剧地；音调偏高地；n. 升半音，升半音号；锐利的东西；骗子；v. 升音演奏；【名】 （Sharp）（英）夏普（人名）
definition: 1. n. a musical notation indicating one half step higher than the note named；2. adj. (of something seen or heard) clearly defined
example: A different way of putting it-- and none of this is going to come in with a sharp, decisive theory.
exampleZh: 从另一个角度来看-,注意，我现在讲的内容,目前都没有一个明确的理论。

meaning: v. （使）变锋利（尖锐，清晰）；（使）改善，提高；（使）加剧
definition: 1. v. make sharp or sharper；2. v. become sharp or sharper
example: He needs to sharpen up before the Olympic trials.
exampleZh: 在奥运会选拔赛之前，他需要进一步提高自己。

meaning: v. （使）破碎，碎裂；破坏，摧毁（抽象物）；使极为惊愕难过，给予极大打击；n. 碎片；受到极大打击的状态
definition: 1. to (cause something to) break suddenly into very small pieces；2. to end or severely damage something
example: What's great about expectations is that when you can shatter them, you create an impact.
exampleZh: 预期的一大好处是，当你能打破它们时，就能产生影响力。

meaning: v. 剃（须），刮去（毛发）；削去，刮掉（薄层）；（少量地）减去，削减；掠过，擦过；n. 刮脸，剃毛发 ；剃刀，刮刀； 侥幸逃过，幸免（close shave）
definition: 1. n. the act of removing hair with a razor；2. v. remove body hair with a razor
example: At a time when beards meant a great deal religiously, he's telling the men to shave off their beards.
exampleZh: 在当时人们把大胡子当做虔诚的象征,彼得却叫人把胡子都刮了

meaning: n. 电动剃须刀，剃毛器；理发师；小伙子；骗子；【名】 （Shaver）（英）谢弗（人名）
definition: 1. n. an adult male who shaves；2. n. a young person of either sex
example: The shaver will run off batteries or mains.
exampleZh: 这个剃须刀可用电池或电源驱动。

meaning: pron. 她（主格，指女性或女孩；亦泛指未标明性别的人）；它（用于指雌性动物，或国家、船舶、汽车、机器、地球、月亮等拟人化事物，也可译“她”）；n. 女人；雌性动物（复数 shes）；（She）人名，尤指中文姓氏“佘”的拉丁字母拼写
definition: 1. abstract: She (; died 613 BC) was for two months in 613 BC ruler of the State of Qi during the Spring and Autumn Period of ancient China. His personal name was Lü She (呂舍), ancestral name Jiang ([and he was not given a posthumous title] due to his short reign.
example: She's stuck between competing ideals of bodily purity just as surely and as firmly as she is stuck to her seat.
exampleZh: 她陷入贞洁理念的矛盾迷潭之中,与陷入陷入椅子一样确定而坚定。

meaning: v. 去除，摆脱；（植物）落（叶），（动物）蜕（皮），脱（毛）；脱掉（所穿衣物）；掉落（货物）；挡水，防水；射出，发出（光）；流，洒，落（泪）；（尤指在战争中）造成伤亡，使流（血）；把（车）停在库棚内；（分区）切断（电力载荷）；n. 棚屋，小屋；（工业上用于生产或存放设备的）厂房，工棚；剪羊棚，挤奶棚
definition: 1. n. an outbuilding with a single story; used for shelter or storage；2. v. get rid of
example: One is time, that I think it takes certain amount of time to shed the thoughts, the anxiety in everything else.
exampleZh: 第一是时间，要想,摆脱一些想法，摆脱焦虑，是需要一定的时间的。

meaning: n. 羊，绵羊；胆小鬼
definition: 1. n. woolly usually horned ruminant mammal related to the goat；2. n. a timid defenseless simpleton who is readily preyed upon
example: This is Virgil: "He should sing thin - spun lays and he should be content feeding his fat sheep."
exampleZh: 这是维吉尔的诗：“他哀唱着纤细的抒情诗“,“喂着肥硕的羊儿，他无比满足“

meaning: adj. （用于强调）纯粹的，完全的；程度深的，数量大的；陡峭的，垂直的；（织物等）极薄的，透明的；adv. 垂直地，陡峭地；彻底地，完全地；v. 急转弯，突然转向；避开（不愉快的话题）；n. 精纺（或透明）织物（或物品）；（尤指船）突然偏航，突然转向；（船首及船尾处的）舷弧
definition: 1. v. turn sharply; change direction abruptly；2. adj. complete and without restriction or qualification; sometimes used informally as intensifiers
example: In any case, Lambert Strether, as he arrives in Paris, has awakened to the sheer wonder of urbane culture.
exampleZh: 无论如何，朗伯，史瑞得到巴黎后完全被那里彬彬有礼的文化震撼了。

meaning: n. 床单，被单；布罩，盖布；纸片，纸张；（Excel 中的）工作表；简要记录，纪要；一整版邮票；（尤指大地区系列地图的一部分的）一张地图；薄板，薄片；（冰或水的）一大片；（雨或火）一大片；拉帆绳，帆脚索；敞舱船的首尾区域；v. （用布）盖上，裹上；把（帆）扣紧（或放松）；（雨）倾盆（或瓢泼）而下；【名】 （Sheet）（英）希特（人名）
definition: 1. n. any broad thin expanse or surface；2. v. come down as if in sheets
example: Let's begin with a kind of warm-up sheet which we can anchor in these little drawings I've made.
exampleZh: 让我们先来热一下身,看一下我在黑板上画的图。

meaning: n. 搁板，架子；（尤指水中）陆架，底岩；告密者（复数 shelfs）；v. 告发（某人）
definition: 1. n. a support that consists of a horizontal surface for holding objects；2. n. a projecting ridge on a mountain or submerged under water
example: You can really decide if you want to commit to it and work on it more or put it on a shelf for a later date.
exampleZh: 你就可以决定,你是否想落实它,更多地为它努力或是暂时搁置它，以后再落实。

meaning: n. （蛋、坚果、某些种子和某些动物的）壳；（甲虫的）鞘翅；（尤指建筑物等遭破坏后剩下的）框架，骨架；壳状物；（人的）表面性格，表面感情；空躯壳；（物理）壳层；炮弹；子弹，弹药筒；轻型赛艇；内棺，粗制棺材；（剑的）护手；（计算机）SHELL PROGRAM 的简称；v. 剥……壳；炮轰；（从对方投手）大量得分
definition: 1. n. ammunition consisting of a cylindrical metal casing containing an explosive charge and a projectile; fired from a large gun；2. v. use explosives on
example: So, from going from the shell of n equals 2, let's say, to the shell of n equals 3.
exampleZh: 比如说，从ｎ等于２到ｎ,等于３壳层如何变化。

meaning: n. 居所，住处；（尤指用以躲避风雨或攻击的）遮蔽物，庇护处；遮蔽，庇护；（人或动物）收容所；v. 提供庇护，提供保护；躲避，避难；使（某人）免遭（困难，讨厌的事）；使免交税；【名】 （Shelter）（英）谢尔特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a structure that provides privacy and protection from danger；2. v. provide shelter for
example: It's the amount that people spend on consumption goods, things that you buy for your current use, like food, shelter, clothing, etc.
exampleZh: 它是人们购买消费品所花费的总额，为每日生活所买的东西，比如食物，住宿，衣物等。

meaning: n. 牧羊人，羊倌；牧师；指导者；v. 牧（羊）；带领，引领，护送；（尤指精神方面）给……指导；【名】 （Shepherd）（英、美、菲）谢泼德（人名）
definition: 1. a person whose job is to take care of sheep and move them from one place to another；2. to make a group of people move to where you want them to go, especially in a kind, helpful, and careful way
example: Moses will later marry Zipporah, one of these women, and live as a shepherd in Midian for about 40 years.
exampleZh: 后来摩西与西坡拉结婚，她是那些女人中的一个，作为一个牧人在米甸生活了大约四十年。

meaning: n. 盾（牌）；防护物，保护人；盾形纹（徽）章；警徽；盾形奖牌；（颁发盾形奖牌的）比赛；背甲，头胸甲，龟甲板；（地质）地盾；v. 保护，保卫；遮挡；给……加防护罩；防止（或减少）辐射；（体育运动中）护住（球）；防御，起保护作用；【名】 （Shield）（英）希尔德（人名）
definition: 1. in the past, a large, flat object made of metal or leather that soldiers held in front of their bodies to protect themselves；2. a large, flat object made of strong plastic that police officers hold in front of their bodies to protect themselves
example: Here I paused in my fiction to shield my eyes and stanch the arrow-straight tracks clawed down my cheek.
exampleZh: 飞箭在我脸上笔直地犁出了一条伤口，我停止了幻想,遮住眼睛，赶忙去止血。

meaning: v. （使）移动，（使）转移；（使）转换到（另一个人或另一事物）；（使）改变意见（或信仰等）；赶快；换（挡）；（计算机）移位；按（计算机键盘上的）Shift 键；摆脱，消除；（尤指大量）销售，出售；狼吞虎咽地吃；含糊其辞，拐弯抹角；n. 改变，转变；轮班工作时间；轮班工作的人；（计算机键盘上的）Shift 键；（计算机）移位；（机动车的）换挡装置；宽松直筒连衣裙（=shift dress）；长而宽松的内衣；（建筑）错位；（美橄）（开赛前）球员位置的变换；（天文）（光谱线的）偏移；语音演变（sound shift 的简称）；计谋，诡计
definition: 1. n. an event in which something is displaced without rotation；2. v. make a shift in or exchange of
example: So the reasons for this really enormous shift in plans, and the enormous shift in subject matter, are worth exploring.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿的计划变化为何如此之大，他对主题的选择为何有这么大的改变，是值得探究的。

meaning: v. （太阳或其他光源）发光，照耀；（用电筒等）照射；（表面）发亮；磨光，擦亮；（眼睛或脸上因快乐而）放光；表现突出，出众；n. 光亮，光泽；擦亮；【名】 （Shine） （英）夏因，（日）新荣（人名）
definition: 1. n. the quality of being bright and sending out rays of light；2. v. be bright by reflecting or casting light
example: The moon he caused to shine, the night to him entrusting.
exampleZh: 他让月亮反射光芒，派遣他在晚上工作。

meaning: adj. 光滑发亮的，有光泽的
definition: 1. adj. reflecting light；2. adj. having a shiny surface or coating
example: The trend now is toward "lifestyle" electronics – black, shiny gee-whiz things that people like to own.
exampleZh: 现在的趋势是追求“有品位”的电子产品——人们渴望拥有那些黑色锃亮、非常炫丽的东西。

meaning: n. （大）船，舰；三（或多）桅帆船； 艇（尤指赛艇）；宇宙飞船； 飞机；v. （用船、飞机、卡车）运送，运输；遣送（某人）；推出（计算机商品），（使）上市；（水手）在船上工作，在船上服役；舷侧进水；把（桨架中的桨）放在船内；给船安装（舵、桅杆等）； 上船，乘船；乘船旅行；提供船只；【名】 (Ship) （美、俄、英）摄（人名）
definition: 1. n. a vessel that carries passengers or freight；2. v. transport commercially
example: He asks the gods what has happened to Lycidas and who exactly was responsible for the sinking of Lycidas' ship.
exampleZh: 他问众神利西达斯怎么了,是谁让他的船沉没的。

meaning: n. （总称）船舶；航运，运输；运费；v. （用船、飞机、卡车）运送，运输；遣送（某人）；推出（计算机商品），（使）上市（ship 的现在分词）；【名】 （Shipping）（英）希平（人名）
definition: 1. n. the commercial enterprise of moving goods and materials；2. n. conveyance provided by the ships belonging to one country or industry
example: Shipping charges on orders sent to Canada are paid C.O.D.
exampleZh: 加拿大订单的运输费用是货到付现款。

meaning: n. 运输，运送；运输的货物，装载的货物量
definition: 1. n. goods carried by a large vehicle；2. n. the act of sending off something
example: He's supposed to call me about the shipment from Tokyo, it still hasn't arrived.
exampleZh: 他应该给我打电话，跟我说一下从东京来的货运情况，那些货还没到。

meaning: n. 造（修）船厂，船坞；造船业，修船业
definition: 1. a place where ships are built or repaired；2. a place where ships are built and repaired
example: Shortly after the workers went on strike, police began to mass at the shipyard.
exampleZh: 工人罢工后不久，警察开始在造船厂集结。

meaning: n. 衬衫，恤衫；球衣；运动队队员
definition: 1. n. a garment worn on the upper half of the body；2. v. put a shirt on
example: He let you borrowed a shirt and you went to a party and you spilled wine on his shirt.
exampleZh: 他借给你一件衬衫，你穿着去参加一个派对，结果溅了一点红酒在上面。

meaning: n. 屎，粪；拉屎，排便；（生病或害怕时的）腹泻，拉肚子 （the shits）；无用之物，劣质品；坏蛋，讨厌鬼；不愉快的经历（或待遇）；个人财产，东西；胡说八道，屁话； 胡来，捣乱；毒品（尤指大麻）；v. 拉屎，排便；拉屎弄脏衣服；极其担忧（害怕）；欺骗，诈骗（某人）；恶劣对待；adj. 糟透的，讨厌透顶的；int. 狗屁，呸（表示气愤、恐惧或失望）
definition: 1. n. obscene terms for feces；2. v. give away information about somebody
example: I'll be in the shit if I don't get this work finished today.
exampleZh: 要是今天不把这活儿做完，那我就惨了。

meaning: v. （因寒冷或害怕而）颤抖，哆嗦，发抖；n. 颤抖,哆嗦（因寒冷、恐惧、激动等）；寒战，寒噤（因恐惧或发高烧）（the shivers）；【名】 （Shiver）（美、斯）希弗（人名）
definition: 1. n. a reflex motion caused by cold or fear or excitement；2. v. tremble convulsively, as from fear or excitement
example: A chill shiver rippled over his skin.
exampleZh: 一阵寒颤传遍了他全身。

meaning: n. 令人震惊的事；吃惊，震惊；休克；电击，触电；减震器；（对经济、传统、生活方式的）冲击，撞击；（爆炸、地震等引起的）剧烈震动；浓密的头发；愤怒，生气；冲击力 ；（竖放在地里促使谷物更快晒干和成熟的）禾束堆；v. 使震惊，使难以置信；（言语或行为）（使）愤慨，（使）生气；使触电，使遭电击；使恐惧（或厌恶）；使生理休克；把......堆成禾束堆；adj. 令人震惊的，令人大感意外的（尤用于新闻报道）；浓密的，蓬乱的；【名】 （Shock）（英）肖克（人名）
definition: 1. n. the feeling of distress and disbelief that you have when something bad happens accidentally；2. v. surprise greatly; knock someone's socks off
example: So it was like a big shock to me because after five years, I thought I know the language.
exampleZh: 所以，这对我来说，就是一个很大的打击，因为五年的学习以后，我以为我掌握这门语言了。

meaning: n. 鞋；马蹄铁；刹车蹄片；（尤指照相机上的）插口；（尤指雪橇滑板的）金属箍；柱脚，桩靴；（巴卡拉纸牌或其他纸牌戏的）发牌盒；他人的处境（shoes）；v. 给（马）钉蹄铁；穿鞋（或靴）（be shod）；用金属片包覆；为（轮子）装轮胎；【名】 （Shoe）休（姓氏）
definition: 1. n. footwear shaped to fit the foot (below the ankle) with a flexible upper of leather or plastic and a sole and heel of heavier material；2. v. furnish with shoes
example: You pay 2,000, 3,000 dollars a month for a shoe box apartment
exampleZh: 你一个月得为一间鞋盒大小的房子花上两三千美元，

meaning: v. 开（枪），射击；射杀，射伤；狩猎，打猎；投（球），射门；玩，打（某种游戏）；拍摄；（使）急速移动；突然把……投向；迅速成名；（疼痛）穿刺；闩上，拔出（门闩）；（植物，种子）发芽；注射（毒品）；准确刨平（木板的边角）；n. 嫩芽，新枝；拍摄；狩猎，射猎场，射击比赛；斜道，滑运道（=chute）；急流，奔流；int. 说吧，请讲；糟糕，哎呀
definition: 1. n. a new branch；2. v. hit with a missile from a weapon
example: Finally, let's do it in green, let's look at the payoffs, the expected payoffs if I shoot to the right.
exampleZh: 最后,用绿线来表示吧,我们来看看我从右路射门的预期收益

meaning: n. 商店，店铺；作坊，工场；手工课，工艺课；手工课教室；购物，采购；有关工作（或公事）的谈话；工作室，办公室；v. 购物；举报，告发；试图说服（公司出版或生产）；（用软件 Photoshop）修（图）
definition: 1. n. a mercantile establishment for the retail sale of goods or services；2. v. do one's shopping
example: So when you go, for example, in your neighborhood, if there's one coffee shop and you like their coffee,
exampleZh: 所以，举个例子来说，如果你住的小区有个咖啡店，而你又喜欢喝咖啡的话，你可以去，

meaning: n. 购物；从商店采买的东西；v. 购物；逛商店；（向警察等）告发（shop 的现在分词）
definition: 1. n. searching for or buying goods or services
example: So a very popular thing to do on Boxing Day is go shopping and take advantage of the sales.
exampleZh: 所以在节礼日人们通常会趁着促销之际出去购物，这很流行。

meaning: n. （海、湖或大河的）滨，岸；沿海国家（或地区）（shores）；涨潮线与落潮线之间的地带；支柱，撑柱；v. 用支撑物（或梁）支撑；支持，帮助（shore up）；【名】 （Shore）（美、英、加）肖尔 （人名）
definition: 1. n. the land along the edge of a body of water；2. v. serve as a shore to
example: Edward King gave his life, and he's recompensed by his new status as the genius of the shore.
exampleZh: 爱德华金献出了他的生命,并得到了作为新的天才的地位的回报。

meaning: adj. 短暂的，短期的；（长度或距离）短的；个子矮的；简短的，短篇的；短缺的，稀少的；不够（长、高或远）的；缩写的；呼吸困难的；唐突的，无礼的；短音的；短球的；（板球）靠近击球手位置的；概率大的；（糕点）松脆的；（黏土）黏性差的；简直，无异于；n. 少量烈酒；电影短片；短裤（shorts）；男用短内裤（shorts）；短音；细麸粉（shorts）；短路；卖空的人；短期证券（shorts）；adv. 达不到标准（或预期）地；突然，短暂；使变短地；短距离地；v. （使）短路；（股票）卖空；【名】 （Short）（英）肖特 （人名）
definition: 1. n. the location on a baseball field where the shortstop is stationed；2. v. cheat someone by not returning him enough money
example: The same nations and the short life expectancy of birth probably the lowest quality of life in other areas.
exampleZh: 这一数字在下降，在上述国家,新生儿预期寿命较短，某些区域生活质量极低。

meaning: n. 短缺，不足
definition: 1. n. the property of being an amount by which something is less than expected or required；2. n. an acute insufficiency
example: There is a shortage of fresh water on the island.
exampleZh: 岛上缺少淡水。

meaning: n. 短裤；男内裤（同 boxer shorts）；短片（short 的复数）；细麸粉；短期证券；（Shorts）肖茨（人名）；v. （使）短路（short 的第三人称单数）
definition: 1. n. trousers that end at or above the knee；2. n. underpants worn by men
example: In other versions he says that Dean got up and was naked, not that he was in his shorts.
exampleZh: 在有的版本里迪恩连短裤都没有穿，完全是裸的。

meaning: n. 缺点，短处
definition: 1. n. a failing or deficiency
example: The shortcoming in education is the cause contributing to juvenile delinquency.
exampleZh: 教育上的缺失是助长青少年犯罪的原因。

meaning: n. 速记（法）；简略的表达方式；adj. 速记的
definition: 1. a system of fast writing that uses lines and simple signs to represent words and phrases；2. giving fewer details than usual
example: This is nice shorthand, all right, but it's something that in fact I probably would want to do differently.
exampleZh: 但是实际上有一些东西，我可能想换种不同的方式来做,为什么我要换种。

meaning: adv. 不久，很快，立刻；简短地，扼要地；（说话）不耐烦地，不友善地
definition: 1. adv. for a short time；2. adv. in the near future
example: We learn shortly afterwards that they have taken this descent to the Piraeus to view a festival, a kind of carnival.
exampleZh: 我们稍后得知,他们一起南下皮里亚斯,去观赏一场庆典，类似嘉年华的庆典。

meaning: n. 射击，开枪（或炮），枪声；射手，枪手；弹丸；批评的话；尝试，努力；击球，射门；铅球；发射；照片，（电影的）镜头；注射；一口，一小杯（烈性酒）；少量；概率，可能性 ；铅沙弹；adj. 杂色的，闪色的；破烂不堪，筋疲力尽；充满（某种特质或情感）；醉的；v. 开（枪），射击；射出（弓箭等）；狩猎（shoot 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. n. an attempt to score in a game；2. adj. varying in color when seen in different lights or from different angles
example: Then they test you to make sure that you have adequate protection, and some people need an additional shot after that.
exampleZh: 然后医生会检测以确定你已获得了保护,有些人在测试完后需要再打一针

meaning: v. （用于纠正别人）应该；（用于建议）该，可以；（表示预期）应该会；（表示与预期相反）本应；（与 I 或 we 连用代替 would，表示虚拟结果）就将；（用于 that 从句，表示建议或安排）可以；（用于 that 从句，表示感情）竟然会；（表示拒绝、恼怒或惊奇）竟会；（表示可能）假如，万一；将（用作 shall 的过去式）；（与 I 和 we 连用，表示客气地请求）想；当然，真的（用于强调自己所相信或所期待的）；（表示强调有趣、惊讶或印象深刻）真该
definition: 1. used to express obligation, advice, expectation, or a probable situation
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: If my code is correct, what should the average price be, after say, 100 days, if there's no bias. Pardon?
exampleZh: 如果我的代码没写错的话，如果没有偏向值那平均价格会是多少呢，如果没有偏向值，请说？

meaning: n. 肩，肩膀；双肩，上背部（shoulders）；（衣服的）肩部；（动物的）前腿连肩肉，肘子；山肩，瓶肩； （公路旁的）路肩，紧急停车道；（担负责任或艰难困苦或提供力量的）肩膀；（四足动物的）肩背；（鸟、昆虫的）肩背；v. 承担，担负；挤，闯；（用肩膀）推开，顶开；肩扛，肩挑
definition: 1. n. the part of the body between the neck and the upper arm；2. v. lift onto one's shoulders
example: Writing the book was as if I had eyes over my shoulder or voices speaking to my ear.
exampleZh: 写这本书就好比自我反省,听自己在辩论一样。

meaning: vi. 叫嚷，大声说；呼叫，喊叫；呼唤，呼喊（以引起注意）；大声吼叫使……住口（或讲话被淹没）（shout sb. down）；将嗓子喊哑； 张扬（shout about）；明确无误地指出（或表示）；（在酒吧、餐厅等）请人喝饮料（或吃东西）；使用大写字母（写电子邮件，表示生气）；n. （愤怒、害怕、激动等的）呼喊，喊叫声； 请客的酒，轮到买酒请客； 紧急召集消防队（或警察）的叫喊声
definition: 1. n. a loud utterance; often in protest or opposition；2. v. utter in a loud voice; talk in a loud voice (usually denoting characteristic manner of speaking)
example: What can we say about those choices? Somebody right behind you, the woman right behind you, shout it out.
exampleZh: 我们怎么评价他们的选择,找你身后的,你身后的那位女士,请大声说

meaning: v. 猛推，乱挤；连推带挤地走； 随便放置，乱放（某物）；移动身体，挪动身体（以腾出地方）；去他的，让……见鬼；n. 猛推；【名】 （Shove）（英）肖夫（人名）
definition: 1. to push someone or something forcefully；2. to put something somewhere in a hurried or careless way
example: You have to give the door a shove or it won't close.
exampleZh: 这门你得猛推一下，否则关不上。

meaning: v. 显示，表明；给……看，出示；演示，教；带领，引领；表露出，显示出；（对某人）表现出，对待；容易显出，容易看到；标示，标明；描绘，描述；放映，播出；展示，展出；露面，出现；证明，证实；替（动物）报名参加比赛； （妇女）已显出身孕；获得第三名（或前三名）；n. 演出，歌舞表演；（电视或广播）节目；展览，展览会；表现，行为；假象，假装；景象；事情，场面；动物比赛；（分娩或月经时的）见红；（做某事的）机会；【名】 （Show）（美、巴西）肖（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of publicly exhibiting or entertaining；2. v. show or demonstrate something to an interested audience
example: and it was a really marvelous show, the improvisation, you know, their covers of other people's bands as well.
exampleZh: 表演太精彩了，他们的即兴演奏，对其他乐队的模仿都很棒。

meaning: adj. 显眼的，艳丽的；昂贵但俗气的
definition: 1. adj. marked by ostentation but often tasteless；2. adj. displaying brilliance and virtuosity
example: The island, the smallest of the Canadian provinces, is home to a variety of showy fall species.
exampleZh: 这个岛屿是加拿大最小的省份，是各式各样艳丽的秋季树种的家园。

meaning: n. 展示（本领、优点等）的场合；（商店、博物馆等的）玻璃陈列柜；v. 展示，展现
definition: 1. a container with glass sides in which valuable or important objects are kept so that they can be looked at without being touched, damaged, or stolen；2. a situation or event that makes it possible for the best features of something to be seen
example: but the building itself to me is the real showcase of that visit.
exampleZh: 但对我来说，建筑本身就是参观那里的真正主要的陈列。

meaning: n. 淋浴器，花洒；淋浴间，淋浴室；淋浴，洗澡；阵雨，阵雪；（落下的东西）一大批，一阵； 流星雨；（为即将结婚或分娩的女子举行的）送礼聚会； 一群乌合之众，一群笨蛋；v. 淋浴，洗澡；洒落，（使）纷纷降落；朝......阵雨般地扔（大量小东西）（shower sb. with）；大量给予，慷慨给予
definition: 1. n. a plumbing fixture that sprays water over you；2. v. expend profusely; also used with abstract nouns
example: I said that if I was really hygienic, and you can now wonder about how often do I shower?
exampleZh: 但是这真的很棒，对不对？,那么为什么我要说这些呢？,我说过如果我真的很讲卫生的话？

meaning: n. （撕或切的）细条，碎片；极少量，些许；完全毁坏（shreds）；v. 切碎，撕碎；粉碎销毁（文件）
definition: 1. a very small amount of something；2. a very small, thin piece that has been torn from something
example: There is nothing like a shred of evidence to suggest that Edward King had any talent whatsoever.
exampleZh: 没有一丝丝证据能证明,爱德华·金在这方面有任何天赋。

meaning: adj. （人）精明的，机敏的；（决定和判断）精明的，准确的；（打击）沉重的，尖锐的；邪恶的，恶意的；（尤指天气）寒冷刺骨的，凛冽的
definition: 1. having or based on a clear understanding and good judgment of a situation, resulting in an advantage；2. able to judge a situation accurately and turn it to your own advantage
example: He was a shrewd lawyer with a talent for uncovering paper trails of fraud.
exampleZh: 他是个精明强干的律师，能从一连串文件中找出诈骗的蛛丝马迹。

meaning: n. 虾，小虾； 矮子，无足轻重的人；v. 捕虾；adj. 与虾有关的；有虾的，虾制的
definition: 1. n. disparaging terms for small people；2. v. fish for shrimp
example: Hines slowly masticated a shrimp.
exampleZh: 海恩斯慢慢地咀嚼着一只虾。

meaning: v. （使）缩小，减少；（通常指布料、衣服等洗后）缩水，皱缩；退缩，畏缩；畏避，回避（工作、责任等）；n. 精神病学家，心理学家；收缩；畏缩
definition: 1. n. a physician who specializes in psychiatry；2. v. wither, as with a loss of moisture
example: If you give up exercise, your muscles shrink and fat increases. By the same token, if you expend more energy you will lose fat.
exampleZh: 如果你放弃锻炼，肌肉就会萎缩，脂肪会增多。同样地，如果你消耗较多的体能，你就会减掉脂肪。

meaning: n. 灌木；（尤指掺朗姆酒或白兰地的）果汁甜酒；果汁露酒；v. 因肯尼亚英语的影响而发错音
definition: 1. a large plant with a rounded shape formed from many small branches growing either directly from the ground or from a hard stem, grown in gardens；2. a drink made from fruit juice mixed with sugar and rum or brandy
example: Once the fire is out, the grass and shrub ecosystems should return quickly.
exampleZh: 火一旦被熄灭，草和灌木的生态系统就会很快恢复。

meaning: n. 灌木丛，灌木（总称）；（林业）灌木林，灌木种植区
definition: 1. a part of a garden where a lot of shrubs have been planted；2. a group of shrubs
example: After she was gone Mary turned down the walk which led to the door in the shrubbery.
exampleZh: 她走后，玛丽走上了通往灌木丛里那扇门的小路。

meaning: v. （表示不知道或不感兴趣）耸（肩）；n. 耸肩；女式紧身短套衫，女式带袖短披肩
definition: 1. n. a gesture involving the shoulders；2. v. raise one's shoulders to indicate indifference or resignation
example: He gave a feeble shrug and tried to squirm free.
exampleZh: 他微微地耸了耸肩，扭动着试图挣脱。

meaning: v. 关闭，合上；把……关在；（使）停止运作，（使）停止营业；禁止通行，封闭；adj. 关闭的，关上的；打烊的，停止营业的；n. 关闭；【名】 （Shut）（俄）舒特（人名）
definition: 1. v. move so that an opening or passage is obstructed; make shut；2. adj. not open
example: This was a civilization that was not shut in on itself, but was in touch with the entire Mediterranean region.
exampleZh: 迈锡尼文明不是一个封闭的文明,它与整个地中海地区都有着联系

meaning: n. 航天飞机（space shuttle 的简称）；往返于两地的交通工具，摆渡车；（英法之间英吉利海峡隧道的）穿梭火车（the Shuttle）；（织机的）梭子；羽毛球（shuttlecock 的简称）；v. 穿梭，往返；穿梭运送
definition: 1. n. badminton equipment consisting of a ball of cork or rubber with a crown of feathers；2. v. travel back and forth between two points
example: The countdown has begun for the launch of the space shuttle.
exampleZh: 航天飞机发射前的倒计时已经开始。

meaning: adj. 害羞的，腼腆的；显得腼腆的，看着羞怯的；（动物）易受惊的，胆小的；犹豫的，有所顾忌的；躲避（或不喜欢）……的；不足的，缺乏的；在……之前（shy of）；（植物）开花不多的，结果很少的；v. （尤指马）惊退，惊逸；（由于紧张或缺乏信心而）回避，避开（shy from）； 投掷，扔；突然投出；n. （尤指马的）惊退，惊逸；投掷，扔； 以球打落椰子的游戏；【名】 （Shy）（英）夏伊（人名）
definition: 1. n. a quick throw；2. v. start suddenly, as from fight
example: If you keep that in mind, and if you're just not shy, I mean, of course you're shy. Everybody's shy.
exampleZh: 如果你能记住这个，而且你不害羞，当然你会害羞。所有人都会。

meaning: n. 羞怯，害羞，腼腆
definition: 1. n. a feeling of fear of embarrassment
example: It was very helpful for overcoming shyness and for just having a good time and being a little silly.
exampleZh: 这个课在克服害羞方面很有用，它让人很开心，也让人有点幽默。

meaning: adv. 害羞地，羞怯地，胆怯地；小心地
definition: 1. adv. in a shy or timid or bashful manner
example: "I wish I could go to sleep before you leave me," he said rather shyly.
exampleZh: “我希望在你离开我之前我能睡着。”他相当害羞地说。

meaning: adj. 生病的，患病的；病人的；恶心的，想吐的；不快的，恼怒的；厌倦的，厌烦的；（情感）强烈得令人不适的；（人）变态的，病态的；（故事、笑话等）令人毛骨悚然的，病态的；不祥的；（喻）（组织，体系，社团）面临严重问题的，不景气的； 极好的；渴望的；n. 病人（the sick）； 呕吐物；v. 呕吐；放狗咬； 派某人去追击（或监视、陪伴）；【名】 （Sick）（德、西）西克（人名）
definition: 1. n. people who are sick；2. v. eject the contents of the stomach through the mouth
example: So, it's a sick obsession with some of us, myself included. So with that said, what can you do?
exampleZh: 我们看起来对这个有近乎病态的强迫了，包括我在内，你们能什么？

meaning: v. 使大为震惊，使愤怒；使厌恶，使作呕；（使）患病，生病
definition: 1. v. cause aversion in; offend the moral sense of；2. v. get sick
example: When they saw that I did not sicken they grew afraid.
exampleZh: 当他们见到我安然无恙的时候，便开始害怕了。

meaning: n. 一旁，侧边；（相对中间而言的）边，侧；侧面；方面，情况；立场，意见；一方，一派；边缘；体侧，肋部；身旁，身边；（平面图形的）边；一面；内壁，内面；（立方体的）面；斜面，坡面；一面纸的文字；自负，傲慢；运动队，球队；母系，父系，血统；配菜；一扇（肉）；电视频道；（一对东西中的）一个，一只；（球的）侧旋；adj. 旁边的，侧面的；次要的，附带的；主菜外附加的；v. 支持，站在……一边；给......铺外墙板；给......装上侧面，形成......的侧面；【名】 （Side）（英）赛德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a place within a region identified relative to a center or reference location；2. v. take sides with; align oneself with; show strong sympathy for
example: On the right hand side, the work, let's call this left hand side, let's call this right hand side.
exampleZh: 在右手边，让我们先在这里,标下标表示左手，这里示右手。

meaning: adv. 斜向一边地；侧面朝前地，侧着；（工作调动）平级地；间接地；adj. 向一边（或一侧）的，向旁边的；（工作，职位）平级变动的；间接的；（观点）非常规的，非正统的
definition: 1. adj. (of movement) at an angle；2. adv. with one side forward or to the front
example: She sat sideways on the chair.
exampleZh: 她侧坐在椅子上。

meaning: n. （军队或警察对某地的）围困，包围；不断的攻击；v. 围攻，包围
definition: 1. n. the action of an armed force that surrounds a fortified place and isolates it while continuing to attack
example: And so they have this-- and Bismarck had predicted that the siege the whole thing would be over.
exampleZh: 他们吃的就是这个,俾斯麦预言道,巴黎城就将不攻自破

meaning: v. 叹气，叹息；（风）呼啸，呜咽；叹息着说； 渴望，思慕；n. 叹气，叹息（声）；（尤指风发出的）叹息般的声音
definition: 1. n. an utterance made by exhaling audibly；2. v. heave or utter a sigh; breathe deeply and heavily
example: As you know from reading your Pairy, the sigh reading has dialogue on personal identity and immortality.
exampleZh: 读，野狼战北，这本书，里面提到过关于人格同一性,和永生不死的对话。

meaning: n. 视力，视觉；看见，见到；视野，视域；景物，景象；名胜，景点（sights）；志向，目标；（枪或炮上的）瞄准器，（光学仪器的）观测器； 奇怪的人，滑稽的人（或事物）； 许多，大量； 观点，见解；v. （突然）看到，（远远）看见；把（枪）瞄准；（用观测器）观测；调整（火器）的瞄准器，调整（光学仪器）的观测器；adj. 见票即付的；即席的
definition: 1. n. an instance of visual perception；2. v. catch sight of; to perceive with the eyes
example: We've used the fundamental equations that are hiding down here, out of sight but never out of mind.
exampleZh: 我们利用了,写在这里的基本方程，虽然没有注意它但却时时刻刻记者它。

meaning: n. 观光，游览；adj. 观光的，游览的；v. 观光（sightsee 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. going about to look at places of interest
example: A sightseeing tour of the city is included to help you get your bearings.
exampleZh: 城市观光游包括在内，以帮助你们弄清方向。

meaning: n. 指示牌，标志；迹象，征兆；示意动作，手势；手语动作；符号，记号；踪迹，踪影；（医）征，体征；神迹（主要用于《圣经》和文学作品中）；（野生动物的）足迹，臭迹；（占星）（黄道12宫中的）宫，星座；（数）正负号；暗号，信号；（表示某人状况或经历的）动作，反应；v. 签名，署名；（与机构、公司等）签约；示意，打手势；打手语；用标志杆（或其他记号）表示
definition: 1. n. a perceptible indication of something not immediately apparent (as a visible clue that something has happened)；2. v. mark with one's signature; write one's name (on)
example: I'm looking at the small print; I don't want to sign anything that I shouldn't sign.
exampleZh: 我在读小体印刷的细则，我不想在不该签的文件上签字。

meaning: n. 签名，署名；签字，签署；鲜明特色，明显特征；（印刷）折标；书贴；标记，用法签（处方上说明药的用法的部分）；（音乐的）拍号；（音乐的）调号；adj. 标志性的，惯有的
definition: 1. n. your name written in your own handwriting；2. n. a distinguishing style
example: But, I also read a poem, and this is kind of a signature-- not my signature, but the kind of course it is.
exampleZh: 不过我还读了一首诗,算是一种签名,不是我的签名,是这种课程的

meaning: n. 信号，暗号；标志，预示；（尤指铁路和公路上的）指示灯，信号灯；（无线电、电视等的）讯号，信号；起因，导火线；（桥牌）信号；（传递的）信息；v. 发信号，示意；标志，预示；告知，表示；（车辆转方向时）打灯示意；adj. 重大的，显要的；作为信号的；【名】 （Signal）（瑞典）西格纳尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. any communication that encodes a message；2. v. communicate silently and non-verbally by signals or signs
example: This is a signal - this passing of phosphorous - is a signal that's used very frequently in intracellular communication.
exampleZh: 这是一种信号,一种通过磷酸来传递的信号,这种信号在细胞内通讯时经常被用到

meaning: adj. 显著的，相当数量的；重要的，意义重大的； 别有含义的，意味深长的；n. 象征，有意义的事物
definition: 1. adj. important in effect or meaning；2. adj. fairly large
example: Now, I think there's a deliberate confusion here about these lines because their precise historical significance isn't what's most significant.
exampleZh: 这里有一个刻意而为的困惑,是关于这些句子中严谨的历史意义的,而不是关于什么是最重要的。

meaning: n. 重要性，意义；意思，含义
definition: 1. n. the quality of being significant；2. n. a meaning that is not expressly stated but can be inferred
example: The new drug has great significance for the treatment of the disease.
exampleZh: 这种新药对于这种病的治疗有重大的意义。

meaning: v. 意味着，象征； 表达，显示（感情、意愿等）； 要紧，有重要性；（作为一种游戏或习俗，美国黑人之间）相互吹牛，相互辱骂
definition: 1. to be a sign of something; to mean；2. to make something known; to show
example: They always mean or signify far more than they're supposed to if their job is simply to make a comparison.
exampleZh: 他们总是比简单的完成一个比喻,而一位或者代表了更多的深层含义。

meaning: adj. （人）安静的，沉默的；沉默寡言的，不爱说话的；（事物）无声的，寂静的；（情感、行为等）不用言语表达的，默默的；只字不提的，不愿讲的；（电影）无声的；（字母）不发音的；（疾病或问题等）悄然的，无症状的
definition: 1. adj. marked by absence of sound；2. adj. failing to speak or communicate etc when expected to
example: And, it follows from him that political liberty means the freedom to act where the law is silent, as he says.
exampleZh: 而他的政治自由意味着,我们可以在法律所认可的范畴内,享有充分的行动自由。

meaning: n. 寂静，无声；沉默，默不作声；保持沉默，拒绝回答；无音信，失去联系；默哀，静默；v. 使安静，使不说话；压制，使不再发表（反对意见）；杀……灭口；给（枪，排气系统）装消音器；int. （用以让人们安静）安静，静下来
definition: 1. n. the state of being silent (as when no one is speaking)；2. v. cause to be quiet or not talk
example: This is Barth's effort to enclose the silence into something readable, to contain that impossibility in the structure of the story.
exampleZh: 这是巴斯想把沉默嵌套到某些可阅读的的，在故事的结构中包含一些不可能的努力。

meaning: n. 硅（一种化学元素，符号为 Si）
definition: 1. n. a tetravalent nonmetallic element; next to oxygen it is the most abundant element in the earth's crust; occurs in clay and feldspar and granite and quartz and sand; used as a semiconductor in transistors
example: The new chip will be made from a piece of silicon about the size of a postage stamp.
exampleZh: 这种新的芯片将由大约邮票大小的一块硅片制成。

meaning: n. 丝绸，丝线；（骑手在赛马时穿的）彩色丝绸赛马服（silks）；绸制赛马帽顶（盖）；王室律师；（雌玉米穗的）穗丝；蜘蛛丝；adj. 丝的，丝制的；vi. （玉米）处于长须的阶段中；【名】 （Silk）（英、瑞典）西尔克（人名）
definition: 1. n. a fabric made from the fine threads produced by certain insect larvae；2. n. fibers from silkworm cocoons provide threads for knitting
example: You can see that wonderful coat and silk bowtie.
exampleZh: 你们看这漂亮大衣和丝质领结。

meaning: adj. 丝制的，丝绸的；丝绸一样的，柔软光洁的；（声音）柔和的，轻柔的；（食物）口感软滑的；（行动）平稳的，流畅的；adv. 光洁地，光滑地
definition: 1. adj. having a smooth, gleaming surface
example: The textile is a lovely, silky fiber made from waste material left after soybeans are used to make Tofu.
exampleZh: 这种纺织品是一种可爱的、柔滑的纤维，它是用大豆做豆腐剩下的废材制成的。

meaning: n. 银；银器（尤指餐具）；银币；银（白）色；银牌（silver medal 的简写）；adj. 银（白）色的；银制的，含银的，（有关）银的；二十五周年纪念的，银婚纪念的；口才流利的；v. 镀（或包）银于；使具有银色光泽，使变成银色；使（头发）变成银灰色（或银白色）；【名】 （Silver）（法）西尔韦，（英、德、芬、瑞典）西尔弗（人名）
definition: 1. n. a soft white precious univalent metallic element having the highest electrical and thermal conductivity of any metal; occurs in argentite and in free form; used in coins and jewelry and tableware and photography；2. v. coat with a layer of silver or a silver amalgam
example: In an aqueous solution, he passes electric current and causes silver ions to deposit and form metallic silver.
exampleZh: 在水溶液中，他接通电流，这得银离子,沉淀，并形成金属银。

meaning: adj. 银色的，似银的；（声音）清脆的，银铃般悦耳的
definition: 1. adj. of lustrous grey; covered with or tinged with the color of silver；2. adj. resembling or reminiscent of silver
example: My father is a small, intense man with silvery hair.
exampleZh: 我父亲是个热情的人，小个子，满头银发。

meaning: adj. 相像的，类似的；（几何图形）相似的；n. 相似之人（或物）；顺势药物（指疗效与某些疾病症状相似的药物，为顺势疗法的基础）
definition: 1. adj. marked by correspondence or resemblance；2. adj. having the same or similar characteristics
example: And I've seen other similar things where commercial photography, photo journalism and all that stuff is up there,
exampleZh: 我也见过很多商业摄影师，记者摄影师，等等，都是

meaning: n. 相似性；相似点，类似的地方
definition: 1. n. the quality of being similar；2. n. a Gestalt principle of organization holding that (other things being equal) parts of a stimulus field that are similar to each other tend to be perceived as belonging together as a unit
example: What are we to make of the incredible similarity of Israel's deity and cult to those of her neighbors?
exampleZh: 我们怎么样解释以色列的神与,它邻国宗教的相似性？

meaning: adj. 简单的，简明的；简朴的，朴素的；纯粹的，完全的；结构单一的，简易的；普通的，平凡的；愚笨的，迟钝的；（动词时态）简单的；（数）简单的；（叶、茎）没有分杈的；（镜头、显微镜等）单镜头的；（利息）单利的；（句子）无从句的；n. 草药，药草；出身低微者；笨蛋；【名】 （Simple）（法）桑普勒（人名）
definition: 1. n. any herbaceous plant having medicinal properties；2. adj. having few parts; not complex or complicated or involved
example: So it's a really powerful and simple formalism, once we set up what is needed the go through it, right?
exampleZh: 因此这是一种很强大而简单的形式,一旦我们定下需要什么,就可以推导出它，对吧？

meaning: n. 简单（性)，容易（性）；简朴，朴素；简单（或质朴、朴素）之处；愚蠢，无知
definition: 1. n. the quality of being simple or uncompounded；2. n. a lack of penetration or subtlety
example: Using plastic to pay for an order is simplicity itself.
exampleZh: 使用信用卡支付订单本身就很简单。

meaning: v. 使简易，简化
definition: 1. v. make simpler or easier or reduce in complexity or extent
example: And here we already see a hint that make is going to simplify all of that for us.
exampleZh: 所以我们刚学习了怎样简化,操作的一个方法。

meaning: adv. 仅仅，只，不过；简直，的确； 简单地，简明地；朴素地，简朴地
definition: 1. adv. and nothing more；2. adv. absolutely; altogether; really
example: They are very aggressive to be type-A people who just simply made two extra hours out of their 24-hour day.
exampleZh: 他们渴望成为上等人,甚至希望每天,能多过两个小时。

meaning: v. 假装，冒充；模拟，模仿；看上去像；计算机模拟；adj. 虚假的，假装的
definition: 1. to do or make something that looks real but is not real；2. to create conditions or processes similar to something that exists
example: The scientist developed one model to simulate a full year of the globe's climate.
exampleZh: 这位科学家研制出一个模型，能模拟全年地球的气候。

meaning: n. 模拟，仿造物；假装，冒充
definition: 1. a model of a set of problems or events that can be used to teach someone how to do something, or the process of making such a model；2. in football, the act of pretending to have been fouled to try to win a penalty or free kick unfairly
example: What I'm more interested in here than in the result of the simulation, is the process of creating it.
exampleZh: 然后你们可以进行思考,我对这些过程，比对仿真程序的结果更感兴趣。

meaning: adj. 同时发生的，同步的
definition: 1. happening or being done at exactly the same time；2. happening or existing at exactly the same time
example: Some hypotheses fail to account for simultaneous extinctions on land and in the seas.
exampleZh: 有些假说不能解释同时发生在陆地和海洋的灭绝。

meaning: n. （违背宗教或道德的）罪，罪恶；过错，过失；v. 犯戒律，犯过失；亵渎，冒犯（上帝，人，原则）（sin against）；abbr. 正弦（sine 的缩写）；【名】 （Sin）（罗）西恩，（匈）欣，（柬、阿拉伯）辛，（缅）信（人名）
definition: 1. n. estrangement from god；2. v. commit a sin; violate a law of God or a moral law
example: And why is that? Within the perspective of Milton's free-will theology, sin can't exist as an external reality.
exampleZh: 为什么呢？从弥尔顿自由意志的学说的角度来看，原罪是不可能以永久现实的形式存在的。

meaning: prep. 自……以后，自……以来；（表示气愤）何曾，什么时候；conj. 在……以后，自……以来；因为，由于，既然；adv. 自……以后，自……以来；此后，后来；n. （Since）（法、美）新斯（人名）
definition: 1. abstract: Since may refer to the following places:
example: And so to see somebody so prolific and who's been that way since he was a teenager, I mean,
exampleZh: 所以，（我们）看到这样一个从青年时期就多产的作家，我的意思是，

meaning: adj. 衷心的，诚挚的；（人）真诚的，诚恳的
definition: 1. adj. open and genuine; not deceitful；2. adj. characterized by a firm and humorless belief in the validity of your opinions
example: He had a way of sounding so sincere. It made me warm and tingly.
exampleZh: 他的话听起来如此真诚。这让我觉得温暖而舒心。

meaning: n. 真诚，真挚
definition: 1. n. an earnest and sincere feeling；2. n. the quality of being open and truthful; not deceitful or hypocritical
example: I was impressed with his deep sincerity.
exampleZh: 让我铭记在心的是他深切的诚意。

meaning: v. 唱（歌），演唱；鸣，啼；呜呜作响，发出嗖嗖声；（向警方）告密；（尤指用诗歌等文学作品）歌颂，赞颂；n. 唱歌，演唱； 业余演唱会；鸣声，呼啸声；abbr. 单数（singular 的缩写形式）；【名】 （Sing）（老、德、泰）辛（人名）
definition: 1. v. deliver by singing；2. v. produce tones with the voice
example: And it's virgins who get to sing the nuptial song at the wedding of the lamb that John also envisions.
exampleZh: 只有处子才可以在约翰想象,的羔羊婚礼上唱这首婚礼之歌。

meaning: n. 歌手，歌唱家；Singer（英语姓氏或人名，译名有“桑热”，常见“辛格”）
definition: 1. n. a person who sings；2. n. United States inventor of an improved chain-stitch sewing machine (1811-1875)
example: The Heart responds.] The Heart. What, be a singer born and lack a theme?
exampleZh: 心回应道],心：什么，一个天生的歌唱家怎能缺少一个旋律？

meaning: adj. 单一的，单个的；单身的，未婚的；各自的，分别的；单人的，单人用的；（票）单程的；统一的；由一个部分构成的；（花）单瓣的；唯一的；（酒的）一份；n. 单曲唱片；（板球中的）一分打，（棒球中的）一垒打；单身者，未婚者； 单程票；（旅馆等的）单人房间；单打（比赛）； 一元纸币；（鸣钟术）不同次序鸣钟法；（影剧院的）一张票，一个座位；一份酒；v. 挑选，选出；（棒球）击出一垒打；对（幼苗，幼树）进行间苗；将（铁轨）变成单线；以一垒打使（跑垒）得分
definition: 1. n. a base hit on which the batter stops safely at first base；2. v. hit a single
example: because he directed a movie that went to the Oscars last year called "A Simple..."，"A Single Man". I'm sorry.
exampleZh: 因为他去年导演的电影《简单...》，是《单身男人》入围了奥斯卡。我很抱歉。

meaning: adj. 单数的，单数形式的；非凡的，突出的；奇怪的，异常的；独一无二的，独特的；（数）（方阵）零行列式的；n. 单数，单数形式（the singular）
definition: 1. n. the form of a word that is used to denote a singleton；2. adj. unusual or striking
example: 'I am' is the first person singular of the present tense of the verb 'to be'.
exampleZh: I am是动词to be现在时的第一人称单数。

meaning: n. 奇特，奇怪；单一，独特；（数，物理）奇点
definition: 1. n. the quality of being one of a kind；2. n. strangeness by virtue of being remarkable or unusual
example: It would be wonderful to observe a singularity and obtain direct evidence of the undoubtedly bizarre phenomena that occur near one.
exampleZh: 如果能观察到一颗奇点，并获取关于奇点附近出现的可信的怪异现象的直接证据，那将非常好。

meaning: adj. 邪恶的，不祥的；（纹章）（在）盾形纹章左侧的
definition: 1. making you feel that something bad or evil might happen；2. evil, or suggesting that something evil is going to happen
example: Even the sinister bio-mimicry of the Preying Mantis, luring unsuspecting pollinators to their death, has a beautiful symmetry to it.
exampleZh: 即使是邪恶的捕食螳螂，它用以引诱不知情者上钩的拟态，也是一个美丽的对称形态。

meaning: v. 下沉，沉没；使失败，受挫；下降，下陷；倒下，坐下；衰退，恶化；渗透，渐渐陷入；减少，降低；（声音）变低，变小；堕落，沉沦；挖掘；插入，打入；投进，滚进；投资；喝（酒）；adj. 贫困的，贫民窟的；n. 水槽，水池；洼地，渗坑；位于社会贫困地区的学校或房产；藏垢的场所；汇，壑；【名】 （Sink）（美、英、罗）辛克（人名）
definition: 1. n. plumbing fixture consisting of a water basin fixed to a wall or floor and having a drainpipe；2. v. fall or drop to a lower place or level
example: So realize if it doesn't quite sink in today, not a problems in terms of these low level details.
exampleZh: 如果你们没有完全吸收我今天讲的内容，没关系,这些小细节都会在习题集中找得到。

meaning: v. 小口喝，抿；n. 一小口（饮料），一啜之量；【名】 (Sip) （美、荷）西普（人名）
definition: 1. n. a small drink；2. v. drink in sips
example: He took a sip of the medicine and screwed up his face.
exampleZh: 他喝了一小口药后做了个怪相。

meaning: n. 先生，长官（尤指对上级的尊称）；老师（学生对男教师的称呼）；先生，阁下（正式或商业信函开头的称呼）（Dear Sir）；爵士（用于爵士或准男爵名字之前）（Sir）；决不，的确（no/yes sir）（同 siree）；【名】 （苏丹、德）西尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. term of address for a man；2. n. a title used before the name of knight or baronet
example: Sir, we ought to teach the people that they are doing wrong in worshipping the images and pictures in the temple."
exampleZh: 先生，我们应该告诫人们，他们不应该,崇敬寺庙里的肖像或照片“

meaning: n. 姐姐，妹妹；（称志同道合者）姐妹；（女权运动中的）姐妹；姊妹，大姐，妹妹（妇女对其他妇女表示友好和支持时的用语）；姐妹，大姐，妹子（用作女性间的称呼）；大姐，小妹（美国黑人妇女之间使用的称呼）；修女，女教友（Sister）；护士（长）（Sister）；（美国大学）女生联谊会会员；（尤指组织之间的）姐妹（关系）；adj. 同类的，同质的，如同姐妹的
definition: 1. n. a female person who has the same parents as another person；2. n. (Roman Catholic Church) a title given to a nun (and used as a form of address)
example: I haven't seen it, but one of my sister's favourite films. So yeah, I think, all these cultures,
exampleZh: 我没有看过，但是它是我姐姐最喜欢的电影之一。所以，我认为，所有的这些文化，

meaning: v. 坐下，就座；能容纳，可坐（……人）；为……做模特；（比赛）不用（某选手）；（狗等动物）蹲坐；处在，坐落在； 担任职务，当委员；开会，开庭；参加（考试）；照看小孩；n. 坐的一段时间；（衣服的）合身；【名】 （Sit）（美、加）西特（人名）
definition: 1. v. be seated；2. v. sit around, often unused
example: it's like really, forest sit on that side, so it's really nice to sit down and read a book or something.
exampleZh: 那一边简直就像是一片森林，在那里坐下来看看书或干点别的什么将会是件很美妙的事情。

meaning: n. 坐着（做某事）的一段时间；（一次）供人画像（照相）的时间；一批，一次（就餐时间）；（法庭的）开庭，（议会的）开会；孵卵；adj. 坐的，坐着做的；（母鸡，鸟）孵蛋的，伏窝的；现任的，在任期内的；易击中的；（动物）蹲着的，（鸟）停落的；v. 坐，坐下；使就座；坐落在，位于（sit 的现在分词形式）；【名】 (Sitting) （美、加）西特（人名）
definition: 1. n. (photography) the act of assuming a certain position (as for a photograph or portrait)；2. adj. (of persons) having the torso erect and legs bent with the body supported on the buttocks
example: you get more of...you already have things that you want to talk about, going in, sitting down to dinner.
exampleZh: 你会得到更多……走进去，坐下来吃顿饭的同时，你已经想好要聊哪些话题了，

meaning: n. （建筑的）工地，用地；（某事发生的）地点，现场；（作某种用途的）场所，场地；网站，站点（=website）；（身体的某个）部位；（城镇、建筑物或纪念碑的）地基，选址；遗址，原址；（帐篷或大篷车内）歇脚的地方；v. 使坐落在，为......选址
definition: 1. n. the piece of land on which something is located (or is to be located)；2. v. assign a location to
example: So it's built only a few metres away from the site of the original Shakespeare Globe of the 1600s.
exampleZh: 它建在离十七世纪修建的莎士比亚环球剧院几米之外的地方。

meaning: n. 情况，形势；重要问题，突发情况；（建筑物或城镇的）地理位置，环境特点；工作，职位
definition: 1. n. the general state of things; the combination of circumstances at a given time；2. n. a condition or position in which you find yourself
example: One is a little bit higher and one is a little bit lower than they are in the atomic situation.
exampleZh: 一个有点高,一个有点低,相比他们是原子状态的情景而言。

meaning: v. 使位于，使坐落于；把.......放在（特殊的环境中），把......跟（具体情境）联系；处于（某特定经济或婚姻）状况（be situated）；adj. 位于……的，坐落在……的
definition: 1. v. determine or indicate the place, site, or limits of, as if by an instrument or by a survey；2. v. put (something somewhere) firmly
example: How do we situate Christianity in the context of modern physics and psychology?
exampleZh: 我们如何将基督教置于现代物理学和心理学的背景中呢？

meaning: num. 六，数字 6；六个；六个人（或物）一组；六岁；六点钟；n. （Six）西克斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. the cardinal number that is the sum of five and one；2. adj. denoting a quantity consisting of six items or units
example: We're moving into the large on-term across next term where we'll teach 600 students in six sections, of about 100 each.
exampleZh: 我们准备下学期,搬去更大的地方,就能一次教六个班的学生，每个班100人左右。

meaning: num. 十六，十六个；adj. 十六的，十六个的
definition: 1. n. the cardinal number that is the sum of fifteen and one；2. adj. being one more than fifteen
example: I was probably, I think, sixteen when I went, so this was several, several years ago.
exampleZh: 那时我才十六岁，那是几年前的事了。

meaning: num. 六十，六十个；六十岁；n. （仅复数 sixties）六十几；六十多岁；the sixties 指二十世纪六十年代
definition: 1. n. the cardinal number that is the product of ten and six；2. adj. being ten more than fifty
example: Sixty-six, right 'cause we've got one in the 64's column 1 and a one in the two's column, okay.
exampleZh: 6，因为我们在64那列得到一个,和在2列得到一个。

meaning: n. 大小，尺寸；庞大，巨大；数量，规模；（尤指衣服、鞋子等的）尺寸，尺码；特定尺寸；相应尺码的人（或衣物）；（使纸张、布料坚挺且光亮的）浆料，（贴壁纸用的）涂料；v. 依大小分类（或排列）；按一定大小制作；改变......的大小； 给（衣服、纸张等）上浆，给......涂胶； 大致评价，估量；估算（或测量某物）大小；可比拟；adj. 一定大小（或尺码）的
