definition: 1. n. the physical magnitude of something (how big it is)；2. v. cover or stiffen or glaze a porous material with size or sizing (a glutinous substance)
example: An entry is made in the memo whenever an item, memo and an available size pair is considered.
exampleZh: 每当选择一件物品和考虑，一种可行的方案时，都会访问。

meaning: adj. 相当大的，颇大的
definition: 1. adj. fairly large；2. adj. large in amount or extent or degree
example: Harry inherited the house and a sizable piece of land that surrounds it.
exampleZh: 哈里继承了那座房子和房子周围一块相当大的土地。

meaning: n. 溜冰鞋，滑冰鞋； 四轮溜冰鞋，旱冰鞋；（滑冰鞋上的）冰刀；（载笨重物的）滑板车；滑板（skateboard 的简称）；鳐鱼（一种扁平状海鱼）；鳐鱼肉；（南非）声名狼藉的粗鲁白人；v. 滑冰，溜冰；在滑板上滑行，溜出（花样）；滑行；一笔带过，回避（skate over/round）；（喻）一蹴而就（skate through）；【名】 （Skate）（美、俄、墨）斯卡特（人名）
definition: 1. n. sports equipment that is worn on the feet to enable the wearer to glide along and to be propelled by the alternate actions of the legs；2. v. move along on skates
example: I would like to, sometime before we move out of New York. I would like to ice skate there.
exampleZh: 我也想在我们搬出纽约前去一次。我想在那儿溜冰。

meaning: n. 滑冰，溜冰，滑板；v. 滑冰，溜冰；在滑板上滑行，溜出（花样）；滑行（skate 的现在分词）
definition: 1. n. the sport of gliding on skates
example: There's a lot of, you know, surfing, water sports, skating, stuff like that that I like to do.
exampleZh: 可以经常，你知道，可以冲浪、水上运动、滑冰，我喜欢做的那些事。

meaning: n. 骨骼，骨架；梗概，提纲；骨瘦如柴的人（或动物）；（建筑物、桥梁等的）框架，骨架；（维持运转所需的）最少人员，基干人员；钢架雪车；adj. （员工）最基本的，基干的
definition: 1. n. something reduced to its minimal form；2. n. a scandal that is kept secret
example: So, let's go ahead and draw our Lewis structure based on the rest of the rules now that we have a skeleton.
exampleZh: 那么，让我们继续画我们的路易斯结构,看看在得到骨架之后还有哪些规则。

meaning: adj. 不相信的，持怀疑态度的；（哲）怀疑论的，不可知论的
definition: 1. doubting that something is true or useful
example: If you're still skeptical about exercising, we can only ask you to trust us and give it a try.
exampleZh: 如果你仍对锻炼持怀疑态度，我们只能请你相信我们，试一试。
family: skeptical / sceptical / skeptic / sceptic / skepticism / scepticism

meaning: n. （对一切都）持怀疑态度的人；怀疑论者，不可知论者；无神论者；adj. 不相信的，持怀疑态度的；怀疑论的，不可知论的
definition: 1. a person who doubts the truth or value of an idea or belief
example: A skeptic might conclude that practitioners are afraid to lay their beliefs on the line.
exampleZh: 持怀疑态度的人可能会得出结论说，从业人员害怕坦白自己的信念。
family: skeptical / sceptical / skeptic / sceptic / skepticism / scepticism

meaning: 怀疑态度；怀疑主义
definition: 1. doubt that something is true or useful
example: This question of determinism is as important in the discourse of literary theory as the question of skepticism.
exampleZh: 在文学理论的话语中,决定论的问题和怀疑论的问题是同等重要的。
family: skeptical / sceptical / skeptic / sceptic / skepticism / scepticism

meaning: n. 素描，速写，草图；（任何作品的）粗样，初稿；简述，概述；幽默短剧，滑稽小品；滑稽的人（或物）；v. （给……）画速写，（给……）画素描；简述，概述；（用手或身体）做（姿势）；【名】 （Sketch）（英）斯凯奇（人名）
definition: 1. n. preliminary drawing for later elaboration；2. v. make a sketch of
example: She drew a sketch map of the area to show us the way.
exampleZh: 她画了一幅这个地区的略图，用来给我们指路。

meaning: adj. 粗略的，不完全的；（绘画）素描似的；破落的，声名狼藉的
definition: 1. adj. giving only major points; lacking completeness
example: I was kind of skeptical because, you know, you just hear about how bad it is and how sketchy but,
exampleZh: 我有点怀疑，因为你知道，总是能听说交通多么不完善，

meaning: n. 滑雪（水）板；（车辆的）滑橇；水橇，滑水撬（=waterski）；v. 滑雪，滑水；adj. 滑雪的，滑水的
definition: 1. n. narrow wood or metal or plastic runners used in pairs for gliding over snow；2. v. move along on skis
example: so we decided not to go because the ski season is over.
exampleZh: 所以我们决定不去了，因为滑雪季节过去了。

meaning: n. 滑雪运动，滑水运动；v. 滑雪，滑水（ski 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. a sport in which participants must travel on skis
example: Mike actually holds the world record for downhill speed skiing for blind person, which is 60 miles an hour.
exampleZh: 实际上,迈克是盲人高山滑雪的记录保持者，速度达到了每小时60英里。

meaning: n. 技巧， 技艺；（特定的）技术，技能；v. 培训（工人）；【名】 （Skill）（瑞典）希尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. an ability that has been acquired by training；2. n. ability to produce solutions in some problem domain
example: I suppose to a lesser literacy skill of being a good listener or viewer and have information push condensed.
exampleZh: 假设一名优秀的聆听者,或观众需要较少的文化素养,我会将信息压缩。

meaning: adj. 有技巧的，熟练的；制作精良的，处理巧妙的
definition: 1. adj. having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
example: Advertisers are skilful at creating the impression of loudness through their expert use of such factors.
exampleZh: 广告商熟练地运用这些因素来创造响度印象。

meaning: adj. 熟练的，有技能的；技术性的，需要熟练技术的
definition: 1. adj. having or showing or requiring special skill
example: You could look at what it does but babies are not very coordinated or skilled so you need to use clever methods.
exampleZh: 你可以观察婴儿,但婴儿不怎么配合,或者说他们的言语技能并不熟练,所以你必须要用精巧的方法才能做到

meaning: v. （从液体表面）撇去（浮物）；掠过，擦过（表面）；用（扁石）打水漂；略读，浏览；略微讨论（或处理）（skim over）；（尤指一段时间内）挪用（小数额钱）；盗用（信用卡电子信息）；n. 液面上的表层物；浏览；脱脂品（尤指脱脂奶）；adj. 脱脂的；撇去浮沫的；【名】 （Skim）（美）史奇姆（人名）
definition: 1. to move quickly just above a surface without touching it；2. to throw a flat stone horizontally over water so that it touches and rises off the surface several times
example: Now if you read down, if you sort of skim down, you'll see that kind of language applied to critics.
exampleZh: 如果你阅读下去，如果你浏览下去，你会看到批判的语言的运用。

meaning: n. 皮，皮肤；兽皮，皮毛；（水果或蔬菜的）外皮；香肠衣；（液体表面凝结的）薄皮，薄层；（建筑物、飞机等的）外壳；卷烟纸；（软件、网站等的）界面，皮肤；光头；（盛液体的）皮囊；雪橇外皮，防滑底层（用海豹皮或其他材料做成，系于雪橇下侧以防攀登时向后滑动）；（尤作爵士乐用语）鼓，鼓面；色情文学作品（或影片）；斯金牌戏（每一位玩牌者有一张牌，各自打赌这张牌不会是第一张与发出的牌配对）；v. 剥皮，削皮；擦破（身体某部位）；（伤口）长出新皮；皮肤愈合；（选手）轻松过球；彻底击败，轻易击败（对手）；骗取（某人的）钱财；制作大麻香烟（skin up）
definition: 1. n. a natural protective body covering and site of the sense of touch；2. v. climb awkwardly, as if by scrambling
example: Exposure to strong sunlight can damage the skin and increase the risk of disease.
exampleZh: 暴露在强烈阳光下会损伤皮肤并增加患病风险。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: adj. 极瘦的，皮包骨的；（衣服）紧身的；低脂肪的，加脱脂奶的；n. 骨瘦如柴的人，瘦骨嶙峋的人；内部消息，机密情报（the skinny）；紧身牛仔裤或长裤（skinnies）；【名】 （Skinny）（俄、美、澳、加、荷）斯金尼（人名）
definition: 1. n. confidential information about a topic or person；2. adj. being very thin
example: I just come back with my black coffee and my double espresso mocha latte skinny frothed, except it isn't espresso.
exampleZh: 我回到桌位上，双手拿着我的黑咖啡,和一杯双倍浓度无咖啡因少泡沫的穆哈咖啡，其实不是无咖啡因的。

meaning: v. 蹦蹦跳跳地走；跳绳；不做（应做的事等），不参加；跳过，略过；快速转移，骤然转换（话题）；悄悄溜走，突然离开；打水漂；当（运动队的）领队；n. 蹦跳；（计算机）跳跃（进位），跳行；违约者，讨债者； 废料桶；罐笼，箕斗，吊斗；（草地滚木球或冰壶运动队的）领队，队长；【名】 （Skip）人名，（英）斯基普
definition: 1. n. a gait in which steps and hops alternate；2. v. bypass
example: So I'm going to read just parts, and I'm going to skip around a little bit and stop and start: How to enjoy James Joyce's great novel, Ulysses.
exampleZh: 我会读其中一些部分，再读一下一些其他内容,然后再停下来讲：,“怎么欣赏詹姆斯，乔伊斯伟大的小说《尤利西斯》

meaning: n. 女裙，半身裙；（连衣裙、外衣等的）下摆（skirts）；（车辆或机器基座的）挡板，裙板；（供食用的）多筋动物肉； 腰窝肉；（马鞍的）垂边；v. 环绕……的四周，沿……的边缘走；绕开，回避（话题）
definition: 1. n. cloth covering that forms the part of a garment below the waist；2. v. avoid or try to avoid fulfilling, answering, or performing (duties, questions, or issues)
example: and you have to have the right pants and skirt and things like that, a tie.
exampleZh: 而且你必须穿对了裤子裙子那一类东西，还有领带。

meaning: n. 颅骨，头骨；脑袋，头脑；v. 击中（某人的）头
definition: 1. the bones of the head that surround the brain and give the head its shape；2. the bones of the head that surround the brain, or infml someone’s mind or head
example: It's not as though what the scientist did was open up my skull,take the brain out.
exampleZh: 并不是那个科学家把我的头颅打开把大脑取出来。

meaning: n. 天，天空；天堂，天国之力；v. 把（球）击向空中；（尤指在展览中）把（画）高挂在墙上；踢或击高空球；把桨叶翘得过高；飞涨；【名】 （Sky）（英）斯凯（人名）
definition: 1. n. the atmosphere and outer space as viewed from the earth；2. v. throw or toss with a light motion
example: Actually, I suppose to get ideally married under the open sky, under a Chuppah, gather people under the open sky.
exampleZh: 实际上，我理想中的婚礼就是,在户外的天空和犹太传统的彩棚下进行，人们聚集在蓝天下。

meaning: n. （建筑物或群山在天空映衬下的）轮廓线
definition: 1. n. the outline of objects seen against the sky；2. n. the line at which the sky and Earth appear to meet
example: As I arrived, the shimmering skyline of domes and minarets was imprinted on my memory.
exampleZh: 当我到达时，穹顶和尖塔形成的泛着微光的空中轮廓线铭刻在我的记忆中。

meaning: n. 摩天大楼
definition: 1. n. a very tall building with many stories
example: The NEC's skyscraper and its gadgetry are controlled in the basement.
exampleZh: 日本电气公司的摩天大楼及其所有电子设备系统都在地下室进行管控。

meaning: adj. 不紧的，松弛的；（生意）萧条的，清淡的；懈怠的，敷衍了事的；（潮水）迟缓的，平缓的；淫荡的，下流的；n. （绳索的）松弛部分；富余部分，闲置部分；裤子（slacks）；煤屑；懈怠，懒散；v. 懈怠，偷懒；使（绳索等）松弛；减缓，放慢；熟化（石灰）；缓慢（或懒散地）工作；【名】 （Slack）（美）斯莱克（人名）
definition: 1. not tight; loose；2. showing little activity; not busy or happening in a positive way
example: Because if they work any harder than that, then the other person is just going to slack off instead.
exampleZh: 因为我们知道如果自己超额完成工作,其他人就可以少做点工作了

meaning: v. （使）砰地关上；用力一放，使劲一推；猛烈撞击；猛烈抨击；突然（或猛然）采取行动；闯，冲； 轻松得分或战胜（某人）； （电话公司）未经允许接管（电话顾客）的账单（slamming）；n. 猛关（或推、摔、撞等），猛摔（或撞等）的声音； 诗歌朗诵比赛；（桥牌）满贯； 监狱（the slam）；【名】 （Slam）（俄、美）斯拉姆（人名）
definition: 1. to (cause to) move against a hard surface with force and usually a loud noise；2. to criticize
example: People differ to the extent it will hurt them to watch me slam my thumb with a hammer.
exampleZh: 不同的人看到我用锤子打拇指,会感受到不同程度的痛苦。

meaning: v. （用手掌）打，拍；拍打，拍击；（尤指生气地）啪的一声放下，随意扔放；（快速地、随意地或用力地）涂抹（某物）；甩击；侮辱；n. 拍，掌击；掌击声，拍打声；（厚厚地或随意涂抹的）化妆品；侮辱；adv. 直接地，猛然； 恰好，正好；adj. 精力不足的，效率不高的；（食物）松软的，过于柔软的
definition: 1. n. a blow from a flat object (as an open hand)；2. v. hit with something flat, like a paddle or the open hand
example: That's going to presumably be given--mathematically if we gave it a number, we'd slap a zero on that.
exampleZh: 如果用数学解释,给它一个数字，给它一个零。

meaning: v. （用利器）砍，劈；大幅度削减，大大降低；严厉批评，抨击；猛力移动，袭击；n. （用刀等）砍，劈；（长而窄的）伤口，砍痕；斜杠，斜线号； 撒尿，小便；装饰性开叉；（喻）明亮的条纹（或色线）； 残留枝桠；沼泽低地
definition: 1. to cut with a sharp blade using a quick, strong movement；2. in ice hockey, to hit or try to hit another player with the stick by swinging it, which is against the rules and results in a penalty (= punishment)
example: Right, so there's that special sentinel value that's back slash zero, which we'll start to see more explicitly now.
exampleZh: 对的，这里有一个特殊的值“反斜杠0“,我们等下会更了解它。

meaning: n. （对动物的）屠宰；（对人的）屠杀；彻底击败，一边倒的比赛；v. 宰杀（动物）；屠杀，杀戮；（在体育比赛中）使惨败；严厉批评；【名】 （Slaughter）（美）斯劳特（人名）
definition: 1. the killing of many people cruelly and unfairly, especially in a war；2. the killing of animals for meat
example: Lack of chicken feed means that chicken farms are having to slaughter their stock.
exampleZh: 饲料不足意味着养鸡场将不得不宰杀鸡。

meaning: n. 奴隶，苦工；完全受（某事物）控制的人；从动装置；v. 苦干，拼命干；使（装置）从属于（另一装置）；【名】 （Slave）（塞、罗）斯拉韦（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person who is owned by someone；2. v. work very hard, like a slave
example: There's this deep religious tradition that came out of Slave Religion, but there is also a deep anger. -Yes. Yes.
exampleZh: 在《奴隶宗教》这本书中,既有深深的宗教传统，又有一种怒火，-的确如此。

meaning: n. 奴隶制，蓄奴；奴隶身份，奴役；过分依赖，过分投入
definition: 1. n. the state of being under the control of another person；2. n. the practice of owning slaves
example: You can read Jeremiah and Isaiah and some of the great Old Testament prophets in some ways as defenders of slavery.
exampleZh: 你可以读一读耶利米书和以赛亚书,在《旧约》中,还有些在某些方面,作为奴隶制拥护者的的伟大先知们的著作

meaning: v. 睡，睡觉；供……住宿；（尤指入夜后某地或建筑物）沉寂，静寂；安息，安眠；发生性关系；n. 睡眠，睡觉；（一段）睡眠时间；眵，眼屎；死，长眠；【名】 （Sleep）斯利普（姓氏）
definition: 1. n. a natural and periodic state of rest during which consciousness of the world is suspended；2. v. be asleep
example: We see Dean sort of begging for sleep after his conversation with Carlo Marx in the basement in Denver.
exampleZh: 我们看到迪恩在丹佛与卡洛马克思在地下室里谈话之后,几乎是有点在祈求睡眠。

meaning: adj. 困倦的，想睡的；（城镇或地区）寂静的，冷清的；（生意，组织，工业）没有活力的，呆滞的
definition: 1. adj. ready to fall asleep
example: In Italy, obviously, Milan and Turin were terribly important cities, and Rome, which is just sort of a sleepy, ecclesiastical capital full of tourists and clergy.
exampleZh: 在意大利,最重要的城市,显然就是米兰和都灵,还有罗马,这个城市只是一座,充斥着观光者和神职人员的教会都城

meaning: n. 睡意，瞌睡，想睡
definition: 1. n. a very sleepy state
example: Most experts in sleep behavior agree that there is virtually an epidemic of sleepiness in the nation.
exampleZh: 大多数研究睡眠行为的专家都认为，在这个国家，嗜睡实际上是一种流行病。

meaning: n. 袖子；袖套；（机器的）套筒，套管；唱片套；风向袋；（机尾的）减速伞，制动伞；v. 给……装套筒
definition: 1. n. the part of a garment that is attached at the armhole and that provides a cloth covering for the arm；2. n. small case into which an object fits
example: I don't have any more philosophical arguments up my sleeve on this issue.
exampleZh: 我已两手空空，拿不出什么哲学论调了。

meaning: adj. 苗条的，纤细的；（尤指竿、枝或茎）细长的，狭窄的；微薄的，不足的
definition: 1. adj. being of delicate or slender build；2. adj. very narrow
example: The blind Fury here is the mythological figure Atropos; this is the Fate that cuts the slender thread by which our lives dangle.
exampleZh: 这里的暴怒是指神话人物阿特洛波斯;,命运剪断了维系生命的细线。

meaning: n. （切下的食物）薄片，片；（蛋糕等的）小块 ；水果切块；部分，份；例子；（体育运动中的）斜切球，削球，侧旋球；（切片用的）薄刀，（铲食物用的）铲子；v. 把……切成薄片；切，割，划；轻易快速穿过（空气或水等）；削（球），斜切打；（无意中）打出弧线球；减少（时间、钱等）
definition: 1. n. a share of something；2. v. make a clean cut through
example: When I refer to my car as opposed to what we could doubt: the car stage or the car slice.
exampleZh: 当我提到我的车,对照一下有疑问的地方：,车的阶段或者部分。

meaning: v. （使）滑行，滑动；滑落；迅速熟练地进出；（使）快捷而悄声地移动；（价格等）下滑，下跌；逐渐败坏，开始出现问题；滑垒；n. 滑梯；滑道；滑行，滑动；（价格、数量等的）下降，跌落，减少；幻灯片；（情况）变糟，恶化，（人）出现问题；（显微镜的）载物玻璃片；（乐器或机器上的）滑动装置；（岩石，土等的）崩落；小发夹；（棒球）滑垒；（吉他）滑奏；无后帮凉鞋（或轻便鞋）
definition: 1. n. a small flat rectangular piece of glass on which specimens can be mounted for microscopic study；2. v. move obliquely or sideways, usually in an uncontrolled manner
example: Sarah's hair was out of her face and held back by a hair slide.
exampleZh: 萨拉脸上没有头发，而是用小发夹将头发扎在脑后

meaning: adj. 轻微的，少量的；（人）瘦小的，纤弱的；（尤指创作）不深奥的，不重要的；v. 怠慢，轻视；破坏，摧毁（防御工事）；n. 冒犯，冷落
definition: 1. n. a deliberate discourteous act (usually as an expression of anger or disapproval)；2. v. pay no attention to, disrespect
example: So in return to, we have a slight variance here, -- where I'm defining apparently -- declaring a function called cube.
exampleZh: 作为应答，这里我们有一点变化，这里我显然定义了-,声明了一个叫做cube的函数。

meaning: adv. 稍微，轻微地；（指某人身材）纤弱地，瘦小地
definition: 1. adv. to a small degree or extent；2. adv. in a slim or slender manner
example: Then as you move in, the outer courtyard, the outer enclosure of the sanctuary, bears a slightly higher degree of holiness.
exampleZh: 然后你走进去，它的外部空间，圣所的外围，神圣的程度有所提高。

meaning: adj. 苗条的，纤细的；单薄的；（物）狭长的；（衣服）修长的，紧身的；（数量或数字）微小的；（公司或其他组织）精简的；诡计多端的，狡猾的；v. （靠节食等）变苗条，减肥；减少（产品），缩减（人员）；n. （非洲）艾滋病；瘦身课程（或时期）；【名】 （Slim）（阿拉伯）萨利姆，（英、西）斯利姆（人名）
definition: 1. v. take off weight；2. adj. being of delicate or slender build
example: That's right. Louisiana Slim he's sometimes called. Yes, Sir. I sure have met Big Slim. And he used to work in the east Texas oil fields?"
exampleZh: 对，人们有时叫他路易斯安那的细杆，是的先生我肯定,遇见过，他过去是不是经常在得克萨斯州东部的油田工作？“

meaning: v. 滑倒，失足；滑落，脱落；溜走，悄悄地走；偷偷塞进；滑行，打滑；下降，变差；陷入；迅速穿上，迅速脱下；摆脱，挣脱；飞逝，过得飞快；被（某人）忘记；放出（动物，尤指猎狗）；（身体部分）移位，脱臼；（编织）挑过一针不结；略微松动（汽车离合器）；（动物）流产；n. 疏漏，差错；小纸条；滑，滑倒；滑动；衬裙；（击球员后侧的）守场员；（制陶器用的）泥浆，泥釉；（飞机飞行中的）侧滑；牵狗皮带；（两个码头之间）泊位；（编织）挑针；变糟，下跌；接枝，插枝；瘦小的年轻人；【名】 （Slip）（芬）斯利普（人名）
definition: 1. n. a socially awkward or tactless act；2. v. move stealthily
example: This is the place where people typically slip up in debugging. They don't think in advance what they expect the result to be.
exampleZh: 实验就推翻了你的假设了,人们在做调试的时候往往忽略了这一点,他们做实验之前并没有想想。

meaning: adj. 湿滑的，容易打滑的；狡猾的，不可靠的；模棱两可的，模糊的
definition: 1. adj. causing or tending to cause things to slip or slide；2. adj. not to be trusted
example: He is a slippery customer, and should be carefully watched.
exampleZh: 他可是个狡猾的主顾，得小心看着他。

meaning: n. 室内便鞋，拖鞋；轻便舞鞋；v. 用拖鞋打（人）
definition: 1. n. low footwear that can be slipped on and off easily; usually worn indoors；2. n. a person who slips or slides because of loss of traction
example: With its lips, the sly fly clipped the slippery slipper that eclipsed his sight.
exampleZh: 这只狡猾的苍蝇用嘴咬住了那只滑溜溜、挡住它视线的拖鞋。

meaning: n. 口号，标语；广告语；苏格兰高地的战斗呐喊
definition: 1. n. a favorite saying of a sect or political group
example: Her campaign slogan, "a president for the people," was pleasantly alliterative but empty.
exampleZh: 她的竞选口号“总统为人民”虽然悦耳动听但空洞无物。

meaning: n. 斜坡，斜面；山坡；滑雪斜坡；斜度，坡度；（电子）斜率；扛枪姿势； 东方人（尤指越南人）；v. 倾斜，成斜坡；歪斜；悄悄地走，溜； 逛，随意走动
definition: 1. n. an elevated geological formation；2. v. be at an angle
example: Up a trackless slope climbs the master artist, and at the top, on a windy ridge, whom do you think he meets?
exampleZh: 伟大的艺术家在那无路可寻的山峰上攀登，他登上山顶，迎风而立，你们猜他遇到了谁？

meaning: n. （可投入东西的）狭长孔，狭槽；（在一系列事件中为某事安排的）时间，空档；（组织、团体等中的）位置，职位；v. 把……投入窄孔中，把……放到指定位置；为……安排时间，安置； 与……融洽相处，适应（生活方式）；（足球运动员）准确射门进球；鹿的足迹（slots）；【名】 （Slot）（英、荷）斯洛特（人名）
definition: 1. a long, narrow hole, especially one for putting coins into or for fitting a separate piece into；2. an amount of time that is officially allowed for a single event in a planned order of activities or events
example: It tells us of the critical junctures in the nation's history, and that will help us then slot the different prophets in.
exampleZh: 告诉我们这个国家历史上的重大转型期，这就能帮我们锁定不同的预言家。

meaning: adj. （移动，运行）低速的，缓慢的；慢速的，低速的；耗时的，太慢的；迟缓的，慢吞吞的；（钟表）慢的；迟钝的，愚笨的；（胶片）曝光慢的；（镜头）小孔径的；（生意）清淡的，不景气的；不曲折的，乏味的，无趣的；（火，烤箱）小火的，弱火的；（球场或地面）软的，阻球的，奔跑困难的；v. （使）放慢速度，（使）减速；（使）降低，（使）减少；（生活，工作）放松；adv. 低速地，缓慢地；【名】 （Slow）（英）斯洛（人名）
definition: 1. v. lose velocity; move more slowly；2. adj. not moving quickly; taking a comparatively long time
example: You would have this initial response, now that initial response might be too slow to prevent you from getting chickenpox.
exampleZh: 你对水痘病毒产生初始应答,这种初始应答可能,过于缓慢,无法预防水痘

meaning: n. 贫民窟，棚屋区；脏乱的房子（或房间）；v. （短期）去贫穷地方，过简朴生活
definition: 1. a very poor and crowded area, especially of a city；2. a very untidy or dirty place
example: I sometimes compare myself with the mad old slum women I hear denouncing and remembering; "how dare you?"
exampleZh: 我有时自比贫民窟的疯老女人,我听到指责不断提及，你怎敢“

meaning: v. （价格、价值、数量等）骤降，猛跌；惨败，猛跌；（因无力站立而）倒下，倚，靠；（肩或脑袋）耷拉着；n. （价格、销售额、利润等的）突然下跌；（经济的）不景气，萧条；（运动员或运动队的）低迷期
definition: 1. (of prices, values, or sales) to fall suddenly；2. to sit or fall heavily and suddenly
example: The slump on Wall Street set up a chain reaction in stock markets around the world.
exampleZh: 华尔街股价暴跌在全球股票市场上引起了连锁反应。

meaning: adj. 小型的；（数量）少的；小规模的；无关紧要的，不重要的；幼小的，年幼的；（字母）小写的；（嗓音）微弱的，轻柔的；一般的，非极端的；出丑的，羞愧的；n. 小件衣服（尤指内衣）（smalls）；后腰（the small of the/sb.'s back）；小费，小额礼金（smalls）；小件物品；矮小的人；adv. 成小块地；小小地；【名】 （Small）（英）斯莫尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. the slender part of the back；2. adj. limited or below average in number or quantity or magnitude or extent
example: I basically gave them free ray at the beginning, so they work in small groups, and travel from site to site.
exampleZh: 在最初，我给了他们充分的自由，孩子们组成学习小组，在各地游览。

meaning: adj. 聪明的，明智的；（人）衣着得体的；整洁而漂亮的，光鲜的；耍小聪明的，不恭的；时髦的，高档的；迅速有力的，迅猛的；智能的；v. （身体部位）感到刺痛；（因批评、失败等）难过，烦恼；n. 剧痛，刺痛；痛苦，苦恼；聪明，敏锐（smarts）；adv. 机敏地，整洁地，潇洒地；【名】 （Smart）（法）斯马尔，（英、德）斯马特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a kind of pain such as that caused by a wound or a burn or a sore；2. v. be the source of pain
example: So things can be dangerous. But generally, if you're smart, I think it's a very safe place to live.
exampleZh: 因此，危险还是存在的。但大多数情况下，只要你精明点，我认为那儿还是一个非常安全的居住地。

meaning: n. 智能手机（运行移动操作系统，可安装并运行应用程序，具备较强计算和联网能力的移动电话）
definition: 1. abstract: A smartphone, or smart phone, is a mobile phone built on a mobile operating system, with more advanced computing capability and connectivity than a feature phone. The first smartphones combined the functions of a personal digital assistant (PDA) with a mobile phone.
example: What kind of service do you hope to provide with the smartphone later on?
exampleZh: 你希望智能手机以后能提供什么样的服务？

meaning: v. 打碎，（使）粉碎；（使）猛击，（使）猛撞；（用力）撞开，闯过；击溃，使结束；撞毁，撞坏（交通工具）；（网球等比赛中）扣球，打高压球；（轻松）打破（记录）；n. 猛烈撞击声，破碎时的哗啦声；猛击；撞车，车祸；（网球运动中的）高压球，扣球；大获成功的歌曲（或戏剧、电影）（=smash hit）；（由白兰地、果味水和冰混合调制的）斯马喜（混合烈酒）饮料；破产，投资失败；adv. 哗啦一声；adj. 非常轰动的，出色的
definition: 1. n. a vigorous blow；2. v. hit hard
example: We can't just smash things and start all over, we have to design a system of risk management.
exampleZh: 而不是简单地打破一切再重新来过，我们应当设计一个好的风险管理体系。

meaning: n. 气味；臭味；嗅觉；嗅，闻；v. 有……气味，发出......的气味；闻出，闻到；（用鼻子凑过去）闻，嗅；有嗅觉，能闻出（smell sth. out）；散发异味，有难闻的气味；觉察出，感觉到；看起来像，有……意味；【名】 （Smell）（美、俄、英、印、新）史默乐（人名）
definition: 1. n. the sensation that results when olfactory receptors in the nose are stimulated by particular chemicals in gaseous form；2. v. inhale the odor of; perceive by the olfactory sense
example: You smell and you think, "Is that Japanese? Is that Indian? What type of food is that?"
exampleZh: 你使劲闻了闻，你在想“这是日本料理，还是印度菜？这到底是什么菜呢？”

meaning: adj. 有难闻气味的，发臭的
definition: 1. adj. offensively malodorous
example: Previous lab studies have shown that smelly socks work well in attracting mosquitoes.
exampleZh: 早先的实验室研究表明，臭袜子在吸引蚊子方面很管用。

meaning: v. 微笑；微笑着说，以微笑表示；现出（笑容）；觉得好笑，觉得高兴；惠及，赞许；n. 微笑，笑容；一脸笑意，喜滋滋的（all smiles）；【名】 （Smile）（俄、印、美）斯米莱（人名）
definition: 1. n. a facial expression characterized by turning up the corners of the mouth; usually shows pleasure or amusement；2. v. change one's facial expression by spreading the lips, often to signal pleasure
example: And by his smile, I knew that sullen hall,-- By his dead smile I knew we stood in Hell.
exampleZh: 看着他的笑，我想起了阴沉压抑的礼堂-,看着他的笑，我想起了阴沉压抑的礼堂。

meaning: n. （通常指城市中汽车、工厂等排出的）烟雾，雾霾
definition: 1. n. air pollution by a mixture of smoke and fog
example: Under the cover of the smog, He snatched the pot on the sly.
exampleZh: 在烟雾的掩护下，他偷偷地拿走了那只壶。

meaning: adj. 烟雾弥漫的
definition: 1. adj. clouded with a mixture of smoke and fog
example: His bird-spotting book encourages residents of Beijing to look out for egrets and kestrels through the still-smoggy air.
exampleZh: 他在观鸟书中鼓励北京当地居民在仍旧烟雾弥漫的空气中留心找一下白鹭和红隼。

meaning: n. （燃烧所产生的）烟，烟雾；吸烟，抽烟；（抽的）香烟，（吸的）毒品； （伦敦之类的）大城市（the Smoke）；无常的事物；v. 吸烟，吸毒品；（作为习惯）抽烟；冒烟，冒气；用烟熏制；（战斗或竞赛中）彻底击败；开枪杀死（某人）；用力快击（球）；弥漫
definition: 1. n. a cloud of fine particles suspended in a gas；2. v. inhale and exhale smoke from cigarettes, cigars, pipes
example: II Only thin smoke without flame ; From the heaps of couch-grass; Yet this will go onward the same Though Dynasties pass.
exampleZh: 只有没有火焰的烟,从茅草堆中冒出;,然而这还是会照样向前,即使朝代更迭。

meaning: adj. 烟雾弥漫的；冒出大量烟的；烟灰色的，似烟的；有烟熏味的，熏制般的；（声音或眼睛）迷人的，性感的
definition: 1. adj. marked by or emitting or filled with smoke；2. adj. tasting of smoke
example: The fish had just the right amount of smoky flavour for my taste.
exampleZh: 那条鱼刚好有适量的烟熏味，正对我的口味。

meaning: adj. （表面）光滑的，平坦的，平整的；顺利的，无困难的；（动作等）流畅的，（骑马、航行等）平稳的；（人）圆滑的，八面玲珑的；（液体混合物）均匀的，不结块的；（声音）圆润的，悦耳的；（味道、气味等）醇和的，不烈的；（网球拍或软式壁球拍无线结的一面）光面，滑面；v. 抚平，弄平滑；轻轻地涂擦（液体、面霜等）；解决问题，消除困难；修改（图表、曲线等）以减少不规则现象；缓和；使优雅；n. 平滑部分；adv. 光滑地，平稳地，流畅地
definition: 1. n. the act of smoothing；2. v. make smooth or smoother, as if by rubbing
example: From 1983 to the present as you just said, the economy has a long period of smooth, robust expansion interrupted by two very mild recessions.
exampleZh: 第二时期是从1983年至今，正如你所说，经济长时间处于,平稳强健的发展状态,而只出现了两次轻度衰退。

meaning: v. 走私，偷运；偷偷携带，夹带
definition: 1. to take things or people to or from a place secretly and often illegally；2. to take things or people to or from a country or place illegally and secretly
example: Customs officials foiled an attempt to smuggle the paintings out of the country.
exampleZh: 海关关员阻截了一次企图走私画作出境的阴谋。

meaning: n. 走私（罪）；v. 偷偷携带，夹带；走私，偷运（smuggle 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. the act or process of taking things or people to or from a place secretly and often illegally；2. the crime of taking goods or people into or out of a country illegally
example: Even though when I imagine that meeting, I'm in some sense, smuggling myself in as an observer.
exampleZh: 即便当我想象这场会议时，在某种程度上将自己作为观察者进入。

meaning: n. 走私犯，偷运者
definition: 1. someone who smuggles；2. someone who takes goods or people into or out of a country illegally
example: Fett stayed at Jabba's palace, and was present when Solo's friends attempted to rescue the carbon-frozen smuggler.
exampleZh: 费特留在了贾巴的宫殿里，当索洛的朋友们赶来搭救他时，这个赏金猎人又一次出场。

meaning: n. 零食，点心，小吃；快餐；易办到的事，小菜一碟；v. 吃点心，吃零食
definition: 1. n. a light informal meal；2. v. eat a snack; eat lightly
example: It is customary to offer a drink or a snack to guests.
exampleZh: 通常用饮料或小吃招待客人。

meaning: n. 蜗牛；迟钝的人；v. 缓慢移动
definition: 1. a small creature with a soft, wet body and a round shell, that moves very slowly and often eats garden plants
example: The snail moved slowly across the garden path, leaving a thin trail behind it.
exampleZh: 蜗牛缓慢地爬过花园小径，身后留下一道细细的痕迹。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 蛇；阴险狡诈的人；管道疏通器；蛇形浮动汇率制（the snake）；v. 蛇行，蜿蜒前进；拉（重物）
definition: 1. n. limbless scaly elongate reptile; some are venomous；2. v. move smoothly and sinuously, like a snake
example: He went around passing out rumors that his mother had actually been impregnated by the god Apollo, when he appeared as a snake in her bed.
exampleZh: 他散布谣言说,阿波罗神化身为蛇，与他的母亲结合。

meaning: v. （使咔嚓）断裂，绷断；（使啪地）打开，关上，移动；厉声说，怒气冲冲地说；突然失控，精神崩溃；（狗等动物）突然咬；拍照，摄影；使……终结；噼啪地响；打响指；快速后传（球）；用子母扣扣；n. 喀嚓声，啪嗒声；快照，照片；摁扣，搭扣；呼“同”牌游戏；容易的事；某种短时期的天气；迅速的动作；（裆下后传）发球；（风格或动作）充满活力；不耐烦的语调（或样子）；食物；薄脆饼干；突然折断；adj. 突然的，仓促的；int. 真巧啊，一模一样；（呼“同”牌游戏中的）“同！”
definition: 1. to cause something that is thin to break suddenly and quickly with a cracking sound；2. to suddenly become unable to control a strong feeling, especially anger
example: This is very important, because when you buy a rope, they will tell you how much tension it can take before it'll snap.
exampleZh: 这非常重要,因为你去买绳子,他们会告诉你,绳子能承受的最大拉力是多少

meaning: v. 一把抓住，立马夺下；夺去，抢走；抓住机会做（某事）；侥幸获得（胜利），险胜；n. 抢夺，偷窃；（歌曲或谈话的）片段；片刻，一会儿；（举重）抓举；（女性的）阴部
definition: 1. to take hold of something suddenly and roughly；2. to take something or someone away by force
example: "The squirrel took a lot of time to build up enough courage to snatch the nut," she said.
exampleZh: “松鼠花了很长时间才鼓起足够的勇气去抢坚果。”她说。

meaning: v. 偷偷地走，潜行；偷带，私运；偷走（不重要的或小的东西）；偷偷地做（或获得）；（尤作儿童用语）打小报告，告密；n. 打小报告的人，告状者（尤指儿童）；鬼鬼祟祟的人；四分卫快速带球切入；旅游鞋，软帮运动鞋；偷偷摸摸的行为；adj. 出其不意的，偷偷摸摸的
definition: 1. to go somewhere secretly, or to take someone or something somewhere secretly；2. to secretly tell someone in authority, especially a teacher, that someone else has done something bad, often in order to cause trouble
example: You sneak a look at your watch to see how long you've got to wait.
exampleZh: 你偷偷看一眼手表，看还要等多久。

meaning: v. （出声地）以鼻吸气，抽鼻子（如因哭泣或感冒）；嗅，闻；嗤之以鼻地说，轻蔑地说；吸入（气体或毒品）；嗅到，察觉出；n. 抽鼻子，哼；吸入的空气（或其他物质）；气味；线索，迹象；轻蔑，厌恶
definition: 1. to smell something by taking air in through your nose；2. to take air in quickly through your nose, usually to stop the liquid inside the nose from flowing out
example: You're on the phone with this guy all the time and you sniff something out, you can maybe stop it.
exampleZh: 如果你和某人经常通话联系,并且嗅出了问题,你也许就不会借钱给他们了

meaning: n. 势利小人，谄上欺下的人；自以为懂行者，自命不凡的人
definition: 1. a person who respects and likes only people who are of a high social class, and/or a person who has extremely high standards who is not satisfied by the things that ordinary people like；2. A snob can also be a person who gives a very high value to any quality which that person believes makes him or her better than other people
example: I mean Thoreau may have been a snob, he may have been smarmy, and he may have wanted you to think he was cool because he sold pencils.
exampleZh: 我的意思是,梭罗也许个势利小人,他也许有点爱说奉承话,他也许觉得卖铅笔,会让你们认为他很酷

meaning: adj. 势利眼的，自命不凡的
definition: 1. like a snob
example: They had a snobbish dislike for their intellectual and social inferiors.
exampleZh: 他们很势利眼，不喜欢才智和社会地位不如自己的人。

meaning: n. 雪，积雪；降雪，一场雪；下雪天；（因信号差出现在电视屏幕的）“雪花”干扰；似雪的菜肴；似雪的冷冻气体；可卡因；v. 下雪，飘雪；（用花言巧语）蒙骗，使相信；使洒落；使变白；【名】 （Snow）斯诺（人名）
definition: 1. n. precipitation falling from clouds in the form of ice crystals；2. v. fall as snow
example: Can't complain when the whole North East on the other side of the country is getting piled with snow.
exampleZh: 当美国东北区白雪皑皑时，在这儿我们也不会抱怨寒冷。

meaning: adj. 多雪的，下雪的；雪白的；白雪覆盖的
definition: 1. adj. marked by the presence of snow；2. adj. covered with snow
example: We strode across the snowy fields.
exampleZh: 我们大步流星地穿过雪封的旷野。

meaning: adv. （表程度）如此，这么；也一样（用于倒装）；（口语）那么（引出新话题）；确是如此；conj. 所以，因此；以便，为了（表目的）；pron. 这样，如此（指代前述内容、情况或方式）；n. （So）人名；（柬）索
definition: 1. n. the syllable naming the fifth (dominant) note of any musical scale in solmization；2. adv. to a very great extent or degree
example: She wanted him to stop being so cool, so detached, so cynical.
exampleZh: 她希望他不再那么冷酷无情，那么无动于衷，那么愤世嫉俗。

meaning: v. 浸泡；使湿透，浸湿；（液体）渗入，渗透；（在浴缸里）长时间泡浴；向……敲竹杠（征重税）；吸收，吸入；沉浸在（学习中）；n. 浸泡，浸透；（长时间的）泡浴，洗澡；酒鬼；积水洼地，水洼；大雨
definition: 1. n. the process of becoming softened and saturated as a consequence of being immersed in water (or other liquid)；2. v. submerge in a liquid
example: What I need is to soak in a hot tub.
exampleZh: 我需要的是在浴盆里泡个热水澡。

meaning: n. 肥皂；肥皂剧；v. 擦肥皂；对……拍马屁
definition: 1. n. a cleansing agent made from the salts of vegetable or animal fats；2. v. rub soap all over, usually with the purpose of cleaning
example: And I said, "Oh, my goodness, after I've sent you to college to love soap operas. That wasn't what I had in mind.
exampleZh: 我就说：“哦天啊，我把你送进大学,让你喜欢肥皂剧去了，我没想到是这样。

meaning: v. （数量、价值、水平、规模等）急升，猛涨；高飞，翱翔；升空，升腾；（精神或希望）高涨；(树木、建筑等）高耸，屹立；升至（很高的高度），高达；（音乐）升高，增强；n. 高飞；高涨；【名】 （Soar）（英、葡）索尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of rising upward into the air；2. v. rise rapidly
example: Most animals seek shade when temperatures in the Sahara Desert soar to 120 degrees Fahrenheit.
exampleZh: 当撒哈拉沙漠的温度飙升到120华氏度时，大多数动物会寻找庇荫处。

meaning: v. 啜泣，抽噎；哭诉，呜咽地说；（风等）发出呜咽声；n. 抽噎（声），呜咽（声）
definition: 1. to cry noisily, taking in deep breaths；2. an act or sound of sobbing
example: The sob he had fought with so long refused to be beaten.
exampleZh: 他强忍了许久的啜泣终于再也克制不住。

meaning: adj. 未喝醉的，清醒的；严肃的，冷静的；素淡的，朴素的；v. （使）变得持重，变得冷静；（使）醒酒，（使）清醒；【名】 （Sober）索伯（人名）
definition: 1. not having drunk alcohol or not affected by alcohol；2. (of an alcoholic or drug addict) not having had an alcoholic drink or taken drugs for a period of time
example: Jefferson:"Northerners are cool, sober, laborious, persevering, independent, jealous of their own liberties, chicaning, superstitious, and hypocritical in their religion."
exampleZh: 杰斐逊说,"北方人冷静,稳重,勤劳,坚毅,独立,珍惜自身的自由,奸诈,迷信,还假装是虔诚宗教信徒"

meaning: adj. （表示不认同）所谓的；叫做……的，号称……的
definition: 1. adj. doubtful or suspect
example: Despite the vogue for so-called health teas, there is no evidence that they are any healthier.
exampleZh: 尽管所谓的保健茶成了时尚，但并没有证据表明这种茶更有益于健康。

meaning: n. 英式足球，足球
definition: 1. n. a football game in which two teams of 11 players try to kick or head a ball into the opponents' goal
example: Now if you can just persuade the English and Portsmouth soccer players of this lesson, I'd be very happy.
exampleZh: 现在如果你能让英格兰或者朴茨茅斯球员,学会这个规律的话,我会非常高兴的

meaning: n. 社会（以群体形式生活在一起的人的总称）；社群（某国家、地区、时期等的群体组织）；社团，协会；上层社会；交往，相伴；阶层，界；植物的群落，动物的群体
definition: 1. n. an extended social group having a distinctive cultural and economic organization；2. n. a formal association of people with similar interests
example: These materials were transmitted and developed by different circles within Israelite society over centuries, and they crystallized at different times.
exampleZh: 这些资料被传播发展,几世纪来，由以色列社会中的不同圈子，它们曾在不同的时期都非常明确。

meaning: adj. 社会的；社会地位的，社会阶层的；社交的，交际的；好交际的，合群的；群居的；n. 社交聚会，联欢会；社会保障（the social）
definition: 1. n. a party of people assembled to promote sociability and communal activity；2. adj. relating to human society and its members
example: We then promised to move to an emphasis on psychological matters, and finally social and cultural determinants of literature.
exampleZh: 然后我们把重点转移到了心理学，最后还讨论了社会和文化对文学的决定因素。

meaning: v. 交往，交际；使合群，使适应社会生活；使社会主义化，按社会主义原则行事
definition: 1. v. take part in social activities; interact with others；2. v. train for a social environment
example: We guarantee that you will find a community with which to socialize.
exampleZh: 我们保证你将找到一个可以社交的团体。

meaning: adj. 好交际的，合群的，友善的；（地方，场合，活动）气氛友好的；n. （非正式的）社交聚会，交谊会；座位面对面的敞篷马车；并肩双座的三轮车；S 形的双人坐椅
definition: 1. n. a party of people assembled to promote sociability and communal activity；2. adj. inclined to or conducive to companionship with others
example: She was, and remained, extremely sociable, enjoying dancing, golf, tennis, skating, and bicycling.
exampleZh: 她以前是，现在依然是极其好交际，喜欢跳舞、打高尔夫、打网球、滑冰和骑自行车。

meaning: n. 社会主义，社会主义制度；（马克思主义理论）社会主义社会
definition: 1. n. a political theory advocating state ownership of industry；2. n. an economic system based on state ownership of capital
example: As socialism with Chinese characteristics has entered a new era, the main contradiction facing Chinese society has evolved.
exampleZh: 随着中国特色社会主义进入新时代，中国社会面临的主要矛盾发生进一步的变化。

meaning: adj. 支持社会主义的，与社会主义有关的；n. 社会主义者
definition: 1. n. a political advocate of socialism；2. adj. of or relating to or promoting or practicing socialism
example: This is...isn't this an example of kind of thing that... ? a socialist would refer to as market failure?
exampleZh: 莫非这正好验证了。,社会主义者关于资本主义市场失效的理论？

meaning: n. 社会学，社会关系研究
definition: 1. n. the study and classification of human societies
example: This degree offers a major specialization in social policy alongside a course in sociology.
exampleZh: 该学位提供一门社会政策主专业课和一门社会学课程。

meaning: n. 社会学家，社会关系研究者
definition: 1. n. a social scientist who studies the institutions and development of human society
example: As an Arab sociologist puts it, in a tribal society you do not buy loyalty, you only rent it.
exampleZh: 正如一位阿拉伯社会学家所说，在一个部落社会中，你不是收买忠诚，只是在租赁。

meaning: n. 短袜；猛击，重击；（马小腿处的）白色标记；实力，重点；鞋垫；v. 猛击；使遭损失，损害；（棒球运动中）猛击，狠打（球）；给……穿袜；【名】 （Sock）（德）佐克（姓氏）
definition: 1. n. hosiery consisting of a cloth covering for the foot; worn inside the shoe; reaches to between the ankle and the knee；2. v. hit hard
example: He groped around in the dark for his other sock.
exampleZh: 他在黑暗中到处瞎摸找另一只袜子。

meaning: n. （电源）插座；（电器）插口，插孔；（人体的）窝，槽；（高尔夫插球杆的）棒头承口；（用以插入某物使其转动的）承窝，轴孔；v. 插入，使装入插座
definition: 1. the part of a piece of equipment, especially electrical equipment, into which another part fits；2. a part of the body into which another part fits
example: When either of them receives data, it writes the data to the other socket.
exampleZh: 当它们其中一个收到数据时，就会将数据写到另一个套接字。

meaning: n. 苏打，碳酸钠；苏打水，碳酸水；汽水（甜味碳酸软饮料）；一杯（或一瓶、一罐）汽水；（Soda）人名（意）索达，（日）曾田（姓）
definition: 1. n. a sodium salt of carbonic acid; used in making soap powders and glass and paper；2. n. a sweet drink containing carbonated water and flavoring
example: That's very nice. So basically, you get a lot of benefit supposedly from this 7-Up soda from the 1920's or so.
exampleZh: 这非常好，因此基本上，在二十世纪二十年代,喝到这样的七喜恐怕对你大有好处。

meaning: n. 钠（一种化学元素，符号为 Na）；adj. （发出橙色强光的）钠光的
definition: 1. a soft, silver-white chemical element that is found in salt
example: It is 1.7475. Conclusion: if I start to react sodium with chlorine, the result is a crystal, a three-dimensional array.
exampleZh: 这是1。7475，结论就是：,如果我使钠和氯反应，结果将会是一个晶体，一个三维排列。

meaning: n. 沙发；长椅；（Sofa）人名；（塞）索法
definition: 1. n. an upholstered seat for more than one person
example: I decided to ditch the sofa bed.
exampleZh: 我决定把沙发床扔掉。

meaning: adj. 易弯曲的，柔软的；柔滑的，细嫩的；无棱角的，轮廓不鲜明的；柔和的，悦目的；（声音）安静的，轻柔的；（雨、风等）温和的，不猛烈的；有同情心的，心肠软的；力度不够的，不严厉的；轻松的，安逸的；（水）软性的；胆小的，懦弱的；虚弱的，健康欠佳的；发软音的；（毒品）毒性不强的；（饮料）不含酒精的；（市场或经济）疲软的；愚蠢的；（目标）易被攻击的；非严肃性的，不重要的；（天气）多雨的，潮湿的，解冻的；（辐射）穿透力弱的；（洗涤剂）生物降解性的；（色情描写）非赤裸裸的，隐晦的；adv. 温柔地；轻轻地；无力地，愚蠢地；n. 柔性；柔软的东西；柔软部分
definition: 1. adj. yielding readily to pressure or weight；2. adv. in a relaxed manner; or without hardship
example: And then my father who has passed, who is dead I should say, and profound in his spirituality. A very soft-spoken person.
exampleZh: 然后是我的爸爸，虽然他已经去世了，一致和深刻的精神世界，他是个很斯文的人。

meaning: v. （使）变软，软化；（使）态度缓和，变宽厚；减轻，削弱；（使）（表情或声音）变轻柔；（使）柔和，和缓；（市场、货币或商品）贬值；软化（水），从（水）中除去无机盐
definition: 1. v. make (images or sounds) soft or softer；2. v. lessen in force or effect
example: There were also pledges to soften the impact of the subsidy cuts on the poorer regions.
exampleZh: 也有保证要减轻消减给较贫困地区补贴所造成的冲击。

meaning: n. 软件；（计算机）程序及相关文档资料的总称，与 hardware（硬件）相对
definition: 1. n. (computer science) written programs or procedures or rules and associated documentation pertaining to the operation of a computer system and that are stored in read/write memory
example: I was given two weeks and one other programmer in Biz Stone to write the software. And we did it.
exampleZh: 我和比兹·斯通手下的另一个程序设计师,得到了两周时间来编写软件。

meaning: n. 泥土，土壤；（可供某物发展的）土壤，温床；国土，领土；耕作，务农（the soil）；粪便；v. 弄脏，玷污
definition: 1. n. the state of being covered with unclean things；2. v. make soiled, filthy, or dirty
example: So, you must imagine these are successive kings who are being buried in this, what must have been, sacred soil.
exampleZh: 因此,你必须设想他们是被埋葬在,这块圣土中的历任国王

meaning: adj. 太阳的，和太阳有关的；（与）太阳能（有关）的；n. （中世纪房屋的）屋顶室，顶层房间；【名】 （Solar）（法、英、意、西、塞、捷）索拉尔（人名）
definition: 1. adj. relating to or derived from the sun or utilizing the energies of the sun
example: Saturn is the second biggest planet in the solar system.
exampleZh: 土星是太阳系的第二大的行星。

meaning: n. 士兵，军人；（昆） 兵蚁；垂直的砖（或木头等建筑材料）；面包条，土司条；懒汉；v. 当兵；坚持不懈，迎难而上（~ on）；假称害病；磨洋工
definition: 1. n. an enlisted man or woman who serves in an army；2. v. serve as a soldier in the military
example: One boy did an imitation of a soldier with a loudspeaker.
exampleZh: 一个男孩拿着扬声器学着士兵的样子。

meaning: adj. 唯一的，仅有的；专用的，独享的；（尤指女性）未婚的；单独的，没人陪伴的；n. 脚底；鞋底（不包括后跟）；脚趾和脚弓之间的部分；（刨子等工具的）底部，（高尔夫球棒头的）底端；（船舱或驾驶室的）地面，地板；鳎（鱼）； 脚底；v. 给（鞋）换底；【名】 （Sole）（西）索莱（人名）
definition: 1. n. the underside of footwear or a golf club；2. v. put a new sole on
example: My sole reason for coming here was to see you.
exampleZh: 我到这儿唯一的原因就是来看你。

meaning: adv. 单独地，仅有地
definition: 1. adv. without any others being included or involved
example: Too often we make decisions based solely upon what we see in the magazines.
exampleZh: 大多数时候，我们仅仅依据在杂志上看到的东西作决定。

meaning: adj. 表情严肃的，庄严的；（承诺、协定等）庄严的，郑重的；（仪式）庄严的，隆重的
definition: 1. adj. dignified and somber in manner or character and committed to keeping promises；2. adj. characterized by a firm and humorless belief in the validity of your opinions
example: I made a solemn promise that I would return.
exampleZh: 我郑重承诺我会回来的。

meaning: n. 严肃，庄严；（重大场合的）礼仪，仪式；一本正经
definition: 1. n. a trait of dignified seriousness；2. n. a solemn and dignified feeling
example: The setting for this morning's signing ceremony matched the solemnity of the occasion.
exampleZh: 今天早上签字仪式的布置符合这种场合的庄严气氛。

meaning: v. 请求，索求，征求（意见）；兜售，推销；拉（客），卖淫
definition: 1. to ask someone for money, information, or help；2. to ask for something in a persuasive and determined way
example: You can solicit more opinions, compile them, and then consider how much personal bias may be involved.
exampleZh: 你可以征集更多意见，将它们汇总整理，之后考量其中可能涉及多少个人偏见。

meaning: n. 初级律师，事务律师，诉状律师；推销员，招揽生意的人，游说者；法务官
definition: 1. a type of lawyer in Britain and Australia who is trained to prepare cases and give advice on legal subjects and can represent people in lower courts；2. the official in a local government who deals with legal matters
example: and then you're called a solicitor in England if you want to do the corporate work.
exampleZh: 做商业的在英国叫solicitor。

meaning: adj. 固体的，坚硬的；结实的，牢固的；实心的，无空隙的；纯质的；纯色的，单色的；可靠的，可信赖的；一致的，坚定的；不中断的，连续的；相当不错（但谈不上出色或独特）的；立体的，立方的；关系融洽的；严厉的，不公平的；很难的；n. 立体（图形）；固体；固体食物；（液体中的）固形物；【名】 （Solid）（瑞典）索利德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a substance that is solid at room temperature and pressure；2. adj. of definite shape and volume; firm; neither liquid nor gaseous
example: So,composition alone can't give you the answer to the question why is the plywood superior to the solid pine board?
exampleZh: 只用组成成分无法解答,这个问题,为什么胶合板要优于松木板呢？

meaning: n. 坚固，坚硬；稳固，可靠（性）；体积
definition: 1. n. the consistency of a solid；2. n. state of having the interior filled with matter
example: Abbot H.Thayer has suggested that this gradation obliterates the appearance of solidity, which is due to shadow.
exampleZh: Abbot H·Thayer 曾提出，这种渐变会消除由阴影产生的立体感外观。

meaning: v. （使）凝固，变硬；（使）变可靠，（使）变稳固
definition: 1. v. make solid or more solid; cause to solidify；2. v. become solid
example: The joint battle against SARS can only further solidify our friendship and cooperation.
exampleZh: 共同抗击非典型肺炎，只会更加增强我们的友谊与合作。

meaning: n. 团结一致；（波兰的）团结工会（Solidarity）
definition: 1. agreement between and support for the members of a group, especially a political group；2. agreement between and support for the members of a group
example: It was solidarity with his allies that led him to be such a competent and brave officer.
exampleZh: 是他同盟友的团结,让他成为勇敢能干的船长。

meaning: adj. 独自的，单独的；偏僻的，孤立的；独自完成的；（人或动物）独处的，独居的；（花或其他部分）单生的；唯一的，仅有的；n. 单独监禁；独居者，隐士
definition: 1. A solitary person or thing is the only person or thing in a place；2. done alone
example: They share solitude, solitary, too, in their relation to each other.
exampleZh: 他们分担孤独和寂寞，在和彼此的交往过程中。

meaning: n. 独居，独处，孤独；偏僻的地方，无人居住的地方
definition: 1. the situation of being alone without other people；2. the situation of being alone, often by choice
example: He enjoyed his moments of solitude before the pressures of the day began in earnest.
exampleZh: 他很喜欢一天的压力真正开始前的独处时刻。

meaning: adj. 单独的，独自的；独奏的，单人表演的；（击球时）垒上无跑垒员的；（摩托车）没有跨斗的；n. 单人表演，单飞，独自完成的事情；单人纸牌戏，惠斯特纸牌戏；惠斯特纸牌戏中为赢五圈牌的叫牌；没有跨斗的摩托车；v. 独奏，独唱；单独飞行；单人攀登；adv. 单独地，独自地
definition: 1. alone; without other people；2. In baseball, a solo home run (= a hit that sends the ball out of the playing area) is one that scores only one run (= point) because no other players from the hitter's team are standing at any of the bases (= places that players have to reach in order to score)
example: They might say for that sort of music: "All right. We're now going to have a thirty-two-bar solo.
exampleZh: 他们会事先交流好要演出一段怎样的乐章,好吧,我们要出一段三十二小节的独奏曲

meaning: v. 解决，处理；解释，解答
definition: 1. v. find the solution to (a problem or question) or understand the meaning of；2. v. find the solution
example: So I'm going to solve this by enumerate and check, which is an example of what's called a brute-force algorithm.
exampleZh: 你懂的,所以我得靠列举和检验来解决这个问题,这就是我们说的穷举算法。

meaning: n. （问题、困难等的）解决办法；（练习或竞赛的）解答，答案；溶液；溶解过程，溶解状态；（满足特定需要的）产品（或服务）（solutions）
definition: 1. n. a homogeneous mixture of two or more substances; frequently (but not necessarily) a liquid solution；2. n. a statement that solves a problem or explains how to solve the problem
example: The notion here is that you can get a globally optimal solution from locally optimal solutions to sub-problems.
exampleZh: 这里的概念是你可以通过,子问题的局部最优方案,得到全局优化解决方案。

meaning: adj. （尤指公司）有偿付能力的，付得起的；有溶解力的；n. 溶剂；（对处境的某种态度）起削弱（或瓦解）作用的事物；解决方法
definition: 1. n. a liquid substance capable of dissolving other substances；2. adj. capable of meeting financial obligations
example: The standard way to capture CO2 is to use a solvent called monoethanolamine (MEA).
exampleZh: 捕获二氧化碳的标准方法是使用一种叫做单乙醇胺（MEA）的溶剂。

meaning: adj. 可溶的，易于溶解的；（问题）可解答的，可解决的
definition: 1. adj. (of a substance) capable of being dissolved in some solvent (usually water)；2. adj. susceptible of solution or of being solved or explained
example: Steroids are small molecules - much smaller than proteins - smaller molecules that tend to be hydrophobic or lipid soluble.
exampleZh: 类固醇是小分子物质,比蛋白质小得多,这类小分子是非水溶性的,或者说是脂溶性的

meaning: det. 若干，一些；某个，某种；相当多，大量；少量的，不多的；了不起的，很不错的；不怎么样的，算不上……的；pron. 有些，一部分；adv. 有些，稍微；大约；【名】 （Some）（美、印）索梅（人名）
definition: 1. adj. quantifier; used with either mass nouns or plural count nouns to indicate an unspecified number or quantity；2. adv. (of quantities) imprecise but fairly close to correct
example: He found that some droplets had a certain velocity, and then others had a velocity plus some step.
exampleZh: 他发现了一些液滴存在某个速度，还有其他的液滴有速度和位移。

meaning: pron. 某人，有人；重要人物，当权人物；n. 大人物，重要人物
definition: 1. n. a human being
example: Somebody rose and asked him if he had considered putting the elements in alphabetical order. They were very cruel.
exampleZh: 有人起来问他,是否考虑过将这些元素,按字母顺序排列，他们非常冷酷。

meaning: adv. 以某种方式，用某种方法；由于某种不明原因，不知为什么
definition: 1. adv. in some unspecified way or manner; or by some unspecified means；2. adv. for some unspecified reason
example: In that case, we understand it as a sequence of cross-sections rather than something that somehow organically changes through time.
exampleZh: 这样，我们就是在学习一个个语言的横截面,而不是语言自然的变化过程。

meaning: pron. 有人，某人；重要人物
definition: 1. n. a human being
example: It is the most amazing image because amidst of all this chaos, is this image of someone sitting there, breathing.
exampleZh: 那是最神奇的场景,在众多喧哗中，有人静坐呼吸。

meaning: pron. 某事，某物；……或诸如此类的东西，……什么的；大致，大约，左右；什么什么（用于表示不记得人名、数字的余下部分或歌词等）；还算幸运的事；重要的人（或事）；（想法或建议）有道理，值得考虑；有点儿，有几分；adv. 稍微，有点；很，非常
definition: 1. n. a thing of some kind
example: How do you influence the way people connect the way they think about something and the way they act about something.
exampleZh: 您是怎样影响人们,让人们将其所想与,所为联系起来的呢？

meaning: adv. 在（将来或过去的）某个时候；adj. 曾经的，以前的；偶尔的
definition: 1. adj. belonging to some prior time；2. adv. at some indefinite or unstated time
example: I would like to, sometime before we move out of New York. I would like to ice skate there.
exampleZh: 我也想在我们搬出纽约前去一次。我想在那儿溜冰。

meaning: adv. 有时，间或
definition: 1. adv. on certain occasions or in certain cases but not always
example: but they're still really good at like teaching, but sometimes a little bit crazy. Like... like very strange personalities.
exampleZh: 但是他们还是很擅长教学，但是有时候有点疯狂，比如性格有点奇怪。

meaning: adv. 稍微，有点；pron. 几分；某物
definition: 1. adv. to a small degree or extent；2. adv. to a moderately sufficient extent or degree
example: So I would say, even though basketball can be somewhat fun to watch on a big screen.
exampleZh: 所以我说，尽管在大屏幕上看篮球比赛也有它的乐趣，（现场看更好）。

meaning: adv. 在某处；到某处；n. 某个地方
definition: 1. n. an indefinite or unknown location；2. adv. in or at or to some place
example: or just go for dinner or lunch somewhere around the place because there are really nice restaurants around here.
exampleZh: 或者在学校周围的餐馆里吃顿晚饭或午饭因为我们学校周围有一些不错的餐馆。

meaning: n. 儿子；孩子（长者对男孩或年轻男子的称呼）；（某国或地区出生并能作其代表的）男性，子；圣子（耶稣基督）（the Son）；（动物的）雄性后代；男性后裔；（某个人、某种影响或某种环境）熏陶出的人；（司铎对男子或男孩的称呼）孩子（my son）；【名】 （Son）（土、老、柬）松，（法、罗）索恩，（日）存（人名）
definition: 1. n. a male human offspring；2. n. the divine word of God; the second person in the Trinity (incarnate in Jesus)
example: For example, if your son got in a fight with his sister and you're very concerned about him,
exampleZh: 例如，如果你的儿子跟他的妹妹打了起来，你对他很是担心，

meaning: n. 歌，歌曲；歌唱，声乐；（鸟的）鸣啭，啼啭；押韵的诗歌；【名】 （Song）（英）桑，（汉语）宋（人名）
definition: 1. n. a short musical composition with words；2. n. a distinctive or characteristic sound
example: If you write a song, and you should be able to sell that the rights to that song online
exampleZh: 如果你写了一首歌，你应该能在网上卖它的版权，

meaning: adv. 很快，马上，不久；早，快；宁可，宁愿
definition: 1. adv. in the near future
example: But the new Presbyterian Party soon developed its own methods of employing state power to control and regulate the church.
exampleZh: 但新的长老派很快就发展了自己的办法,那就是利用政府权力控制和管理教会。

meaning: v. 使平静，安抚；减轻，缓和（疼痛）
definition: 1. to make someone feel calm or less worried；2. to make a part of the body less painful
example: When I have a sore throat, I like to eat popsicles, because they can soothe the pain.
exampleZh: 我喉咙痛的时候喜欢吃冰棒，冰棒能缓解疼痛。

meaning: adj. 见多识广的，老练的，见过世面的；复杂巧妙的，先进的，精密的；水平高的，在行的；时尚的，精致的；v. 使老于世故；使（设备、技术等）更复杂先进；（老练地）讲话（或推理）（sophisticate 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. adj. having or appealing to those having worldly knowledge and refinement and savoir-faire；2. adj. ahead in development; complex or intricate
example: You will be able to infer from some of our code how in fact you can implement some more sophisticated programs.
exampleZh: 你可以从一些代码中推断出,应该要怎样实现一些较复杂的程序。

meaning: n. 精明老练；（人的）高度文化修养；（机器、方法的）精密，复杂，先进；诡辩
definition: 1. n. uplifting enlightenment；2. n. a deliberately invalid argument displaying ingenuity in reasoning in the hope of deceiving someone
example: In its own right it is a tool of extraordinary sophistication, yet based on an idea of ingenious simplicity.
exampleZh: 就其本身而言，它是一种极其复杂的工具，但却基于一种巧妙而简单的理念。

meaning: adj. （发炎）疼痛的，酸痛的；恼火的，恼怒的；（精神上）痛苦的，困扰的；极度的，非常的；n. 伤处，痛处，疮；痛处，伤心事；【名】 （Sore）（法）索尔，（意）索雷
definition: 1. n. an open skin infection；2. adj. hurting
example: His feet were sore after the walk.
exampleZh: 他走路把脚都走疼了。

meaning: n. 悲伤，悲痛，悲哀；伤心事；v. 感到（或表示）悲伤
definition: 1. n. an emotion of great sadness associated with loss or bereavement；2. v. feel grief; eat one's heart out
example: They said that the decision was made more in sorrow than in anger.
exampleZh: 他们说作出这个决定，与其说是出于气愤，不如说是出于悲伤。

meaning: adj. 悲伤的，悲痛的，悲哀的；使人悲伤的
definition: 1. adj. experiencing or marked by or expressing sorrow especially that associated with irreparable loss
example: She was very sorrowful when her beauty company caught fire.
exampleZh: 当她的美容公司着火时，她非常伤心。

meaning: adj. 抱歉的，惭愧的，歉疚的；表示同情的，难过的；后悔的，懊悔的；可怜的，糟糕的；int. （用于表示歉意）对不起，抱歉；没听清，请再讲一遍；（纠正自己说错的话）不对，应该是
definition: 1. adj. feeling or expressing sorrow or pity；2. adj. feeling or expressing regret or sorrow or a sense of loss over something done or undone
example: If this were to be an absolute zero Kelvin, then we could we can have something, T2 Sorry, it's T2.
exampleZh: 如果它等于绝对零度，我们可以，对不起，这是。

meaning: n. 种类，品种；某一种（或某一类）人；（计算机对信息的）分类，排序；程度，方式；v. 整理，把……分类，拣选；妥善处理，安排妥当；交往；协调
definition: 1. n. a category of things distinguished by some common characteristic or quality；2. v. examine in order to test suitability
example: God creates the world and then sort of, as Milton says himself, "uncircumscrib'd withdraws," right? God is not there.
exampleZh: 上帝创造了这个世界，然后，就像弥尔顿说的，“退出了“，是吗，上帝不在结构之中。

meaning: n. 灵魂；心灵；某种人；（用于否定句中）一个人（也没有）；灵乐；感受强烈感情的能力；（艺术、音乐作品或文章中的）热情，气魄；精神，精髓；（某地的）人们，人口（souls）；（人类整体的）精神状况，道德品质；（某种品质的）典范，化身；美国黑人文化（或种族尊严）；鬼魂；adj. 激情黑人的，黑人文化的；【名】 （Soul）（英、法）苏尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. the immaterial part of a person; the actuating cause of an individual life；2. n. a human being
example: I think even soul's emotion... People are a little too off for good church, for good church people. -Right.
exampleZh: 这也和“灵魂情感“有关。。。,人们对按时拜谒教会这件事，太冷淡，-是的。

meaning: n. 声音，声响；听力范围，听距；乐音；（音乐演出、电影等的）音响录制和播出，音响制作；无线电广播；声音，音响；（个人或乐队的）音乐特色，音乐风格；流行音乐（sounds）；海峡，海湾；厄勒海峡（the Sound）；印象，感觉；（检查体腔的）医用探子；v. （使）发声，（使）作响；发出（警告等），（以……语调）发表；测量（水体）的深度；试探，探询；听起来像；（从嗓音中）听起来；（用于谈论印象或观点）听起来，似乎；发音；听诊（肺或其他体腔）；（医）用探子检查（人的膀胱或其他内腔）；（尤指鲸鱼）向深海潜入；adj. 无损伤的，健康的，坚实的；合理的，明智的，可靠的；全面的，透彻的；酣睡的，沉睡的；（惩罚）严厉的；不错的，实实在在的；资金充实的；adv. 酣畅地
definition: 1. n. the particular auditory effect produced by a given cause；2. v. appear in a certain way
example: I go in, and I remix and produce the sound that they have, and we put them out.
exampleZh: 之后才加入到制作过程当中，将原声带进行混合重组，并将它们拿到市场上发行。

meaning: n. 汤，羹；发动机等的马力，动力；困境，麻烦（主要用于 in the soup）；vt. （常作 soup up）给（发动机、车辆等）加速，增加马力
definition: 1. n. liquid food especially of meat or fish or vegetable stock often containing pieces of solid food；2. v. dope (a racehorse)
example: You can look at her and say, "We don't have any of the ingredients for chicken soup."
exampleZh: 你可以看着她，说“我们都没有做鸡汤的食材。”

meaning: adj. 酸的，酸味的；（牛奶等）馊（味）的，酸臭的；不友善的，脾气坏的；（关系、计划等变得）坏的，令人不快的；（土壤）缺少石灰质的，酸性过重的；（石油，天然气）含硫量较高的；v. （使）（关系、情况）变糟，变坏；（使）变酸，（使）酸腐；使喜悦减少；n. 有酸味的酒精饮料；酸味；苦事；【名】 （Sour）（柬）索（人名）
definition: 1. n. a cocktail made of a liquor (especially whiskey or gin) mixed with lemon or lime juice and sugar；2. v. go sour or spoil
example: And I think eventually that question would gnaw at you and sour and override the pleasure.
exampleZh: 最终那个疑问会折磨你,飞升超越那种快感。

meaning: n. 来源，出处；（问题的）原因，根源；消息人士，信息来源；河流源头，发源地；源（代）码；（电子）源极，电源；（技）源；v. （从某地）获得；找出……的来源；【名】 （Source）（法）苏尔斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. the place where something begins, where it springs into being；2. v. get (a product) from another country or business
example: The relativity of truth, the profusion of languages, these things that afflict Eliot are a source of faith for Stevens.
exampleZh: 真理的相关性，语言的丰富性，这些折磨着艾略特的事物，对于史蒂文斯而言却是信仰的来源。

meaning: n. 南，（罗盘的）南方；（某个地方、国家、区域的）南部；美国南部各州，英格兰南部（the South）；（南半球的）发展中国家（the South）；（桥牌）坐在南首位置的人（South）；adj. 位于南方的，朝南的；（风）来自南方的；（用于国家、州或地区等的名称中）南部的，南部居民的；adv. 向南，朝南；去南方，在南方；低于（south of）；下滑，恶化；v. 向南方，朝南；（天体）穿过子午线
definition: 1. n. the region of the United States lying south of the Mason-Dixon line；2. adj. situated in or facing or moving toward or coming from the south
example: If you head up around, like Clement, near like Arguello, like just a couple blocks south of the Presidio,
exampleZh: 要是直走，就是克莱门街，挨着阿圭罗街，距离普雷西迪奥两个街区的距离，

meaning: adj. 在南方的，向南的；南方的；美国南部地区的（Southern）；（风）从南面吹来的；n. 南方人（Southern）；【名】 （Southern）（英）萨瑟恩（人名）
definition: 1. adj. in or characteristic of a region of the United States south of (approximately) the Mason-Dixon line；2. adj. situated in or oriented toward the south
example: I think that maybe the one thing they have going for them down in Southern California is the weather.
exampleZh: 我觉得人们喜欢在南加州住，还有可能是因为这里的天气。

meaning: n. 东南，东南方；东南地区，东南部；adj. 东南的，东南部的；（风）来自东南的；adv. 在东南，朝东南；来自东南
definition: 1. n. the compass point midway between south and east; at 135 degrees；2. adj. coming from the southeast
example: How did it affect...India affects the rest of Asia in particular the developing countries ? of southeast Asia?
exampleZh: 印度。。。是如何影响亚洲其他国家,尤其是东南亚,发展中国家的？

meaning: adj. 东南部的，东南方的；朝东南的
definition: 1. adj. situated in or oriented toward the southeast；2. adj. of a region of the United States generally including Alabama; Georgia; Florida; Tennessee; South Carolina; North Carolina
example: The foliage of Hocking Hills is so breathtaking the fall time that it's known as Southeastern Ohio's Scenic Wonderland.
exampleZh: 在秋天，霍金山上的枝叶是如此的美不胜收，以至于霍金山被誉为俄亥俄州东南部著名风景区。

meaning: n. 西南，西南方（指南与西之间的方向）；西南部（某地朝向西南的部分）；（常作 the Southwest）美国西南部地区；adj. 西南的，西南部的；（风）来自西南方的；adv. 往西南，朝西南；来自西南（方）；在西南方（常后接 of 引出参照地点）
definition: 1. n. the compass point midway between south and west; at 225 degrees；2. adj. coming from the southwest
example: This southwest region of France is the home of claret.
exampleZh: 法国西南部的这个地区是波尔多干红葡萄酒的产地。

meaning: adj. 西南部的；向西南的；（多用于风、气流等）来自西南的
definition: 1. n. a dialect of Middle English；2. adj. situated in or oriented toward the southwest
example: Butter has now been replaced by margarine in Happy Pancake House restaurants throughout the southwestern United States.
exampleZh: 在美国西南部的快乐煎饼屋餐厅里，黄油已经被人造黄油所取代。

meaning: n. 纪念品，纪念物；v. 把……作为纪念品
definition: 1. n. something of sentimental value；2. n. a reminder of past events
example: You can keep that for a souvenir if you'd like.
exampleZh: 如果你们喜欢，你们可以把那个当做一个纪念品。

meaning: n. 君主，元首；金镑（旧时英国金币，面值一英镑）；独立国；adj. （国家）有主权的，完全独立的；掌握全部权力的，有至高无上的权力的；首要的；非常好的，非常有效的；不折不扣的；【名】 （Sovereign）（美、加、俄、英、印、澳）索夫林（人名）
definition: 1. a king or queen；2. a British gold coin that was in use in Britain from 1817 to 1914 and was worth £1
example: Lithuania and Armenia signed a treaty in Vilnius recognizing each other as independent sovereign states.
exampleZh: 立陶宛和亚美尼亚在维尔纽斯签订了一份互相承认各自为独立主权国家的协定。

meaning: n. 主权，最高统治权，最高权威；独立自主；主权国家，自治州
definition: 1. the power of a country to control its own government
example: Hawaii's native minority is demanding a greater degree of sovereignty over its own affairs.
exampleZh: 夏威夷的土著少数民族要求对自己的事务拥有更大程度的主权。

meaning: v. 播种，种；激起，散布，煽动；埋（地雷），将（一地区）布上地雷；布满，覆盖；n. 母猪；某些雌性哺乳动物（如豚鼠）；铁锭；【名】 （Sow）（几、马里、乍、毛里塔、塞内）索乌（人名）
definition: 1. n. an adult female hog；2. v. place (seeds) in or on the ground for future growth
example: The piglets are taken from the sow to be fattened for market.
exampleZh: 这些小猪被从母猪身边带走，好育肥上市。

meaning: n. 空间，空地；（尤指有特定用途的）空位，处所；（公共汽车等的）空座；开阔地，空旷处；开阔，空旷；太空，外层空间；宇宙空间；一段时间；属于自己的空间；空格，空行；版面，篇幅；广告专页，广告插播时间；（乐）（谱表的）线间空白；（电信）空号；v. 把（某物）隔开；在（词语等）之间加空格；变得昏昏沉沉，瞪着眼发呆
definition: 1. n. the unlimited expanse in which everything is located；2. v. place at intervals
example: He separates the waters above and the waters below and creates this space that will become the inhabited world.
exampleZh: 他将天上的水和地上的水分离开来,开创了这个将被居住的世界。

meaning: adj. （房间或建筑物）宽敞的；无边无际的
definition: 1. adj. very large in expanse or scope；2. adj. (of buildings and rooms) having ample space
example: It's a small car, yet it's surprisingly spacious.
exampleZh: 这辆汽车不大，然而却出奇地宽敞。

meaning: adj. 空间的，与空间有关的；空间理解能力的
definition: 1. adj. pertaining to or involving or having the nature of space
example: One is also able to see how specific acts are related to a temporal and spatial context.
exampleZh: 人们也能看到具体的行为如何与时间和空间背景相关联。

meaning: n. 宇宙飞船
definition: 1. n. a spacecraft designed to carry a crew into interstellar space (especially in science fiction)
example: Its spaceship was engineered by Bert Rutan, renowned for designing the Voyager.
exampleZh: 它的飞船由伯特·鲁坦设计建造，此人因设计“旅行者”号飞船而闻名。

meaning: n. 锹，铲；（纸牌中的）黑桃（spades）；黑桃牌；黑人，黑鬼；v. 用锹挖（地），用锹铲（土）；把……弄实抹平；【名】 （Spade）（法）斯帕德，（英）斯佩德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a playing card in the major suit that has one or more black figures on it；2. v. dig (up) with a spade
example: There's the spade in "Home Burial," the spade that's used to bury the couple's little child.
exampleZh: 在“叶落归根“中有锹“,用来埋藏这对夫妇的小孩的。

meaning: n. （不可数）意大利式细面条（一种细长实心的意大利面食，常与酱汁同食）；（Spaghetti，首字母大写）意大利语人名或姓氏，音译“斯帕盖蒂”
definition: 1. pasta made in the form of long, thin strings
example: But the word white shows up a lot in the high glycemic index foods -white rice, white spaghetti, white bread.
exampleZh: 但是白色这个词会在,许多高血糖指数的食物中出现,白米,白面条,白面包

meaning: n. 时间跨度，一段时间；（桥或拱的）墩距，跨距；宽度，翼展；范围，包括的种类；（航海）跨绳；一队人（或动物）；数值范围；一掌的长度；v. 持续，贯穿；包括（广大地区），涵盖（多项内容）；横跨，跨越；张开手覆盖（或环绕）；给（动物）套上轭；adj. 整洁干净的，照管得很好的（spick and span）；【名】 （Span）（捷）斯潘（人名）
definition: 1. n. the complete duration of something；2. v. to cover or extend over an area or time period
example: But if you think of the time span about 900 to 700 B.C., that is, when these changes are taking place.
exampleZh: 但是如果你发现它发生在,大约公元前900年到700年之间时

meaning: adj. 备用的，外加的；不用的，闲置的；空闲的，空余的；多余的；简单的，简朴的；瘦的，瘦高的；少量的；节约的；v. 抽出，拿出（时间、金钱等）；饶恕，赦免；省得，免去；节约，吝惜；保证（或满足）自己的需要（spare oneself）；剩余，剩下（时间、金钱或空间）；分让；删节；n. 备用品；（车辆或机器的）零件，备件；（十柱保龄球戏中的）二击全倒；【名】 (Spare)（美、英、瑞典、加、拉脱维亚、印、法）史琶尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. an extra component of a machine or other apparatus；2. v. refrain from harming
example: Can you tell us about some of the spare time activities that you can do in San Francisco?
exampleZh: 你能告诉我们你在旧金山空闲时间都做什么吗？
exampleSource: 旧金山和洛杉矶的差异

meaning: adv. 一点点，俭省地
definition: 1. adv. to a meager degree or in a meager manner
example: It's also great when sparingly rubbed on a well-marbled steak or a fatty pork chop before the meat goes onto the grill.
exampleZh: 在肉放上烤架之前，在肥瘦均匀的牛排或油滋滋的猪排骨上少量摩擦，也是很棒的。

meaning: n. 导火线，诱因；火花，火星；电火花；一丝，略微；生气，活力，才华；愤怒的情感，激烈的情绪；军队中对无线电报务员（或电工）的昵称（Sparks）；生龙活虎的小伙子；（内燃机里火花塞的）放电；v. 引发，触发；产生火花（电火花）；点燃；增加趣味（或活力、风味等）；求婚；【名】 (Spark) （美）斯帕克（人名）
definition: 1. n. a momentary flash of light；2. v. put in motion or move to act
example: It all sort of depends on how you hit it off with somebody, whether there's a spark.
exampleZh: 这要看你是不是跟那个人合得来，能不能擦出火花。

meaning: v. 闪烁，闪耀；生气勃勃，热情奔放；（眼睛）发亮；（酒类饮料）起泡；n. 闪耀，闪烁；（眼睛的）神采；生气，活力；气泡
definition: 1. n. merriment expressed by a brightness or gleam or animation of countenance；2. v. reflect brightly
example: There was a sparkle of excitement in her eyes.
exampleZh: 她眼里闪耀着激动的光芒。

meaning: v. 谈话，交谈；说，讲述；（会）讲（某种语言）；发言，演讲；（不用言语）表明，显示；代表……讲话，充当……的代言人；（发言或写作中）提到，谈及；以……方式说；表达（思想、观点）；（乐器或其他物体）发出特有的响声；（猎狗）吠
definition: 1. v. express in speech；2. v. exchange thoughts; talk with
example: or it's a moment where you're both feeling opened and available to speak about what the other person looks like.
exampleZh: 或者是在你们彼此都感觉轻松坦率，因而可以评价对方的样子的时候。

meaning: n. 发言者，演讲者；说话者；讲某种语言的人；扬声器，喇叭；（议会或立法机构的）议长（Speaker）；【名】 （Speaker）斯皮克（人名）
definition: 1. n. someone who expresses in language; someone who talks (especially someone who delivers a public speech or someone especially garrulous)；2. n. electro-acoustic transducer that converts electrical signals into sounds loud enough to be heard at a distance
example: maybe you're practicing English with a native speaker and you didn't quite catch what the other person said.
exampleZh: 也许你正和一位母语为英语的朋友练习英语口语，但你没能很好地理解那个人在说什么。

meaning: n. 矛，标枪；嫩枝，幼芽；v. （用尖利的东西）刺，叉；（用锋利的武器）刺，刺杀；【名】 （Spear）斯皮尔（人名）
definition: 1. a weapon consisting of a pole with a sharp, usually metal, point at one end, that is either thrown or held in the hand；2. a thin pointed stem or leaf
example: Satan's spear is to the tallest pine what the tallest pine is to a little, bitty wand.
exampleZh: 撒旦的长矛对于最高的松木而言就如同最高的松木,对比一根小小的棍子一般大。

meaning: adj. 特殊的，特别的；格外看重的，特别要好的；专门的，特设的；特有的，独具特色的；格外的，分外的；（主题）研究深入的；（数）特殊（矩阵）的；n. 特色菜；特别节目；特价商品，折扣商品；特派员，临时警察，特约记者；专车；【名】 （Special）（印、美、俄）史派西娅乐（人名）
definition: 1. n. a special offering (usually temporary and at a reduced price) that is featured in advertising；2. adj. unique or specific to a person or thing or category
example: I felt like, in my hometown of Huston, it was cool, special, and different that I was an actor.
exampleZh: 在我的老家休斯顿，作为一名演员，我觉得很酷、很特别、很与众不同。
family: special / specialize / specializise / specialization / specializatiosation / specialist

meaning: vi. 专门研究（或从事），专攻；专营；（生）使（器官）专化，使特化
definition: 1. v. become more special；2. v. be specific about
example: So, we are going to specialize to a very limited class of problems in the rest of this class.
exampleZh: 在接下来的时间里,我们会专门研究,一类非常有限的问题
family: special / specialize / specializise / specialization / specializatiosation / specialist

meaning: n. 专业；专业化，专门化；（生物）特化作用
definition: 1. n. the act of specializing; making something suitable for a special purpose；2. n. the special line of work you have adopted as your career
example: The Ph. D. candidate is likely to change his field of specialization if he drops out.
exampleZh: 如果这位博士生退学，他很可能会改变自己的专业方向。
family: special / specialize / specializise / specialization / specializatiosation / specialist

meaning: n. 专家；专科医生；美国陆军专业人员（高于一等兵低于下士的军衔）；adj. 专业的；专门的；专家的
definition: 1. n. an expert who is devoted to one occupation or branch of learning；2. n. practices one branch of medicine
example: Each specialist has a team of doctors under him or her.
exampleZh: 每位专家手下都有一组医生。
family: special / specialize / specializise / specialization / specializatiosation / specialist

meaning: n. 专业，专长；特色食品，特产；特产， 专卖店；（律）盖印的书面合同
definition: 1. a product that is extremely good in a particular place；2. a subject that someone knows a lot about
example: You can go to medical school. And then,this is the specialty topics that pertain to the devices engineering systems.
exampleZh: 你可以去上医学院，到时,这个专业的课题就从属于,设备工程系统。

meaning: n. （动植物的）种，物种；种类；（具有相同特征的）一类人；（化学，物理）核素；（圣餐中用的）面包和圣酒；adj. 原种的
definition: 1. n. (biology) taxonomic group whose members can interbreed；2. n. a specific kind of something
example: And in fact, Skinner explicitly made the analogy from the natural selection of species to the natural selection of behavior.
exampleZh: 实际上，斯金纳也确实明确地,对物种的自然选择,同行为的自然选择进行过类比。

meaning: adj. 明确的，具体的；特定的；特有的，独特的；有特殊功能的，有特效的；（生物）种的；（关税，税）按数量（根据固定税率）征取而非按货价征取的；（物理）（与参照物同一性质成）比率的；n. 细节，详情；特效药
definition: 1. n. a fact about some part (as opposed to general)；2. adj. (sometimes followed by `to') applying to or characterized by or distinguishing something particular or special or unique
example: This is very simple but it's a great way to ask about a specific category among many different categories.
exampleZh: 这是个非常简单的句型，但它在询问不同种类中某一特定类型的事物时是非常理想的句型。

meaning: adv. 特意，专门地；明确地，具体地；具体来说，确切地说；局限性地；专门；（生）种的
definition: 1. adv. in distinction from others
example: Remember, this is pattern that we use when the question relates specifically to the person you are speaking with.
exampleZh: 记住，我们使用这个句型时，所提的问题仅仅针对谈话的对象。

meaning: v. 明确指出；具体说明；把……列入说明书
definition: 1. v. specify as a condition or requirement in a contract or agreement; make an express demand or provision in an agreement；2. v. determine the essential quality of
example: The contract has to specify what are the causes of, let's say, death or a situation in which one is covered.
exampleZh: 合约中必须指明,合约建立目的，比如说，死亡或者承保的是什么情况。

meaning: n. 规格，规范，明细单，说明书；明确说明，详述；（申请专利用的）发明物说明书
definition: 1. n. a detailed description of design criteria for a piece of work；2. n. naming explicitly
example: An idea of abstraction, that idea of specification, is exactly what we want to use inside of our functions.
exampleZh: 抽象的概念，规格化的概念,就是我们想要运用到。

meaning: n. 样品，标本；（尤指动植物的）实例；（化验的）抽样，血样，尿样；具有……特性的人（幽默用法）
definition: 1. n. an example regarded as typical of its class；2. n. a bit of tissue or blood or urine that is taken for diagnostic purposes
example: Those billions and billions of birds shrank to a single remaining specimen, a passenger pigeon named Martha.
exampleZh: 那数十亿只鸟缩减为一个仅存的标本，一只名叫玛莎的旅鸽。

meaning: n. 精彩的表演，壮观的场面；壮观的景象；不寻常的事，出人意料的情况；眼镜（spectacles）
definition: 1. an unusual or unexpected event or situation that attracts attention, interest, or disapproval；2. a public event or show that is exciting to watch
example: But, anyway, this poor guy's not doing very well up there and becomes this sort of big spectacle.
exampleZh: 但是这个可怜的人在这上面肯定不好受,还成为众人的焦点

meaning: adj. 壮观的，令人惊叹的；惊人的，突如其来的；n. 壮观场面，盛大演出
definition: 1. very exciting to look at；2. especially great
example: So that's how using some of these basic ratios gives us this primordial type of music and it's quite spectacular.
exampleZh: 这就是如何用基本的音符来为我们创造,简单的音乐,但是这种音乐真的很雄奇壮丽

meaning: n. （尤指体育比赛的）观看者，观众；旁观者
definition: 1. a person who watches an activity, especially a sports event, without taking part；2. a person who watches an activity, esp. a public event, without taking part
example: I had been a spectator, and then suddenly a participant, a player, and a member of the jury.
exampleZh: 我曾是一个旁观者，然后突然变成了参与者、玩家和陪审团的一员。

meaning: n. 范围，幅度；光谱；波谱，频谱；余象
definition: 1. the set of colours into which a beam of light can be separated, or a range of waves, such as light waves or radio waves；2. a range of different positions, opinions, etc. between two extreme points
example: A spectrum is formed by a ray of light passing through a prism.
exampleZh: 一束光通过棱镜就会形成光谱。

meaning: v. 猜测，推测；投机
definition: 1. v. to believe especially on uncertain or tentative grounds；2. v. talk over conjecturally, or review in an idle or casual way and with an element of doubt or without sufficient reason to reach a conclusion
example: Those are easy. There's no getting around reading those things, and then it gets to be more interesting as we speculate.
exampleZh: 这些都是显而易见的,还有些历史是,没有记录的,靠的是人们丰富的联想

meaning: n. 投机，投机买卖；猜测，推测，推断
definition: 1. n. a message expressing an opinion based on incomplete evidence；2. n. a hypothesis that has been formed by speculating or conjecturing (usually with little hard evidence)
example: Every conceivable Protestant sect was publishing treatises of theological speculation and publishing treatises of religious propaganda at an extraordinary rate.
exampleZh: 任何能想到的新教徒的宗教派别都在以不同寻常的,速度出版神学思考著作和,宗教宣传著作。

meaning: adj. 推测的，猜测的，推断的；投机性的，风险性的；好奇的，揣摩的；倾向于推测的，爱思辨的
definition: 1. adj. not financially safe or secure；2. adj. not based on fact or investigation
example: Even before the invention of the electric light bulb, the author produced a remarkable work of speculative fiction.
exampleZh: 甚至在电灯泡发明之前，这位作者就创作了一部出色的思辨虚构作品（科幻小说）。

meaning: n. 演说，发言，谈话；说话的能力；说话方式；口语，言语；（戏剧中的）台词；（该词常用于使某人感到自己所说的话很愚蠢）长篇大论
definition: 1. n. the act of delivering a formal spoken communication to an audience；2. n. (language) communication by word of mouth
example: Because you're able to use this questions to soften your speech in asking a variety of different questions.
exampleZh: 因为你可以用这样的问句来使你提出的问题更为温和。

meaning: adj. （因气愤、震惊、惊讶等）说不出话的，无语的；非言语所能表达的
definition: 1. adj. unable to speak temporarily
example: She says nothing after this encounter, remaining silent or speechless for the rest of the mask, but Milton clearly finds, I think, something threatening here.
exampleZh: 在这次相遇中她什么都没说，在接下来中也保持着沉默寡言，可我认为弥尔顿在这里找到了一些威胁。

meaning: n. （运动）速度；（某事发生或进行的）速度；快，迅速；排挡，变速器；快门速度；感光度；照片曝光的时间；安非他明；成功，繁荣；v. 快速移动；快速运送；超速驾驶；（使）加速，促进；使兴旺发达，帮助成功；用（脱氧麻黄碱之类的）兴奋剂成瘾；【名】 （Speed）斯皮德（人名）
definition: 1. n. distance travelled per unit time；2. v. step on it
example: For example, if we're talking about a pitcher, like Matsuzaka, we might want to know the speed of his average fastball.
exampleZh: 举例来说，如果我们谈到一个投手，就像松阪，我们想知道他投出,快球的平均速度。

meaning: adj. 迅速发生的；高速的，快速移动的；【名】 （Speedy）（英）斯皮迪（人名）
definition: 1. adj. characterized by speed; moving with or capable of moving with high speed；2. adj. accomplished rapidly and without delay
example: I hope you can forgive me and please accept my best wishes for a speedy recovery.
exampleZh: 希望你能原谅我，并请接受我最诚挚的祝福，祝早日康复。

meaning: n. 超速驾驶，超速行驶；adj. 快速行进的，快速移动的；v. 快速前行；加速，促进；超速行驶（speed 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. changing location rapidly；2. adj. moving with great speed
example: The police caught him speeding.
exampleZh: 警察发现他超速行驶。

meaning: n. 一段时间；（疾病突然的）一次发作；咒语，符咒，着魔；魅力，魔力；轮班；休息期；（板球）（一个投手的）一轮投球时间；木片；v. 拼写，拼缀出（单词）；拼作，拼成；招致，意味着（通常指坏事）；具有……的显著特征；替换，顶替；稍事休息；【名】 （Spell）斯佩尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a psychological state induced by (or as if induced by) a magical incantation；2. v. orally recite the letters of or give the spelling of
example: So we had two weeks like about... Three weeks ago, we had like a big heat spell.
exampleZh: 所以我们已经有两个星期像这样了……三个星期前，我们有一个持续高温的时期。

meaning: n. 拼写，拼写能力；拼法，拼读；v. （用字母）拼写，拼出；招致，意味着（通常指坏事）；替换，顶替（spell 的现在分词形式）；【名】 （Spelling）斯佩林（人名）
definition: 1. n. forming words with letters according to the principles underlying accepted usage
example: Her spelling isn't too hot.
exampleZh: 她的拼写不太好。

meaning: v. 度过，花（时间）；花（钱），花费；消耗，用尽（精力等）；n. 花费，开销；n. 预算
definition: 1. v. pass (time) in a specific way；2. v. pay out
example: We aren't very wealthy, so we don't have enough money to spend on that even if I wanted to.
exampleZh: 我们不是很富有，所以即使是我想买，我也没有足够的钱去买。

meaning: n. （尤指政府或组织的）支出，开销，花费；v. 用，花（钱）；花（时间），度过；花费，消耗，用尽（精力等）（spend的现在分词形式）；花费，消耗，用尽（精力等）（spend 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. the act of spending or disbursing money
example: And so I would never condemn people for spending time and going and looking at that and developing themselves.
exampleZh: 所以我从不会谴责人们将时间花在上面浏览，查阅并充实自己。

meaning: n. （活动、兴趣、专业知识的）范围，领域；球体，球，球形；社会阶层；势力范围；苍穹，天，天空；天体；天体外壳；地球仪；vt. 使……成球形；包围；放入球内
definition: 1. n. a particular environment or walk of life；2. n. any spherically shaped artifact
example: This area was formerly within the sphere of influence of the US.
exampleZh: 这一地区先前属于美国的势力范围。

meaning: adj. 球形的，球状的；（与）球体（有关）的；在球内（或球面上）形成的；天体的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to spheres or resembling a sphere；2. adj. having the shape of a sphere or ball
example: And this is kind of nice because you see it is not an abrupt spherical surface.
exampleZh: 这种动画很好,因为你从中看到的并不是一个唐突的球面。

meaning: n. 香料，调味品；情趣，趣味；赤褐色；糖果；少许；v. 给……增添趣味；在……中加香料；【名】 （Spice）斯派斯（人名）
definition: 1. a substance made from a plant, used to give a special flavour to food；2. something that makes something else more exciting and interesting
example: My team is working on a spice vending machine for spices.
exampleZh: 我的团队正在设计一个香料自动售货机。

meaning: adj. 加有香料的，辛辣的；刺激的，粗俗的
definition: 1. containing strong flavours from spices；2. exciting and interesting, especially because of being shocking or dealing with sexual matters
example: The spicy flavours in these dishes call for reds rather than whites.
exampleZh: 这些菜肴味道辛辣，宜配红葡萄酒而不是白葡萄酒。

meaning: n. 蜘蛛；（搜索引擎的）蜘蛛程序，（计算机）爬虫程序；状似蜘蛛的物体；蛛网形系索；台球棒三脚架；设圈套者；v. （似蜘蛛般）急促爬动；设网，设圈套；（在因特网上）快速搜索（crawl 的别名）
definition: 1. a small creature with eight thin legs that catches insects in a web (= a net made from sticky threads)
example: The spider must wait for prey to be ensnared on its web.
exampleZh: 蜘蛛一定要耐心等待，直到猎物被它的蛛网困住。

meaning: v. （使）洒出，泼出，溢出；（东西）倒出，洒落；涌出，蜂拥而出；（光线）透进，倾泻在……上；向（某人）说出秘密；使（某人）从马上（或自行车上）摔下来；（球赛中）掉球；（航海）减少（帆）的受风压力（多指把帆放松）；n. 洒出（量），溢出（量）；（从马、自行车上等的）摔下，跌下；职位空缺；（点火用的）纸捻，木片；小塞子；【名】 （Spill）（德、美、英、法）施皮尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. liquid that is spilled；2. v. cause or allow (a liquid substance) to run or flow from a container
example: That's because the ideas of physics don't fall into 75-minute segments and sometimes they spill over a little bit.
exampleZh: 因为物理的知识不是死板的75分钟课程,所以我会有时候做一些微调

meaning: v. （使）快速旋转；（使）急转身；（头感到）眩晕；纺纱，纺织；飞驰，疾驰；编故事；有倾向性地陈述；（用甩干机或洗衣机）甩干（衣服）；（昆虫）吐（丝），结（网）；（用旋式诱饵）钓鱼；播放（唱片）；抛（硬币）；（球）旋转；（用车床将金属薄板）旋压成形；n. 高速旋转；兜风；带倾向性的解释（或说法）；（政治上的）倾向性报道；（尤指板球、网球、斯诺克球中的）旋转球；（飞机的）旋冲，螺旋下降；晕头转向，焦虑不安；（物理）核素总角动量
definition: 1. n. a swift whirling motion (usually of a missile)；2. v. revolve quickly and repeatedly around one's own axis
example: So by parallel we mean - they're either both spin up remember that's our spin quantum number, that fourth quantum number.
exampleZh: 所以我们意味着,它们都是自旋向上,记住我们的自旋量子数，是第四个量子数。

meaning: n. 脊髓，脊柱；书脊；（动植物的）刺，刺毛；中心力量，中流砥柱；骨气，勇气；直线型薪酬级别制；（地质）火山栓，熔岩塔
definition: 1. the line of bones down the centre of the back that provides support for the body and protects the spinal cord；2. a long, sharp point like a needle growing out of an animal such as a hedgehog or a plant such as a cactus
example: A bone in my spine was out of alignment.
exampleZh: 我的脊椎骨有一节脱位。

meaning: adj. 脊髓的，脊柱的；（与）中心（有关）的，骨干的；针的，尖刺的；n. 脊椎麻醉
definition: 1. of the spine；2. of the spine down the center of the back
example: Almost all sensory information from the trunk and limbs passes through the spinal cord.
exampleZh: 几乎所有来自躯干及四肢的感官信息都经由脊髓传递。

meaning: n. 螺旋形，螺旋形之物；持续加剧的上升（或下降、恶化）；旋球；v. 螺旋式上升（或下降），盘旋上升（或下降）；持续下降，持续恶化；急剧上升；adj. 螺旋形的；（医）扭折（骨折的一种）；spiral-bound的简称
definition: 1. a shape made up of curves, each one above or wider than the one before；2. a situation in which a price, etc. becomes lower, or a situation gets worse and is difficult to control because one bad event causes another
example: It's an opportunity to deal with those perhaps in a more constructive way, than letting the feeling spiral.
exampleZh: 也许可以借这个机会用更有建设性,的方法应对，而不是使负面情绪恶化。

meaning: n. 精神，心灵；情绪，心境；勇气，意志，活力；（对团体、队伍、社会的）忠心，（群体中的）态度，精神；心态，态度；本质，精髓，基本精神；真实意义，实质；灵魂，鬼魂；具有特别品质的人物，在群体或活动中发挥特殊作用的人物；烈酒；挥发性液体（尤指用蒸馏法提炼的燃料）；神灵；圣灵（Spirit，Holy Spirit 的简称）；v. 偷偷带走，秘密弄走；鼓励，鼓舞
definition: 1. n. the vital principle or animating force within living things；2. v. infuse with spirit
example: A lot has happened since the exuberant optimism of the political spirit that we see in a tract like Areopagitica.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿在《论出版自由》中发表了极为乐观的政治思想之后,政治形势发生了很大变化。

meaning: adj. 精神的，心灵的；宗教的；（人）高尚的，不为物欲所动的；n. （原为美国黑人所唱的）圣歌，灵歌
definition: 1. n. a kind of religious song originated by Blacks in the southern United States；2. adj. concerned with sacred matters or religion or the church
example: He is expected to be enthroned early next year as the spiritual leader.
exampleZh: 人们预计他将于明年初作为精神领袖登位。

meaning: v. 啐唾沫（常表示愤怒或鄙视）；吐出（食物，液体）；怒斥；（火，煮物）爆出火花，发出噼啪声，（使）迸溅；（发怒时）发呼噜呼噜声；下小雨；将烤肉扦子戳入（肉）中以便放在火上烤；表演说唱音乐；n. 唾液，口水；烤肉扦子；岬角，海岬；几乎长得一模一样的人；锹深的泥土层；啐唾沫，吐痰，吐食物；沙嘴
definition: 1. n. a narrow strip of land that juts out into the sea；2. v. expel or eject (saliva or phlegm or sputum) from the mouth
example: Notices in the waiting room requested that you neither smoke nor spit.
exampleZh: 等候室的告示要求人们不要吸烟也不要随地吐痰。

meaning: n. 恶意，怨恨；不顾，尽管；不由自主地；vt. 刁难，使恼怒
definition: 1. n. feeling a need to see others suffer；2. v. hurt the feelings of
example: But in spite of that, I noticed that as I went, as I ventured outside of law school,
exampleZh: 但尽管那样，当我走出法学院，开始去外面闯荡的时候，我发现

meaning: v. （液体）稀里哗啦地溅落，飞溅；朝……泼洒，使……溅湿；泼溅着水行进，拍打着水游；以显著版面刊载，以大篇幅报道；使有色块，使有光斑； 在（某物）上花很多钱；n. 落水声，溅泼声；溅上的液体，溅洒后留下的污渍；掺入饮料的少量液体；色块，光斑；（报章等旨在招徕读者的）重点文章；拍水，戏水；引人注目的效果
definition: 1. n. the sound like water splashing；2. v. cause (a liquid) to spatter about, especially with force
example: We're going to splash out and buy a new car.
exampleZh: 我们打算挥霍一下，买辆新车。

meaning: adj. 极佳的，非常好的；壮丽的，灿烂的，辉煌的；（一段时光）令人愉快的；int. （表示赞许或满意）好极了，痛快
definition: 1. adj. having great beauty and splendor；2. adj. characterized by grandeur
example: He invaded and he was clobbered, and then you read the splendid story Herodotus tells of how he was captured.
exampleZh: 他大举入侵波斯,但惨遭重创,接着,你就读到希罗多德,讲述他如何被俘的故事了

meaning: n. 壮丽，壮观；美景，让人印象深刻的事物（splendors）；【名】 （Splendor）斯普伦多尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a quality that outshines the usual；2. n. the quality of being magnificent or splendid or grand
example: The author tried to depict the splendor of the sunset.
exampleZh: 作家试图摹写落日的光彩。

meaning: v. （使）分裂，（使）产生分歧；（使）分开，分成（不同部分）；（使）撕裂；分担，分享；划破，割破；结束关系，分手；迅速离开；使（原子）产生核裂变；告发，揭发；（头）剧痛；n. 裂口，裂缝；分离，分裂，分歧；分配，份额；区分，不同；劈叉；分开（或切开）的东西；错层式房屋；分段耗时；平局，连续打成平局的比赛；adj. 分裂的
definition: 1. n. extending the legs at right angles to the trunks (one in front and the other in back)；2. v. separate into parts or portions
example: That got split in half, and that got split in half until I got to a list of one.
exampleZh: 在那里被分成两半，然后在那里被分两半,直到得到长度为一的列表。

meaning: v. 破坏，糟蹋；溺爱，宠坏；善待，格外关照；（食物）变质，腐败；使（选票）作废；极度渴望，跃跃欲试；抢劫（人，地方），掠夺；n. 赃物，战利品（the spoils）；成功所带来的好处（spoils）；（开掘时挖出的）废土，废泥土
definition: 1. n. (usually plural) valuables taken by violence (especially in war)；2. v. make a mess of, destroy or ruin
example: and it's more or less that. I don't want to spoil it in case anyone goes to see it.
exampleZh: 差不多就是那样的。万一有人要去观看这部剧呢，我可不想毁了它。

meaning: n. （尤指男性）发言人，代言人
definition: 1. n. a male spokesperson
example: A spokesman dismissed any suggestion of a boardroom rift.
exampleZh: 发言人的话打消了人们关于董事会不和的所有推测。

meaning: n. 发言人；代言人
definition: 1. n. an advocate who represents someone else's policy or purpose
example: A spokesperson for the food industry said the TV programme was alarmist.
exampleZh: 食品业的一位发言人说这个电视节目危言耸听。

meaning: n. （擦洗用的天然或人造的）海绵块；（用海绵或布）擦拭，擦洗；海绵蛋糕，松软布丁；依赖他人生活的寄生虫，揩油者；海绵（一种海洋软体动物）；（女用）避孕海绵；海绵填料；金属绵；v. 用海绵擦洗；用湿布（或海绵）擦掉，揩去；白吃，揩油；用海绵抹（漆）
definition: 1. a soft substance that is full of small holes and can absorb a lot of liquid, and is used for washing and cleaning；2. the action of rubbing something or someone with a wet sponge or cloth in order to clean it, him, or her
example: Take your jacket off and I'll sponge it down with water.
exampleZh: 把你的夹克脱下来，我要用海绵蘸上水把它擦一擦。

meaning: adj. 海绵似的，柔软吸水的；（金属）多孔的；（尤指机动车辆的制动系统）不稳固的
definition: 1. soft and able to absorb or having already absorbed a lot of liquid, like a sponge；2. soft and able to absorb a lot of liquid
example: You see, adult female birds during egg production produce a layer of spongy bone tissue inside certain long bones.
exampleZh: 你看，成年雌鸟在产蛋的过程中会在某些长骨内产生一层海绵状的骨组织。

meaning: n. 赞助者，赞助商；（培训或教育的）资助者；（慈善活动的）捐款者，捐资机构；法案的倡议者；担保人，保证人；（宗教事宜中的）引领人；v. 赞助（活动、节目等）； 为慈善活动捐资，为义赛捐款；倡议，提交（法案等）；主办，促成；纵容；为……担保
definition: 1. n. someone who supports or champions something；2. v. assume sponsorship of
example: Please could you sponsor me for my school's campaign for Help the Aged?
exampleZh: 请问你们能赞助我开展我校的“帮助老年人”活动吗？

meaning: n. 赞助，赞助款；资助，倡议
definition: 1. n. the act of sponsoring (either officially or financially)
example: The festival is heavily dependent on sponsorship for its success.
exampleZh: 这次节日庆祝活动成功与否，在很大程度上就看赞助了。

meaning: adj. 自发的，非筹划安排的；（程序，事件）自发的，自然的；（人）天真率直的；（生物）（机体活动）本能的
definition: 1. adj. happening or arising without apparent external cause；2. adj. said or done without having been planned or written in advance
example: Yeats counterposes Isaiah's prophetic coal to the blazing body of Section IV, where fire is spontaneous, imminent, something that arises from the body.
exampleZh: 叶芝将比赛亚的预言性的煤,和第五节里燃烧的身体相对照，这里火是自燃的，迫在眉睫的，是从人身体里升出的。

meaning: n. 自发性，自然；自发行为
definition: 1. n. the quality of being spontaneous and coming from natural feelings without constraint
example: OK, so now let's try to formulate how to describe the equilibrium state and what dictates spontaneity.
exampleZh: 现在我们尝试,找出如何描述平衡态以及,什么东西表明自发性。

meaning: n. 匙，勺子；（作打击乐器用的）调羹对；一匙的量；调羹状物品；vt. 用匙舀，使成匙状；高挑球
definition: 1. n. a piece of cutlery with a shallow bowl-shaped container and a handle; used to stir or serve or take up food；2. v. scoop up or take up with a spoon
example: Just about every culture uses some sort of utensils to eat food with, a knife and a fork, chopsticks, a spoon.
exampleZh: 几乎所有的文化都会使用某些餐具,刀叉,筷子,勺子

meaning: n. 一匙，一勺（的量）
definition: 1. n. as much as a spoon will hold
example: In 'a spoonful of sugar', the word 'spoonful' is a partitive.
exampleZh: 在a spoonful of sugar中，spoonful一词是表量词。

meaning: n. （某项）体育运动；体育运动；运动会（sports）；野外运动（尤指打猎或钓鱼）；（狩猎、钓鱼等活动带来的）成就感；乐趣；开朗大度的人；（用作友好称呼，尤指对男子）朋友，老兄，哥们儿；（生）突变，芽变；v. （引人注目地）穿戴，展示；嬉戏，玩耍；adj. 运动的
definition: 1. n. an active diversion requiring physical exertion and competition；2. v. wear or display in an ostentatious or proud manner
example: when other people that might not have been involved with the sport wouldn't really know what to do.
exampleZh: 而或许没参与过这项运动的人连做什么都不知道。

meaning: n. 运动员（通常指男性），运动家；有运动家风度的人，有体育精神的人；（Sportsman）人名；斯波茨曼
definition: 1. n. someone who engages in sports
example: As a sportsman, he should show his power and strength when he has to.
exampleZh: 作为一名运动员，在必要时，他应当展现自己的力量与实力。

meaning: n. 地点，场所；点，斑点；污点，污渍；丘疹，疱疹；某演员的固定节目；排名位置； 少量，一点；几滴，少许（液体）；困境，窘境；现货交易，现金交易；聚光灯（spotlight 的简称）；（多米诺牌、纸牌或骰子上的）点；调灰泥板，调石膏板；（特定面值的）钞票；（英足）点球点；v. 看见，注意到；让分，让步；飘了几滴雨；借（钱）给；使有斑点，使有污迹；稀疏地点缀；在场监护（运动员）；（军）确定敌人的位置；将（球）放在适当位置；adj. 现货交易的，立即支付的
