example: Abidjan was thrown into turmoil because of a protest by taxi drivers.
exampleZh: 阿比让因计程车司机们的抗议而陷入了混乱。

meaning: v. 旋转，转动；转身，扭转（身体部位）；翻转；旋动，拧动；翻动（书页）；转向，拐（弯）；（路或河流）转弯；对准；（潮）涨落；（使）松开，释放；表演，做；（使）扭转局势；（使）变成，成为；转移（思考、处理、观察等的对象）；求助于，求教于；达到（一定年龄或时间）；（使）反胃，（使）恶心；车削；获得（利益）；扭伤（脚踝）；造（句），组（词）；（印刷）倒排，倒空；包抄（敌军）；n. 转动，旋转；转向；（道路的）转弯处；轮到的机会；（情况的）变化，转变；交替时刻；短小节目；短小节目表演者；散步，转一圈；（疾病的）一阵发作，不适；（影响他人的）举止，行为；吓唬，惊吓；（股票等的）买卖差价；（板球）（球）弹地转向；（一卷绳子等的）一圈；涨潮或落潮；（乐）回音；【名】 （Turn）（德、匈）图恩（人名）
definition: 1. n. a circular segment of a curve；2. v. change orientation or direction, also in the abstract sense
example: They click upon themselves as the breeze rises and turn many-colored as the stir cracks and crazes their enamel.
exampleZh: 一阵风吹起，树枝就咯喇喇响,闪射出五彩缤纷，原来这一颤动,冰块坼裂成瓷瓶上的无数细纹。

meaning: n. 到场人数，参加人数；（选举的）投票人数，投票率；公路避车道，临时停车道；岔道口；（铁道）会让点，道岔；装束，穿着；全套车马；（芭蕾）外开性
definition: 1. the number of people who are present at an event, especially the number who go to vote at an election；2. the number of people who are present for an event
example: Election officials predict they'll set a new turnout record for an off-year election in Washington state.
exampleZh: 选举官员预测，他们将在华盛顿州创下非大选年参加投票人数的新纪录。

meaning: n. （一定时期内的）营业额，成交量；（商店的）货物周转率，销售比率；人事变动率，人员流动率；半圆馅饼（用水果、肉类或蔬菜做馅）；（比赛中的）易手，失误；adj. 翻过来的，可翻转的
definition: 1. the amount of business that a company does in a period of time；2. the rate at which employees leave a company and are replaced by new people
example: The company reported a rapid turnover of staff after the restructuring reduced opportunities for promotion.
exampleZh: 重组减少了晋升机会后，公司报告员工流动率迅速上升。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 海龟；海龟肉；龟；淡水龟；（计算机）龟标；v. 翻到背面或顶部；（尤指在水中）捕捉海龟；【名】 （Turtle）（英）特特尔（人名）
definition: 1. a reptile that lives in the sea and has a thick shell covering its body into which it can move its head and legs for protection. Turtles come onto land in order to lay their eggs；2. a reptile that lives in rivers and lakes and has a thick shell covering its body into which it can move its head and legs for protection. Turtles come onto land in order to lay their eggs
example: Experts say if the island is not protected, the spill could wipe out the gulf's turtle population.
exampleZh: 专家们说如果那座小岛得不到保护，此次泄露有可能使该海湾地区的海龟灭绝。

meaning: n. 家庭教师，私人教师；导师，指导教师；大学助教；（负责成人教育或在大中学中有特别任务的）教师；（尤指音乐）课本；v. 指导，辅导，担任私人教师；当家庭教师，当大学助教，当大学导师
definition: 1. n. a person who gives private instruction (as in singing or acting)；2. v. be a tutor to someone; give individual instruction
example: You seem to be on very familiar terms with your tutor.
exampleZh: 你似乎和你的导师之间很随便。

meaning: adj. 导师的，辅导的；n. 导师辅导课；学习指南，教程
definition: 1. n. a session of intensive tuition given by a tutor to an individual or to a small number of students；2. adj. of or relating to tutors or tutoring
example: There is an excellent tutorial section, which carefully walks you through how to play.
exampleZh: 有一个非常好的使用指南，它仔细地教你怎么玩。

meaning: num. 十二，十二个；n. 十二，十二个；十二点（可指正午或午夜）；adj. 十二的，十二个的
definition: 1. n. the cardinal number that is the sum of eleven and one；2. adj. denoting a quantity consisting of 12 items or units
example: where i'm working, you know, twelve hours a day for a couple a months of the year.
exampleZh: 一年里好几个月我都是每天工作1２个小时。

meaning: adj. 第十二的，第十二个的；十二分之一的；n. 第十二（个/名/位）；十二分之一；（某月的）第十二日；num. 第十二
definition: 1. n. position 12 in a countable series of things；2. adj. coming next after the eleventh and just before the thirteenth in position
example: They have found really no evidence of extensive conquest and destruction in thirteenth and twelfth century archaeological layers.
exampleZh: 他们并没有找到大规模占领的证据,十三世纪摧毁和十二世纪考古层的证据。

meaning: num. 二十；n. 二十；二十几（用复数形式 twenties，指年龄、温度等二十至二十九之间的数字）；二十年代（the twenties，指二十世纪二十年代）；二十美元纸币（常作 a twenty）；adj. 二十的，二十个的
definition: 1. n. the cardinal number that is the sum of nineteen and one；2. adj. denoting a quantity consisting of 20 items or units
example: All of this is Darwinian thinking and, I think, increasingly will be central in importance in the twenty-first century.
exampleZh: 这就是达尔文所思考的，我认为，这在二十一世纪会越来越重要。

meaning: n. 第二十（个）；二十分之一；（某月的）20 日；adj. 第二十的；二十分之一的
definition: 1. n. position 20 in a countable series of things；2. adj. coming next after the nineteenth in position
example: World War I left an indelible imprint on the twentieth-century world.
exampleZh: 第一次世界大战给20世纪的世界留下了深远的影响。

meaning: adv. 两次；两倍，强（或好、难）的多
definition: 1. adv. two times；2. adv. to double the degree
example: and I also really like the, you know, going to the theatre as well obviously because I went twice.
exampleZh: 我还真的很喜欢去剧院。这很明显，因为我去过两次了。

meaning: n. 双胞胎之一，孪生儿之一；两个极相似的事物之一，两个非常相像的人中的一个；（有一对单人床的）双人间；双引擎飞机；孪晶体；双子星座（the Twins）；adj. 双胞胎的，孪生的；成对的，成双的；双重的，相关联的，同时出现的；（镇或市）友好的，姐妹的；（植物）双生的；（卧室）有两张单人床的；（晶体）孪晶的；v. 使结成姐妹城市，使结成友好城市；使（两人或两事物）紧密结合，使相连；生双胞胎；【名】 （Twin）特温（人名）
definition: 1. n. either of two offspring born at the same time from the same pregnancy；2. v. duplicate or match
example: The Twin Towers had the same function in New York that the Eiffel Tower has in Paris.
exampleZh: 双子座对于纽约的作用,与埃菲尔铁塔对于巴黎的作用相同。

meaning: v. 使弯曲；（使）扭曲变形；扭动身体；扭伤（脚踝等）；旋转，转动；编织，捻在一起；缠绕；歪曲，曲解；蜿蜒，曲折；欺诈；牌面朝上；n. 扭动，转动；弯曲处，拐弯处；转折，变化；螺旋形物体；扭摆舞（the twist）；扭歪，（性格）反常；（棉，丝） 合股线；混合酒；欺诈；（棍棒或其他物体） 扭转度；扭转力，转矩；绕轴旋转前进；【名】 （Twist）（美、英、荷）特威斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. an unforeseen development；2. v. to move in a twisting or contorted motion, (especially when struggling)
example: Her hands began to twist the handles of the bag she carried.
exampleZh: 她的双手开始拧她拎着的那个包的拎柄。

meaning: num. 二；两个；adj. 两个的；n. 两个；数字二；两个一组
definition: 1. n. the cardinal number that is the sum of one and one or a numeral representing this number；2. adj. being one more than one
example: Now let's think about designing the experiment itself. The goal here, there are two goals. Or more than two.
exampleZh: 那么现在让我们来想想,怎么设计实验本身吧，这里有两个目标，或者多于两个目标。

meaning: n. 类型，种类；具有某种特征的人，典型；（印刷的）文字，字体；（印刷）铅字，活字；象征；（艺术的）典型，榜样；（宗教学）预兆；（植，动）型，模式标本；（奖章或硬币）图案；（语言学）类型，型；v. （用计算机或打字机）打字；测定……的类型，分型；【名】 （Type）（英）泰普（人名）
definition: 1. n. a subdivision of a particular kind of thing；2. v. write by means of a keyboard with types
example: What place can it occupy in each type of discourse, what functions can it assume, and by obeying what rules?"
exampleZh: 它可以在每种话语中占据什么样的位置，它在遵循什么原则的情况下可以有什么样的功能？“

meaning: n. 打字员；打字者
definition: 1. n. someone paid to operate a typewriter
example: She worked as a typist in a law firm.
exampleZh: 她在一家法律公司当打字员。

meaning: n. 打字机
definition: 1. n. hand-operated character printer for printing written messages one character at a time
example: He was in his office, battering the keyboard of his computer as if it were an old manual typewriter.
exampleZh: 他在办公室重重地敲打着他的计算机键盘，好像在用一部老式的手动打字机。

meaning: adj. 典型的，有代表性的；一贯的，平常的；不出所料，特有的；象征性的
definition: 1. adj. exhibiting the qualities or characteristics that identify a group or kind or category；2. adj. of a feature that helps to distinguish a person or thing
example: The good scholars of Milton reveal their typical resistance to anything even remotely interesting or alive in the text.
exampleZh: 研究弥尔顿的优秀学者们透露他们反对,研究文本中那些不太有趣和生动的东西。

meaning: n. 轮胎；轮箍；（Tyre）提尔；v. 装轮胎于……；【名】 （Tyre）（美、英、加）泰尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a port in southern Lebanon on the Mediterranean Sea; formerly a major Phoenician seaport famous for silks；2. n. hoop that covers a wheel
example: She taught me how to change a tyre.
exampleZh: 她教会了我换轮胎。

meaning: adj. 丑陋的，难看的；（通常因涉及暴力、挑衅行为而）令人厌恶的，邪恶的，恶性的；无礼的；道德败坏的；可怕的，恐怖的；难听的，不悦耳的
definition: 1. adj. displeasing to the senses；2. adj. inclined to anger or bad feelings with overtones of menace
example: The river that runs through Middlesbrough became ugly on the eye and hard on the nose.
exampleZh: 那条流经米德尔斯伯勒的河变得丑不忍睹，臭不可闻。

meaning: n. 丑陋，难看；丑陋之物；丑恶，邪恶
definition: 1. n. qualities of appearance that do not give pleasure to the senses；2. n. the quality of being wicked
example: The advert was trying to "show the ugliness of the illness, not of AIDS victims", he added.
exampleZh: 他补充道，这则广告旨在“展现这种疾病的丑恶之处，而非艾滋病患者的丑陋”。

meaning: adj. 最终的，最后的；最根本的，最基础的；极限的，终极的；首要的，决定性的；（太空或时空中）最遥远的；（物理）极限的；n. 最好的事物，最终的事物；最终（或最根本）的事实（或原则）；极限飞盘（Ultimate Frisbee 的简称）；v. 结束
definition: 1. n. the finest or most superior quality of its kind；2. adj. furthest or highest in degree or order; utmost or extreme
example: And with the ultimate goal of teaching it at a university level, hopefully at a school like Columbia
exampleZh: 我最终的目标是在大学教书，很希望能在像哥伦比亚这样的大学，

meaning: adv. 最终，最后；根本上，最重要地
definition: 1. adv. as the end result of a succession or process
example: Milton ultimately is a pious man and wants us to frown on Satan's critique of the Judeo-Christian conception of divinity.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿终究还是个虔诚的教徒，想要我们厌恶撒旦,对犹太教与基督教共有的神权概念的批判。

meaning: n. （尤指政治上的）过激分子，极端主义者；超级马拉松（ultramarathon的简称）；adj. 极端的，偏激的；adv. 很，非常；【名】 ；（Ultra）（俄）乌尔特拉（人名）
definition: 1. a person who has extreme political or religious opinions, or opinions that are more extreme than others in the same political party, etc.；2. an extreme supporter of a football club, often one who is part of an organized group that may also have extreme political opinions
example: The new ultra-low emission zone (Ulez) is likely to be a big issue in next year's mayoral election.
exampleZh: “超低排放新区（Ulez）”很可能是明年伦敦市长选举的重大议题。

meaning: n. 伞，雨伞，阳伞；综合体，总体；保护伞，庇护；（有众多附属小机构或小群体的）伞形组织；（战斗机或高射炮构成的）掩护幕，防空火网；（动）（水母）伞膜；adj. （大的组织）包括许多小团体的；（词汇）总称的，总括的
definition: 1. n. a lightweight handheld collapsible canopy；2. adj. covering or applying simultaneously to a number of similar items or elements or groups
example: And in such a hurry to get out that door that he forgets his umbrella completely.
exampleZh: 而在他匆忙地想出门之下，他完全把带伞的事抛到脑后了。

meaning: adj. （投票、决定、协议等）全体同意的，无异议的；（所有人）一致同意的，意见一致的
definition: 1. If a group of people are unanimous, they all agree about one particular matter or vote the same way, and if a decision or judgment is unanimous, it is formed or supported by everyone in a group；2. in complete agreement or showing complete agreement
example: that it's pretty unanimous, um, attitude towards how education should be done.
exampleZh: 他们的教育观念都是相当一致的。

meaning: adj. 犹豫的，无把握的；无法确知的，不确定的；多变的，难预料的；信心不足的；（脚步）蹒跚的，踉跄的
definition: 1. adj. lacking or indicating lack of confidence or assurance；2. adj. not established beyond doubt; still undecided or unknown
example: The conclusion of this parable seems so violent perhaps because the lesson to be learned from the parable is so uncertain.
exampleZh: 这个故事的结尾看起来太残酷了,可能因为这个寓言想要教给我们的东西太不确定。

meaning: n. 犹豫，无把握；拿不定的事，令人无把握的局面；紧张不安
definition: 1. n. being unsettled or in doubt or dependent on chance；2. n. the state of being unsure of something
example: They hoped the waiting and the uncertainty would wear down my resistance.
exampleZh: 他们希望这种等待和不确定性会削弱我的抵抗。

meaning: n. 叔叔，伯父，伯伯，舅父，姑父，姨丈；（对年长男性亲属的称呼，用于姓名前常大写）叔叔，伯父，舅舅；（非正式，小孩或年轻人对非亲属年长男性的友好称呼）叔叔，大叔，伯伯；（Uncle Sam，非正式，多用于美国）山姆大叔（美国或美国政府的绰号）
definition: 1. n. the brother of your father or mother; the husband of your aunt；2. n. a source of help and advice and encouragement
example: So my dad's a doctor, my uncle's a doctor, So it's kind like you're going to be a doctor.
exampleZh: 我的父亲和叔叔都是医生，所以你本来也该成为医生的。

meaning: v. 揭露，发现；揭开盖子，移开覆盖物；发掘，挖出；脱帽（尤指表示敬意）
definition: 1. v. make visible；2. v. remove all or part of one's clothes to show one's body
example: The reason he had to uncover it was that beehive tombs, like everything else, were buried.
exampleZh: 他必须揭开它的原因是这些蜂窝墓，像其他东西一样，被埋在地下。

meaning: prep. 在（或到、通过）……下面；在……表面下，由……覆盖着；少于，小于，低于；由……控制（或管理、经营）； 按照，依据（法律、协议或制度）；在……过程中；在……的影响下；用，以（尤指假名）；属于，列入，在……项之下；在……情况下，在……条件下；在（治疗）中；（计算机）在（某个系统）下；栽有；（尤指看法不正确时）以为……；adv. 在下面；在下面穿过；在水下；少于，小于，较年轻；在昏迷中，陷入昏迷状态；adj. 较低的，下面的
definition: 1. adj. located below or beneath something else；2. adv. down to defeat, death, or ruin
example: And in fact, under type checking, different languages sometimes fall on a spectrum from weak to strong typing.
exampleZh: 实际上，在类型检查的下面，不同的语言会对应着,从弱到强的一个定型范围。

meaning: adj. （国家或地区）不发达的，经济落后的；发育不全的；（胶卷）显影不足的；v. （使）发展不完全；（使）显影不足（underdevelop 的过去式和过去分词）
definition: 1. adj. relating to societies in which capital needed to industrialize is in short supply；2. adj. not yet fully developed
example: Underdeveloped countries should be assisted by allowing them access to modern technology.
exampleZh: 应该通过允许不发达国家使用现代技术来帮助它们。

meaning: v. 低估，对……估计不足；轻视，小看（某人）；n. 低估，对……估计不足
definition: 1. n. an estimation that is too low; an estimate that is less than the true or actual value；2. v. assign too low a value to
example: And I'll just say a word quickly, that don't underestimate the influence here of an ideology beneath this.
exampleZh: 我要简单阐述一个单词,不要小看了这种现象下的,意识形态对此的影响

meaning: v. 经历，经受
definition: 1. v. go through (mental or physical states or experiences)；2. v. go or live through
example: Nonetheless Oscar Wilde, a friend of Yeats nonetheless, Yeats's poetry does undergo an important and notable stylistic change.
exampleZh: 王尔德也是叶芝的朋友,但叶芝的诗歌的确经历了,重要的值得一提的风格上的改变。

meaning: n. 大学本科生，大学肄业生；adj. 大学本科生的，大学肄业生的
definition: 1. n. a university student who has not yet received a first degree
example: So recently we also set up a meeting with the new director of undergraduate studies in chemical engineering and
exampleZh: 最近我们还和化学工程本科部的新主任开了一次会，

meaning: adv. 在地（面）下；；隐蔽地，隐匿地；在地（面）下；adj. 地（面）下的；秘密的，地下的；标新立异的，小众的；v. 铺（电缆）于地下；；铺（电缆）于地下；n. 地铁；（反政府的）地下组织；先锋派团体
definition: 1. n. a secret group organized to overthrow a government or occupation force；2. adj. under the level of the ground
example: I've seen like harp players on the underground and then classical music to kind of...
exampleZh: 我在地下通道见过弹竖琴的人，也见过弹奏古典乐的……

meaning: vt. 构成……的基础，为……的起因；位于……的下面
definition: 1. to be a hidden cause of or strong influence on something；2. to be a cause of or strong influence on something
example: Scant attention has been paid to many of the dubious social and economic assumptions that underlie the plan.
exampleZh: 人们对该计划背后的许多可疑的社会和经济假设缺乏关注。

meaning: adj. 根本的，潜在的；表面下的，下层的；优先的；（数量或水平）实际的；v. 位于…的下面；构成…的基础（underlie 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. real but not immediately obvious；2. used to describe something on which something else is based
example: To stop a problem you have to understand its underlying causes.
exampleZh: 要解决问题，你得了解其潜在原因。

meaning: v. 在……下面画线；强调，突出；n. （尤指为强调）下划线；（动物）下体轮廓
definition: 1. n. a line drawn underneath (especially under written matter)；2. v. give extra weight to (a communication)
example: Secondly, we need to underline the need for the government to take leadership on these issues.
exampleZh: 其次，我们需要强调政府在这些问题上发挥领导作用的必要性。

meaning: v. 逐渐削弱（损害）；故意破坏（某人）的形象（或威信）；在……下面挖，（尤指）从根基处损坏
definition: 1. v. destroy property or hinder normal operations；2. v. hollow out as if making a cave or opening
example: Offering advice on each and every problem will undermine her feeling of being adult.
exampleZh: 每个问题都为她提出忠告会逐渐削弱她的成年意识。

meaning: prep. 在……下面，在……底下；在……底面，在……底部；在……表面之下；adv. 在……下面，在……底下；在……底面，在……底部；在……表面之下；n. 物体的下表面，底面，底部（the underneath）；adj. 下面的，底层的
definition: 1. adv. on the lower or downward side; on the underside of；2. adv. under or below an object or a surface; at a lower place or level; directly beneath
example: OK, so what we have to do is get back underneath this reaction, and see what the molar quantities are.
exampleZh: 我们应该做的是,再回到这个反应，看看摩尔量是多少。

meaning: v. 理解，懂得；了解，明白（某事物）；谅解，体谅；得知，听说；默认，默许；领会，推断出；解释
definition: 1. v. know and comprehend the nature or meaning of；2. v. perceive (an idea or situation) mentally
example: OK, important -- if you are part of this group here think about it and make sure you understand that.
exampleZh: 好的，这很重要，如果刚才你选了可逆过程,请好好想想并且保证已经理解了这个问题。

meaning: n. （对某学科、过程或情况的）了解，认识；（非正式的）协议，谅解；理解，谅解，体谅；理解，看法，解释，意见；思维能力，理解力；adj. 能谅解的，宽容的；有洞察力的，判断力强的；v. 懂，理解，领会；了解，认识到，明了；了解，谅解，体谅（understand 的现在分词）
definition: 1. n. the cognitive condition of someone who understands；2. adj. characterized by understanding based on comprehension and discernment and empathy
example: What did we lose in our understanding of it as a literary object when the second half was not published?
exampleZh: 将它置于文学作品之列来理解时,我们失去了什么？,书的后半部分没出版时？

meaning: v. 承担，从事；承诺，答应；在内侧行驶时赶上并超越（另一辆车）
definition: 1. v. enter upon an activity or enterprise；2. v. accept as a challenge
example: We want all our members to undertake this trip responsibly, with their eyes open.
exampleZh: 我们希望我们所有的成员都明白其中的困难、负责任地进行这次旅行。

meaning: n. 任务，企业；许诺，保证；丧葬业，殡仪业；v. 承担，从事；承诺，答应；在内侧行驶时赶上并超越（另一辆车）（undertake 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. any piece of work that is undertaken or attempted；2. n. the trade of a funeral director
example: The landlord gave a written undertaking that the repairs would be carried out.
exampleZh: 房东书面保证将进行维修。

meaning: n. 内衣，衬衣
definition: 1. n. undergarment worn next to the skin and under the outer garments
example: For Christmas my brother and I got new underwear, one toy and one book.
exampleZh: 作为圣诞礼物，我弟弟和我得到了新内衣、一件玩具和一本书。

meaning: v. 解开，松开；消除……影响或结果，使恢复原状；撤销（先前的计算机指令）；破坏，毁掉；n. （计算机）撤消还原
definition: 1. v. cancel, annul, or reverse an action or its effect；2. v. deprive of certain characteristics
example: He tried to undo the knot by picking at it with his fingers.
exampleZh: 他用手指不停地扯，想把绳结解开。

meaning: adv. 无疑，肯定
definition: 1. adv. with certainty
example: Country music was undoubtedly one of the forerunners of rock and roll.
exampleZh: 乡村音乐无疑是摇滚乐的先导之一。

meaning: adj. 担忧的，不安的；令人不舒服的，不安稳的；（情况）不稳定的；（书或音乐）难懂的，晦涩的；不和谐的，矛盾的
definition: 1. adj. lacking a sense of security or affording no ease or reassurance；2. adj. causing or fraught with or showing anxiety
example: His spear "were but a wand / he walkt with to support uneasy steps."
exampleZh: 他的长矛“看来只不过是小棍/他挎着长矛，迈着沉重的步伐，“

meaning: adj. 未被雇用的，失业的；（物）闲置的，未用的；n. 失业者（the unemployed）
definition: 1. n. people who are involuntarily out of work (considered as a group)；2. adj. not engaged in a gainful occupation
example: But the bank would say, hey you're unemployed; we can't give you a mortgage.
exampleZh: 但银行会说,你失业了,所以我们不能给你办贷款

meaning: n. 失业人数，失业率；失业，失业状态；失业救济金
definition: 1. n. the state of being unemployed or not having a job
example: On the other hand the Fed is also concerned with unemployment and the possibility of a collapse in the system.
exampleZh: 另一方面,美联储也被失业和,这个体系中崩塌地潜在的可能性困扰着。

meaning: v. 打开，展开；呈现，逐渐明朗；发生，发展
definition: 1. to open or spread out something that has been folded；2. If a situation or story unfolds, it develops or becomes clear to other people
example: It's also going to be the process of watching an artistic form unfold over a very exciting period of time.
exampleZh: 更是一个观察某种艺术形式在一段,刺激的时间里展现的过程。

meaning: n. 制服，校服；穿制服的警官；（某一群体的人穿的）典型服装，特有服装；（无线电通讯）字母 U 的代码；adj. 全部相同的，始终如一的；制服式的；v. 使一致；使穿制服
definition: 1. n. clothing of distinctive design worn by members of a particular group as a means of identification；2. v. provide with uniforms
example: Even though in London, you also get people who wear like a sort of typical East London uniform.
exampleZh: 即使在伦敦，也有人穿着典型的东伦敦的制服。

meaning: n. 统一（性)，一致（性）；统一的实例
definition: 1. n. a condition in which everything is regular and unvarying；2. n. the quality of lacking diversity or variation (even to the point of boredom)
example: Despite these differences, there is general uniformity in the organization and curricula of public schools throughout the country.
exampleZh: 尽管存在这些差异，全国公立学校的组织和课程总体上是一致的。

meaning: v. （使）联合，（使）统一；使协调
definition: 1. to bring together; combine；2. to bring separate parts of something together so that they are one
example: However, any interpretation that seeks to unify all of the novel's diverse elements is bound to be somewhat unconvincing.
exampleZh: 然而，任何试图将小说的所有不同元素统一起来的解读，都必然有些难以令人信服。

meaning: n. 联合，统一；联合的行为、实例或过程
definition: 1. the act or process of bringing together or combining things or people；2. the forming of a single thing by bringing together separate parts
example: The controversy has arisen over the text of the preamble to the unification treaty.
exampleZh: 就统一条约的序文措词出现了争论。

meaning: adj. 单方的，单边的；单侧的，单面的；（父母）单系的；舌边音
definition: 1. involving only one group or country；2. done independently by one group or country
example: The French tax is not just a unilateral move by one country in need of revenue.
exampleZh: 法国的这项税收政策并非只是一个急需财政收入的国家单方面采取的举措。

meaning: n. 工会；联邦，联盟；协会，俱乐部；联合，合并；结婚，婚姻；美利坚合众国（the Union）；（数）并，并集；联管节，接头；（印度次大陆）村落联合体；教区联合济贫组织；旗帜上象征国家统一的部分；混纺织物
definition: 1. n. an organization of employees formed to bargain with the employer；2. adj. being of or having to do with the northern United States and those loyal to the Union during the American Civil War
example: On a line for sometime... and then it was close to the Soviet Union That's really suspicious to Washington.
exampleZh: 有一段时间是同一战线的。,当时和苏联关系紧密,使得美国心生疑虑。

meaning: adj. 独一无二的，独特的；非常特别的，极不寻常的；（某人、地或事物）独具的，特有的；n. 独一无二的人（或事）；【名】 （Unique）尤妮克（人名）
definition: 1. adj. radically distinctive and without equal；2. adj. (followed by `to') applying exclusively to a given category or condition or locality
example: Every city has their own unique qualities and things to do, so I cannot really say a specific city.
exampleZh: 每一座城市都有自己的特质和可以做的事情，所以我说不出具体哪个城市最好。

meaning: n. 单位；一件（商品）；（公寓楼的）单元；部件，元件；（家具的）组合件，配件；科，室，部门；班组，小队；（课本）单元；（计量）单位；个位数；警车；学习量；股份单位
definition: 1. n. any division of quantity accepted as a standard of measurement or exchange；2. n. an individual or group or structure or other entity regarded as a structural or functional constituent of a whole
example: Thus far, for us it's been testing individual functions. Later in the term we'll talk about unit testing of classes.
exampleZh: 至今为止，我们用到单元测试的地方,就是测试每个单独的方法,在后面我们会讲到类的单元测试。

meaning: v. （使）联合，（使）团结；统一，使统一
definition: 1. v. act in concert or unite in a common purpose or belief；2. v. become one
example: He said "vegetarians unite," and I looked at him and said "yeah, ha ha."
exampleZh: “素食者们团结起来，”他说道，我看着他，说“行，哈哈。”

meaning: n. 团结，统一；整体性，统一性；三一律（指戏剧在时间、地点和情节三点上的统一性）；统一体；（数目或数字）一；【名】 （Unity）尤妮蒂（人名）
definition: 1. n. an undivided or unbroken completeness or totality with nothing wanting；2. n. the smallest whole number or a numeral representing this number
example: Unity was difficult. Being somewhat isolated, the inhabitants of each region developed a distinctive economic and cultural character.
exampleZh: 团结很困难，它有一点孤立，每一个地域的居民都发展起来,有了各自经济文化特点。

meaning: n. 宇宙，天地万物（the universe）；领域，体系；（已知宇宙以外的）宇宙
definition: 1. n. everything that exists anywhere；2. n. (statistics) the entire aggregation of items from which samples can be drawn
example: The idea of a parallel universe is hard to grasp.
exampleZh: 认为另有一个平行宇宙的概念是很难理解的。

meaning: adj. 普遍的，全体的，全世界的；通用的，万能的；（逻）全称的，总称的；n. 普遍原则，通用原理；普遍看法，普遍特征；（逻）全称命题；（哲）普遍，一般概念；（哲）共相；（语言学）普遍现象，通用规则
definition: 1. n. (linguistics) a grammatical rule (or other linguistic feature) that is found in all languages；2. adj. of worldwide scope or applicability
example: And here I want to distinguish between the individual question about the inevitability of death, and the universal question.
exampleZh: 在这里我要区分,死亡必然性的个人性，以及普遍性。

meaning: n. 大学，综合性大学；大学校舍
definition: 1. n. the body of faculty and students at a university；2. n. establishment where a seat of higher learning is housed, including administrative and living quarters as well as facilities for research and teaching
example: Sure, Columbia University is one of the oldest universities in the United States, I think. Number 4 or 5, I believe.
exampleZh: 当然，哥伦比亚大学是美国最古老的大学之一。我想它大概是第四或第五古老的吧。

meaning: v. 释放出，发泄（力量、感情等）；解开皮带放开（动物）；放开，解除对……的限制
definition: 1. to suddenly release a violent force that cannot be controlled；2. to let happen or begin something powerful that, once begun, cannot be controlled
example: The officers were still reluctant to unleash their troops in pursuit of a defeated enemy.
exampleZh: 军官们仍不愿发兵追击溃敌。

meaning: conj. 除非，除非在……情况下；若非，如果不；prep. 除……之外；除……之外
definition: 1. abstract: Unless, first published by Fourth Estate, an imprint of Harper Collins in 2002, is the final novel by Canadian writer Carol Shields. Semi-autobiographical, it was the capstone to Shields's writing career: she died shortly after its publication in 2003.
example: STUDENT: No. Not unless he wants to break the vase into little pieces and stuff it in the corners.
exampleZh: 学生：【听不见】,教授：不，除非它想把花瓶打成碎片,然后把它们堆到角落里。

meaning: adj. 前所未有的，史无前例的；（大小、数量、程度等）前所未知的，空前的
definition: 1. never having happened or existed in the past
example: We are now witnessing an unprecedented increase in violent crime.
exampleZh: 我们现在看到暴力犯罪空前增多。

meaning: conj. 到……时，直到……为止；prep. 到……时，直到……为止；直到（某处）
definition: 1. up to a particular time, or continuing before a specified event
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: It might be like a single, a single mother, you know. She might not get home from work until like 6.
exampleZh: 也有可能是个单亲母亲。她下班到家可能要6点之后了。

meaning: v. （首次）公开，揭示；为……揭幕，揭去……上的覆盖物；除去面纱，显露
definition: 1. to remove a covering like a curtain from a new structure at a formal ceremony in order to show the opening or finishing of a new building or work of art；2. If you unveil something new, you show it or make it known for the first time
example: The company, which is expected to unveil a new version of the Kindle next week, did not say when Kindle titles would be available on mobile phones.
exampleZh: 该公司预计将于下周推出新版 Kindle，但没有透露 Kindle 电子书什么时候可以在手机上使用。

meaning: adv. 向上，由低向高；到楼上；（太阳）升起；在高处；面朝上，面朝天；从地下到表面，向水面；向北方，朝北方；往（较高或较远的）某处；去，在（更重要的地方，如大城市或大学）；到……的近处，靠近；到前面，朝前面；处于（或进入）直立状态；起床；用劲地，以较大气力；（吐）出来；（强度，音量，活动）由弱到强，由低到高，由轻到响；（列表中）处于更高位置，（议程中）处于更重要的位置；（水平、数量或比率）由低到高；高出，多；向较高地位，向更好的状态；出现，出席；（在品质、知识或成就方面）相等，比得上；一起，聚拢地；紧紧地，牢固地；计划要，被建议，正被考虑；愿意做（或参与）；出庭受审的；处于工作（或可用）状态，进入（可用）状态；（在讨论或思考时）引起某人的注意；靠近（某人）；靠近顶端；做完地，完成地；封闭，关闭；成碎片，分成部分；处于活跃期，进入兴奋状态；公开展示地；停下来；每名队员，每个队；（航行）逆风地，逆水地；（舵柄）迎风转舵；（棒球）在场上击球；（长发）向头上（或脑后）梳理的；彻底地，完全地；（时间）到；（道路）正在整修的；（尤指异常或不愉快的事情）发生，出现；prep. 往较高处，向较高处；沿着……，顺着……；近顶端；往（河，溪）上游；adj. 在高处；（向上）开；升于地平线之上；冒出地面，冒出水面；在前方，在前面；起床；上涨； (时间) 到点的；（正在）发生，进行，出现；得分领先于（对手），超前于（对手）；正常运行，正常工作，起作用；（在活动中）轮到某人；高兴，兴奋；对……了如指掌的，熟悉的；（道路）正在修整的；（骑师）骑着马的；（物理）（夸克的味）带有+2/3电荷的，上夸克的（质子和中子被认为是由上夸克和下夸克组成）；向上移动的，上行的； （时间）到点的；（时间）终止，结束；v. 使…更高，提高；举起，抬起；突然行动；n. （某一阶段的）成功，繁荣；走运；在增长，在改善中；（人或企业）诚实守法；蒸蒸日上，越来越成功；int. （用于命令士兵或动物）起来！起立！
definition: 1. v. raise；2. adj. being or moving higher in position or greater in some value; being above a former position or level

meaning: v. 为……增加最新信息，更新；使现代化；向……提供最新信息；n. 最新报道，最新消息；（计算机软件的）更新；新型，新版
definition: 1. n. news that updates your information；2. v. modernize or bring up to date

meaning: v. （使）（计算机、机器或软件）升级；提高（设施、服务等的）档次，改善；（使）升级到更高待遇，（使）升舱；使（雇员）升职；使（某事物）升格；n. 改善，提高档次；（计算机的）升级；上坡；adj. 往上的；adv. 往上

meaning: v. 支持，维护（法规、制度或原则）；认可，维持（法院原判）；鼓励；举起
definition: 1. to defend or keep a principle or law, or to say that a decision that has already been made, especially a legal one, is correct；2. to defend or maintain a principle or law, or to state that a decision that has already been made, esp. a legal one, is correct
example: It is the responsibility of every government to uphold certain basic principles.
exampleZh: 每个政府都有责任维护某些基本原则。

meaning: v. 上载，上传；n. 上载（上传）的内容，上传

example: Once you modify this file, upload it via RAM.
exampleZh: 一旦您修改了这个文件，通过 RAM 来上传它。

meaning: prep. 在……上；用在一些动词后，与 on 同义；一……即……，一……就……；（用于两个相同的名词之间，强调数量之多）（一个）接（一个），……又……；将要发生，马上来临；adv. 在上面地；此后
definition: 1. on; a more formal word for on in many phrases

meaning: adj. 上面的，上层的，较高的；顶部的，上部的；（在机构、体系等中）较高级的，上级的；上游的，北部的；（地质，考古）晚期的，较近期的；n. 鞋面，鞋帮；兴奋剂（尤指安非他明）；【名】 （Upper）（英）厄珀（人名）
definition: 1. n. the higher of two berths；2. adj. higher in place or position

meaning: adj. （人）直立的，挺直的；直立的，垂直的，立式的；正直的，诚实的；（椅子）直靠背的，没有扶手的；adv. 笔直地，直立地，垂直地；平稳地；n. （起支撑作用的）直柱，立柱，直立部分；球门柱；立式钢琴
definition: 1. n. a vertical structural member as a post or stake；2. adj. in a vertical position; not sloping

exampleZh: 也就是说，如果你看到由点连成的竖线时，那就是埃菲尔铁塔。

meaning: n. 起义，暴动；升起；v. 起床；起义；上升（uprise 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. an act of opposition, sometimes using violence, by many people in one area of a country against those who are in power

exampleZh: 叶芝描绘了这样一个事件,它带来了毁灭，对复活节前世界的毁灭。

meaning: v. 使心烦意乱，使生气；打乱，搅乱；打翻，使倾覆；翻倒；意外击败（强对手）；使（肠胃）不适；制造麻烦，破坏某人的计划；镦锻，镦粗；adj. 不高兴的，心烦意乱的；（肠胃）不适的；n. 烦恼，失望；肠胃不适；爆冷门；混乱，麻烦；翻倒，颠覆
definition: 1. n. an unhappy and worried mental state；2. v. disturb the balance or stability of

exampleZh: 信中有很多对支派的抱怨,这些怨言后来引起了迦南的混乱和颠覆。

meaning: adv. 往楼上，在楼上；脑力上，精神上；n. 楼上（the upstairs）；adj. 楼上的

exampleZh: 楼上的场地不错,也许我可以试试再把那个场地订下来

meaning: adj. 包含最新信息的；现代的，时髦的

exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: adj. 升高的，上升的；向上的，朝上的；adv. 向上，向高处；改善，升高；（数量）上升地，上涨地
definition: 1. adj. directed up；2. adv. spatially or metaphorically from a lower to a higher position

exampleZh: 这架直升飞机向上冲去，另一架飞机也以相同的移动方向冲了上去。

meaning: adv. 向上，朝上，向高处；（数量、水平等）趋于上升，上调；prep. upwards of：多于，……以上，超过
definition: 1. adv. spatially or metaphorically from a lower to a higher position；2. adv. to a later time

meaning: n. （化学元素）铀

example: Like I said before, Uranium-Lead Dating has been with us for a while.
exampleZh: 就像我之前说到的，铀铅年代测定法已经存在一段时间了。

meaning: adj. 城市的，城镇的；黑人音乐的；住在都市的；【名】 （Urban）（英）厄本，（法）于尔邦（人名）

meaning: v. 使城市化，使都市化；使文雅

exampleZh: “这里有很多机会，也有很大的压力和责任驱使我们思考如何城市化。”濑户说。

meaning: n. 城市化，都市化
definition: 1. n. the condition of being urbanized；2. n. the social process whereby cities grow and societies become more urban
example: Rapid urbanization brings with it a more westernized and generally more sugary diet.

meaning: v. 敦促，催促，力劝；竭力主张，强烈要求；驱赶，鞭策；鼓励，激励（~ sb. on）；n. 强烈的欲望，冲动；推动力

meaning: adj. 紧急的，急迫的；急切的，催促的；（尤指某人的行动）执着的，坚定的

meaning: n. 紧急，迫切；迫切需要；紧急的事
definition: 1. n. the state of being urgent; an earnest and insistent necessity；2. n. pressing importance requiring speedy action

meaning: n. 尿液，小便

meaning: v. 排尿，小便

meaning: pron. 我们

meaning: n. （词语的）用法；使用，用量；（尤指形成权利，义务，标准等的）常规做法，惯例；虐待，不公待遇

meaning: adj. 有用的，有益的；好的，熟练的

example: These two relations involving entropy are also useful because they'll let us see how entropy depends on volume and pressure.
exampleZh: 这两个涉及熵的关系也非常有用,因为他们告诉我们,熵和体积，压强的关系。

meaning: adj. 无用的，无价值的；差劲的，无能的；无效的，徒劳的；（身体一部分或心智因有病或受到损害而）丧失功能的
definition: 1. adj. having no beneficial use or incapable of functioning usefully

meaning: adj. 用过的，旧的；二手的；习惯于，适应于；v. 使用，利用；消耗；说，写，使用（词语或语言）（use 的过去式和过去分词）
definition: 1. adj. employed in accomplishing something；2. adj. of persons; taken advantage of

meaning: adj. 通常的，惯常的；n. 常事（the usual）；常喝的饮料（尤指酒）（the usual）

meaning: adv. 通常地，经常地

meaning: n. （煤气、水、电等的）公共服务，公用事业；（供电、供水等的）公用事业单位；应用程序，实用程序；实用，有用；小卡车，轻型货车；（博弈论，经济学）效用；adj. 有用的，多功能的；（体育运动）多面手的；实用的

meaning: v. 利用，使用

meaning: n. 利用，使用 (=utilisation)； 利用，使用

meaning: adj. 极度的，最大的；最远的；n. 极度，极限

meaning: adj. 完全的，彻底的；v. 说，讲；发出（声音）；使用（伪钞）；发射；【名】 （Utter） （美、瑞、德、加、法、俄、匈）乌特（人名）
definition: 1. v. articulate; either verbally or with a cry, shout, or noise；2. adj. without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers

meaning: adv. 完全地，彻底地

meaning: adj. （地方）空着的，无人用的；（职位，工作）空缺的；茫然的，失神的；【名】 （Vacant）（法）瓦康（人名）

example: She had a kind of vacant look on her face.

meaning: n. 空缺，空职；（旅馆等的）空房，空间；无知，空虚；空隙，空处

example: How did the woman get to know about the job vacancy?
exampleZh: 那个女人是怎么知道职位空缺的？

meaning: n. （学校的）假期，（法院的）休庭期；休假，假期；腾出，辞去；v. 度假

meaning: n. 疫苗；（计算机）杀毒软件；adj. 疫苗的，菌苗的

meaning: v. 给……接种疫苗；接种疫苗

meaning: n. 接种疫苗，种痘

example: So, that's another example of the difference between a vaccine that works, and a vaccination that works, right?
exampleZh: 所以,这个例子讲的是研发疫苗和,研究疫苗接种的不同之处,对吗

meaning: n. 真空，真空容器；真空吸尘器；空白，空虚；（用真空吸尘器所做的）清洁，清扫；v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；adj. 利用真空的；真空的；产生真空的
definition: 1. n. the absence of matter；2. v. clean with a vacuum cleaner
example: And, in between, there is void, which is very similar to how we would describe vacuum.
exampleZh: 而存在其中的，就是虚无了，那是与我们描述的真空很接近。

meaning: adj. 不明确的，不清楚的；（形状）模糊的；（感情、记忆等）不完整的，不清晰的；含糊其词的，闪烁其词的；茫然的，心不在焉的；【名】 （Vague）韦格（人名）
definition: 1. adj. not clearly understood or expressed；2. adj. not precisely limited, determined, or distinguished
example: It had been my accidental reading of fiction and literary criticism that had invoked in me vague glimpses of life's possibilities.
exampleZh: 我偶尔会读小说和文学评述,这让我隐约地窥探到,生活的可能性，“

meaning: adj. 虚荣的，自负的；徒劳的
definition: 1. adj. characteristic of false pride; having an exaggerated sense of self-importance；2. adj. unproductive of success
example: "For we assert," he says, "nature does nothing in vain and man alone " among the animals has speech.
exampleZh: 他说，“因为我们主张自然演变并不无道理,而人类独立于其它动物之外,是因为我们有辩论能力。

meaning: n. 虚荣（心），自负；（相对于非常严肃的事而言）无意义，微不足道；梳妆台，盥洗柜；自负的行为，虚荣的态度；自费出版
definition: 1. n. feelings of excessive pride；2. n. the quality of being valueless or futile
example: Their professions to justice are just that, they are professions or pretensions expressing their vanity and their ambition.
exampleZh: 他们在正义上的专业训练，只是他们的专业,或说自命表达其自负与野心。

meaning: adj. （文件或票证）有效的；正当的，合理的；合法有效的；计算机系统接受的，被计算机系统认为有效的
definition: 1. adj. well grounded in logic or truth or having legal force；2. adj. still legally acceptable
example: It's not a valid experiment if it has no chance of showing that my hypothesis is flawed.
exampleZh: 如果根本没可能证明我的假设,是有瑕疵的，那么这个试验。

meaning: v. 批准，确认……有效；证实，确认；使生效，使具有法律效力；证明有……价值，认可
definition: 1. v. declare or make legally valid；2. v. prove valid; show or confirm the validity of something
example: as well as install them in the cars and validate the software that was with them.
exampleZh: 还把系统安装在车里并检验配对的软件。

meaning: n. （法律上的）有效，合法，认可；真实性，正确性
definition: 1. n. the quality of being logically valid；2. n. the quality of having legal force or effectiveness
example: It was for the police to assess the validity or otherwise of the evidence.
exampleZh: 应由警方来评价证据的有效与否。

meaning: n. 山谷，溪谷，谷地；流域，河谷地区；（Valley）人名；瓦利；瓦莱
definition: 1. n. a long depression in the surface of the land that usually contains a river
example: all local, which are from the upstate area like Saugerties, Woodstock, Rhinebeck and just all Hudson Valley area artists.
exampleZh: 他们都是当地的艺术家，来自索格蒂斯、伍德斯托克、莱茵贝克。都是来自哈德逊谷地的艺术家。

meaning: n. 价值；等值，等价，物有所值；重要性，有用性；重要特点，显著特点；价值观（values）；（数学中的）值；（音乐中的）时值（指音符的时间长度）；（词或其他语言单位）确切意义；（色彩）明暗度；v. 尊重，重视；给……估价，给……定价
definition: 1. n. a numerical quantity measured or assigned or computed；2. v. fix or determine the value of; assign a value to
example: But also just that you have created space on this campus for good conversations about what do we value. -Yes.
exampleZh: 除此之外,在校园里，您为学生提供了一个,有关价值观的对话的空间，-是的。

meaning: adj. 值钱的，贵重的；有益的，宝贵的；重要的，珍贵的；可估价的；n. 贵重品
definition: 1. n. something of value；2. adj. having great material or monetary value especially for use or exchange
example: It's as if the commodity of the bride is deemed truly valuable only if it can be guaranteed pure and untouched.
exampleZh: 这就好像新娘这件商品,只有在完全的纯净没有动过才是有真正价值的。

meaning: n. 阀，活门；（小号等乐器的）阀键，活塞；（身体器官或管道的）瓣，瓣膜；电子管，真空管；热离子管（thermionic valve 的简称）；壳板；裂爿；v. 装阀于；以活门调节；【名】 （Valve）（俄、芬）瓦尔韦（人名）
definition: 1. a device that opens and closes to control the flow of liquids or gases, or a similar structure in the heart and the veins that controls the flow of blood；2. part of a musical instrument such as a trumpet that changes the sound by controlling the flow of air
example: You take a throttle valve, which consists of some sort of porous plug between two cylinders that is insulated. There is insulation here.
exampleZh: 有一个节流阀，它由一些多孔的塞子组成,这些多孔塞在两个绝热的汽缸之中,这里是绝热的，底下也是绝热的。

meaning: n. （厢式）小型货车；面包车；（铁路上运送包裹、邮件等的）车厢；拖车；先锋；v. 用车搬运；【名】 （Van）（老、泰、柬、缅）万（人名）
definition: 1. n. any creative group active in the innovation and application of new concepts and techniques in a given field (especially in the arts)；2. n. the leading units moving at the head of an army
example: And then when I tell them like, "No, we just had Armin van Buuren perform a few weeks ago."
exampleZh: 当我跟他们说，“不是这样的，几个星期前阿曼·凡·布伦刚刚过来演出。

meaning: v. 突然不见，消失；不复存在，灭绝；（数学）变为零；使不见，使消失；n. 弱化音
definition: 1. v. get lost, as without warning or explanation；2. v. become invisible or unnoticeable
example: Yet pleasure at your own can vanish if you learn that a colleague has been given a bigger one.
exampleZh: 然而，如果你得知一位同事得到的那份比你的更大，你自己的喜悦感就会消失。

meaning: n. 蒸气，水蒸气（等于 vapour）；雾气，烟雾
definition: 1. n. a visible suspension in the air of particles of some substance；2. n. the process of becoming a vapor
example: Such feedbacks might involve ice on land and sea, clouds, or water vapor, which also absorb radiant heat.
exampleZh: 这种反馈可能涉及陆地和海洋上的冰、云或水蒸气，这些也会吸收辐射热。

meaning: adj. 各种各样的；迥异的，千差万别的；det. 不止一个的，各别的；pron. 不止一个的，各别的
definition: 1. adj. of many different kinds purposefully arranged but lacking any uniformity；2. adj. considered individually
example: Similarly, Israel's gods, or Israel's God, was worshiped at various high places: they're referred to as elevated or high places.
exampleZh: 类似的，以色列的神灵或者说以色列的上帝，也是在各种各样的高地受到崇拜：,它们被称作高起的地方或高地。

meaning: n. 多样化，变化；种类，品种；（人或物的）各式各样；综艺表演，杂耍表演
definition: 1. n. a collection containing a variety of sorts of things；2. n. noticeable heterogeneity
example: But practice this, because it's something that's such an easy way to ask such a variety of questions.
exampleZh: 但是你仍然需要好好练习，因为这个简单的用法能够提出各种各样的问题。

meaning: v. （使）不同，（使）呈现差异；（根据情况而）变化，改变；改变，使……变化；变奏；【名】 （Vary）（英、法、罗、柬）瓦里（人名）
definition: 1. v. make or become different in some particular way, without permanently losing one's or its former characteristics or essence；2. v. be at variance with; be out of line with
example: This means you can vary the neutron number without changing chemical identity, because chemical identity is fixed by the proton.
exampleZh: 这表示你可以改变中子数,而不会改变它的化学特性，因为化学特性是由质子决定的。

meaning: n. 变化，变动；变奏曲；变化，变异；（天文）二均差；（数）变分，变差；磁偏角；（芭蕾）单人舞
definition: 1. n. an instance of change; the rate or magnitude of change；2. n. an activity that varies from a norm or standard
example: This delicious variation on an omelette is quick and easy to prepare.
exampleZh: 这种略有变化的美味煎蛋饼做起来又快又容易。

meaning: adj. 易变的，多变的；时好时坏的；可变的，可调节的；（数）（数字）变量的；（植，动）变异的，变型的；（齿轮）变速的；n. 可变性，可变因素；（数学中的）变量，变元；（计算机）变量（元）；（天文）变星的简称；（东北信风带以北或南半球的东南信风带与西风带之间的）变风区
definition: 1. n. something that is likely to vary; something that is subject to variation；2. adj. liable to or capable of change
example: The temperature remained constant while pressure was a variable in the experiment.
exampleZh: 做这实验时温度保持不变，但压力可变。

meaning: n. 变种，变形；（单词拼写或读音的）变异，变体；adj. 不同的，变体的，变种的
definition: 1. n. an event that departs from expectations；2. adj. differing from a norm or standard
example: Then a variant, by the way, of number one the falsifying things, is whether the record-keeping itself is reactive.
exampleZh: 然后还有个变数要说一下,关于篡改记录,是否只是为了记录而记录

meaning: adj. 巨大的，广大的；n. 广阔空间；【名】 （Vast）（法）瓦斯特（人名）
definition: 1. adj. unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope
example: All of this monistic philosophy, I think, is implicit in the image of divinity's impregnation of the vast abyss.
exampleZh: 这所有的一元论观点，我认为，都可从神灵孕育洪荒这一意象中看出来。

meaning: n. 蔬菜；植物人；呆板懒散的人；植物；adj. 植物的
definition: 1. n. edible seeds or roots or stems or leaves or bulbs or tubers or nonsweet fruits of any of numerous herbaceous plant；2. adj. of the nature of or characteristic of or derived from plants
example: As a general rule vegetable oils are better for you than animal fats.
exampleZh: 一般来说，植物油比动物脂肪对人较有好处。

meaning: n. 素食者，素食主义者；食草动物；adj. 素食的，素的
definition: 1. n. eater of fruits and grains and nuts; someone who eats no meat or fish or (often) any animal products
example: Previously humans were to be vegetarian: Genesis 1, the portrait was one in which humans and animals did not compete for food, or consume one another.
exampleZh: 在《创世纪》1中，早期的人类是素食主义者，描绘了一幅人类和动物,不用争夺食物，不用互相残杀的景象。

meaning: n. （总称）植物，植被；（植物的）生长；呆板单调的生活
definition: 1. plants in general, or plants that are found in a particular area
example: Anyone who is acquainted with these works will immediately recognize in the poem certain references to vegetation ceremonies.
exampleZh: 熟悉这些作品的人,会马上在诗里认出,某些提及植物仪式的部分。

meaning: n. 交通工具，车辆；（实现目的的）工具，媒介；（为展露主演者才华而）度身定制的创作（电影、电视节目、歌曲等）；赋形药，调漆料；（个人，组织从事经营、尤指投资的）公司
definition: 1. n. a conveyance that transports people or objects；2. n. a medium for the expression or achievement of something
example: The robbers drove off in a stolen vehicle.
exampleZh: 劫匪驾驶着一辆偷来的汽车逃跑了。

meaning: n. 面纱，面罩；（修女的）头巾；遮盖物，掩饰，借口；避而不谈（难堪或不愉快的）某事；（古犹太教）圣布；（植）菌幕；（穆斯林国家妇女）带面纱的习俗；v. 以面纱掩盖；遮盖，掩饰；【名】 （Veil）（法）韦伊，（德）法伊尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a garment that covers the head and face；2. v. to obscure, or conceal with or as if with a veil
example: A fine drizzle began to veil the hills.
exampleZh: 蒙蒙细雨渐渐笼罩了群山。

meaning: n. 静脉；（植物的）叶脉，（昆虫的）翅脉；（干酪、石头等的）纹理，纹路；矿脉，矿层，岩脉；（某种特定的）情绪，风格，主题；几分；（普通用语或比喻用法）血管；v. 使成脉络；像脉络般分布于；【名】 （Vein）（英）维因，（塞）魏因（人名）
definition: 1. a tube that carries blood to the heart from the other parts of the body；2. the frame of a leaf or an insect's wing
example: He could have died after developing deep vein thrombosis during a flight to Sydney.
exampleZh: 他在飞往悉尼的航班上引发成深部静脉血栓之后，差点送命。

meaning: n. 速度，速率；高速，快速；（经济）周转率，流通速度
definition: 1. the speed at which something is moving；2. the speed at which something is travelling in a particular direction
example: He found that some droplets had a certain velocity, and then others had a velocity plus some step.
exampleZh: 他发现了一些液滴存在某个速度，还有其他的液滴有速度和位移。

meaning: n. 天鹅绒，丝绒；（鹿角成长期中带茸毛的）鹿角嫩皮，鹿茸；天鹅绒似的东西；adj. 天鹅绒制的，天鹅绒的；柔软光滑的，天鹅绒般的（通常为暗色的）
definition: 1. a cloth usually made from silk or cotton with a thick, soft surface；2. made of velvet
example: I taped the base of the feather onto the velvet.
exampleZh: 我用胶带把羽毛的根部粘到天鹅绒上。

meaning: n. 小贩，摊贩；卖主，卖方；（出售某类商品的）销售商，供应商；（贸易） 自动售货机
definition: 1. n. someone who promotes or exchanges goods or services for money
example: She stopped at one vendor, flashed her badge, and picked a handful of mushrooms.
exampleZh: 她在一个小贩跟前停住了，亮了亮徽章，然后抓起一把蘑菇。

meaning: n. 通风孔，排气口；（衣物的）开衩，衩口；(鸟、鱼等小动物的）肛门；（强烈情绪或能量的）发泄，表达；火山口；（烟囱的）烟道；炮眼，火门；v. 表达，发泄（强烈感情）；排放（烟、煤气等）；给……一个出口，给……提供排放口；【名】 （Vent）（美、德）芬特（人名）
definition: 1. a small opening that allows air, smoke, or gas to enter or leave a closed space；2. a cut in the bottom of a piece of clothing to allow the person wearing it to move more easily
example: She gave full vent to her feelings in a violent outburst.
exampleZh: 她大发脾气以宣泄情绪。

meaning: v. 使通风，使通气；（用呼吸机）给……供氧；公开表达（感情或意见）；射杀（人）
definition: 1. to cause fresh air to enter and move around a closed space；2. to force air in and out of the lungs of a person who cannot breathe easily on their own, using a special machine called a ventilator
example: Ventilate as much as possible to completely air out the room or spill zone with outside air.
exampleZh: 尽可能地通风，以彻底用室外空气置换房间或泄漏区域的空气。

meaning: n. 通风，通风系统；（医）（尤指人工）给肺提供空气；（对意见、问题、抱怨等的）公开讨论（或调查）
definition: 1. the movement of fresh air around a closed space, or the system that does this；2. the act of forcing air in and out of the lungs of a person who cannot breathe easily on their own, using a special machine called a ventilator
example: Make sure that there is adequate ventilation in the room before using the paint.
exampleZh: 在使用油漆前确保室内通风充足。

meaning: n. 风险项目，冒险事业；冒险旅行，冒险行动；v. 敢于去（未知或危险等地方）；冒险；小心地说，谨慎地做；敢说，大胆表示；【名】 （Venture) （法）旺蒂尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. any venturesome undertaking especially one with an uncertain outcome；2. v. proceed somewhere despite the risk of possible dangers
example: I was still uncommitted to the venture when we reached Kanpur.
exampleZh: 直到我们到达坎普尔时，我还是不太支持这次冒险。

meaning: n. （事件的）发生地点，（活动的）场所；审判地（指郡或区）
definition: 1. the place where a public event or meeting happens；2. the city or county in which a trial happens
example: We're still trying to decide on a venue.
exampleZh: 我们仍然在设法选定一个会场。

meaning: n. 动词；动词词性；动词性短语或从句；（Verb）（俄）韦尔布（人名）
definition: 1. n. a word that serves as the predicate of a sentence；2. n. a content word that denotes an action or a state
example: And so the fact that in this whole slide here, this algorithm for sorting, I'm using the verb sort.
exampleZh: 在这个排序算法中,我用到了一个动词排序。

meaning: adj. 口头的，非书面的；用言辞的，文字的；动词的；多话的，爱说话的；n. （语法）动词性单词（或短语、从句）；辱骂，侮辱；话，（尤指）气话；歌词，电影对话（verbals）；（不利的）口头供认；v. （尤指不正当地）诱使（嫌疑犯）招供
definition: 1. adj. communicated in the form of words；2. adj. of or relating to or formed from words in general
example: They received a verbal offer to buy the company lock, stock and barrel.
exampleZh: 他们收到全盘收购公司的口头承诺。

meaning: n. （法庭的）裁定，判决；（权威的）评判，定论；意见，决定
definition: 1. an opinion or decision made after judging the facts that are given, especially one made at the end of a trial；2. a decision by a jury as to whether someone is guilty after having heard the facts given at a trial
example: They actually can be used in a court of law as a stage toward arriving at a verdict.
exampleZh: 这些词在法庭上,指审判前的一个程序。

meaning: n. 边缘；（道路旁的）植草路肩，绿地；极限，临界点；山墙突瓦；权杖；v. 趋向，接近，濒临；处在边缘；【名】 （Verge）（英、美、法、加、西）贝尔赫（人名）
definition: 1. the edge or border of something；2. the strip of land at the edge of a road or path
example: This is a little paradise, a paradise on the verge of being lost as the shades lose their leaves.
exampleZh: 这是一个微小的天堂，一个随着叶子的凋落,即将失去的天堂。

meaning: v. 核实，查证；证明，证实
definition: 1. v. confirm the truth of；2. v. verify or regulate by conducting a parallel experiment or comparing with another standard, of scientific experiments
example: Inspectors were sent to visit nuclear sites and verify compliance with the treaty.
exampleZh: 监察员被派去参观核址并核实条约的遵守情况。

meaning: n. 证实，证明，核实；（哲）（通过实证方法对命题）证实；（确保裁减武器协议所规定程序得以执行的）核查
definition: 1. n. additional proof that something that was believed (some fact or hypothesis or theory) is correct；2. n. (law) an affidavit attached to a statement confirming the truth of that statement
example: You should also see all of the verification points and test objects listed in the Script Explorer on the right.
exampleZh: 你还应该看到右侧的脚本资源管理器中列出的所有验证点和测试对象。

meaning: adj. 多才多艺的，有多种技能的；多用途的，多功能的
definition: 1. able to change easily from one activity to another or able to be used for many different purposes；2. (of people) able to do many different things or to adjust to new conditions, or (of things) able to be used for many different purposes
example: What we had was just a group of very hardworking, versatile people who could do all sorts of different jobs.
exampleZh: 我们的员工非常勤奋，多才多艺，能胜任各种不同的工作。

meaning: n. 诗，韵文；诗节，（歌曲的）节；（《圣经》或其他经文的）节，句；（赞美诗的）独唱部，小组唱部；v. 作诗；【名】 （Verse）（德）费尔泽（人名）
definition: 1. writing that is arranged in short lines with a regular rhythm; poetry；2. one of the parts that a poem or song is divided into
example: The Old Testament prophet had said, "All flesh is grass," an important verse for the new dispensation of Christianity.
exampleZh: 旧约里说，“凡有血气的，尽都如草“,这是基督教教义新体系中的重要一条。

meaning: n. （同一种物件稍有不同的）样式，型号；（从不同角度的）说法，描述；（电影、剧本、乐曲等的）版本，改编形式；《圣经》译本；胎位倒转术；v. 创制……的新版本，更新……的版本
definition: 1. n. an interpretation of a matter from a particular viewpoint；2. n. something a little different from others of the same type
example: What Levi-Strauss is saying here is that his approach to myth is itself only a version of the myth.
exampleZh: 列维这里想说的是,研究神话的方法本身只是神话的一个版本。

meaning: prep. （比赛或诉讼中）以……为对手，与……竞争；与……相对，与……相比
definition: 1. abstract: Versus is the diffusion line of noted Italian fashion house Versace. It began in 1989 as the first of many diffusion lines by the house, a gift by the founder Gianni Versace to his sister, Donatella Versace.
example: Only 18.8% of the class of 1982 had some kind of diploma four years after high school, versus 45% of the class of 1972.
exampleZh: 相对于1972届学生中有45%在中学毕业4年后获得了某种文凭来说，1982届学生的这一比例只有18.8%。

meaning: adj. 垂直的，直立的；纵向的；不同层次（或等级）的；（某类产品从生产到销售各个阶段）纵向结构的；（尤指疾病或遗传特性传递）代代相传的；（解剖）颅顶的，头顶的；顶点的，最高点的；n. 垂直线，垂直面，竖直位置；竖杆；垂直高度差
definition: 1. n. something that is oriented vertically；2. adj. at right angles to the plane of the horizon or a base line
example: For some buildings a vertical section is more informative than a plan.
exampleZh: 对一些建筑物来说，垂直剖面图比平面图提供的信息更多。

meaning: adv. （用于强调形容词或副词）很，非常；极其，完全地；显著的，典型的；显然，确实，真正地；adj. 同一的，恰好的，正是的；（加强名词的语气）仅仅的，唯独的，甚至于；（强调极限的地点或时间）最……的，极端的，十足的；最远端的，末端的；真正的，真实的；最佳的，最合适的；【名】 （Very）（法、爱）维里（人名）
definition: 1. adj. precisely as stated；2. adv. used as intensifiers; `real' is sometimes used informally for `really'; `rattling' is informal
example: Because I am very, very proud to be a Texan. As I think you'll find with most people from Texas.
exampleZh: 因为我为自己是德克萨斯人而感到无比骄傲。我想你会发现许多德克萨斯人有同样的感受。

meaning: n. 船，舰；（人或动物的）血管，（植物的）导管；（盛液体用的）容器，器皿；（有某种特质或用途的）人；【名】 （Vessel）韦塞尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a tube in which a body fluid circulates；2. n. a craft designed for water transportation
example: Here, a concept is to introduce a gene that causes the process of new blood vessel growth.
exampleZh: 看这儿,一种疗法是导入,可以促进新血管生成的基因

meaning: n. 背心，汗衫； 马甲，西装背心；坎肩，（特制的）背心；（无袖保暖）内衣；v. 授予，赋予，给予（权利或责任）；（权力、财产等）交给，归属；（唱诗班歌手，神职人员）穿圣衣，穿法衣；给……穿衣服；【名】 （Vest）（英）维斯特，（匈）韦什特（人名）
definition: 1. a type of underwear, often with no sleeves, that covers the upper part of the body, worn for extra warmth；2. a shirt without sleeves, usually made out of cotton, that is worn in the summer or for sport
example: His life was saved by a quarter-inch-thick bullet-proof vest.
exampleZh: 他被0.25英寸厚的防弹背心救了一命。

meaning: n. 老兵，退伍军人；经验丰富的人，老手；adj. 经验丰富的，老练的；古老的
definition: 1. n. a serviceman who has seen considerable active service；2. adj. rendered competent through trial and experience
example: She was, I don't know, ninety and she married some sixty-year-old Confederate veteran at some point in time.
exampleZh: 她大概有,大概有,九十岁,她在某个时期嫁给了一个,六十岁的南部邦联老兵

meaning: n. 否决权；拒绝认可，禁止；v. 否决，禁止；拒不接受，反对
definition: 1. n. a vote that blocks a decision；2. v. vote against; refuse to endorse; refuse to assent
example: That would mean voting no, that is to say, using the veto.
exampleZh: 那就意味着投反对票，也就是说，行使否决权。

meaning: prep. 经由，经过（某一地方）；通过，借助于（某种手段或人）
definition: 1. abstract: Via is a genus of moths of the Noctuidae family.
example: I could actually swipe a card and generate electronic receipt via email and then send it out to a person.
exampleZh: 这下，我真的能刷刷卡，发一封邮件，把电子回执,发给对方。

meaning: adj. 可望成功的，切实可行的；能存活的，能生长发育的
definition: 1. able to work as intended or able to succeed；2. able to continue to exist as or develop into a living being
example: Now, recruiting is tremendously important because you need to have a certain number of settlers to make the settlement viable.
exampleZh: 招募是极其重要的,因为你需要有一定数量的移民,来维持居住地的运转

meaning: v. （使）震动，（使）颤动；摇摆，踌躇
definition: 1. to shake slightly and quickly, or to cause something to do this, in a way that is felt rather than seen or heard；2. a setting on an electronic device that causes it to vibrate when something happens, such as receiving a new message
example: It's important to tighten up the wheels properly, otherwise they vibrate loose and fall off.
exampleZh: 把车轮拧紧很重要，否则它们会振动而松脱。

meaning: n. 震动，颤动，抖动；（情感）感应，共鸣
definition: 1. continuous quick, slight shaking movement
example: Feeling the glass, he discovered that he could dampen the vibration but couldn't make it stop.
exampleZh: 通过触摸玻璃，他发现他可以抑制玻璃的振动但是无法使它停止下来。

meaning: n. 堕落，邪恶；小毛病，坏习惯；（与性或毒品有关的）罪行，道德败坏行为；老虎钳（同 vise）；代理人，任副职者；（尤指马厩里马因厌倦而出现的）劣性，恶癖；v. 握住，钳紧；adj. 副的；代替的，代理的；prep. 代替；【名】 （Vice）（塞）维采（人名）
definition: 1. used as part of the title of particular positions. The person who holds one of these positions is next below in authority to the person who holds the full position and can act for them；2. a moral fault or weakness in someone's character
example: It has 125 assistants to the neutron, it has 75 vice neutrons and 111 assistants to the vice neutrons.
exampleZh: 周围有125个辅助中子，有75个副中子和,111个辅助副中子。

meaning: n. 周围地区，邻近地区，附近
definition: 1. the area around a place or where the speaker is；2. the area immediately surrounding something
example: There were a hundred or so hotels in the vicinity of the station.
exampleZh: 在车站附近有大约一百家左右的旅馆。

meaning: adj. 凶险的，会造成伤害的；严厉的，恶毒的，恶意的；剧烈的，恶劣的；不道德的，罪恶的；（语言，推理）不完善的，谬误的；【名】 （Vicious）（英）维舍斯（人名）
definition: 1. Vicious people or actions show an intention or wish to hurt someone or something very badly；2. used to describe an object, condition, or remark that causes great physical or emotional pain
example: Their loss was partly due to a vicious price war between manufacturers that has cut margins to the bone.
exampleZh: 他们的亏损部分是因为制造商之间把利润空间削减到了极点的一场恶性价格战。

meaning: n. 受害者，罹难者；（面对不幸事件或虐待时的）无助者，患病者；牺牲品，祭品；受骗者
definition: 1. n. an unfortunate person who suffers from some adverse circumstance；2. n. a person who is tricked or swindled
example: You blame yourself as a victim of trauma for not having the sufficient vigilance in your outer cortex to ward it off.
exampleZh: 你会因为你的脑皮层,不能有效保护你不受创伤危害,而成为创伤受害者。

meaning: v. 使受害，迫害
definition: 1. v. make a victim of；2. v. punish unjustly
example: We hope you'll read what we've made available to help you because holding onto unforgiveness and bitterness will only victimize you further.
exampleZh: 我们希望你能阅读我们为你准备的帮助内容，因为心怀不肯宽恕的怨怼只会让你进一步受到伤害。

meaning: n. 胜利，成功，获胜；【名】 （Victory）（西）维多利，（英）维克托里（人名）
definition: 1. n. a successful ending of a struggle or contest
example: The victory was mine, I still believe, but when I made to take trophy, winded Helen shook her head, declaring, "I have the curse."
exampleZh: 我依然相信，胜利属于我，但是我刚要，摘得战利品时，海伦气喘吁吁地摇了摇头，说道：,我被诅咒了“

meaning: adj. 胜利的，获胜的
definition: 1. adj. having won；2. adj. experiencing triumph
example: The city of Amsterdam grows up not only as part of this victorious struggle against the Spanish armies.
exampleZh: 阿姆斯特丹的成长不仅仅是,反抗西班牙军队胜利的一部分

meaning: n. （某个事件或场合的）录像；（指方法）录影；录像带；音乐录影；录像机；视频播放软件；adj. 电视的，视频的；图像的，画面的；v. 录下（电视节目）；（用摄像机）拍摄
definition: 1. n. the visible part of a television transmission；2. n. a recording of both the video and audio components (especially one containing a recording of a movie or television program)
example: If you look up on the internet, Liverpool, and look up a video of somebody speaking from Liverpool,
exampleZh: 如果你在网上搜索，利物浦，搜索说利物浦方言的人的视频，

meaning: n. 观点，看法；（理解或思维的）方法，方式；景象，视野；风景，景色；风景画，风景照；图像，视图；（一次）观看，一睹，一览；（文本或图表在计算机屏幕上的）显示方式；v. 看待，考虑；观看；查看，观察；（在计算机屏幕上）阅读，看；看见（狐狸）离开隐藏处
definition: 1. n. a way of regarding situations or topics etc.；2. v. deem to be
example: Well, this view, this evolutionary view, or evolutionary model, was challenged by man a named Yehezkel Kaufmann in the 1930's.
exampleZh: 这个改进了的观点，或者说改进了的模型，在20世纪30年代受到了来自考夫曼的质疑。

meaning: n. 观点，看法；视角，观察点
definition: 1. n. a mental position from which things are viewed；2. n. a place from which something can be viewed
example: You have to know where to stand for a good viewpoint.
exampleZh: 你得知道站在哪儿才会有好的视角。

meaning: n. 活力，精力（美式拼法；英式常作 vigour）；（文风、表达等的）气势，力度；（人名；英、法） Vigor，维戈尔
definition: 1. n. forceful exertion；2. n. active strength of body or mind
example: Many come through periods of stress with more physical and mental vigor than they had before.
exampleZh: 许多人在经历了一段时间的压力后，身心都比以前更有活力。

meaning: adj. 精力充沛的，充满活力的；强壮的，强健的
definition: 1. adj. characterized by forceful and energetic action or activity；2. adj. strong and active physically or mentally
example: They worked with the same people in this group and kept the vigorous discussion going.
exampleZh: 在这群人中他们总是和同样的人一起工作,总是在进行热烈的讨论。

meaning: n. 乡村，村庄；在乡村的，乡村的；村民；（城市中带有村庄特点的）生活小区，居民区；（有有限自治权的）小自治市；高级城郊购物中心；（动物的）群落
definition: 1. n. a community of people smaller than a town；2. n. a settlement smaller than a town
example: It's a long avenue that runs from Greenwich Village all the way up into Harlem, almost into Harlem.
exampleZh: 它是条很长的大道，从格林威治村一直延伸到哈莱姆，几乎到哈莱姆里面了。

meaning: n. 乡村居民，村民
definition: 1. n. one who has lived in a village most of their life
example: At seven in the evening, the gentleman heard a knock at the door, and the villager opened the door.
exampleZh: 晚上七点，这位绅士听到有人敲门，村民打开了门。

meaning: n. 醋；尖酸，刻薄
definition: 1. n. sour-tasting liquid produced usually by oxidation of the alcohol in wine or cider and used as a condiment or food preservative；2. n. dilute acetic acid
example: If the sauce seems too sweet, add a dash of red wine vinegar.
exampleZh: 如果酱太甜，就加少许红酒醋。

meaning: v. 违反，违背；侵犯，打扰；亵渎，损毁（神圣之地等）；强奸
definition: 1. v. fail to agree with; be in violation of; as of rules or patterns；2. v. act in disregard of laws, rules, contracts, or promises
example: Nuclear weapons seem to violate the just war principle of proportionality.
exampleZh: 核武器似乎违背了罚当其罪的正义战争原则。

meaning: n. （对法律、协议、原则等的）违背，违反；侵权行为，（对人权的）侵犯； （对某物的）损毁，（对圣地的）亵渎；强奸
definition: 1. n. a crime less serious than a felony；2. n. an act that disregards an agreement or a right
example: His possession of classified documents in his home was, at the very least, a violation of navy security regulations.
exampleZh: 他把机密文件放在家里，这最起码是违反了海军安全条例。

meaning: adj. 暴力的；（人）有暴力倾向的；含暴力行为的；剧烈的；（风、暴风雨或爆炸）强烈的，猛烈的；带有强烈愤怒情绪的，激烈的；（颜色的）鲜艳的
definition: 1. adj. acting with or marked by or resulting from great force or energy or emotional intensity；2. adj. effected by force or injury rather than natural causes
example: He believes that a virgin like the Lady is secure or safe from the violent attacks imagined by his younger brother.
exampleZh: 他认为像那位女士那样的处女，在他弟弟想象的,暴力袭击中是很安全的。

meaning: n. 暴力，暴行；（言行的）狂暴，激烈，愤怒；巨大的破坏力
definition: 1. n. an act of aggression (as one against a person who resists)；2. n. the property of being wild or turbulent
example: He makes the decision to punish humans because the world has corrupted itself through hamas, through bloodshed and violence.
exampleZh: 他决定惩罚人类,是因为人类世界已经因为暴力，血腥而堕落。

meaning: n. 小提琴（一种弓弦乐器，为提琴家族中音区最高的成员，通常有四根弦，以琴弓擦弦发声）；小提琴手；(Violin)（意）维奥林（人名）
definition: 1. n. bowed stringed instrument that is the highest member of the violin family; this instrument has four strings and a hollow body and an unfretted fingerboard and is played with a bow
example: And so there are only two kinds of waves that can exist on this violin string, standing or traveling.
exampleZh: 由于这只有两种波,可以存在在这条弦上，驻波或行波。

meaning: n. 小提琴演奏者，小提琴家
definition: 1. n. a musician who plays the violin
example: And he is a violist, not a violinist, but the principle here is pretty much the same, so tell us about the construction of the instrument.
exampleZh: 他是位中提琴手,不是小提琴手,但提琴的原理都很相近,跟我们讲解下乐器的结构吧

meaning: n. 处女，处男；无经验的人，新手；（昆）孤雌生殖的雌虫；圣母马利亚（the Virgin）；室女宫（the Virgin）；adj. 原始状态的，未开发的；处女的，处男的；（橄榄油）初榨的；（尤指白色物品）纯洁的，未玷污的；（黏土）未烧制的；（羊毛）未纺过的；（金属）从矿石直接提取的，原生的
definition: 1. someone who has never had sex；2. a person with no experience of a particular activity
example: He believes that a virgin like the Lady is secure or safe from the violent attacks imagined by his younger brother.
exampleZh: 他认为像那位女士那样的处女，在他弟弟想象的,暴力袭击中是很安全的。

meaning: n. 童贞，处女状态，处男状态；（某方面的）天真，缺乏经验
definition: 1. the state of never having had sex；2. the state of having no experience in a particular area
example: It's the sage and serious doctrine of virginity that concludes the speech. It's clear that something's happened between 1634 and 1637.
exampleZh: 它是总结演说,有关童贞的智慧而严肃的教义,很明显，在1634年到1637年间发生过什么。

meaning: adj. 几乎……的，实质上的；（在计算机或互联网上存在或出现的）虚拟的，模拟的；（光学）虚的，虚拟的；（机械学）虚的；（物理）虚的
definition: 1. adj. being actually such in almost every respect；2. adj. existing in essence or effect though not in actual fact
example: Up to four players can compete in a virtual world of role playing.
exampleZh: 最多能有4个人可以在虚拟世界中扮演角色进行角逐。

meaning: adv. 事实上，几乎；虚拟地，模拟地
definition: 1. adv. in essence or effect but not in fact；2. adv. (of actions or states) slightly short of or not quite accomplished
example: It virtually ignores the tree of life until we get to the end of the story And that's important.
exampleZh: 它实际上忽略了知识树，我们读完故事便会发现,这一点很重要。

meaning: n. 高尚的道德，德行；美德，优秀品质；优点，长处；（尤指妇女的）贞操；功效；（传统基督教天使学）道德天使（天国九级制度的第七级）（virtues）；【名】 （Virtue）弗丘（人名）
definition: 1. n. the quality of doing what is right and avoiding what is wrong；2. n. any admirable quality or attribute
example: We recognize in ourselves a virtue which is considered to be the cornerstone of many systems of moral understanding.
exampleZh: 我们承认我们拥有那种美德，可以作为,许多道德认知体系的基石。

meaning: adj. 道德高尚的，品行端正的；自命清高的，自鸣得意的；贞洁的；有效力的
definition: 1. adj. morally excellent；2. adj. in a state of sexual virginity
example: Louis was shown as an intelligent, courageous and virtuous family man.
exampleZh: 路易斯看上去是一个聪明、勇敢而且品德高尚的顾家男人。

meaning: n. 病毒；病毒性疾病，病毒感染；（计算机）病毒，（手机的）短信病毒；有害影响，毒害；毒液；【名】 （Virus）比鲁斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. (virology) ultramicroscopic infectious agent that replicates itself only within cells of living hosts; many are pathogenic; a piece of nucleic acid (DNA or RNA) wrapped in a thin coat of protein；2. n. a harmful or corrupting agency
example: We know now that it's caused by a related virus, called vaccinia, remember the virus that causes smallpox is called variola.
exampleZh: 我们现在知道这病由一种相关的病毒引起,这种病毒叫牛痘病毒,想想天花病毒也被叫做牛痘病毒

meaning: n. 签证；v. 签发签证；【名】 （Visa）（塞、芬）维萨（人名）
definition: 1. n. an endorsement made in a passport that allows the bearer to enter the country issuing it；2. v. provide (a passport) with a visa
example: You know, I came over on a holiday, the first time. I came on a six-month visa holiday.
exampleZh: 那时我是来度假的，第一次来。凭六个月假期签证过来的。

meaning: adj. 看得见的；明显的，引人注目的；（进出口贸易）有形商品的；（物理）（光）可见的；现有的，可得到的；n. 有形进出口货物（visibles）
definition: 1. adj. capable of being seen; or open to easy view；2. adj. obvious to the eye
example: I quoted the other day Wallace Stevens saying that poetry should "make the visible a little hard to see."
exampleZh: 引用华莱士斯蒂文斯的话来说,诗歌应该模糊事物的本质“

meaning: n. 能见度，能见距离；可见性，明显性；关注度，知名度
definition: 1. n. quality or fact or degree of being visible; perceptible by the eye or obvious to the eye；2. n. degree of exposure to public notice
example: It was raining heavily and visibility was poor.
exampleZh: 当时天下着大雨，能见度很低。

meaning: n. 幻想，想象；幻觉，幻象；构想，展望；眼力，远见卓识；视力，视觉；视野；美好的人（或事物）；（电视或电影的）图像；v. 想像
definition: 1. n. a vivid mental image；2. n. the ability to see; the visual faculty
example: And we get such a dramatic vision of that in the next episode that follows, the episode of the kitten.
exampleZh: 下面关于小猫的那里,有个令人难以忘怀的场景。

meaning: adj. 有眼力的，有远见卓识的；（宗教）幻觉的；想象力丰富的，空想的；n. 有远见的人，愿景家；出现宗教幻觉的人；想象力丰富的人
definition: 1. n. a person given to fanciful speculations and enthusiasms with little regard for what is actually possible；2. adj. not practical or realizable; speculative
example: That's "The Magi"; again, a visionary poem where Yeats is saying, "I see, I see in my mind's eye."
exampleZh: 还是《东方三贤》,一首幻想诗，此刻，正如我时时在内心中所见“

meaning: v. 参观，游览；拜访，作客；浏览（网页）；视察，巡视；找（医生或律师）咨询；闲谈；（多作圣经用语）（上帝）救助（某人），降临（某地）；使某人遭受（有害或不快之事）；n. 参观，游览；拜访，作客；（政治领导人或公务员的）访问，视察；（到网站的）访问；（在宾馆或汽车旅馆等的）住宿，逗留；就诊，咨询（律师等）；会面，闲聊；【名】 （Visit）（泰）威实（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of going to see some person or place or thing for a short time；2. v. visit a place, as for entertainment
example: And part of my journalism class was actually to go visit them and kind of see how they're doing.
exampleZh: 我所在的新闻学课上的同学有人去参观过，看他们是怎样运作的。

meaning: n. 访问者，参观者；（网站的）浏览者；客队队员（visitors）；候鸟；（大学或其他学术机构的）督察员
definition: 1. n. someone who visits
example: Reception just rang through to say my visitor has arrived.
exampleZh: 服务台刚刚打电话来说我的客人到了。

meaning: adj. 视觉的，视力的；栩栩如生的；n. 视觉资料（指说明性的图片、影片等）
definition: 1. adj. relating to or using sight；2. adj. able to be seen
example: Some abstraction is also apparent in the shift from visual to aural imagery in describing God's self-manifestations or theophanies.
exampleZh: 某些抽离在从纳贡者到听见神的自我宣称,或者神显的想像中也是十分明显的。

meaning: v. 想象，使形象化；使可见，使显现
definition: 1. v. imagine; conceive of; see in one's mind；2. v. view the outline of by means of an X-ray
example: It's almost a way of inviting us to visualize the separation of these two people as they speak.
exampleZh: 这几乎是吸引我们去观察,说话的两个孤立的个体。

meaning: adj. 至关重要的，必不可少的；生机勃勃的，充满活力的；生命的，维持生命所必需的；n. 身体的重要内脏，维持生命的重要器官（vitals）；【名】 （Vital）维塔尔（人名）
definition: 1. adj. urgently needed; absolutely necessary；2. adj. performing an essential function in the living body
example: It seems that computer technology is vital in making visual effects. What if we didn't have it?
exampleZh: 好像计算机技术对视觉特效很有用。要是没有这个我们会怎么样？

meaning: n. 活力，热情；生机，生命力
definition: 1. n. an energetic style；2. n. a healthy capacity for vigorous activity
example: Frost's "sound of sense," the abstract vitality of our speech.
exampleZh: 弗罗斯特的“感性的声音“或者是我们讲的抽象活力。

meaning: n. 维生素，维他命；维生素片，维生素丸
definition: 1. n. any of a group of organic substances essential in small quantities to normal metabolism
example: Oranges are rich in vitamin C.
exampleZh: 橘子含有丰富的维生素C。

meaning: adj. 生动的，逼真的；（颜色）鲜艳的，明亮的；（人的想像）丰富的
definition: 1. adj. evoking lifelike images within the mind；2. adj. having the clarity and freshness of immediate experience
example: He gave a vivid account of his life as a fighter pilot.
exampleZh: 他生动地描述了他那战斗机飞行员的生活。

meaning: n. （某人掌握或使用的）全部词汇；（某一语言的）词汇；（某个学科的）专业词汇，术语；（尤指外语教科书中的）词汇表；（美术、音乐等领域的）表现形式，表达手段
definition: 1. n. a listing of the words used in some enterprise；2. n. a language user's knowledge of words
example: that will be a lot more successful than trying to cram a lot of vocabulary words right away.
exampleZh: 那样会比一下子塞给自己很多单词要好得多。

meaning: adj. 嗓音的，发声的，歌唱的；直言不讳的，大声表达的；n. （乐曲中的）歌唱部分，声乐部分；【名】 （Vocal）（西）博卡尔（人名）
definition: 1. relating to or produced by the voice, either in singing or speaking；2. often expressing opinions and complaints in speech
example: What's interesting are all of the vocal nuances so let's listen to just a bit of this please.
exampleZh: 感受人声中有趣的微妙变化,让我们一起听一下

meaning: n. （认为某种职业适合自己的）使命感；（认为特别适合自己的）工作，职业，生活方式；神召，天命，（宗教）使命感
definition: 1. n. the particular occupation for which you are trained；2. n. a body of people doing the same kind of work
example: But my teaching at a certain form of ministering therefore is a kind of vocation, a kind of calling.
exampleZh: 但是教书由于在某种程度上为人服务,所以可以称作一种职业，一种召唤。

meaning: adj. 职业的，职业技术的，业务知识的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to a vocation or occupation; especially providing or undergoing training in special skills
example: The levels of education offered by different vocational schools are unequal.
exampleZh: 不同职业学校提供的教育水平是不等的。

meaning: n. 流行，时髦；adj. 时髦的，流行的；v. （模仿模特在 T 形台上的姿态）随音乐跳舞；【名】 （Vogue）（葡）沃格（人名）
definition: 1. a fashion or general liking, especially one that is temporary；2. the state of being popular or fashionable for a period of time
example: Pale colours are much more in vogue than autumnal bronzes and coppers.
exampleZh: 浅色比秋季的古铜色和紫铜色更为流行。

meaning: n. 嗓音，说话声，歌唱声；发言权，表达意愿的权利；愿望，意见，呼声；（突然闪现的）想法，感觉；代言人，喉舌；（语法）语态；（语音）浊音；（文学作品或作者的）独特风格；（乐曲）声部；单音，单声；v. 表达，吐露（感情或意见）；（语音）发浊音；（乐）给（管风琴）调音
definition: 1. n. the distinctive quality or pitch or condition of a person's speech；2. v. give voice to
example: He's a literary power, a figure who could be called upon to supply the voice of tradition in itself.
exampleZh: 他是一种文化力量，一个,可以随时用来声援传统文化的人物。

meaning: n. 空间，空白，空虚；空虚感，失落感；（墙、建筑物上的）孔隙；（桥牌和惠斯特用语）缺门；adj. 不合法的，无效的；（话语，行动）无效的，无用的；毫无……的，缺乏……的；空的，空空如也的；（职位）空缺；（桥牌和惠斯特用语）缺门的；v. 使无效，使作废；排泄，排放（大小便）；排放（水、气体等）；倒空（容器），疏空（空间）
definition: 1. a large hole or empty space；2. a feeling of unhappiness because someone or something is missing
example: So, indeed, we are talking about a lot of void and a tiny little bit of extremely dense being.
exampleZh: 事实上，更多的是许多真空,只有极小部分的高密度的物质。

meaning: adj. 易变的，动荡不定的，反复无常的；（情绪）易变的，易怒的，突然发作的；（液体或固体）易挥发的，易气化的；（计算机内存）易失的；n. 挥发物；有翅的动物；【名】 （Volatile）（意）沃拉蒂莱（人名）
definition: 1. likely to change suddenly and unexpectedly, especially by getting worse；2. likely to change emotional state very suddenly, especially by becoming angry
example: The longing heart accumulates desires that become in time a kind of volatile waste, which can't be contained.
exampleZh: 渴望的心聚集欲望,假以时日便成了,会挥发不能抑制的废物。

meaning: n. 易变，活泼；挥发性
definition: 1. the quality or state of being likely to change suddenly, especially by becoming worse；2. the quality of being likely to become angry suddenly
example: So first, I choose a volatility randomly, from some distribution of possible volatilities 2 from to, in this case, 0.2.
exampleZh: 来决定的一个值，所以首先我先随机选择一个浮动值，从可能的浮动值中的分布进行选择,在这个例子中就是0。

meaning: n. 火山
definition: 1. n. a fissure in the earth's crust (or in the surface of some other planet) through which molten lava and gases erupt；2. n. a mountain formed by volcanic material
example: You have, like lava emerging from a volcano, a rupture.
exampleZh: 相反，就像岩浆从火山喷出一样，突然爆发。

meaning: adj. 火山的，火山引发的；（感情或情绪）猛烈的，易突然发作的；n. 火山岩
definition: 1. adj. relating to or produced by or consisting of volcanoes；2. adj. explosively unstable
example: Over 200 people have been killed by volcanic eruptions.
exampleZh: 已有两百多人死于火山喷发。

meaning: n. 排球运动；排球（球）
definition: 1. n. a game in which two teams hit an inflated ball over a high net using their hands；2. n. an inflated ball used in playing volleyball
example: You can go have a barbecue, play volleyball for the day, tan, have fun on the beach.
exampleZh: 你可以去烧烤，打排球，晒太阳，在沙滩上玩耍。

meaning: n. 伏特（电压单位，符号 V）；环骑（马术术语）；闪避；（Volt）人名，捷克人名，译作“沃尔特”
definition: 1. n. a unit of potential equal to the potential difference between two points on a conductor carrying a current of 1 ampere when the power dissipated between the two points is 1 watt; equivalent to the potential difference across a resistance of 1 ohm when 1 ampere of current flows through it
example: A possible fire risk exists involving damaged batteries, as seen when a fire erupted in a Volt.
exampleZh: 一辆沃蓝达汽车发生起火事故时，受损电池可能存在引发火灾的风险。

meaning: n. 电压，伏特数
definition: 1. n. the rate at which energy is drawn from a source that produces a flow of electricity in a circuit; expressed in volts；2. n. the difference in electrical charge between two points in a circuit expressed in volts
example: If there were no voltage on the plates, we would expect everything to be over here in some negative value falling.
exampleZh: 如果板子上没有速度，这些可能都在这,都是负值下降的。

meaning: n. 体积，容积；总数，总量；音量，响度；（控制音量的）旋钮，控制杆；（成套图书中的）卷，册；（期刊）合订本；书籍；（写在羊皮纸或纸草纸上的）书卷；（尤指头发的）厚，多；adj. 大量的；v. 以卷的形式发出；成团卷起
definition: 1. n. the amount of 3-dimensional space occupied by an object；2. n. the property of something that is great in magnitude
example: These two relations involving entropy are also useful because they'll let us see how entropy depends on volume and pressure.
exampleZh: 这两个涉及熵的关系也非常有用,因为他们告诉我们,熵和体积，压强的关系。

meaning: adj. （衣服）宽松的；浩繁的，长篇的，冗长的；（容器、家具等）容量大的；（作家）多产的
definition: 1. adj. large in volume or bulk；2. adj. marked by repeated turns and bends
example: It was from here, also, that he wrote voluminous letters to friends seeking knowledge about politics.
exampleZh: 也是从这儿，他发出无数的信件给朋友,寻求政治知识。

meaning: n. 志愿者，义务工作者；自告奋勇者，主动做某事的人；志愿兵，义勇兵；自生植物；无因受益人；v. 自愿做，义务做，无偿做；志愿服役，志愿参军；主动提供（信息），主动说出（或建议）；自作主张地说，（未经当事人同意）举荐；adj. 志愿（者）的
definition: 1. n. (military) a person who freely enlists for service；2. v. tell voluntarily
example: She now helps in a local school as a volunteer three days a week.
exampleZh: 她现在作为一名志愿者每周3天在当地一所学校帮忙。

meaning: adj. 自愿的，自发的，主动的；（机构或组织）志愿的，义务性的；（工作）志愿的，无偿的，义务的；（工作者）志愿的，无偿服务的；（人体活动）随意的，可以控制的；（让与）自愿的，无偿的；n. （教堂里管风琴演奏的）仪式终始曲；（尤指作为其他作品的序曲，或自由创作的）即兴曲，自由调；（比赛中的）自选表演；自愿行动；志愿者
definition: 1. n. (military) a person who freely enlists for service；2. adj. of your own free will or design; not forced or compelled
example: The majority of the sacrifices that are described in the opening chapters of Leviticus, in Leviticus 1 through 7, are voluntary sacrifices.
exampleZh: 大部分祭品,在《利未记》的开头，第一章到第七章所提到的那些，都是自愿作为祭品的。

meaning: v. 投票选举，投票表决；投票评选；（通过投票）决定给予（资助），同意提供（款项）；表明，公认（某事好或坏）；投票同意；建议，主张；n. 选票，票；投票，表决；（选举中的）选票总数（the vote）；选举权，表决权；投票结果，表决结果；投票者，选民（the vote）；特定投票群体，特定选民；【名】 （Vote）（英、法）沃特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a choice that is made by counting the number of people in favor of each alternative；2. v. express one's preference for a candidate or for a measure or resolution; cast a vote
example: Now here's a question for you guys, which we're going to vote on, so you better start thinking about it.
exampleZh: 现在我希望，大家来，判断一下。

meaning: n. 选民，选举人，投票人；有投票权者
definition: 1. n. a citizen who has a legal right to vote
example: One voter in Brasilia summed up the mood – "Politicians have lost credibility," he complained.
exampleZh: 一位巴西利亚选民简述了人们的心情–“政治家们已丧失信誉，”他抱怨道。

meaning: n. 代金券，票券；收据，凭单；证人，保证人，证明者；v. 证实……的可靠性
definition: 1. a piece of paper that can be used to pay for particular goods or services or that allows you to pay less than the usual price for them；2. in the US, a scholarship (= money to pay for studies) that allows a student to attend a private school rather than a state school
example: This voucher can be redeemed at any of our branches.
exampleZh: 这抵用券在我们的任一分支机构都可以使用。

meaning: n. 誓约，诺言；（婚礼等上的）誓言；v. 立誓，发誓
definition: 1. to make a determined decision or promise to do something；2. a serious promise or decision
example: I made a silent vow to be more careful in the future.
exampleZh: 我默默发誓今后要更加小心。

meaning: n. （尤指坐船或飞往太空的）航行，旅行；（对某事或某人有大量新发现的）发现之旅；v. 航行，远行
definition: 1. n. an act of traveling by water；2. v. travel by boat propelled by wind or by other means
example: He was an orphan, he had no family, and he was on his first long voyage at sea.
exampleZh: 他是孤儿，没有家人，这是他首次出海远航。

meaning: adj. 粗俗的，庸俗的，不雅的；（笑话、评论、动作等）下流的；（人）粗鲁的，无礼的；平民的，通俗语言的；n. 平民，百姓
definition: 1. not suitable, simple, dignified or beautiful; not in the style preferred by the upper classes of society；2. rude and likely to upset or anger people, especially by referring to sex and the body in an unpleasant way
example: I think that is the most vulgar and tasteless remark I have ever heard in my life.
exampleZh: 我认为那是我平生听到过的最庸俗没品位的话。

meaning: adj. （身体或精神）脆弱的，易受伤的；（事物、人或地方）易受攻击的，易受伤害的；易患病的；（桥牌）有局方的，有身价的
definition: 1. adj. susceptible to attack；2. adj. susceptible to criticism or persuasion or temptation
example: That naturally hits monoline insurance companies more than multiline insurance companies because they are more specialized and more vulnerable.
exampleZh: 它对单线保险公司的冲击,自然要大于多线保险公司,因为它们的业务更单一也更容易受到影响

meaning: n. 易损性，弱点；（桥牌）局况
definition: 1. n. the state of being vulnerable or exposed；2. n. susceptibility to injury or attack
example: Even if you did everything that I would do, we would still have a vulnerability to financial crises.
exampleZh: 即使你做了我说的所有事情，我们还是有弱点以至于金融危机趁虚而入的。

meaning: n. 工资，报酬；（经济）工资总额；（喻）报应；v. 进行，发动（战争，运动）
definition: 1. n. something that remunerates；2. v. carry on (wars, battles, or campaigns)
example: He goes off and gets the support of the emperor of Austria to wage a war against his own father.
exampleZh: 他前往奥地利想得到奥地利国王的支持,从而通过向俄国开战来反抗他的父亲

meaning: n. （一般由马拉的）四轮运货车；（无顶的）铁路货车车厢，车皮；旅行轿车（station wagon 的简称）；（用作食品货摊的）手推车；儿童玩具小车；（吉卜赛人或马戏团用的）大篷车；令人不快的女人；v. 用运货马车运输货物；【名】 （Wagon）（法、德）瓦贡（人名）
definition: 1. n. any of various kinds of wheeled vehicles drawn by a horse or tractor；2. n. van used by police to transport prisoners
example: On Sunday the horses were harnessed to a heavy wagon for a day-long ride over the border.
exampleZh: 星期天这些马被套在一辆沉重的货车上，踏上长达一天的旅程越过边境。

meaning: n. 腰，腰围；（衣服的）腰部，腰身；船腰，飞机机身中部，（提琴、沙漏等的）中间细部，（黄蜂等的）细腰；女衬衫，紧身胸衣
definition: 1. n. the narrowing of the body between the ribs and hips；2. n. the narrow part of the shoe connecting the heel and the wide part of the sole
example: When men gain weight they tend to distribute it above the waist, abdominal obesity, or what's called the apple shape.
exampleZh: 当男性体重增加,他们的身体趋向于,把脂肪储存在腰间,也就是腹部肥胖,也就是我们所说的苹果形身材

meaning: v. 等候；盼望，期待；推迟，延缓；（已备好）可处理，可取用；（用于鼓励或威胁）等着；（用于打断讲话）等一下，慢着；服侍，招待；n. 等待，等候的时间；（城镇）官方乐队（waits）；【名】 （Wait）（英）韦特，（捷）魏特（人名）
definition: 1. n. time during which some action is awaited；2. v. stay in one place and anticipate or expect something
example: And your dad is like, "Oh, give me a big hug, I can't wait to see you."
exampleZh: 你的爸爸说，“哦，来赶紧给爸爸抱一下，我等不及要见你了。”

meaning: n. 服务员，侍者
definition: 1. n. a person whose occupation is to serve at table (as in a restaurant)；2. n. a person who waits or awaits
example: And it's--you might think, " "All right. The life of a waiter is not the worst thing in the world."
exampleZh: 而这时，你可能会想，“好吧，侍应生的生活又不是这世上最坏的事情“

meaning: v. 放弃（权利、要求等）；不强制执行（规定、限制），免除（费用）
definition: 1. to not demand something you have a right to, or not cause a rule to be obeyed；2. to remove a player from a team's roster (= list of players) and make that player available to other teams
example: Interestingly, an author may not waive any of the rights provided by copyright.
exampleZh: 有趣的是，作者不能放弃版权提供的任何权利。

meaning: n. （对权利或要求的）放弃；弃权声明书
definition: 1. an agreement that you do not have to pay or obey something；2. the act of a sports team removing a player from its roster (= list of players) and making that player available to other teams
example: We have this one parting gift-- just a little legal waiver for the cameras if you would.
exampleZh: 我这有份临别赠礼-,准许我们使用您肖像权的声明，希望您笑纳。

meaning: v. 唤醒，醒来；唤起，激起；（方）为（死者）守夜，为……守灵；警觉；n. （葬礼前后的）守夜，守灵；（航行中的船等留下的）尾流，航迹；【名】 （Wake）（英）韦克（人名）
definition: 1. n. the consequences of an event (especially a catastrophic event)；2. v. be awake, be alert, be there
example: I mean, it will wake us up in the morning. It will be the color of a beautiful bird.
exampleZh: 我是觉得，那样的颜色会让我们在早上惊醒。它会是一只漂亮的鸟的颜色。

meaning: v. 唤醒，醒来；唤起（记忆）
definition: 1. v. cause to become awake or conscious；2. v. stop sleeping
example: Though fear was upon her, and she longed to hear male voices, she would not waken them.
exampleZh: 尽管恐惧笼罩着她，她渴望听到男性的声音，但她不愿唤醒他们。

meaning: v. 走，步行；徒步旅行，散步；陪（某人）走，护送（某人）；带（宠物）散步，遛；把（某物）移走，使（某物）移动；消失，被偷；轻易做成（某事）；放弃，突然退出；出现，显灵；（使）上一垒；被无罪释放，未获刑罚；（击球手不等裁判指示）离开球场；生活；n. 步行，散步；徒步旅行；散步的小路，步行的路径；步态；步行的距离（或时间）；步行速度；（棒球）自由上垒；（护林人的）管辖林区；斗鸡场；小猎犬驯养场；（邮递员的）投递路线；一群沙锥；【名】 （Walk）（美）沃克（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of traveling by foot；2. v. use one's feet to advance; advance by steps
example: In fact, I used to go to church in Harlem. And it was... We would walk to and from church.
exampleZh: 事实上，我过去经常去哈莱姆的教堂。它……我们会从家里步行到教堂，然后再从教堂步行回家。

meaning: n. 城墙，围墙；墙，壁，墙壁；屏障，壁垒；（感情或行为的）障碍，隔阂；人墙，隔离墙；（身体器官或动植物细胞等的）外壁；（盒子或管道等空心物的）内壁；堆得像墙一样的大量东西；柏林墙（the Wall）；防波堤，防洪堤；（尤指宏大的）峭立面；围住矿脉（或矿层）的岩石；梅戈拉毛眼蝶（同 wall brown）；v. 用墙围住（一区域）；砌墙封闭，砌墙堵住（wall sth. up）；把……关起来，禁闭（wall sb./sth. in/up）；adj. 墙壁的；【名】 （Wall）（英）沃尔，（德、芬、捷、瑞典）瓦尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. an architectural partition with a height and length greater than its thickness; used to divide or enclose an area or to support another structure；2. v. surround with a wall in order to fortify
example: A shudder in the loins engenders there The broken wall, the burning roof and tower And Agamemnon dead.
exampleZh: 腰肢的猛一颤动,残破的墙垣，燃烧的屋顶和塔巅,阿伽门农死去。

meaning: n. 钱包，皮夹；（装文件的）皮夹，塑料夹；（尤指商贩和朝拜者用的）行囊，旅行袋；【名】 （Wallet）（英）沃利特，（法）瓦莱（人名）
definition: 1. n. a pocket-size case for holding papers and paper money
example: even at gunpoint for their watch or their wallet, cell phone, belongings like that.
exampleZh: 甚至是被枪指着劫持，要他们的手表、钱包、手机等类似的财物。

meaning: v. 漫游，游荡，漫步，流浪；走神，开小差；偏离，走偏（道路、航线等）；（目光）游移，往别处看；（河流、道路等）蜿蜒曲折；离题；（因年老而）神志恍惚，精神错乱；在人的身上摸来摸去（尤指他人不情愿时）；（对固定的性伴侣）不忠；n. 游荡，漫步；【名】 （Wander）万德（人名）
definition: 1. v. move about aimlessly or without any destination, often in search of food or employment；2. v. be sexually unfaithful to one's partner in marriage
example: You can't wander around any Greek city, or Roman city of the Ancient World, without seeing the latrine.
exampleZh: 古代希腊城市，及罗马城市，都有公共厕所。

meaning: v. 想要，希望；需要；（用于提出建议）应该；缺少；搜捕，追捕；想见（某人），想与（某人）谈话；（用于疑问句中表示提议或邀请）想要，需要；照料，爱护（小孩）；想要进去，想要出去；应受；n. 缺乏，缺少；贫穷，贫困；渴望的东西，需要的东西
definition: 1. n. a state of extreme poverty；2. v. feel or have a desire for; want strongly
example: We should be able to read whatever we want, just as we should be able to eat whatever we want.
exampleZh: 我们应该有权利读我们想读的东西，就像我们可以吃所有想吃的东西一样。

meaning: n. 战争，战争状态；竞争，斗争，对抗；（为消灭有害事物的）长期斗争，顽强抵御；舌战，论战；军事，战术；v. 进行战争，斗争
definition: 1. n. the waging of armed conflict against an enemy；2. v. make or wage war
example: There's a way in which the context of the war, too, shadows the poem and remains present in it.
exampleZh: 在战争的背景下，也投影于诗中同时也保持了它的现实性。

meaning: n. 病房，病室；（城镇或村庄的）区，选区；被监护人（尤指儿童）；牢房；监视，看守；（锁内）齿凸（wards）；城堡内空地，堡场；v. 接受（病人）入病房；看守，保护；【名】 （Ward）沃德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person who is under the protection or in the custody of another；2. v. watch over or shield from danger or harm; protect
example: The superfluous action suggests that there was something more at stake, perhaps, than Saint Ebba's attempt to ward off sexual assault.
exampleZh: 过多的行动表明，有比,圣人Ebba试图保护自己不受侵犯更有风险的东西。

meaning: n. 衣柜，衣橱；（某人的）全部服装；（剧院、电视台等的）服装部，戏装管理部
definition: 1. a tall cupboard in which you hang your clothes；2. all of the clothes that a person owns
example: There were several expensive suits hanging in the wardrobe.
exampleZh: 衣柜里挂着几套昂贵的衣服。

meaning: n. 陶器，器皿；（某种）物品，器皿；（尤指在市场或街上出售的）商品，货物；int. 当心，注意（狩猎时的警告叫喊声）；v. 留意，小心；【名】 （Ware）（罗）瓦雷，（英、加纳）韦尔，（日）吾（人名）
