definition: 1. n. articles of the same kind or material; usually used in combination: `silverware', `software'；2. v. spend extravagantly
example: I heard that MIT offers Open Course Ware to students. What do you think of it?
exampleZh: 我听说麻省理工给学生提供开放式课件。你有什么看法？

meaning: n. 仓库，货栈，货仓；仓储式批发商店，仓储式零售商店；v. 将（商品）存库，使入库；将（某人，尤其是犯人或精神病患者）安置在条件差的仓库式的收容所中
definition: 1. n. a storehouse for goods and merchandise；2. v. store in a warehouse
example: It's a huge warehouse full of amazing pieces which they pick up from all around the world.
exampleZh: 它是个很大的仓库，装满了神奇的东西，它们是从世界各地收集而来的。

meaning: n. 战争，作战；（团体、公司等之间的）斗争，竞争
definition: 1. n. the waging of armed conflict against an enemy；2. n. an active struggle between competing entities
example: Such a condition, a state of war, may mean a condition of open warfare, but not necessarily.
exampleZh: 这样一种状态，战争状态，也许意味着公开的战争状态，但这也不是必须的。

meaning: adj. 暖和的，温暖的；（衣服或建筑物）保暖的，防寒的；友好的，热情的；暖色调的；（尤指儿童游戏中）快要发现的，即将猜中的；（土壤）吸热快的，保温的；（猎）（气味，踪迹）新鲜的，强烈的；（声音）充满情感的，浑厚饱满的；v. （使）温暖，（使）变暖和；（对某人） 产生好感，（对想法） 开始感兴趣；同情；激动；使……兴奋； （使）变得更友好，变得更可爱；打（某人屁股）；n. 暖和的地方（或地区）（the warm）；取暖；厚呢短大衣（British warm的简称）；adv. 温暖地；【名】 （Warm）沃姆（人名）
definition: 1. v. get warm or warmer；2. adj. having or producing a comfortable and agreeable degree of heat or imparting or maintaining heat
example: and this... In the warm weather you see many, many people there. So... not far from here.
exampleZh: 而且……在天气暖和的时候，你可以在那儿看到许许多多的人。所以……离这儿不远。

meaning: n. 温暖，暖和；热情，友好；激动
definition: 1. n. the sensation caused by heat energy；2. n. a warmhearted feeling
example: So, here, it's nice to have a little bit of warmth in the midst of all the cold.
exampleZh: 所以在这儿，能在漫长的寒冷中有一丝温暖是非常好的。

meaning: v. 提醒，使警惕；警告，告诫（不要做……）；预先通知；（体育运动）警告；【名】 （Warn）（英）沃恩，（德）瓦恩（人名）
definition: 1. v. notify of danger, potential harm, or risk；2. v. admonish or counsel in terms of someone's behavior
example: It seems only right to warn you of the risk.
exampleZh: 似乎应该警告你有风险。

meaning: n. 警示，提醒，告诫；（对不良行为的）警告；预告，预兆；adj. 表示警告的，告诫的；v. 提醒注意（可能发生的事），使警惕；劝告（使有所防备），告诫；警告（warn 的现在分词）；【名】 （Warning）（德）瓦宁（人名）
definition: 1. n. a message informing of danger；2. adj. serving to warn
example: Again, we'll arrange for this, but you need to give us enough warning so that we can deal with that.
exampleZh: 重申，我们会对此进行安排，不过你需要给我们足够的提醒,以便我们能及时处理。

meaning: n. （法院授予警方采取行动的）令状，授权令；（思考、决定或做某事的）正当理由，依据；（接受款项、服务等的）凭单，许可证；（财政）认股权证；准尉委任书；v. 使有必要，使正当；需要，值得；允诺，保证
definition: 1. to make a particular activity necessary；2. used to say that you are certain about something
example: He feels that a variety of sorts of clinical evidence at his disposal warrant the distinction, but it is not an easy one.
exampleZh: 他觉得很多,临床证据都可以证明二者不同，但是这并不简单。

meaning: n. （商品的）保修单，保用卡；（保险合同用语）（被保险人对某些陈述所作的）保证，担保；正当理由，依据
definition: 1. a written promise from a company to repair or replace a product that develops a fault within a particular period of time, or to do a piece of work again if it is not satisfactory；2. a written promise by a company to repair or replace a product that breaks within a fixed period of time or do again a piece of work that is not satisfactory
example: The television comes with a full two-year warranty.
exampleZh: 这台电视机有整两年的保修期。

meaning: n. （尤指旧时的）武士，勇士；（瑜伽体式）战士
definition: 1. n. someone engaged in or experienced in warfare
example: New Zealand's quarrel with France over the Rainbow Warrior incident was formally ended.
exampleZh: 新西兰和法国之间关于“彩虹勇士号”事件的争端已经正式了结。

meaning: adj. 小心翼翼的，谨慎的，警戒的
definition: 1. adj. marked by keen caution and watchful prudence；2. adj. openly distrustful and unwilling to confide
example: People did not teach their children to be wary of strangers.
exampleZh: 人们以前没教过自己的孩子们要提防陌生人。

meaning: v. 清洗，洗涤；洗澡，（用水和肥皂）洗（身体的某部分）；（水）漫过，流过，冲刷；站得住脚，令人相信或接受；（织物，服装，染料）耐洗；（情感）强烈冲击；粉刷；镀（金，银）于；使湿透，浸泡；n. 洗涤；正在洗的衣物，将要洗的衣物；（涂料的）薄涂层，涂料；（对对立双方均无益处的）形势（或结果）；（船驶过划出的）波浪，波浪拍打声；（尤指用于清洗皮肤的）洗药，清洁剂；（水流的）冲积物；浅水沙滩；泔水，泔脚；已发酵的麦芽汁；(the Wash) 沃什湾；【名】 （Wash）（美）瓦什（人名）
definition: 1. n. a thin coat of water-base paint；2. v. clean with some chemical process
example: It will wash away and so you got to pick the right materials in order to build a bridge.
exampleZh: 它可能会被水冲走,之后人们就会选择更好的材料,以造出了更为坚固的桥

meaning: n. 洗涤，洗刷；待洗（或正在洗、刚洗过）的衣物；v. 洗涤；洗澡，（用水和肥皂）洗（身体的某部分）；（水）漫过，流过，冲刷（wash 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. the work of cleansing (usually with soap and water)；2. n. garments or white goods that can be cleaned by laundering
example: laundry. We used to have a washing machine and a dryer in our house.
exampleZh: 那就是洗衣服。过去我们家有洗衣机和烘干机。

meaning: n. 浪费，滥用；废物，废弃物（同 wastes）；荒地，荒原（wastes）；（尤指因租借人的行为或疏忽而导致的）不动产的损坏，产业损伤；粪便，尿液；v. 浪费，滥用；未能充分利用，没有物尽其用；杀害，谋杀（某人）；（使）（人，身体部位）逐渐变虚弱，变消瘦；破坏，毁坏（地方）；（时间）流逝，被花掉；adj. （通常指城市中的某地）荒芜的，荒废的；（材料、物质等）废弃的，无用的
definition: 1. n. any materials unused and rejected as worthless or unwanted；2. v. spend thoughtlessly; throw away
example: According to the Second Brother, it's virtually impossible for a single, helpless maiden to pass uninjured in this wild, surrounding waste.
exampleZh: 弟弟认为，一个孤独无助的女孩想要，毫发无伤的穿过这野外的荒原是根本不可能的。

meaning: adj. 浪费的，挥霍的
definition: 1. adj. inefficient in use of time and effort and materials；2. adj. tending to squander and waste
example: Parents pay for wasteful grand parties, expensive cars, and designer clothes.
exampleZh: 父母为铺张浪费的盛大聚会、昂贵的汽车和名牌服装买单。

meaning: v. 看，注视；观看（电视节目、比赛等）；关注；照看，守护；当心，留意；监视；n. 表，手表；观察，监视； 警卫队，治安队；警戒时间，（警卫或治安队等的）值班时间；巡夜人，巡夜队（the watch）；一群夜莺；（某人的）管理期；（官方）天气预警，天气警报
definition: 1. n. a small portable timepiece；2. v. look attentively
example: And if you are prepared to stand up for about two and a half to three hours to watch a play,
exampleZh: 而且你要准备好了站上大约两个半小时到三个小时，去看一场戏剧，

meaning: adj. 注意的，警惕的
definition: 1. adj. carefully observant or attentive; on the lookout for possible danger；2. adj. experiencing or accompanied by sleeplessness
example: The best thing is to be watchful and see the family doctor for any change in your normal health.
exampleZh: 最好的做法就是保持警惕，身体一有变化就去看家庭医生。

meaning: n. 水，雨水；水域，（江、河、湖、海等）大片的水；（某个国家的）领海，海域（waters）；不明朗（或未知的、困难、危险等）局面（waters）；羊水（waters）；（湖、海的）水面；水位；乘船，走水路；v. 给……浇水，灌溉；给…...水喝，饮（动物）；（风等使眼睛）流泪；流口水；（江河）流经并给（某地区）供水；加水冲淡，稀释；【名】 （Water）（英）沃特（人名）
definition: 1. n. binary compound that occurs at room temperature as a clear colorless odorless tasteless liquid; freezes into ice below 0 degrees centigrade and boils above 100 degrees centigrade; widely used as a solvent；2. v. supply with water, as with channels or ditches or streams
example: There's the primeval fresh water, fresh water ocean, Apsu Which is identified with a male divine principle, a male god Apsu.
exampleZh: 有原始的淡水，淡水海洋，它与男性神道有关，这个男性神灵叫做。

meaning: adj. 防水的，不透水的；v. 使……不透水，对……作防水处理；n. 防水衣物，雨衣
definition: 1. n. any fabric impervious to water；2. v. make watertight
example: The traditional backpack with a difference—it's waterproof.
exampleZh: 这个跟传统背包不同—它防水。

meaning: adj. （容器或房间）防漏水的，水密的；（理论、计划或协议）严密的，无懈可击的
definition: 1. adj. not allowing water to pass in or out；2. adj. without flaws or loopholes
example: If she could just establish the time the picture had been taken, Mick would have a watertight alibi.
exampleZh: 只要她能确定拍这张照片的时间，米克就可以有一个无懈可击的不在现场的证据。

meaning: n. 瓦，瓦特（电功率单位）；【名】 （Watt）（英，葡）瓦特（人名）
definition: 1. the standard measure of electrical power
example: Two people who have divergent views on this question are George Watt and Bob Marr.
exampleZh: 在这个问题上意见相左的两个人是乔治·瓦特和鲍勃·马尔。

meaning: v. 挥手；挥手示意；挥舞，挥动；飘扬，摆动，摇晃；使（头发）略呈波形；（威胁地）举起（某物）；n. 海浪；大海（the waves）；（活动、行为的）爆发，浪潮；涌现的人（或物）；挥手；波，波状运动；（头发的）卷曲；波浪形；（地震、爆炸的）冲击波；人浪（the wave）
definition: 1. n. one of a series of ridges that moves across the surface of a liquid (especially across a large body of water)；2. v. signal with the hands or nod
example: Well, if this thing is going to vibrate for any length of time it better be a standing wave.
exampleZh: 好的，如果它在任意时间振动,那它就是驻波。

meaning: adj. （头发）鬈曲的；波纹状的，波浪形的；（纹章）波形的，波状的；【名】 （Wavy）威维（人名）
definition: 1. adj. of hair in waves；2. adj. uneven by virtue of having wrinkles or waves
example: Instead of straight hair, this bob works well with wavy or crimped hair.
exampleZh: 取代直发，这种波波头很适合波浪状或者卷曲的头发。

meaning: n. 蜡，蜂蜡；耳垢； 一阵愤怒；唱片；类似蜡的黏性物质（尤指液体或碳氢化合物）；v. 给……上（或打）蜡；用蜡除去（身体部位）的毛发；（月亮）渐圆，渐满；（带着某种情绪）说，写；（数量、规模等）增加，变大；把……灌制成唱片；adj. 蜡制的，似蜡的；【名】 （Wax）（德、罗、匈、英）瓦克斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. any of various substances of either mineral origin or plant or animal origin; they are solid at normal temperatures and insoluble in water；2. v. cover with wax
example: It's a bit small, but it basically has wax models of famous figures,
exampleZh: 它有点小，但是基本上，它那里都是名人的蜡像。

meaning: n. 方法，手段；习俗，习惯，行为方式；（行事）作风，（某事发生的）方式；道路，路线；行进路线，通路；方向；……路（用于道路的名称）；出入通道，门口；距离，时段；方面；（两种之一的）选择；情况，状态；（某人居住的）地区，地方；（分成的）部分；职业，行当；（船）航行，动力；船台，滑道（ways）；adv. 大大地，远远地；非常，很；adj. 途中的；【名】 （Way）韦（人名）
definition: 1. n. how something is done or how it happens；2. adv. to a great degree or by a great distance; very much (`right smart' is regional in the United States)
example: It's like, 5-minute-walk that way. If you just walk that way, you'll hit it
exampleZh: 差不多有5分钟的路程。你们沿着那条路走，一会就到了，

meaning: pron. 我们（主格）；笔者，本人（作者或演讲人使用）；朕，寡人；n. （We）人名；（缅）韦
definition: 1. abstract: We is the first album of the Croatian composer, pianist and pop singer Vladimir Bodegrajac (stage name Van Bod), released in 2011, published by the Croatian Association of Music Theorists.
example: We should be able to read whatever we want, just as we should be able to eat whatever we want.
exampleZh: 我们应该有权利读我们想读的东西，就像我们可以吃所有想吃的东西一样。

meaning: adj. 虚弱的，无力的；不牢固的；懦弱的，无判断力的；无影响力的，无权力的；疲软的，萧条的；不擅长的；无说服力的；力量微弱的，无强度的；（光、热或声音）微弱的；无活力的，无生气的；（饮品）稀的；（脸的部分）瘦小的，（容貌）不突出的；（受强烈情感影响而）腿发软的；无效力的，没有吸引力的；（动词）弱的，规则的；非重读的；弱电解的，弱电解质的；n. 穷人，弱者，病人（the weak）
definition: 1. adj. having little physical or spiritual strength；2. adj. overly diluted; thin and insipid
example: And in fact, under type checking, different languages sometimes fall on a spectrum from weak to strong typing.
exampleZh: 实际上，在类型检查的下面，不同的语言会对应着,从弱到强的一个定型范围。

meaning: v. （使）虚弱，（使）衰弱；（使）变弱，削弱；使（肯定程度）减弱，动摇，犹豫；（使）（大楼 、结构体等）不结实；（使）（股票等）疲弱，疲软
definition: 1. v. lessen the strength of；2. v. become weaker
example: Nothing could weaken his resolve to continue.
exampleZh: 什么也不能削弱他继续下去的决心。

meaning: n. 虚弱，软弱；缺点，不足；疲软；癖好，嗜好，宠爱
definition: 1. n. a flaw or weak point；2. n. powerlessness revealed by an inability to act
example: Indeed the major strides in prevention have largely come from a perspective focused " on systematically building competency,not correcting weakness."
exampleZh: 事实上，在预防方面取得的重大进展,基本上来自一个观点,也就是注重培养能力，而非改正错误“

meaning: n. 财富；富有；大量
definition: 1. n. the state of being rich and affluent; having a plentiful supply of material goods and money；2. n. the quality of profuse abundance
example: How would you recommend that investors protect their wealth during this period to ? take advantage of upcoming investment opportunities?
exampleZh: 那你对投资者在这段时间内,如何保护他们的财产并且,进一步利用这即将到来的投资机会有什么建议呢？

meaning: adj. 富有的，丰富的；n. 富人（the wealthy）
definition: 1. adj. having an abundant supply of money or possessions of value
example: The optimates, meaning "the best," tended to support the interests of the wealthy senators and the few wealthiest families.
exampleZh: 贵族派，是指精英“,主张保护元老院议员的利益,以及少数富裕家庭。

meaning: n. 武器，兵器，凶器；（用于应付困境的）工具，手段；v. 武装，装备
definition: 1. n. any instrument or instrumentality used in fighting or hunting；2. n. a means of persuading or arguing
example: It's a spear that you thrust and it's got a bronze point, which is the business end of the weapon.
exampleZh: 而是用来刺杀的近战武器,在刺人的一端有铜质的矛头

meaning: v. 穿（衣服），戴（首饰等）；蓄（须），留（发）；销蚀，磨损，踩出（路），磨出（洞）；流露，面带（某种表情）；使疲乏，使虚弱，使厌倦；经久耐用；不显老；允许，接受；（船）升，挂（旗）；消磨（时间） ；（航海）使（船头）转向下风；n. （特定人群、场合或用途穿的）服装；穿，戴；（因长期使用而造成的）磨损，损坏；耐用性，经久性
definition: 1. n. impairment resulting from long use；2. v. be dressed in
example: So it's like a... It's always a mix of something that's nice to wear but at the same time, also looks nice.
exampleZh: 所以这就像……经常是穿起来舒服、但同时看起来也好看的结合。

meaning: adj. 疲劳的，疲倦的；使人疲劳的，令人厌烦的；厌倦的，厌烦的；v. （使）疲倦，（使）厌烦；忧伤，烦恼
definition: 1. very tired or lacking energy and enthusiasm；2. bored by something because you have experienced too much of it
example: Another book, another book cover, The Weary Blues, by Langston Hughes, 1926.
exampleZh: 另一本书，另一本的封面，这是1926年由兰斯顿，休斯所著的《萎靡的布鲁斯》

meaning: n. 疲倦，疲劳；厌倦
definition: 1. great tiredness；2. the state of being bored with something because you have experienced too much of it
example: I noticed, behind the neutrality of his gaze, a deep weariness.
exampleZh: 我觉察到，在他那不动声色的凝视背后有一种深深的厌倦。

meaning: n. 天气，气象；恶劣天气（指寒冷、潮湿等），自然力；气象预报；处境；气候；v. （受风吹雨打而）（使）褪色，（使）风化；平安度过（困境）；（船）航行到（海角）的上风，安全绕过（海角）；使（板，瓦片）交搭向下倾斜以挡雨；让（鹰）在露天栖息一段时间；adj. 露天的；迎风的；【名】 （Weather）（英）韦瑟（人名）
definition: 1. n. the meteorological conditions: temperature and wind and clouds and precipitation；2. v. face or endure with courage
example: I think that maybe the one thing they have going for them down in Southern California is the weather.
exampleZh: 我觉得人们喜欢在南加州住，还有可能是因为这里的天气。

meaning: v. （用织布机）编，织；（用……）编成；编造（故事或计划）；将（素材等）编入（故事或设计中）；迂回行进，穿行（以避开障碍）；（蜘蛛）结网；（驾机）绕飞，作闪避动作；（马）不断左右摇晃头部和前身；n. 编法，织法，编织式样；编织图案；（使头发显得厚密或更长的）织发
definition: 1. n. pattern of weaving or structure of a fabric；2. v. interlace by or as it by weaving
example: They would spin and weave cloth, cook and attend to the domestic side of life.
exampleZh: 他们纺纱、织布、做饭，还料理家务。

meaning: n. （蜘蛛）网；网状物，错综复杂的事物；网络；（鸟兽的）蹼；连接板，金属薄条（片）；（连续印刷用）一卷纸；（制造卷筒纸的造纸机上的）无端金属丝网；织物；v. 用网（或网状物）覆盖；使中圈套；形成网
definition: 1. n. an intricate network suggesting something that was formed by weaving or interweaving；2. v. construct or form a web, as if by weaving
example: Derrida, as I said, believes in a kind of seamless web of discourse or discursivity. We are awash in discourse.
exampleZh: 德里达，我说过，他相信有一种无缝的网,存在于论述或推论中，我们在论述中是处于同一水平线的。

meaning: n. 网络广播；网络直播；v. 在网络上直播
definition: 1. abstract: A webcast is a media presentation distributed over the Internet using streaming media technology to distribute a single content source to many simultaneous listeners/viewers. A webcast may either be distributed live or on demand.
example: I'll be doing a live webcast with Jun Loayza tomorrow at my house.
exampleZh: 明天，我将在家中和洛艾萨进行网络直播。

meaning: n. 网站（全球资讯网的主机站）
definition: 1. n. a computer connected to the internet that maintains a series of web pages on the World Wide Web
example: So, this is what happens. You go to the website, there's all these bars down the side, so there's lecture videos.
exampleZh: 事情就是这样，你们访问这个网站，在下边有这些栏，还有上课的视频。

meaning: v. 结婚，娶，嫁；（使）结合；坚持，专心于（活动、信仰或制度）
definition: 1. n. the fourth day of the week; the third working day；2. v. take in marriage
example: He has bought a house for the couple and hopes that one day they can wed.
exampleZh: 他为这对情侣买了房子，希望有一天他们能够结婚。

meaning: n. 婚礼，结婚庆典；婚礼的；结婚纪念，结婚纪念日；结合；v. 结婚，娶，嫁；（使）结合；坚持，专心于（活动、信仰或制度）（wed 的现在分词）；【名】 （Wedding）（德）韦丁（人名）
definition: 1. n. the social event at which the ceremony of marriage is performed；2. n. the act of marrying; the nuptial ceremony
example: And that's great if you just want to get a one of like, beautiful hat for a wedding
exampleZh: 如果你想买一个类似于参加婚礼的漂亮的帽子这样的东西，去那儿是很好的，

meaning: n. 楔子，三角木；楔形物，三角形物（尤指食物）；不和；（高尔夫）楔形铁头球棒；（高尔夫）楔形铁头球棒击出的球；有鞋跟的女鞋；坡跟鞋鞋跟；（人或动物组成的）楔形队形；钱，收入；v. （将……）楔入，插入，挤入；把……楔住，把……楔牢；（制作陶瓷时）揉（陶土）；【名】 （Wedge）韦奇（人名）
definition: 1. a piece of metal, wood, rubber, etc. with a pointed edge at one end and a wide edge at the other, either pushed between two objects to keep them still or forced into something to break pieces off it；2. a piece of something, especially food, in the shape of a triangle
example: The logograms were incised on damp clay tablets with a stylus with a wedge shape at its end.
exampleZh: 这些标识是用一根末端为楔形的手写笔在潮湿的泥板上刻下的。

meaning: n. 星期三，周三；adv. 在星期三（多用于北美英语及新闻报道）
definition: 1. n. the fourth day of the week; the third working day
example: Test 1 will be a week from Wednesday, and I will say something about that later in the week.
exampleZh: 测试1从周三开始，持续一周，我会在之后的一周跟你们说一些东西。

meaning: n. 野草，杂草；香烟，烟草（the weed）；水草，水生植物；大麻；瘦弱的人，懦弱的人；（长腿）瘦弱的马；v. 除草，为……除杂草；【名】 （Weed）（美、英、加、印、澳）威德（人名）
definition: 1. n. any plant that crowds out cultivated plants；2. v. clear of weeds
example: He is eager to weed out the many applicants he believes may be frauds.
exampleZh: 他急于剔除那些他认为可能是行骗的申请人。

meaning: n. 星期，周；一个星期的时间，一周；一周工作时间，工作周；（除去星期六和星期日的）星期，周；活动周（举行某项活动的一周）；（从某天算起的）一周；（某天之前的）一周；一周又一周，接连好几个星期
definition: 1. n. any period of seven consecutive days；2. n. a period of seven consecutive days starting on Sunday
example: Bryant Park used to have fashion week there and that was like, a great meeting place for people there.
exampleZh: 布莱恩公园过去有时尚周，那里真的是个很适合与人见面的地方。

meaning: adj. 每周的，一周一次的；持续一周的，按周计算的；周刊的；n. 周报，周刊；adv. 每周，每星期
definition: 1. n. a periodical that is published every week (or 52 issues per year)；2. adj. occurring or payable every week
example: And on the other, a table, which held loaves of bread that were changed on a weekly basis.
exampleZh: 另一边是一张桌子，用来摆放长面包,面包一周替换一次。

meaning: n. 平日，普通日，工作日（周一至周五）；adj. 平日的，工作日的（常作定语）
definition: 1. n. any day except Sunday (and sometimes except Saturday)；2. adj. occurring every day of the week except Sunday (and sometimes Saturday)
example: If you normally do your fruit shopping on Saturday, choose a weekday night to go instead.
exampleZh: 如果你通常在周六买水果，那就选择一个工作日的晚上再去。

meaning: n. 周末；周末旅行，周末度假；adj. 周末的；v. 度周末
definition: 1. n. a time period usually extending from Friday night through Sunday; more loosely defined as any period of successive days including one and only one Sunday；2. v. spend the weekend
example: So when you go home today or some time this weekend, make sure you read this page in detail.
exampleZh: 因此，请大家在今天回家之后或者在周末找个时间，务必仔细读一读这页纸。

meaning: v. （通常因悲伤）哭泣，流泪；（伤口）流出液体，渗出脓液；哭着说；哀悼；n. 哭泣，落泪
definition: 1. v. shed tears because of sadness, rage, or pain
example: So, that sense of isolation in the tower makes her weep.
exampleZh: 让她热泪盈眶。

meaning: v. 称，称……的重量；重，有……重；认真考虑，权衡；具有重要性，影响；起（锚），启航；使烦恼，使忧虑；斟酌（字句）；n. （航海）（船）在航行中
definition: 1. v. have a certain weight；2. v. show consideration for; take into account
example: Some things seem light if you don't weigh them, but once you do, they might weigh a ton.
exampleZh: 有些事不上称没有四两重，上了称一千斤也打不住。

meaning: n. 重量，分量，体重；重；杠铃，哑铃；砝码，秤砣；重体，重物；重量单位，衡制；重担，负担；影响力，重要性；大量的某物；投掷器械（包括铁饼、铅球、链球等）；（布料）表面密度；重心；（引力场作用于物体上的）重力；（统计）权重，权数；v. 加重量于，使变重；（经改动）使倾向于……；重视，加权重于；加重压于（马）上；对（织物）作加重处理；【名】 （Weight）（英）韦特，（捷）魏格特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the vertical force exerted by a mass as a result of gravity；2. v. weight down with a load
example: These are unquestionably strong words, and I think it's impossible for us to overestimate the weight of these words.
exampleZh: 毫无疑问，这些言辞非常激烈，我觉得,怎么高估它们的分量都不过分。

meaning: adj. 奇怪的，不寻常的；怪异的，超自然的；n. 命运；预言者；v. 使心生疑惑，使感到疏远
definition: 1. n. Fate personified; one of the three Weird Sisters；2. adj. suggesting the operation of supernatural influences
example: and response to any situation that feels strange or weird or just doesn't sit right with you.
exampleZh: 你可以用来表达你对那些让你感到陌生、怪异或者就是不对劲的情况的反应。

meaning: v. 欢迎，迎接；迎新；乐意接纳，欣然接受；乐于接受（已发生的事）；庆祝；adj. （某人）受欢迎的；令人愉快的；（表示乐于让某人做某事）可随意；尽管……好了（指非常乐意让别人拥有自己不想要的东西）；n. 欢迎，迎接；（对观念的）接受；int. 欢迎；【名】 （Welcome） （美、印）韦尔科姆（人名）
definition: 1. n. the state of being welcome；2. v. accept gladly
example: So, if you want to go at 1:00, you're welcome to do so, but please arrange it with my assistants.
exampleZh: 如果你想去上1点的课，也可以，但是一定要和我的助教安排一下。

meaning: n. 幸福，安康；福利救济，社会福利；（给失业者和穷人的）福利救济金；adj. 福利的；接受社会救济的
definition: 1. n. governmental provision of economic assistance to persons in need；2. n. something that aids or promotes well-being
example: We don't care at all about corporations-- we should make that clear-- except as they contribute to individual welfare.
exampleZh: 我们完全不关心企业-,我们应该明确这一点-,除非它们对个人福利有贡献。

meaning: adv. 顺利地，令人满意地；熟练地，技术好地；妥善地，恰当地；赞扬地，赞许地；有益地，有利地；容易地；友善地；有充分理由，合理地；很，非常；富裕地，舒适地；完全地，充分地；大大地，远远地；（程度或标准）多少，怎样；adj. 健康的；令人满意的；明智的，可取的；n. 水井，油井，气井；楼梯井，电梯井道；（法庭中的）律师席；韦尔斯（有矿泉的地方）（Wells）；（储液体的）凹槽；（大量）来源，源泉；吧台酒架；廉价酒；（物理）势阱，电位阱；int. （用于表示想要开口说话）嗯，好；唔，嗯，哦（表示对要说的话不确定）；好吧，算了（对不愉快的事表示接受）；好啦，哎呀（用于劝说或让人不要生气、焦虑等）；嗳（表示生气或不赞成）；怎么样呢，哎（表示等待回答或行动）；好啦（用于结束活动或对话）；（停顿后继续交谈）唔，这个；（表示惊奇、愤怒或宽慰）哎呀，哟，啊；噢（用于纠正刚才说过的话）；v. （液体）流出，涌出；（感情）涌上，涌起；【名】 （Well）（英、德、荷）韦尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a deep hole or shaft dug or drilled to obtain water or oil or gas or brine；2. v. come up, as of a liquid
example: This is giving us one more try on the vsper geometries, because it didn't go so well on Wednesday.
exampleZh: 这里再给你们一次机会，我们周三课堂练习做的不是很好。

meaning: n. 幸福，安康；（国家的）繁荣
definition: 1. n. a contented state of being happy and healthy and prosperous
example: You see this whole realm on life flourishing, on happiness, on well-being has been until recently dominated by the self-health movement.
exampleZh: 殷盛人生，快乐，幸福感这一整个领域，在此之前一直被心理自助运动统治。

meaning: adj. 众所周知的
definition: 1. adj. widely or fully known；2. adj. frequently experienced; known closely or intimately
example: I wanted to list a few errors that are well-known and that are exploited by unscrupulous people in finance.
exampleZh: 我先罗列一些大家熟知的错误,这些错误常常被无良的人在金融领域中利用

meaning: adj. 富裕的，小康的，殷实的；顺利的，走运的，处境好的；（在某事物方面）充裕的，供应充足的；繁荣昌盛的
definition: 1. adj. in fortunate circumstances financially; moderately rich；2. adj. fortunately situated
example: The program provides scholarships for talented students from less well-off families.
exampleZh: 该计划为来自经济条件较差家庭的学生提供奖学金。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: n. 西，西方；（某个国家、地区或地方的）西部；西方国家 (指美国、加拿大以及西欧、北欧和南欧诸国)（the West)；（美国）西部（尤指密西西比河以西诸州）(the West, the west)；西方（国家）（与东欧前共产主义国家相对的欧洲和北美洲的非共产主义国家）（the West)；（桥牌）坐在西首位置的人；adj. 西方的,向西的；（风）来自西方的；（用于国家、州和地区的名称中）西部的；adv. 向西方，朝西方；……以西；【名】 （West）（英、德、芬、瑞典）韦斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the countries of (originally) Europe and (now including) North America and South America；2. adj. situated in or facing or moving toward the west
example: At any one time, there's about, I think, 50 or 60 different productions in the West End here in London.
exampleZh: 任何时候，我想想，大概都有50或者60部不同的成品剧在伦敦西区上演。

meaning: adj. 西方的，西部的；（Western）西方国家的（指与北美、西欧、北欧、南欧各国相关的）；美国西部的；n. （关于19世纪美国西部生活，尤指牛仔生活的）西部电影、西部小说；西方人；【名】 （Western）（英）韦斯顿（人名）
definition: 1. n. a film about life in the western United States during the period of exploration and development；2. adj. relating to or characteristic of regions of western parts of the world
example: So, his letters come out of this western land, New Mexico, and a land of criminality, the reform school.
exampleZh: 他的信从新墨西哥这片西部的土地而来，还是寄宿学校这种犯罪滋生地。

meaning: n. 西方人，欧美人；西部居民，尤指美国西部的人
definition: 1. n. an inhabitant of a western area; especially of the U.S.
example: It's the first time a Westerner has been convicted for a drug-related offence in recent years in China.
exampleZh: 这是近年来第一次有西方人在中国被判犯有与毒品有关的罪行。

meaning: adj. 湿的，潮湿的；（天气）下雨的，多雨的；（油漆、墨水等）未干的；（婴幼儿或尿片）尿湿的；软弱的，优柔寡断的；允许售酒的，不禁酒的；（尤指被右翼保守派认为）具有自由主义倾向的保守派的；（人） 嗜好酒的；用水（或其他液体）的；（鱼）新鲜的；（轮船）易（从船首或舷侧）进水的；n. 雨，雨天（the wet）；保守党温和派成员；湿气，水分，液体；软弱的人，窝囊废（含贬义）；酒；反禁酒者；v. 把（某物）弄湿；（尤指婴儿或小孩子）把……尿湿；（倒入滚烫的开水）沏（茶）；变湿；【名】 （Wet）（英、纳米、南非）韦特（人名）
definition: 1. n. wetness caused by water；2. v. cause to become wet
example: He lurched up the aisle, falling against two tables on the way and getting his hand wet in somebody's coffee.
exampleZh: 他突然歪向走道边，撞到了路中间的两张桌子,手还碰到了别人的咖啡。

meaning: n. 鲸；巨大的东西；v. 殴打，猛击；捕鲸；使惨败；【名】 （Whale）（爱）惠尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a very large person; impressive in size or qualities；2. v. hunt for whales
example: And it's a popular place for whale watching, when it's the season for the whales
exampleZh: 到了看鲸鱼的季节，那是观赏鲸鱼的热门场所，

meaning: n. 码头，停泊处；v. 靠码头；把货卸在码头上；为……建码头
definition: 1. an area like a wide wall built near the edge of the sea or a river where ships can be tied and goods can be taken off them；2. an area in a port where goods are taken off and put on ships
example: The one with the pointy roof, which I can't see, is Canary Wharf itself.
exampleZh: 那个有尖头屋顶的，现在我看不见，是金丝雀码头本身。

meaning: det. 什么，什么样的；（指数量的全部）所……的；全部的，所有的；多么（好或坏）的，何等的；pron. 什么；（感叹）多么；无论什么；……的事物；conj. （用于动词和形容词后引导名词性关系从句）什么，所……的事物；（用于强调句型句首）所……的（是……）；……那样的（事物）；（指全部的量）所有的；int. （表示惊讶、气愤、怀疑、喜欢、厌恶等）什么，真的吗；（口语，用于应答或请对方重复）什么？；adv. 到什么程度，在哪一方面；（口语）哦，呃（用于暂停思考）；（用于句末征求同意）是吧
definition: 1. used to ask about or refer to a thing, situation, or amount
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: What place can it occupy in each type of discourse, what functions can it assume, and by obeying what rules?"
exampleZh: 它可以在每种话语中占据什么样的位置，它在遵循什么原则的情况下可以有什么样的功能？“

meaning: det. 任何……的事物，无论什么；pron. 任何事物；究竟是什么；无所谓，什么都可以； 名叫某某的东西（用于指称不知道的东西）；adv. 任何，丝毫（表强调）；不管怎样；conj. 不管什么，无论什么；任何…...的事物，凡是…...的东西；int. （表示勉强接受）随便你怎么说
definition: 1. adj. one or some or every or all without specification
example: Even if they are writer or an artist or whatever you are doing, I think it's a very inspiring place.
exampleZh: 即使他们是作家或艺术家，无论你从事什么行业，我想这都是一个非常启发人心的地方。

meaning: adj. 任何，无论什么；adv. 丝毫（用于强调否定句）；pron. 任何事物，无论什么
definition: 1. adj. one or some or every or all without specification
example: I have had very little help from doctors and no sympathy whatsoever.
exampleZh: 我从医生那儿得到的帮助极少，而且没得到任何同情。

meaning: n. 小麦（植物），小麦（籽实）；小麦面包；小麦色；【名】 （Wheat）（英）惠特（人名）
definition: 1. n. annual or biennial grass having erect flower spikes and light brown grains；2. n. grains of common wheat; sometimes cooked whole or cracked as cereal; usually ground into flour
example: Vegetables can be grown many times in places where you could never grow wheat or grain.
exampleZh: 也许不能生产小麦和谷物的土地,蔬菜却可以长好几季

meaning: n. 轮子，车轮；汽车（wheels）；机轮，齿轮，传动轮；（汽车、轮船等的）方向盘，转向盘；系统，机构；轮状物；轮盘（一种旋转的赌具）；轮；重要人物，大亨；轮式机械（或器具）；旋转，回旋；（诗歌等的）叠句；（用于牵拉或分裂肢体的）轮式刑车（the wheel）；v. 推，拉（带轮运输工具）；用有轮之物推动（或拉动、移动）……；（鸟或飞机）盘旋；（使）迅速转身，猛然转身
definition: 1. n. a simple machine consisting of a circular frame with spokes (or a solid disc) that can rotate on a shaft or axle (as in vehicles or other machines)；2. v. change directions as if revolving on a pivot
example: The wheel is pulling to the left.
exampleZh: 方向盘正在向左打。

meaning: adv. 什么时候；什么情况下；什么场合下；（用于时间的表达方式之后）在那时，其时；当时，当场；pron. 什么时候；何时（多用于 since、till、until 等之后）；conj. 当……时，在……时候；在……之后；一……就；随时，在任何……时候；既然，考虑到；虽然，然而，可是；这时，突然；n. 时间，时候；日期；场合
definition: 1. abstract: "When" - a song by French singer Amanda Lear released in 1980 by Ariola Records.
example: When would they be hired again? Perhaps, as the saying goes, when pigs fly.
exampleZh: 他们什么时候会被重新雇用？也许正像俗话说的，等到猴年马月吧。

meaning: conj. 无论何时，无论什么情况；每当；什么时间都行；不知什么时候；adv. 究竟什么时候；不论何时，随便什么时候
definition: 1. abstract: Whenever is a 2000 children's musical play with words Alan Ayckbourn and music by Denis King, that was shown as the Stephen Joseph Theatre's Christmas production. It is loosely derived from The Wizard of Oz, and it is about a young Victorian girl named Emily to travels back and forth in time to avert a disaster.
example: But for a long time I was chastened whenever I remembered that my mother had come close to killing me.
exampleZh: 然而很长一段时间里,一想起母亲过来揍我,我就会很听话，“

meaning: adv. 在哪里，去哪儿，从哪里；……的地方，在那里；到什么地步，在哪方面；pron. 哪里；conj. 在……的地方，哪里，什么地方；n. 地点，位置
definition: 1. abstract: Asia City Media Group (Asia)Morris Visitor Publications (global)St. Joseph Media (Canada)
example: but I'd like to, I'd love to see a system where, where you can work as an attorney no matter what
exampleZh: 但我希望看到的制度是，你可以当律师，不论你的学历如何，

meaning: conj. 无论在哪里，在任何地方；在任何情况下；不知在哪里，不知在什么地方；adv. 究竟在哪儿（用在疑问句句首，表示惊讶）；无论在哪里，无论去哪里；随便什么地方，无所谓
definition: 1. in or to any place; in every situation
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: We have sworn to fight cruelty wherever we find it.
exampleZh: 我们已郑重许诺，无论在哪儿发现暴行我们都要与其斗争。

meaning: n. 下落，去向，所在之处；adv. 在何处，靠近什么地方；conj. （尤用于某些动词和形容词后，引导表示具体处所的从句）具体在哪里
definition: 1. the place where a person or thing is；2. in what part or area
example: Well, there are four principal ways that composers signal to us the whereabouts of the down beat.
exampleZh: 以下有四条主要途径,是作曲家用来告诉我们重拍在哪里的

meaning: conj. （表示对比）但是，然而；鉴于（用于文件的开头）；n. 序言，开场白；条件语句
definition: 1. used to contrast two facts, usually in a formal context
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: Whereas, 27% of whites are reading at a low level, 22% of Asian-Pacific kids are reading at low level.
exampleZh: 也处于低水平，然而，27%的白人孩子阅读能力很差，而22%亚太地区的孩子阅读能力很差。

meaning: adv. 凭此，借以；conj. 凭此，借以，与……一致；在……的情况下，处于……的位置
definition: 1. by which way or method；2. in which, or with which
example: The two colleges have a reciprocal arrangement whereby students from one college can attend classes at the other.
exampleZh: 两所学院有一项互惠协定，允许学生在院际间选课。

meaning: conj. 是否（表选择或可能性）；不管，无论；pron. 两个中的哪一个
definition: 1. used to introduce a choice between possibilities or to express uncertainty
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: It requires the citizens are informed, not just informed, well-informed enough to know whether they are being adequately served.
exampleZh: 公民需要了解，不仅仅是了解，要很好地了解他们是否,得到了政府的良好服务。

meaning: pron. 哪一个，哪一些；（指明事物）……的那个，……的那些；（进一步提供有关某事物的信息）那个，那些；哪个是哪个（用于 cannot tell/know which is which）；det. 哪一个，哪一些；（指明事物）……的那个，……的那些；（进一步提供有关某事物的信息）那个，那些；adj. 哪一个，哪一些；无论哪个；（进一步提供有关某事物的信息）那个，那些；n. （计算）Unix/Linux 命令，用于在 PATH 中查找可执行文件的位置
definition: 1. abstract: which is a Unix command used to identify the location of executables.
example: They all look so alike to me that I'm never sure which is which.
exampleZh: 它们在我看来简直一模一样，我永远分不清哪个是哪个。

meaning: det. （用于名词前）无论哪个；无论哪些；任何一个；pron. （单独使用，可后接 of 短语）无论哪个；无论哪些；任何一个；所选择的那个（些）；（用于补充说明）以……为准
definition: 1. any one or ones from a group, regardless of which
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: Whichever of you gets here first will get the prize.
exampleZh: 你们谁第一个到达这里谁就获奖。

meaning: conj. 当……的时候；与……同时；而，然而（表示对比）；尽管，虽然；直到……为止；n. 一段时间；同时；在此期间；v. 消磨时间；prep. （北英格兰）直到；adv. 在……的时候
definition: 1. n. a period of indeterminate length (usually short) marked by some action or condition
example: He's narrating in great detail what happened while he was in the womb. Where does this knowledge come from?
exampleZh: 他花了很大笔墨很详细地描写了,他还在子宫里发生的事，但他是怎么知道的呢？

meaning: n. 鞭子，皮鞭；党鞭，政党纪律委员；（用鸡蛋、鲜奶油与水果混合制成的）甜品；书面通知；鞭打，抽打；鞭策物，刺激物；鞭状枝，鞭状植物；（用于割某些庄稼的）长柄大镰刀，钐刀；党员资格（the whip）；定单绞辘；车；（专管把离群猎狗赶回狗群的）猎人副手；v. 鞭打，抽；快速移开，快速拿走；快速移动（某物）；搅打（奶油或蛋清使成糊状）；偷盗，盗取；（在外力作用下）猛然移动；（柔韧性的物体、雨、风等）拍打，猛打；（故意）激起（情绪）；彻底击败；急投，急传；将细绳缠绕于（某物），用细绳缠绕加固
definition: 1. n. an instrument with a handle and a flexible lash that is used for whipping；2. v. beat severely with a whip or rod
example: I can just whip out a variable, this time it's gonna be dynamically stored there.
exampleZh: 我们可以临时分配一个变量，将这个值暂时存放在这个变量中。

meaning: v. （使）飞旋，（使）旋转；猛地转动；晕眩，（思绪）混乱；n. 旋转，回旋； 纷繁，忙乱；晕眩；螺旋状的糖果（或饼干）；短暂的旅行
definition: 1. to (cause something to) turn around in circles；2. a continuous and exciting period of activity
example: I learn not to separate these creatures bursting with violent energy from the sky where their desires whirl.
exampleZh: 我学会了不应拆散这些有着狂暴精力的生物，他们爆发出的精力源于天空，他们的欲念亦回旋于九霄之上。

meaning: n. 威士忌酒，威士忌（亦作 whiskey）；一杯威士忌（酒）；adj. 威士忌的，威士忌酒的
definition: 1. n. a liquor made from fermented mash of grain
example: She had drunk half a bottle of whisky.
exampleZh: 她已经喝了半瓶威士忌。

meaning: v. 耳语，低语，小声说；（私下或秘密地）传说（某事），谣传；（树叶）发沙沙声，（风）发飒飒声，（水）发潺潺声；n. 耳语（声），低语（声），私语（声）；沙沙声，飒飒声，潺潺声；传闻，谣言；蛛丝马迹，暗示；少许，微量；少量信息
definition: 1. n. speaking softly without vibration of the vocal cords；2. v. speak softly; in a low voice
example: These are dimensions of communication that I've been identifying in "Mowing" with the whisper of the scythe, that is, a tone of meaning or a way of meaning.
exampleZh: 这是谈话的特点,这个是我在“割草“中提到的“,镰刀的低语，这就是，一种语调蕴含的意思或者是一种方式的意义。

meaning: n. 哨子；口哨声；哨子声；（火车、船或工厂等地的）汽笛，警笛；汽笛声，警笛声；呼啸声；小竖笛；（鸟的）啭鸣声；一套衣服，一手同花色牌；v. 吹口哨，用口哨吹奏（曲调）；（向某人）吹口哨（以唤起注意或表示爱憎）；吹哨示意；鸣响；（鸟）啭鸣；迅速移动，呼啸而过；得不到，空指望
definition: 1. n. the sound made by something moving rapidly or by steam coming out of a small aperture；2. v. make whistling sounds
example: On the platform, the guard blew his whistle.
exampleZh: 站台上，警卫吹响了他的哨子。

meaning: adj. 白色的；白种人的，白肤色的；苍白的；加牛奶（或奶油）的；（葡萄酒）白的，淡黄色的；（面粉）精白的；空白的；树皮淡色的；（玻璃）透明的，无色的；完全公正的，非常诚实的；（魔法）善意的；（血细胞）白的；（政治）反动的；纯洁的；n. 白色，白颜料；白种人，白人；白葡萄酒；眼白；蛋清，蛋白；白色运动服（whites）；要洗涤的白色织物（whites）；白衣服；执白棋者，白方；白色的东西，白球；白粉蝶；v. 把……漆成白色，使变白；【名】 （White）怀特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a member of the Caucasoid race；2. v. turn white
example: She is a woman who looks very white but is categorized as black in that system of the South.
exampleZh: 事实是，她虽比较白,但还是一个南方的黑人。

meaning: pron. 谁，什么人（用于疑问句）；……的人（引导定语从句）；谁（用于某些动词或形容词后引导从句）
definition: 1. n. a United Nations agency to coordinate international health activities and to help governments improve health services
example: And so I live with a, with a friend who's actually in another graduate school who's doing public health.
exampleZh: 我和一个朋友一起住。他和我就读的研究生院不同，他是公共卫生专业的研究生。

meaning: pron. 无论谁；任何人；n. 《爱谁谁》（电影名）
definition: 1. any person who; the person who, regardless of identity
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: So you just sign up to be on team of, you know, whoever you can gather. Your friends.
exampleZh: 所以你只需报名参加，不管你能召集到谁。可能是你的朋友们，你们组成一个队。

meaning: adj. 全部的，整个的；完整的，完好无损的；(强调大小或重要性）整个的，全部的；要点，主旨；健全的，健康的；n. 整体，全部；adv. 完全地；整个
definition: 1. n. all of something including all its component elements or parts；2. adj. including all components without exception; being one unit or constituting the full amount or extent or duration; complete
example: He's a black man, and he passes for his whole life as Jewish, and in doing so rejects his family.
exampleZh: 他是黑人，并以犹太人的身份度过一生，这样做受到了家人的反对。

meaning: adv. 完全地，全部地
definition: 1. adv. to a complete degree or to the full or entire extent (`whole' is often used informally for `wholly')
example: They're not wholly good, not wholly evil, and no one god's will is absolute.
exampleZh: 他们不是完全的善良，也不是完全的邪恶，也没有一个神灵的意愿是绝对的。

meaning: n. 批发，趸售；adj. 批发的，趸售的；大规模的，大批的；adv. 批发地，成批卖地；完全地；v. 批发销售；以……价格批发
definition: 1. of or for the selling of goods in large amounts at low prices to shops and businesses, rather than the selling of goods in shops to customers；2. (especially of something bad or too extreme) complete or affecting a lot of things, people, places, etc.
example: They are only doing what is necessary to prevent wholesale destruction of vegetation.
exampleZh: 他们只是在做为防止植被遭大规模破坏而必须做的事情。

meaning: adj. （食物）有益健康的；有益身心健康的，增进身心健康的；（显得）健康的，朝气蓬勃的
definition: 1. good for you, and likely to improve your life either physically, morally, or emotionally；2. good for you, and likely to benefit you physically, morally, or emotionally
example: Peanut butter is a wholesome food, but it will put you over your daily calorie limits.
exampleZh: 花生酱是一种有益健康的食物，但它会使您超出日常卡路里的摄入量。

meaning: pron. 谁（who 的宾格）；（用作关系代词）……的人
definition: 1. abstract: WHOM (94.9 FM, "94.
example: That is the special category that Foucault wants to reserve for those privileged figures whom he calls founders of discursivity.
exampleZh: 这就是福柯想为那些他称之为散漫性创始人的,特权作家们保留的特殊类别。

meaning: pron. 谁的（疑问代词）；其，……的（关系代词）；det. 谁的（限定词）；其，……的（关系限定词）
definition: 1. belonging to which person or thing; of whom or of which
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: Orpheus had provided Milton with a paradigm of the poet, the poet whose discipline and whose abstinence nourished and strengthened his poetry.
exampleZh: 俄耳甫斯在弥尔顿看来是诗人的模范,他严于律己，节制禁欲，让诗作更加出色。

meaning: adv. （用于问句）为什么，为何；（反问，表示不必）何必；……的原因；为什么（不）；为什么（表生气或恼火）；n. 理由，原因；int. 哎呀
definition: 1. n. the cause or intention underlying an action or situation, especially in the phrase `the whys and wherefores'
example: But why is it acting? Why specifically acting and why this weird comment at the end, "What could be prettier?"
exampleZh: 为什么是表演，为什么是具体的表演，为什么,会有这么奇怪的评论，还能有更漂亮的事情吗“

meaning: adj. 邪恶的，不道德的；恶作剧的，淘气的，调皮的；很坏的，恶劣的；很棒的，极好的；令人不快的，令人厌恶的；adv. 极其，非常；n. 恶人，邪恶的人（the wicked）
definition: 1. morally wrong and bad；2. slightly immoral or bad for you, but in an attractive way
example: Like when we went to go see Wicked, we did it on the lottery and it cost us $26 or so per ticket
exampleZh: 比如说我们去看《魔法坏女巫》，我们被抽中了，每张票大概只花了26美元，

meaning: adj. 宽的，宽阔的，广阔的；…宽的（用于数词或度量短语后）；张大的，完全张开的（指眼睛、嘴等）；广泛的，范围广的；差距大的，程度大的；偏离的，未中的，远离目标的；宽松的，肥大的（指衣物）；adv. 广泛地，广阔地，远及各处；充分地，完全地；偏离目标地，未中地；n. 大千世界，广阔的世界；（板球）投偏的球，偏球；（Wide）维德（瑞典、芬兰人名）
definition: 1. adj. having great (or a certain) extent from one side to the other；2. adv. with or by a broad space
example: He leaves the city, he travels far and wide, he crosses these primeval seas and endures all sorts of hardships.
exampleZh: 他离开了城市，去很远的地方，他穿过茫茫大海，旅途劳顿。

meaning: n. 宽度，广度；（布料等）按尺寸剪裁的材料；（游泳池的）池宽；宽阔，宽大；整幅的东西
definition: 1. n. the extent of something from side to side
example: The road was reduced to 18 ft in width by adding parking bays.
exampleZh: 这条路增加了停车区域后，宽度减少为18英尺。

meaning: v. （使）变宽，加宽；（使）扩展，程度加深，范围扩大；（尤因惊讶或恐惧而眼睛）睁大；【名】 （Widen）（德）维登（人名）
definition: 1. v. become broader or wider or more extensive；2. v. make (clothes) larger
example: They may have to widen the road to cope with the increase in traffic.
exampleZh: 他们可能得拓宽这条道路以适应车辆的增多。

meaning: adj. 普遍的，广泛的
definition: 1. adj. widely circulated or diffused；2. adj. distributed over a considerable extent
example: Well, the conception of the universe that was widespread among ancient peoples is one that you're probably familiar with.
exampleZh: 那就是，对宇宙的理解,一个古人很崇尚,大家也很熟悉的说法。

meaning: n. 寡妇，遗孀；活寡妇（指丈夫经常外出参加某项运动或活动的女人）；寡妇鸟；（印刷）未排足的行；v. 使丧偶，使成为寡妇（或鳏夫）
definition: 1. n. a woman whose husband is dead especially one who has not remarried；2. v. cause to be without a spouse
example: "You're a widow?"—"Yes. My husband's been dead a year now."
exampleZh: “你是个寡妇？”——“是的，我丈夫去世1年了。”

meaning: n. 鳏夫
definition: 1. n. a man whose wife is dead especially one who has not remarried
example: He is a widower and lives in Durango.
exampleZh: 他是一个鳏夫，住在杜兰戈。

meaning: v. 挥，操，使用（武器、工具等）；运用（权力），施加（影响）
definition: 1. to hold a weapon or tool and look as if you are going to use it；2. to have a lot of influence or power over other people
example: The men who wield the power are certainly backing him to the hilt.
exampleZh: 那些掌权者当然都在全力支持他。

meaning: n. 妻子，已婚妇女，夫人
definition: 1. n. a married woman; a man's partner in marriage
example: This is a poet who, with his wife, practiced automatic writing, who believed that the dead spoke through the living.
exampleZh: 他是这样的诗人，和他妻子一起，尝试着，自动写作，他们相信死人通过活人说话。

meaning: adj. （动植物）自然生长的，野生的；（土地）无人烟的，未开垦的；（人）未开化的，野蛮的；不受控制的，放荡的；暴风雨的，狂暴的；（做事或说话）轻率的，缺乏根据的；激动人心的；满腔热情的，十分热衷的；感情强烈的（尤指生气、高兴或激动）；（表情、外表等）走神的，不专注的；特别的，怪异的；（纸牌）百搭的；嘈杂混乱的；adv. 自然地，不受控制地；n. 偏远地区，人烟稀少的地区；自然环境，野生状态；v. 野蛮对待，残酷对待；【名】 （Wild）（英）怀尔德，（法、德、葡、捷、匈）维尔德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a wild primitive state untouched by civilization；2. adj. marked by extreme lack of restraint or control
example: According to the Second Brother, it's virtually impossible for a single, helpless maiden to pass uninjured in this wild, surrounding waste.
exampleZh: 弟弟认为，一个孤独无助的女孩想要，毫发无伤的穿过这野外的荒原是根本不可能的。

meaning: n. 未开发的地区，荒野；荒芜的地方，杂草丛生处；低潮时期，在野；大量，茫茫一片
definition: 1. n. (politics) a state of disfavor；2. n. a wooded region in northeastern Virginia near Spotsylvania where inconclusive battles were fought in the American Civil War
example: Wilderness designation prohibits road building, the use of mechanized equipment and most other developments.
exampleZh: 荒野之地禁止筑路、使用机械设备以及绝大多数其它的开发。

meaning: n. 野生动植物；adj. 野生动植物的
definition: 1. n. all living things (except people) that are undomesticated
example: And also you have a chance to see fish and other wildlife in the water.
exampleZh: 你也有机会见到海里的鱼儿和其他野生动物。

meaning: v. 将，将要；请（请求某人做某事）；总是，惯于；（表示对习惯性发生行为不满）老是，一直；可能，大概；愿意，乐意；必须，一定；表示能力、容量能；（表示承诺或威胁）会，要；希望，想要；立定志向，决意；立遗嘱遗赠；n. 意志，决心，毅力；意愿，心愿；遗嘱
definition: 1. n. the capability of conscious choice and decision and intention；2. v. decree or ordain
example: Test 1 will be a week from Wednesday, and I will say something about that later in the week.
exampleZh: 测试1从周三开始，持续一周，我会在之后的一周跟你们说一些东西。

meaning: adj. 愿意的，乐意的；乐于相助的，积极肯干的；出于自愿的，志愿的；v. 希望，想要（某事发生）；凭意志促使……做某事；立遗嘱遗赠（will 的现在分词形式）；【名】 （Willing）（德、芬、瑞典）维林，（英）威林（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of making a choice；2. adj. disposed or inclined toward
example: At each cross-section, people are either willing to use a certain sign in a certain way or they're not.
exampleZh: 在每一个横街面上，人们可以自由的,以自己的方式使用符号。

meaning: n. 乐意，意愿
definition: 1. n. cheerful compliance
example: Yeah, I don't know, I think it's a, it's probably willingness to take risks.
exampleZh: 我不清楚，我觉得可能得有去承担风险的意愿。

meaning: n. 意志力，毅力
definition: 1. n. the trait of resolutely controlling your own behavior
example: It appears that people, at some level, think that they can exert willpower over it and control it.
exampleZh: 这说明在某种程度上,人们认为他们可以通过意志力控制结果

meaning: v. （在战斗、比赛、游戏等中）赢，获胜；赢得（奖品等）；通过努力得到（某物）；为……赢得，使……获得；采（矿）；晾（干草）；n. （在比赛、竞赛等中的）胜利；【名】 （Win）（德、荷、缅）温，（英）温（女子教名 Winifred 的昵称）（人名）
definition: 1. n. a victory (as in a race or other competition)；2. v. be the winner in a contest or competition; be victorious
example: It's this kind of wealth that allow them to fight this long, hard war of independence, which they finally win.
exampleZh: 这些所带来的财富,就成了他们为之奋斗的原动力,使得他们在艰苦的独立战争中获得胜利

meaning: n. 获胜的人（或队、动物等），优胜者；（体育比赛中）致胜的一分，制胜的进球；可能成功的人（或事物），极好的人（或事物），成功的人（或事物）；获益者，赢家；（桥牌）能赢的牌；【名】 （Winner）（美、德、英）温纳（人名）
definition: 1. n. the contestant who wins the contest；2. n. a gambler who wins a bet
example: Well assume that we're in a plurality election here, so the winner is the person who gets a plurality.
exampleZh: 假设我们在进行一个多数制选举,所以当选者是获得票数最多的人

meaning: n. 风，气流；风向，逼近的形势；呼吸，呼吸能力；肠胃气胀；管乐器，吹奏乐器；大话，空谈；放屁；弯，弯曲处；一圈，一转；（给钟表）上发条；（由风带来，表明附近有动物、人存在的）气味；v. 弯曲前进，蜿蜒而行；卷缠，缠绕，绕成团；卷绕（磁带等）；给（钟、表）上发条；转动（把手）；（用辘轳、绞车等）吊起（某物）；使喘不过气来，使喘大气；给（婴儿）拍嗝儿； 嗅出（人，动物）的气味；吹（号角，哨子）；adj. 管乐的；【名】 （Wind）（英、德、瑞典）温德（人名）
definition: 1. n. air moving (sometimes with considerable force) from an area of high pressure to an area of low pressure；2. v. to move or cause to move in a sinuous, spiral, or circular course
example: This is The Wind Among the Reeds, author William Butler Yeats, the year 1899, on the verge of the new century.
exampleZh: 这是威廉巴特勒叶芝的《苇间风》,在新世纪即将到来之际的1899年出版。

meaning: adj. 多风的，风大的；夸夸其谈的，空话连篇的；胃内气胀的；（道路，河流）蜿蜒的，弯弯曲曲的；（人）紧张的，忧虑的
definition: 1. adj. abounding in or exposed to the wind or breezes；2. adj. not practical or realizable; speculative
example: It was very wet and windy the day I drove over the hill to Del Norte.
exampleZh: 我开车越过小山去德尔诺特的那天下大雨又刮大风。

meaning: n. 窗，窗玻璃；（计算机屏幕的）视窗；（信封上的）透明纸窗；（商店的）陈列窗，橱窗；一丝的机会，短暂的时机；观察（或学习）的渠道；（办理业务的）窗口；（物理）大气窗；（干扰雷达用的）金属箔片
definition: 1. n. a framework of wood or metal that contains a glass windowpane and is built into a wall or roof to admit light or air；2. n. a transparent opening in a vehicle that allow vision out of the sides or back; usually is capable of being opened
example: If you look at page 62, it's in these little stories: Remi woke up and saw me come in the window.
exampleZh: 看第62页，在这些小故事里就有：,雷米醒来看见我在窗前。

meaning: n. 葡萄酒，果蔬酒；深紫红色；v. 喝酒；设酒宴款待（某人）；跳摆臀舞；【名】 （Wine）（英）瓦恩（人名）
definition: 1. n. fermented juice (of grapes especially)；2. v. drink wine
example: He let you borrowed a shirt and you went to a party and you spilled wine on his shirt.
exampleZh: 他借给你一件衬衫，你穿着去参加一个派对，结果溅了一点红酒在上面。

meaning: n. 酿酒厂，葡萄酒酿造厂，酒庄（复数 wineries）
definition: 1. n. distillery where wine is made
example: and I worked for the world's largest winery, E&J Gallo, or Ernest and Julio Gallo winery.
exampleZh: 我在世界最大的酒庄，美国嘉露酒庄工作。

meaning: n. （鸟、昆虫或蝙蝠的）翅膀，翼；（飞机的）机翼；（建筑的）侧翼，耳房，厢房，配楼；（舞台的）侧面，侧翼（the wings）；（组织或政党的）派系，翼；（汽车等的）挡泥板，翼子板；（运动场的）边沿；飞行徽章；禽类翅膀，（尤指供食用的）鸡翅；空军联队；（鸟或昆虫）在飞行中；（蝙蝠或翼手龙的）翼膜；翅膀（指飞翔的能力、手段或快速）；（剖）翼状部，翼状结构，翅状部；（植）翼瓣，翅，气囊；侧翼部队；一群鸻（鸟）；（冰球、足球等运动中的）边锋，侧翼队员；v. 飞，飞行；被迅速送往；擦伤（尤指手臂或翅膀）；用力扔（某物）；射伤（鸟的）翅膀；【名】 （Wing）（英、印尼）温（人名）
definition: 1. n. a movable organ for flying (one of a pair)；2. v. travel through the air; be airborne
example: So Andy is our crazy right-wing guy and Sudipta is our crazy left-wing guy, everyone else is in between.
exampleZh: 安迪是疯狂的右派,并且苏迪普塔是疯狂的左派,其他人介于两者之间

meaning: v. 眨眼示意，使眼色；（灯光）闪烁，明灭；n. 眨眼（示意），眼色；一会儿，一瞬间；小憩；闪烁；弹塑料片游戏中用的塑料圆片；【名】 （Wink）（美、德、英、荷、巴、加、瑞）温克（人名）
definition: 1. to close one eye for a short time as a way of greeting someone or showing friendliness, sexual interest, etc., or of showing that you are not serious about something you have said；2. When lights wink, they keep flashing on and off quickly
example: 'I know you understand,' he said and gave a conspiratorial wink.
exampleZh: “我知道你明白。”他说道，会意地眨一眨眼。

meaning: n. 冬季，（天文）从冬至点到春分点的期间；年，岁；adj. 冬天的，冬天出现的；用于冬天的；（水果）冬季才成熟的；（麦等）秋季播种来年收获的，越冬的；v. （在某处）过冬，越冬；使度过冬季；【名】 （Winter）（英、德、西、法）温特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the coldest season of the year; in the northern hemisphere it extends from the winter solstice to the vernal equinox；2. v. spend the winter
example: This demo works wonderfully in the winter months in Boston when we will all be full of static at all times.
exampleZh: 在冬天的波士顿,这个实验进行的非常好,因为我们一直处于,充满静电的环境中。

meaning: v. （用布、手等）擦干净，抹掉；擦掉（液体、污垢、印迹）；把（某物）擦干净；消除，抹去（计算机、磁带或录像机上的信息等）；擦干（洗过的碟子、杯子）；抹去（旧事）；彻底去除（或消灭）（某物）；涂抹（液体）；拒绝（某人，观点），解雇（某人）；刷（卡）；n. （湿）抹布，纸巾；擦，拭，擦净；划变
definition: 1. n. the act of rubbing or wiping；2. v. rub with a circular motion
example: But Newton's law is-- You see, you've got to go back and wipe out everything you know.
exampleZh: 但牛顿定律是,如你所知的,你必须回到过去,忘掉你所知道的一切

meaning: n. 金属丝，金属线；电线，导线；隐蔽式电子收听器；电报；（赛马）起跑线，终点线（the wire）；铁丝网（the wire）；用金属丝制的，用金属线制的；通讯社；v. 给……接上电线，接通（电源）；（用电线）接通，连接；电汇（钱款）；发电报给（某人）；用金属线固定（或加固）；给……安装窃听器；用金属网诱捕（动物）；（槌球）在拱门边阻挡（球，射球，选手）；【名】 （Wire）怀尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. ligament made of metal and used to fasten things or make cages or fences etc；2. v. provide with electrical circuits
example: So you can imagine a bead with a wire going through it and the bead can only slide back and forth.
exampleZh: 你可以想象一个穿在绳子上的珠子,小珠只能前后滑动

meaning: adj. 无线的，使用无线电信号的；n. 无线电发射和接收系统；无线电收音机；v. 用无线电报与…联系，打无线电话
definition: 1. n. medium for communication；2. adj. having no wires
example: The group is working to promote the adoption of broadband wireless access over long distances.
exampleZh: 该集团正在致力于推广远距离宽带无线访问的采用。

meaning: adj. （行为或决定）明智的，高明的；有学问的，精通的；说话粗鲁的；v. 了解，知道；【名】 （Wise）（英）怀斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a way of doing or being；2. adj. having or prompted by wisdom or discernment
example: She wrote a very compelling argument about O'Connor's fiction not about Wise Blood in particular, but about her stories.
exampleZh: 她针对奥克纳小说写过一篇极有说服力的文章,并不只是针对《慧血》，而是针对奥克纳的所有故事。

meaning: n. 智慧，才智；明智；学问，知识；普遍看法；【名】 （Wisdom）（英）威兹德姆（人名）
definition: 1. n. accumulated knowledge or erudition or enlightenment；2. n. the trait of utilizing knowledge and experience with common sense and insight
example: Well, Yeats begins in scorn of an audience that's unable to recognize true wisdom and great art.
exampleZh: 叶芝以嘲讽一个不能识别真正的,的智慧和伟大的艺术的观众开始。

meaning: v. 希望（做某事），想要（某事发生）；祝，祝愿（某人好运、幸福等）；愿望，心愿；希望（不可能或可能性很小的事变成事实）；真希望（用于表示对做过某事或未做某事感到后悔或失望）；（用来表示对某人行为的厌烦）我希望……；（用于要说的话可能使人不快或担心等时）不想，无意；这是再好不过的，没有比这更好的了；希望……发生在……身上；n. 希望，愿望；（靠魔术实现的）愿望，心愿；（书信或贺卡等中的）祝愿，祝福（wishes）；想要的东西，希望的事；请求，要求；【名】 （Wish）（美）威什（人名）
definition: 1. n. a specific feeling of desire；2. v. hope for; have a wish
example: and yet are not the things that we covet or wish to banish, We recognize in ourselves the capacity for disinterestedness.
exampleZh: 而且我们既不会垂涎于它也不会产生厌恶之感，我们承认我们有能力做到绝对公正。

meaning: n. （说话）风趣；说话风趣的人；机智；明智（the wit）；（不使用语言的）幽默机智；v. 知道；即，就是；【名】 （Wit）（泰）威，（英、德、波）威特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a message whose ingenuity or verbal skill or incongruity has the power to evoke laughter；2. n. mental ability
example: Historically, it has not been pleasure or wit or beauty that has been associated with the experience of reading Milton.
exampleZh: 一直以来，人们阅读米尔顿作品的时候,感受到的都不是愉悦，机智，或者美好。

meaning: adj. 风趣的，诙谐的，机智的；【名】 （Witty）（英）威蒂（人名）
definition: 1. adj. combining clever conception and facetious expression
example: That's funny. I mean, that's really cool. If someone is witty enough to do that, then it's awesome.
exampleZh: 这确实很好笑，真的很酷！如果有人真的够诙谐能做出那种事，真的很棒！

meaning: n. 巫婆，巫师；迷人的女子；美首鲽；（侮辱性用语）丑老太婆；v. （巫婆）施魔法于；（女子）把（男子）迷住
definition: 1. a woman who is believed to have magical powers and who uses them to harm or help other people
example: The film is a spinoff from the TV series "Sabrina The Teenage Witch."
exampleZh: 这部电影是电视连续剧《少年女巫萨布丽娜》的衍生作品。

meaning: prep. 和……在一起，与……一同；用，以；具有；带着，携带；穿着；患（病）；关于，对于，在……方面；反对（与……争斗、争论或竞争时）；支持，拥护；由于，因为；受……影响；随着，随；顺着，沿着；包括，包含；虽然，尽管；受雇于，在……工作；由……负责；交给……处理；（与 part、dispense 等连用）表示与某物分离、去除或放弃
definition: 1. together with; having, using, or characterized by something
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: Fewer people write with their left hand than with their right.
exampleZh: 用左手写字的人比用右手的人少。

meaning: v. 提，取（银行账户中的钱款）；停止提供，不再给予； 退出，不参加；（军队）撤离； 脱离（社会），不与人交往；离开；（将某物从某地或位置）抽回，移开；撤回，收回（前言）；（从某物中）拿出；停止提供，召回；退出，返回（至另一个房间）；（因对工作时间、报酬等不满意而）罢工；取消（许可、邀请或提议）；戒毒
definition: 1. v. pull back or move away or backward；2. v. withdraw from active participation
example: There have been calls for Britain to withdraw from the EU.
exampleZh: 一直有人呼吁英国退出欧盟。

meaning: n. 收回，撤回，停止；（对所说人的话的）收回，撤回；撤军，撤退；不再参加，退出（组织）；提款，取钱；戒毒过程，脱瘾期；脱瘾症状；沉默寡言，孤僻
definition: 1. n. a retraction of a previously held position；2. n. the act of taking out money or other capital
example: He replied that the UN had passed two major resolutions calling for a complete withdrawal.
exampleZh: 他回复说联合国已经通过要求完全撤军的两项重大决议。

meaning: v. （使）枯萎，（使）干枯；衰弱，逐渐消失；使感到愚蠢，使感到羞愧；（人的四肢、皮肤等）变枯槁，萎缩；n. 甲，马肩隆；【名】 （Wither）（英）威瑟（人名）
definition: 1. (to cause) to become weak and dry and decay；2. to slowly disappear, lose importance, or become weaker
example: Is it working on a supersecret social site that'll blow away its competitors—or has it been left to wither?
exampleZh: 它是在开发一款能远超竞争对手的绝密社交网站，还是已经被弃置任其荒废了？

meaning: v. 保留，隐瞒，扣留；克制，抑制（情感或反应等）
definition: 1. to refuse to give something or to keep back something；2. to refuse to give something, or to keep back something
example: It can be inferred that Facebook is self-enhancer's paradise because people can withhold their unflattering sides.
exampleZh: 可以推断，Facebook 是自我提升者的天堂，因为人们可以隐藏自己不讨喜的一面。

meaning: prep. 在（某段时间）之内；在……限度内；在（某段距离）内；在（某区域或空间）里；在（群体或组织）内部；在自己内心，在心灵深处；接近，误差不到……；adv. 在里面，在内部；在内心深处，在思想上；在（某段时间）之内；（距离）在……之内；（某个地方）之内；在（群体或组织）内部；在……范围内，在……限度内；误差不到……；n. 里面，内部
definition: 1. adv. on the inside
example: And obviously within this long period many many different ideas and perspectives were involved within each side of conflict.
exampleZh: 很明显，很久了,非常多的不同的观点和看法,出现在冲突的双方之中。

meaning: prep. 没有，缺乏；不使用，不借助；在没有（发生或做某事）的情况下；没有，不带（某种感情）；不和……在一起，无……相伴；在外面，在外部；adv. 没有，缺乏；在外面；conj. （方）不那样的话；除非，如果不；n. 外部，外面
definition: 1. abstract: "Without" is the debut single from half-English, half-Italian solo singer Jack Savoretti taken from his debut album, Between the Minds.
example: And this poem seemed like one you might find and be able to read yourself, without me there to explain it.
exampleZh: 而这首诗似乎是一首,你们自己就可以读懂的，不用我多做解释的诗。

meaning: v. 顶住，抵住；经受住，承受住（攻击、批评等）；反抗
definition: 1. v. resist or confront with resistance；2. v. stand up or offer resistance to somebody or something
example: The plants were unable to withstand the rigours of a harsh winter.
exampleZh: 这些植物经受不住严冬的考验。

meaning: n. （尤指犯罪或事故的）目击者；（法庭等的）证人；（签署正式文件的）见证人，连署人；宗教信仰声明，见证；见证人（声明自己笃信基督教的人）；证据，证言；证明标志；v. 目击，目睹；见证，经历（事件、变化等）；在（正式文件）上签名，连署；作见证（公开声明自己对基督教的信仰）；证明，表明；为…...作证；作证，作证人；【名】 （Witness）（津）威特尼斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. someone who sees an event and reports what happened；2. v. be a witness to
example: The police need a witness to make a positive ID.
exampleZh: 警方需要有目击者加以确认。

meaning: n. 狼；色狼，色鬼；（喻）残忍凶狠的人；同性恋者；狼音，不谐和音，粗厉音；v. 狼吞虎咽地吃；【名】 （Wolf）（以、捷、芬、瑞典、德、匈、法、罗、荷、英）沃尔夫（人名）
definition: 1. n. any of various predatory carnivorous canine mammals of North America and Eurasia that usually hunt in packs；2. v. eat hastily
example: He thought he had better track this wolf and see where it lived.
exampleZh: 他认为他最好跟踪这只狼，并看看它在哪儿生活。

meaning: n. 成年女子，妇女；（泛指）女性；带修饰语指来自……（或做……、喜欢……等）的女子；女工，女仆；妻子，女友，情人；（盛气凌人的称呼）女人；v. 使女性化；配备女性员工；使（某人）与女性交往
definition: 1. n. an adult female person (as opposed to a man)；2. n. women as a class
example: She writes, Woman's being created last will not be a very great argument to debase the dignity of the female sex.
exampleZh: 她写道，女性被后造出来并不能,为压制女性尊严做论证。

meaning: v. 想知道，好奇，琢磨；不知是否（用于提问或礼貌地提出请求）；感到疑惑，（对…）感到不安；感到惊讶，觉得惊奇；n. 惊讶，惊叹；奇观，奇迹；令人惊讶的事物，令人难以置信的事物；能人，奇才，有特效的东西；adj. 极好的，灵验的；【名】 （Wonder）（美）旺德（人名）
definition: 1. n. the feeling aroused by something strange and surprising；2. v. have a wish or desire to know something
example: In any case, Lambert Strether, as he arrives in Paris, has awakened to the sheer wonder of urbane culture.
exampleZh: 无论如何，朗伯，史瑞得到巴黎后完全被那里彬彬有礼的文化震撼了。

meaning: adj. 绝妙的，令人惊叹的，极好的
definition: 1. adj. extraordinarily good; used especially as intensifiers
example: In the meantime the Eiffel Tower is a wonderful way of showing the degree to which the vertical axis is virtual.
exampleZh: 与此同时，埃菲尔铁塔,很好地向大家展示了,竖轴在何种程度上是虚拟的。

meaning: n. 木材，木料，木头；树林，林地；（高尔夫）木头球棒，木棒；木制酒桶；木棒挥击；（滚木球戏中所用重心略偏的）圆球；（保龄球戏的）木瓶；上天保佑（表示希望继续走好运）；adj. 木制的；用来切割或加工木材的；用木材做燃料的；v. 收集木材；植林于；给……添加木柴；【名】 （Wood）（英、法、西、葡、阿拉伯）伍德（人名）
definition: 1. n. the hard fibrous lignified substance under the bark of trees；2. n. the trees and other plants in a large densely wooded area
example: There was never a sound beside the wood but one, And that was my long scythe whispering to the ground.
exampleZh: 树林边静悄悄，只有一点声音，那是我的长镰在对大地低语。

meaning: adj. 木制的；（行为）僵硬的，呆板的；木头似的，木头特性的
definition: 1. adj. made or consisting of (entirely or in part) or employing wood；2. adj. lacking ease or grace
example: But when he take a wooden block tower apart and then put the pieces back together piece for piece duplicate.
exampleZh: 但当你拆掉堆好的木积木,又把它们重新摆在一起,照原样一块块摆好。

meaning: n. 羊毛，动物毛；毛线，绒线；毛料，毛织物；金属（或矿）丝；【名】 （Wool）（英）伍尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a fabric made from the hair of sheep；2. n. fiber sheared from animals (such as sheep) and twisted into yarn for weaving
example: He wound the wool into a ball.
exampleZh: 他把毛线缠绕成一团。

meaning: adj. 羊毛的，羊毛制的；n. 毛织品；毛料衣物（常用复数 woolens）
definition: 1. n. a fabric made from the hair of sheep；2. adj. of or related to or made of wool
example: The cold-bed batch type steam dyeing process for woolen yarn by reactive dyes is described in this book.
exampleZh: 本书介绍了羊毛纱线活性染料的冷床间歇式蒸染色方法。

meaning: n. 字，词，单词；（某人说的）话，言语（words）；简短的交谈，谈话；命令，指示；消息，信息；诺言，承诺；口角，吵架（words）；（警告、建议、赞扬的）话，话语；歌词（words）；一个字（所说或所写的最小量）（a word）；（不同于行动的）言，言语；字（尤指16或32个字节的计算机数据基本单位）；《圣经》，福音（the Word）；v. 措辞，用词；int. （表示接受或同意别人刚说的话）就是，说得对；【名】 （Word）（英）沃德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a unit of language that native speakers can identify；2. v. put into words or an expression
example: The English word 'sensible' and the French word 'sensible' are false friends.
exampleZh: 英语的sensible一词和法语的sensible一词同形异义。

meaning: n. 措词，用词；v. 措辞，用词（word 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. the manner in which something is expressed in words
example: It was the standard form of wording for a consent letter.
exampleZh: 这是同意书的标准用词。

meaning: n. 工作，职业；劳动，活计；职责，工作内容；作品，著作；工作成果，作为；工作地点，工作时间；工作所需的材料（或档案等）；（机器的）活动部件（the works）；所有东西，全套物品（the works）；土木工程，建筑（works）；工厂（works）；善行，德行（works）；防御工事；（物理学）功；整形手术；v. 工作，干活儿；从事体力（或脑力）劳动；从事……工作，在……工作；努力取得，力争；运转，运行；开动，操作（机器、装置等）；奏效，成功；产生……作用；（使）变成，逐步移动；（使）（身体某部位）抽动；（用某种材料）画画，创作；使成形，加工；博得，赢得（众人的支持或欢心）；计算，算出；思考，动脑筋；以（某种假定或思想）为基础（或前提）；安排；耕种；开采（矿）；adj. 工作的，与工作有关的；适合工作时穿戴的；用于工作的；【名】 （Work）（英、埃塞、丹、冰、美）沃克（人名）
definition: 1. n. activity directed toward making or doing something；2. v. exert oneself by doing mental or physical work for a purpose or out of necessity
example: Let's pretend that at work, your boss gives you too much work and not enough time to finish it.
exampleZh: 假设你上班的时候，老板给了你太多的工作，你没有足够的时间来完成它。

meaning: n. 工作者，工作人员；劳工，工人；工作做得……的人；工人阶级（the workers）；工蜂，工蚁；【名】 （Worker）沃克（姓氏）
definition: 1. n. a person who works at a specific occupation；2. n. a member of the working class (not necessarily employed)
example: So I threw a party in New York, and her best friend, my co-worker came, and she brought her,
exampleZh: 我在纽约开了个派对，而她最好的朋友，也就是我的同事，把她带到派对上去了。

meaning: n. （国家或地区的）劳动力，劳动人口；（某组织或公司的）全体员工，全体从业人员
definition: 1. n. the force of workers available
example: Our society is those people. They are the citizens, they are the consumers, and they are the workforce.
exampleZh: 社会是有人组成的，他们便是公民，他们是消费者，他们是生产力，那么我们应该。

meaning: n. 锻炼，训练；试验
definition: 1. n. the activity of exerting your muscles in various ways to keep fit
example: And your workout routine is getting in the way of your job. You have to make a decision.
exampleZh: 但是你的健身计划开始影响到工作。你不得不做一个选择。

meaning: n. 车间，工场，作坊；研讨会，讲习班；v. （在正式上演前）研讨性演出（戏剧）
definition: 1. n. small workplace where handcrafts or manufacturing are done；2. n. a brief intensive course for a small group; emphasizes problem solving
example: She got a bank loan to rent and equip a small workshop.
exampleZh: 她取得一笔银行贷款来租用和装备一个小车间。

meaning: n. 世界，地球，天下；星球，天体；地区，国家，时代；社会，生活；领域，界，圈子；生物界，自然界；人生，生活圈子，阅历；人世，今生，来世；世俗；（有某种特色的）地方，情景；大量，无数；一切，重要性（the world）；adj. 世界上最重要的，世界闻名的；世界（性）的；环球的
definition: 1. n. everything that exists anywhere；2. adj. involving the entire earth; not limited or provincial in scope
example: That is to say, it is subservient to the natural world; its importance is that it refers to that world.
exampleZh: 也就是说，这些学科都是自然世界的奴仆;,它们存在的价值就是去解释那个自然世界。

meaning: adj. 世界范围的，全世界的；adv. 在全世界，在世界各地
definition: 1. adj. spanning or extending throughout the entire world；2. adj. involving the entire earth; not limited or provincial in scope
example: There were no reported cases after that, and so by the late '70s, the world was certified sort of free of smallpox worldwide.
exampleZh: 在那之后就再也没有过报告,到七十年代晚些时候,已经确认世界各国都摆脱了天花

meaning: n. 蠕虫；（某些昆虫的）幼虫；寄生虫，寄生虫病；小人物，懦夫；蠕虫病毒；蛆虫；螺纹状物，蜗杆，旋管；v. （给动物）驱肠虫；蠕动，曲折行进；（通常为欺骗别人或得到好处）逐渐取得（成功或好感）；abbr. 一次写入型光盘，单写多读型光盘（write-once read-many）；【名】 （Worm）（德、丹、葡）沃尔姆（人名）
definition: 1. n. any of numerous relatively small elongated soft-bodied animals especially of the phyla Annelida and Chaetognatha and Nematoda and Nemertea and Platyhelminthes; also many insect larvae；2. v. to move in a twisting or contorted motion, (especially when struggling)
example: And there's some space-time worm taking place in Michigan, some space-time person worm taking place in New York.
exampleZh: 然后在密西根出现了某时空蠕虫，在纽约也出现了某时空蠕虫。

meaning: v. 担心，发愁；使担忧，使发愁，使焦虑；烦扰，使不安宁；（狗）追赶，撕咬（其他动物）；n. 令人担忧的事，令人发愁的问题；担心，忧虑
definition: 1. n. something or someone that causes anxiety; a source of unhappiness；2. v. be worried, concerned, anxious, troubled, or uneasy
example: and not worry about, you know, if your husband likes it, or if your mom likes it, or whatever.
exampleZh: 而不去管你丈夫喜不喜欢，或者你妈妈喜不喜欢。

meaning: adj. 担心的，发愁的；v. 担心，发愁；使担忧，使发愁，使焦虑；烦扰，使不安宁（worry 的过去式和过去分词）
definition: 1. adj. afflicted with or marked by anxious uneasiness or trouble or grief；2. adj. mentally upset over possible misfortune or danger etc
example: But I was not worried because I still have more than half of the cash in my bank account.
exampleZh: 但我并不担心,因为公司的银行账户上还有60多万美元。

meaning: adj. 更糟的，更坏的，更差的；（病得）更厉害的；adv. 更坏，更差，更糟；更糟的是，更倒霉的是；n. 更糟的事，更恶劣的情况
definition: 1. n. something inferior in quality or condition or effect；2. adj. (comparative of `bad') inferior to another in quality or condition or desirability
example: And for better or for worse we've done a lot of damage over the past few years for this stuff.
exampleZh: 过去的几年，无论好坏,我们都已经对这个东西造成很大的损坏了。

meaning: v. 敬奉（神）；爱慕，崇拜；n. 敬神，拜神；崇拜，爱慕； 阁下（对地位高的人的尊称）
definition: 1. n. the activity of worshipping；2. v. love unquestioningly and uncritically or to excess; venerate as an idol
example: The worship practices of ancient Israel and Judah clearly resemble what we know of Canaanite and Ancient Near Eastern worship practices.
exampleZh: 古代以色列和犹太崇拜仪式非常像,我们所知的迦南和古代近东的崇拜仪式。

meaning: adj. 最差的，最糟的，最严重的；adv. 最差地，最糟地，最严重地；n. 最坏的人（或事），最糟的情况；v. 打败，击败；【名】 （Worst）（英、德）沃斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the least favorable outcome；2. v. defeat thoroughly
example: If the worst comes to the worst, we'll just have to sell the house.
exampleZh: 如果最坏的事发生，我们就只好把房子卖掉。

meaning: adj. 价值……的，值……钱的；值得的，具有……价值的；拥有……财产的；（尤指合同）毫无价值的；n. 价格，价值；重要性，作用；能用（一个星期、一个月等）的东西；prep. 价值……；值得；【名】 （Worth）沃特（人名）
definition: 1. n. an indefinite quantity of something having a specified value；2. adj. having sufficient worth
example: It was kind of we'd fooled ourselves into thinking that things were worth an amount that they actually weren't.
exampleZh: 就像我们欺骗自己去想，东西有价值但实际上它们并非如此。

meaning: adj. 无价值的，没用处的；不中用的，品质差的
definition: 1. adj. lacking in usefulness or value；2. adj. morally reprehensible
example: That's $1 more than it costs now in the market, so the options are worthless unless the price of the stock goes up.
exampleZh: 这样每股就要比市场价多花费一美元,除非股票价格增长了,否则这个期权就是没有价值的

meaning: adj. 重要的，有益的，值得做的
definition: 1. adj. sufficiently valuable to justify the investment of time or interest
example: We believe the time and hard work involved in completing such an assignment are worthwhile.
exampleZh: 我们相信为完成这项任务所需要投入的时间和付出的努力是值得的。

meaning: adj. 值得尊敬的，值得注意的，值得敬仰的；值得的，应得的，相配的；好（但乏味）的；有（某人或事物）的典型特征；n. 知名人士，要人（常为玩笑或贬义）；【名】 （Worthy）（英）沃西（人名）
definition: 1. n. word is often used humorously；2. adj. having worth or merit or value; being honorable or admirable
example: A number of the report's findings are worthy of note.
exampleZh: 这份报告里有些调查结果值得注意。

meaning: n. 值得；相当；有价值
definition: 1. n. the quality or state of having merit or value
example: He had a neat idea and that was to give letter grades to securities that represented credit worthiness.
exampleZh: 他有个绝妙的主意,就是用字母,给证券评级,以此来代表其信用状况

meaning: v. 将，将会（will 的过去式，用于转述）；会......（用于提出意见或征求建议时）；会，就（表示预期或设想）；会（表示不曾发生或不可能存在的事）；才会，就会（说明动机）；想（表示某人想要某物或想做某事）；就（不），偏（不）；请…...好吗？（表示客气地请求别人做某事）；要不要…...？；过去老是，过去常常；总是，爱（带出一贯的行为）；但愿…...（表示强烈的愿望）；也许，大概（表示推测或希望）；肯定，应该（表示有充分理由猜测是某种情况）
definition: 1. n. the capability of conscious choice and decision and intention；2. v. decree or ordain
example: One would shop and cook, another would set the table and another would wash up.
exampleZh: 一人会购物和烹饪，一人摆桌子，另外一人洗餐具。

meaning: n. （刀、枪或其他武器所致的）创伤，伤口；（感情或名誉的）损害，痛苦；v. （武器或其他利器）伤害，使受伤；（在感情上）使受创伤；v. 蜿蜒；使喘不过气；缠绕（wind 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. n. any break in the skin or an organ caused by violence or surgical incision；2. v. cause injuries or bodily harm to
example: The path was rocky, as some of them... Eventually I wound up at Yale and then I wound up staying at Yale to teach.
exampleZh: 路途虽坎坷。,但最终我在耶鲁大学留下了,并在此执教。

meaning: v. 包，裹，包装；用（手臂、指头或腿）围紧，用……绕住；绕……走；完成拍摄，杀青 ；使（车辆）撞上（固定物体）；（使文字）换行；n. 披肩，围巾； 包裹（或包装）材料；宽松外套，浴衣；面卷饼（一种三明治，由薄面包包着肉、蔬菜等）；拍摄（或录音）结束，停机；（全身覆盖湿布或海草等进行的）皮肤护理；（喻）秘密；一小包白粉（毒品）
definition: 1. n. cloak that is folded or wrapped around a person；2. v. arrange or fold as a cover or protection
example: Store refrigerated food in reusable containers rather than in plastic wrap or aluminium foil.
exampleZh: 用可再用容器而不是保鲜膜或铝箔纸来储存冷冻食品。

meaning: n. 包装纸，包装材料；v. 包，裹；用……缠绕（或围紧）；（使文字）换行（wrap 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. the covering (usually paper or cellophane) in which something is wrapped；2. n. an enveloping bandage
example: Nick asked for the tile to be delivered in waterproof wrapping.
exampleZh: 尼克要求这块砖放被在防水包装材料里寄送。

meaning: v. 破坏，断送（计划、关系等）；（严重）破坏，毁坏（车辆或建筑物）；造成（船舶）失事，使遇难；毁船打劫；（为获取有用的零件、碎料而）拆，拆除（破汽车、旧建筑物等）；营救失事船只；失事；n. 沉船，遇难船；遭到严重破坏的东西（尤指建筑物、车辆）；健康（或精神）严重受损的人；（船舶的）失事，遇难，交通事故；杂乱的地方；（船舶失事后被冲上岸的）残货，沉船漂浮物
definition: 1. n. something or someone that has suffered ruin or dilapidation；2. v. smash or break forcefully
example: They live without nomoi and they wreck not of one another, that is to say,each family lives by itself.
exampleZh: 独眼怪没有法律,如同一盘散沙,就是说,他们每个家庭都自给自足

meaning: n. 残货，残骸；（计划等失败或遭到破坏后的）残余；（船只等的）失事
definition: 1. n. the remaining parts of something that has been wrecked
example: A man was crawling away from the burning wreckage.
exampleZh: 一个男人正从燃烧着的残骸往外爬。

meaning: v. 猛拉，猛扭，挣脱；扭伤；夺走（某人），拆散；使痛苦，使十分难过（尤指以致哭喊出声）；用扳钳拧；n. 扳手，扳钳；（离别的）痛苦，难受；猛扭，猛拉；（机械）偶单力组；扭伤；歪曲；【名】 （Wrench）（英）伦奇（人名）
definition: 1. to pull and twist something suddenly or violently away from its position；2. to twist part of your body badly, such as your arm or leg, and injure it
example: I ran to several stores before I found the wrench.
exampleZh: 我跑了好几家商店，才找到这扳手。

meaning: v. （与某人）摔跤，扭打；使劲搬动，用力操作；努力解决，艰难对付；n. 摔跤，角力；艰苦的斗争，搏斗
definition: 1. to fight with someone (especially as a sport) by holding them and trying to throw them to the ground；2. to fight with someone by holding and trying to throw that person to the ground, or to do this as a sport
example: What's the main reason for the father teaching his daughters to wrestle?
exampleZh: 父亲教女儿们摔跤的主要原因是什么？

meaning: n. 摔跤运动；v. （与某人）摔跤，扭打；使劲搬动，用力操作；努力解决，艰难对付（wrestle 的现在分词）
definition: 1. a sport in which two people fight and try to throw each other to the ground
example: The university's wrestling team trained for months before competing in the national championship.
exampleZh: 这所大学的摔跤队为参加全国锦标赛训练了数月。
exampleSource: 补充例句（按六级难度编写）

meaning: adj. 可怜的，悲惨的；（表示憎恶）讨厌的，该死的；感到不适的，不愉快的；极坏的，恶劣的
definition: 1. unpleasant or of low quality；2. feeling very ill or very unhappy
example: So, as so far I know, you're dying to know about midterm and final and those wretched things.
exampleZh: 现在我估计,你们都特别想知道关于,那些期中期末之类的破事

meaning: n. （皮肤上的）皱纹；（布或纸上的）皱褶； 小困难，小难题；令人吃惊的情节，出人意料的事情；妙计，好主意；v. （使脸上）起皱纹，皱起；（布料等）起皱，起褶
definition: 1. n. a slight depression in the smoothness of a surface；2. v. gather or contract into wrinkles or folds; pucker
example: The skin on her cheeks and around her eyes was beginning to wrinkle.
exampleZh: 她脸颊上和眼睛周围的皮肤开始起皱纹了。

meaning: n. 手腕，腕关节；（四足动物前腿的）膝关节，（鸟翅膀的）腕；袖口，腕部；（机器的）曲柄销，肘节销
definition: 1. n. a joint between the distal end of the radius and the proximal row of carpal bones
example: Why didn't we say that Luke died when he lost his wrist? Because the brain after all was the part of the body that houses the personality.
exampleZh: 为什么我们不说，当卢克断手后,就死了呢？，因为大脑才是,储存人格的身体部位。

meaning: v. 写作，编写；写道；写信；书写，写字；谱写（音乐作品）；编写（计算机程序）；将（计算机中的）数据写入（磁盘或其他储存媒体）；填写（表格、支票等），拟定；（笔）能写字；拼写；参加（笔试）；书写，手写（与铅印相对）；以写作为生；承保（保险单）
definition: 1. v. produce a literary work；2. v. communicate or express by writing
example: And on this side, we're going to write out an engine, and we're going to say this is a Carnot engine.
exampleZh: 在这边，我们画出一个热机，是卡诺热机。

meaning: n. （职业的）作家，作者；执笔者，撰写人；写字……的人；（计算机）记录器；〈英，史〉文书，抄写员
definition: 1. n. writes (books or stories or articles or the like) professionally (for pay)；2. n. a person who is able to write and has written something
example: Moore is quoting here in that phrase "business documents and school-books," as she tells us, from Tolstoy, a prose writer.
exampleZh: 穆尔在那个短语里引用了这句,“商业文书和教科书“，正如她告诉我们的，引用来自托尔斯泰，俄国小说家。

meaning: n. 写作，著书；作品，著作；写，书写；字迹；（书写或印刷的）文字；（某作家或专题的）著作，作品（writings）；v. 写字；写作；写信（write 的现在分词）
definition: 1. n. the act of creating written works；2. n. the work of a writer; anything expressed in letters of the alphabet (especially when considered from the point of view of style and effect)
example: This is a poet who, with his wife, practiced automatic writing, who believed that the dead spoke through the living.
exampleZh: 他是这样的诗人，和他妻子一起，尝试着，自动写作，他们相信死人通过活人说话。

meaning: adj. 错误的，不合乎事实的；（状况）有问题的，（身体）有毛病的；（决定、选择、行动等）错误的；（言论或想法）错的；不道德的，不能被社会所接受的；不合适的，不适宜的；（机器设备）出毛病的；上下（或前后、里外）颠倒的；adv. 错误地，不符合事实地；（方式或方向）不适当地，不适宜地；出问题；不正当地；n. 坏事，不道德行为， 错误的行为（或情况）；冤枉，不公平的行为；v. 不公正地对待，冤枉；【名】 （Wrong）（美、俄、荷）朗（人名）
definition: 1. n. that which is contrary to the principles of justice or law；2. v. treat unjustly; do wrong to
example: And you don't always wind up with the right answer or wrong answer, but just different points of view.
exampleZh: 最后不一定有答案的对错，只是不同的看法。

meaning: n. X 射线，X 光；X 光照片；X 光检查；（无线电通讯中使用的）字母 X 的代码词；v. 用 X 光检查，使用 X 光，给…拍 X 光片；adj. X 光的，与 X 射线有关的
definition: 1. n. electromagnetic radiation of short wavelength produced when high-speed electrons strike a solid target；2. v. examine by taking x-rays
example: I suggested that he rest, and sent him for an X-ray.
exampleZh: 我建议他休息，并叫他去作一次X光检查。

meaning: n. 帆船，快艇，游艇；v. 驾帆船比赛，驾驶帆船，乘游艇；【名】 （Yacht）（美、加、土、法、荷、俄）约特（人名）
definition: 1. a boat with sails and sometimes an engine, used for either racing or travelling on for pleasure；2. a large and usually expensive boat, used for racing or for traveling around for pleasure
example: A sadder story of disaster at sea was never told than that of the survivors of the yacht, Mignonette.
exampleZh: 最惨绝人寰的海难,“木犀草号“幸存者的骇人经历。

meaning: n. 码（长度单位，等于 3 英尺或 0.91 米）；（尤指沙等建筑材料的）平方码，立方码；（某种用途的）区域，场地；（小屋的）后院，院子； 庭院花园； 包括房子的庭院； 出租庭院；城市小区；帆桁； 100美元，百元钞票； 苏格兰场（the Yard）；（尤指牙买加侨民之间所指的）祖国，牙买加（Yard）； 庭院花园；v. 把（木材）堆放（或运至）场内；把（家畜）驱入圈栏；（麋鹿）冬令集居；【名】 （Yard）（英）亚德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a unit of length equal to 3 feet; defined as 91.44 centimeters; originally taken to be the average length of a stride；2. n. the enclosed land around a house or other building
example: And when I see the car on the junk dealer's yard in 2010 and ask is that my car or not.
exampleZh: 当2010年在废品站,看到那辆车0,问是不是我的车。

meaning: v. 打哈欠；（开口、洞穴等）豁开，裂开；n. 哈欠；乏味的事物（或人）
definition: 1. to open the mouth wide and take a lot of air into the lungs and slowly send it out, usually when tired or bored；2. an act of yawning
example: In other words, if there are no surprises, it's just a yawn.
exampleZh: 换言之，若作品中没有令人惊讶之处，它只不过像是个哈欠。

meaning: n. 年，日历年；年，一年时间；与某事相关的一年，年度；学年；年级，某年级的学生；年龄，年纪，岁；很久，好长时间；年代，时代
definition: 1. n. a period of time containing 365 (or 366) days；2. n. a period of time occupying a regular part of a calendar year that is used for some particular activity
example: But this year, it's my senior year, so I'm just trying to take it easy and... take my classes.
exampleZh: 但是今年我已经大四了，所以不想再那么忙了，就……好好地上课吧。

meaning: adj. 一年一次的，每年的；年度的，一年的；adv. 一年一次地，每年地；n. 年刊，年鉴
definition: 1. n. a reference book that is published regularly once every year；2. adj. occurring or payable every year
example: In Holland, the government sets a yearly budget for health care.
exampleZh: 在荷兰，政府设有一个保健年度预算。

meaning: v. 怀念，渴望
definition: 1. to wish very strongly, especially for something that you cannot have or something that is very difficult to have；2. to desire something strongly, esp. something difficult or impossible to obtain
example: All of us actually yearn for a slow and calm life.
exampleZh: 事实上，我们都渴望一个缓慢而平静的生活。

meaning: n. 渴望，向往；adj. 渴望的；v. 怀念，渴望（yearn 的现在分词）
definition: 1. a strong feeling of wishing for something, especially something that you cannot have or get easily
example: If the arms are outstretched in the yearning position, the person tends to be more suspicious.
exampleZh: 如果双臂伸出，呈渴望状，这种人往往比较多疑。

meaning: v. 叫喊，大喊； 喊叫帮忙；n. 叫喊，吼叫；（为运动队加油的）呐喊，欢呼
definition: 1. n. a loud utterance; often in protest or opposition；2. v. utter a sudden loud cry
example: and they want the celebrity to lose it because if they lose it, and they yell or anything,
exampleZh: 他们想要名人失控，因为如果失控了，他们会叫骂什么的，

meaning: adj. 黄的，黄色的；黄色人种的，黄皮肤的；胆怯的；（新闻报道）夸张失实的，耸人听闻的；黄色危险警报的；嫉妒的，猜疑的；n. 黄色，黄颜料；黄色衣服，黄色衣料；（运动或比赛中的）黄色球，黄色物（尤指斯诺克的黄球）；黄蛾（或黄蝴蝶）；（植物的）黄化病；v. （使）变黄
definition: 1. n. yellow color or pigment; the chromatic color resembling the hue of sunflowers or ripe lemons；2. v. turn yellow
example: In the second line of Tony the Tow Truck, we learn that "I live in a little yellow garage."
exampleZh: 托运车托尼》第二行，写道“我住在一个黄色的垃圾箱里“

meaning: adv. 是，是的，对；是吗？（升调，表示疑问或请对方继续说）；n. 是（表示肯定），肯定答复；赞成票
definition: 1. n. an affirmative
example: It's usually best to respond in a complete sentence rather than saying yes or no which can be ambiguous.
exampleZh: 一般来说，回答最好是完整的句子，而不是简单的模棱两可的“是”或“不是”。

meaning: int. （非正式口语）是，对；adv. （非正式口语）是，对；表示惊讶、怀疑、不信或反对
definition: 1. adv. not only so, but
example: So that's not really a... Yeah, in the Palestinian society, there are religious organizations, religious institutions. That is true.
exampleZh: 所以这不是真正的问题。,恩，在巴勒斯坦社会，有宗教组织，宗教仪式，这是对的。

meaning: adv. 在昨天；日前，不久前；n. 昨天；最近，往昔
definition: 1. n. the day immediately before today；2. adv. on the day preceding today
example: I knew you in this dark: for so you frowned Yesterday through me as you jabbed and killed.
exampleZh: 在黑暗中我认出了你,刺戮屠杀我的时候，你和昨天一样皱着眉。

meaning: adv. 仍然，还；现在，此刻；迄今为止，到目前为止；还需，还差；终归，迟早；又，甚至（强调增加或重复）；然而，尽管；conj. 然而，但是；【名】 （Yet）（东南亚国家华语）一（人名）
definition: 1. adv. up to the present time；2. adv. used in negative statement to describe a situation that has existed up to this point or up to the present time
example: We have not yet found them all, Lords and Commons, nor ever shall do, till her Master's second coming.
exampleZh: 我们还有找到这些碎片，上帝和普通人，我们也不会去找，知道她的主人第二次来。

meaning: v. 产生（收益、效益等），产生（结果）；出产（天然产品，农产品，工业产品）；屈服，让步；放弃，让出；给（大路上的车辆）让路；（受压）活动，弯曲，折断；被……替代；请（某人）讲话；停止争论；n. 产量；收益，利润，红利（或股息）率
definition: 1. n. production of a certain amount；2. v. be the cause or source of
example: Like the moon, Satan may look beautiful, but upon a closer scrutiny that beauty begins to yield certain metaphysical flaws.
exampleZh: 像月亮那样，撒旦看起来非常美好，但是近看,就会发现这份美丽开始显露出一些抽象的瑕疵。

meaning: n. 瑜伽，瑜伽术； 瑜伽派（印度哲学派别）
definition: 1. n. Hindu discipline aimed at training the consciousness for a state of perfect spiritual insight and tranquility that is achieved through the three paths of actions and knowledge and devotion；2. n. a system of exercises practiced as part of the Hindu discipline to promote control of the body and mind
example: After their release,they are much less likely to return to jail if they do some yoga there.
exampleZh: 在狱中练过瑜伽的犯人,获释后较少会再进监狱。

meaning: n. 酸奶（亦作 yoghourt），酸乳酪
definition: 1. n. a custard-like food made from curdled milk
example: Lunch was a feast of meat and vegetables, cheese, yoghurt and fruit, with unlimited wine.
exampleZh: 午餐是一场盛宴，有肉、蔬菜、奶酪、酸奶和水果，以及不限量的葡萄酒。

meaning: pron. 你；你们；（口语或非正式书面语）泛指任何人；n. （You）人名；（柬）尤；（东南亚国家华语）猷
definition: 1. the person or people being spoken or written to
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: You are lost. You're in a new city and you're lost and you don't know where you're going.
exampleZh: 你迷路了。你刚到一个城市，没法找到方向。你不知道你该怎么走。

meaning: adj. 幼小的，年轻的；存在不久的，新成立的；（显得）年轻的，（显得）岁数不大的；适合年轻人的；由年轻人（或儿童）构成的，青少年的，平均年龄小的；夭折的，早逝的；n. 年轻人（the young）；幼崽，雏鸟；【名】 （Young）（英、葡）扬，（柬）永，（中）杨，（广东话）威妥玛（人名）
definition: 1. n. any immature animal；2. adj. (used of living things especially persons) in an early period of life or development or growth
example: He serves as something like a complicated double for the young, unpublished, and as of yet unproductive poet himself.
exampleZh: 他就像一个复杂的替身，是那些年轻的，还没出版诗歌或是不多产的诗人自己的替身。

meaning: n. 年轻人，少年
definition: 1. n. a young person of either sex
example: Like every youngster who grows up in Bethlehem, Ramiz is learning to deal with life as a series of negotiations.
exampleZh: 如同每一个在伯利恒土生土长的少年，拉米兹学习着如何应付生活，就像进行一连串的协商谈判。

meaning: det. 你的，你们的；泛指任何人的；（用于 typical、normal 等形容词前）通常所说的，典型的；（用于尊称头衔前）您的
definition: 1. belonging to or relating to the person or people being spoken to
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: And while you're there your dancing the night away, but you get a call on your iPhone from your boss.
exampleZh: 在夜店里跳着舞时，你突然接到了老板的电话。
